This word describes something that makes a problem or a person's anger much worse or more serious. It is the perfect opposite of trying to calm someone down.
Synonyms: Irritating (परेशान करने वाला), Annoying (चिढ़ाने वाला), Exasperating (क्रोध दिलाने वाला).
Antonyms: Pleasing (सुखद), Calming (शांत करने वाला), Helpful (सहायक).

This refers to an action or manner intended to placate or pacify a situation. It is essentially a synonym for the given word.
Synonyms: Appeasing (संतुष्ट करने वाला), Propitiatory (मनाने वाला), Yielding (झुकने वाला).
Antonyms: Stubborn (ज़िद्दी), Antagonistic (विरोधी), Hostile (शत्रुतापूर्ण).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Fulsome
questionsEn.s:
Fulsome - अतिरंजित (Complimentary or flattering to an excessive degree)
Overdone - अत्यधिक (Done to an excessive or exaggerated degree)
Sincere - सच्चा (Free from pretense or deceit; genuine)
Excessive - अत्यधिक (More than is necessary, normal, or desirable)
Lavish - भव्य (Sumptuously rich, elaborate, or luxurious)


Hence, 'Sincere' is the most suitable antonym for 'Fulsome'.
oa:
This word refers to something that is excessive or carried out to an extreme degree. It matches the "excessive" aspect of the given word and thus acts as a synonym.
Synonyms: Exaggerated (अतिशयोक्तिपूर्ण), Excessive (अत्यधिक), Superfluous (अनावश्यक).
Antonyms: Understated (कम करके बताया गया), Subtle (सूक्ष्म), Moderate (मध्यम).

This word describes a person or feeling that is genuine, honest, and free from pretense. It is the direct opposite of being fulsome, which implies fake or over-the-top behavior.
Synonyms: Genuine (असली), Candid (निष्कपट), Heartfelt (हार्दिक).
Antonyms: Hypocritical (ढोंगी), Insincere (दिखावटी), False (झूठा).

This describes an amount or degree that is more than necessary, normal, or desirable. It is a core component of the definition of the given word, making it a synonym.
Synonyms: Immoderate (असंयमित), Lavish (अत्यधिक), Surplus (अतिरिक्त).
Antonyms: Meager (अल्प), Scanty (कम), Insufficient (अपर्याप्त).

This refers to something that is very generous, large in amount, or expensive-looking. While often positive, in the context of praise, it can be synonymous with being fulsome.
Synonyms: Bountiful (प्रचुर), Munificent (दानी), Grand (भव्य).
Antonyms: Stingy (कंजूस), Economical (मितव्ययी), Poor (घटिया).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Mendacious
questionsEn.s:
Mendacious - मिथ्यावादी (Not telling the truth; lying)
Dishonest - बेईमान (Not honest or trustworthy)
Fraudulent - कपटी (Involving or done by fraud or deception)
Truthful - सत्यवादी (Habitually telling the truth)
Deceitful - धोखेबाज़ (Guilty of or involving deceit)


Hence, 'Truthful' is the most suitable antonym for 'Mendacious'.
oa:
This word describes a person or behavior that is not trustworthy and prone to cheating or lying. It is a primary synonym for being mendacious.
Synonyms: Deceitful (धोखेबाज़), Untruthful (असत्य), Fraudulent (कपटी).
Antonyms: Honest (ईमानदार), Trustworthy (भरोसेमंद), Integrity (सच्चाई).

This refers to something obtained, done by, or involving deception, especially criminal deception. It aligns with the dishonest nature of the given word.
Synonyms: Crooked (बेईमान), Corrupt (भ्रष्ट), Shady (संदिग्ध).
Antonyms: Valid (मान्य), Legal (कानूनी), Ethical (नैतिक).

This word describes someone who consistently tells the truth and is honest. It is the direct and most appropriate opposite of being mendacious or lying.
Synonyms: Veracious (सत्यवादी), Reliable (भरोसेमंद), Frank (साफ़गो).
Antonyms: Lying (झूठा), Deceptive (भ्रामक), False (असत्य).

This refers to the act or practice of misleading others through lies or tricks. It is another strong synonym for the given word.
Synonyms: Guileful (छली), Crafty (चालाक), Insincere (दिखावटी).
Antonyms: Straightforward (सीधा), Open (खुला), Candid (निष्कपट).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Quixotic
questionsEn.s:
Quixotic - विलक्षण (Exceedingly idealistic, unrealistic and impractical)
Romantic - काल्पनिक (Characteristic of an idealized view of reality)
Visionary - स्वप्नद्रष्टा (Thinking about the future with imagination)
Pragmatic - व्यावहारिक (Dealing with things in a realistic way)
Idealistic - आदर्शवादी (Guided by ideals rather than practical considerations)


Hence, 'Pragmatic' is the most suitable antonym for 'Quixotic'.
oa:
This word refers to a style of thinking that is idealistic and sentimental rather than realistic. It is a synonymous concept to the dreamy nature of being quixotic.
Synonyms: Fanciful (काल्पनिक), Dreamy (ख्वाबों वाला), Visionary (कल्पनाशील).
Antonyms: Practical (व्यावहारिक), Realistic (वास्तविक), Cynical (कुटिल).

This refers to someone who has thinking about the future with great imagination and wisdom, often in an idealistic way. It shares the "idealistic" trait of the given word.
Synonyms: Creative (रचनात्मक), Inspired (प्रेरित), Utopian (आदर्शवादी).
Antonyms: Unimaginative (कल्पनाहीन), Mundane (साधारण), Prosaic (नीरस).

This word refers to dealing with things sensibly and realistically in a way that is based on practical rather than theoretical considerations. It is the perfect antonym for being quixotic.
Synonyms: Practical (व्यावहारिक), Efficient (कुशल), Realistic (यथार्थवादी).
Antonyms: Idealistic (आदर्शवादी), Romantic (काल्पनिक), Unrealistic (अवास्तविक).

This refers to the pursuit of high or noble principles and goals, often neglecting practical realities. It is a direct synonym for the given word.
Synonyms: Utopian (आदर्शवादी), Optimistic (आशावादी), Unrealistic (अव्यावहारिक).
Antonyms: Realist (यथार्थवादी), Skeptical (संदेही), Pragmatic (व्यावहारिक).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Obsequious
questionsEn.s:
Obsequious - चापलूस (Obedient or attentive to an excessive degree)
Assertive - मुखर (Having a confident and forceful personality)
Submissive - दब्बू (Ready to conform to the authority of others)
Flattering - खुशामदी (Full of praise that is not sincere)
Senile - वृद्ध (Showing a loss of mental ability in old age)


Hence, 'Assertive' is the most suitable antonym for 'Obsequious'.
oa:
This word describes a person who has a confident and forceful personality, standing up for their rights and opinions. It is the opposite of being excessively submissive or servile.
Synonyms: Confident (आत्मविश्वासी), Decisive (निर्णायक), Firm (दृढ़).
Antonyms: Timid (डरपोक), Shy (संकोची), Submissive (दब्बू).

This refers to being ready to conform to the authority or will of others; meekly obedient. It is a direct synonym for the servile nature of the given word.
Synonyms: Compliant (आज्ञाकारी), Docile (विनम्र), Passive (निष्क्रिय).
Antonyms: Defiant (विद्रोही), Rebellious (बागी), Assertive (मुखर).

This refers to the act of praising someone excessively, often insincerely, to win favor. It describes a key behavior of an obsequious person, making it a synonym.
Synonyms: Complimentary (प्रशंसात्मक), Adulatory (चापलूसी भरा), Sycophantic (चापलूस).
Antonyms: Insulting (अपमानजनक), Critical (आलोचनात्मक), Blunt (मुँहफट).

This word describes a person showing a decline or deterioration of physical strength or mental functioning, especially short-term memory, as a result of old age. It is contextually unrelated.
Synonyms: Aged (वृद्ध), Doddering (लड़खड़ाता हुआ), Weak-minded (कमज़ोर दिमाग).
Antonyms: Youthful (युवा), Alert (सतर्क), Vigorous (फुर्तीला).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Soporific
questionsEn.s:
Soporific - निद्राजनक (Tending to induce drowsiness or sleep)
Stimulating - स्फूर्तिदायक (Raising levels of nervous activity; making alert)
Drowsy - ऊंघता हुआ (Sleepy and lethargic; half-asleep)
Sleep-inducing - नींद लाने वाला (Causing or tending to cause sleep)
Sedative - शामक (Promoting calm or inducing sleep)


Hence, 'Stimulating' is the most suitable antonym for 'Soporific'.
oa:
This word describes something that raises levels of physiological or nervous activity in the body, making one feel more alert and awake. It is the direct opposite of inducing sleep.
Synonyms: Invigorating (फूर्तिदायक), Energizing (ऊर्जावान), Exciting (उत्तेजक).
Antonyms: Boring (नीरस), Dulling (सुस्त करने वाला), Sedative (शांतिदायक).

This word refers to being sleepy and lethargic; half-asleep. It describes the state caused by something soporific, making it a synonym in a causative sense.
Synonyms: Somnolent (नींद में), Sluggish (सुस्त), Tired (थका हुआ).
Antonyms: Awake (जागा हुआ), Alert (सतर्क), Energetic (सक्रिय).

This is a phrase that directly defines the given word. Since it describes the same effect of causing sleep, it cannot be the antonym.
Synonyms: Narcotic (नशीला), Somniferous (नींद लाने वाला), Hypnotic (सम्मोहक).
Antonyms: Awakening (जगाने वाला), Stimulant (उत्तेजक), Reviving (पुनर्जीवित करने वाला).

This refers to a drug or substance taken for its calming or sleep-inducing effect. It functions as a synonym in medical or pharmacological contexts.
Synonyms: Tranquilizer (शामक), Calming (शांत करने वाला), Anodyne (पीड़ानाशक).
Antonyms: Agitator (उत्तेजित करने वाला), Stimulant (उत्तेजक), Provocative (उकसाने वाला).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Oppugn
questionsEn.s:
Oppugn - विरोध करना (To call into question or contradict; to dispute)
Question - सवाल उठाना (A doubt about the truth or validity of something)
Defend - रक्षा करना (Speak or write in favor of; support)
Dispute - विवाद करना (Argue about; suggest that something is not true)
Challenge - चुनौती देना (Dispute the truth or validity of something)


Hence, 'Defend' is the most suitable antonym for 'Oppugn'.
oa:
This word means to feel or express doubt about something or to raise an objection. While similar to challenging, it is less aggressive than the given word and acts as a mild synonym.
Synonyms: Query (सवाल करना), Dispute (विवाद करना), Challenge (चुनौती देना).
Antonyms: Accept (स्वीकार करना), Believe (मानना), Trust (भरोसा करना).

This word means to speak or write in favor of something, specifically to support it against criticism or opposition. It is the direct opposite of attacking or contradicting an idea.
Synonyms: Support (समर्थन करना), Uphold (बनाए रखना), Champion (पक्ष लेना).
Antonyms: Oppose (विरोध करना), Attack (हमला करना), Criticize (आलोचना करना).

This refers to a disagreement or argument about something, often involving a formal challenge to the truth of a statement. It is a synonym for the given word.
Synonyms: Contradict (खंडन करना), Debate (बहस करना), Oppugn (विरोध करना).
Antonyms: Agree (सहमत होना), Concur (एकमत होना), Accord (तालमेल).

This refers to the act of calling into question the integrity or validity of something. It is the primary meaning of the given word and thus a synonym.
Synonyms: Defy (अवहेलना करना), Confront (सामना करना), Oppose (विरोध करना).
Antonyms: Yield (हार मानना), Surrender (आत्मसमर्पण), Submit (झुकना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Demur
questionsEn.s:
Demur - आपत्ति करना (Raise objections or show reluctance)
Agree - सहमत होना (Have the same opinion about something)
Oppose - विरोध करना (Disagree with and attempt to prevent)
Object - ऐतराज़ करना (Say that one disagrees with or disapproves)
Resist - रोकना (Withstand the action or effect of)


Hence, 'Agree' is the most suitable antonym for 'Demur'.
oa:
This word means to have the same opinion about something or to concur with a proposal or statement. It is the direct opposite of raising an objection or showing reluctance.
Synonyms: Consent (सहमति देना), Concur (एकमत होना), Assent (स्वीकृति देना).
Antonyms: Differ (अलग होना), Dissent (असहमत होना), Object (आपत्ति करना).

This word refers to the act of disagreeing strongly with something and trying to prevent its success. It is a synonym for showing reluctance or objection.
Synonyms: Resist (प्रतिरोध करना), Combat (मुकाबला करना), Defy (अवहेलना करना).
Antonyms: Favor (पक्ष लेना), Support (समर्थन करना), Assist (मदद करना).

This means to say that you disagree with or disapprove of something. It is the fundamental meaning of the given word and acts as its synonym.
Synonyms: Protest (विरोध करना), Remonstrate (शिकायत करना), Complain (शिकायत करना).
Antonyms: Accept (स्वीकार करना), Approve (मंजूरी देना), Endorse (पुष्टि करना).

This refers to the act of struggling against someone or something or refusing to accept a change. It aligns with the "reluctance" aspect of the given word.
Synonyms: Withstand (सामना करना), Counter (प्रतिकार करना), Oppugn (विरोध करना).
Antonyms: Yield (झुकना), Comply (पालन करना), Submit (समर्पण करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Zany
questionsEn.s:
Zany - विदूषक जैसा (Amusingly unconventional and idiosyncratic)
Sensible - समझदार (Chosen in accordance with wisdom or prudence)
Bizarre - विचित्र (Very strange or unusual)
Clownish - जोकर जैसा (Foolish or comical in a way that is like a clown)
Eccentric - सनकी (Unconventional and slightly strange)


Hence, 'Sensible' is the most suitable antonym for 'Zany'.
oa:
This word refers to being practical, reasonable, and showing good judgment. It is the most appropriate opposite for something that is wildly unconventional or foolishly comical.
Synonyms: Rational (तार्किक), Prudent (विवेकपूर्ण), Level-headed (संतुलित).
Antonyms: Foolish (मूर्ख), Absurd (बेतुका), Ridiculous (हास्यास्पद).

This describes something that is very strange or unusual, especially so as to cause interest or amusement. It matches the unconventional nature of the given word and is a synonym.
Synonyms: Weird (अजीब), Peculiar (अनोखा), Grotesque (विकृत).
Antonyms: Normal (सामान्य), Ordinary (साधारण), Standard (मानक).

This word refers to behavior that is foolish, comical, or playful in a way that resembles a clown. It is a direct synonym for the "zany" quality.
Synonyms: Buffoonish (मसखरा), Comical (मज़ेदार), Ludicrous (ऊटपटांग).
Antonyms: Serious (गंभीर), Solemn (औपचारिक), Grave (गंभीर).

This refers to a person or behavior that is unconventional and slightly strange. It is a close synonym for being zany, as both imply deviation from the norm.
Synonyms: Quirky (अजीब), Abnormal (असामान्य), Odd (विचित्र).
Antonyms: Conventional (पारंपरिक), Typical (विशिष्ट), Common (आम).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Incessant
questionsEn.s:
Incessant - निरंतर (Continuing without pause or interruption)
Constant - सतत (Occurring continuously over a period of time)
Ceaseless - बेरोक (Constant and unending)
Intermittent - रुक-रुक कर (Occurring at irregular intervals)
Perpetual - शाश्वत (Never ending or changing)


Hence, 'Intermittent' is the most suitable antonym for 'Incessant'.
oa:
This word refers to something that stays the same or happens repeatedly over a long period. It is a direct synonym for the non-stopping nature of being incessant.
Synonyms: Continuous (लगातार), Steady (स्थिर), Persistent (दृढ़).
Antonyms: Fickle (चंचल), Changing (बदलने वाला), Occasional (कभी-कभी).

This describes something that is constant and unending, often used for unpleasant things. It is essentially an exact synonym for the given word.
Synonyms: Unending (अनंत), Eternal (शाश्वत), Relentless (अथक).
Antonyms: Finite (सीमित), Ending (समाप्त होने वाला), Brief (संक्षिप्त).

This word refers to something occurring at irregular intervals; not continuous or steady. It is the direct opposite of a process that happens without any interruption.
Synonyms: Periodic (आवधिक), Sporadic (छिटपुट), Fragmentary (खंडित).
Antonyms: Constant (लगातार), Regular (नियमित), Continuous (निरंतर).

This refers to something that never ends or changes, or occurring repeatedly. It functions as a synonym for the "never-ending" aspect of the given word.
Synonyms: Everlasting (चिरस्थायी), Infinite (असीम), Undying (अमर).
Antonyms: Temporary (अस्थायी), Transient (क्षणिक), Fleeting (क्षणभंगुर).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Piquant
questionsEn.s:
Piquant - चटपटा (Having a pleasantly sharp taste or appetizing flavor)
Bland - फीका (Lacking strong features or characteristics; tasteless)
Spicy - मसालेदार (Flavored with or fragrant with spice)
Zesty - ज़ायकेदार (Having a strong, pleasant, and somewhat spicy flavor)
Tart - खट्टा (Sharp or acid in taste)


Hence, 'Bland' is the most suitable antonym for 'Piquant'.
oa:
This word refers to food or drink that is mild-tasting, unseasoned, or lacking in strong flavor. It is the most accurate antonym for something that has a sharp or spicy taste.
Synonyms: Tasteless (बेस्वाद), Insipid (फीका), Mild (नरम).
Antonyms: Spicy (चटपटा), Flavorful (स्वादिष्ट), Piquant (तीखा).

This word refers to food that is strongly flavored with spices, often giving a hot or sharp sensation. It is a direct synonym for the given word's flavor profile.
Synonyms: Hot (तीखा), Seasoned (मसालेदार), Zesty (मज़ेदार).
Antonyms: Plain (सादा), Bland (फीका), Mild (हल्का).

This refers to having a strong, pleasant, and somewhat spicy or salty flavor. It is a synonym that describes a lively and piquant quality.
Synonyms: Tangy (चटपटा), Savory (ज़ायकेदार), Sharp (तीक्ष्ण).
Antonyms: Dull (नीरस), Flat (फीका), Tasteless (बेज़ायका).

This refers to a sharp, pungent, or sour taste. While slightly different in nuance, it shares the "sharpness" of the given word and does not act as an opposite.
Synonyms: Acidic (अम्लीय), Sour (खट्टा), Acerbic (कड़वा).
Antonyms: Sweet (मीठा), Sugary (मीठा), Bland (फीका).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Pulchritude
questionsEn.s:
Pulchritude - शारीरिक सौंदर्य (Beauty; especially physical beauty)
Grace - शालीनता (Elegance or beauty of form, manner, or motion)
Ugliness - कुरूपता (The quality of being unpleasant or repulsive)
Charm - आकर्षण (The power of delighting or attracting others)
Beauty - सुंदरता (A combination of qualities that pleases the senses)


Hence, 'Ugliness' is the most suitable antonym for 'Pulchritude'.
oa:
This refers to smoothness and elegance of movement or a courteous goodwill. While it is a component of overall attractiveness, it is more a synonym than an opposite.
Synonyms: Elegance (शिष्टता), Poise (संतुलन), Refinement (सुधार).
Antonyms: Awkwardness (अनाड़ीपन), Clumsiness (फूहड़पन), Rudeness (अशिष्टता).

This word refers to the quality of being unpleasant or repulsive in appearance. It is the direct and most accurate antonym for physical beauty.
Synonyms: Hideousness (भयानकता), Unattractiveness (भद्दापन), Unsightliness (कुरूपता).
Antonyms: Beauty (सुंदरता), Pulchritude (सौंदर्य), Attraction (आकर्षण).

This refers to the power or quality of pleasing or delighting others. Since it is a positive attribute related to being attractive, it functions as a synonym.
Synonyms: Allure (मोहकता), Fascination (आकर्षण), Charisma (प्रतिभा).
Antonyms: Repulsion (अरुचि), Boredom (नीरसता), Offensiveness (अपमान).

This refers to a combination of qualities, such as shape, color, or form, that pleases the aesthetic senses. It is the direct definition and synonym of the given word.
Synonyms: Comeliness (सुंदरता), Fairness (गोरापन), Loveliness (प्यारापन).
Antonyms: Ugliness (कुरूपता), Deformity (विकृति), Grotesqueness (कुरूपता).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Incorrigible
questionsEn.s:
Incorrigible - असुधार्य (Not able to be corrected, improved, or reformed)
Chronic - पुरानी (Persisting for a long time or constantly recurring)
Deep-rooted - गहरी जड़ें (Firmly established and difficult to change)
Habitual - आदतन (Done or acting by force of habit)
Reclaimable - सुधारने योग्य (Capable of being recovered or reformed)


Hence, 'Reclaimable' is the most suitable antonym for 'Incorrigible'.
oa:
This word refers to a condition, especially an illness or habit, that persists for a long time or constantly recurs. It describes the stubborn nature of the given word, acting as a synonym.
Synonyms: Constant (लगातार), Habitual (आदतन), Deep-seated (गहरा).
Antonyms: Temporary (अस्थायी), Acute (तीव्र), Occasional (छिटपुट).

This describes an idea, habit, or feeling that is firmly established and difficult to change. It is contextually synonymous with being incorrigible.
Synonyms: Ingrained (अंतर्निहित), Fixed (तय), Entrenched (मज़बूत).
Antonyms: Superficial (सतही), Casual (अनौपचारिक), New (नया).

This refers to something done constantly or as a habit. It is a synonym that explains why an incorrigible person is so difficult to correct.
Synonyms: Regular (नियमित), Routine (दैनिक), Customary (पारंपरिक).
Antonyms: Unusual (असामान्य), Infrequent (दुर्लभ), Rare (विरल).

This word refers to something or someone that can be recovered, restored, or brought back to a better state or way of life. It is the direct opposite of being beyond correction.
Synonyms: Reformable (सुधार योग्य), Recoverable (पुन: प्राप्त करने योग्य), Salvageable (उद्धार योग्य).
Antonyms: Incurable (असाध्य), Hopeless (निराशाजनक), Irredeemable (अशोध्य).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Abrogate
questionsEn.s:
Abrogate - निरस्त करना (Repeal or do away with a law or formal agreement)
Abolish - समाप्त करना (Formally put an end to a system or practice)
Revoke - वापस लेना (Official cancellation of a decree or promise)
Uphold - कायम रखना (Confirm or support something questioned)
Annul - शून्य घोषित करना (Declare invalid; nullify)


Hence, 'Uphold' is the most suitable antonym for 'Abrogate'.
oa:
This means to formally put an end to a system, practice, or institution. It is a direct synonym for the given word in the context of laws or rules.
Synonyms: Eradicate (उन्मूलन), Terminate (समाप्त करना), Quash (रद्द करना).
Antonyms: Create (बनाना), Found (स्थापित करना), Establish (बसाना).

This refers to the official cancellation of a decree, decision, or promise. It is essentially a synonym for the act of abrogating.
Synonyms: Rescind (रद्द करना), Countermand (वापस लेना), Repeal (निरस्त करना).
Antonyms: Confirm (पुष्टि करना), Grant (प्रदान करना), Renew (नवीनीकृत करना).

This word means to confirm or support something which has been questioned, or to maintain a custom or law. It is the direct antonym of repealing or doing away with a law.
Synonyms: Support (समर्थन करना), Maintain (बनाए रखना), Validate (मान्य करना).
Antonyms: Overturn (पलटना), Abrogate (रद्द करना), Reject (अस्वीकार करना).

This means to declare something, like a marriage or a contract, invalid or as if it never existed. It is a synonym that implies cancellation.
Synonyms: Nullify (शून्य करना), Void (अमान्य करना), Invalidate (अमान्य करना).
Antonyms: Validate (मान्य करना), Ratify (पुष्टि करना), Sanction (मंजूरी देना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Reverence
questionsEn.s:
Reverence - श्रद्धा (Deep respect for someone or something)
Respect - आदर (Feeling of deep admiration for qualities)
Devotion - भक्ति (Love, loyalty, or enthusiasm for a cause)
Contempt - तिरस्कार (The feeling that someone is worthless)
Worship - पूजा (The expression of reverence and adoration)


Hence, 'Contempt' is the most suitable antonym for 'Reverence'.
oa:
This word refers to a feeling of deep admiration for someone or something elicited by their abilities or qualities. It is a direct synonym for the given word.
Synonyms: Esteem (आदर), Admiration (प्रशंसा), Appreciation (सराहना).
Antonyms: Disrespect (अनादर), Scorn (घृणा), Disdain (तिरस्कार).

This refers to love, loyalty, or enthusiasm for a person, activity, or cause. It captures the deep emotional attachment found in reverence, making it a synonym.
Synonyms: Loyalty (निष्ठा), Fidelity (वफादारी), Commitment (प्रतिबद्धता).
Antonyms: Apathy (उदासीनता), Treachery (विश्वासघात), Indifference (अनदेखी).

This word refers to the feeling that a person or a thing is beneath consideration, worthless, or deserving scorn. It is the direct opposite of holding someone in high respect.
Synonyms: Disdain (तिरस्कार), Derision (उपहास), Scorn (घृणा).
Antonyms: Respect (सम्मान), Reverence (श्रद्धा), Regard (आदर).

This refers to the feeling or expression of reverence and adoration for a deity. It is an extreme form of reverence and acts as a synonym.
Synonyms: Adoration (आराधना), Venerate (पूजना), Glorify (महिमामंडन).
Antonyms: Desecrate (अपवित्र करना), Blaspheme (ईशनिंदा), Profane (अपवित्र).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Incandescent
questionsEn.s:
Incandescent - देदीप्यमान (Emitting light as a result of being heated)
Dusky - धुंधला (Dim, shadowy, or darkish in color)
Resplendent - चमकीला (Attractive and impressive through being colorful)
Glistening - चमकता हुआ (Shining with a sparkling light)
Fulgent - अत्यंत चमकदार (Shining brightly; radiant)


Hence, 'Dusky' is the most suitable antonym for 'Incandescent'.
oa:
This word refers to something that is dim, darkish, or lacking in light. It is the most appropriate opposite for something that emits intense heat-induced light.
Synonyms: Gloomy (धुंधला), Shadowy (छायादार), Murky (अंधेरा).
Antonyms: Bright (चमकदार), Radiant (दीप्तिमान), Luminous (प्रकाशमान).

This describes something that is attractive and impressive through being richly colorful or shining. It functions as a synonym for being brightly lit.
Synonyms: Brilliant (शानदार), Splendid (भव्य), Dazzling (चकाचौंध वाला).
Antonyms: Dull (नीरस), Dark (अंधेरा), Plain (सादा).

This refers to something that is shining with a sparkling light, often from a wet surface. It is a synonym that describes a light-emitting property.
Synonyms: Shimmering (झिलमिलाता), Sparkling (चमकता), Twinkling (टिमटिमाता).
Antonyms: Matte (फीका), Dim (मंद), Dull (धुंधला).

This is a literary word meaning shining brightly or radiant. It is an exact synonym for the brilliant glow implied by being incandescent.
Synonyms: Luminous (प्रकाशवान), Beaming (हंसमुख/चमकदार), Lustrous (चमकीला).
Antonyms: Dark (अंधेरा), Somber (उदास/धुंधला), Obscure (अस्पष्ट).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Turpitude
questionsEn.s:
Turpitude - नीचता (Depravity; wickedness; a wicked act)
Depravity - दुष्टता (Moral corruption; wickedness)
Vice - दोष (Immoral or wicked behavior)
Morality - नैतिकता (Principles concerning right and wrong behavior)
Sin - पाप (An immoral act considered a transgression)


Hence, 'Morality' is the most suitable antonym for 'Turpitude'.
oa:
This word refers to moral corruption or wickedness. It shares the exact same negative connotation as the given word and is thus a synonym.
Synonyms: Corruption (भ्रष्टाचार), Vice (बुराई), Immorality (अनैतिकता).
Antonyms: Virtue (गुण), Morality (नैतिकता), Purity (शुद्धता).

This refers to immoral or wicked behavior or a specific bad habit. It serves as a concise synonym for the wicked nature described by turpitude.
Synonyms: Sin (पाप), Wrongdoing (गलत काम), Fault (दोष).
Antonyms: Merit (योग्यता), Asset (संपत्ति/गुण), Virtue (सदाचार).

This word refers to principles concerning the distinction between right and wrong or good and bad behavior. it is the direct antonym of wickedness or immorality.
Synonyms: Ethics (नीतिशास्त्र), Virtue (सदाचार), Integrity (अखंडता).
Antonyms: Wickedness (दुष्टता), Turpitude (नीचता), Corruption (भ्रष्टता).

This refers to an immoral act considered to be a transgression against divine law. It aligns with the immoral context of the given word and acts as a synonym.
Synonyms: Offence (अपराध), Crime (जुर्म), Transgression (उल्लंघन).
Antonyms: Blessing (आशीर्वाद), Good deed (नेक काम), Virtue (पुण्य).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Lassitude
questionsEn.s:
Lassitude - थकान (A state of physical or mental weariness)
Exhaustion - थकावट (A state of extreme physical or mental tiredness)
Apathy - उदासीनता (Lack of interest, enthusiasm, or concern)
Vigor - उत्साह (Physical strength and good health)
Lethargy - सुस्ती (A lack of energy and enthusiasm)


Hence, 'Vigor' is the most suitable antonym for 'Lassitude'.
oa:
This refers to a state of extreme physical or mental tiredness. It is the primary cause and characteristic of lassitude, making it a synonym.
Synonyms: Fatigue (थकान), Weariness (थकावट), Enervation (कमज़ोरी).
Antonyms: Vigor (ऊर्जा), Vitality (प्राणशक्ति), Strength (शक्ति).

This refers to a lack of interest, enthusiasm, or concern. While it describes a similar state of "not doing anything," it focuses on emotion rather than physical energy.
Synonyms: Indifference (उदासीनता), Detachment (अलगाव), Passivity (निष्क्रियता).
Antonyms: Interest (रुचि), Passion (जुनून), Concern (चिंता).

This word refers to physical strength and good health, or effort, energy, and enthusiasm. it is the most accurate antonym for a state of weariness and lack of energy.
Synonyms: Vitality (जीवन शक्ति), Energy (ऊर्जा), Robustness (मज़बूती).
Antonyms: Frailty (दुर्बलता), Lethargy (सुस्ती), Weakness (कमज़ोरी).

This refers to a lack of energy and enthusiasm, often involving pathological drowsiness. It is a direct synonym for the given word.
Synonyms: Sluggishness (सुस्ती), Torpor (जड़ता), Drowsiness (नींद).
Antonyms: Alacrity (तत्परता), Liveliness (जीवंतता), Activity (सक्रियता).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Sagacious
questionsEn.s:
Sagacious - बुद्धिमान (Having or showing keen mental discernment)
Insightful - सूक्ष्मदर्शी (Showing an accurate and deep understanding)
Wise - ज्ञानी (Having or showing experience and good judgment)
Foolish - मूर्ख (Lacking good sense or judgment; unwise)
Prudent - विवेकपूर्ण (Acting with or showing care for the future)


Hence, 'Foolish' is the most suitable antonym for 'Sagacious'.
oa:
This word describes someone who shows a deep and accurate understanding of a complex situation. It aligns with the wisdom implied by being sagacious, making it a synonym.
Synonyms: Perceptive (अनुभवी), Discerning (विवेकशील), Sharp (तेज़).
Antonyms: Dull (मंदबुद्धि), Ignorant (अज्ञानी), Unaware (अनभिज्ञ).

This refers to having or showing experience, knowledge, and good judgment. It is the primary meaning of the given word and acts as its most common synonym.
Synonyms: Learned (विद्वान), Sage (ऋषि तुल्य), Intelligent (बुद्धिमान).
Antonyms: Foolish (मूर्ख), Unwise (नासमझ), Stupid (बेवकूफ).

This word refers to lacking good sense or judgment; being unwise. It is the direct and most appropriate antonym for someone who is wise and discerning.
Synonyms: Silly (नादान), Inane (बेतुका), Absurd (हास्यास्पद).
Antonyms: Sagacious (बुद्धिमान), Sensible (समझदार), Prudent (विवेकपूर्ण).

This word refers to acting with or showing care and thought for the future. It is a synonymous trait for someone who possesses sagacity.
Synonyms: Cautious (सावधान), Judicious (उचित), Wary (सतर्क).
Antonyms: Reckless (लापरवाह), Rash (जल्दबाज़), Impolitic (अविवेकपूर्ण).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Opprobrium
questionsEn.s:
Opprobrium - तिरस्कार (Harsh criticism or public disgrace)
Disgrace - अपमान (Loss of reputation as a result of dishonor)
Contempt - अवमानना (The feeling that someone is worthless)
Honor - सम्मान (High respect; great esteem)
Censure - निंदा (The expression of severe disapproval)


Hence, 'Honor' is the most suitable antonym for 'Opprobrium'.
oa:
This word refers to the loss of reputation or respect as the result of a dishonorable action. It is a direct synonym for the given word.
Synonyms: Shame (शर्म), Dishonor (अपमान), Ignominy (कलंक).
Antonyms: Honor (सम्मान), Pride (गर्व), Glory (शान).

This refers to the feeling that a person or thing is beneath consideration or worthless. It captures the attitude behind opprobrium, making it a synonym.
Synonyms: Scorn (घृणा), Disdain (तिरस्कार), Mockery (उपहास).
Antonyms: Respect (आदर), Admiration (प्रशंसा), Regard (सम्मान).

This word refers to high respect, great esteem, or a privilege that confers distinction. It is the direct antonym for public disgrace or harsh criticism.
Synonyms: Prestige (प्रतिष्ठा), Recognition (मान्यता), Dignity (गरिमा).
Antonyms: Shame (शर्म), Infamy (बदनामी), Opprobrium (निंदा).

This word refers to the formal expression of severe disapproval, especially in a public or official capacity. It is a synonym for the criticism aspect of the given word.
Synonyms: Reprimand (फटकार), Condemnation (निंदा), Denunciation (आरोप).
Antonyms: Praise (प्रशंसा), Approval (स्वीकृति), Commendation (सराहना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Refulgent
questionsEn.s:
Refulgent - देदीप्यमान (Shining brightly; radiant)
Dull - मंद (Lacking brightness, vividness, or sheen)
Radiant - दीप्तिमान (Sending out light; shining brightly)
Gleaming - चमकता हुआ (Shining brightly, especially with reflected light)
Luminous - प्रकाशमान (Full of or shedding light)


Hence, 'Dull' is the most suitable antonym for 'Refulgent'.
oa:
This word refers to something that is not bright, shiny, or vivid; lacking in interest or excitement. it is the perfect opposite of something that shines brilliantly.
Synonyms: Drab (फीका), Lusterless (चमकहीन), Matte (धुंधला).
Antonyms: Bright (चमकदार), Shining (चमकता हुआ), Vivid (जीवंत).

This refers to something that is sending out light or shining or glowing brightly. It is a direct synonym for the brilliant quality of the given word.
Synonyms: Glowing (दमकता), Beaming (हंसमुख/दीप्तिमान), Effulgent (तेजस्वी).
Antonyms: Dim (धुंधला), Dark (अंधेरा), Somber (गंभीर/उदास).

This refers to a small, bright light or a reflectively shiny surface. It shares the core meaning of being shiny, making it a synonym.
Synonyms: Glistening (चमकता), Sparkling (झिलमिलाता), Lustrous (चमकदार).
Antonyms: Tarnished (कलंकित/फीका), Dirty (गंदा), Dull (नीरस).

This describes something that is full of or shedding light, especially in the dark. It is a synonym that refers to the emission of light.
Synonyms: Phosphorescent (दीप्तिमान), Fluorescent (चमकदार), Bright (उज्ज्वल).
Antonyms: Opaque (अपारदर्शी), Obscure (अस्पष्ट), Dark (अंधेरा).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Obdurate
questionsEn.s:
Obdurate - हठी (Stubbornly refusing to change one's opinion)
Callous - निर्दयी (Showing an insensitive disregard for others)
Yielding - झुकने वाला (Ready to give way to others; compliant)
Adamant - अटल (Refusing to be persuaded or change one's mind)
Hardened - कठोर (Used to something; no longer easily affected)


Hence, 'Yielding' is the most suitable antonym for 'Obdurate'.
oa:
This word refers to showing or having an insensitive and cruel disregard for others. It describes the emotional hardness often found in stubborn people, acting as a synonym.
Synonyms: Heartless (निर्दयी), Unfeeling (संवेदनाहीन), Cold (बेरुखा).
Antonyms: Kind (दयालु), Compassionate (सहानुभूतिपूर्ण), Sensitive (संवेदनशील).

This word describes someone who is ready to give way to others, being compliant or flexible. It is the direct antonym for being stubborn and refusing to change.
Synonyms: Compliant (आज्ञाकारी), Flexible (लचीला), Accommodating (मिलनसार).
Antonyms: Stubborn (ज़िद्दी), Rigid (कठोर), Obdurate (हठी).

This refers to someone who is refusing to be persuaded or to change one's mind. it is a strong synonym for being obdurate.
Synonyms: Unshakable (अटल), Firm (दृढ़), Immovable (अचल).
Antonyms: Hesitant (हिचकिचाने वाला), Uncertain (अनिश्चित), Pliable (लचीला).

This word describes someone who has become used to something unpleasant and is no longer easily moved or affected by it. It aligns with the "stubborn" context and acts as a synonym.
Synonyms: Toughened (सख्त), Habitual (आदतन), Seasoned (अनुभवी).
Antonyms: Innocent (मासूम), Soft (कोमल), Vulnerable (कमज़ोर).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Pusillanimous
questionsEn.s:
Pusillanimous - डरपोक (Showing a lack of courage or determination)
Timid - दब्बू (Showing a lack of courage or confidence)
Brave - बहादुर (Ready to face and endure danger or pain)
Cowardly - कायर (Lacking courage)
Faint-hearted - कमज़ोर दिल (Lacking courage; timid)


Hence, 'Brave' is the most suitable antonym for 'Pusillanimous'.
oa:
This word refers to showing a lack of courage or confidence; being easily frightened. It is a direct synonym for the given word.
Synonyms: Shy (संकोची), Fearful (डरपोक), Mouselike (दब्बू).
Antonyms: Bold (निडर), Confident (आत्मविश्वासी), Brave (साहसी).

This word refers to a person ready to face and endure danger or pain; showing courage. it is the most appropriate opposite for being cowardly or timid.
Synonyms: Courageous (साहसी), Valorous (वीर), Gallant (शौर्यवान).
Antonyms: Cowardly (कायर), Timid (डरपोक), Pusillanimous (डरपोक).

This word refers to lacking courage and being prone to fear. It is the primary synonym and definition of the given word.
Synonyms: Craven (डरपोक), Spineless (कमज़ोर), Faint-hearted (कमज़ोर दिल).
Antonyms: Heroic (वीर), Daring (साहसी), Intrepid (निडर).

This refers to lacking courage or enthusiasm; being timid or shy. It is essentially a synonym for the given word.
Synonyms: Weak (कमज़ोर), Fearful (भीत), Nervous (घबराया हुआ).
Antonyms: Stalwart (मज़बूत), Determined (दृढ़), Stout (बहादुर).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Vociferous
questionsEn.s:
Vociferous - मुखर (Expressing opinions in a loud and forceful way)
Noisy - शोरगुल वाला (Making or given to making a lot of noise)
Loud - ज़ोरदार (Producing a lot of noise)
Silent - मौन (Not making or accompanied by any sound)
Boisterous - ऊधमी (Noisy, energetic, and cheerful)


Hence, 'Silent' is the most suitable antonym for 'Vociferous'.
oa:
This word refers to making a lot of loud or unpleasant noise. It is a direct synonym that captures the loud nature of the given word.
Synonyms: Loud (ज़ोरदार), Rowdy (उपद्रवी), Clamorous (हंगामा करने वाला).
Antonyms: Quiet (शांत), Silent (मौन), Peaceful (शांतिपूर्ण).

This describes a sound that has a high volume or is easily heard. It is a fundamental component of the meaning of vociferous, acting as a synonym.
Synonyms: Blaring (ज़ोर का), Piercing (चुभने वाला), Thunderous (गरजता हुआ).
Antonyms: Soft (हल्का), Whispered (फुसफुसाया हुआ), Muted (धीमा).

This word refers to a person or thing that is not making or accompanied by any sound. It is the most accurate antonym for someone who expresses opinions loudly and forcefully.
Synonyms: Mute (मूक), Quiet (शांत), Still (अचल).
Antonyms: Noisy (शोर वाला), Talkative (बातूनी), Vociferous (मुखर).

This word refers to a person, event, or behavior that is noisy, energetic, and cheerful. It functions as a synonym that adds a sense of unruly energy to the noise.
Synonyms: Lively (जीवंत), Animated (सक्रिय), Exuberant (उत्साही).
Antonyms: Restrained (संयमित), Quiet (शांत), Calm (स्थिर).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Furtive
questionsEn.s:
Furtive - चोरी-छिपे (Attempting to avoid notice or attention)
Covert - गुप्त (Not openly acknowledged or displayed)
Sneaky - धूर्त (Acting in a secretive or stealthy way)
Open - खुला (Frank and communicative; not secretive)
Stealthy - चुपके से (Behaving in a cautious and surreptitious manner)


Hence, 'Open' is the most suitable antonym for 'Furtive'.
oa:
This word refers to something that is not openly acknowledged or displayed; secret. It is a direct synonym for the given word's secretive nature.
Synonyms: Hidden (छिपा हुआ), Underground (गुप्त), Cloaked (नकाबपोश).
Antonyms: Overt (प्रत्यक्ष), Public (सार्वजनिक), Open (खुला).

This refers to acting in a secretive or stealthy way, often with a dishonest intent. It is a common synonym for being furtive.
Synonyms: Sly (धूर्त), Crafty (चालाक), Underhand (कपटपूर्ण).
Antonyms: Honest (ईमानदार), Direct (सीधा), Sincere (सच्चा).

This word refers to something that is not concealed or secretive; being honest and frank. It is the direct antonym of trying to avoid notice or being secretive.
Synonyms: Candid (स्पष्ट), Public (सार्वजनिक), Overt (प्रकट).
Antonyms: Secret (गुप्त), Furtive (चोरी-छिपे), Hidden (छिपा हुआ).

This refers to behavior that is cautious and surreptitious as to not be seen or heard. It is a strong synonym describing a similar mode of action.
Synonyms: Surreptitious (गुप्त), Feline (बिल्ली जैसा/चुपचाप), Secret (रहस्यमय).
Antonyms: Bold (साहसी), Noisy (शोर वाला), Obvious (ज़ाहिर).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Exiguous
questionsEn.s:
Exiguous - अत्यल्प (Very small in size or amount)
Meager - अल्प (Lacking in quantity or quality)
Plentiful - प्रचुर (Existing in or yielding great quantities)
Sparse - विरल (Thinly dispersed or scattered)
Skimpy - अपर्याप्त (Providing or consisting of less than is needed)


Hence, 'Plentiful' is the most suitable antonym for 'Exiguous'.
oa:
This word refers to something that is lacking in quantity or quality. It is an exact synonym for the small or scanty nature of the given word.
Synonyms: Scanty (अल्प), Insufficient (अपर्याप्त), Sparse (कम).
Antonyms: Plentiful (प्रचुर), Ample (काफी), Abundant (भरपूर).

This word refers to something that exists in great quantities or is abundant. it is the direct and most appropriate antonym for being very small or scanty in amount.
Synonyms: Bountiful (भरपूर), Copious (अत्यधिक), Profuse (प्रचुर).
Antonyms: Scarce (दुर्लभ), Exiguous (अल्प), Limited (सीमित).

This word refers to something that is thinly dispersed or scattered; not dense. It shares the "lack of quantity" aspect, acting as a synonym.
Synonyms: Thin (पतला), Scanty (कम), Scattered (बिखरा हुआ).
Antonyms: Dense (घना), Thick (मोटा), Abundant (प्रचुर).

This refers to something that is short or small in size or amount, often providing less than what is needed. It is a synonym that often carries a slightly informal tone.
Synonyms: Paltry (तुच्छ), Negligible (नगण्य), Modest (मामूली).
Antonyms: Generous (उदार), Full (पूरा), Large (बड़ा).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Transitory
questionsEn.s:
Transitory - क्षणिक (Not permanent; lasting for a short time)
Fleeting - अल्पकालिक (Lasting for a very short time)
Eternal - अनंत (Lasting or existing forever)
Momentary - थोड़ी देर का (Lasting for a very short time)
Temporary - अस्थायी (Lasting for only a limited period)


Hence, 'Eternal' is the most suitable antonym for 'Transitory'.
oa:
This refers to something that lasts for a very short time. It is a direct synonym for the short-lived nature of being transitory.
Synonyms: Evanescent (क्षणिक), Brief (संक्षिप्त), Momentary (थोड़ी देर का).
Antonyms: Endless (अनंत), Permanent (स्थायी), Lasting (टिकाऊ).

This word refers to something that lasts or exists forever; without end or beginning. it is the most accurate antonym for something that only lasts a short time.
Synonyms: Everlasting (शाश्वत), Infinite (असीम), Immortal (अमर).
Antonyms: Temporary (अस्थायी), Finite (सीमित), Transitory (अल्पकालिक).

This describes something that lasts for a very short time; occurring at a particular moment. It is another synonym describing brief duration.
Synonyms: Passing (अस्थायी), Instant (तुरंत), Ephemeral (क्षणिक).
Antonyms: Continuous (निरंतर), Persistent (दृढ़), Constant (स्थिर).

This refers to something that is lasting for only a limited period of time; not permanent. It is the primary synonym for the given word.
Synonyms: Provisional (अस्थायी), Short-term (अल्पकालिक), Interim (अंतरिम).
Antonyms: Durable (टिकाऊ), Stable (स्थिर), Fixed (तय).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Nugatory
questionsEn.s:
Nugatory - तुच्छ (Of no value or importance; useless)
Worthless - बेकार (Having no real value or use)
Futile - व्यर्थ (Incapable of producing any useful result)
Significant - महत्वपूर्ण (Great or important to be worthy of attention)
Trivial - मामूली (Of little value or importance)


Hence, 'Significant' is the most suitable antonym for 'Nugatory'.
oa:
This word describes something that has no real value or use. It matches the "no value" aspect of the given word and is thus a synonym.
Synonyms: Useless (बेकार), Valueless (मूल्यहीन), Trashy (घटिया).
Antonyms: Valuable (कीमती), Useful (उपयोगी), Worthy (लायक).

This refers to an action that is incapable of producing any useful result; pointless. It aligns with the idea of being ineffective or useless, making it a synonym.
Synonyms: Vain (व्यर्थ), Fruitless (निष्फल), Bootless (बेकार).
Antonyms: Effective (प्रभावी), Fruitful (सफल), Successful (कामयाब).

This word refers to something that is sufficiently great or important to be worthy of attention; noteworthy. it is the direct opposite of being trivial or of no value.
Synonyms: Important (महत्वपूर्ण), Meaningful (सार्थक), Momentous (प्रभावशाली).
Antonyms: Minor (मामूली), Nugatory (तुच्छ), Trivial (नगण्य).

This describes something that is of little value or importance. It is a direct synonym for the given word.
Synonyms: Petty (मामूली), Insignificant (नगण्य), Trifling (तुच्छ).
Antonyms: Serious (गंभीर), Essential (अनिवार्य), Major (मुख्य).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Vindicate
questionsEn.s:
Vindicate - सही साबित करना (Clear someone of blame; justify)
Justify - औचित्य सिद्ध करना (Show or prove to be right or reasonable)
Carefree - निश्चिंत (Free from anxiety or responsibility)
Forgive - माफ़ करना (Stop feeling angry toward someone for an offense)
Accuse - आरोप लगाना (Claim that someone has done something wrong)


Hence, 'Accuse' is the most suitable antonym for 'Vindicate'.
oa:
This word means to show or prove that something is right, reasonable, or warranted. It is a direct synonym for the "justify" aspect of the given word.
Synonyms: Warrant (औचित्य बताना), Substantiate (पुष्टि करना), Validate (मान्य करना).
Antonyms: Invalidate (अमान्य करना), Disprove (गलत साबित करना), Reject (अस्वीकार करना).

This word describes someone who is free from anxiety or responsibility. It is contextually unrelated to the act of clearing blame or proving something right.
Synonyms: Easygoing (निश्चिंत), Untroubled (परेशानी रहित), Blithe (प्रसन्न).
Antonyms: Anxious (चिंतित), Stressed (तनावग्रस्त), Responsible (ज़िम्मेदार).

This means to stop feeling angry or resentful toward someone for an offense, flaw, or mistake. While it involves a positive outcome, it is not the logical opposite of being cleared of a charge.
Synonyms: Pardon (क्षमा करना), Condone (अनदेखा करना), Absolve (दोषमुक्त करना).
Antonyms: Blame (दोष देना), Resent (नाराज़ होना), Punish (दंड देना).

This word refers to the act of claiming that someone has done something wrong or committed a crime. It is the direct opposite of vindicating, which involves clearing someone of such charges.
Synonyms: Charge (आरोप लगाना), Indict (दोषी ठहराना), Implicate (फँसाना).
Antonyms: Exonerate (दोषमुक्त करना), Absolve (बरी करना), Vindicate (सही साबित करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Dissemble
questionsEn.s:
Dissemble - पाखंड करना (Conceal one's true motives or feelings)
Disguise - भेष बदलना (Give a different appearance to conceal identity)
Reveal - प्रकट करना (Make previously unknown information known)
Obscure - अस्पष्ट (Keep from being seen; conceal)
Pretend - दिखावा करना (Act as if something is true when it is not)


Hence, 'Reveal' is the most suitable antonym for 'Dissemble'.
oa:
This word means to give a different appearance to a person or thing in order to conceal its identity. It is a direct synonym for the act of hiding true motives.
Synonyms: Camouflage (छिपाना), Mask (मुखौटा लगाना), Cloak (ढंकना).
Antonyms: Reveal (प्रकट करना), Expose (उजागर करना), Unmask (नकाब उतारना).

This word means to make previously unknown or secret information known to others. it is the direct opposite of concealing one's true feelings or motives.
Synonyms: Disclose (उजागर करना), Unveil (पर्दा उठाना), Divulge (प्रकाशित करना).
Antonyms: Hide (छिपाना), Conceal (गुप्त रखना), Dissemble (ढोंग करना).

This means to keep from being seen or to conceal; to make something unclear. It shares the "hiding" aspect, making it a synonym.
Synonyms: Cloud (धुंधला करना), Befog (उलझाना), Hide (छिपाना).
Antonyms: Clarify (स्पष्ट करना), Elucidate (व्याख्या करना), Explain (समझाना).

This word means to speak and act so as to make it appear that something is the case when in fact it is not. It is a near-perfect synonym for dissembling.
Synonyms: Feign (ढोंग करना), Fake (बनावटी), Simulate (अनुकरण करना).
Antonyms: Be real (वास्तविक होना), Be honest (ईमानदार होना), Authentic (असली).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Ostentatious
questionsEn.s:
Ostentatious - दिखावटी (Characterized by vulgar or pretentious display)
Modest - विनीत (Unassuming or moderate in the estimation of oneself)
Showy - भड़कीला (Intended to attract attention or admiration)
Flashy - चमकीला (Stylish in a way that attracts attention)
Pretentious - ढोंगी (Attempting to impress by affecting importance)


Hence, 'Modest' is the most suitable antonym for 'Ostentatious'.
oa:
This word refers to being unassuming or moderate in the estimation of one's abilities or the display of wealth. It is the direct opposite of being showy or pretentious.
Synonyms: Humble (विनम्र), Simple (साधारण), Unpretentious (दिखावा रहित).
Antonyms: Arrogant (अहंकारी), Flashy (भड़कीला), Ostentatious (दिखावटी).

This describes something having an appearance which is intended to attract attention or admiration. It is the literal definition and primary synonym of the given word.
Synonyms: Gaudy (भड़कीला), Garish (चमकीला), Loud (धमाकेदार/चमकीला).
Antonyms: Plain (सादा), Subtle (सूक्ष्म), Dull (नीरस).

This word refers to something that is stylish or exciting in a way that is intended to attract attention. It is a common synonym for the given word.
Synonyms: Snazzy (आकर्षक), Glitzy (तड़क-भड़क वाला), Jazzy (चमकीला).
Antonyms: Understated (संयमित), Quiet (शांत), Drab (फीका).

This refers to attempting to impress by affecting greater importance, talent, or culture than is actually possessed. It captures the false display aspect, making it a synonym.
Synonyms: Pompous (गर्वित), Grandiose (भव्य), Affected (बनावटी).
Antonyms: Genuine (वास्तविक), Honest (सच्चा), Down-to-earth (व्यवहारिक).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Impecunious
questionsEn.s:
Impecunious - निर्धन (Having little or no money)
Insolvent - दिवालिया (Unable to pay one's debts)
Wealthy - धनी (Having a great deal of money; rich)
Indigent - दरिद्र (Poor; needy)
Penniless - कंगाल (Having no money at all)


Hence, 'Wealthy' is the most suitable antonym for 'Impecunious'.
oa:
This word refers to being unable to pay one's debts as they fall due. It is a synonym that describes a specific, severe state of having no money.
Synonyms: Bankrupt (दिवालिया), Ruined (बर्बाद), Broke (कंगाल).
Antonyms: Solvent (ऋण चुकाने में सक्षम), Wealthy (धनी), Stable (स्थिर).

This word refers to having a great deal of money, resources, or assets; being rich. it is the direct and most appropriate opposite of having little or no money.
Synonyms: Affluent (समृद्ध), Opulent (कीमती/धनी), Prosperous (संपन्न).
Antonyms: Poor (गरीब), Indigent (निर्धन), Needy (ज़रूरतमंद).

This refers to being poor or needy. It is a formal synonym for the impecunious state of an individual.
Synonyms: Destitute (बेसहारा), Penurious (दरिद्र), Poverty-stricken (गरीबी से त्रस्त).
Antonyms: Rich (अमीर), Moneyed (पैसे वाला), Loaded (मालामाल).

This word describes someone who has no money at all. It is a very direct and common synonym for the given word.
Synonyms: Destitute (अभावग्रस्त), Needy (कंगाल), Pitiable (दयनीय).
Antonyms: Wealthy (धनी), Comfortably off (संपन्न), Rich (रईस).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Pernicious
questionsEn.s:
Pernicious - हानिकारक (Having a harmful effect, especially in a gradual way)
Harmful - क्षतिकारक (Likely to cause damage or injury)
Innocuous - अहानिकारक (Not harmful or offensive)
Virulent - विषैला (Extremely severe or harmful in its effects)
Noxious - विषैला (Harmful, poisonous, or very unpleasant)


Hence, 'Innocuous' is the most suitable antonym for 'Pernicious'.
oa:
This describes something that causes or is likely to cause damage, injury, or trouble. it is the core meaning and most common synonym of the given word.
Synonyms: Damaging (क्षतिकारक), Deleterious (हानिकारक), Adverse (विपरीत).
Antonyms: Beneficial (लाभदायक), Helpful (सहायक), Advantageous (फायदेमंद).

This word refers to something that is not harmful or offensive; being safe or harmless. it is the perfect antonym for something that has a destructive effect.
Synonyms: Harmless (अहानिकारक), Safe (सुरक्षित), Benign (सौम्य).
Antonyms: Toxic (विषैला), Dangerous (खतरनाक), Pernicious (घातक).

This refers to something that is extremely severe or harmful in its effects; often used for diseases or poison. It is a powerful synonym for the given word.
Synonyms: Toxic (ज़हरीला), Deadly (घातक), Malignant (घातक).
Antonyms: Mild (हल्का), Weak (कमज़ोर), Harmless (अहानिकारक).

This describes something that is harmful, poisonous, or very unpleasant. It functions as a direct synonym, especially when referring to physical harm or gases.
Synonyms: Baneful (विनाशकारी), Pestilential (महामारी जैसा), Foul (गंदा).
Antonyms: Wholesome (पौष्टिक), Clean (साफ़), Healthy (स्वस्थ).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Lugubrious
questionsEn.s:
Lugubrious - उदास (Looking or sounding sad and dismal)
Joyous - आनंदपूर्ण (Full of happiness and delight)
Mournful - शोकाकुल (Feeling or expressing deep sadness)
Gloomy - निराशाजनक (Dark or poorly lit; causing sadness)
Sorrowful - दुखद (Feeling or showing grief)


Hence, 'Joyous' is the most suitable antonym for 'Lugubrious'.
oa:
This word describes a state of feeling, showing, or causing great happiness and delight. it is the perfect opposite of looking or sounding sad and dismal.
Synonyms: Cheerful (हंसमुख), Jubilant (प्रफुल्लित), Mirthful (आनंदपूर्ण).
Antonyms: Sorrowful (दुखी), Sad (उदास), Gloomy (निराशाजनक).

This word refers to expressing or feeling deep sadness, often associated with a funeral or loss. It is a direct synonym for the given word.
Synonyms: Doleful (दुखद), Plaintive (शोकपूर्ण), Sad (उदास).
Antonyms: Happy (खुश), Lively (जीवंत), Joyful (हर्षित).

This describes a state of darkness, shadows, or a feeling of despair and sadness. It is a synonym that captures the "dismal" aspect of the given word.
Synonyms: Somber (उदास), Dim (धुंधला), Depressing (निराशाजनक).
Antonyms: Bright (उज्ज्वल), Sunny (धूप वाला), Cheerful (खुशमिज़ाज).

This refers to feeling or showing grief, regret, or sadness. It is a direct and simple synonym for being lugubrious.
Synonyms: Heartbroken (दुखी), Unhappy (नाखुश), Wretched (दयनीय).
Antonyms: Delighted (प्रसन्न), Content (संतुष्ट), Glad (खुश).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Redolent
questionsEn.s:
Redolent - सुगंधित (Strongly reminiscent or suggestive of; fragrant)
Fragrant - खुशबूदार (Having a pleasant or sweet smell)
Evocative - याद दिलानेवाला (Bringing strong images or memories to mind)
Odorous - गंधयुक्त (Having or giving off a smell)
Unscented - गंधहीन (Having no smell)


Hence, 'Unscented' is the most suitable antonym for 'Redolent'.
oa:
This describes something that has a pleasant or sweet smell. It represents one of the primary meanings of the given word, acting as a synonym.
Synonyms: Aromatic (सुगंधित), Scented (खुशबूदार), Perfumed (इत्र जैसा).
Antonyms: Stinking (बदबूदार), Foul (गंदा), Odorous (दुर्गंधयुक्त).

This word refers to something that brings strong images, memories, or feelings to mind. It captures the figurative meaning of redolence, making it a synonym.
Synonyms: Suggestive (संकेतपूर्ण), Reminiscent (याद दिलाने वाला), Resonant (गूँजने वाला).
Antonyms: Forgettable (भुलक्कड़), Dull (नीरस), Uninspiring (प्रेरणाहीन).

This word describes something that has or gives off a smell, especially an unpleasant one. While often negative, in a neutral sense, it is synonymous with having a scent.
Synonyms: Smelly (बदबूदार), Malodorous (दुर्गंधयुक्त), Pungent (तीखा).
Antonyms: Odorless (गंधहीन), Scentless (खुशबू रहित), Clean (साफ़).

This word describes something that has no smell or fragrance. it is the direct antonym for something that is strongly redolent or fragrant.
Synonyms: Odorless (गंधहीन), Scent-free (खुशबू रहित), Neutral (तटस्थ).
Antonyms: Fragrant (सुगंधित), Redolent (सुगंधपूर्ण), Smelly (बदबूदार).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Incipient
questionsEn.s:
Incipient - आरंभिक (In an initial stage; beginning to happen or develop)
Nascent - नवजात (Just coming into existence; showing potential)
Developing - विकासशील (Growing or becoming more advanced)
Advanced - उन्नत (At a higher or more developed stage)
Budding - उभरता हुआ (Beginning to develop or show promise)


Hence, 'Advanced' is the most suitable antonym for 'Incipient'.
oa:
This word refers to something that is just coming into existence and beginning to display signs of future potential. It is an exact synonym for being incipient.
Synonyms: Emerging (उभरता हुआ), Developing (विकसित होता हुआ), Dawning (शुरुआत).
Antonyms: Dying (मरता हुआ), Waning (घटता हुआ), Fading (मिटता हुआ).

This refers to the process of growing or becoming more mature or advanced. It matches the "beginning to develop" aspect, serving as a synonym.
Synonyms: Evolving (क्रमिक विकास), Growing (बढ़ता हुआ), Advancing (प्रगतिशील).
Antonyms: Stagnating (ठहरा हुआ), Receding (पीछे हटना), Regressing (पीछे जाना).

This word refers to something that is at a higher, more developed, or more complex stage. it is the direct opposite of being in the initial or beginning stages.
Synonyms: Sophisticated (जटिल/उन्नत), Modern (आधुनिक), Mature (परिपक्व).
Antonyms: Primitive (आदिम), Rudimentary (मौलिक), Incipient (आरंभिक).

This describes a person or a thing that is beginning to develop or show promise in a particular field. It is a common figurative synonym for the given word.
Synonyms: Promising (उज्ज्वल), Embryonic (भ्रूण जैसा), Immature (अपरिपक्व).
Antonyms: Experienced (अनुभवी), Fully-fledged (पूर्ण विकसित), Expert (विशेषज्ञ).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Pulverize
questionsEn.s:
Pulverize - चूर्ण करना (Reduce to fine particles; crush)
Crumble - टुकड़े-टुकड़े होना (Break or fall apart into small fragments)
Shatter - चकनाचूर करना (Break suddenly and violently into pieces)
Restore - बहाल करना (Return something to its former condition)
Crush - कुचलना (Deform or pulverize by force)


Hence, 'Restore' is the most suitable antonym for 'Pulverize'.
oa:
This means to break or fall apart into small fragments, especially as part of a process of deterioration. It is a synonym that involves breaking down into pieces.
Synonyms: Disintegrate (बिखर जाना), Decay (सड़ना), Fragment (टुकड़े होना).
Antonyms: Solidify (जमना), Unite (जुड़ना), Build (बनाना).

This word refers to breaking or causing to break suddenly and violently into pieces. It matches the destructive nature of the given word and acts as a synonym.
Synonyms: Smash (चकनाचूर करना), Break (तोड़ना), Demolish (नष्ट करना).
Antonyms: Repair (मरम्मत करना), Fix (ठीक करना), Mend (सुधारना).

This word refers to the act of returning something to its former condition, place, or position. it is the direct opposite of crushing or grinding something into powder.
Synonyms: Rejuvenate (पुनर्जीवित करना), Rehabilitate (पुनर्वास), Reconstruct (पुनर्निर्माण).
Antonyms: Destroy (नष्ट करना), Pulverize (पीसना), Damage (क्षति पहुँचाना).

This means to deform, pulverize, or force out of shape by compressing forcefully. It is the primary meaning and direct synonym of the given word.
Synonyms: Squash (कुचलना), Mash (मसलना), Grind (पीसना).
Antonyms: Expand (फैलाना), Inflate (फुलाना), Release (छोड़ना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Recalcitrance
questionsEn.s:
Recalcitrance - हठ (Obstinate defiance of authority or restraint)
Defiance - अवहेलना (Open resistance; bold disobedience)
Compliance - अनुपालन (The act of conforming to a rule or command)
Resistance - प्रतिरोध (The refusal to accept or comply with something)
Rebellion - विद्रोह (An act of open resistance to authority)


Hence, 'Compliance' is the most suitable antonym for 'Recalcitrance'.
oa:
This word refers to open resistance or bold disobedience. It is the core meaning and most common synonym for being recalcitrant.
Synonyms: Rebellion (विद्रोह), Insubordination (अनाज्ञाकारिता), Obstinacy (ज़िद).
Antonyms: Obedience (आज्ञाकारिता), Submission (समर्पण), Compliance (अनुपालन).

This word refers to the act of conforming to a rule, such as a specification, policy, standard or law. it is the direct antonym for resistance or defiance toward authority.
Synonyms: Agreement (सहमति), Observance (अनुपालन), Conformity (अनुरूपता).
Antonyms: Resistance (प्रतिरोध), Defiance (अवहेलना), Recalcitrance (हठ).

This refers to the refusal to accept or comply with something; the use of force to oppose something. It is an exact synonym for the given word.
Synonyms: Opposition (विरोध), Obstruction (बाधा), Counteraction (प्रतिक्रिया).
Antonyms: Acceptance (स्वीकृति), Assistance (सहायता), Yielding (झुकना).

This refers to an act of violent or open resistance to an established government or ruler. It captures the aggressive form of recalcitrance, making it a synonym.
Synonyms: Mutiny (बगावत), Uprising (विद्रोह), Revolt (राजद्रोह).
Antonyms: Loyalty (निष्ठा), Peace (शांति), Allegiance (राजभक्ति).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Torpor
questionsEn.s:
Torpor - सुस्ती (A state of physical or mental inactivity; lethargy)
Stupor - मूर्छा (A state of near-unconsciousness or insensibility)
Liveliness - जीवंतता (The quality of being outgoing and energetic)
Sluggishness - ढीलापन (The state of being slow-moving or inactive)
Inertia - जड़ता (A tendency to do nothing or remain unchanged)


Hence, 'Liveliness' is the most suitable antonym for 'Torpor'.
oa:
This word refers to a state of near-unconsciousness or insensibility. It is a medical or intense synonym for the inactivity described by the given word.
Synonyms: Numbness (सुन्नता), Daze (हैरानी/मूर्छा), Coma (बेहोशी).
Antonyms: Consciousness (चेतना), Awareness (जागरूकता), Alertness (सतर्कता).

This word refers to the quality of being outgoing, energetic, and enthusiastic. it is the direct opposite of being in a state of physical or mental inactivity.
Synonyms: Vitality (जीवंतता), Animation (सजीवता), Sprightliness (फुर्ती).
Antonyms: Dullness (नीरसता), Torpor (सुस्ती), Inertia (जड़ता).

This describes the state of being slow-moving or inactive. It is the primary characteristic of torpor, acting as a direct synonym.
Synonyms: Laziness (आलस्य), Indolence (सुस्ती), Sloth (कामचोरी).
Antonyms: Speed (गति), Alacrity (तत्परता), Quickness (तेज़ी).

This word refers to a tendency to do nothing or to remain unchanged. In physics and common usage, it is synonymous with the lack of motion or energy found in torpor.
Synonyms: Inaction (निष्क्रियता), Passivity (निष्क्रियता), Stagnation (ठहराव).
Antonyms: Energy (ऊर्जा), Activity (सक्रियता), Momentum (गति).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Prosaic
questionsEn.s:
Prosaic - नीरस (Dull; lacking poetic beauty or imagination)
Imaginative - कल्पनाशील (Having or showing creativity or original thought)
Banal - घिसा-पिटा (Lacking in originality as to be boring)
Ordinary - साधारण (With no special or distinctive features; normal)
Dull - सुस्त (Lacking interest or excitement)


Hence, 'Imaginative' is the most suitable antonym for 'Prosaic'.
oa:
This word describes someone or something showing creativity or original thought. It is the perfect antonym for something that is dull and lacking in imagination.
Synonyms: Creative (रचनात्मक), Inventive (आविष्कारी), Visionary (कल्पनाशील).
Antonyms: Dull (नीरस), Mundane (साधारण), Prosaic (फीका).

This word refers to something so lacking in originality as to be obvious and boring. It is a direct synonym for the uninteresting nature of being prosaic.
Synonyms: Trite (घिसा-पिटा), Commonplace (मामूली), Humdrum (नीरस).
Antonyms: Original (मौलिक), Unique (अनोखा), Fresh (ताज़ा).

This word describes something with no special or distinctive features; normal. It captures the everyday, unexciting quality of the given word, serving as a synonym.
Synonyms: Routine (नियमित), Standard (मानक), Typical (विशिष्ट).
Antonyms: Extraordinary (असाधारण), Unusual (असामान्य), Remarkable (अद्भुत).

This refers to something that is lacking interest or excitement. It is a core synonym for the boring and flat style implied by being prosaic.
Synonyms: Tedious (थकाऊ), Boring (ऊबाऊ), Flat (फीका).
Antonyms: Exciting (रोमांचक), Interesting (दिलचस्प), Vibrant (जीवंत).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Palliate
questionsEn.s:
Palliate - कम करना (Make a disease or its symptoms less severe)
Worsen - बदतर करना (Make something more severe or intense)
Alleviate - हल्का करना (Make suffering or a problem less severe)
Mitigate - शांत करना (Make something bad less severe or painful)
Ease - राहत देना (Make something unpleasant less serious)


Hence, 'Worsen' is the most suitable antonym for 'Palliate'.
oa:
This word means to make something, especially a bad situation or a negative feeling, more severe or intense. it is the direct antonym for trying to reduce the severity of a problem.
Synonyms: Aggravate (बिगाड़ना), Exacerbate (बदतर करना), Intensify (तेज़ करना).
Antonyms: Improve (सुधारना), Palliate (शांत करना), Alleviate (कम करना).

This means to make suffering, deficiency, or a problem less severe. It is a direct synonym for the given word's purpose of reducing severity.
Synonyms: Relieve (राहत देना), Ease (आसान करना), Soothe (शांत करना).
Antonyms: Heighten (बढ़ाना), Increase (बढ़ाना), Worsen (बिगाड़ना).

This refers to the act of making something bad less severe, serious, or painful. It is an exact synonym for the process of palliating.
Synonyms: Attenuate (कम करना), Diminish (घटाना), Allay (शांत करना).
Antonyms: Magnify (बढ़ाना), Provoke (उकसाना), Agitate (परेशान करना).

This means to make something unpleasant or intense less serious or severe. It functions as a common synonym in both medical and general contexts.
Synonyms: Lighten (हल्का करना), Soften (कोमल बनाना), Relax (आराम देना).
Antonyms: Tighten (सख्त करना), Hinder (बाधा डालना), Burden (बोझ डालना).

test.instructions: Standard CBT Pattern Exam. Positive Marks: +1, Negative Marks: -1. Total Questions: 50.

test.title: Set - 2

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Munificent
questionsEn.s:
Munificent - बहुत उदार (Extremely generous in giving)
Lavish - ठाठदार (Rich, elaborate, or luxurious)
Generous - दानी (Willing to give more than necessary)
Stingy - कंजूस (Unwilling to spend or give)
Benevolent - परोपकारी (Well-meaning and kindly)


Hence, 'Stingy' is the most suitable antonym for 'Munificent'.
oa:
This word describes something that is sumptuously rich, elaborate, or luxurious. When applied to a person, it means they are very generous, which makes it a synonym rather than an opposite of the question word.
Synonyms: Bountiful (प्रचुर), Extravagant (फ़िजूलख़र्च), Munificent (उदार).
Antonyms: Meager (अल्प), Scanty (कम), Parsimonious (किफ़ायती).

This term refers to showing a readiness to give more of something, especially money, than is strictly necessary or expected. It serves as a direct synonym for the given word and does not fit the requirement for an antonym.
Synonyms: Magnanimous (महामना), Charitable (दानशील), Altruistic (परोपकारी).
Antonyms: Greedy (लालची), Selfish (स्वार्थी), Mean (नीच/कंजूस).

This word refers to being unwilling to give or spend; ungenerous. It is the direct opposite of being munificent, as it describes a person who is extremely miserly with their resources.
Synonyms: Miserly (कंजूस), Parsimonious (किफ़ायती), Niggardly (लोभी).
Antonyms: Generous (उदार), Munificent (दानी), Liberal (मुक्तहस्त).

This word describes someone who is well-meaning and kindly. While it focuses more on the intent of kindness, it is often associated with generosity, making it a synonym in many contexts.
Synonyms: Kind-hearted (दयालु), Philanthropic (लोकहितैषी), Benign (सौम्य).
Antonyms: Malevolent (द्रोही), Cruel (क्रूर), Spiteful (द्वेषपूर्ण).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Quell
questionsEn.s:
Quell - शांत करना (To put an end to, typically by the use of force)
Suppress - दबाना (Forcibly put an end to)
Provoke - भड़काना (Stimulate or give rise to a reaction)
Subdue - वश में करना (Bring under control by force)
Restrain - रोकना (Keep under control or within limits)


Hence, 'Provoke' is the most suitable antonym for 'Quell'.
oa:
This word means to forcibly put an end to something, such as a rebellion or an emotion. It is a direct synonym for the given word as both involve stopping an activity or feeling by force.
Synonyms: Subdue (दबाना), Quash (कुचलना), Extinguish (बुझाना).
Antonyms: Incite (उकसाना), Provoke (भड़काना), Encourage (प्रोत्साहित करना).

This word means to stimulate or give rise to a reaction or emotion, typically a strong or unwelcome one in someone. It is the most appropriate opposite for 'quell' because it involves starting or increasing trouble rather than stopping it.
Synonyms: Instigate (भड़काना), Inflame (उत्तेजित करना), Agitate (उकसाना).
Antonyms: Quell (शांत करना), Allay (धीमा करना), Pacify (शांत करना).

This term refers to bringing a person or country under control by force. It aligns perfectly with the meaning of 'quell' and therefore serves as a synonym.
Synonyms: Conquer (जीतना), Overcome (काबू पाना), Vanquish (पराजित करना).
Antonyms: Liberate (मुक्त करना), Awaken (जगाना), Stimulate (उत्तेजित करना).

This word means to prevent someone or something from doing something; to keep under control or within limits. It is a synonymous concept focusing on control and restriction.
Synonyms: Constrain (बाध्य करना), Curb (नियंत्रित करना), Check (रोकना).
Antonyms: Release (मुक्त करना), Permit (अनुमति देना), Loose (ढीला करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Esoteric
questionsEn.s:
Esoteric - गुप्त/गूढ़ (Intended for or understood by only a small number of people)
Obscure - अस्पष्ट (Not discovered or known about; uncertain)
Straight Forward - सीधा/सरल (Easy to do or understand)
Cryptic - रहस्यमय (Having a meaning that is mysterious or obscure)
Abstract - अमूर्त (Existing in thought; not concrete)


Hence, 'Straight Forward' is the most suitable antonym for 'Esoteric'.
oa:
This word refers to something that is not discovered or known about; uncertain. It functions as a synonym for esoteric because both describe things that are difficult for the general public to understand.
Synonyms: Abstruse (गूढ़), Cryptic (गुप्त), Arcane (रहस्यमय).
Antonyms: Common (सामान्य), Clear (स्पष्ट), Obvious (ज़ाहिर).

This phrase describes something that is easy to do or understand; honest and open. It is the direct opposite of esoteric, which refers to specialized knowledge intended for only a few people.
Synonyms: Direct (सीधा), Simple (सरल), Uncomplicated (आसान).
Antonyms: Esoteric (गूढ़), Complex (जटिल), Ambiguous (अस्पष्ट).

This word refers to having a meaning that is mysterious or obscure. It is a synonym of the question word, as both imply a sense of being hidden or difficult to interpret.
Synonyms: Enigmatic (रहस्यमय), Puzzling (पेचीदा), Mystifying (भ्रमित करने वाला).
Antonyms: Explicit (सुस्पष्ट), Plain (सादा), Evident (प्रकट).

This word describes something existing in thought or as an idea but not having a physical or concrete existence. While it can be difficult to understand, it is not the logical opposite of specialized knowledge.
Synonyms: Theoretical (सैद्धांतिक), Conceptual (वैचारिक), Intangible (अमूर्त).
Antonyms: Concrete (ठोस), Physical (भौतिक), Real (वास्तविक).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Gullibility
questionsEn.s:
Gullibility - भोलापन (Tendency to be easily persuaded that something is true)
Naivety - सीधापन (Lack of experience, wisdom, or judgment)
Innocence - मासूमियत (The state of being innocent or guileless)
Trust - भरोसा (Firm belief in the reliability of someone)
Skepticism - संदेहवाद (A skeptical attitude; doubt as to the truth)


Hence, 'Skepticism' is the most suitable antonym for 'Gullibility'.
oa:
This word refers to a lack of experience, wisdom, or judgment. It is a synonym for the question word, as both describe a person who is too ready to believe things without question.
Synonyms: Innocence (भोलापन), Simplicity (सादगी), Credulity (भोलापन).
Antonyms: Sophistication (जटिलता), Wisdom (बुद्धिमत्ता), Experience (अनुभव).

This refers to the state, quality, or fact of being innocent of a crime or offense. In a general sense, it implies a lack of guile or worldliness, making it a synonym for gullibility.
Synonyms: Purity (शुद्धता), Guilelessness (निष्कपटता), Virtue (सदाचार).
Antonyms: Guilt (दोष), Corruption (भ्रष्टाचार), Cynicism (कुटिलता).

This is a firm belief in the reliability, truth, or ability of someone or something. While trust is a positive trait, being too trusting leads to gullibility, making this a closely related synonym.
Synonyms: Confidence (विश्वास), Reliance (भरोसा), Faith (आस्था).
Antonyms: Distrust (अविश्वास), Doubt (संदेह), Suspicion (शंका).

This word refers to a skeptical attitude; doubt as to the truth of something. It is the direct opposite of gullibility, which is the tendency to believe everything without proof.
Synonyms: Doubt (शंका), Cynicism (कुटिलता), Incredulity (अविश्वास).
Antonyms: Belief (विश्वास), Gullibility (भोलापन), Conviction (दृढ़ विश्वास).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Noxious
questionsEn.s:
Noxious - हानिकारक/विषैला (Harmful, poisonous, or very unpleasant)
Beneficial - लाभदायक (Resulting in good; advantageous)
Toxic - विषैला (Poisonous or very harmful)
Poisonous - ज़हरीला (Capable of causing illness or death)
Harmful - नुकसानदेह (Causing or likely to cause harm)


Hence, 'Beneficial' is the most suitable antonym for 'Noxious'.
oa:
This word refers to something that results in good; having a favorable or advantageous effect. It is the direct opposite of being noxious, which describes something harmful or poisonous.
Synonyms: Advantageous (लाभदायक), Helpful (सहायक), Wholesome (पौष्टिक).
Antonyms: Harmful (हानिकारक), Noxious (विषैला), Deleterious (क्षतिकारक).

This word refers to something that is poisonous or very harmful. It is a direct synonym for the question word and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an antonym.
Synonyms: Poisonous (विषैला), Deadly (घातक), Lethal (जानलेवा).
Antonyms: Harmless (अहानिकारक), Healthy (स्वस्थ), Non-toxic (विषरहित).

This describes a substance that is capable of causing death or illness if taken into the body. It is a synonym that captures the dangerous physical nature of being noxious.
Synonyms: Venomous (ज़हरीला), Toxic (विषैला), Virulent (अत्यधिक हानिकारक).
Antonyms: Antidotal (विषनाशक), Safe (सुरक्षित), Innocent (हानिरहित).

This refers to something that causes or is likely to cause harm. Since this is the primary meaning of noxious, it serves as a synonym rather than an opposite.
Synonyms: Damaging (क्षतिकारक), Injurious (नुकसानदेह), Destructive (विनाशकारी).
Antonyms: Harmless (बेज़रर), Useful (उपयोगी), Benign (सौम्य).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Pernicious
questionsEn.s:
Pernicious - घातक (Having a harmful effect, especially in a gradual way)
Harmful - नुकसानदेह (Causing or likely to cause damage or injury)
Detrimental - अहितकर (Tending to cause harm)
Injurious - हानिकारक (Causing or likely to cause damage or injury)
Beneficial - फायदेमंद (Resulting in good; favorable or advantageous)


Hence, 'Beneficial' is the most suitable antonym for 'Pernicious'.
oa:
This word describes something that causes or is likely to cause damage, injury, or trouble. It is the definition of the question word and acts as its primary synonym.
Synonyms: Deleterious (हानिकारक), Adverse (विपरीत), Damaging (नुकसानदेह).
Antonyms: Beneficial (फायदेमंद), Helpful (सहायक), Kind (दयालु).

This refers to something that tends to cause harm. It is a strong synonym for pernicious, especially in formal or academic contexts regarding effects.
Synonyms: Disadvantageous (अहितकर), Pernicious (घातक), Prejudicial (हानिकारक).
Antonyms: Profitable (लाभदायक), Useful (उपयोगी), Beneficial (हितकारी).

This word refers to something that causes or is likely to cause damage or injury. It functions as a synonym, describing the negative impact shared by the given word.
Synonyms: Baneful (विनाशकारी), Hurtful (कष्टदायक), Noxious (नुकसानदेह).
Antonyms: Safe (सुरक्षित), Curative (रोगहर), Salubrious (स्वास्थ्यवर्धक).

This word refers to something that is favorable or advantageous; resulting in good. It is the direct and most appropriate opposite for a word that means having a harmful effect.
Synonyms: Advantageous (लाभदायक), Healthful (स्वास्थ्यप्रद), Constructive (रचनात्मक).
Antonyms: Harmful (हानिकारक), Pernicious (विनाशकारी), Destructive (नाशकारी).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Vexatious
questionsEn.s:
Vexatious - कष्टप्रद (Causing or tending to cause annoyance or frustration)
Pleasant - सुखद (Giving a sense of happy satisfaction or enjoyment)
Annoying - चिड़चिड़ा (Causing irritation or slight anger)
Troublesome - परेशानी भरा (Causing difficulty or annoyance)
Irritating - कष्टकारी (Causing annoyance, impatience, or mild anger)


Hence, 'Pleasant' is the most suitable antonym for 'Vexatious'.
oa:
This word refers to something giving a sense of happy satisfaction or enjoyment. It is the most logical opposite for being vexatious, which implies causing frustration or worry.
Synonyms: Agreeable (सुखद), Delightful (सुहावना), Charming (मनमोहक).
Antonyms: Annoying (परेशान करने वाला), Vexatious (कष्टप्रद), Unpleasant (अरुचिपूर्ण).

This word describes someone or something that causes irritation or slight anger. It is a direct synonym for the question word, as both relate to causing distress.
Synonyms: Irritating (चिढ़ाने वाला), Pesky (परेशान करने वाला), Galling (कष्टदायक).
Antonyms: Soothing (शांत करने वाला), Comforting (आरामदायक), Pleasing (मनोरम).

This refers to something that causes difficulty or annoyance. It functions as a synonym because it describes the burdensome nature of being vexatious.
Synonyms: Bothersome (तंग करने वाला), Onerous (कष्टसाध्य), Perplexing (हैरान करने वाला).
Antonyms: Easy (आसान), Convenient (सुविधाजनक), Helpful (सहायक).

This word means causing annoyance, impatience, or mild anger. It serves as a synonym for the given word's core characteristic of being a source of bother.
Synonyms: Exasperating (क्रोध दिलाने वाला), Maddening (पागल कर देने वाला), Vexing (तंग करने वाला).
Antonyms: Calm (शांत), Delightful (आनंदमय), Mild (हल्का).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Serene
questionsEn.s:
Serene - शांत (Calm, peaceful, and untroubled)
Chaotic - अराजक (In a state of complete confusion and disorder)
Calm - स्थिर (Free from agitation or strong emotion)
Peaceful - शांतिपूर्ण (Free from disturbance; tranquil)
Tranquil - शांत (Free from disturbance; calm)


Hence, 'Chaotic' is the most suitable antonym for 'Serene'.
oa:
This word refers to a state of complete confusion and disorder. It stands as the direct opposite of being serene, which implies a state of calm and tranquility.
Synonyms: Disordered (अव्यवस्थित), Turbulent (अशांत), Anarchic (अराजक).
Antonyms: Orderly (व्यवस्थित), Serene (शांत), Systematic (नियमित).

This term refers to a state of being free from agitation, excitement, or disturbance. It is the most common synonym for the given word and cannot be its antonym.
Synonyms: Tranquil (शांत), Placid (सौम्य), Peaceful (शांतिपूर्ण).
Antonyms: Violent (हिंसक), Agitated (उत्तेजित), Stormy (तूफ़ानी).

This refers to a state that is free from disturbance; tranquil. It is synonymous with the quality of being serene and describes a similar quiet condition.
Synonyms: Quiet (चुप), Restful (आरामदायक), Untroubled (चिंतामुक्त).
Antonyms: Noisy (शोर वाला), Hostile (शत्रुतापूर्ण), Warring (युद्धरत).

This word describes someone or something that is free from disturbance; calm. It is essentially a direct synonym for the question word.
Synonyms: Serene (निर्मल), Still (स्थिर), Halcyon (शांत).
Antonyms: Disturbed (परेशान), Busy (व्यस्त), Frantic (उन्मत्त).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Sagacious
questionsEn.s:
Sagacious - बुद्धिमान (Having or showing keen mental discernment)
Wise - ज्ञानी (Having experience, knowledge, and good judgment)
Foolish - मूर्ख (Lacking good sense or judgment; unwise)
Prudent - विवेकपूर्ण (Acting with or showing care for the future)
Shrewd - चतुर (Having or showing sharp powers of judgment)
