Hence, 'Foolish' is the most suitable antonym for 'Sagacious'.
oa:
This word refers to having or showing experience, knowledge, and good judgment. It is the primary synonym for sagacious and describes the same intellectual quality.
Synonyms: Learned (विद्वान), Intelligent (बुद्धिमान), Sage (ऋषि समान).
Antonyms: Ignorant (अज्ञानी), Foolish (मूर्ख), Stupid (बेवकूफ).

This word refers to a person or action lacking good sense or judgment; unwise. It is the direct and most accurate antonym for someone who is wise and sagacious.
Synonyms: Inane (बेतुका), Silly (नासमझ), Ridiculous (हास्यास्पद).
Antonyms: Wise (ज्ञानी), Sagacious (बुद्धिमान), Prudent (विवेकपूर्ण).

This word describes acting with or showing care and thought for the future. It is a synonym that shares the "good judgment" aspect of the question word.
Synonyms: Judicious (उचित), Cautious (सावधान), Wary (सतर्क).
Antonyms: Reckless (लापरवाह), Rash (जल्दबाज़), Impulsive (अवेगी).

This describes having or showing sharp powers of judgment; astute. It is a synonym, often implying a practical and sometimes self-serving kind of wisdom.
Synonyms: Astute (चतुर), Sharp (तेज़), Clever (चालाक).
Antonyms: Naive (भोला), Gullible (सीधा-साधा), Dull (मंदबुद्धि).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Felicity
questionsEn.s:
Felicity - परम सुख (Intense happiness; bliss)
Misery - कष्ट/पीड़ा (A state or feeling of great distress)
Despair - निराशा (The complete loss or absence of hope)
Sorrow - शोक (Deep distress caused by loss or misfortune)
Anger - क्रोध (A strong feeling of annoyance or hostility)


Hence, 'Misery' is the most suitable antonym for 'Felicity'.
oa:
This word refers to a state or feeling of great distress or discomfort of mind or body. It is the direct opposite of intense happiness or great joy.
Synonyms: Sorrow (दुख), Suffering (पीड़ा), Wretchedness (दयनीयता).
Antonyms: Joy (खुशी), Felicity (परम सुख), Bliss (परमानंद).

This refers to the complete loss or absence of hope. While it is a negative emotion, misery is the more direct contextual opposite to the happiness of felicity.
Synonyms: Hopelessness (निराशा), Desperation (बेचैनी), Pessimism (निराशावाद).
Antonyms: Hope (आशा), Optimism (आशावाद), Confidence (आत्मविश्वास).

This word refers to a feeling of deep distress caused by loss, disappointment, or other misfortune. It is a synonym for unhappiness and thus an antonym of the general concept of joy.
Synonyms: Grief (शोक), Sadness (उदासी), Regret (पछतावा).
Antonyms: Gladness (प्रसन्नता), Happiness (सुख), Mirth (आनंद).

This describes a strong feeling of annoyance, displeasure, or hostility. It is a negative emotion, but it has no direct relationship with the state of happiness or joy.
Synonyms: Rage (क्रोध), Fury (कोश), Resentment (नाराज़गी).
Antonyms: Peace (शांति), Calm (स्थिरता), Contentment (संतोष).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Repudiate
questionsEn.s:
Repudiate - परित्याग करना (Refuse to accept; reject the validity or authority of)
Reject - अस्वीकार करना (Dismiss as inadequate or inappropriate)
Disown - संबंध तोड़ना (Refuse to acknowledge or maintain connection with)
Deny - नकारना (State that something is not true)
Accept - स्वीकार करना (Consent to receive or undertake something)


Hence, 'Accept' is the most suitable antonym for 'Repudiate'.
oa:
This word means to dismiss as inadequate, inappropriate, or not to one's taste. It is a direct synonym for the given word in the sense of refusing to accept something.
Synonyms: Refuse (अस्वीकार करना), Discard (त्यागना), Decline (अस्वीकार करना).
Antonyms: Accept (स्वीकार करना), Welcome (स्वागत करना), Adopt (अपनाना).

This means to refuse to acknowledge or maintain any connection with. It is a synonym that describes a more personal form of repudiation.
Synonyms: Renounce (त्यागना), Abandon (छोड़ना), Forsake (परित्याग करना).
Antonyms: Claim (दावा करना), Acknowledge (मानना), Support (सहारा देना).

This word refers to the act of stating that something is not true or refusing to admit something. It is a synonym that focuses on the refusal to recognize the validity of a claim.
Synonyms: Contradict (खंडन करना), Refute (गलत ठहराना), Gainsay (अस्वीकार करना).
Antonyms: Admit (स्वीकार करना), Confess (कबूल करना), Validate (पुष्टि करना).

This word means to consent to receive or undertake something offered. It is the direct opposite of repudiating, which involves refusing to accept or have anything to do with.
Synonyms: Receive (प्राप्त करना), Embrace (अपनाना), Assent (सहमति देना).
Antonyms: Reject (रद्द करना), Deny (नकारना), Repudiate (त्यागना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Credulous
questionsEn.s:
Credulous - भोला (Having too great a readiness to believe things)
Trusting - भरोसा करनेवाला (Tendency to believe in others)
Skeptical - संदेही (Not easily convinced; having doubts)
Gullible - आसानी से धोखा खानेवाला (Easily persuaded to believe something)
Naive - अनुभवहीन (Lacking experience, wisdom, or judgment)


Hence, 'Skeptical' is the most suitable antonym for 'Credulous'.
oa:
This word refers to showing a tendency to have belief in the honesty or sincerity of others. It matches the core meaning of the given word and thus acts as a synonym.
Synonyms: Unsuspecting (शंकारहित), Reliant (भरोसेमंद), Gullible (भोला).
Antonyms: Suspicious (शंकालु), Skeptical (संदेही), Wary (सतर्क).

This word refers to not being easily convinced; having doubts or reservations. It is the most accurate antonym for being too ready to believe things.
Synonyms: Doubtful (संदेहपूर्ण), Cynical (कुटिल/अविश्वासी), Incredulous (अविश्वासी).
Antonyms: Belief (विश्वास), Credulous (भोला), Trusting (भरोसेमंद).

This refers to someone who is easily persuaded to believe something; being naive. It is a direct and common synonym for the question word.
Synonyms: Naive (नदान), Innocent (मासूम), Exploitable (शोषण के योग्य).
Antonyms: Astute (चतुर), Sharp (तेज़), Discerning (समझदार).

This word describes a person showing a lack of experience, wisdom, or judgment. It captures the underlying reason for being credulous, serving as its synonym.
Synonyms: Artless (सरल), Simple (सादा), Guileless (निष्कपट).
Antonyms: Sophisticated (जटिल), Experienced (अनुभवी), Wise (विद्वान).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Ineffable
questionsEn.s:
Ineffable - अवर्णनीय (Too great or extreme to be expressed in words)
Expressible - वर्णनीय (Capable of being described or put into words)
Inarticulate - अस्पष्ट (Unable to express oneself clearly)
Unfathomable - अथाह (Incapable of being fully understood)
Indescribable - अकथनीय (Too unusual or extreme to be described)


Hence, 'Expressible' is the most suitable antonym for 'Ineffable'.
oa:
This word refers to something that is capable of being put into words or described. It is the direct opposite of ineffable, which describes something too great to be expressed.
Synonyms: Describable (वर्णन योग्य), Definable (परिभाषित करने योग्य), Utterable (बोलने योग्य).
Antonyms: Ineffable (अवर्णनीय), Mysterious (रहस्यमय), Inexpressible (अकथनीय).

This describes someone who is unable to express oneself clearly or something that is not clearly pronounced. It is related to speech difficulties rather than the greatness of an emotion.
Synonyms: Unclear (अस्पष्ट), Silent (मौन), Mumbled (बुदबुदाया हुआ).
Antonyms: Articulate (सुस्पष्ट), Eloquent (वाकपटु), Fluent (धाराप्रवाह).

This word refers to something that is incapable of being fully explored or understood. While it shares a sense of vastness with the given word, it is more of a synonym than an opposite.
Synonyms: Incomprehensible (समझ से बाहर), Enigmatic (रहस्यमयी), Deep (गहरा).
Antonyms: Simple (साधारण), Clear (स्पष्ट), Understandable (सुगम).

This word means too unusual, extreme, or shocking to be adequately described. It is a direct synonym for the question word.
Synonyms: Unutterable (कथनातीत), Beyond words (शब्दों के परे), Incredible (अविश्वसनीय).
Antonyms: Ordinary (साधारण), Common (सामान्य), Mundane (नीरस).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Ignorance
questionsEn.s:
Ignorance - अज्ञानता (Lack of knowledge, information, or education)
Knowledge - ज्ञान (Facts, information, and skills acquired by a person)
Wisdom - बुद्धिमत्ता (The quality of having experience and good judgment)
Awareness - जागरूकता (Knowledge or perception of a situation or fact)
Understanding - समझ (The ability to comprehend or interpret something)


Hence, 'Knowledge' is the most suitable antonym for 'Ignorance'.
oa:
This word refers to facts, information, and skills acquired through experience or education. It is the direct and primary antonym for a lack of information or awareness.
Synonyms: Wisdom (बुद्धिमत्ता), Learning (शिक्षा), Erudition (विद्वत्ता).
Antonyms: Ignorance (अज्ञानता), Illiteracy (निरक्षरता), Folly (मूर्खता).

This refers to the quality of having experience, knowledge, and good judgment. While related to knowledge, it is a higher form of insight and acts as a synonym to the positive aspect of knowing.
Synonyms: Sagacity (दूरदर्शिता), Insight (अंतर्दृष्टि), Prudence (विवेक).
Antonyms: Stupidity (बेवकूफी), Foolishness (मूर्खता), Inexperience (अनुभवहीनता).

This refers to knowledge or perception of a situation or fact. It is a synonym that describes the opposite state of being ignorant or oblivious.
Synonyms: Consciousness (चेतना), Recognition (पहचान), Mindfulness (सतर्कता).
Antonyms: Ignorance (अज्ञान), Unconsciousness (अचेतनता), Oblivion (भूल).

This word refers to the ability to understand something; comprehension. It is a synonymous concept that implies the possession of knowledge or insight.
Synonyms: Comprehension (समझ), Grasp (पकड़/समझ), Discernment (विवेक).
Antonyms: Misunderstanding (गलतफहमी), Ignorance (अज्ञान), Confusion (भ्रम).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Iconoclast
questionsEn.s:
Iconoclast - मूर्तिभंजक (A person who attacks settled beliefs or institutions)
Critic - आलोचक (A person who expresses unfavorable opinions)
Rebel - विद्रोही (A person who resists authority or control)
Conformist - अनुपालन करनेवाला (A person who follows accepted rules or customs)
Dissenter - असहमत (A person who disagrees with majority opinion)


Hence, 'Conformist' is the most suitable antonym for 'Iconoclast'.
oa:
This word refers to a person who expresses an unfavorable opinion of something. Since an iconoclast is a person who criticizes established beliefs, this is a synonym.
Synonyms: Reviewer (समीक्षक), Detractor (निंदक), Analyst (विशेषक).
Antonyms: Supporter (समर्थक), Admirer (प्रशंसक), Advocate (पक्षधर).

This refers to a person who rises in opposition or armed resistance against an established government or ruler. It aligns with the iconoclast's resistance to norms, making it a synonym.
Synonyms: Revolutionary (क्रांतिकारी), Insurgent (विद्रोही), Mutineer (बागी).
Antonyms: Loyalist (राजभक्त), Follower (अनुयायी), Conformist (अनुपालन करने वाला).

This word refers to a person who conforms to accepted behavior or established practices. It is the direct opposite of an iconoclast, who seeks to break or challenge such norms.
Synonyms: Traditionalist (परंपरावादी), Follower (अनुगामी), Conservative (रूढ़िवादी).
Antonyms: Rebel (विद्रोही), Iconoclast (परंपराभंजक), Dissenter (असहमत).

This word refers to a person who dissents or disagrees with an established church, political party, or majority opinion. It is a synonym for the question word.
Synonyms: Nonconformist (अपरंपरावादी), Heretic (पाखंडी), Objector (आपत्तिकर्ता).
Antonyms: Believer (आस्तिक), Conformist (आज्ञाकारी), Supporter (समर्थक).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Upright
questionsEn.s:
Upright - ईमानदार (Strictly honorable or honest; vertically positioned)
Corrupt - भ्रष्ट (Willing to act dishonestly for personal gain)
Honest - सच्चा (Free of deceit; truthful and sincere)
Ethical - नैतिक (Relating to moral principles or conduct)
Noble - कुलीन/नेक (Having fine personal qualities or high moral principles)


Hence, 'Corrupt' is the most suitable antonym for 'Upright'.
oa:
This word refers to being willing to act dishonestly in return for money or personal gain. It is the direct opposite of being strictly honorable or honest.
Synonyms: Dishonest (बेईमान), Venal (भ्रष्ट), Crooked (कुटिल).
Antonyms: Upright (ईमानदार), Ethical (नैतिक), Honest (सच्चा).

This word refers to being free of deceit and untruthfulness; sincere. It is a primary synonym for being upright and does not serve as an antonym.
Synonyms: Veracious (सत्यवादी), Forthright (साफगो), Direct (सीधा).
Antonyms: Deceitful (धोखेबाज़), Dishonest (बेईमान), Mendacious (मिथ्यावादी).

This refers to relating to moral principles or the branch of knowledge dealing with these. It is a synonymous trait for someone who is described as upright.
Synonyms: Moral (नैतिक), Principled (सैद्धांतिक), Righteous (धर्मी).
Antonyms: Immoral (अनैतिक), Unethical (नीतिहीन), Wrong (गलत).

This word refers to having or showing fine personal qualities or high moral principles. It serves as a synonym as it captures the honorable nature of being upright.
Synonyms: Virtuous (सदाचारी), Dignified (गरिमापूर्ण), Worthy (योग्य).
Antonyms: Ignoble (नीच), Base (घटिया), Mean (तुच्छ).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Gregarious
questionsEn.s:
Gregarious - मिलनसार (Fond of company; sociable)
Sociable - सामाजिक (Willing to engage in activities with others)
Solitary - अकेला/एकांतप्रिय (Done or existing alone; enjoying solitude)
Friendly - मित्रवत (Kind and pleasant)
Outgoing - मिलनसार (Friendly and socially confident)


Hence, 'Solitary' is the most suitable antonym for 'Gregarious'.
oa:
This word refers to a person who is willing to talk and engage in activities with other people; companionable. It is a direct synonym for the given word.
Synonyms: Affable (मिलनसार), Extroverted (बहिर्मुखी), Outgoing (सामाजिक).
Antonyms: Unsociable (असामाजिक), Aloof (अलग-थलग), Reserved (संकोची).

This word refers to a person or thing that is done or existing alone; enjoying being alone. It is the direct opposite of being gregarious or fond of company.
Synonyms: Reclusive (वैरागी), Isolated (अकेला), Lonely (एकांत).
Antonyms: Sociable (मिलनसार), Gregarious (सामाजिक), Popular (लोकप्रिय).

This describes someone who is kind and pleasant toward others. It is a synonym that captures the positive social interaction implied by being gregarious.
Synonyms: Amiable (सुशील), Cordial (मैत्रीपूर्ण), Genial (खुशमिजाज).
Antonyms: Hostile (शत्रुतापूर्ण), Unfriendly (अमैत्रीपूर्ण), Grumpy (चिड़चिड़ा).

This word refers to someone who is friendly and socially confident. It is a common synonym for gregarious individuals who thrive in groups.
Synonyms: Extroverted (बहिर्मुखी), Social (सामाजिक), Unreserved (बेबाक).
Antonyms: Introverted (अंतर्मुखी), Shy (शर्मीला), Timid (दब्बू).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Ponderous
questionsEn.s:
Ponderous - बोझिल (Slow and clumsy because of great weight)
Clumsy - अनाड़ी (Awkward in movement or in handling things)
Light - हल्का (Having little weight; easy to lift or move)
Heavy - भारी (Of great weight; difficult to move)
Slow - धीमा (Moving or operating at a low speed)


Hence, 'Light' is the most suitable antonym for 'Ponderous'.
oa:
This word refers to being awkward in movement or in handling things. Since it is a characteristic of being ponderous (slow and heavy), it functions as a synonym.
Synonyms: Gauche (फूहड़), Awkward (भद्दा), Ungainly (अनाड़ी).
Antonyms: Graceful (सुरुचिपूर्ण), Adroit (निपुण), Skillful (कुशल).

This word refers to something having little weight or being easy to move. it is the direct and most accurate antonym for something that is slow and heavy.
Synonyms: Weightless (भारहीन), Airy (हल्का), Featherweight (बहुत हल्का).
Antonyms: Heavy (भारी), Ponderous ( बोझिल), Burdensome (भारी).

This describes something that is of great weight; difficult to lift or move. It is a direct synonym for the given word and cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Massive (विशाल), Weighty (वज़नी), Hefty (भारी-भरकम).
Antonyms: Light (हल्का), Slight (मामूली), Thin (पतला).

This word refers to moving or operating at a low speed. It is a synonymous trait for ponderous things, which are slow due to their great weight.
Synonyms: Sluggish (सुस्त), Leisured (धीमा), Dilatory (विलंबकारी).
Antonyms: Fast (तेज़), Quick (फुर्तीला), Rapid (तीव्र).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Connive
questionsEn.s:
Connive - मिलीभगत करना (Secretly allow a wrongdoing to occur)
Support - समर्थन (Give assistance to or back someone)
Oppose - विरोध करना (Disagree with and attempt to prevent)
Motivate - प्रेरित करना (Provide a reason for doing something)
Reject - अस्वीकार करना (Dismiss as inadequate or inappropriate)


Hence, 'Oppose' is the most suitable antonym for 'Connive'.
oa:
This word means to give assistance to or be in agreement with. While conniving involves a form of "secret support," this word is too general and positive to be a direct antonym.
Synonyms: Assist (मदद करना), Aid (सहायता देना), Back (समर्थन करना).
Antonyms: Oppose (विरोध करना), Block (बाधा डालना), Hinder (रोकना).

This word means to disagree with and attempt to prevent, especially by argument or force. It is the logical opposite of conniving, which involves secretly allowing or cooperating in wrongdoing.
Synonyms: Resist (प्रतिरोध करना), Combat (मुकाबला करना), Defy (अवहेलना करना).
Antonyms: Agree (सहमत होना), Support (समर्थन करना), Connive (मिलनसार होना).

This refers to providing someone with a reason for doing something. It is contextually unrelated to the act of conspiring or allowing illegal acts.
Synonyms: Inspire (प्रेरित करना), Stimulate (उत्तेजित करना), Encourage (प्रोत्साहित करना).
Antonyms: Discourage (हतोत्साहित करना), Deter (रोकना), Dissuade (मना करना).

This word means to dismiss as inadequate, inappropriate, or not to one's taste. It functions as a synonym in the context of refusing to be part of a plan, but 'oppose' is stronger.
Synonyms: Refuse (अस्वीकार करना), Decline (नकारना), Spurn (तिरस्कार करना).
Antonyms: Accept (स्वीकार करना), Approve (मंजूरी देना), Sanction (अनुमोदन करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Futile
questionsEn.s:
Futile - व्यर्थ (Incapable of producing any useful result; pointless)
Useless - बेकार (Not fulfilling any intended purpose)
Pointless - निरर्थक (Having little or no sense or purpose)
Effective - प्रभावी (Successful in producing an intended result)
Vain - व्यर्थ/घमंडी (Producing no result; useless)


Hence, 'Effective' is the most suitable antonym for 'Futile'.
oa:
This word refers to not fulfilling or not being expected to fulfill any intended purpose or desired outcome. it is a direct synonym for the given word.
Synonyms: Worthless (बेकार), Vain (व्यर्थ), Pointless (निरर्थक).
Antonyms: Useful (उपयोगी), Effective (प्रभावी), Fruitful (सार्थक).

This refers to having no little or no sense, use, or purpose. It captures the essence of being futile and serves as a synonym.
Synonyms: Senseless (बेमतलब), Aimless (उद्देश्यहीन), Inane (निरर्थक).
Antonyms: Meaningful (सार्थक), Purposeful (उद्देश्यपूर्ण), Relevant (प्रासंगिक).

This word refers to being successful in producing a desired or intended result. It is the direct opposite of being futile or useless.
Synonyms: Productive (उत्पादक), Potent (शक्तिशाली), Fruitful (सफल).
Antonyms: Futile (व्यर्थ), Ineffective (अक्षम), Useless (बेकार).

This describes something that is producing no result; useless. It is an exact synonym for futile, often used in phrases like "in vain."
Synonyms: Bootless (व्यर्थ), Fruitless (निष्फल), Nugatory (नगण्य).
Antonyms: Successful (कामयाब), Effective (प्रभावी), Worthwhile (सार्थक).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Garrulous
questionsEn.s:
Garrulous - बातूनी (Excessively talkative, especially on trivial matters)
Talkative - वाचाल (Fond of or given to talking)
Loquacious - बातूनी (Tending to talk a great deal)
Quiet - शांत/चुप (Making little or no noise; saying very little)
Chatty - मिलनसार/गप्पी (Fond of making conversation)


Hence, 'Quiet' is the most suitable antonym for 'Garrulous'.
oa:
This word refers to a person who is fond of or given to talking. It is the core meaning of the given word and acts as its primary synonym.
Synonyms: Loquacious (वाचाल), Chatty (गप्पी), Voluble (वाक्पटु).
Antonyms: Quiet (शांत), Silent (मौन), Reserved (मितभाषी).

This word describes someone who tends to talk a great deal; talkative. It is a more formal synonym for being garrulous.
Synonyms: Gabby (बातूनी), Mouthy (मुँहफट), Garrulous (वाचाल).
Antonyms: Taciturn (अल्पभाषी), Reticent (संकोची), Brief (संक्षिप्त).

This word refers to a person who makes little or no noise or someone who does not talk much. It is the perfect antonym for someone who is excessively talkative.
Synonyms: Silent (मौन), Reticent (मितभाषी), Taciturn (अल्पभाषी).
Antonyms: Noisy (शोर वाला), Loud (ज़ोरदार), Garrulous (बातूनी).

This is an informal word for being fond of making conversation. It functions as a synonym that describes a friendly but excessively talkative nature.
Synonyms: Conversational (संवादात्मक), Gossipy (गप्पी), Talkative (बातूनी).
Antonyms: Taciturn (मौन), Introverted (अंतर्मुखी), Reserved (संकोची).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Profuse
questionsEn.s:
Profuse - प्रचुर (Especially of something offered or discharged)
Copious - प्रचुर (Abundant in supply or quantity)
Abundant - भरपूर (Existing or available in large quantities)
Scarce - दुर्लभ (Insufficient for the demand; small in amount)
Plentiful - पर्याप्त (Existing in or yielding great quantities)


Hence, 'Scarce' is the most suitable antonym for 'Profuse'.
oa:
This word refers to something that is abundant in supply or quantity. It is a direct synonym for the given word's meaning of being plentiful.
Synonyms: Abundant (प्रचुर), Ample (पर्याप्त), Plentiful (भरपूर).
Antonyms: Sparse (कम), Meager (अल्प), Scanty (कम).

This describes something that exists or is available in large quantities; plentiful. It functions as a near-perfect synonym for being profuse.
Synonyms: Profuse (अत्यधिक), Bountiful (भरपूर), Lavish (शानदार).
Antonyms: Scarce (दुर्लभ), Rare (अनोखा), Deficient (अपूर्ण).

This word refers to something that is insufficient for the demand; occurring in small amounts. It is the direct opposite of being abundant or profuse.
Synonyms: Scant (अल्प), Rare (दुर्लभ), Sparse (छिटपुट).
Antonyms: Profuse (प्रचुर), Plentiful (भरपूर), Copious (अत्यधिक).

This refers to something existing in or yielding great quantities; abundant. It is a synonym that describes the exact same condition as profuse.
Synonyms: Copious (भरपूर), Liberal (उदार), Munificent (दानी).
Antonyms: Scanty (कम), Small (छोटा), Limited (सीमित).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Innocuous
questionsEn.s:
Innocuous - अहानिकारक (Not harmful or offensive)
Harmless - निरापद (Not able or likely to cause harm)
Benign - सौम्य (Gentle and kindly; not harmful in effect)
Harmful - हानिकारक (Causing or likely to cause harm)
Safe - सुरक्षित (Not exposed to danger or risk)


Hence, 'Harmful' is the most suitable antonym for 'Innocuous'.
oa:
This word describes something that is not able or likely to cause harm. It is the literal definition and primary synonym of the given word.
Synonyms: Safe (सुरक्षित), Innocent (मासूम), Benign (अहानिकारक).
Antonyms: Harmful (हानिकारक), Dangerous (खतरनाक), Toxic (विषैला).

This describes something that is gentle and kindly or, in medicine, not harmful in effect. It serves as a synonym that focuses on the non-threatening nature of something.
Synonyms: Gentle (सौम्य), Mild (हल्का), Amiable (सुशील).
Antonyms: Malignant (घातक), Harsh (कठोर), Evil (बुरा).

This word refers to something that causes or is likely to cause harm, injury, or damage. it is the direct and most accurate antonym for something that is safe or harmless.
Synonyms: Pernicious (घातक), Deleterious (नुकसानदेह), Toxic (विषैला).
Antonyms: Innocuous (अहानिकारक), Safe (सुरक्षित), Beneficial (लाभदायक).

This describes something that is protected from or not exposed to danger or risk; not likely to cause harm. It is a strong synonym for being innocuous.
Synonyms: Secure (निश्चिंत), Protected (आरक्षित), Dependable (भरोसेमंद).
Antonyms: Hazardous (जोखिम भरा), Precarious (असुरक्षित), Risky (खतरनाक).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Esoteric
questionsEn.s:
Esoteric - गूढ़ (Intended for or understood by only a few)
Arcane - रहस्यमय (Understood by few; mysterious or secret)
Common - सामान्य (Occurring, found, or done often; prevalent)
Mystical - रहस्यवादी (Relating to mysticism or hidden spiritual meaning)
Obscure - धुंधला (Not discovered or known about; uncertain)


Hence, 'Common' is the most suitable antonym for 'Esoteric'.
oa:
This word refers to something that is understood by few; mysterious or secret. It is a direct synonym for esoteric as both describe specialized knowledge.
Synonyms: Recondite (गूढ़), Obscure (अस्पष्ट), Occult (गुप्त).
Antonyms: Common (आम), Known (ज्ञात), Plain (सादा).

This word refers to something occurring, found, or done often; prevalent. It is the direct opposite of knowledge or things that are hidden or understood only by a few.
Synonyms: General (सामान्य), Ordinary (साधारण), Familiar (परिचित).
Antonyms: Esoteric (गूढ़), Rare (दुर्लभ), Unusual (असामान्य).

This describes something relating to mystics or religious mysticism. While it involves secret or deep meaning, it is essentially a synonym in the context of being hidden from common understanding.
Synonyms: Spiritual (आध्यात्मिक), Transcendent (उत्कृष्ट), Cryptic (गुप्त).
Antonyms: Logical (तार्किक), Empirical (प्रायोगिक), Ordinary (सामान्य).

This word refers to something that is not discovered or known about; uncertain. It serves as a synonym as both words describe things that are not easily accessible to the public.
Synonyms: Vague (अस्पष्ट), Ambiguous (अनेकार्थक), Hidden (छिपा हुआ).
Antonyms: Clear (स्पष्ट), Obvious (ज़ाहिर), Well-known (प्रसिद्ध).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Tacit
questionsEn.s:
Tacit - मौन (Understood or implied without being stated)
Implicit - अंतर्निहित (Suggested though not directly expressed)
Unstated - अनकहा (Not said or written)
Explicit - सुस्पष्ट (Stated clearly and in detail)
Understood - समझा हुआ (Perceived the intended meaning)


Hence, 'Explicit' is the most suitable antonym for 'Tacit'.
oa:
This word refers to something suggested though not directly expressed. It is the primary synonym for the given word and cannot be its antonym.
Synonyms: Inherent (अंतर्निहित), Understood (समझा हुआ), Latent (गुप्त).
Antonyms: Explicit (सुस्पष्ट), Stated (कहा हुआ), Direct (सीधा).

This refers to something not said or written. It matches the "silent" or "implied" nature of the given word and thus acts as a synonym.
Synonyms: Wordless (बिना शब्दों के), Silent (मौन), Undeclared (अघोषित).
Antonyms: Spoken (कहा हुआ), Declared (घोषित), Written (लिखित).

This word refers to something stated clearly and in detail, leaving no room for confusion or doubt. It is the direct opposite of being implied or tacit.
Synonyms: Clear (स्पष्ट), Precise (सटीक), Specific (विशिष्ट).
Antonyms: Implicit (अंतर्निहित), Tacit (मौन), Vague (अस्पष्ट).

This refers to something that is perceived or intended though not expressed. It serves as a synonym because a tacit agreement is one that is understood without being spoken.
Synonyms: Comprehended (समझा हुआ), Assumed (माना हुआ), Agreed (सहमत).
Antonyms: Misinterpreted (गलत समझा), Unknown (अज्ञात), Explicit (स्पष्ट).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Felicitous
questionsEn.s:

Fortunate - भाग्यशाली (Happening by a lucky chance)
Unfortunate - दुर्भाग्यपूर्ण (Marked by bad luck; unsuitable)
Happy - खुश (Feeling or showing pleasure or contentment)
Appropriate - उपयुक्त (Suitable or proper in the circumstances)


Hence, 'Unfortunate' is the most suitable antonym for 'Felicitous'.
oa:
This word refers to happening by a lucky chance; lucky. It aligns with the positive and apt nature of the given word, acting as a synonym.
Synonyms: Lucky (भाग्यशाली), Successful (सफल), Prosperous (समृद्ध).
Antonyms: Unfortunate (दुर्भाग्यपूर्ण), Disastrous (विनाशकारी), Poor (बेचारा).

This word refers to something marked by bad luck or being unsuitable. it is the most appropriate opposite for 'felicitous', which means well-chosen or pleasing.
Synonyms: Unlucky (अभागा), Ill-fated (बदनसीब), Untoward (अप्रिय).
Antonyms: Felicitous (सुखद), Happy (खुश), Favorable (अनुकूल).

This refers to feeling or showing pleasure or contentment. It is a synonymous concept to the "pleasing" aspect of being felicitous.
Synonyms: Glad (प्रसन्न), Cheerful (हंसमुख), Joyful (आनंदित).
Antonyms: Sad (उदास), Gloomy (निराशाजनक), Miserable (अति दुखी).

This describes something that is suitable or proper in the circumstances. It is a direct synonym for the given word's meaning of being well-chosen or apt.
Synonyms: Fitting (उचित), Apt (उपयुक्त), Relevant (प्रासंगिक).
Antonyms: Inappropriate (अनुचित), Unsuitable (अयोग्य), Improper (गलत).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Sporadic
questionsEn.s:
Sporadic - छिटपुट (Occurring at irregular intervals; scattered)
Infrequent - विरल (Not occurring often)

Frequent - बार-बार होनेवाला (Occurring or done many times)
Intermittent - रुक-रुक कर (Not continuous or steady)


Hence, 'Frequent' is the most suitable antonym for 'Sporadic'.
oa:
This word refers to something not occurring often; occasional. It is a primary synonym for the question word, as both describe things that happen irregularly.
Synonyms: Rare (दुर्लभ), Scant (अल्प), Unperiodic (अनियमित).
Antonyms: Frequent (लगातार), Habitual (आदतन), Often (अक्सर).

This word refers to something occurring, appearing, or done infrequently and irregularly. It perfectly matches the definition of being sporadic, making it a synonym.
Synonyms: Periodic (छिटपुट), Casual (कभी-कभार), Incident (आकस्मिक).
Antonyms: Constant (निरंतर), Regular (नियमित), Persistent (दृढ़).

This word refers to something occurring or done on many occasions, in many cases, or in quick succession. It is the direct opposite of being sporadic or occurring at irregular intervals.
Synonyms: Recurrent (पुनरावर्ती), Repeated (बार-बार होने वाला), Common (आम).
Antonyms: Rare (दुर्लभ), Sporadic (छिटपुट), Isolated (अलग-थलग).

This describes something occurring at irregular intervals; not continuous or steady. It is an exact synonym for the question word.
Synonyms: Spasmodic (रुक-रुक कर), Fitful (अस्थिर), Fragmentary (खंडित).
Antonyms: Continuous (लगातार), Steady (स्थिर), Uninterrupted (अबाध).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Fastidious

Antonyms: Careless (लापरवाह), Sloppy (गंदा/ढीला), Casual (अनौपचारिक).

This word refers to something done in a careless and unsystematic way. It is the direct and most accurate antonym for someone who is very attentive to detail or fastidious.
Synonyms: Careless (असावधान), Haphazard (अव्यवस्थित), Slapdash (जल्दबाज़).
Antonyms: Precise (सटीक), Neat (साफ़-सुथरा), Fastidious (नखरेबाज़).

This refers to someone who is fastidious about one's needs or requirements; hard to please. it is a direct synonym for the given word.
Synonyms: Finicky (नकचढ़ा), Particular (विशेष), Choosy (चुनने वाला).
Antonyms: Easygoing (मिलनसार), Relaxed (निश्चिंत), Indifferent (उदासीन).

This word describes having or showing sensitive insight. While it relates to a keen sense of observation, it is not the logical opposite of being fastidious.
Synonyms: Discerning (विवेकी), Insightful (सूक्ष्मदर्शी), Astute (चतुर).
Antonyms: Obtuse (मंदबुद्धि), Ignorant (अज्ञानी), Dull (सुस्त).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: BRAWNY
questionsEn.s:

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Retired
questionsEn.s:

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Veracity
questionsEn.s:

oa:

This refers to the quality or state of being true. It is the definition and primary synonym of the question word, making it inappropriate as an antonym.

This word refers to the quality or state of being correct or precise. It functions as a synonym because truthful information must also be accurate.

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Immutable

Antonyms: Immutable (अपरिवर्तनीय), Fixed (तय), Rigid (कठोर).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Debacle

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Extinguished

Distant - दूर (Far away in space or time; not closely related)
Close - निकट (Only a short distance away; intimate)
Familiar - परिचित (Well known from close association)
Personal - व्यक्तिगत (Affecting a particular person rather than anyone else)


Hence, 'Distant' is the most suitable antonym for 'Intimate'.
oa:
This word describes someone or something far away in space or time, or not closely related. It is the direct opposite of being closely acquainted or familiar.
Synonyms: Remote (दूरस्थ), Aloof (अलग-थलग), Detached (निष्पक्ष/अलग).
Antonyms: Intimate (घनिष्ठ), Close (निकट), Near (पास).

This word refers to being only a short distance away or having a strong relationship. It is a primary synonym for the given word.
Synonyms: Near (निकट), Familiar (परिचित), Dear (प्रिय).
Antonyms: Far (दूर), Distant (दूर), Remote (दूरस्थ).

This word describes someone or something well known from long or close association. It is a synonym that captures the essence of intimacy.
Synonyms: Acquainted (परिचित), Common (सामान्य), Recognized (मान्यता प्राप्त).
Antonyms: Strange (अजीब), Unknown (अज्ञात), Foreign (विदेशी).

This refers to belonging to or affecting a particular person rather than anyone else. It is a synonymous concept as intimate relationships are also highly personal.
Synonyms: Private (निजी), Individual (व्यक्तिगत), Confidential (गोपनीय).
Antonyms: Public (सार्वजनिक), General (सामान्य), Universal (सार्वभौमिक).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Chicanery
questionsEn.s:
Chicanery - छल-कपट (The use of trickery to achieve a purpose)
Deceit - धोखा (Action of deceiving someone by misrepresenting truth)
Honesty - ईमानदारी (Quality of being free of deceit; truthfulness)
Trickery - चालाकी (The practice of using deceptive methods)
Subterfuge - बहाना/छल (Deceit used in order to achieve one's goal)


Hence, 'Honesty' is the most suitable antonym for 'Chicanery'.
oa:
This word refers to the action or practice of deceiving someone by concealing or misrepresenting the truth. it is a direct synonym for the given word.
Synonyms: Deception (छल), Duplicity (कपट), Fraud (धोखाधड़ी).
Antonyms: Honesty (ईमानदारी), Candor (साफगोई), Sincerity (सच्चाई).

This word refers to the quality of being honest; free of deceit and untruthfulness. it is the direct opposite of using trickery or chicanery.
Synonyms: Integrity (सच्चाई), Uprightness (ईमानदारी), Probity (नैतिकता).
Antonyms: Deceit (छल), Chicanery (धोखेबाज़ी), Guile (धूर्तता).

This is the practice of using deceptive methods to cheat or outwit someone. It is another direct synonym for chicanery.
Synonyms: Subterfuge (छल), Artifice (चालाकी), Guile (धूर्तता).
Antonyms: Fairness (निष्पक्षता), Openness (खुलापन), Directness (सीधापन).

This word refers to deceit used in order to achieve one's goal. It functions as a synonym that describes a similar dishonest strategy.
Synonyms: Evasion (टाल-मटोल), Stratagem (चाल), Maneuver (पैंतरेबाज़ी).
Antonyms: Frankness (साफगोई), Sincerity (सच्चाई), Candor (स्पष्टवादिता).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Condemned
questionsEn.s:
Condemned - निंदित (Expressed complete disapproval of; sentenced)
Praised - प्रशंसित (Expressed warm approval or admiration)
Blamed - दोषी ठहराया (Assigned responsibility for a fault)
Cursed - शापित (Deserving of a curse; extremely unfortunate)
Jinxed - अभागा (Bringing or accompanied by bad luck)


Hence, 'Praised' is the most suitable antonym for 'Condemned'.
oa:
This word means to express warm approval or admiration of someone. It is the direct opposite of being condemned, which means to be strongly disapproved of.
Synonyms: Applauded (सराहना), Commended (प्रशंसित), Acclaimed (प्रशंसित).
Antonyms: Criticized (आलोचना), Condemned (निंदा), Blamed (दोषी).

This word refers to having responsibility assigned for a fault or wrong. It functions as a synonym for being condemned in a judgmental context.
Synonyms: Accused (आरोपित), Rebuked (फटकार), Reproached (तिरस्कृत).
Antonyms: Forgiven (माफ किया), Absolved (दोषमुक्त), Praised (प्रशंसित).

This refers to being under a curse or deserving of a curse; used to express strong dislike. It is a synonym that describes a severe negative judgment.
Synonyms: Damned (शापित), Execrated (घृणित), Ill-fated (अभागा).
Antonyms: Blessed (धन्य), Fortunate (भाग्यशाली), Favored (पसंदीदा).

This describes someone who is bringing or accompanied by bad luck. While negative, it refers to luck rather than formal disapproval, making it contextually different.
Synonyms: Hexed (शापित), Unlucky (बदनसीब), Ill-starred (दुर्भाग्यपूर्ण).
Antonyms: Lucky (भाग्यशाली), Successful (कामयाब), Fortunate (खुशनसीब).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Belligerent
questionsEn.s:
Belligerent - लड़ाकू (Hostile and aggressive; engaged in a war)
Aggressive - आक्रामक (Ready or likely to attack or confront)
Hostile - शत्रुतापूर्ण (Unfriendly; antagonistic)
Peaceful - शांतिपूर्ण (Free from disturbance; not involving violence)
Combative - युद्धप्रिय (Ready or eager to fight)


Hence, 'Peaceful' is the most suitable antonym for 'Belligerent'.
oa:
This word refers to being ready or likely to attack or confront; characterized by aggression. it is a direct synonym for being belligerent.
Synonyms: Hostile (शत्रुतापूर्ण), Bellicose (लड़ाकू), Pugnacious (झगड़ालू).
Antonyms: Peaceful (शांतिपूर्ण), Gentle (कोमल), Meek (दब्बू).

This word refers to being unfriendly or antagonistic; of or belonging to an enemy. It functions as a synonym for the combative nature of the question word.
Synonyms: Antagonistic (विरोधी), Adverse (विपरीत), Malicious (दुर्भावनापूर्ण).
Antonyms: Friendly (मिलनसार), Amiable (सुशील), Cordial (मैत्रीपूर्ण).

This word refers to being free from disturbance; tranquil or not involving war or violence. It is the most appropriate opposite for someone who is hostile or aggressive.
Synonyms: Tranquil (शांत), Pacific (शांतिप्रिय), Non-violent (अहिंसक).
Antonyms: Belligerent (लड़ाकू), Aggressive (आक्रामक), Violent (हिंसक).

This refers to being ready or eager to fight; pugnacious. It is a strong synonym for someone who is belligerent.
Synonyms: Quarralsome (झगड़ालू), Militant (जुझारू), Feisty (जोशीला).
Antonyms: Submissive (दब्बू), Yielding (झुकने वाला), Compliant (आज्ञाकारी).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Disgracers
questionsEn.s:
Disgracers - अपमान करनेवाले (Those who bring shame or dishonor)
Honorees - सम्मानित व्यक्ति (People who receive an award or recognition)
Outcasts - जातिच्युत (People rejected by society or a social group)
Rejects - अस्वीकृत (People dismissed as inadequate or inappropriate)
Insulters - अपमानकर्ता (People who treat someone with disrespect)


Hence, 'Honorees' is the most suitable antonym for 'Disgracers'.
oa:
This word refers to people who receive an award or special recognition. They are the direct opposite of disgracers, who bring shame or dishonor.
Synonyms: Awardees (पुरस्कार विजेता), Celebrants (उत्सव मनाने वाले), Dignitaries (विशिष्ट व्यक्ति).
Antonyms: Disgracers (अपमानित करने वाले), Outcasts (बहिष्कृत), Rejects (अस्वीकृत).

This refers to people who have been rejected by society or a social group. It describes a state similar to being disgraced, making it a synonym.
Synonyms: Exile (निर्वासित), Pariah (अछूत), Outsider (बाहरी व्यक्ति).
Antonyms: Insiders (अंदरूनी व्यक्ति), Members (सदस्य), Accepted (स्वीकृत).

This refers to people or things dismissed as inadequate or inappropriate. It is synonymous with those who are not honored or accepted.
Synonyms: Refusals (अस्वीकृतियां), Cast-offs (त्यागे हुए), Failure (असफलता).
Antonyms: Selections (चयन), Choices (विकल्प), Honorees (सम्मानित व्यक्ति).

This word refers to people who speak to or treat someone with disrespect or scorn. it is a direct synonym for disgracers, as both involve demeaning behavior.
Synonyms: Offender (अपराधी), Scoffer (उपहासक), Reviler (गाली देने वाला).
Antonyms: Praisers (प्रशंसा करने वाले), Admirers (प्रशंसक), Flatterers (चापलूस).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Sublime
questionsEn.s:
Sublime - उत्कृष्ट/भव्य (Of such excellence, grandeur, or beauty)
Mediocre - साधारण (Of only moderate quality; not very good)
Exalted - उच्च (Placed at a high or powerful level; noble)
Glorious - शानदार (Having or deserving glory; very impressive)
Supreme - सर्वोच्च (Highest in rank or authority; greatest)


Hence, 'Mediocre' is the most suitable antonym for 'Sublime'.
oa:
This word refers to something that is of only moderate quality; not very good. It is the direct opposite of being sublime, which refers to something of very great excellence or beauty.
Synonyms: Ordinary (साधारण), Average (औसत), Commonplace (मामूली).
Antonyms: Excellent (उत्कृष्ट), Sublime (भव्य), Exceptional (असाधारण).

This word refers to something placed at a high or powerful level; held in high regard. it is a direct synonym for the lofty nature of the given word.
Synonyms: Lofty (ऊँचा), Elevated (उच्च), Grand (भव्य).
Antonyms: Base (नीच), Humble (विनीत), Lowly (साधारण).

This refers to something having or deserving glory; very beautiful or impressive. It functions as a synonym describing the impressive quality of the given word.
Synonyms: Splendid (शानदार), Brilliant (दीप्तिमान), Magnificent (भव्य).
Antonyms: Terrible (भयानक), Horrible (भयानक), Awful (अति बुरा).

This word describes something that is highest in rank or authority; very great or greatest. It matches the "superior" meaning of sublime, making it a synonym.
Synonyms: Utmost (चरम), Paramount (सर्वोच्च), Peerless (अद्वितीय).
Antonyms: Inferior (अवर), Secondary (माध्यमिक), Minor (मामूली).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Candid
questionsEn.s:
Candid - स्पष्टवादी (Truthful and straightforward; frank)
Sincere - ईमानदार (Free from pretense or deceit; genuine)
Honest - सच्चा (Free of deceit and untruthfulness)
Evasive - टालनेवाला (Directed toward avoidance; not direct)
Frank - साफ़गो (Open, sincere, or undisguised in manner)


Hence, 'Evasive' is the most suitable antonym for 'Candid'.
oa:
This word refers to being free from pretense or deceit; proceeding from genuine feelings. It is a direct synonym for being candid or open.
Synonyms: Heartfelt (हार्दिक), Honest (ईमानदार), Genuine (असली).
Antonyms: Fake (बनावटी), Insincere (दिखावटी), False (झूठा).

This word refers to being free of deceit and untruthfulness; sincere. It is the most common synonym for the question word and describes the same direct behavior.
Synonyms: Truthful (सत्यवादी), Trustworthy (भरोसेमंद), Ethical (नैतिक).
Antonyms: Deceitful (धोखेबाज़), Shady (संदिग्ध), Crooked (कुटिल).

This word refers to being directed toward avoidance or escape; not being direct. It is the direct opposite of being candid, which involves being open and frank.
Synonyms: Ambiguous (अस्पष्ट), Elusive (मायावी), Shifty (धूर्त).
Antonyms: Direct (सीधा), Candid (साफगो), Honest (सच्चा).

This describes someone who is open, sincere, or undisguised in manner or appearance. It is an exact synonym for the given word.
Synonyms: Blunt (मुँहफट), Direct (स्पष्ट), Open (खुला).
Antonyms: Secretive (गुप्त), Evasive (गोल-मोल), Reserved (मितभाषी).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Celerity
questionsEn.s:
Celerity - शीघ्रता (Swiftness of movement; speed)
Slowness - धीमापन (The quality or state of being slow)
Speed - गति (The rate at which something moves or operates)
Rapid - तीव्र (Happening in a short time or at a fast pace)
Quick - तेज़ (Moving fast or doing something in a short time)


Hence, 'Slowness' is the most suitable antonym for 'Celerity'.
oa:
This word refers to the quality or state of being slow. It is the direct and most appropriate opposite for celerity, which means swiftness or speed.
Synonyms: Tardiness (मंदी), Delay (देरी), Leisureliness (धीमापन).
Antonyms: Speed (गति), Celerity (शीघ्रता), Velocity (वेग).

This word refers to the rate at which someone or something is able to move or operate. It is the literal definition and primary synonym of the question word.
Synonyms: Velocity (वेग), Quickness (फुर्ती), Rapidness (तेजी).
Antonyms: Slowess (धीमापन), Stagnation (जड़ता), Delay (देरी).

This describes something happening in a short time or at a fast pace. Since it relates to speed, it functions as a synonym rather than an opposite.
Synonyms: Swift (तीव्र), Fast (तेज़), Brisk (फुर्तीला).
Antonyms: Slow (धीमा), Gradual (क्रमिक), Sluggish (सुस्त).

This word refers to moving fast or doing something in a short time. It is a common synonym for the state of celerity.
Synonyms: Prompt (तत्पर), Hasty (जल्दबाज़), Sudden (अचानक).
Antonyms: Deliberate (सोचा-समझा), Slow (मंद), Laggard (पिछड़ा).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Amplify
questionsEn.s:
Amplify - बढ़ाना (Enlarge or increase; increase the volume of)
Expand - विस्तार करना (Become or make larger or more extensive)
Magnify - बड़ा करना (Make appear larger than it is; exaggerate)
Reduce - कम करना (Make smaller or less in amount or size)
Increase - वृद्धि करना (Become or make greater in size or degree)


Hence, 'Reduce' is the most suitable antonym for 'Amplify'.
oa:
This word refers to becoming or making larger or more extensive. it is a direct synonym for the given word's meaning of increasing volume or size.
Synonyms: Enlarge (विस्तार करना), Extend (बढ़ाना), Broaden (व्यापक बनाना).
Antonyms: Shrink (सिकुड़ना), Contract (सिकुड़ना), Abbreviate (संक्षिप्त करना).

This means to make something appear larger than it is, especially with a lens or by exaggeration. It functions as a synonym describing an increase in scale.
Synonyms: Aggrandize (बढ़ाना), Boost (बढ़ाना), Exaggerate (बढ़ा-चढ़ाकर कहना).
Antonyms: Diminish (घटाना), Minimize (कम करना), Belittle (तुच्छ समझना).

This word means to make smaller or less in amount, degree, or size. It is the direct opposite of amplifying or increasing something.
Synonyms: Decrease (घटाना), Abate (कम करना), Curtail (छोटा करना).
Antonyms: Increase (बढ़ाना), Amplify (बढ़ाना), Augment (बढ़ाना).

This refers to becoming or making greater in size, amount, intensity, or degree. It is the primary definition and synonym of the given word.
Synonyms: Augment (बढ़ाना), Raise (ऊंचा करना), Grow (उगाना/बढ़ना).
Antonyms: Decrease (घटाना), Decline (पतन/गिरावट), Dwindle (कम होना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Trivial
questionsEn.s:
Trivial - तुच्छ (Of little value or importance)
Insignificant - नगण्य (Too small or unimportant to be worth consideration)
Minor - छोटा/गौण (Lesser in importance or significance)
Important - महत्वपूर्ण (Of great significance or value)
Commonplace - मामूली (Not unusual; ordinary; lack of uniqueness)


Hence, 'Important' is the most suitable antonym for 'Trivial'.
oa:
This word refers to something too small or unimportant to be worth consideration. It is a direct and exact synonym for the question word.
Synonyms: Petty (मामूली), Minor (गौण), Nugatory (तुच्छ).
Antonyms: Important (महत्वपूर्ण), Major (मुख्य), Vital (अनिवार्य).

This describes something lesser in importance, seriousness, or significance. It aligns perfectly with the meaning of trivial, acting as a synonym.
Synonyms: Secondary (द्वितीयक), Slight (मामूली), Petty (मामूली).
Antonyms: Major (प्रमुख), Primary (प्राथमिक), Significant (महत्वपूर्ण).

This word refers to something of great significance or value. It is the direct and most appropriate opposite for being trivial or unimportant.
Synonyms: Crucial (निर्णायक), Vital (आवश्यक), Momentous (महत्वपूर्ण).
Antonyms: Trivial (तुच्छ), Unimportant (महत्वहीन), Paltry (नगण्य).

This refers to something not unusual; ordinary. While ordinary things can be trivial, this word describes lack of uniqueness rather than lack of importance, making it a loose synonym.
Synonyms: Routine (नियमित), Mundane (नीरस), Standard (मानक).
Antonyms: Exceptional (असाधारण), Rare (अनोखा), Unique (अद्वितीय).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Ebullient
questionsEn.s:
Ebullient - जोशीला (Cheerful and full of energy)
Depressed - उदास (In a state of general unhappiness or despondency)
Cheerful - हंसमुख (Noticeably happy and optimistic)
Joyful - आनंदपूर्ण (Feeling, showing, or causing great pleasure)
Enthusiastic - उत्साही (Having or showing intense and eager enjoyment)


Hence, 'Depressed' is the most suitable antonym for 'Ebullient'.
oa:
This word refers to a person in a state of general unhappiness or despondency. It is the direct emotional opposite of being cheerful, energetic, and ebullient.
Synonyms: Gloomy (उदास), Melancholy (विषादपूर्ण), Despondent (हताश).
Antonyms: Ebullient (जोशीला), Happy (खुश), Cheerful (हंसमुख).

This word refers to being noticeably happy and optimistic. It is a primary synonym for the given word and describes the same positive energy.
Synonyms: Joyful (आनंदित), Merry (खुशहाल), Blithe (प्रसन्न).
Antonyms: Sad (उदास), Sullen (चिड़चिड़ा), Gloomy (निराशाजनक).

This describes a feeling, showing, or causing great pleasure and happiness. It functions as a synonym that captures the high spirits of being ebullient.
Synonyms: Jubilant (उल्लसित), Elated (उत्तेजित), Exuberant (उत्साही).
Antonyms: Sorrowful (दुखद), Mournful (शोकाकुल), Miserable (दयनीय).

This word refers to having or showing intense and eager enjoyment, interest, or approval. It is a synonym that describes the ebullient person's energy.
Synonyms: Zealous (उत्साही), Eager (उत्सुक), Passionate (भावुक).
Antonyms: Indifferent (उदासीन), Apathetic (रुचिहीन), Passive (निष्क्रिय).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Exquisite
questionsEn.s:
Exquisite - अत्यंत सुंदर (Extremely beautiful and delicate)
Beautiful - सुंदर (Pleasing the senses or mind aesthetically)
Coarse - खुरदरा/भद्दा (Rough or loose in texture; lacking refinement)
Delicate - नाज़ुक (Very fine in texture or structure; intricate)
Fine - बढ़िया (Of very high quality; very thin or slender)


Hence, 'Coarse' is the most suitable antonym for 'Exquisite'.
oa:
This word refers to something pleasing the senses or mind aesthetically. It is a synonym that reflects the high quality of beauty implied by being exquisite.
Synonyms: Lovely (प्यारा), Handsome (सुंदर), Gorgeous (भव्य).
Antonyms: Ugly (कुरूप), Hideous (घिनौना), Unattractive (असुंदर).

This word refers to something rough or loose in texture or grain; lacking refinement or elegance. It is the direct opposite of the fine, delicate, and beautiful nature of exquisite things.
Synonyms: Rough (खुरदरा), Crude (अपरिष्कृत), Harsh (कठोर).
Antonyms: Exquisite (उत्कृष्ट), Fine (बढ़िया), Delicate (नाज़ुक).

This describes something very fine in texture or structure; of intricate workmanship or quality. It is an exact synonym for the "exquisite" quality of a person or object.
Synonyms: Frail (नाजुक), Subtle (सूक्ष्म), Fragile (नाजुक).
Antonyms: Strong (मज़बूत), Sturdy (हट्टा-कट्टा), Tough (कठोर).

This word refers to something of very high quality; very thin or slender. It functions as a direct synonym for the given word.
Synonyms: Superior (बेहतर), Excellent (उत्कृष्ट), Refined (सभ्य).
Antonyms: Poor (घटिया), Coarse (खुरदरा), Inferior (अवर).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Euphemism
questionsEn.s:
Euphemism - प्रियभाषण (A mild or indirect word used in place of a harsh one)
Understatement - हल्का कथन (Presentation of something as less important)
Directness - साफ़गोई (The quality of being plain or straightforward)
Substitute - विकल्प (A person or thing serving in place of another)
Vagueness - अस्पष्टता (Lack of certainty or distinctness)


Hence, 'Directness' is the most suitable antonym for 'Euphemism'.
oa:
This word refers to the presentation of something as being smaller or less important than it actually is. While it shares the "softening" trait, it is a related concept rather than an opposite.
Synonyms: Minimization (न्यूनतमीकरण), Restraint (संयम), Trivialization (तुच्छीकरण).
Antonyms: Exaggeration (अतिशयोक्ति), Hyperbole (बढ़ा-चढ़ाकर कहना), Emphasis (ज़ोर).

This word refers to the quality of being plain or straightforward in expression. It is the direct opposite of a euphemism, which is an indirect way of saying something harsh.
Synonyms: Frankness (साफ़गोई), Candor (स्पष्टवादिता), Forthrightness (ईमानदारी).
Antonyms: Evasion (टाल-मटोल), Euphemism (प्रियभाषण), Ambiguity (अस्पष्टता).

This word refers to a person or thing acting or serving in place of another. A euphemism is technically a substitute word, making this a synonym for its function.
Synonyms: Alternative (विकल्प), Replacement (प्रतिस्थापन), Proxy (प्रतिनिधि).
Antonyms: Original (असली), Authentic (प्रमाणिक), Permanent (स्थायी).

This describes a lack of certainty or distinctness. Euphemisms are often vague to avoid offense, making this word a synonym describing their nature.
Synonyms: Ambiguity (अस्पष्टता), Imprecision (अशुद्धता), Obscurity (अस्पष्टता).
Antonyms: Clarity (स्पष्टता), Precision (सटीकता), Specificity (विशिष्टता).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Heresy
questionsEn.s:
Heresy - पाखंड/विधर्म (Belief or opinion contrary to orthodox religious doctrine)
Unorthodoxy - अपरंपरागत (Quality of being contrary to traditional beliefs)
Dogma - धर्मसिद्धांत (A set of principles laid down as incontrovertibly true)
Orthodoxy - रूढ़िवादिता (Authorized or generally accepted theory or practice)
Dissent - मतभेद (Holding of opinions at variance with official ones)


Hence, 'Orthodoxy' is the most suitable antonym for 'Heresy'.
oa:
This word refers to the quality of being contrary to what is usual, traditional, or accepted. it is an exact synonym for the belief system described by heresy.
Synonyms: Dissidence (असहमति), Nonconformity (अपरंपरावादिता), Heterodoxy (विधर्म).
Antonyms: Orthodoxy (रूढ़िवादिता), Tradition (परंपरा), Convention (मान्यता).

This refers to a principle or set of principles laid down by an authority as incontrovertibly true. While related to traditional beliefs, it describes the rules themselves rather than the state of following them.
Synonyms: Doctrine (सिद्धांत), Creed (मत), Belief (विश्वास).
Antonyms: Doubt (संदेह), Skepticism (संदेहवाद), Disbelief (अविश्वास).

This word refers to authorized or generally accepted theory, doctrine, or practice. It is the direct opposite of heresy, which is belief contrary to such accepted doctrine.
Synonyms: Traditionalism (परंपरावादिता), Conformity (अनुपालन), Convention (रूढ़ि).
Antonyms: Heresy (पाखंड), Heterodoxy (विधर्म), Eccentricity (विलक्षणता).

This refers to the expression or holding of opinions at variance with those previously or officially held. It is a synonym describing the act of having a heretical view.
Synonyms: Disagreement (असहमत), Opposition (विरोध), Objection (आपत्ति).
Antonyms: Agreement (सहमति), Acceptance (स्वीकृति), Compliance (अनुपालन).

test.instructions: Standard CBT Pattern Exam. Positive Marks: +1, Negative Marks: -1. Total Questions: 50.

test.title: Set - 3

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Disparate
questionsEn.s:
Disparate - भिन्न (Essentially different in kind)
Distinct - स्पष्ट/अलग (Clearly separate or different)
Separate - पृथक (Set apart or not joined)
Similar - समान (Having a resemblance in appearance or character)
Contrasting - विपरीत (Showing striking differences)


Hence, 'Similar' is the most suitable antonym for 'Disparate'.
oa:
This word describes things that are clearly separate and different from each other. It emphasizes individuality and variation, making it a synonym of the given word rather than its opposite.
Synonyms: Discrete (अलग), Various (विभिन्न), Diverse (विविध).
Antonyms: Identical (समान), Unified (एकीकृत), Similar (एक जैसा).

This term refers to things that are set apart or not joined. While it reflects the lack of connection found in disparate elements, it does not provide the required opposite meaning.
Synonyms: Detached (अलग), Disconnected (असंपर्कित), Independent (स्वतंत्र).
Antonyms: Connected (जुड़ा हुआ), Joined (संबद्ध), Mixed (मिश्रित).

This word describes things that have a resemblance in appearance, character, or quantity without being identical. It is the most appropriate opposite for things that are essentially different in kind.
Synonyms: Alike (समान), Akin (समान), Analogous (तुलनीय).
Antonyms: Disparate (भिन्न), Different (अलग), Dissimilar (असमान).

This refers to things that show a striking difference when compared. It highlights the divergence between items, which aligns with being disparate rather than opposing it.
Synonyms: Conflicting (विरोधी), Deviant (विचलित), Divergent (भिन्न).
Antonyms: Harmonious (सामंजस्यपूर्ण), Matching (मिलता-जुलता), Consonant (अनुरूप).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Hegemony
questionsEn.s:
Hegemony - आधिपत्य (Leadership or dominance by one country or group)
Subordination - अधीनता (The state of being lower in rank or position)
Leadership - नेतृत्व (The action of leading a group or organization)
Equality - समानता (The state of being equal in status or rights)
Authority - अधिकार (The power to give orders and enforce obedience)


Hence, 'Subordination' is the most suitable antonym for 'Hegemony'.
oa:
This term refers to the action of occupying a lower legal or social rank. It represents the state of being under someone else's authority, which is the direct opposite of holding dominance or leadership.
Synonyms: Inferiority (अधीनता), Dependency (निर्भरता), Servitude (दासता).
Antonyms: Dominance (प्रभुत्व), Hegemony (आधिपत्य), Mastery (महारत).

This refers to the action of leading a group of people or an organization. Since hegemony often involves the leadership of one nation over others, this word acts as a synonym.
Synonyms: Command (नेतृत्व), Guidance (मार्गदर्शन), Direction (निर्देशन).
Antonyms: Following (अनुसरण), Obedience (आज्ञाकारिता), Subservience (चापलूसी).

This word describes the state of being equal, especially in status, rights, and opportunities. While it contrasts with dominance, it describes a balanced state rather than the direct inverse of control.
Synonyms: Parity (समानता), Fairness (निष्पक्षता), Uniformity (एकरूपता).
Antonyms: Disparity (असमानता), Hierarchy (पदानुक्रम), Domination (प्रभुत्व).

This is the power or right to give orders, make decisions, and enforce obedience. It is a key element of hegemony and therefore serves as a synonym.
Synonyms: Power (शक्ति), Jurisdiction (अधिकार क्षेत्र), Control (नियंत्रण).
Antonyms: Powerlessness (शक्तिहीनता), Weakness (कमजोरी), Submission (आत्मसमर्पण).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Contumacious
questionsEn.s:
Contumacious - अवज्ञाकारी (Stubbornly or willfully disobedient to authority)
Rebellious - विद्रोही (Showing a desire to resist authority or control)
Obedient - आज्ञाकारी (Willing to comply with orders or requests)
Unruly - अनियंत्रित (Disorderly and disruptive; not amenable to discipline)
Stubborn - जिद्दी (Determined not to change one's attitude or position)


Hence, 'Obedient' is the most suitable antonym for 'Contumacious'.
oa:
This describes a person who shows a desire to resist authority, control, or convention. It is a direct synonym for the stubborn disobedience implied by the given word.
Synonyms: Defiant (विद्रोही), Mutinous (बगावती), Insurgent (बागी).
Antonyms: Obedient (आज्ञाकारी), Compliant (अनुकूल), Docile (विनम्र).

This word describes someone who is willing to comply with orders or requests and is submissive to another's will. It is the perfect opposite of being stubbornly disobedient.
Synonyms: Submissive (दब्बू), Compliant (आज्ञाकारी), Dutiful (कर्तव्यपरायण).
Antonyms: Contumacious (अवाज्ञाकारी), Stubborn (जिद्दी), Wayward (स्वेच्छाचारी).

This refers to someone who is disorderly and disruptive and not amenable to discipline or control. It functions as a synonym for being contumacious.
Synonyms: Wild (बेकाबू), Rowdy (उपद्रवी), Ungovernable (अनियंत्रित).
Antonyms: Orderly (अनुशासित), Calm (शांत), Disciplined (अनुशासित).

This describes a person who has a dogged determination not to change their attitude or position on something. It captures the essence of being contumacious and is thus a synonym.
Synonyms: Obstinate (हठी), Adamant (अटल), Persistent (दृढ़).
Antonyms: Flexible (लचीला), Pliable (कोमल), Yielding (झुकने वाला).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Foment
questionsEn.s:
Foment - भड़काना (Instigate or stir up an undesirable course of action)
Incite - उकसाना (Encourage or stir up violent or unlawful behavior)
Stir - उत्तेजित करना (Arouse a strong feeling in someone)
Quash - कुचल देना (Put an end to; suppress or extinguish)
Instigate - प्रेरित करना (Bring about or initiate an action)


Hence, 'Quash' is the most suitable antonym for 'Foment'.
oa:
This word means to encourage or stir up violent or unlawful behavior. It is a strong synonym for the question word, as both involve provoking trouble.
Synonyms: Provoke (उकसाना), Agitate (उत्तेजित करना), Kindle (सुलगाना).
Antonyms: Suppress (दबाना), Calm (शांत करना), Discourage (हतोत्साहित करना).

This refers to the act of moving something or exciting a strong feeling in someone. It aligns with the idea of starting or encouraging a conflict, making it a synonym.
Synonyms: Rouse (जगाना), Stimulate (प्रेरित करना), Instigate (भड़काना).
Antonyms: Soothe (शांत करना), Quiet (चुप करना), Settle (स्थिर करना).

This word means to put an end to something, especially by force, or to suppress a feeling or action. It is the direct opposite of encouraging or provoking a situation.
Synonyms: Suppress (कुचलना), Subdue (वश में करना), Extinguish (मिटाना).
Antonyms: Foment (भड़काना), Encourage (बढ़ावा देना), Provoke (उकसाना).

This word means to bring about or initiate an action or event, especially something negative. It is contextually synonymous with the act of fomenting.
Synonyms: Prompt (प्रेरित करना), Trigger (शुरू करना), Actuate (सक्रिय करना).
Antonyms: Prevent (रोकना), Halt (बंद करना), Deter (रोकना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Abstruse
questionsEn.s:
Abstruse - गूढ़ (Difficult to understand; obscure)
Cryptic - रहस्यमय (Having a meaning that is mysterious)
Obscure - अस्पष्ट (Not clearly expressed or easily understood)
Clear - स्पष्ट (Easy to perceive, understand, or interpret)
Incomprehensible - समझ से बाहर (Not able to be understood)


Hence, 'Clear' is the most suitable antonym for 'Abstruse'.
oa:
This word refers to something having a meaning that is mysterious or obscure. It is a synonym for the given word as both imply a difficulty in understanding.
Synonyms: Enigmatic (रहस्यमय), Puzzling (पेचीदा), Recondite (गूढ़).
Antonyms: Clear (स्पष्ट), Obvious (ज़ाहिर), Plain (सादा).

This describes something that is not discovered or known about, or something that is uncertain and difficult to understand. It acts as a direct synonym.
Synonyms: Vague (अस्पष्ट), Ambiguous (अनेकार्थी), Arcane (गुप्त).
Antonyms: Distinct (सुस्पष्ट), Lucid (साफ), Famous (प्रसिद्ध).

This word refers to something that is easy to perceive, understand, or interpret. It is the perfect antonym for a word that signifies being deep and difficult to grasp.
Synonyms: Lucid (सुबोध), Manifest (प्रकट), Transparent (पारदर्शी).
Antonyms: Abstruse (गूढ़), Murky (धुंधला), Complex (जटिल).

This refers to something that is not able to be understood or grasped by the mind. It functions as a synonym describing the extreme nature of being abstruse.
Synonyms: Unfathomable (अथाह), Intelligible (अबोधगम्य), Baffling (चकरा देने वाला).
Antonyms: Understandable (समझने योग्य), Simple (सरल), Concise (संक्षिप्त).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Evanescent
questionsEn.s:
Evanescent - क्षणभंगुर (Soon passing out of sight, memory, or existence)
Fleeting - क्षणिक (Lasting for a very short time)
Transient - अस्थायी (Lasting only for a short time; impermanent)
Enduring - स्थायी (Lasting over a period of time; durable)
Ephemeral - अल्पकालिक (Lasting for a very short time)


Hence, 'Enduring' is the most suitable antonym for 'Evanescent'.
oa:
This word describes something that lasts for a very short time. It is a synonym of the question word, as both describe a rapid disappearance.
Synonyms: Momentary (क्षणिक), Short-lived (अल्पकालिक), Ephemeral (क्षणभंगुर).
Antonyms: Lasting (टिकाऊ), Enduring (स्थायी), Constant (निरंतर).

This refers to something that stays or lasts for only a short time before passing away. It captures the temporary essence of the given word and serves as a synonym.
Synonyms: Passing (अस्थायी), Fugitive (क्षणिक), Brief (संक्षिप्त).
Antonyms: Eternal (अनंत), Permanent (स्थायी), Perpetual (शाश्वत).

This word refers to something that lasts over a long period or remains in existence. it is the most appropriate opposite for something that vanishes quickly.
Synonyms: Durable (मज़बूत), Abiding (अटल), Perennial (चिरस्थायी).
Antonyms: Fleeting (क्षणिक), Evanescent (क्षणभंगुर), Fragile (नाज़ुक).

This describes things that are very short-lived or lasting for only a day. It is a direct synonym that perfectly matches the meaning of the given word.
Synonyms: Transitory (अस्थायी), Volatile (अस्थिर), Deciduous (अल्पकालिक).
Antonyms: Ageless (अमर), Immortal (अमर), Lifelong (आजीवन).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Concomitant
questionsEn.s:
Concomitant - सहवर्ती (Naturally accompanying or associated)
Separate - अलग (Existing or happening independently)
Related - संबंधित (Connected in some way; belonging to the same group)
Independent - स्वतंत्र (Not depending on another's authority or association)
Detached - पृथक (Disconnected or standing apart from others)


Hence, 'Separate' is the most suitable antonym for 'Concomitant'.
oa:
This word refers to things that are set apart, independent, or not connected. It serves as the direct opposite of being naturally associated or accompanying something else.
Synonyms: Independent (स्वतंत्र), Detached (अलग), Disconnected (असंपर्कित).
Antonyms: Concomitant (सहगामी), Linked (जुड़ा हुआ), Associated (संबद्ध).

This word describes things that belong to the same family, group, or type; or things that are connected. It is a synonym for the associated nature of the given word.
Synonyms: Connected (संबद्ध), Allied (जुड़ा हुआ), Kin (सजातीय).
Antonyms: Unrelated (असंबंधित), Foreign (विदेशी), Alien (विदेशी).

This refers to something not influenced or controlled by others in matters of opinion or conduct. While similar to the correct answer, it focuses on control rather than the lack of association.
Synonyms: Autonomous (स्वायत्त), Self-reliant (आत्मनिर्भर), Free (मुक्त).
Antonyms: Dependent (निर्भर), Relative (सापेक्ष), Subject (अधीन).

This refers to something that is separate or disconnected, often in a physical or emotional sense. It functions as a synonym for being apart.
Synonyms: Disjoined (अलग), Unfastened (खुला), Aloof (अलग-थलग).
Antonyms: Fastened (जकड़ा हुआ), Involved (शामिल), Attached (जुड़ा हुआ).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Erudite
questionsEn.s:
Erudite - विद्वान (Having or showing great knowledge or learning)
Ignorant - अज्ञानी (Lacking knowledge or awareness in general)
Intellectual - बौद्धिक (Possessing a high capacity for thought and reason)
Wise - बुद्धिमान (Having or showing experience and good judgment)
Scholarly - पंडित (Involving or relating to serious academic study)


Hence, 'Ignorant' is the most suitable antonym for 'Erudite'.
oa:
This word describes a person who is lacking in knowledge or training in general. It is the most direct antonym for someone who is deeply learned and scholarly.
Synonyms: Uninformed (अज्ञानी), Uneducated (अशिक्षित), Illiterate (निरक्षर).
Antonyms: Learned (विद्वान), Erudite (ज्ञानी), Academic (शिक्षित).

This relates to a person's ability to think in a logical way and understand difficult ideas. It describes a high capacity for learning, making it a synonym.
Synonyms: Cerebral (दिमागी), Rational (तार्किक), Brainy (बुद्धिमान).
Antonyms: Foolish (मूर्ख), Simple (साधारण), Ignorant (अनभिज्ञ).

This refers to having or showing experience, knowledge, and good judgment. It aligns with the knowledgeable profile of an erudite person and is a synonym.
Synonyms: Sagacious (बुद्धिमान), Sapient (चतुर), Judicious (विवेकपूर्ण).
Antonyms: Unwise (अविवेकपूर्ण), Naive (नासमझ), Injudicious (असंगत).

This word describes someone who is devoted to study and possesses deep academic knowledge. Since it captures the academic aspect of the given word, it acts as a synonym.
Synonyms: Academic (शैक्षिक), Bookish (किताबी), Studious (अध्ययनशील).
Antonyms: Practical (व्यावहारिक), Untaught (अशिक्षित), Unscholarly (गैर-विद्वान).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Dearth
questionsEn.s:
Dearth - अकाल/कमी (A scarcity or lack of something)
Abundance - प्रचुरता (A very large quantity of something)
Lack - अभाव (The state of being without or not having enough)
Shortage - कमी (A state where something needed is insufficient)
Scarcity - दुर्लभता (The state of being in short supply)


Hence, 'Abundance' is the most suitable antonym for 'Dearth'.
oa:
This word refers to a very large quantity of something, being more than enough. it is the direct opposite of a scarcity or lack.
Synonyms: Plenitude (भरमार), Wealth (प्रचुरता), Profusion (अत्यधिकता).
Antonyms: Dearth (कमी), Shortage (कमी), Lack (अभाव).

This refers to the state of being without or not having enough of something. It is the primary definition and synonym of the question word.
Synonyms: Absence (अनुपस्थिति), Deficiency (अपूर्णता), Need (ज़रूरत).
Antonyms: Surplus (अधिकता), Excess (अतिरिक्त), Plenty (प्रचुरता).

This word describes a state in which something needed cannot be obtained in sufficient amounts. It is contextually synonymous with being in a state of dearth.
Synonyms: Deficit (घाटा), Paucity (न्यूनता), Insufficiency (अपर्याप्तता).
Antonyms: Sufficiency (पर्याप्तता), Adequacy (योग्यता), Glut (अधिकता).

This word refers to a state of being in short supply or difficult to find. It perfectly matches the meaning of the given word and serves as a synonym.
Synonyms: Exiguity (अल्पता), Meagerness (कमी), Sparseness (कमी).
Antonyms: Abundance (प्रचुरता), Opulence (संपन्नता), Copiousness (भरमार).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Parsimonious
questionsEn.s:
Parsimonious - कंजूस (Extremely unwilling to spend money or use resources)
Stingy - मक्खीचूस (Unwilling to give or spend; ungenerous)
Frugal - मितव्ययी (Sparing or economical with regard to money or food)
Generous - उदार (Willing to give more than is necessary or expected)
Economical - किफायती (Giving good value or service in relation to the amount of money spent)


Hence, 'Generous' is the most suitable antonym for 'Parsimonious'.
oa:
This word describes someone who is unwilling to give or spend; ungenerous. It is a direct synonym for the given word's extreme frugality.
Synonyms: Miserly (कंजूस), Penurious (दरिद्र), Niggardly (कंजूस).
Antonyms: Bountiful (उदार), Generous (दानी), Liberal (मुक्तहस्त).

This refers to a person who is sparing or economical with regard to money or food. While a more positive term, it shares the "careful spending" trait and is a synonym.
Synonyms: Thrifty (मितव्ययी), Prudent (विवेकपूर्ण), Saving (बचत करने वाला).
Antonyms: Wasteful (अपव्ययी), Extravagant (फिजूलखर्च), Prodigal (खर्चीला).

This word describes a person who is willing to give money, help, or kindness freely and often more than is expected. It is the most appropriate opposite of being parsimonious.
Synonyms: Benevolent (परोपकारी), Altruistic (निःस्वार्थ), Munificent (बहुत उदार).
Antonyms: Greedy (लालची), Stingy (कंजूस), Parsimonious (अत्यधिक मितव्ययी).

This refers to using money or resources carefully and not wasting them. It is a synonym that describes the sensible management of wealth, unlike the correct answer.
Synonyms: Thrifty (किफायती), Sparing (किफायती), Methodical (व्यवस्थित).
Antonyms: Lavish (शानदार), Opulent (धनी), Careless (लापरवाह).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Somnolent
questionsEn.s:
Somnolent - ऊंघता हुआ (Sleepy; drowsy; tending to cause sleep)
Awake - जागृत (Not asleep; conscious)
Dull - सुस्त (Lacking interest or excitement; uninteresting)
Lethargic - सुस्त (Affected by lethargy; sluggish and apathetic)
Sluggish - मंद (Slow-moving or inactive)


Hence, 'Awake' is the most suitable antonym for 'Somnolent'.
oa:
This word refers to a state of being not asleep and fully conscious. It is the direct and most accurate antonym for a word that signifies being sleepy or drowsy.
Synonyms: Alert (सतर्क), Conscious (सचेत), Vigilant (जागरूक).
Antonyms: Asleep (सोया हुआ), Drowsy (ऊंघता हुआ), Somnolent (नींद में).

This describes someone who is lacking interest or excitement; slow to understand. While it shares the "low energy" aspect, it does not describe the specific state of sleepiness.
Synonyms: Tedious (थकाऊ), Boring (नीरस), Uninspired (प्रेरणाहीन).
Antonyms: Sharp (तेज़), Bright (चमकदार), Intelligent (बुद्धिमान).

This refers to a lack of energy and enthusiasm; being sluggish. It functions as a synonym that describes a state similar to sleepiness.
Synonyms: Listless (सुस्त), Passive (निष्क्रिय), Apathetic (उदासीन).
Antonyms: Active (सक्रिय), Energetic (ऊर्जावान), Dynamic (गतिशील).

This describes being slow-moving or inactive. It aligns with the slow, heavy feeling of being somnolent, making it a synonym.
Synonyms: Torpid (जड़), Slow (धीमा), Inactive (निष्क्रिय).
Antonyms: Fast (तेज़), Swift (तीव्र), Brisk (फुर्तीला).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Indefatigable
questionsEn.s:
Indefatigable - अथक (Persisting tirelessly; untiring)
Tenacious - दृढ़ (Tending to keep a firm hold; persistent)
Exhausted - थका-हारा (Very tired; completely used up)
Dogged - हठी (Having or showing grim persistence)
Relentless - बेदम (Unceasingly intense; constant)


Hence, 'Exhausted' is the most suitable antonym for 'Indefatigable'.
oa:
This word refers to someone who is tending to keep a firm hold of something; being persistent or stubborn. It is a synonym that describes a person's tireless grip on a goal.
Synonyms: Dogged (हठी), Firm (दृढ़), Persistent (लगातार).
Antonyms: Irresolute (दुविधापूर्ण), Weak (कमजोर), Wavering (डगमगाने वाला).

This word describes a state of being very tired, either physically or mentally, and having no energy left. It is the direct antonym for someone who never tires.
Synonyms: Fatigued (थका हुआ), Spent (अशक्त), Wearied (थका हुआ).
Antonyms: Refreshed (ताज़ा), Indefatigable (अथक), Vigorous (ऊर्जावान).

This describes someone who shows tenacity and grim persistence. It perfectly captures the "not giving up" aspect of the question word, making it a synonym.
Synonyms: Resolute (दृढ़), Unflagging (अथक), Constant (नियमित).
Antonyms: Yielding (हार मानने वाला), Surrendering (आत्मसमर्पण करने वाला), Feeble (कमजोर).

This refers to something that is unceasingly intense or harsh. It functions as a synonym as it implies a lack of stopping or tiring.
Synonyms: Incessant (लगातार), Cruel (क्रूर), Persistent (निरंतर).
Antonyms: Lenient (नरम), Mild (हल्का), Intermittent (रुक-रुक कर).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Laconic
questionsEn.s:
Laconic - मितभाषी (Using very few words; brief)
Elliptical - संक्षिप्त (Brief and often cryptic; using few words)
Wordy - शब्दों से भरा (Using or expressed in too many words)
Compendious - सारगर्भित (Concise but comprehensive)
Clipped - छोटा/तेज़ (Characterized by short, sharp vowel sounds)


Hence, 'Wordy' is the most suitable antonym for 'Laconic'.
oa:
This word refers to speech or writing that is brief and often obscure. It matches the brevity of the given word and thus acts as its synonym.
Synonyms: Terse (संक्षिप्त), Concise (लघु), Coded (संकेतिक).
Antonyms: Plain (सादा), Explicit (स्पष्ट), Detailed (विस्तृत).

This word describes using or expressed in too many words. It is the direct and most appropriate opposite of being brief and concise in speech.
Synonyms: Verbose (वाचाल), Talkative (बातूनी), Garrulous (बातूनी).
Antonyms: Laconic (मितभाषी), Succinct (संक्षिप्त), Brief (छोटा).

This refers to something that contains or presents the essential facts in a concise way. It is essentially a synonym for the given word's economy of language.
Synonyms: Abridged (संक्षिप्त), Summary (सारांश), Short (लघु).
Antonyms: Comprehensive (व्यापक), Lengthened (विस्तृत), Unabridged (पूर्ण).

This describes speech that is characterized by quick, short sounds and often implies brevity. It is a synonym that focuses on the sound and style of brief speech.
Synonyms: Snappy (तेज़), Curt (रुखा), Precise (सटीक).
Antonyms: Drawling (खींचकर बोलना), Slow (धीमा), Elaborate (सविस्तार).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Ephemeral
questionsEn.s:
Ephemeral - क्षणभंगुर (Lasting for a very short time)
Temporary - अस्थायी (Lasting for only a limited period of time)
Momentary - क्षणिक (Lasting for a very short time)
Eternal - शाश्वत (Lasting or existing forever; without end)
Fleeting - अल्पकालिक (Passing swiftly; vanishing quickly)


Hence, 'Eternal' is the most suitable antonym for 'Ephemeral'.
oa:
This word refers to something lasting for only a limited period of time; not permanent. It is the primary synonym for the given word's short-lived nature.
Synonyms: Short-term (अल्पकालिक), Provisional (अस्थायी), Passing (क्षणिक).
Antonyms: Permanent (स्थायी), Constant (निरंतर), Stable (स्थिर).

This describes something that lasts for a very short time; occurring at a particular moment. It captures the extreme brevity of the given word, acting as a synonym.
Synonyms: Brief (संक्षिप्त), Fleeting (क्षणिक), Transitory (अल्पकालिक).
Antonyms: Continuous (लगातार), Enduring (स्थायी), Perpetual (शाश्वत).

This word refers to something that lasts or exists forever; without end or beginning. it is the most accurate antonym for something that is short-lived.
Synonyms: Everlasting (शाश्वत), Immortal (अमर), Infinite (असीम).
Antonyms: Finite (सीमित), Mortal (नश्वर), Ephemeral (क्षणभंगुर).

This refers to something that passes very quickly or lasts for a very short duration. It is essentially an exact synonym for being ephemeral.
Synonyms: Evanescent (क्षणिक), Vanishing (विलुप्त होता), Short-lived (अल्पकालिक).
Antonyms: Ceaseless (बेरोक), Lasting (टिकाऊ), Abiding (स्थिर).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Tenebrous
questionsEn.s:
Tenebrous - तिमिराच्छन्न/अंधेरा (Dark; shadowy or obscure)
Bright - उज्ज्वल (Emitting or reflecting much light; shining)
Shadowy - छायादार (Full of shadows; dark or ill-defined)
Murky - धुंधला (Dark and gloomy, typically due to mist)
Obscure - अस्पष्ट (Not discovered or known about; uncertain)


Hence, 'Bright' is the most suitable antonym for 'Tenebrous'.
oa:
This word refers to something that emits or reflects much light; being shining or vivid. It is the direct and most appropriate opposite for something that is dark and gloomy.
Synonyms: Luminous (प्रकाशमान), Radiant (दीप्तिमान), Brilliant (शानदार).
Antonyms: Tenebrous (अंधेरा), Dull (मंद), Somber (उदास).

This describes something that is full of shadows, dark, or ill-defined. It is a direct synonym for the dark quality of the given word.
Synonyms: Dim (धुंधला), Murky (अंधेरा), Obscure (अस्पष्ट).
Antonyms: Clear (स्पष्ट), Visible (दृश्य), Lit (प्रकाशित).

This refers to something that is dark and gloomy, especially due to thick mist or dirt. It is contextually synonymous with being tenebrous.
Synonyms: Cloudy (धुंधला), Muddy (गंदा), Gloomy (निराशाजनक).
Antonyms: Crystal-clear (बिल्कुल साफ), Pure (शुद्ध), Transparent (पारदर्शी).

This describes something that is not discovered or known about; or something uncertain and difficult to see. It is a synonym that emphasizes the lack of light and clarity.
Synonyms: Hidden (छिपा हुआ), Ambiguous (अस्पष्ट), Mysterious (रहस्यमय).
Antonyms: Obvious (ज़ाहिर), Plain (सादा), Well-known (प्रसिद्ध).
