questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Derelict
questionsEn.s:
Derelict - परित्यक्त (In a very poor condition as a result of disuse and neglect)
Dilapidated - टूटा-फूटा (In a state of disrepair or ruin)
Attentive - सचेत (Paying close attention to something)
Deserted - निर्जन (Empty of people and abandoned)
Ruined - बर्बाद (Damaged irreparably; spoiled)


Hence, 'Attentive' is the most suitable antonym for 'Derelict'.
oa:
This word refers to a building or object in a state of disrepair or ruin as a result of age or neglect. It matches the ruined condition of being derelict and acts as a synonym.
Synonyms: Ramshackle (खस्ताहाल), Ruined (बर्बाद), Crumbling (जर्जर).
Antonyms: Restored (बहाल), New (नया), Intact (सही-सलामत).

This word describes someone who is paying close attention to something; or something that is well-maintained and cared for. it is the most suitable opposite of being neglected or abandoned.
Synonyms: Vigilant (सतर्क), Conscientious (ईमानदार), Mindful (सचेत).
Antonyms: Neglectful (लापरवाह), Careless (असावधान), Derelict (उपेक्षित).

This refers to a place that is empty of people and has been abandoned. It is a direct synonym describing the abandonment aspect of the given word.
Synonyms: Forsaken (त्यागा हुआ), Uninhabited (निर्जन), Vacant (खाली).
Antonyms: Crowded (भीड़भाड़ वाला), Occupied (भरा हुआ), Populous (आबाद).

This describes something that has been damaged so badly that it is no longer useful or existing. It is a synonym for the state of disrepair implied by being derelict.
Synonyms: Wrecked (तबाह), Destroyed (नष्ट), Spoiled (खराब).
Antonyms: Safe (सुरक्षित), Mended (सुधरा हुआ), Protected (संरक्षित).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Apathy
questionsEn.s:
Apathy - उदासीनता (Lack of interest, enthusiasm, or concern)
Indifference - बेपरवाही (Lack of interest, concern, or sympathy)
Enthusiasm - उत्साह (Intense and eager enjoyment or interest)
Laziness - आलस्य (The quality of being unwilling to work)
Carelessness - लापरवाही (Failure to give sufficient attention to avoiding errors)


Hence, 'Enthusiasm' is the most suitable antonym for 'Apathy'.
oa:
This word refers to a lack of interest, concern, or sympathy. It is the primary synonym and definition of the given word.
Synonyms: Detachment (अलगाव), Unconcern (बेपरवाही), Passivity (निष्क्रियता).
Antonyms: Concern (चिंता), Compassion (सहानुभूति), Anxiety (उत्सुकता).

This word refers to intense and eager enjoyment, interest, or approval. it is the direct and most accurate antonym for a lack of feeling or interest.
Synonyms: Zeal (उत्साह), Passion (जुनून), Eagerness (उत्सुकता).
Antonyms: Apathy (उदासीनता), Boredom (ऊब), Disinterest (अरुचि).

This describes the quality of being unwilling to work or use energy; idleness. While related to a lack of action, it describes a physical habit rather than an emotional state.
Synonyms: Sloth (आलस्य), Indolence (सुस्ती), Inactivity (निष्क्रियता).
Antonyms: Industry (परिश्रम), Diligence (लगन), Hard work (कड़ी मेहनत).

This refers to the failure to give sufficient attention to avoiding harm or errors. It is contextually unrelated to the "lack of feeling" implied by apathy.
Synonyms: Negligence (लापरवाही), Laxity (ढीलापन), Remissness (असावधानी).
Antonyms: Precision (सटीकता), Caution (सावधानी), Accuracy (शुद्धता).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Reprobate
questionsEn.s:
Reprobate - नीच/बदमाश (An unprincipled person; wicked)
Rogue - धूर्त (A dishonest or unprincipled person)
Virtuous - सदाचारी (Having or showing high moral standards)
Unprincipled - अनैतिक (Not acting in accordance with moral rules)
Rakish - छैला (Displaying a dashing or slightly disreputable manner)


Hence, 'Virtuous' is the most suitable antonym for 'Reprobate'.
oa:
This word refers to a dishonest or unprincipled man. It is a synonym that describes the same negative character as the given word.
Synonyms: Scoundrel (बदमाश), Villain (दुष्ट), Knave (धूर्त).
Antonyms: Hero (नायक), Saint (संत), Paragon (आदर्श).

This word describes a person who has high moral standards and shows moral excellence. It is the perfect antonym for someone who is unprincipled or wicked.
Synonyms: Righteous (धर्मी), Ethical (नैतिक), Honorable (सम्माननीय).
Antonyms: Evil (दुष्ट), Vicious (शातिर), Reprobate (नीच).

This refers to someone who is not acting in accordance with moral principles or rules. It is an exact synonym for the given word.
Synonyms: Corrupt (भ्रष्ट), Deceitful (कपटी), Shameless (निर्लज्ज).
Antonyms: Moral (नैतिक), Honest (ईमानदार), Ethical (सदाचारी).

This word refers to having or displaying a dashing, jaunty, or slightly disreputable appearance or manner. While slightly negative, it focuses on style and behavior rather than total lack of principle.
Synonyms: Dapper (ठाठदार), Dissolute (विषयी), Carefree (लापरवाह).
Antonyms: Solemn (गंभीर), Respectable (माननीय), Modest (विनीत).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Exacerbate
questionsEn.s:
Exacerbate - बिगाड़ना (Make a problem, bad situation, or negative feeling worse)
Alleviate - हल्का करना (Make suffering or a deficiency less severe)
Intensify - तीव्र करना (Become or make more intense)
Improve - सुधारना (Make or become better)
Aggravate - और बिगाड़ देना (Make a situation worse or more serious)


Hence, 'Alleviate' is the most suitable antonym for 'Exacerbate'.
oa:
This word means to make suffering, deficiency, or a problem less severe. it is the direct antonym for making a bad situation worse.
Synonyms: Mitigate (कम करना), Relieve (राहत देना), Ease (आसान करना).
Antonyms: Exacerbate (बिगाड़ना), Intensify (तेज़ करना), Worsen (बदतर करना).

This means to become or make something more intense or extreme. It is a synonym for the given word as it implies increasing the severity of a situation.
Synonyms: Heighten (बढ़ाना), Escalate (तेज़ करना), Boost (उठाना).
Antonyms: Dampen (धीमा करना), Subdue (शांत करना), Diminish (घटाना).

This means to make or become better. While it is a positive change, "alleviate" is the more specific medical/contextual opposite for the act of worsening a condition.
Synonyms: Ameliorate (सुधारना), Enhance (बेहतर बनाना), Refine (परिष्कृत करना).
Antonyms: Degenerate (पतन), Decay (सड़ना), Mar (बिगाड़ना).

This means to make a problem, injury, or offense worse or more serious. It is an exact synonym for the act of exacerbating.
Synonyms: Inflame (सुलगाना), Annoy (परेशान करना), Irritate (चिढ़ाना).
Antonyms: Calm (शांत करना), Placate (मनाना), Soothe (सहलाना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Misanthropic
questionsEn.s:
Misanthropic - मानवद्वेषी (Disliking humankind and avoiding human society)
Sociable - मिलनसार (Willing to talk and engage with other people)
Reclusive - एकांतवासी (Avoiding the company of other people; solitary)
Cynical - कुटिल/संदेही (Distrustful of human sincerity or integrity)
Pessimistic - निराशावादी (Tending to see the worst aspect of things)


Hence, 'Sociable' is the most suitable antonym for 'Misanthropic'.
oa:
This word describes a person who is willing to talk and engage in activities with other people; being friendly. It is the most appropriate opposite for someone who hates or avoids human society.
Synonyms: Affable (मिलनसार), Amiable (मित्रवत), Extroverted (बहिर्मुखी).
Antonyms: Reclusive (एकांतप्रिय), Hostile (शत्रुतापूर्ण), Misanthropic (मानवद्वेषी).

This describes a person who lives a solitary life and tends to avoid other people. It is a synonym for the behavior often associated with being misanthropic.
Synonyms: Hermit-like (तपस्वी जैसा), Solitary (अकेला), Unsociable (असामाजिक).
Antonyms: Outgoing (मिलनसार), Gregarious (झुंड में रहने वाला), Social (सामाजिक).

This refers to someone who is motivated by self-interest and is skeptical of human sincerity or integrity. It is a synonym for the distrustful worldview of a misanthrope.
Synonyms: Skeptical (संदेही), Pessimistic (निराशावादी), Sarcastic (व्यंग्यात्मक).
Antonyms: Optimistic (आशावादी), Trusting (भरोसेमंद), Gullible (भोला).

This describes a person who tends to see the worst aspect of things or believes that the worst will happen. It is contextually related to the negative attitude of a misanthrope.
Synonyms: Gloomy (निराशापूर्ण), Defeatist (हार मानने वाला), Hopeless (आशाहीन).
Antonyms: Hopeful (आशावान), Sanguine (आशावादी), Positive (सकारात्मक).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Quaint
questionsEn.s:
Quaint - विचित्र/पुराना (Attractively unusual or old-fashioned)
Humble - विनम्र (Showing a modest estimate of one's importance)
Ordinary - साधारण (With no special or distinctive features; normal)
Tolerant - सहनशील (Willing to allow opinions one disagrees with)
Gale - तेज़ आंधी (A very strong wind)


Hence, 'Ordinary' is the most suitable antonym for 'Quaint'.
oa:
This word refers to having or showing a modest or low estimate of one's own importance. It is contextually unrelated to the unusual or old-fashioned quality of being quaint.
Synonyms: Modest (विनीत), Meek (नम्र), Unpretentious (दिखावा रहित).
Antonyms: Proud (अभिमानी), Arrogant (अहंकारी), Haughty (घमंडी).

This word refers to something with no special or distinctive features; being normal or common. It is the best opposite for something that is attractively unusual or uniquely old-fashioned.
Synonyms: Commonplace (मामूली), Mundane (साधारण), Standard (मानक).
Antonyms: Unusual (असामान्य), Unique (अनोखा), Quaint (विचित्र).

This describes someone who shows a willingness to allow the existence of opinions or behavior that one does not necessarily agree with. It has no connection with the given word's meaning.
Synonyms: Broad-minded (उदार), Patient (सहनशील), Lenient (उदार).
Antonyms: Biased (पक्षपाती), Narrow-minded (संकीर्ण), Prejudice (पूर्वाग्रह).

This is a noun referring to a very strong wind. Since it represents a natural phenomenon and is a different part of speech in context, it cannot be an antonym for an adjective describing style.
Synonyms: Storm (तूफान), Tempest (झंझावत), Blast (झोंका).
Antonyms: Breeze (मंद हवा), Calm (शांति), Zephyr (हल्की हवा).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Obloquy
questionsEn.s:
Obloquy - निंदा/तिरस्कार (Strong public criticism or verbal abuse)
Praise - प्रशंसा (Expression of approval or admiration)
Condemnation - दोषारोपण (The expression of very strong disapproval)
Abuse - गाली/दुरुपयोग (Cruel and violent treatment or language)
Discredit - बदनामी (Loss or lack of reputation or respect)


Hence, 'Praise' is the most suitable antonym for 'Obloquy'.
oa:
This word refers to the expression of approval or admiration for someone or something. it is the direct and most appropriate opposite for strong public criticism or disgrace.
Synonyms: Commendation (सराहना), Accolade (सम्मान), Adoration (प्रशंसा).
Antonyms: Censure (निंदा), Abuse (गाली), Obloquy (तिरस्कार).

This word refers to the expression of very strong disapproval; censure. It is a direct synonym for the critical nature of the given word.
Synonyms: Denunciation (आरोप), Reprimand (फटकार), Castigation (आलोचना).
Antonyms: Approval (स्वीकृति), Absolution (दोषमुक्ति), Support (समर्थन).

This refers to the use of cruel, violent, or insulting language or treatment. It functions as a synonym describing the harsh verbal aspect of obloquy.
Synonyms: Invective (गाली-गलौज), Malignment (बदनामी), Slander (निंदा).
Antonyms: Respect (आदर), Kindness (दया), Protection (रक्षा).

This refers to the loss or lack of reputation or respect. It captures the shameful outcome of obloquy, making it a synonym.
Synonyms: Dishonor (अपमान), Infamy (बदनामी), Stigma (कलंक).
Antonyms: Honor (सम्मान), Glory (शान), Fame (प्रसिद्धि).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Surreptitious
questionsEn.s:
Surreptitious - गुप्त (Kept secret, especially because it would not be approved of)
Covert - प्रच्छन्न (Not openly acknowledged or displayed)
Furtive - चोरी-छिपे (Attempting to avoid notice, typically due to guilt)
Overt - प्रकट (Done or shown openly; not secret or hidden)
Stealthy - चुपके से (Behaving in a cautious and secretive manner)


Hence, 'Overt' is the most suitable antonym for 'Surreptitious'.
oa:
This word refers to something that is not openly acknowledged or displayed; being secret. It is an exact synonym for the given word's secretive nature.
Synonyms: Clandestine (गुप्त), Stealthy (चुपके से), Underground (छिपा हुआ).
Antonyms: Overt (प्रकट), Open (खुला), Visible (दृश्य).

This describes someone attempting to avoid notice or attention, typically because of guilt. It perfectly matches the meaning of surreptitious, acting as a synonym.
Synonyms: Sneaky (धूर्त), Slily (चोरी-छिपे), Hidden (गुप्त).
Antonyms: Forthright (स्पष्ट), Bold (निडर), Honest (ईमानदार).

This word refers to something done or shown openly; being plainly apparent and not secret or hidden. it is the direct antonym for being secretive or surreptitious.
Synonyms: Manifest (प्रकट), Obvious (ज़ाहिर), Public (सार्वजनिक).
Antonyms: Covert (गुप्त), Hidden (छिपा हुआ), Surreptitious (रहस्यमय).

This refers to behavior that is cautious and surreptitious so as not to be seen or heard. It is another strong synonym for the question word.
Synonyms: Feline (बिल्ली जैसा/दबे पाँव), Secret (गुप्त), Furtive (चोरी-छिपे).
Antonyms: Noisy (शोर वाला), Obvious (स्पष्ट), Open (खुला).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Noisome
questionsEn.s:
Noisome - दुर्गंधयुक्त/हानिकारक (Having an extremely offensive smell; harmful)
Fragrant - खुशबूदार (Having a pleasant or sweet smell)
Rancid - बासी/दुर्गंधयुक्त (Smelling or tasting unpleasant as a result of being old)
Putrid - सड़ा हुआ (Decaying or rotting and emitting a fetid smell)
Malodorous - बदबूदार (Smelling very unpleasant)


Hence, 'Fragrant' is the most suitable antonym for 'Noisome'.
oa:
This word describes something that has a pleasant or sweet smell. It is the direct opposite of something that is foul-smelling or offensive to the senses.
Synonyms: Aromatic (सुगंधित), Perfumed (सुवासित), Scented (खुशबूदार).
Antonyms: Malodorous (दुर्गंधयुक्त), Stinking (बदबूदार), Noisome (घृणित).

This refers to foods containing fat or oil that have become unpleasant-smelling or tasting due to being old or stale. It functions as a synonym for foul odors.
Synonyms: Sour (खट्टा), Stale (बासी), Putrid (सड़ा हुआ).
Antonyms: Fresh (ताज़ा), Sweet (मीठा), Pure (शुद्ध).

This describes something (typically organic matter) that is decaying or rotting and emitting a fetid smell. it is a strong synonym for being noisome.
Synonyms: Fetid (बदबूदार), Rotting (सड़ता हुआ), Foul (गंदा).
Antonyms: Wholesome (पौष्टिक), Clean (साफ़), Fragrant (सुगंधित).

This word literally means having an unpleasant smell. It is a direct and technical synonym for the given word's primary meaning.
Synonyms: Stinking (बदबूदार), Smelly (दुर्गंधयुक्त), Mephitic (जहरीला/बदबूदार).
Antonyms: Savory (स्वादिष्ट), Sweet-smelling (सुगंधित), Fresh (ताज़ा).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Garrulous
questionsEn.s:
Garrulous - बातूनी (Excessively talkative, especially on trivial matters)
Quit - छोड़ना (Leave a place or stop doing something)
Reserved - संकोची (Restrained in words or manner; slow to reveal thoughts)
Shy - शर्मीला (Nervous or timid in the company of others)
Silent - मौन (Not making or accompanied by any sound)


Hence, 'Reserved' is the most suitable antonym for 'Garrulous'.
oa:
This is a verb that means to leave a place, usually permanently, or to stop doing something. It is contextually unrelated to being talkative or silent.
Synonyms: Leave (छोड़ना), Resign (इस्तीफा देना), Cease (बंद करना).
Antonyms: Continue (जारी रखना), Join (शामिल होना), Start (शुरू करना).

This word describes a person who is slow to reveal emotion or opinions; being restrained and not talkative. It is the best antonym for being excessively talkative.
Synonyms: Reticent (अल्पभाषी), Taciturn (मौन), Shy (शर्मीला).
Antonyms: Garrulous (बातूनी), Loquacious (वाचाल), Outgoing (मिलनसार).

This refers to being nervous or timid in the company of other people. While shy people are often quiet, shyness is a feeling of anxiety rather than a specific choice of brevity in speech.
Synonyms: Bashful (संकोची), Timid (डरपोक), Diffident (आत्मविश्वासहीन).
Antonyms: Confident (आत्मविश्वासी), Bold (निडर), Aggressive (आक्रामक).

This word refers to a person or thing not making or accompanied by any sound. While the opposite of talking, "reserved" is a better personality antonym for a habitual talker.
Synonyms: Mute (मूक), Quiet (शांत), Still (अचल).
Antonyms: Noisy (शोर वाला), Talkative (बातूनी), Clamorous (हंगामा करने वाला).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Ineluctable
questionsEn.s:
Ineluctable - अपरिहार्य (Unable to be resisted or avoided; inescapable)
Unavoidable - अनिवार्य (Not able to be ignored or prevented)
Preventable - निवारणीय (Able to be kept from happening)
Inevitable - अटल (Certain to happen; unavoidable)
Inescapable - जिससे बचा न जा सके (Unable to be avoided or denied)


Hence, 'Preventable' is the most suitable antonym for 'Ineluctable'.
oa:
This word refers to something that is certain to happen and cannot be prevented. It is a direct synonym for the given word.
Synonyms: Inevitable (अपरिहार्य), Inescapable (अनिवार्य), Fixed (तय).
Antonyms: Avoidable (टालने योग्य), Uncertain (अनिश्चित), Preventable (रोकने योग्य).

This word refers to something that is able to be kept from happening or arising. It is the direct antonym for something that is impossible to escape or avoid.
Synonyms: Avoidable (परिहार्य), Evadable (बचने योग्य), Avertible (टालने योग्य).
Antonyms: Ineluctable (अपरिहार्य), Fatal (घातक), Inevitable (अनिवार्य).

This refers to something that is certain to happen; unavoidable. It matches the "unable to be escaped" aspect perfectly, acting as a synonym.
Synonyms: Compulsory (अनिवार्य), Necessary (आवश्यक), Sure (निश्चित).
Antonyms: Doubtful (संदेहात्मक),

This describes something that is unable to be avoided or denied. It is an exact synonym for the given word.
Synonyms: Relentless (अथक), Unalterable (अपरिवर्तनीय), Persistent (निरंतर).
Antonyms: Fleeting (क्षणिक), Escapable (बचने योग्य), Mutable (बदलने योग्य).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Turbulent
questionsEn.s:
Turbulent - अशांत (Characterized by conflict, disorder, or confusion)
Deceptive - भ्रामक (Giving an appearance different from the true one)
Humble - विनम्र (Having or showing a modest estimate of one's importance)
Calm - शांत (Free from agitation or strong emotion; peaceful)
Satisfied - संतुष्ट (Contented; pleased with something)


Hence, 'Calm' is the most suitable antonym for 'Turbulent'.
oa:
This word refers to giving an appearance or impression different from the true one; being misleading. it is contextually unrelated to a state of disorder or conflict.
Synonyms: Misleading (भ्रामक), Illusory (काल्पनिक), Fraudulent (धोखेबाज़).
Antonyms: Honest (ईमानदार), Genuine (वास्तविक), Truthful (सच्चा).

This describes a person who has or shows a modest or low estimate of one's own importance. It does not provide an opposite relationship for a state of chaos.
Synonyms: Meek (नम्र), Lowly (मामूली), Unassuming (दिखावा रहित).
Antonyms: Arrogant (अभिमानी), Proud (गर्वित), Bold (साहसी).

This word refers to a state of being free from agitation, excitement, or disturbance; being peaceful. it is the direct and most accurate antonym for being turbulent.
Synonyms: Serene (शांत), Placid (सौम्य), Tranquil (स्थिर).
Antonyms: Stormy (तूफानी), Violent (हिंसक), Turbulent (अशांत).

This word describes someone who is content or pleased with something. While a state of mind, it is not the logical opposite of the chaotic nature described by the given word.
Synonyms: Content (संतुष्ट), Pleased (खुश), Gratified (कृतज्ञ).
Antonyms: Frustrated (हताश), Discontented (असंतोष), Anxious (चिंतित).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Egalitarian
questionsEn.s:
Egalitarian - समतावादी (Believing in the principle that all people are equal)
Fair - निष्पक्ष (Treating people equally without favoritism)
Biased - पक्षपाती (Unfairly prejudiced for or against someone)
Democratic - लोकतांत्रिक (Relating to or supporting democracy)
Equitable - न्यायसंगत (Fair and impartial)


Hence, 'Biased' is the most suitable antonym for 'Egalitarian'.
oa:
This word refers to treating people equally without favoritism or discrimination. It is a synonym that describes the core belief of an egalitarian system.
Synonyms: Equitable (न्यायसंगत), Just (उचित), Impartial (निष्पक्ष).
Antonyms: Unfair (अन्यायपूर्ण), Biased (पक्षपाती), Prejudiced (पूर्वाग्रही).

This word describes showing an unreasonable-like or dislike for a person or group based on personal opinions. It is the direct opposite of being egalitarian.
Synonyms: Partial (पक्षपाती), Prejudiced (पूर्वाग्रही), Subjective (आत्मपरक).
Antonyms: Egalitarian (समतावादी), Objective (वस्तुनिष्ठ), Neutral (तटस्थ).

This refers to a system of government based on the principle of equal rights and participation for all citizens. It functions as a synonym for egalitarianism.
Synonyms: Popular (लोकप्रिय/जनता का), Representative (प्रतिनिधि), Liberal (उदार).
Antonyms: Authoritarian (तानाशाही), Dictatorial (तानाशाही), Tyrannical (अत्याचारी).

This describes something that is fair and impartial. It perfectly aligns with the given word's meaning of promoting equal rights and opportunities.
Synonyms: Honest (ईमानदार), Fair-minded (निष्पक्ष), Even-handed (समान रूप से).
Antonyms: Disproportionate (असमान), Biased (पक्षपाती), Unjust (अनुचित).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Monstrous
questionsEn.s:
Monstrous - राक्षसी/विशाल (Extremely large; frighteningly ugly or wicked)
Beautiful - सुंदर (Pleasing the senses or mind aesthetically)
Odd - अजीब (Different from what is usual or expected; strange)
Abnormal - असामान्य (Deviating from what is normal or usual)
Strange - विचित्र (Unusual or surprising; difficult to understand)


Hence, 'Beautiful' is the most suitable antonym for 'Monstrous'.
oa:
This word refers to something that is pleasing to the aesthetic senses or the mind. It is the most appropriate opposite for something that is frighteningly large, ugly, or wicked.
Synonyms: Gorgeous (भव्य), Lovely (प्यारा), Attractive (आकर्षक).
Antonyms: Hideous (भयानक), Ugly (कुरूप), Monstrous (राक्षसी).

This refers to something that is different from what is usual or expected; being strange. While not necessarily large or frightening, it describes an unusual state, making it a weak synonym.
Synonyms: Peculiar (अजीब), Eccentric (सनकी), Queer (विचित्र).
Antonyms: Normal (सामान्य), Regular (नियमित), Typical (विशिष्ट).

This word describes something that deviates from what is normal or average, typically in a way that is undesirable. It is a synonym for the unnatural quality of being monstrous.
Synonyms: Unusual (असामान्य), Anomalous (अनियमित), Irregular (अनियमित).
Antonyms: Average (औसत), Common (आम), Standard (मानक).

This refers to something unusual or surprising in a way that is difficult to understand. It shares the "deviating from norm" aspect, functioning as a synonym.
Synonyms: Weird (अजीब), Bizarre (विचित्र), Unfamiliar (अपरिचित).
Antonyms: Familiar (परिचित), Known (ज्ञात), Ordinary (साधारण).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Elucidate
questionsEn.s:
Elucidate - स्पष्ट करना (Make something clear; explain)
Clarify - साफ़ करना (Make a statement less confused)
Explain - समझाना (Make an idea clear by describing it in detail)
Obscure - धुंधला करना (Make unclear and difficult to understand)
Illuminate - प्रकाश डालना (Help to clarify or explain; light up)


Hence, 'Obscure' is the most suitable antonym for 'Elucidate'.
oa:
This word means to make a statement or situation less confused and more comprehensible. It is a direct synonym for the given word.
Synonyms: Explain (समझाना), Illuminate (स्पष्ट करना), Decode (सुलझाना).
Antonyms: Confuse (भ्रमित करना), Obscure (अस्पष्ट करना), Cloud (धुंधला करना).

This means to make an idea or situation clear to someone by describing it in more detail. It is the primary definition and synonym of elucidating.
Synonyms: Interpret (व्याख्या करना), Explicate (विस्तार से बताना), Describe (वर्णन करना).
Antonyms: Misinterpret (गलत समझना), Conceal (छिपाना), Hide (छिपाना).

This word means to keep from being seen; or to make something unclear and difficult to understand. It is the direct opposite of making something clear.
Synonyms: Befog (उलझाना), Complicate (जटिल बनाना), Mask (छिपाना).
Antonyms: Elucidate (स्पष्ट करना), Reveal (प्रकट करना), Clarify (साफ करना).

This literally means to help to clarify or explain something; or to light up. It is contextually synonymous with the act of elucidating.
Synonyms: Brighten (चमकाना), Highlight (उजागर करना), Enlighten (शिक्षित करना).
Antonyms: Darken (अंधेरा करना), Shadow (छाया डालना), Obfuscate (अस्पष्ट करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Euphemism
questionsEn.s:
Euphemism - प्रियभाषण (A mild or indirect word substituted for a harsh one)
Directness - प्रत्यक्षता (The quality of being plain and straightforward)
Ambiguity - अस्पष्टता (Openness to more than one interpretation)
Politeness - विनम्रता (Behavior that is respectful and considerate)
Formality - औपचारिकता (Rigid observance of convention or etiquette)


Hence, 'Directness' is the most suitable antonym for 'Euphemism'.
oa:
This word refers to the quality of being plain, straightforward, and honest in expression. It is the direct opposite of using a mild or indirect term to hide a harsh reality.
Synonyms: Frankness (साफ़गोई), Candor (स्पष्टवादिता), Bluntness (मुँहफटपन).
Antonyms: Evasion (टाल-मटोल), Deceit (छल), Euphemism (प्रियभाषण).

This word refers to the quality of being open to more than one interpretation; inexactness. While often indirect, it describes confusion rather than the intentional softening of language.
Synonyms: Vagueness (अस्पष्टता), Obscurity (गूढ़ता), Uncertainty (अनिश्चितता).
Antonyms: Clarity (स्पष्टता), Precision (सटीकता), Certainty (निश्चितता).

This refers to behavior that is respectful and considerate of other people. While euphemisms are often used to be polite, the word describes a manner rather than a linguistic tool of indirectness.
Synonyms: Courtesy (शिष्टाचार), Civility (सभ्यता), Gentility (शालीनता).
Antonyms: Rudeness (अशिष्टता), Insolence (बदतमीज़ी), Impoliteness (अभद्रता).

This refers to the rigid observance of convention or etiquette. It is contextually unrelated to the specific practice of replacing harsh words with mild ones.
Synonyms: Protocol (नियम), Ritual (रीति-रिवाज), Solemnity (औपचारिकता).
Antonyms: Casualness (अनौपचारिकता), Familiarity (घनिष्ठता), Ease (सहजता).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Obsolete
questionsEn.s:
Obsolete - अप्रचलित (No longer produced or used; out of date)
Outdated - पुराना (Old-fashioned or no longer useful)
Ancient - प्राचीन (Belonging to the very distant past)
Current - वर्तमान (Belonging to the present time; happening now)
Disused - प्रयोग में न होना (No longer being used)


Hence, 'Current' is the most suitable antonym for 'Obsolete'.
oa:
This word describes something that is old-fashioned or no longer useful. It is a perfect synonym for the given word.
Synonyms: Archaic (प्राचीन), Antiquated (पुराना), Passed (बीता हुआ).
Antonyms: Modern (आधुनिक), Current (वर्तमान), New (नया).

This refers to something belonging to the very distant past and no longer in existence. It functions as a synonym that emphasizes extreme age and lack of use.
Synonyms: Antique (पुरातन), Primitive (आदिम), Venerable (प्राचीन).
Antonyms: Recent (हालिया), Contemporary (समकालीन), Fresh (ताज़ा).

This word refers to something belonging to the present time; happening or being used now. it is the direct and most appropriate opposite for being no longer in use.
Synonyms: Present (वर्तमान), Contemporary (समकालीन), Modern (आधुनिक).
Antonyms: Obsolete (अप्रासंगिक), Past (भूतकाल), Old (पुराना).

This describes something that is no longer being used. It is an exact synonym for the given word, focusing on the cessation of use.
Synonyms: Abandoned (त्यागा हुआ), Neglected (उपेक्षित), Defunct (मृत).
Antonyms: Active (सक्रिय), Utilized (उपयोग में), Employed (प्रयुक्त).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Cajole
questionsEn.s:
Cajole - फुसलाना (Persuade someone by sustained coaxing or flattery)
Entice - लुभाना (Attract or tempt by offering pleasure or advantage)
Bully - धमकाना (Intimidate or coerce someone forcefully)
Persuade - मनाना (Convince someone through reasoning or argument)
Flatter - चापलूसी करना (Lavish insincere praise on someone for self-interest)


Hence, 'Bully' is the most suitable antonym for 'Cajole'.
oa:
This word means to attract or tempt by offering pleasure or advantage. It is a synonym because both involve persuading someone, though through different means.
Synonyms: Lure (लुभाना), Seduce (बहलाना), Tempt (ललचाना).
Antonyms: Repel (पीछे हटाना), Dissuade (रोकना), Warn (चेतावनी देना).

This word means to seek to harm, intimidate, or coerce someone who is perceived as vulnerable. It is the direct opposite of using gentle persuasion or flattery to get what one wants.
Synonyms: Intimidate (धमकाना), Coerce (मजबूर करना), Browbeat (डराना).
Antonyms: Cajole (फुसलाना), Comfort (सांत्वना देना), Support (सहयोग करना).

This means to convince someone to do something through reasoning or argument. It is the core meaning and a direct synonym of the given word.
Synonyms: Convince (मनाना), Influence (प्रभावित करना), Coax (फुसलाना).
Antonyms: Deter (रोकना), Discourage (हतोत्साहित करना), Halt (रोकना).

This word means to lavish insincere praise and compliments upon someone, especially to further one's own interests. It is a primary method of cajoling, making it a synonym.
Synonyms: Adulate (चापलूसी करना), Praise (प्रशंसा करना), Compliment (सराहना).
Antonyms: Insult (अपमान करना), Criticize (आलोचना करना), Mock (मज़ाक उड़ाना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Obdurate
questionsEn.s:
Obdurate - हठी (Stubbornly refusing to change one's opinion)
Adamant - अटल (Refusing to be persuaded or change one's mind)
Inflexible - कठोर (Unwilling to change or compromise)
Compliant - आज्ञाकारी (Disposed to agree with others or obey rules)
Unyielding - अडिग (Not giving way to pressure; hard or solid)


Hence, 'Compliant' is the most suitable antonym for 'Obdurate'.
oa:
This word refers to someone who is refusing to be persuaded or to change one's mind. It is a direct synonym for the stubborn nature of the given word.
Synonyms: Firm (दृढ़), Unshakable (अटल), Fixed (तय).
Antonyms: Pliable (लचीला), Yielding (झुकने वाला), Hesitant (दुविधापूर्ण).

This describes someone or something that is unwilling to change or compromise. It matches the "unyielding" aspect perfectly, acting as a synonym.
Synonyms: Rigid (कठोर), Stubborn (जिद्दी), Unbending (अटल).
Antonyms: Flexible (लचीला), Adaptable (अनुकूलनीय), Compliant (अनुरूप).

This word describes someone who is disposed to agree with others or obey rules, especially to an excessive degree. It is the direct opposite of being stubborn and unyielding.
Synonyms: Obedient (आज्ञाकारी), Docile (विनम्र), Cooperative (सहयोगी).
Antonyms: Obdurate (हठी), Defiant (विद्रोही), Obstinate (जिद्दी).

This refers to someone who is not giving way to pressure; hard or solid. It is an exact synonym for the given word.
Synonyms: Relentless (बेरहम), Staunch (कट्टर), Persistent (लगातार).
Antonyms: Weak (कमजोर), Soft (कोमल), Yielding (झुकने वाला).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Obstinate
questionsEn.s:
Obstinate - ज़िद्दी (Stubbornly refusing to change one's opinion)
Adamant - अटल (Refusing to be persuaded or change one's mind)
Stubborn - हठी (Determined not to change one's position)
Pliable - लचीला (Easily influenced; yielding or flexible)
Headstrong - उद्दंड (Energetic, self-willed, and stubborn)


Hence, 'Pliable' is the most suitable antonym for 'Obstinate'.
oa:
This refers to someone who is refusing to be persuaded or to change one's mind. It is a synonym that describes a similar level of stubbornness to the question word.
Synonyms: Stubborn (जिद्दी), Fixed (तय), Firm (दृढ़).
Antonyms: Yielding (झुकने वाला), Uncertain (अनिश्चित), Flexible (लचीला).

This word describes having a dogged determination not to change one's attitude or position. It is the primary definition and most common synonym of being obstinate.
Synonyms: Obstinate (हठी), Headstrong (हठी), Dogged (हठी).
Antonyms: Compliant (आज्ञाकारी), Pliable (लचीला), Docile (विनम्र).

This word describes someone who is easily influenced or yielding; being flexible. It is the direct and most appropriate opposite for being stubborn and difficult to move.
Synonyms: Adaptable (अनुकूलनीय), Malleable (लचीला), Supple (कोमल).
Antonyms: Obstinate (जिद्दी), Rigid (कठोर), Hard (कठिन).

This word describes someone who is energetic, self-willed, and stubborn. It functions as a synonym describing an impulsive form of obstinacy.
Synonyms: Wilful (ज़िद्दी), Refractory (उद्दंड), Wayward (स्वेच्छाचारी).
Antonyms: Obedient (आज्ञाकारी), Submissive (दब्बू), Controlled (नियंत्रित).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Superfluous
questionsEn.s:
Superfluous - अनावश्यक (Unnecessary, especially through being more than enough)
Redundant - फालतू (Not or no longer needed or useful)
Unnecessary - फालतू (Not needed; more than is necessary)
Essential - अनिवार्य (Absolutely necessary; extremely important)
Extra - अतिरिक्त (Added to an existing or usual amount)


Hence, 'Essential' is the most suitable antonym for 'Superfluous'.
oa:
This word refers to something that is not or no longer needed or useful; being superfluous. It is a direct synonym for the given word.
Synonyms: Excess (अतिरिक्त), Surplus (फालतू), Spare (अतिरिक्त).
Antonyms: Essential (अनिवार्य), Scarce (दुर्लभ), Needed (आवश्यक).

This describes something that is not needed or wanted. It is the core definition and a simple synonym for being superfluous.
Synonyms: Nonessential (अनावश्यक), Worthless (बेकार), Futile (व्यर्थ).
Antonyms: Important (महत्वपूर्ण), Necessary (ज़रूरी), Basic (मौलिक).

This word refers to something that is absolutely necessary; extremely important. it is the direct opposite of being extra or not needed.
Synonyms: Vital (महत्वपूर्ण), Crucial (अनिवार्य), Indispensable (अपरिहार्य).
Antonyms: Superfluous (अनावश्यक), Trivial (तुच्छ),

This refers to something added to an existing or usual amount or number. It is a synonym that captures the "additional" aspect of being superfluous.
Synonyms: Additional (अतिरिक्त), Supplemental (पूरक), Reserve (आरक्षित).
Antonyms: Main (मुख्य), Lacking (कम), Deficiency (अपूर्णता).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Propitiate
questionsEn.s:
Propitiate - शांत करना/मनाना (Win or regain the favor of by doing something)
Appease - संतुष्ट करना (Pacify someone by meeting their demands)
Mollify - नरम करना (Appease the anger or anxiety of someone)
Placate - शांत करना (Make someone less angry or hostile)
Enrage - क्रोधित करना (Make someone very angry)


Hence, 'Enrage' is the most suitable antonym for 'Propitiate'.
oa:
This word means to pacify or placate someone by acceding to their demands. It is a direct synonym for the given word's act of calming someone.
Synonyms: Mollify (शांत करना), Conciliate (संतुष्ट करना), Assuage (कम करना).
Antonyms: Aggravate (बिगाड़ना), Irritate (चिढ़ाना), Provoke (उकसाना).

This means to appease the anger or anxiety of someone. It matches the soothing and calming nature of the question word, making it a synonym.
Synonyms: Soothe (शांत करना), Soften (कोमल बनाना), Pacify (शांत करना).
Antonyms: Enrage (क्रोधित करना), Upset (परेशान करना), Excite (उत्तेजित करना).

This means to make someone less angry or hostile. It is an exact synonym that describes the intentional calming of a situation.
Synonyms: Quiet (चुप करना), Settle (स्थिर करना), Satisfy (संतुष्ट करना).
Antonyms: Angur (नाराज़ करना), Incite (भड़काना), Stir (उत्तेजित करना).

This word means to make someone very angry. It is the direct and perfect opposite for attempting to win over or calm someone down.
Synonyms: Infuriate (क्रोधित करना), Madden (पागल करना), Incense (क्रोध दिलाना).
Antonyms: Propitiate (मनाना), Calm (शांत करना), Please (खुश करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Dogmatic
questionsEn.s:
Dogmatic - हठधर्मी (Inclined to lay down principles as undeniably true)
Stubborn - हठी (Determined not to change one's position)
Flexible - लचीला (Ready and able to change to adapt to circumstances)
Rigid - कठोर (Unable to bend or be changed; not adaptable)
Arrogant - अहंकारी (Revealing an exaggerated sense of importance)


Hence, 'Flexible' is the most suitable antonym for 'Dogmatic'.
oa:
This describes a person who is determined not to change their attitude or position. It aligns with the unyielding nature of being dogmatic, making it a synonym.
Synonyms: Obstinate (हठी), Inflexible (कठोर), Mulish (जिद्दी).
Antonyms: Yielding (झुकने वाला), Submissive (दब्बू), Pliable (कोमल).

This word describes a person who is ready and able to change so as to adapt to different circumstances. It is the direct opposite of holding opinions as undeniably true.
Synonyms: Adaptable (अनुकूलनीय), Open-minded (खुले विचारों वाला), Pliable (लचीला).
Antonyms: Rigid (कठोर), Dogmatic (कट्टर), Stubborn (जिद्दी).

This refers to something that is unable to bend or be forced out of shape; or not able to be changed or adapted. It is a direct synonym for the dogmatic mindset.
Synonyms: Stiff (सख्त), Unbending (अटल), Formal (औपचारिक).
Antonyms: Elastic (लोचदार), Fluid (तरल), Soft (नरम).

This describes a person having or revealing an exaggerated sense of one's own importance or abilities. While dogmatic people often seem arrogant, this word focuses on pride rather than fixed beliefs.
Synonyms: Haughty (घमंडी), Proud (अभिमानी), Conceited (अहंकारी).
Antonyms: Humble (विनम्र), Modest (विनीत), Shy (शर्मीला).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Clandestine
questionsEn.s:
Clandestine - गुप्त (Kept secret or done secretively)
Open - खुला (Frank and communicative; not secret)
Long - लंबा (Measuring a great distance from end to end)
Secret - रहस्य (Not meant to be known or seen by others)
Boring - उबाऊ (Not interesting; tedious)


Hence, 'Open' is the most suitable antonym for 'Clandestine'.
oa:
This word refers to something that is not concealed or secretive; being honest and frank. It is the direct and most accurate antonym for being secret or concealed.
Synonyms: Public (सार्वजनिक), Manifest (प्रकट), Explicit (स्पष्ट).
Antonyms: Clandestine (गुप्त), Hidden (छिपा हुआ), Covert (प्रच्छन्न).

This is an adjective describing great length in space or time. Since it refers to physical or temporal measurement, it is contextually unrelated to the secrecy of an act.
Synonyms: Extended (विस्तृत), Lengthy (लंबा), Protracted (दीर्घ).
Antonyms: Short (छोटा), Brief (संक्षिप्त), Abrupt (अचानक).

This refers to something that is not meant to be known or seen by others. It is the primary definition and direct synonym of the given word.
Synonyms: Confidential (गोपनीय), Private (निजी), Stealthy (चुपके से).
Antonyms: Known (ज्ञात), Revealed (प्रकट), Exposed (उजागर).

This refers to something that is not interesting; being tedious. It describes an emotional response and has no connection with whether an act is secret or open.
Synonyms: Dull (नीरस), Tedious (थकाऊ), Humdrum (फीका).
Antonyms: Exciting (रोमांचक), Interesting (दिलचस्प), Thrilling (उत्तेजक).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Sanguine
questionsEn.s:
Sanguine - आशावादी (Optimistic or positive, especially in an apparently bad situation)
Optimistic - आशावान (Hopeful and confident about the future)
Cheerful - हंसमुख (Noticeably happy and optimistic)
Pessimistic - निराशावादी (Tending to see the worst aspect of things)
Hopeful - आशान्वित (Feeling or inspiring optimism about the future)


Hence, 'Pessimistic' is the most suitable antonym for 'Sanguine'.
oa:
This word refers to being hopeful and confident about the future. It is the primary meaning and an exact synonym for the given word.
Synonyms: Confident (आत्मविश्वासी), Positive (सकारात्मक), Buoyant (उत्साही).
Antonyms: Pessimistic (निराशावादी), Gloomy (उदास), Hopeless (आशाहीन).

This describes a person who is noticeably happy and optimistic. It captures the bright mood implied by being sanguine, making it a synonym.
Synonyms: Jolly (हंसमुख), Merry (खुशहाल), Blithe (प्रसन्न).
Antonyms: Sad (दुखी), Morose (चिड़चिड़ा), Gloomy (निराशाजनक).

This word describes a person who tends to see the worst aspect of things or believes that the worst will happen. It is the direct and perfect antonym for being sanguine.
Synonyms: Cynical (कुटिल), Gloomy (उदास), Despondent (निराश).
Antonyms: Sanguine (आशावादी), Hopeful (आशावान), Optimistic (सकारात्मक).

This refers to feeling or inspiring optimism about a future event. It functions as a synonym that describes the core sentiment of a sanguine individual.
Synonyms: Aspiring (महत्वाकांक्षी), Expectant (आशावान), Promised (उज्ज्वल).
Antonyms: Despairing (निराश), Dismal (शोकपूर्ण), Doubtful (संदेहास्पद).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Rebarbative
questionsEn.s:
Rebarbative - अप्रिय (Unattractive and objectionable; repellent)
Attractive - आकर्षक (Pleasing or appealing to the senses)
Repulsive - घृणित (Causing intense distaste or disgust)
Off-putting - अरुचिकर (Unpleasant in a way that discourages interest)
Irritating - चिढ़ाने वाला (Showing or feeling slight anger; annoying)


Hence, 'Attractive' is the most suitable antonym for 'Rebarbative'.
oa:
This word refers to something that is pleasing or appealing to the senses; or having qualities that draw people in. it is the direct opposite of being repellent or irritating.
Synonyms: Appealing (मोहक), Alluring (लुभावना), Charming (आकर्षक).
Antonyms: Rebarbative (अप्रिय), Repulsive (घृणित), Ugly (भद्दा).

This describes something that is causing intense distaste or disgust. It is an exact synonym for the repellent nature of the question word.
Synonyms: Hideous (भयानक), Revolting (घिनौना), Loathsome (घृणास्पद).
Antonyms: Delightful (सुखद), Pleasant (सुहाना), Attractive (आकर्षक).

This refers to something that is unpleasant or unsettling in a way that discourages interest. It functions as a synonym describing an unattractive quality.
Synonyms: Unpleasant (अप्रिय), Distasteful (अरुचिकर), Repellent (प्रतिकारक).
Antonyms: Engaging (मनोहर), Welcoming (स्वागतपूर्ण), Inviting (लुभावना).

This describes something that is causing annoyance, impatience, or mild anger. It aligns with the irritating aspect of being rebarbative, making it a synonym.
Synonyms: Annoying (चिढ़ाने वाला), Vexing (कष्टदायक), Exasperating (क्रोध दिलाने वाला).
Antonyms: Soothing (शांत करने वाला), Pleasing (खुश करने वाला), Calming (सुकून देने वाला).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Exonerate
questionsEn.s:
Exonerate - दोषमुक्त करना (Absolve someone from blame for a fault or wrongdoing)
Convict - दोषी ठहराना (Declare someone to be guilty of a criminal offense)
Free - मुक्त (Not under the control or in the power of another)
Excuse - क्षमा करना (Lessen the blame attaching to a fault; forgive)
Liberate - आज़ाद करना (Set someone free from imprisonment or oppression)


Hence, 'Convict' is the most suitable antonym for 'Exonerate'.
oa:
This word means to declare someone to be guilty of a criminal offense by the verdict of a jury or the decision of a judge. it is the direct antonym for clearing someone of blame.
Synonyms: Sentence (सज़ा देना), Condemn (दोषी ठहराना), Indict (अभियुक्त बनाना).
Antonyms: Exonerate (दोषमुक्त करना), Absolve (बरी करना), Acquit (बरी करना).

This means to release someone from confinement or slavery; or to make something available. While similar to the result of being exonerated, it describes the physical act rather than the legal clearing of name.
Synonyms: Release (मुक्त करना), Liberate (आज़ाद करना), Discharge (छोड़ना).
Antonyms: Imprison (कैद करना), Confine (सीमित करना), Bind (जकड़ना).

This means to attempt to lessen the blame attaching to a fault or offense; or to forgive. It involves overlooking a fault rather than proving innocence, making it a weak synonym.
Synonyms: Pardon (क्षमा करना), Condone (नज़रअंदाज़ करना), Forgive (माफ़ करना).
Antonyms: Blame (दोष देना), Punish (दंड देना), Accuse (आरोप लगाना).

This word means to set someone free from a situation, especially imprisonment or slavery. It functions as a synonym describing the liberation following an exoneration.
Synonyms: Deliver (छुड़ाना), Emancipate (आज़ाद करना), Save (बचाना).
Antonyms: Enslave (गुलाम बनाना), Detain (हिरासत में लेना), Oppress (उत्पीड़ित करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Scrupulous
questionsEn.s:
Scrupulous - सदाचारी/सूक्ष्म (Diligent, thorough, and extremely attentive to details)
Honest - ईमानदार (Free of deceit and untruthfulness; sincere)
Immoral - अननैतिक (Not conforming to accepted standards of morality)
Conscientious - कर्तव्यनिष्ठ (Wishing to do what is right; thorough)
Ethical - नैतिक (Relating to moral principles)


Hence, 'Immoral' is the most suitable antonym for 'Scrupulous'.
oa:
This word describes a person who is truthful and sincere; free of deceit. It is a synonym that captures the moral integrity implied by being scrupulous.
Synonyms: Upright (ईमानदार), Veracious (सत्यवादी), Trustworthy (भरोसेमंद).
Antonyms: Dishonest (बेईमान), Corrupt (भ्रष्ट), Crooked (धूर्त).

This word describes a person or behavior that is not conforming to accepted standards of morality. It is the direct opposite of being morally careful and upright.
Synonyms: Wicked (दुष्ट), Unethical (अनैतिक), Dissolute (विषयी).
Antonyms: Moral (नैतिक), Scrupulous (सदाचारी), Virtuous (पवित्र).

This describes a person wishing to do what is right, especially to do one's work or duty well and thoroughly. It is an exact synonym for being scrupulous.
Synonyms: Diligent (परिश्रमी), Meticulous (सूक्ष्म), Painstaking (मेहनती).
Antonyms: Lazy (आलसी), Negligent (लापरवाह), Careless (असावधान).

This refers to something relating to moral principles or the branch of knowledge dealing with these. It serves as a synonym as it describes the high principles of a scrupulous person.
Synonyms: Moral (नैतिक), Principled (सैद्धांतिक), Honorable (माननीय).
Antonyms: Unprincipled (सिद्धांतहीन), Evil (बुरा), Sinful (पापी).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Intransigence
questionsEn.s:
Intransigence - अड़ियलपन (Refusal to change one's views or to agree about something)
Obstinacy - हठ (Stubbornness; the quality of being obstinate)
Compromise - समझौता (An agreement reached by mutual concession)
Defiance - अवहेलना (Open resistance; bold disobedience)
Rigidity - कठोरता (Inability to be to changed or adapted; stiffness)


Hence, 'Compromise' is the most suitable antonym for 'Intransigence'.
oa:
This word refers to the quality or condition of being stubborn; being obstinate. It is an exact synonym for the refusal to change one's position.
Synonyms: Stubbornness (हठ), Tenacity (दृढ़ता), Rigidity (कठोरता).
Antonyms: Flexibility (लचीलापन), Obedience (आज्ञाकारिता), Compliance (अनुपालन).

This word refers to an agreement or a settlement of a dispute that is reached by each side making concessions. it is the direct opposite of being stubborn and refusing to yield.
Synonyms: Agreement (समझौता), Accord (सहमति), Concession (रियायत).
Antonyms: Dispute (विवाद), Intransigence (अड़ियलपन), Conflict (टकराव).

This refers to open resistance or bold disobedience. It is a synonym that describes an aggressive form of the stubbornness found in intransigence.
Synonyms: Rebellion (विद्रोह), Insubordination (अनाज्ञाकारिता), Contumacy (अवज्ञा).
Antonyms: Submission (समर्पण), Compliance (पालन), Resignation (त्याग).

This word describes the inability to be to changed or adapted; being stiff and fixed. It functions as a synonym describing the fixed nature of an intransigent person.
Synonyms: Hardness (सख्ती), Inflexibility (कठोरता), Stiff (दृढ़ता).
Antonyms: Elasticity (लोच), Softness (कोमलता), Fluidity (तरलता).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Imbroglio
questionsEn.s:
Imbroglio - उलझन (An extremely confused, complicated, or embarrassing situation)
Entanglement - फँसाव (A complicated or compromising relationship)
Complication - जटिलता (A factor that makes something more difficult)
Agreement - समझौता (Harmony or accordance in opinion)
Dispute - विवाद (A disagreement, argument, or debate)


Hence, 'Agreement' is the most suitable antonym for 'Imbroglio'.
oa:
This word refers to a complicated or compromising relationship or situation. It is a perfect synonym for the confusing nature of an imbroglio.
Synonyms: Complexity (जटिलता), Snarl (उलझन), Mesh (जाल).
Antonyms: Simplicity (सरलता), Clarity (स्पष्टता), Solution (समाधान).

This refers to a circumstance that complicates something; a difficult factor or issue. It aligns with the messy and confused aspect of the question word, acting as a synonym.
Synonyms: Difficulty (मुश्किल), Obstacle (बाधा), Intricacy (बारीकी).
Antonyms: Ease (आसानी), Benefit (लाभ), Advantage (फायदा).

This word refers to harmony or accordance in opinion or feeling; or a negotiated settlement. it is the best opposite for a state of complicated disagreement or confusion.
Synonyms: Concord (सामंजस्य), Harmony (तालमेल), Settlement (समझौता).
Antonyms: Imbroglio (उलझन), Conflict (संघर्ष), Dispute (विवाद).

This refers to a disagreement, argument, or debate. It describes the common cause of an imbroglio, making it a contextual synonym.
Synonyms: Quarrel (झगड़ा), Contention (विवाद), Feud (दुश्मनी).
Antonyms: Accord (सहमति), Peace (शांति), Conciliation (मिलाप).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Tedious
questionsEn.s:
Tedious - उबाऊ (Too long, slow, or dull; tiresome or monotonous)
Dull - नीरस (Lacking interest or excitement)
Boring - ऊबाऊ (Not interesting; tedious)
Exciting - रोमांचक (Causing great enthusiasm and eagerness)
Tiresome - थकाने वाला (Causing one to feel bored or annoyed)


Hence, 'Exciting' is the most suitable antonym for 'Tedious'.
oa:
This word refers to something that is lacking interest or excitement; uninspiring. It is an exact synonym for being tedious.
Synonyms: Boring (ऊबाऊ), Humdrum (नीरस), Prosaic (फीका).
Antonyms: Bright (चमकदार), Sharp (तीक्ष्ण), Exciting (रोमांचक).

This word describes something that is not interesting and makes you feel tired or impatient. It is the primary definition and common synonym of the given word.
Synonyms: Wearisome (थकाऊ), Tiresome (ऊबाऊ), Stale (बासी/पुराना).
Antonyms: Fascinating (दिलचस्प), Engaging (मोहक), Intriguing (लुभावना).

This word refers to something that is causing great enthusiasm and eagerness. it is the direct and most appropriate opposite for being boring or tiresome.
Synonyms: Thrilling (उत्तेजक), Exhilarating (हर्षित करने वाला), Stimulating (स्फूर्तिदायक).
Antonyms: Tedious (थकाऊ), Boring (नीरस), Dull (सुस्त).

This describes something that is causing one to feel bored or annoyed. It is a near-perfect synonym that highlights the exhaustion caused by a tedious task.
Synonyms: Irksome (परेशान करने वाला), Monotonous (एकरस), Dreary (सुनसान).
Antonyms: Refreshing (ताज़ा), Pleasurable (सुखद), Interesting (रुचिकर).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Covert
questionsEn.s:
Covert - गुप्त (Not openly acknowledged or displayed)
Secret - रहस्य (Not meant to be known or seen by others)
Hidden - छिपा हुआ (Kept out of sight; concealed)
Clandestine - अवैध/गुप्त (Kept secret or done secretively)
Overt - प्रत्यक्ष (Done or shown openly; plainly apparent)


Hence, 'Overt' is the most suitable antonym for 'Covert'.
oa:
This word refers to something that is not meant to be known or seen by others. It is the core definition and primary synonym of being covert.
Synonyms: Private (निजी), Stealthy (चुपके से), Underground (गुप्त).
Antonyms: Known (ज्ञात), Revealed (प्रकट), Open (खुला).

This describes something that is kept out of sight or concealed. It matches the "covered" aspect of the question word, acting as a synonym.
Synonyms: Camouflaged (छिपा हुआ), Cloaked (ढका हुआ), Latent (अंतर्निहित).
Antonyms: Visible (दृश्य), Apparent (स्पष्ट), Exposed (उजागर).

This refers to something kept secret or done secretively, especially because it is illicit. It is a formal synonym for being covert.
Synonyms: Surreptitious (गुप्त), Furitive (चोरी-छिपे), Underhand (कपटपूर्ण).
Antonyms: Authorised (अधिकृत), Public (सार्वजनिक), Legal (वैध).

This word refers to something done or shown openly; being plainly apparent and not secret or hidden. it is the direct antonym for being secret or concealed.
Synonyms: Manifest (प्रकट), Explicit (स्पष्ट), Unconcealed (खुला).
Antonyms: Covert (गुप्त), Hidden (छिपा हुआ), Cryptic (रहस्यमय).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Disparate
questionsEn.s:
Disparate - भिन्न (Essentially different in kind; not allowing comparison)
Alike - एक जैसा (Similar to each other; in a similar way)
Different - अलग (Not the same as another or each other)
Contrasting - विपरीत (Differing strikingly in comparison)
Dissimilar - असमान (Not alike; different)


Hence, 'Alike' is the most suitable antonym for 'Disparate'.
oa:
This word describes things that are similar to each other or in the same manner. it is the perfect opposite for things that are essentially different and distinct in kind.
Synonyms: Similar (समान), Akin (एक जैसा), Uniform (एकरूप).
Antonyms: Disparate (भिन्न), Distinct (अलग), Diverse (विविध).

This word refers to things that are not the same as each other or are unlike in nature. it is a primary synonym for the diversity found in disparate items.
Synonyms: Dissimilar (असमान), Diverse (विविध), Variation (विभिन्न).
Antonyms: Identical (समान), Same (वही), Similar (समान).

This refers to things that show a striking difference when compared. It captures the divergence aspect, functioning as a synonym.
Synonyms: Conflicting (विरोधी), Opposing (विपरीत), Divergent (अलग).
Antonyms: Parallel (समांतर), Matching (मेल खाता हुआ), Consistent (संगत).

This word describes things that are not alike; being different. It is an exact synonym for the lack of similarity implied by being disparate.
Synonyms: Unrelated (असंबंधित), Heterogeneous (विविध), Distinct (अलग).
Antonyms: Alike (समान), Equivalent (बराबर), Analogous (तुलनीय).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Denial
questionsEn.s:
Denial - अस्वीकार (The action of declaring something to be untrue)
Affirmation - अभिपुष्टि (The action of confirming something to be true)
Opposition - विरोध (Resistance or dissent, expressed in action or argument)
Refusal - इनकार (An act of indicating that one is not willing to do something)
Liberal - उदार (Willing to respect or accept behavior different from one's own)


Hence, 'Affirmation' is the most suitable antonym for 'Denial'.
oa:
This word refers to the action of confirming something to be true, or a formal statement of agreement. it is the direct opposite of refusing to accept something.
Synonyms: Confirmation (पुष्टि), Assent (सहमति), Acceptance (स्वीकृति).
Antonyms: Denial (अस्वीकार), Refusal (इनकार), Rejection (अस्वीकृति).

This refers to the act of disagreeing strongly with something and trying to prevent its success. While negative, it refers to a conflict of power rather than the mere refusal to accept a truth.
Synonyms: Resistance (प्रतिरोध), Hostility (शत्रुता), Antagonism (विरोध).
Antonyms: Support (सहयोग), Cooperation (सहयोग), Agreement (सहमति).

This word refers to the act of indicating or showing that one is not willing to do or accept something. It is the most direct synonym for denial.
Synonyms: Rejection (अस्वीकृति), Declination (अस्वीकार), Veto (अधिकार का प्रयोग कर रोकना).
Antonyms: Consent (सहमति), Permission (अनुमति), Grant (स्वीकृति).

This word refers to being open to new behavior or opinions and willing to discard traditional values. It describes a personality or political trait and is contextually unrelated to the act of denying.
Synonyms: Progressive (प्रगतिशील), Tolerant (सहनशील), Broad-minded (उदार).
Antonyms: Conservative (रूढ़िवादी), Narrow-minded (संकीर्ण), Strict (सख्त).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Differ
questionsEn.s:
Differ - भिन्न होना (Be unlike or dissimilar)
Conform - अनुरूप होना (Be similar in form or type; comply with rules)
Question - सवाल उठाना (Feel or express doubt about; raise an objection)
Reject - अस्वीकार करना (Dismiss as inadequate or inappropriate)
Ignore - अनदेखा करना (Refuse to take notice of or acknowledge)


Hence, 'Conform' is the most suitable antonym for 'Differ'.


101. Select the word opposite in meaning to: Disparate
A) Distinct /// This term describes things that are clearly separate and different from each other in quality or character. It shares a similar meaning with the question word and thus cannot be considered its opposite.
Synonyms: Discrete (विशिष्ट), Individual (अलग), Diverse (विविध).
Antonyms: Similar (समान), Identical (एक जैसा), Alike (समान).
B) Separate /// This word refers to items that are kept apart or are distinct from one another. It reinforces the idea of being different or disconnected, which aligns with the given word.
Synonyms: Detached (अलग), Disconnected (असंबद्ध), Independent (स्वतंत्र).
Antonyms: Connected (जुड़ा हुआ), United (संयुक्त), Integrated (एकीकृत).
C) Similar ✅ /// This word describes things that look or act like each other or have characteristics in common. It is the direct opposite of being disparate, which refers to things so unlike that they cannot be compared.
Synonyms: Alike (समान), Akin (सजातीय), Comparable (तुलनीय).
Antonyms: Disparate (भिन्न), Different (अलग), Dissimilar (असमान).
D) Contrasting /// This refers to things that are very different from each other in a noticeable way. Since it emphasizes the lack of similarity, it acts as a synonym for the given word.
Synonyms: Conflicting (विरोधाभासी), Contradictory (विपरीत), Divergent (भिन्न).
Antonyms: Harmonious (सामंजस्यपूर्ण), Consistent (सुसंगत), Uniform (एकसमान).
Disparate - भिन्न / विजातीय (Essentially different in kind)
Distinct - स्पष्ट / अलग (Clearly separate and different)
Separate - पृथक (Not joined, connected, or combined)
Similar - समान / एक जैसा (Having a resemblance in appearance or character)
Contrasting - विपरीत (Differing strikingly)


Hence, 'Similar' is the most suitable antonym for 'Disparate'.


102. Select the word opposite in meaning to: Hegemony
A) Subordination ✅ /// This term refers to the action or state of being placed in or occupying a lower rank or position. It is the perfect opposite of hegemony, which represents dominance or leadership by one group over others.
Synonyms: Inferiority (अधीनता), Dependency (निर्भरता), Servitude (गुलामी).
Antonyms: Supremacy (सर्वोच्चता), Dominance (प्रभुत्व), Hegemony (आधिपत्य).
B) Leadership /// This refers to the action of leading a group of people or an organization. While it is a form of influence, it is often seen as a synonym for the power exercised in hegemony.
Synonyms: Guidance (मार्गदर्शन), Authority (अधिकार), Command (कमान).
Antonyms: Followership (अनुगामिता), Obedience (आज्ञाकारिता), Subservience (चापलूसी).
C) Equality /// This word describes the state of being equal, especially in status, rights, and opportunities. While it represents a lack of dominance, it describes a balanced state rather than the specific state of being under control.
Synonyms: Parity (समानता), Fairness (निष्पक्षता), Uniformity (एकरूपता).
Antonyms: Inequality (असमानता), Disparity (विषमता), Hierarchy (श्रेणीबद्धता).
D) Authority /// This refers to the power or right to give orders, make decisions, and enforce obedience. It is a fundamental component of hegemony and therefore acts as a synonym.
Synonyms: Power (शक्ति), Control (नियंत्रण), Jurisdiction (अधिकार क्षेत्र).
Antonyms: Powerlessness (शक्तिहीनता), Weakness (कमज़ोरी), Incapacity (अक्षमता).
Hegemony - आधिपत्य (Leadership or dominance, especially by one state over others)
Subordination - अधीनता (The state of being lower in rank or position)
Leadership - नेतृत्व (The action of leading a group or organization)
Equality - समानता (The state of being equal, especially in status or rights)
Authority - अधिकार (The power or right to give orders or make decisions)


Hence, 'Subordination' is the most suitable antonym for 'Hegemony'.


103. Select the word opposite in meaning to: Contumacious
A) Rebellious /// This word describes a person who is showing a desire to resist authority, control, or convention. It is a direct synonym for being contumacious and thus fails to be an opposite.
Synonyms: Defiant (विद्रोही), Mutinous (बगावती), Insubordinate (अनाज्ञाकारी).
Antonyms: Compliant (आज्ञाकारी), Docile (विनम्र), Submissive (दब्बू).
B) Obedient ✅ /// This word refers to a person who is willing to comply with orders or requests or to submit to another's authority. It is the direct opposite of being stubbornly disobedient.
Synonyms: Dutiful (कर्तव्यपरायण), Submissive (दब्बू), Compliant (अनुकूल).
Antonyms: Contumacious (अड़ियल), Rebellious (विद्रोही), Obstinate (ज़िद्दी).
C) Unruly /// This refers to someone or something that is disorderly and disruptive and not amenable to discipline or control. It functions as a synonym for the given word.
Synonyms: Wild (अनियंत्रित), Rowdy (उपद्रवी), Disobedient (अनाज्ञाकारी).
Antonyms: Orderly (व्यवस्थित), Manageable (प्रबंधनीय), Disciplined (अनुशासित).
D) Stubborn /// This describes a person who is having or showing dogged determination not to change one's attitude or position. It captures the essence of contumacious behavior, making it a synonym.
Synonyms: Obstinate (ज़िद्दी), Headstrong (हठी), Mulish (अड़ियल).
Antonyms: Flexible (लचीला), Pliable (कोमल), Yielding (झुकने वाला).
Contumacious - अवज्ञाकारी (Stubbornly or willfully disobedient to authority)
Rebellious - विद्रोही (Showing a desire to resist authority)
Obedient - आज्ञाकारी (Willing to comply with orders or requests)
Unruly - अनियंत्रित (Disorderly and disruptive; not amenable to control)
Stubborn - ज़िद्दी (Determined not to change one's position on something)


Hence, 'Obedient' is the most suitable antonym for 'Contumacious'.


104. Select the word opposite in meaning to: Foment
A) Incite /// This means to encourage or stir up violent or unlawful behavior. It describes the same action as the given word and is therefore a synonym.
Synonyms: Provoke (उकसाना), Agitate (उत्तेजित करना), Instigate (भड़काना).
Antonyms: Calm (शांत करना), Discourage (निरुत्साहित करना), Deter (रोकना).
B) Stir /// This refers to a state of excitement, anger, or interest among a group of people. It aligns with the goal of fomenting trouble, making it a synonym.
Synonyms: Arouse (जगाना), Kindle (सुलगाना), Stimulate (प्रेरित करना).
Antonyms: Quell (दबाना), Allay (शांत करना), Subdue (वश में करना).
C) Quash ✅ /// This word means to put an end to something, especially by force, or to suppress a feeling or movement. it is the direct opposite of stirring up or fomenting trouble.
Synonyms: Suppress (दबाना), Extinguish (मिटाना), Nullify (रद्द करना).
Antonyms: Foment (भड़काना), Encourage (बढ़ावा देना), Provoke (उकसाना).
D) Instigate /// This word means to bring about or initiate an action or event, especially something bad. It is an exact synonym for foment.
Synonyms: Prompt (प्रेरित करना), Trigger (शुरू करना), Abet (उकसाना).
Antonyms: Halt (रोकना), Prevent (रोकना), Stifle (दबाना).
Foment - भड़काना (Instigate or stir up an undesirable or violent action)
Incite - उकसाना (Encourage or stir up unlawful behavior)
Stir - उत्तेजित करना (Arouse a strong feeling in someone)
Quash - कुचलना / दबाना (Put an end to; suppress)
Instigate - भड़काना (Bring about or initiate something, especially bad)


Hence, 'Quash' is the most suitable antonym for 'Foment'.


105. Select the word opposite in meaning to: Abstruse
A) Cryptic /// This word describes a meaning that is mysterious or obscure, often deliberately so. It shares the characteristic of being hard to understand, making it a synonym.
Synonyms: Enigmatic (रहस्यमय), Puzzling (पेचीदा), Arcane (गुप्त).
Antonyms: Straightforward (सीधा), Plain (स्पष्ट), Evident (प्रकट).
B) Obscure /// This refers to something not discovered or known about; uncertain or unclear. It is a direct synonym for the complex nature of the question word.
Synonyms: Vague (अस्पष्ट), Ambiguous (अनेकार्थी), Murky (धुंधला).
Antonyms: Famous (प्रसिद्ध), Clear (स्पष्ट), Obvious (ज़ाहिर).
C) Clear ✅ /// This word refers to something that is easy to perceive, understand, or interpret. It is the direct opposite of being abstruse, which describes something profoundly difficult to grasp.
Synonyms: Lucid (सुस्पष्ट), Manifest (प्रकट), Explicit (साफ़).
Antonyms: Abstruse (गूढ़), Vague (अस्पष्ट), Mysterious (रहस्यमय).
D) Incomprehensible /// This word refers to something that is not able to be understood or grasped by the mind. It functions as a strong synonym for the given word.
Synonyms: Unfathomable (अथाह), Intelligible (समझ से बाहर), Perplexing (हैरान करने वाला).
Antonyms: Intelligible (सुबोध), Comprehensible (समझने योग्य), Simple (सरल).
Abstruse - गूढ़ / जटिल (Difficult to understand; obscure)
Cryptic - रहस्यमय (Having a meaning that is mysterious or obscure)
Obscure - अस्पष्ट (Not discovered or known about; uncertain)
Clear - स्पष्ट (Easy to perceive, understand, or interpret)
Incomprehensible - समझ से बाहर (Not able to be understood)


Hence, 'Clear' is the most suitable antonym for 'Abstruse'.


106. Select the word opposite in meaning to: Evanescent
A) Fleeting /// This word describes something that lasts for a very short time. Since it matches the fleeting nature of the given word, it acts as a synonym.
Synonyms: Momentary (क्षणिक), Short-lived (अल्पकालिक), Passing (अस्थायी).
Antonyms: Lasting (टिकाऊ), Permanent (स्थायी), Constant (नियमित).
B) Transient /// This refers to staying or lasting only for a short time. It captures the essence of vanishing quickly, making it a direct synonym.
Synonyms: Ephemeral (क्षणभंगुर), Fugitive (अस्थायी), Impermanent (अनित्य).
Antonyms: Persistent (दृढ़), Eternal (अनंत), Enduring (स्थायी).
C) Enduring ✅ /// This word refers to something that lasts over a long period of time or is durable and permanent. it is the direct opposite of vanishing quickly like a vapor.
Synonyms: Abiding (अटल), Permanent (स्थायी), Perpetual (लगातार).
Antonyms: Fleeting (क्षणिक), Evanescent (क्षणभंगुर), Brief (लघु).
D) Ephemeral /// This describes things that are very short-lived or transitory. It is functionally identical to the question word and therefore serves as a synonym.
Synonyms: Transitory (अल्पकालिक), Brief (संक्षिप्त), Fugacious (क्षणिक).
Antonyms: Immortal (अमर), Lifelong (आजीवन), Everlasting (शाश्वत).
Evanescent - क्षणभंगुर (Soon passing out of sight, memory, or existence)
Fleeting - क्षणिक (Lasting for a very short time)
Transient - अस्थायी (Lasting only for a short time; impermanent)
Enduring - स्थायी (Continuing or long-lasting)
Ephemeral - अल्पकालिक (Lasting for a very short time)


Hence, 'Enduring' is the most suitable antonym for 'Evanescent'.


107. Select the word opposite in meaning to: Concomitant
A) Separate ✅ /// This term describes things that are kept apart, disconnected, or independent of one another. It is the direct opposite of being concomitant, which implies things happening together.
Synonyms: Detached (अलग), Independent (स्वतंत्र), Unconnected (असंबद्ध).
Antonyms: Linked (जुड़ा हुआ), Associated (संबद्ध), Concomitant (सहगामी).
B) Related /// This word refers to things belonging to the same family, group, or type; connected. Since it implies a bond or association, it serves as a synonym.
Synonyms: Allied (संबद्ध), Akin (समान), Affiliated (संबद्ध).
Antonyms: Unrelated (असंबंधित), Foreign (विदेशी), Irrelevant (अप्रासंगिक).
C) Independent /// This describes things that are not influenced or controlled by others in matters of opinion or conduct. While close to being an opposite, it focuses on control rather than the timing of occurrence.
Synonyms: Self-reliant (आत्मनिर्भर), Autonomous (स्वायत्त), Free (मुक्त).
Antonyms: Dependent (निर्भर), Subordinate (अधीन), Connected (जुड़ा हुआ).
D) Detached /// This refers to things that are separate or disconnected, often used for physical items or emotional states. It is a strong synonym for being separate but does not capture the logical relationship as effectively as 'separate'.
Synonyms: Disconnected (अलग), Isolated (अलग-थलग), Loosened (ढीला).
Antonyms: Attached (जुड़ा हुआ), Conjoined (संयुक्त), Affixed (संबद्ध).
Concomitant - सहवर्ती (Naturally accompanying or associated)
Separate - पृथक (Setting or keeping apart; disconnected)
Related - संबंधित (Belonging to the same family, group, or type)
Independent - स्वतंत्र (Not depending on another's authority)
Detached - अलग (Separate or disconnected)


Hence, 'Separate' is the most suitable antonym for 'Concomitant'.


108. Select the word opposite in meaning to: Erudite
A) Ignorant ✅ /// This word describes a person who lacks knowledge, information, or education in general or specific areas. it is the most accurate antonym for someone who is deeply learned and scholarly.
Synonyms: Uneducated (अशिक्षित), Illiterate (अनपढ़), Uninformed (अज्ञानी).
Antonyms: Learned (विद्वान), Erudite (ज्ञानी), Knowledgeable (जानकार).
B) Intellectual /// This refers to a person possessing a highly developed intellect. It aligns with the mental capacity required to be erudite, acting as a synonym.
Synonyms: Cerebral (दिमागी), Rational (तार्किक), Academic (शैक्षिक).
Antonyms: Stupid (मूर्ख), Simple-minded (भोल-भाला), Brainless (बुद्धिहीन).
C) Wise /// This word refers to having or showing experience, knowledge, and good judgment. It is a positive synonymous trait that often accompanies erudition.
Synonyms: Sagacious (बुद्धिमान), Sage (ऋषि तुल्य), Judicious (विवेकपूर्ण).
Antonyms: Foolish (मूर्ख), Unwise (नासमझ), Injudicious (अविवेकपूर्ण).
D) Scholarly /// This describes a person who is devoted to academic study or possesses academic knowledge. It is a direct synonym for the quest word.
Synonyms: Academic (पंडित), Studious (अध्ययनशील), Lettered (साक्षर).
Antonyms: Unlearned (अशिक्षित), Ignorant (अज्ञानी), Illiterate (निरक्षर).
Erudite - विद्वान (Having or showing great knowledge or learning)
Ignorant - अज्ञानी (Lacking knowledge or awareness in general)
Intellectual - बौद्धिक (Relating to the intellect; possessing great intellect)
Wise - बुद्धिमान (Having or showing experience and good judgment)
Scholarly - पंडित (Involving or relating to serious academic study)


Hence, 'Ignorant' is the most suitable antonym for 'Erudite'.


109. Select the word opposite in meaning to: Dearth
A) Abundance ✅ /// This word refers to a very large quantity of something; being plentiful. it is the direct and most appropriate antonym for a scarcity or lack of something.
Synonyms: Plenty (प्रचुरता), Profusion (अत्यधिकता), Copiousness (भरमार).
Antonyms: Scarcity (कमी), Dearth (अभाव), Shortage (कमी).
B) Lack /// This word means the state of being without or not having enough of something. It is a direct synonym for the given word.
Synonyms: Deficiency (अभाव), Absence (अनुपस्थिति), Shortage (कमी).
Antonyms: Presence (उपस्थिति), Surplus (अतिरिक्त), Sufficiency (पर्याप्तता).
C) Shortage /// This refers to a situation in which something needed cannot be obtained in sufficient amounts. It functions as an exact synonym for dearth.
Synonyms: Deficit (घाटा), Scantiness (कमी), Paucity (अभाव).
Antonyms: Glut (भरमार), Excess (अति), Surplus (बहुतायत).
D) Scarcity /// This describes the state of being scarce or in short supply; a shortage. It is another core synonym for the word provided.
Synonyms: Rareness (दुर्लभता), Exiguity (अल्पता), Meagerness (कमी).
Antonyms: Abundance (प्रचुरता), Plethora (अत्यधिकता), Wealth (प्रचुरता).
Dearth - कमी / अभाव (A scarcity or lack of something)
Abundance - प्रचुरता (A very large quantity of something)
Lack - कमी (The state of being without enough of something)
Shortage - किल्लत (A situation in which something needed is insufficient)
Scarcity - दुर्लभता (The state of being in short supply)


Hence, 'Abundance' is the most suitable antonym for 'Dearth'.


110. Select the word opposite in meaning to: Parsimonious
A) Stingy /// This word refers to being mean or ungenerous with money; being unwilling to spend. it is a primary synonym for the question word.
Synonyms: Miserly (कंजूस), Niggardly (कंजूस), Penurious (दरिद्र).
Antonyms: Generous (उदार), Munificent (दानी), Liberal (मुक्तहस्त).
B) Frugal /// This word describes someone who is simple, plain, and costing little, often out of necessity or discipline. While similar to being parsimonious, it is more about avoiding waste.
Synonyms: Thrifty (मितव्ययी), Economical (किफायती), Sparing (किफायती).
Antonyms: Extravagant (फिजूलखर्च), Wasteful (अपव्ययी), Prodigal (अतिव्ययी).
C) Generous ✅ /// This word describes a person who is willing to give money, help, or resources freely, often more than expected. it is the direct opposite of being stingy or parsimonious.
Synonyms: Benevolent (परोपकारी), Charitable (दानशील), Altruistic (निःस्वार्थ).
Antonyms: Parsimonious (कंजूस), Greedy (लालची), Selfish (स्वार्थी).
D) Economical /// This refers to giving good value or service in relation to the amount of money or time spent. It is a synonymous concept related to careful spending.
Synonyms: Prudent (विवेकपूर्ण), Efficient (कुशल), Budget (किफायती).
Antonyms: Expensive (महंगा), Dear (कीमती), Lavish (भव्य).
Parsimonious - कंजूस (Very unwilling to spend money or use resources)
Stingy - अल्पव्ययी / कंजूस (Ungenerous; unwilling to give or spend)
Frugal - मितव्ययी (Sparing or economical with regard to money)
Generous - दानी / उदार (Willing to give more than is necessary or expected)
Economical - किफायती (Giving good value in relation to money spent)


Hence, 'Generous' is the most suitable antonym for 'Parsimonious'.


111. Select the word opposite in meaning to: Somnolent
A) Awake ✅ /// This word refers to being not asleep or being conscious and alert. it is the most appropriate opposite for a word that describes being sleepy or drowsy.
Synonyms: Conscious (सचेत), Alert (सतर्क), Watchful (चौकस).
Antonyms: Asleep (सोया हुआ), Dormant (सुप्त), Somnolent (निद्रालु).
B) Dull /// This describes something that is lacking interest or excitement; boring. While sometimes associated with drowsiness, it refers more to quality than a state of sleep.
Synonyms: Tedious (थकाऊ), Drab (फीका), Humdrum (नीरस).
Antonyms: Vivid (जीवंत), Sharp (तेज़), Bright (चमकदार).
C) Lethargic /// This word refers to being affected by lethargy; sluggish and apathetic. It is a near-synonym describing a lack of energy similar to being somnolent.
Synonyms: Listless (सुस्त), Passive (निष्क्रिय), Torpid (जड़).
Antonyms: Energetic (ऊर्जावान), Active (सक्रिय), Vigorous (जोशपूर्ण).
D) Sluggish /// This refers to being slow-moving or inactive; lacking in energy. It reinforces the drowsy connotation of the given word, making it a synonym.
Synonyms: Slow (धीमा), Heavy (भारी/सुस्त), Indolent (आलसी).
Antonyms: Quick (तेज़), Rapid (द्रुत), Fast (तेज़).
Somnolent - निद्रालु (Sleepy; drowsy; tending to cause sleep)
Awake - जागृत (Not asleep; conscious)
Dull - सुस्त (Lacking interest or excitement; boring)
Lethargic - ऊर्जाहीन (Sluggish and apathetic)
Sluggish - मंद (Slow-moving or inactive)


Hence, 'Awake' is the most suitable antonym for 'Somnolent'.


112. Select the word opposite in meaning to: Indefatigable
A) Tenacious /// This word describes someone who tends to keep a firm hold of something; being persistent or determined. It shares the "never giving up" trait with the given word, acting as a synonym.

Antonyms: Disparate (भिन्न), Different (अलग), Diverse (विविध).
B) Different /// This word describes things that are not the same as another or each other; unlike in nature. it is a primary synonym for the given word.
Synonyms: Dissimilar (असमान), Discrepant (विरोधाभासी), Various (विभिन्न).
Antonyms: Same (वही), Similar (समान), Matching (मिलता-जुलता).
C) Contrasting /// This refers to things differing strikingly from one another. It aligns with the idea of having distinct and separate qualities, making it a synonym.
Synonyms: Conflicting (विरोधी), Divergent (अलग), Adverse (विपरीत).
Antonyms: Complementary (पूरक), Uniform (एकरूप), Consistent (सुसंगत).
D) Dissimilar /// This describes things that are not alike; being different. It functions as an exact synonym for the given word.
Synonyms: Unlike (भिन्न), Distant (अलग), Distinct (विशिष्ट).
Antonyms: Resembling (मिलता-जुलता), Akin (सजातीय), Alike (समान).
Disparate - भिन्न / विजातीय (Essentially different in kind; not able to be compared)
Alike - एक जैसा (Similar to each other)
Different - अलग (Not the same as another or each other; unlike)
Contrasting - विपरीत (Differing strikingly)
Dissimilar - असमान (Not alike; different)


Hence, 'Alike' is the most suitable antonym for 'Disparate'.


149. Select the word opposite in meaning to: Denial
A) Affirmation ✅ /// This word refers to the action or process of affirming something or being affirmed; a formal declaration that something is true. it is the direct opposite of refusing to accept or deny the truth.
Synonyms: Confirmation (पुष्टि), Validation (मान्यता), Assent (सहमति).
Antonyms: Denial (अस्वीकार), Refusal (इन्कार), Negation (नकार).
B) Opposition /// This word refers to resistance or dissent, expressed in action or argument. While it involves a negative response, it is a broader term than a specific denial of a fact.
Synonyms: Resistance (विरोध), Obstruction (बाधा), Counteraction (प्रतिकार).
Antonyms: Support (समर्थन), Cooperation (सहयोग), Compliance (अनुपालन).
C) Refusal /// This word refers to the action of indicating or declaring that one is not willing to do something. It is a very close synonym for the act of denial.
Synonyms: Rejection (अस्वीकृति), Declination (अस्वीकार), Veto (निषेधाधिकार).
Antonyms: Acceptance (स्वीकृति), Consent (सहमति), Permission (अनुमति).
D) Liberal /// This word refers to being willing to respect or accept behavior or opinions different from one's own. It is contextually unrelated to the act of denying or affirming a statement.
Synonyms: Open-minded (खुले विचारों वाला), Broad (विस्तृत), Generous (उदार).
Antonyms: Conservative (रूढ़िवादी), Narrow (संकीर्ण), Strict (सख्त).
Denial - इनकार / अस्वीकार (The action of declaring something to be untrue)
Affirmation - पुष्टि / दृढ़ कथन (A formal declaration that something is true)
Opposition - विरोध (Resistance or dissent expressed in argument)
Refusal - अस्वीकृति (The act of indicating that one will not do something)
Liberal - उदार (Willing to accept different behavior or opinions)


Hence, 'Affirmation' is the most suitable antonym for 'Denial'.


150. Select the word opposite in meaning to: Differ
A) Conform ✅ /// This word means to comply with rules, standards, or laws, or to be similar in form or type. it is the direct antonym for being different or disagreeing.
Synonyms: Agree (सहमत होना), Accord (सामंजस्य बिठाना), Adapt (अनुकूल बनाना).
Antonyms: Differ (अलग होना), Dissent (असहमत होना), Vary (भिन्न होना).
B) Question /// This word refers to feeling or expressing doubt about something. While doubting is a part of differing, the word focuses on an inquiry rather than a state of being different.
Synonyms: Query (सवाल करना), Doubt (संदेह करना), Challenge (चुनौती देना).
Antonyms: Accept (स्वीकार करना), Trust (विश्वास करना), Answer (उत्तर देना).
C) Reject /// This means to dismiss as inadequate, unacceptable, or faulty. It is a reaction that often follows a difference of opinion, acting as a contextually related term rather than an opposite.
Synonyms: Dismiss (खारिज करना), Spurn (तिरस्कार करना), Decline (अस्वीकार करना).
Antonyms: Accept (स्वीकार करना), Adopt (अपनाना), Welcome (स्वागत करना).
D) Ignore /// This refers to refusing to take notice of or acknowledge something; being intentionally disregardful. It does not provide the logical contrast of "being the same" that 'conform' does.
