Synonyms: Disregard (उपेक्षा करना), Overlook (अनदेखा करना), Neglect (नज़रअंदाज़ करना).
Antonyms: Heed (ध्यान देना), Notice (ध्यान देना), Acknowledge (स्वीकार करना).
Differ - भिन्न होना / असहमत होना (Be unlike or dissimilar; be of a different opinion)
Conform - अनुरूप होना (Comply with rules or standards; be similar)
Question - सवाल उठाना (Feel or express doubt about something)
Reject - अस्वीकार करना (Dismiss as inadequate or unacceptable)
Ignore - अनदेखा करना (Refuse to take notice of or acknowledge)


Hence, 'Conform' is the most suitable antonym for 'Differ'.
oa:
This word means to be similar in form or type; or to behave according to socially acceptable conventions or standards. it is the most appropriate opposite for being different or unlike.
Synonyms: Agree (सहमत होना), Comply (अनुपालन करना), Harmonize (तालमेल बिठाना).
Antonyms: Differ (अलग होना), Dissent (असहमत होना), Vary (भिन्न होना).

This refers to the act of feeling or expressing doubt about something; or raising an objection. It is contextually unrelated to the quality of being alike or different.
Synonyms: Query (सवाल करना), Dispute (विवाद करना), Challenge (चुनौती देना).
Antonyms: Accept (स्वीकार करना), Trust (भरोसा करना), Believe (मानना).

This means to dismiss as inadequate, inappropriate, or not to one's taste. While it implies a difference in choice, it is a verb of action rather than a description of being unlike.
Synonyms: Discard (त्यागना), Repudiate (अस्वीकार करना), Spurn (तिरस्कार करना).
Antonyms: Accept (स्वीकार करना), Welcome (स्वागत करना), Adopt (अपनाना).

This means to refuse to take notice of or acknowledge; to disregard intentionally. It does not provide any logical opposite to the act of differing.
Synonyms: Neglect (नज़रअंदाज़ करना), Overlook (अनदेखा करना), Slight (उपेक्षा करना).
Antonyms: Notice (ध्यान देना), Attend (ध्यान देना), Heed (मानना).

test.instructions: Standard CBT Pattern Exam. Positive Marks: +1, Negative Marks: -1. Total Questions: 50.

test.title: Set - 4

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Clear
questionsEn.s:
Clear - स्पष्ट (Easy to perceive, understand, or interpret)
Obscure - अस्पष्ट (Not discovered or known about; uncertain)
Open - खुला (Allowing access, passage, or a view)
Bright - उज्ज्वल (Giving out or reflecting a lot of light)
Frank - साफ़गो (Open, honest, and direct in speech or writing)


Hence, 'Obscure' is the most suitable antonym for 'Clear'.
oa:
This word describes something that is not discovered or known about; uncertain or unclear to the senses. It is the direct opposite of something that is easily understood or visible.
Synonyms: Vague (अस्पष्ट), Ambiguous (अनेकार्थी), Murky (धुंधला).
Antonyms: Clear (स्पष्ट), Obvious (ज़ाहिर), Lucid (सुस्पष्ट).

This word refers to things that are not closed or blocked; being frank. while related to clarity, it describes accessibility rather than visual or mental comprehensibility.
Synonyms: Unobstructed (खुला), Candid (स्पष्ट), Exposed (उजागर).
Antonyms: Closed (बंद), Restricted (प्रतिबंधित), Secret (गुप्त).

This describes something that gives out or reflects a lot of light; being shining. It is a synonym for the "vivid" aspect of being clear.
Synonyms: Radiant (दीप्तिमान), Luminous (प्रकाशमान), Vivid (चमकदार).
Antonyms: Dull (नीरस), Dark (अंधेरा), Somber (उदास).

This word refers to being open, honest, and direct in speech or writing. It is a synonym that describes a clear and straightforward person.
Synonyms: Candid (निष्कपट), Blunt (मुँहफट), Direct (सीधा).
Antonyms: Evasive (टालमटोल करने वाला), Deceptive (भ्रामक), Secretive (गुप्त).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Candid
questionsEn.s:
Candid - स्पष्टवादी (Truthful and straightforward; frank)
Frank - साफ़गो (Open, honest, and direct in speech)
Guarded - सतर्क / संयमित (Cautious and having a reserved manner)
Honest - ईमानदार (Free of deceit and untruthfulness; sincere)
Open - खुला (Frank and communicative; not secretive)


Hence, 'Guarded' is the most suitable antonym for 'Candid'.
oa:
This word refers to being open, honest, and direct in speech or writing. It is an exact synonym for the question word.
Synonyms: Direct (सीधा), Straightforward (सरल), Blunt (मुँहफट).
Antonyms: Guarded (सतर्क), Evasive (टालमटोल वाला), Insincere (दिखावटी).

This word describes someone who is cautious and having a reserved manner, especially in speech. it is the direct opposite of being open and honest (candid).
Synonyms: Cautious (सतर्क), Wary (सावधान), Reticent (मितभाषी).
Antonyms: Candid (स्पष्टवादी), Open (खुला), Reckless (लापरवाह).

This word refers to being free of deceit and untruthfulness; sincere. It is a fundamental synonym for the nature of being candid.
Synonyms: Truthful (सच्चा), Upright (ईमानदार), Genuine (असली).
Antonyms: Dishonest (बेईमान), Corrupt (भ्रष्ट), Fake (नकली).

This describes someone who is frank and communicative; not secretive. It is another core synonym for the given word.
Synonyms: Transparent (पारदर्शी), Manifest (प्रकट), Plain (सादा).
Antonyms: Secretive (गुप्त), Closed (बंद), Hidden (छिपा हुआ).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Accentuate
questionsEn.s:
Accentuate - ज़ोर देना (Make more noticeable or prominent)
Emphasize - महत्व देना (Give special importance or prominence)
Highlight - उजागर करना (Pick out and emphasize a part of something)
Obscure - धुंधला करना (Make unclear, less visible, or unimportant)
Promote - बढ़ावा देना (Further the progress of something; support)


Hence, 'Obscure' is the most suitable antonym for 'Accentuate'.
oa:
This word means to give special importance or prominence to something in speaking or writing. It is a direct synonym for accentuate.
Synonyms: Stress (ज़ोर देना), Highlight (उजागर करना), Underscore (रेखांकित करना).
Antonyms: Understate (कम करके बताना), Ignore (अनदेखा करना), Play down (महत्व घटाना).

This refers to picking out and emphasizing the most important part of something. It functions as an exact synonym.
Synonyms: Feature (दिखाना), Spot (चिह्नित करना), Accent (ज़ोर देना).
Antonyms: Obscure (धुंधला करना), Hide (छिपाना), Cover (ढंकना).

This word means to make something unclear, less visible, or unimportant. it is the direct opposite of emphasizing or highlighting something.
Synonyms: Cloud (धुंधला करना), Mask (छिपाना), Befog (उलझाना).
Antonyms: Accentuate (ज़ोर देना), Clarify (स्पष्ट करना), Reveal (प्रकट करना).

This refers to supporting or encouraging the progress of something. While highlighting can lead to promotion, the word describes support rather than the visual or linguistic emphasis of 'accentuate'.
Synonyms: Advance (बढ़ावा देना), Boost (तेज़ करना), Support (समर्थन देना).
Antonyms: Demote (पदावनत करना), Hinder (बाधा डालना), Oppose (विरोध करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Cursory
questionsEn.s:
Cursory - सरसरी (Hasty and therefore not thorough or detailed)
Thorough - पूर्ण / गहन (Performed with great care and completeness)
Brief - संक्षिप्त (Of short duration; not lasting for long)
Hasty - जल्दबाज़ी (Done with excessive speed or urgency)
Superficial - सतही (Existing or occurring at or on the surface)


Hence, 'Thorough' is the most suitable antonym for 'Cursory'.
oa:
This word describes something that is performed or written with great care and completeness. it is the direct opposite of a hasty or superficial glance.
Synonyms: Exhaustive (विस्तृत), Comprehensive (व्यापक), Rigorous (सख्त/गहन).
Antonyms: Cursory (सरसरी), Hasty (जल्दबाज़), Superficial (सतही).

This refers to something of short duration; being concise. While cursory looks are brief, the word 'brief' describes length rather than the lack of care.
Synonyms: Short (छोटा), Concise (संक्षिप्त), Succinct (चुस्त).
Antonyms: Long (लंबा), Detailed (विस्तारित), Prolonged (दीर्घ).

This word describes something done with excessive speed or urgency; hurried. it is a direct synonym for the careless speed of a cursory look.
Synonyms: Rapid (तेज़), Hurried (जल्दबाज़ी में), Impetuous (अविचारी).
Antonyms: Slow (धीमा), Deliberate (सोचा-समझा), Leisurely (आराम से).

This refers to something existing or occurring at or on the surface. it is a strong synonym for cursory, as both imply a lack of depth or detail.
Synonyms: Shallow (सतही), External (बाहरी), Slight (मामूली).
Antonyms: Deep (गहरा), Profound (गहन), Thorough (संपूर्ण).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Maladroit
questionsEn.s:
Maladroit - अनाड़ी (Inefficient or inept; clumsy)
Clumsy - भद्दा (Awkward in movement or in handling things)
Awkward - बेढंगा (Lacking skill or grace in behavior or movement)
Skillful - कुशल (Having or showing knowledge and ability)
Inept - अयोग्य (Having or showing no skill; clumsy)


Hence, 'Skillful' is the most suitable antonym for 'Maladroit'.
oa:
This word refers to a person awkward in movement or in handling things. It is a common synonym for being maladroit.
Synonyms: Awkward (भोंडा), Inept (अक्षम), Ungraceful (फूहड़).
Antonyms: Skillful (कुशल), Graceful (सुरुचिपूर्ण), Adroit (चतुर).

This describes someone who is lacking skill or grace in behavior or movement. It functions as a direct synonym for the given word.
Synonyms: Gauche (अनाड़ी), Bumbling (गड़बड़ करने वाला), Unhandy (अकुशल).
Antonyms: Handy (कुशल), Deft (निपुण), Smooth (सुचारू).

This word refers to having or showing the knowledge, ability, or training to perform a certain activity or task well. it is the direct opposite of being clumsy or inept.
Synonyms: Adroit (चतुर), Proficient (निपुण), Adept (कुशल).
Antonyms: Maladroit (अनाड़ी), Clumsy (भद्दा), Incompetent (अयोग्य).

This word refers to having or showing no skill; being clumsy. It is an exact synonym for the word provided in the question.
Synonyms: Bungling (गड़बड़ करने वाला), Incapable (अक्षम), Crude (कच्चा/अकुशल).
Antonyms: Competent (सक्षम), Capable (योग्य), Expert (विशेषज्ञ).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Dependence
questionsEn.s:
Dependence - निर्भरता (The state of relying on or being controlled by someone)
Autonomy - स्वायत्तता (The right or condition of self-government)
Slavery - गुलामी (The state of being a slave; extreme dependence)
Subordinate - अधीन (Lower in rank or position; under authority)
Submissiveness - दब्बूपन (The quality of being ready to conform to authority)


Hence, 'Autonomy' is the most suitable antonym for 'Dependence'.
oa:
This term refers to the right or condition of self-government; being independent. It is the direct and most appropriate opposite for relying on others.
Synonyms: Independence (स्वतंत्रता), Liberty (आज़ादी), Self-rule (स्वराज).
Antonyms: Dependence (निर्भरता), Slavery (गुलामी), Subservience (चाटुकारिता).

This refers to the state of being a slave; being owned by another person. It is an extreme form of dependence and therefore acts as a synonym in a negative context.
Synonyms: Bondage (बंधुआ), Servitude (सेवा), Captivity (कैद).
Antonyms: Freedom (आज़ादी), Emancipation (मुक्ति), Liberty (स्वतंत्रता).

This word refers to a person under the authority or control of another within an organization. It describes a dependent relationship, making it a synonym.
Synonyms: Inferior (अधीन), Assistant (सहायक), Junior (छोटा).
Antonyms: Superior (श्रेष्ठ), Chief (मुख्य), Boss (मालिक).

This refers to the quality of being ready to conform to the authority or will of others; meekness. it is a synonymous trait found in dependent entities.
Synonyms: Compliance (अनुपालन), Docility (विनम्रता), Passivity (निष्क्रियता).
Antonyms: Resistance (प्रतिरोध), Defiance (अवहेलना), Assertiveness (मुखरता).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Interesting
questionsEn.s:
Interesting - दिलचस्प (Arousing curiosity or interest; holding attention)
Monotonous - नीरस (Dull, tedious, and lacking in variety)
Terrible - भयानक (Extremely bad or serious)
Terrifying - डरावना (Causing extreme fear)
Disastrous - विनाशकारी (Causing great damage)


Hence, 'Monotonous' is the most suitable antonym for 'Interesting'.
oa:
This word refers to something that is dull, tedious, and lacking in variety and interest. it is the direct antonym for something that arouses curiosity or attention.
Synonyms: Boring (ऊबाऊ), Humdrum (नीरस), Wearisome (थकाऊ).
Antonyms: Exciting (रोमांचक), Interesting (दिलचस्प), Vibrant (जीवंत).

This describes something that is extremely bad or serious. While negative, its meaning relates to quality and fear rather than the lack of interest.
Synonyms: Awful (भयानक), Horrific (खौफनाक), Dreadful (बहुत बुरा).
Antonyms: Wonderful (अद्भुत), Great (महान), Excellent (उत्कृष्ट).

This refers to something that causes extreme fear. it is an intense emotion and doesn't logically serve as an opposite to being interesting.
Synonyms: Frightening (डरावना), Petrifying (स्तब्ध करने वाला), Scary (भयभीत करने वाला).
Antonyms: Comforting (आरामदायक), Soothing (शांत करने वाला), Reassuring (आश्वस्त करने वाला).

This refers to something causing great damage or being highly unsuccessful. It describes a catastrophic event, which is unrelated to interest levels.
Synonyms: Catastrophic (विनाशकारी), Calamitous (आपदाजनक), Ruinous (विनाशकारी).
Antonyms: Beneficial (लाभकारी), Successful (सफल), Fortunate (भाग्यशाली).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Degenerate
questionsEn.s:
Degenerate - पतित होना / बिगड़ना (Decline or deteriorate physically, mentally, or morally)
Flourish - फलना-फूलना (Grow or develop in a healthy or vigorous way)
Perish - नष्ट होना (Die, especially in a violent or sudden way)
Dismiss - खारिज करना (Treat as unworthy of consideration; send away)
Decay - क्षय (The state or process of rotting or decomposition)


Hence, 'Flourish' is the most suitable antonym for 'Degenerate'.
oa:
This word means to grow or develop in a healthy or vigorous way, especially as the result of a particularly favorable environment. it is the direct opposite of declining or deteriorating.
Synonyms: Thrive (फलना-फूलना), Prosper (समृद्ध होना), Bloom (खिलना).
Antonyms: Wither (मुरझाना), Decay (सड़ना), Degenerate (पतित होना).

This word refers to dying, typically in a violent, sudden, or untimely way. it is a synonymous end-point for a degenerating process.
Synonyms: Expire (दम तोड़ना), Decease (मरना), Vanish (गायब होना).
Antonyms: Survive (जीवित रहना), Live (जीना), Endure (बने रहना).

This means to send someone away or allow them to leave, or to treat something as unworthy of consideration. It has no logical connection to the process of deterioration.
Synonyms: Reject (खारिज करना), Discharge (निकाल देना), Discard (त्यागना).
Antonyms: Hire (किराये पर लेना/रखना), Accept (स्वीकार करना), Engage (शामिल करना).

This refers to the state or process of rotting or decomposition. it is an exact synonym that describes the physical form of degenerating.
Synonyms: Rot (सड़ना), Decompose (सड़ना), Crumble (बिखरना).
Antonyms: Grow (बढ़ना), Recover (सुधरना), Regenerate (पुनर्जीवित होना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Lengthy
questionsEn.s:
Lengthy - लंबा (Especially in speech or writing; long or extended)
Concise - संक्षिप्त (Giving a lot of information clearly in a few words)
Extended - विस्तारित (Made longer or bigger)
Elongated - लंबा किया हुआ (Long in relation to width)
Protracted - दीर्घ (Lasting for a long time or longer than expected)


Hence, 'Concise' is the most suitable antonym for 'Lengthy'.
oa:
This word describes information that is given clearly and in a few words; being brief but comprehensive. it is the direct opposite of being long or wordy.
Synonyms: Succinct (चुस्त), Brief (संक्षिप्त), Short (छोटा).
Antonyms: Lengthy (लंबा), Verbose (शब्दबहुल), Detailed (विस्तृत).

This word refers to something made longer or bigger; being prolonged. it is a direct synonym for the long nature of being lengthy.
Synonyms: Protracted (दीर्घ), Elongated (बढ़ा हुआ), Outstretched (फैला हुआ).
Antonyms: Abbreviated (छोटा किया हुआ), Contracted (सिकुड़ा हुआ), Brief (लघु).

This describes something that is unusually long in relation to its width. It matches the physical description of being lengthy, acting as a synonym.
Synonyms: Stretched (तनी हुई), Linear (रेखीय), Long (लंबा).
Antonyms: Squat (नाटा/छोटा), Shortened (छोटा किया हुआ), Compressed (दबाया हुआ).

This refers to something lasting for a long time or longer than expected or usual. It functions as a synonym, particularly regarding the duration of events.
Synonyms: Drawn-out (लंबा), Lingering (सुस्त/देर तक), Extensive (विस्तृत).
Antonyms: Short-lived (अल्पकालिक), Rapid (तेज़), Sudden (अचानक).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Bashful
questionsEn.s:
Bashful - शर्मीला (Reluctant to draw attention to oneself; shy)
Loquacious - बातूनी (Tending to talk a great deal; talkative)
Talkative - वाचाल (Fond of or given to talking)
Taciturn - अल्पभाषी (Reserved or uncommunicative in speech)
Diffident - आत्मविश्वासहीन (Lacking self-confidence; modest or shy)


Hence, 'Loquacious' is the most suitable antonym for 'Bashful'.
oa:
This word describes someone who tends to talk a great deal; being talkative. it is the direct opposite of being shy, timid, or reluctant to speak.
Synonyms: Garrulous (बातूनी), Voluble (वाचाल), Chatty (गप्पी).
Antonyms: Bashful (शर्मीला), Taciturn (अल्पभाषी), Silent (मौन).

This word refers to being fond of or given to talking. It is a direct synonym for the opposite relationship we seek, and thus correctly identifies the contrast to bashfulness.
Synonyms: Vocal (मुखर), Communicative (मिलनसार), Outgoing (बहिर्मुखी).
Antonyms: Quiet (शांत), Reserved (संकोची), Mute (गूंगा).

This refers to a person who is reserved or uncommunicative in speech; saying little. it is a near-synonym describing the quiet behavior of a bashful person.
Synonyms: Reticent (अल्पभाषी), Silent (मौन), Reserved (संकोची).
Antonyms: Talkative (बातूनी), Garrulous (वाचाल), Loquacious (बातूनी).

This describes someone who is lacking self-confidence; being modest or shy. It is an exact synonym for being bashful.
Synonyms: Sheepish (दब्बू), Timid (डरपोक), Hesitant (हिचकिचाने वाला).
Antonyms: Bold (निडर), Confident (आत्मविश्वासी), Arrogant (अभिमानी).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Acquitted
questionsEn.s:
Acquitted - दोषमुक्त (Free from a criminal charge by a verdict of not guilty)
Convicted - अपराधी / दोषी (Declared guilty of a criminal offense)
Pardoned - क्षमा प्राप्त (Forgiven for an error or offense)
Exempted - छूट प्राप्त (Free from an obligation or requirement)
Liberate - मुक्त / स्वतंत्र (Set free from imprisonment or oppression)


Hence, 'Convicted' is the most suitable antonym for 'Acquitted'.
oa:
This word refers to someone who has been declared guilty of a criminal offense by a court. it is the direct legal and logical opposite of being cleared of charges.
Synonyms: Condemned (दोषी), Sentenced (दंडित), Found guilty (अपराधी पाया गया).
Antonyms: Acquitted (दोषमुक्त), Exonerated (बरी), Absolved (मुक्त).

This refers to someone who has been forgiven for an error or offense. While it leads to freedom, a pardon implies guilt was present but forgiven, whereas acquittal denies guilt.
Synonyms: Forgiven (माफ़ किया हुआ), Absolved (दोषमुक्त), Excused (माफ़ किया गया).
Antonyms: Punished (दंडित), Blamed (दोषी), Rebuked (फटकारा गया).

This refers to someone who is free from an obligation or requirement imposed on others. It has no relation to criminal guilt or innocence.
Synonyms: Freed (मुक्त), Spared (छूट प्राप्त), Excused (छूट प्राप्त).
Antonyms: Required (अनिवार्य), Bound (बाध्य), Obliged (कृतज्ञ/बाध्य).

This describes someone who has been set free from imprisonment, slavery, or oppression. it is a synonymous outcome for an acquitted person but describes the physical state rather than the legal one.
Synonyms: Delivered (बचाया गया), Freed (आज़ाद), Released (छोड़ दिया गया).
Antonyms: Enslaved (गुलाम), Detained (हिरासत में), Captive (कैदी).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Learned
questionsEn.s:
Learned - विद्वान (Having much knowledge acquired by study)
Well-read - सुशिक्षित (Knowledgeable through reading many books)
Mature - परिपक्व (Fully developed in body or mind)
Accomplished - निपुण (Highly skilled at a particular activity)
Ignorant - अज्ञानी (Lacking knowledge, information, or education)


Hence, 'Ignorant' is the most suitable antonym for 'Learned'.
oa:
This describes someone who has at some time read much literature or a wide variety of books and is knowledgeable. it is a direct synonym for being learned.
Synonyms: Educated (शिक्षित), Erudite (विद्वान), Cultured (सभ्य).
Antonyms: Uninformed (अज्ञानी), Illiterate (निरक्षर), Ignorant (अनपढ़).

This refers to being fully developed physically or having reached an advanced stage of mental or emotional development. It describes age and wisdom rather than academic knowledge.
Synonyms: Grown-up (वयस्क), Ripe (परिपक्व), Seasoned (अनुभवी).
Antonyms: Childish (बचकाना), Immature (अपरिपक्व), Juvenile (किशोर).

This describes someone who is highly trained or skilled in a particular activity. while learned people are often accomplished, this word focuses on skill rather than theoretical knowledge.
Synonyms: Expert (विशेषज्ञ), Proficient (निपुण), Gifted (प्रतिभाशाली).
Antonyms: Unskilled (अकुशल), Amateur (नौसिखिया), Clumsy (अनाड़ी).

This word refers to a person who lacks knowledge, information, or education. it is the perfect antonym for someone who is learned and knowledgeable.
Synonyms: Uneducated (अशिक्षित), Unaware (अनभिज्ञ), Oblivious (बेखबर).
Antonyms: Learned (विद्वान), Wise (बुद्धिमान), Sagacious (ज्ञानी).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Flaunt
questionsEn.s:
Flaunt - दिखावा करना (Display something ostentatiously to provoke envy)
Show off - शेखी बघारना (Display boastfully)
Sink - डूबना (Go down below the surface of something)
Hide - छिपाना (Put or keep out of sight; conceal)
Propose - प्रस्ताव रखना (Put forward a plan or suggestion)


Hence, 'Hide' is the most suitable antonym for 'Flaunt'.
oa:
This word refers to displaying someone or something that is a source of pride in an ostentatious way. it is a direct synonym for the boastful nature of flaunting.
Synonyms: Parade (प्रदर्शन करना), Brag (शेखी बघारना), Vaunt (डींग मारना).
Antonyms: Hide (छिपाना), Conceal (गुप्त रखना), Minimize (कम करके दिखाना).

This means to go down below the surface of something, especially a liquid; to drop. It is contextually unrelated to the display of attributes or possessions.
Synonyms: Submerge (डूबना), Descend (नीचे जाना), Plunge (गोता लगाना).
Antonyms: Float (तैरना), Rise (उठना), Soar (ऊंची उड़ान भरना).

This word means to put or keep out of sight; to conceal from others. it is the direct opposite of flaunting, which involves showing something off proudly or shamelessly.
Synonyms: Conceal (छिपाना), Disguise (ढकना), Cover (छिपाना).
Antonyms: Flaunt (दिखावा करना), Reveal (प्रकट करना), Display (प्रदर्शित करना).

This word refers to putting forward an idea or plan for consideration or discussion by others. it has no connection to the act of showing off.
Synonyms: Suggest (सुझाव देना), Offer (प्रस्ताव देना), Submit (प्रस्तुत करना).
Antonyms: Reject (अस्वीकार करना), Withdraw (वापस लेना), Oppose (विरोध करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Accepted
questionsEn.s:
Accepted - स्वीकृत (Agreed to or received willingly)
Accused - अभियुक्त (A person charged with a crime or wrongdoing)
Admitted - भर्ती / स्वीकृत (Confessed to be true or allowed to enter)
Rejected - अस्वीकृत (Dismissed as inadequate or unacceptable)
Consented - सहमत (Gave permission for something to happen)


Hence, 'Rejected' is the most suitable antonym for 'Accepted'.
oa:
This word refers to a person or group who is charged with or on trial for a crime. It describes a legal status unrelated to the voluntary act of accepting something.
Synonyms: Blamed (दोषी ठहराया गया), Charged (अभियुक्त), Indicted (आरोपित).
Antonyms: Exonerated (दोषमुक्त), Acquitted (बरी), Absolved (मुक्त).

This word refers to being allowed to enter a place or being confessed as true. In many contexts, it acts as a synonym for accepting a fact or person.
Synonyms: Acknowledged (स्वीकृत), Allowed (अनुमत), Confessed (माना हुआ).
Antonyms: Denied (अस्वीकृत), Excluded (बाहर रखा गया), Rejected (अस्वीकार किया गया).

This word refers to something that has been dismissed as inadequate, unacceptable, or faulty. it is the direct opposite of receiving or agreeing to something willingly.
Synonyms: Spurned (ठुकराया हुआ), Declined (अस्वीकृत), Vetoed (निरस्त).
Antonyms: Accepted (स्वीकृत), Approved (मंजूर), Embraced (अपनाया हुआ).

This word means that someone has given permission for something to happen or has agreed to do something. It is a strong synonym for accepting a proposal.
Synonyms: Agreed (सहमत), Assented (स्वीकृत), Permitted (अनुमत).
Antonyms: Refused (मना किया), Disagreed (असहमत), Objected (आपत्ति जताई).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Turbulent
questionsEn.s:
Turbulent - अशांत (Characterized by conflict, disorder, or confusion)
Anarchic - अराजक (With no controlling rules or principles)
Volatile - अस्थिर (Liable to change rapidly and unpredictably)
Settled - स्थिर (Stable and unlikely to change)
Blustery - तूफानी (Characterized by strong winds)


Hence, 'Settled' is the most suitable antonym for 'Turbulent'.
oa:
This word refers to a state of disorder due to absence or non-recognition of authority. It is a direct synonym for the chaotic nature of being turbulent.
Synonyms: Lawless (अराजक), Chaotic (अव्यवस्थित), Riotous (उपद्रवी).
Antonyms: Orderly (व्यवस्थित), Disciplined (अनुशासित), Governed (शासित).

This describes something liable to change rapidly and unpredictably, especially for the worse. It matches the unstable quality of a turbulent situation, making it a synonym.
Synonyms: Unstable (अस्थिर), Fickle (चंचल), Erratic (अनियमित).
Antonyms: Stable (स्थिर), Constant (नियमित), Steady (स्थिर).

This word refers to something that is stable, calm, or resolved; being unlikely to change. it is the direct opposite of being in a state of conflict, disorder, or confusion.
Synonyms: Stable (स्थिर), Calm (शांत), Fixed (निश्चित).
Antonyms: Turbulent (अशांत), Agitated (उत्तेजित), Unresolved (अनसुलझा).

This refers to weather characterized by strong winds; being stormy. it is a synonymous term that describes a specific physical form of turbulence.
Synonyms: Windy (तूफानी), Stormy (अशांत), Gusty (झोंकेदार हवा वाला).
Antonyms: Still (शांत), Breezeless (हवा रहित), Calm (स्थिर).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Pristine
questionsEn.s:
Pristine - निर्मल / अछूता (In its original condition; unspoiled)
Primal - मौलिक (Relating to the early stages of development)
Sullied - गंदा / कलंकित (Damaged the purity or integrity of)
Spacious - विशाल (Having ample space)
Precious - कीमती (Of great value; not to be wasted)


Hence, 'Sullied' is the most suitable antonym for 'Pristine'.
oa:
This word refers to something relating to the early stages in evolutionary development; being primeval. While referring to origins, it lacks the "purity" connotation of pristine.
Synonyms: Original (मौलिक), Basic (मूलभूत), Ancient (प्राचीन).
Antonyms: Sophisticated (जटिल), Modern (आधुनिक), Advanced (उन्नत).

This word refers to something that has been damaged the purity or integrity of; being defiled. it is the direct opposite of being in an original, clean, and unspoiled condition.
Synonyms: Tainted (दूषित), Tarnished (कलंकित), Defiled (अपवित्र).
Antonyms: Pristine (निर्मल), Pure (शुद्ध), Clean (साफ़).

This describes something having ample space; being large. It is contextually unrelated to the purity or condition of an object.
Synonyms: Roomy (विशाल), Capacious (बड़ा), Vast (विस्तृत).
Antonyms: Cramped (तंग), Narrow (संकीर्ण), Small (छोटा).

This word refers to an object or substance of great value; being highly esteemed. while many pristine things are precious, the word focuses on value rather than condition.
Synonyms: Valuable (कीमती), Prized (बहुमूल्य), Dear (प्यारा).
Antonyms: Worthless (बेकार), Cheap (सस्ता), Common (मामूली).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Arbitrarily
questionsEn.s:
Arbitrarily - मनमाने ढंग से (Based on random choice or personal whim)
Indiscriminately - अंधाधुंध (At random or without careful judgment)
Whimsically - मनमौजी तरीके से (In a playful or unpredictable manner)
Sporadically - रुक-रुक कर (Occurring at irregular intervals)
Meticulously - सूक्ष्मता से (With great attention to detail; very carefully)


Hence, 'Meticulously' is the most suitable antonym for 'Arbitrarily'.
oa:
This word refers to being done at random or without careful judgment. It is a direct synonym for the "random" aspect of acting arbitrarily.
Synonyms: Randomly (बेतरतीब), Aimlessly (बिना उद्देश्य के), Haphazardly (लापरवाही से).
Antonyms: Selectively (चयनित रूप से), Carefully (सावधानी से), Judiciously (विवेकपूर्ण ढंग से).

This word refers to acting in a playful or fanciful manner or being based on a sudden desire rather than logic. It acts as a synonym for arbitrary decision-making.
Synonyms: Capriciously (मनमौजी ढंग से), Fancifully (काल्पनिक रूप से), Erratically (अनियमित रूप से).
Antonyms: Rationally (तार्किक रूप से), Logically (तर्कसंगत), Consistently (नियमित रूप से).

This refers to things occurring at irregular intervals or only in a few places; scattered. It functions as a synonym that highlights the irregular nature of arbitrary actions.
Synonyms: Occasionally (कभी-कभी), Periodically (समय-समय पर), Fitfully (रुक-रुक कर).
Antonyms: Continuously (लगातार), Regularly (नियमित रूप से), Constantly (सदैव).

This word refers to being done with great attention to detail; very carefully and precisely. it is the direct opposite of acting without reason, logic, or a systematic plan.
Synonyms: Carefully (सावधानीपूर्वक), Thoroughly (विस्तार से), Painstakingly (कठिन परिश्रम से).
Antonyms: Arbitrarily (मनमाने ढंग से), Sloppily (लापरवाही से), Haphazardly (बेतरतीब).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Brawny
questionsEn.s:
Brawny - ताकतवर / मांसल (Physically strong; muscular)
Beefy - हट्टा-कट्टा (Muscular or robust)
Weak - कमज़ोर (Lacking physical strength and energy)
Strong - मज़बूत (Having great physical power and ability)
Pale - पीला (Lacking color or intensity of color)


Hence, 'Weak' is the most suitable antonym for 'Brawny'.
oa:
This word describes a person who is muscular or robust; being physically heavy. it is an exact synonym for being brawny.
Synonyms: Muscular (मांसल), Burly (हट्टा-कट्टा), Husky (तगड़ा).
Antonyms: Scrawny (दुबला), Thin (पतला), Weak (कमज़ोर).

This word describes a person or thing that lacks physical strength and energy. it is the direct and most appropriate opposite for being strong and muscular.
Synonyms: Feeble (कमज़ोर), Frail (दुर्बल), Infirm (अशक्त).
Antonyms: Strong (मज़बूत), Brawny (शक्तिशाली), Mighty (बलवान).

This refers to having the power to move heavy weights or perform other physically demanding tasks. It is the primary synonym and definition of the question word.
Synonyms: Powerful (ताकतवर), Robust (हृष्ट-पुष्ट), Sturdy (तगड़ा).
Antonyms: Weak (कमज़ोर), Fragile (नाज़ुक), Puny (नन्हा/कमज़ोर).

This word describes a person having a light color or being white due to illness or shock. While it often implies weakness, its primary meaning relates to color rather than physical strength.
Synonyms: Wan (पीला), Pallid (फीका), Anemic (रक्तहीन).
Antonyms: Ruddy (लाल), Flush (दमकता), Rosy (गुलाबी).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Shortest
questionsEn.s:
Shortest - सबसे छोटा (Measuring the least distance or lasting the least time)
Largest - सबसे बड़ा (Of considerable or great size or extent)
Farthest - सबसे दूर (At the greatest distance in space or time)
Longest - सबसे लंबा (Measuring the greatest distance from end to end)
Biggest - सबसे बड़ा (Of great size, extent, or importance)


Hence, 'Longest' is the most suitable antonym for 'Shortest'.
oa:
This word refers to things being of great size or amount; being big. it focuses on volume or area rather than linear measurement or time, making it an imperfect opposite.
Synonyms: Biggest (सबसे बड़ा), Grandest (भव्य), Greatest (महान).
Antonyms: Smallest (सबसे छोटा), Tiniest (अत्यंत छोटा), Minor (मामूली).

This refers to the greatest distance from a particular point. While it involves measurement, it refers to distance in space rather than length or duration.
Synonyms: Most distant (सबसे दूर), Remote (दूरस्थ), Utmost (अत्यंत).
Antonyms: Nearest (सबसे नज़दीक), Closest (सबसे समीप), Proximal (समीपवर्ती).

This word describes something that measures the greatest distance from end to end or lasts for the greatest amount of time. it is the direct and most accurate antonym for shortest.
Synonyms: Lengthiest (सबसे लंबा), Extended (विस्तारित), Protracted (दीर्घ).
Antonyms: Shortest (सबसे छोटा), Briefest (संक्षिप्ततम), Quickest (सबसे तेज़).

This word refers to something of considerable or relatively great size or importance. Similar to 'largest', it refers to overall scale rather than specific length.
Synonyms: Enormous (विशाल), Massive (बड़ा), Gigantic (विशालकाय).
Antonyms: Smallest (सबसे छोटा), Minuscule (बहुत छोटा), Slight (मामूली).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Famous
questionsEn.s:
Famous - प्रसिद्ध (Known about by many people)
Boring - उबाऊ (Not interesting; tedious)
Eminent - प्रख्यात (Famous and respected within a particular sphere)
Obscure - अज्ञात (Not discovered or known about; uncertain)
Untalented - अकुशल (Lacking natural ability or skill)


Hence, 'Obscure' is the most suitable antonym for 'Famous'.
oa:
This word describes something that is not interesting; being tedious. While some famous people are boring, the words describe unrelated qualities of fame versus interest.
Synonyms: Dull (नीरस), Tiresome (थकाऊ), Banal (घिसा-पिटा).
Antonyms: Exciting (रोमांचक), Interesting (दिलचस्प), Fascinating (आकर्षक).

This refers to a person who is famous and respected within a particular sphere or profession. it is a direct synonym for being famous.
Synonyms: Illustrious (शानदार), Renowned (प्रसिद्ध), Distinguished (विशिष्ट).
Antonyms: Obscure (अज्ञात), Unknown (अनजान), Minor (मामूली).

This word refers to something or someone not discovered or known about; being uncertain or unknown. it is the direct opposite of being widely known or recognized.
Synonyms: Unknown (अज्ञात), Anonymous (अनाम), Nameless (नामहीन).
Antonyms: Famous (प्रसिद्ध), Celebrated (विख्यात), Notorious (कुख्यात).

This word describes someone who lacks natural ability or skill. While lack of talent might prevent fame, the word describes ability rather than public recognition.
Synonyms: Inept (अक्षम), Skilless (अकुशल), Incompetent (अयोग्य).
Antonyms: Talented (प्रतिभाशाली), Gifted (गुणी), Skillful (कुशल).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Stigmatize
questionsEn.s:
Stigmatize - कलंकित करना (Describe or regard as worthy of disgrace or disapproval)
Praise - प्रशंसा करना (Express warm approval or admiration of)
Protect - रक्षा करना (Keep safe from harm or injury)
Spoil - बिगाड़ना (Diminish or destroy the value or quality of)
Complain - शिकायत करना (Express dissatisfaction or annoyance)


Hence, 'Praise' is the most suitable antonym for 'Stigmatize'.
oa:
This word refers to the expression of approval or admiration for someone or something. it is the direct opposite of labeling someone in a disgraceful or shameful way.
Synonyms: Commend (सराहना), Exalt (महिमामंडन करना), Laud (प्रशंसा करना).
Antonyms: Stigmatize (कलंकित करना), Condemn (निंदा करना), Criticize (आलोचना करना).

This word refers to the act of keeping someone or something safe from harm or injury. While protection might prevent stigma, the word describes safety rather than the social valuation of a person.
Synonyms: Guard (रक्षा करना), Defend (बचाव करना), Shield (ढाल बनना).
Antonyms: Expose (उजागर करना), Abandon (त्यागना), Attack (हमला करना).

This means to diminish or destroy the value or quality of something, or to treat a person with excessive indulgence. it functions as a synonym in the sense of damaging someone's reputation.
Synonyms: Ruin (बर्बाद करना), Mar (बिगाड़ना), Damage (क्षति पहुँचाना).
Antonyms: Repair (सुधारना), Enhance (बढ़ाना), Improve (बेहतर बनाना).

This refers to expressing dissatisfaction or annoyance about something. it is a reaction to a problem but doesn't capture the act of marking someone with a negative label.
Synonyms: Grumble (बड़बड़ाना), Whine (शिकायत करना), Protest (विरोध करना).
Antonyms: Applaud (प्रशंसा करना), Accept (स्वीकार करना), Rejoice (खुश होना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Sullen
questionsEn.s:
Sullen - उदास / चिड़चिड़ा (Bad-tempered and sulky; gloomy)
Morose - उदास (Sullen and ill-tempered)
Cheerful - हंसमुख (Noticeably happy and optimistic)
Clean - साफ़ (Free from dirt, marks, or stains)
Risen - उठा हुआ (Moved from a lower to a higher position)


Hence, 'Cheerful' is the most suitable antonym for 'Sullen'.
oa:
This word describes a person who is sullen and ill-tempered. It is a direct synonym for the gloomy and bad-tempered nature of the question word.
Synonyms: Gloomy (उदास), Glum (खिन्न), Sulky (चिड़चिड़ा).
Antonyms: Cheerful (हंसमुख), Joyful (आनंदित), Lively (जीवंत).

This word describes a person who is noticeably happy and optimistic. it is the perfect opposite for someone who is brooding and ill-tempered.
Synonyms: Jolly (प्रसन्न), Sunny (खुशमिज़ाज), Mirthful (आनंदपूर्ण).
Antonyms: Sullen (उदास), Depressed (हताश), Somber (गंभीर).

This describes something that is free from dirt, marks, or stains. It refers to physical cleanliness and has no contextual relation to human temperament.
Synonyms: Pure (शुद्ध), Spotless (बेदाग), Tidy (साफ़-सुथरा).
Antonyms: Dirty (गंदा), Filthy (गलीज), Soiled (मैला).

This refers to something that has moved from a lower to a higher position. it is the past participle of 'rise' and is unrelated to emotional states.
Synonyms: Ascended (ऊपर उठा हुआ), Elevated (ऊँचा), High (ऊँचा).
Antonyms: Fallen (गिरा हुआ), Lowered (नीचे किया हुआ), Settled (स्थिर).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Exaggerated
questionsEn.s:
Exaggerated - अतिरंजित (Represented as better or worse than it really is)
Overstated - बढ़ा-चढ़ाकर (Stated too strongly; exaggerated)
Aggrandized - महिमामंडित (Enhanced in reputation or power)
Inflated - फुला हुआ (Excessively or unreasonably high)
Understated - संयमित (Presented as less important than it really is)


Hence, 'Understated' is the most suitable antonym for 'Exaggerated'.
oa:
This word refers to something stated too strongly; being exaggerated. it is a direct and perfect synonym for the question word.
Synonyms: Hyperbolic (अतिशयोक्तिपूर्ण), Inflated (बढ़ा-चढ़ाकर), Magnified (विस्तारित).
Antonyms: Understated (संयमित), Modest (मामूली), Realistic (वास्तविक).

This means to increase the power, status, or wealth of something or to make it appear greater than it is. it is a synonym that often refers to enhancing one's reputation.
Synonyms: Elevated (ऊँचा), Exalted (महिमामंडित), Boosted (बढ़ाया हुआ).
Antonyms: Belittled (नीचा दिखाया गया), Humiliated (अपमानित), Degraded (पतित).

This describes something that is excessively or unreasonably high; being exaggerated. It functions as a synonym, often used for prices or ego.
Synonyms: Puffed (फुला हुआ), Swollen (सूजा हुआ), Bloated (अतिरंजित).
Antonyms: Deflated (पिचका हुआ), Reduced (कम किया हुआ), Shrunken (सिकुड़ा हुआ).

This word refers to something presented or expressed in a subtle and effective way, or as being less important than it really is. it is the direct and most accurate antonym for exaggerated.
Synonyms: Minimalist (न्यूनतम), Subtle (सूक्ष्म), Low-key (संयमित).
Antonyms: Exaggerated (अतिशयोक्तिपूर्ण), Showy (दिखावटी), Overdone (अत्यधिक).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Therapeutic
questionsEn.s:
Therapeutic - उपचारात्मक (Relating to the healing of disease)
Remedial - सुधारात्मक (Provided or intended as a remedy or cure)
Harmful - हानिकारक (Causing or likely to cause harm)
Curative - रोगनिवारक (Able to cure disease)
Healing - आरोग्यकारी (Making sound or healthy again)


Hence, 'Harmful' is the most suitable antonym for 'Therapeutic'.
oa:
This word refers to something provided or intended as a remedy or cure. It is a direct synonym for the healing quality of being therapeutic.
Synonyms: Curative (रोगनिवारक), Healing (उपचारात्मक), Corrective (सुधारात्मक).
Antonyms: Harmful (हानिकारक), Damaging (क्षतिकारक), Toxic (विषैला).

This word refers to something causing or likely to cause damage, injury, or trouble. it is the direct opposite of being therapeutic, which aims to heal and improve health.
Synonyms: Detrimental (हानिकारक), Deleterious (घातक), Injurious (कष्टदायक).
Antonyms: Beneficial (फायदेमंद), Therapeutic (उपचारात्मक), Wholesome (पौष्टिक).

This describes something that is able to cure a disease. it is an exact synonym for the word provided in the question.
Synonyms: Medicinal (औषधीय), Restorative (पुनर्योजी), Therapeutic (उपचारात्मक).
Antonyms: Pathogenic (रोगजनक), Poisonous (ज़हरीला), Harmful (नुकसानदेह).

This refers to the process of making or becoming sound or healthy again. It captures the essential meaning of therapeutic, acting as its primary synonym.
Synonyms: Sanative (आरोग्यकारी), Recuperative (स्वास्थ्यलाभ संबंधी), Soothing (शांत करने वाला).
Antonyms: Aggravating (भड़काने वाला), Irritating (चिढ़ाने वाला), Destructive (विनाशकारी).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Colossal
questionsEn.s:
Colossal - विशालकाय (Extremely large or massive)
Tiny - बहुत छोटा (Very small)
Graceful - सुरुचिपूर्ण (Having or showing grace or elegance)
Close - नज़दीक (Only a short distance away or apart)
Mammoth - विशाल (Huge; enormous)


Hence, 'Tiny' is the most suitable antonym for 'Colossal'.
oa:
This word describes something that is very small in size or amount. it is the perfect and direct antonym for something that is extremely large or colossal.
Synonyms: Minute (सूक्ष्म), Minuscule (बहुत छोटा), Small (छोटा).
Antonyms: Colossal (विशाल), Huge (बड़ा), Enormous (बहुत बड़ा).

This describes someone having or showing grace or elegance. It refers to movement or appearance and is contextually unrelated to the size of an object.
Synonyms: Elegant (सुरुचिपूर्ण), Lithe (लचीला), Fluid (सहज).
Antonyms: Clumsy (अनाड़ी), Awkward (भोंडा), Inelegant (अशिष्ट).

This word refers to being only a short distance away or having a strong relationship. It has no connection to the physical scale or size implied by 'colossal'.
Synonyms: Near (नज़दीक), Adjacent (सटा हुआ), Intimate (करीबी).
Antonyms: Distant (दूर), Far (दूर), Remote (दूरस्थ).

This word refers to something that is huge or enormous. it is an exact synonym for being colossal, often used to describe large projects or objects.
Synonyms: Gigantic (विशालकाय), Titanic (अत्यंत विशाल), Massive (बड़ा).
Antonyms: Small (छोटा), Tiny (नन्हा), Infinitesimal (अत्यंत सूक्ष्म).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Patchily
questionsEn.s:
Patchily - अव्यवस्थित रूप से (Unevenly in quality or performance)
Decoratively - सजावटी रूप से (In a way meant to make things attractive)
Noisily - शोरगुल के साथ (In a loud or unpleasant manner)
Consistently - नियमित रूप से (In every case or every time; unchangingly)
Irregularly - अनियमित रूप से (At uneven or varying rates or intervals)


Hence, 'Consistently' is the most suitable antonym for 'Patchily'.
oa:
This word refers to being done in a way that is intended to make something look more attractive. It is contextually unrelated to the consistency or pattern of an action.
Synonyms: Ornamentally (सजावटी रूप से), Pleasantly (सुखद ढंग से), Beautifully (खूबसूरती से).
Antonyms: Plainly (सादगी से), Drably (नीरसता से), Ugly (भोंडा).

This word refers to being accompanied by a lot of loud or unpleasant noise. it describes sound rather than the frequency or distribution of an action.
Synonyms: Loudly (ज़ोर से), Clamorously (हंगामे के साथ), Boisterously (ऊधम के साथ).
Antonyms: Quietly (शांति से), Silently (चुपचाप), Softly (धीरे से).

This word refers to something done in every case or every time; in a way that does not change. it is the direct opposite of acting patchily, which implies doing things unevenly or in some places only.
Synonyms: Uniformly (एकरूपता से), Regularly (नियमित रूप से), Constantly (सदैव).
Antonyms: Patchily (अव्यवस्थित रूप से), Fitfully (रुक-रुक कर), Sporadically (छिटपुट).

This word refers to being done at uneven or varying rates or intervals. it is a direct synonym for the inconsistent nature of acting patchily.
Synonyms: Erratically (अनियमित रूप से), Intermittently (रुक-रुक कर), Haphazardly (बेतरतीब ढंग से).
Antonyms: Methodically (व्यवस्थित रूप से), Orderly (क्रमबद्ध), Smoothly (सुचारू रूप से).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Terse
questionsEn.s:
Terse - संक्षिप्त / रूखा (Sparing in the use of words; abrupt)
Brief - संक्षिप्त (Of short duration; concise)
Wordy - शब्दबहुल (Using or expressed in too many words)
Concise - चुस्त (Giving a lot of information in a few words)
Short - छोटा (Measuring a small distance or duration)


Hence, 'Wordy' is the most suitable antonym for 'Terse'.
oa:
This word refers to something lasting a short time or being concise in speech. it is an exact synonym for being terse.
Synonyms: Short (छोटा), Succinct (चुस्त), Pithy (सारगर्भित).
Antonyms: Lengthy (लंबा), Detailed (विस्तृत), Wordy (शब्दबहुल).

This word refers to using or expressed in too many words; being verbose. it is the direct and most appropriate opposite for a brief or abrupt style of speaking.
Synonyms: Verbose (वाचाल), Prolix (शब्दबहुल), Long-winded (लंबा-चौड़ा).
Antonyms: Terse (संक्षिप्त), Laconic (मितभाषी), Concise (छोटा).

This describes information that is given clearly and in a few words. It is another core synonym for the question word.
Synonyms: Summary (सार), Compressed (दबाया हुआ), Compact (सघन).
Antonyms: Expansive (विस्तृत), Redundant (अतिरिक्त), Wordy (शब्दबहुल).

This word describes things of small length or duration. It acts as a general synonym for the brief nature of being terse.
Synonyms: Abbreviated (लघु), Ephemeral (क्षणिक), Temporary (अस्थायी).
Antonyms: Tall (ऊँचा), Extended (दीर्घ), Persistent (लगातार).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Deplorable
questionsEn.s:
Deplorable - निंदनीय (Deserving strong condemnation; shockingly bad)
Commendable - प्रशंसनीय (Deserving praise)
Miserable - दयनीय (Very unhappy or uncomfortable)
Equitable - न्यायसंगत (Fair and impartial)
Reprehensible - दोषपूर्ण (Deserving censure or condemnation)


Hence, 'Commendable' is the most suitable antonym for 'Deplorable'.
oa:
This word refers to something deserving praise or approval. it is the direct opposite of being disgraceful or deserving strong condemnation.
Synonyms: Praiseworthy (प्रशंसनीय), Laudable (सराहनीय), Estimable (सम्माननीय).
Antonyms: Deplorable (निंदनीय), Shameful (शर्मनाक), Wicked (दुष्ट).

This word refers to being very unhappy or uncomfortable, or causing such a feeling. While related to suffering, it describes a state of misery rather than the act of being morally wrong or unacceptable.
Synonyms: Wretched (दयनीय), Unhappy (दुखी), Pitiable (दयनीय).
Antonyms: Joyful (आनंदित), Content (संतुष्ट), Cheerful (प्रसन्न).

This word refers to being fair and impartial. it describes justice and has no logical connection to the disgraceful quality of being deplorable.
Synonyms: Just (उचित), Unbiased (निष्पक्ष), Honest (सच्चा).
Antonyms: Biased (पक्षपाती), Unfair (अनुचित), Prejudiced (पूर्वाग्रही).

This refers to being deserving of censure or condemnation. it is a direct synonym for the blameworthy nature of the question word.
Synonyms: Blameworthy (दोषी), Culpable (अपराधी), Shameful (शर्मनाक).
Antonyms: Innocent (निर्दोष), Virtuous (सदाचारी), Blameless (निष्कलंक).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Valor
questionsEn.s:
Valor - शौर्य / वीरता (Great courage in the face of danger, especially in battle)
Cowardice - कायरता (Lack of bravery)
Dishonour - अपमान (A state of shame or disgrace)
Prestige - प्रतिष्ठा (Widespread respect and admiration)
Boldness - साहस (Willingness to take risks; confidence)


Hence, 'Cowardice' is the most suitable antonym for 'Valor'.
oa:
This word refers to a lack of bravery or courage. it is the direct and perfect antonym for valor, which describes great courage in the face of danger.
Synonyms: Timidity (डरपोकपन), Fearfulness (कायरता), Cravenness (डरपोकपन).
Antonyms: Bravery (बहादुरी), Valor (शौर्य), Heroism (वीरता).

This word refers to a state of shame or disgrace. While cowards are often dishonored, the word describes reputation rather than the specific quality of being brave or fearful.
Synonyms: Shame (शर्म), Disgrace (अपमान), Ignominy (कलंक).
Antonyms: Honor (सम्मान), Pride (गर्व), Glory (शान).

This word refers to widespread respect and admiration felt for someone or something. it describes social standing and is contextually unrelated to physical courage.
Synonyms: Status (रुतबा), Reputation (प्रतिष्ठा), Eminence (श्रेष्ठता).
Antonyms: Lowliness (हीनता), Obscurity (अज्ञातवास), Discredit (बदनामी).

This word refers to a willingness to take risks or act innovatively; being confident and courageous. it is an exact synonym for valor.
Synonyms: Daring (साहस), Intrepidity (निडरता), Audacity (धृष्टता).
Antonyms: Caution (सावधानी), Fear (डर), Timidity (डरपोकपन).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Efficient
questionsEn.s:
Efficient - कुशल / सक्षम (Achieving maximum productivity with minimum wasted effort)
Unruly - अनियंत्रित (Disorderly and disruptive; not amenable to control)
Methodical - व्यवस्थित (Done according to a systematic procedure)
Unprofitably - अलाभकारी ढंग से (In a way that does not produce profit or benefit)
Incompetent - अयोग्य (Not having the necessary skills to do something successfully)


Hence, 'Incompetent' is the most suitable antonym for 'Efficient'.
oa:
This word describes a person or thing that is disorderly and disruptive and not amenable to discipline or control. it has no connection to productivity or skill levels.
Synonyms: Disorderly (अव्यवस्थित), Rowdy (उपद्रवी), Wild (अनियंत्रित).
Antonyms: Orderly (व्यवस्थित), Disciplined (अनुशासित), Manageable (प्रबंधनीय).

This describes someone done according to a systematic or established form of procedure. It is a synonym that describes how an efficient person works.
Synonyms: Systematic (व्यवस्थित), Orderly (क्रमबद्ध), Structured (सुनियोजित).
Antonyms: Chaotic (अव्यवस्थित), Disorganized (अस्त-व्यस्त), Random (बेतरतीब).

This word refers to being done in a way that does not make a profit or produce a benefit. while inefficient work is often unprofitable, the word focuses on financial outcome rather than the use of resources.
Synonyms: Fruitlessly (व्यर्थ में), Uselessly (बेकार में), Vainly (निष्फल).
Antonyms: Profitably (लाभदायक ढंग से), Productively (सार्थक रूप से), Successfully (सफलतापूर्वक).

This word refers to not having or showing the necessary skills to do something successfully. it is the direct opposite of being efficient, which involves performing a task with minimum waste and maximum skill.
Synonyms: Inept (अक्षम), Unskilled (अकुशल), Incapable (अयोग्य).
Antonyms: Efficient (कुशल), Capable (सक्षम), Expert (विशेषज्ञ).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Derogatory
questionsEn.s:
Derogatory - अपमानजनक (Showing a critical or disrespectful attitude)
Pejorative - निंदात्मक (Expressing contempt or disapproval)
Disrespectful - अनादरपूर्ण (Showing a lack of respect)
Critical - आलोचनात्मक (Expressing adverse or disapproving judgments)
Laudatory - प्रशंसात्मक (Expressing praise and commendation)


Hence, 'Laudatory' is the most suitable antonym for 'Derogatory'.
oa:
This word refers to expressing contempt or disapproval. It is an exact synonym for the demeaning and insulting nature of being derogatory.
Synonyms: Disparaging (उपेक्षापूर्ण), Belittling (नीचा दिखाने वाला), Slanderous (निंदात्मक).
Antonyms: Complimentary (प्रशंसात्मक), Favorable (अनुकूल), Praising (सराहनीय).

This refers to showing a lack of respect; being rude. it functions as a direct synonym for the insulting quality of the question word.
Synonyms: Insolent (गुस्ताख), Impolite (अशिष्ट), Rude (अशिष्ट).
Antonyms: Respectful (आदरपूर्ण), Courteous (विनम्र), Polite (सभ्य).

This word describes the expression of an adverse or disapproving comments or judgments. it is a synonym, although sometimes it can refer to a balanced analysis rather than pure insult.
Synonyms: Fault-finding (दोष खोजने वाला), Captious (चिड़चिड़ा), Severe (सख्त).
Antonyms: Supportive (समर्थन देने वाला), Commendatory (प्रशंसात्मक), Forgiving (माफ़ करने वाला).

This word refers to an action or speech expressing praise and commendation. it is the direct opposite of making insulting or derogatory remarks.
Synonyms: Complimentary (प्रशंसात्मक), Acclamatory (अभिनंदनपूर्ण), Adulatory (खुशामदी).
Antonyms: Derogatory (अपमानजनक), Critical (आलोचनात्मक), Reproachful (तिरस्कारपूर्ण).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Munificent
questionsEn.s:
Munificent - दानी / उदार (Very generous)
Generous - उदार (Willing to give more than is necessary or expected)
Miserly - कंजूस (Unwilling to spend money; stingy)
Charitable - दानशील (Relating to the assistance of those in need)
Modest - विनीत (Unassuming in the estimation of one's abilities)


Hence, 'Miserly' is the most suitable antonym for 'Munificent'.
oa:
This word describes a person who is willing to give money, help, or kindness freely. it is an exact and primary synonym for being munificent.
Synonyms: Magnanimous (उदार), Bountiful (प्रचुर), Philanthropic (परोपकारी).
Antonyms: Stingy (कंजूस), Mean (नीच), Greedy (लालची).

This word refers to a person who is unwilling to spend money and acts like a miser. it is the direct opposite of being extremely generous or munificent.
Synonyms: Stingy (कंजूस), Parsimonious (मितव्ययी), Niggardly (कंजूस).
Antonyms: Munificent (दानी), Generous (उदार), Lavish (भव्य).

This refers to being relating to the assistance of those in need. Since it involves giving, it functions as a synonym describing the generous nature of the given word.
Synonyms: Altruistic (निःस्वार्थ), Benevolent (परोपकारी), Liberal (मुक्तहस्त).
Antonyms: Selfish (स्वार्थी), Hard-hearted (पत्थर दिल), Greedy (लालची).

This word refers to being unassuming or moderate in the estimation of one's abilities or achievements. while related to personality, it describes humility rather than the specific act of giving money.
Synonyms: Humble (विनीत), Unpretentious (दिखावा रहित), Simple (साधारण).
Antonyms: Proud (घमंडी), Arrogant (अहंकारी), Boastful (शेखीखोर).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Auspicious
questionsEn.s:
Auspicious - शुभ / अनुकूल (Conducive to success; favorable)
Propitious - अनुकूल (Indicating a good chance of success)
Fortunate - भाग्यशाली (Happening by a lucky chance)
Ominous - अशुभ (Giving the impression that something bad will happen)
Opportune - सामयिक (Occurring at a favorable or appropriate time)


Hence, 'Ominous' is the most suitable antonym for 'Auspicious'.
oa:
This word describes something that is giving or indicating a good chance of success; being favorable. it is an exact synonym for being auspicious.
Synonyms: Favorable (अनुकूल), Advantageous (लाभदायक), Promising (आशाजनक).
Antonyms: Unfortunate (दुर्भाग्यपूर्ण), Hostile (शत्रुतापूर्ण), Adverse (विपरीत).

This word refers to something happening by a lucky chance; being lucky. It aligns with the positive successful nature of the question word, acting as a synonym.
Synonyms: Lucky (भाग्यशाली), Blessed (सुखी), Happy (प्रसन्न).
Antonyms: Unlucky (अभागा), Miserable (दयनीय), Cursed (शापित).

This word refers to giving the worrying impression that something bad is going to happen; being threateningly inauspicious. it is the perfect opposite of a sign of good luck.
Synonyms: Threatening (धमकी भरा), Sinister (अशुभ), Portentous (अमंगलकारी).
Antonyms: Auspicious (शुभ), Promising (आशाजनक), Encouraging (प्रोत्साहित करने वाला).

This word refers to something done or occurring at a specially favorable or appropriate time. It acts as a synonym that describes a timely and positive situation.
Synonyms: Timely (समय पर), Suitable (उपयुक्त), Appropriate (उचित).
Antonyms: Inopportune (असमय), Inappropriate (अनुचित), Unsuitable (अयोग्य).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Persevere
questionsEn.s:
Persevere - दृढ़ रहना / लगे रहना (Continue in a course of action despite difficulty)
Discontinue - बंद करना (Cease from doing or providing something)
Fail - असफल होना (Be unsuccessful in achieving one's goal)
Damage - क्षति पहुँचाना (Physical harm that impairs value or function)
Unclaim - दावा छोड़ना (To give up or renounce a previous claim)


Hence, 'Discontinue' is the most suitable antonym for 'Persevere'.
oa:
This word means to stop doing something, especially something that has been happening regularly. it is the direct opposite of persisting in an effort despite difficulties.
Synonyms: Cease (बंद करना), Halt (रोकना), Quit (छोड़ना).
Antonyms: Persevere (लगातार जारी रखना), Continue (जारी रखना), Persist (बने रहना).

This refers to being unsuccessful in achieving one's goal. While those who don't persevere may fail, the word describes the outcome rather than the act of stopping the effort itself.
Synonyms: Flop (असफल होना), Collapse (पतन होना), Miss (चूकना).
Antonyms: Succeed (सफल होना), Win (जीतना), Achieve (हासिल करना).

This word means to inflict physical harm on something so as to impair its value or function. it has no logical connection to the continuity of effort.
Synonyms: Harm (नुकसान पहुँचाना), Impair (बिगाड़ना), Mar (खराब करना).
Antonyms: Repair (सुधारना), Fix (ठीक करना), Mend (सुधारना).

This is not a standard dictionary word in this context; it likely refers to the act of giving up a claim to something. It is contextually unrelated to perseverance.
Synonyms: Renounce (त्यागना), Relinquish (छोड़ना), Disown (अस्वीकार करना).
Antonyms: Assert (दावा करना), Claim (दावा करना), Maintain (बनाए रखना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Astute
questionsEn.s:
Astute - चतुर / सयाना (Having an ability to accurately assess situations)
Distraught - व्याकुल (Deeply upset and agitated)
Savvy - जानकार (Shrewd and knowledgeable; having practical sense)
Adroit - निपुण (Clever or skillful in using the hands or mind)
Gullible - भोला-भाला (Easily persuaded to believe something)


Hence, 'Gullible' is the most suitable antonym for 'Astute'.
oa:
This word refers to being very worried and upset. it describes an emotional state of distress and has no relation to mental sharpness or intelligence.
Synonyms: Agitated (उत्तेजित), Distressed (परेशान), Worried (चिंतित).
Antonyms: Calm (शांत), Composed (धैर्यवान), Serene (निर्मल).

This word refers to having practical knowledge and ability; being shrewd and knowledgeable. it is a direct and modern synonym for being astute.
Synonyms: Sharp (तेज़), Shrewd (चतुर), Knowledgeable (जानकार).
Antonyms: Ignorant (अज्ञानी), Green (नौसिखिया), Naive (नादान).

This word refers to being clever or skillful in using the hands or mind. It functions as a synonym that highlights the cleverness aspect of the question word.
Synonyms: Dexterous (निपुण), Skillful (कुशल), Deft (चतुर).
Antonyms: Maladroit (अनाड़ी), Clumsy (भद्दा), Inept (अक्षम).

This word describes someone who is easily persuaded to believe something; being credulous. it is the direct opposite of being astute, which involves being sharp and difficult to trick.
Synonyms: Naive (भोल-भाला), Credulous (भोला), Trusting (भरोसेमंद).
Antonyms: Astute (चतुर), Cynical (कुटिल), Skeptical (संदेही).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Lucid
questionsEn.s:
Lucid - स्पष्ट / सुबोध (Expressed clearly; easy to understand)
Dreadful - भयानक (Extremely bad or serious)
Inconspicuous - अप्रत्यक्ष (Not clearly visible or attracting attention)
Ambiguous - अनेकार्थी / अस्पष्ट (Open to more than one interpretation)
Dull - नीरस (Lacking interest or excitement)


Hence, 'Ambiguous' is the most suitable antonym for 'Lucid'.
oa:
This word describes something that is extremely bad or serious. While confusing things can be dreadful, the word focuses on the severity of a negative quality rather than clarity.
Synonyms: Awful (भयानक), Horrible (डरावना), Terrible (बहुत बुरा).
Antonyms: Wonderful (अद्भुत), Pleasant (सुखद), Excellent (उत्कृष्ट).

This refers to things that are not clearly visible or attracting attention; being not noticeable. While related to sight, it describes presence rather than the clarity of expression or thought.
Synonyms: Unobtrusive (विनीत/अप्रत्यक्ष), Hidden (छिपा हुआ), Modest (साधारण).
Antonyms: Conspicuous (विशिष्ट), Noticeable (प्रत्यक्ष), Obvious (ज़ाहिर).

This word refers to a language or situation that is open to more than one interpretation; having a double meaning. it is the direct opposite of being clear and easy to understand (lucid).
Synonyms: Equivocal (अस्पष्ट), Vague (अस्पष्ट), Unclear (अनिश्चित).
Antonyms: Lucid (स्पष्ट), Explicit (सुस्पष्ट), Certain (निश्चित).

This describes something that is lacking interest or excitement; being boring. while it can refer to a lack of light, it usually describes a lack of quality rather than a lack of logical clarity.
Synonyms: Tedious (थकाऊ), Drab (फीका), Humdrum (नीरस).
Antonyms: Vivid (जीवंत), Sharp (तेज़), Bright (चमकदार).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Inept
questionsEn.s:
Inept - अयोग्य / अनाड़ी (Having or showing no skill; clumsy)
Clumsy - भद्दा (Awkward in movement or in handling things)
Bungling - गड़बड़ करने वाला (Carrying out a task clumsily or incompetently)
Competent - सक्षम (Having the necessary ability or skill)
Gauche - फूहड़ (Lacking ease or grace; unsophisticated)


Hence, 'Competent' is the most suitable antonym for 'Inept'.
oa:
This word refers to a person who is awkward in movement or handling things. It is a direct synonym for being inept.
Synonyms: Maladroit (अनाड़ी), Bungling (गड़बड़ करने वाला), Ungraceful (फूहड़).
Antonyms: Deft (निपुण), Skillful (कुशल), Graceful (सुरुचिपूर्ण).

This describes someone who is prone to carrying out a task clumsily or incompetently. it functions as a strong synonym for the given word.
Synonyms: Incompetent (अक्षम), Botching (बिगाड़ने वाला), Inept (अयोग्य).
Antonyms: Expert (विशेषज्ञ), Capable (योग्य), Efficient (सक्षम).

This word refers to having the necessary ability, knowledge, or skill to do something successfully. it is the direct and most appropriate opposite for being inept or unskilled.
Synonyms: Capable (योग्य), Proficient (निपुण), Qualified (सक्षम).
Antonyms: Inept (अयोग्य), Incompetent (अक्षम), Inadequate (अपर्याप्त).

This describes a person who is socially awkward and lacking in ease or grace. While it focuses on social behavior, it acts as a synonym for being clumsy or inept in manners.
Synonyms: Awkward (भोंडा), Inelegant (अशिष्ट), Tactless (अकुशल).
Antonyms: Sophisticated (सभ्य), Urbane (शिष्ट), Suave (सौम्य).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Plunged
questionsEn.s:
Plunged - गिरना / डूबना (Jumped or fell quickly and suddenly)
Dived - गोता लगाया (Jumped headfirst into water)
Ascended - ऊपर चढ़ा (Went up or climbed; rose)
Cruised - सुचारू रूप से चला (Sailed or traveled at a steady speed)
Plateaued - स्थिर हो गया (Reached a state of little or no change)


Hence, 'Ascended' is the most suitable antonym for 'Plunged'.
oa:
This word means to jump headfirst into water or to fall suddenly and quickly. it is an exact synonym for the action described by the question word.
Synonyms: Submerged (डूबना), Descended (नीचे गिरना), Dropped (गिरा हुआ).
Antonyms: Rose (उठा), Ascended (चढ़ा), Emerged (उभरा).

This word means to go up or climb; to rise through the air. it is the direct opposite of plunging, which involves a sudden downward movement.
Synonyms: Rose (ऊपर उठा), Climbed (चढ़ा), Soared (ऊंची उड़ान भरी).
Antonyms: Plunged (गिरा), Descended (नीचे उतरा), Sank (डूबा).

This refers to sailing about in an area without a precise destination, or traveling at a steady speed. it describes horizontal movement and is contextually unrelated to vertical plunging.
Synonyms: Sailed (समुद्री यात्रा की), Coasted (आसानी से चला), Traveled (यात्रा की).
Antonyms: Halted (रुका), Struggled (संघर्ष किया), Raced (तेज़ी से चला).

This refers to a state of little or no change following a period of activity or progress. while it involves a lack of movement, it describes a horizontal line in progress rather than the opposite of falling.
Synonyms: Levelled off (स्थिर हुआ), Stagnated (ठहरा रहा), Stabilized (स्थिर हुआ).
Antonyms: Increased (बढ़ा), Decreased (घटा), Fluctured (उतार-चढ़ाव हुआ).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Depth
questionsEn.s:
Depth - गहराई (The distance from the top to the bottom; profundity)
Intensity - तीव्रता (The quality of being intense or forceful)
Abyss - अथाह खाई (A deep or seemingly bottomless chasm)
Profundity - गहनता (Deep insight; great depth of knowledge)
Shallowness - छिछलापन (Lacking depth; superficiality)


Hence, 'Shallowness' is the most suitable antonym for 'Depth'.
oa:
This word refers to the quality of being intense; having great force, strength, or concentration. While deep feelings are intense, the word describes strength rather than physical or metaphorical distance from the top.
Synonyms: Force (शक्ति), Power (ताकत), Magnitude (परिमाण).
Antonyms: Weakness (कमज़ोरी), Mildness (हल्कापन), Feebleness (निर्बलता).

This word refers to a deep or seemingly bottomless chasm. It is a synonym that describes an extreme or literal form of depth.
Synonyms: Chasm (खाई), Gulf (खाड़ी/अथाह), Void (शून्य).
Antonyms: Summit (शिखर), Peak (चोटी), Surface (सतह).

This word refers to deep insight; being great in knowledge or thought. It is a synonym for the metaphorical "depth" of the mind or a subject.
Synonyms: Sagacity (बुद्धिमानी), Insight (सूझबूझ), Acuity (तीक्ष्णता).
Antonyms: Shallowness (छिछोरापन), Triviality (तुच्छता), Superficiality (सतहीपन).

This word refers to the quality of being shallow; having little depth or lacking in serious thought or feeling. it is the direct and most appropriate opposite for depth.
Synonyms: Superficiality (सतहीपन), Frivolity (छिछोरापन), Emptiness (खालीपन).
Antonyms: Depth (गहराई), Profundity (गहनता), Breadth (विस्तार).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Generous
questionsEn.s:
Generous - उदार (Willing to give money or help freely)
Kind - दयालु (Friendly, generous, and considerate)
Stingy - कंजूस (Unwilling to give or spend; ungenerous)
Benevolent - परोपकारी (Well-meaning and kindly)
Charitable - दानशील (Relating to the assistance of those in need)


Hence, 'Stingy' is the most suitable antonym for 'Generous'.
oa:
This word describes a person who is friendly, generous, and considerate. It is a synonym that highlights the helpful nature of the question word.
Synonyms: Benevolent (परोपकारी), Compassionate (सहानुभूतिपूर्ण), Helpful (सहायक).
Antonyms: Cruel (निर्दयी), Mean (नीच), Harsh (कठोर).

This word describes someone who is unwilling to give or spend; being ungenerous with money. it is the direct and most common antonym for being generous.
Synonyms: Miserly (कंजूस), Parsimonious (मितव्ययी), Niggardly (कंजूस).
Antonyms: Generous (उदार), Munificent (दानी), Liberal (मुक्तहस्त).

This refers to well-meaning and kindly; serving a charitable rather than a profit-making purpose. it is a formal synonym for being generous.
Synonyms: Philanthropic (परोपकारी), Altruistic (निःस्वार्थ), Humanist (मानवतावादी).
Antonyms: Malevolent (दुर्भावनापूर्ण), Selfish (स्वार्थी), Cruel (निर्दयी).

This word refers to being relating to the assistance of those in need. It functions as an exact synonym found in the context of giving to the poor.
Synonyms: Beneficent (परोपकारी), Magnanimous (उदार), Free-handed (मुक्तहस्त).
Antonyms: Greedy (लालची), Grasping (लालची), Stingy (कंजूस).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Active
questionsEn.s:
Active - सक्रिय (Engaging or ready to engage in physically energetic pursuits)
Energetic - ऊर्जावान (Showing or involving great vitality or energy)
Agile - फुर्तीला (Able to move quickly and easily)
Lively - जीवंत (Full of life and energy; active and outgoing)
Passive - निष्क्रिय (Accepting what happens without active response)


Hence, 'Passive' is the most suitable antonym for 'Active'.
oa:
This word describes a person showing or involving great vitality or energy. it is a direct synonym for someone who is physically or mentally active.
Synonyms: Vigorous (ऊर्जावान), Dynamic (गतिशील), Animated (जीवंत).
Antonyms: Lethargic (सुस्त), Tired (थका हुआ), Sluggish (मंद).

This refers to being able to move quickly and easily. It is a synonym that describes a physical type of being active and flexible.
Synonyms: Nimble (फुर्तीला), Lithe (लचीला), Sprightly (चपल).
Antonyms: Clumsy (अनाड़ी), Slow (धीमा), Stiff (कठोर).

This word describes a person or place that is full of life and energy; being active and outgoing. It acts as a synonym representing high spirit.
Synonyms: Spirited (जोशीला), Vivacious (जीवंत), Perky (प्रसन्न).
Antonyms: Dull (नीरस), Somber (गंभीर), Listless (सुस्त).

This word describes someone accepting or allowing what happens or what others do, without active response or resistance. it is the direct opposite of being active or taking initiative.
Synonyms: Inactive (निष्क्रिय), Submissive (दब्बू), Compliant (अनुकूल).
Antonyms: Active (सक्रिय), Assertive (मुखर), Dynamic (गतिशील).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Borrow
questionsEn.s:
Borrow - उधार लेना (Take and use something with the intention of returning it)
Entrust - सौंपना (Assign the responsibility for something to someone)
Usurp - हड़पना (Take a position of power illegally or by force)
Appropriate - हस्तगत करना (Take something for one's own use without permission)
Lend - उधार देना (Grant the use of something understanding it will be returned)


Hence, 'Lend' is the most suitable antonym for 'Borrow'.
oa:
This word means to assign the responsibility for doing something to someone. while it involves giving something, it focuses on responsibility rather than the temporary use of an object.
Synonyms: Commit (सौंपना), Consign (सुपुर्द करना), Assign (सौंपना).
Antonyms: Withdraw (वापस लेना), Retain (रखना), Keep (बचाए रखना).

This means to take a position of power or importance illegally or by force. it involves taking something without permission, which is contextually far from the mutual agreement of borrowing.
Synonyms: Seize (हड़पना), Annex (हड़पना), Appropriate (अधिकार करना).
Antonyms: Surrender (आत्मसमर्पण करना), Yield (छोड़ना), Release (मुक्त करना).

This means to take something for one's own use, typically without the owner's permission. It describes an unauthorized taking, whereas borrowing is consensual.
Synonyms: Commandeer (अधिग्रहण करना), Take (लेना), Pocket (जेब में डालना).
Antonyms: Return (वापस करना), Give (देना), Bestow (प्रदान करना).

This word means to grant to someone the use of something on the understanding that it will be returned. it is the direct and most appropriate opposite for taking something with the intention to return it.
Synonyms: Loan (उधार देना), Advance (अग्रिम देना), Provide (प्रदान करना).
Antonyms: Borrow (उधार लेना), Take (लेना), Receive (प्राप्त करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Departure
questionsEn.s:
Departure - प्रस्थान (The action of leaving, especially to start a journey)
Advent - आगमन (The arrival of a notable person or thing)
Exodus - पलायन (A mass departure of people)
Exit - निकास (An act of going out of or leaving a place)
Withdrawal - वापसी (The action of removing or pulling back)


Hence, 'Advent' is the most suitable antonym for 'Departure'.
oa:
This word refers to the arrival of a notable person or thing. it is the direct opposite of a departure, as it describes a coming into being or a starting point at a location.
Synonyms: Arrival (आगमन), Approach (आगमन), Appearance (प्रकटीकरण).
Antonyms: Departure (प्रस्थान), Exit (निकास), Withdrawal (वापसी).

This word refers to a mass departure of people. It is a synonym that describes a large-scale version of departing.
Synonyms: Migration (प्रवास), Flight (पलायन), Evacuation (निकासी).
Antonyms: Influx (आगमन), Arrival (आगमन), Return (वापसी).

This refers to the act of going out of or leaving a place. It is a fundamental synonym and literal definition of a departure.
Synonyms: Outflow (निकासी), Egress (निकास), Parting (विदाई).
Antonyms: Entrance (प्रवेश), Entry (प्रवेश), Intake (प्रवेश).

This word refers to the action of withdrawing or removing something; the act of pulling back. it functions as a synonym that emphasizes the act of leaving a position or commitment.
Synonyms: Retreat (पीछे हटना), Recessional (वापसी), Removal (हटाव).
Antonyms: Advance (आगे बढ़ना), Entry (प्रवेश), Installation (स्थापना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Giant
questionsEn.s:
Giant - विशाल / दैत्य (A person or thing of unusually great size or importance)
Huge - बहुत बड़ा (Extremely large; enormous)
Immense - अत्यंत विशाल (Extremely large or great, especially in scale)
Enormous - विशाल (Very large in size, quantity, or extent)
Tiny - नन्हा (Very small)


Hence, 'Tiny' is the most suitable antonym for 'Giant'.
oa:
This word refers to something extremely large in size or amount. it is a direct synonym for being a giant.
Synonyms: Enormous (विशाल), Massive (बड़ा), Gigantic (विशालकाय).
Antonyms: Tiny (नन्हा), Small (छोटा), Petite (छोटा).

This describes something that is extremely large or great, especially in scale or degree. It functions as another strong synonym for the question word.
Synonyms: Vast (विस्तृत), Monumental (विशाल), Colossal (विशालकाय).
Antonyms: Microscopic (अत्यंत सूक्ष्म), Minute (सूक्ष्म), Little (छोटा).

This word refers to something very large in size, quantity, or extent. it is a near-perfect synonym for the scale implied by a giant.
Synonyms: Gargantuan (विशालकाय), Titanic (महान), Substantial (काफी बड़ा).
Antonyms: Modest (मामूली), Petty (तुच्छ), Tiny (बहुत छोटा).

This word refers to something that is very small. it is the direct and most accurate antonym for something that is extremely large or gigantic.
Synonyms: Minuscule (बहुत छोटा), Minute (सूक्ष्म), Puny (छोटा/कमज़ोर).
Antonyms: Giant (विशाल), Huge (बड़ा), Mammoth (विशाल).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Concentrate
questionsEn.s:
Concentrate - केंद्रित करना (Focus all one's attention on a particular object or activity)
Focus - ध्यान केंद्रित करना (The center of interest or activity)
Consolidate - मज़बूत करना (Make something stronger or more solid)
Assemble - इकट्ठा करना (Gather together in one place for a common purpose)
Disperse - तितर-बितर करना (Distribute or spread over a wide area)


Hence, 'Disperse' is the most suitable antonym for 'Concentrate'.
oa:
This word means to adapt to the prevailing level of light or to pay particular attention to something. It is an exact synonym for the act of concentrating.
Synonyms: Centralize (केंद्रित करना), Direct (निर्देशित करना), Rivet (स्थिर करना).
Antonyms: Disperse (तितर-बितर करना), Scattter (बिखेरना), Distract (ध्यान भटकना).

This word refers to the act of making something physically stronger or more solid; combining into a single more effective whole. it acts as a synonym describing the gathering of resources.
Synonyms: Combine (जोड़ना), Merge (मिलाना), Fortify (मज़बूत करना).
Antonyms: Separate (अलग करना), Divide (बाँटना), Weaken (कमज़ोर करना).

This word refers to the act of gathering together in one place for a common purpose. It is a synonym that describes the collective aspect of concentrating things.
Synonyms: Collect (इकट्ठा करना), Gather (एकत्र करना), Muster (संग्रह करना).
Antonyms: Disband (भंग करना), Scatter (बिखेरना), Disperse (तितर-बितर करना).

This word means to distribute or spread over a wide area; to go in different directions. it is the direct and most appropriate opposite for concentrating or focusing in one place.
Synonyms: Scatter (बिखेरना), Diffuse (फैलाना), Dissipate (नष्ट करना/फैलाना).
Antonyms: Concentrate (केंद्रित करना), Gather (इकट्ठा करना), Accumulate (जमा करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Colorful
questionsEn.s:
Colorful - रंगीन (Having many or varied colors; vivid)
Vivid - ज्वलंत (Producing powerful feelings or clear images; bright)
Monochrome - एकरंगा (Executed in tones of only one color)
Radiant - दीप्तिमान (Sending out light; shining or glowing brightly)
Vibrant - जीवंत (Full of energy and life; bright and striking)


Hence, 'Monochrome' is the most suitable antonym for 'Colorful'.
oa:
This word refers to producing powerful feelings or strong, clear images in the mind; being intensely bright. it is a synonym that captures the intensity of being colorful.
Synonyms: Bright (चमकदार), Vibrant (जीवंत), Graphic (चित्रात्मक).
Antonyms: Dull (नीरस), Drab (फीका), Pale (पीला).

This word refers to a photograph or picture developed or executed in black and white or in varying tones of only one color. it is the direct and most accurate antonym for being colorful.
Synonyms: Black-and-white (श्वेत-श्याम), Neutral (तटस्थ), Unicolor (एक रंग का).
Antonyms: Colorful (रंगीन), Polychromatic (बहुवर्ण), Bright (चमकदार).

This refers to sending out light; shining or glowing brightly. while related to visual appeal, it acts as a synonym describing a brilliant and colorful quality.
Synonyms: Beaming (दीप्तिमान), Luminous (प्रकाशमान), Effulgent (तेजस्वी).
Antonyms: Dim (धुंधला), Shadowy (छायादार), Dark (अंधेरा).

This word describes something full of energy and life; being bright and striking in color. It is a direct synonym for the lively nature of being colorful.
Synonyms: Vivid (चमकदार), Animated (जोशपूर्ण), Dynamic (गतिशील).
Antonyms: Lifeless (निर्जीव), Somber (उदास), Spiritless (उत्साहहीन).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Glanced
questionsEn.s:
Glanced - सरसरी नज़र डाली (Take a brief or hurried look)
Peeked - झाँका (Take a quick or furtive look)
Stared - घूरना (Look fixedly or vacantly with eyes wide open)
Skimmed - सरसरी तौर पर पढ़ना (Read something quickly to note important points)
Peeped - झाँकना (Look quickly and furtively, especially through a gap)


Hence, 'Stared' is the most suitable antonym for 'Glanced'.
oa:
This word refers to a quick or furtive look, especially through a small opening. It is a synonym that describes a brief look similar to a glance.
Synonyms: Peeped (झाँका), Glanced (नज़र डाली), Glimpsed (झलक देखी).
Antonyms: Stared (घूरा), Scrutinized (बारीकी से देखा), Ignored (अनदेखा किया).

This word means to look fixedly or vacantly at someone or something with one's eyes wide open. it is the direct opposite of a quick, casual glance.
Synonyms: Gazed (एकटक देखा), Glared (घूरा), Leered (तिरछी नज़र से देखा).
Antonyms: Glanced (नज़र डाली), Peeped (झाँका), Glimpsed (झलक देखी).

This word refers to reading something quickly so as to note only the important points or looking over something rapidly. it functions as a synonym for a cursory look.
Synonyms: Scanned (तेज़ी से देखा), Browsed (सरसरी तौर पर पढ़ा), Glanced over (नज़र डाली).
Antonyms: Studied (गहन अध्ययन किया), Perused (ध्यान से पढ़ा), Inspected (निरीक्षण किया).

This means to look quickly and furtively at something, especially through a narrow opening. It is another synonym for a short and quick visual interaction.
Synonyms: Spy (ताक-झाँक करना), Peek (झाँकना), Glint (झलक).
Antonyms: Gaze (एकटक देखना), Gape (मुँह फाड़कर देखना), Ignore (अनदेखा करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Depressed
questionsEn.s:
Depressed - उदास (In a state of general unhappiness or despondency)
Cheerful - हंसमुख (Noticeably happy and optimistic)
Despondent - हताश (In low spirits from loss of hope or courage)
Melancholy - उदासी (A feeling of pensive sadness)
Mournful - शोकाकुल (Feeling or expressing great sadness)


Hence, 'Cheerful' is the most suitable antonym for 'Depressed'.
oa:
