This word describes a person who is noticeably happy and optimistic. it is the direct and most appropriate opposite for a state of unhappiness and low spirits.
Synonyms: Joyful (आनंदित), Jolly (हंसमुख), Mirthful (प्रसन्न).
Antonyms: Depressed (उदास), Gloomy (निराशाजनक), Morose (खिन्न).

This word refers to being in low spirits from loss of hope or courage. It functions as an exact synonym for the heavy sadness of being depressed.
Synonyms: Dejected (हताश), Miserable (दुखी), Downcast (खिन्न).
Antonyms: Hopeful (आशावान), Optimistic (आशावादी), Encouraged (प्रोत्साहित).

This word refers to a feeling of pensive sadness, typically with no obvious cause. It is a synonym that describes a deep and lingering sadness.
Synonyms: Sorrowful (शोकाकुल), Lugubrious (उदास), Somber (गंभीर).
Antonyms: Radiant (दमकता हुआ), Exuberant (उल्लासपूर्ण), Happy (खुश).

This refers to feeling or expressing or inducing sadness, regret, or grief. It functions as a synonym describing the sorrow found in depression.
Synonyms: Doleful (दुखद), Plaintive (शोकपूर्ण), Sad (उदास).
Antonyms: Jubilant (प्रफुल्लित), Excited (उत्तेजित), Cheerful (हंसमुख).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Give back
questionsEn.s:
Give back - वापस करना (Return something to its owner)
Keep - पास रखना (Have or retain possession of)
Return - लौटाना (Come or go back to a place or person)
Reimburse - चुकाना (Repay a person who has spent or lost money)
Resort - सहारा लेना / स्थल (A place frequented for holidays; a course of action)


Hence, 'Keep' is the most suitable antonym for 'Give back'.
oa:
This word means to retain possession of something; to continue to have or hold. it is the direct opposite of returning an item to its owner.
Synonyms: Retain (बनाए रखना), Withhold (रोक लेना), Reserve (आरक्षित करना).
Antonyms: Return (वापस करना), Relinquish (त्यागना), Restore (बहाल करना).

This means to come or go back to a place or person or to give back an item. it is the primary synonym for the phrase provided in the question.
Synonyms: Restore (वापस देना), Remit (वापस भेजना), Refund (पैसे लौटाना).
Antonyms: Take (लेना), Borrow (उधार लेना), Keep (पास रखना).

This word means to repay someone who has spent or lost money. It functions as a synonym in the specific context of giving back money.
Synonyms: Repay (चुकाना), Compensate (मुआवज़ा देना), Indemnify (क्षतिपूर्ति करना).
Antonyms: Charge (शुल्क लेना), Deprive (वंचित करना), Owe (ऋणी होना).

This word refers to a place that is a popular destination for vacations or the action of turning to a course of action in difficulty. It is grammatically and contextually unrelated.
Synonyms: Refuge (शरण), Resource (संसाधन), Alternative (विकल्प).
Antonyms: Avoid (बचना), Abstain (परहेज करना), Shun (दूर रहना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Dig
questionsEn.s:
Dig - खोदना (Break up and move earth with a tool or hands)
Excavate - खुदाई करना (Make a hole or channel by digging)
Burrow - बिल खोदना (A hole or tunnel dug by an animal)
Fill - भरना (Cause a space to become full or blocked)
Unearth - खोज निकालना (Find something in the ground by digging)


Hence, 'Fill' is the most suitable antonym for 'Dig'.


151. Select the word opposite in meaning to: Clear
A) Obscure ✅ /// This word refers to something that is not discovered or known about; uncertain or difficult to understand. It is the most appropriate opposite for being clear and easy to comprehend.
Synonyms: Vague (अस्पष्ट), Ambiguous (अनेकार्थी), Murky (धुंधला).
Antonyms: Clear (स्पष्ट), Obvious (ज़ाहिर), Lucid (सुबोध).
B) Open /// This describes something that is not closed or blocked, or someone who is honest and frank. While being open can imply clarity, it does not provide the required opposite relationship.
Synonyms: Accessible (सुलभ), Frank (साफ़दिल), Exposed (खुला).
Antonyms: Closed (बंद), Secretive (रहस्यमय), Shut (बंद).
C) Bright /// This refers to something that gives out or reflects a lot of light, or someone who is intelligent. It is often a characteristic of being clear but is not its opposite.
Synonyms: Radiant (चमकदार), Brilliant (शानदार), Vivid (जीवंत).
Antonyms: Dark (अंधेरा), Dull (धुंधला), Gloomy (उदास).
D) Frank /// This word describes a person who is open, honest, and direct in speech or writing. It shares a similar positive connotation of honesty with being clear but does not function as an antonym.
Synonyms: Candid (स्पष्टवादी), Forthright (सीधा), Blunt (मुँहफट).
Antonyms: Evasive (टालमटोल करने वाला), Secretive (गुप्त), Dishonest (बेईमान).
Clear - स्पष्ट (Easy to perceive, understand, or interpret)
Obscure - अस्पष्ट (Not clearly expressed or easily understood)
Open - खुला (Allowing access; not closed or blocked)
Bright - उज्ज्वल (Giving out or reflecting much light)
Frank - निष्कपट (Honest and direct in speech or writing)


Hence, 'Obscure' is the most suitable antonym for 'Clear'.


152. Select the word opposite in meaning to: Candid
A) Frank /// This word describes a person who is open, honest, and direct in speech or writing. It serves as a direct synonym for the given word rather than an opposite.
Synonyms: Forthright (स्पष्ट), Direct (सीधा), Blunt (मुँहफट).
Antonyms: Evasive (टालमटोल करने वाला), Insincere (दिखावटी), Deceptive (भ्रामक).
B) Guarded ✅ /// This word refers to a person who is cautious and reserved, especially in revealing information or feelings. It is the perfect opposite of being candid or open.
Synonyms: Cautious (सतर्क), Reticent (अल्पभाषी), Wary (सावधान).
Antonyms: Candid (स्पष्टवादी), Open (खुला), Frank (साफ़दिल).
C) Honest /// This word refers to someone who is truthful and sincere; free of deceit. Since it is the core meaning of being candid, it cannot be considered the antonym.
Synonyms: Upright (ईमानदार), Trustworthy (भरोसेमंद), Veracious (सत्यवादी).
Antonyms: Corrupt (भ्रष्ट), Crooked (बेईमान), Mendacious (झूठा).
D) Open /// This describes someone who is frank and communicative, not hiding one's thoughts or feelings. It is a synonym for the given word.
Synonyms: Transparent (पारदर्शी), Communicative (मिलनसार), Accessible (सुलभ).
Antonyms: Secretive (रहस्यमय), Reserved (संकोची), Hidden (छिपा हुआ).
Candid - स्पष्टवादी (Frank and outspoken; honest)
Frank - साफगो (Honest and direct in speech or writing)
Guarded - सावधान (Cautious and having a reserved manner)
Honest - ईमानदार (Free of deceit; truthful and sincere)
Open - खुला (Frank and communicative; not secretive)


Hence, 'Guarded' is the most suitable antonym for 'Candid'.


153. Select the word opposite in meaning to: Accentuate
A) Emphasize /// This means to give special importance or prominence to something in speaking or writing. It matches the meaning of the question word, making it a synonym.
Synonyms: Stress (ज़ोर देना), Highlight (उजागर करना), Underline (रेखांकित करना).
Antonyms: Ignore (अनदेखा करना), Understate (कम करके बताना), Neglect (उपेक्षा करना).
B) Highlight /// This word refers to drawing special attention to something or making it more prominent. It is contextually identical to being accentuated and serves as a synonym.
Synonyms: Spotlight (सुर्खियों में लाना), Feature (प्रस्तुत करना), Accent (ज़ोर देना).
Antonyms: Obscure (धुंधला करना), Hide (छिपाना), Overlook (नज़रअंदाज़ करना).
C) Obscure ✅ /// This word refers to the act of making something unclear, uncertain, or difficult to see or notice. It is the direct opposite of emphasizing or highlighting a feature.
Synonyms: Mask (छिपाना), Cloud (धुंधला करना), Befog (उलझाना).
Antonyms: Clarify (स्पष्ट करना), Accentuate (ज़ोर देना), Reveal (प्रकट करना).
D) Promote /// This means to support or encourage the cause or venture of something. While positive, it does not specifically relate to making a feature stand out visually or verbally like the given word.
Synonyms: Advance (बढ़ावा देना), Foster (प्रोत्साहित करना), Boost (आगे बढ़ाना).
Antonyms: Hinder (बाधा डालना), Discourage (हतोत्साहित करना), Oppose (विरोध करना).
Accentuate - ज़ोर देना (Make more noticeable or prominent)
Emphasize - ज़ोर देना (Give special importance to something)
Highlight - प्रमुखता देना (Draw special attention to something)
Obscure - अस्पष्ट करना (Make unclear or difficult to see)
Promote - बढ़ावा देना (Support or encourage the progress of)


Hence, 'Obscure' is the most suitable antonym for 'Accentuate'.


154. Select the word opposite in meaning to: Cursory
A) Thorough ✅ /// This word describes an action performed with great care and attention to detail; being complete and exhaustive. it is the direct opposite of a hasty or superficial glance.
Synonyms: Comprehensive (विस्तृत), Exhaustive (संपूर्ण), Meticulous (सूक्ष्म).
Antonyms: Cursory (सरसरी), Superficial (सतही), Careless (लापरवाह).
B) Brief /// This word refers to something that lasts for a short time or uses few words. While cursory actions are brief, this word describes duration rather than the lack of depth.
Synonyms: Short (संक्षिप्त), Concise (लघु), Ephemeral (क्षणिक).
Antonyms: Long (लंबा), Detailed (विस्तृत), Extended (विस्तारित).
C) Hasty /// This describes something done with excessive speed or urgency; hurried. It is a synonym that captures the lack of care associated with being cursory.
Synonyms: Rash (जल्दबाज़), Quick (तेज़), Impetuous (अविचारी).
Antonyms: Deliberate (सोचा-समझा), Slow (धीमा), Cautious (सावधान).
D) Superficial /// This describes something existing or occurring at or on the surface; lacking depth of character or understanding. It is a very close synonym for the given word.
Synonyms: Shallow (उथला), Exterior (बाहरी), Frivolous (ओछा).
Antonyms: Profound (गहन), Deep (गहरा), Internal (आंतरिक).
Cursory - सरसरी (Hasty and therefore not thorough or detailed)
Thorough - पूर्ण/विस्तृत (Complete with regard to every detail)
Brief - संक्षिप्त (Of short duration; not lasting long)
Hasty - जल्दबाज़ी (Done with excessive speed or urgency)
Superficial - सतही (Existing or occurring at or on the surface)


Hence, 'Thorough' is the most suitable antonym for 'Cursory'.


155. Select the word opposite in meaning to: Maladroit
A) Clumsy /// This word describes a person who moves or handles things in a careless or awkward way. It is a direct synonym for being maladroit and cannot be the opposite.
Synonyms: Awkward (बेढंगा), Ungainly (फूहड़), Blundering (भूल करने वाला).
Antonyms: Graceful (सुरुचिपूर्ण), Agile (फुर्तीला), Skillful (कुशल).
B) Awkward /// This refers to a person who lacks grace or skill in movement or social manner. It captures the essence of being maladroit, making it a synonym.
Synonyms: Gauche (अशिष्ट), Inept (अकुशल), Bumbling (अनाड़ी).
Antonyms: Adroit (निपुण), Elegant (शिष्ट), Dexterous (दक्ष).
C) Skillful ✅ /// This word refers to someone who has or shows knowledge, ability, or training to perform a certain activity or task well. It is the direct antonym for being clumsy or inept.
Synonyms: Adroit (निपुण), Proficient (कुशल), Expert (विशेषज्ञ).
Antonyms: Incompetent (अयोग्य), Maladroit (अनाड़ी), Inept (अकुशल).
D) Inept /// This describes someone who has or shows no skill; being clumsy. It serves as a synonym that emphasizes a total lack of competence.
Synonyms: Unskillful (अकुशल), Incompetent (अक्षम), Amateurish (शौकिया).
Antonyms: Competent (योग्य), Capable (सक्षम), Skilled (कुशल).
Maladroit - अनाड़ी (Inefficient or inept; clumsy)
Clumsy - बेढंगा (Awkward in movement or in handling things)
Awkward - भद्दा (Lacking skill or manner; causing difficulty)
Skillful - कुशल (Having or showing skill)
Inept - अयोग्य (Having or showing no skill; clumsy)


Hence, 'Skillful' is the most suitable antonym for 'Maladroit'.


156. Select the word opposite in meaning to: Dependence
A) Autonomy ✅ /// This word refers to the right or condition of self-government; independence or the ability to make one's own decisions. It is the direct opposite of relying on others.
Synonyms: Independence (स्वतंत्रता), Sovereignty (प्रभुसत्ता), Freedom (आज़ादी).
Antonyms: Dependence (निर्भरता), Subjugation (अधीनता), Slavery (गुलामी).
B) Slavery /// This refers to the condition in which one person is owned by another and is forced to work for them. It represents an extreme form of dependence and acts as a synonym in a negative sense.
Synonyms: Bondage (दास्ता), Servitude (गुलामी), Thrall (गुलाम).
Antonyms: Liberty (स्वतंत्रता), Autonomy (स्वायत्तता), Release (मुक्ति).
C) Subordinate /// This word refers to a person under the authority or control of another within an organization. It describes a dependent relationship rather than an opposite one.
Synonyms: Junior (कनिष्ठ), Assistant (सहायक), Underling (अधीनस्थ).
Antonyms: Superior (वरिष्ठ), Boss (प्रमुख), Leader (नेता).
D) Submissiveness /// This describes a willingness to yield to the authority of another; being meekly obedient. It is a characteristic often found in dependence, making it a synonym.
Synonyms: Compliance (अनुपालन), Docility (विनम्रता), Passive (दब्बू).
Antonyms: Defiance (अवहेलना), Assertiveness (मुखरता), Resistance (प्रतिरोध).
Dependence - निर्भरता (The state of relying on or being controlled by someone)
Autonomy - स्वायत्तता (The right or condition of self-government)
Slavery - गुलामी (The state of being a slave; being owned by another)
Subordinate - अधीनस्थ (Lower in rank or position)
Submissiveness - विनम्रता (The quality of being ready to yield to others)


Hence, 'Autonomy' is the most suitable antonym for 'Dependence'.


157. Select the word opposite in meaning to: Interesting
A) Monotonous ✅ /// This word describes something that is dull, tedious, and repetitive; lacking in variety and interest. it is the most appropriate opposite for something that captures attention.
Synonyms: Boring (ऊबाऊ), Humdrum (नीरस), Prosaic (फीका).
Antonyms: Exciting (रोमांचक), Interesting (दिलचस्प), Varied (विविध).
B) Terrible /// This word refers to something extremely bad, serious, or unpleasant. While it describes a negative quality, its opposite is "wonderful" or "good," not necessarily "interesting."
Synonyms: Awful (भयानक), Horrible (डरावना), Dreadful (खतरनाक).
Antonyms: Excellent (बेहतरीन), Wonderful (अद्भुत), Pleasant (सुखद).
C) Terrifying /// This word refers to something that causes extreme fear. Its meaning relates to intense emotion rather than the level of interest or curiosity.
Synonyms: Frightening (डरावना), Petrifying (अति डरावना), Scaring (भयभीत करने वाला).
Antonyms: Soothing (सुकून देने वाला), Comforting (दिलासा देने वाला), Reassuring (आश्वस्त करने वाला).
D) Disastrous /// This describes something that causes great damage or is a complete failure. It relates to the outcome or severity of an event rather than how interesting it is.
Synonyms: Catastrophic (विनाशकारी), Calamitous (आपत्तिजनक), Ruinous (हानिकारक).
Antonyms: Beneficial (लाभकारी), Fortunate (भाग्यशाली), Successful (सफल).
Interesting - दिलचस्प (Arousing curiosity or interest; holding attention)
Monotonous - नीरस (Dull, tedious, and repetitious; lacking variety)
Terrible - भयानक (Extremely bad or serious)
Terrifying - डरावना (Causing extreme fear)
Disastrous - विनाशकारी (Causing great damage)


Hence, 'Monotonous' is the most suitable antonym for 'Interesting'.


158. Select the word opposite in meaning to: Degenerate
A) Flourish ✅ /// This word means to grow or develop in a healthy or vigorous way, especially as the result of a particularly favorable environment. it is the direct opposite of declining or deteriorating.
Synonyms: Thrive (फलना-फूलना), Prosper (समृद्ध होना), Bloom (खिलना).
Antonyms: Decline (गिरना), Degenerate (पतित होना), Wither (मुरझाना).
B) Perish /// This word refers to the act of dying, especially in a violent, sudden, or untimely way. It represents an ultimate end or decline, making it synonymous with degeneration in some contexts.
Synonyms: Die (मरना), Expire (समाप्त होना), Vanish (मिट जाना).
Antonyms: Survive (जीवित रहना), Live (जीना), Endure (बने रहना).
C) Dismiss /// This means to order or allow to leave; to send away. It is contextually unrelated to the concept of growth or deterioration.
Synonyms: Discharge (निकाल देना), Reject (अस्वीकार करना), Oust (बेदखल करना).
Antonyms: Hire (नियुक्त करना), Accept (स्वीकार करना), Appoint (नियुक्त करना).
D) Decay /// This word refers to the state or process of rotting or decomposition through the action of bacteria and fungi. It is a direct synonym for the process of degenerating.
Synonyms: Rot (सड़ना), Decompose (गलना), Corrupt (भ्रष्ट होना).
Antonyms: Grow (बढ़ना), Refresh (ताज़ा करना), Flourish (पनपना).
Degenerate - पतन होना (To decline or deteriorate physically or morally)
Flourish - फलना-फूलना (To grow or develop in a healthy or vigorous way)
Perish - नष्ट होना (To suffer complete ruin or destruction; to die)
Dismiss - खारिज करना (To send away; to treat as unworthy of consideration)
Decay - क्षय (To rot or decompose through a natural process)


Hence, 'Flourish' is the most suitable antonym for 'Degenerate'.


159. Select the word opposite in meaning to: Lengthy

C) Assemble /// This means to gather together in one place for a common purpose. It describes the physical act of coming together, acting as a synonym.
Synonyms: Collect (इकट्ठा करना), Convene (आयोजित करना), Muster (जुटाना).
Antonyms: Disperse (तितर-बितर करना), Scatter (बिखेरना), Dismiss (विदा करना).
D) Disperse ✅ /// This word means to distribute or spread over a wide area; to go in different directions. it is the direct opposite of focusing or gathering in one spot.
Synonyms: Scatter (बिखेरना), Dissipate (नष्ट करना), Diffuse (फैलाना).
Antonyms: Concentrate (केंद्रित करना), Gather (इकट्ठा करना), Collect (संचय करना).
Concentrate - केंद्रित करना (Focus all one's attention or mental effort on a particular object)
Focus - ध्यान केंद्रित करना (The center of interest or activity)
Consolidate - मज़बूत करना (Make something physically stronger or more solid)
Assemble - इकट्ठा करना (Gather together in one place for a common purpose)
Disperse - बिखेरना (Distribute or spread over a wide area)


Hence, 'Disperse' is the most suitable antonym for 'Concentrate'.


196. Select the word opposite in meaning to: Colorful
A) Vivid /// This word describes something that produces powerful feelings or strong, clear images in the mind. It is a direct synonym that implies intense color.
Synonyms: Bright (चमकदार), Intense (तीव्र), Graphic (सजीव).
Antonyms: Dull (नीरस), Faded (धुंधला), Pale (फीका).
B) Monochrome ✅ /// This word refers to something consisting of or displaying images in only one color or shades of one color. it is the technical and direct opposite of being colorful.
Synonyms: Black and white (श्वेत-श्याम), Uncolored (रंगहीन), Tonal (एक ही रंग का).
Antonyms: Colorful (रंगीन), Polychromatic (बहुरंगी), Multicolored (रंग-बिरंगा).
C) Radiant /// This describes something that is sending out light; shining or glowing brightly. While it implies brightness, it acts as a synonym in terms of visual impact.
Synonyms: Beaming (दीप्तिमान), Luminous (चमकदार), Effulgent (तेजस्वी).
Antonyms: Dim (धुंधला), Dark (अंधेरा), Somber (गंभीर).
D) Vibrant /// This describes something that is full of energy and life, or something that is bright and striking. It is a near-perfect synonym for being colorful.
Synonyms: Spirited (जोशीला), Dynamic (गतिशील), Vivid (जीवंत).
Antonyms: Lifeless (निर्जीव), Drab (फीका), Listless (सुस्त).
Colorful - रंगीन (Having much or varied color; bright)
Vivid - सजीव (Producing powerful feelings or strong, clear images)
Monochrome - एकरंगा (Consisting of or displaying images in one color)
Radiant - दीप्तिमान (Sending out light; shining or glowing brightly)
Vibrant - जीवंत (Full of energy and enthusiasm; bright and striking)


Hence, 'Monochrome' is the most suitable antonym for 'Colorful'.


197. Select the word opposite in meaning to: Glanced
A) Peeked /// This word means to look quickly or furtively, typically through a narrow opening. It is a synonym that captures the brief and sudden nature of a glance.
Synonyms: Peeped (झांका), Glimpsed (एक झलक देखी), Squinted (तिरछी नज़र से देखा).
Antonyms: Ignored (अनदेखा किया), Overlooked (नज़रअंदाज़ किया), Stared (घूरा).
B) Stared ✅ /// This word means to look fixedly or vacantly at someone or something with one's eyes wide open. It is the direct opposite of a quick, temporary look.
Synonyms: Gazed (एकटक देखा), Glared (नाराज़गी से देखा), Peered (गौर से देखा).
Antonyms: Glanced (एक नज़र डाली), Blinked (पलकें झपकाईं), Winked (आँख मारी).
C) Skimmed /// This means to go or move quickly and lightly over or on a surface or through a text. It functions as a synonym in the sense of looking over something very rapidly.
Synonyms: Scanned (तेज़ी से पढ़ा), Browsed (नज़र डाली), Brushed (छुआ).
Antonyms: Scrutinized (बारीकी से जाँच की), Studied (गहन अध्ययन किया), Examined (परीक्षण किया).
D) Peeped /// This means to look quickly and furtively at something, especially through a small opening. It is an exact synonym for peeking or glancing.
Synonyms: Pried (तांक-झांक की), Spied (जासूसी की), Glanced (नज़र डाली).
Antonyms: Ignored (अनदेखा किया), Stared (घूरा), Disregarded (उपेक्षा की).
Glanced - एक नज़र डाली (Take a brief or hurried look)
Peeked - झांका (Look quickly or furtively)
Stared - घूरना (Look fixedly or vacantly at someone or something)
Skimmed - सरसरी तौर पर देखा (Go or move quickly and lightly over or through)
Peeped - चुपके से देखा (Look quickly and furtively at something)


Hence, 'Stared' is the most suitable antonym for 'Glanced'.


198. Select the word opposite in meaning to: Depressed
A) Cheerful ✅ /// This word describes a person who is noticeably happy and optimistic. it is the most logical and direct antonym for someone in a state of sadness or low spirits.
Synonyms: Joyful (आनंदित), Jolly (हंसमुख), Content (संतुष्ट).
Antonyms: Depressed (उदास), Gloomy (निराशाजनक), Miserable (दुखी).
B) Despondent /// This describes someone who is in low spirits from loss of hope or courage. It is a direct synonym for the deep sadness of being depressed.
Synonyms: Hopeless (निराश), Dejected (खिन्न), Disheartened (हतोत्साहित).
Antonyms: Hopeful (आशावादी), Encouraged (प्रोत्साहित), Optimistic (आशावान).
C) Melancholy /// This word refers to a feeling of pensive sadness, typically with no obvious cause. It matches the "low spirits" aspect of the given word, making it a synonym.
Synonyms: Sorrowful (दुखद), Gloomy (उदास), Doleful (शोकपूर्ण).
Antonyms: Happy (खुश), Lively (जीवंत), Exuberant (उत्साही).
D) Mournful /// This describes someone feeling or expressing overwhelming sorrow or grief, often for the dead. It is a synonym that captures an intense form of depression.
Synonyms: Lugubrious (शोकाकुल), Plaintive (शोकपूर्ण), Sad (दुखी).
Antonyms: Joyous (हर्षित), Jubilant (प्रफुल्लित), Cheerful (प्रसन्न).
Depressed - उदास (In a state of general unhappiness or despondency)
Cheerful - हँसमुख (Noticeably happy and optimistic)
Despondent - निराश (In low spirits from loss of hope or courage)
Melancholy - विषादग्रस्त (A feeling of pensive sadness)
Mournful - शोकाकुल (Feeling or expressing sadness, regret, or grief)


Hence, 'Cheerful' is the most suitable antonym for 'Depressed'.


199. Select the word opposite in meaning to: Give back
A) Keep ✅ /// This word means to have or retain possession of something; not to return it. It is the direct and most logical opposite of returning an item to its owner.
Synonyms: Retain (रखना), Withhold (रोकना), Reserve (आरक्षित करना).
Antonyms: Give back (वापस देना), Return (लौटाना), Distribute (बाँटना).
B) Return /// This means to give, put, or send something back to a place or person. It is the literal definition and primary synonym of the phrase "give back."
Synonyms: Restore (बहाल करना), Repay (चुक़ाना), Recompense (क्षतिपूर्ति).
Antonyms: Take (लेना), Borrow (उधार लेना), Seize (हड़पना).
C) Reimburse /// This means to repay a person who has spent or lost money. It acts as a synonym in the specific context of giving back financial resources.
Synonyms: Compensate (मुआवज़ा देना), Refund (पैसे वापस करना), Remunerate (पारिश्रमिक देना).
Antonyms: Charge (शुल्क लेना), Penalize (दंड देना), Deprive (वंचित करना).
D) Resort /// This word refers to the act of turning to and adopting a strategy or course of action, especially an extreme one. It is contextually unrelated to the act of returning items.
Synonyms: Recourse (सहारा), Measure (उपाय), Option (विकल्प).
Antonyms: Abstain (बचना), Avoid (परहेज करना), Ignore (नज़रअंदाज़ करना).
Give back - वापस देना (To return something to its owner)
Keep - रखना (To have or retain possession of something)
Return - लौटाना (Give, put, or send something back to a place or person)
Reimburse - चुकाना (Repay a person who has spent or lost money)
Resort - सहारा लेना (Turn to and adopt a course of action)


Hence, 'Keep' is the most suitable antonym for 'Give back'.


200. Select the word opposite in meaning to: Dig
A) Excavate /// This word means to make a hole or channel by digging. it is a formal and direct synonym for the given word.
Synonyms: Scoop (उलीचना), Hollow (खोखला करना), Quarry (खोदना).
Antonyms: Fill (भरना), Bury (दफनाना), Cover (ढंकना).
B) Burrow /// This means to make a hole or tunnel, typically to use as a dwelling. It captures the repetitive and constructive aspect of digging, acting as a synonym.
Synonyms: Tunnel (सुरंग बनाना), Mine (खुदाई करना), Penetrate (छेदना).
Antonyms: Surface (सतह पर आना), Emerge (उभरना), Fill in (भर देना).
C) Fill ✅ /// This word means to put something into a space or container so that it is full. It is the direct physical opposite of removing earth to create a hole.
Synonyms: Stuff (ठूंसना), Pack (भरना), Load (लादना).
Antonyms: Dig (खोदना), Empty (खाली करना), Drain (निकालना).
D) Unearth /// This means to find something in the ground by digging. It functions as a synonym that focuses on the discovery aspect of the digging process.
Synonyms: Discover (खोजना), Exhume (कब्र से निकालना), Reveal (प्रकट करना).
Antonyms: Bury (दफनाना), Hide (छिपाना), Conceal (गुप्त रखना).
Dig - खोदना (Break up and move earth with a tool or hands)
Excavate - खुदाई करना (Make a hole or channel by digging)
Burrow - बिल बनाना (Make a hole or tunnel, especially as a dwelling)
Fill - भरना (Put something into a space or container)
Unearth - खोज निकालना (Find something in the ground by digging)


Hence, 'Fill' is the most suitable antonym for 'Dig'.
oa:
This word refers to the act of making a hole or channel by digging. it is a formal synonym for the given word, often used in archaeology or construction.
Synonyms: Quarry (खदान खोदना), Hollow (खोखला करना), Scoop (कुरेदना).
Antonyms: Fill (भरना), Bury (दफनाना), Cover (ढंकना).

This word refers to a hole or tunnel dug by a small animal as a dwelling. It acts as a synonym that describes a specific biological purpose of digging.
Synonyms: Tunnel (सुरंग बनाना), Mine (खदान खोदना), Sap (कमज़ोर करना/खोदना).
Antonyms: Emerge (बाहर निकलना), Seal (बंद करना), Surface (सतह पर आना).

This word means to cause a space or container to become full or blocked. it is the direct and logical opposite of digging a hole out of the ground.
Synonyms: Stuff (ठूँसना), Plug (बंद करना), Cram (खचाखच भरना).
Antonyms: Dig (खोदना), Empty (खाली करना), Drain (निकास करना).

This word refers to finding something in the ground by digging. It is a synonym that emphasizes the outcome of a successful dig.
Synonyms: Discover (खोजना), Disinter (निकालना), Reveal (प्रकट करना).
Antonyms: Conceal (छिपाना), Inter (दफनाना), Entomb (समाधि देना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Get back
questionsEn.s:
Get back - वापस पाना (To recover or regain possession of something)
Regain - पुन: प्राप्त करना (Obtain possession of something again after losing it)
Retrieve - वापस लाना (Get or bring something back from a place)
Recover - बहाल करना (Find or regain possession of something lost)
Lose - खोना (Become unable to find something; be deprived of)


Hence, 'Lose' is the most suitable antonym for 'Get back'.
oa:
This word means to obtain possession or use of something again after losing it. It is a direct synonym for the process of getting something back.
Synonyms: Retrieve (पुन: प्राप्त करना), Recover (बहाल करना), Reclaim (वापस पाना).
Antonyms: Lose (खोना), Forfeit (गंवाना), Relinquish (त्यागना).

This means to get or bring something back from a place. It aligns perfectly with the question word, serving as a synonym.
Synonyms: Fetch (लाना), Recapture (फिर से पकड़ना), Rescue (बचाना).
Antonyms: Abandon (छोड़ना), Discard (फेंक देना), Lose (गुम करना).

This word means to find or regain possession of something stolen or lost. It is contextually identical to getting something back.
Synonyms: Recuperate (स्वस्थ होना), Redeem (मुक्त करना), Salvage (उद्धार करना).
Antonyms: Detract (कम करना), Suffer (सहना), Decline (गिरना).

This word refers to becoming unable to find something or no longer having something that you used to have. it is the direct and most appropriate opposite for regaining possession.
Synonyms: Misplace (खो देना), Forfeit (गंवाना), Drop (गिराना).
Antonyms: Find (पाना), Get back (वापस पाना), Gain (प्राप्त करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Cosy
questionsEn.s:
Cosy - आरामदायक (Giving a feeling of comfort, warmth, and relaxation)
Uncomfortable - असुविधाजनक (Causing physical or mental unease)
Homely - घरेलू (Simple but comfortable and warm)
Comfortable - सुखद (Providing physical ease and relaxation)
Snug - सटा हुआ (Comfortable, warm, and cozy; well protected)


Hence, 'Uncomfortable' is the most suitable antonym for 'Cosy'.
oa:
This word describes a state that causes physical or mental unease or pain. It is the direct and perfect antonym for a place that feels warm and comfortable.
Synonyms: Uneasy (बेचैन), Awkward (असहज), Harsh (कठोर).
Antonyms: Comfortable (आरामदायक), Cosy (सुखद), Pleasant (सुहावना).

This word refers to a place that is simple but comfortable and warm, like one's own home. It acts as a synonym for the welcoming atmosphere of being cosy.
Synonyms: Domestic (घरेलू), Informal (अनौपचारिक), Simple (साधारण).
Antonyms: Formal (औपचारिक), Grand (भव्य), Elegant (सुरुचिपूर्ण).

This refers to providing physical ease and relaxation; free from constraint. It is a direct and simple synonym for the question word.
Synonyms: Restful (आरामदेह), Easy (आसान), Commodious (विस्तृत).
Antonyms: Strenuous (कठिन), Harsh (कठोर), Unpleasant (अप्रिय).

This word describes something that is comfortable, warm, and cosy; well-protected from the cold. It is an exact synonym for the concept of being cosy.
Synonyms: Tight (कसा हुआ), Secure (सुरक्षित), Cuddly (प्यारा).
Antonyms: Loose (ढीला), Exposed (खुला), Cold (ठंडा).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Go on
questionsEn.s:
Go on - जारी रखना (To continue an activity or process)
Proceed - आगे बढ़ना (To begin or continue a course of action)
Continue - निरंतर रखना (To persist in an activity without interruption)
Persist - डटे रहना (To continue firmly in a course of action)
Stop - रुकना (To cease to happen or occur; to end)


Hence, 'Stop' is the most suitable antonym for 'Go on'.
oa:
This means to begin or continue a course of action. It is a direct synonym for the instruction to keep going.
Synonyms: Advance (आगे बढ़ना), Progress (प्रगति करना), Move (चलना).
Antonyms: Stop (रुकना), Halt (थमना), Regress (पीछे जाना).

This word means to persist in an activity or process without interruption. It represents the primary meaning of the given phrase.
Synonyms: Endure (बने रहना), Persist (डटे रहना), Sustain (बनाए रखना).
Antonyms: Cease (बंद करना), Desist (रुकना), Terminate (समाप्त करना).

This means to continue firmly or obstinately in an opinion or a course of action in spite of difficulty. It functions as a strong synonym.
Synonyms: Persevere (धैर्य रखना), Abide (अटल रहना), Remain (रहना).
Antonyms: Yield (हार मानना), Quit (छोड़ना), Give up (त्यागना).

This word means to come to an end; to cease to happen or to occur. it is the direct and most appropriate opposite for continuing an action.
Synonyms: Halt (थमना), Finish (खत्म करना), Quit (छोड़ना).
Antonyms: Start (शुरू करना), Continue (जारी रखना), Go on (आगे बढ़ना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Destruction
questionsEn.s:
Destruction - विनाश (The action or process of causing so much damage)
Preservation - संरक्षण (The act of keeping something in its original state)
Devastation - तबाही (Great destruction or severe damage)
Ruin - बर्बादी (The physical destruction or disintegration of something)
Damage - क्षति (Physical harm that impairs function or value)


Hence, 'Preservation' is the most suitable antonym for 'Destruction'.
oa:
This word refers to the action of maintaining something in its original or existing state. It is the direct antonym for the act of destroying something.
Synonyms: Conservation (संरक्षण), Protection (रक्षा), Maintenance (रखरखाव).
Antonyms: Destruction (विनाश), Ruin (बर्बादी), Damage (क्षति).

This word refers to great destruction or damage; severe shock or grief. It functions as a direct and more intense synonym for the question word.
Synonyms: Havoc (तबाही), Desolation (वीरानी), Ravage (विनाश).
Antonyms: Creation (सृजन), Restoration (बहाली), Development (विकास).

This refers to the physical destruction or disintegration of something or the state of being decayed. It is an exact synonym for destruction.
Synonyms: Bankruptcy (दिवालियापन), Wreckage (मलबा), Demolition (ध्वस्त करना).
Antonyms: Building (निर्माण), Structure (ढांचा), Fix (सुधार).

This word refers to physical harm that impairs the value, usefulness, or normal function of something. It is a synonym that captures the harmful aspect of destruction.
Synonyms: Harm (नुकसान), Injury (चोट), Impairment (बिगाड़).
Antonyms: Repair (मरम्मत), Benefit (लाभ), Improvement (सुधार).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Immigration
questionsEn.s:
Immigration - आप्रवासन (The action of coming to live permanently in a foreign country)
Influx - अंतर्प्रवाह (The arrival or entry of large numbers of people)
Emigration - उत्प्रवासन (The act of leaving one's country to settle in another)
Entry - प्रवेश (An act of going or coming into a place)
Arrival - आगमन (The action or process of reaching a place)


Hence, 'Emigration' is the most suitable antonym for 'Immigration'.
oa:
This word refers to an arrival or entry of large numbers of people or things. It is a synonym that describes the movement of people *into* a place.
Synonyms: Inundation (सैलाब), Incursion (आक्रमण/प्रवेश), Inflow (अंतर्वाह).
Antonyms: Outflow (बहिर्वाह), Exodus (पलायन), Departure (प्रस्थान).

This word refers to the act of leaving one's own country to settle permanently in another. It is the direct directional opposite of moving into a country.
Synonyms: Departure (निकास), Migration (प्रवासन), Displacement (विस्थापन).
Antonyms: Immigration (आप्रवासन), Arrival (आगमन), Entry (प्रवेश).

This word refers to the act of going or coming into a place. It aligns with the "entering" part of immigration, making it a synonym in a general sense.
Synonyms: Entrance (प्रवेश), Access (पहुँच), Admission (दाखिला).
Antonyms: Exit (निकास), Exclusion (बहिष्कार), Egress (बाहर निकलना).

This word refers to the action or process of arriving or reaching a place. It describes the end result of immigration, acting as a synonym.
Synonyms: Advent (आगमन), Appearance (उपस्थिति), Approach (पहुँच).
Antonyms: Departure (प्रस्थान), Leave-taking (विदाई), Exit (निकास).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Strange
questionsEn.s:
Strange - अजीब (Unusual or surprising in a way that is hard to understand)
Weird - विचित्र (Suggesting something supernatural; very strange)
Odd - विषम (Different from what is usual or expected)
Foreign - विदेशी (Coming from or belonging to another country)
Familiar - परिचित (Well known from long or close association)


Hence, 'Familiar' is the most suitable antonym for 'Strange'.
oa:
This word refers to something suggesting supernatural or unnatural forces; being very strange. It is a direct and common synonym for the question word.
Synonyms: Eerie (डरावना), Peculiar (अजीब), Bizarre (विचित्र).
Antonyms: Normal (सामान्य), Common (आम), Regular (नियमित).

This describes something different from what is usual or expected; being strange. It is an exact and near-perfect synonym.
Synonyms: Curious (अनोखा), Unusual (असाधारण), Freakish (विचित्र).
Antonyms: Ordinary (साधारण), Standard (मानक), Typical (विशिष्ट).

This refers to something coming from or belonging to a country or language other than one's own. While often considered "strange," it is a synonym describing unfamiliar origins.
Synonyms: Alien (विदेशी), Exotic (विदेशी), External (बाहरी).
Antonyms: Native (देशी), Local (स्थानीय), Domestic (घरेलू).

This word refers to something well-known from long or close association. it is the perfect antonym for something that is strange or unknown.
Synonyms: Recognized (परिचित), Common (साधारण), Accustomed (अभ्यस्त).
Antonyms: Strange (अजीब), Unfamiliar (अपरिचित), Alien (विदेशी).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Enquired
questionsEn.s:
Enquired - पूछताछ की (Ask for information from someone)
Asked - पूछा (Say something in order to obtain information)
Questioned - सवाल किया (Ask questions of someone, especially officially)
Investigated - जांच की (Carry out a formal inquiry to discover facts)


Hence, 'Answered' is the most suitable antonym for 'Enquired'.
oa:
This means to say something in order to obtain information or to request something. It is the primary and most common synonym for having enquired.
Synonyms: Queried (पूछा), Questioned (सवाल किया), Requested (अनुरोध किया).
Antonyms: Answered (जवाब दिया), Replied (उत्तर दिया), Responded (प्रतिक्रिया दी).

This word means to say or write something as a reaction to someone's question or statement. it is the direct functional opposite of asking or enquiring.
Synonyms: Replied (उत्तर दिया), Responded (जवाब दिया), Retorted (प्रतिउत्तर दिया).
Antonyms: Asked (पूछा), Enquired (पूछताछ की), Questioned (सवाल किया).

This means to ask someone questions, especially as part of an official investigation. It serves as a more formal synonym for enquired.
Synonyms: Interrogated (पूछताछ की), Examined (जांच की), Audited (परीक्षण किया).
Antonyms: Believed (मान लिया), Accepted (स्वीकार किया), Ignored (अनदेखा किया).

This word refers to carrying out a systematic or formal inquiry to discover and examine the facts of an incident or allegation. It is a synonym that implies a deeper form of enquiry.
Synonyms: Explored (खोजा), Probed (जांचा), Studied (अध्ययन किया).
Antonyms: Neglected (उपेक्षा की), Overlooked (नज़रअंदाज़ किया), Abandoned (छोड़ दिया).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Delicious
questionsEn.s:
Delicious - स्वादिष्ट (Highly pleasant to the taste)
Tasty - ज़ायकेदार (Having a pleasant or distinct flavor)
Delectable - रमणीय/स्वादिष्ट (Extremely pleasant to the taste)
Distasteful - अरुचिकर (Unpleasant or disagreeable; not to one's taste)
Savory - नमकीन/मसालेदार (Having a pleasant, salty or spicy taste)


Hence, 'Distasteful' is the most suitable antonym for 'Delicious'.
oa:
This word describes food that has a very good or pleasant flavor. It is a direct and simple synonym for the question word.
Synonyms: Savory (ज़ायकेदार), Yummy (स्वादिष्ट), Appreciable (सराहनीय/अच्छे स्वाद वाला).
Antonyms: Tasteless (बेस्वाद), Bland (फीका), Awful (भयानक).

This word refers to food or drink that is extremely pleasant to the taste; being delicious. It acts as a formal and sophisticated synonym.
Synonyms: Luscious (रसीला), Appetizing (क्षुधावर्धक), Scrumptious (स्वादिष्ट).
Antonyms: Repulsive (अरुचिकर), Distasteful (अप्रिय), Nauseating (घिनौना).

This word refers to something that is unpleasant or disagreeable, especially in terms of taste or moral quality. it is the most appropriate opposite for something that tastes good.
Synonyms: Unpalatable (बेस्वाद), Offensive (अपमानजनक), Repellent (विकर्षक).
Antonyms: Delicious (स्वादिष्ट), Tasty (ज़ायकेदार), Pleasant (सुखद).

This describes food that belongs to the category that is salty or spicy rather than sweet. While specific, it is synonymous with having a good flavor.
Synonyms: Piquant (चटपटा), Salty (नमकीन), Zesty (मज़ेदार).
Antonyms: Sweet (मीठा), Bland (बेस्वाद), Sugary (मीठा).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Hardly ever
questionsEn.s:
Hardly ever - शायद ही कभी (Almost never; very rarely)
Occasionally - कभी-कभार (At infrequent or irregular intervals)
Rarely - बहुत कम (Not often; exceptionally)
Seldom - कभी-कभार (Not often; rarely)
Frequently - अक्सर (Regularly or habitually; often)


Hence, 'Frequently' is the most suitable antonym for 'Hardly ever'.
oa:
This word means at infrequent or irregular intervals; now and then. It describes something that happens sometimes, making it a mild synonym or at least not a strong antonym.
Synonyms: Sometimes (कभी-कभी), Periodic (आवधिक), Sporadic (छिटपुट).
Antonyms: Constantly (लगातार), Always (हमेशा), Regularly (नियमित रूप से).

This word describes something that is not often done; being very uncommon. It is an exact synonym for the phrase "hardly ever."
Synonyms: Seldom (यदा-कदा), Scarcely (मुश्किल से), Infrequently (दुर्लभता से).
Antonyms: Often (अक्सर), Frequently (बार-बार), Habitually (आदतन).

This word means not often; rarely. It is contextually identical to being hardly ever and serves as a synonym.
Synonyms: Occasionally (कदाचित), Sparsely (विरल रूप से), Barely (शायद ही).
Antonyms: Frequently (अक्सर), Regularly (नियमित), Continuous (निरंतर).

This word means regularly or habitually; occurring often. it is the direct and most appropriate opposite for something that almost never happens.
Synonyms: Often (अक्सर), Repeatedly (बार-बार), Continually (लगातार).
Antonyms: Seldom (कभी-कभार), Rarely (शायद ही कभी), Hardly ever (मुश्किल से कभी).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Delay
questionsEn.s:
Delay - देरी (A period of time by which something is late or postponed)
Hasten - शीघ्रता करना (Be quick to do something; move with speed)
Postpone - स्थगित करना (Arrange for something to take place at a later time)
Defer - टालना (Put off an action or event to a later time)
Procrastinate - टालमटोल करना (Delay or postpone action; put off doing something)


Hence, 'Hasten' is the most suitable antonym for 'Delay'.
oa:
This word means to be quick to do something or to move with speed. It is the direct opposite of putting something off or causing a wait.
Synonyms: Hurry (जल्दी करना), Accelerate (तेज़ करना), Expedite (शीघ्रता करना).
Antonyms: Delay (देरी करना), Retard (धीमा करना), Loiter (सुस्ती दिखाना).

This word means to cause or arrange for something to take place at a time later than that first scheduled. It is a direct synonym for the act of delaying.
Synonyms: Defer (टालना), Reschedule (पुनर्निर्धारित करना), Shelve (स्थगित करना).
Antonyms: Advance (आगे बढ़ाना), Hasten (जल्दी करना), Maintain (बनाए रखना).

This word means to put off an action or event to a later time; to postpone. It aligns perfectly with the question word, serving as a synonym.
Synonyms: Adjourn (स्थगित करना), Suspend (निलंबित करना), Prolong (लंबा खींचना).
Antonyms: Expedite (जल्दी करना), Complete (पूरा करना), Execute (निष्पादित करना).

This word means to delay or postpone action; to put off doing something habitually. It is a synonym that emphasizes the human tendency to waste time.
Synonyms: Dally (समय गँवाना), Idle (सुस्ती दिखाना), Shilly-shally (हिचकिचाना).
Antonyms: Act (कार्य करना), Rush (जल्दी करना), Tackle (सामना करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Incredible
questionsEn.s:
Incredible - अविश्वसनीय (Impossible to believe; extraordinary)
Unbelievable - अकल्पनीय (Too improbable to be believed)
Ordinary - साधारण (With no special or distinctive features; normal)
Amazing - अद्भुत (Causing great surprise or wonder)
Extraordinary - असाधारण (Very unusual or remarkable)


Hence, 'Ordinary' is the most suitable antonym for 'Incredible'.
oa:
This word refers to something that is too improbable or extraordinary to be believed. It is the primary and literal synonym for being incredible.
Synonyms: Improbable (असंभव), Extraordinary (असाधारण), Astonishing (आश्चर्यजनक).
Antonyms: Believable (विश्वसनीय), Likely (संभावित), Possible (संभव).

This word refers to something with no special or distinctive features; being normal or commonplace. It is the perfect opposite of something that is so amazing it defies belief.
Synonyms: Commonplace (साधारण), Standard (मानक), Routine (नियमित).
Antonyms: Amazing (अद्भुत), Incredible (अविश्वसनीय), Exceptional (असाधारण).

This word describes something that causes great surprise or wonder; being astonishing. It acts as a synonym describing the positive aspect of being incredible.
Synonyms: Stupendous (विशाल/अद्भुत), Miraculous (चमत्कारी), Marvelous (अनोखा).
Antonyms: Boring (उबाऊ), Ordinary (मामूली), Unimpressive (प्रभावहीन).

This word refers to something very unusual or remarkable. It matches the "out of the ordinary" nature of the given word, serving as a synonym.
Synonyms: Notable (उल्लेखनीय), Rare (दुर्लभ), Singular (अद्वितीय).
Antonyms: Usual (सामान्य), Average (औसत), Common (आम).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Angry
questionsEn.s:
Angry - क्रोधित (Feeling or showing strong annoyance or displeasure)
Serene - शांत (Calm, peaceful, and untroubled)
Enraged - आगबबूला (Very angry; furious)
Mad - पागल/नाराज़ (Mentally ill; extremely foolish or very angry)
Irritated - चिड़चिड़ा (Showing or feeling slight anger; annoyed)


Hence, 'Serene' is the most suitable antonym for 'Angry'.
oa:
This word describes a state of being calm, peaceful, and untroubled. it is the perfect opposite for someone who is feeling or showing strong annoyance or rage.
Synonyms: Tranquil (शांत), Placid (शांत), Composed (संयमित).
Antonyms: Angry (क्रोधित), Stormy (तूफ़ानी), Agitated (उत्तेजित).

This word describes someone who is very angry or furious. It is a synonym that captures an extreme or intense level of anger.
Synonyms: Incensed (क्रोधित), Infuriated (बेहद नाराज़), Wrathful (क्रोधी).
Antonyms: Pleased (प्रसन्न), Calm (शांत), Content (संतुष्ट).

This is an informal word used to describe someone who is very angry or someone who is mentally ill. It serves as a common synonym for being angry.
Synonyms: Livid (नाराज़), Fuming (गुस्से में), Cross (नाराज़).
Antonyms: Sane (समझदार), Calm (शांत), Cheerful (हंसमुख).

This word refers to someone who is showing or feeling slight anger; being annoyed. It is a synonym that describes a milder form of being angry.
Synonyms: Vexed (परेशान), Peeved (चिड़चिड़ा), Annoyed (नाराज़).
Antonyms: Soothed (शांत), Comforted (दिलासा प्राप्त), Grateful (आभारी).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Former
questionsEn.s:
Former - भूतपूर्व (Having previously filled a particular role or status)
Previous - पिछला (Existing or occurring before in time or order)
Current - वर्तमान (Belonging to the present time; happening now)
Past - बीता हुआ (Gone by in time and no longer existing)
Earlier - पहले का (Happening or done before the expected time)


Hence, 'Current' is the most suitable antonym for 'Former'.
oa:
This word describes something existing or occurring before in time or order. It is a direct synonym for the given word's reference to the past.
Synonyms: Preceding (पूर्वगामी), Earlier (पूर्व), Prior (पहले का).
Antonyms: Subsequent (आगामी), Future (भविष्य का), Later (बाद का).

This word refers to something belonging to the present time; happening or being used now. it is the logical opposite of something that was in place previously.
Synonyms: Present (वर्तमान), Modern (आधुनिक), Existing (मौजूदा).
Antonyms: Former (भूतपूर्व), Past (बीता हुआ), Obsolete (अप्रचलित).

This word refers to the time or a period of time before the moment of speaking or writing. It functions as a synonym for the "former" status of an event or person.
Synonyms: Gone (बीता हुआ), Bygone (पुराना), Ancient (प्राचीन).
Antonyms: Present (वर्तमान), Future (भविष्य), Prospective (भावी).

This refers to something happening or done before the usual or expected time, or occurring in the past. it is another synonym describing a prior point in time.
Synonyms: Preliminary (प्रारंभिक), Beforehand (पहले से), Forward (आगे का/पहले).
Antonyms: Later (बाद में), Delayed (विलेम्बित), Tardily (देरी से).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Damaged
questionsEn.s:
Damaged - क्षतिग्रस्त (Harmed or spoiled in some way)
Flawless - त्रुटिहीन (Without any imperfections or defects; perfect)
Deteriorated - बिगड़ा हुआ (Become progressively worse in condition)
Defaced - विरूपित (Spoil the surface or appearance of something)
Broken - टूटा हुआ (Separated into pieces as a result of a blow or strain)


Hence, 'Flawless' is the most suitable antonym for 'Damaged'.
oa:
This word describes something that is without any imperfections or defects; being perfect. it is the direct opposite of something that has been harmed or spoiled.
Synonyms: Perfect (उत्तम), Immaculate (बेदाग), Pristine (निर्मल).
Antonyms: Damaged (क्षतिग्रस्त), Defective (दोषपूर्ण), Faulty (खराब).

This word refers to something having become progressively worse in quality or condition. It is a synonym that describes the process of becoming damaged.
Synonyms: Worsened (बिगड़ा हुआ), Declined (गिरा हुआ), Degenerated (पतित).
Antonyms: Improved (सुधरा हुआ), Developed (विकसित), Enhanced (बढ़ा हुआ).

This word means to spoil the surface or appearance of something, especially by writing or drawing on it. It is a synonym describing a specific type of damage.
Synonyms: Marred (विकृत), Disfigured (कुरूप किया हुआ), Spoiled (खराब).
Antonyms: Beautified (सजाया हुआ), Restored (बहाल), Adorned (सुसज्जित).

This refers to something being in pieces which are no longer in their original or functional state. It is a direct and simple synonym for being damaged.
Synonyms: Shattered (टूटा हुआ), Fractured (दरार वाला), Ruined (बर्बाद).
Antonyms: Fixed (ठीक किया हुआ), Whole (पूरा), Intact (अखंड).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Habitual
questionsEn.s:
Habitual - आदतन (Done or acting by force of habit)
Regular - नियमित (Done or happening frequently)
Occasional - प्रासंगिक/कभी-कभी (Happening or done infrequently and irregularly)
Customary - प्रथागत (According to the usual practices associated with a place)
Routine - नियमित कार्य (A sequence of actions regularly followed)


Hence, 'Occasional' is the most suitable antonym for 'Habitual'.
oa:
This describes something done or happening frequently or at fixed intervals. It is a direct synonym for the repetitive nature of being habitual.
Synonyms: Constant (निरंतर), Routine (नियमित), Steady (स्थिर).
Antonyms: Irregular (अनियमित), Unusual (असामान्य), Rare (दुर्लभ).

This word refers to something occurring, appearing, or done infrequently and irregularly. it is the perfect antonym for something that is done as a habit.
Synonyms: Sporadic (छिटपुट), Periodic (आवधिक), Infrequent (दुर्लभ).
Antonyms: Constant (लगातार), Habitual (आदतन), Persistent (दृढ़).

This word describes something according to the customs or usual practices associated with a particular society or place. It functions as a synonym for habitual actions within a culture.
Synonyms: Traditional (पारंपरिक), Usual (सामान्य), Established (स्थापित).
Antonyms: Strange (अजीब), Rare (अनोखा), Unconventional (अपरंपरागत).

This refers to a sequence of actions regularly followed; a fixed program. It is an exact synonym for describing a habitual lifestyle or task.
Synonyms: Methodical (व्यवस्थित), Standard (मानक), Automatic (स्वचालित).
Antonyms: Chaotic (अस्त-व्यस्त), Random (अनियमित), Spontaneous (स्वैच्छिक).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Disappointing
questionsEn.s:
Disappointing - निराशाजनक (Failing to fulfill someone's hopes or expectations)
Frustrating - हताशापूर्ण (Causing annoyance or lack of control)
Discouraging - निरुत्साहित करने वाला (Causing someone to lose confidence)
Underwhelming - प्रभावहीन (Failing to impress or make an impact)
Satisfying - संतोषजनक (Giving fulfillment or the pleasure of success)


Hence, 'Satisfying' is the most suitable antonym for 'Disappointing'.
oa:
This word describes something that causes a feeling of annoyance or lack of control because one cannot achieve something. It is a synonym that captures the negative emotion behind a disappointment.
Synonyms: Annoying (परेशान करने वाला), Vexing (तंग करने वाला), Discouraging (हतोत्साहित करने वाला).
Antonyms: Satisfying (संतोषजनक), Gratifying (सुखद), Helpful (मददगार).

This refers to something that causes a loss of confidence or enthusiasm. It functions as a synonym describing the demoralizing effect of a disappointing event.
Synonyms: Demoralizing (मनोबल गिराने वाला), Pessimistic (निराशावादी), Gloomy (उदास).
Antonyms: Encouraging (प्रोत्साहित करने वाला), Inspiring (प्रेरक), Heartening (उत्साहजनक).

This describes something that fails to impress or make a positive impact or is disappointingly inadequate. It is a direct synonym for the question word.
Synonyms: Insipid (फीका), Flat (नीरस), Mediocre (औसत दर्जे का).
Antonyms: Impressive (प्रभावशाली), Amazing (अद्भुत), Striking (चौंकाने वाला).

This word refers to something that gives fulfillment or the pleasure of being provided with what is needed or desired. It is the direct opposite of failing to meet expectations.
Synonyms: Gratifying (सुखद), Fulfilling (संतोषजनक), Pleasing (प्रसन्न करने वाला).
Antonyms: Disappointing (निराशाजनक), Insufficient (अपर्याप्त), Frustrating (परेशान करने वाला).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: How much
questionsEn.s:
How much - कितना (Asking about an uncountable quantity or degree)
How many - कितने (Asking about a countable quantity or number)
How often - कितनी बार (Asking about the frequency of an event)
How little - कितना कम (Asking about or emphasizing a small amount)
How long - कितना लंबा (Asking about the duration of time or physical length)


Hence, 'How little' is the most suitable antonym for 'How much'.
oa:
This phrase is used to ask about countable quantities rather than uncountable amounts. While distinct, it is a related interrogative rather than a direct antonym.
Synonyms: What number (कितने), What quantity (कितनी संख्या), How numerous (कितने अधिक).
Antonyms: None (कोई नहीं), Few (कुछ), Little (कम).

This is used to ask about the frequency of an event or action. It relates to time and repetition rather than the quantity of a substance or idea.
Synonyms: How frequently (कितनी बार), How regularly (कितने अंतराल पर), How many times (कितनी दफा).
Antonyms: Never (कभी नहीं), Rarely (शायद ही कभी), Once (एक बार).

This phrase is used to ask about or emphasize a very small amount or degree of something. it is the direct quantitative opposite of asking about a large or general amount.
Synonyms: How small (कितना कम), To what small extent (कितने कम अंश तक), How insignificant (कितना तुच्छ).
Antonyms: How much (कितना), How great (कितना बड़ा), To what extent (किस हद तक).

This is used to ask about the duration of time or the physical length of an object. It relates to measurement in one dimension rather than general quantity.
Synonyms: What duration (कितना समय), What length (कितनी लंबाई), How protracted (कितना लंबा).
Antonyms: Briefly (संक्षेप में), Short (छोटा), Quickly (जल्दी).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Advance
questionsEn.s:
Advance - आगे बढ़ना (Move forward in a purposeful way)
Progress - प्रगति (Forward or onward movement towards a destination)
Promote - पदोन्नति/बढ़ावा देना (Further the progress of something; support)
Retreat - पीछे हटना (An act of moving back or withdrawing)
Proceed - जारी रखना (Begin or continue a course of action)


Hence, 'Retreat' is the most suitable antonym for 'Advance'.
oa:
This word means to move forward or make a development; to improve. It is a direct synonym for the act of advancing.
Synonyms: Evolution (विकास), Breakthrough (सफलता), Movement (चाल).
Antonyms: Regression (पतन), Recession (मंदी), Decline (गिरावट).

This means to further the progress of something; to support or encourage. It functions as a synonym that implies helping something to move forward.
Synonyms: Boost (बढ़ाना), Upgrade (उन्नत करना), Champion (समर्थन करना).
Antonyms: Demote (पदावनत करना), Oppose (विरोध करना), Block (बाधा डालना).

This word means to move back or withdraw from a position or from a battle. it is the direct tactical and general opposite of moving forward or advancing.
Synonyms: Withdraw (पीछे हटना), Recede (दूर जाना), Backtrack (वापस आना).
Antonyms: Advance (आगे बढ़ना), Attack (हमला करना), Progress (प्रगति करना).

This means to begin or continue a course of action; to move forward. It serves as a near-perfect synonym for the question word.
Synonyms: Continue (जारी रखना), Pursue (पीछा करना), Go ahead (आगे बढ़ना).
Antonyms: Stop (रुकना), Halt (थमना), Terminate (समाप्त करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Humidity
questionsEn.s:
Humidity - उमस/नमी (The state or quality of being humid; amount of vapor)
Dampness - नमी (The state or condition of being slightly wet)
Moisture - नमी (Water or other liquid diffused in small quantities)
Wetness - गीलापन (The state or condition of being covered with liquid)
Dryness - सूखापन (The state or quality of being free from liquid or moisture)


Hence, 'Dryness' is the most suitable antonym for 'Humidity'.
oa:
This refers to the state or condition of being slightly wet; being moisture-laden. It is a direct synonym that describes the presence of water in the air or on a surface.
Synonyms: Moistness (नमी), Wetness (गीलापन), Clamminess (चिपचिपाहट).
Antonyms: Dryness (सूखापन), Aridity (शुष्कता), Dehydration (निर्जलीकरण).

This refers to water or other liquid diffused in a small quantity as vapor, within a solid, or condensed on a surface. It is the primary cause and synonym of humidity.
Synonyms: Liquid (तरल), Dew (ओस), Condensation (संक्षेपण).
Antonyms: Drought (सूखा), Parchedness (अत्यधिक सूखापन), Dryness (खुश्की).

This word refers to the state or condition of being covered or saturated with water or another liquid. It is a stronger synonym that implies a high degree of moisture.
Synonyms: Soaked (तरबतर), Saturation (संतृप्ति), Sloppiness (गंदगी/गीला).
Antonyms: Aridity (सूखापन), Drought (अकाल), Sterility (बाँझपन/सूखा).

This word refers to the state or quality of being free from moisture or liquid. it is the perfect physical antonym for humidity.
Synonyms: Aridity (शुष्कता), Drought (सूखा), Thirst (प्यास/सूखा).
Antonyms: Humidity (नमी), Dampness (गीलापन), Wetness (तरलता).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Delighted
questionsEn.s:
Delighted - प्रसन्न (Feeling or showing great pleasure)
Elated - उत्तेजित/खुश (Ecstatically happy)
Jubilant - प्रफुल्लित (Feeling or expressing great happiness and triumph)
Displeased - अप्रसन्न (Feeling or showing annoyance and dissatisfaction)
Overjoyed - अति प्रसन्न (Extremely happy)


Hence, 'Displeased' is the most suitable antonym for 'Delighted'.
oa:
This word describes a person who is ecstatically happy. It is an intense synonym for being delighted, representing an extreme form of happiness.
Synonyms: Overjoyed (अत्यधिक खुश), Thrilled (रोमांचित), Euphoric (उत्साहित).
Antonyms: Miserable (दुखी), Depressed (उदास), Sad (ग़मगीन).

This describes someone showing great happiness and triumph. It functions as a synonym that often carries a sense of celebration.
Synonyms: Triumphant (विजयी), Exultant (प्रफुल्लित), Rejoicing (आनंदित).
Antonyms: Defeated (हारा हुआ), Sorrowful (दुखद), Glum (खिन्न).

This word refers to a feeling of annoyance or dissatisfaction. It is the direct opposite of being happy or delighted with someone or something.
Synonyms: Annoyed (परेशान), Dissatisfied (असंतुष्ट), Angry (नाराज़).
Antonyms: Delighted (प्रसन्न), Pleased (खुश), Content (संतुष्ट).

This describes someone who is extremely happy; being filled with joy. It is an exact and common synonym for the question word.
Synonyms: Enchanted (मंत्रमुग्ध), Rapturous (भावविभोर), Delighted (खुश).
Antonyms: Heartbroken (दुखी), Mournful (शोकाकुल), Despondent (निराश).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Grabbed
questionsEn.s:
Grabbed - पकड़ा (Grasp or seize suddenly and roughly)
Release - छोड़ना (Allow or enable to escape from confinement; set free)
Snatched - छीना (Quickly seize in a rude or eager way)
Seized - जब्त (Take hold of suddenly and forcibly)
Clutched - जकड़ा (Grasp or seize something tightly or eagerly)


Hence, 'Release' is the most suitable antonym for 'Grabbed'.
oa:
This word means to allow or enable to escape from confinement; to set free or let go. It is the direct and logical opposite of seizing or clutching something tightly.
Synonyms: Free (आज़ाद करना), Relinquish (त्यागना), Loose (ढीला छोड़ना).
Antonyms: Grab (पकड़ना), Seize (जब्त करना), Detain (हिरासत में लेना).

This means to quickly seize something in a rude or eager way. It serves as a direct synonym for the sudden action of grabbing.
Synonyms: Plucked (खींचा), Gripped (पकड़ा), Pinched (चुराया).
Antonyms: Returned (लौटाया), Offered (प्रदान किया), Released (छोड़ा).

This word means to take hold of suddenly and forcibly. It is an exact synonym for having grabbed something by force.
Synonyms: Apprehended (पकड़ा), Annexed (हड़पा), Grasped (पकड़ा).
Antonyms: Released (मुक्त किया), Freed (आज़ाद किया), Surrendered (समर्पित किया).

This means to grasp or seize something tightly or eagerly. It is a synonym that describes the tight holding aspect after grabbing.
Synonyms: Hugged (गले लगाया/जकड़ा), Clasped (पकड़ा), Held (थामा).
Antonyms: Released (छोड़ा), Let go (जाने दिया), Abandoned (त्यागा).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Disgusting
questionsEn.s:
Disgusting - घृणित (Arousing revulsion or strong indignation)
Revolting - घृणास्पद (Causing intense disgust; offensive)
Repulsive - विकर्षक (Arousing intense distaste or aversion)
Delightful - आनंददायक (Very pleasant, attractive, or enjoyable)
Nauseating - उबकाई लाने वाला (Causing nausea; extremely unpleasant)


Hence, 'Delightful' is the most suitable antonym for 'Disgusting'.
oa:
This word describes something that causes intense disgust or being offensive. It is an exact synonym for the question word, often used for unpleasant sights or smells.
Synonyms: Nauseating (घिनौना), Offensive (अपमानजनक), Repulsive (अरुचिकर).
Antonyms: Attractive (आकर्षक), Pleasant (सुखद), Charming (मनमोहक).

This describes something that causes intense distaste or aversion; tending to drive away. It functions as a powerful synonym for being disgusting.
Synonyms: Loathsome (घृणित), Odious (घिनौना), Vile (नीच).
Antonyms: Appealing (आकर्षक), Delightful (आनंददायक), Inviting (लुभावना).

This word describes something that is very pleasant, attractive, or enjoyable. it is the direct and most appropriate opposite for something that causes disgust.
Synonyms: Charming (मनमोहक), Lovely (प्यारा), Enchanting (दिलकश).
Antonyms: Disgusting (घिनौना), Horrible (भयानक), Unpleasant (अप्रिय).

This describes something that causes a feeling of nausea; being extremely unpleasant. It is a synonym that focuses on the physical sickness caused by disgust.
Synonyms: Sickening (बीमार करने वाला), Stomach-churning (कलेजा हिलाने वाला), Gross (भद्दा).
Antonyms: Delicious (स्वादिष्ट), Healthy (स्वस्थ), Appetizing (क्षुधावर्धक).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Improvement
questionsEn.s:
Improvement - सुधार (A change that makes something better or more valuable)
Progress - प्रगति (Forward movement towards a destination or goal)
Advancement - उन्नति (The act of moving forward or making progress)
Betterment - बेहतरी (The act or process of making something better)
Deterioration - गिरावट (The process of becoming progressively worse)


Hence, 'Deterioration' is the most suitable antonym for 'Improvement'.
oa:
This word means to move forward or develop towards a better, more complete, or more modern state. It is a direct synonym for improvement.
Synonyms: Advancement (उन्नति), Evolution (विकास), Growth (बढ़त).
Antonyms: Regression (पतन), Decline (गिरावट), Retrogression (पीछे हटना).

This refers to an act of moving forward or making progress in a career or field. It is a synonym that focuses on climbing a hierarchy or improving a status.
Synonyms: Breakthrough (सफलता), Promotion (पदोन्नति), Step up (कदम बढ़ाना).
Antonyms: Demotion (पदावनति), Setback (बाधा), Stagnation (ठहराव).

This refers to the act or process of making something better. It is an exact and near-perfect synonym for the given word.
Synonyms: Amelioration (सुधार), Refinement (संशोधन), Enhancement (बढ़ावा).
Antonyms: Worsening (बिगाड़ना), Injury (नुकसान), Damage (क्षति).

This word refers to the process of becoming progressively worse in quality or condition. it is the direct and most accurate antonym for improvement.
Synonyms: Decline (गिरावट), Degeneration (पतन), Decay (क्षय).
Antonyms: Improvement (सुधार), Advancement (उन्नति), Recovery (बहाली).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Disagree
questionsEn.s:
Disagree - असहमत होना (Have or express a different opinion)
Concur - सहमत होना (Be of the same opinion; agree)
Conflict - संघर्ष (A serious incompatibility between opinions or interests)
Oppose - विरोध करना (Disagree with and attempt to prevent)
Contradict - खंडन करना (Assert the opposite of a statement made by someone)


Hence, 'Concur' is the most suitable antonym for 'Disagree'.
oa:
This word means to be of the same opinion; to agree. It is the formal and most appropriate antonym for having a difference of opinion.
Synonyms: Accord (तालमेल), Consort (सहमत होना), Coincide (एक ही समय होना/सहमत होना).
Antonyms: Disagree (असहमत होना), Conflict (टकराना), Differ (अलग होना).

This refers to a serious incompatibility between two or more opinions, principles, or interests. It is a synonym that describes the result of disagreeing.
Synonyms: Discord (कलह), Dispute (विवाद), Clash (टकराव).
Antonyms: Harmony (सामंजस्य), Peace (शांति), Agreement (सहमति).

This means to disagree with and attempt to prevent, especially by argument. It is a synonym that focuses on the active resistance part of disagreement.
Synonyms: Resist (विरोध करना), Defy (अवहेलना करना), Combat (सामना करना).
Antonyms: Support (समर्थन करना), Favour (पक्ष लेना), Approve (मंजूरी देना).

This means to deny the truth of a statement by asserting the opposite. It functions as a synonym that describes a direct verbal disagreement.
Synonyms: Deny (खंडन करना), Refute (गलत साबित करना), Counter (प्रतिकार करना).
Antonyms: Confirm (पुष्टि करना), Verify (सत्यापित करना), Acknowledge (स्वीकार करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Interruption
questionsEn.s:
Interruption - अवरोध (An act, utterance, or period that interrupts something)
Break - अंतराल (A pause in continuity in an ongoing activity)
Continuation - निरंतरता (The action of carrying on an activity over a period)
Pause - विराम (A temporary stop in action or speech)
Disruption - व्यवधान (Disturbance or problems which interrupt an event)


Hence, 'Continuation' is the most suitable antonym for 'Interruption'.
oa:
This refers to a pause in continuity in an ongoing activity or state. It is a direct synonym for the act of interrupting a process.
Synonyms: Interval (अंतराल), Gap (दरार), Rupture (विच्छेद).
Antonyms: Continuity (निरंतरता), Link (कड़ी), Union (मेल).

This word refers to the action of carrying on a specific activity or process over a period of time. it is the direct opposite of being interrupted or stopped.
Synonyms: Persistence (स्थिरता), Extension (विस्तार), Prolongation (लंबा खिंचना).
Antonyms: Interruption (अवरोध), Cessation (समाप्ति), End (अंत).

This refers to a temporary stop in action or speech. It is a synonym that captures the brief nature of many interruptions.
Synonyms: Hesitation (हिचकिचाहट), Suspense (निलंबन), Wait (ठहराव).
Antonyms: Action (कार्य), Resumption (पुन: आरंभ), Motion (गति).

This refers to disturbance or problems which interrupt an event, activity, or process. It is a strong synonym describing a more forceful or negative interruption.
Synonyms: Disorder (अव्यवस्था), Disturbance (अशांति), Interference (बाधा).
Antonyms: Order (व्यवस्था), Stability (स्थिरता), Organization (संगठन).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Convenient
questionsEn.s:
Convenient - सुविधाजनक (Fitting in well with a person's needs or plans)
Accessible - सुलभ (Able to be reached or entered; easy to talk to)
Advantageous - लाभदायक (Involving or creating favorable circumstances)
Inopportune - असमय (Happening at an inconvenient or inappropriate time)
Handy - आसान/पास (Convenient to handle or use; useful)


Hence, 'Inopportune' is the most suitable antonym for 'Convenient'.
oa:
This word describes a place, person, or thing that is able to be reached or entered. It is a synonym that describes the ease of use associated with being convenient.
Synonyms: Reachable (पहुँच योग्य), Obtainable (प्राप्त करने योग्य), Available (उपलब्ध).
Antonyms: Remote (सुदूर), Unattainable (अप्राप्य), Inaccessible (दुर्गम).

This describes something that creates a favorable circumstance or increases the chance of success. It functions as a synonym for the beneficial nature of being convenient.
Synonyms: Beneficial (लाभदायक), Helpful (सहायक), Profitable (लाभकारी).
Antonyms: Detrimental (हानिकारक), Harmful (नुकसानदेह), Unfavorable (प्रतिकूल).

This word describes something happening at an inconvenient or inappropriate time. it is the most accurate antonym for something that is suitable or handy.
Synonyms: Unsuitable (अनुपयुक्त), Ill-timed (असमय), Inappropriate (अनुचित).
Antonyms: Opportune (समयोचित), Convenient (सुविधाजनक), Timely (सामयिक).

This word refers to something that is convenient to handle or use; being useful. It is an exact and common synonym for the question word.
Synonyms: Useful (उपयोगी), Nifty (मज़ेदार/उपयोगी), Practical (व्यावहारिक).
Antonyms: Cumbersome (भारी/असुविधाजनक), Useless (बेकार), Awkward (बेढंगा).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Guiltiness
questionsEn.s:
Guiltiness - दोषिता (The state or fact of having committed an offense)
Blame - दोष (Responsibility for a fault or wrong)
Innocence - निर्दोषता (The state or fact of being innocent of an offense)
Fault - गलती (An unattractive or unsatisfactory feature)
Remorse - पछतावा (Deep regret or guilt for a wrong committed)


Hence, 'Innocence' is the most suitable antonym for 'Guiltiness'.
oa:
This word refers to the responsibility for a fault or wrong. It is a synonym that captures the moral burden associated with being guilty.
Synonyms: Culpability (दोषिता), Fault (दोष), Accusation (आरोप).
Antonyms: Praise (प्रशंसा), Credit (श्रेय), Vindication (पुष्टि).

This word refers to the state, quality, or fact of being innocent of a crime or offense. it is the direct and absolute antonym for being guilty.
Synonyms: Guiltlessness (निर्दोषिता), Purity (शुद्धता), Integrity (ईमानदारी).
Antonyms: Guilt (दोष), Sin (पाप), Corruption (भ्रष्टता).

This refers to an unattractive or unsatisfactory feature, or the responsibility for an accident or misfortune. It is a synonym related to the commission of a mistake.
Synonyms: Flaw (त्रुटि), Error (गलती), Deficiency (कमी).
Antonyms: Virtue (गुण), Strength (ताकत), Merit (योग्यता).

This refers to deep regret or guilt for a wrong committed. While it implies guilt, it describes the emotional reaction rather than the legal or moral state itself.
Synonyms: Penitence (पछतावा), Contrition (पछतावा), Regret (ग्लानि).
Antonyms: Shamelessness (बेशर्मी), Satisfaction (संतोष), Pride (गर्व).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Charming
questionsEn.s:
Charming - आकर्षक (Very pleasant or attractive; delightful)
Delightful - आनंदमय (Very pleasant, attractive, or enjoyable)
Attractive - सुंदर (Appealing to the senses or mind)
Repulsive - घिनौना (Arousing intense distaste or aversion)
Engaging - दिलचस्प (Charming and attractive)


Hence, 'Repulsive' is the most suitable antonym for 'Charming'.
oa:
This word describes something that is very pleasant, attractive, or enjoyable. It is a direct and positive synonym for being charming.
Synonyms: Enchanting (दिलकश), Lovely (प्यारा), Captivating (मोहक).
Antonyms: Disgusting (घिनौना), Offensive (अपमानजनक), Boring (नीरस).

This describes something appealing to the senses or mind through beauty, form, or character. It serves as a synonym that focuses on visual or mental appeal.
Synonyms: Alluring (लुभावना), Pretty (सुंदर), Engaging (आकर्षक).
Antonyms: Repulsive (विकर्षक), Plain (साधारण), Ugly (कुरूप).

This word refers to something that causes intense distaste or aversion; tending to drive away. it is the direct and most accurate antonym for something that is pleasant or charming.
Synonyms: Loathsome (घृणित), Revolting (अरुचिकर), Offensive (घिनौना).
Antonyms: Charming (मनमोहक), Attractive (आकर्षक), Pleasing (प्रसन्न).

This refers to something that is charming and attractive in a way that occupies the mind. It is a near-perfect synonym for the question word.
Synonyms: Winning (जीतने वाला/मोहक), Intriguing (दिलचस्प), Fetching (आकर्षक).
Antonyms: Repellent (विकर्षक), Off-putting (अरुचिकर), Dull (सुस्त).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Horrible
questionsEn.s:
Horrible - भयानक (Causing or likely to cause horror; shocking)
Terrible - बहुत बुरा (Extremely bad or serious)
Awful - डरावना (Very bad or unpleasant)
Dreadful - भीषण (Causing or involving great suffering or fear)
Pleasant - सुखद (Giving a sense of happy satisfaction or enjoyment)


Hence, 'Pleasant' is the most suitable antonym for 'Horrible'.
oa:
This describes something extremely bad or serious; being very unpleasant. It is a direct and common synonym for the question word.
Synonyms: Awful (भयानक), Ghastly (भयंकर), Abominable (घृणित).
Antonyms: Wonderful (अद्भुत), Excellent (बेहतरीन), Great (महान).

This word refers to something very bad or unpleasant. It functions as an exact synonym used for similar contexts of dislike or fear.
Synonyms: Dreadful (डरावना), Nasty (गंदा), Vile (नीच).
Antonyms: Lovely (प्यारा), Beautiful (सुंदर), Pleasant (सुखद).

This describes something that causes great fear, irritation, or suffering. It is another synonym that captures the frightening aspect of being horrible.
Synonyms: Frightful (डरावना), Grim (भयंकर), Dire (भीषण).
Antonyms: Comforting (आरामदायक), Encouraging (प्रोत्साहित), Good (अच्छा).

This word describes something that gives a sense of happy satisfaction or enjoyment. it is the direct and most appropriate antonym for something that is unpleasant or horrible.
Synonyms: Agreeable (अनुकूल), Nice (अच्छा), Gratifying (सुखद).
Antonyms: Horrible (भयानक), Nasty (बुरा), Harsh (कठोर).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Displayed
questionsEn.s:
Displayed - प्रदर्शित (Put in a prominent place in order to be seen)
Revealed - प्रकट (Make previously unknown information known)
Hidden - छिपा हुआ (Kept out of sight; concealed)
Exhibited - प्रदर्शित (Manifest or reveal a quality or feeling)
Shown - दिखाया (Allow or cause something to be visible)


Hence, 'Hidden' is the most suitable antonym for 'Displayed'.
oa:
This word means to make previously unknown or secret information known to others. It is a synonym that implies uncovering something to be displayed.
Synonyms: Disclosed (प्रकट किया), Unveiled (पर्दा उठाया), Exposed (उजागर किया).
Antonyms: Hidden (छिपाया), Concealed (गुप्त रखा), Masked (ढंका).

This word refers to something kept out of sight or concealed. it is the direct and absolute antonym for displaying something in the open.
Synonyms: Concealed (गुप्त), Secret (छिपा हुआ), Obscure (धुंधला).
Antonyms: Displayed (प्रदर्शित), Obvious (ज़ाहिर), Clear (स्पष्ट).

This word refers to showing a quality or feeling by one's behavior or revealing something for public display. It is an exact synonym for having displayed something.
Synonyms: Presented (प्रस्तुत किया), Shown (दिखाया), Demonstrated (दिखाया).
Antonyms: Suppressed (दबाया हुआ), Covered (ढंका हुआ), Withdrawn (वापस लिया).

This means to allow or cause something to be visible. It is the primary and most common synonym for the action of displaying.
Synonyms: Illustrated (चित्रित), Pointed out (इशारा किया), Indicated (संकेत दिया).
Antonyms: Hidden (छिपा हुआ), Canceled (रद्द), Obscured (अस्पष्ट).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Installing
questionsEn.s:
Installing - स्थापित करना (Place or fix equipment in position ready for use)
Removing - हटाना (Take something away or off from the position occupied)
Fixing - मरम्मत (The action of fastening something or repairing)
Assembling - इकट्ठा करना (Gather together in one place for a purpose)
Setting up - स्थापना (The act of establishing or organizing something)


Hence, 'Removing' is the most suitable antonym for 'Installing'.
oa:
This word refers to the act of taking something away or getting rid of it from a specific place. It is the direct procedural opposite of putting a new item in place.
Synonyms: Detaching (अलग करना), Extracting (निकालना), Deleting (मिटाना).
Antonyms: Installing (स्थापित करना), Fitting (लगाना), Inserting (डालना).

This word refers to repairing something or making it firm and stable. While often part of installation, it focuses on maintenance rather than initiation.
Synonyms: Repairing (सुधारना), Mending (ठीक करना), Securing (मज़बूत करना).
Antonyms: Breaking (तोड़ना), Damaging (नुकसान पहुँचाना), Loosening (ढीला करना).

This word refers to the act of gathering together in one place or fitting together the parts of something. It acts as a synonym that describes a stage of installation.
Synonyms: Connecting (जोड़ना), Constructing (निर्माण करना), Joining (मिलाना).
Antonyms: Dismantling (बिखेरना), Separating (अलग करना), Scattering (तितर-बितर).

This means to place something in position so that it is ready for use. It is a direct and very common phrasal synonym for installing.
Synonyms: Instituting (संस्थापित करना), Organizing (व्यवस्थित करना), Preparing (तैयार करना).
Antonyms: Dismantling (समाप्त करना), Shutting down (बंद करना), Removing (हटाना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Convince
questionsEn.s:
Convince - विश्वास दिलाना (Persuade someone firmly to believe the truth)
Persuade - मनाना (Induce someone to do something through reasoning)
Dissuade - रोकना (Persuade someone not to take a course of action)
Encourage - प्रोत्साहित करना (Give support, confidence, or hope to someone)
Influence - प्रभावित करना (The capacity to have an effect on behavior)


Hence, 'Dissuade' is the most suitable antonym for 'Convince'.
oa:
This word means to induce someone to do something through reasoning or argument. It is a direct synonym that captures the core essence of the question word.
Synonyms: Influence (प्रभावित करना), Coax (फुसलाना), Induce (प्रेरित करना).
Antonyms: Dissuade (रोकना), Discourage (हतोत्साहित करना), Deter (मना करना).

This word means to persuade someone not to take a particular course of action. it is the direct and most appropriate opposite of convincing someone to do or believe something.
Synonyms: Deter (रोकना), Discourage (निरुत्साहित करना), Divert (मोड़ना).
Antonyms: Persuade (मनाना), Convince (विश्वास दिलाना), Encourage (प्रोत्साहित करना).

This means to give support, confidence, or hope to someone. While positive, it focuses on motivation rather than the logical shift of opinion implied by convincing.
Synonyms: Inspire (प्रेरित करना), Support (समर्थन करना), Hearten (उत्साहित करना).
Antonyms: Depress (हतोत्साहित करना), Hinder (बाधा डालना), Intimidate (डराना).

This word refers to the capacity to have an effect on the character, development, or behavior of someone. It acts as a synonym that describes the broader power of persuasion.
Synonyms: Affect (प्रभाव डालना), Sway (प्रभावित करना), Control (नियंत्रित करना).
Antonyms: Neglect (उपेक्षा करना), Fail (विफल होना), Follow (अनुसरण करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Grant
questionsEn.s:
Grant - प्रदान करना (Agree to give or allow something requested)
Allow - अनुमति देना (Let someone have or do something; permit)
Refuse - इनकार करना (Indicate that one is not willing to give)
Bestow - अर्पण करना (Confer or present an honor, right, or gift)
Give - देना (Freely transfer the possession of something)
