Hence, 'Refuse' is the most suitable antonym for 'Grant'.
oa:
This word means to let someone have or do something. It is a direct synonym for the permission or gift aspect of the given word.
Synonyms: Permit (अनुमति देना), Consent (सहमति देना), Sanction (मंजूरी देना).
Antonyms: Forbid (मना करना), Prohibit (रोकना), Refuse (अस्वीकार करना).

This word means to indicate or show that one is not willing to do something or to give something. it is the direct and perfect antonym for granting a request or gift.
Synonyms: Deny (अस्वीकार करना), Decline (मना करना), Reject (नकारना).
Antonyms: Grant (प्रदान करना), Accept (स्वीकार करना), Bestow (देना).

This word means to confer or present a gift, right, or honor. It functions as a formal synonym for the act of granting something.
Synonyms: Award (पुरस्कार देना), Give (देना), Confer (प्रदान करना).
Antonyms: Withdraw (वापस लेना), Deprive (वंचित करना), Withhold (रोकना).

This is the most basic word for providing someone with something or hand over as a present. It is a simple and direct synonym.
Synonyms: Hand over (सौंपना), Present (प्रस्तुत करना), Donate (दान देना).
Antonyms: Take (लेना), Keep (रखना), Receive (प्राप्त करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Attention
questionsEn.s:
Attention - ध्यान (Notice taken of someone or something; concentration)
Focus - केंद्र बिंदु (The center of interest or activity)
Concentration - एकाग्रता (The power of focusing all one's attention)
Disregard - उपेक्षा (The action of paying no attention to something)
Notice - सूचना/ध्यान (The fact of observing or paying attention)


Hence, 'Disregard' is the most suitable antonym for 'Attention'.
oa:
This word refers to the center of interest or activity; paying particular notice to one thing. It is a direct synonym for the act of paying attention.
Synonyms: Concentration (एकाग्रता), Notice (ध्यान), Centrality (केंद्रिता).
Antonyms: Distraction (विचलित), Neglect (उपेक्षा), Disregard (अवहेलना).

This word refers to the action or power of focusing all one's attention. It represents an intense form of attention, acting as a synonym.
Synonyms: Absorption (तल्लीनता), Application (परिश्रम/ध्यान), Fixation (नियत ध्यान).
Antonyms: Confusion (उलझन), Dispersion (बिखराव), Inattention (लापरवाही).

This word refers to the action or state of paying no attention to something; being indifferent or ignoring. it is the direct and perfect antonym for attention.
Synonyms: Negligence (लापरवाही), Indifference (उदासीनता), Oversight (अनदेखी).
Antonyms: Attention (ध्यान), Respect (सम्मान), Care (परवाह).

This word refers to the fact of observing or paying attention to something. It is contextually identical to having something in one's attention, making it a synonym.
Synonyms: Awareness (जागरूकता), Perception (अनुभूति), Observation (निरीक्षण).
Antonyms: Ignorance (अज्ञानता), Neglect (अनदेखी), Blindness (अंधापन/अनदेखी).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Forgive
questionsEn.s:
Forgive - माफ़ करना (Stop feeling angry or resentful toward someone)
Pardon - क्षमा (Release an offender from the consequences of an offense)
Excuse - बहाना/माफ़ करना (Seek to lessen the blame attaching to a fault)
Condemn - निंदा करना (Express complete disapproval; sentence to punishment)
Absolve - दोषमुक्त (Declare someone free from guilt or punishment)


Hence, 'Condemn' is the most suitable antonym for 'Forgive'.
oa:
This word means to release an offender from the legal consequences of an offense or sin. It is the most common synonym for the act of forgiving.
Synonyms: Absolve (दोषमुक्त करना), Exonerate (बरी करना), Remit (क्षमा करना).
Antonyms: Punish (दंड देना), Sentence (सज़ा देना), Convict (दोषी ठहराना).

This means to seek to lessen the blame attaching to a fault or offense; to overlook or forgive. It is a synonym that implies a milder form of forgiveness.
Synonyms: Condone (अनदेखा करना), Justify (उचित ठहराना), Overlook (नज़रअंदाज़ करना).
Antonyms: Blame (दोष देना), Condemn (निंदा करना), Accuse (आरोप लगाना).

This word means to express complete disapproval of someone or something, typically in public; to find someone guilty. it is the direct moral and legal opposite of forgiving.
Synonyms: Censure (निंदा करना), Criticize (आलोचना करना), Sentence (सज़ा सुनाना).
Antonyms: Praise (प्रशंसा करना), Applaud (सराहना), Forgive (माफ़ करना).

This word means to declare someone free from guilt, obligation, or punishment. It acts as a formal and religious synonym for the act of forgiving.
Synonyms: Exculpate (दोषमुक्त करना), Clear (साफ करना/बरी), Discharge (मुक्त करना).
Antonyms: Indict (आरोप लगाना), Incriminate (दोषी ठहराना), Bind (बाध्य करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Burning
questionsEn.s:
Burning - जलता हुआ (On fire; very hot or bright)
Freezing - जमा देने वाला (Extremely cold; below the freezing point)
Scorching - झुलसाने वाला (Very hot; burning the surface of something)
Blazing - धधकना (Burning fiercely and brightly)
Smoldering - सुलगना (Burn slowly with smoke but no flame)


Hence, 'Freezing' is the most suitable antonym for 'Burning'.
oa:
This word refers to the state of being very cold; turning into ice. It is the direct thermal opposite of intense heat or fire.
Synonyms: Chilly (बहुत ठंडा), Frosty (बर्फ़ीला), Icy (बर्फ जैसा).
Antonyms: Burning (जलता हुआ), Boiling (उबलता हुआ), Torrid (तप्त).

This describes something that is very hot; burning the surface of something with flame or heat. It functions as a direct synonym for intense burning.
Synonyms: Sweltering (तपाने वाला), Searing (झुलसाने वाला), Blazing (धधकना).
Antonyms: Cold (ठंडा), Freezing (जमाने वाला), Refreshing (ताज़गी भरा).

This describes something burning fiercely and brightly. It is an exact synonym that captures the visual and heat aspects of a fire.
Synonyms: Flaming (ज्वलनशील), Radiant (चमकीला), Glowing (दमकता).
Antonyms: Extinguished (बुझा हुआ), Dim (धुंधला), Dark (अंधेरा).

This means to burn slowly with smoke but no flame. It is a synonym that describes a slower and more persistent type of burning.
Synonyms: Seething (खोलना/गुस्से में), Fuming (धुआं छोड़ना), Simmering (धीरे-धीरे जलना).
Antonyms: Quenched (बुझा हुआ), Cold (ठंडा), Flare (भड़कना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Get on
questionsEn.s:
Get on - चढ़ना (Step onto a vehicle; make progress)
Board - सवार होना (Get on or into a ship, aircraft, or other vehicle)
Remain - बने रहना (Continue to exist; stay in the same place)
Enter - प्रवेश करना (Come or go into a place or situation)
Mount - चढ़ना (Climb up or onto something)


Hence, 'Remain' is the most suitable antonym for 'Get on'.
oa:
This word means to get on or into a ship, aircraft, or other vehicle. It is a direct synonym for the act of entering a vehicle.
Synonyms: Enter (प्रवेश करना), Mount (चढ़ना), Ascend (ऊपर जाना).
Antonyms: Alight (उतरना), Disembark (उतरना), Exit (बाहर निकलना).

This word means to continue to exist, especially after other similar or related people or things have ceased to do so. In the context of movement or progress, staying put is the opposite of moving forward or getting on.
Synonyms: Stay (रहना), Wait (ठहरना), Linger (सुस्ती दिखाना).
Antonyms: Depart (प्रस्थान करना), Leave (छोड़ना), Get on (चढ़ना/चलना).

This means to come or go into a place. It acts as a synonym describing the initial part of getting on a transport or into a situation.
Synonyms: Infiltrate (घुसपैठ करना), Penetrate (भेजना), Invade (आक्रमण करना).
Antonyms: Leave (छोड़ना), Exit (निकास), Depart (चले जाना).

This means to climb up or on to something; to get on a horse, bicycle, or platform. It serves as a direct and physical synonym.
Synonyms: Climb (चढ़ना), Scale (ऊँचाई नापना/चढ़ना), Rise (उठना).
Antonyms: Descend (नीचे उतरना), Dismount (नीचे आना), Fall (गिरना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Gap
questionsEn.s:
Gap - अंतराल (A break or hole in an object or between two objects)
Opening - शुरुआत/छेद (A space that allows access or passage)
Space - जगह (A continuous area which is free or available)
Breach - उल्लंघन/दरार (A gap made in a wall or barrier)
Continuity - निरंतरता (The unbroken and consistent existence of something)


Hence, 'Continuity' is the most suitable antonym for 'Gap'.
oa:
This refers to a space which allows something to pass through or provides a view. It is a direct synonym for the space found in a gap.
Synonyms: Aperture (छेद), Slot (खांचा), Vent (निकास).
Antonyms: Closure (बंदी), Solid (ठोस), Blockage (रुकावट).

This word refers to a continuous area or expanse which is free, available, or unoccupied. It is a synonym that describes the void characteristic of a gap.
Synonyms: Vacuum (शून्यता), Interval (अंतराल), Void (खाली जगह).
Antonyms: Crowdedness (भीड़), Density (घनत्व), Fullness (पूर्णता).

This word refers to an act of breaking or failing to observe a law, agreement, or code of conduct, or a gap made in a wall. It functions as a formal synonym.
Synonyms: Rift (दरार), Cleft (दरार), Rupture (विच्छेद).
Antonyms: Agreement (सहमति), Union (मेल), Repair (मरम्मत).

This word refers to the unbroken and consistent existence or operation of something over a period of time. it is the direct opposite of having a break or gap.
Synonyms: Persistence (स्थिरता), Constancy (निरंतरता), Durability (टिकाऊपन).
Antonyms: Disruption (बाधा), Gap (अंतराल), Interruption (अवरोध).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Accurate
questionsEn.s:
Accurate - सटीक (Correct in all details; exact)
Precise - सूक्ष्म (Marked by exactness and accuracy of expression)
Inexact - अशुद्ध (Not quite accurate or correct)
Exact - एक दम सही (Not approximated in any way; precise)


Hence, 'Inexact' is the most suitable antonym for 'Accurate'.
oa:
This word describes something marked by exactness and accuracy of expression or detail. It is an exact synonym for the given word.
Synonyms: Exact (सटीक), Specific (विशिष्ट), Meticulous (सूक्ष्म).
Antonyms: Vague (अस्पष्ट), Loose (ढीला), Inaccurate (गलत).

This refers to something free from error; in accordance with fact or truth. It functions as the primary and simplest synonym for being accurate.
Synonyms: Right (सही), Proper (उचित), Valid (मान्य).
Antonyms: Wrong (गलत), False (झूठा), Erroneous (अशुद्ध).

This word describes something that is not quite accurate or correct; being approximate or vague. it is the most appropriate and direct antonym.
Synonyms: Imprecise (अस्पष्ट), Loose (ढीला-ढाला), Rough (अनुमानित).
Antonyms: Accurate (सटीक), Precise (निश्चित), Exact (एकदम सही).

This refers to something not approximated in any way; being precise and correct. It is a very close synonym that emphasizes the lack of deviation.
Synonyms: Strict (सख्त), Correct (सही), Literal (शाब्दिक).
Antonyms: General (सामान्य), Vague (अनिश्चित), Faulty (दोषपूर्ण).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Afraid
questionsEn.s:
Afraid - डरा हुआ (Feeling fear or anxiety; frightened)
Fearful - भयाक्रांत (Feeling or showing fear or anxiety)
Timid - डरपोक (Showing a lack of courage or confidence)
Courageous - साहसी (Not deterred by danger or pain; brave)
Anxious - चिंतित (Feeling or showing worry or nervousness)


Hence, 'Courageous' is the most suitable antonym for 'Afraid'.
oa:
This describes someone who is feeling or showing fear or anxiety. It is a direct synonym that captures the core emotion of the question word.
Synonyms: Scared (डरा हुआ), Anxious (चिंतित), Apprehensive (शंकित).
Antonyms: Brave (बहादुर), Bold (निडर), Confident (आत्मविश्वासी).

This word describes a person who is showing a lack of courage or confidence; easily frightened. It is a synonym that refers to a fearful personality trait.
Synonyms: Shy (शर्मीला), Mouselike (दब्बू), Bashful (संकोची).
Antonyms: Audacious (साहसी), Daring (निडर), Plucky (साहसी).

This word refers to a person ready to face and endure danger or pain; showing courage. it is the direct and most appropriate opposite for being afraid.
Synonyms: Brave (बहादुर), Valorous (वीर), Intrepid (निडर).
Antonyms: Cowardly (कायर), Afraid (डरा हुआ), Timid (डरपोक).

This word refers to someone feeling or showing worry, unease, or nervousness. It matches the "unease" part of fear, making it a synonym.
Synonyms: Nervous (घबराया हुआ), Worried (चिंतित), Uneasy (बेचैन).
Antonyms: Calm (शांत), Serene (स्थिर), Composed (धैर्यवान).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Foolish
questionsEn.s:
Foolish - मूर्ख (Lacking good sense or judgment; unwise)
Wise - बुद्धिमान (Having or showing experience and good judgment)
Silly - नादान (Having or showing a lack of common sense)
Reckless - लापरवाह (Done without regard to the consequences)
Unwise - नासमझ (Not wise or sensible; foolish)


Hence, 'Wise' is the most suitable antonym for 'Foolish'.
oa:
This word refers to having or showing experience, knowledge, and good judgment. It is the direct and most appropriate antonym for someone who lacks good sense.
Synonyms: Sagacious (बुद्धिमान), Learned (विद्वान), Intelligent (चतुर).
Antonyms: Foolish (मूर्ख), Unwise (नासमझ), Silly (नादान).

This word describes someone who is having or showing a lack of common sense or judgment; being absurd and foolish. It is a direct synonym.
Synonyms: Inane (बेतुका), Frivolous (छिछोरा), Ridiculous (हास्यास्पद).
Antonyms: Serious (गंभीर), Sensible (समझदार), Rational (तर्कसंगत).

This describes a person who is acting or done without regard to the consequences; being heedless of danger. It acts as a synonym that emphasizes a specific type of foolishness.
Synonyms: Careless (लापरवाह), Rash (जल्दबाज़), Impetuous (अविचारी).
Antonyms: Cautious (सावधान), Prudent (विवेकपूर्ण), Careful (सतर्क).

This word refers to something or someone not showing good judgment or being foolish. It is an exact synonym that directly negates the quality of wisdom.
Synonyms: Ill-advised (अनुचित), Judicious (अविवेकपूर्ण), Blind (अंधा/विवेकहीन).
Antonyms: Wise (बुद्धिमान), Sensible (समझदार), Strategic (रणनीतिक).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Antique
questionsEn.s:
Antique - प्राचीन (A collectible object such as a piece of furniture that has high value because of its considerable age)
Vintage - पुराना (Something from the past of high quality)
Modern - आधुनिक (Relating to the present or recent times)
Classic - उत्कृष्ट (Judged over a period of time to be of the highest quality)
Ancient - प्राचीन (Belonging to the very distant past)


Hence, 'Modern' is the most suitable antonym for 'Antique'.
oa:
This word refers to something of high quality and lasting value from the past. While more specific than "antique," it functions as a synonym describing old items.
Synonyms: Classic (पुराना), Old-fashioned (पुरानी शैली), Retro (अतीत का).
Antonyms: Modern (आधुनिक), Contemporary (समकालीन), Current (वर्तमान).

This word refers to something relating to the present or recent times as opposed to the remote past. it is the direct and most appropriate opposite for being old or antique.
Synonyms: Contemporary (समकालीन), Recent (हाल का), Present-day (वर्तमान).
Antonyms: Antique (प्राचीन), Ancient (पुराना), Obsolete (अप्रचलित).

This refers to something judged over a period of time to be of the highest quality and outstanding of its kind. It functions as a synonym when referring to timeless or old items.
Synonyms: Standard (मानक), Exemplary (अनुकरणीय), Traditional (पारंपरिक).
Antonyms: Inferior (घटिया), Modern (आधुनिक), New (नया).

This word refers to something belonging to the very distant past and no longer in existence. It is an exact synonym for the extremely old nature of an antique.
Synonyms: Antique (प्राचीन), Primeval (आदिम), Archaic (पुराना).
Antonyms: Modern (आधुनिक), Young (युवा), New (नया).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Forever
questionsEn.s:
Forever - हमेशा (For all future time; for always)
Eternally - अनंत काल तक (In a way that continues or lasts forever)
Temporarily - अस्थायी रूप से (For a limited period of time; not permanently)
Always - सदा (At all times; on all occasions)
Perpetually - निरंतर (In a way that never ends or changes)


Hence, 'Temporarily' is the most suitable antonym for 'Forever'.
oa:
This word means in a way that continues or lasts forever; being in an everlasting manner. It is a direct and literal synonym for the question word.
Synonyms: Everlastingly (शाश्वत रूप से), Perpetually (निरंतर), Infinitely (अनंत रूप से).
Antonyms: Temporarily (अस्थायी रूप से), Briefly (संक्षेप में), Momentarily (क्षण भर के लिए).

This word means for a limited period of time; not permanently. it is the direct and perfect antonym for an action or state that lasts forever.
Synonyms: Provisionally (अस्थायी रूप से), Briefly (कुछ समय के लिए), Momentarily (क्षण भर के लिए).
Antonyms: Permanently (स्थायी रूप से), Forever (हमेशा), Eternally (अनंत काल तक).

This word means at all times; on all occasions. It is the most common synonym used to describe the unending duration of "forever."
Synonyms: Constantly (लगातार), Invariably (परिवर्तनहीन), Continually (निरंतर).
Antonyms: Never (कभी नहीं), Seldom (शायद ही कभी), Occasionally (कभी-कभी).

This word means in a way that never ends or changes; constantly. It functions as a formal synonym for something that goes on without end.
Synonyms: Endlessly (अंतहीन), Abidingly (अटल), Incessantly (निरंतर).
Antonyms: Discontinuously (रुक-रुक कर), Temporarily (अस्थायी रूप से), Transitorily (अल्पकालिक).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Affordable
questionsEn.s:
Affordable - किफायती (Inexpensive; reasonably priced)
Reasonable - उचित (As much as is appropriate or fair; moderate)
Accessible - सुलभ (Able to be reached or entered)
Inexpensive - सस्ता (Not costing a great deal; cheap)
Overpriced - अत्यधिक महंगा (Too expensive; costing more than it is worth)


Hence, 'Overpriced' is the most suitable antonym for 'Affordable'.
oa:
This word describes a price that is fair and sensible. It is a direct synonym that implies a product is well-priced and within reach for many people.
Synonyms: Modest (मामूली), Inexpensive (सस्ता), Sensible (उचित).
Antonyms: Expensive (महंगा), Extravagant (खर्चीला), Outrageous (अत्यधिक).

This refers to something that is easy to approach, reach, enter, or use. While related to affordability in terms of being able to get something, it is more about location or ease of use than price.
Synonyms: Available (उपलब्ध), Attainable (प्राप्त करने योग्य), Convenient (सुविधाजनक).
Antonyms: Remote (दूर), Forbidden (वर्जित), Restricted (प्रतिबंधित).

This describes something that does not cost much money; being cheap. It is an exact synonym for the question word.
Synonyms: Low-priced (कम कीमत वाला), Economical (मितव्ययी), Bargain (सस्ता).
Antonyms: Costly (कीमती), Expensive (महंगा), Dear (प्रिय/महंगा).

This word describes something that is too expensive; costing more than it is worth. it is the direct and most appropriate opposite for being affordable.
Synonyms: Exorbitant (अत्यधिक), Dear (महंगा), Extravagant (खर्चीला).
Antonyms: Cheap (सस्ता), Affordable (किफायती), Reasonable (उचित).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Amazed
questionsEn.s:
Amazed - हैरान (Greatly surprised; astonished)
Startled - चौंका हुआ (Feeling or showing sudden shock or alarm)
Unimpressed - अप्रभावित (Not feeling admiration or respect)
Shocked - स्तब्ध (Surprised and upset by something unexpected)
Astonished - विस्मित (Greatly surprised or impressed)


Hence, 'Unimpressed' is the most suitable antonym for 'Amazed'.
oa:
This word means feeling or showing sudden shock or alarm. It is a synonym that captures the sudden and surprising nature of being amazed.
Synonyms: Surprised (आश्चर्यचकित), Shocked (स्तब्ध), Astounded (हैरान).
Antonyms: Calm (शांत), Unmoved (अविचलित), Expectant (अपेक्षित).

This word refers to not feeling admiration or respect for someone or something. it is the direct emotional opposite of being amazed or struck with wonder.
Synonyms: Indifferent (उदासीन), Disenchanted (मोहभंग), Moved (प्रभावित नहीं).
Antonyms: Amazed (हैरान), Impressed (प्रभावित), Enthralled (मुग्ध).

This word refers to being surprised and upset by something very unexpected and unpleasant. It serves as a synonym focusing on the intensity of the surprise.
Synonyms: Stunned (अवाक), Appalled (भयभीत), Bewildered (उलझा हुआ).
Antonyms: Unfazed (बेपरवाह), Composed (शांत), Relaxed (आरामदायक).

This word refers to being greatly surprised or impressed; being amazed. It is a near-perfect synonym for the given word.
Synonyms: Dumbfounded (हक्का-बक्का), Flabbergasted (हैरान), Thunderstruck (भौंचक्का).
Antonyms: Bored (ऊबा हुआ), Apathetic (उदासीन), Predictable (अनुमानित).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Frighten
questionsEn.s:
Frighten - डराना (Make someone afraid or anxious)
Alarm - खतरे की सूचना (Cause someone to feel frightened or disturbed)
Scare - डराना (Cause great fear or nervousness in someone)
Terrify - आतंकित करना (Cause someone to feel extreme fear)
Comfort - आराम (The state of physical ease and freedom from pain)


Hence, 'Comfort' is the most suitable antonym for 'Frighten'.
oa:
This means to cause someone to feel frightened, disturbed, or in danger. It is a direct synonym for the act of scaring someone.
Synonyms: Panic (आतंकित करना), Shock (स्तब्ध करना), Agitate (परेशान करना).
Antonyms: Comfort (दिलासा देना), Reassure (आश्वस्त करना), Soothe (शांत करना).

This word means to cause great fear or nervousness in someone; to frighten. It is the most common and direct synonym for the question word.
Synonyms: Terrorize (डराना), Daunt (हतोत्साहित करना), Intimidate (धमकाना).
Antonyms: Embolden (साहस बढ़ाना), Encourage (प्रोत्साहित करना), Calm (शांत करना).

This word means to cause someone to feel extreme fear. It functions as an intense synonym for the act of frightening.
Synonyms: Petrify (पत्थर कर देना/डराना), Horrify (भयभीत करना), Appal (डराना).
Antonyms: Delight (खुश करना), Cheer (आनंदित करना), Please (प्रसन्न करना).

This word means to ease the grief or distress of someone; to console or soothe. it is the direct opposite of causing fear or distress in another person.
Synonyms: Console (दिलासा देना), Solace (शांति देना), Reassure (ढाढस बंधाना).
Antonyms: Frighten (डराना), Distress (दुखी करना), Agitate (उत्तेजित करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Average
questionsEn.s:
Average - औसत (A number expressing the central value; ordinary)
Common - सामान्य (Occurring, found, or done often; prevalent)
Ordinary - साधारण (With no special or distinctive features; normal)
Exceptional - असाधारण (Unusually good; outstanding)
Typical - विशिष्ट (Having the distinctive qualities of a particular type)


Hence, 'Exceptional' is the most suitable antonym for 'Average'.
oa:
This word describes something occurring, found, or done often; being prevalent. It acts as a synonym for the "ordinary" or typical aspect of being average.
Synonyms: Usual (सामान्य), Familiar (परिचित), Standard (मानक).
Antonyms: Rare (दुर्लभ), Unique (अनोखा), Extraordinary (असाधारण).

This describes something with no special or distinctive features; being normal. It is an exact synonym for the unremarkable nature of being average.
Synonyms: Humdrum (नीरस), Routine (नियमित), Plain (साधारण).
Antonyms: Remarkable (अद्भुत), Exceptional (असाधारण), Special (खास).

This word refers to something unusually good or outstanding; being much better than average. it is the direct and most appropriate opposite for something that is only mediocre.
Synonyms: Extraordinary (असाधारण), Outstanding (उत्कृष्ट), Remarkable (अद्भुत).
Antonyms: Average (औसत), Mediocre (मामूली), Common (साधारण).

This describes something having the distinctive qualities of a particular type of person or thing. It serves as a synonym that emphasizes being a standard example.
Synonyms: Characteristic (विशिष्ट), Quintessential (सर्वोत्कृष्ट), Regular (नियमित).
Antonyms: Abnormal (असामान्य), Unusual (अजीब), Peculiar (विचित्र).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Give up
questionsEn.s:
Give up - हार मान लेना (Cease making an effort; admit defeat)
Quit - छोड़ना (Leave a place or stop doing something)
Surrender - आत्मसमर्पण (Stop resisting an opponent and submit to authority)
Abandon - त्यागना (Cease to support or look after; leave permanently)
Persist - डटे रहना (Continue firmly in a course of action despite difficulty)


Hence, 'Persist' is the most suitable antonym for 'Give up'.
oa:
This word means to leave a place, usually permanently, or to stop doing something. It is a direct synonym for the act of surrendering or giving up.
Synonyms: Abandon (छोड़ना), Depart (प्रस्थान करना), Resign (इस्तीफा देना).
Antonyms: Start (शुरू करना), Persist (डटे रहना), Continue (जारी रखना).

This word means to stop resisting an enemy or opponent and submit to their authority. It is contextually synonymous with the act of giving up a fight.
Synonyms: Yield (हार मानना), Capitulate (हथियार डालना), Succumb (झुकना).
Antonyms: Resist (विरोध करना), Fight (लड़ना), Conquer (जीतना).

This means to cease to support or look after someone; to leave permanently. It serves as a synonym focusing on the act of leaving or deserting.
Synonyms: Desert (त्यागना), Forsake (छोड़ना), Discard (फेंक देना).
Antonyms: Reclaim (वापस पाना), Maintain (बनाए रखना), Adopt (गोद लेना).

This word means to continue firmly or obstinately in an opinion or a course of action in spite of difficulty. it is the direct and perfect antonym for quitting or giving up.
Synonyms: Persevere (धैर्य रखना), Continue (जारी रखना), Endure (सहन करना/बने रहना).
Antonyms: Give up (छोड़ना), Quit (बंद करना), Surrender (हार मानना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Give away
questionsEn.s:
Give away - बाँटना/देना (Give something as a gift or reveal a secret)
Donate - दान देना (Give money or goods for a good cause)
Keep - रखना (Have or retain possession of something)
Hand out - वितरित करना (To give something to each person in a group)
Reveal - प्रकट करना (Make previously unknown information known to others)


Hence, 'Keep' is the most suitable antonym for 'Give away'.
oa:
This word means to give money or goods for a good cause, for example, to a charity. It is a synonym that describes a generous and intentional form of giving.
Synonyms: Present (उपहार देना), Bestow (प्रदान करना), Contribute (योगदान देना).
Antonyms: Take (लेना), Withdraw (वापस लेना), Receive (प्राप्त करना).

This word means to have or retain possession of something; not to give it to others. it is the direct and logical opposite of distributing or revealing something.
Synonyms: Retain (रखना), Withhold (रोकना), Reserve (आरक्षित करना).
Antonyms: Give away (बाँटना), Distribute (देना), Discard (छोड़ना).

This means to give something to each person in a group. It is a direct and common synonym for the act of physical distribution.
Synonyms: Circulate (प्रसारित करना), Disseminate (फैलाना), Issue (जारी करना).
Antonyms: Gather (इकट्ठा करना), Collect (संचय करना), Retain (रखना).

This means to make previously unknown or secret information known to others. It functions as a synonym for the metaphorical "giving away" of a secret.
Synonyms: Disclose (उजागर करना), Divulge (प्रकाशित करना), Unmask (नकाब हटाना).
Antonyms: Hide (छिपाना), Conceal (गुप्त रखना), Dissemble (पाखंड करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Approach
questionsEn.s:
Approach - पास आना (Come near or nearer to someone or something)
Advance - आगे बढ़ना (Move forward in a purposeful way)
Near - निकट (At or to a short distance away; close)
Retreat - पीछे हटना (An act of moving back or withdrawing)
Reach - पहुँचना (Stretch out an arm to touch; arrive at)


Hence, 'Retreat' is the most suitable antonym for 'Approach'.
oa:
This word means to move forward in a purposeful way; to make progress. It functions as a synonym for the movement towards something.
Synonyms: Progress (प्रगति करना), Proceed (आगे बढ़ना), March (कूच करना).
Antonyms: Retreat (पीछे हटना), Recede (दूर जाना), Halt (रुकना).

This word means at or to a short distance away; being close. It is a synonym that describes the physical state achieved by an approach.
Synonyms: Close (पास), Proximate (समीप), Adjacent (बगल में).
Antonyms: Distant (दूर), Far (दूर), Remote (सुदूर).

This word means to move back or withdraw from a position or from a battle. it is the direct and absolute antonym for approaching or coming closer.
Synonyms: Withdraw (वापस हटना), Backtrack (पीछे मुड़ना), Recede (पीछे जाना).
Antonyms: Approach (पास आना), Advance (आगे बढ़ना), Confront (सामना करना).

This means to stretch out an arm in order to touch or grasp something, or to arrive at a destination. It serves as a synonym representing the final stage of an approach.
Synonyms: Arrive (पहुँचना), Attain (प्राप्त करना), Achieve (हासिल करना).
Antonyms: Miss (चूक जाना), Leave (छोड़ना), Fail (विफल होना).

test.instructions: Standard CBT Pattern Exam. Positive Marks: +1, Negative Marks: -1. Total Questions: 50.

test.title: Set - 6

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Foreign
questionsEn.s:
Foreign - विदेशी (From or relating to a different country)
Domestic - घरेलू / स्वदेशी (Relating to one's own country or home)
Alien - पराया / विदेशी (Belonging to a foreign country or nature)
Overseas - समुद्रपार (Relating to a country across the sea)
External - बाहरी (Coming from or relating to the outside)


Hence, 'Domestic' is the most suitable antonym for 'Foreign'.
oa:
This word relates to one's own country or home rather than to other countries. It is the direct antonym for something that comes from or relates to a different nation.
Synonyms: Local (स्थानीय), Native (स्वदेशी), Internal (आंतरिक).
Antonyms: Foreign (विदेशी), Alien (अजनबी), External (बाहरी).

This word describes someone or something belonging to a foreign country or having a different nature. It acts as a synonym for the given word rather than an opposite.
Synonyms: Exotic (विदेशी), Strange (अजीब), Outsider (बाहरी व्यक्ति).
Antonyms: Familiar (परिचित), Resident (निवासी), Indigenous (स्वदेशी).

This refers to something situated in or relating to a country across the sea. It functions as a synonym in the context of international or foreign affairs.
Synonyms: International (अंतर्राष्ट्रीय), Transcontinental (पारमहाद्वीपीय), Abroad (विदेश में).
Antonyms: Inland (देश के भीतर), Domestic (घरेलू), Local (स्थानीय).

This word relates to the outside of something or to foreign countries and their relations. It describes a similar outward-facing context as the question word.
Synonyms: Outer (बाहरी), Exterior (बाहरी), Outward (बाहर की ओर).
Antonyms: Inner (भीतरी), Interior (आंतरिक), Central (केंद्रीय).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Anxious
questionsEn.s:
Anxious - चिंतित (Feeling worried, nervous, or uneasy)
Nervous - घबराया हुआ (Easily agitated or alarmed)
Calm - शांत (Not showing or feeling nervousness or anger)
Worried - परेशान (Feeling anxiety about potential problems)
Restless - बेचैन (Unable to rest or relax as a result of anxiety)


Hence, 'Calm' is the most suitable antonym for 'Anxious'.
oa:
This word describes someone who is easily agitated or alarmed; tending to be anxious. It is a synonym that captures the uneasy feeling of the question word.
Synonyms: Apprehensive (शंकित), Edgy (बेचैन), Jittery (घबराया हुआ).
Antonyms: Confident (आत्मविश्वासी), Bold (निडर), Composed (शांत).

This word refers to a state of being free from agitation, excitement, or worry. It serves as the most appropriate opposite for being worried or anxious.
Synonyms: Serene (निर्मल), Tranquil (शांत), Placid (सौम्य).
Antonyms: Anxious (चिंतित), Agitated (उत्तेजित), Frantic (बेचैन).

This describes feeling or showing anxiety about a problem or a situation. It is the core synonym for the question word and does not fit the antonym requirement.
Synonyms: Concerned (चिंतित), Uneasy (बेचैन), Troubled (परेशान).
Antonyms: Unconcerned (निश्चिंत), Carefree (बेफ़िक्र), Secure (सुरक्षित).

This refers to the inability to rest or relax as a result of anxiety or boredom. It aligns with the agitated state of being anxious, making it a synonym.
Synonyms: Fidgety (चंचल), Uneasy (अस्थिर), Skittish (चंचल).
Antonyms: Peaceful (शांतिपूर्ण), Relaxed (शांत), Patient (धैर्यवान).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Fortunately
questionsEn.s:
Fortunately - भाग्यवश (Happening by good luck; luckily)
Unfortunately - दुर्भाग्यवश (Happening by bad luck; unluckily)
Luckily - सौभाग्य से (Indicating that something happens by good fortune)
Happily - सुखद रूप से (In a cheerful way or by a fortunate chance)
Thankfully - शुक्र है कि (In a thankful manner; expressing relief)


Hence, 'Unfortunately' is the most suitable antonym for 'Fortunately'.
oa:
This adverb is used to say that something is unlucky or a matter of regret. It is the direct and logical antonym for something happening by good luck.
Synonyms: Unluckily (दुर्भाग्य से), Regrettably (खेदजनक रूप से), Unhappily (दुर्भाग्यवश).
Antonyms: Happily (सौभाग्य से), Lucked out (भाग्यशाली), Prosperously (समृद्ध रूप से).

This word is used to indicate that something happens by good fortune. It is a direct synonym of the question word and describes a positive turn of events.
Synonyms: Providentially (ईश्वर की कृपा से), Happily (खुशी से), Propitiously (अनुकूलता से).
Antonyms: Unluckily (दुर्भाग्य से), Adversely (प्रतिकूल रूप से), Inauspiciously (अशुभ रूप से).

This describes something done in a cheerful way or indicates a fortunate result. It shares the same positive connotation as the given word and is thus a synonym.
Synonyms: Blissfully (आनंदपूर्वक), Joyfully (हर्षपूर्वक), Contentedly (संतोषपूर्वक).
Antonyms: Sadly (दुखद रूप से), Unhappily (दुर्भाग्यवश), Miserably (दयनीय रूप से).

This refers to being grateful or used to express relief that something fortunate has happened. It aligns with the "fortunate" context, making it a synonym.
Synonyms: Gratefully (कृतज्ञतापूर्वक), Appreciatively (सराहना के साथ), Relievedly (राहत के साथ).
Antonyms: Ungratefully (अकृतज्ञतापूर्वक), Sadly (दुख के साथ), Harshly (कठोरता से).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Gaining
questionsEn.s:
Gaining - प्राप्त करना (Obtaining or securing an advantage or increase)
Acquiring - हासिल करना (To come into possession or ownership of)
Winning - जीतना (Being successful in a contest or conflict)
Earning - कमाना (Obtain money or reward in return for labor)
Losing - खोना (Ceasing to have or retain something)


Hence, 'Losing' is the most suitable antonym for 'Gaining'.
oa:
This word means to buy or obtain an asset or an object for oneself. It is a synonym that describes the act of getting or increasing one's possessions.
Synonyms: Obtaining (प्राप्त करना), Procuring (हासिल करना), Securing (पाना).
Antonyms: Losing (खोना), Surrendering (त्यागना), Relinquishing (छोड़ना).

This refers to being successful or victorious in a contest or effort. It is contextually synonymous with gaining an advantage or a prize.
Synonyms: Conquering (जीतना), Prevailing (सफल होना), Triumphed (विजेता).
Antonyms: Failing (असफल होना), Dropping (हारना), Yielding (हार मानना).

This refers to obtaining money or reward in return for labor or services. It is a form of gaining and therefore serves as a synonym.
Synonyms: Meriting (लायक होना), Deserving (पाना), Fetching (कमा लेना).
Antonyms: Spending (खर्च करना), Squandering (लुटाना), Forfeiting (ज़ब्त होना).

This word refers to being deprived of or ceasing to have something. It is the direct opposite of gaining, which involves an increase or acquisition.
Synonyms: Misplacing (खो देना), Forfeiting (गंवाना), Depleting (कम करना).
Antonyms: Finding (पाना), Gaining (प्राप्त करना), Accumulating (बढ़ाना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Accompany
questionsEn.s:
Accompany - साथ जाना (To go somewhere with someone as a companion)
Escort - सुरक्षा हेतु साथ जाना (Go with as a guard or companion)
Follow - पीछे चलना (Go or come after a person or thing)
Abandon - छोड़ देना (To leave someone or something permanently)
Attend - उपस्थित होना (Be present at or go with as an assistant)


Hence, 'Abandon' is the most suitable antonym for 'Accompany'.
oa:
This word means to go with someone as a companion, guard, or guide. It is a direct synonym of the question word and implies being with someone.
Synonyms: Attend (साथ देना), Guide (मार्गदर्शन करना), Conduct (ले जाना).
Antonyms: Leave (छोड़ना), Abandon (त्यागना), Neglect (अनदेखा करना).

This refers to moving or traveling behind someone or something. While it involves a different spatial relation, it still implies staying with or going after someone, making it a synonym.
Synonyms: Pursue (पीछा करना), Succeed (पीछे आना), Trail (पीछा करना).
Antonyms: Lead (नेतृत्व करना), Avoid (बचना), Desert (छोड़ देना).

This word means to leave a person, place, or thing permanently or for a long time. it is the direct opposite of accompanying someone.
Synonyms: Desert (त्यागना), Forsake (परित्याग करना), Quit (छोड़ना).
Antonyms: Stay (रुकना), Accompany (साथ देना), Support (समर्थन करना).

This refers to being present at an event or to accompany someone as an assistant or servant. It captures the essence of being with someone, functioning as a synonym.
Synonyms: Assist (सहायता करना), Serve (सेवा करना), Accompany (साथ होना).
Antonyms: Disregard (उपेक्षा करना), Avoid (बचना), Depart (चले जाना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Pleasure
questionsEn.s:
Pleasure - आनंद (A feeling of happy satisfaction and enjoyment)
Enjoyment - सुख (The process of taking pleasure in something)
Delight - हर्ष (A high degree of pleasure or joy)
Happiness - खुशी (The state of being happy or satisfied)
Pain - दर्द / पीड़ा (Physical or emotional suffering or discomfort)


Hence, 'Pain' is the most suitable antonym for 'Pleasure'.
oa:
This refers to the state or process of taking pleasure in something. Since it defines the positive feeling of the question word, it is a synonym.
Synonyms: Delight (आनंद), Gratification (संतुष्टि), Mirth (प्रसन्नता).
Antonyms: Misery (कष्ट), Dissatisfaction (असंतोष), Boredom (ऊब).

This refers to a high degree of gratification or pleasure; joy. It is a synonym that captures the extreme positive aspect of the question word.
Synonyms: Bliss (परम सुख), Glee (उल्लास), Satisfaction (तृप्ति).
Antonyms: Dismay (बेचैनी), Sorrow (शोक), Pain (दर्द).

This is the state of being happy or showing pleasure and contentment. It is functionally synonymous with the general feeling of pleasure.
Synonyms: Contentment (संतोष), Joy (हर्ष), Cheer (खुशी).
Antonyms: Sadness (उदासी), Despair (निराशा), Agony (व्यथा).

This word refers to highly unpleasant physical or emotional suffering. It is the direct and most accurate antonym for a feeling of pleasure.
Synonyms: Suffering (पीड़ा), Agony (यातना), Distress (कष्ट).
Antonyms: Comfort (आराम), Ease (राहत), Pleasure (आनंद).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Amusing
questionsEn.s:
Amusing - मनोरंजक (Causing laughter or providing entertainment)
Humorous - हास्यपूर्ण (Causing lighthearted laughter and amusement)
Boring - उबाऊ (Not interesting; tedious or dull)
Entertaining - दिलचस्प (Providing amusement or enjoyment)
Witty - वाक्पटु (Showing quick and inventive verbal humor)


Hence, 'Boring' is the most suitable antonym for 'Amusing'.
oa:
This word describes someone or something that causes lighthearted laughter or amusement. It is a direct synonym of the question word.
Synonyms: Funny (हास्यपूर्ण), Witty (चतुर), Jocular (मज़ाकिया).
Antonyms: Serious (गंभीर), Solemn (औपचारिक), Grave (गंभीर).

This word describes something that is not interesting or exciting and fails to provide amusement. it is the perfect antonym for being amusing.
Synonyms: Tedious (थकाऊ), Dull (नीरस), Humdrum (फीका).
Antonyms: Exciting (रोमांचक), Interesting (दिलचस्प), Amusing (मनोरंजक).

This refers to something that provides amusement or enjoyment. It is essentially a synonym for the given word.
Synonyms: Diverting (मनोरंजक), Pleasing (सुखद), Engaging (मोहक).
Antonyms: Tiresome (थकाने वाला), Uninteresting (अरुचिकर), Vapid (फीका).

This word describes someone showing quick and inventive verbal humor. It is a synonym that captures a specific type of intellectual amusement.
Synonyms: Clever (चालाक/हाज़िरजवाब), Sharp (तेज़), Smart (बुद्धिमान).
Antonyms: Stupid (मूर्ख), Inane (बेतुका), Dull-witted (मंदबुद्धि).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Forbidden
questionsEn.s:
Forbidden - वर्जित (Not allowed; banned by law or rule)
Prohibited - निषिद्ध (That has been forbidden; banned)
Allowed - अनुमत (Having permission to do something)
Restricted - प्रतिबंधित (Limited in extent, number, or action)
Barred - रोक लगा हुआ (Prevented or prohibited from doing something)


Hence, 'Allowed' is the most suitable antonym for 'Forbidden'.
oa:
This means that something has been forbidden by law, rule, or authority. It is an exact synonym for the given word.
Synonyms: Banned (प्रतिबंधित), Interdicted (वर्जित), Vetoed (अस्वीकृत).
Antonyms: Allowed (अनुमत), Authorized (अधिकृत), Permitted (मंजूर).

This word means that someone has permission to do something or that something is permitted. It is the direct opposite of being forbidden.
Synonyms: Permitted (मंजूर), Authorized (मान्य), Sanctioned (स्वीकृत).
Antonyms: Forbidden (वर्जित), Prohibited (निषिद्ध), Banned (रोक लगा हुआ).

This word describes something that is limited in extent, number, or action. While it implies some level of control, it is more a synonym for being limited than a direct opposite of forbidden.
Synonyms: Confined (सीमित), Bound (बंधा हुआ), Cramped (तंग).
Antonyms: Free (मुक्त), Unlimited (असीमित), Open (खुला).

This means to prevent or prohibit someone from doing something or from entering a place. It acts as a synonym for being forbidden.
Synonyms: Excluded (बाहर रखा), Blocked (रुका हुआ), Prevented (रोका हुआ).
Antonyms: Admitted (प्रवेश दिया), Accepted (स्वीकार किया), Invited (आमंत्रित).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Adventurous
questionsEn.s:
Adventurous - साहसी (Willing to take risks or try new experiences)
Daring - साहसी (Willing to take or seek out risks)
Cautious - सावधान (Avoiding potential problems or dangers)
Bold - निडर (Showing an ability to take risks; confident)
Brave - बहादुर (Ready to face and endure danger or pain)


Hence, 'Cautious' is the most suitable antonym for 'Adventurous'.
oa:
This word describes a person who is willing to take or seek out risks; bold. It is a synonym that captures the gutsy nature of being adventurous.
Synonyms: Bold (निडर), Audacious (साहसी), Intrepid (बेखौफ).
Antonyms: Cowardly (कायर), Timid (डरपोक), Cautious (सावधान).

This word refers to a person who avoids potential problems or dangers; showing great care. It is the direct and most appropriate opposite for being adventurous.
Synonyms: Careful (सावधान), Wary (सतर्क), Prudent (विवेकपूर्ण).
Antonyms: Reckless (लापरवाह), Adventurous (साहसी), Rash (जल्दबाज़).

This describes someone who is not afraid of danger or difficult situations. It is a core characteristic of an adventurous person, serving as a synonym.
Synonyms: Courageous (बहादुर), Fearless (निर्भीक), Gallant (वीर).
Antonyms: Shy (संकोची), Meek (दब्बू), Afraid (डरा हुआ).

This refers to someone ready to face and endure danger or pain; showing courage. It is a direct synonym for the spirit of adventure.
Synonyms: Valorous (वीर), Stouthearted (दृढ़ संकल्पी), Plucky (साहसी).
Antonyms: Faint-hearted (कमज़ोर दिल), Craven (डरपोक), Gutless (डरपोक).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Fresh
questionsEn.s:
Fresh - ताज़ा (Recently made or obtained; not decayed)
New - नया (Produced or introduced for the first time)
Crisp - कुरकुरा (Pleasantly firm, dry, and fresh)
Recent - हाल का (Having happened or been done only a short time ago)
Stale - बासी (No longer fresh or pleasant; dry or musty)


Hence, 'Stale' is the most suitable antonym for 'Fresh'.
oa:
This word refers to something produced, introduced, or discovered recently or now for the first time. It is a direct synonym for being fresh.
Synonyms: Recent (हाल ही का), Novel (नया), Original (मौलिक).
Antonyms: Old (पुराना), Antique (प्राचीन), Hackneyed (घिसा-पिटा).

This refers to something (especially food) that is pleasantly firm and fresh. It is a synonym, particularly in the context of vegetables or papers.
Synonyms: Brittle (कुरकुरा), Crunchy (कुरकुरा), Fresh (ताज़ा).
Antonyms: Soggy (गीला-पिला), Limp (ढीला/मुरझाया), Soft (नरम).

This word describes something that happened, began, or was done only a short time ago. It serves as a synonym that emphasizes the time aspect of freshness.
Synonyms: Latter (पिछला), Current (वर्तमान), Modern (आधुनिक).
Antonyms: Former (भूतपूर्व), Ancient (प्राचीन), Past (पुराना).

This word refers to food (like bread) that is no longer fresh and pleasant to eat; also used for ideas. It is the perfect antonym for being fresh.
Synonyms: Musty (बासी), Fusty (पुराना), Flat (फीका).
Antonyms: Fresh (ताज़ा), New (नया), Sweet (मीठा).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Fancy
questionsEn.s:
Fancy - सजावटी (Elaborate in structure or decoration; not plain)
Elaborate - विस्तृत (Involving many carefully arranged details)
Ornate - अलंकृत (Made in an intricate shape or decorated complexly)
Decorative - सजावटी (Serving to make something look more attractive)
Simple - साधारण (Plain, basic, or uncomplicated in form)


Hence, 'Simple' is the most suitable antonym for 'Fancy'.
oa:
This word describes something that involves many carefully arranged parts or details. It is a synonym for the decorative and complex nature of "fancy."
Synonyms: Detailed (विस्तृत), Complex (जटिल), Intricate (पेचीदा).
Antonyms: Simple (साधारण), Plain (सपाट), Basic (बुनियादी).

This refers to something made in an intricate shape or decorated with complex patterns. It is an exact synonym for fancy objects or buildings.
Synonyms: Decorated (सजावटी), Showy (दिखावटी), Rococo (अलंकारपूर्ण).
Antonyms: Austere (सादा), Unadorned (बिना सजावट का), Stark (सख्त/सादा).

This refers to something serving to make something look more attractive; ornamental. It functions as a synonym that highlights the aesthetic goal of being fancy.
Synonyms: Aesthetic (सौंदर्यपूर्ण), Ornamental (सजावटी), Garnished (सजाया हुआ).
Antonyms: Functional (कार्यात्मक), Utility (उपयोगिता), Plain (सादा).

This word refers to something that is plain, basic, or uncomplicated in form or nature. It is the direct opposite of being fancy or elaborate.
Synonyms: Uncomplicated (सरल), Modest (विनीत), Humble (मामूली).
Antonyms: Complex (जटिल), Fancy (शानदार), Sophisticated (उन्नत).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Flee
questionsEn.s:
Flee - भाग जाना (To run away from a place or situation of danger)
Stay - ठहरना (To remain in the same place)
Evade - बचना (Escape or avoid, especially by cleverness)
Run - दौड़ना (Move at a speed faster than a walk)
Escape - बच निकलना (To succeed in getting away from something)


Hence, 'Stay' is the most suitable antonym for 'Flee'.
oa:
This word means to remain in the same place or to continue to be in a specified state. It is the direct opposite of running away or fleeing.
Synonyms: Remain (रुकना), Dwell (ठहरना), Wait (प्रतीक्षा करना).
Antonyms: Leave (छोड़ना), Depart (चले जाना), Flee (भागना).

This refers to the act of escaping or avoiding something, especially by guile or trickery. It is a synonym that describes a clever way of running away.
Synonyms: Avoid (बचना), Elude (बच निकलना), Shirk (टालना).
Antonyms: Confront (सामना करना), Face (सामना करना), Meet (मिलना).

This is a general term for moving at a speed faster than a walk, often used in the context of fleeing from danger. It acts as a primary synonym.
Synonyms: Dash (तेज़ी से दौड़ना), Bolt (भाग जाना), Scuttle (भागना).
Antonyms: Walk (पैदल चलना), Creep (रेंगना), Halt (रुकना).

This means to break free from confinement or control; to get away. It is an exact synonym for the act of fleeing.
Synonyms: Abscond (फरार होना), Breakout (निकल भागना), Fly (उड़ना/भागना).
Antonyms: Capture (पकड़ना), Stay (ठहरना), Imprison (कैद करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Admire
questionsEn.s:
Admire - प्रशंसा करना (Regard with respect or warm approval)
Respect - आदर करना (Feeling of deep admiration for someone)
Despise - तिरस्कार करना (Feel contempt or deep repugnance for)
Appreciate - सराहना करना (Recognize the full worth of; be grateful for)
Praise - गुणगान करना (Express warm approval or admiration)


Hence, 'Despise' is the most suitable antonym for 'Admire'.
oa:
This means to have a deep admiration for someone elicited by their abilities or qualities. It is a direct synonym for the given word.
Synonyms: Esteem (आदर), Value (महत्व देना), Honor (सम्मान).
Antonyms: Despise (तिरस्कार करना), Scorn (घृणा करना), Insult (अपमान करना).

This word means to feel a deep contempt or a strong dislike for someone or something. it is the most appropriate opposite for showing admiration.
Synonyms: Loathe (नफ़रत करना), Detest (घृणा करना), Abhor (नफ़रत करना).
Antonyms: Admire (प्रशंसा करना), Like (पसंद करना), Adore (बहुत चाहना).

This means to recognize the full worth of something or to be grateful for it. It functions as a synonym that implies positive valuation.
Synonyms: Cherish (संजोना), Treasure (अनमोल समझना), Welcome (स्वागत करना).
Antonyms: Overlook (नज़रअंदाज़ करना), Neglect (अनदेखी करना), Belittle (कम आंकना).

This refers to the expression of approval or admiration for someone or something. It is a synonym describing the verbal form of admiration.
Synonyms: Compliment (तारीफ़), Laud (सराहना), Extol (गुणगान करना).
Antonyms: Criticize (आलोचना करना), Blame (दोष देना), Condemn (निंदा करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Fairly
questionsEn.s:
Fairly - निष्पक्ष रूप से (In a fair and reasonable manner)
Justly - न्यायपूर्वक (In a way that is morally right and fair)
Unjustly - अन्यायपूर्ण ढंग से (In a way that is not fair or right)
Rightfully - उचित रूप से (According to a legitimate right or claim)
Honestly - ईमानदारी से (In a truthful, sincere, or honorable way)


Hence, 'Unjustly' is the most suitable antonym for 'Fairly'.
oa:
This word refers to doing something in a way that is morally right and fair. It is a direct synonym that aligns with the sense of fairness in the question word.
Synonyms: Equitably (न्यायसंगत रूप से), Rightly (सही ढंग से), Fair-mindedly (निष्पक्षता से).
Antonyms: Unjustly (अन्यायपूर्ण ढंग से), Biasedly (पक्षपात से), Wrongly (गलत ढंग से).

This word refers to doing something in a way that is not based on or behaving according to what is morally right and fair. It is the direct opposite of "fairly."
Synonyms: Unfairly (गलत तरीके से), Wrongfully (अन्यायपूर्ण ढंग से), Biasedly (पक्षपात से).
Antonyms: Fairly (निष्पक्ष रूप से), Justly (न्यायपूर्ण ढंग से), Honorably (सम्मानजनक रूप से).

This refers to doing something according to a legitimate right or claim. It shares the "correctness" of being fair, making it a synonym.
Synonyms: Lawfully (कानूनी रूप से), Legitimately (वैध रूप से), Properly (उचित रूप से).
Antonyms: Illegally (गैरकानूनी रूप से), Unfairly (अनुचित रूप से), Wrongly (गलत रूप से).

This refers to doing something in a truthful and sincere way. Since fairness often implies honesty, it functions as a synonym in many contexts.
Synonyms: Sincerely (ईमानदारी से), Truthfully (सच्चाई से), Frankly (साफ़गोई से).
Antonyms: Dishonestly (बेईमानी से), Deceitfully (छलपूर्वक), Fraudulently (धोखे से).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Scared
questionsEn.s:
Scared - डरा हुआ (Fearful; frightened)
Brave - बहादुर (Ready to face and endure danger; courageous)
Nervous - घबराया हुआ (Easily agitated or alarmed; anxious)
Worried - चिंतित (Feeling anxiety about potential problems)
Cautious - सावधान (Careful to avoid potential problems or dangers)


Hence, 'Brave' is the most suitable antonym for 'Scared'.
oa:
This word describes a person ready to face and endure danger or pain; showing courage. It is the direct and most accurate antonym for being scared or fearful.
Synonyms: Courageous (साहसी), Bold (निडर), Fearless (निर्भीक).
Antonyms: Scared (डरा हुआ), Cowardly (कायर), Timid (दब्बू).

This word refers to being easily agitated or alarmed; tending to be anxious. It is a synonym that describes a slightly less intense version of being scared.
Synonyms: Edgy (बेचैन), Jittery (घबराया हुआ), Worried (चिंतित).
Antonyms: Calm (शांत), Composed (संतुलित), Confident (आत्मविश्वासी).

This describes feeling or showing anxiety about a potential problem or a situation. It aligns with the mental state of being scared, making it a synonym.
Synonyms: Anxious (चिंतित), Concerned (शंकित), Uneasy (परेशान).
Antonyms: Carefree (निश्चिंत), Unconcerned (बेपरवाह), Secure (सुरक्षित).

This word refers to avoiding potential problems or dangers; showing great care. While not a direct synonym, a person who is scared often acts with caution, making it contextually related rather than opposite.
Synonyms: Wary (सतर्क), Prudent (सावधान), Vigilant (चौकस).
Antonyms: Reckless (लापरवाह), Impetuous (अविवेकी), Rash (उतावला).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Fact
questionsEn.s:
Fact - तथ्य (A thing that is known or proved to be true)
Reality - वास्तविकता (The state of things as they actually exist)
Truth - सच्चाई (The quality or state of being true)
Fiction - कल्पना / कहानी (Something that is invented or untrue)
Actuality - हकीकत (Actual existence; the state of being real)


Hence, 'Fiction' is the most suitable antonym for 'Fact'.
oa:
This word refers to the state of things as they actually exist, as opposed to an idealistic or notional idea of them. It is an exact synonym of the question word.
Synonyms: Actuality (वास्तविकता), Truth (सत्य), Existence (अस्तित्व).
Antonyms: Fantasy (कल्पना), Delusion (भ्रम), Fiction (असात्य).

This refers to the quality or state of being true or in accordance with fact or reality. It is the primary synonym for the given word.
Synonyms: Veracity (सत्यता), Fact (तथ्य), Certainty (निश्चितता).
Antonyms: Lie (झूठ), Falsehood (असत्य), Fiction (कल्पना).

This word refers to something that is invented or imagined and is not true. It is the most appropriate opposite for a proven fact or reality.
Synonyms: Fantasy (कल्पना), Fabrication (बनावट), Legend (दंतकथा).
Antonyms: Fact (तथ्य), Reality (हकीकत), Truth (सच्चाई).

This refers to the actual existence, typically as contrasted with what was intended or expected. It functions as a formal synonym for being a fact.
Synonyms: Substantiality (वास्तविकता), Essence (सार), Fact (तथ्य).
Antonyms: Potentiality (क्षमता), Illusion (भ्रम), Fiction (कल्पना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Magnanimous
questionsEn.s:
Magnanimous - उदार (Generous or forgiving, especially toward a rival)
Altruistic - परोपकारी (Showing a selfless concern for others)
Self-absorbed - आत्मकेंद्रित (Preoccupied with one's own interests or feelings)
Noble - कुलीन / महान (Having fine personal qualities or high moral principles)
Gracious - विनीत (Courteous, kind, and pleasant)


Hence, 'Self-absorbed' is the most suitable antonym for 'Magnanimous'.
questionsEn.source: Selection Post Phase XIII (Graduate), 02 Aug 2025, Shift 3
oa:
This word refers to showing a disinterested and selfless concern for the well-being of others. It is a synonym that captures the noble and generous spirit of being magnanimous.
Synonyms: Benevolent (परोपकारी), Philanthropic (समाजसेवी), Unselfish (निस्वार्थ).
Antonyms: Selfish (स्वार्थी), Greedy (लालची), Stingy (कंजूस).

This word describes a person who is preoccupied with one's own feelings, interests, or situation. It is the direct opposite of being generous and big-hearted toward others.
Synonyms: Egocentric (आत्मकेंद्रित), Narcissistic (अहंकारी), Self-centered (स्वार्थी).
Antonyms: Magnanimous (उदार), Altruistic (परोपकारी), Considerate (विचारशील).

This word refers to having or showing fine personal qualities or high moral principles. It is a direct synonym that describes the character of a magnanimous person.
Synonyms: Dignified (गरिमापूर्ण), Illustrious (शानदार), Virtuous (सदाचारी).
Antonyms: Base (नीच), Ignoble (अधम), Common (साधारण).

This refers to being courteous, kind, and pleasant, especially towards someone of lower social status. It serves as a synonym for the kind-hearted nature of the question word.
Synonyms: Polished (सुसंस्कृत), Affable (मिलनसार), Cordial (हार्दिक).
Antonyms: Rude (अशिष्ट), Churlish (असभ्य), Unmannerly (बदतमीज़).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Tenacious
questionsEn.s:
Tenacious - दृढ़ (Tending to keep a firm hold of something; clinging)
Persistent - लगातार (Continuing firmly in a course of action)
Fragile - नाज़ुक (Easily broken or damaged)
Yielding - झुकने वाला (Ready to give way to others; compliant)
Firm - मज़बूत (Having a solid surface; strongly felt)


Hence, 'Yielding' is the most suitable antonym for 'Tenacious'.
questionsEn.source: Selection Post Phase XIII (Graduate), 24 Jul 2025, Shift 3
oa:
This word describes someone who continues firmly or obstinately in a course of action in spite of difficulty. It is an exact synonym for being tenacious.
Synonyms: Dogged (हठी/दृढ़), Constant (सतत), Stubborn (ज़िद्दी).
Antonyms: Fickle (चंचल), Irresolute (अनिश्चित), Weak (कमज़ोर).

This describes something that is easily broken or damaged. While it implies weakness, it usually refers to physical structure rather than a lack of determination, making it less precise than the correct antonym.
Synonyms: Delicate (नाज़ुक), Frail (दुर्बल), Brittle (कुरकुरा).
Antonyms: Robust (मज़बूत), Tough (कठोर), Durable (टिकाऊ).

This word describes a person who is ready to give way to others; being compliant or flexible. It is the direct opposite of holding on firmly or being tenacious.
Synonyms: Compliant (आज्ञाकारी), Pliant (लचीला), Docile (विनीत).
Antonyms: Obstinate (ज़िद्दी), Tenacious (दृढ़), Adamant (अटल).

This refers to something strongly felt and unlikely to change, or physically solid. It is a synonym that describes the unshakable quality of a tenacious person.
Synonyms: Solid (ठोस), Steady (स्थिर), Unwavering (निश्चल).
Antonyms: Shaky (अस्थिर), Flabby (ढीला), Yielding (झुकने वाला).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Blistering
questionsEn.s:
Blistering - अत्यंत गर्म / तीव्र (Extremely hot or intense)
Scorching - झुलसाने वाला (Very hot; burning)
Chilly - ठंडा (Unpleasantly cold)
Burning - जलता हुआ (On fire or very hot)
Incendiary - आग लगाने वाला (Designed to cause fires or conflict)


Hence, 'Chilly' is the most suitable antonym for 'Blistering'.
questionsEn.source: Selection Post Phase XIII (Graduate), 25 Jul 2025, Shift 3
oa:
This refers to something that is very hot. It is a direct synonym for the high temperature or intensity implied by the question word.
Synonyms: Sweltering (तपती), Burning (जलता हुआ), Roasting (बहुत गर्म).
Antonyms: Freezing (बेहद ठंडा), Chilly (ठंडा), Cold (शीतल).

This word refers to something that is unpleasantly cold. It serves as the most accurate opposite for something that is "blistering" or intensely hot.
Synonyms: Cool (शीतल), Frosty (तुषारपूर्ण), Nippy (ठंडा).
Antonyms: Hot (गर्म), Blistering (तपता हुआ), Warm (गुनगुना).

This word describes something that is on fire or very hot. It is a fundamental synonym for the blistering heat or intensity.
Synonyms: Fiery (आग्नेय), Flaming (प्रज्वलित), Red-hot (तप्त).
Antonyms: Quenched (बुझा हुआ), Cold (ठंडा), Damp (गीला).

This refers to a device or attack designed to cause fires, or tending to stir up conflict. It captures the extreme "heat" or destructive nature, serving as a synonym.
Synonyms: Inflammatory (उत्तेजक), Provocative (उकसाने वाला), Combustible (ज्वलनशील).
Antonyms: Peacemaking (शांत करने वाला), Conciliatory (मिलाप करानेवाला), Extinguishing (बुझाने वाला).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Recount
questionsEn.s:
Recount - वर्णन करना (Tell someone about something; narrate)
Narrate - सुनाना (Give a spoken or written account of)
Suppress - दबाना (Prevent the expression or knowledge of)
Retell - फिर से सुनाना (Tell a story again or in a new way)
Detail - ब्यौरा देना (Give full information about something)


Hence, 'Suppress' is the most suitable antonym for 'Recount'.
questionsEn.source: Selection Post Phase XIII (Graduate), 28 Jul 2025, Shift 3
oa:
This word means to give a spoken or written account of a story or event. It is a direct synonym for the act of recounting.
Synonyms: Relate (वर्णन करना), Tell (बताना), Describe (बताना).
Antonyms: Conceal (छिपाना), Suppress (दबाना), Hide (गुप्त रखना).

This word means to prevent the development, action, or expression of something; to keep secret. It is the direct opposite of narrating or recounting information.
Synonyms: Censor (प्रतिबंधित करना), Withhold (रोकना), Stifle (दबाना).
Antonyms: Reveal (प्रकट करना), Recount (बताना), Disclose (उजागर करना).

This means to tell a story or event again or in a different way. It is a synonymous action to recounting, just focused on repetition.
Synonyms: Repeat (दोहराना), Reiterate (बार-बार कहना), Recapitulate (सारांश बताना).
Antonyms: Hush up (दबा देना), Ignore (अनदेखा करना), Forget (भूल जाना).

This word means to give full information about something. It aligns with the descriptive nature of recounting, acting as a synonym.
Synonyms: Enumerate (सूचीबद्ध करना), Specify (विशिष्ट रूप से बताना), Itemize (ब्यौरा देना).
Antonyms: Generalize (सामान्यीकरण करना), Summarize (संक्षेप में बताना), Omit (छोड़ देना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Lucid
questionsEn.s:
Lucid - स्पष्ट (Expressed clearly; easy to understand)
Clear - साफ़ (Easy to perceive, understand, or interpret)
Confusing - भ्रामक (Bewildering; difficult to understand)
Bright - उज्ज्वल (Giving out or reflecting much light; shining)
Fluent - धाराप्रवाह (Able to express oneself easily and articulately)


Hence, 'Confusing' is the most suitable antonym for 'Lucid'.
questionsEn.source: Selection Post Phase XIII (Graduate), 29 Aug 2025, Shift 1
oa:
This word refers to something that is easy to perceive, understand, or interpret. it is the primary synonym and literal definition of being lucid.
Synonyms: Evident (स्पष्ट), Obvious (ज़ाहिर), Transparent (पारदर्शी).
Antonyms: Obscure (अस्पष्ट), Vague (धुंधला), Unclear (ग़लत).

This word describes something that is difficult to understand or makes someone feel bewildered. It is the perfect opposite of being clear and lucid.
Synonyms: Muddled (उलझा हुआ), Ambiguous (अस्पष्ट), Perplexing (हैरान करने वाला).
Antonyms: Lucid (स्पष्ट), Simple (सरल), Understandable (बोधगम्य).

This describes something that gives off much light or is shining. While often used for clarity, it describes the physical light aspect, making it a synonym in a metaphorical sense.
Synonyms: Radiant (चमकीला), Luminous (प्रकाशमान), Vivid (उज्ज्वल).
Antonyms: Dull (धुंधला), Dark (अंधेरा), Somber (उदास).

This refers to the ability to express oneself easily and articulately. It shares the "clarity of expression" trait with the given word, acting as a synonym.
Synonyms: Articulate (सुस्पष्ट), Smooth (सहज), Voluble (वाचाल).
Antonyms: Inarticulate (अस्पष्ट), Hesitant (हिचकिचाता हुआ), Halting (लड़खड़ाता हुआ).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Impervious
questionsEn.s:
Impervious - अभेद्य / अप्रभावित (Not allowing fluid to pass through; unaffected by)
Impregnable - अजेय (Unable to be captured or broken into)
Permeable - पारगम्य (Allowing liquids or gases to pass through)
Durable - टिकाऊ (Able to withstand wear, pressure, or damage)
Impassive - भावहीन (Not feeling or showing emotion)


Hence, 'Permeable' is the most suitable antonym for 'Impervious'.
questionsEn.source: Selection Post Phase XIII (Graduate), 29 Aug 2025, Shift 1
oa:
This word refers to something that is unable to be captured or broken into. It captures the "unaffected" or "impenetrable" nature of being impervious, acting as a synonym.
Synonyms: Invincible (अजेय), Secure (सुरक्षित), Unassailable (अभेद).
Antonyms: Vulnerable (असुरक्षित), Weak (कमज़ोर), Fragile (नाज़ुक).

This word describes a material or membrane that allows liquids or gases to pass through it. it is the direct scientific and general antonym for being impervious.
Synonyms: Porous (छिद्रपूर्ण), Penetrable (प्रवेश योग्य), Accessible (सुलभ).
Antonyms: Impervious (अभेद्य), Sealed (बंद), Watertight (जलसह).

This refers to something that is able to withstand wear, pressure, or damage; hard-wearing. While related to being tough, it focuses on longevity rather than impenetrability, making it a general synonym.
Synonyms: Lasting (टिकाऊ), Robust (मज़बूत), Resilient (लचीला).
Antonyms: Perishable (नश्वर), Temporary (अस्थायी), Flimsy (कमज़ोर).

This describes someone who is not feeling or showing emotion. It captures the figurative meaning of being "unaffected" (impervious to emotion), thus serving as a synonym.
Synonyms: Expressionless (भावहीन), Stoic (उदासीन), Stolid (सुस्त/शांत).
Antonyms: Emotional (भावुक), Demonstrative (प्रकट करने वाला), Sensitive (संवेदनशील).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Reposte
questionsEn.s:
Reposte - जवाबी प्रहार (A quick, clever reply to an insult or criticism)
Endorsement - समर्थन (Public approval or support)
Apology - क्षमा याचना (A regretful acknowledgment of an offense)
Compliment - प्रशंसा (A polite expression of praise)
Confirmation - पुष्टि (The action of verifying something)


Hence, 'Apology' is the most suitable antonym for 'Reposte'.
questionsEn.source: Selection Post Phase XIII (Graduate), 29 Jul 2025, Shift 3
oa:
This refers to the action of endorsing or giving one's public approval or support to someone or something. It describes a positive response, but "apology" is a better situational opposite for a sharp retort.
Synonyms: Sanction (मंजूरी), Ratification (पुष्टि), Approval (स्वीकृति).
Antonyms: Opposition (विरोध), Rejection (अस्वीकृति), Disapproval (निंदा).

This word refers to a regretful acknowledgment of an offense or failure. While a "reposte" is a sharp or witty reply (often defensive), an apology is an admission of wrong, making it a strong behavioral opposite.
Synonyms: Regret (खेद), Atonement (प्रायश्चित), Confession (स्वीकारोक्ति).
Antonyms: Accusation (आरोप), Reposte (जवाबी हमला), Defiance (अवहेलना).

This refers to a polite expression of praise or admiration. Since a reposte is often a defensive or sharp retort, a kind compliment acts as a contrast.
Synonyms: Tribute (श्रद्धांजलि), Accolade (सम्मान), Flattery (चापलूसी).
Antonyms: Insult (अपमान), Slur (कलंक), Taunt (ताना).

This means the action of confirming something or the state of being confirmed. It is a neutral response that verifies rather than retorts, making it contextually unrelated.
Synonyms: Verification (सत्यापन), Validation (पुष्टि), Substantiation (सबूत).
Antonyms: Denial (खंडन), Refutation (अस्वीकृति), Contradiction (विरोध).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Prodigious
questionsEn.s:
Prodigious - विशाल / अद्भुत (Impressively great in size, force, or extent)
Meagre - अल्प (Lacking in quantity or quality)
Phenomenal - असाधारण (Very remarkable; extraordinary)
Enormous - बहुत बड़ा (Very large in size, quantity, or extent)
Monumental - महान / विशाल (Great in importance, extent, or size)


Hence, 'Meagre' is the most suitable antonym for 'Prodigious'.
questionsEn.source: Selection Post Phase XIII (Graduate), 30 Jul 2025, Shift 3
oa:
This word refers to something that is lacking in quantity or quality; lean or thin. It is the perfect antonym for something that is impressively great or enormous.
Synonyms: Scanty (अल्प), Paltry (तुच्छ), Inadequate (अपर्याप्त).
Antonyms: Abundant (प्रचुर), Plentiful (भरपूर), Prodigious (विशाल).

This word describes something that is very remarkable or extraordinary. It is a synonym that emphasizes the impressive and unusual nature of the question word.
Synonyms: Exceptional (असाधारण), Amazing (अद्भुत), Marvellous (शानदार).
Antonyms: Ordinary (सामान्य), Average (औसत), Common (आम).

This refers to something that is very large in size, quantity, or extent. It is a direct synonym that focuses on the massive scale implied by being prodigious.
Synonyms: Huge (विशाल), Massive (बड़ा), Immense (अत्यधिक).
Antonyms: Tiny (छोटा), Minute (सूक्ष्म), Microscopic (बहुत छोटा).

This describes something that is great in importance, extent, or size. It captures the "grand" aspect of the given word, acting as a synonym.
Synonyms: Majestic (भव्य), Grand (शानदार), Epic (महान).
Antonyms: Trivial (नगण्य), Minor (मामूली), Petty (तुच्छ).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Mythical
questionsEn.s:
Mythical - पौराणिक (Occurring in or characteristic of myths; imaginary)
Imaginary - काल्पनिक (Existing only in the imagination)
Verifiable - सत्यापन योग्य (Able to be checked or demonstrated to be true)
Supernatural - अलोकिक (Attributed to some force beyond scientific understanding)
Symbolic - प्रतीकात्मक (Serving as a symbol)


Hence, 'Verifiable' is the most suitable antonym for 'Mythical'.
questionsEn.source: Selection Post Phase XIII (Graduate), 31 Jul 2025, Shift 3
oa:
This describes something that exists only in the imagination and is not real. It is a direct synonym for being mythical.
Synonyms: Fictional (काल्पनिक), Unreal (असली नहीं), Fanciful (काल्पनिक).
Antonyms: Real (वास्तविक), Actual (सत्य), Existential (विद्यमान).

This word refers to something that can be checked or demonstrated to be true, accurate, or justified. it is the direct antonym for something based on myth or imagination.
Synonyms: Provable (प्रमाणित करने योग्य), Authentic (प्रामाणिक), Confirmed (पुष्ट).
Antonyms: Mythical (पौराणिक), Unproven (अपुष्ट), Dubious (संदिग्ध).

This refers to something attributed to some force beyond scientific understanding or the laws of nature. It aligns with the "myth" aspect, serving as a synonym.
Synonyms: Paranormal (अतींद्रिय), Ghostly (अलोकिक), Miraculous (चमत्कारी).
Antonyms: Natural (प्राकृतिक), Normal (सामान्य), Mundane (साधारण).

This word refers to something serving as a symbol; figurative. While myths are symbolic, this word describes a mode of representation rather than an opposite of myth.
Synonyms: Emblematic (प्रतीकात्मक), Representative (प्रतिनिधि), Figurative (रूपक).
Antonyms: Literal (शाब्दिक), Direct (सीधा), Plain (स्पष्ट).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Falter
questionsEn.s:
Falter - लड़खड़ाना (Lose strength or momentum; speak hesitantly)
Waver - डगमगाना (Become unsteady or unreliable; be undecided)
Stumble - ठोकर खाना (Trip or momentarily lose one's balance)
Persist - डटे रहना (Continue firmly in a course of action)
Demur - आपत्ति करना (Raise objections or show reluctance)


Hence, 'Persist' is the most suitable antonym for 'Falter'.
questionsEn.source: Selection Post Phase XIII (12th), 02 Aug 2025, Shift 2
oa:
This word means to become unsteady or to hesitate in a decision. It is an exact synonym for the lack of momentum described by the question word.
Synonyms: Hesitate (हिचकिचाना), Vacillate (डगमगाना), Totter (लड़खड़ाना).
Antonyms: Decide (तय करना), Persist (डटे रहना), Advance (आगे बढ़ना).

This refers to a momentary loss of balance or making a mistake. It is a physical and metaphorical synonym for faltering.
Synonyms: Slip (फिसलना), Blunder (चूक), Trip (ठोकर खाना).
Antonyms: Glide (सहजता से चलना), Stabilize (स्थिर होना), Succeed (सफल होना).

This word means to continue firmly or obstinately in a course of action in spite of difficulty or opposition. it is the direct antonym of losing confidence or faltering.
Synonyms: Endure (टिकना), Persevere (डटे रहना), Continue (जारी रखना).
Antonyms: Quit (छोड़ना), Falter (लड़खड़ाना), Cease (रुकना).

This refers to raising objections or showing reluctance. While it involves a form of hesitation, it describes a verbal refusal rather than a loss of momentum, making it a synonym in a broad sense.
Synonyms: Object (आपत्ति करना), Protest (विरोध करना), Hesitate (हिचकिचाना).
Antonyms: Accept (स्वीकार करना), Agree (सहमत होना), Consent (मंजूरी देना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Bold
questionsEn.s:
Bold - साहसी (Showing an ability to take risks; confident and courageous)
Adventurous - हिम्मती (Willing to take risks or try new experiences)
Brave - बहादुर (Ready to face and endure danger or pain)
Timid - डरपोक (Showing a lack of courage or confidence)
Fearless - निर्भीक (Lacking fear; very brave)


Hence, 'Timid' is the most suitable antonym for 'Bold'.
questionsEn.source: Selection Post Phase XIII (10th), 01 Aug 2025, Shift 1
oa:
This word describes a person who is willing to take risks or try new methods; being daring. It is a direct synonym for the courageous nature of being bold.
Synonyms: Enterprising (उद्यमी/साहसी), Audacious (निडर), Gutsy (हिम्मती).
Antonyms: Cautious (सावधान), Wary (सतर्क), Careful (सजग).

This word refers to a person ready to face and endure danger or pain; showing courage. It is the primary synonym for the question word.
Synonyms: Valorous (वीर), Gallant (शौर्यवान), Intrepid (निर्भीक).
Antonyms: Cowardly (कायर), Faint-hearted (कमज़ोर दिल), Timid (डरपोक).

This word refers to a person showing a lack of courage or confidence; being easily frightened. It is the direct and most accurate antonym for being bold.
Synonyms: Shy (संकोची), Bashful (शर्मीला), Fearful (डरपोक).
Antonyms: Bold (साहसी), Confident (आत्मविश्वासी), Daring (निडर).

This refers to someone who is free from fear; being very brave. It is a synonym that captures the "no-fear" aspect of being bold.
Synonyms: Dauntless (निडर), Unafraid (भयमुक्त), Heroic (वीर).
Antonyms: Terrified (भयभीत), Anxious (चिंतित), Scared (डरा हुआ).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Obscure
questionsEn.s:
Obscure - अस्पष्ट / गुमनाम (Not discovered or known about; uncertain)
Prominent - प्रसिद्ध / मुख्य (Important; famous; particularly noticeable)
Vague - अनिश्चित (Of uncertain, indefinite, or unclear character)
Faint - धीमा / धुंधला (Barely perceptible; lacking brightness or volume)
Hidden - छिपा हुआ (Kept out of sight; concealed)


Hence, 'Prominent' is the most suitable antonym for 'Obscure'.
questionsEn.source: Selection Post Phase XIII (10th), 01 Aug 2025, Shift 1
oa:
This word refers to something that is important or famous, or something that is easily seen; conspicuous. It is the direct antonym for something hidden or unknown.
Synonyms: Eminent (प्रसिद्ध), Noticeable (प्रत्यक्ष), Salient (मुख्य).
Antonyms: Obscure (अस्पष्ट/गुमनाम), Hidden (छिपा हुआ), Minor (मामूली).

This word describes something that is of uncertain, indefinite, or unclear character or meaning. It is a direct synonym for the "unclear" aspect of the question word.
Synonyms: Indistinct (अस्पष्ट), Hazy (धुंधला), Ambiguous (दोअर्थी).
Antonyms: Precise (सटीक), Clear (साफ़), Definite (निश्चित).

This describes something (like a feeling or light) that is weak, dizzy, or barely perceptible. It aligns with the "hard to see" nature of being obscure, making it a synonym.
Synonyms: Dim (धुंधला), Pale (फीका), Weak (कमज़ोर).
Antonyms: Intense (तीव्र), Loud (ज़ोरदार), Strong (मज़बूत).

This refers to something that is kept out of sight; concealed. It is a literal synonym for the state of being obscure or unknown.
Synonyms: Cloaked (छिपा हुआ), Secret (गुप्त), Covert (प्रच्छन्न).
Antonyms: Exposed (उजागर), Visible (दिखाई देने वाला), Public (सार्वजनिक).

questionsEn.q: Select the word nearest in meaning to: Pristine
questionsEn.s:
Pristine - प्राचीन / निर्मल (In its original condition; unspoiled; clean)
Polluted - प्रदूषित (Made dirty or harmful; contaminated)
Immaculate - बेदाग (Perfectly clean, neat, or tidy)
Dirty - गंदा (Covered or marked with an unclean substance)
Untouched - अछूता (Not handled, used, or affected)


Hence, 'Immaculate' is the most suitable synonym for 'Pristine'.
questionsEn.source: Selection Post Phase XIII (10th), 01 Aug 2025, Shift 2
oa:
This word describes something that has been made dirty or harmful by poisonous or industrial waste. it is the direct opposite of being pristine.
Synonyms: Contaminated (दूषित), Fouled (गंदा), Tainted (कलंकित).
Antonyms: Clean (साफ़), Pristine (शुद्ध), Pure (पवित्र).

This word refers to something that is perfectly clean, neat, or tidy; free from flaws or mistakes. It is the closest synonym for the "spotless" quality of being pristine.
Synonyms: Spotless (बेदाग), Pure (शुद्ध), Flawless (त्रुटिहीन).
Antonyms: Filthy (गंदा), Sullied (मैला), Tarnished (कलंकित).

This describes something that is covered or marked with an unclean substance. It functions as a direct antonym rather than a synonym for the given word.
Synonyms: Grimy (मैला), Soiled (गंदा), Muddy (कीचड़ युक्त).
Antonyms: Clean (साफ़), Pristine (ताज़ा), Sparkling (चमकदार).

This describes something that has not been handled, used, or affected. While very close to the original meaning of pristine (unspoiled), it is slightly less focused on "cleanness" than immaculate.
Synonyms: Unspoiled (बिना बिगड़ा हुआ), Intact (अक्षुण्ण), Virgin (अछूता).
Antonyms: Affected (प्रभावित), Used (इस्तेमाल किया हुआ), Damaged (क्षतिग्रस्त).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Docile
questionsEn.s:
Docile - विनम्र / आज्ञाकारी (Ready to accept control or instruction; submissive)
Soft - कोमल (Easy to mold or compress; having a pleasing texture)
Headstrong - ज़िद्दी (Self-willed and obstinate; hard to control)
Gentle - सौम्य (Mild, kind, or tender in temperament)
Compliant - अनुपालन करने वाला (Disposed to agree with others or obey rules)


Hence, 'Headstrong' is the most suitable antonym for 'Docile'.
questionsEn.source: Selection Post Phase XIII (10th), 01 Aug 2025, Shift 2
oa:
This word refers to something that is easy to mold, cut, or compress; not hard or firm. While often used for gentle personalities, it refers more to texture than to obedience, making it unrelated as an antonym.
Synonyms: Supple (लचीला), Tender (कोमल), Mellow (नरम).
Antonyms: Hard (कठोर), Rigid (सख्त), Tough (मज़बूत).

This word describes a person who is self-willed and obstinate; refusing to be controlled. It is the direct opposite of being submissive or docile.
Synonyms: Stubborn (ज़िद्दी), Willful (हठी), Refractory (अड़ियल).
Antonyms: Docile (विनम्र), Obedient (आज्ञाकारी), Submissive (दब्बू).

This refers to having or showing a mild, kind, or tender temperament. It is a synonym that aligns with the quiet and easy-to-manage nature of being docile.
Synonyms: Mild (नरम), Amiable (मिलनसार), Kind (दयालु).
Antonyms: Brutal (क्रूर), Harsh (कठोर), Violent (हिंसक).

This describes someone who is disposed to agree with others or obey rules, especially to an excessive degree. It is a direct synonym for the given word.
Synonyms: Obedient (आज्ञाकारी), Accommodating (मिलनसार), Yielding (झुकने वाला).
Antonyms: Defiant (विद्रोही), Resistant (प्रतिरोधी), Obstinate (ज़िद्दी).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Barbarous
questionsEn.s:
Barbarous - बर्बर (Exceedingly brutal; primitive and uncivilized)
Civilized - सभ्य (At a high stage of social development; polite)
Cruel - निर्दयी (Willfully causing pain or suffering to others)
Savage - जंगली / भयानक (Fierce, violent, and uncontrolled; primitive)
Brutal - क्रूर (Savagely violent; very cruel or harsh)


Hence, 'Civilized' is the most suitable antonym for 'Barbarous'.
questionsEn.source: Selection Post Phase XIII (10th), 01 Aug 2025, Shift 3
oa:
This word refers to a society or person that has at a high stage of social and cultural development; showing polite and cultured behavior. It is the perfect opposite of being primitive or cruel.
Synonyms: Cultured (सुसंस्कृत), Refined (शिष्ट), Sophisticated (उन्नत).
Antonyms: Savage (असभ्य), Barbarous (बर्बर), Crude (अविकसित).

This word refers to someone willfully causing pain or suffering to others, or feeling no concern about it. It is a primary synonym for the "savage" aspect of being barbarous.
Synonyms: Brutal (क्रूर), Vicious (दुष्ट), Heartless (निर्दयी).
Antonyms: Kind (दयालु), Compassionate (सहानुभूतिपूर्ण), Humane (मानवीय).

This describes something that is fierce, violent, and uncontrolled. It is an exact synonym for the primitive and wild nature of being barbarous.
