Synonyms: Primitive (आदिम), Wild (जंगली), Ferocious (भयंकर).
Antonyms: Tame (पालतू), Docile (विनम्र), Civilized (सभ्य).

This word refers to something savoring of the nature of a brute; being very cruel or harsh. It functions as a strong synonym for the question word.
Synonyms: Ruthless (बेदर्द), Relentless (अथक/कठोर), Pitiless (निष्ठुर).
Antonyms: Gentle (सौम्य), Tender (कोमल), Merciful (दयालु).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Infernal
questionsEn.s:
Infernal - नारकीय (Relating to hell or the underworld; extremely bad)
Wicked - दुष्ट (Evil or morally wrong)
Damned - शापित (Condemned by God to eternal punishment)
Heavenly - स्वर्गीय (Of or belonging to heaven; very pleasing)
Accursed - अभागा / शापित (Under a curse; used to express irritation)


Hence, 'Heavenly' is the most suitable antonym for 'Infernal'.
questionsEn.source: Selection Post Phase XIII (10th), 01 Aug 2025, Shift 3
oa:
This word refers to someone evil or morally wrong. It captures the "hellish" or extremely bad nature of the question word, acting as a synonym.
Synonyms: Evil (बुरा), Sinful (पापी), Heinous (जघन्य).
Antonyms: Virtuous (सदाचारी), Saintly (पुण्य), Moral (नैतिक).

This refers to someone condemned by God to suffer eternal punishment in hell. It is a theological synonym that perfectly matches the "infernal" theme.
Synonyms: Cursed (शापित), Doomed (अभागा), Lost (खोया हुआ/नरकवासी).
Antonyms: Blessed (धन्य), Saved (सुरक्षित), Redeemed (उद्धृत).

This word refers to something of or belonging to heaven; being divine or very pleasing. It is the direct and most appropriate opposite for something related to hell.
Synonyms: Celestial (आकाशीय), Divine (दिव्य), Blissful (परम सुखद).
Antonyms: Infernal (नारकीय), Hellish (भयानक), Diabolical (पैशाचिक).

This word describes someone or something under a curse. It aligns with the negative, punished state implied by being infernal, serving as a synonym.
Synonyms: Ill-fated (बदकिस्मत), Execrable (घृणित), Detestable (घिनौना).
Antonyms: Fortunate (भाग्यशाली), Favored (अनुग्रहित), Lucky (खुशकिस्मत).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Axiom
questionsEn.s:
Axiom - स्वयं सिद्ध सत्य (A self-evident truth that requires no proof)
Truism - सामान्य सत्य (A statement that is obviously true)
Adage - कहावत (A proverb or short statement expressing a general truth)
Absurdity - बेतुकापन (The state of being ridiculous or unreasonable)
Principle - सिद्धांत (A fundamental truth or law)


Hence, 'Absurdity' is the most suitable antonym for 'Axiom'.
questionsEn.source: Selection Post Phase XIII (10th), 02 Aug 2025, Shift 1
oa:
This refers to a statement that is obviously true and says nothing new or interesting. It is a synonym as it describes a self-evident truth, similar to an axiom.
Synonyms: Platitude (घिसी-पिटी बात), Cliché (नयापन रहित), Maxim (कहावत).
Antonyms: Paradox (विरोधाभास), Lie (झूठ), Enigma (पहेली).

This refers to a proverb or short statement expressing a general truth. It is a synonym that describes a traditional principle or rule of conduct.
Synonyms: Proverb (कहावत), Aphorism (सत्यभाषण), Dictum (उक्ति).
Antonyms: Absurdity (मूर्खता), Nonsense (बकवास), Falsehood (असत्य).

This refers to the quality or state of being ridiculous or wildly unreasonable. it is the direct opposite of a fundamental truth or logical principle.
Synonyms: Folly (मूर्खता), Nonsense (बेतुकापन), Preposterousness (असंगति).
Antonyms: Axiom (सिद्धांत), Truth (सत्य), Reason (तर्क).

This refers to a fundamental truth or proposition that serves as the foundation for a system of belief or behavior. It is essentially a synonym for an axiom.
Synonyms: Rule (नियम), Canon (सिद्धांत), Standard (मानक).
Antonyms: Exception (अपवाद), Aberration (विचलन), Violation (उल्लंघन).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Morbid
questionsEn.s:
Morbid - अस्वास्थ्यकर / उदास (Characterized by an unhealthy interest in death)
Cheerful - हंसमुख (Noticeably happy and optimistic)
Grim - विकट (Very serious or gloomy; forbidding)
Gloomy - निराशाजनक (Dark or poorly lit; feeling of despair)
Sickly - अस्वस्थ (Often ill; looking unhealthy)


Hence, 'Cheerful' is the most suitable antonym for 'Morbid'.
questionsEn.source: Selection Post Phase XIII (10th), 02 Aug 2025, Shift 1
oa:
This word describes a person who is noticeably happy and optimistic. it is the perfect antonym for someone who has an unhealthy interest in sad or unpleasant things.
Synonyms: Joyful (हर्षित), Merry (हंसमुख), Blithe (प्रसन्न).
Antonyms: Gloomy (उदास), Morbid (दुखी/अस्वस्थ), Morose (चिड़चिड़ा).

This word refers to something very serious or gloomy, or forbidding in uninviting appearance. It is a synonym that captures the dark nature of the question word.
Synonyms: Stern (सख्त), Harsh (कठोर), Dreadful (भयानक).
Antonyms: Pleasant (सुखद), Amiable (मिलनसार), Bright (प्रसन्न).

This refers to a state of darkness, shadows, or a feeling of despair. It functions as a synonym that describes the sad mental state associated with morbidity.
Synonyms: Somber (उदास), Dismal (निराशाजनक), Melancholy (उदासी).
Antonyms: Sunny (उज्ज्वल), Radiant (चमकदार), Cheerful (खुशमिज़ाज).

This describes someone who is often ill or looking unhealthy. It is a synonym that focuses on the "unhealthy" physical aspect of the word morbid.
Synonyms: Ailing (बीमार), Infirm (कमज़ोर), Wan (पीला/बीमार).
Antonyms: Robust (हट्टा-कट्टा), Healthy (स्वस्थ), Hardy (मज़बूत).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Reverence
questionsEn.s:
Reverence - श्रद्धा (Deep respect for someone or something)
Respect - आदर (A feeling of deep admiration for someone)
Esteem - प्रतिष्ठा (Respect and admiration, typically for a person)
Honor - सम्मान (High respect; great esteem)
Disrespect - अनादर (Lack of respect or courtesy)


Hence, 'Disrespect' is the most suitable antonym for 'Reverence'.
questionsEn.source: Selection Post Phase XIII (10th), 02 Aug 2025, Shift 1
oa:
This word refers to a feeling of deep admiration for someone elicited by their abilities or qualities. It is a direct synonym for the question word.
Synonyms: Esteem (आदर), Admiration (प्रशंसा), Regard (सम्मान).
Antonyms: Contempt (तिरस्कार), Disdain (घृणा), Scorn (तिरस्कार).

This refers to respect and admiration, typically for a person. It is a synonym that describes holding someone in high regard.
Synonyms: Appreciation (सराहना), Valuation (मान देना), Honor (सम्मान).
Antonyms: Disrespect (अनादर), Mockery (उपहास), Discredit (बदनामी).

This word refers to high respect, great esteem, or a privilege that confers distinction. It functions as a strong synonym for the given word.
Synonyms: Prestige (प्रतिष्ठा), Dignity (गरिमा), Recognition (मान्यता).
Antonyms: Shame (शर्म), Dishonor (अपमान), Infamy (बदनामी).

This word refers to a lack of respect or courtesy toward someone or something. it is the direct and most appropriate opposite for reverence.
Synonyms: Insolence (बदतमीज़ी), Impoliteness (अभद्रता), Rudeness (अशिष्टता).
Antonyms: Reverence (श्रद्धा), Courteousness (शिष्टता), Civility (सभ्यता).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Denounce
questionsEn.s:
Denounce - निंदा करना (Publicly declare to be wrong or evil)
Condemn - दोषी ठहराना (Express complete disapproval of)
Accuse - आरोप लगाना (Charge someone with an offense or crime)
Defend - रक्षा करना (Support or protect from criticism or attack)
Blame - दोष देना (Assign responsibility for a fault or wrong)


Hence, 'Defend' is the most suitable antonym for 'Denounce'.
questionsEn.source: Selection Post Phase XIII (10th), 24 Jul 2025, Shift 1
oa:
This means to express complete disapproval of something, typically in public. It is a direct synonym of the question word.
Synonyms: Censure (निंदा करना), Criticize (आलोचना करना), Decry (दोष देना).
Antonyms: Commend (सराहना करना), Applaud (तारीफ़ करना), Praise (प्रशंसा करना).

This means to charge someone with an offense or crime. It is a synonym that describes the act of pointing out a wrongdoing.
Synonyms: Blame (दोष देना), Incriminate (फँसाना), Indict (अभियुक्त बनाना).
Antonyms: Absolve (बरी करना), Exonerate (दोषमुक्त करना), Pardon (क्षमा करना).

This word means to speak or write in favor of something or someone, especially to support it against criticism. It is the direct opposite of publicly attacking or denouncing.
Synonyms: Support (समर्थन करना), Uphold (बनाए रखना), Champion (पक्ष लेना).
Antonyms: Denounce (निंदा करना), Attack (हमला करना), Oppose (विरोध करना).

This word refers to assigning responsibility for a fault or wrong. It acts as a synonym for the negative judgment involved in denouncing.
Synonyms: Reprimand (फटकारना), Fault (दोष निकालना), Chide (डांटना).
Antonyms: Forgive (माफ़ करना), Credit (श्रेय देना), Exculpate (निर्दोष ठहराना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Taciturn
questionsEn.s:
Taciturn - अल्पभाषी (Reserved or uncommunicative in speech; saying little)
Talkative - बातूनी (Fond of or given to talking)
Silent - मौन (Not making or accompanied by any sound)
Reserved - संकोची (Slow to reveal emotion or opinions)
Quiet - शांत (Making little or no noise; saying little)


Hence, 'Talkative' is the most suitable antonym for 'Taciturn'.
questionsEn.source: Selection Post Phase XIII (10th), 24 Jul 2025, Shift 1
oa:
This word describes a person who tends to talk a great deal. It is the direct and most accurate antonym for someone who is reserved or says little.
Synonyms: Loquacious (बातूनी), Garrulous (मुखर), Voluble (वाचाल).
Antonyms: Taciturn (अल्पभाषी), Silent (मौन), Reserved (संकोची).

This refers to someone who is not making or accompanied by any sound. It is a synonym that captures the quiet nature of being taciturn.
Synonyms: Mute (मूक), Still (अचल), Quiet (शांत).
Antonyms: Noisy (शोर वाला), Vocal (मुखर), Talkative (बातूनी).

This describes someone who is slow to reveal emotion or opinions; being uncommunicative. It is an exact synonym for the given word.
Synonyms: Reticent (मितभाषी), Shy (शर्मीला), Withdrawn (अंतर्मुखी).
Antonyms: Outgoing (मिलनसार), Sociable (सामाजिक), Extroverted (बहिर्मुखी).

This refers to making little or no noise or being a person who says little. It acts as a primary synonym for the behavior of a taciturn person.
Synonyms: Soft (धीमा), Peaceful (शांत), Tranquil (स्थिर).
Antonyms: Loud (ज़ोरदार), Boisterous (ऊधमी), Rowdy (उपद्रवी).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Celebrated
questionsEn.s:
Celebrated - प्रसिद्ध (Widely known and praised; renowned)
Famous - मशहूर (Known about by many people)
Inglorious - अपमानजनक (Causing shame or a loss of honor)
Acclaimed - प्रशंसित (Publicly praised; greeted with applause)
Honored - सम्मानित (Regarded with great respect)


Hence, 'Inglorious' is the most suitable antonym for 'Celebrated'.
questionsEn.source: Selection Post Phase XIII (10th), 25 Jul 2025, Shift 1
oa:
This word refers to someone or something widely known and recognized. it is the primary synonym for being celebrated.
Synonyms: Renowned (प्रसिद्ध), Noted (मशहूर), Well-known (विख्यात).
Antonyms: Unknown (अज्ञात), Obscure (गुमनाम), Hidden (छिपा हुआ).

This word refers to something that is causing shame or a loss of honor; not famous. it is the perfect opposite for someone who is honored and celebrated.
Synonyms: Shameful (शर्मनाक), Dishonorable (अपमानजनक), Disgraceful (लज्जास्पद).
Antonyms: Celebrated (प्रसिद्ध), Noble (महान), Distinguished (विशिष्ट).

This refers to something publicly praised or greeted with loud applause. It acts as a strong synonym for being celebrated.
Synonyms: Applauded (सराहा गया), Commended (प्रशंसित), Extolled (महिमामंडित).
Antonyms: Criticized (आलोचित), Denounced (निंदित), Rejected (अस्वीकृत).

This describes someone who is regarded with great respect or high esteem. It is a synonym that matches the positive recognition of the question word.
Synonyms: Respected (सम्मानित), Venerated (पूजनीय), Revered (श्रद्धेय).
Antonyms: Insulted (अपमानित), Disregarded (उपेक्षित), Mocked (उपहासित).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Vivacious
questionsEn.s:
Vivacious - जीवंत (Attractively lively and animated; high-spirited)
Cheerful - प्रसन्न (Noticeably happy and optimistic)
Lively - फुर्तीला (Full of life and energy; active)
Bubbly - उत्साही (Full of cheerful high spirits and energy)
Unattractive - अनाकर्षक (Not pleasing or appealing to look at)


Hence, 'Unattractive' is the most suitable antonym for 'Vivacious'.
questionsEn.source: Selection Post Phase XIII (10th), 25 Jul 2025, Shift 1
oa:
This word describes someone who is noticeably happy and optimistic. It is a direct synonym for the lively and high-spirited nature of being vivacious.
Synonyms: Jubilant (प्रफुल्लित), Jolly (हंसमुख), Mirthful (आनंदपूर्ण).
Antonyms: Gloomy (उदास), Sullen (चिड़चिड़ा), Dejected (हतोत्साहित).

This refers to someone full of life and energy; active and outgoing. It is the primary synonym and definition of the question word.
Synonyms: Animated (सजीव), Sprightly (फुर्तीला), Vibrant (जीवंत).
Antonyms: Lethargic (सुस्त), Sluggish (धीमा), Lifeless (निर्जीव).

This describes a person who is full of cheerful high spirits and energy. It is an informal synonym for being vivacious.
Synonyms: Effervescent (उत्साही), Sparky (चमकदार/फुर्तीला), Gay (प्रसन्न).
Antonyms: Somber (गंभीर), Serious (संजीदा), Quiet (शांत).

This word refers to someone who is not pleasing or appealing to look at. In the context of personality and charm, it is the most suitable opposite for being attractive and full of life (vivacious).
Synonyms: Plain (साधारण), Homely (भद्दा), Unsightly (कुरूप).
Antonyms: Attractive (आकर्षक), Vivacious (मोहक), Beautiful (सुंदर).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Fallacy
questionsEn.s:
Fallacy - भ्रांति (A mistaken belief, especially one based on unsound argument)
Delusion - भ्रम (A false belief maintained despite contradiction)
Mistake - गलती (An action or judgment that is misguided or wrong)
Fiction - कल्पना (Something that is invented or imagined)
Truth - सत्य (The quality or state of being true; reality)


Hence, 'Truth' is the most suitable antonym for 'Fallacy'.
questionsEn.source: Selection Post Phase XIII (10th), 26 Jul 2025, Shift 1
oa:
This refers to an idiosyncratic belief or impression that is firmly maintained despite being contradicted by reality. It is a synonym describing a false mental state.
Synonyms: Hallucination (मृगतृष्णा), Illusion (भ्रम), Misconception (गलतफहमी).
Antonyms: Reality (वास्तविकता), Truth (सच्चाई), Verity (सत्यता).

This refers to an action or judgment that is misguided or wrong. It is a common synonym that describes an error in logic or fact.
Synonyms: Error (चूक), Blunder (बड़ी गलती), Oversight (अनदेखी).
Antonyms: Correctness (शुद्धता), Accuracy (सटीकता), Precision (शुद्धता).

This refers to literature or stories that describe imaginary events and people. It acts as a synonym that describes something not based on true facts.
Synonyms: Myth (पौराणिक कथा), Fabrication (बनावट), Fable (कहानी).
Antonyms: Fact (तथ्य), Non-fiction (वास्तविक साहित्य), History (इतिहास).

This word refers to the quality or state of being true; being in accordance with fact or reality. it is the direct and most appropriate opposite for a fallacy.
Synonyms: Veracity (सत्यता), Fact (हकीकत), Accuracy (शुद्धता).
Antonyms: Fallacy (भ्रांति), Lie (झूठ), Deception (छल).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Venerable
questionsEn.s:
Venerable - पूजनीय (Accorded a great deal of respect, especially because of age)
Respected - आदरणीय (Admired by many for their qualities)
Honored - सम्मानित (Regarded with great respect)
Immature - अपरिपक्व (Not fully developed; lacking emotional maturity)
Elderly - वृद्ध (Old; past middle age)


Hence, 'Immature' is the most suitable antonym for 'Venerable'.
questionsEn.source: Selection Post Phase XIII (10th), 26 Jul 2025, Shift 1
oa:
This word describes someone who is admired by many people for their qualities or achievements. It is a core synonym for being venerable.
Synonyms: Esteemed (आदरणीय), Admired (प्रशंसित), Worthy (लायक).
Antonyms: Despised (तिरस्कृत), Scorned (घृणास्पद), Ignored (उपेक्षित).

This describes someone regarded with great respect or high esteem. It is another direct synonym capturing the dignified nature of the given word.
Synonyms: Revered (श्रद्धेय), Distinguished (विशिष्ट), Glorified (महिमामंडित).
Antonyms: Insulted (अपमानित), Disgraced (कलंकित), Shamed (शर्मसार).

This word describes someone not fully developed or showing lack of wisdom and emotional stability. it is the direct opposite of being old and wise (venerable).
Synonyms: Childish (बचकाना), Callow (अनुभवहीन), Juvenile (किशोर).
Antonyms: Mature (परिपक्व), Venerable (पूजनीय), Wise (बुद्धिमान).

This describes someone who is old. It is a literal synonym, as respect in the context of being venerable often comes with old age.
Synonyms: Aged (वृद्ध), Senior (वरिष्ठ), Ancient (प्राचीन).
Antonyms: Young (युवा), Youthful (तरुण), Adolescent (किशोर).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Eager
questionsEn.s:
Eager - उत्सुक (Wanting to do or have something very much)
Indifferent - उदासीन (Having no particular interest or sympathy)
Keen - उत्साही (Having or showing eagerness or enthusiasm)
Interested - रुचि रखने वाला (Showing curiosity or concern about something)
Enthusiastic - जोशपूर्ण (Having intense and eager enjoyment)


Hence, 'Indifferent' is the most suitable antonym for 'Eager'.
questionsEn.source: Selection Post Phase XIII (10th), 28 Jul 2025, Shift 1
oa:
This word describes a person having no particular interest or sympathy; being unconcerned. It is the direct opposite of being excited or keen about something.
Synonyms: Apathetic (उदासीन), Detached (अलगाव), Uninterested (अरुचि).
Antonyms: Eager (उत्सुक), Passionate (जुनूनी), Keen (उत्सुक).

This refers to having or showing eagerness or enthusiasm. it is the primary synonym for the given word.
Synonyms: Enthusiastic (उत्साही), Avid (लालसा), Intent (दृढ़).
Antonyms: Reluctant (अनिच्छुक), Bored (ऊबा हुआ), Dull (सुस्त).

This describes showing curiosity or concern about something. It functions as a general synonym for being eager.
Synonyms: Curious (जिज्ञासु), Attentive (चौकस), Engaged (संलग्न).
Antonyms: Oblivious (बेखबर), Indifferent (उदासीन), Disinterested (निष्पक्ष/बेखबर).

This word refers to having or showing intense and eager enjoyment, interest, or approval. It is a strong synonym for the given word.
Synonyms: Zealous (उत्साही), Excited (उत्तेजित), Vibrant (जीवंत).
Antonyms: Apathetic (भावहीन), Listless (बेजान), Passive (निष्क्रिय).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Perturbed
questionsEn.s:
Perturbed - व्याकुल (Anxious or unsettled; upset)
Unsettled - अस्थिर (Lacking stability; feeling anxious)
Worried - चिंतित (Feeling anxiety about potential problems)
Anxious - बेचैन (Feeling worried, nervous, or uneasy)
Calm - शांत (Free from agitation or strong emotion)


Hence, 'Calm' is the most suitable antonym for 'Perturbed'.
questionsEn.source: Selection Post Phase XIII (10th), 28 Jul 2025, Shift 1
oa:
This word describes someone or something that is not stable or calm; feeling uneasy. It is a direct synonym that captures the anxious nature of the question word.
Synonyms: Disturbed (परेशान), Restless (बेचैन), Shaken (हिला हुआ).
Antonyms: Settled (स्थिर), Calm (शांत), Secure (सुरक्षित).

This describes feeling or showing anxiety about a problem. It is the core synonym for being perturbed.
Synonyms: Anxious (चिंतित), Apprehensive (शंकित), Troubled (दुखी).
Antonyms: Carefree (निश्चिंत), Confident (आत्मविश्वासी), Serene (शांत).

This refers to feeling worried, nervous, or uneasy, typically about an imminent event. It serves as a synonym that highlights the nervous aspect of being perturbed.
Synonyms: Uneasy (बेचैन), Fretful (चिड़चिड़ा), Edgy (उत्तेजित).
Antonyms: Relaxed (आरामदेह), Peaceful (शांतिपूर्ण), Content (संतुष्ट).

This word refers to a state of being free from agitation, excitement, or worry. It is the direct and most appropriate opposite for being mentally disturbed or perturbed.
Synonyms: Placid (सौम्य), Tranquil (शांत), Unflappable (अविचलित).
Antonyms: Perturbed (व्याकुल), Agitated (उत्तेजित), Frantic (बेचैन).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Glut
questionsEn.s:
Glut - प्रचुरता / भरमार (An excessively abundant supply of something)
Overload - अतिभार (An excessive amount of something)
Satiate - तृप्त करना (Satisfy to the full)
Stuff - ठूँसना (Fill a receptacle tightly with something)
Starve - भूखा रहना (Suffer severely from lack of food)


Hence, 'Starve' is the most suitable antonym for 'Glut'.
questionsEn.source: Selection Post Phase XIII (10th), 29 Aug 2025, Shift 3
oa:
This refers to giving someone or something too much of something. It is a direct synonym that describes an excessive supply or burden.
Synonyms: Surcharge (अधिभार), Surfeit (अत्यधिक), Inundate (बाढ़ की तरह भर देना).
Antonyms: Relieve (राहत देना), Ease (कम करना), Underload (कम भरना).

This word means to satisfy a desire or an appetite to the full. While it involves having enough of something, it describes a state of fulfillment rather than an excessive physical supply, making it a synonym in a broad sense.
Synonyms: Surfeit (अत्यधिक खिलाना), Gorge (जी भर कर खाना), Content (संतुष्ट करना).
Antonyms: Deprive (वंचित करना), Dissatisfy (अतृप्त छोड़ना), Hunger (भूखा रहना).

This refers to the act of filling something tightly or to overflowing. It is a common synonym for the "filling" or "excess" aspect of a glut.
Synonyms: Cram (ठूँसना), Pack (भरना), Fill (भरना).
Antonyms: Empty (खाली करना), Drain (निकालना), Clear (साफ़ करना).

This word means to suffer severely or die from hunger. it is the direct opposite of having a glut (excessive supply), as it implies a total and dangerous lack of essentials.
Synonyms: Famish (भूखा मरना), Perish (नष्ट होना), Deprive (वंचित रखना).
Antonyms: Glut (भरपूर), Feast (दावत), Feed (खिलाना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word which can substitute the given phrase: A person who walks in sleep
questionsEn.s:
A person who walks in sleep - नींद में चलने वाला
Insomniac - अनिद्रा रोगी (A person who is unable to sleep)
Somnambulist - नींद में चलने वाला (A person who walks in their sleep)
Narcoleptic - अचानक सो जाने वाला (A person prone to falling asleep suddenly)
Daydreamer - दिन में सपने देखने वाला (A person who indulges in idle thoughts)


Hence, 'Somnambulist' is the most suitable substitute for 'A person who walks in sleep'.
questionsEn.source: Selection Post Phase XIII (10th), 29 Aug 2025, Shift 3
oa:
This refers to a person who is regularly unable to sleep. While it relates to sleep issues, it describes a lack of sleep rather than physical movement during it.
Synonyms: Sleepless person (नींद न आने वाला), Wakeful (जागृत), Restless (बेचैन).
Antonyms: Heavy sleeper (गहरी नींद सोने वाला), Somnolent (नींद में रहने वाला), Slumberer (सोने वाला).

This is the correct scientific and dictionary term for a person who walks while they are asleep.
Synonyms: Sleepwalker (नींद में चलने वाला), Noctambulist (रात में चलने वाला).
Antonyms: Awake person (जागा हुआ), Conscious (सचेत).

This refers to a person suffering from a condition characterized by an extreme tendency to fall asleep whenever in relaxing surroundings. It is a sleep disorder, but different from walking in sleep.
Synonyms: Drowsy person (ऊंघने वाला), Somnolent (नींद में), Lethargic (सुस्त).
Antonyms: Alert (सतर्क), Insomniac (नींद न आने वाला), Awake (सचेत).

This describes a person who indulges in idle or pleasant thoughts while awake. It is a metaphorical "sleep" state, but not the physical condition described.
Synonyms: Visionary (स्वप्नद्रष्टा), Fantasist (कल्पनाशील), Idler (आलसी).
Antonyms: Realist (यथार्थवादी), Pragmatist (व्यावहारिक), Doer (कर्ता).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Harass
questionsEn.s:
Harass - परेशान करना (Subject to aggressive pressure or intimidation)
Annoy - चिढ़ाना (Make someone slightly angry; irritate)
Comfort - दिलासा देना (A state of physical ease and freedom from pain)
Disturb - बाधा डालना (Interfere with the normal arrangement of)
Irritate - जलन पैदा करना (Make someone annoyed, impatient, or angry)


Hence, 'Comfort' is the most suitable antonym for 'Harass'.
questionsEn.source: Selection Post Phase XIII (10th), 29 Jul 2025, Shift 1
oa:
This word means to make someone slightly angry; to irritate. it is a direct synonym that captures the irritating nature of the question word.
Synonyms: Vex (परेशान करना), Irk (चिढ़ाना), Bother (तंग करना).
Antonyms: Please (खुश करना), Gratify (संतुष्ट करना), Comfort (दिलासा देना).

This word means to provide consolation or to make someone feel less unhappy. it is the most appropriate opposite for someone who is being harassed or bothered.
Synonyms: Soothe (शांत करना), Solace (दिलासा), Console (ढांढस बंधाना).
Antonyms: Harass (परेशान करना), Torment (यातना देना), Distressed (दुखी).

This refers to the act of interfering with the normal arrangement or functioning of something; to bother. It is a synonym that describes an interruption of peace.
Synonyms: Disrupt (बाधा डालना), Upset (परेशान करना), Agitate (उत्तेजित करना).
Antonyms: Order (व्यवस्थित करना), Settle (स्थिर करना), Calm (शांत करना).

This means to make someone annoyed, impatient, or slightly angry. It is contextually synonymous with the act of harassment.
Synonyms: Exasperate (गुस्सा दिलाना), Provoke (उकसाना), Aggravate (बढ़ाना).
Antonyms: Soothe (शांत करना), Allay (कम करना), Molify (शांत करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Jovial
questionsEn.s:
Jovial - उल्लासपूर्ण (Cheerful and friendly)
Morose - चिड़चिड़ा (Sullen and ill-tempered)
Cheerful - प्रसन्न (Noticeably happy and optimistic)
Happy - खुश (Feeling or showing pleasure or contentment)
Joyful - आनंदपूर्ण (Feeling, expressing, or causing great pleasure)


Hence, 'Morose' is the most suitable antonym for 'Jovial'.
questionsEn.source: Selection Post Phase XIII (10th), 29 Jul 2025, Shift 1
oa:
This word describes a person who is sullen and ill-tempered. It is the perfect opposite for someone who is cheerful and friendly.
Synonyms: Sullen (चिड़चिड़ा), Gloomy (उदास), Glum (खिन्न).
Antonyms: Jovial (प्रफुल्लित), Cheerful (हंसमुख), Lively (जीवंत).

This describes someone who is noticeably happy and optimistic. it is the primary synonym for the question word.
Synonyms: Jolly (हंसमुख), Merry (खुशहाल), Blithe (प्रसन्न).
Antonyms: Depressed (उदास), Miserable (दुखी), Sad (दुखी).

This refers to feeling or showing pleasure or contentment. It is a fundamental synonym for being jovial.
Synonyms: Content (संतुष्ट), Glad (प्रसन्न), Delighted (प्रसन्न).
Antonyms: Unhappy (नाखुश), Sorrowful (शोकाकुल), Melancholy (उदास).

This word refers to feeling, expressing, or causing great pleasure and happiness. It functions as an exact synonym for the cheerful nature of the given word.
Synonyms: Jubilant (उल्लसित), Ecstatic (अति प्रसन्न), Rapturous (आनंदमयी).
Antonyms: Mournful (शोकपूर्ण), Doleful (दुखद), Heartbroken (दुखी).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Barren
questionsEn.s:
Barren - बंजर (Too poor to produce much or any vegetation)
Sterile - बाँझ (Not able to produce children or crops)
Fertile - उपजाऊ (Capable of producing abundant vegetation or crops)
Dry - सूखा (Free from moisture or liquid; lacking rain)
Deserted - वीरान (Empty of people; abandoned)


Hence, 'Fertile' is the most suitable antonym for 'Barren'.
questionsEn.source: Selection Post Phase XIII (10th), 30 Jul 2025, Shift 1
oa:
This word refers to something that is not able to produce children or young; also used for land that lacks vegetation. It is a direct synonym of the question word.
Synonyms: Infertile (बाँझ), Fruitless (निष्फल), Arid (बंजर).
Antonyms: Fertile (उपजाऊ), Fruitful (फलदायक), Productive (उत्पादक).

This word refers to land or soil that is capable of producing abundant vegetation or crops. it is the direct and most accurate antonym for barren land.
Synonyms: Fruitful (फलदायी), Productive (उत्पादक), Fecund (उपजाऊ).
Antonyms: Barren (बंजर), Sterile (अनुत्पादक), Desolate (वीरान).

This refers to something free from moisture or liquid; lacking rainfall. While dry land is often barren, this word describes the moisture level rather than the ability to produce, making it a contextual synonym.
Synonyms: Parched (झुलसा हुआ), Arid (शुष्क), Dehydrated (निर्जलित).
Antonyms: Wet (गीला), Damp (नम), Humid (आर्द्र).

This word refers to a place that is empty of people; abandoned. While barren places are often deserted, this word focuses on the lack of inhabitants rather than agricultural productivity.
Synonyms: Abandoned (परित्यक्त), Forsaken (छोड़ा हुआ), Vacant (खाली).
Antonyms: Populated (आबाद), Crowded (भीड़भाड़ वाला), Inhabited (बसा हुआ).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Insipid
questionsEn.s:
Insipid - फीका (Lacking flavor; weak or tasteless)
Tasteless - बेस्वाद (Lacking flavor; not pleasing to the palate)
Dull - नीरस (Lacking interest or excitement; boring)
Vapid - बेजान (Offering nothing that is stimulating or challenging)
Appetizing - भूख बढ़ाने वाला (Stimulating to the appetite; appealing)


Hence, 'Appetizing' is the most suitable antonym for 'Insipid'.
questionsEn.source: Selection Post Phase XIII (10th), 30 Jul 2025, Shift 1
oa:
This refers to something lacking flavor. it is the primary synonym for the question word when applied to food or drink.
Synonyms: Bland (फीका), Flavorless (बेस्वाद), Vapid (नीरस).
Antonyms: Savory (ज़ायकेदार), Tasty (स्वादिष्ट), Piquant (चटपटा).

This word describes something that is lacking interest or excitement; boring. It is a figurative synonym for "insipid" when describing a person or a conversation.
Synonyms: Tedious (थकाऊ), Humdrum (नीरस), Uninspiring (प्रेरणाहीन).
Antonyms: Exciting (रोमांचक), Vibrant (जीवंत), Interesting (दिलचस्प).

This word refers to something that is offering nothing that is stimulating or challenging; being flat. It is a sophisticated synonym for being insipid.
Synonyms: Inane (बेतुका), Characterless (गुणहीन), Spiritless (बेजान).
Antonyms: Zesty (ज़ायकेदार), Animated (सजीव), Piquant (तीखा).

This word refers to something, especially food, that is stimulating to the appetite; being appealing or tasty. it is the perfect antonym for something that is bland or insipid.
Synonyms: Tempting (मोहक), Mouth-watering (ललचाने वाला), Savory (स्वादिष्ट).
Antonyms: Repulsive (अरुचिकर), Unpalatable (बेस्वाद), Insipid (फीका).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Veracity
questionsEn.s:
Veracity - सत्यता (Conformity to facts; accuracy; truthfulness)
Falsehood - असत्य (The state of being untrue; a lie)
Accuracy - शुद्धता (The quality or state of being correct or precise)
Truthfulness - सच्चाई (The quality of being honest and not telling lies)
Honesty - ईमानदारी (The quality of being honest and sincere)


Hence, 'Falsehood' is the most suitable antonym for 'Veracity'.
oa:
This word refers to the state of being untrue or a lie. It is the direct and most accurate antonym for being truthful or having veracity.
Synonyms: Deception (धोखा), Untruth (असत्य), Fabrication (बनावट).
Antonyms: Veracity (सत्यता), Truth (सच्चाई), Accuracy (शुद्धता).

This word refers to the quality or state of being correct or precise. It is a synonym that captures the "truthfulness" of information.
Synonyms: Exactness (सटीकता), Precision (शुद्धता), Correctness (शुद्धता).
Antonyms: Inaccuracy (अशुद्धि), Error (चूक), Faultiness (दोष).

This refers to the quality of being honest and not telling lies. It is a direct and common synonym for the question word.
Synonyms: Honesty (ईमानदारी), Sincerity (सच्चाई), Candor (स्पष्टवादिता).
Antonyms: Dishonesty (बेईमानी), Mendacity (झूठ), Deceit (छल).

This refers to the quality of being honest; free of deceit and untruthfulness. It is a foundational synonym for veracity.
Synonyms: Integrity (अखंडता), Probity (शुद्धता), Rectitude (नैतिकता).
Antonyms: Duplicity (दोगलापन), Guile (धूर्तता), Fraud (धोखा).

test.instructions: Standard CBT Pattern Exam. Positive Marks: +1, Negative Marks: -1. Total Questions: 50.

test.title: Set - 7

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Oracular
questionsEn.s:
Oracular - रहस्यमय (Ambiguous or obscure; hard to interpret)
Lucid - स्पष्ट (Easy to understand; clearly expressed)
Impress - प्रभावित करना (To make someone feel admiration)
Anxious - चिंतित (Feeling worried or uneasy)
Idealistic - आदर्शवादी (Guided by high principles)


Hence, 'Lucid' is the most suitable antonym for 'Oracular'.
oa:
This word refers to something that is expressed clearly and is easy to understand. It serves as the direct opposite of being oracular, which implies being mysterious, ambiguous, or difficult to interpret like an ancient prophecy.
Synonyms: Clear (स्पष्ट), Intelligible (बोधगम्य), Transparent (पारदर्शी).
Antonyms: Vague (अस्पष्ट), Ambiguous (अस्पष्ट), Cryptic (गुप्त).

This verb means to make someone feel admiration or respect. While it describes a strong effect on the mind, it has no direct logical connection to the clarity or mystery of a statement and thus does not fit the required relationship.
Synonyms: Influence (प्रभावित करना), Affect (असर डालना), Dazzle (चकाचौंध करना).
Antonyms: Bore (ऊबा देना), Disappoint (निराश करना), Repel (अरुचि पैदा करना).

This word describes a state of feeling worried, nervous, or uneasy about something with an uncertain outcome. It relates to a person’s emotional state rather than the clarity of a message or prophecy.
Synonyms: Worried (चिंतित), Apprehensive (शंकित), Uneasy (बेचैन).
Antonyms: Calm (शांत), Confident (आत्मविश्वासी), Serene (निर्मल).

This term refers to the pursuit of high or noble principles and goals, often in an unrealistic way. Although it describes a way of thinking, it does not provide an antonym for the enigmatic nature of the given word.
Synonyms: Utopian (आदर्शवादी), Romantic (काल्पनिक), Visionary (स्वप्नद्रष्टा).
Antonyms: Pragmatic (व्यावहारिक), Realistic (यथार्थवादी), Cynical (कुटिल).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Peevish
questionsEn.s:
Peevish - चिड़चिड़ा (Easily irritated, especially by unimportant things)
Suave - शिष्ट / सौम्य (Charming, confident, and elegant)
Flat - सपाट (Level and even; lacking emotion)
Tedious - उबाऊ (Too long, slow, or dull)
Dull - मंद (Lacking interest or excitement)


Hence, 'Suave' is the most suitable antonym for 'Peevish'.
oa:
This word describes a person who is charming, confident, and elegant, typically in a smooth and polite way. It is the most suitable opposite for being peevish, which involves being easily irritated by unimportant things.
Synonyms: Sophisticated (सुसंस्कृत), Urbane (शिष्ट), Debonair (खुशमिजाज).
Antonyms: Rude (अशिष्ट), Gauche (फूहड़), Uncouth (गंवार).

This word describes something that is level and even without any raised parts, or something lacking in interest or emotion. It does not address the irritable temperament implied by the given word.
Synonyms: Level (समतल), Dull (नीरस), Insipid (बेस्वाद).
Antonyms: Uneven (असमान), Sharp (तेज), Interesting (दिलचस्प).

This refers to something that is too long, slow, or dull, causing boredom or tiredness. It is more related to the nature of a task rather than the irritability of a person's character.
Synonyms: Boring (उबाऊ), Monotonous (नीरस), Wearisome (थकाऊ).
Antonyms: Exciting (रोमांचक), Interesting (दिलचस्प), Engaging (मोहक).

This word describes someone or something that lacks interest, brightness, or intelligence. While it conveys a negative trait, it does not specifically contrast with being fretful or easily annoyed.
Synonyms: Drab (फीका), Lusterless (चमकहीन), Stupid (मंदबुद्धि).
Antonyms: Bright (चमकीला), Intelligent (बुद्धिमान), Sharp (तेज).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Slander
questionsEn.s:
Slander - बदनामी (The action of making a false spoken statement)
Mock - उपहास करना (Tease or laugh at in a scornful way)
Praise - प्रशंसा करना (Expression of approval or admiration)
Blame - दोष देना (Assign responsibility for a wrong)
Abuse - दुरुपयोग / गाली (Cruel treatment or insulting language)


Hence, 'Praise' is the most suitable antonym for 'Slander'.
oa:
This word refers to teasing or making fun of someone in a contemptuous or unkind manner. Since it is also a negative action aimed at damaging someone's dignity, it acts more as a relative term than an opposite.
Synonyms: Ridicule (उपहास करना), Deride (मजाक उड़ाना), Taunt (ताना मारना).
Antonyms: Praise (प्रशंसा करना), Respect (आदर करना), Flatter (चापलूसी करना).

This word means to express warm approval or admiration for someone or something. It is the direct opposite of slander, which involves making false and damaging statements about someone.
Synonyms: Commend (सराहना करना), Laud (गुणगान करना), Extol (प्रशंसा करना).
Antonyms: Criticize (आलोचना करना), Slander (निंदा करना), Vilify (बदनाम करना).

This refers to assigning responsibility for a fault or wrong. While it involves a negative judgment, it focuses on accountability rather than the act of making false statements to ruin a reputation.
Synonyms: Accuse (दोष देना), Reprimand (फटकारना), Censure (निंदा करना).
Antonyms: Forgive (माफ करना), Exonerate (दोषमुक्त करना), Commend (सराहना करना).

This word involves using something to bad effect or for a bad purpose, or treating someone with cruelty. It aligns with the harmful nature of slander rather than providing a contrasting meaning.
Synonyms: Mistreat (दुर्व्यवहार करना), Misuse (दुरुपयोग करना), Insult (अपमान करना).
Antonyms: Protect (रक्षा करना), Honor (सम्मान करना), Cherish (संजोना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Pompous
questionsEn.s:
Pompous - आडंबरपूर्ण (Affectedly grand, solemn, or self-important)
Submissive - विनम्र / आज्ञाकारी (Ready to conform to the will of others)
Energy - ऊर्जा (Strength and vitality for activity)
Urgency - तात्कालिकता (Requirement of immediate action)
Delight - आनंद (Great pleasure or satisfaction)


Hence, 'Submissive' is the most suitable antonym for 'Pompous'.
oa:
This word describes a person who is ready to conform to the authority or will of others; being meekly obedient or humble. It functions as an effective antonym for someone who is self-important or arrogant.
Synonyms: Humble (विनम्र), Meek (दब्बू), Yielding (झुकने वाला).
Antonyms: Arrogant (अहंकारी), Dominant (प्रभावी), Assertive (मुखर).

This is a noun referring to the strength and vitality required for sustained physical or mental activity. It describes a physical or mental state rather than a personality trait related to arrogance or humility.
Synonyms: Vigor (ऊर्जा), Vitality (शक्ति), Spirit (जोश).
Antonyms: Lethargy (सुस्ती), Apathy (उदासीनता), Weakness (कमजोरी).

This refers to the state of requiring immediate action or attention. Its meaning relates to the time-sensitive nature of a situation and has no relevance to the display of self-importance.
Synonyms: Importance (महत्व), Necessity (अनिवार्यता), Exigency (अति आवश्यकता).
Antonyms: Triviality (तुच्छता), Leisure (विश्राम), Delay (देरी).

This refers to a high degree of gratification or pleasure. While it is a positive emotion, it does not serve as a logical opposite for the characteristic of being pretentious or showy.
Synonyms: Joy (आनंद), Happiness (खुशी), Glee (उल्लास).
Antonyms: Misery (कष्ट), Sorrow (दुख), Disgust (घृणा).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Vindicate
questionsEn.s:
Vindicate - सही साबित करना (Clear of blame or suspicion; prove right)
Exonerate - दोषमुक्त करना (Absolve someone from blame or fault)
Accuse - आरोप लगाना (Charge with an offense or crime)
Defend - रक्षा करना (Protect from harm or criticism)
Justify - औचित्य सिद्ध करना (Show or prove to be right or reasonable)


Hence, 'Accuse' is the most suitable antonym for 'Vindicate'.
oa:
This means to absolve someone from blame or a fault, especially after a formal investigation. It is a synonym of the question word, as both involve clearing someone of wrongdoing.
Synonyms: Acquit (बरी करना), Absolve (दोषमुक्त करना), Clear (दोषमुक्त करना).
Antonyms: Convict (दोषी ठहराना), Blame (दोष देना), Condemn (निंदा करना).

This word means to charge someone with an offense or a crime. It is the direct opposite of vindicating, which involves proving someone is right or clearing them of charges.
Synonyms: Charge (आरोप लगाना), Implicate (फँसाना), Indict (अभियुक्त बनाना).
Antonyms: Vindicate (सही सिद्ध करना), Absolve (बरी करना), Defend (रक्षा करना).

This refers to the act of protecting someone or something from harm or criticism. While it is the action one takes to achieve vindication, it is not the logical opposite.
Synonyms: Guard (रक्षा करना), Protect (बचाना), Shield (ढाल बनना).
Antonyms: Attack (हमला करना), Abandon (छोड़ देना), Surrender (समर्पण करना).

This word means to show or prove that something is right, reasonable, or warranted. It serves as a near-perfect synonym for the "prove right" aspect of vindication.
Synonyms: Warrant (औचित्य बताना), Validate (मान्य करना), Substantiate (पुष्टि करना).
Antonyms: Invalidate (अमान्य करना), Deny (नकारना), Refute (खंडन करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Affluent
questionsEn.s:
Affluent - समृद्ध (Having a great deal of money; wealthy)
Wealthy - धनवान (Having a lot of money or assets)
Rich - अमीर (Having a great deal of money)
Destitute - अत्यंत गरीब (Extremely poor and lacking necessities)
Prosperous - संपन्न (Successful in material terms; flourishing)


Hence, 'Destitute' is the most suitable antonym for 'Affluent'.
oa:
This word describes a person who has a great deal of money, resources, or assets. It is a direct synonym for affluent and therefore cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Rich (अमीर), Moneyed (धनवान), Prosperous (संपन्न).
Antonyms: Poor (गरीब), Needy (ज़रूरतमंद), Destitute (बेसहारा).

This is a common term for having a lot of money or possessions. Since it perfectly matches the meaning of being affluent, it does not fulfill the antonym requirement.
Synonyms: Well-off (सुखी-संपन्न), Opulent (धनी), Loaded (मालामाल).
Antonyms: Impoverished (कंगाल), Penniless (दरिद्र), Broke (पैसे न होना).

This word refers to a person who is without the basic necessities of life and has no money. it is the direct and most appropriate opposite for being affluent or wealthy.
Synonyms: Poverty-stricken (गरीबी से त्रस्त), Indigent (निर्धन), Penniless (कंगाल).
Antonyms: Affluent (समृद्ध), Wealthy (धनी), Rich (अमीर).

This word describes someone who is successful in material terms; flourishing financially. It is synonymous with the state of being affluent and successful.
Synonyms: Thriving (फलने-फूलने वाला), Successful (कामयाब), Flourishing (उन्नत).
Antonyms: Failing (असफल), Poor (गरीब), Bankrupt (दिवालिया).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Commend
questionsEn.s:
Commend - सराहना करना (Praise formally or officially)
Praise - प्रशंसा करना (Express warm approval or admiration)
Approve - मंज़ूरी देना (Believe that something is good or acceptable)
Criticize - आलोचना करना (Indicate the faults in a disapproving way)
Applaud - प्रशंसा करना / तालियाँ बजाना (Show approval of someone by clapping)


Hence, 'Criticize' is the most suitable antonym for 'Commend'.
oa:
This word refers to expressing warm approval or admiration for someone's achievements or qualities. It is the primary synonym for the question word.
Synonyms: Applaud (सराहना), Extol (गुणगान करना), Laud (प्रशंसा करना).
Antonyms: Criticize (आलोचना करना), Condemn (निंदा करना), Censure (फटकारना).

This refers to believing that someone or something is good or acceptable. While related, it describes an internal judgment that leads to the act of commending.
Synonyms: Sanction (मंजूरी देना), Endorse (समर्थन करना), Ratify (पुष्टि करना).
Antonyms: Reject (अस्वीकार करना), Oppose (विरोध करना), Disallow (मना करना).

This word means to indicate the faults of someone or something in a disapproving way. It is the most appropriate opposite for commending or praising someone.
Synonyms: Censure (निंदा करना), Blame (दोष देना), Condemn (तिरस्कार करना).
Antonyms: Praise (प्रशंसा करना), Commend (सराहना करना), Compliment (तारीफ़ करना).

This refers to showing approval of someone by clapping one's hands or by praising them highly. It serves as a direct synonym for the act of commending.
Synonyms: Cheer (प्रोत्साहित करना), Hail (जयकार करना), Commend (बधाई देना).
Antonyms: Boo (अनादर करना), Hiss (तिरस्कार करना), Ridicule (मजाक उड़ाना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Wilt
questionsEn.s:
Wilt - मुरझाना (Become limp through loss of water or heat)
Cruel - निर्दयी (Willfully causing pain or suffering)
Merciless - बेदर्द (Showing no mercy or pity)
Revive - पुनर्जीवित करना (Restore to life or consciousness; regain vigor)
Strict - सख्त (Demanding that rules are obeyed and observed)


Hence, 'Revive' is the most suitable antonym for 'Wilt'.
oa:
This word describes a person or action that willfully causes pain or suffering to others. It is a personality trait that has no connection with the drooping or withering process of a plant.
Synonyms: Brutal (क्रूर), Vicious (दुष्ट), Heartless (निर्दयी).
Antonyms: Kind (दयालु), Compassionate (सहानुभूतिपूर्ण), Humane (मानवीय).

This refers to showing no mercy or pity. Like the previous option, it describes a harsh character trait and does not provide an antonym for the physical process of wilting.
Synonyms: Ruthless (बेदर्द), Pitiless (निष्ठुर), Relentless (कठोर).
Antonyms: Merciful (दयालु), Forgiving (क्षमाशील), Lenient (उदार).

This word means to restore to life, consciousness, or vigor, especially after drooping or fading. it is the direct and most suitable opposite for wilting or withering.
Synonyms: Rejuvenate (पुनर्जीवित करना), Refresh (ताज़ा करना), Resuscitate (होश में लाना).
Antonyms: Wilt (मुरझाना), Wither (कुम्हलाना), Faint (बेहोश होना).

This describes someone who demands that rules concerning behavior are obeyed and observed. It is contextually unrelated to the biological or physical act of losing freshness.
Synonyms: Rigid (कठोर), Stern (सख्त), Stringent (कड़ा).
Antonyms: Lenient (उदार), Flexible (लचीला), Easygoing (नरम).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Quell
questionsEn.s:
Quell - शांत करना / दबाना (Put an end to, typically by the use of force)
Suppress - दमन करना (Forcibly put an end to something)
Calm - शांत (Not showing or feeling nervousness or anger)
Silence - चुप कराना (Cause someone to become silent)
Agitate - उत्तेजित करना (Make someone troubled or nervous)


Hence, 'Agitate' is the most suitable antonym for 'Quell'.
oa:
This means to forcibly put an end to something, like a rebellion or a feeling. it is a direct synonym for quell as both involve stopping an activity by force.
Synonyms: Subdue (दबाना), Quash (कुचलना), Silence (चुप करना).
Antonyms: Incite (उकसाना), Provoke (भड़काना), Encourage (प्रोत्साहित करना).

This refers to making someone or something free from agitation or strong emotion. It matches the "quieten" aspect of the given word, thus acting as a synonym.
Synonyms: Soothe (शांत करना), Pacify (शांत करना), Allay (कम करना).
Antonyms: Agitate (उत्तेजित करना), Disturb (परेशान करना), Exasperate (क्रोध दिलाना).

This means to cause someone to stop speaking or making noise, often through force or authority. It captures a specific result of quelling, making it a synonym.
Synonyms: Muffle (दबाना), Quiet (शांत करना), Stifle (गला घोंटना/दबाना).
Antonyms: Amplify (बढ़ाना), Loud (ज़ोर से बोलना), Express (प्रकट करना).

This word means to stir up, disturb, or provoke trouble or nervousness. it is the direct antonym of quelling or suppressing a situation.
Synonyms: Provoke (भड़काना), Incite (उकसाना), Fluster (घबराना).
Antonyms: Calm (शांत करना), Quell (दबाना), Pacify (मनाना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Tangible
questionsEn.s:
Tangible - वास्तविक / स्पर्शनीय (Perceptible by touch; clear and definite)
Invisible - अदृश्य (Unable to be seen)
Real - असली (Actually existing as a thing or occurring in fact)
Intangible - अमूर्त (Unable to be touched or grasped; not having physical presence)
Definite - निश्चित (Clearly stated or decided; not vague or doubtful)


Hence, 'Intangible' is the most suitable antonym for 'Tangible'.
oa:
This word describes something that cannot be seen by the eye. While related to perception, something can be invisible but still tangible (like wind or a gas, in a very broad sense, or a dark object). It is not the precise opposite.
Synonyms: Hidden (अदृश्य), Unseen (अज्ञात), Imperceptible (अगोचर).
Antonyms: Visible (दृश्य), Apparent (प्रकट), Conspicuous (सुस्पष्ट).

This refers to something that actually exists as a thing or occurs in fact. Since tangible things are inherently real, this word serves as a synonym.
Synonyms: Actual (वास्तविक), Concrete (ठोस), Authentic (प्रामाणिक).
Antonyms: Fake (बनावटी), Imaginary (काल्पनिक), Unreal (असली नहीं).

This word refers to something that is unable to be touched or grasped; not having a physical presence. It is the direct and most accurate antonym for tangible.
Synonyms: Abstract (अमूर्त), Ethereal (अलोकिक), Impalpable (अस्पर्शनीय).
Antonyms: Tangible (ठोस), Concrete (वास्तविक), Material (भौतिक).

This describes something clearly stated or decided; not vague or doubtful. It relates to the clarity of an idea rather than its physical touchability.
Synonyms: Certain (निश्चित), Clear (स्पष्ट), Specific (विशिष्ट).
Antonyms: Vague (अस्पष्ट), Indefinite (अनिश्चित), Ambiguous (दोअर्थी).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Magnanimous
questionsEn.s:
Magnanimous - उदार (Very generous or forgiving, especially toward a rival)
Noble - महान (Having or showing fine personal qualities)
Petty - तुच्छ / संकीर्ण (Of little importance; small-minded)
Forgiving - क्षमाशील (Ready to forgive; stop feeling angry at someone)
Generous - दानी (Willing to give money or help freely)


Hence, 'Petty' is the most suitable antonym for 'Magnanimous'.
oa:
This word refers to having or showing fine personal qualities or high moral principles. Since it captures the virtuous essence of being magnanimous, it is a synonym.
Synonyms: Virtuous (सदाचारी), Dignified (गरिमापूर्ण), Illustrious (शानदार).
Antonyms: Ignoble (नीच), Base (अधम), Shameless (निर्लज्ज).

This word describes someone who is unduly concerned with trivial matters, especially in a small-minded or spiteful way. It is the direct antonym for being noble and generous.
Synonyms: Small-minded (संकीर्ण), Mean (नीच), Spiteful (द्वेषपूर्ण).
Antonyms: Magnanimous (उदार), Broad-minded (उदार), Generous (दानी).

This refers to the act of stopping feeling angry or resentful toward someone for an offense. It is a key attribute of a magnanimous person, thus serving as a synonym.
Synonyms: Merciful (दयालु), Lenient (उदार), Compassionate (सहानुभूतिपूर्ण).
Antonyms: Vengeful (प्रतिशोधी), Unforgiving (बेदर्द), Spiteful (द्वेषी).

This word describes a person who is willing to give money, help, or kindness freely. It is a direct synonym that expresses the core meaning of being magnanimous.
Synonyms: Bountiful (प्रचुर), Benevolent (परोपकारी), Philanthropic (दानशील).
Antonyms: Stingy (कंजूस), Greedy (लालची), Selfish (स्वार्थी).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Construct
questionsEn.s:
Construct - निर्माण करना (Build or erect something; make by combining parts)
Create - रचना करना (Bring something into existence)
After - के बाद (Following in time, place, or order)
Hide - छिपाना (Put or keep out of sight; conceal)
Destroy - नष्ट करना (Put an end to the existence of by damaging it)


Hence, 'Destroy' is the most suitable antonym for 'Construct'.
oa:
This means to bring something into existence. Since building and creating are essentially the same act, this word serves as a synonym.
Synonyms: Found (नींव रखना), Establish (बसाना), Invent (आविष्कार करना).
Antonyms: Destroy (नष्ट करना), Demolish (ध्वस्त करना), Erase (मिटाना).

This is a preposition or adverb referring to a time following an event. It relates to chronological sequence and has no connection with building or destroying structures.
Synonyms: Subsequent (बाद का), Following (अगला), Later (बाद में).
Antonyms: Before (पहले), Previous (पिछला), Prior (पूर्व).

This means to put or keep out of sight; to conceal. While one might hide a constructed object, the word itself is not an antonym for the act of building.
Synonyms: Conceal (छिपाना), Cover (ढंकना), Camouflage (भेष बदलना).
Antonyms: Reveal (प्रकट करना), Show (दिखाना), Expose (उजागर करना).

This word means to end the existence of something by damaging or attacking it. it is the direct and most appropriate opposite of constructing or building.
Synonyms: Demolish (ध्वस्त करना), Ruin (बर्बाद करना), Wreck (तबाह करना).
Antonyms: Construct (बनाना), Build (निर्माण करना), Restore (सुधारना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Impute
questionsEn.s:
Impute - आरोप लगाना (Represent something, especially something undesirable, as being done or possessed by someone)
Support - समर्थन करना (Give assistance to; enable to function)
Energetic - ऊर्जावान (Showing or involving great activity or vitality)
Cheerful - हँसमुख (Noticeably happy and optimistic)
Lively - सजीव (Full of life and energy; active and outgoing)


Hence, 'Support' is the most suitable antonym for 'Impute'.
oa:
This word means to give assistance to, or to back a person or a cause. In a legal or moral context, while imputing involves assigning guilt, supporting involves backing someone up, providing a contextual opposite.
Synonyms: Back (समर्थन देना), Assist (सहायता करना), Uphold (कायम रखना).
Antonyms: Oppose (विरोध करना), Deny (नकारना), Impute (दोष मढ़ना).

This word describes a person showing or involving great activity or vitality. It relates to energy levels and physical movement, having no relation to the act of assigning blame.
Synonyms: Vigorous (ऊर्जावान), Lively (जीवंत), Active (सक्रिय).
Antonyms: Lethargic (सुस्त), Lazy (आलसी), Weak (कमजोर).

This describes a state of being noticeably happy and optimistic. It describes a person's mood rather than the act of attributing a fault to someone.
Synonyms: Jolly (हंसमुख), Joyful (आनंदित), Merry (प्रसन्न).
Antonyms: Gloomy (उदास), Sad (दुखी), Morose (चिड़चिड़ा).

This refers to someone full of life and energy; active and outgoing. Similar to "energetic," it describes a personality type or physical state rather than a verbal or judicial action.
Synonyms: Animated (सजीव), Spirited (जोशपूर्ण), Vivacious (जिंदादिल).
Antonyms: Listless (बेजान), Lifeless (निर्जीव), Quiet (शांत).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Meticulous
questionsEn.s:
Meticulous - अति सावधान (Showing great attention to detail; very careful)
Negligent - लापरवाह (Failing to take proper care in doing something)
Thorough - पूर्ण / विस्तृत (Complete with regard to every detail)
Precise - सटीक (Marked by exactness and accuracy of expression)
Careful - सावधान (Avoiding potential danger, mishap, or error)


Hence, 'Negligent' is the most suitable antonym for 'Meticulous'.
oa:
This word describes a person who fails to take proper care in doing something. It is the perfect opposite for someone who is extremely careful and precise about details.
Synonyms: Careless (लापरवाह), Lax (ढीला-ढाला), Remiss (असावधान).
Antonyms: Careful (सावधान), Meticulous (सूक्ष्म), Diligent (परिश्रमी).

This refers to doing something with great care and with completeness. It is a direct synonym for the given word, as both imply attention to every detail.
Synonyms: Exhaustive (विस्तृत), Rigorous (सख्त/गहन), In-depth (गहराई से).
Antonyms: Superficial (सतही), Cursory (सरसरी), Careless (लापरवाह).

This word describes something marked by accuracy and exactness. It matches the "careful" nature of the question word and acts as a synonym.
Synonyms: Exact (सटीक), Accurate (सही), Detailed (विशिष्ट).
Antonyms: Vague (अस्पष्ट), Inexact (ग़लत), Loose (ढीला).

This is a general term for making sure of avoiding potential danger, mishap, or error. Since it is the defining trait of being meticulous, it is a synonym.
Synonyms: Wary (सजग), Attentive (चौकस), Vigilant (चौकन्ना).
Antonyms: Reckless (लापरवाह), Rash (जल्दबाज़), Heedless (असावधान).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Imitate
questionsEn.s:
Imitate - नकल करना (Copy or simulate a person or thing)
Replicate - दोहराना (Make an exact copy of; reproduce)
Copy - प्रतिलिपि (A thing made to be similar or identical to another)
Innovate - नया करना (Make changes in something established; introduce new ideas)
Echo - गूँज (A sound or series of sounds caused by reflection; repeat)


Hence, 'Innovate' is the most suitable antonym for 'Imitate'.
oa:
This word means to make an exact copy of something or to reproduce it. It is a technical synonym for the general act of imitating.
Synonyms: Duplicate (नकल करना), Reproduce (पुनरुत्पादित करना), Copy (प्रतिलिपि बनाना).
Antonyms: Original (असली), Unique (अनोखा), Vary (बदलना).

This is the most common term for doing something in the same way as someone else. Since it is the literal definition of imitate, it cannot be the antonym.
Synonyms: Mimic (नकल उतारना), Ape (बंदर की तरह नकल करना), Follow (अनुकरण करना).
Antonyms: Lead (नेतृत्व करना), Innovate (नया करना), Create (बनाना).

This word means to make changes in something established, especially by introducing new methods, ideas, or products. it is the direct opposite of just copying or imitating.
Synonyms: Originate (शुरुआत करना), Invent (आविष्कार करना), Pioneer (मार्ग प्रशस्त करना).
Antonyms: Imitate (नकल करना), Copy (अनुकरण करना), Follow (पीछे चलना).

This refers to the repetition of a sound caused by the reflection of sound waves, or to repeat someone else's words or ideas. It serves as a synonym in a figurative sense.
Synonyms: Resonate (गूंजना), Repeat (दोहराना), Reiterate (बार-बार कहना).
Antonyms: Silence (शांति), Differ (अलग होना), Originalize (नया सोचना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Enhance
questionsEn.s:
Enhance - बेहतर बनाना (Intensify, increase, or further improve the quality)
Increase - बढ़ाना (Become or make greater in size, amount, or degree)
Enlarge - बड़ा करना (Make or become larger or more extensive)
Diminish - घटाना (Make or become less)
Augment - वृद्धि करना (Make something greater by adding to it)


Hence, 'Diminish' is the most suitable antonym for 'Enhance'.
oa:
This means to become or make greater in size, amount, or degree. Since enhancing something usually involves increasing its quality or value, this acts as a synonym.
Synonyms: Expand (विस्तार करना), Grow (बढ़ना), Boost (बढ़ावा देना).
Antonyms: Decrease (घटाना), Abate (कम करना), Decline (गिरावट).

This word refers to making something bigger in size. It is a synonym, particularly when the enhancement involves physical growth or expansion.
Synonyms: Magnify (बड़ा करना), Dilate (फैलाना), Broaden (चौड़ा करना).
Antonyms: Shrink (सिकुड़ना), Contract (सिकुड़ना), Narrow (संकीर्ण करना).

This word means to make or become less in size, importance, or value. it is the direct and most appropriate opposite for enhancing or improving something.
Synonyms: Reduce (कम करना), Lessen (घटाना), Decrease (गिराना).
Antonyms: Enhance (बढ़ाना), Improve (सुधारना), Augment (वृद्धि करना).

This word means to make something greater by adding to it; to increase. It is a formal synonym for the act of enhancing.
Synonyms: Supplement (पूरक होना), Ameliorate (सुधारना), Reinforce (मजबूत करना).
Antonyms: Deplete (कम करना), Drain (खाली करना), Weaken (कमजोर करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Lucid
questionsEn.s:
Lucid - स्पष्ट (Expressed clearly; easy to understand)
Transparent - पारदर्शी (Allowing light to pass through so objects can be seen)
Clear - साफ (Easy to perceive, understand, or interpret)
Vague - अस्पष्ट (Of uncertain, indefinite, or unclear character or meaning)
Coherent - सुसंगत (Logical and consistent)


Hence, 'Vague' is the most suitable antonym for 'Lucid'.
oa:
This word refers to something (like glass) through which light can pass so that objects behind can be distinctly seen. It is a direct physical synonym for the "clear" aspect of being lucid.
Synonyms: Clear (पारदर्शी), Limpid (स्वच्छ), Crystalline (क्रिस्टल जैसा).
Antonyms: Opaque (अपारदर्शी), Cloudy (धुंधला), Murky (अस्पष्ट).

This is the primary definition and synonym of the question word, referring to something easy to perceive or understand. It cannot be the antonym.
Synonyms: Plain (स्पष्ट), Obvious (जाहिर), Distinct (साफ).
Antonyms: Unclear (ग़लत/धुंधला), Vague (अस्पष्ट), Fuzzy (धुंधला).

This word describes something that is of uncertain, indefinite, or unclear character or meaning. it is the perfect antonym for being clear and lucid.
Synonyms: Ambiguous (दोअर्थी), Indistinct (अस्पष्ट), Obscure (अस्पष्ट).
Antonyms: Precise (सटीक), Lucid (साफ-सुथरा), Explicit (स्पष्ट).

This word refers to an argument or theory that is logical and consistent. Since a coherent message is easy to understand, it functions as a synonym for being lucid.
Synonyms: Logical (तार्किक), Consistent (संगत), Systematic (व्यवस्थित).
Antonyms: Incoherent (असंगत), Muddled (उलझा हुआ), Confused (भ्रमित).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Benevolent
questionsEn.s:
Benevolent - परोपकारी (Well-meaning and kindly)
Humane - मानवीय (Having or showing compassion or benevolence)
Generous - उदार (Willing to give more than is necessary or expected)
Kind - दयालु (Having or showing a friendly, generous nature)
Malevolent - दुर्भावनापूर्ण (Having or showing a wish to do evil to others)


Hence, 'Malevolent' is the most suitable antonym for 'Benevolent'.
oa:
This word describes someone who shows compassion or benevolence. it is a direct synonym that highlights the kind nature of the given word.
Synonyms: Compassionate (सहानुभूतिपूर्ण), Kind-hearted (दयालु), Merciful (रहमदिल).
Antonyms: Cruel (क्रूर), Inhumane (अमानवीय), Brutal (अत्याचारी).

This describes a person who is willing to give money, help, or kindness freely. it is one of the core synonyms of being benevolent.
Synonyms: Magnanimous (उदार), Altruistic (परोपकारी), Liberal (दानी).
Antonyms: Miserly (कंजूस), Stingy (कंजूस), Greedy (लालची).

This is the most common term for someone who is caring and helpful to others. It is a direct synonym for the gentle nature of benevolence.
Synonyms: Amiable (मिलनसार), Gracious (विनीत), Benign (सौम्य).
Antonyms: Harsh (कठोर), Unkind (कठोर), Mean (नीच).

This word refers to a person having or showing a wish to do evil to others. it is the direct and most accurate antonym for being kind and well-meaning.
Synonyms: Spiteful (द्वेषपूर्ण), Hostile (शत्रुतापूर्ण), Malicious (दुर्भावनापूर्ण).
Antonyms: Benevolent (परोपकारी), Loving (प्यारा), Amiable (प्रिय).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Inflate
questionsEn.s:
Inflate - फुलाना (Fill with air or gas so that it becomes distended)
Increase - बढ़ाना (Become or make greater in size or amount)
Reduce - कम करना (Make smaller or less in amount, degree, or size)
Expand - विस्तार करना (Become or make larger or more extensive)
Swell - सूजना (Become larger or rounder in size)


Hence, 'Reduce' is the most suitable antonym for 'Inflate'.
oa:
This means to become or make greater in size or amount. it is a synonym that captures the general idea of expanding or blowing something up.
Synonyms: Augment (वृद्धि करना), Grow (बढ़ना), Escalate (तेजी से बढ़ना).
Antonyms: Decrease (घटना), Diminish (कम होना), Decline (गिरावट).

This word means to make smaller or less in amount, degree, or size. it is the most appropriate antonym for inflating or expanding something.
Synonyms: Lessen (घटाना), Diminish (कम करना), Contract (सिकुड़ना).
Antonyms: Increase (बढ़ाना), Inflate (फुलाना), Expand (विस्तार करना).

This word refers to becoming or making larger or more extensive. it is a direct synonym that describes the physical act of inflating.
Synonyms: Swell (सूजना), Amplify (बढ़ाना), Distend (फूलना).
Antonyms: Shrink (सिकुड़ना), Condense (संक्षिप्त करना), Narrow (संकीर्ण करना).

This refers to becoming larger or rounder in size, typically as a result of an accumulation of fluid. It is another physical synonym for the process of inflating.
Synonyms: Bulge (उभारना), Bloat (फूलना), Puff up (सूज जाना).
Antonyms: Wither (मुरझाना), Deflate (पिचकना), Recede (पीछे हटना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Wan
questionsEn.s:
Wan - पीला / कमजोर (Pale and giving the impression of illness or exhaustion)
Tiring - थकाने वाला (Causing one to feel exhausted)
Healthy - स्वस्थ (In good health)
Long - लंबा (Measuring a great distance from end to end)
Wearisome - थकाऊ (Causing one to feel tired or bored)


Hence, 'Healthy' is the most suitable antonym for 'Wan'.
oa:
This word describes something that causes one to feel exhausted or drained of energy. While it results in the fatigue associated with being wan, it describes the cause rather than a physical appearance.
Synonyms: Exhausting (थकाने वाला), Wearisome (थकाऊ), Grueling (भीषण).
Antonyms: Refreshing (ताजा करने वाला), Invigorating (स्फूर्तिदायक), Energizing (ऊर्जावान).

This word refers to being in good physical or mental condition; not being ill. it is the direct opposite of looking pale and weak (wan).
Synonyms: Robust (स्वस्थ), Hardy (मजबूत), Vigorous (फुर्तीला).
Antonyms: Sickly (बीमार), Wan (पीला), Infirm (अशक्त).

This refers to something that measures a great distance from end to end. It describes a dimension of space or time and has no contextual relevance to a person's complexion or health.
Synonyms: Extended (विस्तृत), Lengthy (लंबा), Protracted (दीर्घ).
Antonyms: Short (छोटा), Brief (संक्षिप्त), Abbreviated (लघु).

This describes something causing fatigue or boredom. Like "tiring," it refers to the effect of a task rather than the physical appearance of a person, making it an unsuitable antonym.
Synonyms: Boring (उबाऊ), Tedious (नीरस), Tiresome (थकाऊ).
Antonyms: Stimulating (उत्तेजक), Exciting (रोमांचक), Interesting (दिलचस्प).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Hostile
questionsEn.s:
Hostile - शत्रुतापूर्ण (Unfriendly; antagonistic)
Friendly - मित्रवत (Kind and pleasant)
Aggressive - आक्रामक (Ready or likely to attack or confront)
Rude - अशिष्ट (Offensively impolite or bad-mannered)
Bitter - कड़वा / कटु (Feeling or showing anger, hurt, or resentment)


Hence, 'Friendly' is the most suitable antonym for 'Hostile'.
oa:
This word describes a person who is kind and pleasant or an action that shows goodwill. it is the direct and most appropriate opposite of being antagonistic or hostile.
Synonyms: Amicable (मित्रवत), Cordial (हार्दिक), Affable (मिलनसार).
Antonyms: Hostile (शत्रुतापूर्ण), Aggressive (आक्रामक), Unkind (कठोर).

This word refers to a person ready or likely to attack or confront. It is a synonym that captures the forceful and angry nature of hostility.
Synonyms: Combative (लड़ाकू), Belligerent (युद्धप्रिय), Pugnacious (झगड़ालू).
Antonyms: Peaceful (शांतिपूर्ण), Mild (नरम), Submissive (दब्बू).

This describes someone who is offensively impolite or bad-mannered. It serves as a synonym that highlights the lack of courtesy found in a hostile individual.
Synonyms: Impolite (असभ्य), Insolent (बदतमीज), Churlish (अशिष्ट).
Antonyms: Polite (विनम्र), Courteous (शिष्ट), Civil (सभ्य).

This refers to feeling or showing anger, hurt, or resentment because of bad experiences. It is a synonym that describes the deep-seated emotional aspect of being hostile.
Synonyms: Resentful (क्रुद्ध), Rancorous (द्वेषी), Acrimonious (कटु).
Antonyms: Sweet (मधुर), Content (संतुष्ट), Kind (दयालु).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Dominate
questionsEn.s:
Dominate - हावी होना (Have a commanding influence on; exercise control over)
Rule - शासन करना (Exercise ultimate power or authority over)
Submit - झुकना / समर्पण (Accept or yield to a superior force or authority)
Govern - शासन करना (Conduct the policy and affairs of a state)
Control - नियंत्रण (The power to influence or direct people's behavior)


Hence, 'Submit' is the most suitable antonym for 'Dominate'.
oa:
This means to exercise ultimate power or authority over an area and its people. It is a direct synonym for the act of dominating or controlling.
Synonyms: Reign (शासन करना), Command (आदेश देना), Govern (प्रशासन करना).
Antonyms: Obey (आज्ञा मानना), Serve (सेवा करना), Surrender (हार मानना).

This word means to accept or yield to a superior force or to the will of another person. it is the direct antonym for exercising dominance or control over others.
Synonyms: Yield (झुकना), Surrender (समर्पण करना), Bow (हार मानना).
Antonyms: Dominate (दबदबा बनाना), Resist (विरोध करना), Defy (अवहेलना करना).

This means to conduct the policy, actions, and affairs of a state or organization. It functions as a synonym in a political or administrative context.
Synonyms: Administer (प्रबंध करना), Direct (निर्देशित करना), Lead (नेतृत्व करना).
Antonyms: Mismanage (कुप्रबंध करना), Destabilize (अस्थिर करना), Obey (पालन करना).

This word refers to the power to influence or direct people's behavior or the course of events. It is a core synonym describing the essence of domination.
Synonyms: Manage (नियंत्रित करना), Regulate (विनियमित करना), Mastery (प्रभुत्व).
Antonyms: Release (छोड़ना), Follow (अनुसरण करना), Permit (अनुमति देना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Mature
questionsEn.s:
Mature - परिपक्व (Fully developed physically or mentally)
Developed - विकसित (Having grown or changed and become more advanced)
Immature - अपरिपक्व (Not fully developed; behaving in a childish way)
Experienced - अनुभवी (Having knowledge or skill from involvement)
Grown - बड़ा (Having reached the stage of full physical development)


Hence, 'Immature' is the most suitable antonym for 'Mature'.
oa:
This word refers to someone or something that has grown or changed and become more advanced. It serves as a direct synonym for being mature.
Synonyms: Evolved (विकसित), Sophisticated (उन्नत), Advanced (उन्नत).
Antonyms: Primitive (आदिम), Backward (पिछड़ा), Immature (अपरिपक्व).

This word describes a person or thing that is not fully grown or developed, or someone who behaves in a childish way. It is the perfect antonym for being mature.
Synonyms: Childish (बचकाना), Callow (अनुभवहीन), Juvenile (किशोर).
Antonyms: Mature (परिपक्व), Adult (वयस्क), Grown-up (विकसित).

This describes someone who has gained knowledge or skill from doing something over a long period. Since experience often leads to maturity, it functions as a synonym.
Synonyms: Seasoned (अनुभवी), Skilled (कुशल), Veteran (पुराना खिलाड़ी).
Antonyms: Novice (नौसिखिया), Amateur (शौकिया), Green (अनुभवहीन).

This is a general term for having reached the stage of full physical development. It is essentially a synonym for the question word.
Synonyms: Adult (वयस्क), Fully-fledged (पूर्ण विकसित), Finished (पूरा).
Antonyms: Young (छोटा), Budding (उभरता हुआ), Unfinished (अधूरा).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Prudent
questionsEn.s:
Prudent - विवेकपूर्ण (Acting with or showing care and thought for the future)
Undicious - [Typo for Injudicious] (Lacking in good judgment)
Thoughtless - विचारहीन (Showing a lack of consideration; reckless)
Cautious - सावधान (Avoiding potential problems or dangers)
Sensible - समझदार (Chosen in accordance with wisdom; practical)


Hence, 'Thoughtless' is the most suitable antonym for 'Prudent'.
oa:
This is likely a typographical error for "Injudicious," which would have been a direct antonym. However, within the given standard options, we must evaluate the others for the best fit.
Synonyms: [N/A - Non-standard word]
Antonyms: [N/A - Non-standard word]

This word describes a person who does not consider the consequences of their actions or the feelings of others. it is a suitable opposite for being prudent, which involve careful thought for the future.
Synonyms: Reckless (लापरवाह), Impetuous (अविवेकी), Heedless (असावधान).
Antonyms: Prudent (विवेकपूर्ण), Careful (सावधान), Considerate (विचारशील).

This word refers to avoiding potential problems or dangers; being wary. it is a primary synonym for someone who is prudent.
Synonyms: Vigilant (चौकस), Wary (सतर्क), Guarded (सचेत).
Antonyms: Reckless (लापरवाह), Bold (निडर), Rash (जल्दबाज़).

This describes someone chosen in accordance with wisdom or prudence; being practical. It is a direct synonym for the given word.
Synonyms: Rational (तार्किक), Judicious (उचित), Wise (बुद्धिमान).
Antonyms: Absurd (बेतुका), Silly (मूर्खतापूर्ण), Ridiculous (हास्यास्पद).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Vilify
questionsEn.s:
Vilify - बदनाम करना (Speak or write about in an abusively disparaging manner)
Commend - सराहना करना (Praise formally or officially)
Malign - दुर्भावनापूर्ण (Speak about someone in a spitefully critical manner)
Slur - कलंक (An allegation likely to damage a reputation)
Defame - मानहानि करना (Damage the good reputation of someone)


Hence, 'Commend' is the most suitable antonym for 'Vilify'.
oa:
This word means to praise formally or officially. it is the direct opposite of vilifying, which involves speaking or writing about someone in an abusively disparaging manner.
Synonyms: Praise (प्रशंसा करना), Laud (गुणगान करना), Extol (सराहना करना).
Antonyms: Criticize (आलोचना करना), Vilify (बदनाम करना), Condemn (निंदा करना).

This verb means to speak about someone in a spitefully critical manner. It is a direct synonym for the act of vilifying.
Synonyms: Slander (बदनाम करना), Defame (अपमानित करना), Libel (कलंक लगाना).
Antonyms: Praise (प्रशंसा करना), Honor (सम्मान करना), Benefit (लाभ पहुँचाना).

This refers to an insinuation or allegation about someone that is likely to insult them or damage their reputation. It matches the insulting nature of the given word and acts as a synonym.
Synonyms: Insult (अपमान), Affront (तिरस्कार), Smear (कलंक).
Antonyms: Compliment (तारीफ़), Tribute (श्रद्धांजलि), Credit (श्रेय).

This means to damage the good reputation of someone; to slander or libel. It is an exact synonym for vilifying.
Synonyms: Besmirch (गंदा करना/कलंकित करना), Blacken (बदनाम करना), Denigrate (नीचा दिखाना).
Antonyms: Exalt (महिमामंडन करना), Commend (सराहना करना), Uplift (उठाना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Authorize
questionsEn.s:
Authorize - अधिकृत करना (Give official permission for or approval to)
Forbid - वर्जित करना (Refuse to allow something; prohibit)
Allow - अनुमति देना (Give someone permission to do something)
Empower - सशक्त बनाना (Give someone the authority or power to do something)
Permit - मंज़ूर करना (Officially allow someone to do something)


Hence, 'Forbid' is the most suitable antonym for 'Authorize'.
oa:
This word means to refuse to allow something or to order someone not to do something. it is the direct antonym for giving official permission or authorizing an action.
Synonyms: Prohibit (निषेध करना), Ban (प्रतिबंधित करना), Disallow (मना करना).
Antonyms: Permit (अनुमति देना), Authorize (अधिकृत करना), Allow (मंजूरी देना).

This is a common word meaning to give someone permission to do something. Since it is the defining action of authorization, it is a synonym.
Synonyms: Permit (मंजूर करना), Grant (देना), Sanction (मंजूरी देना).
Antonyms: Forbid (मना करना), Prevent (रोकना), Halt (रोकना).

This word means to give someone the authority or power to do something. It captures the essence of giving rights, serving as a synonym.
Synonyms: Enable (सक्षम बनाना), Delegate (अधिकार सौंपना), Entrust (सौंपना).
Antonyms: Disenfranchise (अधिकार छीनना), Restrict (प्रतिबंधित करना), Weaken (कमजोर करना).

This word refers to officially allowing someone to do something. It is an exact synonym for authorize in many contexts.
Synonyms: Consent (सहमति देना), License (लाइसेंस देना), Agree (सहमत होना).
Antonyms: Veto (अस्वीकार करना), Refuse (इनकार करना), Stop (रोकना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Resilient
questionsEn.s:
Resilient - लचीला / सहनशील (Able to withstand or recover quickly from difficulties)
Tough - कठोर (Strong enough to withstand adverse conditions)
Buoyant - प्रसन्नचित्त (Capable of floating; cheerful and optimistic)
Fragile - नाज़ुक (Easily broken or damaged)
Flexible - लचीला (Capable of bending easily without breaking)


Hence, 'Fragile' is the most suitable antonym for 'Resilient'.
oa:
This word describes something strong enough to withstand adverse conditions or rough handling. Since toughness is a core component of resilience, it acts as a synonym.
Synonyms: Strong (मजबूत), Hardy (सहनशील), Durable (टिकाऊ).
Antonyms: Weak (कमजोर), Delicate (नाजुक), Soft (नरम).

This refers to an optimistic and cheerful person or something capable of floating. Metaphorically, it implies a resilient spirit that "floats" above trouble, making it a synonym.
Synonyms: Cheerful (खुशमिजाज), Elastic (लचीला), Lighthearted (प्रसन्न).
Antonyms: Gloomy (उदास), Depressed (निराश), Heavy-hearted (दुखी).

This word describes something easily broken, damaged, or vulnerable. it is the direct and most accurate antonym for being resilient or tough.
Synonyms: Frail (दुर्बल), Brittle (नाजुक), Flimsy (कमजोर).
Antonyms: Resilient (लचीला), Strong (मजबूत), Robust (हट्टा-कट्टा).

This word refers to someone or something able to be easily modified to respond to altered circumstances. it is a synonymous trait for the adaptive nature of resilience.
Synonyms: Pliable (लचीला), Adaptable (अनुकूलनीय), Supple (लचकदार).
Antonyms: Rigid (कठोर), Inflexible (अटल), Stiff (सख्त).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Affirm
questionsEn.s:
Affirm - पुष्टि करना (State as a fact; assert strongly and publicly)
Refuse - इनकार करना (Indicate that one is not willing to accept)
Accept - स्वीकार करना (Consent to receive a thing offered)
Acknowledge - स्वीकार करना (Accept or admit the existence or truth of)
Support - समर्थन करना (Bear all or part of the weight of; hold up)


Hence, 'Refuse' is the most suitable antonym for 'Affirm'.
oa:
This word means to indicate that one is not willing to do, accept, or grant something. In the context of statements, it acts as a suitable antonym for affirming or accepting a truth.
Synonyms: Decline (इनकार करना), Reject (अस्वीकार करना), Spurn (तिरस्कार करना).
Antonyms: Accept (स्वीकार करना), Affirm (पुष्टि करना), Grant (देना).

This means to consent to receive or undertake something offered. Since affirming something often involves accepting its truth, it functions as a synonym.
Synonyms: Admit (मानना), Agree (सहमत होना), Consent (सहमति देना).
Antonyms: Refuse (मना करना), Deny (नकारना), Dissent (असहमत होना).

This refers to accepting or admitting the existence or truth of something. It is essentially a synonym for the act of affirming.
Synonyms: Recognize (मान्यता देना), Concede (स्वीकार करना), Grant (मानना).
Antonyms: Ignore (अनदेखा करना), Disregard (उपेक्षा करना), Overlook (नज़रअंदाज़ करना).

This means to give assistance to, or to suggest the truth of something. It aligns with the positive confirmation of the question word, serving as a synonym.
Synonyms: Back (समर्थन करना), Bolster (मजबूत करना), Advocate (पक्ष लेना).
Antonyms: Oppose (विरोध करना), Attack (हमला करना), Undermine (कमजोर करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Lax
questionsEn.s:
Lax - ढीला-ढाला / लापरवाह (Not sufficiently strict, severe, or careful)
Reliable - विश्वसनीय (Consistently good in quality or performance; trustworthy)
Stack - ढेर (A pile of objects, typically one that is neatly arranged)
Careless - असावधान (Not giving sufficient attention to avoiding errors)
Loose - ढीला (Not firmly or tightly fixed in place; relaxed)


Hence, 'Reliable' is the most suitable antonym for 'Lax'.
oa:
This word describes a person or thing with trustworthy qualities that can be depended on. it serves as a suitable opposite for being lax, which implies being careless or irresponsible.
Synonyms: Trustworthy (भरोसेमंद), Dependable (विश्वसनीय), Solid (ठोस).
Antonyms: Irresponsible (लापरवाह), Lax (ढीला), Fickle (चंचल).

This noun refers to a pile of objects, typically one that is neatly arranged. It is contextually unrelated to the behavioral trait of being careless or strict.
