Synonyms: Pile (ढेर), Heap (ढेर), Accumulation (संग्रह).
Antonyms: Individual (अकेला), Scatter (बिखराव), Minority (अल्पता).

This word describes someone who does not give sufficient attention or thought to avoiding harm or errors. It is a direct and perfect synonym for being lax.
Synonyms: Negligent (लापरवाह), Heedless (असावधान), Slipshod (लापरवाह).
Antonyms: Careful (सावधान), Diligent (मेहनती), Meticulous (सूक्ष्म).

This refers to something not firmly or tightly fixed in place. While it describes a physical state, it is used figuratively as a synonym for the "not strict" nature of being lax.
Synonyms: Slack (ढीला), Relaxed (नरम), Untied (खुला).
Antonyms: Tight (कसा हुआ), Rigid (कठोर), Strict (सख्त).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Commendable
questionsEn.s:
Commendable - सराहनीय (Deserving praise)
Notable - उल्लेखनीय (Worthy of attention or notice; remarkable)
Blameworthy - निंदनीय (Deserving to be blamed or considered wrong)
Laudable - प्रशंसनीय (Deserving praise and commendation)
Admirable - प्रशंसनीय (Arousing or deserving respect and approval)


Hence, 'Blameworthy' is the most suitable antonym for 'Commendable'.
oa:
This word describes someone or something worthy of attention or notice; remarkable. Since commendable things are usually notable, this functions as a synonym.
Synonyms: Remarkable (असाधारण), Significant (महत्वपूर्ण), Prominent (प्रसिद्ध).
Antonyms: Common (साधारण), Obscure (अज्ञात), Trivial (मामूली).

This word refers to something deserving of blame; being reprehensible. it is the direct and most appropriate opposite for something that deserves praise.
Synonyms: Reprehensible (निंदनीय), Culpable (दोषी), Guilty (दोषी).
Antonyms: Commendable (सराहनीय), Innocent (निर्दोष), Praise-worthy (प्रशंसनीय).

This describes an action, idea, or goal deserving praise and commendation. It is a direct and formal synonym for the question word.
Synonyms: Praiseworthy (प्रशंसनीय), Meritorious (लायक), Worthy (योग्य).
Antonyms: Despicable (घृणित), Dishonorable (अपमानजनक), Paltry (तुच्छ).

This word refers to something arousing or deserving respect and approval. It matches the positive quality of the given word and acts as a synonym.
Synonyms: Estimable (आदरणीय), Splendid (भव्य), Excellent (उत्कृष्ट).
Antonyms: Unworthy (अयोग्य), Contemptible (नीच), Disreputable (बदनाम).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Assert
questionsEn.s:
Assert - दावा करना (State a fact or belief confidently and forcefully)
Deny - नकारना (State that one refuses to admit the truth of)
Maintain - बनाए रखना (State something strongly to be the case)
Proclaim - घोषणा करना (Announce officially or publicly)
Declare - घोषित करना (Say something in a solemn and emphatic manner)


Hence, 'Deny' is the most suitable antonym for 'Assert'.
oa:
This word means to state that one refuses to admit the truth or existence of something. it is the direct antonym for asserting or stating something confidently as a fact.
Synonyms: Refute (खंडन करना), Contradict (नकारना), Gainsay (अस्वीकार करना).
Antonyms: Assert (पुष्टि करना), Affirm (दावा करना), Accept (मानना).

This means to state something strongly to be the case. it is a direct synonym that highlights the persistent nature of asserting a point.
Synonyms: Insist (ज़ोर देना), Uphold (बनाए रखना), Declare (घोषित करना).
Antonyms: Abandon (छोड़ देना), Quit (त्यागना), Waive (छोड़ना).

This refers to announcing something officially or publicly. It is a synonym that captures the formal and loud aspect of an assertion.
Synonyms: Announce (घोषणा करना), Herald (सूचना देना), Publish (प्रकाशित करना).
Antonyms: Conceal (छिपाना), Suppress (दबाना), Withhold (रोकना).

This means to say something in a solemn and emphatic manner. It is the most common synonym for the question word.
Synonyms: State (कहना), Pronounce (घोषित करना), Affirm (दावा करना).
Antonyms: Retract (वापस लेना), Revoke (रद्द करना), Hide (छिपाना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Eminent
questionsEn.s:
Eminent - विख्यात (Famous and respected within a particular profession)
Prominent - मुख्य / प्रसिद्ध (Important; famous)
Celebrated - प्रशंसित (Widely known and praised)
Distinguished - विशिष्ट (Very successful, authoritative, and commanding respect)
Obscure - गुमनाम / अस्पष्ट (Not discovered or known about; uncertain)


Hence, 'Obscure' is the most suitable antonym for 'Eminent'.
oa:
This word describes something important or famous, or something particularly noticeable. it is a direct synonym for the high status implied by being eminent.
Synonyms: Famous (प्रसिद्ध), Renowned (मशहूर), Noted (विख्यात).
Antonyms: Unknown (अज्ञात), Obscure (गुमनाम), Minor (मामूली).

This refers to someone widely known and praised. it matches the positive recognition of the given word and acts as a synonym.
Synonyms: Acclaimed (प्रशंसित), Honored (सम्मानित), Distinguished (विशिष्ट).
Antonyms: Forgotten (भुला दिया गया), Disgraced (कलंकित), Inglorious (अपमानजनक).

This word describes a person who is very successful and admired by other people. it is essentially a formal synonym for being eminent.
Synonyms: Illustrious (शानदार), Noble (महान), Reputable (प्रतिष्ठित).
Antonyms: Common (साधारण), Average (औसत), Mediocre (मामूली).

This word describes someone or something not discovered or known about; being uncertain or unknown. it is the direct and perfect antonym for being eminent or famous.
Synonyms: Hidden (गुप्त), Unknown (अज्ञात), Lowly (मामूली).
Antonyms: Eminent (विख्यात), Famous (प्रसिद्ध), Conspicuous (सुस्पष्ट).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Scrupulous
questionsEn.s:
Scrupulous - ईमानदार / कर्तव्यनिष्ठ (Diligent, thorough, and extremely attentive to details)
Principled - सिद्धांतों वाला (Acting in accordance with moral principles)
Ethical - नैतिक (Relating to moral principles or the branch of knowledge)
Careless - लापरवाह (Not giving sufficient attention or thought)
Dishonest - बेईमान (Behaving in an untrustworthy or fraudulent way)


Hence, 'Dishonest' is the most suitable antonym for 'Scrupulous'.
oa:
This word refers to a person acting in accordance with moral principles. Since it describes a highly ethical nature, it is a direct synonym of being scrupulous.
Synonyms: Ethical (नैतिक), Moral (सदाचारी), Honorable (सम्मानजनक).
Antonyms: Corrupt (भ्रष्ट), Wicked (दुष्ट), Dishonest (बेईमान).

This refers to relating to moral principles or the branch of knowledge dealing with these. it is an exact synonym that captures the moral aspect of the question word.
Synonyms: Righteous (धर्मी), Proper (उचित), Virtuous (पुण्यशील).
Antonyms: Immoral (अनैतिक), Unethical (अनीतिपूर्ण), Sinful (पापी).

This describes someone who does not give enough attention to what they are doing, resulting in mistakes. While a scrupulous person is careful, the moral/dishonest contrast in this context is stronger than the careful/careless one.
Synonyms: Negligent (लापरवाह), Lax (ढीला), Heedless (असावधान).
Antonyms: Careful (सावधान), Attentive (चौकस), Meticulous (सूक्ष्म).

This word describes someone who behaves in an untrustworthy or fraudulent way. it is the direct and most appropriate opposite for being morally careful and upright (scrupulous).
Synonyms: Deceitful (धोखेबाज), Fraudulent (कपटी), Corrupt (भ्रष्ट).
Antonyms: Honest (ईमानदार), Scrupulous (कर्तव्यनिष्ठ), Upright (ईमानदार).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Superficial
questionsEn.s:
Superficial - सतही (Existing or occurring at or on the surface; shallow)
Shallow - उथला (Of little depth; lacking intellectual substance)
Surface - सतह (The outside part or uppermost layer of something)
External - बाहरी (Belonging to or forming the outer surface)
Deep - गहरा (Extending far down; showing great insight)


Hence, 'Deep' is the most suitable antonym for 'Superficial'.
oa:
This is the most common synonym for the question word, referring to something of little depth or something that lacks intellectual substance.
Synonyms: Surface (सतही), Frivolous (ओछा), Slight (मामूली).
Antonyms: Deep (गहरा), Profound (गहन), Serious (गंभीर).

This word relates to the outside part or uppermost layer of something. it is a direct synonym describing things that do not go deep.
Synonyms: Exterior (बाहरी), Outer (बाहरी), Superficial (सतही).
Antonyms: Interior (आंतरिक), Core (मुख्य), Inner (भीतरी).

This word describes something belonging to or forming the outer surface or structure of something. it acts as a synonym in the context of being on the outside.
Synonyms: Outward (बाहर की ओर), Exterior (बाहरी), Extrinsic (बाहरी).
Antonyms: Internal (आंतरिक), Inward (भीतरी), Intrinsic (स्वाभाविक).

This word refers to something extending far down from the top or surface, or something showing great knowledge or insight. it is the direct and perfect antonym for being superficial.
Synonyms: Profound (गहन), Abyssal (अथाह), Intense (तीव्र).
Antonyms: Shallow (उथला), Superficial (सतही), Trivial (मामूली).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Approve
questionsEn.s:
Approve - मंज़ूर करना (Officially agree to or accept as satisfactory)
Reject - अस्वीकार करना (Dismiss as inadequate or inappropriate)
Sanction - अनुमति देना (Give official permission or approval for an action)
Endorse - समर्थन करना (Declare one's public approval or support of)
Certify - प्रमाणित करना (Attest or confirm in a formal statement)


Hence, 'Reject' is the most suitable antonym for 'Approve'.
oa:
This word means to dismiss as inadequate, inappropriate, or not to one's taste. it is the direct and most accurate antonym for accepting or approving a proposal.
Synonyms: Refuse (मना करना), Discard (त्यागना), Decline (अस्वीकार करना).
Antonyms: Accept (स्वीकार करना), Approve (मंजूरी देना), Adopt (अपनाना).

This verb means to give official permission or approval for an action. it is a formal synonym for the act of approving.
Synonyms: Permit (अनुमति देना), Authorize (अधिकृत करना), Warrant (मंजूरी देना).
Antonyms: Prohibit (निषेध करना), Ban (प्रतिबंधित करना), Veto (अस्वीकार करना).

This refers to declaring one's public approval or support of something. it functions as a strong synonym for the question word.
Synonyms: Back (समर्थन करना), Support (सहयोग देना), Ratify (पुष्टि करना).
Antonyms: Oppose (विरोध करना), Denounce (निंदा करना), Discredit (बदनाम करना).

This word means to attest or confirm in a formal statement. it acts as a synonym by providing formal validation or approval.
Synonyms: Validate (मान्य करना), Verify (पुष्टि करना), Attest (प्रमाणित करना).
Antonyms: Nullify (शून्य करना), Disprove (गलत साबित करना), Counterfeit (जालसाजी करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Arraign
questionsEn.s:
Arraign - अदालत में पेश करना (Call or bring someone before a court to answer a criminal charge)
Justify - सही ठहराना (Show or prove to be right or reasonable)
Gluttonous - पेटू (Excessively greedy, especially regarding food)
Hungry - भूखा (Feeling or showing the need for food)
Selfish - स्वार्थी (Lacking consideration for others; concerned with oneself)


Hence, 'Justify' is the most suitable antonym for 'Arraign'.
oa:
This word means to show or prove to be right or reasonable. in a situational context, while arraigning involves calling someone to court for a crime, justifying provides a reason that clears the action, making it a contextual opposite.
Synonyms: Vindicate (सही सिद्ध करना), Warrant (औचित्य बताना), Defend (बचाव करना).
Antonyms: Condemn (निंदा करना), Blame (दोष देना), Accuse (आरोप लगाना).

This describes a person who is excessively greedy, especially regarding food. it describes a personal habit and has no logical connection to the legal process of arraignment.
Synonyms: Greedy (लालची), Voracious (पेटू), Edacious (खाऊ).
Antonyms: Ascetic (संयमी), Moderate (मितव्ययी), Abstemious (अल्पाहारी).

This refers to a feeling or showing the need for food. it is a basic physiological state and is completely unrelated to court proceedings or accusations.
Synonyms: Famished (भूखा), Ravenous (अति भूखा), Starving (भूखों मरता).
Antonyms: Full (तृप्त), Sated (संतुष्ट), Gorged (अति तृप्त).

This word describes someone lacking consideration for others; concerned chiefly with one's own profit or pleasure. it is a character flaw unrelated to the required legal antonym.
Synonyms: Egocentric (आत्मकेंद्रित), Narcissistic (अहंकारी), Greedy (स्वार्थी).
Antonyms: Altruistic (परोपकारी), Generous (दानी), Selfless (निस्वार्थ).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Liberation
questionsEn.s:
Liberation - मुक्ति (The act of setting someone free from imprisonment)
Captivity - कैद (The condition of being imprisoned or confined)
Independence - स्वतंत्रता (The state of being independent; self-government)
Emancipation - छुटकारा (The process of being set free from restrictions)
Freedom - आज़ादी (The power or right to act, speak, or think as one wants)


Hence, 'Captivity' is the most suitable antonym for 'Liberation'.
oa:
This word refers to the condition of being imprisoned or confined. it is the direct and most accurate antonym for liberation or freedom.
Synonyms: Imprisonment (कारावास), Confinement (कन्फ़ाइनमेंट), Bondage (गुलामी).
Antonyms: Freedom (आज़ादी), Liberty (स्वतंत्रता), Release (मुक्ति).

This describes the fact or state of being independent; having self-government. it is a direct synonym for the state of liberation.
Synonyms: Sovereignty (संप्रभुता), Autonomy (स्वायत्तता), Self-rule (स्वराज).
Antonyms: Dependence (निर्भरता), Subjugation (अधीनता), Slavery (गुलामी).

This means the fact or process of being set free from legal, social, or political restrictions. it is a formal synonym for liberation.
Synonyms: Deliverance (मुक्ति), Manumission (दास्ता से मुक्ति), Release (छुटकारा).
Antonyms: Enslavement (दास्ता), Oppression (उत्पीड़न), Restraint (प्रतिबंध).

This is the power or right to act, speak, or think as one wants. it is the most common synonym and literal meaning of the given word.
Synonyms: Liberty (आजादी), Exemption (छूट), Immunity (मुक्ति).
Antonyms: Captivity (कैद), Restriction (पाबंदी), Constraint (बाधा).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Ascend
questionsEn.s:
Ascend - चढ़ना (Go up or climb; rise through the air)
Rise - उठना (Move from a lower position to a higher one)
Soar - ऊँची उड़ान (Fly or rise high in the air)
Climb - ऊपर चढ़ना (Go or come up a slope or staircase)
Descend - नीचे उतरना (Move or fall downward)


Hence, 'Descend' is the most suitable antonym for 'Ascend'.
oa:
This word means to move from a lower position to a higher one. it is a direct synonym for the upward movement of ascending.
Synonyms: Arise (उठना), Lift (ऊपर उठना), Elevate (ऊँचा उठाना).
Antonyms: Fall (गिरना), Sink (डूबना), Lower (नीचे करना).

This word refers to flying or rising high in the air. it serves as an emphatic synonym for the act of ascending rapidly or to great heights.
Synonyms: Fly (उड़ना), Tower (ऊँचा होना), Rocket (तेजी से ऊपर जाना).
Antonyms: Plummet (तेजी से गिरना), Drop (गिरना), Descend (उतरना).

This means to go up or ascend, especially using one's hands and feet. it is a common synonym for the question word.
Synonyms: Mount (चढ़ना), Scale (चढ़ना), Surmount (पार करना).
Antonyms: Descend (उतरना), Dismount (उतरना), Fall (गिरना).

This word means to move or fall downward. it is the direct and most appropriate opposite of moving upward or ascending.
Synonyms: Fall (गिरना), Drop (गिरना), Plunge (नीचे गिरना).
Antonyms: Ascend (चढ़ना), Rise (उठना), Climb (चढ़ना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Candid
questionsEn.s:
Candid - साफ़गो / स्पष्ट (Truthful and straightforward; frank)
Deceitful - धोखेबाज़ (Guilty of or involving deceit; misleading)
Blunt - मुँहफट (Uncompromisingly forthright; not sharp)
Honest - ईमानदार (Free of deceit and untruthfulness; sincere)
Frank - स्पष्टवादी (Open, sincere, or undisguised in manner)


Hence, 'Deceitful' is the most suitable antonym for 'Candid'.
oa:
This word describes a person or behavior that is guilty of or involving deceit; being dishonest and misleading. it is the direct antonym for being frank and honest (candid).
Synonyms: Dishonest (बेईमान), Insincere (दिखावटी), Shifty (धूर्त).
Antonyms: Candid (स्पष्टवादी), Honest (ईमानदार), Trustworthy (भरोसेमंद).

This word refers to someone who is uncompromisingly forthright; being very direct. it functions as a synonym for the straightforward nature of the given word.
Synonyms: Frank (साफ-साफ), Forthright (मुखर), Direct (सीधा).
Antonyms: Subtle (सूक्ष्म), Tactical (रणनीतिक), Evasive (टाल-मटोल करने वाला).

This means to be free of deceit and untruthfulness; being sincere. it is the primary synonym and core definition of being candid.
Synonyms: Trustworthy (भरोसेमंद), Sincere (सच्चा), Veracious (सत्यवादी).
Antonyms: Lying (झूठा), False (असत्य), Fraudulent (कपटी).

This word refers to being open, sincere, or undisguised in manner or appearance. it is an exact synonym for the given word.
Synonyms: Open (खुला), Plain-spoken (साफगो), Direct (सीधा).
Antonyms: Evasive (कपटपूर्ण), Secretive (गुप्त), Guarded (सचेत).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Diligent
questionsEn.s:
Diligent - परिश्रमी (Having or showing care and conscientiousness in one's work)
Meticulous - अति सावधान (Showing great attention to detail; very careful)
Efficient - कुशल (Achieving maximum productivity with minimum effort)
Lazy - आलसी (Unwilling to work or use energy)
Hardworking - मेहनती (Tending to work with energy and commitment)


Hence, 'Lazy' is the most suitable antonym for 'Diligent'.
oa:
This word describes someone showing great attention to detail; being very careful and precise. it is a direct synonym for the hardworking and careful nature of being diligent.
Synonyms: Thorough (विस्तृत), Scrupulous (कर्तव्यनिष्ठ), Precise (सटीक).
Antonyms: Careless (लापरवाह), Negligent (बेपरवाह), Messy (गंदा).

This refers to someone achieving maximum productivity with minimum wasted effort or expense. While related to work, it functions as a synonym focusing on effectiveness.
Synonyms: Competent (सक्षम), Productive (उत्पादक), Proficient (कुशल).
Antonyms: Inefficient (अक्षम), Wateful (फिजूलखर्च), Idle (निकम्मा).

This word describes a person who is unwilling to work or use energy. it is the direct and most accurate antonym for someone who is hardworking and diligent.
Synonyms: Indolent (आलसी), Idle (बेकार), Slothful (कामचोर).
Antonyms: Diligent (मेहनती), Active (सक्रिय), Industrious (परिश्रमी).

This is the primary synonym for the question word, referring to a person who puts a lot of effort into a job. it cannot be the opposite.
Synonyms: Industrious (मेहनती), Assiduous (परिश्रमी), Sedulous (लगातार लगा हुआ).
Antonyms: Lazy (आलसी), Unambitious (महत्वाकांक्षाहीन), Lethargic (सुस्त).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Withdraw
questionsEn.s:
Withdraw - पीछे हटना / निकालना (Remove or take away; pull back from a position)
Remove - हटाना (Take something away from a position occupied)
Advance - आगे बढ़ना (Move forward in a purposeful way)
Recede - पीछे जाना (Go or move back or further away from a position)
Deduct - घटाना (Subtract or take away an amount from a total)


Hence, 'Advance' is the most suitable antonym for 'Withdraw'.
oa:
This word means to take something away from a position or place. it is a synonym for the physical act of withdrawing something.
Synonyms: Extract (निकालना), Detach (अलग करना), Discard (त्यागना).
Antonyms: Insert (डालना), Add (जोड़ना), Attach (जोड़ना).

This word means to move forward in a purposeful way; to progress. it is the direct opposite of withdrawing or pulling back from a position.
Synonyms: Proceed (आगे बढ़ना), Progress (प्रगति करना), Forge ahead (आगे निकलना).
Antonyms: Withdraw (पीछे हटना), Recede (पीछे जाना), Retreat (पीछे हटना).

This refers to moving further away from a previous position, especially of water or a tide. it is a synonym that describes a movement backward, similar to withdrawing.
Synonyms: Retreat (पीछे हटना), Ebb (कम होना), Wane (घटना).
Antonyms: Advance (आगे बढ़ना), Approach (पास आना), Increase (बढ़ना).

This verb means to subtract or take away an amount from a total. it serves as a synonym in the specific context of finances or numbers.
Synonyms: Subtract (घटाना), Abate (कम करना), Debit (काटना).
Antonyms: Add (जोड़ना), Supplement (वृद्धि करना), Append (संलग्न करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Knave
questionsEn.s:
Knave - धूर्त / बेईमान (A dishonest or unscrupulous man; a scoundrel)
Shady - संदेहास्पद (Situated in shade; suspicious or dishonest)
Fuzzy - धुंधला (Having a frizzy texture; not clear or distinct)
Dark - अंधेरा (With little or no light; evil or gloomy)
Paragon - उत्कृष्ट उदाहरण (A person or thing viewed as a model of excellence)


Hence, 'Paragon' is the most suitable antonym for 'Knave'.
oa:
This word describes someone who is suspicious or dishonest. it serves as a direct synonym for the untrustworthy character of a knave.
Synonyms: Dubious (संदिग्ध), Crooked (बेईमान), Dishonest (कपटी).
Antonyms: Trustworthy (भरोसेमंद), Honest (ईमानदार), Reputable (प्रतिष्ठित).

This describes something that is having a frizzy or fluffy texture, or an idea that is unclear. it describes clarity or texture and is contextually unrelated to moral character.
Synonyms: Blurred (धुंधला), Vague (अस्पष्ट), Hazy (धुंधला).
Antonyms: Clear (साफ), Sharp (तेज), Distinct (सुस्पष्ट).

This word describes something with little or no light, or something evil and gloomy. While "evil" is related, it is too general and physical to act as the specific moral opposite of a knave.
Synonyms: Dim (अंधेरा), Somber (उदास), Gloomy (निराशाजनक).
Antonyms: Bright (चमकदार), Light (उजाला), Luminous (प्रकाशमान).

This word refers to a person or thing viewed as a model of excellence or perfection. it is the direct moral and social opposite of a knave (a scoundrel or dishonest person).
Synonyms: Model (आदर्श), Exemplar (नमूना), Epitome (प्रतीक).
Antonyms: Knave (धूर्त), Villain (खलनायक), Scoundrel (बदमाश).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Audacity
questionsEn.s:
Audacity - दुस्साहस (A willingness to take bold risks; rude or disrespectful behavior)
Boldness - साहस (Willingness to take risks and act innovatively)
Cowardice - कायरता (Lack of bravery)
Bravery - वीरता (Courageous behavior or character)
Modesty - विनम्रता (The quality of being unassuming in the estimation of one's abilities)


Hence, 'Cowardice' is the most suitable antonym for 'Audacity'.
oa:
This is the primary synonym for the question word, referring to a willingness to take bold risks. it cannot be the antonym.
Synonyms: Daring (साहस), Temerity (दुस्साहस), Bravery (वीरता).
Antonyms: Cowardice (कायरता), Timidity (डर), Hesitation (हिचकिचाहट).

This word refers to a lack of bravery or courage. it is the direct and most appropriate opposite for being audacious or bold.
Synonyms: Timidity (डरपोकपन), Poltroonery (डर), Fearfulness (भीरुता).
Antonyms: Audacity (साहस), Valor (वीरता), Courage (हिम्मत).

This describes courageous behavior or character. it is a direct synonym for the positive side of having audacity.
Synonyms: Valour (वीरता), Gallantry (शौर्य), Intrepidity (निर्भीकता).
Antonyms: Fear (भय), Meekness (दब्बू), Cowardice (कायरता).

This refers to the quality or state of being unassuming or moderate in the estimation of one's abilities. While an audacious person may lack modesty, the core opposite is related to courage rather than humility.
Synonyms: Humility (विनम्रता), Meekness (नम्रता), Simplicity (सादापन).
Antonyms: Arrogance (अभिमान), Conceit (अहंकार), Pride (गर्व).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Durable
questionsEn.s:
Durable - टिकाऊ (Able to withstand wear, pressure, or damage; hard-wearing)
Strong - मज़बूत (Able to withstand great force or pressure)
Sturdy - ठोस (Strongly and solidly built)
Firm - दृढ़ (Having a solid, unyielding surface or structure)
Fragile - नाज़ुक (Easily broken or damaged)


Hence, 'Fragile' is the most suitable antonym for 'Durable'.
oa:
This word describes something able to withstand great force or pressure. it is a synonym that describes the sturdy nature of being durable.
Synonyms: Robust (हट्टा-कट्टा), Tough (मजबूत), Hardy (सहनशील).
Antonyms: Weak (कमजोर), Feeble (निर्बल), Frail (दुर्बल).

This word refers to something strongly and solidly built. it serves as a direct synonym for the long-lasting quality of the question word.
Synonyms: Solid (ठोस), Sound (सही-सलामत), Substantial (मजबूत).
Antonyms: Flimsy (कमजोर), Shaky (अस्थिर), Fragile (नाज़ुक).

This describes something strongly felt and unlikely to change, or physically solid. it is a synonym that captures the unshakable quality of durable materials.
Synonyms: Rigid (सख्त), Secure (सुरक्षित), Unwavering (अटल).
Antonyms: Soft (नरम), Loose (ढीला), Yielding (झुकने वाला).

This word describes something easily broken, damaged, or vulnerable. it is the direct and most accurate antonym for something that is built to last (durable).
Synonyms: Delicate (नाजुक), Frail (कमजोर), Flimsy (पतला/कमजोर).
Antonyms: Durable (टिकाऊ), Robust (मजबूत), Hardy (कठोर).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Yoke
questionsEn.s:
Yoke - दासता / बंधन (A wooden crosspiece that is fastened over the necks of two animals; bondage)
Immoral - अनैतिक (Not conforming to accepted standards of morality)
Vicious - शातिर / क्रूर (Deliberately cruel or violent)
Harness - नियंत्रण में लाना (A set of straps and fittings for an animal; control)
Liberate - मुक्त करना (Set someone free from a situation of restriction)


Hence, 'Liberate' is the most suitable antonym for 'Yoke'.
oa:
This word describes something that is not conforming to accepted standards of morality. it relates to a person's character or actions and is contextually unrelated to the concept of burden or bondage.
Synonyms: Wicked (दुष्ट), Corrupt (भ्रष्ट), Sinful (पापी).
Antonyms: Virtuous (सदाचारी), Moral (नैतिक), Pious (धार्मिक).

This refers to something deliberately cruel or violent. it is a personality trait or behavior that does not contrast with the joining or restrictive nature of a yoke.
Synonyms: Brutal (क्रूर), Savage (जंगली), Malicious (दुर्भावनापूर्ण).
Antonyms: Gentle (सौम्य), Kind (दयालु), Benevolent (परोपकारी).

This refers to a set of straps and fittings by which a horse or other animal is fastened to a cart. it is a direct synonym of a yoke in its physical and restrictive sense.
Synonyms: Gear (साजो-सामान), Tackle (उपकरण), Control (नियंत्रण).
Antonyms: Release (छोड़ना), Free (मुक्त करना), Unfasten (खोलना).

This word means to set someone free from a situation, especially imprisonment or slavery, in which their liberty is severely restricted. it is the direct antonym of being under a yoke or bondage.
Synonyms: Free (आजाद करना), Release (मुक्त करना), Rescue (बचाना).
Antonyms: Enslave (गुलाम बनाना), Yoke (जोड़ना/नियंत्रित करना), Subjugate (अधीन करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Eloquent
questionsEn.s:
Eloquent - वाक्पटु (Fluent or persuasive in speaking or writing)
Inexpressive - भावहीन (Not conveying any particular feeling or thought)
Articulate - सुस्पष्ट (Having the ability to speak fluently and coherently)
Fluent - धाराप्रवाह (Able to express oneself easily and articulately)
Persuasive - प्रेरक (Good at persuading someone through reasoning)


Hence, 'Inexpressive' is the most suitable antonym for 'Eloquent'.
oa:
This word describes a person or their appearance not conveying any particular feeling or thought. it is the direct and most appropriate opposite of being articulate and persuasive (eloquent).
Synonyms: Expressionless (भावहीन), Vacant (खाली), Deadpan (शांत).
Antonyms: Eloquent (प्रभावशाली), Expressive (अर्थपूर्ण), Meaningful (सार्थक).

This describes someone having or showing the ability to speak fluently and coherently. it is a direct synonym for being eloquent.
Synonyms: Fluent (धाराप्रवाह), Silver-tongued (वाक्पटु), Persuasive (प्रेरक).
Antonyms: Inarticulate (अस्पष्ट), Hesitant (हिचकिचाता हुआ), Mumbled (बड़बड़ाया हुआ).

This word refers to the ability to express oneself easily and articulately. it captures the smooth delivery aspect of the question word, serving as a synonym.
Synonyms: Natural (सहज), Effortless (बिना प्रयास के), Voluble (वाचाल).
Antonyms: Halting (लड़खड़ाता हुआ), Stuttering (हकलाता हुआ), Slow (धीमा).

This describes someone good at persuading someone to do or believe something through reasoning or the use of temptation. it is a synonym that highlights the influential power of an eloquent person.
Synonyms: Convincing (ठोस), Compelling (दमदार), Cogent (प्रभावशाली).
Antonyms: Weak (कमजोर), Unconvincing (अप्रभावी), Feeble (निर्बल).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Light (Punishment)
questionsEn.s:
Light - हल्का (Not great in amount, intensity, or severity)
Heavy - भारी (Of great weight; severe or intense)
Dark - अंधेरा (With little or no light)
Serious - गंभीर (Significant or extreme in degree; not slight)
Milo - माइलो (A brand name or a type of sorghum)


Hence, 'Serious' is the most suitable antonym for 'Light'.
oa:
This word is often used to describe severe punishment. while it works in common speech, in an exam context, "serious" or "severe" is often the more formal antonym for the gravity of a legal consequence.
Synonyms: Weighty (भारी), Burdensome (बोझिल), Severe (सख्त).
Antonyms: Light (हल्का), Trivial (मामूली), Minor (छोटा).

This word refers to a lack of light or a gloomy atmosphere. it describes visibility or mood and has no relevance to the severity of a punishment.
Synonyms: Black (काला), Obscure (धुंधला), Gloomy (निराशाजनक).
Antonyms: Bright (उज्ज्वल), Light (उजाला), Luminous (प्रकाशमान).

This word describes something that is significant or extreme in degree; not slight or trivial. In the context of a punishment, it is the most appropriate opposite for "light."
Synonyms: Severe (कठोर), Grave (गंभीर), Weighty (महत्वपूर्ण).
Antonyms: Light (हल्का), Trivial (तुच्छ), Playful (चंचल).

This is a proper noun (often a brand name) or a type of grain. it has absolutely no connection to vocabulary regarding punishment or severity.
Synonyms: [N/A]
Antonyms: [N/A]

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Prominent
questionsEn.s:
Prominent - मुख्य / प्रसिद्ध (Important; famous; particularly noticeable)
Obscure - गुमनाम (Not discovered or known about; uncertain)
Renowned - विख्यात (Known or talked about by many people; famous)
Eminent - प्रतिष्ठित (Famous and respected within a profession)
Conspicuous - सुस्पष्ट (Standing out so as to be clearly visible)


Hence, 'Obscure' is the most suitable antonym for 'Prominent'.
oa:
This word describes someone or something not discovered or known about; uncertain. it is the direct and most appropriate opposite for being famous or prominent.
Synonyms: Unknown (अज्ञात), Hidden (गुप्त), Vague (अस्पष्ट).
Antonyms: Prominent (प्रसिद्ध), Famous (मशहूर), Noticeable (सुस्पष्ट).

This describes a person widely known and admired. it is a direct synonym for the high status of being prominent.
Synonyms: Famous (प्रसिद्ध), Eminent (विख्यात), Noted (विख्यात).
Antonyms: Unheard of (अज्ञात), Inglorious (अपमानजनक), Obscure (गुमनाम).

This describes someone famous and respected within a particular profession. it functions as an exact synonym for the given word.
Synonyms: Distinguished (विशिष्ट), Illustrious (शानदार), Noble (महान).
Antonyms: Ordinary (सामान्य), Common (साधारण), Unknown (अज्ञात).

This word refers to something clearly visible or attracting attention. it matches the "easily seen" aspect of being prominent and acts as a synonym.
Synonyms: Obvious (ज़ाहिर), Salient (मुख्य), Striking (आकर्षक).
Antonyms: Inconspicuous (अस्पष्ट), Discrete (संयमित), Hidden (छिपा हुआ).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Deliberate
questionsEn.s:
Deliberate - सोचा-समझा (Done consciously and intentionally; slow and careful)
Calculated - पूर्व-नियोजित (Done with a full awareness of the consequences)
Rash - जल्दबाज़ (Done without careful consideration of consequences)
Intentional - जानबूझकर (Done on purpose)
Cautious - सावधान (Avoiding potential problems or dangers)


Hence, 'Rash' is the most suitable antonym for 'Deliberate'.
oa:
This word describes an action that is done with a full awareness of the likely consequences. it is a near-perfect synonym for the intentional nature of being deliberate.
Synonyms: Premeditated (पूर्व-नियोजित), Intentional (जानबूझकर), Planned (तय किया हुआ).
Antonyms: Spontaneous (स्वाभाविक), Random (बिना सोचे-समझे), Accidental (आकस्मिक).

This word describes an action done without careful consideration of the possible consequences; being impetuous. it is the direct and most accurate antonym for being deliberate.
Synonyms: Hasty (जल्दबाज़), Reckless (लापरवाह), Impetuous (अविवेकी).
Antonyms: Deliberate (सोचा-समझा), Cautious (सावधान), Prudent (विवेकपूर्ण).

This means something done on purpose. it is the core synonym and definition of the question word.
Synonyms: Conscious (सचेत), Willful (हठी/जानबूझकर), Purposeful (उद्देश्यपूर्ण).
Antonyms: Accidental (आकस्मिक), Unintentional (अनजाने में), Involuntary (अनिच्छुक).

This describes a person avoiding potential problems or dangers. While a deliberate person is often cautious, the word describes a personality trait rather than the intentionality of a specific act.
Synonyms: Careful (सावधान), Wary (सतर्क), Vigilant (चौकस).
Antonyms: Reckless (लापरवाह), Rash (जल्दबाज़), Adventurous (साहसी).

test.title: Set - 8

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Niggardly
questionsEn.s:
Niggardly - कंजूस / अल्प (Showing extreme unwillingness to spend or give)
Mingy - कंजूस / तुच्छ (Unwilling to spend or give freely)
Inefficient - अकुशल / अक्षम (Lacking effectiveness or proper skill)
Generous - उदार / दानी (Willing to give more than expected)
Sinful - पापी / अधर्मी (Against moral or religious principles)
Hence, 'Generous' is the most suitable antonym for 'Niggardly'.
oa:
This term characterizes someone as extremely stingy or reluctant to part with money. Since it mirrors the negative trait of being miserly, it acts as a synonym rather than the required opposite.
Synonyms: Miserly (कंजूस), Parsimonious (मितव्ययी), Penny-pinching (किफ़ायती).
Antonyms: Munificent (बहुत उदार), Bountiful (उदार), Liberal (दानशील).

This word pertains to a lack of organization or skill in completing a task effectively. Its focus is on poor performance or incompetence, which is unrelated to the financial attitude of stinginess.
Synonyms: Incompetent (अयोग्य), Inept (अनाड़ी), Unskilled (अकुशल).
Antonyms: Proficient (निपुण), Capable (सक्षम), Adept (कुशल).

This word describes a willingness to give or share money and kindness freely, often exceeding what is expected. It serves as the perfect antonym to being niggardly, which is characterized by extreme stinginess.
Synonyms: Altruistic (परोपकारी), Philanthropic (समाजसेवी), Benevolent (दयालु).
Antonyms: Greedy (लालची), Selfish (स्वार्थी), Niggardly (कंजूस).

This term refers to actions that are morally wrong or violate religious laws. While it implies bad character, it does not address the specific context of giving or spending money.
Synonyms: Wicked (दुष्ट), Depraved (चरित्रहीन), Corrupt (भ्रष्ट).
Antonyms: Virtuous (सदाचारी), Righteous (धर्मी), Pious (धार्मिक).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Dissident
questionsEn.s:
Dissident - विरोधी (A person who opposes official policy)
Alienated - अलग-थलग (Feeling isolated or estranged)
Iconoclast - स्थापित मान्यताओं का विरोधी (Person who attacks traditional beliefs)
Divisive - फूट डालने वाला (Tending to cause disagreement)
Orthodox - रूढ़िवादी (Following traditional or accepted beliefs)
Hence, 'Orthodox' is the most suitable antonym for 'Dissident'.
oa:
This word describes someone who feels isolated or excluded from a group or society. While a dissident might feel this way, it describes an emotional state rather than an alignment with established beliefs.
Synonyms: Estranged (अलग-थलग), Isolated (एकाकी), Detached (पृथक).
Antonyms: Integrated (एकीकृत), United (संयुक्त), Sociable (मिलनसार).

This refers to a person who attacks cherished beliefs or traditional institutions. It is a synonym for dissident, as both involve opposing established norms, thus failing to provide an opposite.
Synonyms: Rebel (विद्रोही), Radical (चरमपंथी), Nonconformist (अपरंपरावादी).
Antonyms: Believer (आस्तिक), Conformist (अनुपालन करने वाला), Traditionalist (परंपरावादी).

This term is used for something that causes strong disagreement or hostility between people. It describes the effect of a person's actions rather than their adherence to traditional rules.
Synonyms: Discordant (विवादास्पद), Disruptive (विघटनकारी), Alienating (अलगाव पैदा करने वाला).
Antonyms: Harmonious (सामंजस्यपूर्ण), Unifying (एकीकृत करने वाला), Agreeable (सहमत).

This word refers to following traditional or generally accepted rules, beliefs, and practices. It is the direct opposite of a dissident, who actively opposes and disagrees with official policies or established norms.
Synonyms: Conservative (रूढ़िवादी), Traditional (परंपरागत), Conventional (पारंपरिक).
Antonyms: Heterodox (विधर्मी), Dissident (विरोधी), Eccentric (विलक्षण).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Meretricious
questionsEn.s:
Meretricious - भड़कीला पर बेकार (Apparently attractive but having no real value)
Brazen - बेशर्म (Bold and without shame)
Natural - प्राकृतिक (Existing in or caused by nature)
Exemplary - आदर्श (Serving as a desirable model)
Gaudy - भड़कीला (Extravagantly bright or showy)
Hence, 'Natural' is the most suitable antonym for 'Meretricious'.
oa:
This word refers to being bold and without shame. While it can describe a flashy personality, it focuses on shamelessness rather than the deceptive attractiveness implied by the given word.
Synonyms: Audacious (धृष्ट), Bold (साहसी), Shameless (बेशर्म).
Antonyms: Modest (विनम्र), Shy (शर्मीला), Timid (डरपोक).

This word refers to things that are genuine and come from nature, without being artificial or pretentious. It is the perfect antonym for meretricious, which refers to things that are deceptively attractive but lack real value.
Synonyms: Authentic (वास्तविक), Genuine (असली), Pure (शुद्ध).
Antonyms: Artificial (बनावटी), Fake (नकली), Affected (दिखावटी).

This term describes something that is so good that it serves as a model or example for others. It indicates high quality but does not specifically contrast with the "showy but worthless" nature of the target word.
Synonyms: Commendable (प्रशंसनीय), Ideal (आदर्श), Sterling (उत्कृष्ट).
Antonyms: Deplorable (शोचनीय), Unworthy (अयोग्य), Mediocre (सामान्य).

This word describes something extravagantly bright or showy, often in a tasteless way. It serves as a synonym for the flashy aspect of meretricious and therefore cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Garish (भड़कीला), Flashy (दिखावटी), Ostentatious (आडंबरपूर्ण).
Antonyms: Plain (सादा), Simple (सरल), Understated (न्यूनतम).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Nebulous
questionsEn.s:
Nebulous - अस्पष्ट (Vague, hazy, or indistinct)
Definite - निश्चित (Clearly stated or decided)
Inchoate - अविकसित (Just beginning; not fully formed)
Dismal - निराशाजनक (Gloomy or depressing)
Sullen - चिड़चिड़ा (Bad-tempered and sulky)
Hence, 'Definite' is the most suitable antonym for 'Nebulous'.
oa:
This word refers to something that is clearly stated, certain, and easy to identify. It is the direct opposite of nebulous, which describes things that are vague, hazy, or indistinct.
Synonyms: Explicit (स्पष्ट), Clear (सुस्पष्ट), Certain (निश्चित).
Antonyms: Vague (अस्पष्ट), Uncertain (अनिश्चित), Indistinct (धुंधला).

This term refers to something that has just begun and is not fully formed or developed. While related to a lack of clarity, it focuses on early stages of growth rather than haziness.
Synonyms: Rudimentary (अविकसित), Nascent (नवजात), Formless (निराकार).
Antonyms: Developed (विकसित), Mature (परिपक्व), Finished (पूर्ण).

This word describes something gloomy, depressing, or bleak. It refers to the mood or appearance of a situation rather than its level of clarity or precision.
Synonyms: Sombre (उदास), Bleak (बेरंग), Depressing (निराशाजनक).
Antonyms: Bright (चमकीला), Cheerful (प्रसन्न), Radiant (उज्ज्वल).

This term characterizes someone who is bad-tempered, silent, and gloomy. It focuses on a person's behavior and attitude rather than the indistinct nature of an idea or object.
Synonyms: Glum (खिन्न), Morose (चिड़चिड़ा), Sulky (उदास).
Antonyms: Amiable (सुशील), Joyful (हर्षित), Sociable (मिलनसार).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Intrepid
questionsEn.s:
Intrepid - निडर (Fearless and adventurous)
Greed - लालच (Excessive desire for more)
Kind - दयालु (Friendly and generous)
Meek - दब्बू (Quiet, gentle, and easily frightened)
Sigh - लंबी साँस (A long deep audible breath)
Hence, 'Meek' is the most suitable antonym for 'Intrepid'.
oa:
This refers to an excessive desire for wealth or possessions. It is a character flaw related to wanting more, which has no direct connection to courage or fear.
Synonyms: Avarice (लोभ), Rapacity (लालच), Cupidity (लोभ).
Antonyms: Generosity (उदारता), Philanthropy (परोपकार), Altruism (निःस्वार्थता).

This word describes a person who is friendly, generous, and considerate. While it is a positive trait, it focuses on benevolence rather than the fearlessness represented by the target word.
Synonyms: Compassionate (दयालु), Amiable (सुशील), Benevolent (हितकारी).
Antonyms: Cruel (क्रूर), Mean (मतलबी), Harsh (कठोर).

This word describes a person who is quiet, gentle, and easily imposed upon, often lacking courage. It is the appropriate opposite of intrepid, which describes someone who is extremely brave and adventurous.
Synonyms: Timid (डरपोक), Submissive (दब्बू), Humble (विनम्र).
Antonyms: Bold (साहसी), Fearless (निडर), Assertive (मुखर).

This is a physical act or a sound made to express relief, exhaustion, or sadness. It is a verb/noun representing an action and does not describe a personality trait.
Synonyms: Gasp (लंबी साँस), Moan (ाह), Exhale (साँस छोड़ना).
Antonyms: Laughter (हँसी), Smile (मुस्कान), Cheer (उल्लास).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Clandestine
questionsEn.s:
Clandestine - गुप्त (Kept secret or done secretively)
Abrupt - अचानक (Sudden and unexpected)
Illicit - अवैध (Forbidden by law or rules)
Open - खुला (Not secret or hidden; visible)
Wary - सावधान (Feeling or showing caution)
Hence, 'Open' is the most suitable antonym for 'Clandestine'.
oa:
This word refers to something sudden or unexpected, often appearing rude. It describes the timing or manner of an action rather than whether it is hidden or open.
Synonyms: Sudden (अचानक), Hasty (जल्दबाज़), Curt (रूखा).
Antonyms: Gradual (क्रमिक), Expected (प्रत्याशित), Smooth (सहज).

This term describes something that is forbidden by law, rules, or custom. While illicit activities are often clandestine, the word itself is a near-synonym and does not provide an opposite.
Synonyms: Illegal (अवैध), Unlawful (गैरकानूनी), Prohibited (वर्जित).
Antonyms: Legal (कानूनी), Lawful (वैध), Authorized (अधिकृत).

This word means not hidden or secret; it refers to something that is accessible and visible to everyone. It is the direct antonym for clandestine, which means kept secret or hidden.
Synonyms: Public (सार्वजनिक), Overt (प्रकट), Transparent (पारदर्शी).
Antonyms: Secret (गुप्त), Hidden (छिपा हुआ), Private (निजी).

This word describes someone who feels or shows caution about possible dangers or problems. It pertains to a person's alertness rather than the secrecy of an act.
Synonyms: Cautious (सतर्क), Watchful (चौकस), Vigilant (सावधान).
Antonyms: Careless (लापरवाह), Reckless (बेपरवाह), Heedless (असावधान).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Callow
questionsEn.s:
Callow - अनुभवहीन (Young and without experience)
Inexperienced - अनाड़ी (Lacking knowledge or skill)
Jejune - सतही (Simplistic or naive)
Sophisticated - दुनियादार (Experienced and cultured)
Juvenile - किशोर (Childish or immature)
Hence, 'Sophisticated' is the most suitable antonym for 'Callow'.
oa:
This word describes someone who lacks the knowledge or skills gained from doing something for a long time. It is a direct synonym for the given word and does not work as an opposite.
Synonyms: Callow (अनुभवहीन), Untrained (अकुशल), Green (नया).
Antonyms: Experienced (अनुभवी), Seasoned (पक्का), Veteran (पुराना खिलाड़ी).

This term refers to something that is simplistic, naive, or superficial. It is often used to describe immature thoughts or styles, making it synonymous with the target word.
Synonyms: Simple (सरल), Naive (भोला), Shallow (सतही).
Antonyms: Profound (गहन), Intellectual (बौद्धिक), Deep (गहरा).

This word describes someone who has a lot of worldly experience and knowledge of culture and fashion. It is the perfect opposite of callow, which refers to being young, naive, and inexperienced.
Synonyms: Cultured (सुसंस्कृत), Refined (परिष्कृत), Urbane (शिष्ट).
Antonyms: Callow (अनुभवहीन), Naive (भोला), Simple (सादा).

This term relates to young people or behavior that is childish. Since it highlights youth and immaturity, it acts as a synonym for callow and is not the required opposite.
Synonyms: Childish (बचकाना), Puerile (तुच्छ), Adolescent (किशोर).
Antonyms: Mature (परिपक्व), Adult (वयस्क), Senile (वृद्ध).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Abeyance
questionsEn.s:
Abeyance - निलंबन (State of temporary disuse or suspension)
Dormancy - सुप्तावस्था (State of being inactive)
Quiescence - निश्चलता (State of inactivity or dormancy)
Latency - अव्यक्तता (State of existing but not yet active)
Continuation - निरंतरता (The act of carrying on without stopping)
Hence, 'Continuation' is the most suitable antonym for 'Abeyance'.
oa:
This refers to a state of being temporarily inactive or in a deep sleep. It conveys the same idea as abeyance and therefore functions as a synonym rather than an antonym.
Synonyms: Inactivity (निष्क्रियता), Latency (अव्यक्तता), Quiescence (शांति).
Antonyms: Activity (सक्रियता), Operation (संचालन), Action (कार्य).

This word describes a state of quietness or inactivity. Like the target word, it implies that a process has stopped for a while, making it a synonym instead of an opposite.
Synonyms: Calmness (स्थिरता), Silence (शांति), Stillness (निश्चलता).
Antonyms: Turmoil (अशांति), Agitation (उत्तेजना), Motion (गति).

This term describes a state of existing but not yet being developed or active. It focuses on hidden potential or inactivity, aligning closely with the meaning of abeyance.
Synonyms: Potential (संभावना), Suspension (निलंबन), Hibernation (सुप्तावस्था).
Antonyms: Manifestation (प्रकटीकरण), Realization (साक्षात्कार), Actualization (वास्तविकता).

This word refers to the act of carrying on with something without stopping. It serves as the direct opposite of abeyance, which involves a temporary suspension or halt of an activity.
Synonyms: Persistence (निरंतरता), Resumption (पुनरारंभ), Progress (प्रगति).
Antonyms: Halt (विराम), Suspension (निलंबन), Interruption (बाधा).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Melody
questionsEn.s:
Melody - मधुर ध्वनि (A sweet and agreeable succession of sounds)
Chant - मंत्र / जाप (Repeated rhythmic phrase)
Lyric - गीत के बोल (Words of a song)
Cacophony - शोर / कर्कश ध्वनि (Harsh and discordant mixture of sounds)
Inflection - स्वर का उतार-चढ़ाव (Change in pitch or tone of voice)
Hence, 'Cacophony' is the most suitable antonym for 'Melody'.
oa:
This word refers to a rhythmic phrase that is repeated, often in a musical or religious context. While related to sound, it does not represent the opposite of a sweet tune.
Synonyms: Incantation (मंत्र), Intonation (स्वरोच्चारण), Recitation (पाठ).
Antonyms: Silence (चुप्पी), Quiet (शांति), Speech (भाषण).

This term refers to the words of a song or a poem expressing the writer's emotions. It is a component of a song but does not provide an antonym for the sweet sound itself.
Synonyms: Verse (कविता), Stanza (पद्य), Poem (काव्य).
Antonyms: Prose (गद्य), Narrative (कथा), Fact (तथ्य).

This word refers to a harsh, discordant, and unpleasant mixture of sounds. It is the direct opposite of melody, which is characterized by sweet and harmonious sounds.
Synonyms: Discord (कलह), Harshness (कर्कशता), Dissonance (अस्वरता).
Antonyms: Harmony (सामंजस्य), Melody (मधुर संगीत), Euphony (सुस्वरता).

This term refers to the modulation of the voice or the way the pitch changes during speech. It is a technical aspect of vocal sound rather than a contrast to melody.
Synonyms: Modulation (स्वर-परिवर्तन), Variation (उतार-चढ़ाव), Accent (स्वराघात).
Antonyms: Monotone (एकरसता), Uniformity (एकरूपता), Sameness (समानता).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Diffident
questionsEn.s:
Diffident - संकोची (Lacking self-confidence; shy)
Bashful - शर्मीला (Shy or self-conscious)
Demure - विनीत (Reserved and modest)
Aggressive - प्रगल्भ / आक्रामक (Forceful and assertive)
Meek - नम्र (Quiet and easily imposed upon)
Hence, 'Aggressive' is the most suitable antonym for 'Diffident'.
oa:
This word describes someone who is socially shy or timid, often feeling awkward around others. It is a synonym for diffident and therefore does not satisfy the required relationship.
Synonyms: Shy (शर्मीला), Coy (लजीला), Sheepish (संकोची).
Antonyms: Confident (आत्मविश्वासी), Bold (साहसी), Extroverted (बहिर्मुखी).

This term describes a person who is reserved, modest, or shy in behavior. It carries a similar meaning of being retiring or quiet, which mirrors rather than opposes diffident.
Synonyms: Modest (विनम्र), Sedate (गंभीर), Prim (शिष्ट).
Antonyms: Brazen (बेशर्म), Forward (ढीठ), Outgoing (मिलनसार).

This word refers to being assertive, forceful, or ready to confront others boldly. It is the correct opposite of diffident, as the latter implies a lack of self-confidence and excessive shyness.
Synonyms: Assertive (मुखर), Forceful (प्रभावी), Bold (साहसी).
Antonyms: Timid (डरपोक), Diffident (संकोची), Passive (निष्क्रिय).

This term describes someone who is quiet, gentle, and easily ordered around by others. It is another synonym for the lack of assertiveness found in a diffident person.
Synonyms: Submissive (दब्बू), Yielding (नमनशील), Gentle (कोमल).
Antonyms: Spirited (जोशीला), Arrogant (अहंकारी), Rebellious (विद्रोही).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: To maneuver
questionsEn.s:
To maneuver - चालाकी से दिशा देना (To skillfully guide or move strategically)
To manipulate - हेरफेर करना (To control or influence cleverly)
To proceed - आगे बढ़ना (To begin or continue an action)
To cease - बंद करना (To bring to an end or stop)
To machinate - षड्यंत्र करना (To engage in secret plots)
Hence, 'To cease' is the most suitable antonym for 'To maneuver'.
oa:
This verb means to control or influence a person or situation cleverly and often unfairly. It is synonymous with the strategic part of maneuvering and is not an opposite.
Synonyms: Exploit (शोषण करना), Influence (प्रभावित करना), Handle (सँभालना).
Antonyms: Leave alone (अकेला छोड़ना), Neglect (उपेक्षा करना), Be honest (ईमानदार होना).

This term simply means to begin or continue a course of action. It focuses on the act of moving forward rather than the skill or strategy involved in guiding something.
Synonyms: Advance (आगे बढ़ना), Continue (जारी रखना), Progress (प्रगति करना).
Antonyms: Stop (रुकना), Halt (ठहरना), Retreat (पीछे हटना).

This word means to bring an activity or process to a complete end. It serves as the opposite of maneuvering, which involves the active, skillful movement and guidance of a process.
Synonyms: Terminate (समाप्त करना), Stop (रुकना), Discontinue (बंद करना).
Antonyms: Begin (शुरू करना), Persist (बने रहना), Start (आरंभ करना).

This verb refers to engaging in secret plots or schemes. It is a synonym for the deceptive or tactical side of maneuvering and therefore fails to provide an opposite.
Synonyms: Plot (साजिश करना), Conspire (योजना बनाना), Scheme (योजना बनाना).
Antonyms: Oppose (विरोध करना), Disorganize (अव्यवस्थित करना), Reveal (प्रकट करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: To avert
questionsEn.s:
To avert - टालना / रोकना (To prevent or avoid a situation)
To aid - मदद करना (To provide help or assistance)
To deter - रोकना / निरुत्साहित करना (To discourage from action)
To forestall - पहले ही रोक देना (To act in advance to prevent)
To preclude - रोकना / असंभव बनाना (To make impossible to happen)
Hence, 'To aid' is the most suitable antonym for 'To avert'.
oa:
This word means to provide help, support, or assistance to make a process easier. It is the opposite of averting, which means to turn away or prevent something from happening.
Synonyms: Assist (सहायता करना), Support (समर्थन करना), Facilitate (सुविधाजनक बनाना).
Antonyms: Hinder (बाधा डालना), Block (रोकना), Avert (टालना).

This term means to discourage someone from doing something through fear or doubt. It is a near-synonym to avert as both involve stopping an event from occurring.
Synonyms: Discourage (निरुत्साहित करना), Prevent (रोकना), Daunt (धमकाना).
Antonyms: Encourage (प्रोत्साहित करना), Incite (उकसाना), Provoke (भड़काना).

This word refers to preventing or obstructing something by taking action in advance. Since it describes the same outcome as averting, it acts as a synonym.
Synonyms: Preclude (रोकना), Anticipate (पूर्वानुमान करना), Obstruct (बाधा डालना).
Antonyms: Allow (अनुमति देना), Permit (अनुमति देना), Assist (सहायता करना).

This term means to make something impossible or to prevent it from happening. It is a strong synonym for avert and does not work as an antonym.
Synonyms: Exclude (निकालना), Prevent (रोकना), Stop (रुकना).
Antonyms: Include (शामिल करना), Advance (बढ़ावा देना), Promote (पदोन्नत करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Impugnable
questionsEn.s:
Impugnable - विवादास्पद (That which can be challenged or questioned)
Dicey - अनिश्चित (Risky or uncertain)
Debatable - विवाद्य (Open to discussion or argument)
Indubious - निर्विवाद (Beyond doubt or unquestionable)
Hazy - धुंधला (Unclear or vague)
Hence, 'Indubious' is the most suitable antonym for 'Impugnable'.
oa:
This informal word refers to something that is risky, unpredictable, or uncertain. It describes the dangerous nature of a situation rather than whether it can be challenged or questioned.
Synonyms: Risky (जोखिम भरा), Uncertain (अनिश्चित), Perilous (खतरनाक).
Antonyms: Safe (सुरक्षित), Certain (निश्चित), Secure (मजबूत).

This term means that something is open to discussion or can be argued against. It is a direct synonym for impugnable and therefore cannot be used as its opposite.
Synonyms: Questionable (संदिग्ध), Controversial (विवादास्पद), Disputable (विवाद्य).
Antonyms: Certain (निश्चित), Indisputable (निर्विवाद), Absolute (पूर्ण).

This word refers to something that is beyond doubt, certain, and cannot be questioned. it is the perfect antonym for impugnable, which describes something that can be challenged or called into question.
Synonyms: Unquestionable (निर्विवाद), Evident (स्पष्ट), Undeniable (अकाट्य).
Antonyms: Doubtful (संदिग्ध), Vague (अस्पष्ट), Impugnable (विवादास्पद).

This word describes something that is unclear, vague, or indistinct. It refers to a lack of visual or mental clarity, which is not the direct opposite of being able to challenge an idea.
Synonyms: Vague (अस्पष्ट), Cloudy (धुंधला), Foggy (धुंधला).
Antonyms: Clear (स्पष्ट), Lucid (सुस्पष्ट), Bright (उज्ज्वल).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Veneration
questionsEn.s:
Veneration - श्रद्धा / सम्मान (Great respect or reverence)
Adoration - गहरी भक्ति (Deep love and respect)
Contempt - तिरस्कार / अवमानना (Feeling that something is worthless)
Reverence - आदर (Deep respect for someone)
Admiration - प्रशंसा (Respect and warm approval)
Hence, 'Contempt' is the most suitable antonym for 'Veneration'.
oa:
This word refers to deep love, devotion, and great respect. It functions as a synonym for veneration and does not provide the required opposite relationship.
Synonyms: Worship (पूजा), Devotion (भक्ति), Love (प्रेम).
Antonyms: Hatred (नफरत), Loathing (घृणा), Dislike (नापसंदगी).

This term refers to a feeling that someone or something is worthless or beneath consideration. It is the direct opposite of veneration, which involves showing great respect or reverence.
Synonyms: Disdain (तिरस्कार), Scorn (घृणा), Mockery (उपहास).
Antonyms: Respect (सम्मान), Veneration (श्रद्धा), Regard (आदर).

This word means deep respect for someone or something, often in a religious or formal context. It is a strong synonym for the target word and is not an antonym.
Synonyms: Honor (सम्मान), Deference (सम्मान), Homage (श्रद्धांजलि).
Antonyms: Disrespect (अपमान), Irreverence (अनादर), Impudence (धृष्टता).

This term describes a feeling of respect and warm approval. While positive, it mirrors the meaning of veneration and therefore does not serve as an opposite.
Synonyms: Appreciation (प्रशंसा), Praise (तारीफ), Regard (आदर).
Antonyms: Condemnation (निंदा), Criticism (आलोचना), Disapproval (अस्वीकृति).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Incentive
questionsEn.s:
Incentive - प्रोत्साहन (Thing that motivates or encourages action)
Impetus - प्रेरणा / गति (Force that makes something happen)
Stimulus - उकसावा (Something that rouses activity)
Enticement - प्रलोभन (Something used to attract or tempt)
Hindrance - बाधा / रुकावट (Thing that provides resistance or delay)
Hence, 'Hindrance' is the most suitable antonym for 'In Incentive'.
oa:
This word refers to a force that makes something happen or happen more quickly. It functions as a synonym for incentive, as both encourage action.
Synonyms: Motivation (प्रेरणा), Momentum (गति), Stimulus (प्रोत्साहन).
Antonyms: Discouragement (निरुत्साह), Blockage (अवरोध), Check (रोक).

This term describes something that rouses activity or energy in someone or something. Since it acts as a synonym for incentive, it does not provide an opposite meaning.
Synonyms: Spur (प्रोत्साहन), Catalyst (उत्प्रेरक), Inspiration (प्रेरणा).
Antonyms: Deterrent (अवरोधक), Hindrance (बाधा), Deadener (निश्चेतक).

This word refers to something used to attract or tempt someone, often by offering a reward. It is synonymous with the attractive nature of an incentive.
Synonyms: Allure (आकर्षण), Lure (प्रलोभन), Bait (प्रलोभन).
Antonyms: Repulsion (विकर्षण), Warning (चेतावनी), Deterrence (निवारण).

This term refers to a thing that provides resistance, delay, or obstruction to something or someone. It is the perfect opposite of incentive, which is meant to encourage and speed up a process.
Synonyms: Obstacle (बाधा), Impediment (रुकावट), Barrier (अवरोध).
Antonyms: Aid (सहायता), Assistance (मदद), Incentive (प्रोत्साहन).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Benediction
questionsEn.s:
Benediction - आशीर्वाद (A blessing or expression of good wishes)
Criticism - आलोचना (Expression of disapproval based on faults)
Innovation - नवाचार (Introduction of new ideas or methods)
Beautitude - परमानंद (Supreme blessedness or happiness)
Approbation - प्रशंसा / स्वीकृति (Formal approval or praise)
Hence, 'Criticism' is the most suitable antonym for 'Benediction'.
oa:
This word refers to the expression of disapproval or the pointing out of faults in something. It serves as an appropriate antonym for benediction, which is an expression of blessings or good wishes.
Synonyms: Disapproval (अस्वीकृति), Condemnation (निंदा), Censure (भर्त्सना).
Antonyms: Praise (प्रशंसा), Benediction (आशीर्वाद), Approval (स्वीकृति).

This term describes the introduction of new ideas, methods, or devices. Its focus is on creativity and change, which is entirely unrelated to the religious or formal act of blessing.
Synonyms: Novelty (नयापन), Modernization (आधुनिकीकरण), Invention (आविष्कार).
Antonyms: Stagnation (स्थिरता), Tradition (परंपरा), Obsolescence (अप्रचलन).

This word refers to supreme blessedness or extreme happiness. It is a synonym for the state resulting from a benediction and therefore cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Bliss (परमानंद), Felicity (परम सुख), Joy (हर्ष).
Antonyms: Misery (कष्ट), Sorrow (दुःख), Agony (पीड़ा).

This term refers to approval or praise, especially formal approval. While it is positive, it aligns with the supportive nature of a benediction rather than contrasting it.
Synonyms: Endorsement (समर्थन), Acceptance (स्वीकार), Consent (सहमति).
Antonyms: Dislike (नापसंदगी), Refusal (अस्वीकार), Censure (निंदा).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Canonical
questionsEn.s:
Canonical - मानक / शास्त्रीय (Accepted as being authoritative and accurate)
Approved - स्वीकृत (Officially accepted as satisfactory)
Official - आधिकारिक (Relating to a formal authority)
Sanctioned - अनुमोदित (Given official permission)
Unorthodox - अपरंपरागत (Not conforming to accepted standards)
Hence, 'Unorthodox' is the most suitable antonym for 'Canonical'.
oa:
This term means officially agreed or accepted as satisfactory. It describes the same quality of being authoritative that the target word does, acting as a synonym.
Synonyms: Sanctioned (अनुमोदित), Accepted (स्वीकृत), Validated (मान्य).
Antonyms: Rejected (अस्वीकृत), Denied (अस्वीकार), Banned (प्रतिबंधित).

This word relates to an authority or public body and its formal duties. It mirrors the authoritative nature of canonical and does not provide the required opposite.
Synonyms: Authorized (अधिकृत), Formal (औपचारिक), Authentic (प्रमाणिक).
Antonyms: Unofficial (अनौपचारिक), Private (निजी), Casual (अनौपचारिक).

This term refers to something that has been given official permission or approval. It is synonymous with the recognized status of canonical and is not an antonym.
Synonyms: Endorsed (समर्थित), Permitted (अनुमत), Allowed (स्वीकृत).
Antonyms: Forbidden (वर्जित), Prohibited (प्रतिबंधित), Outlawed (गैरकानूनी).

This word refers to something that does not conform to traditional or accepted standards or beliefs. It is the direct opposite of canonical, which implies following recognized and authoritative rules.
Synonyms: Unconventional (अपरंपरागत), Radical (चरमपंथी), Eccentric (विलक्षण).
Antonyms: Orthodox (रूढ़िवादी), Traditional (पारंपरिक), Canonical (मानक).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Disdain
questionsEn.s:
Disdain - तिरस्कार / उपेक्षा (Feeling that something is unworthy of respect)
Antipathy - घृणा / विरोध (Deep-seated feeling of dislike)
Admiration - प्रशंसा (Feeling of respect and warm approval)
Derision - उपहास (Mockery or ridicule)
Scorn - घृणा / अवमानना (Belief that someone is worthless)
Hence, 'Admiration' is the most suitable antonym for 'Disdain'.
oa:
This word refers to a deep-seated feeling of dislike or aversion. It is similar in sentiment to disdain, which involves looking down on something, and therefore acts as a synonym.
Synonyms: Hostility (शत्रुता), Enmity (दुश्मनी), Hatred (नफरत).
Antonyms: Sympathy (सहानुभूति), Fondness (लगाव), Affinity (समानता).

This term describes a feeling of respect and warm approval for someone or something. it is the correct opposite of disdain, which is a feeling that someone is not worthy of respect.
Synonyms: Appreciation (प्रशंसा), Regard (आदर), Respect (सम्मान).
Antonyms: Contempt (तिरस्कार), Disdain (घृणा), Scorn (उपेक्षा).

This term refers to the use of mockery or ridicule to show contempt. It describes a behavior that expresses disdain and is thus a synonym rather than an opposite.
Synonyms: Mockery (उपहास), Ridicule (हंसी उड़ाना), Scorn (तिरस्कार).
Antonyms: Praise (प्रशंसा), Respect (आदर), Flattery (चापलूसी).

This word means the feeling or belief that someone or something is worthless or despicable. It is a strong synonym for disdain and cannot be used as its antonym.
Synonyms: Contempt (अवमानना), Disdain (तिरस्कार), Spite (द्वेष).
Antonyms: Veneration (श्रद्धा), Honor (सम्मान), Approval (स्वीकृति).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Sentience
questionsEn.s:
Sentience - संवेदनशीलता (Capacity to feel or perceive subjectively)
Disregard - उपेक्षा (Action of ignoring or treating as unworthy)
Appreciation - प्रशंसा (Recognition of good qualities)
Consciousness - चेतना (State of being aware and perceiving)
Perception - धारणा / बोध (Ability to see or hear through senses)
Hence, 'Disregard' is the most suitable antonym for 'Sentience'.
oa:
This word refers to the action of ignoring something or treating it as unimportant. In this context, it represents a lack of awareness or perception, acting as the opposite of sentience.
Synonyms: Neglect (उपेक्षा), Inattention (असावधानी), Indifference (उदासीनता).
Antonyms: Attention (ध्यान), Regard (आदर), Sentience (संवेदनशीलता).

This term refers to the recognition and enjoyment of the good qualities of someone or something. It involves active perception and feeling, which is similar to the nature of sentience.
Synonyms: Gratitude (कृतज्ञता), Valuation (मूल्यांकन), Recognition (प्रशंसा).
Antonyms: Criticism (आलोचना), Depreciation (मूल्यह्रास), Disregard (उपेक्षा).

This word describes the state of being aware of and able to think and perceive surroundings. It is a synonym for the mental capacity implied by sentience and is not an opposite.
Synonyms: Awareness (जागरूकता), Alertness (सतर्कता), Mind (चेतना).
Antonyms: Unconsciousness (अचेतन), Coma (मूर्छा), Insensibility (जड़ता).

This term refers to the ability to see, hear, or become aware of something through the senses. It is a core component of sentience rather than a contrasting idea.
Synonyms: Insight (अंतर्दृष्टि), Observation (अवलोकन), Understanding (बोध).
Antonyms: Ignorance (अज्ञान), Blindness (अंधता), Stupidity (मूर्खता).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Incapacitate
questionsEn.s:
Incapacitate - अक्षम करना (To deprive of strength or ability to function)
Cripple - अपंग बनाना (To make unable to move properly)
Facilitate - सुविधा प्रदान करना (To make a process easy or easier)
Maim - विकलांग करना (To injure and permanently damage)
Immobilize - निश्चल करना (To prevent from moving or operating)
Hence, 'Facilitate' is the most suitable antonym for 'Incapacitate'.
oa:
This term means to cause someone to become unable to move or walk properly. It is a synonym for incapacitate, as both involve depriving someone of their ability to function.
Synonyms: Disable (अक्षम करना), Paralyse (अपंग करना), Enfeeble (कमजोर करना).
Antonyms: Cure (ठीक करना), Strengthen (मजबूत करना), Mobilize (सक्रिय करना).

This word means to make an action or process easy or easier to achieve. It is the direct opposite of incapacitating, which involves making something unable to work or function.
Synonyms: Assist (सहायता करना), Ease (सरल बनाना), Expedite (शीघ्र करना).
Antonyms: Hinder (बाधा डालना), Block (रोकना), Incapacitate (अक्षम करना).

This term refers to wounding or injuring someone so that part of the body is permanently damaged. It is a near-synonym to incapacitate and does not provide an antonym.
Synonyms: Mutitlate (विकलांग करना), Disfigure (बिगाड़ना), Injure (चोट पहुँचाना).
Antonyms: Heal (स्वस्थ करना), Repair (मरम्मत करना), Mend (सुधारना).

This word means to prevent someone or something from moving or operating as normal. Like the target word, it involves taking away functionality, making it a synonym.
Synonyms: Paralyse (निश्चल करना), Freeze (जड़ करना), Restrain (रोकना).
Antonyms: Release (मुक्त करना), Move (हिलाना), Activate (सक्रिय करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Lambency
questionsEn.s:
Lambency - चमक / प्रकाश (A soft, radiant light or glow)
Effulgence - उज्ज्वलता (Brilliant radiance or splendor)
Dullness - मंदता / उदासी (Lack of brightness or liveliness)
Gusto - उत्साह (Enthusiastic enjoyment)
Phosphorescence - स्फुरदीप्ति (Light emission without heat)
Hence, 'Dullness' is the most suitable antonym for 'Lambency'.
oa:
This word refers to a brilliant radiance or a shining splendor. It describes a high level of brightness, which aligns with the meaning of lambency rather than opposing it.
Synonyms: Radiance (चमक), Brilliance (दीप्ति), Splendor (वैभव).
Antonyms: Darkness (अंधेरा), Obscurity (अस्पष्टता), Gloom (उदासी).

This term refers to a lack of brightness, intensity, or liveliness. It serves as the direct opposite of lambency, which characterizes a soft, radiant glow or light.
Synonyms: Dreariness (नीरसता), Gloom (अंधेरा), Dimness (मंदता).
Antonyms: Brightness (चमक), Sparkle (झिलमिलाहट), Lambency (प्रकाश).

This term describes enthusiastic and vigorous enjoyment or appreciation. It focuses on human emotion and energy rather than the physical quality of light or glow.
Synonyms: Enthusiasm (उत्साह), Zest (जोश), Vigor (जोश).
Antonyms: Apathy (उदासीनता), Indifference (बेपरवाही), Reluctance (अनिच्छा).

This word refers to the emission of light without burning or heat, resulting in a luminous appearance. It is a specific type of glow and acts as a synonym for lambency.
Synonyms: Luminescence (प्रकाश), Fluorescence (प्रतिदीप्ति), Glow (चमक).
Antonyms: Blackness (कालिमा), Darkness (अंधकार), Shadow (छाया).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Turgid
questionsEn.s:
Turgid - सूजा हुआ / आडंबरपूर्ण (Swollen or tediously pompous)
Bloated - फूला हुआ (Swollen with fluid or gas)
Humble - विनम्र (Showing a modest estimate of importance)
Puffy - सूजा हुआ (Swollen, especially from fluid or air)
Tumescent - सूजा हुआ (Becoming swollen or distended)
Hence, 'Humble' is the most suitable antonym for 'Turgid'.
oa:
This word describes something that is swollen with fluid or gas. It is a synonym for the physical aspect of turgid and does not satisfy the requirement for an opposite.
Synonyms: Swollen (सूजा हुआ), Distended (फूला हुआ), Puffy (थुलथुल).
Antonyms: Deflated (पिचका हुआ), Thin (दुबला), Shrunken (सिकुड़ा हुआ).

This word refers to having or showing a modest estimate of one's own importance. In a metaphorical sense, it is the perfect antonym for turgid, which can describe pompous or bombastic language.
Synonyms: Modest (विनम्र), Unassuming (विनम्र), Meek (नम्र).
Antonyms: Pompous (आडंबरपूर्ण), Arrogant (अहंकारी), Turgid (गर्वित).

This term describes something that is swollen or distended, particularly on the face or body. It mirrors the literal meaning of turgid and acts as a synonym rather than an opposite.
Synonyms: Inflated (फूला हुआ), Edematous (सूजा हुआ), Bulging (उभरा हुआ).
Antonyms: Hollow (खोखला), Sunken (धँसा हुआ), Flat (समतल).

This word refers to something becoming swollen, especially in a medical or physiological context. It is a direct synonym for the "swollen" meaning of turgid.
Synonyms: Enlarged (बढ़ा हुआ), Turgid (सूजा हुआ), Distended (फूला हुआ).
Antonyms: Flaccid (ढीला), Shriveled (मुरझाया हुआ), Contracted (संकुचित).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Raucous
questionsEn.s:
Raucous - कर्कश (Making a disturbingly harsh and loud noise)
Dulcet - मधुर (Sound that is sweet and soothing)
Hoarse - रूखा / भारी (Rough and harsh sounding voice)
Jarring - बेसुरा (Incongruous or clashing sound)
Torrent - प्रवाह / बौछार (A strong and fast-moving stream)
Hence, 'Dulcet' is the most suitable antonym for 'Raucous'.
oa:
This word refers to sounds that are sweet, soothing, and pleasing to the ear. It is the direct opposite of raucous, which describes sounds that are disturbingly harsh and loud.
Synonyms: Melodious (मधुर), Harmonious (सामंजस्यपूर्ण), Euphonious (सुस्वर).
Antonyms: Harsh (कर्कश), Jarring (बेसुरा), Raucous (शोर भरा).

This term describes a voice that sounds rough and harsh, typically due to a sore throat. It is a synonym for the abrasive quality of raucous sound.
Synonyms: Husky (रूखा), Croaky (फटा हुआ), Rasping (कर्कश).
Antonyms: Clear (साफ), Smooth (चिकना), Mellifluous (मधुर).

This word refers to something that is incongruous or shockingly clashing, especially sounds. It functions as a synonym for the unpleasant nature of being raucous.
Synonyms: Discordant (बेसुरा), Grating (कर्कश), Clashing (विरोधी).
Antonyms: Harmonious (सुखद), Soothing (शांत), Consistent (संगत).

This term describes a strong and fast-moving stream of water or liquid. It focuses on the volume and speed of a physical flow rather than the quality of sound.
Synonyms: Flood (बाढ़), Deluge (जलप्रलय), Cascade (प्रपात).
Antonyms: Drip (बूँद), Trickle (बूँद-बूँद टपकना), Drought (सूखा).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Predilection
questionsEn.s:
Predilection - पूर्वाग्रह / पसंद (A preference or special liking for something)
Inclination - रुझान (Natural tendency or urge)
Enduring - सहनशील (Lasting over a period of time)
Enmity - दुश्मनी (Being actively opposed or hostile)
Domicile - निवास (A person's permanent home)
Hence, 'Enmity' is the most suitable antonym for 'Predilection'.
oa:
This term refers to a person's natural tendency or urge to act or feel in a particular way. It is a synonym for predilection, as both involve a bias in favor of something.
Synonyms: Preference (पसंद), Penchant (लगाव), Propensity (झुकाव).
Antonyms: Aversion (घृणा), Dislike (नापसंदगी), Antipathy (विरोध).

This word describes something that is lasting over a long period of time. It focuses on durability or tolerance rather than on having a specific liking or preference for something.
Synonyms: Durable (टिकाऊ), Permanent (स्थायी), Constant (निरंतर).
Antonyms: Fleeting (क्षणिक), Transient (अस्थायी), Short-lived (अल्पकालिक).

This word refers to a state of being actively opposed or hostile toward someone or something. It is the correct opposite of predilection, which involves having a special liking or bias toward something.
Synonyms: Hostility (शत्रुता), Animosity (द्वेष), Hatred (नफरत).
Antonyms: Amity (मित्रता), Predilection (पसंद), Friendship (दोस्ती).

This term refers to the country or place that a person treats as their permanent home. It is a legal or residential term that has no connection to likes, dislikes, or preferences.
Synonyms: Residence (निवास), Abode (घर), Habitation (वासस्थान).
Antonyms: Exile (निर्वासन), Displacement (विस्थापन), Homelessness (बेघर).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: To Indict
questionsEn.s:
To Indict - आरोप लगाना (To formally accuse of a crime)
To Arraign - अदालत में बुलाना (To bring someone to answer a charge)
To Censure - निंदा करना (To express severe disapproval)
To Exonerate - दोषमुक्त करना (To clear someone of blame or crime)
To Impeach - अभियोग चलाना (To challenge validity or charge an official)
Hence, 'To Exonerate' is the most suitable antonym for 'To Indict'.
oa:
This verb means to call or bring someone before a court to answer a criminal charge. It is a synonym for the process of indicting someone and therefore is not an opposite.
Synonyms: Charge (आरोप लगाना), Prosecute (मुकदमा चलाना), Summon (बुलाना).
Antonyms: Exonerate (दोषमुक्त करना), Pardon (क्षमा करना), Release (मुक्त करना).

This term means to express severe disapproval of someone or something, especially in a formal statement. It is a negative action similar to indicting rather than an opposite.
Synonyms: Criticize (आलोचना करना), Reprimand (फटकारना), Condemn (निंदा करना).
Antonyms: Praise (प्रशंसा करना), Commend (सराहना करना), Laud (बखान करना).

This word means to officially declare someone free from blame or guilt for a fault or crime. It is the direct opposite of indict, which involves formally accusing or charging someone.
Synonyms: Acquit (बरी करना), Absolve (दोषमुक्त करना), Vindicate (साबित करना).
Antonyms: Convict (दोषी ठहराना), Indict (आरोप लगाना), Blame (दोष देना).

This verb refers to calling into question the integrity or validity of something, or formally charging a high public official with a crime. It acts as a synonym for accusing.
Synonyms: Challenge (चुनौती देना), Accuse (दोषी ठहराना), Denounce (निंदा करना).
Antonyms: Confirm (पुष्टि करना), Support (समर्थन करना), Validate (मान्य करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Savant
questionsEn.s:
Savant - विद्वान (A learned person in a specific field)
Amateur - अनाड़ी / नौसिखिया (Person inexperienced or doing it for pleasure)
Academic - शैक्षिक (Relating to studies or scholarship)
Pundit - पंडित / विशेषज्ञ (An expert in a particular subject)
Egghead - बुद्धिजीवी (A highly academic or studious person)
Hence, 'Amateur' is the most suitable antonym for 'Savant'.
oa:
This word refers to a person who is incompetent or inexperienced in a particular activity, often doing it as a hobby rather than a profession. It is the opposite of a savant, who is a learned person.
Synonyms: Novice (नौसिखिया), Tyro (अनाड़ी), Inexpert (अकुशल).
Antonyms: Expert (विशेषज्ञ), Savant (विद्वान), Professional (पेशेवर).

This term relates to education, scholarship, or a person who is studious. Since it describes someone involved in learning, it is synonymous with the studious nature of a savant.
Synonyms: Scholarly (विद्वत्तापूर्ण), Educational (शैक्षिक), Studious (अध्ययनशील).
Antonyms: Practical (व्यावहारिक), Ignorant (अज्ञानी), Untrained (अशिक्षित).

This word refers to an expert in a particular subject or field who is frequently called on to give opinions. It is a direct synonym for savant and therefore not an opposite.
Synonyms: Expert (विशेषज्ञ), Authority (अधिकारी), Sage (मनीषी).
Antonyms: Layman (साधारण व्यक्ति), Ignoramus (मूर्ख), Follower (अनुयायी).

This informal and sometimes insulting term describes a person who is highly academic or studious. It is a synonym for the intellectual nature of a savant.
Synonyms: Intellectual (बुद्धिजीवी), Scholar (विद्वान), Highbrow (पढ़ा-लिखा).
Antonyms: Lowbrow (अशिक्षित), Philistine (असंस्कृत), Simpleton (मूर्ख).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Dissension
questionsEn.s:
Dissension - विवाद (Disagreement leading to discord)
Bickering - छोटी बातों पर झगड़ा (Petty and trivial arguing)
Controversy - सार्वजनिक विवाद (Prolonged public disagreement)
Strife - संघर्ष (Angry or bitter disagreement)
Harmony - सामंजस्य (State of peaceful agreement)
Hence, 'Harmony' is the most suitable antonym for 'Dissension'.
oa:
This term refers to petty and trivial arguing or quarreling. It is a type of minor disagreement and acts as a synonym for the conflict found in dissension.
Synonyms: Quarreling (झगड़ा), Squabbling (तकरार), Arguing (बहस).
Antonyms: Agreeing (सहमत होना), Conceding (मान लेना), Assenting (स्वीकार करना).

This word describes a prolonged public disagreement or heated discussion. It is a synonym for the discord implied by dissension and therefore not an opposite.
Synonyms: Dispute (विवाद), Debate (बहस), Polemic (विवादास्पद).
Antonyms: Consensus (आम सहमति), Harmony (तालमेल), Peace (शांति).

This term refers to angry or bitter disagreement over fundamental issues. It describes a state of conflict, making it synonymous with the essence of dissension.
Synonyms: Conflict (संघर्ष), Friction (अनबन), Discord (कलह).
Antonyms: Concord (सामंजस्य), Amity (मित्रता), Cooperation (सहयोग).

This word refers to a state of peaceful agreement and cooperation where all parties are in accord. It is the perfect antonym for dissension, which involves disagreement and discord.
Synonyms: Accord (सामंजस्य), Concord (तालमेल), Unity (एकता).
Antonyms: Dissension (विवाद), Strife (संघर्ष), Conflict (विरोध).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Bifurcate
questionsEn.s:
Bifurcate - दो शाखाओं में बाँटना (Divide into two branches or forks)
Combine - मिलाना / जोड़ना (Join or merge to form a single unit)
Ramify - शाखाएँ बनाना (Form branches or offshoots)
Furcate - विभाजित करना (Divide into branches)
Diverge - अलग दिशा में जाना (Depart from a course or separate)
Hence, 'Combine' is the most suitable antonym for 'Bifurcate'.
oa:
This verb means to join or merge two or more things together to form a single unit. It is the direct opposite of bifurcate, which involves dividing something into two branches.
Synonyms: Unite (जोड़ना), Merge (मिलाना), Join (सम्मिलित करना).
Antonyms: Bifurcate (विभाजित करना), Separate (अलग करना), Divide (बाँटना).

This term means to form branches or offshoots, or to spread out in a complex way. It describes a process of dividing or branching out, making it synonymous with bifurcate.
