Synonyms: Branch (शाखाएँ निकलना), Diverge (फैलना), Fork (दो हिस्सों में बँटना).
Antonyms: Centralize (केंद्रित करना), Simplify (सरल बनाना), Converge (एक बिंदु पर मिलना).

This word means to divide into two or more branches. It is essentially a synonym for bifurcate and therefore cannot be used as its antonym.
Synonyms: Split (बाँटना), Fork (विभाजित होना), Branch (शाखा बनाना).
Antonyms: Unite (जोड़ना), Combine (मिलाना), Merge (एकीकृत करना).

This term means to depart from a set course or to separate and go in different directions. It carries the same idea of splitting apart as the target word.
Synonyms: Deviate (विचलित होना), Separate (अलग होना), Fork (बँटना).
Antonyms: Converge (मिलना), Coincide (मेल खाना), Connect (जुड़ना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Extenuate
questionsEn.s:
Extenuate - कम करना (To make an offense seem less serious)
Strengthen - मजबूत करना (To make or become stronger)
Enfeeble - कमजोर करना (To make weak or feeble)
Abate - घटाना (To reduce in amount or intensity)
Acquit - बरी करना (To free from a criminal charge)
Hence, 'Strengthen' is the most suitable antonym for 'Extenuate'.
oa:
This word means to make something stronger, more effective, or more resilient. In the context of a fault or crime, it is the opposite of extenuating, which means making an offense seem less serious.
Synonyms: Fortify (मजबूत करना), Reinforce (सुदृढ़ करना), Enhance (बढ़ाना).
Antonyms: Weaken (कमजोर करना), Enfeeble (अशक्त करना), Extenuate (कम करना).

This term means to make someone or something weak or feeble. It is synonymous with the idea of reducing strength, which is similar to the "lessening" nature of extenuating.
Synonyms: Weaken (कमजोर करना), Debilitate (दुर्बल करना), Sap (शक्ति छीनना).
Antonyms: Invigorate (स्फूर्ति देना), Strengthen (मजबूत करना), Revitalize (पुनर्जीवित करना).

This verb means to reduce in amount, degree, or intensity. Since it involves making something less severe or strong, it acts as a synonym for extenuate.
Synonyms: Subside (कम होना), Decline (घटना), Lessen (घटाना).
Antonyms: Increase (बढ़ाना), Intensify (तीव्र करना), Magnify (बढ़ाना).

This word refers to freeing someone from a criminal charge by a verdict of not guilty. While related to law, it describes a final legal judgment rather than the lessening of an offense's seriousness.
Synonyms: Exonerate (दोषमुक्त करना), Absolve (बरी करना), Clear (साफ करना).
Antonyms: Convict (दोषी ठहराना), Sentence (सजा देना), Blame (दोषी मानना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Fecund
questionsEn.s:
Fecund - उपजाऊ (Capable of producing an abundance of offspring)
Prolific - उत्पादक (Producing many works or offspring)
Sterile - बाँझ / निष्फल (Not able to produce offspring or seeds)
Necessitate - आवश्यक बनाना (Make something necessary as a result)
Turmoil - अशांति (State of great disturbance or confusion)
Hence, 'Sterile' is the most suitable antonym for 'Fecund'.
oa:
This word describes someone or something that produces many works, offspring, or results. It is a direct synonym for fecund and does not satisfy the requirement for an opposite.
Synonyms: Fertile (उपजाऊ), Productive (उत्पादक), Fruitful (फलदायक).
Antonyms: Barren (बंजर), Sterile (बाँझ), Unproductive (अनुत्पादक).

This term refers to something that is not able to produce offspring, seeds, or fruit; it means infertile. It is the direct opposite of fecund, which means highly fertile and productive.
Synonyms: Barren (बंजर), Infertile (अनुर्वर), Unproductive (निष्फल).
Antonyms: Fecund (उपजाऊ), Fertile (उर्वर), Prolific (प्रचुर).

This verb means to make something necessary as a result or consequence. Its focus is on requirement and cause, which is unrelated to the concept of biological or artistic fertility.
Synonyms: Require (आवश्यक होना), Compel (विवश करना), Demand (माँग करना).
Antonyms: Obviate (निवारण करना), Prevent (रोकना), Eliminate (हटाना).

This noun refers to a state of great disturbance, confusion, or uncertainty. It describes a chaotic situation rather than the productivity or fertility of a person or land.
Synonyms: Chaos (अराजकता), Commotion (कोलाहल), Disorder (अव्यवस्था).
Antonyms: Peace (शांति), Order (व्यवस्था), Tranquility (स्थिरता).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Desecrate
questionsEn.s:
Desecrate - अपवित्र करना (To treat a sacred place with disrespect)
Sanctify - पवित्र करना (To make holy or set apart as sacred)
Profane - अधार्मिक (Showing disrespect for sacred things)
Befoul - गंदा करना (To make dirty or impure)
Defile - दूषित करना (To spoil the purity of something)
Hence, 'Sanctify' is the most suitable antonym for 'Desecrate'.
oa:
This word means to make something holy, set it apart as sacred, or purify it. It serves as the direct opposite of desecrate, which means to treat a sacred thing with violent disrespect.
Synonyms: Consecrate (पवित्र करना), Hallow (पूजनीय बनाना), Bless (आशीर्वाद देना).
Antonyms: Desecrate (अपवित्र करना), Profane (अधार्मिक बनाना), Defile (दूषित करना).

This term refers to showing disrespect for something sacred or treating it as common. Since it describes the same negative action as desecrate, it functions as a synonym.
Synonyms: Desecrate (अपवित्र करना), Blaspheme (ईश-निंदा करना), Violate (उल्लंघन करना).
Antonyms: Worship (पूजा करना), Revere (आदर करना), Respect (सम्मान करना).

This term means to make something dirty, impure, or foul. While it describes a negative state, its focus is on physical filth rather than the violation of sacredness.
Synonyms: Dirty (गंदा करना), Contaminate (प्रदूषित करना), Pollute (दूषित करना).
Antonyms: Clean (साफ करना), Purify (शुद्ध करना), Sanitize (कीटाणुरहित करना).

This word means to spoil the purity or cleanliness of something, or to treat a sacred place with disrespect. It is a strong synonym for desecrate and cannot be used as its opposite.
Synonyms: Corrupt (भ्रष्ट करना), Degrade (नीचा दिखाना), Taint (कलंकित करना).
Antonyms: Honor (सम्मान देना), Purify (शुद्ध करना), Elevate (ऊँचा उठाना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Waggish
questionsEn.s:
Waggish - चुलबुला / मजाकिया (Playful or humorous)
Jocular - हंसी मजाक करनेवाला (Characterized by joking)
Whimsical - मनमौजी (Playfully quaint or fanciful)
Flippant - चंचल / असंजीदा (Not showing a serious attitude)
Solemn - गंभीर (Serious, formal, and dignified)
Hence, 'Solemn' is the most suitable antonym for 'Waggish'.
oa:
This word refers to something characterized by joking or jesting. It is a synonym for the humorous nature of waggish and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an opposite.
Synonyms: Humorous (मजाकिया), Witty (चतुर), Playful (चुलबुला).
Antonyms: Solemn (गंभीर), Serious (संजीदा), Earnest (गंभीर).

This term describes someone who is playfully quaint or fanciful, especially in an appealing way. It aligns with the lighthearted and humorous vibe of waggish, making it a synonym.
Synonyms: Capricious (मनमौजी), Fanciful (काल्पनिक), Quaint (अजीब).
Antonyms: Practical (व्यावहारिक), Realistic (यथार्थवादी), Grounded (स्थिर).

This term characterizes someone who does not show a serious or respectful attitude when they should. It is similar to waggish in its lack of seriousness, acting as a synonym.
Synonyms: Disrespectful (अनादरपूर्ण), Glib (वाचाल), Superficial (सतही).
Antonyms: Respectful (सम्मानपूर्ण), Courteous (विनम्र), Sincere (ईमानदार).

This word refers to something that is serious, formal, dignified, and sincere. It is the direct opposite of waggish, which describes behavior that is playful, humorous, or mischievous.
Synonyms: Serious (गंभीर), Grave (गंभीर), Earnest (संजीदा).
Antonyms: Waggish (चुलबुला), Frivolous (तुच्छ), Lighthearted (खुशमिजाज).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Colossal
questionsEn.s:
Colossal - विशालकाय (Extremely large or great)
Epic - महाकाव्य (Long narrative poem or grand in scale)
Rust - जंग (Reddish-brown coating on iron)
Teeny - बहुत छोटा (Extremely small or tiny)
Vast - विशाल (Of very great extent or quantity)
Hence, 'Teeny' is the most suitable antonym for 'Colossal'.
oa:
This word refers to a long narrative poem or something very grand and heroic in scale. While it implies greatness, it is more of a synonym for the vast scale of colossal.
Synonyms: Heroic (वीरतापूर्ण), Grand (भव्य), Majestic (शानदार).
Antonyms: Ordinary (साधारण), Trivial (तुच्छ), Minor (मामूली).

This term refers to a reddish-brown coating formed on iron by oxidation. It is a chemical process and a physical substance that has no relationship with the size or scale of an object.
Synonyms: Corrosion (क्षरण), Oxidation (ऑक्सीकरण), Decay (क्षय).
Antonyms: Polish (पॉलिश), Shine (चमक), Protection (सुरक्षा).

This informal word refers to something that is extremely small or tiny. It serves as the direct opposite of colossal, which describes something that is extremely large or great in size.
Synonyms: Tiny (छोटा), Minuscule (सूक्ष्म), Minute (नगण्य).
Antonyms: Colossal (विशालकाय), Enormous (विशाल), Huge (बहुत बड़ा).

This word describes something of very great extent or quantity; immense. Since it carries the same meaning as colossal regarding extreme size, it acts as a synonym.
Synonyms: Enormous (विशाल), Immense (अत्यधिक), Huge (बड़ा).
Antonyms: Small (छोटा), Narrow (तंग), Limited (सीमित).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Opprobrium
questionsEn.s:
Opprobrium - अपमान / निंदा (Harsh criticism or public disgrace)
Adulation - अतिप्रशंसा (Excessive praise or admiration)
Ignominy - बदनामी (Public shame or disgrace)
Mystical - रहस्यमय (Having a spiritual or mystical nature)
Preclude - रोकना (To prevent or make impossible)
Hence, 'Adulation' is the most suitable antonym for 'Opprobrium'.
oa:
This word refers to excessive praise, admiration, or flattery. It is the direct opposite of opprobrium, which involves harsh criticism, public disgrace, or shame.
Synonyms: Commendation (प्रशंसा), Applause (वाहवाही), Praise (बखान).
Antonyms: Criticism (आलोचना), Opprobrium (अपमान), Scorn (घृणा).

This term refers to public shame, disgrace, or dishonor. It carries almost the same meaning as the target word and therefore serves as a synonym rather than an opposite.
Synonyms: Disgrace (अपमान), Infamy (कुख्याति), Humiliation (निरादर).
Antonyms: Honor (सम्मान), Fame (प्रसिद्धि), Glory (महिमा).

This word refers to things that have a spiritual or hidden meaning, or relate to mysticism. It focuses on the supernatural or mysterious, which is unrelated to the context of public reputation.
Synonyms: Spiritual (आध्यात्मिक), Enigmatic (रहस्यमय), Esoteric (गूढ़).
Antonyms: Mundane (सांसारिक), Clear (स्पष्ट), Obvious (जाहिर).

This verb means to make something impossible or to prevent it from happening. It describes the prevention of an event rather than a person's standing or the criticism they receive.
Synonyms: Prevent (रोकना), Avert (टालना), Block (बाधा डालना).
Antonyms: Allow (अनुमति देना), Permit (अनुमति देना), Facilitate (सुविधाजनक बनाना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Rampage
questionsEn.s:
Rampage - उपद्रव (Violent or unrestrained behavior)
Binge - खुराक / अतिरेक (Excessive indulgence in something)
Frenzy - उन्माद (Extreme excitement or wild activity)
Harmony - सामंजस्य (State of peace and agreement)
Turmoil - उथल-पुथल (State of great disturbance or confusion)
Hence, 'Harmony' is the most suitable antonym for 'Rampage'.
oa:
This word refers to an excessive indulgence in something, particularly food or drink. It describes a lack of self-control but is not a direct opposite of the violent chaos implied by a rampage.
Synonyms: Spree (हो-हल्ला), Indulgence (लत), Glut (भरमार).
Antonyms: Restraint (संयम), Temperance (परहेज), Moderation (मर्यादा).

This term describes a state of extreme excitement or wild activity that is often out of control. It is a synonym for the chaotic nature of a rampage and cannot be used as an opposite.
Synonyms: Madness (पागलपन), Furor (उन्माद), Hysteria (हिस्टीरिया).
Antonyms: Calmness (शांति), Composure (धैर्य), Peace (स्थिरता).

This word refers to a state of peace, agreement, and synchronization between different elements. It represents the direct opposite of a rampage, which is characterized by violent and uncontrolled behavior.
Synonyms: Peace (शांति), Concord (तालमेल), Amity (मित्रता).
Antonyms: Conflict (संघर्ष), Rampage (उपद्रव), Discord (कलह).

This term refers to a state of great disturbance, disorder, or confusion. Like rampage, it describes a situation lacking order, making it a synonym instead of an antonym.
Synonyms: Chaos (अराजकता), Commotion (कोलाहल), Agitation (उत्तेजना).
Antonyms: Stability (स्थिरता), Quiet (शांति), Order (व्यवस्था).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Blasphemous
questionsEn.s:
Blasphemous - पाखंडी / अपवित्र (Disregarding God or sacred things)
Pious - धार्मिक (Devoutly religious and holy)
Profane - अपवित्र (Showing disrespect for sacred things)
Sacrilegious - पवित्रता का अपमान (Violating something sacred)
Irreligious - अधर्मी (Lacking religious belief or hostile to it)
Hence, 'Pious' is the most suitable antonym for 'Blasphemous'.
oa:
This word describes a person who is devoutly religious, holy, and shows deep respect for God. It is the direct opposite of blasphemous, which involves disregarding or insulting sacred things.
Synonyms: Religious (धार्मिक), Devout (भक्त), Godly (ईश्वरपरायण).
Antonyms: Blasphemous (पाखंडी), Irreligious (अधर्मी), Impious (अधर्मी).

This term refers to things that are not religious or that show a lack of respect for sacred things. It is a direct synonym for the target word and does not work as an opposite.
Synonyms: Secular (सांसारिक), Irreverent (अनादरपूर्ण), Ungodly (अधर्मी).
Antonyms: Sacred (पवित्र), Holy (पावन), Sanctified (पवित्र किया हुआ).

This term characterizes an act that involves the violation or misuse of what is regarded as sacred. It mirrors the meaning of blasphemous and therefore functions as a synonym.
Synonyms: Impious (अधर्मी), Profane (अपवित्र), Sinful (पापी).
Antonyms: Reverent (आदरपूर्ण), Devotional (भक्तिमय), Pious (धार्मिक).

This word describes someone who is indifferent or hostile to religion, or lacking religious belief. It aligns with the unholy nature of blasphemy rather than providing an opposite.
Synonyms: Atheistic (नास्तिक), Heathen (काफ़िर), Unbelieving (अविश्वासी).
Antonyms: Devout (धार्मिक), Spiritual (आध्यात्मिक), Faithful (विश्वासी).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Trepidation
questionsEn.s:
Trepidation - घबराहट / भय (A feeling of fear or anxiety about something)
Bawdy - अश्लील (Humorously indecent)
Calm - शांत (Free from strong emotions or agitation)
Fear - भय (Emotion caused by threat of danger)
Violent - हिंसक (Using physical force to hurt or damage)
Hence, 'Calm' is the most suitable antonym for 'Trepidation'.
oa:
This term refers to language or humor that is indecent in a humorous way. It focuses on the crude nature of content and has no relationship with feelings of fear or anxiety.
Synonyms: Risqué (अश्लील), Vulgar (अशिष्ट), Lewd (कामुक).
Antonyms: Chaste (शुद्ध), Decent (शिष्ट), Clean (साफ).

This word refers to a state of being free from strong emotions like fear, anxiety, or excitement. It is the correct opposite of trepidation, which involves a feeling of fear or agitation.
Synonyms: Serenity (शांति), Tranquility (स्थिरता), Composure (धैर्य).
Antonyms: Agitation (उत्तेजना), Anxiety (चिंता), Trepidation (भय).

This term refers to an unpleasant emotion caused by the threat of danger, pain, or harm. It is a direct synonym for trepidation and therefore cannot be used as its antonym.
Synonyms: Dread (डर), Terror (आतंक), Fright (भय).
Antonyms: Bravery (साहस), Courage (हिम्मत), Boldness (निर्भयता).

This word describes an action involving physical force intended to hurt or damage. It focuses on the intensity of physical aggression rather than the internal feeling of nervous dread.
Synonyms: Brutal (क्रूर), Fierce (उग्र), Savage (अमानवीय).
Antonyms: Gentle (सौम्य), Peaceful (शांत), Kind (दयालु).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Multifaceted
questionsEn.s:
Multifaceted - बहुआयामी (Having many different aspects or features)
Adroit - चतुर / कुशल (Clever or skillful)
Handy - सुविधाजनक (Useful or convenient)
Pliable - लचीला (Easily bent or flexible)
Simple - सरल / साधारण (Plain or uncomplicated in form)
Hence, 'Simple' is the most suitable antonym for 'Multifaceted'.
oa:
This word refers to someone who is clever or skillful in using their hands or mind. It describes a person's ability rather than the number of aspects or features a thing has.
Synonyms: Skillful (कुशल), Dexterous (निपुण), Adept (दक्ष).
Antonyms: Inept (अनाड़ी), Clumsy (भद्दा), Incompetent (अयोग्य).

This term describes something that is convenient to handle or useful for a particular purpose. It focuses on utility and ease of use, which does not contrast with having many sides.
Synonyms: Useful (उपयोगी), Convenient (सुविधाजनक), Helpful (सहायक).
Antonyms: Useless (बेकार), Inconvenient (असुविधाजनक), Cumbersome (भारी).

This word refers to something that is easily bent or flexible, or a person who is easily influenced. It describes physical or mental flexibility rather than simplicity of form.
Synonyms: Flexible (लचीला), Malleable (नमनशील), Adaptable (अनुकूलनीय).
Antonyms: Rigid (कठोर), Stubborn (जिद्दी), Inflexible (अटल).

This word refers to something that is plain, uncomplicated, or consists of only one part or aspect. It serves as the direct opposite of multifaceted, which implies having many different aspects.
Synonyms: Uncomplicated (सरल), Basic (बुनियादी), Elementary (प्राथमिक).
Antonyms: Complex (जटिल), Multifaceted (बहुआयामी), Intricate (पेचीदा).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Epidemic
questionsEn.s:
Epidemic - महामारी (A widespread occurrence of an infectious disease)
Contagious - संक्रामक (Spread from one to another by contact)
Endemic - स्थानीय रोग (Regularly found in a certain area)
Limited - सीमित (Restricted in size or extent)
Infectious - छूत का (Liable to be transmitted through environment)
Hence, 'Limited' is the most suitable antonym for 'Epidemic'.
oa:
This term describes a disease that can be spread from one person to another by direct or indirect contact. It describes the nature of how a disease spreads, mirroring the behavior of an epidemic.
Synonyms: Infectious (संक्रामक), Transmissible (हस्तांतरणीय), Communicable (छूत का).
Antonyms: Non-communicable (गैर-संक्रामक), Incommunicable (अछूत), Sterile (बाँझ).

This word refers to a disease or condition that is regularly found among particular people or in a specific area. While it limits scope, it still describes the presence of a disease, acting as a related term.
Synonyms: Local (स्थानीय), Regional (क्षेत्रीय), Indigenous (स्वदेशी).
Antonyms: Pandemic (विश्वव्यापी), Exotic (विदेशी), Global (वैश्विक).

This word refers to something that is restricted in size, amount, or extent. It serves as an appropriate antonym for epidemic, which implies a widespread and rapidly increasing occurrence of something.
Synonyms: Restricted (सीमित), Finite (निश्चित), Small (अल्प).
Antonyms: Widespread (व्यापक), Endless (अनंत), Epidemic (महामारी).

This term describes a disease-causing organism that is liable to be transmitted to people through the environment. It is a synonym for the spreading quality of an epidemic.
Synonyms: Spreading (फैलने वाला), Pestilential (विनाशकारी), Catching (छूत का).
Antonyms: Harmless (हानिरहित), Safe (सुरक्षित), Healthy (स्वस्थ).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Rampart
questionsEn.s:
Rampart - किले की दीवार (A defensive wall with a broad top)
Barricade - बाधा / बैरिकेड (Improvised barrier for defense)
Fort - किला (A fortified building or position)
Embankment - तटबंध (Wall built to prevent river flooding)
Ditch - खाई (A narrow channel dug in the ground)
Hence, 'Ditch' is the most suitable antonym for 'Rampart'.
oa:
This term refers to an improvised barrier erected to prevent or delay the movement of opposing forces. It is a synonym for the defensive purpose of a rampart.
Synonyms: Obstacle (बाधा), Barrier (अवरोध), Hurdle (अड़चन).
Antonyms: Passage (मार्ग), Opening (द्वार), Entrance (प्रवेश).

This word refers to a fortified building or a strategic position used for defense. It serves as a synonym for the general defensive structure that includes a rampart.
Synonyms: Fortress (किला), Citadel (गढ़), Stronghold (किला).
Antonyms: Ruin (खंडहर), Cottage (कुटिया), Shack (झोपड़ी).

This term refers to a wall or bank of earth or stone built to prevent flooding or to carry a road. It describes a similar structural feature as a rampart.
Synonyms: Dam (बाँध), Mound (टीला), Levee (तटबंध).
Antonyms: Depresion (गर्त), Valley (घाटी), Hollow (खाई).

This word refers to a narrow channel dug in the ground, typically used for drainage or as a boundary. In a defensive context, a ditch is an opening in the ground, whereas a rampart is a protective wall above it.
Synonyms: Trench (खाई), Gutter (नाली), Channel (नहर).
Antonyms: Ridge (मेड़), Rampart (किले की दीवार), Mound (टीला).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Lugubrious
questionsEn.s:
Lugubrious - उदास (Looking or sounding sad and dismal)
Clumsy - अनाड़ी (Awkward in movement or handling)
Lucid - स्पष्ट (Expressed clearly; easy to understand)
Optimistic - आशावादी (Hopeful and confident about the future)
Sinister - अशुभ (Giving the impression of being evil or harmful)
Hence, 'Optimistic' is the most suitable antonym for 'Lugubrious'.
oa:
This term describes someone who is awkward in movement or in handling things. It relates to physical coordination rather than the emotional state of being sad or dismal.
Synonyms: Awkward (अनाड़ी), Inept (अकुशल), Gawky (भद्दा).
Antonyms: Graceful (सौम्य), Adroit (चतुर), Dexterous (निपुण).

This word refers to something that is expressed clearly and is easy to understand. It focuses on intellectual or visual clarity rather than on a person's mood or expression.
Synonyms: Clear (स्पष्ट), Intelligible (सुबोध), Coherent (सुसंगत).
Antonyms: Vague (अस्पष्ट), Confusing (भ्रामक), Obscure (धुंधला).

This term refers to being hopeful and confident about the future. It is the direct antonym of lugubrious, which characterizes someone who looks or sounds extremely sad, gloomy, or dismal.
Synonyms: Hopeful (आशावादी), Sanguine (आश्वस्त), Cheerful (प्रसन्न).
Antonyms: Pessimistic (निराशावादी), Lugubrious (उदास), Gloomy (विषादपूर्ण).

This word describes something that gives an impression that something harmful or evil is happening. It describes a threatening quality rather than a simple sadness.
Synonyms: Menacing (धमकी भरा), Ominous (अशुभ), Threatening (डरावना).
Antonyms: Auspicious (शुभ), Benign (सौम्य), Innocent (निर्दोष).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Ensconce
questionsEn.s:
Ensconce - छिपाकर रखना / बसना (To settle in a comfortable and safe place)
Establish - स्थापित करना (To set up on a firm basis)
Impudence - ढिठाई / अक्खड़पन (Quality of being disrespectful or rude)
Request - अनुरोध (Act of asking politely for something)
Unveil - अनावरण करना / प्रकट करना (To uncover or reveal something)
Hence, 'Unveil' is the most suitable antonym for 'Ensconce'.
oa:
This word means to set up something on a firm or permanent basis. It is a synonym for the "settling" part of ensconcing and therefore does not provide an opposite.
Synonyms: Found (स्थापित करना), Settle (बसना), Fix (निश्चित करना).
Antonyms: Uproot (उखाड़ना), Destroy (नष्ट करना), Remove (हटाना).

This term refers to the quality of being disrespectful or bold in a rude way. It is a noun describing a personality trait, which is unrelated to the act of settling in a safe place.
Synonyms: Insolence (धृष्टता), Rudeness (अशिष्टता), Audacity (गुस्ताखी).
Antonyms: Respect (सम्मान), Polite (विनम्र), Modesty (विनम्रता).

This term refers to the act of asking politely or formally for something. It is an act of communication and has no connection with the physical or metaphorical act of hiding or settling.
Synonyms: Appeal (अनुरोध), Petition (याचिका), Entreaty (विनती).
Antonyms: Order (आदेश), Demand (माँग), Command (आज्ञा).

This word means to remove a cover from something to reveal it or to make something known for the first time. It is the direct opposite of ensconce, which means to settle comfortably or hide away safely.
Synonyms: Reveal (प्रकट करना), Disclose (उजागर करना), Expose (दिखाना).
Antonyms: Hide (छिपाना), Ensconce (छिपाकर रखना), Cover (ढकना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Parsimonious
questionsEn.s:
Parsimonious - कंजूस (Very unwilling to spend money or resources)
Avaricious - लोभी (Having extreme greed for wealth)
Chintzy - घटिया / कंजूस (Stingy or of poor quality)
Frugal - मितव्ययी (Sparing or economical with money)
Lavish - ठाठदार / अतिव्ययी (Sumptuously rich or spending freely)
Hence, 'Lavish' is the most suitable antonym for 'Parsimonious'.
oa:
This term describes someone who has an extreme greed for wealth or material gain. It is a synonym for the negative side of being overly careful with money, thus failing as an opposite.
Synonyms: Greedy (लालची), Grasping (लोभी), Covetous (लालायित).
Antonyms: Generous (उदार), Magnanimous (महामना), Charitable (दानी).

This informal word refers to something cheap, stingy, or of poor quality. It mirrors the stingy nature of parsimonious and therefore functions as a synonym.
Synonyms: Cheap (सस्ता), Mean (कंजूस), Miserly (कृपण).
Antonyms: Lavish (शानदार), Expensive (महंगा), Quality (गुणवत्तापूर्ण).

This word describes a person who is economical or sparing regarding money or food. While it has a more positive tone than parsimonious, it still means being careful with money, making it a synonym.
Synonyms: Thrifty (किफायती), Sparing (मितव्ययी), Prudent (सावधान).
Antonyms: Wasteful (अपव्ययी), Extravagant (फिजूलखर्च), Prodigal (खर्चीला).

This term refers to something sumptuously rich, elaborate, or luxurious, or a person who spends money very freely. It is the direct opposite of being parsimonious, which implies extreme stinginess.
Synonyms: Extravagant (अतिव्ययी), Profuse (प्रचुर), Opulent (भव्य).
Antonyms: Parsimonious (कंजूस), Meager (अल्प), Scanty (कम).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: To filch
questionsEn.s:
To filch - चुराना (To steal something of small value casually)
To smuggle - तस्करी करना (To move goods illegally)
To appropriate - हड़पना (To take for one's own use without permission)
To encroach - अतिक्रमण करना (To intrude on territory or rights)
To give back - वापस देना (To return something to the owner)
Hence, 'To give back' is the most suitable antonym for 'To filch'.
oa:
This verb means to move goods illegally into or out of a country. While it involves illegal gain, it is a specialized type of theft and does not represent a direct opposite.
Synonyms: Bootleg (अवैध व्यापार करना), Run (तस्करी करना), Sneak (चोरी-छिपे ले जाना).
Antonyms: Export (निर्यात करना), Import (आयात करना), Declare (घोषित करना).

This word means to take something for one's own use, typically without the owner's permission. It is a synonym for the act of stealing or taking away, not an antonym.
Synonyms: Seize (जब्त करना), Take (लेना), Usurp (हड़पना).
Antonyms: Return (लौटाना), Give (देना), Relinquish (त्यागना).

This term refers to intruding on a person's territory or rights gradually. It describes an act of taking more than what is allowed, aligning with the negative sense of filching.
Synonyms: Intrude (अतिक्रमण करना), Trespass (अनाधिकार प्रवेश), Infringe (उल्लंघन करना).
Antonyms: Respect (सम्मान करना), Withdraw (पीछे हटना), Keep away (दूर रहना).

This phrase means to return something to its original owner or place. It is the direct opposite of filching, which involves stealing or taking something away in a casual or sneaky manner.
Synonyms: Return (लौटाना), Restore (बहाल करना), Refund (वापस करना).
Antonyms: Steal (चोरी करना), Filch (चुराना), Take (लेना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Refulgent
questionsEn.s:
Refulgent - उज्ज्वल / देदीप्यमान (Shining brightly; radiant)
Dark - अंधकारमय (Lack of light or brightness)
Loud - तेज़ (Producing much noise)
Rough - खुरदरा (Having an uneven or irregular surface)
Sweet - मीठा / मधुर (Pleasant taste or sound)
Hence, 'Dark' is the most suitable antonym for 'Refulgent'.
oa:
This word refers to a total or partial absence of light. It serves as the direct opposite of refulgent, which describes something that is shining brightly or is radiant with light.
Synonyms: Dim (धुंधला), Gloomy (अंधकारमय), Obscure (अस्पष्ट).
Antonyms: Refulgent (चमकीला), Bright (उज्ज्वल), Radiant (देदीप्यमान).

This term describes a sound that produces a lot of noise or has high volume. It pertains to the sense of hearing, whereas the target word pertains to visual brightness.
Synonyms: Noisy (शोर भरा), Blaring (तेज), Thunderous (कानफोड़ू).
Antonyms: Quiet (शांत), Silent (चुप), Faint (धीमा).

This word describes an uneven or irregular surface that is not smooth. It refers to the physical texture of an object rather than its level of light or brilliance.
Synonyms: Coarse (खुरदरा), Uneven (असमतल), Rugged (कठोर).
Antonyms: Smooth (चिकना), Level (समतल), Sleek (चमकदार).

This term describes a pleasant taste characteristic of sugar or honey, or something melodious to hear. It does not relate to the visual quality of shining light.
Synonyms: Sugary (मीठा), Dulcet (मधुर), Pleasant (सुखद).
Antonyms: Bitter (कड़वा), Sour (खट्टा), Harsh (कठोर).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Skeptic
questionsEn.s:
Skeptic - संशयवादी (Person inclined to doubt accepted opinions)
Believer - विश्वासी (Person who believes in the truth of something)
Erroneous - गलत (Incorrect or mistaken)
Nervous - चिंतित (Easily agitated or anxious)
Nihilist - शून्यवादी (Person who believes life is meaningless)
Hence, 'Believer' is the most suitable antonym for 'Skeptic'.
oa:
This word refers to a person who accepts a particular thing as true or who has religious faith. It is the direct opposite of a skeptic, who is inclined to question or doubt opinions.
Synonyms: Faithful (विश्वासी), Devotee (भक्त), Adherent (अनुयायी).
Antonyms: Skeptic (संशयवादी), Doubter (शंकालु), Cynic (निंदक).

This term describes something that is wrong or incorrect. While a skeptic might point out errors, the word itself is an adjective describing a state of being wrong, not a person's attitude.
Synonyms: Incorrect (गलत), False (असत्य), Mistaken (अशुद्ध).
Antonyms: Accurate (सटीक), Correct (सही), Right (सत्य).

This word describes someone who is easily agitated or alarmed, often feeling anxious. It focuses on a temporary emotional state of worry rather than a habitual tendency to doubt facts.
Synonyms: Anxious (चिंतित), Apprehensive (भयभीत), Timid (डरपोक).
Antonyms: Confident (आत्मविश्वासी), Bold (साहसी), Calm (शांत).

This term refers to a person who believes that life is meaningless and rejects all religious and moral principles. It is an extreme form of skepticism, making it a near-synonym rather than an opposite.
Synonyms: Pessimist (निराशावादी), Cynic (निंदक), Unbeliever (नास्तिक).
Antonyms: Idealist (आदर्शवादी), Optimist (आशावादी), Believer (विश्वासी).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Recede
questionsEn.s:
Recede - पीछे हटना (To move back or withdraw)
Ebb - घटना (The movement of tide out to sea; decline)
Fade - मंद पड़ना (To gradually become less distinct)
Extend - फैलाना (To stretch out or make larger)
Wane - क्षीण होना (To decrease in size or degree)
Hence, 'Extend' is the most suitable antonym for 'Recede'.
oa:
This verb refers to the movement of the tide going out to sea or something declining. It carries the same meaning of moving backward, acting as a synonym for recede.
Synonyms: Wane (घटना), Retreat (पीछे हटना), Recede (पीछे जाना).
Antonyms: Flow (प्रवाह), Advance (आगे बढ़ना), Rise (बढ़ना).

This word means to gradually grow faint or disappear, especially in terms of color or sound. While it involves becoming less distinct, it does not represent the opposite of withdrawing.
Synonyms: Dim (धुंधला होना), Vanish (गायब होना), Dissolve (मिटना).
Antonyms: Brighten (चमकना), Emerge (उभरना), Appear (प्रकट होना).

This term means to make something longer or larger, or to stretch it out further in space or time. It is the direct opposite of recede, which involves moving back or becoming distant.
Synonyms: Expand (फैलाना), Prolong (लंबा करना), Increase (बढ़ाना).
Antonyms: Recede (पीछे हटना), Curtail (कम करना), Contract (सिकुड़ना).

This verb refers to decreasing in size, extent, or degree, particularly in reference to the moon or strength. It is a synonym for the "declining" aspect of receding.
Synonyms: Decrease (घटाना), Diminish (कम होना), Decline (ह्रास).
Antonyms: Wax (बढ़ना), Grow (बढ़ना), Increase (बढ़ाना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Rebuff
questionsEn.s:
Rebuff - अस्वीकार करना (To reject someone in an abrupt manner)
Rebuke - फटकार (Sharp disapproval or criticism)
Snub - तिरस्कार (To ignore or spurn disdainfully)
Nix - रद्द करना (To reject or put an end to something)
Praise - प्रशंसा (Expression of approval or admiration)
Hence, 'Praise' is the most suitable antonym for 'Rebuff'.
oa:
This term means to express sharp disapproval or criticism of someone because of their actions. It is a negative response similar to a rebuff and therefore is not an opposite.
Synonyms: Scold (डाँटना), Reprimand (फटकारना), Chide (झिड़कना).
Antonyms: Praise (प्रशंसा करना), Applaud (सराहना), Commend (बखान करना).

This word means to ignore or spurn someone disdainfully or to reject them abruptly. It is a direct synonym for rebuff and does not satisfy the requirement for an opposite.
Synonyms: Slight (तिरस्कार करना), Cold-shoulder (उपेक्षा करना), Insult (अपमान करना).
Antonyms: Welcome (स्वागत करना), Greet (अभिवादन), Accept (स्वीकार करना).

This informal term means to reject or put an end to something, particularly a proposal. Since it involves an act of refusal, it is synonymous with the core meaning of rebuff.
Synonyms: Veto (अस्वीकार करना), Cancel (रद्द करना), Reject (नकारना).
Antonyms: Approve (मंजूर करना), Support (समर्थन करना), Sanction (मंजूरी देना).

This word refers to expressing approval, admiration, or commendation for someone or something. It is the perfect antonym for rebuff, which involves rejecting or spurning something ungraciously.
Synonyms: Commend (सराहना), Extol (बखान करना), Laud (प्रशंसा करना).
Antonyms: Rebuff (अस्वीकार करना), Censure (निंदा करना), Criticize (आलोचना करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Vexatious
questionsEn.s:
Vexatious - कष्टप्रद (Causing annoyance or frustration)
Calamitous - विनाशकारी (Causing great disaster or misfortune)
Treacherous - विश्वासघाती (Deceptive and unreliable)
Soothing - शांतिदायक (Calming or alleviating distress)
Pliable - मुलायम / लचीला (Easily bent or flexible)
Hence, 'Soothing' is the most suitable antonym for 'Vexatious'.
oa:
This term describes something causing or involving a great disaster, destruction, or misfortune. It describes a severe negative event, which is far more extreme than mere annoyance.
Synonyms: Disastrous (विनाशकारी), Tragic (दुखद), Catastrophic (महाविपत्तिपूर्ण).
Antonyms: Fortunate (भाग्यशाली), Beneficial (लाभकारी), Lucky (शुभ).

(Note: likely a typo for Treacherous). This term describes someone or something that is deceptive, unreliable, or likely to betray. It focuses on dishonesty rather than a sense of relief or peace.
Synonyms: Deceitful (कपटी), Disloyal (विश्वासघाती), Perfidious (धोखेबाज).
Antonyms: Faithful (वफादार), Loyal (निष्ठावान), Honest (ईमानदार).

This word describes something that has a calming, comforting, or relieving effect. It is the direct antonym for vexatious, which describes things that cause annoyance, frustration, or distress.
Synonyms: Calming (शांतिपूर्ण), Tranquilizing (शांतिदायक), Comforting (आरामदायक).
Antonyms: Irritating (चिड़चिड़ा), Vexatious (अभिशापदायक), Disturbing (परेशान करने वाला).

This term refers to something that is easily bent, flexible, or a person who is easily influenced. It describes adaptability rather than the level of emotional comfort provided.
Synonyms: Flexible (लचीला), Malleable (नमनशील), Adaptable (अनुकूलनीय).
Antonyms: Rigid (कठोर), Inflexible (अटल), Obstinate (जिद्दी).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Burgeon
questionsEn.s:
Burgeon - तेजी से बढ़ना (To grow or increase rapidly)
Bolster - मजबूत करना (Support or strengthen)
Shrivel - मुरझाना (To wither or become smaller and wrinkled)
Mount - चढ़ना / बढ़ना (To climb or increase in amount)
Amplify - बढ़ाना (To increase in volume or intensity)
Hence, 'Shrivel' is the most suitable antonym for 'Burgeon'.
oa:
This term means to support, strengthen, or prop up something. While it relates to growth or improvement, its focus is on providing stability rather than the act of growing itself.
Synonyms: Support (समर्थन देना), Reinforce (सुदृढ़ करना), Uphold (बनाए रखना).
Antonyms: Undermine (कमजोर करना), Weaken (कमजोर करना), Hinder (बाधा डालना).

This word means to wrinkle and become smaller, often due to a loss of moisture or vitality. It is the perfect antonym for burgeon, which means to grow or increase rapidly.
Synonyms: Wither (मुरझाना), Shrink (सिकुड़ना), Contract (संकुचित होना).
Antonyms: Burgeon (तेजी से बढ़ना), Grow (फलना-फूलना), Expand (फैलना).

This term refers to the act of climbing up, increasing in amount, or setting something up. It aligns with the idea of rising or growing, acting as a synonym for the "increasing" aspect of burgeon.
Synonyms: Ascend (चढ़ना), Accumulate (इकट्ठा होना), Increase (बढ़ना).
Antonyms: Descend (उतरना), Drop (गिरना), Decrease (घटाना).

This word means to make something more intense, larger, or louder. Since it describes an increase in volume or impact, it functions as a synonym for burgeoning.
Synonyms: Magnify (बढ़ाना), Expand (विस्तार करना), Intensify (तीव्र करना).
Antonyms: Diminish (कम करना), Reduce (घटाना), Condense (संक्षिप्त करना).

test.instructions: Standard CBT Pattern Exam. Positive Marks: +1, Negative Marks: -0.25. Total Questions: 50.

test.title: Set - 9

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Commiserate
questionsEn.s:
Commiserate - सहानुभूति प्रकट करना (To express or feel sympathy or pity)
Debatable - विवादास्पद (Open to discussion or argument)
Empathize - सहानुभूति रखना (Understand and share feelings of another)
Indifferent - उदासीन (Having no particular interest or sympathy)
Legion - सेना / बड़ी संख्या (A vast multitude or large number)
Hence, 'Indifferent' is the most suitable antonym for 'Commiserate'.
oa:
This term means that something is open to discussion or argument; it is not certain. It describes the nature of a claim or idea, which is unrelated to the feeling of sympathy.
Synonyms: Disputable (विवादास्पद), Questionable (संदिग्ध), Controversial (विवाद्य).
Antonyms: Certain (निश्चित), Indisputable (निर्विवाद), Definite (स्पष्ट).

This term means to understand and share the feelings of another person. It is a direct synonym for commiserate and therefore cannot be used as its opposite.
Synonyms: Sympathize (सहानुभूति रखना), Compassionate (दया दिखाना), Relate (जुड़ना).
Antonyms: Ignore (अनदेखा करना), Disregard (उपेक्षा करना), Mock (उपहास करना).

This term refers to having no particular interest, concern, or sympathy for something or someone. It is the direct opposite of commiserate, which involves feeling and expressing pity.
Synonyms: Apathetic (उदासीन), Unconcerned (बेपरवाह), Detached (पृथक).
Antonyms: Commiserate (सहानुभूति प्रकट करना), Caring (सहानुभूतिपूर्ण), Sensitive (संवेदनशील).

This word refers to a vast multitude or a very large number of people or things. It describes quantity or a military unit and has no connection to emotional responses.
Synonyms: Multitude (भीड़), Host (दल), Horde (झुंड).
Antonyms: Few (कुछ), Handful (मुट्ठी भर), Minority (अल्पसंख्यक).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Ostentation
questionsEn.s:
Ostentation - दिखावा (Excessive display or showiness)
Comical - हास्यास्पद (Humorous or funny)
Insane - पागल (Mentally deranged or crazy)
Modest - विनम्र (Simple and humble; not excessive)
Swanky - ठाठदार (Stylish or luxurious in a showy way)
Hence, 'Modest' is the most suitable antonym for 'Ostentation'.
oa:
This term refers to something that is funny, amusing, or laughable. It describes a sense of humor rather than a style of display or behavior.
Synonyms: Humorous (हास्यास्पद), Funny (मजाकिया), Hilarious (प्रफुल्लित करने वाला).
Antonyms: Solemn (गंभीर), Grave (गंभीर), Serious (संजीदा).

This word describes someone who is mentally deranged or extremely foolish. It focuses on mental health or lack of logic, which is unrelated to the flashy display of wealth.
Synonyms: Mad (पागल), Crazy (विक्षिप्त), Lunatic (दीवाना).
Antonyms: Sane (समझदार), Rational (तर्कसंगत), Sensible (बुद्धिमान).

This word describes someone who is humble, simple, and avoids making an excessive display of their abilities or wealth. It is the direct opposite of ostentation, which involves showiness.
Synonyms: Humble (विनम्र), Simple (सादा), Unpretentious (दिखावा रहित).
Antonyms: Ostentatious (दिखावटी), Boastful (घमंडी), Showy (भड़कीला).

This term refers to something stylish, luxurious, or expensive in a way that is intended to impress. It acts as a synonym for the flashy nature of ostentation.
Synonyms: Posh (शानदार), Elegant (भव्य), Flashy (दिखावटी).
Antonyms: Plain (सादा), Cheap (सस्ता), Poor (खराब).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Vigilance
questionsEn.s:
Vigilance - चौकसी (State of keeping careful watch for danger)
Indifference - उदासीनता (Lack of interest or concern)
Diligence - परिश्रम (Careful and persistent work)
Acuity - तीक्ष्णता (Sharpness or keenness of thought or vision)
Circumspection - सतर्कता (Quality of being wary and cautious)
Hence, 'Indifference' is the most suitable antonym for 'Vigilance'.
oa:
This term refers to a lack of interest, concern, or attention. It serves as the direct opposite of vigilance, which involves keeping a careful and watchful eye for possible dangers.
Synonyms: Negligence (लापरवाही), Apathy (उदासीनता), Carelessness (बेपरवाही).
Antonyms: Vigilance (चौकसी), Attention (ध्यान), Alertness (सतर्कता).

This word describes careful and persistent work or effort. While it involves focus, it is more of a synonym for the conscientious nature required in being vigilant.
Synonyms: Industriousness (परिश्रम), Meticulousness (सावधानी), Assiduity (तन्मयता).
Antonyms: Idleness (आलस्य), Laziness (सुस्ती), Sloth (सुस्ती).

This term refers to sharpness or keenness of thought, vision, or hearing. It is an intellectual or sensory quality that supports vigilance rather than opposing it.
Synonyms: Sharpness (तीक्ष्णता), Keeness (कुशाग्रता), Precision (शुद्धता).
Antonyms: Dullness (मंदता), Stupidity (मूर्खता), Insensitivity (असंवेदनशीलता).

This word refers to the quality of being wary and unwilling to take risks; being cautious. It is a near-synonym for vigilance as both involve careful watching.
Synonyms: Caution (सावधानी), Prudence (विवेकाधिकार), Wariness (सतर्कता).
Antonyms: Recklessness (बेपरवाही), Impudence (गुस्ताखी), Rashness (जल्दबाजी).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Cavalier
questionsEn.s:
Cavalier - लापरवाह / अभिमानी (Showing lack of proper concern; offhand)
Condescending - कृपालु (Showing an attitude of patronizing superiority)
Curt - संक्षिप्त / रूखा (Rudely brief or abrupt in speech)
Humble - विनम्र (Showing a modest estimate of one's importance)
Haughty - अभिमानी (Arrogantly superior and disdainful)
Hence, 'Humble' is the most suitable antonym for 'Cavalier'.
oa:
This word refers to having or showing an attitude of patronizing superiority. It carries a similar negative tone to being cavalier (disdainful), acting as a synonym.
Synonyms: Patronizing (कृपालु), Arrogant (अहंकारी), Haughty (घमंडी).
Antonyms: Humble (विनम्र), Respectful (सम्मानपूर्ण), Modest (विनीत).

This term describes a way of speaking that is rudely brief or abrupt. While it describes a negative interaction, it focuses on brevity rather than the casual lack of concern implied by cavalier.
Synonyms: Abrupt (अचानक), Blunt (रूखा), Snappy (तीखा).
Antonyms: Polite (विनम्र), Detailed (विस्तृत), Gracious (सुशील).

This term refers to having or showing a modest or low estimate of one's own importance. It is the direct opposite of cavalier, which involves being haughty or showing a lack of proper concern.
Synonyms: Modest (विनम्र), Unassuming (विनम्र), Meek (नम्र).
Antonyms: Cavalier (लापरवाह), Proud (गर्वित), Arrogant (अहंकारी).

This term describes someone who is arrogantly superior and disdainful. Since it mirrors the dismissive and proud nature of a cavalier person, it is a synonym instead of an opposite.
Synonyms: Vain (अभिमानी), Supercilious (घमंडी), Snooty (अक्खड़).
Antonyms: Humble (विनम्र), Down-to-earth (व्यावहारिक), Shy (शर्मीला).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Rebuke
questionsEn.s:
Rebuke - फटकार (Expression of sharp disapproval or criticism)
Admonition - चेतावनी (A firm warning or reprimand)
Censure - निंदा (Formal expression of disapproval)
Scold - भला-बुरा कहना (Angrily finding fault with someone)
Flattery - चापलूसी (Excessive or insincere praise)
Hence, 'Flattery' is the most suitable antonym for 'Rebuke'.
oa:
This term refers to a firm warning or a mild reprimand. It is a synonym for the act of correcting or criticizing someone and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an opposite.
Synonyms: Reprimand (फटकार), Warning (चेतावनी), Chiding (झिड़क).
Antonyms: Praise (प्रशंसा), Commendation (सराहना), Approval (स्वीकृति).

This word refers to the formal expression of severe disapproval, especially in a legal or official capacity. It acts as a strong synonym for the target word rebuke.
Synonyms: Condemnation (निंदा), Criticism (आलोचना), Blame (दोष).
Antonyms: Endorsement (समर्थन), Compliment (प्रशंसा), Approbation (स्वीकृति).

This verb means to angrily find fault with someone or to rebuke them, particularly a child. It is a common synonym for the act of rebuking and cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Berate (डाँटना), Rail (फटकारना), Reprove (निंदा करना).
Antonyms: Praise (तारीफ करना), Flatter (चापलूसी करना), Comfort (दिलासा देना).

This term refers to excessive or insincere praise given to someone to please them or for personal gain. It is the direct opposite of a rebuke, which involves expressing sharp disapproval or criticism.
Synonyms: Adulation (अतिप्रशंसा), Sycophancy (चापलूसी), Blandishment (मीठी बातें).
Antonyms: Rebuke (फटकार), Criticism (आलोचना), Insult (अपमान).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Rebate
questionsEn.s:
Rebate - छूट (A deduction or discount on something)
Deduction - कटौती (Amount taken away from a total)
Bonus - लाभांश (Extra sum of money as a reward)
Increase - वृद्धि (A rise in the amount or number of something)
Remission - माफी (Cancellation of a debt or penalty)
Hence, 'Increase' is the most suitable antonym for 'Rebate'.
oa:
This word refers to an amount that is taken away from a total, such as a discount or tax reduction. It is a direct synonym for rebate and therefore fails to provide an opposite.
Synonyms: Discount (छूट), Reduction (कमी), Allowance (रियायत).
Antonyms: Increase (वृद्धि), Addition (योग), Rise (बढ़त).

This term refers to an extra sum of money added to a person's wages as a reward for good performance. While it is a positive gain, it is not the structural opposite of a discount or rebate.
Synonyms: Reward (पुरस्कार), Incentive (प्रोत्साहन), Perk (अतिरिक्त लाभ).
Antonyms: Penalty (दंड), Fine (जुर्माना), Deduction (कटौती).

This word refers to a rise in the amount, level, or number of something. It is the direct opposite of a rebate, which involves a deduction or a decrease in the cost or amount.
Synonyms: Rise (बढ़त), Addition (योग), Augmentation (वृद्धि).
Antonyms: Rebate (छूट), Decrease (कमी), Reduction (कमी).

This term refers to the cancellation of a debt, charge, or penalty. Since it involves a reduction or a letting go of a payment, it acts as a synonym for the target word.
Synonyms: Abatement (कमी), Cancellation (रद्दीकरण), Pardon (माफी).
Antonyms: Imposition (थोपना), Charge (शुल्क), Penalty (दंड).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Bequest
questionsEn.s:
Bequest - वसीयत (Money or property left to someone in a will)
Accord - सहमति / प्रदान करना (To grant power or be in agreement)
Damage - क्षति (Physical harm that impairs value)
Complex - जटिल (Consisting of many connected parts)
Withdraw - वापस लेना (To remove or take away something)
Hence, 'Withdraw' is the most suitable antonym for 'Bequest'.
oa:
This verb means to give or grant someone power or status, or to be in agreement. It focuses on the act of granting rather than the specific context of leaving property behind.
Synonyms: Grant (प्रदान करना), Concede (स्वीकार करना), Agree (सहमत होना).
Antonyms: Refuse (मना करना), Disagree (असहमत होना), Withhold (रोक लेना).

This term refers to physical harm that impairs the value or usefulness of something. It describes the state of an object and has no logical connection to the legal act of a legacy.
Synonyms: Harm (हानि), Ruin (विनाश), Injury (चोट).
Antonyms: Repair (मरम्मत), Benefit (लाभ), Restoration (बहाली).

This word describes something that consists of many different and connected parts; it is intricate. It describes the structure of an object or idea, not the transfer of wealth.
Synonyms: Intricate (पेचीदा), Complicated (जटिल), Elaborate (विस्तृत).
Antonyms: Simple (सरल), Basic (बुनियादी), Plain (सादा).

This verb means to remove or take away something from a particular place or possession. It serves as the opposite of a bequest, which is the act of giving or leaving something to another.
Synonyms: Remove (हटाना), Retract (वापस लेना), Detach (अलग करना).
Antonyms: Give (देना), Bequeath (वसीयत करना), Deposit (जमा करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Imbroglio
questionsEn.s:
Imbroglio - उलझन (Extremely confused or complicated situation)
Misery - कष्ट (State of great physical or mental distress)
Censure - निंदा (Express severe disapproval of something)
Composure - धैर्य / शांति (State of feeling calm and in control)
Dilemma - दुविधा (A difficult situation or choice)
Hence, 'Composure' is the most suitable antonym for 'Imbroglio'.
oa:
This term refers to a state of great physical or mental distress or discomfort. While an imbroglio can cause distress, the word focuses on the feeling of pain rather than the complexity of a situation.
Synonyms: Suffering (कष्ट), Distress (पीड़ा), Agony (व्यथा).
Antonyms: Happiness (खुशी), Bliss (परमानंद), Joy (हर्ष).

This word refers to the expression of severe disapproval of someone or something. It describes a form of criticism rather than the nature of a complicated or confused situation.
Synonyms: Criticism (आलोचना), Condemnation (निंदा), Reprimand (फटकार).
Antonyms: Praise (प्रशंसा), Approbation (स्वीकृति), Support (समर्थन).

This word refers to the state of being calm, peaceful, and in control of oneself. It is the direct opposite of an imbroglio, which is an extremely confused, complicated, or embarrassing situation.
Synonyms: Calmness (स्थिरता), Serenity (शांति), Poise (आत्मसंयम).
Antonyms: Agitation (उत्तेजना), Turmoil (अशांति), Imbroglio (उलझन).

This term refers to a difficult situation or problem where a choice has to be made between two or more options. It is a synonym for the predicament found in an imbroglio.
Synonyms: Predicament (कठिन परिस्थिति), Quandary (व्याकुलता), Mess (उलझन).
Antonyms: Solution (समाधान), Resolution (संकल्प), Certainty (निश्चितता).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Evanescent
questionsEn.s:
Evanescent - क्षणभंगुर (Quickly fading or disappearing)
Enticing - आकर्षक (Something that attracts or tempts)
Fleeting - क्षणिक (Lasting for a very short time)
Erratic - अनियमित (Not even or regular; unpredictable)
Elusive - पकड़ में न आने वाला (Difficult to find or achieve)
Hence, 'Enticing' is the most suitable antonym for 'Evanescent'.
oa:
This word describes something that is attractive or tempting; it holds one's interest. In this context, it represents something that stays in the mind or draws one in, unlike evanescent things that vanish quickly.
Synonyms: Alluring (आकर्षक), Tempting (लुभावना), Appealing (मनोहारी).
Antonyms: Repelling (विकर्षक), Distasteful (अप्रिय), Evanescent (क्षणिक).

This term describes something that lasts for a very short time. It is a direct synonym for evanescent and therefore cannot be used as its opposite.
Synonyms: Transient (क्षणिक), Short-lived (अल्पकालिक), Ephemeral (क्षणभंगुर).
Antonyms: Permanent (स्थायी), Lasting (टिकाऊ), Eternal (शाश्वत).

This word refers to something that is not even or regular in pattern; it is unpredictable. While it describes a lack of stability, it does not specifically address the duration of existence.
Synonyms: Unpredictable (अनियमित), Variable (परिवर्तनशील), Inconsistent (अस्थिर).
Antonyms: Stable (स्थिर), Consistent (संगत), Regular (नियमित).

This term refers to something or someone that is difficult to find, catch, or achieve. While it implies something hard to grasp, it is not the direct opposite of something that fades away.
Synonyms: Evasive (पकड़ में न आने वाला), Slippery (धूर्त), Subtle (सूक्ष्म).
Antonyms: Obvious (स्पष्ट), Definite (निश्चित), Accessible (सुगम).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Panegyric
questionsEn.s:
Panegyric - प्रशंसा भाषण (A public speech or text in praise of someone)
Noxious - हानिकारक (Harmful, poisonous, or very unpleasant)
Criticism - आलोचना (Expression of disapproval based on faults)
Fantasy - कल्पना (Activity of imagining impossible things)
Grandeur - वैभव (Splendor and impressiveness of style)
Hence, 'Criticism' is the most suitable antonym for 'Panegyric'.
oa:
This term describes something that is harmful, poisonous, or very unpleasant. It focuses on physical or environmental harm rather than on the nature of speech or criticism.
Synonyms: Toxic (विषैला), Harmful (हानिकारक), Pernicious (घातक).
Antonyms: Harmless (हानिरहित), Beneficial (लाभकारी), Wholesome (स्वास्थ्यवर्धक).

This word refers to the expression of disapproval or the analysis of perceived faults or mistakes. It is the direct opposite of a panegyric, which is a formal speech or text in praise of someone.
Synonyms: Condemnation (निंदा), Disapproval (अस्वीकृति), Censure (भर्त्सना).
Antonyms: Praise (प्रशंसा), Panegyric (प्रशंसा भाषण), Approbation (स्वीकृति).

This term refers to the faculty of imagining things that are impossible or improbable. It focuses on the creative mind or unrealistic ideas rather than on the public judgment of a person's worth.
Synonyms: Imagination (कल्पना), Delusion (भ्रम), Vision (स्वप्न).
Antonyms: Reality (वास्तविकता), Fact (तथ्य), Truth (सत्य).

This noun refers to splendor and impressiveness, especially of appearance or style. While positive, it describes a physical quality rather than a type of speech or writing.
Synonyms: Splendor (वैभव), Magnificence (शान), Majesty (महिमा).
Antonyms: Insignificance (तुच्छता), Simplicity (सादगी), Meanness (कंजूसी).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Phlegmatic
questionsEn.s:
Phlegmatic - सुस्त / शांत (Calm and unemotional)
Ardent - उत्साही (Very enthusiastic or passionate)
Indifferent - उदासीन (Having no interest or sympathy)
Prohibit - वर्जित करना (To formally forbid something)
Merciless - निर्दयी (Showing no mercy; ruthless)
Hence, 'Ardent' is the most suitable antonym for 'Phlegmatic'.
oa:
This word describes someone who is very enthusiastic, passionate, and full of intense feeling. It is the perfect opposite of phlegmatic, which characterizes someone who is calm, unemotional, and sluggish.
Synonyms: Passionate (उत्साही), Eager (उत्सुक), Fervent (जोशीला).
Antonyms: Phlegmatic (सुस्त), Indifferent (उदासीन), Apathetic (बेपरवाह).

This term refers to having no particular interest, concern, or sympathy. While similar to being phlegmatic, it is a synonym for the lack of emotion rather than an opposite.
Synonyms: Unconcerned (बेपरवाह), Detached (पृथक), Apathetic (उदासीन).
Antonyms: Interested (इच्छुक), Concerned (चिंतित), Passionate (भावुक).

This verb means to formally forbid something by law, rule, or other authority. It focus on restriction of actions, which is unrelated to describing a person's emotional temperament.
Synonyms: Forbid (वर्जित करना), Ban (प्रतिबंधित करना), Restrain (रोकना).
Antonyms: Allow (अनुमति देना), Permit (अनुमति देना), Authorize (अधिकृत करना).

This term characterizes someone who shows no mercy; they are cruel or ruthless. It focus on the severity of a person's judgment rather than their lack of emotional excitement.
Synonyms: Cruel (निर्दयी), Ruthless (क्रूर), Pitiless (बेरहम).
Antonyms: Compassionate (दयालु), Kind (मेहरबान), Merciful (दयावान).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Churlish
questionsEn.s:
Churlish - अशिष्ट (Rude in a mean-spirited way)
Belittle - तुच्छ समझना (To dismiss as unimportant)
Courteous - विनम्र (Polite and respectful in manner)
Fervent - जोशीला (Displaying passionate intensity)
Uncouth - भद्दा / असभ्य (Lacking good manners or refinement)
Hence, 'Courteous' is the most suitable antonym for 'Churlish'.
oa:
This verb means to dismiss someone or something as unimportant. While it is a rude action, it describes a specific behavioral choice rather than a general polite temperament.
Synonyms: Disparage (नीचा दिखाना), Underrate (तुच्छ समझना), Decry (निंदा करना).
Antonyms: Praise (प्रशंसा करना), Extol (बखान करना), Exaggerate (बढ़ा-चढ़ाकर कहना).

This word describes someone who is polite, respectful, and considerate in their manners. It is the direct opposite of churlish, which means being rude, mean-spirited, and surly.
Synonyms: Polite (विनम्र), Civil (शिष्ट), Mannerly (सभ्य).
Antonyms: Churlish (अशिष्ट), Rude (अभद्र), Boorish (गंवार).

This term describes having or displaying a passionate intensity. It relates to the strength of an emotion rather than the level of politeness or social etiquette.
Synonyms: Intense (तीव्र), Ardent (जोशीला), Zealous (उत्साही).
Antonyms: Apathetic (उदासीन), Cold (शीतल), Indifferent (बेपरवाह).

This term characterizes someone who lacks good manners, refinement, or grace. It is a direct synonym for churlish and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an opposite.
Synonyms: Boorish (गंवार), Rude (असभ्य), Awkward (भद्दा).
Antonyms: Refined (परिष्कृत), Sophisticated (दुनियादार), Civil (शिष्ट).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Sullen
questionsEn.s:
Sullen - चिड़चिड़ा (Bad-tempered and sulky)
Glum - उदास (Feeling dejected and silent)
Silent - चुप (Not speaking or making sound)
Crabby - चिड़चिड़ा (Irritable or in a bad mood)
Agreeable - सुखद / सहमत (Enjoyable and pleasurable)
Hence, 'Agreeable' is the most suitable antonym for 'Sullen'.
oa:
This word describes someone who is feeling dejected, silent, and gloomy. It serves as a synonym for sullen and therefore does not provide the required opposite meaning.
Synonyms: Gloomy (उदास), Sullen (चिड़चिड़ा), Moody (बदमिजाज).
Antonyms: Happy (खुश), Cheerful (प्रसन्न), Bright (उज्ज्वल).

This term means not speaking or making any sound. While a sullen person is often silent, the word itself is neutral and does not contrast the bad temper implied by being sullen.
Synonyms: Quiet (शांत), Mute (मूक), Still (निश्चल).
Antonyms: Talkative (बातूनी), Noisy (शोर भरा), Vocal (मुखर).

This informal word describes someone who is irritable or in a bad mood. It is a synonym for the ill-tempered nature of a sullen person and is not an antonym.
Synonyms: Irritable (चिड़चिड़ा), Grouchy (बदमिजाज), Peevish (झुंझलाया हुआ).
Antonyms: Pleasant (सुखद), Amiable (सुशील), Good-natured (नेक-दिल).

This term refers to someone or something that is quite enjoyable, pleasurable, or easy to get along with. It serves as the correct opposite for sullen, which describes being bad-tempered and sulky.
Synonyms: Pleasant (सुखद), Amiable (सुशील), Congenial (अनुकूल).
Antonyms: Sullen (चिड़चिड़ा), Disagreeable (अप्रिय), Hostile (शत्रुतापूर्ण).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Summon
questionsEn.s:
Summon - बुलाना (To order someone to be present)
Dismiss - विदा करना / खारिज करना (To send away or allow to leave)
Draft - रूपरेखा (A preliminary version or plan)
Invite - आमंत्रित करना (To make a polite request to come)
Mobilise - संगठित करना (To organize for collective action)
Hence, 'Dismiss' is the most suitable antonym for 'Summon'.
oa:
This verb means to send someone away or to allow them to leave. it is the direct opposite of summon, which involves ordering someone to be present or to come to a specific place.
Synonyms: Release (मुक्त करना), Discharge (निकालना), Discard (त्यागना).
Antonyms: Summon (बुलाना), Recall (वापस बुलाना), Engage (नियुक्त करना).

This term refers to a preliminary vision, plan, or a version of a document. It can also mean selecting someone for military service, but it does not represent the act of sending away.
Synonyms: Outline (रूपरेखा), Sketch (रेखाचित्र), Version (संस्करण).
Antonyms: Completion (पूर्णता), Final (अंतिम), Finish (समाप्ति).

This verb means to make a polite or friendly request for someone to go somewhere. While it involves calling someone, it is a choice rather than a mandatory order like a summon.
Synonyms: Request (अनुरोध करना), Ask (पूछना), Welcome (आमंत्रित करना).
Antonyms: Expel (निकालना), Reject (नकारना), Exclude (निकाल देना).

This word means to organize and encourage a group of people to take collective action. It is related to summoning many people but does not provide an opposite meaning.
Synonyms: Organize (संगठित करना), Activate (सक्रिय करना), Rally (एकत्र करना).
Antonyms: Disorganize (अव्यवस्थित करना), Halt (रोकना), Demobilize (विघटित करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Pellucid
questionsEn.s:
Pellucid - पारदर्शक (Clear and easily understood; transparent)
Torpid - निष्क्रिय (Lacking in energy or vigor)
Explicit - स्पष्ट (Clearly stated and leaving no confusion)
Murky - धुंधला (Dark, obscure, and not clear)
Limpid - निर्मल (Clear, transparent, or easily understood)
Hence, 'Murky' is the most suitable antonym for 'Pellucid'.
oa:
This term describes someone who is lacking in energy or vigor; they are mentally or physically inactive. It focuses on a state of laziness rather than the clarity of a substance or idea.
Synonyms: Lethargic (सुस्त), Sluggish (मंद), Inactive (निष्क्रिय).
Antonyms: Active (सक्रिय), Energetic (ऊर्जावान), Lively (जीवंत).

This word describes something that is clearly stated and leaves no room for confusion. It is a synonym for the intellectual clarity of being pellucid.
Synonyms: Clear (स्पष्ट), Precise (सटीक), Definite (निश्चित).
Antonyms: Implicit (अप्रत्यक्ष), Vague (अस्पष्ट), Ambiguous (संदिग्ध).

This word refers to something that is dark, obscure, and not clear. It is the direct opposite of pellucid, which describes a substance or idea that is transparent or easy to understand.
Synonyms: Cloudy (धुंधला), Dark (अंधेरा), Foggy (धुंधला).
Antonyms: Pellucid (पारदर्शक), Clear (साफ), Transparent (पारदर्शी).

This term characterizes something that is clear, transparent, or easily understood. It is a direct synonym for pellucid and therefore cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Crystal-clear (निर्मल), Lucid (सुस्पष्ट), Translucent (पारभासी).
Antonyms: Murky (मैला), Turbid (गंदला), Opaque (अपारदर्शी).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Adamant
questionsEn.s:
Adamant - अटल (Refusing to be persuaded or change one's mind)
Rigid - कठोर (Unable to bend or wanting to change)
Flexible - लचीला (Capable of bending easily or willing to change)
Fixed - स्थिर (Fastened securely and not able to move)
Unshakable - अडिग (Cannot be changed or weakened)
Hence, 'Flexible' is the most suitable antonym for 'Adamant'.
oa:
This term describes someone or something that is unable to bend or be forced out of shape; it refers to being stiff. It is a synonym for the stubborn nature of being adamant.
Synonyms: Inflexible (अटल), Stiff (कठोर), Unyielding (अडिग).
Antonyms: Flexible (लचीला), Pliable (नमनशील), Yielding (झुकने वाला).

This word describes someone who is capable of bending easily without breaking, or a person who is willing to change and compromise. It is the correct opposite of adamant.
Synonyms: Pliable (लचीला), Adaptable (अनुकूलनीय), Supple (नम्य).
Antonyms: Rigid (कठोर), Adamant (अटल), Stubborn (जिद्दी).

This word refers to something that is securely placed or fastened and cannot be moved or changed. It mirrors the unchanging nature of being adamant, making it a synonym.
Synonyms: Stable (स्थिर), Unchanging (अपरिवर्तनीय), Established (स्थापित).
Antonyms: Changeable (परिवर्तनशील), Variable (अस्थिर), Shifting (बदलता हुआ).

This term describes a person whose beliefs or decisions cannot be changed or weakened. It is a strong synonym for the unwavering quality of an adamant person.
Synonyms: Steadfast (अडिग), Resolute (दृढ़), Firm (मजबूत).
Antonyms: Fickle (अस्थिर), Weak (कमजोर), Wavering (डगमगाता हुआ).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Dominate
questionsEn.s:
Dominate - हावी होना (To have a commanding position or power)
Surrender - आत्मसमर्पण करना (To stop resisting and submit to authority)
Prevail - प्रभावी होना (To prove superior or be victorious)
Dictate - हुक्म चलाना (To state authoritatively)
Command - आज्ञा देना (To give an authoritative order)
Hence, 'Surrender' is the most suitable antonym for 'Dominate'.
oa:
This verb means to stop resisting an enemy or opponent and to submit to their authority. It is the correct opposite of dominate, which means to have a commanding position or power over others.
Synonyms: Yield (हार मान लेना), Capitulate (समर्पण करना), Submit (झुकना).
Antonyms: Dominate (हावी होना), Conquer (जीतना), Prevail (प्रभावी होना).

This term means to prove to be more powerful than opposing forces; to be victorious. It is synonymous with the controlling power implied by the target word dominate.
Synonyms: Triumph (विजयी होना), Conquer (जीतना), Overcome (काबू पाना).
Antonyms: Lose (हारना), Fail (असफल होना), Surrender (समर्पण करना).

This word means to state or order something authoritatively. It describes a form of domination or control, making it a synonym rather than an opposite.
Synonyms: Order (आदेश देना), Command (आज्ञा देना), Prescribe (निर्धारित करना).
Antonyms: Follow (अनुसरण करना), Ask (पूछना), Comply (अनुपालन करना).

This verb refers to giving an authoritative order or having authority over something. It mirrors the meaning of dominate and therefore cannot be its antonym.
Synonyms: Direct (निर्देशित करना), Lead (नेतृत्व करना), Rule (शासन करना).
Antonyms: Obey (आज्ञा मानना), Serve (सेवा करना), Submit (झुकना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Squander
questionsEn.s:
Squander - बर्बाद करना (To waste money or time recklessly)
Frivol - समय गँवाना (To behave carefree and superficial)
Dissipate - उड़ाना (To waste recklessly or disappear)
Hoard - जमा करना (To accumulate and store for later use)
Expend - खर्च करना (To spend or use up something)
Hence, 'Hoard' is the most suitable antonym for 'Squander'.
oa:
This term refers to behaving in a carefree and superficial way or wasting time on unimportant things. It aligns with the wasteful nature of squandering, making it a synonym.
Synonyms: Dally (समय गँवाना), Idling (सुस्ती करना), Trifle (तुच्छ काम करना).
Antonyms: Focus (ध्यान केंद्रित करना), Work (काम करना), Save (बचाना).

This verb means to cause something (like energy or money) to disappear or to waste it recklessly. Since it mirrors the act of wasting resources, it is a synonym.
Synonyms: Waste (बर्बाद करना), Lavish (खर्च करना), Scatter (बिखेरना).
Antonyms: Conserve (संरक्षित करना), Preserve (बचाना), Collect (इकट्ठा करना).

This word means to accumulate resources and store them away secretly for future use. It is the perfect antonym for squander, which involves wasting resources foolishly.
Synonyms: Save (बचाना), Store (संग्रहित करना), Accumulate (इकट्ठा करना).
Antonyms: Squander (बर्बाद करना), Spend (खर्च करना), Distribute (बाँटना).

This term refers to spending or using up resources like money, time, or energy. While it can be neutral, it describes the act of using something up, which aligns with squandering.
Synonyms: Spend (खर्च करना), Consume (उपभोग करना), Use (इस्तेमाल करना).
Antonyms: Save (बचाना), Accumulate (इकट्ठा करना), Earn (कमाना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Irk
questionsEn.s:
Irk - चिढ़ाना (To irritate or annoy someone)
Attract - आकर्षित करना (To draw or arouse interest)
Discourage - निरुत्साहित करना (To cause loss of confidence)
Irritate - तंग करना (To make someone feel annoyed)
Please - खुश करना (To cause happiness or satisfaction)
Hence, 'Please' is the most suitable antonym for 'Irk'.
oa:
This word means to draw or pull something toward oneself, or to arouse interest or liking. While it describes a positive pull, it does not directly contrast with the feeling of annoyance.
Synonyms: Allure (आकर्षित करना), Charm (मोहना), Entice (लुभाना).
Antonyms: Repel (विकर्षित करना), Disgust (घृणा करना), Deter (रोकना).

This term means to cause someone to lose confidence or enthusiasm. It focuses on lowering morale rather than being the opposite of causing irritation.
Synonyms: Dismay (हतोत्साहित करना), Daunt (धमकाना), Deter (रोकना).
Antonyms: Encourage (प्रोत्साहित करना), Motivate (प्रेरित करना), Inspire (प्रेरित करना).

This verb refers to making someone feel annoyed or impatient. It is a direct synonym for the target word irk and therefore does not function as an opposite.
Synonyms: Annoy (परेशान करना), Vex (चिढ़ाना), Bother (तंग करना).
Antonyms: Please (खुश करना), Soothe (शांत करना), Comfort (दिलासा देना).

This word means to cause someone to feel happy, satisfied, or content. It serves as the direct opposite of irk, which means to irritate or annoy someone.
Synonyms: Gratify (संतुष्ट करना), Delight (प्रसन्न करना), Gladden (खुश करना).
Antonyms: Irk (चिढ़ाना), Annoy (परेशान करना), Offend (अपमानित करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Grotesque
questionsEn.s:
Grotesque - भद्दा / विकृत (Comically or repulsively ugly or distorted)
Free - मुक्त (Not under control or restricted)
Odd - विचित्र (Different from what is usual; strange)
Plain - सादा (Simple or ordinary in form)
Queer - अजीब (Strange or unusual)
Hence, 'plain' is the most suitable antonym for 'Grotesque'.
oa:
This word refers to not being under the control of another or being able to act as one wishes. It describes a state of liberty and has no connection with visual malformation.
Synonyms: Independent (स्वतंत्र), Liberated (मुक्त), Unrestricted (अबाध).
Antonyms: Confined (सीमित), Enslaved (गुलाम), Restricted (प्रतिबंधित).

This term describes something that is different from what is usual or expected; strange. It is a synonym for the unusual or weird appearance associated with the word grotesque.
Synonyms: Weird (अजीब), Strange (विचित्र), Peculiar (अनोखा).
Antonyms: Normal (सामान्य), Regular (नियमित), Common (साधारण).

This word describes something that is simple, ordinary, and lacks decoration or distortion. It is the direct opposite of grotesque, which refers to being comically or repulsively ugly and distorted.
Synonyms: Simple (सादा), Ordinary (सामान्य), Unadorned (बिना सजावट का).
Antonyms: Ornate (सजावटी), Grotesque (भद्दा), Elaborate (विस्तृत).

This term refers to something that is strange, odd, or unusual. It carries a similar meaning to being weird or grotesque, acting as a synonym instead of an antonym.
Synonyms: Strange (अजीब), Unusual (असामान्य), Eccentric (विलक्षण).
Antonyms: Ordinary (साधारण), Conventional (पारंपरिक), Usual (सामान्य).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Befuddle
questionsEn.s:
Befuddle - चकित कर देना (To confuse someone or make them unable to think clearly)
Baffle - हक्का-बक्का करना (To confuse someone completely)
Daze - स्तब्ध करना (To stun or stupefy often to confusion)
Fluster - घबराहट (To make someone agitated or confused)
Explicate - व्याख्या करना (To explain something in detail or make clear)
Hence, 'Explicate' is the most suitable antonym for 'Befuddle'.
oa:
This term means to confuse someone completely or to be too difficult for them to understand. It is a direct synonym for befuddle and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an opposite.
Synonyms: Perplex (हक्का-बक्का करना), Puzzle (उलझाना), Mystify (रहस्यमय बनाना).
Antonyms: Clarify (स्पष्ट करना), Explain (समझाना), Enlighten (प्रकाश डालना).

This verb means to stun or stupefy someone, often as a result of a shock or a bright light. It describes a state of mental confusion, mirroring the core idea of being befuddled.
Synonyms: Stun (स्तब्ध करना), Bewilder (चकरा देना), Shock (झटका देना).
Antonyms: Alert (सतर्क), Rouse (जगाना), Awaken (जाग्रत करना).

This word means to make someone agitated or confused by making them hurried or nervous. It focuses on the agitated state of confusion, making it synonymous with the target word.
Synonyms: Agitate (घबराना), Perturb (परेशान करना), Upset (विचलित करना).
Antonyms: Calm (शांत करना), Soothe (आराम देना), Steady (स्थिर करना).

This word means to explain an idea or theory in great detail and to make it clear. It is the perfect antonym for befuddle, which involves causing confusion or making things unclear.
Synonyms: Explain (व्याख्या करना), Clarify (स्पष्ट करना), Elucidate (सुलझाना).
Antonyms: Confuse (उलझाना), Befuddle (चकित करना), Obscure (धुंधला करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Supplant
questionsEn.s:
Supplant - स्थान लेना (To take the place of someone by force)
Supersede - जगह लेना (To replace something previously in use)
Surrender - समर्पण करना (To give up or yield to another's power)
Usurp - हड़प लेना (To take a position of power illegally)
Oust - बेदखल करना (To drive out or expel someone)
Hence, 'Surrender' is the most suitable antonym for 'Supplant'.
oa:
This word means to take the place of a person or thing that was previously in authority or use. It is a direct synonym for supplant and therefore cannot be used as its opposite.
Synonyms: Replace (बदलना), Displace (हटाना), Supplant (स्थान लेना).
Antonyms: Maintain (बनाए रखना), Keep (रखना), Restore (बहाल करना).

This verb means to give up or yield to another person's power or control. It is the correct opposite of supplant, which involves forcefully or strategically taking someone else's place.
Synonyms: Yield (हार मान लेना), Submit (झुकना), Capitulate (समर्पण करना).
Antonyms: Supplant (स्थान छीनना), Conquer (जीतना), Resist (विरोध करना).

This term refers to taking a position of power or importance illegally or by force. Since it involves the same aggressive act of replacing someone as supplanting does, it is a synonym.
Synonyms: Seize (हड़पना), Appropriate (कब्जा करना), Annex (मिला लेना).
Antonyms: Relinquish (त्यागना), Return (लौटाना), Resign (इस्तीफा देना).

This word means to drive out or expel someone from a position or place. It is synonymous with the act of forcing someone out to take their spot, making it a synonym.
Synonyms: Eject (निकालना), Banish (निर्वासित करना), Evict (बेदखल करना).
Antonyms: Appoint (नियुक्त करना), Invite (आमंत्रित करना), Install (स्थापित करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Scrimp
questionsEn.s:
Scrimp - कंजूसी करना (To be frugal or economize by using less)
Skimp - कम खर्च करना (To be too thrifty or stingy)
Conserve - बचाना / संरक्षण (To use something carefully to avoid waste)
Squander - गँवाना / बर्बाद करना (To waste something in a reckless manner)
Curtail - घटाना (To reduce in quantity or restrict)
Hence, 'Squander' is the most suitable antonym for 'Scrimp'.
oa:
This informal word means to be too thrifty or stingy, or to do something insufficiently to save money. It is a direct synonym for scrimp and does not satisfy the requirement for an opposite.
Synonyms: Stint (कंजूसी करना), Scant (कम करना), Pinch (बचत करना).
Antonyms: Spend (खर्च करना), Lavish (उदारता दिखाना), Squander (बर्बाद करना).

This verb means to use something carefully or frugally in order to avoid wasting it. While it involves being careful, it focus on preservation rather than the reckless waste implied by the opposite.
Synonyms: Preserve (संरक्षित करना), Protect (बचाना), Save (बचा कर रखना).
Antonyms: Waste (बर्बाद करना), Spend (खर्च करना), Exhaust (निःशेष करना).

This word refers to wasting something, especially money or time, in a reckless or foolish manner. It is the direct opposite of scrimp, which involves being extremely frugal and saving as much as possible.
Synonyms: Waste (बर्बाद करना), Dissipate (उड़ाना), Misspend (गलत खर्च करना).
Antonyms: Scrimp (कंजूसी करना), Save (बचाना), Hoard (जमा करना).

This term means to reduce in quantity or to put a restriction on something. While it involves reduction, it describes a formal act of cutting down rather than a lifestyle of extreme frugality.
Synonyms: Reduce (घटाना), Decrease (कम करना), Limit (सीमित करना).
Antonyms: Extend (बढ़ाना), Expand (फैलाना), Increase (बढ़ाना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Guzzle
questionsEn.s:
Guzzle - लालची की तरह खाना-पीना (To eat and drink greedily)
Carouse - डटकर शराब पीना (To drink and enjoy in a noisy way)
Starve - भूखा मरना (To suffer or die from hunger)
Imbibe - पीना / ग्रहण करना (To drink or absorb ideas)
Quaff - खूब पीना (To drink a beverage heartily)
Hence, 'Starve' is the most suitable antonym for 'Guzzle'.
oa:
This verb means to drink alcohol and enjoy oneself with others in a noisy and lively way. It aligns with the excessive consumption aspect of guzzling, acting as a synonym.
Synonyms: Revel (आनंद मनाना), Frolic (मौज-मस्ती करना), Party (उत्सव मनाना).
Antonyms: Fast (व्रत रखना), Abstain (परहेज करना), Grieve (शोक मनाना).

This word means to suffer or die from extreme hunger or to go without food for a long time. It is the direct opposite of guzzle, which means to eat and drink greedily and in large amounts.
Synonyms: Hunger (भूखा मरना), Fast (उपवास करना), Perish (नष्ट होना).
Antonyms: Guzzle (बहुत खाना-पीना), Feast (दावत उड़ाना), Satiate (तृप्त करना).

This term means to drink alcohol or to absorb ideas or knowledge. Since it involves the act of drinking or taking something in, it functions as a synonym for guzzle.
Synonyms: Drink (पीना), Consume (उपभोग करना), Swallow (निगलना).
Antonyms: Eject (निकालना), Emit (छोड़ना), Abstain (बचना).

This verb refers to drinking a beverage heartily or in large gulps. It is a direct synonym for the act of guzzling or drinking something quickly and with great enjoyment.
Synonyms: Gulp (गटकना), Swallow (निगलना), Swig (खूब पीना).
Antonyms: Sip (बूँद-बूँद पीना), Nibble (कुतरना), Abstain (परहेज करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Sultry
questionsEn.s:
Sultry - उमस भरा (Hot and humid weather)
Frigid - कड़क ठंडा (Extremely cold conditions)
Muggy - गर्म और नम (Unpleasantly warm and humid)
Sticky - चिपचिपा (Adhering to a surface or sweaty weather)
Soggy - गीला (Soaked with moisture; wet and soft)
Hence, 'Frigid' is the most suitable antonym for 'Sultry'.
oa:
This word refers to weather that is extremely cold or to a person who is stiff and formal. It serves as the direct opposite of sultry, which describes weather that is unpleasantly hot and humid.
Synonyms: Freezing (कड़क ठंडा), Icy (बर्फीला), Glacial (ठंडा).
Antonyms: Sultry (उमस भरा), Hot (गर्म), Tropical (उष्णकटिबंधीय).

This term describes weather that is unpleasantly warm and humid. It is a direct synonym for sultry and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an opposite.
Synonyms: Humid (नम), Damp (सीलन भरा), Sticky (चिपचिपा).
Antonyms: Dry (सूखा), Arid (शुष्क), Crisp (ताजा).

This word refers to weather that makes one feel sweaty or to something that adheres to surfaces. In terms of weather, it mirrors the humid feeling of a sultry day, acting as a synonym.
Synonyms: Humid (नम), Sweaty (पसीने से तर), Clammy (चिपचिपा).
Antonyms: Dry (सूखा), Smooth (चिकना), Non-adhesive (चिपचिपाहट रहित).
