This term describes something that is soaked with moisture; it is wet and soft. While related to moisture, it describes the physical state of an object rather than atmospheric heat and humidity.
Synonyms: Waterlogged (पानी से भरा), Soaked (भीगा हुआ), Saturated (तृप्त).
Antonyms: Dry (सूखा), Parched (सूखा हुआ), Dehydrated (निर्जलित).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Supple
questionsEn.s:
Supple - लचीला (Flexible and can bend easily without breaking)
Flexible - लचीला (Capable of bending easily)
Brittle - भंगुर (Hard but liable to break easily)
Pliable - नम्य / कोमल (Easily bent or shaped)
Bending - मुड़ने वाला (Action of changing shape into a curve)
Hence, 'Brittle' is the most suitable antonym for 'Supple'.
oa:
This term describes something that is capable of bending easily without breaking. It is a direct synonym for supple and therefore cannot be used as its opposite.
Synonyms: Pliable (लचीला), Malleable (नमनशील), Adaptable (अनुकूलनीय).
Antonyms: Rigid (कठोर), Stiff (सख्त), Adamant (अटल).

This word describes something that is hard but liable to break or shatter easily if bent. It is the direct opposite of supple, which characterizes things that bend smoothly without breaking.
Synonyms: Fragile (भंगुर), Breakable (नाजुक), Crisp (कुरकुरा).
Antonyms: Supple (लचीला), Durable (टिकाऊ), Resilient (लचीला).

This word refers to something that is easily bent or shaped, or a person who is easily influenced. Like the target word, it describes ease of bending, making it a synonym.
Synonyms: Flexible (लचीला), Elastic (लोचदार), Ductile (नमनशील).
Antonyms: Obstinate (हठी), Hard (कठोर), Rigid (सख्त).

This term refers to the action of changing the shape or direction of something to form a curve. It describes the physical act related to flexibility rather than providing a contrasting quality.
Synonyms: Curving (मुड़ना), Flexing (झुकना), Yielding (झुकने वाला).
Antonyms: Straightening (सीधा करना), Resisting (विरोध करना), Stiffening (सख्त होना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Nugatory
questionsEn.s:
Nugatory - नगण्य / तुच्छ (Of no value or importance; useless)
Delusive - भ्रामक (Misleading, deceptive, or illusory)
Futile - व्यर्थ (Useless or incapable of producing results)
Unreal - अवास्तविक (Imaginary or lacking substance)
Productive - उत्पादक (Yielding good results or useful)
Hence, 'Productive' is the most suitable antonym for 'Nugatory'.
oa:
This term refers to something that is misleading, deceptive, or based on an illusion. It describes the false nature of a claim rather than its lack of productivity or value.
Synonyms: Deceptive (भ्रामक), Illusory (भ्रामक), False (असत्य).
Antonyms: Honest (ईमानदार), Genuine (असली), Real (वास्तविक).

This word describes an action that has no success or is useless and ineffective. It is a direct synonym for nugatory and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an opposite.
Synonyms: Useless (बेकार), Vain (व्यर्थ), Ineffectual (अप्रभावी).
Antonyms: Effective (प्रभावी), Fruitful (फलदायक), Productive (उत्पादक).

This term refers to something that is imaginary or does not exist in the physical world. While it describes a lack of substance, it does not specifically address the lack of value or effectiveness.
Synonyms: Imaginary (काल्पनिक), Fictional (काल्पनिक), Nonexistent (अस्तित्वहीन).
Antonyms: Real (वास्तविक), Tangible (ठोस), Actual (यथार्थ).

This word means yielding good results, being profitable, or being capable of creating something useful. It is the direct opposite of nugatory, which describes things of no value or importance.
Synonyms: Fruitful (फलदायक), Effective (प्रभावी), Constructive (रचनात्मक).
Antonyms: Nugatory (तुच्छ), Idle (बेकार), Unproductive (अनुत्पादक).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Naive
questionsEn.s:
Naive - भोला-भाला (Innocent, inexperienced, or lacking wisdom)
Artful - चालाक (Skillful in achieving a goal through deceit)
Candid - स्पष्टवादी (Straightforward and truthful)
Credulous - विश्वासी (Too ready to believe things)
Sincere - ईमानदार (Free from pretense or deceit; genuine)
Hence, 'Artful' is the most suitable antonym for 'Naive'.
oa:
This word refers to someone who is clever or skillful, particularly in achieving a goal through deceit or cunning. It is the direct opposite of naive, which implies being innocent and simple.
Synonyms: Cunning (चालाक), Shrewd (चतुर), Sly (धूर्त).
Antonyms: Naive (भोला), Simple (सादा), Guileless (निष्कपट).

This term describes a person who is straightforward, honest, and open in speech. While a positive trait, it focuses on truthfulness rather than the worldly experience that contrasts with naivety.
Synonyms: Frank (स्पष्टवादी), Sincere (ईमानदार), Open (खुला).
Antonyms: Deceptive (भ्रामक), Evasive (टालमटोल करने वाला), Guarded (सतर्क).

This word describes someone who is too ready to believe things without evidence; they are easily fooled. It is a synonym for the trusting and simple nature of a naive person.
Synonyms: Gullible (भोला), Trusting (विश्वासी), Naive (अनाड़ी).
Antonyms: Skeptical (संशयवादी), Suspicious (संदेहपूर्ण), Wary (सावधान).

This term describes a person who is free from pretense or deceit; they are genuine. Like candid, it mirrors the positive side of being innocent rather than providing a direct opposite to it.
Synonyms: Honest (ईमानदार), True (असली), Heartfelt (हार्दिक).
Antonyms: Insincere (बनावटी), Hypocritical (पाखंडी), False (असत्य).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Obfuscate
questionsEn.s:
Obfuscate - अस्पष्ट करना (To make obscure or unclear; confuse)
Envelop - लपेटना (To cover or surround completely)
Puzzle - उलझाना (Something difficult to understand or explain)
Haze - धुंध (Unclear state or mental confusion)
Clarify - स्पष्ट करना (To make less confusing and comprehensible)
Hence, 'Clarify' is the most suitable antonym for 'Obfuscate'.
oa:
This verb means to wrap up, cover, or surround something completely. While it involves covering an object, it focus on the physical act of wrapping rather than making an idea difficult to understand.
Synonyms: Cover (ढकना), Surround (घेरना), Wrap (लपेटना).
Antonyms: Uncover (खोलना), Release (मुक्त करना), Expose (उजागर करना).

This term refers to something that is difficult to explain or understand, or the act of confusing someone. It is a synonym for the act of obfuscating or making things unclear.
Synonyms: Confuse (उलझाना), Perplex (हैरान करना), Baffle (चकित करना).
Antonyms: Clarify (स्पष्ट करना), Simplify (सरल बनाना), Solve (हल करना).

This noun or verb refers to a state of mental confusion or a visual obstruction caused by mist. It describes the state of being unclear, making it a synonym rather than an opposite.
Synonyms: Mist (धुंध), Fog (कोहरा), Blur (अस्पष्टता).
Antonyms: Clarity (स्पष्टता), Sharpness (तीक्ष्णता), Light (प्रकाश).

This word means to make something less confusing and more comprehensible; it involves making a statement or situation clear. It is the direct opposite of obfuscate.
Synonyms: Explain (समझाना), Elucidate (सुलझाना), Simplify (सरल बनाना).
Antonyms: Obfuscate (अस्पष्ट करना), Confuse (उलझाना), Complicate (जटिल बनाना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Triumph
questionsEn.s:
Triumph - विजय (A great victory or achievement)
Establish - स्थापित करना (To set up on a firm or permanent basis)
Sorrow - दुःख (Deep distress caused by loss or misfortune)
Disdain - तिरस्कार (Feeling that something is unworthy of respect)
Elation - उल्लास (Great happiness and exhilaration)
Hence, 'Sorrow' is the most suitable antonym for 'Triumph'.
oa:
This verb means to set up on a firm or permanent basis, or to initiate a system. Its focus is on creation and organization, which does not represent a direct contrast to the act of winning.
Synonyms: Found (स्थापित करना), Settle (बसना), Form (बनाना).
Antonyms: Destroy (नष्ट करना), Uproot (उखाड़ना), Abolish (समाप्त करना).

This word refers to a feeling of deep distress caused by loss, disappointment, or misfortune. It serves as an appropriate antonym for the elation or success implied by a triumph.
Synonyms: Grief (शोक), Sadness (दुःख), Misery (कष्ट).
Antonyms: Joy (खुशी), Triumph (विजय), Elation (उल्लास).

This term refers to the feeling that someone or something is unworthy of one's consideration or respect. It describes a social attitude rather than the result of a competition or battle.
Synonyms: Contempt (तिरस्कार), Scorn (घृणा), Disregard (उपेक्षा).
Antonyms: Respect (सम्मान), Admiration (प्रशंसा), Veneration (श्रद्धा).

This term refers to great happiness and exhilaration, particularly after a success. Since it describes the feeling one has after winning, it acts as a synonym for the spirit of a triumph.
Synonyms: Joy (हर्ष), Exultation (उल्लास), Euphoria (परमानंद).
Antonyms: Depression (अवसाद), Sorrow (दुःख), Gloom (उदासी).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Differ
questionsEn.s:
Differ - असहमत होना / अलग होना (To disagree or be different)
Alter - बदलना (To make something different in some way)
Concur - सहमत होना (To be of the same opinion or agree)
Digress - विषय से भटकना (To leave the main subject temporarily)
Vary - परिवर्तित होना (To differ in size, amount, or nature)
Hence, 'Concur' is the most suitable antonym for 'Differ'.
oa:
This verb means to make something different in some way without changing it completely. It focuses on the act of modification rather than the expression of disagreement between people.
Synonyms: Change (बदलना), Modify (संशोधित करना), Vary (परिवर्तित करना).
Antonyms: Maintain (बनाए रखना), Keep (रखना), Preserve (संरक्षित करना).

This word means to be of the same opinion or to agree with someone. It is the direct opposite of differ, which involves disagreeing or having a different opinion.
Synonyms: Agree (सहमत होना), Accord (तालमेल रखना), Coincide (मेल खाना).
Antonyms: Differ (असहमत होना), Disagree (विरोध करना), Clash (झगड़ना).

This verb refers to leaving the main subject temporarily in speech or writing. It describes a movement away from a topic rather than the act of disagreeing on a specific point.
Synonyms: Stray (भटकना), Deviate (विचलित होना), Wander (घूमना).
Antonyms: Focus (केंद्रित करना), Stay (बने रहना), Stick (लगे रहना).

This term means to differ in size, amount, degree, or nature from something else of the same general class. It acts as a synonym for the structural differences implied by the target word differ.
Synonyms: Differ (अलग होना), Fluctuate (उतार-चढ़ाव होना), Change (बदलना).
Antonyms: Uniform (समान), Stabilize (स्थिर रहना), Conform (अनुरूप होना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Salve
questionsEn.s:
Salve - मरहम (A soothing balm used to heal or relieve pain)
Cerate - मोम का लेप (Mixture of wax and fat used as an ointment)
Liniment - मलहम (Lotion used for rubbing on body to relieve pain)
Remedy - उपाय (Medicine or treatment for a disease or injury)
Blockage - अवरोध (Obstruction that prevents movement or flow)
Hence, 'Blockage' is the most suitable antonym for 'Salve'.
oa:
This term refers to a mixture of wax and fat used as a base for ointments. It describes a substance that is very similar in function and form to a salve, acting as a synonym.
Synonyms: Ointment (मरहम), Balm (लेप), Cream (क्रीम).
Antonyms: Irritant (परेशान करने वाला), Acid (तेजाब), Abrasion (खरोंच).

This word refers to a liquid or lotion, especially one made with oil, for rubbing on the body to relieve pain. Like salve, it is meant to heal, making it a synonym.
Synonyms: Lotion (लोशन), Emollient (कोमल बनाने वाला), Balm (मरहम).
Antonyms: Poison (जहर), Toxin (विष), Irritant (चिड़चिड़ाहट पैदा करने वाला).

This term refers to a medicine or treatment for a disease or injury. Since salves are a type of medical remedy, this word functions as a general synonym for the target word.
Synonyms: Cure (उपचार), Treatment (इलाज), Solution (समाधान).
Antonyms: Disease (रोग), Ailment (बीमारी), Poison (विष).

This word refers to an obstruction that prevents movement or flow through a passage. In a metaphorical or physical sense, it provides an opposite to the soothing, healing, and flow-restoring nature of a salve.
Synonyms: Obstruction (अवरोध), Barrier (बाधा), Impediment (रुकावट).
Antonyms: Passage (मार्ग), Opening (द्वार), Salve (उपचार).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Gregarious
questionsEn.s:
Gregarious - मिलनसार (Fond of company; sociable)
Affable - सुशील (Friendly and easy to talk to)
Genial - हँसमुख (Friendly and cheerful)
Introvert - अंतर्मुखी (A shy person who prefers to be alone)
Urbane - सभ्य / शिष्ट (Courteous and refined in manner)
Hence, 'Introvert' is the most suitable antonym for 'Gregarious'.
oa:
This word describes someone who is friendly, good-natured, or easy to talk to. It is a synonym for the sociable and pleasant nature of a gregarious person.
Synonyms: Genial (मिलनसार), Sociable (सामाजिक), Cordial (हार्दिक).
Antonyms: Surly (चिड़चिड़ा), Hostile (शत्रुतापूर्ण), Unfriendly (अमित्र).

This term describes someone who is friendly and cheerful. Since it characterizes a person who enjoys being around others, it acts as a synonym for being gregarious.
Synonyms: Amiable (सुशील), Jolly (खुशमिजाज), Cheerful (हंसमुख).
Antonyms: Gloomy (उदास), Morose (चिड़चिड़ा), Sullen (चिड़चिड़ा).

This word refers to a person who is shy or retiring and prefers spending time alone rather than in the company of others. it is the correct antonym for gregarious.
Synonyms: Solitary (एकाकी), Shy (शर्मीला), Reticent (अल्पभाषी).
Antonyms: Extrovert (बहिर्मुखी), Gregarious (मिलनसार), Outgoing (सामाजिक).

This term describes a person (especially a man) who is courteous and refined in manner. While positive, it focuses on sophistication rather than the basic desire for social company.
Synonyms: Sophisticated (दुनियादार), Refined (परिष्कृत), Cultured (सुसंस्कृत).
Antonyms: Uncouth (भद्दा), Rustic (ग्रामीण), Churlish (अशिष्ट).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Tremulous
questionsEn.s:
Tremulous - काँपता हुआ (Shaking or quivering slightly)
Feeble - कमजोर (Lacking physical strength or energy)
Frugal - मितव्ययी (Sparing or economical with money or food)
Stable - स्थिर (Not likely to give way or firmly fixed)
Vital - आवश्यक (Absolutely necessary or full of life)
Hence, 'Stable' is the most suitable antonym for 'Tremulous'.
oa:
This term describes someone or something that is lacking in physical strength, especially as a result of age or illness. It focus on weakness, which is synonymous with the shaky nature of being tremulous.
Synonyms: Weak (कमजोर), Frail (नाज़ुक), Enfeebled (दुर्बल).
Antonyms: Strong (मजबूत), Robust (शक्तिशाली), Healthy (स्वस्थ).

This word describes a person who is economical or sparing regarding money or food. It focuses on financial carefulness and has no connection to physical shaking or stability.
Synonyms: Thrifty (किफायती), Sparing (मितव्ययी), Economical (बचत करने वाला).
Antonyms: Extravagant (फिजूलखर्च), Wasteful (अपव्ययी), Lavish (अतिव्ययी).

This term refers to something that is firmly fixed, not likely to give way or overturn, or a person who is steady. It is the direct opposite of tremulous, which describes shaking or quivering slightly.
Synonyms: Steady (स्थिर), Firm (दृढ़), Constant (निश्चित).
Antonyms: Tremulous (काँपता हुआ), Unstable (अस्थिर), Shaky (डाँवाँडोल).

This word describes something that is absolutely necessary, essential, or full of energy and life. Its focus is on importance or vitality rather than on whether something is shaking or steady.
Synonyms: Essential (आवश्यक), Crucial (महत्वपूर्ण), Indispensable (अपरिहार्य).
Antonyms: Trivial (तुच्छ), Unimportant (महत्वहीन), Minor (नगण्य).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Affinity
questionsEn.s:
Affinity - लगाव / समानता (A natural liking or sympathy for someone)
Aversion - घृणा (A feeling of strong dislike or opposition)
Preference - पसंद (Liking something more than another thing)
Attraction - आकर्षण (A feeling of liking or being drawn to something)
Empathy - सहानुभूति (Capacity to understand others' feelings)
Hence, 'aversion' is the most suitable antonym for 'Affinity'.
oa:
This word refers to a strong feeling of dislike or a desire to avoid someone or something. it is the direct opposite of affinity, which involves a natural liking or sympathy for someone.
Synonyms: Dislike (नापसंदगी), Hatred (नफरत), Loathing (घृणा).
Antonyms: Affinity (आकर्षण), Fondness (लगाव), Liking (पसंद).

This term refers to the fact that you like something or someone more than another thing. It is a synonym for the selective liking implied by affinity and is not an opposite.
Synonyms: Liking (पसंद), Choice (चुनाव), Penchant (झुकाव).
Antonyms: Dislike (नापसंदगी), Rejection (अस्वीकार), Aversion (घृणा).

This word describes a feeling of liking someone or being drawn to something. Since it aligns with the core idea of affinity being a "pull" toward something, it acts as a synonym.
Synonyms: Allure (आकर्षण), Appeal (मोह), Fascination (आकर्षण).
Antonyms: Repulsion (विकर्षण), Disgust (घृणा), Aversion (विरोध).

This term refers to the capacity to understand or feel what another person is experiencing from within their frame of reference. It is synonymous with the sympathetic connection of affinity.
Synonyms: Understanding (समझ), Compassion (सहानुभूति), Relatability (संबद्धता).
Antonyms: Apathy (उदासीनता), Cruelty (क्रूरता), Indifference (बेपरवाही).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Accept
questionsEn.s:
Accept - स्वीकार करना (To agree to receive or take something)
Acquire - प्राप्त करना (To buy or obtain something for oneself)
Release - मुक्त करना (To allow to escape or let go)
Reject - अस्वीकार करना (To refuse to accept or believe something)
Obtain - हासिल करना (To get or secure something)
Hence, 'reject' is the most suitable antonym for 'Accept'.
oa:
This verb means to buy or obtain an asset or object for oneself. It describes the act of getting something, which is a specific way of accepting or taking something in.
Synonyms: Obtain (प्राप्त करना), Gain (पाना), Get (लेना).
Antonyms: Lose (खोना), Give (देना), Relinquish (त्यागना).

This verb means to allow something or someone to be free or to let go of them. While it involves a form of letting go, it does not represent the direct refusal of an offer or idea.
Synonyms: Free (मुक्त करना), Discharge (निकालना), Liberate (आज़ाद करना).
Antonyms: Hold (पकड़ना), Detain (हिरासत में लेना), Capture (पकड़ना).

This word means to refuse to accept, use, or believe in someone or something. it is the direct opposite of accept, which involves saying yes or agreeing to take something.
Synonyms: Refuse (अस्वीकार करना), Decline (नकारना), Spurn (तिरस्कार करना).
Antonyms: Accept (स्वीकार करना), Approve (मंजूरी देना), Welcome (स्वागत करना).

This verb refers to the act of getting, acquiring, or securing something. It is synonymous with the result of accepting something and therefore cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Procure (प्राप्त करना), Secure (हासिल करना), Win (जीतना).
Antonyms: Lose (गँवाना), Fail (असफल होना), Forfeit (जुर्माना देना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Scarce
questionsEn.s:
Scarce - दुर्लभ / कम (Insufficient or not available in enough quantity)
Seldom - कभी-कभार (Not common or infrequent)
Few - कुछ / थोड़े (A small number of something)
Plentiful - भरपूर (Existing in large quantities)
Scanty - अल्प (Small or insufficient in amount)
Hence, 'Plentiful' is the most suitable antonym for 'Scarce'.
oa:
This adverb means not common or infrequent. While it describes how rarely an event occurs, it describes the same rarity as scarce and therefore acts as a synonym.
Synonyms: Rarely (कभी-कभी), Infrequently (शायद ही कभी), Occasionally (कभी-कभार).
Antonyms: Often (अक्सर), Frequently (बार-बार), Regularly (नियमित रूप से).

This term refers to a small number of something. It carries the same idea of limited quantity that the target word does, making it a synonym rather than an antonym.
Synonyms: Some (कुछ), Scanty (अल्प), Meager (थोड़ा).
Antonyms: Many (अनेक), Numerous (बहुत सारे), Multitude (बहुतायत).

This word means existing in great quantities or being abundant. It serves as the direct opposite of scarce, which refers to something being insufficient or not available in enough quantity.
Synonyms: Abundant (प्रचुर), Ample (भरपूर), Copious (बड़ी मात्रा में).
Antonyms: Scarce (दुर्लभ), Meager (अल्प), Deficient (कमी).

This word describes an amount that is insufficient or very small. It is a direct synonym for the target word and cannot be used as its opposite.
Synonyms: Meager (अल्प), Scarce (दुर्लभ), Sparse (विरल).
Antonyms: Plentiful (भरपूर), Profuse (प्रचुर), Lavish (अतिव्ययी).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Expansion
questionsEn.s:
Expansion - विस्तार (The action of becoming larger)
Inflation - मुद्रास्फीति / फुलाव (Filling with air to increase size)
Extension - विस्तार / बढ़ाव (Causing something to become longer)
Compression - संकुचन (Flattening or pressing into a smaller space)
Augmentation - वृद्धि (The action of making something greater)
Hence, 'compression' is the most suitable antonym for 'Expansion'.
oa:
This term refers to the act of filling something with air or gas so that it increases in size. It describes a type of expansion, making it a synonym rather than an opposite.
Synonyms: Swelling (फूलना), Bloating (सूजन), Augmentation (वृद्धि).
Antonyms: Deflation (हवा निकलना), Contraction (सिकुड़न), Shrinkage (कमी).

This word refers to the action of causing something to become longer or larger. It carries the same meaning of increasing size as expansion, acting as a synonym.
Synonyms: Prolongation (विस्तार), Stretching (खींचना), Addition (जोड़).
Antonyms: Shortening (छोटा करना), Reduction (कमी), Curtailment (कटौती).

This term refers to the action of flattening or pressing something into a smaller space. It is the direct opposite of expansion, which involves something becoming larger.
Synonyms: Contraction (संकुचन), Condensation (संघनन), Squeezing (दबाना).
Antonyms: Expansion (विस्तार), Dilation (फैलाव), Inflation (वृद्धि).

This word refers to the act of making something greater by adding to it. It describes an increase in size or value, which aligns with the meaning of expansion.
Synonyms: Increase (बढ़ाना), Enhancement (सुधार), Growth (विकास).
Antonyms: Depletion (कमी), Reduction (घटाना), Diminution (कमी).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Swerve
questionsEn.s:
Swerve - अचानक मुड़ना (To change direction abruptly)
droop - मुरझाना (To bend or hang downward limply)
lurch - झटका / लड़खड़ाहट (Sudden unsteady movement)
straighten - सीधा करना (To make or become straight)
deviate - भटकना (To depart from an established course)
Hence, 'straighten' is the most suitable antonym for 'Swerve'.
oa:
This word means to bend or hang downward limply, often due to exhaustion or lack of water. It focuses on vertical sagging rather than the horizontal change of direction.
Synonyms: Sag (झुकना), Wilt (मुरझाना), Slump (गिरना).
Antonyms: Rise (उठना), Straighten (सीधा होना), Flourish (फलना-फूलना).

This verb refers to making an abrupt, unsteady, or uncontrolled movement. While it involves sudden motion like a swerve, it focuses on staggering rather than a purposeful turn.
Synonyms: Stagger (लड़खड़ाना), Sway (डोलना), Pitch (झुकना).
Antonyms: Steady (स्थिर रहना), Stabilize (स्थिर करना), Glide (सहजता से चलना).

This word means to make or become straight or to move in a direct, uncurving line. It is the direct opposite of swerve, which involves changing direction abruptly.
Synonyms: Align (सीध में करना), Unbend (सीधा करना), Order (व्यवस्थित करना).
Antonyms: Swerve (मुड़ना), Bend (झुकना), Curve (मोड़ना).

This verb means to depart from an established course or standard. It is a synonym for swerving or turning away from a path and therefore cannot be used as an opposite.
Synonyms: Stray (भटकना), Digress (विषयांतर करना), Diverge (अलग होना).
Antonyms: Conform (अनुपालन करना), Follow (अनुसरण करना), Stick (लगे रहना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Sober
questionsEn.s:
Sober - संजीदा / शांत (Serious, sensible, and solemn)
agitated - विचलित (Feeling or appearing troubled or nervous)
serious - गंभीर (Synonym of Sober; solemn in nature)
nervous - चिंतित (Anxious or apprehensive)
calm - शांत (Not showing or feeling nervousness or anger)
Hence, 'agitated' is the most suitable antonym for 'Sober'.
oa:
This word describes someone who is feeling or appearing troubled, nervous, or emotionally disturbed. It is the direct opposite of the sensible, calm, and sensible state implied by sober.
Synonyms: Perturbed (विचलित), Flustered (घबराया हुआ), Excited (उत्तेजित).
Antonyms: Calm (शांत), Sober (संजीदा), Placid (स्थिर).

This term characterizes someone who is solemn or thoughtful in character. It is a synonym for the earnest and sensible nature of being sober rather than an opposite.
Synonyms: Solemn (गंभीर), Earnest (संजीदा), Grave (गंभीर).
Antonyms: Frivolous (तुच्छ), Lighthearted (मजाकिया), Joyful (हर्षित).

This word describes someone who is easily agitated or alarmed, often feeling anxious. While it involves a lack of calm, it describes a type of worry rather than a general lack of sobriety.
Synonyms: Anxious (चिंतित), Apprehensive (भयभीत), Edgy (तनावग्रस्त).
Antonyms: Confident (आत्मविश्वासी), Bold (साहसी), Sober (स्थिर).

This term refers to a state of being peaceful and not showing strong emotions. Since it aligns with the cool-headed and sensible nature of a sober person, it acts as a synonym.
Synonyms: Tranquil (शांत), Serene (निर्मल), Quiet (खामोश).
Antonyms: Agitated (उत्तेजित), Stormy (तूफानी), Violent (उग्र).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Stale
questionsEn.s:
Stale - बासी (No longer fresh and pleasant to eat)
flat - समतल / फीका (Level surface or having lost fizz)
fresh - ताज़ा (Recently made or obtained; not spoiled)
dry - सूखा (Free from moisture or liquid)
sour - खट्टा (Having an acidic taste)
Hence, 'fresh' is the most suitable antonym for 'Stale'.
oa:
This word describes something that has a level surface or, in the case of a drink, has lost its bubbles. While it describes a loss of quality, it does not specifically mean "not fresh."
Synonyms: Level (समतल), Dull (फीका), Boring (नीरस).
Antonyms: Bubbling (बुदबुदाती), Sharp (तीव्र), Elevated (ऊँचा).

This term refers to something recently made, harvested, or obtained; it is not spoiled or old. It is the direct antonym for stale, which describes things that are no longer new.
Synonyms: New (नया), Crisp (ताज़ा), Recent (हाल का).
Antonyms: Stale (बासी), Old (पुराना), Withered (मुरझाया हुआ).

This word refers to something that is free from moisture or liquid. While stale bread is often dry, the word dry itself focuses on the absence of water rather than the age of the item.
Synonyms: Arid (शुष्क), Parched (सूखा), Dehydrated (निर्जलित).
Antonyms: Wet (गीला), Moist (नम), Damp (सीलन भरा).

This term describes a sharp, acidic taste like that of a lemon. It characterizes a specific flavor profile rather than the overall lack of freshness represented by staleness.
Synonyms: Acidic (खट्टा), Tart (तीखा), Sharp (तीक्ष्ण).
Antonyms: Sweet (मीठा), Saccharine (सुगंधित), Dulcet (मधुर).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Dense
questionsEn.s:
Dense - घना (Having constituent parts crowded closely together)
Opaque - अपारदर्शी (Not able to be seen through)
Condensed - संक्षिप्त / गाढ़ा (Made denser or more concise)
Thick - मोटा (Densely filled or covered with)
Sparse - विरल / अल्प (Thinly dispersed or scattered)
Hence, 'Sparse' is the most suitable antonym for 'Dense'.
oa:
This term describes something that is not able to be seen through; it is not transparent. While dense objects are often opaque, the word itself describes visibility rather than thickness.
Synonyms: Cloudy (धुंधला), Obscure (अस्पष्ट), Solid (ठोस).
Antonyms: Transparent (पारदर्शी), Clear (साफ), Lucid (सुस्पष्ट).

This word refers to something that has been made denser or more concise; it is compressed. Since it involves increasing density, it functions as a synonym for dense.
Synonyms: Compressed (दबाया हुआ), Thickened (गाढ़ा), Compacted (संकुचित).
Antonyms: Expanded (फैला हुआ), Diluted (पतला), Sparse (विरल).

This term describes something having a large distance between opposite sides or being closely packed. It is a direct synonym for the physical property of being dense.
Synonyms: Heavy (भारी), Solid (मजबूत), Concentrated (गाढ़ा).
Antonyms: Thin (पतला), Slender (दुबला), Light (हल्का).

This word refers to something that is thinly dispersed or scattered; it means having a small amount in a large area. It is the direct opposite of dense, where parts are crowded together.
Synonyms: Scanty (अल्प), Meager (थोड़ा), Thin (विरल).
Antonyms: Dense (घना), Abundant (प्रचुर), Crowded (ठसाठस).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Finite
questionsEn.s:
Finite - सीमित (Limited in size or extent)
finished - समाप्त (Completed or accomplished)
endless - अनंत (Having no limit or end; infinite)
limited - सीमित (Restricted in size or amount)
bound - बाध्य (Restricted or confined by boundaries)
Hence, 'endless' is the most suitable antonym for 'Finite'.
oa:
This word refers to something that has been completed or brought to an end. While it involves a limit in time, it describes a completed status rather than a lack of boundaries.
Synonyms: Completed (पूर्ण), Concluded (समाप्त), Done (किया हुआ).
Antonyms: Ongoing (जारी), Unfinished (अधूरा), Incomplete (अपूर्ण).

This term refers to something that has no limit in size, extent, or duration; it is infinite. It serves as the direct opposite of finite, which means having definite limits or boundaries.
Synonyms: Infinite (अनंत), Eternal (शाश्वत), Limitless (असीमित).
Antonyms: Finite (सीमित), Brief (संक्षिप्त), Restricted (निश्चित).

This word refers to something that is restricted in size, amount, or extent. It is a direct synonym for finite and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an opposite.
Synonyms: Finite (निश्चित), Restricted (सीमित), Constrained (बाधित).
Antonyms: Unlimited (असीमित), Infinite (अनंत), Boundless (अपार).

This term describes something that is restricted or confined by specific boundaries or rules. It mirrors the meaning of finite and acts as a synonym instead of an antonym.
Synonyms: Confined (सीमित), Restricted (बाधित), Tied (जुड़ा हुआ).
Antonyms: Free (मुक्त), Unbound (असीमित), Independent (स्वतंत्र).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Reprimand
questionsEn.s:
Reprimand - फटकारना (To severely or formally criticize someone)
blame - दोष देना (To hold responsible for a wrong)
compliment - प्रशंसा करना (To express praise or admiration)
reproach - धिक्कारना (Expression of disapproval in actions)
apprehend - गिरफ्तार करना (To arrest or to understand)
Hence, 'compliment' is the most suitable antonym for 'Reprimand'.
oa:
This verb means to assign responsibility for a fault or wrong. It involves a negative judgment of someone's actions, making it synonymous with the act of reprimanding.
Synonyms: Accuse (दोषी ठहराना), Censure (निंदा करना), Condemn (निंदा करना).
Antonyms: Absolve (दोषमुक्त करना), Exonerate (बरी करना), Forgive (क्षमा करना).

This verb means to express praise or admiration for someone's actions or achievements. It serves as the direct opposite of a reprimand, which involves formal criticism.
Synonyms: Praise (प्रशंसा करना), Applaud (सराहना), Commend (बखान करना).
Antonyms: Reprimand (फटकारना), Criticize (आलोचना करना), Insult (अपमान करना).

This term refers to expressing disapproval or disappointment in someone's actions. Since it involves finding fault, it acts as a synonym for the target word.
Synonyms: Chide (झिड़कना), Admonish (चेतावनी देना), Rebuke (फटकारना).
Antonyms: Praise (तारीफ करना), Commend (सराहना करना), Approbate (स्वीकृति देना).

This word means to arrest someone for a crime or to understand something. While it involves a legal consequence, it does not specifically mean the act of verbal criticism.
Synonyms: Arrest (गिरफ्तार करना), Seize (पकड़ना), Understand (समझना).
Antonyms: Release (मुक्त करना), Discharge (निकालना), Free (आज़ाद करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Tender
questionsEn.s:
Tender - कोमल (Showing gentleness, kindness, and affection)
gentle - सुशील (Having a mild and kind character)
rough - खुरदरा / उग्र (Not gentle; violent or uneven)
soft - मुलायम (Not strong or firm)
warm - गरम / स्नेही (Showing enthusiasm or kindness)
Hence, 'rough' is the most suitable antonym for 'Tender'.
oa:
This term describes someone or something that is mild, kind, or showing a tender character. It serves as a direct synonym for the target word and cannot be used as its opposite.
Synonyms: Kind (दयालु), Soft (कोमल), Amiable (सुशील).
Antonyms: Harsh (कठोर), Rough (खुरदरा), Violent (उग्र).

This word means not gentle, violent, or having an uneven surface. It is the perfect antonym for tender, which refers to showing gentleness, kindness, and affection.
Synonyms: Harsh (कठोर), Coarse (खुरदरा), Rugged (ऊबड़-खाबड़).
Antonyms: Tender (कोमल), Smooth (चिकना), Gentle (सुशील).

This term describes something that is not hard or firm to the touch, or someone who is sympathetic. It mirrors the meaning of tender and acts as a synonym.
Synonyms: Supple (लचीला), Delicate (नाज़ुक), Mellow (मधुर).
Antonyms: Hard (कठोर), Tough (मजबूत), Rigid (सख्त).

This word refers to showing enthusiasm, affection, or a moderate degree of heat. Since it describes a pleasant and kind emotion, it aligns with the meaning of tender.
Synonyms: Affectionate (स्नेही), Cordial (हार्दिक), Fervent (जोशीला).
Antonyms: Cold (ठंडा), Aloof (पृथक), Unfriendly (अमित्र).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Escalate
questionsEn.s:
Escalate - तीव्र करना (To increase rapidly or intensify)
reduce - कम करना (To make smaller in size or amount)
raise - उठाना (To move to a higher position)
enlarge - बड़ा करना (To make something more extensive)
heighten - बढ़ाना (To make or become more intense)
Hence, 'reduce' is the most suitable antonym for 'Escalate'.
oa:
This verb means to make something smaller or less in amount, degree, or size. It is the direct opposite of escalate, which involves an increase in intensity or size.
Synonyms: Decrease (घटाना), Diminish (कम करना), Lower (कम करना).
Antonyms: Escalate (बढ़ाना), Increase (बढ़ाना), Boost (बढ़ावा देना).

This term refers to lifting something to a higher position or increasing its level. It is a synonym for the "increasing" aspect of escalating and does not represent an opposite.
Synonyms: Elevate (ऊँचा उठाना), Lift (उठाना), Boost (बढ़ाना).
Antonyms: Drop (गिराना), Lower (नीचे करना), Sink (डुबोना).

This verb means to make or become larger or more extensive. Since it describes a process of expansion, it acts as a synonym for the physical growth found in escalating.
Synonyms: Expand (फैलाना), Magnify (बढ़ाना), Extend (विस्तार करना).
Antonyms: Shrink (सिकुड़ना), Condense (संक्षिप्त करना), Narrow (तंग करना).

This term refers to making or becoming more intense or making something physically higher. It mirrors the core idea of escalating and serves as a synonym.
Synonyms: Intensify (तीव्र करना), Enhance (बढ़ाना), Exacerbate (बिगाड़ना).
Antonyms: Moderate (शांत करना), Alleviate (कम करना), Diminish (घटाना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Illuminate
questionsEn.s:
Illuminate - प्रकाशित करना (To light up or make bright)
light - उजाला (Natural agent that makes things visible)
add - जोड़ना (To join to something to increase size)
erase - मिटाना (To wipe clean or remove marks)
darken - अंधेरा करना (To make or become dark)
Hence, 'darken' is the most suitable antonym for 'Illuminate'.
oa:
This verb means to provide with light or to make something bright. It is a direct synonym for illuminate and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an opposite.
Synonyms: Brighten (चमकाना), Radiant (प्रदीप्त करना), Ignite (सुलगाना).
Antonyms: Darken (अंधेरा करना), Obscure (धुंधला करना), Dim (मंद करना).

This term refers to joining something to something else to increase the size or number. It focuses on quantity and addition, which is unrelated to the clarity or light of an object.
Synonyms: Attach (जोड़ना), Annex (मिलाना), Append (जोड़ना).
Antonyms: Subtract (घटाना), Remove (हटाना), Deduct (कम करना).

This verb means to rub out or remove marks or written information. While it involves making something disappear, it refers to deletion rather than the removal of light.
Synonyms: Delete (मिटाना), Obliterate (नष्ट करना), Efface (मिटाना).
Antonyms: Create (बनाना), Write (लिखना), Restore (बहाल करना).

This word means to make something dark or darker by removing light. It serves as the direct opposite of illuminate, which means to light up or brighten something.
Synonyms: Dim (मंद करना), Shadow (छाया करना), Obscure (धुंधला करना).
Antonyms: Illuminate (प्रकाशित करना), Light (चमकाना), Brighten (उज्ज्वल करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Deficit
questionsEn.s:
Deficit - घाटा / कमी (Amount by which something is too small)
adhere - चिपकना (To stick fast to a surface)
surplus - अधिशेष / फालतू (An amount left over after requirements)
credit - साख / उधार (Ability to obtain goods before payment)
remove - हटाना (To take something away from a position)
Hence, 'surplus' is the most suitable antonym for 'Deficit'.
oa:
This verb means to stick fast to a surface or to follow a rule or belief. Its focus is on attachment or obedience, which is entirely unrelated to financial or numerical shortages.
Synonyms: Stick (चिपकना), Cling (चिपटना), Comply (अनुपालन करना).
Antonyms: Detach (अलग करना), Flout (अवहेलना करना), Disobey (उल्लंघन करना).

This word refers to an amount of something left over after requirements have been met; it is an excess. It is the direct opposite of a deficit, which is a shortage or an insufficient amount.
Synonyms: Excess (अधिकता), Glut (भरमार), Abundance (प्रचुरता).
Antonyms: Deficit (कमी), Shortage (अभाव), Dearth (अकाल).

This term refers to the ability to obtain goods before payment or the acknowledgement of a contribution. While used in finance, it describes a transaction system rather than an overabundance.
Synonyms: Trust (विश्वास), Praise (श्रेय), Loan (उधार).
Antonyms: Debt (कर्ज), Deficit (कमी), Cash (नकद).

This verb means to take something away from a particular position. It describes an action of taking something out, which is unrelated to the numerical concept of having too little.
Synonyms: Detach (हटाना), Delete (मिटाना), Extract (निकालना).
Antonyms: Add (जोड़ना), Insert (डालना), Place (रखना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Brutal
questionsEn.s:
Brutal - क्रूर (Savagely violent and cruel)
Humane - मानवीय / दयालु (Showing compassion or benevolence)
Fierce - भयंकर (Displaying intense aggressiveness)
Sane - समझदार (Sound mind; not mentally ill)
Savage - जंगली / बरबर (Fierce, violent, and uncontrolled)
Hence, 'Humane' is the most suitable antonym for 'Brutal'.
oa:
This word describes someone who shows compassion, benevolence, and kindness toward others. It serves as the perfect opposite of brutal, which describes someone who is savagely violent and cruel.
Synonyms: Compassionate (दयालु), Kind (मेहरबान), Benevolent (परोपकारी).
Antonyms: Brutal (क्रूर), Savage (अमानवीय), Cruel (निर्दयी).

This term describes having or displaying an intense or ferocious aggressiveness. It is a synonym for the violent and aggressive nature found in a brutal person or animal.
Synonyms: Ferocious (भयंकर), Violent (उग्र), Savage (जंगली).
Antonyms: Gentle (सौम्य), Mild (हल्का), Tame (पालतू).

This word describes a person of sound mind who is not mentally ill. While it is a positive trait, it focuses on mental health and logic rather than the presence of kindness or absence of violence.
Synonyms: Rational (तर्कसंगत), Lucid (सुबोध), Normal (स्वस्थचित्त).
Antonyms: Insane (पागल), Crazy (विक्षिप्त), Mad (दीवाना).

This word describes someone or something that is fierce, violent, and uncontrolled. It is a strong synonym for brutal and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an opposite.
Synonyms: Barbaric (बरबर), Cruel (निर्दयी), Ferocious (भयंकर).
Antonyms: Civilized (सभ्य), Tame (पालतू), Gentle (कोमल).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Stationary
questionsEn.s:
Stationary - स्थिर (Not moving or intended to be moved)
tired - थका हुआ (In need of sleep or rest)
motionless - गतिहीन (Not moving; still)
shifting - खिसकने वाला (Moving from one place to another)
still - निश्चल (Not moving or making a sound)
Hence, 'shifting' is the most suitable antonym for 'Stationary'.
oa:
This word describes someone in need of sleep or rest after exertion. It focuses on physical fatigue rather than whether an object is fixed in place or moving.
Synonyms: Weary (थका हुआ), Exhausted (निढाल), Fatigued (पस्त).
Antonyms: Energetic (ऊर्जावान), Refreshed (ताजा), Active (सक्रिय).

This word means not moving or being still. It is a direct synonym for stationary and therefore fails to provide the required opposite relationship.
Synonyms: Still (निश्चल), Fixed (स्थिर), Immobile (अचल).
Antonyms: Moving (गतिशील), Shifting (खिसकता हुआ), Active (सक्रिय).

This word means to move or cause to move from one place to another, particularly over small distances. it is the correct antonym for stationary, which means not moving at all.
Synonyms: Moving (गतिशील), Changeable (बदलने वाला), Floating (चलायमान).
Antonyms: Stationary (स्थिर), Fixed (अचल), Permanent (स्थायी).

This term refers to something that is not moving or making a sound. Since it describes a state of being at rest, it acts as a synonym for the given word stationary.
Synonyms: Static (निश्चल), Quiet (खामोश), Tranquil (शांत).
Antonyms: Noisy (शोर भरा), Moving (गतिशील), Disturbed (परेशान).

test.instructions: Standard CBT Pattern Exam. Positive Marks: +1, Negative Marks: -0.25. Total Questions: 50.

test.title: Set - 10

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Comic
questionsEn.s:
Comic - हास्यपूर्ण (Causing or meant to cause laughter)
Amusing - मनोरंजक (Providing enjoyment or laughter)
Tragic - दुखद (Causing extreme distress or sorrow)
Awkward - बेढंगा (Causing embarrassment or difficulty)
Absurd - बेतुका (Wildly unreasonable or illogical)
Hence, 'Tragic' is the most suitable antonym for 'Comic'.
oa:
This word describes things that provide entertainment or cause laughter. It shares the same lighthearted nature as the given word and thus serves as a synonym rather than the required opposite.
Synonyms: Funny (मज़ेदार), Entertaining (मनोरंजक), Humorous (हास्यपूर्ण).
Antonyms: Boring (उबाऊ), Tedious (थकाऊ), Serious (गंभीर).

This term refers to events or situations causing extreme distress or sorrow, often involving death or suffering. It represents the direct dramatic and emotional opposite of being comic or funny.
Synonyms: Sorrowful (दुखद), Calamitous (विनाशकारी), Grievous (कष्टदायक).
Antonyms: Comic (हास्यपूर्ण), Joyful (हर्षित), Cheerful (प्रसन्न).

This word characterizes situations or behaviors that cause embarrassment or are difficult to deal with. It focuses on lack of grace or discomfort rather than the absence of humor.
Synonyms: Clumsy (अनाड़ी), Ungainly (बेढंगा), Inelegant (भद्दा).
Antonyms: Graceful (सौम्य), Adroit (चतुर), Elegant (शिष्ट).

This word describes things that are wildly unreasonable, illogical, or inappropriate. While often funny, its core meaning is about a lack of sense rather than being a contrast to comedy.
Synonyms: Ridiculous (हास्यास्पद), Preposterous (बेतुका), Farcical (बेतुका).
Antonyms: Sensible (समझदार), Logical (तर्कसंगत), Rational (तर्कसंगत).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Gather
questionsEn.s:
Gather - इकट्ठा करना (To come together or assemble)
Distract - ध्यान भटकाना (To prevent someone from concentrating)
Dispute - विवाद (A disagreement or argument)
Display - प्रदर्शन (To show or exhibit something)
Disperse - तितर-बितर करना (To spread over a wide area)
Hence, 'Disperse' is the most suitable antonym for 'Gather'.
oa:
This verb means to prevent someone from giving their full attention to something. It deals with mental focus rather than the physical act of bringing things together.
Synonyms: Divert (ध्यान हटाना), Sidetrack (भटकाना), Perturb (विचलित करना).
Antonyms: Focus (केंद्रित करना), Attract (आकर्षित करना), Fixate (स्थिर करना).

This word refers to a disagreement, argument, or debate. It describes a verbal or legal conflict, which is unrelated to the act of accumulating or assembling objects.
Synonyms: Argue (बहस करना), Contend (विवाद करना), Clash (झगड़ना).
Antonyms: Agree (सहमत होना), Concur (सहमत होना), Assent (स्वीकार करना).

This term means to put something in a prominent place so that it may be readily seen. It focuses on exhibition rather than the act of collecting or separating.
Synonyms: Exhibit (प्रदर्शित करना), Show (दिखाना), Reveal (प्रकट करना).
Antonyms: Hide (छिपाना), Conceal (गुप्त रखना), Cover (ढकना).

This word means to distribute or spread over a wide area or to go in different directions. it is the direct opposite of gathering or bringing things to one place.
Synonyms: Scatter (बिखेरना), Dissipate (उड़ाना), Diffuse (फैलाना).
Antonyms: Gather (इकट्ठा करना), Assemble (एकत्र करना), Collect (संग्रहित करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Tyrant
questionsEn.s:
Tyrant - तानाशाह (A cruel and oppressive ruler)
Benefactor - दानकर्ता / सहायक (Person who helps or gives money)
Champion - विजेता / समर्थक (A winner or vigorous supporter)
Despot - निरंकुश शासक (Ruler with absolute power)
Rival - प्रतिद्वंद्वी (A person competing with another)
Hence, 'Benefactor' is the most suitable antonym for 'Tyrant'.
oa:
This word refers to a person who gives money or other help to a person or cause. It is the perfect opposite of a tyrant, who is a cruel and oppressive ruler.
Synonyms: Helper (सहायक), Donor (दाता), Philanthropist (परोपकारी).
Antonyms: Oppressor (उत्पीड़क), Tyrant (तानाशाह), Antagonist (विरोधी).

This term describes a person who has defeated all rivals in a competition or someone who vigorously supports a cause. It does not directly contrast with the oppressive nature of a ruler.
Synonyms: Victor (विजेता), Defender (रक्षक), Advocate (समर्थक).
Antonyms: Loser (पराजित), Opponent (विरोधी), Adversary (दुश्मन).

This word refers to a ruler or other person who holds absolute power, typically one who exercises it in a cruel way. It is a synonym for tyrant and thus cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Dictator (तानाशाह), Autocrat (एकछत्र शासक), Monocrat (निरंकुश).
Antonyms: Democrat (लोकतंत्रवादी), Liberator (मुक्तिदाता), Subordinate (अधीनस्थ).

This term refers to a person or thing competing with another for the same objective. It describes a competitive relationship rather than the character or behavior of a ruler.
Synonyms: Competitor (प्रतिद्वंद्वी), Opponent (विरोधी), Adversary (शत्रु).
Antonyms: Ally (मित्र), Partner (साझेदार), Associate (साथी).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Crucial
questionsEn.s:
Crucial - महत्वपूर्ण (Extremely important or necessary)
critical - निर्णायक / महत्वपूर्ण (Of great importance to success)
imperative - अनिवार्य (Of vital importance; necessary)
trivial - मामूली (Of little value or importance)
pivotal - मुख्य / केंद्रीय (Crucial or central to something)
Hence, 'trivial' is the most suitable antonym for 'Crucial'.
oa:
This term describes something that is of the greatest importance to the success or failure of something. It acts as a direct synonym for crucial and is not an opposite.
Synonyms: Essential (अनिवार्य), Vital (महत्वपूर्ण), Pivotal (केंद्रीय).
Antonyms: Unimportant (महत्वहीन), Trivial (मामूली), Minor (नगण्य).

This word refers to something that is of vital importance or an authoritative command. Since it mirrors the significance of the given word, it functions as a synonym.
Synonyms: Necessary (आवश्यक), Urgent (तत्काल), Requisite (अपेक्षित).
Antonyms: Optional (वैकल्पिक), Unnecessary (अनावश्यक), Secondary (गौण).

This term describes something of very little value or importance. It serves as the direct opposite of crucial, which refers to things that are extremely important or decisive.
Synonyms: Insignificant (महत्वहीन), Minor (मामूली), Petty (तुच्छ).
Antonyms: Crucial (महत्वपूर्ण), Vital (आवश्यक), Significant (महत्वपूर्ण).

This term relates to something on which everything else depends; it is central and vital. It is another synonym for crucial and fails to provide the required contrast.
Synonyms: Central (मुख्य), Key (प्रमुख), Decisive (निर्णायक).
Antonyms: Marginal (सीमांत), Irrelevant (अप्रासंगिक), Trivial (नगण्य).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Covetous
questionsEn.s:
Covetous - लोभी / लालची (Greedily desiring what others have)
benevolent - परोपकारी (Kind-hearted and well-meaning)
mercenary - स्वार्थी (Interested only in money/gain)
acquisitive - संग्रहशील (Eager to acquire possessions)
avaricious - धन-लोभी (Having extreme greed for wealth)
Hence, 'benevolent' is the most suitable antonym for 'Covetous'.
oa:
This word describes a person who is well-meaning, kind, and desires to do good for others. It is the direct opposite of being covetous, which involves greedily desiring what belongs to others.
Synonyms: Altruistic (परोपकारी), Kind-hearted (दयालु), Philanthropic (दानशील).
Antonyms: Malevolent (दुष्ट), Cruel (निर्दयी), Greedy (लोभी).

This term refers to someone primarily concerned with making money at the expense of ethics. It shares the greedy motivation of being covetous and therefore functions as a synonym.
Synonyms: Grasping (लोभी), Venal (भ्रष्ट), Acquisitive (लालची).
Antonyms: Altruistic (निःस्वार्थ), Generous (उदार), Idealistic (आदर्शवादी).

This word describes an excessive interest in acquiring money or material things. It is a direct synonym for covetous and does not satisfy the requirement for an opposite.
Synonyms: Greedy (लालची), Avaricious (लोभी), Rapacious (लालची).
Antonyms: Selfless (निःस्वार्थ), Giving (दानी), Simple (सादा).

This term characterizes someone having or showing extreme greed for wealth or material gain. Since it mirrors the exact meaning of covetous, it acts as a synonym.
Synonyms: Greedy (लालची), Miserly (कंजूस), Covetous (लोभी).
Antonyms: Generous (उदार), Magnanimous (महामना), Charitable (दानी).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Eminent
questionsEn.s:
Eminent - प्रसिद्ध / प्रख्यात (Famous and respected within a sphere)
inconspicuous - अप्रत्यक्ष (Not attracting any attention)
exalted - उच्च (Held in high regard or power)
impressive - प्रभावशाली (Evoking admiration through quality)
distinguished - प्रतिष्ठित (Very successful and respected)
Hence, 'inconspicuous' is the most suitable antonym for 'Eminent'.
oa:
This word describes something or someone not clearly visible or not attracting any attention. It is the direct opposite of eminent, which refers to being famous and respected.
Synonyms: Unnoticeable (अप्रत्यक्ष), Obscure (अज्ञात), Low-profile (लो-प्रोफाइल).
Antonyms: Prominent (प्रमुख), Eminent (प्रसिद्ध), Noticeable (स्पष्ट).

This term refers to a person held in high regard or placed at a high level of power. It serves as a synonym for the distinguished status of an eminent person.
Synonyms: Noble (महान), Lofty (उच्च), Distinguished (प्रतिष्ठित).
Antonyms: Humiliated (अपमानित), Lowly (नीच), Base (नीच).

This word describes something that evokes admiration through its size, quality, or skill. It aligns with the positive and noticeable nature of being eminent rather than opposing it.
Synonyms: Grand (शानदार), Striking (प्रभावशाली), Splendid (उत्कृष्ट).
Antonyms: Ordinary (साधारण), Poor (खराब), Mediocre (सामान्य).

This term characterizes someone who is very successful, authoritative, and commanding great respect. It is a direct synonym for eminent and cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Famous (प्रसिद्ध), Renowned (प्रख्यात), Noted (उल्लेखनीय).
Antonyms: Unknown (अज्ञात), Common (साधारण), Uncelebrated (अप्रसिद्ध).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Agony
questionsEn.s:
Agony - व्यथा / तीव्र पीड़ा (Extreme physical or mental suffering)
misery - कष्ट (State of great distress or discomfort)
comfort - आराम / सुख (State of physical ease or relief)
anxiety - चिंता (Feeling of worry or unease)
distress - पीड़ा (Extreme anxiety or sorrow)
Hence, 'comfort' is the most suitable antonym for 'Agony'.
oa:
This term refers to a state or feeling of great physical or mental distress or discomfort. It is a direct synonym for agony and therefore does not function as an opposite.
Synonyms: Suffering (कष्ट), Distress (पीड़ा), Sorrow (दुःख).
Antonyms: Joy (हर्ष), Comfort (आराम), Bliss (परमानंद).

This word refers to a state of physical ease and freedom from pain or constraint. it is the correct opposite of agony, which involves extreme physical or mental suffering.
Synonyms: Relief (राहत), Ease (सुविधा), Solace (सांत्वना).
Antonyms: Agony (व्यथा), Pain (दर्द), Distress (कष्ट).

This word describes a feeling of worry, nervousness, or unease. While a negative state, it focuses on mental tension rather than the intense suffering implied by agony.
Synonyms: Worry (चिंता), Apprehension (आशंका), Unease (बेचैनी).
Antonyms: Certainty (निश्चितता), Confidence (आत्मविश्वास), Calmness (शांति).

This term refers to extreme anxiety, sorrow, or pain. Since it describes the same type of intense suffering as agony, it acts as a synonym instead of an antonym.
Synonyms: Suffering (पीड़ा), Hardship (मुसीबत), Adversity (विपत्ति).
Antonyms: Prosperity (समृद्धि), Happiness (खुशी), Relief (राहत).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Sacred
questionsEn.s:
Sacred - पवित्र / पावन (Dedicated to a religious purpose)
profound - गहरा (Very great or intense)
perpetual - निरंतर (Never ending or changing)
profane - अपवित्र (Not religious; secular or disrespectful)
pious - धर्मनिष्ठ (Devoutly religious)
Hence, 'profane' is the most suitable antonym for 'Sacred'.
oa:
This term describes something of very great or intense depth, or a person having deep knowledge. It refers to depth rather than the religious status of an object or place.
Synonyms: Intense (तीव्र), Deep (गहरा), Insightful (सूझबूझ वाला).
Antonyms: Superficial (सतही), Shallow (उथला), Trivial (मामूली).

This word refers to something never ending or changing; it is everlasting. It focus on duration in time, which is unrelated to the holiness implied by the word sacred.
Synonyms: Constant (निरंतर), Eternal (शाश्वत), Unending (अनंत).
Antonyms: Temporary (अस्थायी), Transient (क्षणिक), Fleeting (अल्पकालिक).

This term refers to things that are not religious or are disrespectful toward sacred things; it means secular or unholy. It is the direct opposite of sacred.
Synonyms: Unholy (अपवित्र), Secular (सांसारिक), Irreverent (अनादरपूर्ण).
Antonyms: Sacred (पवित्र), Holy (पावन), Religious (धार्मिक).

This word describes a person who is devoutly religious and shows deep respect for God. It is a synonym for the holy and reverent nature of something sacred.
Synonyms: Devout (धर्मनिष्ठ), Religious (धार्मिक), Godly (ईश्वरप्रेमी).
Antonyms: Impious (अधर्मी), Sinful (पापी), Irreligious (नास्तिक).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Notorious
questionsEn.s:
Notorious - कुख्यात (Famous for some bad quality or deed)
infamous - बदनाम (Well known for something bad)
vicious - क्रूर (Deliberately cruel or violent)
reputable - प्रतिष्ठित (Having a good reputation; respected)
disgraceful - शर्मनाक (Unacceptable; bringing shame)
Hence, 'reputable' is the most suitable antonym for 'Notorious'.
oa:
This term refers to being well-known for some bad quality or deed. It is a direct synonym for notorious and therefore cannot be used as its opposite.
Synonyms: Scandalous (बदनाम), Disreputable (अपमानजनक), Ill-famed (अप्रसिद्ध).
Antonyms: Reputable (प्रतिष्ठित), Honorable (सम्माननीय), Famous (प्रसिद्ध).

This word describes someone who is deliberately cruel or violent. While it characterizes a person with bad qualities, it does not address their level of fame or reputation.
Synonyms: Cruel (क्रूर), Savage (जंगली), Malicious (दुर्भावनापूर्ण).
Antonyms: Gentle (सौम्य), Kind (दयालु), Benevolent (परोपकारी).

This word refers to being well-known for having a good reputation; it means being honorable and respected. It is the direct opposite of notorious.
Synonyms: Respected (प्रतिष्ठित), Honorable (मान्य), Trustworthy (विश्वसनीय).
Antonyms: Notorious (कुख्यात), Infamous (बदनाम), Disreputable (बदनाम).

This term describes behavior that is shocking and unacceptable, bringing shame. It serves as a synonym for the shameful conduct that makes one notorious.
Synonyms: Shameful (शर्मनाक), Ignominious (अपमानजनक), Deplorable (शोचनीय).
Antonyms: Admirable (प्रशंसनीय), Glorious (शानदार), Worthy (योग्य).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Prolong
questionsEn.s:
Prolong - लंबा करना (To extend the duration of)
increase - बढ़ाना (To make greater in size or degree)
shorten - छोटा करना (To make something shorter in length)
prevent - रोकना (To keep something from happening)
allow - अनुमति देना (To let someone do something)
Hence, 'shorten' is the most suitable antonym for 'Prolong'.
oa:
This verb means to become or make something greater in size, amount, or degree. While it involves expansion, it focuses on quantity rather than shortening the duration.
Synonyms: Expand (बढ़ाना), Boost (बढ़ावा देना), Augment (वृद्धि करना).
Antonyms: Decrease (घटाना), Reduce (कम करना), Diminish (घटाना).

This word means to make something smaller or to reduce its length or duration. It is the direct opposite of prolong, which means to extend the duration of something.
Synonyms: Curtail (कम करना), Abbreviate (संक्षिप्त करना), Abbreviate (छोटा करना).
Antonyms: Prolong (लंबा करना), Extend (बढ़ाना), Lengthen (बढ़ाना).

This term means to keep something from happening or to stop someone from doing something. It focus on stopping an event entirely rather than adjusting its duration.
Synonyms: Stop (रोकना), Hinder (बाधा डालना), Avert (टालना).
Antonyms: Allow (अनुमति देना), Permit (अनुमति देना), Facilitate (सुविधाजनक बनाना).

This verb means to let someone have or do something or to permit an action. It describes giving permission and has no direct relationship with the length of time.
Synonyms: Permit (अनुमति देना), Sanction (मंजूरी देना), Authorize (अधिकृत करना).
Antonyms: Forbid (मना करना), Prohibit (वर्जित करना), Ban (रोकना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Parsimonious
questionsEn.s:
Parsimonious - कंजूस (Unwilling to spend money or resources)
scanty - कम / अल्प (Small or insufficient in quantity)
niggardly - कंजूस (Extremely stingy or ungenerous)
sparing - मितव्ययी (Using or giving in moderation)
profuse - प्रचुर / अत्यधिक (Abundant or overflowing)
Hence, 'profuse' is the most suitable antonym for 'Parsimonious'.
oa:
This word describes an amount that is small or insufficient. While it relates to having very little, it describes a quantity rather than a person's behavior with money.
Synonyms: Meager (अल्प), Scarce (दुर्लभ), Deficient (कमी).
Antonyms: Plentiful (भरपूर), Abundant (प्रचुर), Copious (बड़ी मात्रा में).

This term refers to being extremely stingy or ungenerous with money. It is a direct synonym for parsimonious and therefore cannot be its antonym.
Synonyms: Stingy (कंजूस), Miserly (कृपण), Parsimonious (मितव्ययी).
Antonyms: Generous (उदार), Munificent (दानी), Liberal (दानशील).

This word describes someone who uses or gives something in moderation or is frugal. It characterizes the same carefulness with money as parsimonious, acting as a synonym.
Synonyms: Thrifty (किफायती), Frugal (मितव्ययी), Economical (बचत वाला).
Antonyms: Wasteful (अपव्ययी), Extravagant (फिजूलखर्च), Lavish (अतिव्ययी).

This term refers to something existing in large amounts; it means abundant or overflowing. It serves as the correct opposite for parsimonious, which implies being extremely stingy.
Synonyms: Abundant (प्रचुर), Copious (भरपूर), Plentiful (बहुत अधिक).
Antonyms: Parsimonious (कंजूस), Scanty (अल्प), Meager (थोड़ा).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Prudent
questionsEn.s:
Prudent - सावधान / विवेकी (Showing care and thought for the future)
tactful - विनम्र / कुशल (Skillful in dealing with others)
judicious - बुद्धिमान (Showing good judgment and sense)
indiscreet - अविवेकी (Not careful in speech or action)
practical - व्यावहारिक (Concerned with actual doing rather than theory)
Hence, 'indiscreet' is the most suitable antonym for 'Prudent'.
oa:
This term describes someone who is skilled and sensitive in dealing with others. While positive, it focuses on social skills rather than the general wisdom and future-planning of being prudent.
Synonyms: Diplomatic (नीतिज्ञ), Considerate (विचारशील), Polite (विनम्र).
Antonyms: Rude (अशिष्ट), Tactless (अकुशल), Blundering (भूल करने वाला).

This word refers to someone who has or shows good judgment and sense. It is a direct synonym for prudent and therefore fails to provide an opposite.
Synonyms: Wise (बुद्धिमान), Sensible (समझदार), Sage (मनीषी).
Antonyms: Foolish (मूर्ख), Unwise (अविवेकपूर्ण), Silly (मूर्खतापूर्ण).

This word characterizes someone who is not careful about what they say or do, often revealing secrets or causing embarrassment. it is the perfect antonym for being prudent.
Synonyms: Reckless (लापरवाह), Rash (जल्दबाज़), Impudent (गुस्ताखी).
Antonyms: Prudent (सावधान), Discreet (सतर्क), Careful (सावधान).

This term describes someone who is concerned with the actual doing of things rather than theory. While related to sensible behavior, it does not contrast with the wisdom of being prudent.
Synonyms: Realistic (यथार्थवादी), Pragmatic (व्यावहारिक), Functional (उपयोगी).
Antonyms: Idealistic (आदर्शवादी), Theoretical (सैद्धांतिक), Impractical (अव्यावहारिक).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Severe
questionsEn.s:
Severe - गंभीर (Very great, intense, or harsh)
mild - हल्का / नरम (Not severe or serious; gentle)
morose - चिड़चिड़ा / उदास (Unhappy and unwilling to smile)
meticulous - अति सावधान (Showing great attention to detail)
mediocre - औसत दर्जे का (Of only average quality; not very good)
Hence, 'mild' is the most suitable antonym for 'Severe'.
oa:
This word refers to something that is not severe, serious, or harsh; it means gentle or moderate. it is the direct opposite of severe, which describes something very great or intense.
Synonyms: Gentle (कोमल), Light (हल्का), Moderate (मध्यम).
Antonyms: Severe (गंभीर), Harsh (कठोर), Intense (तीव्र).

This term describes someone who is unhappy, annoyed, and unwilling to speak or smile. It focuses on a person's gloomy mood rather than the intensity of a situation.
Synonyms: Gloomy (उदास), Sullen (चिड़चिड़ा), Glum (खिन्न).
Antonyms: Cheerful (प्रसन्न), Joyful (हर्षित), Happy (खुश).

This word refers to someone who shows great attention to detail; they are very careful and precise. Its focus is on accuracy and care rather than on the severity of a condition.
Synonyms: Thorough (संपूर्ण), Careful (सावधान), Scrupulous (ईमानदार).
Antonyms: Careless (लापरवाह), Sloppy (गंदा), Negligent (बेपरवाह).

This term describes something that is of only average quality; it is not very good. While it implies a lack of excellence, it does not contrast with the intensity of being severe.
Synonyms: Ordinary (साधारण), Average (सामान्य), Common (मामूली).
Antonyms: Exceptional (असाधारण), Excellent (उत्कृष्ट), Superior (बेहतर).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Absurd
questionsEn.s:
Absurd - बेतुका (Wildly unreasonable, illogical, or inappropriate)
sensible - समझदार (Chosen with wisdom or prudence)
sentimental - भावुक (Prompted by feelings of tenderness or sadness)
selfish - स्वार्थी (Concerned chiefly with own profit or pleasure)
sensitive - संवेदनशील (Displaying quick appreciation of feelings)
Hence, 'sensible' is the most suitable antonym for 'Absurd'.
oa:
This word refers to actions or choices made in accordance with wisdom or prudence; they are likely to be beneficial. It is the direct opposite of being absurd or wildly unreasonable.
Synonyms: Rational (तर्कसंगत), Logical (तार्किक), Wise (बुद्धिमान).
Antonyms: Absurd (बेतुका), Ridiculous (हास्यास्पद), Foolish (मूर्ख).

This term describes someone or something prompted by feelings of tenderness, sadness, or nostalgia. It focus on emotion rather than the logical status of an idea.
Synonyms: Emotional (भावुक), Nostalgic (याद ताजा करने वाला), Maudlin (भावुक).
Antonyms: Realistic (यथार्थवादी), Hard-headed (व्यावहारिक), Cold (ठंडा).

This word characterizes someone who lacks consideration for others and is concerned chiefly with their own profit. It describes a moral flaw unrelated to the logical nature of an idea.
Synonyms: Greedy (लालची), Egocentric (अहंकारी), Mean (मतलबी).
Antonyms: Altruistic (परोपकारी), Generous (उदार), Selfless (निःस्वार्थ).

This term refers to having or displaying a quick and delicate appreciation of others' feelings. It describes an emotional responsiveness which does not provide an antonym for being absurd.
Synonyms: Responsive (संवेदनशील), Tender (कोमल), Delicate (नाज़ुक).
Antonyms: Insensitive (असंवेदनशील), Callous (कठोर), Unfeeling (निर्दयी).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Acquit
questionsEn.s:
Acquit - बरी करना (To free someone by a verdict of not guilty)
evict - बेदखल करना (To expel someone from a property)
convict - दोषी ठहराना (To declare someone guilty of a crime)
forgive - क्षमा करना (To stop feeling angry for an offense)
clear - साफ करना / बरी करना (Easy to perceive or to absolve)
Hence, 'convict' is the most suitable antonym for 'Acquit'.
oa:
This verb means to expel someone from a property, especially with legal support. While it involves a legal process, it focus on removal from a home rather than a judgment of innocence or guilt.
Synonyms: Expel (निकालना), Eject (बाहर करना), Oust (बेदखल करना).
Antonyms: Admit (प्रवेश देना), House (आवास देना), Rent to (किराये पर देना).

This word means to formally declare someone to be guilty of a criminal offense by a legal verdict. It is the direct opposite of acquit, which means to declare someone not guilty.
Synonyms: Sentence (सजा देना), Condemn (दोषी ठहराना), Indict (आरोप लगाना).
Antonyms: Acquit (बरी करना), Exonerate (दोषमुक्त करना), Pardon (क्षमा करना).

This term means to stop feeling angry or resentful toward someone for an offense or mistake. While related to releasing blame, it is a personal emotional choice rather than a formal legal verdict.
Synonyms: Pardon (क्षमा करना), Condone (माफ करना), Absolve (दोषमुक्त करना).
Antonyms: Blame (दोष देना), Resent (नाराज होना), Punish (दंड देना).

This verb means to easy to perceive or to remove an obstruction. In a legal sense, it can mean to prove someone innocent, making it a synonym for acquit rather than an antonym.
Synonyms: Absolve (दोषमुक्त करना), Exonerate (बरी करना), Vindicate (साबित करना).
Antonyms: Accuse (आरोप लगाना), Implicate (फँसाना), Blame (दोष देना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Public
questionsEn.s:
Public - सार्वजनिक (Done or existing in open view; for all)
common - आम / साधारण (Found often or shared by many)
restricted - सीमित (Limited in extent or scope)
private - निजी / व्यक्तिगत (Not to be revealed to others)
ready - तैयार (In a suitable state for action)
Hence, 'private' is the most suitable antonym for 'Public'.
oa:
This term describes things that occur often or are shared by many people. It characterizes things that are well-known or widespread, acting as a synonym for the "shared" aspect of being public.
Synonyms: General (सामान्य), Prevalent (प्रचलित), Ordinary (साधारण).
Antonyms: Rare (दुर्लभ), Unique (अनोखा), Specific (विशिष्ट).

(Note: likely a typo for Restricted). This word refers to something limited in extent, number, or scope. While it implies a limit, it does not specifically address the hidden or private nature of information.
Synonyms: Limited (सीमित), Constrained (बाधित), Confined (सीमित).
Antonyms: Unlimited (असीमित), Free (मुक्त), Widespread (व्यापक).

This word refers to things that are intended for or restricted to the use of a particular person or group; it means not to be revealed to others. It is the direct opposite of public.
Synonyms: Personal (व्यक्तिगत), Confidential (गोपनीय), Secret (गुप्त).
Antonyms: Public (सार्वजनिक), Open (खुला), Overt (प्रकट).

This term describes being in a suitable state for action or fully prepared. It focuses on preparedness rather than on whether something is visible to or shared with the public.
Synonyms: Prepared (तैयार), Willing (इच्छुक), Set (निश्चित).
Antonyms: Unprepared (अतैयार), Reluctant (अनिच्छुक), Slow (धीमा).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Progressive
questionsEn.s:
Progressive - प्रगतिशील (Advocating social reform or new ideas)
repeated - दोहराया हुआ (Occurring again or frequently)
moving - गतिशील / भावुक (Changing position or causing emotion)
conservative - रूढ़िवादी (Holding traditional values; cautious of change)
aristocratic - कुलीन (Relating to the highest social class)
Hence, 'conservative' is the most suitable antonym for 'Progressive'.
oa:
This term describes something that occurs again or frequently. It focuses on the frequency of an event rather than the social or political ideology of moving forward with new ideas.
Synonyms: Recurrent (पुनरावर्ती), Frequent (बार-बार), Constant (निरंतर).
Antonyms: Unique (अनोखा), Single (एकमात्र), Sporadic (छिटपुट).

This word can refer to the act of changing position or causing strong emotions. It focus on physical motion or feeling, which is unrelated to the implementation of reform and liberal ideas.
Synonyms: Dynamic (गतिशील), Touching (मर्मस्पर्शी), Shifting (हिलता हुआ).
Antonyms: Static (स्थिर), Motionless (गतिहीन), Unemotional (भावनाहीन).

This word describes someone holding traditional attitudes and values and being cautious about change or innovation. it is the correct opposite of progressive, which favors social reform.
Synonyms: Traditional (रूढ़िवादी), Orthdox (परंपरावादी), Conventional (पारंपरिक).
Antonyms: Progressive (प्रगतिशील), Radical (चरमपंथी), Liberal (उदार).

This term refers to something characteristic of the highest class in a society, often due to birth. It focus on social class and rank rather than on a person's willingness to accept new ideas.
Synonyms: Noble (कुलीन), Elite (विशिष्ट), Patrician (अभिजात).
Antonyms: Common (साधारण), Plebeian (सामान्य), Humble (विनीत).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Ascent
questionsEn.s:
Ascent - चढ़ाव (An upward slope or path; a climb)
depression - गर्त / अवसाद (A low area or feeling of severe sadness)
descent - उतार / ढलान (Act of moving downwards or falling)
decent - सभ्य / उचित (Conforming with moral standards)
distant - दूर (Far away in space or time)
Hence, 'descent' is the most suitable antonym for 'Ascent'.
oa:
This word refers to a state of being extremely sad or a low area on a surface. While it can describe a downward dip, its primary meaning is emotional, making it less precise than a direction word.
Synonyms: Gloom (उदासी), Hollow (गर्त), Slump (गिरावट).
Antonyms: Elation (उल्लास), Elevation (ऊंचाई), Prosperity (समृद्धि).

This term refers to an act of moving downward, dropping, or falling from a higher position. it is the direct physical and literal opposite of ascent, which means an upward slope or climb.
Synonyms: Drop (गिरावट), Fall (पतन), Decline (उतार).
Antonyms: Ascent (चढ़ाव), Rise (बढ़त), Elevation (ऊंचाई).

This word describes something that conforms to generally accepted standards of moral behavior or is of a satisfactory standard. It is a near-homophone of the target word but unrelated in meaning.
Synonyms: Proper (उचित), Respectable (सभ्य), Adequate (पर्याप्त).
Antonyms: Indecent (अशिष्ट), Improper (अनुचित), Poor (खराब).

This term refers to something that is far away in space or time. It describes the magnitude of separation between two points rather than the direction of a path or slope.
Synonyms: Far (दूर), Remote (दूरवर्ती), Isolated (पृथक).
Antonyms: Near (निकट), Close (पास), Adjacent (बगल में).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Foreign
questionsEn.s:
Foreign - विदेशी (From a country other than one's own)
Native - स्वदेशी / मूल निवासी (Born in a specific place or associated with it)
Indian - भारतीय (Relating to India or its people)
Rural - ग्रामीण (Relating to the countryside)
Rustic - देहाती (Simple and unsophisticated; relating to country)
Hence, 'Native' is the most suitable antonym for 'Foreign'.
oa:
This word refers to a person born in a specific place or something associated with one's place of birth. It is the direct opposite of foreign, which describes something from another country.
Synonyms: Indigenous (स्वदेशी), Local (स्थानीय), Domestic (घरेलू).
Antonyms: Foreign (विदेशी), Alien (पराया), Exotic (विदेशी).

This word specifically refers to anything relating to India or its people. While it represents a specific type of native origin for some, it is too specific to be a general antonym for the global term "foreign."
Synonyms: Desi (स्वदेशी), Bharat-related (भारतीय), Asian (एशियाई).
Antonyms: Non-Indian (गैर-भारतीय), Western (पश्चिमी), Global (वैश्विक).

This term describes anything relating to the countryside rather than the town. It focuses on the type of environment (country vs city) rather than the country of origin.
Synonyms: Rustic (देहाती), Country (ग्रामीण), Pastoral (देहाती).
Antonyms: Urban (शहरी), Metropolitan (महानगरीय), City (शहर का).

This word characterizes anything relating to the countryside or people who are simple and unsophisticated. It is a synonym for rural and therefore does not provide an opposite for foreign.
Synonyms: Plain (सादा), Rural (देहाती), Coarse (भद्दा).
Antonyms: Urban (शहरी), Sophisticated (दुनियादार), Refined (परिष्कृत).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Pardon
questionsEn.s:
Pardon - क्षमा करना (To release an offender from consequences)
Kindness - दया / दयालुता (Quality of being friendly and generous)
Grace - कृपा / शालीनता (Courteous goodwill or elegance)
Mercy - दया (Compassion shown to someone who could be punished)
Punish - दंड देना (To inflict a penalty for an offense)
Hence, 'Punish' is the most suitable antonym for 'Pardon'.
oa:
This term refers to the quality of being friendly, generous, and considerate. While kindness often leads to a pardon, the word itself is an abstract trait rather than an opposite action.
Synonyms: Compassion (दया), Benevolence (परोपकार), Gentleness (सौम्यता).
Antonyms: Cruelty (क्रूरता), Meanness (कंजूसी), Harshness (कठोरता).

This word means courteous goodwill or an elegantly polite manner. It describes the style of a person's behavior rather than acting as a functional contrast to releasing an offender.
Synonyms: Elegance (सुंदरता), Goodwill (सद्भावना), Favour (कृपा).
Antonyms: Inelegance (भद्दापन), Disfavour (अकृपा), Rudeness (अशिष्टता).

This term refers to compassion or forgiveness shown toward someone who could be punished. It is a direct synonym for the spirit of a pardon and therefore is not its antonym.
Synonyms: Forgiveness (क्षमा), Clemency (दया), Pity (तरस).
Antonyms: Revenge (प्रतिशोध), Cruelty (क्रूरता), Severity (कठोरता).

This verb means to inflict a penalty on someone as retribution for an offense. It is the direct functional opposite of pardon, which involve releasing someone from legal consequences.
Synonyms: Penalize (दंडित करना), Discipline (अनुशासित करना), Castigate (फटकारना).
Antonyms: Pardon (क्षमा करना), Reward (पुरस्कृत करना), Forgive (माफ करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Exceptional
questionsEn.s:
Exceptional - असाधारण (Unusual; not typical or outstanding)
Uncommon - असामान्य (Out of the ordinary; unusual)
Unthinkable - अकल्पनीय (Too unlikely to be considered)
Unremarkable - साधारण (Not interesting or surprising; ordinary)
Unimaginable - अकल्पनीय (Impossible to imagine or comprehend)
Hence, 'Unremarkable' is the most suitable antonym for 'Exceptional'.
oa:
This term describes something that is out of the ordinary or unusual. It is a direct synonym for the core meaning of exceptional and therefore cannot be used as its opposite.
Synonyms: Rare (दुर्लभ), Unusual (असामान्य), Extraordinary (असाधारण).
Antonyms: Common (आम), Usual (सामान्य), Frequent (बार-बार).

This word refers to an idea so unlikely or undesirable that it cannot be considered a possibility. It focus on being beyond imagination rather than on being ordinary or typical.
Synonyms: Implausible (अकल्पनीय), Incredible (अविश्वसनीय), Absurd (बेतुका).
Antonyms: Plausible (मुमकिन), Likely (संभावित), Possible (संभव).

This word describes something that is not particularly interesting or surprising; it is very ordinary. It is the direct opposite of exceptional, which means unusual or outstanding.
Synonyms: Ordinary (साधारण), Average (सामान्य), Commonplace (मामूली).
Antonyms: Exceptional (असाधारण), Remarkable (उल्लेखनीय), Noteworthy (ध्यान देने योग्य).

This term refers to something that is difficult or impossible to imagine or comprehend. It acts as a synonym for the "extraordinary" aspect of exceptional rather than an antonym.
Synonyms: Inconceivable (अकल्पनीय), Incredible (अविश्वसनीय), Beyond words (अवर्णनीय).
Antonyms: Simple (सरल), Predictable (पूर्वानुमेय), Ordinary (साधारण).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Meagre
questionsEn.s:
Meagre - अल्प / बहुत कम (Lacking in quantity or quality)
Inadequate - अपर्याप्त (Not enough for a purpose)
Premium - किश्त / उत्कृष्ट (Amount paid for insurance or superior quality)
Plentiful - भरपूर (Existing in large quantities)
Scanty - थोड़ा (Small or insufficient in amount)
Hence, 'Plentiful' is the most suitable antonym for 'Meagre'.
oa:
This word describes something that is not enough or not good enough for a specific purpose. It is a direct synonym for meagre and therefore fails to provide an opposite.
Synonyms: Insufficient (अपर्याप्त), Scanty (अल्प), Deficient (कमी).
Antonyms: Sufficient (पर्याप्त), Adequate (संतोषजनक), Ample (भरपूर).

This term refers to an amount paid for insurance or something of superior quality. It focuses on cost or high status and has no direct relationship with the quantity implied by meagre.
Synonyms: Superior (बेहतर), Prime (मुख्य), Fee (शुल्क).
Antonyms: Inferior (घटिया), Standard (मानक), Cheap (सस्ता).

This word refers to something existing in large quantities; it means having more than enough. It is the direct opposite of meagre, which refers to being very small in amount.
Synonyms: Abundant (प्रचुर), Ample (भरपूर), Copious (बड़ी मात्रा में).
Antonyms: Meagre (अल्प), Scanty (थोड़ा), Scarce (दुर्लभ).

This term describes an amount that is very small or insufficient. Since it mirrors the exact idea of having too little, it serves as a synonym rather than an antonym.
Synonyms: Meagre (अल्प), Sparse (विरल), Limited (सीमित).
Antonyms: Abundant (प्रचुर), Profuse (अत्यधिक), Lavish (अतिव्ययी).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Arrogance
questionsEn.s:
Arrogance - अहंकार (Unpleasant pride or self-importance)
Conceit - घमंड (Excessive pride in oneself)
Superiority - श्रेष्ठता (State of being better than others)
Vanity - घमंड (Inflated pride in appearance or self)
Humility - विनम्रता (Quality of not being proud or arrogant)
Hence, 'Humility' is the most suitable antonym for 'Arrogance'.
oa:
This term refers to excessive pride in oneself or one's appearance. It is a direct synonym for arrogance and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an opposite.
Synonyms: Vanity (घमंड), Pride (अभिमान), Hubris (अहंकार).
Antonyms: Humility (विनम्रता), Modesty (नम्रता), Meekness (दब्बूपन).

This word describes the state of being higher in rank, status, or quality. Since arrogant people often feel this way, it acts as a synonym in terms of perceived self-importance.
Synonyms: Supremacy (श्रेष्ठता), Precedence (प्रमुखता), Mastery (महारत).
Antonyms: Inferiority (हीनता), Subordination (अधीनता), Equality (समानता).
