This term refers to an inflated pride in oneself or one's appearance. Like the target word, it describes a negative focus on self-importance, making it a synonym.
Synonyms: Egotism (अहंकार), Conceit (घमंड), Narcissism (आत्ममुग्धता).
Antonyms: Humility (विनम्रता), Diffidence (संकोच), Self-effacement (विनम्र व्यवहार).

This word refers to the quality of being humble and not having an inflated sense of self-importance. it is the perfect antonym for arrogance.
Synonyms: Modesty (नम्रता), Meekness (विनम्रता), Lowliness (दीनता).
Antonyms: Arrogance (अहंकार), Pride (गर्व), Vanity (घमंड).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Transient
questionsEn.s:
Transient - क्षणिक (Temporary or lasting for a short time)
celestial - स्वर्गीय (Belonging to heaven or the sky)
permanent - स्थायी (Lasting for a long time or forever)
temporal - सांसारिक / सामयिक (Relating to time or worldly affairs)
stationary - स्थिर (Not moving or intended to be moved)
Hence, 'permanent' is the most suitable antonym for 'Transient'.
oa:
This word refers to things belonging to the sky or heaven. It focus on the location or nature of an object (heavenly vs earthly) rather than on how long it lasts.
Synonyms: Heavenly (स्वर्गीय), Stellar (तारकीय), Astral (आकाशीय).
Antonyms: Terrestrial (स्थलीय), Earthly (सांसारिक), Mundane (लौकिक).

This word refers to something that is intended to last or remain unchanged indefinitely. It serves as the direct opposite of transient, which means lasting for only a short time.
Synonyms: Lasting (स्थायी), Eternal (शाश्वत), Durable (टिकाऊ).
Antonyms: Transient (क्षणिक), Fleeting (अल्पकालिक), Temporary (अस्थायी).

This term refers to things relating to time or worldly affairs as opposed to spiritual ones. While it involves time, it describes a limited worldly state, often acting as a synonym for transient.
Synonyms: Secular (सांसारिक), Worldly (लौकिक), Earthly (सांसारिक).
Antonyms: Eternal (अनंत), Spiritual (आध्यात्मिक), Timeless (कालातीत).

This word refers to not moving or not intended to be moved. It focus on physical position and motionlessness rather than on the duration of time something exists.
Synonyms: Static (स्थिर), Immobile (अचल), Fixed (नियत).
Antonyms: Shifting (हिलता हुआ), Moving (गतिशील), Mobile (चलायमान).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Liberty
questionsEn.s:
Liberty - स्वतंत्रता (The state of being free within society)
slavery - गुलामी (Condition of being owned by another)
freedom - आजादी (Power to act or speak without restraint)
autonomy - स्वायत्तता (Quality of being self-governing)
reservation - संशय / आरक्षण (Booking or state of having doubts)
Hence, 'slavery' is the most suitable antonym for 'Liberty'.
oa:
This word refers to the condition in which one person is owned by another and lacks all freedom. It is the direct opposite of liberty, which is the state of being free.
Synonyms: Bondage (दास्ता), Servitude (गुलामी), Enslavement (गुलामी).
Antonyms: Liberty (स्वतंत्रता), Freedom (आजादी), Autonomy (स्वायत्तता).

This term refers to the power or right to act, speak, or think as one wants without restraint. It is a direct synonym for liberty and therefore cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Independence (स्वतंत्रता), Liberty (मुक्ति), Release (आजादी).
Antonyms: Captivity (कैद), Restriction (प्रतिबंध), Slavery (गुलामी).

This word describes the quality or state of being self-governing or having independence. Since it involves having freedom of choice, it acts as a synonym for liberty.
Synonyms: Self-rule (स्व-शासन), Sovereignty (संप्रभुता), Independence (स्वायत्तता).
Antonyms: Dependence (निर्भरता), Subjection (अधीनता), Tyranny (तानाशाही).

This term refers to an arrangement to keep something for later use or having doubts about an idea. It describes an administrative act or a mental doubt, which is unrelated to being free.
Synonyms: Booking (बुकिंग), Doubt (संशय), Restriction (प्रतिबंध).
Antonyms: Cancellation (रद्दीकरण), Openness (खुलापन), Certainty (निश्चितता).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Extravagant
questionsEn.s:
Extravagant - फिजूलखर्च (Lacking restraint in spending money)
pauper - कंगाल (A very poor person)
deficit - घाटा (Amount by which something is too small)
thrifty - मितव्ययी (Using money carefully and not wastefully)
generous - उदार (Willing to give money or help freely)
Hence, 'thrifty' is the most suitable antonym for 'Extravagant'.
oa:
This noun refers to a very poor person who relies on charity. While a pauper might have no choice but to spend less, the word describes a person's financial class rather than a spending habit.
Synonyms: Beggar (भिखारी), Mendicant (कंगाल), Indigent (दरिद्र).
Antonyms: Millionaire (लखपति), Rich man (अमीर), Wealthy person (धनी).

This term refers to the amount by which something (like money) is too small; it means a shortage. It describes a numerical balance rather than the personality trait of being wasteful.
Synonyms: Shortfall (कमी), Shortage (अभाव), Dearth (अकाल).
Antonyms: Surplus (अधिशेष), Abundance (प्रचुरता), Profit (लाभ).

This word describes a person who uses money and resources carefully and not wastefully. It is the direct opposite of extravagant, which means lacking restraint in spending.
Synonyms: Frugal (मितव्ययी), Economical (किफायती), Sparing (कम खर्च करने वाला).
Antonyms: Extravagant (फिजूलखर्च), Profligate (अपव्ययी), Prodigal (खर्चीला).

This term refers to a willingness to give money or help freely. While it involves spending, it focus on the kindness of the act rather than the wastefulness or care in handling resources.
Synonyms: Benevolent (उदार), Charitable (दानी), Munificent (महामना).
Antonyms: Greedy (लालची), Stingy (कंजूस), Mean (मतलबी).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Vigilant
questionsEn.s:
Vigilant - सावधान / चौकस (Keeping a careful watch for danger)
visible - दृश्यमान (Able to be seen)
elusive - हाथ न आने वाला (Difficult to find or achieve)
careless - लापरवाह (Not giving sufficient attention or thought)
careful - सतर्क (Thinking about actions to avoid mistakes)
Hence, 'careless' is the most suitable antonym for 'Vigilant'.
oa:
This word describes something that is able to be seen. It focuses on the visual clarity of an object rather than on the state of being watchful or careful for danger.
Synonyms: Discernible (प्रत्यक्ष), Apparent (स्पष्ट), Observable (दिखने योग्य).
Antonyms: Invisible (अदृश्य), Hidden (छिपा हुआ), Obscure (धुंधला).

This term refers to something or someone that is difficult to find, catch, or achieve. It focus on the difficulty of reaching a goal rather than on the level of attention a person provides.
Synonyms: Evasive (पकड़ में न आने वाला), Subtle (सूक्ष्म), Slippery (धूर्त).
Antonyms: Accessible (सुलभ), Clear (स्पष्ट), Obvious (जाहिर).

This word characterizes a person who does not give sufficient attention or thought to avoid harm or errors. It is the direct opposite of being vigilant, which involves keeping a careful watch.
Synonyms: Negligent (बेपरवाह), Heedless (असावधान), Inattentive (असावधान).
Antonyms: Vigilant (सावधान), Careful (सतर्क), Watchful (चौकस).

This term describes a person who thinks about what they are doing to avoid accidents or mistakes. It is a direct synonym for vigilant and therefore cannot be used as its opposite.
Synonyms: Watchful (सावधान), Wary (सतर्क), Cautious (चौकस).
Antonyms: Careless (लापरवाह), Reckless (बेपरवाह), Heedless (असावधान).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Humane
questionsEn.s:
Humane - मानवीय / दयालु (Compassionate and kind toward others)
Sympathetic - सहानुभूतिपूर्ण (Feeling or showing compassion)
Cruel - क्रूर (Willfully causing pain or suffering to others)
Living - जीवित (The state of being alive)
Kind - दयालु (Friendly, generous, and considerate)
Hence, 'Cruel' is the most suitable antonym for 'Humane'.
oa:
This word describes someone who feels or shows compassion and understanding for others. It is a direct synonym for the kind nature of a humane person.
Synonyms: Compassionate (सहानुभूतिपूर्ण), Kind (दयालु), Caring (दयालु).
Antonyms: Indifferent (उदासीन), Callous (कठोर), Unfeeling (निर्दयी).

This word refers to someone who willfully causes pain or suffering to others and feels no concern about it. It is the perfect antonym for being humane, which implies kindness and compassion.
Synonyms: Brutal (क्रूर), Pitiless (निर्दयी), Ruthless (बेरहम).
Antonyms: Humane (मानवीय), Kind (दयालु), Compassionate (सहानुभूतिपूर्ण).

This term refers to the state of being alive or the pursuit of a particular lifestyle. It describes a biological or social state and has no connection with kindness or cruelty.
Synonyms: Alive (जीवित), Breathing (जीवित), Active (सक्रिय).
Antonyms: Dead (मृत), Deceased (स्वर्गवासी), Lifeless (निर्जीव).

This term characterizes a person who is friendly, generous, and considerate. Since it mirrors the benevolent quality of being humane, it functions as a synonym.
Synonyms: Benevolent (परोपकारी), Gracious (सुशील), Helpful (सहायक).
Antonyms: Mean (मतलबी), Hostile (शत्रुतापूर्ण), Cruel (क्रूर).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Extol
questionsEn.s:
Extol - गुणगान करना (To praise enthusiastically)
Censure - निंदा करना (To express severe disapproval)
Realistic - व्यावहारिक (Having a sensible and practical idea)
Exposure - असुरक्षा / प्रकटीकरण (State of being unprotected or revealed)
Boorish - गँवार (Rough and bad-mannered)
Hence, 'Censure' is the most suitable antonym for 'Extol'.
oa:
This word means to express severe disapproval of someone or something, often in a formal way. it is the correct opposite of extol, which means to praise enthusiastically.
Synonyms: Condemn (निंदा करना), Criticize (आलोचना करना), Reprimand (फटकारना).
Antonyms: Extol (बखान करना), Praise (प्रशंसा करना), Commend (सराहना करना).

This term describes having or showing a sensible and practical idea of what can be achieved. It focuses on practical logic rather than on the act of praising or criticizing someone.
Synonyms: Pragmatic (व्यावहारिक), Practical (वास्तविक), Grounded (स्थिर).
Antonyms: Idealistic (आदर्शवादी), Unrealistic (अवास्तविक), Fanciful (काल्पनिक).

This noun refers to the state of having no protection from something harmful or the act of revealing something. It focus on vulnerability or revelation, which is unrelated to praise.
Synonyms: Revelation (प्रकटीकरण), Vulnerability (असुरक्षा), Publicity (प्रसार).
Antonyms: Concealment (छिपाव), Protection (सुरक्षा), Hiding (छिपाना).

This term characterizes someone who is rough and bad-mannered; it refers to being coarse. It describes a person's behavior but does not provide a direct antonym for the act of extolling.
Synonyms: Rude (अशिष्ट), Coarse (भद्दा), Ill-mannered (गंवार).
Antonyms: Refined (परिष्कृत), Polite (शिष्ट), Urbane (सभ्य).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Persist
questionsEn.s:
Persist - बने रहना (To continue firmly despite difficulty)
Insist - जोर देना (To demand something forcefully)
Remain - ठहरना (To stay back or stay in place)
Cease - बंद होना (To bring or come to an end)
Continue - जारी रहना (To keep going or go on)
Hence, 'Cease' is the most suitable antonym for 'Persist'.
oa:
This verb means to demand something forcefully and not accept refusal. While it involves staying firm on a point, it is a synonym for the determined nature of persisting.
Synonyms: Demand (माँग करना), Assert (दावा करना), Maintain (बनाए रखना).
Antonyms: Relinquish (त्यागना), Give in (हार मान लेना), Abandon (छोड़ देना).

This term means to stay in a particular place or condition. Since it describes the continuation of a state, it functions as a synonym for persisting rather than an opposite.
Synonyms: Stay (बने रहना), Endure (बना रहना), Continue (जारी रहना).
Antonyms: Leave (छोड़ना), Depart (चले जाना), Vanish (गायब होना).

This word means to bring an activity or process to a complete end. It is the direct opposite of persist, which involves continuing firmly in an action despite obstacles.
Synonyms: Stop (रुकना), Terminate (समाप्त करना), Discontinue (बंद करना).
Antonyms: Persist (बने रहना), Continue (जारी रखना), Resume (पुनः आरंभ करना).

This term means to keep happening or existing without stopping. It is a direct synonym for the act of persisting and cannot be used as its antonym.
Synonyms: Proceed (आगे बढ़ना), Persist (जारी रखना), Perpetuate (बनाए रखना).
Antonyms: Stop (रुकना), Halt (ठहरना), End (समाप्त करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Glee
questionsEn.s:
Glee - खुशी / आनंद (Great delight or joy)
Woe - शोक / संताप (Great sorrow or distress)
Bliss - परम सुख (Perfect happiness or joy)
Joy - हर्ष (Feeling of great pleasure)
Fun - मज़ा (Enjoyment or lighthearted pleasure)
Hence, 'Woe' is the most suitable antonym for 'Glee'.
oa:
This term refers to great sorrow, distress, or misery. It serves as the direct opposite of glee, which characterizes a state of great delight and happiness.
Synonyms: Sorrow (दुःख), Misery (कष्ट), Anguish (व्यथा).
Antonyms: Joy (हर्ष), Glee (खुशी), Bliss (परमानंद).

This word refers to a state of perfect happiness or great joy. It is a synonym for glee and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an opposite.
Synonyms: Felicity (परम सुख), Joy (हर्ष), Rapture (उल्लास).
Antonyms: Suffering (कष्ट), Agony (पीड़ा), Woe (शोक).

This term refers to a feeling of great pleasure and happiness. Since it mirrors the delightful nature of glee, it functions as a strong synonym.
Synonyms: Delight (प्रसन्नता), Happiness (खुशी), Mirth (आमोद-प्रमोद).
Antonyms: Sadness (उदासी), Sorrow (दुःख), Misery (कष्ट).

This word describes enjoyment, amusement, or lighthearted pleasure. It is a synonym for the entertaining aspect of glee and cannot be used as its antonym.
Synonyms: Amusement (मनोरंजन), Merriment (आनंद), Play (मस्ती).
Antonyms: Boredom (ऊब), Drudgery (कठिन परिश्रम), Tedium (उबाऊपन).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Grotesque
questionsEn.s:
Grotesque - भद्दा (Comically or repulsively ugly or distorted)
Monstrous - राक्षसी (Ugly or frightening like a monster)
Ugly - कुरूप (Unpleasant or repulsive in appearance)
Attractive - आकर्षक (Pleasing or appealing to the senses)
Distorted - विकृत (Pulled or twisted out of shape)
Hence, 'Attractive' is the most suitable antonym for 'Grotesque'.
oa:
This term describes something extremely large, ugly, or horrifying. It is a direct synonym for the repulsively ugly aspect of grotesque and is not an opposite.
Synonyms: Hideous (भयानक), Horrific (डरावना), Giant (विशालकाय).
Antonyms: Beautiful (सुंदर), Small (छोटा), Gentle (कोमल).

This word refers to being unpleasant or repulsive in appearance. Since it captures the core meaning of grotesque, it serves as a synonym rather than an antonym.
Synonyms: Unattractive (अनाकर्षक), Unpleasant (भद्दा), Hideous (कुरूप).
Antonyms: Pretty (सुंदर), Handsome (हसीन), Attractive (मोहक).

This word refers to being pleasing or appealing to the senses; it means having qualities that arouse interest. It is the perfect opposite of grotesque.
Synonyms: Beautiful (सुंदर), Pleasing (मनभावन), Charming (आकर्षक).
Antonyms: Grotesque (भद्दा), Repulsive (घृणित), Ugly (बदसूरत).

This term describes something that is pulled or twisted out of its original shape; it is contorted. It mirrors the misshapen nature of grotesque, acting as a synonym.
Synonyms: Deformed (विकृत), Twisted (मुड़ा हुआ), Warped (टेढ़ा-मेढ़ा).
Antonyms: Straight (सीधा), Original (असली), Perfect (पूर्ण).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Stringent
questionsEn.s:
Stringent - कठोर / सख्त (Strict, precise, and exacting)
Strict - सख्त (Demanding obedience to rules)
Stern - कठोर (Serious and unrelenting)
Lenient - नरम / उदार (More merciful or tolerant than expected)
Severe - गंभीर (Very great or intense; harsh)
Hence, 'Lenient' is the most suitable antonym for 'Stringent'.
oa:
This word refers to demanding that rules or behaviors be strictly obeyed and observed. It is a direct synonym for stringent and therefore fails as an opposite.
Synonyms: Rigid (कठोर), Rigorous (सख्त), Firm (दृढ़).
Antonyms: Flexible (लचीला), Lenient (नरम), Lax (ढीला).

This term characterizes a person or their manner as serious and unrelenting. It mirrors the severe and uncompromising nature of being stringent, acting as a synonym.
Synonyms: Severe (गंभीर), Hard (कठोर), Uncompromising (अटल).
Antonyms: Soft (कोमल), Friendly (मित्रवत), Kind (दयालु).

This word describes a punishment or a person in authority who is more merciful or tolerant than expected. It is the direct opposite of stringent, which implies being strict and precise.
Synonyms: Tolerant (सहनशील), Merciful (दयावान), Sparing (नरम).
Antonyms: Stringent (कठोर), Strict (सख्त), Harsh (कठोर).

This term refers to something that is very great, strong, or intense, particularly in a negative context. It is a synonym for the harsh quality of stringent rules.
Synonyms: Harsh (कठोर), Intense (तीव्र), Extreme (अत्यधिक).
Antonyms: Mild (हल्का), Gentle (कोमल), Moderate (मध्यम).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Persuade
questionsEn.s:
Persuade - राजी करना (To convince through reasoning or argument)
Induce - प्रेरित करना (To succeed in leading someone to act)
Pervade - व्याप्त होना (To spread through every part)
Dissuade - मना करना (To persuade someone not to do something)
Impress - प्रभावित करना (To make someone feel admiration)
Hence, 'Dissuade' is the most suitable antonym for 'Persuade'.
oa:
This verb means to succeed in leading or persuading someone to do something. It is a direct synonym for the target word and does not work as an antonym.
Synonyms: Motivate (प्रेरित करना), Prompt (उकसाना), Convince (मनाना).
Antonyms: Prevent (रोकना), Dissuade (मना करना), Hinder (बाधा डालना).

This term means to spread through and be perceived in every part of something. It focus on the movement of a substance or feeling rather than the act of convincing someone.
Synonyms: Permeate (व्याप्त होना), Infuse (भर देना), Penetrate (घुसना).
Antonyms: Deplete (कम करना), Exit (निकलना), Drain (निकालना).

This word means to persuade someone not to take a particular course of action. it is the exact opposite of persuade, which involves convincing someone to do something.
Synonyms: Discourage (निरुत्साहित करना), Deter (रोकना), Divert (मोड़ना).
Antonyms: Persuade (मनाना), Convince (आश्वस्त करना), Urge (जोर देना).

This verb means to make someone feel admiration and respect. While a positive interaction, it focuses on the emotional impact on someone rather than the specific act of convincing them to act.
Synonyms: Affect (प्रभावित करना), Influence (प्रभाव डालना), Dazzle (चकाचौंध करना).
Antonyms: Disappoint (निराश करना), Disgust (घृणा पैदा करना), Repel (विकर्षित करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Rear
questionsEn.s:
Rear - पिछला भाग (The back part of something)
Back - पीछे (The rear surface or part)
Hind - पिछला (Relating to the back part)
Lower - निचला (Less high in position or rank)
Front - सामने (The side that presents the main view)
Hence, 'Front' is the most suitable antonym for 'Rear'.
oa:
This word refers to the rear surface of a structure or the part furthest from the front. It is a direct synonym for rear and therefore fails to provide an opposite.
Synonyms: Posterior (पिछला), Rear (पिछवाड़ा), Reverse (उल्टा).
Antonyms: Front (सामने), Anterior (अग्र), Lead (प्रमुख).

This term refers to the back part of an animal or object. Like the target word, it describes the posterior position, making it a synonym instead of an antonym.
Synonyms: Back (पिछला), Posterior (पिछला), Tail (पूँछ वाला).
Antonyms: Fore (अगला), Front (सामने), Head (अगला भाग).

This word refers to a position that is less high or further down. It focus on vertical depth or rank rather than the horizontal distinction between front and back.
Synonyms: Bottom (नीचे), Under (नीचे का), Base (निचला).
Antonyms: Upper (ऊपरी), Higher (ऊँचा), Top (शीर्ष).

This term refers to the side or part of an object that presents itself to view or is facing forward. It is the direct spatial opposite of the rear or back part.
Synonyms: Anterior (अग्र), Face (सामने का भाग), Forefront (अग्रिम).
Antonyms: Rear (पिछला), Back (पीछे), Posterior (पिछला).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Bizarre
questionsEn.s:
Bizarre - अजीब / विचित्र (Very strange or unusual)
Strange - विचित्र (Unusual or surprising)
Usual - सामान्य (Habitually or typically occurring)
Happy - खुश (Feeling pleasure or contentment)
Weird - अजीब (Supernatural or very unusual)
Hence, 'Usual' is the most suitable antonym for 'Bizarre'.
oa:
This word refers to things that are unusual or surprising and difficult to understand. It is a direct synonym for bizarre and therefore cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Weird (अजीब), Peculiar (अनोखा), Odd (विचित्र).
Antonyms: Normal (सामान्य), Regular (नियमित), Usual (साधारण).

This word refers to things that are habitually or typically occurring; it means common or ordinary. It is the direct opposite of bizarre, which describes very strange things.
Synonyms: Common (साधारण), Ordinary (सामान्य), Customary (प्रचलित).
Antonyms: Bizarre (अजीब), Rare (दुर्लभ), Strange (विचित्र).

This term describes a feeling of pleasure or contentment. It focuses on human emotion rather than the level of normality or strangeness in a situation.
Synonyms: Joyful (हर्षित), Cheerful (प्रसन्न), Content (संतुष्ट).
Antonyms: Sad (उदास), Miserable (दुखी), Gloomy (खिन्न).

This term describes things suggesting something supernatural or very unusual. Since it mirrors the exact meaning of bizarre, it acts as a synonym instead of an antonym.
Synonyms: Eerie (डरावना), Unusual (असामान्य), Bizarre (अजीब).
Antonyms: Normal (सामान्य), Usual (साधारण), Plain (सादा).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Allure
questionsEn.s:
Allure - लुभाना / आकर्षित करना (Powerfully attract or charm)
Repulse - घृणा पैदा करना (To cause intense distaste or aversion)
Attract - आकर्षित करना (To cause to come near or have interest)
Rewind - पीछे ले जाना (To go back to an earlier time)
Revive - पुनर्जीवित करना (To restore to life or activity)
Hence, 'Repulse' is the most suitable antonym for 'Allure'.
oa:
This word means to cause someone to feel intense distaste or aversion. It serves as the perfect antonym for allure, which involves powerfully attracting or charming someone.
Synonyms: Repel (विकर्षित करना), Disgust (घृणा पैदा करना), Rebuff (अस्वीकार करना).
Antonyms: Allure (आकर्षित करना), Attract (लुभाना), Charm (मोहना).

This verb means to cause someone to come to a place or have an interest by offering an advantage. It is a direct synonym for allure and therefore is not an opposite.
Synonyms: Allure (लुभाना), Entice (आकर्षित करना), Tempt (ललचाना).
Antonyms: Repulse (दूर भगाना), Repel (पीछे धकेलना), Deter (रोकना).

This term means to move back to an earlier time or to make a recording go back. It focus on time and physical sequence, which has no connection with attraction.
Synonyms: Reverse (पीछे करना), Backtrack (वापस जाना), Return (वापस मुड़ना).
Antonyms: Fast-forward (आगे बढ़ाना), Advance (आगे बढ़ना), Proceed (आगे बढ़ना).

This verb means to restore someone to life or consciousness, or to make something active again. It focus on renewal and recovery rather than on the pull of attraction.
Synonyms: Resuscitate (पुनर्जीवित करना), Restore (बहाल करना), Rejuvenate (नया करना).
Antonyms: Kill (मारना), Suppress (दबाना), Wither (मुरझाना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: FLEXIBLE
questionsEn.s:
FLEXIBLE - लचीला (Capable of bending easily without breaking)
Stiff - कठोर / सख्त (Firm and difficult to bend)
Soft - मुलायम (Easy to mold, cut, or compress)
Supple - लचीला (Flexible and bending easily)
Stale - बासी (No longer fresh and pleasant to eat)
Hence, 'Stiff' is the most suitable antonym for 'FLEXIBLE'.
oa:
This word refers to something that is firm and difficult to bend; it means rigid. It serves as the direct opposite of flexible, which describes things that bend easily without breaking.
Synonyms: Rigid (कठोर), Inflexible (अटल), Firm (मजबूत).
Antonyms: Flexible (लचीला), Supple (नम्य), Pliable (लचीला).

This term describes something that is easy to mold, cut, or compress. While flexible things are often soft, this word focuses on texture and hardness rather than the ability to bend.
Synonyms: Tender (कोमल), Mellow (मधुर), Yielding (मुलायम).
Antonyms: Hard (कठोर), Rough (खुरदरा), Tough (मजबूत).

This word characterizes something that is flexible and can bend or fold easily. It is a direct synonym for flexible and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an opposite.
Synonyms: Pliable (लचीला), Lithe (नम्य), Limber (लचीला).
Antonyms: Rigid (सख्त), Brittle (भंगुर), Stiff (कठोर).

This term describes food that is no longer fresh or an idea that is unoriginal. It focuses on freshness and quality, which has no direct connection with physical flexibility.
Synonyms: Old (पुराना), Dry (सूखा), Musty (बासी).
Antonyms: Fresh (ताज़ा), New (नया), Recent (हाल का).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Native
questionsEn.s:
Native - स्वदेशी / मूल निवासी (Associated with a place by birth)
Foreign - विदेशी (From a country other than one's own)
Rustic - देहाती (Relating to the countryside; simple)
Urban - शहरी (Relating to a town or city)
Rural - ग्रामीण (Relating to the countryside rather than town)
Hence, 'Foreign' is the most suitable antonym for 'Native'.
oa:
This word refers to anything that comes from a country or language other than one's own. It serves as the direct opposite of native, which relates to being born in a specific place.
Synonyms: Alien (विदेशी), Exotic (पराया), Overseas (विदेशी).
Antonyms: Native (स्वदेशी), Indigenous (मूल), Local (स्थानीय).

This term relates to the countryside; it means simple or unsophisticated. While it describes a type of origin, it focuses on rural nature rather than on a person's place of birth.
Synonyms: Rural (देहाती), Pastoral (ग्रामीण), Plain (सादा).
Antonyms: Urbane (सभ्य), Sophisticated (दुनियादार), City-like (शहरी).

This word refers to things characteristic of a town or city. It focus on the type of settlement (city vs country) rather than on whether someone is a born inhabitant.
Synonyms: Metropolitan (महानगरीय), Municipal (शहरी), Civic (नागरिक).
Antonyms: Rural (ग्रामीण), Rustic (देहाती), Country (देहाती).

This term describes anything relating to the countryside rather than the town. It focus on environmental location, making it unrelated to the concept of being a native or an outsider.
Synonyms: Country (देहाती), Rustic (ग्रामीण), Agricultural (कृषि संबंधी).
Antonyms: Urban (शहरी), Metropolitan (महानगरीय), Industrial (औद्योगिक).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: REPULSIVE
questionsEn.s:
REPULSIVE - घृणित / अरुचिकर (Arousing intense distaste or disgust)
Hideous - भयानक / भद्दा (Extremely ugly or unpleasant)
Revolting - घिनौना (Causing intense disgust)
Attractive - आकर्षक (Pleasing or appealing to the senses)
Brilliant - चमकदार / बुद्धिमान (Very bright or exceptionally clever)
Hence, 'Attractive' is the most suitable antonym for 'REPULSIVE'.
oa:
This word refers to something extremely ugly or unpleasant. It is a direct synonym for the unattractive nature of being repulsive and therefore cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Repugnant (घृणित), Ugly (बदसूरत), Revolting (घिनौना).
Antonyms: Beautiful (सुंदर), Attractive (आकर्षक), Lovely (प्यारा).

This term describes something causing intense disgust; it is nauseating. Since it mirrors the exact sense of the target word, it acts as a synonym instead of an antonym.
Synonyms: Distasteful (अप्रिय), Nauseous (घृणास्पद), Loathsome (घृणित).
Antonyms: Appetizing (रुचिकर), Pleasant (सुखद), Delightful (मनमोहक).

This term refers to having qualities that arouse interest or being pleasing to the senses. It serves as the correct opposite of repulsive, which causes a feeling of distaste.
Synonyms: Appealing (आकर्षक), Alluring (मोहक), Charming (मनोहर).
Antonyms: Repulsive (घृणित), Ugly (बदसूरत), Disgusting (घिनौना).

This word describes something very bright or exceptionally clever. While positive, it focuses on intensity of light or intellect rather than on the fundamental feeling of attraction or distaste.
Synonyms: Radiant (चमकदार), Intelligent (बुद्धिमान), Splendid (उत्कृष्ट).
Antonyms: Dull (मंद), Stupit (मूर्ख), Dim (धुंधला).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Exodus
questionsEn.s:
Exodus - प्रस्थान / निर्गमन (A mass departure of people)
Exit - निकास (The act of leaving or a way out)
Departure - रवानगी (The act of leaving a place)
Refund - धनवापसी (Sum of money paid back)
Arrival - आगमन (The coming of someone or something)
Hence, 'arrival' is the most suitable antonym for 'Exodus'.
oa:
This noun refers to a way out of a building or the act of leaving. It is a synonym for the "departure" aspect of an exodus and does not provide the required opposite.
Synonyms: Departure (प्रस्थान), Withdrawal (निकासी), Outflow (बहिर्वाह).
Antonyms: Entrance (प्रवेश), Arrival (आगमन), Entry (प्रवेश).

This term means the act of leaving a place, especially to start a journey. Since an exodus is defined as a mass departure, this word acts as its direct synonym.
Synonyms: Leaving (निकलना), Going (जाना), Retirement (वापसी).
Antonyms: Arrival (आगमन), Appearance (प्रकटीकरण), Stay (ठहरना).

This word refers to a sum of money paid back to someone who has been overcharged or is dissatisfied. It focus on financial repayment, which is unrelated to the movement of people.
Synonyms: Repayment (चुकौती), Reimbursement (प्रतिपूर्ति), Rebate (छूट).
Antonyms: Payment (भुगतान), Charge (शुल्क), Debt (कर्ज).

This word refers to the act of reaching a destination or coming to a place. it is the direct opposite of exodus, which involves a mass leaving or departure of people.
Synonyms: Entry (प्रवेश), Influx (आगमन), Appearance (उपस्थिति).
Antonyms: Exodus (प्रस्थान), Departure (रवानगी), Exit (निकास).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Quiescent
questionsEn.s:
Quiescent - शांत / सुप्त (In a state of inactivity or dormancy)
Active - सक्रिय (Willing to engage in pursuits; energetic)
Peaceful - शांतिपूर्ण (Free from disturbance)
Dejected - उदास (Sad and depressed)
Indifferent - उदासीन (Having no particular interest or concern)
Hence, 'active' is the most suitable antonym for 'Quiescent'.
oa:
This word characterizes a state of being in motion, energetic, or involved in activities. It serves as the perfect antonym for quiescent, which refers to being in a state of inactivity or dormancy.
Synonyms: Energetic (ऊर्जावान), Busy (व्यस्त), Dynamic (गतिशील).
Antonyms: Quiescent (शांत), Dormant (सुप्त), Inactive (निष्क्रिय).

This term describes a situation free from disturbance or war. While a quiescent state is often peaceful, the word focuses on tranquility rather than providing a contrast to inactivity.
Synonyms: Tranquil (शांत), Calm (स्थिर), Serene (निर्मल).
Antonyms: Stormy (तूफानी), Violent (उग्र), Disturbed (परेशान).

This word describes someone who is sad and depressed. It focuses on a negative emotional state rather than on the physical or metaphorical lack of activity or motion.
Synonyms: Glum (उदास), Melancholy (विषादपूर्ण), Downcast (खिन्न).
Antonyms: Happy (खुश), Elated (उल्लसित), Cheerful (प्रसन्न).

This term refers to a lack of interest, concern, or sympathy. It focus on a person's apathy rather than on the quiet, inactive nature of a thing or condition.
Synonyms: Apathetic (उदासीन), Unconcerned (बेपरवाह), Detached (पृथक).
Antonyms: Interested (इच्छुक), Passionate (भावुक), Caring (सहानुभूतिपूर्ण).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: BROAD
questionsEn.s:
BROAD - चौड़ा / विस्तृत (Having a large distance from side to side)
Narrow - तंग / संकीर्ण (Small width in relation to length)
Large - विशाल (Of considerable size or extent)
Wide - चौड़ा (Great distance from side to side; expansive)
Long - लंबा (Measuring great distance from end to end)
Hence, 'Narrow' is the most suitable antonym for 'BROAD'.
oa:
This word refers to a small width in relation to length or being limited in scope. It serves as the direct physical and conceptual opposite of the word broad.
Synonyms: Slender (पतला), Tight (संकीर्ण), Restricted (सीमित).
Antonyms: Broad (चौड़ा), Wide (विस्तृत), Large (विशाल).

This term describes something of considerable or relatively great size or extent. Since it aligns with the expansive nature of being broad, it functions as a synonym.
Synonyms: Big (बड़ा), Huge (विशाल), Massive (भारी).
Antonyms: Small (छोटा), Tiny (सूक्ष्म), Little (अल्प).

This term refers to having a large distance from side to side; it is expansive. It is a direct synonym for broad and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an opposite.
Synonyms: Extensive (व्यापक), Broad (चौड़ा), Spacious (विशाल).
Antonyms: Narrow (तंग), Confined (सीमित), Restricted (सीमित).

This word refers to measuring a great distance from end to end. It focus on length rather than the width (side-to-side distance) that broad and narrow describe.
Synonyms: Extended (लंबा), Lengthy (विस्तृत), Protracted (दीर्घ).
Antonyms: Short (छोटा), Brief (संक्षिप्त), Abbreviated (लघु).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: LIBERTY
questionsEn.s:
LIBERTY - स्वतंत्रता (State of being free from restrictions)
Dependence - निर्भरता (State of being controlled by another)
Convenience - सुविधा (Proceeding without difficulty; ease)
Deliverance - मुक्ति (Action of being rescued or set free)
Independence - आजादी (State of being independent; self-rule)
Hence, 'Dependence' is the most suitable antonym for 'LIBERTY'.
oa:
This term refers to the state of relying on or being controlled by someone else. It is the direct opposite of liberty, which involves the state of being free from oppressive restrictions.
Synonyms: Subjugation (अधीनता), Reliance (निर्भरता), Bondage (दास्ता).
Antonyms: Independence (स्वतंत्रता), Liberty (मुक्ति), Autonomy (स्वायत्तता).

This term refers to a state of being able to proceed with something without difficulty. It focus on ease of use rather than on the political or social freedom implied by liberty.
Synonyms: Ease (आराम), Advantage (लाभ), Suitability (उपयुक्तता).
Antonyms: Difficulty (कठिनाई), Obstacle (बाधा), Trouble (परेशानी).

This word refers to the action of being rescued or set free from something undesirable. Since it involves gaining freedom, it acts as a synonym for the result of liberty.
Synonyms: Rescue (बचाव), Liberation (मुक्ति), Release (रिहाई).
Antonyms: Captivity (कैद), Enslavement (गुलामी), Arrest (पकड़).

This term refers to the fact or state of being free from outside control; self-governance. It is a direct synonym for liberty and therefore cannot be its antonym.
Synonyms: Freedom (आजादी), Liberty (मुक्ति), Sovereignty (संप्रभुता).
Antonyms: Dependence (निर्भरता), Subjection (अधीनता), Slavery (दास्ता).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: HASTE
questionsEn.s:
HASTE - जल्दी / शीघ्रता (Excessive speed or urgency of movement)
Lose - खोना (To be deprived of or fail to win)
Rush - तेजी (To move with urgent speed)
Delay - विलंब / देरी (To make something late or slow)
Dash - झपट्टा (To run or travel in a great hurry)
Hence, 'Delay' is the most suitable antonym for 'HASTE'.
oa:
This verb means to be deprived of something or to fail to win. It focuses on the loss of possession or a contest, which has no connection with the speed of an action.
Synonyms: Misplace (खोना), Forfeit (गँवाना), Drop (गिराना).
Antonyms: Find (पाना), Win (जीतना), Gain (हासिल करना).

This word refers to moving or acting with urgent speed. It is a direct synonym for haste and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an opposite.
Synonyms: Hurry (जल्दी), Dash (तेजी), Speed (वेग).
Antonyms: Delay (विलंब), Linger (देर करना), Slowness (धीमापन).

This word means to make something late or to slow down a process. It is the direct opposite of haste, which refers to excessive speed or urgency of movement.
Synonyms: Postpone (टालना), Retard (धीमा करना), Lag (पिछड़ना).
Antonyms: Haste (जल्दी), Hurry (शीघ्रता), Rush (वेग).

This term refers to running or traveling somewhere in a great hurry. It acts as a synonym for the quick movement found in haste, making it an inappropriate antonym.
Synonyms: Sprint (तेज दौड़), Bolt (झपट्टा), Race (दौड़ना).
Antonyms: Crawl (रेंगना), Walk (टहलना), Stop (रुकना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: FICKLE
questionsEn.s:
FICKLE - चंचल / अस्थिर (Likely to change opinions suddenly)
Flighty - चंचल (Irresponsible or inconsistent)
Stable - स्थिर (Firmly fixed or not likely to change)
Subtle - सूक्ष्म / बारीक (Not obvious; delicate and precise)
Crafty - चालाक / धूर्त (Clever in a secretive or dishonest way)
Hence, 'Stable' is the most suitable antonym for 'FICKLE'.
oa:
This word describes someone who is irresponsible or not able to keep their attention on one thing for long. It is a synonym for the changeable nature of being fickle.
Synonyms: Capricious (मनमौजी), Unsteady (अस्थिर), Volatile (परिवर्तनशील).
Antonyms: Constant (स्थिर), Reliable (विश्वसनीय), Steady (नियमित).

This term refers to something that is firmly fixed and not likely to move or change suddenly. It is the correct opposite of fickle, which means changing opinions or feelings frequently.
Synonyms: Constant (स्थिर), Steady (नियमित), Reliable (भरोसेमंद).
Antonyms: Fickle (चंचल), Unstable (अस्थिर), Changeable (परिवर्तनशील).

This word describes something that is not loud, obvious, or noticeable; it is delicate. It focus on the refinement of a quality rather than on whether it is prone to sudden change.
Synonyms: Delicate (नाजुक), Elusive (जटिल), Fine (बारीक).
Antonyms: Obvious (स्पष्ट), Crude (अशिष्ट), Blatant (खुला).

This term characterizes someone who is clever, especially in a dishonest or secretive way. It focus on cunning behavior rather than the inconsistency implied by being fickle.
Synonyms: Cunning (चालाक), Sly (धूर्त), Wily (कपटी).
Antonyms: Honest (ईमानदार), Naive (भोला), Sincere (निष्कपट).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: HILARIOUS
questionsEn.s:
HILARIOUS - बहुत मजेदार (Extremely funny and happy)
Sad - दुखी (Feeling or showing unhappiness)
Blithe - निश्चिंत (Showing casual and cheerful indifference)
Happy - खुश (Feeling pleasure or contentment)
Merry - आनंदपूर्ण (Happy and excited)
Hence, 'Sad' is the most suitable antonym for 'HILARIOUS'.
oa:
This word describes a state of unhappiness or sorrow. It serves as the direct emotional opposite of hilarious, which characterizes something as being extremely funny and happy.
Synonyms: Unhappy (उदास), Gloomy (खिन्न), Sorrowful (दुखद).
Antonyms: Hilarious (मजेदार), Happy (खुश), Joyful (हर्षित).

This term describes someone who shows casual and cheerful indifference. While it involves happiness, it focus on being carefree, making it a near-synonym for the upbeat side of hilarity.
Synonyms: Carefree (निश्चिंत), Cheerful (हंसमुख), Unconcerned (बेपरवाह).
Antonyms: Worried (चिंतित), Anxious (चिंतित), Gloomy (उदास).

This term refers to a feeling of pleasure or contentment. Since it aligns with the positive and joyful nature of being hilarious, it functions as a synonym rather than an opposite.
Synonyms: Joyful (हर्षित), Cheerful (प्रसन्न), Glad (खुश).
Antonyms: Sad (दुखी), Miserable (कष्टदायक), Depressed (उदास).

This term describes a state of being happy and excited. Like hilarious, it refers to high-spirited enjoyment, which means it acts as a synonym instead of an antonym.
Synonyms: Jolly (खुशमिजाज), Festive (आनंदपूर्ण), Lively (जीवंत).
Antonyms: Sombre (गंभीर), Sad (उदास), Grave (गंभीर).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: VICIOUS
questionsEn.s:
VICIOUS - दुष्ट / क्रूर (Cruel or violent on purpose)
Baneful - हानिकारक (Harmful and destructive)
Virtuous - सदाचारी (Having high moral standards)
Unfortunate - दुर्भाग्यपूर्ण (Unlucky or regrettable)
Sinful - पापी (Full of sin; immoral)
Hence, 'Virtuous' is the most suitable antonym for 'VICIOUS'.
oa:
This term describes something that is harmful or destructive. It is a direct synonym for the malevolent and injurious nature of being vicious and is not an opposite.
Synonyms: Harmful (हानिकारक), Noxious (विषैला), Pernicious (घातक).
Antonyms: Beneficial (लाभकारी), Healthy (स्वस्थ), Wholesome (लाभदायक).

This word characterizes someone who has high moral standards and behaves in a righteous manner. It is the perfect antonym for vicious, which means cruel or immoral.
Synonyms: Moral (नैतिक), Righteous (धर्मी), Ethical (सदाचारी).
Antonyms: Vicious (दुष्ट), Wicked (पापी), Corrupt (भ्रष्ट).

This term refers to someone who is unlucky or a situation that is regrettable. It focuses on luck rather than the cruel or violent intent implied by the word vicious.
Synonyms: Unlucky (दुर्भाग्यशाली), Regrettable (शोचनीय), Hapless (अभागा).
Antonyms: Lucky (भाग्यशाली), Fortunate (भाग्यवान), Prosperous (समृद्ध).

This term refers to being full of sin or breaking religious laws. Since it describes immoral and bad behavior, it serves as a synonym for the negative aspect of being vicious.
Synonyms: Wicked (पापी), Evil (बुरा), Corrupt (भ्रष्ट).
Antonyms: Pious (धार्मिक), Pure (शुद्ध), Virtuous (सदाचारी).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Sparse
questionsEn.s:
Sparse - विरल (Thinly dispersed or scattered)
Abundant - प्रचुर / भरपूर (Existing in large quantities)
Tranquil - शांत (Free from disturbance; calm)
Costly - महंगा (Costing a lot of money)
Scanty - थोड़ा / अल्प (Small or insufficient in quantity)
Hence, 'Abundant' is the most suitable antonym for 'Sparse'.
oa:
This word refers to something existing or available in large quantities; it means having plenty. It is the direct opposite of sparse, which means thinly dispersed or scanty.
Synonyms: Plentiful (भरपूर), Copious (प्रचुर), Ample (पर्याप्त).
Antonyms: Sparse (विरल), Scanty (अल्प), Meager (थोड़ा).

This term describes a state free from disturbance; it means calm and peaceful. It focus on the mood or environment rather than the density or quantity of something.
Synonyms: Serene (निर्मल), Calm (शांत), Quiet (खामोश).
Antonyms: Agitated (उत्तेजित), Turbulent (अशांत), Chaotic (अराजक).

This word refers to something that costs a lot of money; it means expensive. It focus on financial value rather than the physical distribution of parts in an area.
Synonyms: Expensive (महंगा), Dear (बहुमूल्य), Lavish (अतिव्ययी).
Antonyms: Cheap (सस्ता), Inexpensive (किफायती), Paltry (तुच्छ).

This term describes an amount that is small or insufficient in quantity. Since it mirrors the exact meaning of sparse (thinly scattered), it acts as a synonym instead of an antonym.
Synonyms: Meager (अल्प), Sparse (विरल), Limited (सीमित).
Antonyms: Plentiful (भरपूर), Abundant (प्रचुर), Copious (बड़ी मात्रा में).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Friendship
questionsEn.s:
Friendship - मित्रता (The state of being friends)
Arrogance - अहंकार (Quality of being arrogant)
Enmity - शत्रुता (State of active opposition or hostility)
Slavery - गुलामी (The state of being a slave)
Amity - भाईचारा (Friendly relations)
Hence, 'Enmity' is the most suitable antonym for 'Friendship'.
oa:
This word refers to the quality of being unpleasantly proud and self-important. It describes a character trait but is not the structural opposite of a mutual relationship like friendship.
Synonyms: Pride (अहंकार), Haughtiness (घमंड), Vanity (अभिमान).
Antonyms: Humility (विनम्रता), Modesty (नम्रता), Meekness (विनीत भाव).

This word refers to a state or feeling of active opposition or hostility toward someone. It is the direct opposite of friendship, which involves a bond of mutual affection.
Synonyms: Hostility (शत्रुता), Animosity (द्वेष), Hatred (नफरत).
Antonyms: Friendship (मित्रता), Amity (भाईचारा), Goodwill (सद्भावना).

This term refers to the state of being a slave or under the absolute control of another. It focus on the loss of freedom rather than the presence of dislike or hostility.
Synonyms: Bondage (दास्ता), Servitude (गुलामी), Subjection (अधीनता).
Antonyms: Freedom (स्वतंत्रता), Liberty (आजादी), Autonomy (स्वायत्तता).

This term refers to friendly relations between people or countries. It is a direct synonym for friendship and therefore cannot be used as its antonym.
Synonyms: Goodwill (सद्भावना), Friendliness (भाईचारा), Concord (तालमेल).
Antonyms: Enmity (दुश्मनी), Hostility (शत्रुता), Discord (कलह).

test.instructions: Standard CBT Pattern Exam. Positive Marks: +1, Negative Marks: -0.25. Total Questions: 50.

test.title: Set - 11

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Emerge
questionsEn.s:
Emerge - उभरना / निकलना (To move out and become visible)
Surface - सतह पर आना (To move to the top or become apparent)
Appear - प्रकट होना (To come into sight)
Disappear - गायब होना (To cease to be visible)
Announce - घोषणा करना (To make a formal public statement)
Hence, 'Disappear' is the most suitable antonym for 'Emerge'.
oa:
This verb means to move up to the top of a liquid or to become apparent. It is a direct synonym for the act of emerging and therefore cannot be used as its opposite.
Synonyms: Appear (प्रकट होना), Arise (उठना), Rise (निकलना).
Antonyms: Sink (डूबना), Submerge (गोता खाना), Disappear (ओझल होना).

This verb means to come into sight or become visible. Since it describes the exact same action as emerge, it functions as a synonym rather than an antonym.
Synonyms: Emerge (निकलना), Materialize (साकार होना), Manifest (प्रकट होना).
Antonyms: Vanish (गायब होना), Disappear (ओझल होना), Fade (मिटना).

This word means to cease to be visible or to go away entirely. it is the direct opposite of emerge, which involves coming out of hiding or becoming visible.
Synonyms: Vanish (गायब होना), Fade (ओझल होना), Evanesce (लुप्त होना).
Antonyms: Emerge (निकलना), Appear (प्रकट होना), Show (दिखाना).

This verb means to make a formal public statement about something. While it involves making something known, it focus on verbal communication rather than physical visibility.
Synonyms: Declare (घोषित करना), Proclaim (घोषणा करना), State (बताना).
Antonyms: Conceal (छिपाना), Withhold (रोक लेना), Suppress (दबाना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Mellow
questionsEn.s:
Mellow - मधुर / कोमल (Pleasantly smooth or soft)
Hard - कठोर (Harsh or unpleasant to the senses; solid)
Soft - मुलायम (Easy to mold or cut; not hard)
Shiny - चमकदार (Reflecting light; polished)
Medium - मध्यम (About halfway between extremes)
Hence, 'Hard' is the most suitable antonym for 'Mellow'.
oa:
This word characterizes a surface that is firm or a sound/voice that is harsh and unpleasant. It serves as the direct opposite of mellow, which means pleasantly smooth and soft.
Synonyms: Harsh (कठोर), Rigid (सख्त), Tough (मजबूत).
Antonyms: Mellow (मधुर), Soft (मुलायम), Tender (कोमल).

This term describes something that is easy to mold, cut, or compress; it is not hard. Since it is a direct synonym for mellow, it cannot be its antonym.
Synonyms: Gentle (कोमल), Supple (लचीला), Mellow (मधुर).
Antonyms: Hard (सख्त), Rough (खुरदरा), Rigid (कठोर).

This word refers to things that reflect light; they are bright and polished. It focus on the visual reflection of a surface rather than on the auditory or tactile quality of being smooth.
Synonyms: Bright (चमकीला), Glossy (चमकदार), Radiant (उज्ज्वल).
Antonyms: Dull (मंद), Matte (चमकहीन), Dim (धुंधला).

This term refers to being about halfway between two extremes of size, quality, or intensity. It describes an average state rather than providing an opposite to smoothness.
Synonyms: Average (सामान्य), Middle (मध्य), Intermediate (मध्यम).
Antonyms: Extreme (अत्यधिक), Maximum (अधिकतम), Minimum (न्यूनतम).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: DIVIDE
questionsEn.s:
DIVIDE - विभाजित करना (To separate or be separated into parts)
Engulf - घेरना / लपेटना (To powerfully affect or surround completely)
Split - अलग करना (To break or cause to break into parts)
Unite - एकजुट करना (To come or bring together for a purpose)
Break - तोड़ना (To separate into pieces by force)
Hence, 'Unite' is the most suitable antonym for 'DIVIDE'.
oa:
This verb means to powerfully affect someone or to completely surround and cover something. It focus on overwhelming an object rather than on the separation or union of parts.
Synonyms: Overwhelm (अभिभूत करना), Inundate (डुबो देना), Swamped (लपेटना).
Antonyms: Uncover (उजागर करना), Release (मुक्त करना), Free (आजाद करना).

This word means to break or cause to break forcibly into parts. Since it describes the same action as dividing, it functions as a direct synonym rather than an opposite.
Synonyms: Divide (बाँटना), Fork (विभाजित करना), Sever (अलग करना).
Antonyms: Unite (जोड़ना), Combine (मिलाना), Join (सम्मिलित करना).

This term means to come or bring together for a common purpose or action. It serves as the direct opposite of divide, which involve separating things into parts.
Synonyms: Join (जोड़ना), Combine (मिलाना), Merge (एकीकृत करना).
Antonyms: Divide (विभाजित करना), Split (अलग करना), Separate (बाँटना).

This verb refers to separating into pieces as a result of a blow, shock, or strain. Like dividing, it involves creating smaller parts from a whole, making it a synonym.
Synonyms: Fracture (तोड़ना), Shatter (टुकड़े-टुकड़े करना), Smash (फोड़ना).
Antonyms: Mend (सुधारना), Repair (मरम्मत करना), Fix (ठीक करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: DEXTERITY
questionsEn.s:
DEXTERITY - निपुणता (Skill in performing tasks, especially with hands)
Agility - फुर्ती (Ability to move quickly and easily)
Ignorance - अज्ञानता (Lack of knowledge or information)
Mastery - महारत (Comprehensive knowledge or skill)
Skill - कौशल (Ability to do something well)
Hence, 'Ignorance' is the most suitable antonym for 'DEXTERITY'.
oa:
This term refers to the ability to move quickly and easily. It is a physical quality that aligns with the skillful nature of dexterity rather than opposing it.
Synonyms: Nimbleness (फुर्ती), Quickness (तेजी), Sprightliness (चपलता).
Antonyms: Sluggishness (सुस्ती), Stiffness (कठोरता), Clumsiness (भद्दापन).

This word refers to a lack of knowledge, information, or education. In a broad metaphorical sense, it serves as the opposite of dexterity, which represents skill and mastery.
Synonyms: Illiteracy (अज्ञानता), Unawareness (अनभिज्ञता), Folly (मूर्खता).
Antonyms: Knowledge (ज्ञान), Dexterity (निपुणता), Wisdom (बुद्धिमानी).

This noun refers to comprehensive knowledge or skill in a particular subject. It is a direct synonym for the high level of ability implied by dexterity.
Synonyms: Proficiency (प्रवीणता), Expertise (विशेषज्ञता), Skill (कौशल).
Antonyms: Incompetence (अयोग्यता), Ignorance (अज्ञान), Failure (विफलता).

This term refers to the ability to do something well, gained through practice or training. Since it mirrors the exact meaning of dexterity, it acts as a synonym instead of an antonym.
Synonyms: Aptitude (योग्यता), Adroitness (निपुणता), Talent (प्रतिभा).
Antonyms: Inability (अक्षमता), Ineptitude (अकुशलता), Clumsiness (भद्दापन).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Obsolete
questionsEn.s:
Obsolete - पुराना / अप्रचलित (No longer produced or used; out of date)
Rigid - कठोर (Unable to bend or be changed)
Recent - हाल का / आधुनिक (Happened or done not long ago)
Remote - दूरस्थ (Situated far from main centers)
Outdated - पुराना (No longer in use or fashion)
Hence, 'Recent' is the most suitable antonym for 'Obsolete'.
oa:
This term describes something that is unable to bend or be changed. It focus on flexibility and strictness, which has no connection with the age or usage status of an object.
Synonyms: Inflexible (अटल), Stiff (सख्त), Unyielding (अडिग).
Antonyms: Flexible (लचीला), Pliable (नमनशील), Adaptable (अनुकूलनीय).

This word refers to something that has happened or been done not long ago; it belongs to a past period close to the present. It is the direct opposite of obsolete.
Synonyms: Modern (आधुनिक), Latest (नवीनतम), Contemporary (समकालीन).
Antonyms: Obsolete (पुराना), Ancient (प्राचीन), Old (पुराना).

This term describes a place that is situated far from the main centers of population. It focus on physical distance rather than the currentness or relevance of a thing.
Synonyms: Distant (दूर), Isolated (पृथक), Secluded (एकांत).
Antonyms: Near (निकट), Close (पास), Central (केंद्रीय).

This word refers to something that is no longer useful or in fashion; it is old-fashioned. It is a direct synonym for obsolete and therefore cannot be used as its antonym.
Synonyms: Archaic (प्राचीन), Antiques (पुराना), Outmoded (पुराना).
Antonyms: Modern (आधुनिक), New (नया), Recent (हाल का).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Derogatory
questionsEn.s:
Derogatory - अपमानजनक (Showing a critical or disrespectful attitude)
Insulting - अपमानजनक (Disrespectful or scornfully abusive)
Depreciating - मूल्य कम करने वाला (Diminishing in value or belittling)
Intricate - जटिल (Very complicated or detailed)
Complimentary - प्रशंसात्मक (Expressing a compliment or approval)
Hence, 'Complimentary' is the most suitable antonym for 'Derogatory'.
oa:
This term refers to being disrespectful or scornfully abusive. It is a direct synonym for the critical nature of being derogatory and therefore is not an opposite.
Synonyms: Disparaging (नीचा दिखाने वाला), Offensive (अपमानजनक), Rude (अशिष्ट).
Antonyms: Complimentary (प्रशंसात्मक), Flattering (चापलूसी भरा), Respectful (सम्मानपूर्ण).

This verb means to diminish in value over a period of time or to belittle something. It mirrors the demeaning aspect of derogatory, acting as a synonym.
Synonyms: Devaluing (मूल्य कम करना), Belittling (छोटा दिखाना), Decrying (निंदा करना).
Antonyms: Appreciating (सराहना), Increasing (बढ़ाना), Enhancing (सुधारना).

This word describes something that is very complicated or detailed. It focus on the complexity of a structure rather than on the critical or praising tone of a remark.
Synonyms: Complex (जटिल), Complicated (पेचीदा), Elaborate (विस्तृत).
Antonyms: Simple (सरल), Basic (बुनियादी), Plain (सादा).

This term refers to expressing a compliment; it involves praising or approving of someone. It is the direct opposite of derogatory, which involves showing a critical attitude.
Synonyms: Appreciative (प्रशंसात्मक), Laudatory (प्रशंसापूर्ण), Favourable (अनुकूल).
Antonyms: Derogatory (अपमानजनक), Critical (आलोचनात्मक), Insulting (निंदनीय).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Industrious
questionsEn.s:
Industrious - परिश्रमी (Hard-working and diligent)
Diligent - मेहनती (Showing care in work or duties)
Durable - टिकाऊ (Able to withstand wear or pressure)
Cautious - सावधान (Careful to avoid potential problems)
Lethargic - सुस्त (Sluggish, apathetic, and inactive)
Hence, 'Lethargic' is the most suitable antonym for 'Industrious'.
oa:
This word describes someone who has or shows care and conscientiousness in their work. It is a direct synonym for industrious and therefore fails as an opposite.
Synonyms: Hardworking (परिश्रमी), Assiduous (मेहनती), Sedulous (परिश्रमी).
Antonyms: Lazy (आलसी), Idle (बेकार), Indolent (सुस्त).

This term refers to something that is able to withstand wear, pressure, or damage; it is hard-wearing. It focus on the physical strength of an object rather than a person's work ethic.
Synonyms: Long-lasting (स्थायी), Strong (मजबूत), Tough (टिकाऊ).
Antonyms: Fragile (नाज़ुक), Flimsy (कमजोर), Weak (निर्बल).

This word describes a person who is careful to avoid potential problems or dangers. While it is a positive work trait, it focus on safety rather than the intensity of effort or hard work.
Synonyms: Wary (सतर्क), Watchful (सावधान), Prudent (विवेकी).
Antonyms: Reckless (लापरवाह), Rash (जल्दबाज़), Heedless (असावधान).

This word refers to a state of being sluggish, apathetic, and lacking energy. It serves as the direct opposite of industrious, which characterizes someone who is hard-working.
Synonyms: Sluggish (सुस्त), Lazy (आलसी), Listless (उदासीन).
Antonyms: Industrious (परिश्रमी), Energetic (ऊर्जावान), Active (सक्रिय).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Assist
questionsEn.s:
Assist - सहायता करना (To help someone by doing a share of work)
Decline - मना करना / घटना (To become less or refuse politely)
Conceal - छिपाना (To prevent from being seen or known)
Support - समर्थन देना (To give assistance or bear weight)
Obstruct - बाधा डालना (To block or deliberately make difficult)
Hence, 'Obstruct' is the most suitable antonym for 'Assist'.
oa:
This verb means to become smaller or less, or to politely refuse an invitation. While it involves turning something down, it does not represent the direct obstruction of help.
Synonyms: Decrease (घटना), Refuse (अस्वीकार करना), Wane (कम होना).
Antonyms: Increase (बढ़ना), Accept (स्वीकार करना), Boost (बढ़ाना).

This term means to hide something or prevent it from being known. It focus on secrecy rather than on whether one is helping or hindering a person's actions.
Synonyms: Hide (छिपाना), Cover (ढकना), Disguise (छद्म भेष बनाना).
Antonyms: Reveal (प्रकट करना), Disclose (उजागर करना), Show (दिखाना).

This word means to give assistance to or to bear the weight of something. Since it mirrors the exact meaning of providing help, it functions as a synonym for assist.
Synonyms: Help (मदद करना), Aid (सहायता करना), Back (समर्थन देना).
Antonyms: Oppose (विरोध करना), Hinder (बाधा डालना), Abandon (छोड़ देना).

This term refers to blocking a path or deliberately making something difficult for someone. it is the direct opposite of assist, which involves providing help.
Synonyms: Hinder (बाधा डालना), Block (रोकना), Impede (अवरोध करना).
Antonyms: Assist (सहायता करना), Facilitate (सुविधा देना), Aid (मदद करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Malice
questionsEn.s:
Malice - द्वेष / दुर्भावना (The desire to harm someone; ill will)
Goodwill - सद्भावना (Friendly and helpful feelings)
Hypocrisy - पाखंड (Claiming higher standards than one has)
Humility - विनम्रता (Quality of having a modest view of oneself)
Truth - सत्य (Quality of being true or in accordance with fact)
Hence, 'Goodwill' is the most suitable antonym for 'Malice'.
oa:
This word refers to friendly, helpful, or cooperative feelings and attitudes. It is the direct opposite of malice, which is characterized by the desire to harm others.
Synonyms: Benevolence (सद्भावना), Kindness (दयालुता), Amity (भाईचारा).
Antonyms: Malice (द्वेष), Animosity (शत्रुता), Spite (दुर्भावना).

This term refers to the practice of claiming to have higher standards or beliefs than is actually the case. It focus on deception in character rather than the specific intent to cause harm.
Synonyms: Deceit (पाखंड), Insincerity (दिखावा), Duplicity (कपट).
Antonyms: Sincerity (ईमानदारी), Honesty (सच्चाई), Genuineness (वास्तविकता).

This word refers to the quality of having a modest or low view of one's own importance. While a positive trait, it focuses on being humble rather than on having friendly intentions toward others.
Synonyms: Modesty (नम्रता), Meekness (विनम्रता), Diffidence (संकोच).
Antonyms: Arrogance (अहंकार), Pride (गर्व), Vanity (अभिमान).

This term refers to the quality or state of being true; it is in accordance with fact or reality. It focus on accuracy and honesty rather than the emotional intent behind an action.
Synonyms: Fact (सत्य), Reality (वास्तविकता), Veracity (सत्यता).
Antonyms: Falsehood (असत्य), Lie (झूठ), Deception (धोखा).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Foul
questionsEn.s:
Foul - गंदा / दुर्गंधयुक्त (Offensive to senses; disgusting smell)
Nasty - घिनौना (Very bad or unpleasant)
Fragrant - सुगंधित (Having a pleasant or sweet smell)
Vile - नीच / बुरा (Extremely unpleasant or immoral)
Proud - गर्वित (Feeling satisfaction from achievements)
Hence, 'Fragrant' is the most suitable antonym for 'Foul'.
oa:
This word refers to things that are very bad or unpleasant. It is a direct synonym for the offensive or disgusting quality of being foul and is not an opposite.
Synonyms: Disgusting (घिनौना), Vile (नीच), Offensive (अप्रिय).
Antonyms: Pleasant (सुखद), Clean (साफ), Nice (अच्छा).

This term describes something having a pleasant or sweet smell. It serves as the direct opposite of foul, which often characterizes a disgusting smell or taste.
Synonyms: Sweet-smelling (सुगंधित), Aromatic (खुशबूदार), Perfumed (सुगंधित).
Antonyms: Foul (दुर्गंधयुक्त), Stinking (बदबूदार), Malodorous (बदबूदार).

This word refers to things that are extremely unpleasant or morally reprehensible. Since it mirrors the same degree of disgusting nature as foul, it acts as a synonym.
Synonyms: Foul (भ्रष्ट), Repugnant (घृणित), Base (नीच).
Antonyms: Noble (महान), Pure (शुद्ध), Admirable (प्रशंसनीय).

This term describes feeling satisfaction and pleasure because of one's achievements. It focuses on personal pride and has no connection with physical or sensory unpleasantness.
Synonyms: Arrogant (अहंकारी), Haughty (घमंडी), Satisfied (संतुष्ट).
Antonyms: Humble (विनम्र), Ashamed (शर्मिंदा), Modest (विनीत).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Hostile
questionsEn.s:
Hostile - शत्रुतापूर्ण (Unfriendly and aggressive)
Amiable - सुशील / मिलनसार (Friendly and pleasant)
Unfavourable - प्रतिकूल (Showing lack of approval or trust)
Adverse - विपरीत (Opposed to interests; harmful)
Violent - हिंसक (Using physical force to hurt)
Hence, 'Amiable' is the most suitable antonym for 'Hostile'.
oa:
This word describes someone who is very kind, friendly, and pleasant to be around. It is the perfect opposite of hostile, which refers to being unfriendly or aggressive.
Synonyms: Friendly (मिलनसार), Genial (सुशील), Affable (मिलनसार).
Antonyms: Hostile (शत्रुतापूर्ण), Unfriendly (अमित्र), Surly (चिड़चिड़ा).

This term describes something that shows a lack of approval or does not help. While it is negative, it focuses on the outcome or support rather than the direct aggressive behavior.
Synonyms: Adverse (प्रतिकूल), Disadvantageous (हानिकारक), Hostile (विरोधी).
Antonyms: Favourable (अनुकूल), Advantageous (लाभदायक), Positive (सकारात्मक).

This word refers to things that are opposed to one's interests or harmful. It functions as a synonym for the negative or opposing nature of being hostile.
Synonyms: Hostile (प्रतिकूल), Harmful (नुकसानदेह), Unfavourable (अहितकर).
Antonyms: Beneficial (लाभकारी), Auspicious (शुभ), Favourable (अनुकूल).

This word describes someone who uses physical force with the intention to hurt others. Since it mirrors the aggressive and threatening nature of hostility, it is a synonym.
Synonyms: Aggressive (आक्रामक), Brutal (क्रूर), Fierce (उग्र).
Antonyms: Peaceful (शांत), Gentle (सौम्य), Calm (शांत).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Sluggish
questionsEn.s:
Sluggish - सुस्त (Lazy and slow-moving)
Dull - मंद (Boring or lacking brightness)
Weak - कमजोर (Lacking physical strength)
Sedentary - गतिहीन (Spending time seated; inactive)
Active - सक्रिय (Energetic and fast; busy)
Hence, 'Active' is the most suitable antonym for 'Sluggish'.
oa:
This word describes someone who is boring or something that lacks brightness and interest. It serves as a synonym for the inactive and slow nature of being sluggish.
Synonyms: Boring (नीरस), Slow (मंद), Tedious (उबाऊ).
Antonyms: Bright (चमकीला), Sharp (तीक्ष्ण), Exciting (रोमांचक).

This term refers to lacking physical strength and energy. While sluggishness involves a lack of speed, weak focuses on the physical inability to perform rather than just the pace.
Synonyms: Feeble (कमजोर), Frail (नाज़ुक), Infirm (अशक्त).
Antonyms: Strong (मजबूत), Robust (शक्तिशाली), Vigorous (जोशीला).

This word characterizes someone who spends a lot of time seated or is physically inactive. It aligns with the slow-moving and lazy nature of being sluggish, making it a synonym.
Synonyms: Inactive (निष्क्रिय), Stationary (स्थिर), Idle (बेकार).
Antonyms: Active (सक्रिय), Mobile (चलायमान), Energetic (ऊर्जावान).

This term refers to someone who is energetic, fast, and constantly moving or doing things. It is the direct opposite of sluggish, which involves being lazy and slow.
Synonyms: Energetic (ऊर्जावान), Lively (जीवंत), Fast (तेज).
Antonyms: Sluggish (सुस्त), Lazy (आलसी), Inactive (निष्क्रिय).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Infirm
questionsEn.s:
Infirm - दुर्बल / अशक्त (Not physically strong, especially due to age)
Feeble - कमजोर (With no energy or power)
Strong - मजबूत (Physically powerful or muscular)
Weak - निर्बल (Having little body strength or energy)
Frail - नाज़ुक (Weak and not healthy)
Hence, 'Strong' is the most suitable antonym for 'Infirm'.
oa:
This term describes someone with no energy or power; they are weak. It is a direct synonym for the physically frail nature of being infirm and therefore is not an opposite.
Synonyms: Weak (कमजोर), Frail (नाज़ुक), Debilitated (दुर्बल).
Antonyms: Strong (मजबूत), Robust (शक्तिशाली), Healthy (स्वस्थ).

This word characterizes a person who is physically powerful and able to lift or carry heavy things. It is the direct opposite of infirm, which refers to being weak, especially through age.
Synonyms: Robust (शक्तिशाली), Stalwart (मजबूत), Muscular (मांसल).
Antonyms: Infirm (दुर्बल), Weak (कमजोर), Feeble (अशक्त).

This term characterizes the body as having little strength or energy. Since it mirrors the core meaning of being infirm, it serves as a synonym rather than an antonym.
Synonyms: Infirm (निर्बल), Feeble (कमजोर), Enfeebled (अशक्त).
Antonyms: Powerful (शक्तिशाली), Strong (मजबूत), Vigorous (ऊर्जावान).

This word describes someone who is weak and not healthy, often implying delicacy. It is another strong synonym for the physical state of being infirm.
Synonyms: Delicate (नाज़ुक), Weak (निर्बल), Fragile (भंगुर).
Antonyms: Robust (मजबूत), Healthy (स्वस्थ), Sturdy (दृढ़).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Sprightly
questionsEn.s:
Sprightly - फुर्तीला (Energetic and in good health)
Active - सक्रिय (Busy or engaging in activity)
Lethargic - सुस्त (Lacking energy or willingness to act)
Energic - ऊर्जावान (Having much energy or vitality)
Lively - जीवंत (Full of energy and enthusiasm)
Hence, 'Lethargic' is the most suitable antonym for 'Sprightly'.
oa:
This term describes someone busy with a particular activity or energetic. It serves as a synonym for the lively and energetic nature of a sprightly person.
Synonyms: Energetic (ऊर्जावान), Lively (जीवंत), Busy (व्यस्त).
Antonyms: Inactive (निष्क्रिय), Passive (सुस्त), Lethargic (आलसी).

This word refers to having little energy and feeling unwilling or unable to do anything. It is the direct opposite of sprightly, which describes someone who is energetic and in good health.
Synonyms: Sluggish (सुस्त), Lazy (आलसी), Inactive (निष्क्रिय).
Antonyms: Sprightly (फुर्तीला), Active (सक्रिय), Energetic (ऊर्जावान).

This term (variant of energetic) characterizes having or involving a lot of energy. Since it describes a state of high vitality, it acts as a synonym for being sprightly.
Synonyms: Vigorous (जोशीला), Dynamic (गतिशील), Sprightly (चंचल).
Antonyms: Weak (कमजोर), Lethargic (सुस्त), Tired (थका हुआ).

This word describes someone full of energy, enthusiasm, and interest. Like the target word, it characterizes a spirited personality, making it a synonym instead of an antonym.
Synonyms: Animated (जोशीला), Vibrant (जीवंत), Spirited (उत्साही).
Antonyms: Dull (नीरस), Sombre (गंभीर), Listless (उदासीन).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Blemish
questionsEn.s:
Blemish - दोष / दाग (A small mark or flaw that spoils appearance)
Stain - धब्बा (A colored patch or dirty mark)
Perfection - परिपूर्णता (State of being without fault or flaw)
Discoloration - विवर्णता (Process of becoming discolored)
Damage - क्षति (Harm or injury caused by breaking)
Hence, 'Perfection' is the most suitable antonym for 'Blemish'.
oa:
This term refers to a colored patch or dirty mark that is difficult to remove. It is a direct synonym for the physical mark of a blemish and therefore fails as an opposite.
Synonyms: Mark (धब्बा), Spot (निशान), Blot (दाग).
Antonyms: Cleanliness (स्वच्छता), Purity (शुद्धता), Perfection (पूर्णता).

This word refers to a state of being perfect, faultless, and without any flaws. it is the direct opposite of blemish, which refers to a flaw or mark that spoils an appearance.
Synonyms: Flawlessness (त्रुटिहीनता), Excellence (उत्कृष्टता), Purity (शुद्धता).
Antonyms: Blemish (दोष), Flaw (त्रुटि), Defect (कमी).

This word refers to the process of becoming discolored or the state of having faded color. Since it describes an imperfection in appearance, it acts as a synonym for blemish.
Synonyms: Tarnish (फीकापन), Stain (धब्बा), Fade (रंग उतरना).
Antonyms: Brightness (चमक), Uniformity (एकरूपता), Colorfulness (रंगमयता).

This term refers to harm or injury caused when something is broken or spoiled. It is a synonym for the negative impact that a blemish has on an object or reputation.
Synonyms: Harm (हानि), Ruin (विनाश), Injury (क्षति).
Antonyms: Repair (मरम्मत), Benefit (लाभ), Restoration (बहाली).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Anxiety
questionsEn.s:
Anxiety - चिंता (Feeling of worry or fear about the future)
Restlessness - बेचैनी (Inability to rest due to worry)
Nervousness - घबराहट (State of being nervous or worried)
Certainty - निश्चितता (Something that is sure to happen)
Panic - आतंक (Sudden uncontrollable fear)
Hence, 'Certainty' is the most suitable antonym for 'Anxiety'.
oa:
This term refers to the inability to rest or relax due to boredom or worry. It is a core symptom and synonym of the state of anxiety, thus failing to provide an opposite.
Synonyms: Agitation (बेचैनी), Unease (बेचैनी), Nervousness (घबराहट).
Antonyms: Calmness (शांति), Peace (स्थिरता), Relaxation (आराम).

This word describes the quality or state of being nervous or worried. Since it mirrors the exact feeling of anxiety, it functions as a direct synonym.
Synonyms: Apprehension (आशंका), Trepidation (भय), Edginess (तनाव).
Antonyms: Confidence (आत्मविश्वास), Courage (साहस), Composure (धैर्य).

This word refers to something that is sure to happen or the state of being completely sure. It serves as the direct opposite of anxiety, which involves worry and uncertainty about the future.
Synonyms: Assurance (निश्चितता), Confidence (विश्वास), Conviction (दृढ़ विश्वास).
Antonyms: Anxiety (चिंता), Doubt (संदेह), Uncertainty (अनिश्चितता).

This term refers to a sudden, uncontrollable feeling of fear that prevents clear thinking. It is an extreme form of anxiety, making it a synonym rather than an antonym.
Synonyms: Terror (आतंक), Alarm (घबराहट), Dread (भय).
Antonyms: Calm (शांत), Serenity (शांति), Coolness (शीतलता).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Fallacy
questionsEn.s:
Fallacy - भ्रम / तर्कदोष (A false belief or a wrong idea)
Cheat - ठगना (To trick or deceive someone)
Flaw - दोष (A mistake that makes something imperfect)
Trick - चाल (Something done to deceive someone)
Truth - सच्चाई (The state or quality of being true)
Hence, 'Truth' is the most suitable antonym for 'Fallacy'.
oa:
This verb or noun refers to tricking someone or a person who acts dishonestly. While a fallacy involves a type of intellectual trickery, this word focus on the act of deception rather than the opposite of a false idea.
Synonyms: Deceive (धोखा देना), Swindle (ठगना), Fraud (कपट).
Antonyms: Be honest (ईमानदार होना), Support (समर्थन देना), Assist (सहायता करना).

This term refers to a mistake or a weakness in something that makes it imperfect. It is a synonym for the error found in a logical fallacy, not an opposite.
Synonyms: Defect (दोष), Error (त्रुटि), Fault (कमी).
Antonyms: Perfection (पूर्णता), Strength (खूबी), Soundness (शुद्धता).

This word refers to something done to make someone believe what is not true. Since a fallacy often acts as a logical trick, it functions as a synonym in this context.
Synonyms: Ruse (चाल), Deception (धोखा), Stratagem (दाँव-पेंच).
Antonyms: Truth (सत्य), Honesty (ईमानदारी), Reality (वास्तविकता).

This word refers to the state or quality of being true and accurate. It is the direct opposite of a fallacy, which is a false belief, error, or a wrong idea.
Synonyms: Verity (सत्यता), Fact (सच्चाई), Reality (वास्तविकता).
Antonyms: Fallacy (भ्रम), Lie (झूठ), Falsehood (असत्य).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Hassled
questionsEn.s:
Hassled - परेशान (To be annoyed by repeated requests)
Relaxed - तनावमुक्त (Not worried or tense; calm)
Annoyed - नाराज (Feeling angry or irritated)
Worried - चिंतित (Thinking that something bad might happen)
Stressed - तनावग्रस्त (Experiencing mental or emotional strain)
Hence, 'Relaxed' is the most suitable antonym for 'Hassled'.
oa:
This word describes a state of being free from worry or tension. It is the direct opposite of being hassled, which involves being annoyed and bothered by repeated demands.
Synonyms: Calm (शांत), Peaceful (निश्चिंत), Unperturbed (अविचलित).
Antonyms: Hassled (परेशान), Stressed (तनावग्रस्त), Agitated (बेचैन).

This term refers to feeling angry or irritated. Since it describes the emotional result of being hassled, it functions as a synonym rather than an opposite.
Synonyms: Vexed (चिढ़ा हुआ), Irritated (नाराज), Peeved (रुष्ट).
Antonyms: Pleased (खुश), Content (संतुष्ट), Gracious (विनम्र).

This word describes someone thinking that something bad might happen. It focus on the mental state of anxiety, mirroring the troubled nature of being hassled.
Synonyms: Anxious (चिंतित), Apprehensive (भयभीत), Troubled (परेशान).
Antonyms: Confident (आत्मविश्वासी), Secure (सुरक्षित), Unconcerned (बेपरवाह).

This term describes experiencing mental or emotional strain. It is a strong synonym for being hassled, as both describe a state of being under pressure and bothered.
Synonyms: Taxed (दबाव में), Burdened (लदा हुआ), Overwhelmed (अभिभूत).
Antonyms: Relaxed (तनावमुक्त), Easygoing (आरामदेह), Calm (शांत).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Impoverished
questionsEn.s:
Impoverished - निर्धन / गरीब (Wiped out financially; poor)
Rich - धनी (Having a lot of money or property)
Deprived - वंचित (Lacking basic necessities of life)
Unlucky - अभागा (Having or causing bad luck)
Needy - ज़रूरतमंद (Not having enough money or food)
Hence, 'Rich' is the most suitable antonym for 'Impoverished'.
oa:
This word refers to having a lot of money, property, or valuable assets. It serves as the direct opposite of impoverished, which means being wiped out financially or poor.
Synonyms: Wealthy (धनी), Prosperous (समृद्ध), Affluent (संपन्न).
Antonyms: Impoverished (निर्धन), Poor (गरीब), Destitute (दरिद्र).

This term describes someone lacking the basic necessities of life, such as food or money. It is a synonym for the "lacking" aspect of being impoverished.
Synonyms: Needy (ज़रूरतमंद), Destitute (अभावग्रस्त), Poor (निर्धन).
Antonyms: Privileged (विशेषाधिकार प्राप्त), Wealthy (धनी), Blessed (धन्य).

This word refers to someone having or causing bad luck. While poverty is often seen as bad luck, the word focus on chance rather than financial status.
Synonyms: Hapless (अभागा), Unfortunate (दुर्भाग्यपूर्ण), Ill-fated (बदकिस्मत).
Antonyms: Lucky (भाग्यशाली), Fortunate (भाग्यवान), Successful (सफल).

This term characterizes people who do not have enough money, clothing, or food. It is a direct synonym for impoverished and therefore fails to provide the required opposite.
Synonyms: Poor (गरीब), Indigent (दरिद्र), Penurious (कंगाल).
Antonyms: Self-sufficient (आत्मनिर्भर), Wealthy (धनी), Prosperous (संपन्न).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Ramify
questionsEn.s:
Ramify - विभाजित करना / शाखाएँ बनाना (To separate into divisions)
Insulate - अलग करना / सुरक्षित करना (Protect by preventing loss of heat)
Divide - बाँटना (To separate into parts or groups)
Isolate - अलग-थलग करना (To keep separate from others)
Unite - जोड़ना / मिलना (To join together for a purpose)
Hence, 'Unite' is the most suitable antonym for 'Ramify'.
oa:
This verb means to protect something by covering it with a material that prevents loss of heat or sound. Its focus is on protection and separation, which is unrelated to the process of branching out.
Synonyms: Protect (सुरक्षित करना), Shield (बचाना), Wrap (लपेटना).
Antonyms: Expose (उजागर करना), Strip (नंगा करना), Uncover (खोलना).

This term refers to separating something into different parts or groups. Since it describes the same process of splitting as ramifying, it functions as a synonym.
Synonyms: Split (बाँटना), Segregate (अलग करना), Branch (शाखाएँ बनाना).
Antonyms: Unite (जोड़ना), Combine (मिलाना), Join (सम्मिलित करना).

This verb means to put or keep someone or something separate from others. It is synonymous with the "separation" part of ramifying rather than being an antonym.
Synonyms: Segregate (अलग करना), Detach (हटाना), Separate (पृथक करना).
Antonyms: Integrate (एकीकृत करना), Associate (जोड़ना), Unite (मिलाना).

This term means to join together for a specific purpose or to form a single unit. It is the direct opposite of ramify, which involves separating or branching into divisions.
Synonyms: Join (जोड़ना), Assemble (एकत्र करना), Combine (मिलाना).
Antonyms: Divide (बाँटना), Ramify (विभाजित करना), Separate (अलग करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Magnificent
questionsEn.s:
Magnificent - भव्य / शानदार (Extremely beautiful or impressive)
Modest - मामूली / विनम्र (Not large, elaborate, or expensive)
Mighty - शक्तिशाली (Very large or powerful)
Opulent - आलीशान (Costly and luxurious)
Grandiose - आडंबरपूर्ण (Impressive and imposing in style)
Hence, 'Modest' is the most suitable antonym for 'Magnificent'.
oa:
This word describes something that is not large, expensive, or elaborate; it is unassuming and simple. It serves as the perfect antonym for magnificent, which means grand and beautiful.
Synonyms: Humble (विनम्र), Simple (सादा), Unassuming (विनीत).
Antonyms: Magnificent (भव्य), Grandiose (आडंबरपूर्ण), Opulent (शानदार).

This term refers to someone or something that is very large, powerful, or important. Since it describes a state of greatness, it acts as a synonym for the scale of magnificent.
Synonyms: Powerful (शक्तिशाली), Great (महान), Strong (मजबूत).
Antonyms: Weak (कमजोर), Tiny (छोटा), Feeble (अशक्त).

This word describes things that are ostentatiously costly and luxurious. It is a strong synonym for the splendid and grand nature of being magnificent.
Synonyms: Luxurious (विलासी), Lavish (अतिव्ययी), Grand (शानदार).
Antonyms: Poor (गरीब), Destitute (निर्धन), Simple (सादा).

This term characterizes something as impressive and imposing in appearance, often in an exaggerated way. It functions as a synonym for magnificent rather than an opposite.
Synonyms: Pompous (आडंबरपूर्ण), Stately (शानदार), Majestic (भव्य).
Antonyms: Modest (मामूली), Simple (साधारण), Humble (विनम्र).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Hazard
questionsEn.s:
Hazard - खतरा / जोखिम (A danger or risk)
Risk - जोखिम (Exposure to danger)
Peril - संकट / जोखिम (Serious and immediate danger)
Safety - सुरक्षा (Condition of being protected from risk)
Gamble - जुआ (To play games of chance or take risks)
Hence, 'Safety' is the most suitable antonym for 'Hazard'.
oa:
This term refers to a situation involving exposure to danger. It is a direct synonym for hazard and therefore cannot be used as the required opposite.
Synonyms: Danger (खतरा), Peril (जोखिम), Threat (धमकी).
Antonyms: Safety (सुरक्षा), Security (बचाव), Protection (रक्षा).

This word describes a state of serious and immediate danger. Since it mirrors the same degree of threat as hazard, it functions as a strong synonym.
Synonyms: Jeopardy (जोखिम), Hazard (खतरा), Menace (खतरा).
Antonyms: Safety (सुरक्षा), Safeguard (रक्षा), Assurance (आश्वासन).

This word refers to the condition of being protected from or unlikely to cause danger, risk, or injury. It is the direct opposite of a hazard, which is a source of danger.
Synonyms: Security (सुरक्षा), Protection (रक्षा), Shelter (शरण).
Antonyms: Hazard (खतरा), Danger (जोखिम), Peril (डर).
