This term refers to taking risky actions in the hope of a desired result, or playing games of chance. It describes a behavior involving hazard rather than providing a contrast to it.
Synonyms: Speculation (सट्टा), Risk (दाँव), Venture (जोखिम).
Antonyms: Certainty (निश्चितता), Caution (सावधानी), Stability (स्थिरता).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Pompous
questionsEn.s:
Pompous - आडंबरपूर्ण (Thinking you are more important than others)
Showy - भड़कीला (Having a striking appearance or style)
Boastful - घमंडी (Showing too much pride in achievements)
Flaunting - इतराना (Showing off to gain admiration)
Humble - विनम्र (Not thinking you are better than others)
Hence, 'Humble' is the most suitable antonym for 'Pompous'.
oa:
This term describes something having a striking or flashy appearance. It aligns with the pretentious and self-important nature of being pompous, acting as a synonym.
Synonyms: Ostentatious (दिखावटी), Flashy (भड़कीला), Pretentious (आडंबरपूर्ण).
Antonyms: Plain (सादा), Understated (न्यूनतम), Humble (विनम्र).

This word describes a person who shows too much pride in their own achievements. Since it characterizes the arrogant side of being pompous, it is a synonym instead of an opposite.
Synonyms: Vainglorious (घमंडी), Arrogant (अहंकारी), Bragging (शेखी बघारना).
Antonyms: Modest (विनम्र), Humble (विनीत), Self-effacing (दब्बू).

This term refers to showing something off that you are proud of so that others will admire it. It mirrors the self-important display found in pompous behavior.
Synonyms: Parading (दिखावा करना), Brandishing (चमकाना), Exhibiting (प्रदर्शित करना).
Antonyms: Concealing (छिपाना), Hiding (छिपाना), Minimizing (कम करके दिखाना).

This word refers to someone who does not think they are better or more important than others; they are unassuming. It serves as the direct opposite of pompous.
Synonyms: Modest (विनम्र), Unpretentious (दिखावा रहित), Meek (नम्र).
Antonyms: Pompous (आडंबरपूर्ण), Arrogant (घमंडी), Haughty (अहंकारी).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Widespread
questionsEn.s:
Widespread - व्यापक / दूर-दूर तक फैला (Found over a large area)
Famous - प्रसिद्ध (Well known to many people)
Limited - सीमित (Restricted in size, amount, or extent)
General - सर्वसामान्य (Affecting all or most people or places)
Overall - समग्र / कुल मिलाकर (Including everything; total)
Hence, 'Limited' is the most suitable antonym for 'Widespread'.
oa:
This word describes someone or something well known to many people. While famous things are often widespread, this word focuses on popularity rather than geographic or numerical range.
Synonyms: Renowned (प्रसिद्ध), Noted (उल्लेखनीय), Celebrated (प्रख्यात).
Antonyms: Unknown (अज्ञात), Obscure (गुमनाम), Infamous (बदनाम).

This word refers to something restricted in size, amount, or extent; it means having boundaries. It is the direct opposite of widespread, which means found over a large area.
Synonyms: Restricted (सीमित), Finite (निश्चित), Confined (सीमित).
Antonyms: Widespread (व्यापक), Extensive (विस्तृत), Vast (विशाल).

This term refers to something affecting all or most people or places. It is a synonym for the broad and inclusive nature of being widespread rather than an opposite.
Synonyms: Universal (सार्वभौमिक), Common (सामान्य), Broad (व्यापक).
Antonyms: Specific (विशिष्ट), Particular (विशेष), Individual (व्यक्तिगत).

This term refers to including everything; it means total or comprehensive. It focus on the completeness of a situation, which aligns with the extensive nature of widespread.
Synonyms: Total (कुल), Comprehensive (व्यापक), Wholesale (पूर्ण).
Antonyms: Partial (आंशिक), Segmented (खंडित), Limited (सीमित).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Augment
questionsEn.s:
Augment - बढ़ाना (To make larger or more effective)
Extend - विस्तार करना (To cause to cover a wider area)
Diminish - घटाना (To become less in size or amount)
Expand - फैलाना (To become larger or more extensive)
Spread - फैलाना (To extend over a large area)
Hence, 'Diminish' is the most suitable antonym for 'Augment'.
oa:
This verb means to cause something to cover a wider area or to make it larger. It is a direct synonym for the act of augmenting and therefore cannot be used as its opposite.
Synonyms: Prolong (लंबा करना), Lengthen (बढ़ाना), Expand (विस्तार करना).
Antonyms: Shorten (छोटा करना), Abbreviate (संक्षिप्त करना), Curtail (कम करना).

This word means to become less in size, amount, or importance; it means to decrease. It serves as the direct opposite of augment, which means to make something larger.
Synonyms: Decrease (घटाना), Reduce (कम करना), Decline (कम होना).
Antonyms: Augment (बढ़ाना), Increase (बढ़ाना), Boost (बढ़ावा देना).

This verb refers to becoming or making something larger or more extensive. Since it mirrors the growth and increase implied by augment, it functions as a synonym.
Synonyms: Amplify (बढ़ाना), Grow (फैलना), Swell (फूलना).
Antonyms: Contract (सिकुड़ना), Shrink (सिकुड़ना), Condense (संक्षिप्त करना).

This term means to extend over a large or increasing area. It describes a type of growth or expansion, making it a synonym for the widening aspect of augmenting.
Synonyms: Distribute (फैलाना), Scatter (बिखेरना), Diffuse (फैलाना).
Antonyms: Gather (इकट्ठा करना), Collect (संग्रहित करना), Concentrate (केंद्रित करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Waver
questionsEn.s:
Waver - डगमगाना / काँपना (To move in a quivering way or hesitate)
Slant - तिरछा (To slope or lean in a direction)
Tilt - झुकना (To move with one end higher than other)
Steady - स्थिर (Firmly fixed or not shaking)
Sway - डोलना (To move slowly from side to side)
Hence, 'Steady' is the most suitable antonym for 'Waver'.
oa:
This term refers to sloping or leaning in a particular direction. It describes a physical orientation or a bias rather than the act of shaking or being indecisive.
Synonyms: Tilt (तिरछा होना), Slope (ढलान), Lean (झुकना).
Antonyms: Level (समतल), Straighten (सीधा करना), Align (सीध में करना).

This verb means to move into a position where one end is higher than the other. Like slant, it focus on a fixed angle rather than on the movement of quivering or hesitating.
Synonyms: Tip (झुकना), List (एक ओर झुकना), Incline (झुकाव).
Antonyms: Balance (संतुलन), Steady (स्थिर करना), Straighten (सीधा करना).

This word refers to being firmly fixed, supported, or balanced; it means not shaking or moving. It is the perfect antonym for waver, which means to move in a quivering way.
Synonyms: Stable (स्थिर), Constant (निश्चित), Firm (दृढ़).
Antonyms: Waver (डगमगाना), Shaky (डाँवाँडोल), Fickle (चंचल).

This verb means to move slowly from side to side. Since it describes the same unsteady, oscillating motion as waver, it functions as a direct synonym.
Synonyms: Oscillate (झूलना), Rock (डोलना), Fluctuate (उतार-चढ़ाव होना).
Antonyms: Fix (स्थिर करना), Stabilize (स्थिर करना), Halt (रुकना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Dividing
questionsEn.s:
Dividing - विभाजित करना (To separate into parts or groups)
Parting - अलग होना (Act of leaving or separating)
Breaking - तोड़ना (To separate suddenly into pieces)
Connecting - जोड़ना (To join or link things together)
Detaching - अलग करना (To remove something from what it is joined to)
Hence, 'Connecting' is the most suitable antonym for 'Dividing'.
oa:
This word refers to the act of leaving or separating. Since it describes the process of moving away or splitting, it serves as a synonym for the concept of dividing.
Synonyms: Separating (अलग होना), Detaching (हटाना), Split (विभाजन).
Antonyms: Joining (जुड़ना), Meeting (मिलना), Connecting (जोड़ना).

This term refers to causing something to separate suddenly into pieces. It describes a violent form of dividing something, making it a synonym instead of an antonym.
Synonyms: Fracturing (तोड़ना), Shattering (चूर-चूर करना), Severing (अलग करना).
Antonyms: Fixing (ठीक करना), Mending (सुधारना), Repairing (मरम्मत करना).

This word refers to the act of joining two or more things together. It is the direct opposite of dividing, which involves separating a whole into different parts or groups.
Synonyms: Joining (जोड़ना), Linking (संबद्ध करना), Uniting (एकत्र करना).
Antonyms: Dividing (विभाजित करना), Separating (अलग करना), Detaching (अलग करना).

This term means to separate or remove something from something else that it is joined to. It acts as a synonym for the act of separating or dividing.
Synonyms: Disconnecting (विच्छेद करना), Uncoupling (अलग करना), Removing (हटाना).
Antonyms: Attaching (जोड़ना), Fastening (बाँधना), Connecting (जोड़ना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Segregate
questionsEn.s:
Segregate - अलग करना (To keep one thing separate from another)
Correlate - सह-संबंधित होना (To have a mutual relationship)
Allude - संकेत करना (To mention in a brief or indirect way)
Integrate - एकीकृत करना (To mix with and join a group or society)
Implicate - फँसाना (To show involvement in a crime or wrong)
Hence, 'Integrate' is the most suitable antonym for 'Segregate'.
oa:
This verb means to have a mutual relationship or connection, where one thing affects or depends on another. It focus on relationship rather than the act of merging groups.
Synonyms: Link (संबद्ध करना), Associate (जोड़ना), Connect (जोड़ना).
Antonyms: Disconnect (अलग करना), Separate (पृथक करना), Differ (अलग होना).

This term means to suggest or call attention to something indirectly; it means to hint. It is a term used in communication and has no connection with the separation of groups.
Synonyms: Hint (संकेत करना), Intimate (सूचित करना), Suggest (सुझाव देना).
Antonyms: State clearly (साफ कहना), Declare (घोषित करना), Proclaim (घोषणा करना).

This word means to mix with and join a society or group, or to combine parts into a whole. It serves as the correct opposite of segregate, which means to keep things separate.
Synonyms: Combine (मिलाना), Merge (एकीकृत करना), Unite (एकत्र करना).
Antonyms: Segregate (अलग करना), Isolate (अलग-थलग करना), Separate (बाँटना).

This verb means to show that someone is involved in a crime or responsible for something bad. It focus on involvement in guilt rather than on the social act of joining groups.
Synonyms: Involve (शामिल करना), Incriminate (दोषी ठहराना), Entangle (फँसाना).
Antonyms: Exonerate (दोषमुक्त करना), Absolve (बरी करना), Exclude (निकाल देना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Harmony
questionsEn.s:
Harmony - सामंजस्य / तालमेल (The state of being in agreement)
Amity - मित्रता (Friendly relations between people)
Concord - तालमेल (Agreement or harmony between groups)
Accord - सहमति (Official agreement or state of harmony)
Conflict - संघर्ष / टकराव (A serious disagreement or argument)
Hence, 'Conflict' is the most suitable antonym for 'Harmony'.
oa:
This term refers to friendly relations between people or countries. It is a direct synonym for the peaceful agreement and concord implied by harmony.
Synonyms: Friendliness (भाईचारा), Goodwill (सद्भावना), Concord (तालमेल).
Antonyms: Enmity (दुश्मनी), Hostility (शत्रुता), Discord (कलह).

This word refers to agreement or harmony between people or groups. Since it carries the same meaning of being in accord, it functions as a synonym for harmony.
Synonyms: Accord (सहमति), Unanimity (एकमतता), Harmony (सामंजस्य).
Antonyms: Discord (विवाद), Conflict (संघर्ष), Dissension (मतभेद).

This noun refers to an official agreement or a state of harmony. It focus on being in agreement, making it another strong synonym for the target word.
Synonyms: Consent (सहमति), Treaty (समझौता), Harmony (तालमेल).
Antonyms: Disagreement (असहमत), Conflict (टकराव), Denial (अस्वीकार).

This term refers to a serious disagreement or argument, or a clash of opposing needs. it is the direct opposite of harmony, which involves a state of agreement and peace.
Synonyms: Strife (संघर्ष), Discord (कलह), Friction (अनबन).
Antonyms: Harmony (सामंजस्य), Peace (शांति), Accord (सहमति).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Elated
questionsEn.s:
Elated - प्रफुल्लित (Ecstatically happy and excited)
Excited - उत्साहित (Very enthusiastic and eager)
Thrilled - रोमांचित (Sudden feeling of excitement and pleasure)
Depressed - उदास (In a state of unhappiness or hopelessness)
Proud - गर्वित (Feeling deep pleasure in achievements)
Hence, 'Depressed' is the most suitable antonym for 'Elated'.
oa:
This term describes a state of being very enthusiastic and eager. It serves as a synonym for the high-spirited and happy feeling of being elated.
Synonyms: Thrilled (रोमांचित), Animated (जोशीला), Eager (उत्सुक).
Antonyms: Bored (ऊबा हुआ), Apathetic (उदासीन), Calm (शांत).

This word describes a sudden feeling of extreme excitement and pleasure. Since it mirrors the ecstatic happiness of being elated, it functions as a synonym.
Synonyms: Delighted (प्रसन्न), Elated (उल्लसित), Overjoyed (गदगद).
Antonyms: Depressed (उदास), Disappointed (निराश), Unmoved (अप्रभावित).

This word characterizes a state of extreme unhappiness, hopelessness, or despondency. It serves as the direct opposite of elated, which means being ecstatically happy.
Synonyms: Miserable (दयनीय), Gloomy (उदास), Dejected (खिन्न).
Antonyms: Elated (प्रफुल्लित), Happy (खुश), Cheerful (हर्षित).

This term refers to feeling deep pleasure or satisfaction as a result of one's achievements. While positive, it focuses on self-esteem rather than the pure ecstatic joy of being elated.
Synonyms: Arrogant (अभिमानी), Satisfied (संतुष्ट), Haughty (घमंडी).
Antonyms: Ashamed (लज्जित), Humble (विनम्र), Modest (विनीत).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Hope
questionsEn.s:
Hope - आशा (Wanting something to happen and thinking it might)
Chance - संभावना (A possibility or opportunity)
Courage - साहस (Ability to do something that frightens one)
Doubt - संदेह (A feeling of uncertainty or lack of belief)
Optimism - आशावाद (Hopefulness and confidence about the future)
Hence, 'Doubt' is the most suitable antonym for 'Hope'.
oa:
This noun refers to a possibility of something happening or an opportunity. It describes the likelihood of an event rather than the internal feeling of desiring it to be true.
Synonyms: Possibility (संभावना), Opportunity (अवसर), Probability (प्रायिकता).
Antonyms: Impossibility (असंभव), Certainty (निश्चितता), Fate (भाग्य).

This term refers to the ability to do something that frightens one; bravery. While it supports hopeful action, it focuses on strength in the face of fear rather than the expectation of a positive outcome.
Synonyms: Bravery (साहस), Fortitude (धैर्य), Valor (वीरता).
Antonyms: Cowardice (कायरता), Fear (डर), Timidity (डरपोकपन).

This word refers to a feeling of uncertainty or a lack of conviction; it means not knowing what to believe. It is the direct opposite of hope, which involves wanting and expecting something to be true.
Synonyms: Uncertainty (अनिश्चितता), Hesitation (संकोच), Skepticism (संदेह).
Antonyms: Hope (आशा), Certainty (निश्चितता), Trust (विश्वास).

This term refers to hopefulness and confidence about the future or the success of something. It is a direct synonym for the core essence of hope and cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Hopefulness (आशावाद), Confidence (विश्वास), Positivity (सकारात्मकता).
Antonyms: Pessimism (निराशावाद), Doubt (संदेह), Despair (निराशा).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Putrefy
questionsEn.s:
Putrefy - सड़ना (To go through decomposition; decay)
Destroy - नष्ट करना (To end the existence of something)
Contaminate - प्रदूषित करना (To make something impure or dirty)
Combine - जोड़ना / मिलाना (To come together to form a single unit)
Decompose - गलना / सड़ना (To decay or break down chemically)
Hence, 'Combine' is the most suitable antonym for 'Putrefy'.
oa:
This verb means to end the existence of something by damaging or attacking it. While related to ending a state, it focus on demolition rather than the chemical process of decaying or building up.
Synonyms: Ruin (विनाश करना), Demolish (ध्वस्त करना), Wreck (बर्बाद करना).
Antonyms: Create (बनाना), Build (निर्माण करना), Construct (स्थापित करना).

This word means to make something impure or dirty by exposure to a polluting substance. It aligns with the "spoiling" nature of putrefying, acting as a synonym.
Synonyms: Pollute (प्रदूषित करना), Infect (संक्रमित करना), Defile (दूषित करना).
Antonyms: Purify (शुद्ध करना), Cleanse (साफ करना), Sanitize (कीटाणुरहित करना).

This word means to join or merge to form a single unit or to come together. In the context of decomposition (which breaks things down), combining serves as an antonym involving integration.
Synonyms: Unite (जोड़ना), Merge (मिलाना), Integrate (एकीकृत करना).
Antonyms: Separate (अलग करना), Decompose (सड़ना), Putrefy (सड़ना).

This verb means to decay or to break down into smaller parts through chemical or biological processes. It is a direct synonym for putrefy and therefore fails as an opposite.
Synonyms: Putrefy (सड़ना), Rot (गलना), Decay (क्षय होना).
Antonyms: Combine (जुड़ना), Preserve (बचाना), Synthesize (संश्लेषित करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Censure
questionsEn.s:
Censure - निंदा / भर्त्सना (Strong and formal disapproval)
Contempt - तिरस्कार (Feeling that someone is worthless)
Applause - प्रशंसा / शाबाशी (Approval or praise expressed by clapping)
Blunder - बड़ी भूल (A stupid or careless mistake)
Fault - दोष (Imperfection or mistake in character/action)
Hence, 'Applause' is the most suitable antonym for 'Censure'.
oa:
This noun refers to a feeling that someone or something is worthless or beneath consideration. It represents a negative attitude similar to censure rather than a contrast.
Synonyms: Disdain (तिरस्कार), Scorn (घृणा), Mockery (उपहास).
Antonyms: Respect (सम्मान), Regard (आदर), Approbation (स्वीकृति).

This term refers to approval or praise expressed by clapping or verbal acknowledgement. It is the direct opposite of censure, which involves strong and formal disapproval.
Synonyms: Praise (प्रशंसा), Acclamation (अभिनंदन), Commendation (सराहना).
Antonyms: Censure (निंदा), Criticism (आलोचना), Hissing (धिक्कारना).

This noun refers to a stupid or careless mistake. It describes an error that might lead to censure, but it does not represent the act of praising or approving.
Synonyms: Mistake (गलती), Error (भूल), Slip-up (चूक).
Antonyms: Accuracy (शुद्धता), Success (सफलता), Precision (सटीकता).

This term refers to an imperfection in a person's character or a mistake in an action. While related to the reason for censure, it describes the flaw itself rather than an opposite response.
Synonyms: Defect (दोष), Flaw (त्रुटि), Shortcoming (कमी).
Antonyms: Virtue (गुण), Strength (खूबी), Perfection (पूर्णता).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Triumph
questionsEn.s:
Triumph - विजय / सफलता (The state of being victorious or successful)
Pride - गर्व (Feeling of pleasure in achievements)
Joy - खुशी (A feeling of great happiness)
Celebration - उत्सव (Act of marking a special happy event)
Failure - असफलता (Lack of success or reaching a goal)
Hence, 'Failure' is the most suitable antonym for 'Triumph'.
oa:
This term refers to a feeling of deep pleasure or satisfaction in one's own achievements. Since it is the primary emotion resulting from a triumph, it acts as a synonym for the feeling of victory.
Synonyms: Satisfaction (संतोष), Self-esteem (आत्मसम्मान), Arrogance (अभिमान).
Antonyms: Humility (विनम्रता), Shame (शर्म), Modesty (नम्रता).

This word refers to a feeling of great happiness. While it accompanies a triumph, it focus on the internal emotion rather than providing a direct opposite to the outcome of winning.
Synonyms: Delight (प्रसन्नता), Happiness (खुशी), Mirth (आनंद).
Antonyms: Sorrow (दुःख), Misery (कष्ट), Gloom (उदासी).

This noun refers to the act of doing something enjoyable to mark a special occasion. It is an activity that follows a triumph, making it a related term rather than an antonym.
Synonyms: Festivity (उत्सव), Party (समारोह), Commemoration (उत्सव).
Antonyms: Mourning (शोक), Fasting (उपवास), Silence (मौन).

This word refers to a lack of success or the inability to achieve a desired aim. It is the direct opposite of triumph, which signifies the state of being victorious or successful.
Synonyms: Defeat (हार), Collapse (पतन), Loss (असफलता).
Antonyms: Triumph (विजय), Success (सफलता), Victory (जीत).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Fecund
questionsEn.s:
Fecund - उपजाऊ (Capable of producing an abundance of offspring)
Genial - हँसमुख (Friendly and cheerful)
Polite - शिष्ट (Showing respectful behavior)
Rude - असभ्य (Offensively impolite or bad-mannered)
Barren - बंजर / बाँझ (Too poor to produce vegetation; infertile)
Hence, 'Barren' is the most suitable antonym for 'Fecund'.
oa:
This word describes a person who is friendly and cheerful. It focus on a person's social temperament rather than their capability to produce offspring or vegetation.
Synonyms: Amiable (सुशील), Friendly (मिलनसार), Affable (हँसमुख).
Antonyms: Surly (चिड़चिड़ा), Hostile (शत्रुतापूर्ण), Morose (उदास).

This term refers to having behavior that is respectful and considerate of other people. It focus on manners and social etiquette, which is unrelated to the biological concept of fertility.
Synonyms: Courteous (सभ्य), Respectful (सम्मानपूर्ण), Mannerly (शिष्ट).
Antonyms: Rude (अशिष्ट), Impolite (अभद्र), Boorish (गंवार).

This word describes behavior that is offensively impolite or bad-mannered. It characterizes a negative social interaction rather than the productivity or fertility of a thing.
Synonyms: Impolite (असभ्य), Insolent (धृष्ट), Churlish (अशिष्ट).
Antonyms: Polite (विनम्र), Gracious (सुशील), Courteous (शिष्ट).

This word describes land that is too poor to produce vegetation or a person unable to have children; it means infertile. It is the direct opposite of fecund.
Synonyms: Sterile (बाँझ), Unproductive (अनुर्वर), Arid (शुष्क).
Antonyms: Fecund (उपजाऊ), Fertile (उर्वर), Prolific (प्रचुर).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Conceited
questionsEn.s:
Conceited - अहंकारी (Excessively proud of oneself; vain)
Proud - गर्वित (Feeling pleasure in achievements)
Vain - घमंडी (Having an excessively high opinion of self)
Modest - विनम्र (Unassuming about one's own abilities)
Superior - श्रेष्ठ (Higher in rank, status, or quality)
Hence, 'Modest' is the most suitable antonym for 'Conceited'.
oa:
This term refers to feeling deep pleasure or satisfaction in one's achievements. Since it characterizes a person who thinks highly of themselves, it acts as a synonym for being conceited.
Synonyms: Arrogant (अभिमानी), Haughty (घमंडी), Vain (अहंकारी).
Antonyms: Humble (विनम्र), Modest (विनीत), Ashamed (लज्जित).

This word describes someone who has an excessively high opinion of their appearance or worth. It is a direct synonym for conceited and therefore cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Narcissistic (आत्ममुग्ध), Conceited (अहंकारी), Egotistical (घमंडी).
Antonyms: Modest (नम्र), Humble (विनम्र), Self-effacing (दब्बू).

This word describes someone who is unassuming in the estimation of their abilities or achievements; they do not boast. It is the direct opposite of being conceited.
Synonyms: Humble (विनीत), Unpretentious (दिखावा रहित), Meek (नम्र).
Antonyms: Conceited (अहंकारी), Arrogant (घमंडी), Vain (अहंकारी).

This term refers to being higher in rank, status, or quality. While conceited people often feel superior, the word itself focus on rank rather than the personality trait of being vain.
Synonyms: Excellent (उत्कृष्ट), Better (बेहतर), Lofty (उच्च).
Antonyms: Inferior (निम्न), Junior (कनिष्ठ), Mediocre (सामान्य).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Comfort
questionsEn.s:
Comfort - आराम (State of physical ease and freedom from pain)
Happiness - खुशी (State of being happy)
Discontentment - असंतोष (Lack of satisfaction; dissatisfaction)
Luxury - विलासिता (State of great comfort involving expense)
Enjoyment - आनंद (Process of taking pleasure in something)
Hence, 'Discontentment' is the most suitable antonym for 'Comfort'.
oa:
This term refers to a state of being happy or content. Since it describes a positive emotional state similar to being comfortable, it functions as a synonym.
Synonyms: Joy (हर्ष), Delight (प्रसन्नता), Bliss (परमानंद).
Antonyms: Sadness (उदासी), Misery (कष्ट), Sorrow (दुःख).

This word refers to a lack of satisfaction or a feeling of being unhappy with one's situation. It is the direct opposite of the physical and mental ease implied by comfort.
Synonyms: Dissatisfaction (असंतोष), Restlessness (बेचैनी), Unease (असुविधा).
Antonyms: Comfort (आराम), Contentment (संतोष), Peace (शांति).

This noun refers to a state of great comfort and elegance, usually involving great expense. It describes an elevated level of comfort, making it a synonym instead of an antonym.
Synonyms: Opulence (वैभव), Wealth (धन), Splendor (शान).
Antonyms: Poverty (गरीबी), Penury (दरिद्रता), Austerity (सादगी).

This term refers to the state or process of taking pleasure in something. Since it aligns with the pleasant feeling associated with comfort, it acts as a synonym.
Synonyms: Pleasure (आनंद), Gratification (तृप्ति), Delight (मज़ा).
Antonyms: Suffering (कष्ट), Pain (पीड़ा), Misery (दुःख).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Obese
questionsEn.s:
Obese - बहुत मोटा (Grossly fat or overweight)
Slim - पतला (Gracefully thin or slender)
Large - बड़ा (Of considerable size or amount)
Stout - थुलथुल / मोटा (Rather fat or of heavy build)
Greasy - तैलीय / चिपचिपा (Covered with oil or insincerely polite)
Hence, 'Slim' is the most suitable antonym for 'Obese'.
oa:
This word describes a person who is gracefully thin or slender. It is the direct physical opposite of obese, which refers to being grossly fat or overweight.
Synonyms: Slender (पतला), Lean (दुबला), Thin (सींकिया).
Antonyms: Obese (मोटा), Fat (स्थूल), Stout (थुलथुल).

This term refers to something of considerable size or quantity. Since it describes a state of being big, it acts as a synonym for the heavy build of an obese person.
Synonyms: Big (बड़ा), Enormous (विशाल), Massive (भारी).
Antonyms: Small (छोटा), Tiny (सूक्ष्म), Little (अल्प).

This word describes a person who is rather fat or of a heavy build. It is a synonym for the overweight nature of being obese and therefore is not its opposite.
Synonyms: Plump (गोल-मटोल), Portly (स्थूल), Fleshy (मांसल).
Antonyms: Thin (दुबला), Slim (पतला), Slender (पतला).

This term refers to something covered with oil or fat, or an insincerely polite manner. While fat-related, it focus on the oily texture rather than the actual weight or size of a person.
Synonyms: Oily (तैलीय), Slick (चिकना), Unctuous (चापलूसी भरा).
Antonyms: Dry (सूखा), Clean (साफ), Sincere (ईमानदार).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Expunge
questionsEn.s:
Expunge - मिटा देना (To remove or obliterate completely)
Add - जोड़ना (To join to something to increase amount)
Draw - रेखाचित्र बनाना (To produce a picture or pull)
Omit - छोड़ देना (To leave out or exclude)
Wipe - साफ करना / पोंछना (To clean by rubbing with a cloth)
Hence, 'Add' is the most suitable antonym for 'Expunge'.
oa:
This verb means to join something to something else to increase the size or number. It serves as the direct opposite of expunge, which involves removing or erasing something completely.
Synonyms: Include (शामिल करना), Insert (डालना), Attach (जोड़ना).
Antonyms: Expunge (मिटाना), Delete (हटाना), Remove (निकालना).

This term refers to producing a picture with a pencil or pulling something. While it involves creating a mark, it is a creative process that does not directly contrast the act of total removal.
Synonyms: Sketch (रेखाचित्र बनाना), Pull (खींचना), Attract (आकर्षित करना).
Antonyms: Push (धकेलना), Repel (विकर्षित करना), Erase (मिटाना).

This verb means to leave out or exclude someone or something, either on purpose or by mistake. Since it involves not including something, it functions as a synonym for expunging.
Synonyms: Exclude (निकालना), Skip (छोड़ना), Neglect (उपेक्षा करना).
Antonyms: Include (शामिल करना), Mention (जिक्र करना), Insert (डालना).

This verb refers to cleaning or drying something by rubbing it with a cloth. In the context of "wiping out," it acts as a synonym for the act of erasing or removing something.
Synonyms: Clean (साफ करना), Erase (मिटाना), Rub (रगड़ना).
Antonyms: Stain (गंदा करना), Dirty (गंदा करना), Smudge (धब्बा लगाना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Sabotage
questionsEn.s:
Sabotage - जान-बूझकर तोड़-फोड़ (Deliberately destroying or damaging)
Damage - नुकसान (To spoil or harm something)
Cripple - अपंग करना (To seriously damage or harm)
Destroy - नष्ट करना (To damage so badly it cannot be used)
Create - बनाना (To bring something into existence)
Hence, 'Create' is the most suitable antonym for 'Sabotage'.
oa:
This term refers to spoiling or harming something, often by breaking it. It is a direct synonym for the act of sabotaging something so that it does not work correctly.
Synonyms: Harm (नुकसान पहुँचाना), Impair (बिगाड़ना), Mar (खराब करना).
Antonyms: Repair (सुधारना), Fix (ठीक करना), Mend (सुधारना).

This verb means to seriously damage or harm someone or something. Since it involve making something unable to function properly, it functions as a synonym for sabotage.
Synonyms: Paralyse (अपंग करना), Disable (अशक्त करना), Enfeeble (कमजोर करना).
Antonyms: Strengthen (मजबूत करना), Mobilize (सक्रिय करना), Support (सहारा देना).

This word refers to damaging something so badly that it can no longer be used. It is a strong synonym for the destructive nature of sabotage and is not an opposite.
Synonyms: Ruin (बर्बाद करना), Demolish (ध्वस्त करना), Obliterate (मिटा देना).
Antonyms: Create (बनाना), Build (निर्माण करना), Restore (बहाल करना).

This verb means to bring something into existence or to make something new. It serves as the direct opposite of sabotage, which involves deliberately destroying existing things.
Synonyms: Produce (उत्पन्न करना), Build (बनाना), Invent (आविष्कार करना).
Antonyms: Destroy (नष्ट करना), Sabotage (तोड़-फोड़ करना), Demolish (ढहाना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Lavish
questionsEn.s:
Lavish - अतिव्ययी / भव्य (Going beyond normal limits; luxurious)
Excessive - अत्यधिक (Too much; too great)
Grand - शानदार (Large and impressive in size or style)
Moderate - मध्यम (Neither too much nor too little)
Generous - उदार (Larger than usual; giving freely)
Hence, 'Moderate' is the most suitable antonym for 'Lavish'.
oa:
This word describes something that is too much or beyond acceptable limits. It is a direct synonym for the extravagant and generous nature of being lavish.
Synonyms: Immoderate (अत्यधिक), Inordinate (अपरिमित), Extravagant (फिजूलखर्च).
Antonyms: Moderate (मध्यम), Scanty (अल्प), Limited (सीमित).

This term refers to something large, impressive, and magnificent. Since it mirrors the luxurious and splendid aspect of the given word, it acts as a synonym.
Synonyms: Majestic (शानदार), Splendid (भव्य), Stately (शानदार).
Antonyms: Humble (विनम्र), Modest (मामूली), Simple (सादा).

This word describes something that is average in amount; it is neither too much nor too little. It serves as the correct opposite for lavish, which means being excessive or luxurious.
Synonyms: Temperate (संयमी), Average (औसत), Balanced (संतुलित).
Antonyms: Excessive (अत्यधिक), Lavish (अतिव्ययी), Extreme (चरम).

This term refers to giving more than usual or being abundant. Like lavish, it describes a willingness to give or use a large amount of resources, making it a synonym.
Synonyms: Benevolent (उदार), Munificent (दानशील), Bountiful (प्रचुर).
Antonyms: Stingy (कंजूस), Miserly (कृपण), Mean (मतलबी).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Gradual
questionsEn.s:
Gradual - क्रमिक / मंद (Happening slowly over a long period)
Abrupt - अचानक (Sudden and unexpected)
Slow - धीमा (Moving or happening without speed)
Regular - नियमित (Done or happening often)
Gentle - सौम्य (Kind and calm)
Hence, 'Abrupt' is the most suitable antonym for 'Gradual'.
oa:
This word refers to something sudden and unexpected. It serves as the direct opposite of gradual, which describes events happening slowly or over a long period.
Synonyms: Sudden (आकस्मिक), Unexpected (अप्रत्याशित), Hasty (जल्दबाज़).
Antonyms: Gradual (क्रमिक), Slow (धीमा), Steady (नियमित).

This term describes something moving or happening without much speed. It is a direct synonym for the core meaning of gradual and therefore fails to provide an opposite.
Synonyms: Leisurely (मंद), Inching (धीरे-धीरे), Sluggish (सुस्त).
Antonyms: Fast (तेज), Rapid (तीव्र), Abrupt (अचानक).

This word refers to something done or happening often or at uniform intervals. While it focus on consistency, it does not contrast the speed or duration implied by being gradual.
Synonyms: Uniform (समान), Constant (निश्चित), Periodic (नियतकालिक).
Antonyms: Irregular (अनियमित), Sporadic (छिटपुट), Occasional (कभी-कभार).

This term describes someone or something kind and calm. While it describes a mild quality, its focus is on kindness rather than on the slow development of a process.
Synonyms: Mild (नरम), Tender (कोमल), Soft (मुलायम).
Antonyms: Harsh (कठोर), Violent (उग्र), Rough (खुरदरा).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Seize
questionsEn.s:
Seize - जकड़ना / पकड़ना (To take hold of suddenly and firmly)
Grab - झपटना (To take control suddenly or forcibly)
Catch - थामना (To take hold of something moving)
Snatch - छीनना (To get something quickly by chance)
Loosen - ढीला करना (To make something less tight)
Hence, 'Loosen' is the most suitable antonym for 'Seize'.
oa:
This verb means to take physical control of something suddenly or forcibly. It is a direct synonym for the act of seizing and therefore cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Catch (पकड़ना), Snatch (झपटना), Capture (जब्त करना).
Antonyms: Release (मुक्त करना), Drop (गिराना), Free (आज़ाद करना).

This term means to take hold of something that is moving. Since it involves the same sudden act of taking possession as seizing does, it acts as a synonym.
Synonyms: Seize (पकड़ना), Hold (थामना), Grip (जकड़ना).
Antonyms: Miss (चूकना), Lose (खोना), Let go (छोड़ देना).

This verb refers to taking something quickly using the only available chance. It mirrors the aggressive and sudden nature of the given word, making it a synonym.
Synonyms: Pluck (छीनना), Grab (झपटना), Wrest (ऐंठना).
Antonyms: Bestow (प्रदान करना), Give (देना), Return (लौटाना).

This word means to become or make something less tight or to let go of a grip. It is the direct opposite of seize, which involves taking hold of something suddenly and firmly.
Synonyms: Slacken (ढीला करना), Relax (शिथिल करना), Ease (कम करना).
Antonyms: Seize (पकड़ना), Tighten (कसना), Clench (जकड़ना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Lessen
questionsEn.s:
Lessen - कम करना (To become less or make something less)
Minimise - न्यूनतम करना (To make as small as possible)
Increase - बढ़ाना / वृद्धि (To become or make larger in amount)
Reduce - घटाना (To make smaller in quantity or size)
Decrease - घटाना (To become or make smaller)
Hence, 'Increase' is the most suitable antonym for 'Lessen'.
oa:
This term means to make something as small as possible in amount or level. It is a synonym for the act of reducing or lessening and is not an opposite.
Synonyms: Reduce (कम करना), Diminish (घटाना), Abate (कम करना).
Antonyms: Maximise (अधिकतम करना), Increase (बढ़ाना), Boost (बढ़ावा देना).

This word refers to becoming or making something larger in number or amount. It serves as the direct opposite of lessen, which means to become or make something less.
Synonyms: Augment (बढ़ाना), Raise (वृद्धि करना), Expand (फैलाना).
Antonyms: Lessen (कम करना), Decrease (घटाना), Diminish (कम करना).

This verb means to make something smaller in quantity, size, or price. Since it mirrors the exact meaning of the target word, it functions as a synonym.
Synonyms: Lessen (घटाना), Lower (कम करना), Downsize (छोटा करना).
Antonyms: Increase (बढ़ाना), Extend (विस्तार करना), Amplify (बढ़ाना).

This word refers to becoming or making something smaller or less. It is a direct synonym for lessen and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an opposite.
Synonyms: Decline (घटना), Wane (कम होना), Drop (कम होना).
Antonyms: Increase (बढ़ना), Grow (बढ़ना), Accumulate (इकट्ठा होना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Controlled
questionsEn.s:
Controlled - संयमित (Having one's feelings under control)
Guarded - सतर्क (Cautious and having reservations)
Excited - उत्तेजित (Feeling happiness and enthusiasm; not calm)
Restrained - शांत / भावहीन (Not showing strong feelings)
Calm - शांत (Not excited, worried, or angry)
Hence, 'Excited' is the most suitable antonym for 'Controlled'.
oa:
This word describes someone who is cautious or has possible reservations. While it implies a type of control over one's speech, it focus on wariness rather than being the opposite of restraint.
Synonyms: Cautious (सतर्क), Wary (सावधान), Circumspect (होशियार).
Antonyms: Open (खुला), Frank (स्पष्टवादी), Candid (निष्कपट).

This word describes a state of feeling or showing high happiness and enthusiasm; it means not being calm. It is the direct opposite of controlled, which involves keeping emotions in check.
Synonyms: Agitated (उत्तेजित), Enthusiastic (उत्साही), Frantic (बेचैन).
Antonyms: Controlled (संयमित), Calm (शांत), Composed (धीर).

This term refers to not showing strong feelings or being kept under control. It is a direct synonym for controlled and therefore fails to provide an opposite.
Synonyms: Subdued (शांत), Disciplined (अनुशासित), Suppressed (दबाया हुआ).
Antonyms: Unrestrained (अनियंत्रित), Wild (जंगली), Bold (साहसी).

This term refers to not being excited, worried, or angry; it means being quiet. Since it characterizes the steady and restricted state of being controlled, it acts as a synonym.
Synonyms: Serene (निर्मल), Tranquil (शांत), Placid (स्थिर).
Antonyms: Excited (उत्तेजित), Nervous (चिंतित), Disturbed (परेशान).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Stalwart
questionsEn.s:
Stalwart - निष्ठावान / मजबूत (Loyal, reliable, and hard-working)
Firm - दृढ़ (Able to stay in shape; steadfast)
Stout - मजबूत / मोटा (Strong and thick in build)
Robust - तगड़ा (Strong and healthy; vigorous)
Cowardly - कायर (Lacking courage or bravery)
Hence, 'Cowardly' is the most suitable antonym for 'Stalwart'.
oa:
This term describes something that stays in the same shape or a person who is steadfast. It is a synonym for the loyal and reliable nature of a stalwart supporter.
Synonyms: Resolute (दृढ़), Steadfast (अडिग), Hard (सख्त).
Antonyms: Weak (कमजोर), Fickle (अस्थिर), Wavering (डगमगाता हुआ).

This word refers to a complete lack of courage or bravery. It is the direct opposite of stalwart, which characterizes a person who is loyal, hardworking, and brave.
Synonyms: Timid (कायर), Gutless (डरपोक), Fainthearted (कमजोर दिल वाला).
Antonyms: Stalwart (निष्ठावान), Brave (बहादुर), Valiant (साहसी).

This word describes someone who is strong and thick, or rather fat. While it can describe physical strength like stalwart, it focuses on build rather than courageous loyalty.
Synonyms: Sturdy (मजबूत), Hefty (भारी-भरकम), Thick (मोटा).
Antonyms: Thin (दुबला), Slim (पतला), Weak (निर्बल).

This term describes someone who is strong and healthy; they are vigorous. Since it mirrors the sturdy and reliable qualities of a stalwart person, it functions as a synonym.
Synonyms: Strong (शक्तिशाली), Vigorous (जोशीला), Sturdy (दृढ़).
Antonyms: Frail (नाज़ुक), Feeble (कमजोर), Infirm (अशक्त).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Slur
questionsEn.s:
Slur - लांछन / कलंक (An unfair comment or insult)
Insult - अपमान (To speak or act rudely to someone)
Mixture - मिश्रण (A combination of different things)
Compliment - प्रशंसा (A statement showing admiration)
Assortment - विविधता / संग्रह (A group of different types of things)
Hence, 'Compliment' is the most suitable antonym for 'Slur'.
oa:
This term refers to speaking or acting rudely to someone to damage their reputation. It is a direct synonym for the offensive nature of a slur and therefore is not an opposite.
Synonyms: Affront (अपमान), Slander (निंदा), Barb (कटाक्ष).
Antonyms: Compliment (प्रशंसा), Praise (तारीफ), Respect (सम्मान).

This noun refers to a combination of different things. It focus on the composition of substances or items and has no connection with social remarks or reputation.
Synonyms: Blend (मिश्रण), Combination (योग), Amalgam (मिश्रण).
Antonyms: Ingredient (अवयव), Element (तत्व), Separation (विभाजन).

This word refers to a statement or action that shows admiration or praise for someone. it is the direct opposite of a slur, which is an unfair comment intended to damage an opinion.
Synonyms: Praise (तारीफ), Commendation (सराहना), Accolade (सम्मान).
Antonyms: Slur (लांछन), Insult (अपमान), Criticism (आलोचना).

This term describes a group of different things or a varied mixture. Like the word mixture, it describes the physical collection of items rather than providing a contrast to an insult.
Synonyms: Variety (विविधता), Collection (संग्रह), Array (श्रृंखला).
Antonyms: Sameness (समानता), Uniformity (एकरूपता), Individual (एकल).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Invade
questionsEn.s:
Invade - आक्रमण करना (To enter a country to subjugate or occupy it)
Surrender - आत्मसमर्पण करना (To stop resisting and submit to authority)
Attack - हमला करना (Aggressive and violent action against a place)
Seize - जब्त करना (To take hold of suddenly and forcibly)
Assault - हमला (A physical attack on someone or something)
Hence, 'surrender' is the most suitable antonym for 'Invade'.
oa:
This verb means to stop resisting an enemy and to submit to their authority. It is the direct opposite of invade, which involves entering a country forcefully to subjugate or occupy it.
Synonyms: Yield (हार मान लेना), Capitulate (समर्पण करना), Submit (झुकना).
Antonyms: Invade (आक्रमण करना), Resist (विरोध करना), Conquer (जीतना).

This term refers to an aggressive and violent action against a person or place. It is a direct synonym for the hostile entry implied by the word invade.
Synonyms: Assault (हमला करना), Storm (धावा बोलना), Aggression (आक्रमण).
Antonyms: Defend (रक्षा करना), Protect (बचाना), Retreat (पीछे हटना).

This verb means to take hold of something suddenly and forcibly, or to occupy a place. It aligns with the "occupying" part of invading, making it a synonym.
Synonyms: Capture (जब्त करना), Annex (मिला लेना), Usurp (हड़पना).
Antonyms: Release (मुक्त करना), Relinquish (त्यागना), Return (लौटाना).

This term refers to a physical attack or a violent onslaught. Since it describes the core action of an invasion, it functions as a synonym rather than an opposite.
Synonyms: Attack (हमला), Onset (आक्रमण), Strike (प्रहार).
Antonyms: Defense (रक्षा), Safeguard (बचाव), Peace (शांति).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Toxic
questionsEn.s:
Toxic - विषैला (Poisonous or harmful)
Healthy - स्वस्थ (In good health or promoting well-being)
Lethal - जानलेवा (Sufficient to cause death)
Harmful - नुकसान पहुँचाने वाला (Likely to cause harm or damage)
Venomous - विषैला (Capable of injecting venom; poisonous)
Hence, 'healthy' is the most suitable antonym for 'Toxic'.
oa:
This word refers to being in good physical condition or something that promotes well-being. It is the perfect antonym for toxic, which describes poisonous or harmful substances.
Synonyms: Wholesome (स्वास्थ्यवर्धक), Nutritious (पौष्टिक), Safe (सुरक्षित).
Antonyms: Toxic (विषैला), Lethal (घातक), Poisonous (विष भरा).

This term describes something that is sufficient to cause death. Since it mirrors the deadly and poisonous nature of being toxic, it acts as a synonym.
Synonyms: Deadly (घातक), Fatal (जानलेवा), Mortal (जानलेवा).
Antonyms: Harmless (हानिरहित), Safe (सुरक्षित), Curative (उपचारात्मक).

This word refers to something that is causing or likely to cause harm or damage. It is a direct synonym for the injurious nature of toxic substances.
Synonyms: Damaging (नुकसानदेह), Injurious (अहितकर), Detrimental (हानिकारक).
Antonyms: Beneficial (लाभकारी), Helpful (सहायक), Advantageous (फायदेमंद).

This term characterizes creatures that inject venom or substances that are poisonous. It is a strong synonym for toxic and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an opposite.
Synonyms: Poisonous (विषैला), Virulent (अत्यधिक विषैला), Malignant (घातक).
Antonyms: Non-toxic (गैर-विषाक्त), Innocuous (अहानिकर), Safe (सुरक्षित).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Delight
questionsEn.s:
Delight - आनंद / खुशी (Great pleasure, satisfaction, or happiness)
Sorrow - दुःख (A feeling of great sadness)
Joy - हर्ष (Great happiness)
Glee - उल्लास (A feeling of happiness or triumph)
Pleasure - सुखद संतोष (A feeling of happy satisfaction)
Hence, 'Sorrow' is the most suitable antonym for 'Delight'.
oa:
This noun refers to a feeling of great sadness or distress. It serves as the direct emotional opposite of delight, which is defined as a state of great pleasure or happiness.
Synonyms: Grief (शोक), Sadness (दुःख), Misery (कष्ट).
Antonyms: Joy (हर्ष), Delight (आनंद), Happiness (खुशी).

This term refers to a feeling of great pleasure and happiness. Since it mirrors the positive essence of delight, it functions as a synonym rather than an antonym.
Synonyms: Delight (आनंद), Bliss (परमानंद), Felicity (सुख).
Antonyms: Sorrow (शोक), Despair (निराशा), Gloom (उदासी).

This term refers to great delight, especially from one's own good fortune. It characterizes a high-spirited joy, making it a direct synonym for the target word.
Synonyms: Exultation (उल्लास), Mirth (आमोद-प्रमोद), Triumph (विजय उल्लास).
Antonyms: Woe (संताप), Melancholy (विषाद), Depression (अवसाद).

This word describes a feeling of happy satisfaction and enjoyment. It is a synonym for the rewarding nature of delight and cannot be used as its antonym.
Synonyms: Gratification (तृप्ति), Comfort (आराम), Satisfaction (संतोष).
Antonyms: Pain (पीड़ा), Suffering (कष्ट), Displeasure (अरुचि).

test.instructions: Standard CBT Pattern Exam. Positive Marks: +1, Negative Marks: -0.25. Total Questions: 50.

test.title: Set - 12

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Barbaric
questionsEn.s:
Barbaric - बर्बर (Extremely cruel and unpleasant)
Brutal - क्रूर (Savagely violent and inhuman)
Civilised - सभ्य (Socially and culturally advanced)
Inhuman - अमानवीय (Lacking compassion or mercy)
Cruel - निर्दयी (Willfully causing pain to others)
Hence, 'Civilised' is the most suitable antonym for 'Barbaric'.
oa:
This word describes someone or something that is savagely violent, cruel, or lacking any feelings of humanity. Since it reflects a similar negative quality as the given word, it acts as a synonym rather than an opposite.
Synonyms: Vicious (भयंकर), Ferocious (क्रूर), Ruthless (निर्दयी).
Antonyms: Gentle (सौम्य), Kind (दयालु), Compassionate (सहानुभूतिपूर्ण).

This word refers to a society or individual that has reached an advanced stage of social and cultural development, characterized by refined behavior and fairness. It is the direct opposite of barbaric, which implies being primitive or cruelly uncivilized.
Synonyms: Polished (परिष्कृत), Cultured (सुसंस्कृत), Sophisticated (सभ्य).
Antonyms: Savage (जंगली), Wild (असंस्कृत), Barbarous (क्रूर).

This term describes behavior that is lacking human qualities of compassion and mercy, often being extremely cruel. Because it shares the negative essence of the question word, it does not serve as the required opposite.
Synonyms: Atrocious (नृशंस), Heartless (बेदर्द), Cold-blooded (निर्दयी).
Antonyms: Humane (मानवीय), Merciful (दयालु), Benevolent (परोपकारी).

This word refers to willfully causing pain or suffering to others or feeling no concern about it. It describes the core nature of being barbaric and therefore functions as a synonym instead of an antonym.
Synonyms: Harsh (कठोर), Spiteful (द्वेषपूर्ण), Malicious (दुर्भावनापूर्ण).
Antonyms: Kind-hearted (नेक दिल), Tender (कोमल), Forgiving (क्षमाशील).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Revel
questionsEn.s:
Revel - मौज-मस्ती करना (To enjoy oneself in a lively and noisy way)
Appreciate - सराहना करना (To recognize the value of something)
Rejoice - आनंद मनाना (To feel great joy or delight)
Mourn - शोक मनाना (To feel or show deep sorrow)
Enjoy - आनंद लेना (To take pleasure in an activity)
Hence, 'Mourn' is the most suitable antonym for 'Revel'.
oa:
This word means to recognize the full worth of someone or something or to be grateful for it. While it is a positive action, it does not express the opposite of enjoying oneself in a noisy or lively way.
Synonyms: Value (महत्व देना), Admire (प्रशंसा करना), Cherish (संजोना).
Antonyms: Disparage (उपेक्षा करना), Criticize (आलोचना करना), Neglect (नजरअंदाज करना).

This word refers to feeling or showing great joy or delight. It is closely related in meaning to reveling and therefore functions as a synonym rather than an opposite.
Synonyms: Celebrate (उत्सव मनाना), Exult (हर्षित होना), Triumph (विजय उल्लास मनाना).
Antonyms: Grieve (शोक मनाना), Lament (विलाप करना), Sorrow (दुखी होना).

This word means to feel or show deep sorrow or regret for the death of someone or the loss of something. It describes a state of grief, which is the direct emotional and contextual opposite of reveling in joy.
Synonyms: Lament (विलाप करना), Grieve (शोक करना), Bewail (शोक मनाना).
Antonyms: Revel (मौज-मस्ती करना), Celebrate (जश्न मनाना), Rejoice (आनंद मनाना).

This word refers to taking delight or pleasure in an activity or occasion. It is the primary meaning of the word revel and thus serves as a synonym rather than the required antonym.
Synonyms: Relish (आनंद लेना), Delight (प्रसन्न होना), Bask (आनंद उठाना).
Antonyms: Hate (नफरत करना), Detest (घृणा करना), Loathe (अनिच्छा होना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Downcast
questionsEn.s:
Downcast - उदास (Feeling despondent or sad)
Disappointed - निराश (Saddened by unfulfilled hopes)
Distressed - व्यथित (Suffering from anxiety or pain)
Successful - सफल (Accomplishing a desired aim)
Cheerful - हँसमुख (Noticeably happy and optimistic)
Hence, 'Cheerful' is the most suitable antonym for 'Downcast'.
oa:
This word describes someone who is sad or displeased because their hopes or expectations have not been fulfilled. It is a synonym for the given word and does not provide an opposite meaning.
Synonyms: Disheartened (हतोत्साहित), Let down (निराश), Dismayed (बेचैन).
Antonyms: Satisfied (संतुष्ट), Contented (संतुष्ट), Gratified (कृतज्ञ).

This word refers to someone suffering from extreme anxiety, sorrow, or physical pain. Since it describes a negative emotional state similar to being downcast, it fails to be an antonym.
Synonyms: Troubled (परेशान), Agonized (व्यथित), Anguished (पीड़ित).
Antonyms: Calm (शांत), Serene (निर्मल), Untroubled (निश्चिंत).

This word refers to accomplishing a desired aim or result. While success can lead to happiness, the word itself describes an achievement rather than the specific emotional state of being happy or sad.
Synonyms: Victorious (विजयी), Prosperous (समृद्ध), Flourishing (फलने-फूलने वाला).
Antonyms: Failed (असफल), Defeated (पराजित), Unsuccessful (विफल).

This word describes someone who is noticeably happy, optimistic, and full of good spirits. It is the direct opposite of being downcast, which implies a state of sadness or despondency.
Synonyms: Joyful (हर्षित), Buoyant (प्रसन्नचित्त), Radiant (उज्ज्वल).
Antonyms: Gloomy (उदास), Depressed (हताश), Melancholic (विषादपूर्ण).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Raze
questionsEn.s:
Raze - पूरी तरह नष्ट करना (To completely destroy a building or town)
Comfort - आराम (State of physical ease or consolation)
Ease - आसानी (Lack of difficulty or effort)
Ruin - बर्बाद करना (To damage something badly)
Build - बनाना / निर्माण करना (To construct something)
Hence, 'Build' is the most suitable antonym for 'Raze'.
oa:
This word refers to a state of physical ease or the act of providing consolation to someone in distress. It has no logical connection to the physical destruction of buildings.
Synonyms: Console (दिलासा देना), Soothe (शांत करना), Relieve (राहत देना).
Antonyms: Distress (व्यथित करना), Irritate (चिढ़ाना), Torment (पीड़ा देना).

This word means the absence of difficulty or effort. While it describes a state of being, it does not relate to the act of demolishing or creating structures.
Synonyms: Simplicity (सरलता), Facility (सुविधा), Smoothness (सहजता).
Antonyms: Difficulty (कठिनाई), Effort (प्रयास), Complexity (जटिलता).

This word means to damage something so badly that it loses all its value or to destroy it completely. It is a synonym for the given word and cannot be its antonym.
Synonyms: Destroy (नष्ट करना), Devastate (तबाह करना), Demolish (ध्वस्त करना).
Antonyms: Restore (बहाल करना), Save (बचाना), Protect (सुरक्षित करना).

This word means to construct something by putting parts or materials together. It is the exact opposite of raze, which refers to the complete destruction or leveling of a building or town.
Synonyms: Construct (निर्माण करना), Erect (खड़ा करना), Create (बनाना).
Antonyms: Demolish (ध्वस्त करना), Raze (नष्ट करना), Dismantle (विघटित करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Modest
questionsEn.s:
Modest - विनम्र (Humble; not boastful about abilities)
Unhappy - दुखी (Feeling or showing sadness)
Conceited - अभिमानी (Excessively proud of oneself)
Sullen - चिड़चिड़ा (Bad-tempered and silent)
Glum - उदास (Sad and quiet)
Hence, 'Conceited' is the most suitable antonym for 'Modest'.
oa:
This word describes someone who is sad, miserable, or unfortunate. Its meaning relates to emotional state rather than the lack of vanity or pride, making it an irrelevant choice.
Synonyms: Sad (उदास), Sorrowful (शोकाकुल), Miserable (दयनीय).
Antonyms: Happy (खुश), Joyful (हर्षित), Cheerful (प्रसन्न).

This word describes a person who is excessively proud of themselves, their looks, or their abilities. It is the direct opposite of being modest, which involves being humble and unassuming.
Synonyms: Vain (घमंडी), Arrogant (अहंकारी), Egotistical (अहंवादी).
Antonyms: Humble (विनम्र), Modest (विनीत), Unassuming (नम्र).

This word refers to a person who is bad-tempered, gloomy, and silent because they are annoyed. It describes a negative disposition rather than a sense of pride or self-importance.
Synonyms: Sulky (चिड़चिड़ा), Glum (उदास), Morose (बदमिजाज).
Antonyms: Amiable (सुशील), Cheerful (हँसमुख), Sociable (मिलनसार).

This word describes someone who is sad, quiet, and disappointed. Like sullen, it focuses on a gloomy emotional state and does not address the quality of humility or pride.
Synonyms: Depressed (हताश), Dismal (निराशाजनक), Despondent (निराश).
Antonyms: Bright (प्रफुल्लित), Joyous (आनंदित), Upbeat (उत्साही).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Exonerate
questionsEn.s:
Exonerate - दोषमुक्त करना (To officially declare someone not responsible for a crime)
Exempt - छूट देना (Free from an obligation or requirement)
Absolve - मुक्त करना (Declare free from guilt or sin)
Acquit - बरी करना (State formally that a person is not guilty)
Engage - काम में लगाना (To interest, attract, or involve someone)
Hence, 'Engage' is the most suitable antonym for 'Exonerate'.
oa:
This word means to free someone from an obligation, duty, or requirement that others are subject to. While it involves "freeing," it relates to rules rather than guilt or blame.
Synonyms: Release (मुक्त करना), Spare (बख्श देना), Excuse (छूट देना).
Antonyms: Oblige (बाध्य करना), Enforce (लागू करना), Subject (अधीन करना).

This word means to formally declare someone free from guilt, sin, or responsibility. It is a direct synonym for exonerate and therefore cannot be the opposite.
Synonyms: Exculpate (निर्दोष ठहराना), Clear (बरी करना), Acquit (दोषमुक्त करना).
Antonyms: Condemn (निंदा करना), Convict (दोषी ठहराना), Blame (दोष देना).

This word means to state formally in a court of law that a person is not guilty of a crime. It is synonymous with the question word and does not satisfy the requirements.
Synonyms: Vindicate (सही साबित करना), Discharge (मुक्त करना), Release (छोड़ना).
Antonyms: Convict (दोषी सिद्ध करना), Sentence (सज़ा देना), Implicate (फँसाना).

This word means to involve someone's interest or to employ someone for a specific task. In a contextual sense, moving from being officially cleared (exonerated) to being actively involved or employed represents a shift from dismissal to involvement.
Synonyms: Involve (शामिल करना), Employ (नियुक्त करना), Occupy (व्यस्त करना).
Antonyms: Dismiss (बर्खास्त करना), Discharge (मुक्त करना), Release (छोड़ना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Obscure
questionsEn.s:
Obscure - अस्पष्ट / अज्ञात (Not easy to see or understand)
Blurred - धुंधला (Unable to be seen clearly)
Apparent - प्रकट / स्पष्ट (Clearly visible or obvious)
Cloudy - बादलों से घिरा (Full of clouds; not clear)
Veiled - छिपा हुआ (Not expressed directly or clearly)
Hence, 'Apparent' is the most suitable antonym for 'Obscure'.
oa:
This word describes something that is unable to be seen or heard clearly, often due to lack of focus or clarity. It is a synonym for the given word and fails to provide an opposite.
Synonyms: Faint (धुंधला), Indistinct (अस्पष्ट), Hazy (अस्पष्ट).
Antonyms: Sharp (तीव्र), Focused (केंद्रित), Clear (स्पष्ट).

This word refers to something that is clearly visible, understood, or obvious to the mind. It is the direct opposite of obscure, which describes things that are hidden, unknown, or difficult to perceive.
Synonyms: Obvious (स्पष्ट), Evident (प्रकट), Manifest (साफ़).
Antonyms: Hidden (छिपा हुआ), Obscure (धुंधला), Ambiguous (अस्पष्ट).

This word literally refers to a sky full of clouds or figuratively to something that is not transparent or clear. Since it implies a lack of clarity, it is synonymous with being obscure.
Synonyms: Murky (मैला), Opaque (अपारदर्शी), Nebulous (धुंधला).
Antonyms: Sunny (धूप वाला), Bright (चमकीला), Clear (साफ).

This word means something that is hidden or not expressed directly, making the meaning indirect or unclear. It functions as a synonym for obscure.
Synonyms: Concealed (गुप्त), Shrouded (ढका हुआ), Disguised (प्रच्छन्न).
Antonyms: Unmasked (प्रकट), Open (खुला), Exposed (खुला हुआ).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Devious
questionsEn.s:
Devious - चालाक / घुमावदार (Using underhand tactics to achieve goals)
Dishonest - बेईमान (Behaving in a deceitful way)
Crooked - कुटिल (Dishonest or illegal)
Crafty - धूर्त (Clever at using deceitful methods)
Sincere - सच्चा (Free from pretense or deceit)
Hence, 'Sincere' is the most suitable antonym for 'Devious'.
oa:
This word describes a person or behavior that is untrustworthy, deceitful, or insincere. Since it captures the very essence of being devious, it acts as a synonym.
Synonyms: Deceitful (कपटी), Duplicitous (छलपूर्ण), Crooked (बेईमान).
Antonyms: Honest (ईमानदार), Sincere (सच्चा), Trustworthy (विश्वसनीय).

This word refers to someone who is dishonest or illegal in their dealings. It is synonymous with the given word and does not offer the required opposite relationship.
Synonyms: Corrupt (भ्रष्ट), Unscrupulous (अनैतिक), Shady (संदिग्ध).
Antonyms: Straight (सीधा), Lawful (कानूनी), Ethical (नैतिक).

This word describes someone who is clever at achieving their aims by indirect or deceitful methods. It is a close synonym for devious and cannot be the antonym.
Synonyms: Sly (धूर्त), Wily (चालाक), Cunning (चतुर).
Antonyms: Naive (भोला), Ingenuous (निष्कपट), Artless (सरल).

This word describes someone who is free from pretense or deceit and acts from genuine feelings. It is the direct opposite of devious, which involves underhand tactics and dishonesty.
Synonyms: Genuine (वास्तविक), Forthright (स्पष्टवादी), Candid (खरा).
Antonyms: Devious (चालाक), Hypocritical (पाखंडी), Deceitful (धोखेबाज).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Occupied
questionsEn.s:
Occupied - व्यस्त / भरा हुआ (Busy or being used)
Late - देर (After the expected time)
Free - खाली / मुक्त (Not busy or not in use)
Vast - विशाल (Extremely large in size)
New - नया (Produced or discovered recently)
Hence, 'Free' is the most suitable antonym for 'Occupied'.
oa:
This word refers to doing something after the expected or usual time. It describes a temporal condition and has no connection with whether a person is busy or a space is in use.
Synonyms: Tardy (विलंबित), Overdue (अतिदेय), Delayed (देर से).
Antonyms: Early (जल्दी), Punctual (समयनिष्ठ), Prompt (तत्काल).

This word describes someone who is not busy or a place that is not being used. It is the exact opposite of occupied, which means being full, in use, or engaged in activity.
Synonyms: Available (उपलब्ध), Vacant (खाली), Unengaged (मुक्त).
Antonyms: Busy (व्यस्त), Full (भरा हुआ), Occupied (व्यस्त).

This word means of very great extent or quantity; immense. It describes the size or scale of something rather than its status of being used or busy.
Synonyms: Enormous (विशाल), Huge (बहुत बड़ा), Gigantic (विशालकाय).
Antonyms: Small (छोटा), Tiny (नन्हा), Limited (सीमित).

This word refers to something produced, introduced, or discovered recently. It indicates age or novelty rather than the state of being engaged or occupied.
Synonyms: Recent (हाल का), Modern (आधुनिक), Fresh (नया).
Antonyms: Old (पुराना), Ancient (प्राचीन), Antique (पुराना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Sober
questionsEn.s:
Sober - संयमी / नशा न किया हुआ (Not affected by alcohol; serious)
Straight - सीधा (Moving in one direction; not curved)
Calm - शांत (Peaceful and relaxed)
Drunk - नशे में (Affected by alcohol)
Unwell - बीमार (Not in good health)
Hence, 'Drunk' is the most suitable antonym for 'Sober'.
oa:
This word means extending uniformly in one direction without a curve. While it can informally mean "honest," it does not represent the opposite of a serious or non-drunk state.
Synonyms: Direct (सीधा), Unbending (अटल), Linear (रेखीय).
Antonyms: Curved (घुमावदार), Crooked (टेढ़ा), Wavy (लहरदार).

This word describes a state of being peaceful and not showing nervousness or anger. Since being sober also implies a level-headed or serious state, this word is more of a relative than an opposite.
Synonyms: Serene (शांत), Placid (निर्मल), Tranquil (शांत).
Antonyms: Agitated (उत्तेजित), Stormy (तूफानी), Frantic (बेचैन).

This word describes being affected by alcohol to the point of losing control over behavior or faculties. It is the direct physical and contextual opposite of being sober.
Synonyms: Intoxicated (नशे में), Inebriated (मदहोश), Tipsy (नशे में धुत).
Antonyms: Sober (संयमी), Teetotal (नशा न करने वाला), Abstinent (परहेज करने वाला).

This word describes a person who is ill or in poor health. It has no direct relation to the state of sobriety or intoxication and thus does not fit the required relationship.
Synonyms: Sick (बीमार), Ill (अस्वस्थ), Ailing (बीमार).
Antonyms: Healthy (स्वस्थ), Fit (तंदुरुस्त), Robust (हृष्ट-पुष्ट).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Authentic
questionsEn.s:
Authentic - प्रामाणिक (Genuine and trustworthy)
Incredible - अविश्वसनीय (Impossible or difficult to believe)
Meagre - अल्प (Lacking in quantity or quality)
Genuine - वास्तविक (Truly what something is said to be)
Notorious - कुख्यात (Famous for something bad)
Hence, 'Incredible' is the most suitable antonym for 'Authentic'.
oa:
This word describes something that is impossible or very difficult to believe. In the context of credibility, it serves as the antonym for authentic, which means trustworthy and reliable.
Synonyms: Unbelievable (अविश्वसनीय), Implausible (अकल्पनीय), Dubious (संदिग्ध).
Antonyms: Credible (विश्वसनीय), Authentic (प्रामाणिक), Plausible (संभाव्य).

This word refers to something lacking in quantity or quality; it describes an amount that is too small or inadequate. It has no relation to truth or authenticity.
Synonyms: Scanty (अल्प), Paltry (तुच्छ), Limited (सीमित).
Antonyms: Abundant (प्रचुर), Plentiful (भरपूर), Copious (अत्यधिक).

This word describes something that is truly what it is said to be; it is real and honest. This is a direct synonym of authentic and therefore cannot be the antonym.
Synonyms: Original (असली), Real (वास्तविक), Bona fide (प्रामाणिक).
Antonyms: Fake (नकली), Spurious (जाली), Counterfeit (बनावटी).

This word means being famous or well-known, typically for some bad quality or deed. It relates to reputation rather than the validity or origin of an object or statement.
Synonyms: Infamous (कुख्यात), Ill-famed (बदनाम), Scandalous (अपमानजनक).
Antonyms: Reputable (प्रतिष्ठित), Respected (सम्मानित), Famous (प्रसिद्ध).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Relay
questionsEn.s:
Relay - आगे पहुँचाना (To receive and pass on a signal or message)
Send - भेजना (To cause to go to a destination)
Pass - सौंपना (To move or hand something forward)
Spread - फैलाना (To extend over a wide area)
Hold - पकड़ कर रखना (To keep or retain in possession)
Hence, 'Hold' is the most suitable antonym for 'Relay'.
oa:
This word means to cause something to go or be taken to a particular destination. Since relaying also involves passing something on, this is more of a synonym.
Synonyms: Dispatch (भेजना), Transmit (प्रसारित करना), Convey (पहुँचाना).
Antonyms: Receive (प्राप्त करना), Keep (रखना), Hold (पकड़ना).

This word means to move or cause to move in a specified direction or to hand something to someone. It describes the action of relaying and is not an opposite.
Synonyms: Transfer (हस्तांतरित करना), Hand (देना), Circulate (फैलाना).
Antonyms: Withhold (रोकना), Retain (बनाए रखना), Stop (रुकना).

This word means to open out or extend something over a wider area. It relates to the distribution of a signal or message, making it similar in context to relay.
Synonyms: Disseminate (प्रचारित करना), Distribute (बाँटना), Escalate (बढ़ाना).
Antonyms: Collect (एकत्र करना), Compress (सिकोड़ना), Gather (इकट्ठा करना).

This word means to grasp, carry, or keep something in one's possession instead of passing it forward. It is the direct opposite of relaying, which involves passing a message or object along.
Synonyms: Retain (बनाए रखना), Keep (रखना), Grip (पकड़ना).
Antonyms: Relay (आगे बढ़ाना), Pass (देना), Release (छोड़ना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Altercation
questionsEn.s:
Altercation - विवाद / कहा-सुनी (A noisy argument or disagreement)
Quarrel - झगड़ा (A heated disagreement)
Agreement - समझौता / सहमति (Harmony in opinion or feeling)
Controversy - सार्वजनिक विवाद (A prolonged public discussion)
Argument - तर्क-वितर्क (An exchange of opposite views)
Hence, 'Agreement' is the most suitable antonym for 'Altercation'.
oa:
This word refers to a heated argument or disagreement between people who are usually on good terms. It is a direct synonym for altercation and cannot be the opposite.
Synonyms: Squabble (तकरार), Row (झगड़ा), Fight (लड़ाई).
Antonyms: Accord (सहमति), Peace (शांति), Harmony (सामंजस्य).

This word refers to a state of harmony or accordance in opinion or feeling. It is the direct opposite of an altercation, which involves noisy disagreement and conflict.
Synonyms: Consensus (आम सहमति), Concord (तालमेल), Harmony (सामंजस्य).
Antonyms: Altercation (विवाद), Discord (मतभेद), Conflict (संघर्ष).

This word describes a prolonged public disagreement or heated discussion. Because it involves conflict, it shares the same negative tone as the question word.
Synonyms: Dispute (विवाद), Debate (बहस), Contention (विवाद).
Antonyms: Agreement (सहमति), Acceptance (स्वीकृति), Unity (एकता).

This word refers to an exchange of opposite views, typically a heated or angry one. It is used interchangeably with altercation and therefore functions as a synonym.
Synonyms: Altercation (कहा-सुनी), Clash (टक्कर), Feud (झगड़ा).
Antonyms: Concurrence (सहमति), Assent (स्वीकृति), Peace (शांति).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Spacious
questionsEn.s:
Spacious - विशाल / विस्तृत (Having ample space)
Boundless - असीम (Unlimited or immense)
Extensive - व्यापक (Covering a large area)
Roomy - बड़ा (Having plenty of room)
Cramped - तंग / संकुचित (Uncomfortably small or restricted)
Hence, 'Cramped' is the most suitable antonym for 'Spacious'.
oa:
This word describes something that is unlimited or immense, having no boundaries. It serves as a synonym for spacious rather than an antonym.
Synonyms: Vast (विशाल), Infinite (अनंत), Endless (अपार).
Antonyms: Limited (सीमित), Finite (सीमित), Restricted (प्रतिबंधित).

This word means covering or affecting a large area. Since it suggests having a lot of space, it functions as a synonym for the given word.
Synonyms: Large-scale (व्यापक), Broad (चौड़ा), Wide (विस्तृत).
Antonyms: Narrow (तंग), Small (छोटा), Tiny (नन्हा).

This word is used to describe a place that has plenty of room or space. It is a direct synonym for spacious and does not provide an opposite meaning.
Synonyms: Capacious (बड़ा), Commodious (विशाल), Ample (पर्याप्त).
Antonyms: Cramped (तंग), Tight (कसा हुआ), Small (छोटा).

This word describes a space that is uncomfortably small or restricted. It is the perfect opposite of spacious, which implies having plenty of room to move.
Synonyms: Crowded (ठसाठस), Restricted (सीमित), Narrow (संकीर्ण).
Antonyms: Spacious (विशाल), Airy (हवादार), Roomy (बड़ा).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Constrict
questionsEn.s:
Constrict - सिकोड़ना / कसना (To make something tighter or narrower)
Smite - जोरदार प्रहार करना (To strike with a firm blow)
Choke - दम घोंटना (To make unable to breathe)
Stretch - फैलाना / खींचना (To pull something to make it longer or wider)
Cramp - ऐंठन (A sudden painful muscle contraction)
Hence, 'Stretch' is the most suitable antonym for 'Constrict'.
oa:
This word means to strike someone or something with a firm blow. It relates to physical impact or being affected by a feeling, which is unrelated to the concept of tightening.
Synonyms: Strike (प्रहार करना), Hit (मारना), Buffet (झकझोरना).
Antonyms: Comfort (दिलासा देना), Assist (सहायता करना), Protect (रक्षा करना).

This word means to make someone unable to breathe by stopping air from reaching the lungs. Since it involves squeezing or restricting, it is a near-synonym to constrict.
Synonyms: Strangle (गला घोंटना), Suffocate (दम घोंटना), Throttle (दबाना).
Antonyms: Breathe (साँस लेना), Release (छोड़ना), Free (मुक्त करना).

This word means to pull something so that it becomes longer or wider. It is the direct opposite of constrict, which involves making something tighter, narrower, or smaller.
Synonyms: Expand (फैलाना), Extend (बढ़ाना), Elongate (लंबा करना).
Antonyms: Constrict (सिकुड़ना), Contract (सिकुड़ना), Shrink (कम करना).

This word refers to a sudden painful involuntary contraction of a muscle. Because it involves an uncontrolled tightening or restriction, it does not serve as an opposite.
Synonyms: Spasm (ऐंठन), Contraction (संकुचन), Stiffness (कठोरता).
Antonyms: Relaxation (शिथिलता), Flexibility (लचीलापन), Ease (आराम).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Taut
questionsEn.s:
Taut - कसा हुआ / तनावपूर्ण (Stretched very tight; not loose)
Tight - तंग / कसकर (Fixed firmly; not loose)
Solid - ठोस (Hard and firm)
Strong - मजबूत (Physically powerful)
Slack - ढीला / सुस्त (Loose; not tightly stretched)
Hence, 'Slack' is the most suitable antonym for 'Taut'.
oa:
This word describes something fixed firmly in position or stretched so it is not loose. It is a direct synonym of taut and therefore cannot be the opposite.
Synonyms: Rigid (सख्त), Firm (मजबूत), Stretched (खिंचा हुआ).
Antonyms: Loose (ढीला), Slack (शिथिल), Relaxed (ढीला).

This word refers to something hard and firm, not in the form of liquid or gas. While it implies firmness, it does not describe the specific tension of a rope or wire.
Synonyms: Firm (ठोस), Stable (स्थिर), Substantial (मजबूत).
Antonyms: Liquid (तरल), Gaseous (गैसीय), Soft (कोमल).

This word describes a person or object that is physically powerful or able to withstand force. It is a positive quality but does not represent the opposite of being stretched tight.
Synonyms: Robust (हृष्ट-पुष्ट), Powerful (शक्तिशाली), Mighty (बलवान).
Antonyms: Weak (कमजोर), Feeble (निर्बल), Fragile (नाजुक).

This word means loose or not held tightly in position. It is the direct opposite of taut, which characterizes a state of being pulled or stretched very tight.
Synonyms: Loose (ढीला), Limp (शिथिल), Relaxed (तनावमुक्त).
Antonyms: Taut (कसा हुआ), Tight (तंग), Rigid (सख्त).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Famished
questionsEn.s:
Famished - अत्यंत भूखा (Extremely hungry)
Volatile - अस्थिर (Liable to change rapidly)
Hesitant - संकोची (Tentative or slow in acting)
Starved - भूखा (Suffering from hunger)
Satiated - तृप्त (Completely satisfied with food)
Hence, 'Satiated' is the most suitable antonym for 'Famished'.
oa:
This word refers to something that is liable to change rapidly and unpredictably, especially for the worse. It describes stability or mood rather than the state of hunger.
Synonyms: Unstable (अस्थिर), Erratic (अनियमित), Capricious (मनमौजी).
Antonyms: Stable (स्थिर), Constant (नियत), Steady (नियमित).

This word describes someone who is slow in acting or speaking because they are unsure. It has no connection to the physical sensation of extreme hunger.
Synonyms: Uncertain (अनिश्चित), Tentative (अनंतिम), Wavering (डगमगाता हुआ).
Antonyms: Decisive (निर्णायक), Confident (आत्मविश्वासी), Resolute (दृढ़).

This word means to suffer or die from hunger. It is a synonym for the given word famished and therefore fails to provide the required opposite.
Synonyms: Ravenous (भुखमरा), Hungry (भूखा), Empty (खाली).
Antonyms: Full (पेट भरा हुआ), Satiated (तृप्त), Satisfied (संतुष्ट).

This word means to be completely satisfied or full, especially with food or pleasure. It is the exact opposite of famished, which describes a state of extreme hunger.
Synonyms: Full (तृप्त), Surfeited (अति तृप्त), Glutted (भरपूर).
Antonyms: Famished (भुखमरा), Hungry (भूखा), Starving (भूखा मरना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Feeble
questionsEn.s:
Feeble - कमजोर (Lacking physical strength)
Wild - जंगली (Living in natural conditions; uncontrolled)
Fickle - चंचल (Changing mind frequently)
Strong - मजबूत (Physically powerful)
Fast - तेज (Moving at high speed)
Hence, 'Strong' is the most suitable antonym for 'Feeble'.
oa:
This word refers to animals or plants living in their natural environment or behavior that is uncontrolled. It does not address the physical weakness implied by the given word.
Synonyms: Untamed (जंगली), Unrestrained (अनियंत्रित), Savage (बर्बर).
Antonyms: Tame (पालतू), Domestic (पालतू), Calm (शांत).

This word describes someone who changes their mind or loyalties frequently and suddenly. It refers to inconsistency in character rather than physical strength.
Synonyms: Capricious (मनमौजी), Inconstant (अस्थिर), Changeable (परिवर्तनशील).
Antonyms: Constant (स्थिर), Loyal (वफादार), Steadfast (अडिग).

This word means having the power to move heavy weights or perform physically demanding tasks. It is the direct opposite of being feeble, which involves lacking physical strength.
Synonyms: Robust (मजबूत), Powerful (शक्तिशाली), Mighty (बलवान).
Antonyms: Feeble (कमजोर), Weak (निर्बल), Frail (नाजुक).

This word means moving or capable of moving at high speed. While it describes physical capability, it is not the direct opposite of the weakness associated with the word feeble.
Synonyms: Rapid (तेज़), Quick (शीघ्र), Swift (द्रुत).
Antonyms: Slow (धीमा), Sluggish (सुस्त), Tardy (विलंबित).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Admirable
questionsEn.s:
Admirable - प्रशंसनीय (Deserving of respect and approval)
Unworthy - अयोग्य / नीच (Not deserving respect or attention)
Appreciable - पर्याप्त (Large enough to be noticed)
Commendable - सराहनीय (Worthy of praise)
Lucky - भाग्यशाली (Having good luck)
Hence, 'Unworthy' is the most suitable antonym for 'Admirable'.
oa:
This word describes someone or something that does not deserve respect, attention, or merit. It is the direct opposite of admirable, which means deserving of high praise and respect.
Synonyms: Disreputable (बदनाम), Despicable (नीच), Base (अधम).
Antonyms: Worthy (योग्य), Admirable (प्रशंसनीय), Noble (महान).

This word refers to something large or important enough to be noticed or valued. It describes the scale of an effect rather than the quality of deserving admiration.
Synonyms: Significant (महत्वपूर्ण), Considerable (पर्याप्त), Noticeable (प्रत्यक्ष).
Antonyms: Negligible (नगण्य), Trivial (तुच्छ), Minor (मामूली).

This word describes an action or quality that is worthy of praise. Since it carries the same meaning as admirable, it serves as a synonym instead of an antonym.
Synonyms: Laudable (प्रशंसनीय), Meritorious (सराहनीय), Praiseworthy (प्रशंसनीय).
Antonyms: Deplorable (शोचनीय), Blameworthy (दोषी), Reprehensible (निंदनीय).

This word describes a person who has good fortune or an event that happens by chance. It relates to fate rather than the intrinsic quality of being respected or admired.
Synonyms: Fortunate (भाग्यशाली), Blessed (धन्य), Prosperous (समृद्ध).
Antonyms: Unlucky (दुर्भाग्यशाली), Hapless (अभागा), Unfortunate (अशुभ).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Primary
questionsEn.s:
Primary - मुख्य / प्रधान (Most important; main)
Secondary - गौण (Less important than the main thing)
Effective - प्रभावशाली (Successfully producing results)
Applicable - प्रासंगिक (Relevant or appropriate)
Active - सक्रिय (Involved in activity)
Hence, 'Secondary' is the most suitable antonym for 'Primary'.
oa:
This word refers to something that is less important than the main thing or follows something else in time or order. it is the direct opposite of primary, which means most important or main.
Synonyms: Auxiliary (सहायक), Minor (गौण), Subsidiary (पूरक).
Antonyms: Primary (मुख्य), Major (प्रमुख), Main (प्रधान).

This word describes something that successfully produces the intended result. It relates to the quality of performance rather than the order of importance.
Synonyms: Potent (प्रभावशाली), Efficient (कार्यकुशल), Productive (फलदायक).
Antonyms: Ineffective (बेअसर), Useless (बेकार), Fruitless (निष्फल).

This word means relevant or appropriate to a particular person or situation. It describes suitability rather than the hierarchy of importance.
Synonyms: Relevant (प्रासंगिक), Pertinent (सम्बद्ध), Suitable (उपयुक्त).
Antonyms: Irrelevant (अप्रासंगिक), Inappropriate (अनुचित), Unfit (अयोग्य).

This word describes someone or something involved in activity or characterized by energetic action. It has no direct relation to being the "main" or "first" part of something.
Synonyms: Energetic (ऊर्जावान), Lively (जीवंत), Dynamic (गतिशील).
Antonyms: Passive (निष्क्रिय), Idle (बेकार), Inactive (सुस्त).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Obdurate
questionsEn.s:
Obdurate - हठी / जिद्दी (Refusing to change one's mind)
Amenable - वशवर्ती / लचीला (Willing to be influenced or accept)
Rigid - कठोर (Not able to be changed)
Callous - निर्दयी (Not caring about others' feelings)
Secure - सुरक्षित (Free from worry or danger)
Hence, 'Amenable' is the most suitable antonym for 'Obdurate'.
oa:
This word describes someone who is happy to accept something or willing to be influenced by others. It is the direct opposite of obdurate, which implies being stubborn and refusing to change.
Synonyms: Compliant (आज्ञाकारी), Cooperative (सहयोगी), Pliable (लचीला).
Antonyms: Obdurate (हठी), Stubborn (ज़िद्दी), Intransigent (अडिग).

This word means unable to bend or unwilling to change. Since it describes a stubborn or unyielding nature, it functions as a synonym for obdurate.
Synonyms: Inflexible (कठोर), Unbending (अटल), Stiff (सख्त).
Antonyms: Flexible (लचीला), Adaptable (अनुकूलनीय), Pliant (नम्र).
