This word describes someone who does not care about the feelings or suffering of others. While it is a negative trait, it focuses on lack of sympathy rather than stubbornness.
Synonyms: Heartless (निर्दयी), Unfeeling (संवेदनाहीन), Cold (बेदर्द).
Antonyms: Kind (दयालु), Compassionate (सहानुभूतिपूर्ण), Sensitive (संवेदनशील).

This word means free from danger or doubt. It describes a state of safety or confidence and has no connection with the quality of being stubborn.
Synonyms: Safe (सुरक्षित), Protected (आरक्षित), Assured (निश्चित).
Antonyms: Insecure (असुरक्षित), Vulnerable (असुरक्षित), Risky (जोखिम भरा).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Multiple
questionsEn.s:
Multiple - बहुविध / अनेक (Involving many parts or things)
Triple - तिगुना (Having three parts)
Double - दोगुना (Twice as much)
Many - बहुत (A large number)
Single - एकल / एक (Only one)
Hence, 'Single' is the most suitable antonym for 'Multiple'.
oa:
This word means having three parts or happening three times. Since it involves more than one, it is a specific type of being multiple rather than an opposite.
Synonyms: Threefold (तिगुना), Ternary (त्रयी), Triplicate (त्रैध).
Antonyms: Single (एकल), Unique (अद्वितीय), Sole (अकेला).

This word means consisting of two parts or twice as much. Like triple, it describes a plural quantity and cannot serve as the opposite of the idea of "many."
Synonyms: Dual (दोहरा), Twin (जुड़वां), Binary (द्वैध).
Antonyms: Single (एक), Singular (एकवचन), Individual (व्यक्तिगत).

This word refers to a large number of people or things. It is a direct synonym for the given word multiple and therefore cannot be the antonym.
Synonyms: Numerous (अनेक), Abundant (प्रचुर), Myriad (असंख्य).
Antonyms: Few (कुछ), Scant (कम), None (कोई नहीं).

This word means only one or individual. It is the direct numerical and conceptual opposite of multiple, which implies having many parts or involving many things.
Synonyms: Individual (अकेला), Sole (मात्र), Solitary (एकमात्र).
Antonyms: Multiple (अनेक), Numerous (अनेक), Plural (बहुवचन).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Pliable
questionsEn.s:
Pliable - लचीला (Easily bent or flexible)
Even - समतल (Flat and smooth)
Rigid - कठोर (Unable to bend; inflexible)
Smooth - चिकना (Regular surface; free from lumps)
Bending - झुकने वाला (Action of forming a curve)
Hence, 'Rigid' is the most suitable antonym for 'Pliable'.
oa:
This word describes a surface that is flat and smooth or a situation that is equal. It does not relate to the flexibility or stiffness of a material.
Synonyms: Level (समतल), Smooth (चिकना), Uniform (एकसमान).
Antonyms: Uneven (असमान), Rough (खुरदरा), Bumpy (ऊबड़-खाबड़).

This word means unable to bend or be forced out of shape; it is stiff and inflexible. It is the direct opposite of pliable, which characterizes something easily bent.
Synonyms: Inflexible (कठोर), Stiff (सख्त), Unyielding (अटल).
Antonyms: Pliable (लचीला), Flexible (लचीला), Elastic (लोचदार).

This word describes a surface that is regular and free from lumps or projections. While a pliable material can be smooth, the word itself is not the opposite of flexible.
Synonyms: Glossy (चमकदार), Polished (चमकाया हुआ), Silky (रेशमी).
Antonyms: Rough (खुरदरा), Coarse (भद्दा), Harsh (कठोर).

This word refers to the action of shaping or forcing something into a curve. It describes the very characteristic of being pliable and is therefore a synonym.
Synonyms: Flexing (झुकना), Curving (मुड़ना), Yielding (नमना).
Antonyms: Straightening (सीधा करना), Resisting (विरोध करना), Staying (स्थिर रहना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Brittle
questionsEn.s:
Brittle - भंगुर (Hard but liable to break easily)
Crumbling - टुकड़े-टुकड़े होना (Falling apart into fragments)
Fragile - नाजुक (Easily broken or damaged)
Durable - टिकाऊ / मजबूत (Able to withstand wear or pressure)
Frail - कमजोर (Weak and delicate)
Hence, 'Durable' is the most suitable antonym for 'Brittle'.
oa:
This word describes something that is breaking or falling apart into small fragments. Since brittle objects often crumble, this word acts as a related synonym rather than an antonym.
Synonyms: Disintegrating (बिखरता हुआ), Decaying (क्षयकारी), Eroding (नष्ट होता हुआ).
Antonyms: Solidifying (जमना), Strengthening (मजबूत होना), Uniting (जुड़ना).

This word means easily broken or damaged. It is a direct synonym for brittle and cannot be used as its opposite.
Synonyms: Delicate (नाजुक), Weak (कमजोर), Flimsy (कमजोर).
Antonyms: Strong (मजबूत), Tough (कठोर), Robust (हृष्ट-पुष्ट).

This word describes something that is able to withstand wear, pressure, or damage over a long period. It is the direct opposite of brittle, which refers to something hard but liable to break easily.
Synonyms: Robust (मजबूत), Sturdy (हृष्ट-पुष्ट), Resilient (लचीला).
Antonyms: Brittle (भंगुर), Fragile (नाजुक), Flimsy (कमजोर).

This word describes someone or something that is weak and delicate. In many contexts, it is synonymous with fragile or brittle and does not provide the required opposite.
Synonyms: Feeble (निर्बल), Infirm (अशक्त), Delicate (नाज़ुक).
Antonyms: Strong (बलवान), Robust (मजबूत), Healthy (स्वस्थ).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Frenzy
questionsEn.s:
Frenzy - उन्माद (A state of uncontrolled excitement)
Rage - क्रोध (Violent uncontrollable anger)
Craze - सनक (Temporary intense enthusiasm)
Fury - रोष (Wild or violent anger)
Calm - शांत (Free from excitement or disturbance)
Hence, 'Calm' is the most suitable antonym for 'Frenzy'.
oa:
This word refers to violent, uncontrollable anger. It is a state of extreme emotional agitation, which makes it a synonym for frenzy rather than an opposite.
Synonyms: Fury (रोष), Wrath (कोप), Outrage (आक्रोश).
Antonyms: Calm (शांति), Serenity (निर्मलता), Peace (शांति).

This word refers to an enthusiastic interest or obsession with something that is often short-lived. Like frenzy, it implies a state of high excitement or lack of control.
Synonyms: Mania (सनक), Fad (धून), Obsession (जुनून).
Antonyms: Indifference (उदासीनता), Apathy (वैराग्य), Dislike (नापसंदगी).

This word describes wild or violent anger. It denotes a state of intense agitation similar to frenzy and therefore functions as a synonym.
Synonyms: Rage (क्रोध), Intensity (तीव्रता), Ferocity (उग्रता).
Antonyms: Gentleness (सौम्यता), Mildness (कोमलता), Tranquility (शांति).

This word refers to a state of being peaceful, quiet, and free from nervousness or excitement. it is the direct emotional and situational opposite of a frenzy.
Synonyms: Serenity (शांति), Tranquility (निश्चलता), Peace (अमन).
Antonyms: Frenzy (उन्माद), Agitation (उत्तेजना), Chaos (अव्यवस्था).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Graceful
questionsEn.s:
Graceful - शोभायमान (Having or showing grace or elegance)
Awkward - बेढंगा / अनाड़ी (Lacking coordination or grace)
Polite - विनम्र (Respectful and considerate)
Refined - परिष्कृत (Cultured and elegant)
Dignified - गरिमामय (Worthy of respect)
Hence, 'Awkward' is the most suitable antonym for 'Graceful'.
oa:
This word describes someone or something that lacks coordination, ease, or elegance. It is the direct opposite of graceful, which implies beauty in movement or manner.
Synonyms: Clumsy (अनाड़ी), Ungainly (भद्दा), Inelegant (अशिष्ट).
Antonyms: Graceful (शोभायमान), Adroit (निपुण), Elegant (शालीन).

This word describes behavior that is respectful and considerate. While a graceful person is often polite, the two words describe different traits (movement/manner vs. social conduct).
Synonyms: Courteous (विनम्र), Civil (सभ्य), Mannerly (शिष्ट).
Antonyms: Rude (अभद्र), Impolite (अशिष्ट), Insolent (बदतमीज).

This word describes someone who is elegant and cultured. It is a synonym for graceful in terms of social standing and manner, making it an inappropriate antonym.
Synonyms: Sophisticated (सयाना), Cultured (सुसंस्कृत), Polished (परिष्कृत).
Antonyms: Crude (अपरिष्कृत), Vulgar (भद्दा), Coarse (खुरदरा).

This word refers to having or showing a composed or serious manner that is worthy of respect. It is closer in meaning to the question word and does not provide a contrast.
Synonyms: Noble (महान), Stately (शानदार), Majestic (राजसी).
Antonyms: Undignified (अशोभनीय), Ridiculous (हास्यास्पद), Petty (तुच्छ).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Rough
questionsEn.s:
Rough - खुरदरा (Not smooth or level)
Coarse - भद्दा (Rough or harsh texture)
Thick - मोटा (Having large distance between sides)
Crude - अपरिष्कृत (Simple and basic; raw)
Smooth - चिकना (Flat surface with no lumps)
Hence, 'Smooth' is the most suitable antonym for 'Rough'.
oa:
This word describes something consisting of large pieces or having a harsh texture. It is a direct synonym for rough and cannot serve as the opposite.
Synonyms: Gritty (खुरदरा), Harsh (कठोर), Unrefined (अपरिष्कृत).
Antonyms: Fine (कोमल), Smooth (चिकना), Soft (नरम).

This word describes something solid that has a large distance between opposite sides. It relates to dimension or density rather than the texture of a surface.
Synonyms: Broad (चौड़ा), Dense (घना), Stout (मोटा).
Antonyms: Thin (पतला), Slender (दुबला), Fine (बारीक).

This word describes something simple, basic, and lacking in detail or refinement. Since it often describes a rough state, it functions as a synonym.
Synonyms: Raw (कच्चा), Natural (प्राकृतिक), Primitive (आदिम).
Antonyms: Refined (परिष्कृत), Elaborate (विस्तृत), Sophisticated (सभ्य).

This word describes a surface that is completely flat with no lumps, holes, or rough areas. It is the direct tactile opposite of the word rough.
Synonyms: Level (समतल), Polished (चमकाया हुआ), Sleek (चिकना).
Antonyms: Rough (खुरदरा), Bumpy (ऊबड़-खाबड़), Uneven (असमान).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Tenacious
questionsEn.s:
Tenacious - दृढ़ / हठी (Not likely to give up; determined)
Persistent - लगातार (Determined to continue)
Relentless - दयाहीन (Not stopping or changing)
Steadfast - अटल (Faithful and loyal)
Yielding - झुकने वाला (Inclined to give in or submit)
Hence, 'Yielding' is the most suitable antonym for 'Tenacious'.
oa:
This word describes someone determined to continue doing something even when it is difficult. It is a synonym for tenacious and does not satisfy the required relationship.
Synonyms: Dogged (हठी), Persevering (दृढ़), Constant (नियत).
Antonyms: Irresolute (दुविधा में), Wavering (अस्थिर), Weak (कमजोर).

This word describes someone who is harsh or inflexible and does not stop or change. It shares the same core idea of persistence as tenacious.
Synonyms: Unyielding (अटल), Incessant (निरंतर), Pitiless (बेदर्द).
Antonyms: Yielding (झुकने वाला), Kind (दयालु), Gentle (सौम्य).

This word refers to someone who is faithful, loyal, and unchanging in their aims. Since it reinforces the idea of being firm, it is a synonym.
Synonyms: Firm (मजबूत), Loyal (वफादार), Unwavering (अडिग).
Antonyms: Fickle (चंचल), Unreliable (अविश्वसनीय), Capricious (मनमौजी).

This word describes someone who is inclined to give in, submit, or comply with others' demands. It is the direct opposite of being tenacious, which implies holding on firmly.
Synonyms: Submissive (आज्ञाकारी), Compliant (कोमल), Pliable (लचीला).
Antonyms: Tenacious (दृढ़), Adamant (अटल), Rigid (सख्त).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Refined
questionsEn.s:
Refined - शिष्ट / परिष्कृत (Polished; showing good manners)
Miserly - कंजूस (Reluctant to spend money)
Crude - अपरिष्कृत (Raw state; lacking sophistication)
Precise - सटीक (Marked by exactness)
Genteel - सभ्य (Polite and respectable)
Hence, 'Crude' is the most suitable antonym for 'Refined'.
oa:
This word describes a person who is reluctant to spend money or share resources. It relates to stinginess rather than the lack of sophistication or elegance.
Synonyms: Stingy (कंजूस), Parsimonious (मितव्ययी), Niggardly (अल्प).
Antonyms: Generous (उदार), Munificent (बहुत उदार), Lavish (फिजूलखर्च).

This word describes something in a natural or raw state or a person lacking in sophistication and good manners. It is the direct opposite of refined, which implies being polished and elegant.
Synonyms: Unrefined (अपरिष्कृत), Coarse (भद्दा), Primitive (आदिम).
Antonyms: Refined (शिष्ट), Sophisticated (सभ्य), Polished (परिष्कृत).

This word means marked by exactness and accuracy. While a refined process can be precise, the word itself describes correctness rather than the opposite of being raw or unpolished.
Synonyms: Accurate (सटीक), Exact (शुद्ध), Specific (विशिष्ट).
Antonyms: Vague (अस्पष्ट), Inexact (अशुद्ध), Ambiguous (संदिग्ध).

This word describes someone who is polite, refined, or respectable, often in an affected way. It is a synonym for the given word and cannot be its antonym.
Synonyms: Respectable (प्रतिष्ठित), Mannerly (शिष्ट), Suave (सुविनीत).
Antonyms: Vulgar (भद्दा), Rude (अभद्र), Common (साधारण).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Proclaim
questionsEn.s:
Proclaim - घोषित करना (To announce officially or publicly)
Announce - घोषणा करना (To make a public statement)
Conceal - छिपाना (To prevent from being known; keep secret)
Exhibit - प्रदर्शन करना (To publicly display something)
Evince - प्रकट करना (To reveal the presence of a quality)
Hence, 'Conceal' is the most suitable antonym for 'Proclaim'.
oa:
This word means to make a formal public statement about a fact or intention. It describes the very essence of proclaim and therefore functions as a synonym.
Synonyms: Declare (घोषित करना), Publish (प्रकाशित करना), Broadcast (प्रसारित करना).
Antonyms: Conceal (छिपाना), Suppress (दबाना), Withhold (रोकना).

This word means to prevent something from being known or to keep it secret. It is the direct opposite of proclaiming, which involves making information known publicly.
Synonyms: Hide (छिपाना), Obscure (धुंधला करना), Mask (पर्दा डालना).
Antonyms: Reveal (प्रकट करना), Proclaim (घोषित करना), Disclose (उजागर करना).

This word means to publicly display an item or a work of art. While it involves making something visible, it relates to objects rather than the formal announcement of news or laws.
Synonyms: Show (दिखाना), Display (प्रदर्शन करना), Unveil (अननावृत करना).
Antonyms: Hide (छिपाना), Cover (ढकना), Conceal (गुप्त रखना).

This word means to reveal the presence of a quality or feeling. It is a formal term for showing or indicating something, making it a near-synonym of proclaim.
Synonyms: Manifest (प्रकट करना), Indicate (सूचित करना), Reveal (दिखाना).
Antonyms: Conceal (छिपाना), Deny (नकारना), Hide (छिपाना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Astound
questionsEn.s:
Astound - चकित कर देना (To surprise someone very much)
Confuse - उलझन में डालना (To make someone unable to think clearly)
Stun - स्तब्ध कर देना (To shock or surprise intensely)
Shock - झटका लगना (Sudden unpleasant surprise)
Clarify - स्पष्ट करना (To make something easier to understand)
Hence, 'Clarify' is the most suitable antonym for 'Astound'.
oa:
This word means to make someone unable to think clearly or to know what to do. While being astounded can lead to confusion, it describes a state of muddled thinking rather than the opposite of surprise.
Synonyms: Baffle (चकरा देना), Perplex (उलझाना), Bewilder (भ्रमित करना).
Antonyms: Clarify (स्पष्ट करना), Explain (समझाना), Enlighten (प्रबुद्ध करना).

This word means to surprise or shock someone so much that they are temporarily unable to react. It is a direct synonym for astound and therefore fails as an antonym.
Synonyms: Amaze (चकित करना), Shock (सदमा पहुँचाना), Daze (स्तब्ध करना).
Antonyms: Bore (ऊबा देना), Expect (अपेक्षा करना), Comfort (दिलासा देना).

This word refers to a sudden upsetting or surprising event. Since astound involves a similar feeling of extreme surprise, this word is a synonym.
Synonyms: Startle (चौंकाना), Appall (डराना), Jolt (झटका देना).
Antonyms: Assure (आश्वस्त करना), Calm (शांत करना), Soothe (शांत करना).

This word means to make something clear and easier to understand. It represents the opposite of the confusion or overwhelming surprise (astounding) by providing logical explanation.
Synonyms: Explain (समझाना), Elucidate (स्पष्ट करना), Simplify (सरल बनाना).
Antonyms: Confuse (उलझाना), Obscure (धुंधला करना), Astound (चकित करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Camaraderie
questionsEn.s:
Camaraderie - भाईचारा / सौहार्द (Friendship and trust among a group)
Friendship - मित्रता (A relationship between friends)
Amity - मेल-जोल (Friendly relations)
Dislike - नापसंदगी (A feeling of not liking someone)
Companionship - साहचर्य (Friendly relationship with others)
Hence, 'Dislike' is the most suitable antonym for 'Camaraderie'.
oa:
This word refers to a relationship between people who are friends. It captures the exact meaning of camaraderie and functions as a synonym.
Synonyms: Fellowship (भाईचारा), Companionship (साहचर्य), Solidarity (एकजुटता).
Antonyms: Enmity (शत्रुता), Hostility (बैर), Discord (विवाद).

This word refers to friendly relations, especially between nations. Since it describes a state of peace and friendship, it is a synonym for the given word.
Synonyms: Harmony (तालमेल), Goodwill (सद्भावना), Accord (सहमति).
Antonyms: Conflict (संघर्ष), Animosity (बैर), Hatred (नफरत).

This word refers to a feeling of not liking or approving of someone or something. It is the direct opposite of camaraderie, which implies mutual trust and friendship.
Synonyms: Aversion (घृणा), Distaste (अरुचि), Animosity (बैर).
Antonyms: Camaraderie (भाईचारा), Liking (पसंद), Affection (स्नेह).

This word refers to the pleasant feeling of having a friendly relationship with someone. It describes the state of being part of a group, making it a synonym for camaraderie.
Synonyms: Company (साथ), Association (संगठन), Comradeship (दोस्ती).
Antonyms: Isolation (अलगाव), Solitude (एकांत), Estrangement (मनमुटाव).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Criticise
questionsEn.s:
Criticise - आलोचना करना (To say what is bad or wrong)
Praise - प्रशंसा करना (To say something is good and admirable)
Disappoint - निराश करना (To fail to fulfill hopes)
Prevent - रोकना (To stop something from happening)
Forgive - क्षमा करना (To stop feeling angry for a wrong)
Hence, 'Praise' is the most suitable antonym for 'Criticise'.
oa:
This word means to express approval or admiration for someone or something. It is the direct opposite of criticizing, which involves pointing out faults or wrongs.
Synonyms: Commend (सराहना), Applaud (प्रशंसा करना), Extol (गुणगान करना).
Antonyms: Criticise (आलोचना करना), Condemn (निंदा करना), Censure (भर्त्सना करना).

This word means to fail to fulfill someone's hopes or expectations. While it is a negative outcome, it does not represent the act of judging or finding fault.
Synonyms: Let down (निराश करना), Sadden (दुखी करना), Dissatisfy (असंतुष्ट करना).
Antonyms: Satisfy (संतुष्ट करना), Delight (खुश करना), Please (प्रसन्न करना).

This word means to stop something from happening or to stop someone from doing something. It describes an action of restraint and has no relation to giving feedback or judgment.
Synonyms: Hinder (बाधा डालना), Stop (रोकना), Block (अवरुद्ध करना).
Antonyms: Allow (अनुमति देना), Permit (इजाजत देना), Facilitate (सुगम बनाना).

This word means to stop feeling angry towards someone for a wrong they have done. It involves mercy and absolution rather than the expression of admiration.
Synonyms: Pardon (क्षमा करना), Absolve (दोषमुक्त करना), Condone (माफ़ करना).
Antonyms: Blame (दोष देना), Resent (नाराजगी रखना), Condemn (निंदा करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Rely
questionsEn.s:
Rely - भरोसा करना (To trust somebody or something)
Distrust - अविश्वास करना (Lack of trust or belief)
Await - प्रतीक्षा करना (To wait for something)
Depend - निर्भर होना (To trust for support)
Move - हिलना / खिसकना (To change position)
Hence, 'Distrust' is the most suitable antonym for 'Rely'.
oa:
This word refers to a lack of trust or the feeling that someone or something cannot be believed. It is the direct opposite of relying, which involves putting faith and trust in something.
Synonyms: Doubt (संदेह करना), Suspect (शंका करना), Misbelieve (अविश्वास करना).
Antonyms: Rely (भरोसा करना), Trust (विश्वास करना), Depend (निर्भर होना).

This word means to wait for someone or something. It describes an action of expectation and has no connection with the concept of trust or dependency.
Synonyms: Wait (प्रतीक्षा करना), Expect (अपेक्षा करना), Anticipate (पूर्वानुमान लगाना).
Antonyms: Depart (चले जाना), Ignore (अनदेखा करना), Neglect (उपेक्षा करना).

This word means to be able to trust or rely on someone for support. It is a direct synonym for the given word rely and therefore cannot be the antonym.
Synonyms: Bank on (भरोसा करना), Lean on (सहारा लेना), Count on (विश्वास करना).
Antonyms: Distrust (अविश्वास करना), Independent (स्वतंत्र होना), Doubt (संदेह करना).

This word means to change position or to put something in a different place. It describes a physical action and is contextually unrelated to the concept of trust.
Synonyms: Shift (खिसकाना), Travel (यात्रा करना), Transfer (स्थानांतरित करना).
Antonyms: Stay (रुकना), Remain (ठहरना), Halt (थमना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Appal
questionsEn.s:
Appal - डराना / स्तब्ध करना (To shock or horrify)
Assure - आश्वस्त करना (To remove doubt or worry)
Alarm - घबराहट (Sudden fear or worry)
Amaze - चकित करना (To surprise greatly)
Astound - भौंचक्का करना (To surprise very much)
Hence, 'Assure' is the most suitable antonym for 'Appal'.
oa:
This word means to remove doubt or worry by making a positive declaration. It is the opposite of appal, which involves creating a state of extreme shock, horror, or distress.
Synonyms: Reassure (आश्वस्त करना), Guarantee (विश्वास दिलाना), Comfort (दिलासा देना).
Antonyms: Appal (भयभीत करना), Alarm (घबराहट पैदा करना), Distress (व्यथित करना).

This word refers to a sudden feeling of fear or worry. Since it involves creating a negative state of mind, it acts as a synonym for appal rather than an opposite.
Synonyms: Frighten (डराना), Panic (आतंकित करना), Scare (डराना).
Antonyms: Calm (शांत करना), Soothe (शांत करना), Quiet (चुप करना).

This word means to surprise someone very much. While it is usually positive, it shares the intensity of "shock" found in appal, making it a near-synonym rather than a contrast.
Synonyms: Astonish (चकित करना), Surpise (हैरान करना), Stun (स्तब्ध करना).
Antonyms: Bore (ऊबा देना), Expect (अपेक्षा करना), Calm (शांत करना).

This word means to surprise someone so greatly that they are bewildered. Like amaze, it is a synonym of the surprise aspect of appal and does not represent an antonym.
Synonyms: Stagger (भौंचक्का करना), Dumbfound (अवाक करना), Startle (चौंकाना).
Antonyms: Assure (आश्वस्त करना), Bore (ऊबा देना), Calm (शांत करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Prey
questionsEn.s:
Prey - शिकार (An animal killed and eaten by another)
Predator - शिकारी (An animal that kills and eats others)
Sufferer - पीड़ित (A person affected by illness or pain)
Loot - लूट का माल (Goods stolen during a conflict)
Game - शिकार (Wild animals hunted for food)
Hence, 'Predator' is the most suitable antonym for 'Prey'.
oa:
This word refers to an animal that naturally hunts, kills, and eats other animals. It is the exact biological and situational opposite of a prey, which is the animal being hunted.
Synonyms: Hunter (शिकारी), Killer (हत्यारा), Carnivore (मांसाहारी).
Antonyms: Prey (शिकार), Quarry (शिकार), Victim (पीड़ित).

This word refers to a person who is affected by an illness, pain, or misfortune. While a prey can be a sufferer, this word describes a state of being rather than the role of a hunter.
Synonyms: Victim (पीड़ित), Patient (रोगी), Martyr (शहीद).
Antonyms: Oppressor (उत्पीड़क), Victor (विजेता), Beneficiary (लाभार्थी).

This word refers to goods stolen from a place during a war or riot. It describes objects taken illegally and does not relate to the biological relationship between animals.
Synonyms: Booty (लूट का माल), Spoils (लूट), Plunder (लूटपाट).
Antonyms: Gift (उपहार), Donation (दान), Offering (भेंट).

This word refers to wild animals or birds hunted for sport or food. It is another way to describe prey in a sporting context, making it a synonym instead of an antonym.
Synonyms: Quarry (शिकार), Target (लक्ष्य), Kill (शिकार).
Antonyms: Hunter (शिकारी), Protector (रक्षक), Guardian (अभिभावक).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Optional
questionsEn.s:
Optional - वैकल्पिक (That you can choose or not)
Voluntary - स्वैच्छिक (Done by choice)
Compulsory - अनिवार्य (That must be done by law)
Arbitrary - मनमाना (Based on random choice)
Elective - वैकल्पिक (Chosen from a range)
Hence, 'Compulsory' is the most suitable antonym for 'Optional'.
oa:
This word means done or given because you want to do it, rather than because you are forced. It is a synonym for optional and does not provide an opposite meaning.
Synonyms: Discretionary (विवेकपूर्ण), Elective (वैकल्पिक), Optional (स्वैच्छिक).
Antonyms: Compulsory (अनिवार्य), Mandatory (अनिवार्य), Obligatory (अनिवार्य).

This word describes something that must be done because of a law, rule, or order. It is the direct opposite of optional, which implies having a choice.
Synonyms: Mandatory (अनिवार्य), Obligatory (बाध्यकारी), Required (आवश्यक).
Antonyms: Optional (वैकल्पिक), Voluntary (स्वैच्छिक), Elective (वैकल्पिक).

This word means based on random choice or personal whim rather than any logical reason or system. It relates to the nature of a decision rather than the requirement to follow it.
Synonyms: Random (मनमाना), Capricious (विचित्र), Chance (सांयोगिक).
Antonyms: Rational (तर्कसंगत), Systematic (व्यवस्थित), Consistent (संगत).

This word describes something that is chosen by election or that can be chosen by a student from a range of subjects. It functions as a synonym for optional.
Synonyms: Optional (वैकल्पिक), Selective (चयनात्मक), Chosen (चुना हुआ).
Antonyms: Compulsory (अनिवार्य), Forced (जबरन), Fixed (निश्चित).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Linger
questionsEn.s:
Linger - देर तक रुकना (To stay somewhere longer than usual)
Leave - छोड़कर जाना (To go away from a place)
Choose - चुनना (To decide on an option)
Entertain - मनोरंजन करना (To interest or amuse someone)
Annoy - परेशान करना (To make someone slightly angry)
Hence, 'Leave' is the most suitable antonym for 'Linger'.
oa:
This word means to go away from a person or place. It is the direct opposite of lingering, which involves staying in a place for longer than necessary.
Synonyms: Depart (प्रस्थान करना), Exit (निकलना), Quit (छोड़ना).
Antonyms: Stay (रुकना), Linger (देर तक रुकना), Remain (ठहरना).

This word means to decide which thing or person you want out of those available. It describes a mental decision-making process and has no relation to staying or leaving.
Synonyms: Select (चुनना), Pick (पसंद करना), Opt (चुनाव करना).
Antonyms: Reject (नकारना), Refuse (अस्वीकार करना), Discard (त्यागना).

This word means to interest or amuse someone to please them. It relates to providing enjoyment and does not address the physical act of staying in one location.
Synonyms: Amuse (मनोरंजन करना), Delight (प्रसन्न करना), Cheer (खुश करना).
Antonyms: Bore (ऊबाना), Annoy (परेशान करना), Depress (उदास करना).

This word means to make someone slightly angry or irritated. It describes an emotional reaction and is contextually unrelated to the concept of time spent in a place.
Synonyms: Irritate (चिढ़ाना), Vex (तंग करना), Bother (परेशान करना).
Antonyms: Please (खुश करना), Soothe (शांत करना), Gratify (संतुष्ट करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Clench
questionsEn.s:
Clench - जकड़ना / भींचना (To close or hold tightly)
Relax - ढीला छोड़ना / आराम देना (To become less tight or tense)
Tighten - कसना (To make something tighter)
Hold - थामना (To keep in one's hand)
Clasp - पकड़ना (To hold or fasten something)
Hence, 'Relax' is the most suitable antonym for 'Clench'.
oa:
This word means to become or make something less hard, tight, or tense. It is the direct opposite of clenching, which involves closing or holding something tightly.
Synonyms: Loosen (ढीला करना), Slacken (शिथिल करना), Unwind (तनाव कम करना).
Antonyms: Clench (जकड़ना), Tighten (कसना), Tense (तनावपूर्ण करना).

This word means to become or make something tight or tighter. Since it describes the same action as clenching, it is a synonym and cannot be the opposite.
Synonyms: Constrict (सिकुड़ना), Secure (मजबूत करना), Fasten (कसना).
Antonyms: Loosen (ढीला करना), Release (छोड़ना), Relax (ढीला छोड़ना).

This word means to take or keep something in one's hand or possession. While clenching is a type of holding, this word does not express the required opposite meaning.
Synonyms: Grasp (पकड़ना), Grip (जकड़ना), Clasp (थामना).
Antonyms: Drop (गिराना), Release (छोड़ना), Lose (खोना).

This word refers to a device for fastening things together or the act of holding something tightly. It is synonymous with the physical action of clenching.
Synonyms: Fasten (बाँधना), Clutch (पकड़ना), Embrace (गले लगाना).
Antonyms: Detach (अलग करना), Release (मुक्त करना), Unclasp (खोलना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Negligent
questionsEn.s:
Negligent - लापरवाह (Failing to take proper care)
Faithful - वफादार (Staying loyal and supportive)
Careful - सावधान (Thinking carefully to avoid mistakes)
Indifferent - उदासीन (Not interested or caring)
Strange - अजीब (Unusual or unexpected)
Hence, 'Careful' is the most suitable antonym for 'Negligent'.
oa:
This word describes someone who is loyal and supports a person or organization consistently. While being faithful involves being responsible, it is not the direct opposite of lacking care.
Synonyms: Loyal (वफादार), Devoted (समर्पित), Constant (अडिग).
Antonyms: Treacherous (विश्वासघाती), Unfaithful (बेवफा), Fickle (अस्थिर).

This word describes someone who thinks about what they are doing to avoid accidents or mistakes. It is the direct opposite of negligent, which implies a failure to take proper care.
Synonyms: Attentive (सतर्क), Wary (सावधान), Vigilant (चौकस).
Antonyms: Negligent (लापरवाह), Careless (असावधान), Heedless (बेपरवाह).

This word describes someone who is not interested in or does not care about something. Since it implies a lack of concern, it is actually a synonym for the attitude of a negligent person.
Synonyms: Apathetic (उदासीन), Unconcerned (बेपरवाह), Detached (अलग).
Antonyms: Concerned (चिंतित), Interested (उत्सुक), Involved (लिप्त).

This word describes something unusual, unexpected, or odd. It relates to the nature of an event or person rather than the amount of care taken in performing a duty.
Synonyms: Odd (अजीब), Peculiar (विचित्र), Bizarre (अनोखा).
Antonyms: Normal (सामान्य), Common (साधारण), Usual (हमेशा वाला).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Rectify
questionsEn.s:
Rectify - सुधारना / शुद्ध करना (To correct something that is wrong)
Assist - सहायता करना (To help or provide support)
Corrupt - बिगाड़ना / भ्रष्ट करना (To involve in dishonest acts; to spoil)
Select - चुनना (To choose from similar things)
Hence, 'Corrupt' is the most suitable antonym for 'Rectify'.
oa:
This word means to make something right or true by removing mistakes. It is a direct synonym for rectify and therefore fails as an antonym.
Synonyms: Amend (सुधारना), Fix (ठीक करना), Remedy (निवारण करना).
Antonyms: Corrupt (बिगाड़ना), Damage (नष्ट करना), Mar (खराब करना).

This word means to provide help or support to someone. While helping someone can involve correcting things, the word itself describes the act of aiding rather than the opposite of fixing.
Synonyms: Help (सहायता करना), Aid (मदद करना), Support (समर्थन करना).
Antonyms: Hinder (बाधा डालना), Obstruct (रोकना), Thwart (बिगाड़ना).

This word means to damage the integrity of something or to involve someone in dishonest acts. It is the opposite of rectifying, which means making something right or pure.
Synonyms: Pervert (बिगाड़ना), Contaminate (दूषित करना), Vitiate (दूषित करना).
Antonyms: Rectify (सुधारना), Purify (शुद्ध करना), Reform (सुधार करना).

This word means to choose someone or something from a number of similar things. It describes an action of choice and is contextually unrelated to the process of correcting errors.
Synonyms: Pick (चुनना), Choose (चुनाव करना), Opt (पसंद करना).
Antonyms: Reject (नकारना), Discard (त्यागना), Dismiss (खारिज करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Ransack
questionsEn.s:
Ransack - छान मारना / लूटना (To search and cause damage)
Pilfer - छिटपुट चोरी करना (To steal small items)
Raid - छापा मारना (A sudden surprise attack)
Seize - ज़ब्त करना (To take hold firmly by force)
Protect - सुरक्षित करना (To keep safe from harm)
Hence, 'Protect' is the most suitable antonym for 'Ransack'.
oa:
This word means to steal things of little value, especially in small quantities. Since ransacking also involves theft (along with damage), this word is a related synonym.
Synonyms: Filch (चोरी करना), Sneak (चुराना), Thieve (चोरी करना).
Antonyms: Give (देना), Bestow (प्रदान करना), Return (वापस करना).

This word refers to a short surprise attack on an enemy or a sudden entry into a place by police. It implies searching or attacking, which aligns with the meaning of ransacking.
Synonyms: Invasion (आक्रमण), Onslaught (हमला), Foray (धावा).
Antonyms: Retreat (पीछे हटना), Defense (रक्षा), Safeguard (सुरक्षा).

This word means to take hold of something suddenly and firmly, often by force or authority. Since it involves taking control, it is synonymous with the aggressive nature of ransacking.
Synonyms: Grab (झपटना), Capture (पकड़ना), Annex (हड़पना).
Antonyms: Release (छोड़ना), Free (मुक्त करना), Loosen (ढीला करना).

This word means to keep someone or something safe from harm, damage, or theft. It is the direct opposite of ransacking, which involves searching a place and causing damage.
Synonyms: Guard (रक्षा करना), Defend (बचाना), Safeguard (सुरक्षित करना).
Antonyms: Ransack (लूटना), Attack (हमला करना), Damage (नष्ट करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Centre
questionsEn.s:
Centre - केंद्र (The middle point of something)
Clear - स्पष्ट (Easy to see or understand)
Periphery - परिधि / बाहरी क्षेत्र (The outer edge or boundary)
Definite - निश्चित (Clearly stated and certain)
Mainstream - मुख्यधारा (Ideas considered normal by most)
Hence, 'Periphery' is the most suitable antonym for 'Centre'.
oa:
This word describes something easy to see, hear, or understand. It refers to clarity and has no spatial relationship to the idea of a middle point.
Synonyms: Transparent (पारदर्शी), Lucent (स्पष्ट), Obvious (प्रकट).
Antonyms: Opaque (अपारदर्शी), Vague (अस्पष्ट), Cloudy (धुंधला).

This word refers to the outer limits or edge of an area or object. It is the direct spatial opposite of the center, which is the middle point.
Synonyms: Boundary (सीमा), Edge (किनारा), Margin (हाशिया).
Antonyms: Centre (केंद्र), Interior (आंतरिक), Core (मूल).

This word describes something that is clearly stated or decided and free of ambiguity. It refers to certainty rather than a physical location.
Synonyms: Fixed (निश्चित), Specific (विशिष्ट), Certain (पक्का).
Antonyms: Indefinite (अनिश्चित), Vague (अस्पष्ट), Ambiguous (संदिग्ध).

This word refers to the ideas or activities that are considered normal and are shared by most people. While it implies being in the "center" of popularity, it is a social concept rather than a geometric opposite.
Synonyms: Conventional (पारंपरिक), Popular (लोकप्रिय), Regular (सामान्य).
Antonyms: Fringe (गौण), Minority (अल्पसंख्यक), Unconventional (अपरंपरागत).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Sinks
questionsEn.s:
Sinks - डूबना (To go down under the surface)
Floats - तैरना (To move on the surface of liquid)
Create - बनाना (To cause something to exist)
Parade - जुलूस (A public procession)
Strolling - टहलना (Walking in a relaxed way)
Hence, 'Floats' is the most suitable antonym for 'Sinks'.
oa:
This word means to move slowly through air or water without sinking to the bottom. It is the direct physical opposite of sinking, which involves going down under the surface.
Synonyms: Drift (तैरना), Hover (मंडराना), Glide (बहना).
Antonyms: Sink (डूबना), Submerge (जलमग्न होना), Dive (गोता लगाना).

This word means to cause something new to happen or exist. It describes an act of production and has no logical connection to the buoyancy of an object in liquid.
Synonyms: Construct (बनाना), Invent (आविष्कार करना), Generate (उत्पन्न करना).
Antonyms: Destroy (नष्ट करना), Demolish (ध्वस्त करना), Erase (मिटाना).

This word refers to a public procession or an occasion where people stand or walk in a line to be seen. It is a social event and unrelated to the concept of sinking.
Synonyms: Procession (जुलूस), March (क़वायद), Display (प्रदर्शन).
Antonyms: Dispersal (विघटन), Hide (छिपना), Retreat (वापसी).

This word means to walk in a slow, relaxed way for pleasure. It describes a type of human movement and does not serve as an opposite to a vertical movement in water.
Synonyms: Sauntering (टहलना), Wandering (भटकना), Ambling (चहलकदमी).
Antonyms: Running (दौड़ना), Hurrying (जल्दी करना), Rushing (वेग से चलना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Rebellion
questionsEn.s:
Rebellion - विद्रोह (Fighting against authority or rules)
Uprising - बगावत (An act of resistance or revolt)
Loyalty - निष्ठा (Faithfulness to commitments or authority)
Sedition - राजद्रोह (Encouraging people to act against government)
Allotment - आवंटन (The process of giving a share)
Hence, 'Loyalty' is the most suitable antonym for 'Rebellion'.
oa:
This word refers to an act of resistance or a revolt against people in power. It is a direct synonym for rebellion and therefore cannot be the antonym.
Synonyms: Revolt (विद्रोह), Mutiny (बगावत), Insurrection (राजद्रोह).
Antonyms: Submission (समर्पण), Loyalty (निष्ठा), Obedience (आज्ञाकारिता).

This word refers to faithfulness to commitments, obligations, or authority. It is the direct moral and social opposite of a rebellion, which involves fighting against authority.
Synonyms: Allegiance (निष्ठा), Fidelity (वफादारी), Devotion (समर्पण).
Antonyms: Treachery (विश्वासघात), Rebellion (विद्रोह), Betrayal (गद्दारी).

This word refers to speech or actions intended to encourage people to rebel against a government. Since it describes the cause of a rebellion, it functions as a synonym.
Synonyms: Treason (देशद्रोह), Agitation (उकसावा), Incitement (भड़काना).
Antonyms: Compliance (अनुपालन), Obedience (पालन), Support (समर्थन).

This word refers to the amount of something that someone is given or the process of sharing it. It describes distribution and has no connection with political or social revolt.
Synonyms: Allocation (आवंटन), Portion (हिस्सा), Share (भाग).
Antonyms: Retention (धारण), Refusal (अस्वीकार), Denial (इनकार).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Hospitality
questionsEn.s:
Hospitality - सत्कार (Friendly and welcoming behavior toward guests)
Complaint - शिकायत (Expression of dissatisfaction)
Cordiality - आत्मीयता (Sincere affection and kindness)
Coldness - रूखापन (Lack of warm feelings; unfriendly behavior)
Wrathful - अति क्रोधित (Full of intense anger)
Hence, 'Coldness' is the most suitable antonym for 'Hospitality'.
oa:
This word refers to a statement expressing dissatisfaction with something. While bad hospitality can lead to a complaint, the word itself is not the direct opposite of a welcoming nature.
Synonyms: Grievance (शिकायत), Objection (आपत्ति), Protest (विरोध).
Antonyms: Praise (प्रशंसा), Commendation (सराहना), Approval (स्वीकृति).

This word refers to sincere affection and kindness. It describes a welcoming and friendly manner, making it a synonym for hospitality.
Synonyms: Friendliness (मित्रता), Warmth (आत्मीयता), Amity (सौहार्द).
Antonyms: Hostility (शत्रुता), Coldness (रूखापन), Aloofness (अलगाव).

This word refers to a lack of warm feelings or unfriendly and distant behavior. It is the direct behavioral opposite of hospitality, which involves being warm and welcoming to guests.
Synonyms: Aloofness (उदासीनता), Hostility (बैर), Detachment (अलगाव).
Antonyms: Warmth (उष्णता), Hospitality (सत्कार), Kindness (दया).

This word describes someone who is full of intense anger. While an angry person is not hospitable, this word describes a specific emotion rather than the general lack of a welcoming attitude.
Synonyms: Furious (क्रुद्ध), Enraged (क्रोधित), Irate (गुस्सैल).
Antonyms: Calm (शांत), Gentle (सौम्य), Patient (धैर्यवान).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Ambition
questionsEn.s:
Ambition - महत्वाकांक्षा (A strong desire to achieve something)
Intent - इरादा (Determined to do something)
Anxiety - चिंता (Feeling of fear or dread)
Object - वस्तु / लक्ष्य (A material thing or an aim)
Laziness - आलस्य (Unwillingness to work or use effort)
Hence, 'Laziness' is the most suitable antonym for 'Ambition'.
oa:
This word refers to being determined to do something or having a specific purpose. Since having an intention is a key part of having an ambition, it functions as a synonym.
Synonyms: Purpose (उद्देश्य), Aim (लक्ष्य), Goal (लक्ष्य).
Antonyms: Hesitation (झिझक), Chance (सांयोगिक), Accident (संयोग).

This word describes a feeling of fear, dread, and uneasiness. While someone might feel anxious about achieving their goals, the word does not represent the opposite of desire or drive.
Synonyms: Worry (चिंता), Apprehension (डर), Unease (बेचैनी).
Antonyms: Calmness (शांति), Confidence (आत्मविश्वास), Serenity (निश्चलता).

This word refers to a material thing or a goal. In the sense of a target, it aligns with ambition; in the sense of a physical item, it is contextually unrelated.
Synonyms: Target (लक्ष्य), Item (वस्तु), Entity (इकाई).
Antonyms: Void (शून्यता), Concept (विचार), Idea (धारणा).

This word refers to the quality of being unwilling to work or use any effort. It is the direct behavioral opposite of ambition, which implies a strong desire and drive to achieve something.
Synonyms: Indolence (आलस्य), Idleness (बेकारी), Sloth (सुस्ती).
Antonyms: Ambition (महत्वाकांक्षा), Diligence (परिश्रम), Industry (मेहनत).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Attracts
questionsEn.s:
Attracts - आकर्षित करना (To cause someone to have interest in something)
Embodies - अवतार लेना / समाहित करना (To express or give form to an idea)
Shrouds - ढकना (To cover or conceal from view)
Elucidates - स्पष्ट करना (To explain something clearly)
Deters - रोकना / निरुत्साहित करना (To discourage someone from an action)
Hence, 'Deters' is the most suitable antonym for 'Attracts'.
oa:
This word means to be an expression of or to give a tangible form to an idea or feeling. It describes representation and has no relation to the act of drawing people toward a place.
Synonyms: Symbolizes (प्रतीक होना), Manifests (प्रकट करना), Represents (निरूपित करना).
Antonyms: Excludes (निकालना), Disembodies (अशरीर करना), Conceals (छिपाना).

This word means to cover or envelop so as to conceal from view. It relates to hiding or obscuring something rather than repelling interest.
Synonyms: Veils (पर्दा डालना), Covers (ढकना), Conceals (गुप्त रखना).
Antonyms: Reveals (उजागर करना), Exposes (खुला छोड़ना), Shows (दिखाना).

This word means to make something clear or to explain it thoroughly. It describes a cognitive or communicative process unrelated to physical or emotional attraction.
Synonyms: Clarifies (स्पष्ट करना), Explains (समझाना), Decodes (व्याख्या करना).
Antonyms: Confuses (उलझाना), Obscures (धुंधला करना), Muddle (गड़बड़ करना).

This word means to prevent or discourage someone from doing something through fear or doubt. It is the direct functional opposite of attracts, which involves drawing people toward an action or place.
Synonyms: Discourages (निरुत्साहित करना), Dissuades (रोकना), Prevents (रोकना).
Antonyms: Attracts (आकर्षित करना), Encourages (प्रोत्साहित करना), Invites (आमंत्रित करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Severe
questionsEn.s:
Severe - गंभीर (Very harsh, strict, or serious)
Withered - मुरझाया हुआ (Dry and shriveled)
Sick - बीमार (Affected by illness)
Gentle - सौम्य / कोमल (Moderate; not strong or violent)
Voracious - भुखमरा / पेटू (Very eager for food or something)
Hence, 'Gentle' is the most suitable antonym for 'Severe'.
oa:
This word describes something that has become dry and shriveled. It relates to the physical decay of plants or skin rather than the intensity of a condition or punishment.
Synonyms: Shrunken (मुरझाया हुआ), Dried (सूखा), Wilted (कुम्हलाया हुआ).
Antonyms: Fresh (ताजा), Blooming (खिला हुआ), Thriving (फलने-फूलने वाला).

This word describes someone affected by physical or mental illness. It is a negative state but does not represent the opposite of being harsh or serious.
Synonyms: Ill (बीमार), Unwell (अस्वस्थ), Ailing (बीमार).
Antonyms: Healthy (स्वस्थ), Well (ठीक), Robust (हृष्ट-पुष्ट).

This word describes something that is moderate in action, mild, and not strong or violent. It is the direct opposite of severe, which implies being harsh, extreme, or very serious.
Synonyms: Mild (हल्का), Soft (कोमल), Moderate (नरम).
Antonyms: Severe (गंभीर), Harsh (कठोर), Violent (हिंसक).

This word describes someone who is very eager for something, especially a lot of food. It relates to an insatiable appetite and has no connection with the level of severity.
Synonyms: Greedy (लालची), Insatiable (अतृप्त), Gluttonous (पेटू).
Antonyms: Satisfied (संतुष्ट), Satiated (तृप्त), Moderate (संयमी).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Humble
questionsEn.s:
Humble - विनम्र (Not proud or not believing one is important)
Dishonour - अपमान (Feeling of loss of respect)
Pleasantry - विनोद (A polite humorous remark)
Modest - विनीत (Not making one's abilities obvious)
Arrogant - अभिमानी (Unpleasantly proud and self-important)
Hence, 'Arrogant' is the most suitable antonym for 'Humble'.
oa:
This word refers to a feeling of embarrassment or the loss of people's respect. It describes a loss of status rather than a specific personality trait like pride or modesty.
Synonyms: Disgrace (अपमान), Shame (शर्म), Ignominy (बदनामी).
Antonyms: Honour (सम्मान), Respect (आदर), Glory (महिमा).

This word refers to a polite and slightly humorous remark made to help people feel relaxed. It describes a type of conversation and is contextually unrelated to humility.
Synonyms: Joke (मज़ाक), Banter (हंसी-ठिठोली), Quip (चुटकुला).
Antonyms: Insult (अपमान), Rudeness (अभद्रता), Harshness (कठोरता).

This word describes someone who does not talk too much about their own abilities. It is a direct synonym for humble and cannot serve as the required opposite.
Synonyms: Unassuming (नम्र), Lowly (विनीत), Meek (सीधा-साधा).
Antonyms: Arrogant (अभिमानी), Proud (गर्वित), Conceited (घमंडी).

This word describes someone who is unpleasantly proud and behaves as if they are more important than others. It is the direct opposite of being humble, which involves not believing one is superior.
Synonyms: Haughty (घमंडी), Proud (अभिमानी), Conceited (अहंकारी).
Antonyms: Humble (विनम्र), Modest (विनीत), Unpretentious (सादा).

test.instructions: Standard CBT Pattern Exam. Positive Marks: +1, Negative Marks: -0.25. Total Questions: 50.

test.title: Set - 13

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Laborious
questionsEn.s:
Laborious - श्रमसाध्य (Needing a lot of time and effort)
Boundless - असीम (Having no limit)
Facile - सहज / आसान (Easy; not needing effort)
Strenuous - कठिन (Needing a lot of effort)
Immense - विशाल (Extremely large in size)
Hence, 'Facile' is the most suitable antonym for 'Laborious'.
oa:
This word means having no limit or being infinite. It describes the extent of something rather than the amount of effort required to perform a task.
Synonyms: Infinite (अनंत), Endless (अपार), Limitless (असीम).
Antonyms: Limited (सीमित), Finite (निश्चित), Restricted (प्रतिबंधित).

This word describes a task that is easy or requires very little effort; it can also imply that something is superficial. It is the direct opposite of laborious, which means needing a lot of time and effort.
Synonyms: Easy (आसान), Effortless (सहज), Simple (सरल).
Antonyms: Laborious (श्रमसाध्य), Arduous (कठिन), Strenuous (जोरदार).

This word describes something that needs a great deal of physical or mental effort. Since it shares the same meaning as laborious, it functions as a synonym.
Synonyms: Arduous (कठिन), Demanding (मांगलिक), Tough (मुश्किल).
Antonyms: Easy (आसान), Facile (सहज), Simple (साधारण).

This word means extremely large in size or degree. It describes magnitude rather than the difficulty or ease of performing an action.
Synonyms: Enormous (विशाल), Huge (बहुत बड़ा), Vast (विस्तृत).
Antonyms: Tiny (नन्हा), Small (छोटा), Minute (सूक्ष्म).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Dispatch
questionsEn.s:
Dispatch - भेजना (The act of sending someone or something)
Acquire - प्राप्त करना (To obtain or begin to have something)
Transmit - प्रसारित करना (To send out signals or messages)
Deliver - पहुँचाना (To give or aim something to a recipient)
Bulletin - समाचार पत्र (A short report or news item)
Hence, 'Acquire' is the most suitable antonym for 'Dispatch'.
oa:
This word means to obtain or begin to have something. It represents the act of receiving or gaining, which is the opposite of dispatch, which means the act of sending something away.
Synonyms: Obtain (प्राप्त करना), Gain (पाना), Procure (अर्जित करना).
Antonyms: Dispatch (भेजना), Lose (खोना), Give away (दे देना).

This word means to broadcast something or carry signals using radio or television. Since it involves sending information from one place to another, it is a synonym for dispatch.
Synonyms: Send (भेजना), Convey (पहुँचाना), Broadcast (प्रसारित करना).
Antonyms: Receive (प्राप्त करना), Collect (एकत्र करना), Hold (रोकना).

This word means to give or direct something to its intended recipient. It describes the completion of a dispatch and therefore functions as a synonym.
Synonyms: Hand over (सौंपना), Distribute (बाँटना), Supply (आपूर्ति करना).
Antonyms: Retain (बनाए रखना), Withhold (रोकना), Withdraw (वापस लेना).

This word refers to a short piece of news or a report released by an organization. It is a noun describing the content being sent rather than the act of sending or receiving itself.
Synonyms: Report (विवरण), Announcement (घोषणा), Newsflash (ताज़ा समाचार).
Antonyms: Secret (गुप्त), Silence (चुप्पी), Suppression (दमन).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Exemplary
questionsEn.s:
Exemplary - आदर्श / श्रेष्ठ (Very good; serving as an example)
Flattering - चापलूसी भरा (Making someone look better than reality)
Unsatisfactory - असंतोषजनक (Not acceptable; not good enough)
Imitative - नक़ली / अनुकरणशील (Copying or following a model)
Desirable - वांछनीय (Wanted or worth having)
Hence, 'Unsatisfactory' is the most suitable antonym for 'Exemplary'.
oa:
This word describes behavior that makes someone look or sound more attractive or important than they are. It involves insincere praise and is not the opposite of being a good model.
Synonyms: Complimentary (प्रशंसात्मक), Adulatory (चापलूसी भरा), Sycophantic (चापलूस).
Antonyms: Insulting (अपमानजनक), Critical (आलोचनात्मक), Disparaging (उपेक्षापूर्ण).

This word describes something that is not acceptable or not good enough. It is the direct opposite of exemplary, which refers to something so good it serves as a model for others.
Synonyms: Inadequate (अपर्याप्त), Poor (खराब), Deficient (अपूर्ण).
Antonyms: Exemplary (आदर्श), Excellent (उत्कृष्ट), Superior (बेहतर).

This word describes something that copies or follows a model or example. While related to the concept of an "example," it describes the act of copying rather than the quality of the model.
Synonyms: Derivative (व्युत्पन्न), Mimicking (नकल उतारना), Echoing (अनुकरण करना).
Antonyms: Original (मौलिक), Creative (रचनात्मक), Inventive (अविष्कारशील).

This word describes something that is wanted by many people because it is worth having. Since exemplary things are usually desirable, this word functions as a related synonym.
Synonyms: Coveted (वांछित), Attractive (आकर्षक), Sought-after (लोकप्रिय).
Antonyms: Undesirable (अवांछनीय), Repulsive (घृणास्पद), Unwanted (अनावश्यक).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Polite
questionsEn.s:
Polite - विनम्र / शिष्ट (Having good manners and showing respect)
Pleaded - याचना की (Asked in a strong and serious way)
Mercy - दया (Kindness shown by a powerful person)
Insensitive - संवेदनहीन (Not able to feel for others)
Rude - अशिष्ट / असभ्य (Not polite)
Hence, 'Rude' is the most suitable antonym for 'Polite'.
oa:
This word means to ask someone for something in a very strong and serious way. It describes an act of earnest requesting and has no relation to the quality of manners.
Synonyms: Begged (याचना की), Appealed (अनुरोध किया), Entreated (विनती की).
Antonyms: Commanded (आदेश दिया), Demanded (मांग की), Ordered (हुक्म दिया).

This word refers to kindness shown by someone who has the power to cause suffering. It describes a quality of forgiveness rather than a lack of social manners.
Synonyms: Compassion (दया), Pity (रहम), Lenience (उदारता).
Antonyms: Cruelty (क्रूरता), Vengeance (प्रतिशोध), Harshness (कठोरता).

This word describes someone who is not able to feel or react to others' feelings. While it characterizes a rude person, it specifically refers to lack of awareness rather than the general opposite of being polite.
Synonyms: Callous (बेदर्द), Unfeeling (संवेदनाहीन), Indifferent (उदासीन).
Antonyms: Sensitive (संवेदनशील), Compassionate (दयालु), Empathetic (सहानुभूतिपूर्ण).

This word means not polite or lacking good manners. It is the direct opposite of polite, which describes someone who is well-mannered and respectful toward others.
Synonyms: Impolite (अशिष्ट), Insolent (बदतमीज), Churlish (असभ्य).
Antonyms: Polite (विनम्र), Courteous (शिष्ट), Civil (सभ्य).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Adversity
questionsEn.s:
Adversity - विपत्ति / कठिनाई (Difficulties or problems)
Fortune - भाग्य / समृद्धि (Luck; especially good luck)
Affliction - कष्ट (Cause of pain or distress)
Brilliance - बुद्धिमत्ता / चमक (Great intelligence or skill)
Penury - अत्यधिक ग़रीबी (State of being very poor)
Hence, 'Fortune' is the most suitable antonym for 'Adversity'.
oa:
This word refers to luck, especially good luck, or the attainment of wealth and success. It is the direct opposite of adversity, which describes a state of difficulties, problems, or misfortune.
Synonyms: Prosperity (समृद्धि), Success (सफलता), Luck (भाग्य).
Antonyms: Adversity (विपत्ति), Misfortune (दुर्भाग्य), Calamity (आपदा).

This word refers to a cause of persistent pain or distress. Since it describes a state of suffering similar to adversity, it functions as a synonym.
Synonyms: Suffering (पीड़ा), Distress (संकट), Misery (कष्ट).
Antonyms: Relief (राहत), Comfort (आराम), Joy (आनंद).

This word refers to great intelligence, skill, or brightness. It describes a positive intellectual or physical attribute rather than the situational state of being successful or unsuccessful.
Synonyms: Splendour (दीप्ति), Radiance (चमक), Genius (प्रतिभा).
Antonyms: Dullness (धुंधलापन), Stupidity (मूर्खता), Darkness (अंधेरा).

This word refers to the state of being extremely poor. Because extreme poverty is a type of adversity, this word is a specific synonym rather than an antonym.
Synonyms: Destitution (दरिद्रता), Indigence (गरीबी), Want (अभाव).
Antonyms: Wealth (धन), Affluence (सम्पन्नता), Riches (अमीरी).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Ancient
questionsEn.s:
Ancient - प्राचीन (Belonging to the very distant past)
Multiple - एकाधिक (Involving several parts or members)
Modern - आधुनिक (Relating to the present or recent times)
Slow - धीमा (Moving at a low speed)
Primitive - आदिम (Relating to an early stage)
Hence, 'Modern' is the most suitable antonym for 'Ancient'.
oa:
This word refers to having or involving several parts, elements, or members. It describes quantity or complexity and has no chronological relationship with being old or new.
Synonyms: Various (विभिन्न), Manifold (अनेक), Numerous (अनेक).
Antonyms: Single (एकल), Unique (अद्वितीय), Sole (मात्र).

This word refers to the present or recent times as opposed to the remote past. It is the direct temporal opposite of ancient, which describes things from the very distant past.
Synonyms: Contemporary (समकालीन), Recent (हाल का), New (नया).
Antonyms: Ancient (प्राचीन), Archaic (पुराना), Antique (पुराना).

This word means moving or operating at a low speed. It describes velocity or pace and is contextually unrelated to the age of an object or period.
Synonyms: Sluggish (सुस्त), Gradual (क्रमिक), Tardy (विलंबित).
Antonyms: Fast (तेज़), Rapid (शीघ्र), Swift (द्रुत).

This word describes something relating to an early stage in development or something ancient. It functions as a synonym for the given word and cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Primal (आदिम), Ancient (पुराना), Early (प्रारंभिक).
Antonyms: Advanced (उन्नत), Modern (आधुनिक), Sophisticated (सभ्य).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Consent
questionsEn.s:
Consent - अनुमति / सहमति (Permission or agreement for something)
Dissent - मतभेद / असहमति (Strong disagreement with an opinion)
Variety - विविधता (Quality of having different forms)
Integrity - अखंडता / सत्यनिष्ठा (Quality of being honest)
Sanction - मंजूरी (Official permission for an action)
Hence, 'Dissent' is the most suitable antonym for 'Consent'.
oa:
This word refers to a strong disagreement or dissatisfaction with a decision or opinion. It is the direct opposite of consent, which implies giving permission or agreeing to something.
Synonyms: Disagreement (असहमति), Opposition (विरोध), Objection (आपत्ति).
Antonyms: Consent (अनुमति), Agreement (सहमति), Assent (स्वीकृति).

This word refers to the quality of having different forms or types. It describes diversity and has no connection with the act of giving or withholding permission.
Synonyms: Diversity (विविधता), Range (विस्तार), Assortment (विविधता).
Antonyms: Uniformity (एकरूपता), Sameness (समानता), Monotony (नीरसता).

This word refers to the quality of being honest and having strong moral principles. It describes character rather than the act of reaching an agreement.
Synonyms: Honesty (ईमानदारी), Probity (सत्यनिष्ठा), Rectitude (नैतिकता).
Antonyms: Deceit (छल), Dishonesty (बेईमानी), Corruption (भ्रष्टाचार).

This word refers to official permission or approval for an action. Since it means giving the go-ahead for something, it is a synonym for consent instead of an antonym.
Synonyms: Authorization (प्राधिकरण), Approval (मंजूरी), Permit (अनुमति).
Antonyms: Prohibition (निषेध), Ban (प्रतिबंध), Veto (वीटो).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Valour
questionsEn.s:
Valour - वीरता / साहस (Great courage in the face of danger)
Forbearance - धैर्य (Patient self-control; restraint)
Erudition - विद्वत्ता (Great knowledge or learning)
Cowardice - कायरता (Behavior showing a lack of bravery)
Idiosyncrasy - व्यक्तिगत विशेषता (Peculiar behavior or quirk)
Hence, 'Cowardice' is the most suitable antonym for 'Valour'.
oa:
This word refers to the quality of being patient and being able to forgive or control oneself in a difficult situation. While it is a virtue, it does not represent the direct opposite of bravery.
Synonyms: Patience (धैर्य), Tolerance (सहनशीलता), Restraint (संयम).
Antonyms: Impatience (अधीरता), Intolerance (असहनशीलता), Agitation (उत्तेजना).

This word refers to the quality of having or showing great knowledge or learning. It describes intellectual depth and is unrelated to the physical or moral courage described by valour.
Synonyms: Scholarship (विद्वत्ता), Knowledge (ज्ञान), Learning (विद्या).
Antonyms: Ignorance (अज्ञानता), Illiteracy (निरक्षरता), Unawareness (अनभिज्ञता).

This word refers to behavior that shows a total lack of bravery and an excessive desire to avoid danger. It is the direct opposite of valour, which implies great courage in the face of danger.
Synonyms: Timidity (भीरुता), Fearfulness (डर), Poltroonery (कायरता).
Antonyms: Valour (वीरता), Bravery (साहस), Courage (हिम्मत).

This word refers to a mode of behavior or a way of thought that is peculiar to an individual. It describes an eccentricity and has no relationship to courage or fear.
Synonyms: Peculiarity (अजीबोगरीब आदत), Quirk (विलक्षणता), Eccentricity (सनक).
Antonyms: Normality (सामान्यता), Convention (परंपरा), Conformity (अनुरूपता).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Guilty
questionsEn.s:
Guilty - दोषी (Responsible for a wrongdoing)
Remnant - अवशेष (A small left-over piece)
Innocent - निर्दोष (Not guilty of a crime or offense)
Nonchalant - बेपरवाह (Behaving in a calm, relaxed manner)
Omnipotent - सर्वशक्तिमान (Having unlimited power)
Hence, 'Innocent' is the most suitable antonym for 'Guilty'.
oa:
This word refers to a small piece or amount of something that is left over from a larger original part. It describes a physical quantity and is unrelated to legal or moral culpability.
Synonyms: Residue (अवशेष), Leavings (बचा-खुचा), Fragment (टुकड़ा).
Antonyms: Whole (संपूर्ण), Bulk (अधिकांश), Entirety (कुल).

This word means not guilty of a crime or offense. It is the direct opposite of guilty, which implies being responsible for or culpable of a specified wrongdoing.
Synonyms: Blameless (निर्दोष), Faultless (त्रुटिहीन), Pure (पवित्र).
Antonyms: Guilty (दोषी), Culpable (दोषी), Criminal (अपराधी).

This word describes someone who is behaving in a calm and relaxed manner, showing no worry or enthusiasm. It describes an attitude rather than the status of innocence.
Synonyms: Unconcerned (बेपरवाह), Casual (लापरवाह), Indifferent (उदासीन).
Antonyms: Anxious (चिंतित), Concerned (चिंतित), Eager (उत्सुक).

This word describes someone who has unlimited power or authority. It is usually used in a theological or political context and has no relation to guilt or innocence.
Synonyms: Almighty (सर्वशक्तिमान), All-powerful (सर्वशक्तिमान), Supreme (सर्वोच्च).
Antonyms: Weak (कमजोर), Powerless (शक्तिहीन), Impotent (अशक्त).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Ruthlessly
questionsEn.s:
Ruthlessly - निर्दयता से (Without pity or compassion)
Leniently - नरमी से (In a mild and tolerant manner)
Indifferently - उदासीनता से (Characterized by lack of interest)
Unscrupulously - अनैतिक रूप से (In a dishonest or unfair manner)
Tyrannically - तानाशाही से (In a cruel and oppressive manner)
Hence, 'Leniently' is the most suitable antonym for 'Ruthlessly'.
oa:
This word means acting in a mild, tolerant, and merciful manner. It is the direct opposite of ruthlessly, which involves acting without pity, compassion, or mercy.
Synonyms: Mercifully (दयालुता से), Mildly (नरमी से), Compassionately (सहानुभूतिपूर्वक).
Antonyms: Ruthlessly (निर्दयता से), Harshly (कठोरता से), Severely (शक्ति से).

This word describes acting with a lack of interest, excitement, or care. While an indifferent person may not be kind, the word does not explicitly capture the opposite of being pitiless.
Synonyms: Apathetically (उदासीनता से), Casually (लापरवाही से), Neutrally (तटस्थ भाव से).
Antonyms: Passionately (जोश से), Eagerly (उत्सुकता से), Concernedly (चिंतापूर्वक).

This word means acting in a manner that lacks moral principles or honesty. Since it describes a negative and unfair way of behaving, it aligns with being ruthless rather than opposing it.
Synonyms: Dishonestly (बेईमानी से), Deceitfully (छल से), Immorally (अनैतिक रूप से).
Antonyms: Honestly (ईमानदारी से), Ethically (नैतिकता से), Fairly (निष्पक्षता से).

This word describes acting in a cruel and oppressive way, especially by an absolute ruler. It is a synonym for acting ruthlessly and therefore fails to be an antonym.
Synonyms: Oppressively (दमनकारी रूप से), Autocratically (निरंकुशता से), Dictatorially (तानाशाही से).
Antonyms: Democratically (लोकतांत्रिक रूप से), Liberally (उदारता से), Fairly (उचित तरीके से).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Cease
questionsEn.s:
Cease - समाप्त करना / रुकना (To bring or come to an end)
Origin - स्रोत / उद्गम (The point where something begins)
Halt - पड़ाव / रुकावट (A suspension of movement)
Produce - उत्पादन करना (To make or manufacture something)
Begin - शुरू करना (To start an action or activity)
Hence, 'Begin' is the most suitable antonym for 'Cease'.
oa:
This word refers to the point or place where something begins or is derived. While it relates to a beginning, it is a noun describing a source rather than a verb describing the act of starting.
Synonyms: Source (स्रोत), Root (जड़), Beginning (शुरुआत).
Antonyms: End (अंत), Termination (समाप्ति), Conclusion (निष्कर्ष).

This word means a suspension of movement or activity. It is a direct synonym for cease, as both imply stopping an ongoing process.
Synonyms: Stop (रुकना), Pause (विराम), Discontinue (बंद करना).
Antonyms: Continue (जारी रखना), Proceed (आगे बढ़ना), Start (शुरू करना).

This word means to make or manufacture something from raw materials. It describes an act of creation but does not specifically address the chronological opposite of ending a process.
Synonyms: Create (बनाना), Manufacture (उत्पादन करना), Yield (उत्पन्न करना).
Antonyms: Destroy (नष्ट करना), Consume (उपभोग करना), Ruin (बर्बाद करना).

This word means to start or undergo the first part of an action or activity. It is the direct functional opposite of cease, which means to bring something to an end.
Synonyms: Start (शुरू करना), Initiate (आरंभ करना), Commence (प्रारंभ करना).
Antonyms: Cease (समाप्त करना), Stop (रोकना), Finish (खत्म करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Continued
questionsEn.s:
Continued - जारी रखा (Lasting without interruption)
Ongoing - चल रहा है (Continuing to exist or happen)
Played - खेला गया (Engaged in an activity for fun)
Stopped - रुक गया (To cause an action to end)
Disregarded - उपेक्षित (Lack of consideration or respect)
Hence, 'stopped' is the most suitable antonym for 'continued'.
oa:
This word describes something that is currently in progress or continuing to exist. It is a direct synonym for continued and therefore cannot be the opposite.
Synonyms: Constant (निरंतर), Persistent (लगातार), Sustained (जारी).
Antonyms: Stopped (रुका हुआ), Finished (समाप्त), Interrupted (बाधित).

This word refers to engaging in activity for enjoyment or performing in a sport. It describes an action but does not address the status of whether that action is ongoing or has stopped.
Synonyms: Performed (प्रस्तुत किया), Participated (भाग लिया), Enacted (अभिनीत).
Antonyms: Refrained (परहेज किया), Avoided (बचा), Ignored (उपेक्षा की).

This word means to cause an action, process, or event to come to an end. It is the direct opposite of continued, which implies that a process is lasting without interruption.
Synonyms: Ceased (समाप्त), Halted (रुका हुआ), Terminated (खत्म).
Antonyms: Continued (जारी), Started (शुरू किया), Resumed (पुनः आरंभ).

This word means lacking consideration or respect for something. It describes an attitude of neglect and is not the chronological or functional opposite of staying in progress.
Synonyms: Ignored (नजरअंदाज), Overlooked (अनदेखा), Neglected (उपेक्षित).
Antonyms: Noticed (देखा), Considered (विचारा), Heeded (ध्यान दिया).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Immoral
questionsEn.s:
Immoral - अनैतिक (Not conforming to standards of morality)
Degree - मात्रा / स्तर (The amount or level of something)
Decent - शालीन / सभ्य (Conforming with moral standards)
Illness - बीमारी (A state of being sick)
Region - क्षेत्र (A particular area or part)
Hence, 'Decent' is the most suitable antonym for 'Immoral'.
oa:
This word refers to an amount, level, or extent to which something happens. It describes a measurement and has no connection with the concept of right and wrong behavior.
Synonyms: Level (स्तर), Extent (सीमा), Grade (श्रेणी).
Antonyms: None (कोई नहीं), Zero (शून्य).

This word describes behavior that conforms to generally accepted standards of respectability or morality. It is the direct moral opposite of being immoral, which implies a lack of ethics.
Synonyms: Moral (नैतिक), Virtuous (सदाचारी), Ethical (नीतिपरक).
Antonyms: Immoral (अनैतिक), Corrupt (भ्रष्ट), Indecent (अश्लील).

This word refers to a disease or a period of sickness affecting the body or mind. It describes a physical or mental health condition and is unrelated to moral principles.
Synonyms: Sickness (बीमारी), Disease (रोग), Ailment (व्याधि).
Antonyms: Health (स्वास्थ्य), Wellness (तंदुरुस्ती), Fitness (चुस्ती).

This word refers to a particular area or part of a surface or country. It describes a geographical or spatial concept and has no relation to ethics or conduct.
Synonyms: Area (क्षेत्र), Zone (क्षेत्र), Territory (प्रदेश).
Antonyms: Whole (संपूर्ण), Everywhere (सर्वत्र).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Intrinsic
questionsEn.s:
Intrinsic - आंतरिक (An essential or basic characteristic)
Elemental - मौलिक (Constituting basic parts)
Introjected - अंतर्मुखी (Internalizing beliefs of others)
Extrinsic - बाहरी / अनावश्यक (Operating from outside; not essential)
Inherent - अंतर्निहित (Essential part of something else)
Hence, 'Extrinsic' is the most suitable antonym for 'Intrinsic'.
oa:
This word relates to the basic or essential parts of something. Since intrinsic qualities are also fundamental, this word serves as a synonym instead of an antonym.
Synonyms: Basic (बुनियादी), Fundamental (मौलिक), Primary (प्रमुख).
Antonyms: Complex (जटिल), Advanced (उन्नत), Extrinsic (बाहरी).

This word refers to the unconscious adoption of the ideas or attitudes of others. It describes a psychological process of internalization and does not specifically contrast with being "inherent."
Synonyms: Internalized (आंतरिक), Absorbed (अवशोषित), Integrated (एकीकृत).
Antonyms: Rejected (नकारा हुआ), Externalized (बाह्यीकृत), Projected (प्रक्षेपित).

This word describes something that is not part of the essential nature of someone or something and comes from the outside. It is the direct opposite of intrinsic, which means inherent or internal.
Synonyms: External (बाहरी), Foreign (विदेशी), Alien (अजनबी).
Antonyms: Intrinsic (आंतरिक), Inherent (अंतर्निहित), Innate (जन्मजात).

This word describes something that is an essential and permanent part of something else. It is a direct synonym for intrinsic and therefore cannot be the opposite.
Synonyms: Innate (जन्मजात), Natural (प्राकृतिक), Internal (आंतरिक).
Antonyms: Acquired (अर्जित), Extrinsic (बाहरी), Extraneous (अनावश्यक).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Identify
questionsEn.s:
Identify - पहचानना (To recognize or distinguish something)
Overlook - अनदेखा करना (To fail to notice or recognize)
Anonymous - अज्ञात / अनाम (Unknown or lacking an identity)
Spot - पता लगाना (To see or notice something suddenly)
Classify - वर्गीकृत करना (To arrange things into groups)
Hence, 'overlook' is the most suitable antonym for 'identify'.
oa:
This word describes something or someone whose name or identity is unknown or not made public. It is an adjective describing a state of being, rather than the act of failing to recognize.
Synonyms: Nameless (अनाम), Unknown (अज्ञात), Unidentified (अपरिचित).
Antonyms: Identified (पहचाना हुआ), Known (ज्ञात), Named (नामित).

This word means to see or notice something, especially when it is difficult to see. It is a synonym for identify in the sense of picking someone or something out from a group.
Synonyms: Locate (पता लगाना), Discern (पहचानना), Detect (ढूँढना).
Antonyms: Miss (चूकना), Overlook (अनदेखा करना), Ignore (उपेक्षा करना).

This word means to arrange things into groups based on their similarities or characteristics. It is a systematic way of identifying but does not provide an opposite meaning.
Synonyms: Categorize (श्रेणीबद्ध करना), Sort (छाँटना), Group (समूह बनाना).
Antonyms: Disorganize (अव्यवस्थित करना), Mix (मिलाना), Confuse (उलझाना).

This word means to fail to notice or recognize something or someone, whether intentionally or accidentally. It is the direct functional opposite of the act of identifying.
Synonyms: Ignore (नजरअंदाज करना), Neglect (उपेक्षा करना), Miss (अनदेखा करना).
Antonyms: Identify (पहचानना), Notice (ध्यान देना), Observe (देखना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Persuade
questionsEn.s:
Persuade - राजी करना (To convince someone to do something)
Discourage - हतोत्साहित करना (To cause someone to lose confidence)
Clade - जीव-वर्ग (A group with a common ancestor)
Propagandize - प्रचार करना (To promote a cause in a biased way)
Influence - प्रभाव (The power to affect someone's behavior)
Hence, 'Discourage' is the most suitable antonym for 'persuade'.
oa:
This word is a biological term referring to a group of organisms sharing a common ancestor. It has no linguistic or behavioral relationship with the act of convincing someone.
Synonyms: Group (समूह), Category (वर्ग), Lineage (वंश).
Antonyms: Individual (व्यक्तिगत), Single (एकल).

This word means to promote or publicize a particular cause or view, often in a biased or misleading way. It describes a method of persuasion and is not an opposite.
Synonyms: Publicize (प्रचार करना), Promote (बढ़ावा देना), Brainwash (मस्तिष्क प्रक्षालन).
Antonyms: Hide (छिपाना), Suppress (दबाना), Conceal (गुप्त रखना).

This word means to cause someone to lose confidence or enthusiasm or to deter them from performing an action. It is the direct behavioral opposite of persuading someone to do something.
Synonyms: Deter (रोकना), Dissuade (मना करना), Dishearten (हतोत्साहित करना).
Antonyms: Persuade (राजी करना), Encourage (प्रोत्साहित करना), Inspire (प्रेरित करना).

This word refers to having an effect on the character, development, or behavior of someone. It is a synonym for the process of persuasion rather than an antonym.
Synonyms: Sway (प्रभावित करना), Affect (असर डालना), Impress (प्रभाव डालना).
Antonyms: Disregard (उपेक्षा करना), Neglect (नजरअंदाज करना), Impede (बाधा डालना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Trivial
questionsEn.s:
Trivial - नगण्य / तुच्छ (Something of little value or importance)
Underrated - कम आँका गया (Not valued highly enough)
Kind - दयालु (Generous and helpful)
Problematic - समस्यात्मक (Causing difficulty or hard to deal with)
Serious - गंभीर (Demanding careful consideration)
Hence, 'serious' is the most suitable antonym for 'Trivial'.
oa:
This word describes something that is not rated or valued highly enough. It relates to the perception of value rather than the intrinsic lack of importance described by "trivial."
Synonyms: Undervalued (कम आँका गया), Underestimated (अल्पाकलित), Unappreciated (असराहनीय).
Antonyms: Overrated (अति-आकलित), Praised (प्रशंसित), Exaggerated (अतिशयोक्तिपूर्ण).

This word describes a person who is generous, helpful, and caring about others' feelings. It describes a personality trait and is contextually unrelated to the importance of an issue.
Synonyms: Benevolent (दयालु), Gracious (विनीत), Considerate (विचारशील).
Antonyms: Cruel (क्रूर), Mean (मतलबी), Harsh (कठोर).

This word describes something that causes difficulty or is hard to deal with. While a trivial issue is easy to ignore, a problematic one is difficult, but it is not the direct opposite of "unimportant."
Synonyms: Difficult (कठिन), Troublesome (परेशान करने वाला), Complex (जटिल).
Antonyms: Easy (आसान), Simple (सरल), Manageable (सुलभ).

This word describes something that demands careful consideration because it is important or dangerous. It is the direct contextual opposite of trivial, which refers to things of little value.
Synonyms: Important (महत्वपूर्ण), Weighty (वजनी), Grave (गंभीर).
Antonyms: Trivial (तुच्छ), Minor (मामूली), Insignificant (नगण्य).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Leisure
questionsEn.s:
Leisure - खाली समय / आराम (Use of free time for enjoyment)
Working - काम करना (The action of doing work)
Growth - विकास (The process of increasing in size)
Restricted - सीमित (Limited in extent or scope)
Development - विकास / प्रगति (The process of being developed)
Hence, 'working' is the most suitable antonym for 'leisure'.
oa:
This word refers to the process of increasing in physical size or complexity. It describes development and does not represent the opposite of having free time for enjoyment.
Synonyms: Development (विकास), Increase (बढ़ोतरी), Expansion (विस्तार).
Antonyms: Decline (गिरावट), Shrinkage (संकुचन), Stagnation (ठहराव).

This word refers to the action of doing work or being engaged in an occupation. It is the direct situational opposite of leisure, which implies a state of being free from work duties.
Synonyms: Laboring (परिश्रम), Employment (रोजगार), Activity (कार्य).
Antonyms: Leisure (आराम), Idleness (बेकारी), Retirement (सेवानिवृत्ति).

This word describes something that is limited in extent, number, or scope. It characterizes a limitation rather than the state of being busy or working.
Synonyms: Limited (सीमित), Constrained (बाधित), Bound (नियत).
Antonyms: Free (मुक्त), Unlimited (असीमित), Open (खुला).

This word refers to the process of developing or being developed. Like growth, it describes a positive change in status rather than the chronological opposite of free time.
Synonyms: Evolution (उद्विकास), Progression (प्रगति), Advancement (उन्नति).
Antonyms: Regression (वापसी), Deterioration (गिरावट), Decay (क्षय).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Cogent
questionsEn.s:
Cogent - ठोस / प्रभावशाली (Clear, logical, and convincing)
Compelling - सम्मोहक (Irresistibly interesting or strong)
Unconvincing - अविश्वसनीय (Failing to make someone believe)
Pertinent - प्रासंगिक (Relevant or applicable)
Unexpected - अप्रत्याशित (Not regarded as likely to happen)
Hence, 'Unconvincing' is the most suitable antonym for 'Cogent'.
oa:
This word describes something that evokes interest or admiration in an irresistible way. It is a synonym for cogent, as both describe arguments that are very strong and convincing.
Synonyms: Persuasive (प्रेरक), Strong (मजबूत), Convincing (कायम करने वाला).
Antonyms: Unconvincing (अविश्वसनीय), Weak (कमजोर), Feeble (निर्बल).

This word describes something that fails to make someone believe that a statement is true or valid. It is the direct opposite of cogent, which means clear, logical, and convincing.
Synonyms: Weak (कमजोर), Feeble (निर्बल), Implausible (अकल्पनीय).
Antonyms: Cogent (ठोस), Logical (तर्कसंगत), Persuasive (प्रेरक).

This word describes something that is relevant or applicable to a particular matter. While a cogent argument is often pertinent, the word itself describes relevance rather than the power to convince.
Synonyms: Relevant (प्रासंगिक), Apposite (उपयुक्त), Germane (सम्बद्ध).
Antonyms: Irrelevant (अप्रासंगिक), Inapplicable (अनुचित), Extraneous (अनावश्यक).

This word describes something that is not regarded as likely to happen. It refers to surprise rather than the logical strength of an argument or a case.
Synonyms: Sudden (अचानक), Unforeseen (अप्रत्याशित), Abrupt (आकस्मिक).
Antonyms: Expected (अपेक्षित), Predicted (पूर्वानुमानित), Foreseen (ज्ञात).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Undesirable
questionsEn.s:
Undesirable - अवांछनीय (Not wanted; harmful or unpleasant)
Advisable - उचित / प्रशंसनीय (Sensible and to be recommended)
Foolish - मूर्खतापूर्ण (Lacking good sense or judgement)
Unadvisable - अनुचित (Not capable of being advised)
Meek - नम्र / दब्बू (Quiet, gentle, and submissive)
Hence, 'advisable' is the most suitable antonym for 'undesirable'.
oa:
This word describes an action that is sensible and recommended because it is beneficial. It is the direct opposite of undesirable, which refers to something that is harmful or unwanted.
Synonyms: Commendable (सराहनीय), Prudent (विवेकपूर्ण), Proper (उचित).
Antonyms: Inadvisable (अनुचित), Foolish (बेवकूफी भरा), Risky (जोखिम भरा).
