This word describes a lack of good sense or judgment. While an undesirable act can be foolish, the word does not represent the direct opposite of being unwanted or harmful.
Synonyms: Unwise (नासमझ), Silly (मूर्खतापूर्ण), Asinine (बुद्धिहीन).
Antonyms: Wise (बुद्धिमान), Sensible (समझदार), Sage (ज्ञानी).

This word refers to an action that is not capable of being advised or is not sensible. It is a synonym for undesirable and cannot be used as its antonym.
Synonyms: Inopportune (अनुपयुक्त), Improper (गलत), Ill-advised (अविवेकपूर्ण).
Antonyms: Advisable (उचित), Recommended (अनुशंसित), Sensible (समझदार).

This word describes someone who is quiet, gentle, and easily imposed upon. It refers to a personality trait of submissiveness and has no relation to the desirability of a situation.
Synonyms: Submissive (दब्बू), Humble (विनम्र), Passive (निष्क्रिय).
Antonyms: Assertive (मुखर), Bold (साहसी), Aggressive (आक्रामक).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Consent
questionsEn.s:
Consent - अनुमति / स्वीकृति (Acceptance or permission for something)
Bickering - छोटी बातों पर झगड़ा (Arguing about petty matters)
Expulsion - निष्कासन (Forcing someone to leave)
Directive - निर्देश (An official authoritative instruction)
Interdiction - पाबंदी / निषेध (The act of prohibiting something)
Hence, 'interdiction' is the most suitable antonym for 'consent'.
oa:
This word refers to arguing about petty and trivial matters. While it involves disagreement, it describes a type of annoying conversation rather than the official refusal of permission.
Synonyms: Squabbling (तकरार), Quarreling (झगड़ा), Sparring (बहस).
Antonyms: Agreeing (सहमत होना), Harmony (तालमेल), Peace (शांति).

This word refers to the action of forcing someone to leave an organization or place. It describes a removal from a group and is contextually unrelated to granting or denying permission.
Synonyms: Removal (निष्कासन), Dismissal (बर्खास्तगी), Ejection (बहिष्कार).
Antonyms: Admission (प्रवेश), Inclusion (समावेशन), Acceptance (स्वीकृति).

This word refers to an official or authoritative instruction or order. While it comes from an authority, it is a command to act rather than a refusal to allow an action.
Synonyms: Order (आदेश), Instruction (निर्देश), Command (हुक्म).
Antonyms: Request (अनुरोध), Suggestion (सुझाव), Plea (विनती).

This word refers to the act of officially forbidding something or prohibiting an action. It is the direct functional opposite of consent, which means giving official approval or acceptance.
Synonyms: Prohibition (निषेध), Ban (प्रतिबंध), Veto (अधिकार का प्रयोग कर रोकना).
Antonyms: Consent (अनुमति), Authorization (प्राधिकरण), Permission (इजाजत).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Nonchalant
questionsEn.s:
Nonchalant - बेपरवाह / लापरवाह (Feeling or appearing casually calm)
Boisterous - शोरगुल वाला (Noisy and energetic)
Unconcerned - उदासीन (Showing lack of interest or worry)
Considerate - विचारशील (Careful not to harm or inconvenience others)
Retrospective - पूर्वव्यापी (Looking back on past events)
Hence, 'considerate' is the most suitable antonym for 'nonchalant'.
oa:
This word describes someone who is noisy, energetic, and cheerful. While it describes high energy, it relates to loudness rather than the deep consideration for others implied by the correct antonym.
Synonyms: Rowdy (उपद्रवी), Clamorous (शोरगुल वाला), Lively (जीवंत).
Antonyms: Quiet (शांत), Serene (निर्मल), Restrained (संयमित).

This word describes someone who shows a lack of interest or worry. It is a direct synonym for nonchalant and therefore cannot be the opposite.
Synonyms: Indifferent (उदासीन), Apathetic (बेपरवाह), Detached (अलग).
Antonyms: Concerned (चिंतित), Anxious (व्याकुल), Caring (सहानुभूतिपूर्ण).

This word describes a person who is careful not to inconvenience or harm others and shows thoughtful concern. It is the opposite of nonchalant, which implies a lack of interest or care.
Synonyms: Thoughtful (विचारशील), Attentive (सतर्क), Empathetic (सहानुभूतिपूर्ण).
Antonyms: Nonchalant (बेपरवाह), Heedless (असावधान), Callous (निर्दयी).

This word means looking back on or dealing with past events or situations. It describes a temporal focus (looking backward) and has no relation to emotional calmness or lack of care.
Synonyms: Backward-looking (पूर्वप्रभावी), Ex post facto (बाद का), Historical (ऐतिहासिक).
Antonyms: Prospective (भावी), Future (भविष्य का), Anticipatory (अग्रिम).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Pacify
questionsEn.s:
Pacify - शांत करना (To make someone calm or quiet)
Placate - तसल्ली देना (To make someone less angry)
Assuage - कम करना (To make an unpleasant feeling less intense)
Aggravate - बिगाड़ना / उत्तेजित करना (To make something worse or more serious)
Quell - वश में करना (To put an end to disorder by force)
Hence, 'Aggravate' is the most suitable antonym for 'Pacify'.
oa:
This word means to make someone less angry or hostile, especially by making concessions. It is a direct synonym for pacify and therefore fails as an antonym.
Synonyms: Soothe (शांत करना), Appease (संतुष्ट करना), Mollify (शमन करना).
Antonyms: Irritate (चिढ़ाना), Provoke (उकसाना), Anger (नाराज करना).

This word means to make an unpleasant feeling, such as fear or pain, less intense. Since it involves calming or easing, it is synonymous with the given word.
Synonyms: Alleviate (कम करना), Relieve (राहत देना), Mitigate (शांत करना).
Antonyms: Aggravate (बिगाड़ना), Intensify (बढ़ाना), Exacerbate (गंभीर करना).

This word means to make a problem, injury, or negative situation worse or more serious. It is the direct opposite of pacifying, which involves calming or resolving conflict.
Synonyms: Worsen (बिगाड़ना), Exacerbate (गंभीर बनाना), Inflame (भड़काना).
Antonyms: Pacify (शांत करना), Alleviate (कम करना), Soothe (शांत करना).

This word means to put an end to a rebellion or disorder, typically by force. It involves the act of calming through suppression, making it a synonym in a formal context.
Synonyms: Suppress (दबाना), Silence (चुप करना), Crush (कुचलना).
Antonyms: Foment (उकसाना), Kindle (जलाना), Stimulate (उत्तेजित करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Penniless
questionsEn.s:
Penniless - गरीब / कंगाल (A person having no money)
Rich - अमीर / धनी (Having a lot of money or property)
Space - जगह (A continuous free area)
Spacious - विशाल (Having ample space)
Dream - सपना (A cherished aspiration or ambition)
Hence, 'Rich' is the most suitable antonym for 'Penniless'.
oa:
This word describes a person who has a lot of money, property, or valuable possessions. It is the direct financial opposite of being penniless, which means having no money at all.
Synonyms: Wealthy (धनी), Affluent (सम्पन्न), Prosperous (समृद्ध).
Antonyms: Penniless (कंगाल), Poor (गरीब), Indigent (निर्धन).

This word refers to a continuous area or expanse which is free or available. It is a noun describing a physical dimension and has no relation to a person's financial status.
Synonyms: Gap (जगह), Area (क्षेत्र), Expanse (विस्तार).
Antonyms: Closure (बंदी), Density (सघनता), Limitation (सीमा).

This word describes a place that has ample space or is roomy. While a rich person might own a spacious house, the word itself describes size rather than wealth.
Synonyms: Capacious (बड़ा), Large (विशाल), Roomy (विस्तृत).
Antonyms: Cramped (तंग), Narrow (संकीर्ण), Confined (सीमित).

This word refers to a cherished aspiration, ambition, or an series of images occurring during sleep. It describes a mental state or goal and is unrelated to current financial poverty.
Synonyms: Aspiration (महत्वाकांक्षा), Vision (कल्पना), Fantasy (स्वप्न).
Antonyms: Reality (वास्तविकता), Fact (तथ्य), Actuality (यथार्थ).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Vivid
questionsEn.s:
Vivid - जीवंत / स्पष्ट (Appearing full of life or freshness)
Perceive - समझना (To become aware of something)
Apprehend - पकड़ना / समझना (To capture someone or to understand)
Murky - धुंधला / उदास (Dark, obscure, or hard to understand)
Envision - कल्पना करना (To anticipate a future development)
Hence, 'murky' is the most suitable antonym for 'vivid'.
oa:
This word means to become aware of or comprehend something through the senses. It describes an internal cognitive process and is not an opposite of the quality of a mental image.
Synonyms: Observe (देखना), Recognize (पहचानना), Grasp (समझना).
Antonyms: Ignore (नजरअंदाज करना), Overlook (अनदेखा करना), Miss (चूकना).

This word means to capture someone for a crime or to understand something. It refers to legal or mental "taking" and does not contrast with the brightness or life of an image.
Synonyms: Arrest (गिरफ्तार करना), Seize (पकड़ना), Understand (समझना).
Antonyms: Release (छोड़ना), Free (मुक्त करना), Misunderstand (गलत समझना).

This word refers to something that is dark, obscure, and challenging to understand or see. It is the direct opposite of vivid, which implies appearing full of life, brightness, or freshness.
Synonyms: Gloomy (उदास), Obscure (अस्पष्ट), Dim (धुंधला).
Antonyms: Vivid (जीवंत), Clear (स्पष्ट), Bright (चमकीला).

This word means to think about or anticipate something as a future possibility. It describes the act of imagining rather than the clarity or dullness of the resulting image.
Synonyms: Visualize (कल्पना करना), Imagine (कल्पना करना), Picture (चित्रांकन करना).
Antonyms: Forget (भूलना), Recall (याद करना), Experience (अनुभव करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Antonym
questionsEn.s:
Antonym - विलोम (A word with the opposite meaning)
Metaverse - आभासी दुनिया (A virtual reality shared space)
Synonym - पर्यायवाची (A word with the same meaning)
Symphony - स्वर-संगति (An elaborate musical composition)
Metonymy - उपलक्षण (Refering to a thing by an associated name)
Hence, 'synonym' is the most suitable antonym for 'antonym'.
oa:
This term refers to a virtual reality space or a collective virtual shared world. It is a modern technological concept and has no linguistic relation to word meanings.
Synonyms: Virtual world (आभासी दुनिया), Cyber-space (साइबर स्पेस), Digital realm (डिजिटल क्षेत्र).
Antonyms: Reality (वास्तविकता), Physical world (भौतिक दुनिया), Actual world (वास्तविक दुनिया).

This word refers to a word or phrase that has the same or nearly the same meaning as another word. It is the direct linguistic and conceptual opposite of an antonym.
Synonyms: Equivalent (समानार्थक), Analogue (सदृश), Metonym (पर्याय).
Antonyms: Antonym (विलोम), Opposite (विपरीत), Reverse (उलटा).

This word refers to an elaborate musical composition for a full orchestra. It is an artistic term and bears no relation to the study of word opposites or meanings.
Synonyms: Concert (सहवादन), Harmony (तालमेल), Orchestration (वाद्य-वृंद रचना).
Antonyms: Noise (शोर), Cacophony (कोलाहल), Discord (बेसुरापन).

This word refers to a figure of speech in which a thing or concept is referred to by the name of something closely associated with it. It is a linguistic device but not the opposite of an antonym.
Synonyms: Synecdoche (उपलक्षण), Symbolism (प्रतीकवाद), Allusion (संकेत).
Antonyms: Literal name (शाब्दिक नाम), Definition (परिभाषा), Explicit term (स्पष्ट शब्द).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Immune
questionsEn.s:
Immune - प्रतिरक्षित (Having protection against diseases)
Susceptible - अतिसंवेदनशील (Vulnerable or prone to something)
Fragile - कमजोर / नाजुक (Delicate or easily broken)
Sick - बीमार (Unwell or having an illness)
Sedentary - गतिहीन (Involving little physical activity)
Hence, 'Susceptible' is the most suitable antonym for 'immune'.
oa:
This word refers to being vulnerable or easily influenced/affected by a disease or attack. It is the direct biological opposite of being immune, which involves having protection or resistance.
Synonyms: Vulnerable (अतिसंवेदनशील), Prone (प्रवृत्त), Exposed (असुरक्षित).
Antonyms: Immune (प्रतिरक्षित), Resistant (प्रतिरोधी), Safe (सुरक्षित).

This word means delicate, weak, or easily broken. While a lack of immunity can make one fragile, the word itself describes physical structural weakness rather than lack of biological protection.
Synonyms: Delicate (नाजुक), Brittle (भंगुर), Flimsy (कमजोर).
Antonyms: Robust (मजबूत), Strong (बलवान), Tough (सख्त).

This word means being unwell or having an illness. It describes a current state of health rather than the inherent capacity of the immune system to resist or be vulnerable to pathogens.
Synonyms: Ill (बीमार), Unwell (अस्वस्थ), Ailing (रोगी).
Antonyms: Healthy (स्वस्थ), Well (ठीक), Fit (तंदुरुस्त).

This word describes a lifestyle or person characterized by much sitting and little physical activity. It relates to habits and activity levels rather than the resistance of the body to disease.
Synonyms: Inactive (निष्क्रिय), Stationary (स्थिर), Idle (सुस्त).
Antonyms: Active (सक्रिय), Energetic (ऊर्जावान), Mobile (गतिशील).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Bulk
questionsEn.s:
Bulk - अधिकांश / बड़ा ढेर (Large amount or majority of something)
Handful - मुट्ठी भर (A small amount of something)
Heavy - भारी (Having a lot of weight)
Staple - मुख्य वस्तु / पिन (Main item or a paper fastener)
Brunt - मुख्य प्रहार (The main impact or force of something)
Hence, 'Handful' is the most suitable antonym for 'Bulk'.
oa:
This word refers to a small amount of something or as much as one can hold in one hand. It is the direct opposite of bulk, which implies a large quantity or the majority of something.
Synonyms: Scant (अल्प), Few (कुछ), Smidgen (जरा सा).
Antonyms: Bulk (अधिकांश), Mass (ढेर), Myriad (असंख्य).

This word describes something that has a lot of weight. While bulk can sometimes be heavy, the word refers to mass/weight rather than the conceptual opposite of a large amount.
Synonyms: Weighty (भारी), Ponderous (वजनी), Hefty (तगड़ा).
Antonyms: Light (हल्का), Weightless (वजनहीन), Airy (हवादार).

This word refers to a small bent pin used to fasten papers or a main item used regularly. It describes an essential item or a fastener and has no relation to quantity.
Synonyms: Main (मुख्य), Principal (प्रमुख), Essential (आवश्यक).
Antonyms: Auxiliary (सहायक), Extra (अतिरिक्त), Minor (गौण).

This word refers to the main impact or heaviest part of a negative force or burden. It describes the severity of an attack rather than the simple quantity of a substance.
Synonyms: Impact (प्रहार), Force (बल), Shock (झटका).
Antonyms: Relief (राहत), Protection (रक्षा), Avoidance (बचाव).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Built
questionsEn.s:
Built - निर्मित (Fundamentally transformed by human activity)
Hackneyed - पुराना / घिसा-पिटा (Unoriginal or overused)
Inimical - हानिकारक (Harmful or hostile)
Fair - उचित / साफ़ (Just or treating people equally)
Interested - रुचि रखने वाला (Showing curiosity or concern)
Hence, 'Fair' is the most suitable antonym for 'built'.
oa:
This word describes a phrase or idea that is unoriginal or overused. It relates to the quality of expression rather than the physical construction or modification of an environment.
Synonyms: Cliche (पुराना), Stale (बासी), Overdone (अत्यधिक).
Antonyms: Fresh (ताज़ा), Original (मौलिक), Novel (नवीन).

This word describes something that is harmful or hostile. It relates to the effect of an action (hostility) rather than the process of human activity creating a structure.
Synonyms: Harmful (हानिकारक), Hostile (शत्रुतापूर्ण), Adverse (प्रतिकूल).
Antonyms: Favorable (अनुकूल), Friendly (मित्रवत), Beneficial (लाभकारी).

This word refers to treating people equally without favoritism or being just. In the context of natural vs built environments, "fair" (as in pure/unblemished) can contrast with environments altered by biased human interest.
Synonyms: Just (उचित), Equitable (न्यायसंगत), Impartial (निष्पक्ष).
Antonyms: Unfair (अनुचित), Biased (पक्षपाती), Prejudiced (पूर्वाग्रही).

This word describes someone showing curiosity or concern about something. It describes a mental state of attraction and is unrelated to the construction of a physical area.
Synonyms: Curious (उत्सुक), Attentive (सतर्क), Keen (इच्छुक).
Antonyms: Indifferent (उदासीन), Bored (ऊबा हुआ), Apathetic (बेपरवाह).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Loyal
questionsEn.s:
Loyal - वफादार (Being very trustable and faithful)
Ardent - उत्साही (Very passionate about something)
Fickle - चंचल / अस्थिर (Never fixed on loyalty or trust)
Stupid - मूर्ख (Foolish or lacking sense)
Tragic - दुखद (Heartbreaking or sad)
Hence, 'Fickle' is the most suitable antonym for 'Loyal'.
oa:
This word describes someone who is very passionate or enthusiastic about something. It is a positive trait often associated with loyalty but does not represent its opposite.
Synonyms: Fervent (उत्साही), Zealous (जोशीला), Passionate (जुनूनी).
Antonyms: Apathetic (उदासीन), Indifferent (बेपरवाह), Cool (शीतल).

This word describes someone who is not constant or reliable in their feelings or loyalties. It is the direct behavioral opposite of being loyal, which implies being steadfast and trustable.
Synonyms: Capricious (चंचल), Unsteady (अस्थिर), Changeable (परिवर्तनशील).
Antonyms: Loyal (वफादार), Constant (स्थिर), Steadfast (अडिग).

This word describes someone who is foolish or lacks intelligence. It relates to mental capacity rather than the moral quality of being faithful or treacherous.
Synonyms: Foolish (मूर्ख), Silly (नासमझ), Asinine (बुद्धिहीन).
Antonyms: Wise (बुद्धिमान), Intelligent (बुद्धिमान), Clever (चतुर).

This word describes something that is heartbreaking, sad, or involving great suffering. It refers to the nature of an event rather than the faithfulness of an individual.
Synonyms: Disastrous (विनाशकारी), Calamitous (आपदाजनक), Sad (दुखद).
Antonyms: Comic (हास्यपूर्ण), Happy (खुश), Fortunate (भाग्यशाली).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Ravaged
questionsEn.s:
Ravaged - तबाह करना (To destroy or ruin something)
Exploded - विस्फोट करना (To burst suddenly with noise)
Demolished - ध्वस्त करना (To destroy a building completely)
Restored - पुनः स्थापित करना (To bring back to a previous situation)
Sealed - मोहरबंद (To close something securely)
Hence, 'Restored' is the most suitable antonym for 'Ravaged'.
oa:
This word means to burst forth suddenly with noise or to cause to do so. While explosions cause destruction, the word describes the mechanism of the event rather than the opposite of being ruined.
Synonyms: Bursted (विस्फोटित), Shattered (चकनाचूर), Blasted (धमाका).
Antonyms: Imploded (अन्तर्विस्फोट), Collapsed (ढहना), Compressed (सिकुड़ना).

This word means to pull down or destroy a building completely. It is a direct synonym for ravaged and therefore cannot be the opposite.
Synonyms: Razed (ध्वस्त), Ruined (बर्बाद), Destroyed (नष्ट).
Antonyms: Built (बनाना), Constructed (निर्माण), Restored (पुनः स्थापित).

This word means to bring something back to its previous state after destruction or damage. It is the direct opposite of ravaged, which involves ruining or destroying a place.
Synonyms: Reinstated (पुनर्स्थापित), Renovated (नवीनीकृत), Fixed (सुधारा).
Antonyms: Ravaged (तबाह), Destroyed (नष्ट), Ruined (बर्बाद).

This word means to close something securely so that it is airtight or cannot be opened. It describes the status of a container or door and has no relation to repair or destruction.
Synonyms: Closed (बंद), Locked (ताला बंद), Fastened (जकड़ा हुआ).
Antonyms: Opened (खुला), Unsealed (खुला), Pierced (छेदा हुआ).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Advanced
questionsEn.s:
Advanced - उन्नत (Developed or moved forward)
Rudimentary - मौलिक / प्रारंभिक (Underdeveloped or basic)
Lackadaisical - सुस्त / निरुत्साहित (Lacking interest or determination)
Operative - कार्यात्मक (Relating to a working situation)
Presumptuous - धृष्ट (Acting in an unauthorized manner)
Hence, 'Rudimentary' is the most suitable antonym for 'Advanced'.
oa:
This word refers to something that is very basic, underdeveloped, or in its early stages. It is the direct opposite of advanced, which implies progress, development, and sophistication.
Synonyms: Primitive (आदिम), Basic (बुनियादी), Elementary (प्राथमिक).
Antonyms: Advanced (उन्नत), Sophisticated (सभ्य), Complex (जटिल).

This word describes someone who lacks enthusiasm and determination, being carelessly lazy. It refers to an attitude toward work rather than the stage of a field's development.
Synonyms: Lazy (आलसी), Indifferent (उदासीन), Listless (सुस्त).
Antonyms: Enthusiastic (उत्साही), Diligent (परिश्रमी), Energetic (ऊर्जावान).

This word refers to a key factor in a situation or someone who is skilled in a particular activity. It relates to functioning or functioning entities rather than the opposite of advancement.
Synonyms: Working (कार्यरत), Functional (कार्यात्मक), Active (सक्रिय).
Antonyms: Inoperative (निष्क्रिय), Idle (बेकार), Useless (अनुपयोगी).

This word describes a person who fails to observe the limits of what is permitted or appropriate. It relates to social boldness rather than the level of progress in a study.
Synonyms: Arrogant (अभिमानी), Bold (धृष्ट), Overconfident (अति-आत्मविश्वासी).
Antonyms: Humble (विनम्र), Modest (विनीत), Respectful (सम्मानपूर्ण).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Anxiety
questionsEn.s:
Anxiety - चिंता / व्याकुलता (Feeling of fear, dread, and unease)
Discomfort - असुविधा (Feeling of mental or physical unease)
Relief - राहत / चैन (Contentment after unpleasantness stops)
Agitation - उत्तेजना / आंदोलन (A state of nervous excitement)
Stress - तनाव (Mental tension from difficult situations)
Hence, 'Relief' is the most suitable antonym for 'Anxiety'.
oa:
This word refers to a state of being mentally or physically uneasy. While it is an uncomfortable state like anxiety, it does not represent the relief or peace that serves as its opposite.
Synonyms: Unease (असुविधा), Hardship (कष्ट), Pain (दर्द).
Antonyms: Comfort (आराम), Ease (आसानी), Pleasure (आनंद).

This word describes the state of contentment and calmness that follows the passing of something unpleasant. It is the direct opposite of anxiety, which is a state of fear and worry.
Synonyms: Solace (सांत्वना), Relaxation (राहत), Comfort (चैन).
Antonyms: Anxiety (चिंता), Distress (संकट), Worry (फिक्र).

This word refers to a state of nervous excitement or the act of disturbing something. It is synonymous with the feeling of unease found in anxiety and cannot be the opposite.
Synonyms: Turmoil (अशांति), Excitement (उत्तेजना), Unrest (बेचैनी).
Antonyms: Calmness (शांति), Stillness (स्थिरता), Peace (सुकून).

This word refers to a state of mental tension caused by a difficult situation. It is a direct synonym for the cause and effect of anxiety and therefore fails as an antonym.
Synonyms: Pressure (दबाव), Tension (तनाव), Strain (खिंचाव).
Antonyms: Peace (शांति), Relaxation (विश्राम), Ease (आराम).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Contracts
questionsEn.s:
Contracts - सिकुड़ना (To become or make smaller or shorter)
Controls - नियंत्रण (To determine behavior or supervise)
Repulses - पीछे हटाना / घृणा (To drive back or cause distaste)
Shrinks - छोटा होना (To become smaller in size)
Expands - फैलाना / बढ़ाना (To become or make something bigger)
Hence, 'expands' is the most suitable antonym for 'contracts'.
oa:
This word means to determine the behavior or to supervise the running of something. It describes the power to direct actions rather than the physical size of an object.
Synonyms: Directs (नियंत्रित करना), Manages (प्रबंध करना), Regulates (नियमित करना).
Antonyms: Surrenders (समर्पण करना), Abandons (त्यागना), Obeys (पालन करना).

This word means to drive back an attacker by force or to cause a feeling of intense distaste. It describes an act of pushing away rather than the opposite of shrinking in size.
Synonyms: Rejects (नकारना), Disgusts (घृणा पैदा करना), Rebuffs (अस्वीकार करना).
Antonyms: Attracts (आकर्षित करना), Charms (मोहित करना), Allures (लुभाना).

This word means to become smaller in size or amount. Since it describes the same physical process as contracting, it is a synonym instead of an antonym.
Synonyms: Contracts (सिकुड़ना), Diminishes (घटाना), Lessens (कम होना).
Antonyms: Expands (फैलाना), Grows (बढ़ना), Increases (बढ़ना).

This word means to become or to make something larger in size or volume. It is the direct physical opposite of contracting, which involves making something smaller or shorter.
Synonyms: Enlarge (बड़ा करना), Extend (विस्तृत करना), Broaden (चौड़ा करना).
Antonyms: Contracts (सिकुड़ना), Shrinks (छोटा होना), Narrow (कम करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Part
questionsEn.s:
Part - अंश / भाग (A portion or division of a whole)
Fragment - टुकड़ा (A small part broken off)
Joint - जोड़ (A point where parts are joined)
Bit - जरा सा / अंश (A small piece or quantity)
Whole - संपूर्ण / पूरा (All of; entire)
Hence, 'Whole' is the most suitable antonym for 'Part'.
oa:
This word refers to a small portion broken off or separated from something. Since it describes a piece of a larger whole, it is synonymous with the given word part.
Synonyms: Piece (टुकड़ा), Section (अनुभाग), Shard (टुकड़ा).
Antonyms: Whole (संपूर्ण), Total (कुल), Entirety (पूरा).

This word refers to a point at which two parts are joined together. While it relates to parts, it describes the connection rather than the conceptual opposite of a single piece.
Synonyms: Connection (सम्बन्ध), Link (संपर्क), Junction (संगम).
Antonyms: Gap (दरार), Separation (अलगाव), Disconnect (विच्छेद).

This word refers to a small piece, part, or quantity of something. It is synonymous with the given word and does not offer the required opposite relationship.
Synonyms: Scrap (अंश), Particle (कण), Portion (हिस्सा).
Antonyms: Bulk (अधिकांश), Mass (ढेर), Whole (पूरा).

This word means all of something or the entire entity. It is the direct logical opposite of a part, which is only a single portion or division of that entity.
Synonyms: Entire (संपूर्ण), Total (कुल), Complete (पूरा).
Antonyms: Part (अंश), Fragment (टुकड़ा), Piece (हिस्सा).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Care
questionsEn.s:
Care - देखभाल / ध्यान (Showing concern or consideration)
Concern - चिंता (Interest or worry about someone)
Disregard - अवहेलना / उपेक्षा (To pay no attention or ignore)
Worry - फिक्र (A state of concern or unease)
Attention - ध्यान देना (Act of paying close consideration)
Hence, 'Disregard' is the most suitable antonym for 'Care'.
oa:
This word refers to showing interest, worry, or attention towards someone or something. It shares the same meaning as care and therefore functions as a synonym.
Synonyms: Regard (ध्यान), Interest (रुचि), Solicitude (चिंता).
Antonyms: Indifference (उदासीनता), Neglect (उपेक्षा), Disregard (अवहेलना).

This word means to pay no attention to, to ignore, or to show no concern for something. It is the direct opposite of care, which implies providing attention and protection.
Synonyms: Ignore (नजरअंदाज करना), Neglect (उपेक्षा करना), Overlook (अनदेखा करना).
Antonyms: Care (देखभाल), Notice (ध्यान देना), Regard (सम्मान देना).

This word describes a state of anxiety or unease about potential problems. Since worrying is a form of deep caring or concern, it is a near-synonym and cannot be the opposite.
Synonyms: Anxiety (चिंता), Apprehension (डर), Unease (बेचैनी).
Antonyms: Calmness (शांति), Confidence (निश्चय), Indifference (बेपरवाही).

This word refers to the act of paying close or careful consideration to something. Since attention is a vital component of caring, it acts as a synonym for the given word.
Synonyms: Focus (एकाग्रता), Heed (ध्यान), Observation (निरीक्षण).
Antonyms: Inattention (असावधानी), Neglect (उपेक्षा), Disregard (अवहेलना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Fertile
questionsEn.s:
Fertile - उपजाऊ (Soil that plants grow well in)
Fecund - उर्वर (Able to produce a lot of offspring/crops)
Rich - धनी / प्रचुर (Having a lot of property or nutrients)
Barren - बंजर / ऊसर (Not good enough for plants to grow)
Wet - गीला (Covered in liquid or water)
Hence, 'Barren' is the most suitable antonym for 'Fertile'.
oa:
This word means able to produce many offspring or crops. It is a direct synonym for fertile and therefore fails to provide the required opposite meaning.
Synonyms: Productive (उत्पादक), Fruitful (फलदायक), Luxuriant (उर्वर).
Antonyms: Barren (बंजर), Sterile (बाँझ), Impotent (शक्तिहीन).

This word describes something that contains a large amount of a useful substance, like rich soil. Since richness leads to fertility, it functions as a synonym.
Synonyms: Abundant (प्रचुर), Wealthy (धनी), Copious (भरपूर).
Antonyms: Poor (गरीब), Lacking (अभावपूर्ण), Depleted (रिक्त).

This word describes land or soil that is not good enough for plants to grow on. It is the direct agricultural opposite of fertile, which implies being highly productive.
Synonyms: Infertile (अनुपजाऊ), Arid (शुष्क), Unproductive (बंजर).
Antonyms: Fertile (उपजाऊ), Fruitful (फलदायी), Lush (हरा-भरा).

This word means covered in liquid, especially water. While fertile land often needs water, the word describes moisture level rather than the ability to produce growth.
Synonyms: Damp (गीला), Moist (नम), Saturated (तर).
Antonyms: Dry (सूखा), Arid (शुष्क), Parched (तपा हुआ).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Casual
questionsEn.s:
Casual - अनौपचारिक / बेपरवाह (Relaxed and not worried)
Spiritual - आध्यात्मिक (Concerning deep thoughts or beliefs)
Personal - व्यक्तिगत (Belonging to a particular person)
Formal - औपचारिक (Serious or official behavior)
Traditional - पारंपरिक (Long-established or part of a custom)
Hence, 'Formal' is the most suitable antonym for 'Casual'.
oa:
This word refers to deep thoughts and beliefs rather than the physical body. It describes a type of focus or existence and has no connection with social effort or interest levels.
Synonyms: Divine (आध्यात्मिक), Sacred (पवित्र), Ethereal (आत्मिक).
Antonyms: Physical (शारीरिक), Material (भौतिक), Mundane (सांसारिक).

This word means belonging to or affecting one particular person. It describes the scope of ownership or impact rather than the relaxed or formal nature of an attitude.
Synonyms: Private (व्यक्तिगत), Individual (वैयक्तिक), Subjective (आत्मगत).
Antonyms: Public (सार्वजनिक), General (सामान्य), Professional (पेशेवर).

This word describes language or behavior used in serious or official situations. It is the direct opposite of casual, which implies a relaxed, unconcerned, or unofficial attitude.
Synonyms: Official (आधिकारिक), Solemn (गंभीर), Ceremonious (औपचारिक).
Antonyms: Casual (अनौपचारिक), Informal (अनौपचारिक), Relaxed (ढीला).

This word describes things that have existed as part of a long-established custom. While traditions are often formal, the word describes history and origin rather than the opposite of being relaxed.
Synonyms: Conventional (परंपरागत), Habitual (प्रचलित), Orthodox (रूढ़िवादी).
Antonyms: Modern (आधुनिक), Novel (नवीन), Unconventional (अपरंपरागत).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Conceit
questionsEn.s:
Conceit - अहंकार / घमंड (Too much pride in yourself)
Concealment - छिपाव (The action of hiding something)
Reveal - प्रकट करना (To make something secret known)
Modesty - विनम्रता (Not trying to make people notice achievements)
Hidden - छिपा हुआ (Put in a place where it cannot be seen)
Hence, 'Modesty' is the most suitable antonym for 'Conceit'.
oa:
This word refers to the action of hiding something or preventing it from being known. It relates to secrecy rather than the internal character trait of being proud or humble.
Synonyms: Hiding (छिपाव), Secrecy (गोपनीयता), Obscurity (धुंधलापन).
Antonyms: Disclosure (प्रकटीकरण), Revelation (प्रकटीकरण), Exposure (खुलासा).

This word means to make something known that was previously secret. It is a verb describing an act of communication and is contextually unrelated to self-importance.
Synonyms: Disclose (उजागर करना), Unveil (प्रकट करना), Divulge (बताना).
Antonyms: Hide (छिपाना), Conceal (गुप्त रखना), Cover (ढकना).

This word describes the quality of not talking about or trying to make people notice your own achievements. It is the direct opposite of conceit, which implies excessive pride in oneself.
Synonyms: Humility (विनम्रता), Meekness (विनीत भाव), Diffidence (संकोच).
Antonyms: Conceit (अहंकार), Pride (गर्व), Arrogance (घमंड).

This word describes something that is put in a place where it cannot be seen. It is an adjective describing visibility and has no relation to the quality of vanity or pride.
Synonyms: Concealed (गुप्त), Secret (छिपा हुआ), Obscure (अस्पष्ट).
Antonyms: Visible (दृश्यमान), Apparent (प्रकट), Open (खुला).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Abundant
questionsEn.s:
Abundant - प्रचुर (Existing in large quantities)
Minimal - कम से कम (Smallest possible amount)
Aplenty - पर्याप्त रूप से (Sufficient quantities)
Plentiful - प्रचुर (Existing in large amounts)
Fertile - उपजाऊ (Producing abundant vegetation)
Hence, 'Minimal' is the most suitable antonym for 'Abundant'.
oa:
This word refers to the smallest possible amount or the least possible. It is the direct opposite of abundant, which means existing in large quantities or more than enough.
Synonyms: Scant (अल्प), Mere (मात्र), Nominal (नाममात्र).
Antonyms: Abundant (प्रचुर), Massive (विशाल), Maximum (अधिकतम).

This word means in sufficient or plentiful quantities. It is a synonym for abundant and therefore cannot be the required opposite.
Synonyms: Copious (भरपूर), Plentiful (पर्याप्त), Abundant (बहुतायत).
Antonyms: Scarce (दुर्लभ), Lacking (अभाव), Short (कम).

This word describes something existing in large amounts or numbers. Since it means the same thing as abundant, it functions as a synonym rather than an antonym.
Synonyms: Ample (पर्याप्त), Profuse (प्रचुर), Bounteous (भरपूर).
Antonyms: Sparse (विरल), Scanty (अल्प), Deficient (न्यून).

This word describes land or soil capable of producing abundant crops. While fertility leads to abundance, the word describes productivity rather than the quantity itself.
Synonyms: Fecund (उर्वर), Fruitful (फलदायी), Productive (उत्पादक).
Antonyms: Barren (बंजर), Sterile (बाँझ), Infertile (अनुपजाऊ).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Irresolute
questionsEn.s:
Irresolute - अनिश्चयपूर्ण (Uncertain and unable to make decisions)
Harsh - कठोर (Rough and unpleasant)
Variant - प्रकार (Different from others of the same kind)
Default - चूक (Failure to fulfill an obligation)
Decisive - निर्णायक (Having the ability to make decisions quickly)
Hence, 'decisive' is the most suitable antonym for 'irresolute'.
oa:
This word describes something rough, unpleasant, or severe. It relates to the intensity of weather or a person's behavior rather than their ability to make decisions.
Synonyms: Severe (कठोर), Brutal (क्रूर), Astringent (तीखा).
Antonyms: Gentle (सौम्य), Mild (हल्का), Soft (कोमल).

This word refers to something that is different or distinct from others of the same kind. It describes diversity in form and has no connection with being uncertain or decisive.
Synonyms: Version (प्रकार), Variation (विभिन्नता), Derivative (व्युत्पन्न).
Antonyms: Standard (मानक), Original (मूल), Uniform (समान).

This word refers to the failure to fulfill an obligation, like repaying a loan. It describes a legal or financial omission and does not contrast with a lack of determination.
Synonyms: Omission (चूक), Neglect (उपेक्षा), Delinquency (दोष).
Antonyms: Fulfillment (पूर्ति), Payment (भुगतान), Obedience (पालन).

This word describes someone who has or shows the ability to make decisions quickly and effectively. It is the direct opposite of irresolute, which implies being uncertain or hesitant.
Synonyms: Resolute (दृढ़), Firm (मजबूत), Constant (अटल).
Antonyms: Irresolute (अनिश्चयपूर्ण), Wavering (अस्थिर), Vacillating (डांवाडोल).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Everlasting
questionsEn.s:
Everlasting - शाश्वत (Lasting forever; eternal)
Eternal - शाश्वत (Lasting or existing forever)
Transient - क्षणिक (Lasting only for a short time)
Fatuous - बुद्धिहीन (Silly and pointless)
Misled - गुमराह (Deceived or led astray)
Hence, 'Transient' is the most suitable antonym for 'Everlasting'.
oa:
This word means lasting or existing forever; without end. It is a direct synonym for everlasting and therefore cannot be the required opposite.
Synonyms: Perpetual (निरंतर), Timeless (कालातीत), Deathless (अमर).
Antonyms: Transient (क्षणिक), Mortal (मरणशील), Brief (संक्षिप्त).

This word means lasting only for a short time; it describes something that is impermanent. It is the exact opposite of everlasting, which implies eternal duration.
Synonyms: Ephemeral (अल्पकालिक), Fleeting (क्षणभंगुर), Temporary (अस्थायी).
Antonyms: Everlasting (शाश्वत), Permanent (स्थायी), Constant (नियत).

This word describes something that is silly and pointless. It relates to the quality of an idea or person rather than the length of time something exists.
Synonyms: Foolish (मूर्ख), Asinine (बुद्धिहीन), Inane (तुच्छ).
Antonyms: Sensible (समझदार), Sage (ज्ञानी), Intelligent (बुद्धिमान).

This word describes someone who has been deceived or led astray. It describes a state of being misinformed rather than a temporal state like lasting forever or being temporary.
Synonyms: Deceived (धोखा खाया हुआ), Fooled (छला गया), Duped (ठगा हुआ).
Antonyms: Guided (निर्देशित), Informed (सूचित), Wise (ज्ञानी).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Acquisition
questionsEn.s:
Acquisition - प्राप्ति / लाभ (The act of obtaining something)
Enthusiasm - उत्साह (Intense and eager enjoyment)
Demoralised - हतोत्साहित (Having lost confidence or hope)
Surprised - आश्चर्यचकित (Feeling mild or amazed astonishment)
Loss - नुकसान / हार (The fact or process of losing something)
Hence, 'Loss' is the most suitable antonym for 'Acquisition'.
oa:
This word refers to intense and eager enjoyment, interest, or approval. It describes an emotional state and has no logical connection with the act of gaining something.
Synonyms: Zeal (उत्साह), Passion (जुनून), Ardor (जोश).
Antonyms: Apathy (उदासीनता), Indifference (बेपरवाही), Boredom (ऊब).

This word describes someone who has lost confidence or hope. It is a negative emotional state but does not represent the opposite of an asset or a gain.
Synonyms: Disheartened (हतोत्साहित), Depressed (उदास), Defeated (निराश).
Antonyms: Encouraged (प्रोत्साहित), Confident (आत्मविश्वासी), Elated (उल्लसित).

This word refers to feeling or showing mild or amazed astonishment. It describes a reaction to an unexpected event rather than the loss or lack of a possession.
Synonyms: Astonished (चकित), Amazed (हैरान), Startled (चौंका हुआ).
Antonyms: Prepared (तैयार), Expectant (प्रतीक्षावान), Indifferent (उदासीन).

This word refers to the fact or process of losing something or someone. It is the direct situational opposite of acquisition, which is the act of obtaining or gaining something.
Synonyms: Defeat (हार), Deprivation (वंचित होना), Depletion (कमी).
Antonyms: Acquisition (लाभ), Gain (प्राप्ति), Possession (अधिकार).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Cacophony
questionsEn.s:
Cacophony - शोर-शराबा (A harsh, unpleasant mixture of sounds)
Colophony - पाइन की राल (A type of resin from pine trees)
Polyphony - बहुस्वर (Music with simultaneous melodies)
Symphony - स्वर-संगति (A harmonious combination of sounds)
Antiphony - प्रतिध्वनि (Alternation of singing by two groups)
Hence, 'Symphony' is the most suitable antonym for 'Cacophony'.
oa:
This word refers to a type of resin obtained from pine trees. It is a technical scientific term and has no relation to the quality of sound or harmony.
Synonyms: Rosin (रोज़िन), Amber (कहरुवा), Resin (राल).
Antonyms: Liquid (तरल), Fluid (द्रव).

This word refers to music that consists of two or more simultaneous melodies. While it describes a complex sound, it is not a direct opposite of harsh noise.
Synonyms: Multipart (बहुस्वर), Melodic (मधुर), Contrapuntal (बहुस्वर-संबंधी).
Antonyms: Monophony (एकस्वरता), Unison (एकताल).

This word refers to an elaborate musical composition or a harmonious combination of sounds. It is the direct auditory opposite of cacophony, which is a harsh mixture of noise.
Synonyms: Harmony (तालमेल), Accord (सहमति), Concord (सामंजस्य).
Antonyms: Cacophony (शोर-शराबा), Noise (शोर), Discord (मतभेद).

This word refers to the alternation of singing or responding by two groups. It describes a style of performance rather than a state of harmony or pleasant sound.
Synonyms: Responding (प्रतिक्रिया), Echoing (प्रतिध्वनि), Alternation (पारी).
Antonyms: Silence (चुप्पी), Solo (एकल), Unison (एकरूपता).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Jeopardy
questionsEn.s:
Jeopardy - खतरा / जोखिम (Danger of loss, harm, or failure)
Safety - सुरक्षा (Condition of being protected from danger)
Danger - खतरा (Possibility of something harmful)
Precaution - सावधानी (Action taken to prevent danger)
Risk - जोखिम (A situation involving exposure to danger)
Hence, 'Safety' is the most suitable antonym for 'Jeopardy'.
oa:
This word refers to the condition of being protected from danger, harm, or injury. It is the direct situational opposite of jeopardy, which implies being in danger of loss or failure.
Synonyms: Security (सुरक्षा), Protection (रक्षा), Shelter (शरण).
Antonyms: Jeopardy (खतरा), Danger (जोखिम), Peril (जोखिम).

This word refers to the possibility of something harmful or unpleasant occurring. It is a direct synonym for jeopardy and therefore cannot be its antonym.
Synonyms: Hazard (जोखिम), Peril (खतरा), Threat (धमकी).
Antonyms: Safety (सुरक्षा), Assurance (निश्चितता), Peace (शांति).

This word refers to an action taken to prevent something dangerous from happening. While related to avoiding danger, it is an action rather than the state of being safe.
Synonyms: Safeguard (सावधानी), Measure (उपाय), Care (सतर्कता).
Antonyms: Neglect (लापरवाही), Carelessness (असावधानी), Risk (जोखिम).

This word refers to a situation involving exposure to danger. Since it carries the same meaning as jeopardy, it functions as a synonym rather than an opposite.
Synonyms: Gamble (जुआ), Uncertainty (अनिश्चितता), Danger (खतरा).
Antonyms: Certainty (निश्चितता), Security (सुरक्षा), Safety (बचाव).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Strange
questionsEn.s:
Strange - अजीब (Unusual or surprising)
Events - घटनाएं (Something that takes place)
Intriguing - रोचक (Unusual, fascinating, or interesting)
Mundane - साधारण / नीरस (Dull or ordinary; lacking excitement)
Place - स्थान (A particular position or area)
Hence, 'Mundane' is the most suitable antonym for 'Strange'.
oa:
This word refers to things that happen or take place. It is a noun describing occurrences and does not provide an adjective to describe the quality of being unusual or ordinary.
Synonyms: Incidents (घटनाएं), Happenings (वाकया), Occasions (अवसर).
Antonyms: Silence (चुप्पी), Inactivity (निष्क्रियता).

This word describes something that is unusual, fascinating, or interesting. It aligns with the "unusual" nature of being strange and therefore serves as a near-synonym.
Synonyms: Fascinating (दिलचस्प), Captivating (मोहक), Riveting (दिलकश).
Antonyms: Boring (उबाऊ), Dull (नीरस), Mundane (साधारण).

This word describes something that is dull, ordinary, or lacking in excitement. It is the direct opposite of strange, which implies something unusual or surprising.
Synonyms: Ordinary (सामान्य), Commonplace (मामूली), Routine (दैनिक).
Antonyms: Strange (अजीब), Extraordinary (असाधारण), Exotic (विदेशी).

This word refers to a particular position, area, or location. It is a noun describing a spatial concept and has no relation to how unusual or common a thing is.
Synonyms: Location (स्थान), Spot (जगह), Area (क्षेत्र).
Antonyms: Space (शून्य), Void (रिक्ति).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Encourage
questionsEn.s:
Encourage - प्रोत्साहित करना (To give support, confidence, or hope)
Boost - बढ़ावा देना (To help or encourage improvement)
Inspire - प्रेरित करना (To fill with the ability to do something)
Energise - ऊर्जा प्रदान करना (To give vitality and enthusiasm)
Dishearten - निराश करना (To cause loss of confidence or hope)
Hence, 'Dishearten' is the most suitable antonym for 'Encourage'.
oa:
This word means to help or encourage something to increase or improve. Since it describes the act of supporting a person or cause, it functions as a synonym.
Synonyms: Lift (बढ़ाना), Enhance (सुधारना), Advance (उन्नति करना).
Antonyms: Hinder (बाधा डालना), Suppress (दबाना), Block (रोकना).

This word means to fill someone with the urge or ability to do something creative or positive. It is a synonym for encourage and cannot be the required opposite.
Synonyms: Motivate (प्रेरित करना), Stimulate (उत्तेजित करना), Influence (प्रभावित करना).
Antonyms: Discourage (निरुत्साहित करना), Depress (उदास करना), Deter (रोकना).

This word means to give vitality and enthusiasm to someone. Since providing energy is a way to encourage, this word serves as a synonym rather than an antonym.
Synonyms: Invigorate (स्फूर्ति देना), Vitalize (सक्रिय करना), Stimulate (उत्साहित करना).
Antonyms: Exhaust (थका देना), Drain (खाली करना), Weary (थकाना).

This word means to cause someone to lose determination or confidence. It is the direct behavioral opposite of encouraging someone, which involves giving support and hope.
Synonyms: Discourage (निरुत्साहित करना), Demoralize (मनोबल गिराना), Daunt (डराना).
Antonyms: Encourage (प्रोत्साहित करना), Cheer (खुश करना), Reassure (आश्वस्त करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Appropriate
questionsEn.s:
Appropriate - उचित (Suitable or proper in the circumstances)
Transparent - पारदर्शी (Easy to see through or perceive)
Improper - अनुचित (Not in accordance with accepted standards)
Salient - महत्वपूर्ण (Most noticeable or prominent)
Disturbing - चिंताजनक (Causing anxiety or concern)
Hence, 'Improper' is the most suitable antonym for 'Appropriate'.
oa:
This word describes something that allows light to pass through or is easy to perceive. It relates to clarity and honesty rather than the suitability of an action.
Synonyms: Clear (स्पष्ट), Obvious (प्रकट), Limpid (पारदर्शी).
Antonyms: Opaque (अपारदर्शी), Ambiguous (अस्पष्ट), Cloudy (धुंधला).

This word refers to something that is not in accordance with accepted rules, standards, or suitability. It is the direct opposite of appropriate, which means proper or suitable.
Synonyms: Unsuitable (अनुपयुक्त), Wrong (गलत), Inappropriate (अनुचित).
Antonyms: Appropriate (उचित), Proper (सही), Correct (शुद्ध).

This word describes the most noticeable or important features of something. It refers to prominence rather than the degree of suitability or correctness.
Synonyms: Notable (उल्लेखनीय), Striking (स्पष्ट), Important (महत्वपूर्ण).
Antonyms: Insignificant (महत्वहीन), Minor (गौण), Trivial (तुच्छ).

This word describes something that causes anxiety, concern, or upset. It describes an emotional effect rather than a violation of the standards of suitability.
Synonyms: Upsetting (परेशान करने वाला), Alarming (चिंताजनक), Unsettling (अस्थिर करने वाला).
Antonyms: Comforting (सुखद), Reassuring (आश्वस्त करने वाला), Pleasing (प्रसन्न करने वाला).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Feud
questionsEn.s:
Feud - झगड़ा / पुश्तैनी दुश्मनी (A prolonged and bitter quarrel)
Harmony - सामंजस्य / शांति (A state of peaceful agreement)
Distrust - अविश्वास (A feeling of doubt or suspicion)
Unfriendliness - अमित्रता (A lack of friendliness or warmth)
Destruct - विनाश करना (To destroy something completely)
Hence, 'Harmony' is the most suitable antonym for 'Feud'.
oa:
This word refers to a pleasing combination of elements or a state of peaceful agreement. It is the direct opposite of a feud, which involves a bitter, long-standing quarrel.
Synonyms: Peace (शांति), Concord (तालमेल), Amity (सौहार्द).
Antonyms: Feud (झगड़ा), Conflict (संघर्ष), Discord (विवाद).

This word refers to a feeling of doubt or suspicion towards someone. While distrust often causes a feud, it describes a lack of trust rather than the state of conflict itself.
Synonyms: Suspicion (संदेह), Doubt (शंका), Scepticism (संशय).
Antonyms: Trust (विश्वास), Reliance (भरोसा), Faith (आस्था).

This word refers to a lack of friendliness or warmth. It is a mild synonym for the early stages of a feud but does not capture the scale of a prolonged bitter battle.
Synonyms: Hostility (शत्रुता), Coldness (रूखापन), Aloofness (अलगाव).
Antonyms: Friendliness (मित्रता), Kindness (दया), Warmth (आत्मीयता).

This word refers to the act of destroying something completely. It is a verb describing the end result of violence rather than the social state of a disagreement.
Synonyms: Ruin (बर्बाद करना), Demolish (ध्वस्त करना), Devastate (तबाह करना).
Antonyms: Build (बनाना), Construct (निर्माण करना), Create (सृजन करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Abominable
questionsEn.s:
Abominable - घिनौना (Causing moral revulsion or hatred)
Worthy - महत्वपूर्ण (Deserving of respect and attention)
Delectable - सुखदायक (Delicious or pleasing to the senses)
Admirable - प्रशंसनीय (Deserving of respect and approval)
Detestable - घृणास्पद (Deserving of intense dislike)
Hence, 'Admirable' is the most suitable antonym for 'Abominable'.
oa:
This word describes something that is good enough for respect or attention. While it is a positive term, it is not as strong or contextually fitting an opposite as the correct choice.
Synonyms: Deserving (योग्य), Merit (पात्र), Suitable (उपयुक्त).
Antonyms: Unworthy (अयोग्य), Base (नीच), Trifling (तुच्छ).

This word refers to something that is delicious or pleasing to the taste. It describes sensory pleasure and is contextually unrelated to moral revulsion or hatred.
Synonyms: Delicious (स्वादिष्ट), Tasty (ज़ायके़दार), Palatable (रुचिकर).
Antonyms: Distasteful (अप्रिय), Nauseating (घिनौना), Unpalatable (बेस्वाद).

This word refers to something that deserves high respect, approval, and admiration. It is the direct moral opposite of abominable, which describes things that cause revulsion or hatred.
Synonyms: Praiseworthy (प्रशंसनीय), Commendable (सराहनीय), Estimable (सम्माननीय).
Antonyms: Abominable (घिनौना), Despicable (नीच), Detestable (घृणास्पद).

This word describes something deserving intense dislike or hatred. It is a direct synonym for abominable and therefore fails to provide the required antonym.
Synonyms: Loathsome (घृणित), Odious (नफरत के योग्य), Repugnant (प्रतिकूल).
Antonyms: Lovable (प्यारा), Adorable (मनमोहक), Likable (पसंद के योग्य).

test.instructions: Standard CBT Pattern Exam. Positive Marks: +1, Negative Marks: -0.25. Total Questions: 50.

test.title: Set - 14

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Entrenched
questionsEn.s:
Entrenched - गहराई से स्थापित (Firmly established and difficult to change)
Averted - टाला गया (Prevented or turned away)
Startling - चौंकाने वाला (Very surprising or shocking)
Transient - क्षणिक (Lasting only for a short time)
Entrusted - सौंपा गया (Given responsibility for)
oa:
This term describes an action taken to turn away one's gaze or to prevent an unfortunate event from occurring. It focuses on avoidance rather than the state of being firmly fixed in a system.
Synonyms: Prevented (रोका हुआ), Avoided (टाला गया), Precluded (निवारित).
Antonyms: Allowed (अनुमति दी), Triggered (सक्रिय किया), Encouraged (प्रोत्साहित किया).

This word refers to something that causes a sudden feeling of shock, surprise, or alarm. It describes the intensity of an impact rather than how deeply a concept is rooted in behavior.
Synonyms: Astonishing (आश्चर्यजनक), Surprising (अद्भुत), Alarming (चिंताजनक).
Antonyms: Predictable (पूर्वानुमेय), Commonplace (मामूली), Expected (अपेक्षित).

This word describes something that lasts for only a very short time and is impermanent. It serves as the direct opposite of entrenched, which characterizes things that are firmly established and difficult to change.
Synonyms: Fleeting (क्षणिक), Ephemeral (क्षणभंगुर), Temporary (अस्थायी).
Antonyms: Permanent (स्थायी), Lasting (चिरस्थायी), Enduring (अडिग).

This verb relates to giving someone the responsibility of doing something or taking care of something valuable. It deals with delegation rather than the duration or fixity of a belief.
Synonyms: Assigned (सौंपा गया), Delegated (प्रतिनिधि नियुक्त), Committed (सुपुर्द).
Antonyms: Withheld (रोका गया), Denied (अस्वीकार किया), Retained (बनाए रखा).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Purportedly
questionsEn.s:
Purportedly - कथित तौर पर (Appearing or stated to be true, though not necessarily so)
Maliciously - दुर्भावनापूर्ण (With intent to do harm)
Impossibly - असंभव रूप से (Not able to occur or be done)
Dramatically - नाटकीय रूप से (In a striking or sudden manner)
Severely - गंभीर रूप से (To a very strict or intense degree)
oa:
This adverb describes actions done with the intention of causing harm or out of spite. It focuses on the motive behind an action rather than the degree of certainty or possibility.
Synonyms: Spitefully (द्वेषपूर्ण), Vindictively (प्रतिशोधी), Malevolently (दुर्भावनापूर्ण).
Antonyms: Benevolently (परोपकारी ढंग से), Kindly (दयालुता से), Amiably (मैत्रीपूर्ण).

This word refers to something that cannot happen or be achieved under any circumstances. It stands as a conceptual opposite to purportedly, which implies that something is claimed or believed to be true even if not proven.
Synonyms: Unattainably (असंभव रूप से), Hopelessly (निराशाजनक), Unfeasibly (अव्यवहार्य).
Antonyms: Possibly (संभवतः), Feasibly (व्यवहार्य रूप से), Likely (शायद).

This word characterizes events or actions that are striking, theatrical, or involve a great deal of sudden change. It relates to the style of occurrence rather than its alleged truth.
Synonyms: Strikingly (प्रभावशाली ढंग से), Spectactularly (भव्य रूप से), Theatrically (नाटकीय रूप से).
Antonyms: Subtly (सुक्ष्मता से), Ordinarily (साधारण रूप से), Slightly (थोड़ा).

This term indicates a high degree of strictness, harshness, or intensity. While it can describe an attack, it does not address the "alleged" nature implied by the question word.
Synonyms: Harshly (कठोरता से), Critically (गंभीर रूप से), Strictly (सख्ती से).
Antonyms: Mildly (हल्के से), Leniently (उदारता से), Gently (कोमलता से).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Intense
questionsEn.s:
Intense - तीव्र / गहरा (Great in strength, degree, or amount)
Thrifty - मितव्ययी (Careful in spending money)
Moderate - मध्यम / औसत (Average in amount or intensity)
Stately - भव्य (Dignified and impressive)
Lavish - आलीशान (Luxurious and expensive)
oa:
This adjective describes a person who is careful with money and resources, avoiding waste. It relates to financial habits rather than the strength or degree of a feeling or situation.
Synonyms: Frugal (मितव्ययी), Economical (किफायती), Parsimonious (अल्पव्ययी).
Antonyms: Extravagant (फिजूलखर्च), Lavish (ठाठदार), Wasteful (अपव्ययी).

This word refers to something that is average in amount, intensity, or degree and is not extreme. It is the direct opposite of intense, which signifies extreme strength or depth.
Synonyms: Temperate (संयमित), Reasonable (उचित), Mild (नरम).
Antonyms: Extreme (अत्यधिक), Intense (तीव्र), Drastic (भीषण).

This term is used to describe something that is impressive and dignified in appearance or manner. It focuses on grandeur and majesty rather than the level of force or emotion.
Synonyms: Majestic (शाही), Grand (भव्य), Regal (राजसी).
Antonyms: Unimpressive (अप्रभावशाली), Lowly (मामूली), Humble (विनम्र).

This word describes something that is sumptuously rich, elaborate, or luxurious. It refers to abundance and luxury rather than the concentrated strength of a phenomenon.
Synonyms: Opulent (संपन्न), Grandiose (आडंबरपूर्ण), Profuse (प्रचुर).
Antonyms: Meager (अल्प), Scanty (कम), Frugal (मितव्ययी).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Cacophony
questionsEn.s:
Cacophony - कोलाहल / कर्कश स्वर (A harsh, discordant mixture of sounds)
Harmony - सामंजस्य / तालमेल (Pleasing combination of elements or sounds)
Alimony - गुजारा भत्ता (Money paid after divorce)
Bedlam - शोरगुल / अराजकता (A state of uproar and confusion)
Sound - ध्वनि (Vibrations that can be heard)
oa:
This word refers to a pleasing combination or arrangement of different elements, especially sounds or voices. it expresses the direct opposite of cacophony, which involves a harsh and discordant mixture of noise.
Synonyms: Concord (सामंजस्य), Accord (सहमति), Euphony (सुस्वरता).
Antonyms: Discord (कलह), Conflict (विवाद), Cacophony (कोलाहल).

This noun refers to a regular amount of money that a court orders a person to pay to their former spouse after a divorce. It has a legal and financial meaning with no relation to sound.
Synonyms: Maintenance (रखरखाव खर्च), Support (निर्वाह निधि), Provision (प्रावधान).
Antonyms: Neglect (उपेक्षा), Abandonment (परित्याग), Debt (ऋण).

This term describes a scene of absolute uproar, confusion, and chaos. It is actually closer in spirit to the idea of cacophony rather than being its opposite.
Synonyms: Chaos (अराजकता), Pandemonium (विप्लव), Commotion (हल्ला-गुल्ला).
Antonyms: Calm (शांति), Order (व्यवस्था), Quiet (नीरवता).

This is a general term for vibrations that travel through the air and can be heard. While cacophony is a type of sound, the word itself is too broad to serve as a specific antonym.
Synonyms: Noise (शोर), Audio (श्रव्य), Vibration (कंपन).
Antonyms: Silence (मौन), Stillness (निश्चलता), Void (शून्यता).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Old
questionsEn.s:
Old - पुराना (Having lived or existed for a long time)
Young - युवा (In an early stage of life)
New - नया (Made or discovered recently)
Modern - आधुनिक (Relating to the present time)
Fresh - ताजा (Newly made or obtained)
oa:
This word refers to living beings who are in an early stage of life. While it contrasts with old, in the context of clothes mentioned in the sentence, it is less appropriate than the term for new objects.
Synonyms: Youthful (युवा), Juvenile (किशोर), Adolescent (किशोर).
Antonyms: Aged (वृद्ध), Elderly (बुजुर्ग), Mature (परिपक्व).

This word describes something that has recently been made, introduced, or discovered. It is the most suitable antonym for old when referring to inanimate objects like clothes.
Synonyms: Fresh (ताजा), Modern (आधुनिक), Novel (नवीन).
Antonyms: Old (पुराना), Ancient (प्राचीन), Stale (बासी).

This term relates to present or recent times as opposed to the remote past. While related to being new, it often describes styles or eras rather than the simple condition of an object.
Synonyms: Contemporary (समकालीन), Current (वर्तमान), Trendy (फैशनेबल).
Antonyms: Archaic (पुराना), Ancient (प्राचीन), Obsolete (अप्रचलित).

This adjective usually refers to food that is not stale or things that are newly made. In the context of used versus unused clothes, "new" is a more standard general opposite.
Synonyms: Untarnished (शुद्ध), Crisp (करारा), Pure (निर्मल).
Antonyms: Stale (बासी), Rotten (सड़ा हुआ), Old (पुराना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Incoherent
questionsEn.s:
Incoherent - असंबद्ध / अस्पष्ट (Lacking clarity or logical connection)
Gloomy - उदास (Dark or poorly lit; sad)
Apparent - प्रकट / प्रत्यक्ष (Clearly visible or understood)
Pensive - विचारमग्न (Engaged in deep thought)
Rational - तर्कसंगत (Based on reason or logic)
oa:
This word describes a state of darkness, sadness, or lack of hope. It relates to mood and atmosphere rather than the logical structure of thought or speech.
Synonyms: Dismal (निराशाजनक), Somber (उदास), Melancholy (विषादपूर्ण).
Antonyms: Cheerful (हंसमुख), Bright (उज्ज्वल), Radiant (देदीप्यमान).

This term refers to something that is clearly visible or understood; obvious. While it implies clarity, it doesn't specifically address the logical flow required to oppose incoherence.
Synonyms: Obvious (स्पष्ट), Evident (प्रकट), Manifest (साफ).
Antonyms: Hidden (छिपा हुआ), Obscure (धुंधला), Ambiguous (अस्पष्ट).

This word describes someone engaged in deep or serious thought, often reflecting a quiet or sad mood. It does not relate to the organization or clarity of expression.
Synonyms: Thoughtful (विचारमग्न), Reflective (चिंतनशील), Meditative (ध्यानमग्न).
Antonyms: Thoughtless (विचारहीन), Heedless (असावधान), Shallow (सतही).

This term describes something based on or in accordance with reason or logic. It is the perfect antonym for incoherent, as it implies a clear and logical connection of ideas.
Synonyms: Logical (तार्किक), Coherent (सुसंगत), Lucid (सुस्पष्ट).
Antonyms: Irrational (अतार्किक), Absurd (बेतुका), Incoherent (असंबद्ध).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Blessed
questionsEn.s:
Blessed - धन्य / सौभाग्यशाली (Holy; bringing happiness or luck)
Appointed - नियुक्त (Officially chosen for a role)
Produced - उत्पादित (Made or brought into existence)
Applied - व्यावहारिक (Put to practical use)
Cursed - शापित (Afflicted with a curse or bad luck)
oa:
This verb refers to the act of officially choosing someone for a job or responsibility. It describes a professional selection rather than a spiritual or fortunate state.
Synonyms: Nominated (नामित), Designated (निर्धारित), Assigned (सौंपा गया).
Antonyms: Dismissed (बर्खास्त), Rejected (अस्वीकार किया), Removed (हटाया गया).

This word relates to making something or bringing something into existence. It focuses on creation or manufacturing rather than the favor or luck associated with being blessed.
Synonyms: Created (निर्मित), Manufactured (उत्पादित), Generated (उत्पन्न).
Antonyms: Destroyed (नष्ट), Consumed (उपभोग किया), Abolished (समाप्त किया).

This term describes something that has a practical use or has been put into operation. It is often used in the context of science or rules, not spiritual favor.
Synonyms: Utilized (उपयोग किया), Implemented (लागू किया), Practiced (व्यावहारिक).
Antonyms: Theoretical (सैद्धांतिक), Ignored (उपेक्षित), Detached (अलग).

This word refers to experiencing misfortune or being under a harmful spell. It serves as the direct spiritual and contextual opposite of being blessed or favored.
Synonyms: Hexed (शापित), Ill-fated (अभागा), Doomed (अभिशप्त).
Antonyms: Blessed (धन्य), Lucky (भाग्यशाली), Favored (अनुग्रहित).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Dwindle
questionsEn.s:
Dwindle - धीरे-धीरे कम होना (To diminish gradually in size or strength)
Deprecate - निंदा करना (To express disapproval of)
Complement - पूरक होना (To add to in a way that improves)
Motivate - प्रेरित करना (To provide incentive to act)
Neglect - उपेक्षा करना (To fail to care for properly)
oa:
This verb means to express strong disapproval of something or to belittle it. It focuses on judgment and criticism rather than the addition or completion of a whole.
Synonyms: Belittle (तुच्छ समझना), Condemn (निंदा करना), Disparage (उपेक्षा करना).
Antonyms: Praise (प्रशंसा करना), Appreciate (सराहना), Commend (सराहना).

This word means to add to something in a way that enhances it or makes it perfect. It provides a contextual opposite to the idea of dwindling or neglecting ideas.
Synonyms: Enhance (बढ़ाना), Complete (पूर्ण करना), Supplement (पूरक होना).
Antonyms: Diminish (कम करना), Detract (घटाना), Dwindle (मंद पड़ना).

This term refers to providing someone with a reason or incentive to do something. While positive, it relates to inspiration rather than the structural addition implied by the sentence.
Synonyms: Inspire (प्रेरित करना), Encourage (प्रोत्साहित करना), Stimulate (उत्तेजित करना).
Antonyms: Discourage (निरुत्साहित), Deter (रोकना), Dishearten (उदास करना).

This word means to fail to take care of or pay attention to something. It is synonymous with the negative aspect of the sentence rather than being an antonym for dwindle.
Synonyms: Ignore (नज़रअंदाज़), Overlook (अनदेखा), Disregard (उपेक्षा).
Antonyms: Attend (ध्यान देना), Cherish (सहेजना), Nurture (पालन-पोषण).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Inherent
questionsEn.s:
Inherent - अंतर्निहित (Existing in something as a permanent or essential part)
Natural - प्राकृतिक (Existing in or derived from nature)
Extraneous - अनावश्यक / बाहरी (Irrelevant or unrelated to the subject)
Induce - प्रेरित करना (To persuade or bring about)
Restricted - सीमित (Limited in scope or access)
oa:
This adjective describes qualities that are part of the basic nature of someone or something. It functions as a synonym for inherent rather than providing an opposite.
Synonyms: Innate (जन्मजात), Intrinsic (आंतरिक), Essential (मौलिक).
Antonyms: Acquired (अर्जित), Foreign (विदेशी), Alien (विचित्र).

This word refers to something that is irrelevant or unrelated to the subject; it comes from outside and is not a natural part of a whole. It is the direct opposite of inherent.
Synonyms: Irrelevant (अप्रासंगिक), External (बाहरी), Unconnected (असंबंधित).
Antonyms: Inherent (अंतर्निहित), Essential (आवश्यक), Intrinsic (आंतरिक).

This verb means to succeed in persuading someone to do something or to bring about a certain state. It is an action of influence rather than a quality of existence.
Synonyms: Persuade (मनाना), Instigate (उकसाना), Provoke (उकसाना).
Antonyms: Deter (रोकना), Prevent (रोकना), Discourage (निरुत्साहित).

This term describes something that is limited in range, scope, or access. It refers to boundaries rather than whether a quality is internal or external.
Synonyms: Limited (सीमित), Confined (सीमित), Capped (प्रतिबंधित).
Antonyms: Unlimited (असीमित), Free (मुक्त), Boundless (अपार).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Mobile
questionsEn.s:
Mobile - गतिशील (Able to move or be moved freely)
Standing - खड़ा हुआ / स्थिर (Remaining in an upright, fixed position)
Interesting - दिलचस्प (Arousing curiosity or interest)
Inside - अंदर (The inner side or surface)
Strange - अजीब (Unusual or surprising)
oa:
This word refers to being in an upright, fixed position and not in motion. It acts as a contextual antonym for mobile, which implies the ability to move freely.
Synonyms: Stationary (स्थिर), Fixed (अचल), Static (निश्चल).
Antonyms: Mobile (गतिशील), Moving (चलता हुआ), Active (सक्रिय).

This adjective describes something that arouses curiosity or holds attention. It focuses on the appeal of a subject rather than its physical ability to move.
Synonyms: Engaging (मोहक), Fascinating (दिलचस्प), Captivating (मनोरम).
Antonyms: Boring (उबाऊ), Dull (फीका), Tedious (थकाऊ).

This term indicates the inner part or interior of something. It describes spatial location rather than the capacity for movement or fixedness.
Synonyms: Inner (भीतरी), Interior (आंतरिक), Within (भीतर).
Antonyms: Outside (बाहरी), Exterior (बाहरी), Surface (सतह).

This word refers to something unusual, surprising, or difficult to understand. It characterizes the nature of an event rather than its physical state of motion.
Synonyms: Odd (अजीब), Peculiar (विचित्र), Weird (अनोखा).
Antonyms: Normal (सामान्य), Familiar (परिचित), Usual (साधारण).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Oppose
questionsEn.s:
Oppose - विरोध करना (To disagree with or try to prevent)
Embody - साकार करना (To represent an idea exactly)
Resist - विरोध करना (To fight against something)
Encourage - प्रोत्साहित करना (To give support or hope)
Elective - वैकल्पिक (Open to choice; optional)
oa:
This verb means to be a physical expression of an idea or quality. It describes the representation of a concept rather than taking a stance for or against it.
Synonyms: Manifest (साकार करना), Represent (प्रतिनिधित्व), Exemplify (उदाहरण देना).
Antonyms: Exclude (निकालना), Disembody (अशरीरी करना), Hide (छिपाना).

This word means to fight against or withstand the action of something. It is a synonym for oppose and thus cannot be the required opposite.
Synonyms: Confront (सामना करना), Defy (अवहेलना), Withstand (सहना).
Antonyms: Submit (समर्पण), Yield (झुकना), Surrender (हार मानना).

This verb means to give support, confidence, or hope to someone to do something. It expresses the opposite of opposing or trying to prevent an action.
Synonyms: Support (समर्थन), Motivate (प्रेरित), Stimulate (प्रोत्साहित).
Antonyms: Oppose (विरोध), Discourage (निरुत्साहित), Deter (रोकना).

This term refers to something that is optional or chosen by election. It describes the method of selection rather than an attitude of agreement or resistance.
Synonyms: Optional (वैकल्पिक), Voluntary (स्वैच्छिक), Selective (चयनात्मक).
Antonyms: Compulsory (अनिवार्य), Mandatory (अनिवार्य), Required (आवश्यक).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Indispensable
questionsEn.s:
Indispensable - अपरिहार्य / आवश्यक (Absolutely necessary)
Superfluous - अनावश्यक / फालतू (Unnecessary; more than enough)
Relentless - निरंतर / कठोर (Unceasingly intense or harsh)
Vigilant - सतर्क / जागरूक (Keeping careful watch for danger)
Transparent - पारदर्शी / स्पष्ट (Easy to see through or understand)
oa:
This word means unnecessary, especially through being more than enough. it is the direct opposite of indispensable, which describes something that is absolutely necessary.
Synonyms: Redundant (अनावश्यक), Excessive (अत्यधिक), Surplus (अतिरिक्त).
Antonyms: Essential (आवश्यक), Vital (महत्वपूर्ण), Indispensable (अपरिहार्य).

This adjective describes someone or something that is harsh, unforgiving, or persistent without stopping. It refers to intensity rather than necessity.
Synonyms: Persistent (निरंतर), Unyielding (अडिग), Merciless (निर्दयी).
Antonyms: Faltering (डगमगाता), Intermittent (रुक-रुक कर), Merciful (दयालु).

This term refers to keeping a careful watch for possible danger or difficulties. It describes an attitude of alertness rather than the importance of a role.
Synonyms: Watchful (चौकस), Alert (सतर्क), Attentive (सावधान).
Antonyms: Careless (लापरवाह), Negligent (असावधान), Heedless (बेपरवाह).

This word describes something that allows light to pass through clearly or is easy to perceive. It relates to clarity rather than whether something can be disregarded.
Synonyms: Clear (स्पष्ट), Pellucid (पारदर्शी), Obvious (साफ).
Antonyms: Opaque (अपारदर्शी), Murky (धुंधला), Ambiguous (अस्पष्ट).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Consolidated
questionsEn.s:
Consolidated - मजबूत / संगठित (Strengthened and made more secure)
Weakened - कमजोर करना (To make or become less strong)
Devised - ईजाद किया (To plan or invent a system)
Strengthened - मजबूत बनाना (To make something stronger)
Formulated - तैयार किया (To prepare something carefully)
oa:
This verb means to make or become less strong in power or physical strength. It is the direct opposite of consolidated, which involves strengthening or making something secure.
Synonyms: Enfeebled (निर्बल), Debilitated (कमज़ोर), Diminished (क्षीण).
Antonyms: Strengthened (मजबूत), Consolidated (संगठित), Fortified (सुदृढ़).

This term refers to the act of planning or inventing a complex procedure or system. It focuses on the creation of an idea rather than the security of a position.
Synonyms: Invented (ईजाद किया), Formulated (तैयार किया), Conceived (कल्पना की).
Antonyms: Destroyed (नष्ट), Ruined (बर्बाद), Neglected (उपेक्षा).

This word means to become stronger or more effective. It serves as a synonym for consolidated and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an opposite.
Synonyms: Fortified (मजबूत), Boosted (बढ़ावा दिया), Reinforced (सुदृढ़).
Antonyms: Weakened (कमज़ोर), Undermined (क्षीण), Sap (कमज़ोर करना).

This verb means to create or prepare something carefully according to a formula or plan. It is about the method of development rather than the strength of a leader's status.
Synonyms: Prepared (तैयार), Developed (विकसित), Drafted (मसौदा तैयार).
Antonyms: Disorganized (अव्यवस्थित), Random (बेतरतीब), Scrapped (रद्द).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Established
questionsEn.s:
Established - स्थापित (Recognized and settled over time)
Displaced - विस्थापित (Forced out of a usual position)
Fail - असफल होना (To not succeed in an aim)
Gratified - संतुष्ट (Feeling pleased or satisfied)
Pupils - छात्र (Students being taught in school)
oa:
This word describes being forced out of one's usual or original position. It serves as a direct opposite to established, which refers to being firmly settled or recognized.
Synonyms: Ousted (बेदखल), Uprooted (जड़ से उखाड़ा), Shifted (विस्थापित).
Antonyms: Settled (स्थापित), Established (स्थिर), Fixed (नियत).

This verb refers to not succeeding in an attempt or expectation. While negative, it describes an outcome of an action rather than a state of being settled in society.
Synonyms: Flop (असफल), Collapse (असफल), Falter (डगमगाना).
Antonyms: Succeed (सफल), Win (जीतना), Triumph (विजयी).

This term means to feel pleased or satisfied due to the fulfillment of a wish or need. It describes a positive emotion rather than a social status.
Synonyms: Satisfied (संतुष्ट), Pleased (प्रसन्न), Contented (तृप्त).
Antonyms: Frustrated (हताश), Dissatisfied (असंतुष्ट), Depressed (उदास).

This plural noun refers to students or children in a school being taught. It is a category of people and bears no logical relationship of opposition to being established.
Synonyms: Students (छात्र), Scholars (विद्यार्थी), Learners (शिक्षार्थी).
Antonyms: Teachers (शिक्षक), Mentors (गुरु), Professors (प्राध्यापक).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Unprecedented
questionsEn.s:
Unprecedented - अभूतपूर्व (Never having happened or existed before)
Lacklustre - नीरस (Dull; lacking interest or energy)
Tarnished - कलंकित (Dull; having lost brightness)
Familiar - परिचित (Well known from long association)
Deranged - विक्षिप्त (Mad or mentally unstable)
oa:
This word describes something that is uninspiring, dull, or lacking in energy. It focuses on the quality of excitement rather than the novelty of an occurrence.
Synonyms: Dull (नीरस), Drab (फीका), Boring (उबाऊ).
Antonyms: Vibrant (जीवंत), Radiant (चमकीला), Brilliant (शानदार).

This term refers to something that has lost its luster or has been spoiled in reputation. It describes a decline from a better state rather than a commonality.
Synonyms: Stained (दाग़दार), Blemished (कलंकित), Dull (धुंधला).
Antonyms: Polished (चमकदार), Bright (उज्ज्वल), Clean (साफ).

This adjective describes something that is well known from long or close association. It is the direct opposite of unprecedented, which means never having happened before.
Synonyms: Common (सामान्य), Usual (साधारण), Customary (प्रचलित).
Antonyms: Unprecedented (अभूतपूर्व), Novel (नवीन), Strange (अजीब).

This word describes someone whose behavior is not normal, often due to mental illness. It refers to instability rather than the historical frequency of an event.
Synonyms: Insane (विक्षिप्त), Maddened (पागल), Unbalanced (असंतुलित).
Antonyms: Sane (समझदार), Rational (तर्कसंगत), Balanced (संतुलित).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Diversity
questionsEn.s:
Diversity - विविधता (The state of being diverse; variety)
Melancholy - उदासी (Pensive sadness)
Equilibrium - संतुलन (A state of balance)
Affinity - आकर्षण (A natural liking for something)
Uniformity - एकरूपता (The quality of being the same throughout)
oa:
This noun refers to a feeling of deep, pensive sadness. It relates to emotional states and has no connection with the concept of variety or sameness.
Synonyms: Sadness (उदासी), Gloom (विषाद), Sorrow (दुःख).
Antonyms: Happiness (प्रसन्नता), Joy (हर्ष), Elation (उल्लास).

This term describes a state in which opposing forces or influences are balanced. While it implies stability, it does not mean "being the same" as required to oppose diversity.
Synonyms: Balance (संतुलन), Stability (स्थिरता), Symmetry (समरूपता).
Antonyms: Imbalance (असंतुलन), Chaos (अराजकता), Turmoil (उथल-पुथल).

This word refers to a natural liking for or understanding of someone or something. It describes a connection or attraction rather than a lack of variety.
Synonyms: Liking (आकर्षण), Empathy (सहानुभूति), Rapport (तालमेल).
Antonyms: Aversion (घृणा), Dislike (नापसंद), Antagonism (विरोध).

This word refers to the quality of being the same or not changing in any way. It expresses the direct opposite of diversity, which implies variety and difference.
Synonyms: Sameness (एकरूपता), Consistency (निरंतरता), Homogeneity (सजातीयता).
Antonyms: Diversity (विविधता), Variety (विभिन्नता), Difference (अंतर).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Precise
questionsEn.s:
Precise - सटीक / एकदम सही (Exact and accurate)
Complicated - जटिल (Difficult to understand or deal with)
Inevitable - अनिवार्य (Certain to happen; unavoidable)
Rough - अनुमानित / मोटा-मोटा (Not exact or detailed)
Adequate - पर्याप्त (Satisfactory or good enough)
oa:
This word describes something that is difficult to understand because it has many interconnected parts. It refers to complexity rather than the accuracy of a measurement.
Synonyms: Intricate (जटिल), Elaborate (विस्तृत), Knotty (पेचीदा).
Antonyms: Simple (सरल), Plain (सादा), Straightforward (सीधा).

This adjective refers to something that is certain to happen and cannot be avoided. It deals with certainty in events rather than precision in data.
Synonyms: Unavoidable (अपरिहार्य), Assured (निश्चित), Bound (तय).
Antonyms: Avoidable (परिहार्य), Preventable (निवार्य), Uncertain (अनिश्चित).

This word means not exact or detailed, often providing only a general idea. It stands as the direct opposite of precise, which implies exactness and accuracy.
Synonyms: Approximate (अनुमानित), Crude (अपरिष्कृत), Vague (अस्पष्ट).
Antonyms: Precise (एकदम सही), Exact (सटीक), Detailed (विस्तृत).

This term describes something that is satisfactory or good enough in quality or quantity. It focuses on sufficiency rather than the degree of exactness.
Synonyms: Sufficient (पर्याप्त), Enough (काफी), Satisfactory (संतोषजनक).
Antonyms: Inadequate (अपर्याप्त), Scanty (अल्प), Deficient (कमी).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Left
questionsEn.s:
Left - बचा हुआ / बाकी (Remaining; not used up)
Stayed - रुका हुआ (Remained in a place)
Finished - समाप्त / खत्म (Brought to an end or consumed)
Present - उपस्थित / वर्तमान (Existing or occurring now)
oa:
This verb refers to remaining in a particular place or not moving. While it deals with the same theme, "left" in the context of the sentence refers to "remaining" rather than "departing."
Synonyms: Remained (बने रहे), Waited (प्रतीक्षा की), Abided (ठहरे).
Antonyms: Departed (चले गए), Left (छोड़ा), Vanished (गायब हुए).

This word means brought to an end or completely used up. It acts as the antonym for "left" when it means "remaining" or "still present" after an event.
Synonyms: Completed (पूर्ण), Concluded (समाप्त), Exhausted (खत्म).
Antonyms: Remaining (बचा हुआ), Left (बाकी), Incomplete (अधूरा).

This word can mean correct or refer to a direction. In neither sense does it serve as an antonym for "left" when used to describe remaining items.
Synonyms: Correct (सही), Proper (उचित), Dexter (दाहिना).
Antonyms: Wrong (गलत), Left (बायां), Sinister (बायां).

This term refers to something existing or occurring now in a particular place. It functions more like a synonym for "left" (in the sense of remaining) rather than an opposite.
Synonyms: Existing (मौजूदा), Current (वर्तमान), Attending (उपस्थित).
Antonyms: Absent (अनुपस्थित), Finished (खत्म), Past (अतीत).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Polite
questionsEn.s:
Polite - विनम्र / शिष्ट (Showing behavior that is respectful)
Rude - असभ्य / अशिष्ट (Offensively impolite or ill-mannered)
Civil - सभ्य (Courteous and polite)
Decent - उचित / शालीन (Socially acceptable or good)
Sober - गंभीर / शांत (Serious and sensible; not drunk)
oa:
This adjective describes someone who is offensively impolite or ill-mannered. It serves as the direct and most common antonym for being polite and respectful.
Synonyms: Impolite (अशिष्ट), Insolent (बदतमीज़), Discourteous (अभद्र).
Antonyms: Polite (विनम्र), Civil (सभ्य), Courteous (शिष्ट).
