This word refers to a state in which you can only think about one person or thing. It is a direct synonym for fetish and therefore does not satisfy the required relationship.
Synonyms: Fixation (जुनून), Mania (सनक), Preoccupation (मग्नता).
Antonyms: Indifference (उदासीनता), Disinterest (अरुचि), Neglect (उपेक्षा).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Disheveled
questionsEn.s:
Disheveled - अस्त-व्यस्त / मैला-कुचैला (Very untidy in appearance)
Tidy - सुव्यवस्थित / साफ (Arranged in good order)
Clumsy - अनाड़ी (Careless and likely to break things)
Infuriated - अतिक्रुद्घ (To make someone very angry)
Excited - उत्साहित (Feeling happiness and enthusiasm)
oa:
This word means arranged with everything in good order and being neat. It acts as the direct and most appropriate antonym for disheveled, which describes a messy appearance.
Synonyms: Neat (सुव्यवस्थित), Ordered (क्रमबद्ध), Clean (साफ-सुथरा).
Antonyms: Disheveled (अस्त-व्यस्त), Messy (गंदा), Untidy (मैला-कुचैला).

This adjective describes someone who is careless and likely to drop or break things. While it can lead to a mess, it refers to physical coordination rather than appearance.
Synonyms: Inept (अनाड़ी), Awkward (बेढंगा), Gauche (फूहड़).
Antonyms: Skillful (निपुण), Graceful (सौम्य), Dexterous (चतुर).

This verb means to make someone very angry or enraged. It describes an emotional state of extreme irritation and has no relationship to the neatness of appearance.
Synonyms: Enraged (अतिक्रुद्घ), Angered (क्रोधित), Incensed (नाराज़).
Antonyms: Calm (शांत), Pleased (प्रसन्न), Pacified (संतुष्ट).

This term refers to feeling or showing happiness and enthusiasm. It characterizes a positive and high-energy emotional state rather than the physical state of being tidy.
Synonyms: Thrilled (उत्साहित), Eager (उत्सुक), Animated (जोशीला).
Antonyms: Bored (ऊबा हुआ), Calm (शांत), Indifferent (उदासीन).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Sweet
questionsEn.s:
Sweet - मीठा / मधुर (Containing or tasting of sugar)
Delicious - स्वादिष्ट (Having a very pleasant taste)
Pleasant - सुहाना (Nice, enjoyable, or friendly)
Bitter - कड़वा / तीखा (With an unpleasantly sharp taste)
Special - विशेष (Not usual or ordinary)
oa:
This adjective describes something having a very pleasant taste or smell. It functions as a positive descriptor for food, similar to sweet, rather than an opposite.
Synonyms: Tasty (स्वादिष्ट), Savory (ज़ायकेदार), Palatable (रुचिकर).
Antonyms: Distasteful (अप्रिय), Insipid (बेस्वाद), Nauseating (घिनौना).

This word means nice, enjoyable, or friendly. It refers to a general sense of satisfaction rather than the specific category of sugar-like taste.
Synonyms: Enjoyable (आनंददायक), Friendly (अनुकूल), Suave (सुहाना).
Antonyms: Unpleasant (अप्रिय), Harsh (कठोर), Mean (नीच).

This term describes an unpleasantly sharp and pungent taste, often associated with things like coffee or alum. it is the direct and most accurate antonym for sweet.
Synonyms: Sharp (तीखा), Acidic (कड़वा), Acrid (कसैला).
Antonyms: Sweet (मीठा), Sugary (मधुर), Mild (हल्का).

This adjective refers to things that are not usual or ordinary, often important for a specific reason. It identifies uniqueness rather than a flavor profile.
Synonyms: Particular (विशेष), Unique (अद्वितीय), Exceptional (असाधारण).
Antonyms: Ordinary (साधारण), Common (सामान्य), Normal (साधारण).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Rectify
questionsEn.s:
Rectify - सुधारना / शुद्ध करना (To correct something that is wrong)
Worsen - बदतर करना (To become or make something worse)
Alter - बदलना (To make something different)
Reason - कारण / तर्क (Cause or explanation for something)
Modify - संशोधित करना (To change something slightly)
oa:
This verb means to become worse or to make something worse than it was. It serves as the direct opposite of rectify, which involves correcting errors and making things right.
Synonyms: Exacerbate (बिगाड़ना), Degrade (घटाना), Aggravate (बदतर करना).
Antonyms: Rectify (सुधारना), Improve (बेहतर बनाना), Mend (मरम्मत).

This word means to make something different in some way without changing it completely. It refers to general modification rather than specifically making something worse or better.
Synonyms: Change (बदलना), Modify (संशोधित), Vary (परिवर्तित).
Antonyms: Stabilize (स्थिर रखना), Preserve (बनाए रखना), Maintain (कायम रखना).

This noun refers to a cause or explanation for something. As a verb, it means to think or talk about something logically. Neither sense provides an opposite for correction.
Synonyms: Cause (कारण), Rationale (औचित्य), Argument (तर्क).
Antonyms: Fallacy (तर्कदोष), Nonsense (बकवास), Result (परिणाम).

This verb means to change something slightly to improve it or make it less extreme. It is often a step in the process of rectifying and is not its opposite.
Synonyms: Adjust (समायोजित), Adapt (अनुकूल बनाना), Revise (संशोधित).
Antonyms: Fix (नियत रखना), Keep (बनाए रखना), Leave (छोड़ना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Complaint
questionsEn.s:
Complaint - शिकायत (Expressing dissatisfaction or criticism)
Challenge - चुनौती (An invitation to compete or take action)
Carp - नुक्ताचीनी (To complain constantly about trivia)
Praise - प्रशंसा (Expression of approval or admiration)
Demur - आपत्ति (To raise objections or show reluctance)
oa:
This verb means to invite someone to take action or engage in a contest. It refers to a call for competition rather than the act of expressing approval or disapproval.
Synonyms: Defiance (चुनौती), Dare (साहस), Confrontation (मुक़ाबला).
Antonyms: Agreement (सहमति), Acceptance (स्वीकृति), Surrender (समर्पण).

This word means to complain or find fault constantly about trivial matters. It is a synonym for the negative action of complaining and therefore not an opposite.
Synonyms: Gumble (बड़बड़ाना), Quibble (नुक्ताचीनी), Nitpick (दोष निकालना).
Antonyms: Praise (प्रशंसा), Commend (सराहना), Extol (बखान).

This term refers to expressing approval, admiration, or compliments for someone's actions. It is the direct opposite of a complaint, which focuses on dissatisfaction.
Synonyms: Commendation (सराहना), Admiration (प्रशंसा), Acclaim (तारीफ).
Antonyms: Complaint (शिकायत), Criticism (आलोचना), Censure (निंदा).

This verb means to raise objections or show reluctance. It identifies a specific type of disagreement or hesitation similar to the sentiment of a complaint.
Synonyms: Object (आपत्ति), Dissent (असहमत), Hesitate (झिझकना).
Antonyms: Assent (स्वीकृति), Agree (सहमत), Accept (स्वीकार).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Camouflage
questionsEn.s:
Camouflage - छलावरण (To hide or disguise by blending in)
Clothed - पहना हुआ (Dressed or covered)
Mask - छिपाना (To conceal or disguise)
Reveal - प्रकट करना / दिखाना (To make something known or visible)
Vanishing - लुप्त होना (Disappearing or fading away)
oa:
This term refers to someone or something that is dressed or covered with clothes. While it involves covering, it doesn't specifically address the intent of concealment.
Synonyms: Dressed (पहना हुआ), Covered (ढका हुआ), Garbed (सज्जित).
Antonyms: Naked (नग्न), Bare (खुला), Exposed (उजागर).

This verb means to conceal or disguise a feeling or situation. It is a synonym for camouflage and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an opposite.
Synonyms: Cloak (छिपाना), Disguise (कपटवेश), Veil (अस्पष्ट करना).
Antonyms: Reveal (प्रकट करना), Unmask (नकाब उतारना), Disclose (खोलना).

This word means to make something known or visible that was previously hidden. It serves as the direct opposite of camouflage, which is meant to hide or blend in.
Synonyms: Disclose (प्रकट करना), Exhibit (दिखाना), Uncover (उजागर).
Antonyms: Camouflage (छिपाना), Hide (गुप्त रखना), Mask (ढकना).

This adjective describes something that is disappearing or fading away. It characterizes a movement toward invisibility, which is more similar to hiding than revealing.
Synonyms: Disappearing (लुप्त), Fading (मिटता हुआ), Evanescent (क्षणिक).
Antonyms: Appearing (प्रकट), Emerging (उभरता), Materializing (साकार).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Incompetent
questionsEn.s:
Incompetent - अयोग्य (Lacking necessary skills or ability)
Forlorn - दुखी / अकेला (Sad and lonely)
Desperate - बेकरार / निराश (Feeling a sense of hopelessness)
Hopeless - निराशाजनक (Feeling or causing despair)
Dexterous - चतुर / कुशल (Having or showing skill with hands)
oa:
This adjective describes someone who is sad and lonely or a place that is deserted. It deals with emotional state or isolation rather than the skill level of a person.
Synonyms: Sad (दुखी), Lonely (अकेला), Pitiful (दयनीय).
Antonyms: Cheerful (प्रसन्न), Joyful (हर्षित), Accompanied (साथी के साथ).

This term describes a hopeless sense that a situation is extremely bad or a person ready to do anything to change it. It refers to urgency and despair.
Synonyms: Frantic (बेकरार), Hopeless (निराशाजनक), Reckless (लापरवाह).
Antonyms: Content (संतुष्ट), Hopeful (आशावादी), Secure (सुरक्षित).

This adjective refers to a feeling of despair or something that is incapable of improvement. It characterizes a lack of optimism rather than a lack of skill.
Synonyms: Dismal (निराशाजनक), Despairing (निराश), Futile (बेकार).
Antonyms: Optimistic (आशावादी), Hopeful (आशामय), Promising (होनहार).

This word means having or showing skill, especially with the hands. it is the direct and most accurate antonym for incompetent, which means lacking necessary skills.
Synonyms: Skillful (कुशल), Adept (निपुण), Adroit (चतुर).
Antonyms: Incompetent (अयोग्य), Clumsy (अनाड़ी), Inept (अकुशल).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Curtail
questionsEn.s:
Curtail - कम करना / घटाना (To reduce or limit something)
Indent - हाशिए में जगह छोड़ना (To start a line further from the margin)
Innate - जन्मजात (Natural or inherent)
Increase - वृद्धि करना / बढ़ाना (To make something larger or more)
Insinuate - संकेत करना (To suggest something indirectly)
oa:
This verb refers to making a space at the beginning of a paragraph or to start a line further in from the margin. It is a technical formatting term with no relation to reduction.
Synonyms: Notch (काटना), Serrate (दंतेदार), Recess (गहराई).
Antonyms: Bulge (उभार), Protrude (निकलना), Flatten (समतल).

This adjective describes something that is natural or inherent, existing in one from birth. It refers to the origin of a trait rather than a change in quantity.
Synonyms: Inborn (जन्मजात), Native (सहज), Intrinsic (आंतरिक).
Antonyms: Acquired (अर्जित), Learned (सीखा हुआ), External (बाहरी).

This word means to make something larger or to result in more. It acts as the direct opposite of curtail, which involves reducing or limiting expenditures.
Synonyms: Expand (बढ़ाना), Boost (बढ़ाना), Augment (वृद्धि करना).
Antonyms: Curtail (कम करना), Decrease (घटाना), Lessen (घटाना).

This verb means to suggest something indirectly or subtly, often something unpleasant. It describes a method of communication and not a change in amount.
Synonyms: Hint (संकेत करना), Intimate (सुझाव देना), Imply (निहित).
Antonyms: Proclaim (घोषणा), Declare (घोषित), State (साफ कहना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Spurious
questionsEn.s:
Spurious - नकली / बनावटी (Fake or false; not genuine)
Fake - जाली (An imitation intended to deceive)
Stolen - चुराया हुआ (Taken without permission)
Splendid - शानदार (Very good or excellent)
Authentic - प्रामाणिक / असली (Genuine or real)
oa:
This adjective describes something that is not genuine; it is an imitation or counterfeit. It functions as a direct synonym for spurious and therefore cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: False (नकली), Counterfeit (जाली), Phony (बनावटी).
Antonyms: Authentic (प्रामाणिक), Real (असली), Genuine (सच्चा).

This term refers to something taken from someone else without permission, especially secretly. It describes how an object was acquired rather than its authenticity.
Synonyms: Purloined (चुराया हुआ), Pilfered (अपहृत), Looted (लूटा हुआ).
Antonyms: Returned (लौटाया), Gifted (उपहार में दिया), Bought (खरीदा).

This word describes something very good, impressive, or excellent in appearance. While positive, it refers to the beauty or quality of a thing rather than its truth.
Synonyms: Magnificent (शानदार), Grand (भव्य), Glorious (उत्कृष्ट).
Antonyms: Ordinary (साधारण), Poor (घटिया), Terrible (भयानक).

This word means genuine, real, and of undisputed origin. it is the direct and most suitable antonym for spurious, which describes something fake or false.
Synonyms: Genuine (असली), Original (वास्तविक), Bona fide (प्रामाणिक).
Antonyms: Spurious (नकली), Fake (जाली), Bogus (खोटा).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Staunch
questionsEn.s:
Staunch - वफादार / दृढ़ (Loyal or committed)
Resolute - दृढ़ / अटल (Determined or unwavering)
Careless - लापरवाह (Not paying attention)
Confused - भ्रमित (Unclear or uncertain)
Unsteady - अस्थिर (Unreliable or inconsistent)
oa:
This adjective describes someone who is admirably purposeful, determined, and unwavering. It is a synonym for the "firm" nature of a staunch ally.
Synonyms: Determined (दृढ़), Constant (अटल), Unwavering (अडिग).
Antonyms: Irresolute (अस्थिर), Wavering (डगमगाता), Weak (कमज़ोर).

This term refers to not paying enough attention or being negligent. While negative, it describes a lack of focus rather than a lack of loyalty or stability.
Synonyms: Negligent (लापरवाह), Heedless (असावधान), Remiss (बेपरवाह).
Antonyms: Careful (सावधान), Attentive (सतर्क), Heedful (चौकस).

This word describes someone who is unclear in mind or uncertain about something. It identifies a state of mental muddle rather than a failure of commitment.
Synonyms: Puzzled (भ्रमित), Baffled (चकित), Perplexed (उलझन में).
Antonyms: Clear (स्पष्ट), Certain (निश्चित), Lucid (सुस्पष्ट).

This adjective refers to being unreliable, inconsistent, or likely to change. It acts as the direct opposite of staunch, which implies being loyal, firm, and committed.
Synonyms: Fickle (अस्थिर), Changeable (परिवर्तनशील), Erratic (अनियमित).
Antonyms: Staunch (वफादार), Stable (स्थिर), Firm (मजबूत).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Dusted
questionsEn.s:
Dusted - हल्का लेप लगाना (Sprinkling a fine layer over something)
Scattered - बिखेरना (To throw or drop randomly)
Sprinkled - छिड़कना (To scatter small drops or particles)
Powdered - चूर्णित (Covered with powder)
Cleaned - साफ किया (To remove particles or substances)
oa:
This verb means to throw or drop things randomly in different directions. It describes a messy distribution of particles rather than their removal.
Synonyms: Dispersed (बिखेरना), Strewn (छितराना), Sprinkled (छिड़कना).
Antonyms: Collected (इकट्ठा), Gathered (संग्रह), Accumulated (जमा).

This term refers to scattering small drops or particles over something. In the context of the sentence, it describes the same action as dusting rather than opposing it.
Synonyms: Dusted (हल्का लेप), Showered (बौछार), Spattered (छींटें देना).
Antonyms: Drained (सूखा), Wiped (पूँछा), Dried (सुखाया).

This adjective describes something that has been reduced to a fine dust or covered with powder. It aligns with the state of the muffin rather than the opposite of the action.
Synonyms: Pulverized (चूर्णित), Ground (पिसा हुआ), Crushed (कुचला).
Antonyms: Solid (ठोस), Granular (दानेदार), Whole (संपूर्ण).

This verb means to remove dirt, particles, or unwanted substances from something. it is the correct opposite for dusting in a context where dusting implies adding a layer.
Synonyms: Wiped (पूँछा), Purified (शुद्ध), Sanitzed (साफ किया).
Antonyms: Dusted (लेप लगाया), Soiled (गंदा किया), Contaminated (दूषित).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Compulsory
questionsEn.s:
Compulsory - अनिवार्य (Required or mandatory)
Obligatory - आवश्यक (Required by rule or law)
Mandatory - अनिवार्य (Required by authority)
Voluntary - स्वैच्छिक / वैकल्पिक (Optional or done by choice)
Subsidiary - सहायक (Secondary or supplemental)
oa:
This word means required by a legal, moral, or other rule. it is a direct synonym for compulsory and therefore does not satisfy the requirements of an antonym.
Synonyms: Mandatory (अनिवार्य), Required (आवश्यक), Necessary (ज़रूरी).
Antonyms: Optional (वैकल्पिक), Voluntary (स्वैच्छिक), Discretionary (विवेकाधीन).

This term describes something required by authority or rules. Like compulsory, it implies that an action must be done and cannot be an opposite.
Synonyms: Compulsory (अनिवार्य), Essential (आवश्यक), Binding (बाध्यकारी).
Antonyms: Elective (वैकल्पिक), Optional (वैकल्पिक), Permissive (अनुमोदक).

This word means done by choice or being optional. it serves as the direct antonym for compulsory, as it implies that an action is not required by law or rule.
Synonyms: Optional (वैकल्पिक), Discretionary (विवेकाधीन), Elective (स्वैच्छिक).
Antonyms: Compulsory (अनिवार्य), Mandatory (अनिवार्य), Obligatory (आवश्यक).

This adjective describes something that is secondary or serves to assist the main part. It focuses on the hierarchy of importance rather than whether something is required.
Synonyms: Secondary (माध्यमिक), Supplemental (पूरक), Auxiliary (सहायक).
Antonyms: Primary (प्राथमिक), Main (मुख्य), Principal (प्रधान).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Bumpy
questionsEn.s:
Bumpy - खुरदरा / ऊबड़-खाबड़ (Having irregularities or rough surfaces)
Jerky - धचका देनेवाला (Characterized by abrupt movements)
Uneven - असमतल (Not level or smooth)
Choppy - अशांत (Characterized by rough or irregular motion)
Steady - स्थिर (Stable, constant, or without fluctuations)
oa:
This term describes a movement characterized by sudden, abrupt, or irregular starts and stops. It aligns with the roughness of a bumpy surface rather than opposing it.
Synonyms: Spasmodic (धचका देनेवाला), Irregular (अनियमित), Uneven (असमतल).
Antonyms: Smooth (चिकना), Continuous (निरंतर), Steady (स्थिर).

This adjective describes a surface that is not level or smooth; it has irregularities. It is a synonym for bumpy and thus cannot be the required opposite.
Synonyms: Rough (खुरदरा), Rugged (कठोर), Pitted (गड्ढेदार).
Antonyms: Even (सम), Level (समतल), Flat (चपटा).

This word usually describes water having small, turbulent waves or a motion that is rough and irregular. It is conceptually similar to being bumpy.
Synonyms: Turbulent (अशांत), Rough (उग्र), Irregular (अनियमित गति).
Antonyms: Calm (शांत), Still (स्थिर), Serene (अविक्षुब्ध).

This word means stable, constant, or without fluctuations and irregularities. in the context of a riding surface or pace, it acts as the most suitable antonym for bumpy.
Synonyms: Stable (स्थिर), Constant (निरंतर), Consistent (समान).
Antonyms: Bumpy (खुरदरा), Erratic (अनियमित), Unstable (अस्थिर).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Jubilant
questionsEn.s:
Jubilant - अत्यधिक ख़ुशी / प्रफुल्लित (Feeling great happiness and triumph)
Indifferent - उदासीन (Having no interest or sympathy)
Thoughtful - विचारशील (Showing consideration for others)
Gay - खुश / लापरवाह (Happy and carefree)
Melancholic - उदास / विषादपूर्ण (Feeling sadness or depression)
oa:
This adjective refers to having no particular interest, concern, or sympathy. While not positive, it describes a lack of emotion rather than a specific feeling of sadness.
Synonyms: Apathetic (उदासीन), Unconcerned (बेपरवाह), Neutral (तटस्थ).
Antonyms: Interested (दिलचस्प), Concerned (चिंतित), Passionate (भावुक).

This word describes someone showing consideration for the needs of others or being deep in thought. It refers to a quiet mental state rather than an opposite emotion to joy.
Synonyms: Reflective (चिंतनशील), Considerate (विचारशील), Attentive (सावधान).
Antonyms: Thoughtless (विचारहीन), Heedless (असावधान), Rash (जल्दबाज).

This adjective means happy, lighthearted, and carefree. It serves as a synonym for jubilant in many contexts and therefore does not satisfy the requirement.
Synonyms: Joyful (हर्षित), Cheerful (प्रसन्न), Jolly (प्रफुल्ल).
Antonyms: Sad (दुखी), Gloomy (उदास), Melancholy (विषादपूर्ण).

This word refers to feeling or expressing sadness, depression, or gloom. it is the direct and most accurate antonym for jubilant, which signifies great happiness.
Synonyms: Gloomy (विषादपूर्ण), Sorrowful (दुखद), Depressed (उदास).
Antonyms: Jubilant (प्रफुल्लित), Joyful (आनंदित), Happy (खुश).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Grow
questionsEn.s:
Grow - बढ़ना (To increase in size or quantity)
Shrink - सिकुड़ना (To decrease in size or quantity)
Crimp - मोड़ना (To fold or bend into tight folds)
Plant - बोना (To put a seed in the ground to grow)
Alter - बदलना (To change or modify something)
oa:
This verb means to become smaller in size or quantity. It serves as the direct and most suitable antonym for grow, which involves an increase in size.
Synonyms: Contract (सिकुड़ना), Diminish (घटाना), Wane (कम होना).
Antonyms: Grow (बढ़ना), Expand (फैलना), Enlarge (विस्तार).

This word refers to folding or bending something into small, tight, or irregular folds. It describes a change in shape rather than the biological or numerical increase of growth.
Synonyms: Fold (मोड़ना), Crease (सलवट), Wrinkle (झुर्री).
Antonyms: Straighten (सीधा करना), Flatten (समतल), Smooth (चिकना करना).

This verb means to put a seed or seedling in the ground so that it can grow. While it is the starting action for growth, it is not its opposite.
Synonyms: Sow (बोना), Embed (स्थापित), Cultivate (खेती करना).
Antonyms: Uproot (जड़ से उखाड़ना), Harvest (काटना), Remove (हटाना).

This term means to change or modify something in some way. It identifies a general transformation rather than specifically addressing an increase or decrease in size.
Synonyms: Change (बदलना), Modify (संशोधित), Vary (परिवर्तित).
Antonyms: Preserve (सुरक्षित रखना), Fix (नियत रखना), Maintain (बनाए रखना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Joyous
questionsEn.s:
Joyous - अत्यधिक ख़ुशी (Expressing great happiness or delight)
Melancholic - उदास (Feeling sad or depressed)
Vengeful - प्रतिशोधी (Having a strong desire for revenge)
Ecstatic - प्रसन्नचित्त (Feeling extremely happy or excited)
Exuberant - ऊर्जावान (Full of energy and enthusiasm)
oa:
This adjective refers to feeling deep sadness or being depressed. It is the direct emotional opposite of joyous, which involves experiencing great happiness or delight.
Synonyms: Gloomy (उदास), Sorrowful (दुखद), Dismal (निराशाजनक).
Antonyms: Joyous (हर्षित), Happy (खुश), Cheerful (प्रसन्न).

This term describes a person having or showing a strong desire for revenge. It characterizes a hostile motive rather than the simple opposite of a happy emotion.
Synonyms: Vindictive (प्रतिशोधी), Spiteful (द्वेषपूर्ण), Retaliatory (बदला लेने वाला).
Antonyms: Forgiving (क्षमाशील), Merciful (दयालु), Benevolent (परोपकारी).

This word refers to feeling extremely happy, excited, or full of overwhelming joy. It functions as a synonym for joyous and therefore is not an opposite.
Synonyms: Elated (उल्लसित), Overjoyed (गदगद), Rapturous (भावविभोर).
Antonyms: Depressed (उदास), Miserable (दयनीय), Sad (दुखी).

This adjective describes someone full of energy, excitement, and cheerfulness. Like joyous, it indicates a very high positive energy level and cannot be an antonym.
Synonyms: Buoyant (उत्साही), High-spirited (जोशीला), Vibrant (जीवंत).
Antonyms: Listless (सुस्त), Apathetic (उदासीन), Dull (फीका).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Superficial
questionsEn.s:
Superficial - सतही (Shallow or lacking depth)
Deviant - असामान्य (Different or abnormal)
Profound - गहरा / गहन (Deep or thorough)
Artificial - नकली (Fake or not natural)
Opposing - विरोधी (Conflicting or contrary)
oa:
This term refers to something that is different from what is considered normal or acceptable. it describes a departure from the norm rather than the depth of a quality.
Synonyms: Abnormal (असामान्य), Irregular (अनियमित), Atypical (विचित्र).
Antonyms: Normal (सामान्य), Regular (नियमित), Standard (मानक).

This adjective means deep, thorough, or having great knowledge and insight. It is the direct opposite of superficial, which describes things that are shallow or lack depth.
Synonyms: Deep (गहरा), Insightful (सूझबूझ वाला), Thorough (संपूर्ण).
Antonyms: Superficial (सतही), Shallow (उथला), Cursory (जल्दबाजी वाला).

This word refers to something made by human beings rather than occurring naturally; fake. While it can imply lack of depth, its primary meaning concerns its origin.
Synonyms: Synthetic (कृत्रिम), Fake (नकली), Man-made (मानव-निर्मित).
Antonyms: Natural (प्राकृतिक), Genuine (असली), Real (वास्तविक).

This adjective describes things that are conflicting, contrary, or in disagreement with one another. It refers to a relationship of conflict rather than the degree of depth.
Synonyms: Conflicting (विरोधी), Contrary (विपरीत), Adverse (प्रतिकूल).
Antonyms: Supporting (समर्थक), Agreeing (सहमत), Allied (संबद्ध).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Forbade
questionsEn.s:
Forbade - मना करना (To prohibit or disallow something)
Prevented - रोकना (To stop something from happening)
Refused - अस्वीकार करना (To decline or reject something)
Declined - नामंजूर (To politely refuse a request)
Allowed - अनुमति देना (To permit or give permission)
oa:
This verb means to stop something from happening or to make it impossible. It is synonymous with the intent of forbidding and therefore cannot be an opposite.
Synonyms: Stopped (रोकना), Blocked (बाधित), Thwarted (विफल).
Antonyms: Allowed (अनुमति देना), Facilitated (सुविधा देना), Helped (मदद).

This term means to decline or reject something offered or requested. Like forbade, it describes a negative response to a desire or action.
Synonyms: Declined (अस्वीकार), Rejected (नकारा), Denied (इनकार).
Antonyms: Accepted (स्वीकार), Consented (सहमत), Agreed (सहमति दी).

This word refers to politely refusing an offer or request. It functions as a synonym for refused and aligns with the restrictive sense of forbidden actions.
Synonyms: Denied (मना किया), Withheld (रोका), Rejected (अस्वीकार).
Antonyms: Accepted (मान लिया), Permitted (अनुमति दी), Approved (मंजूर).

This verb means to permit something or give permission for an action to occur. it is the direct and most suitable antonym for forbade, which involves prohibiting an action.
Synonyms: Permitted (अनुमति देना), Authorised (अधिकृत), Let (होने देना).
Antonyms: Forbade (मना करना), Prohibited (वर्जित), Banned (प्रतिबंधित).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Frugal
questionsEn.s:
Frugal - मितव्ययी (Economical with money or resources)
Reckless - लापरवाह (Without thinking of consequences)
Weary - थका हुआ (Feeling or showing tiredness)
Severe - गंभीर / कठोर (Strict or harsh in degree)
Extravagant - फिजूलखर्च (Wasteful in spending resources)
oa:
This adjective describes behavior done without thinking or caring about the consequences. It identifies a lack of caution but is not specifically related to the use of resources.
Synonyms: Rash (जल्दबाज), Heedless (असावधान), Impetuous (आवेगशील).
Antonyms: Cautious (सावधान), Prudent (विवेकी), Careful (सतर्क).

This term refers to feeling or showing tiredness, especially as a result of excessive exertion. It describes a physical or mental state rather than financial habits.
Synonyms: Tired (थका), Exhausted (निचोड़ा हुआ), Fatigued (थका-माँदा).
Antonyms: Refreshed (ताजा), Energetic (ऊर्जावान), Fresh (निर्मल).

This word means strict, harsh, or intense in degree. While it can describe a disciplined lifestyle, it does not directly address the opposite of being economical.
Synonyms: Strict (गंभीर), Harsh (कठोर), Drastic (भीषण).
Antonyms: Mild (हल्का), Gentle (सौम्य), Lenient (उदार).

This term refers to lacking restraint in spending money or using resources wastefully. It stands as the direct opposite of frugal, which involves being sparing and thrifty.
Synonyms: Lavish (फिजूलखर्च), Wasteful (अपव्ययी), Prodigal (अतिव्ययी).
Antonyms: Frugal (मितव्ययी), Thrifty (किफायती), Stingy (कंजूस).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Persuaded
questionsEn.s:
Persuaded - मनाया (To convince someone to do something)
Evaded - टाल दिया (To escape or avoid something)
Bombarded - बमबारी की (To attack continuously with information)
Dissuaded - रोकना (To persuade someone not to do something)
Situated - स्थित (To be located in a particular position)
oa:
This verb means to escape or avoid someone or something, often through cleverness. It deals with escaping obligations rather than the process of convincing someone.
Synonyms: Avoided (टाल दिया), Dodged (चकमा दिया), Eluded (बच निकला).
Antonyms: Confronted (सामना किया), Faced (सामना किया), Encountered (मिला).

This term refers to attacking continuously with questions, criticisms, or physical projectiles. It describes an overwhelming assault rather than a reversal of persuasion.
Synonyms: Assailed (हमला किया), Pelted (बरसाया), Overwhelmed (अभिभूत).
Antonyms: Shielded (सुरक्षित), Protected (बचाया), Spared (छोड़ दिया).

This word means to persuade someone not to take a particular course of action. It is the direct behavioral and contextual opposite of being persuaded.
Synonyms: Discouraged (निरुत्साहित), Deterred (रोका), Prevented (निवारित).
Antonyms: Persuaded (मनाया), Induced (प्रेरित), Convinced (आश्वस्त).

This term refers to being located or placed in a particular position. it identifies spatial placement and has no logical relationship to the act of convincing.
Synonyms: Located (स्थित), Placed (स्थापित), Positioned (नियत).
Antonyms: Displaced (विस्थापित), Moved (हटाया गया), Removed (हटाया).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Accomplish
questionsEn.s:
Accomplish - पूरा करना / सिद्ध करना (To achieve or complete successfully)
Qualify - योग्यता प्राप्त करना (To be entitled to a benefit)
Retain - बनाए रखना (To keep or continue to have)
Execute - निष्पादित करना (To carry out a plan or order)
Miss - चूकना (To fail to achieve or hit a target)
oa:
This verb means to be entitled to a benefit by fulfilling a necessary condition. While it relates to achievement, it is a prerequisite for success rather than its opposite.
Synonyms: Entitle (योग्यता प्राप्त), Enable (सक्षम), Certify (प्रमाणित).
Antonyms: Disqualify (अयोग्य ठहराना), Fail (असफल), Invalidate (अमान्य).

This word means to keep or continue to have something in one's possession. It focuses on maintaining a state rather than the failure to achieve a goal.
Synonyms: Keep (बनाए रखना), Maintain (कायम रखना), Hold (थामना).
Antonyms: Lose (खोना), Release (छोड़ना), Discard (त्यागना).

This verb means to carry out a plan, order, or course of action. It is a synonym for accomplish and therefore cannot be used as the required antonym.
Synonyms: Perform (निष्पादित करना), Implement (लागू करना), Achieve (पूरा करना).
Antonyms: Neglect (उपेक्षा), Fail (असफल), Halt (रोकना).

This term can mean to fail to hit, reach, or come into contact with something; it also implies failing to achieve an objective. It acts as a suitable antonym for accomplish.
Synonyms: Fail (चूकना), Lose (खोना), Neglect (अनदेखा).
Antonyms: Accomplish (पूरा करना), Hit (लक्ष्य पाना), Reach (पहुँचना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Tedious
questionsEn.s:
Tedious - नीरस / उबाऊ (Too long, slow, or dull)
Interesting - रोचक (Engaging or arousing curiosity)
Informative - सूचनाप्रद (Providing useful information)
Idle - निष्क्रिय (Not active or in use)
Boring - उबाऊ (Not interesting; tedious)
oa:
This adjective refers to something that is engaging, arousing curiosity, or holding attention. It is the perfect antonym for tedious, which implies being long, slow, and dull.
Synonyms: Engaging (रोचक), Fascinating (दिलचस्प), Captivating (मनोरम).
Antonyms: Tedious (उबाऊ), Boring (नीरस), Dull (फीका).

This word describes something that provides useful or interesting information. While a tedious lecture could be informative, the word does not specifically contrast with dullness.
Synonyms: Educational (सूचनाप्रद), Enlightening (ज्ञानवर्धक), Instructive (शिक्षाप्रद).
Antonyms: Uninformative (अनुपयोगी), Vague (अस्पष्ट), Useless (बेकार).

This adjective refers to someone or something that is not active, in use, or working. It focuses on the lack of activity rather than the degree of interest in a task.
Synonyms: Inactive (निष्क्रिय), Lazy (आलसी), Unoccupied (खाली).
Antonyms: Busy (व्यस्त), Active (सक्रिय), Industrious (मेहनती).

This word describes something that is not interesting and causes weariness. It is a direct synonym for tedious and therefore does not satisfy the requirement.
Synonyms: Dull (उबाऊ), Monotonous (एकरस), Wearisome (थकाऊ).
Antonyms: Exciting (उत्तेजक), Riveting (रोमांचक), Interesting (रोचक).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Dismal
questionsEn.s:
Dismal - उदास / निराशाजनक (Depressing, gloomy, or without hope)
Smart - चतुर (Intelligent or quick-witted)
Melancholy - विषादपूर्ण (A feeling of deep sadness)
Exhausting - थकाऊ (Extremely tiring and draining)
Lively - जीवंत (Full of life and energy)
oa:
This word describes someone who is intelligent, quick-witted, or well-dressed. It focuses on mental or physical sharpness rather than the emotional atmosphere of a performance.
Synonyms: Intelligent (चतुर), Sharp (तीक्ष्ण), Clever (होशियार).
Antonyms: Stupid (मूर्ख), Dull (मंद), Inept (अकुशल).

This term refers to a feeling of deep sadness or sorrow. It aligns with the depressing nature of being dismal rather than providing an opposite relationship.
Synonyms: Gloomy (विषादपूर्ण), Sad (उदास), Somber (उदास).
Antonyms: Happy (खुश), Cheerful (प्रसन्न), Elated (उल्लसित).

This adjective describes something that is extremely tiring and draining of energy. While a dismal performance might be tiring to watch, the word is not a direct antonym.
Synonyms: Tiring (थकाऊ), Draining (निचोड़ने वाला), Fatiguing (थकाने वाला).
Antonyms: Refreshing (ताजा), Invigorating (ऊर्जावान), Energizing (जोशीला).

This word refers to something full of life and energy; active and outgoing. It serves as the correct antonym for dismal, which describes a depressing or gloomy performance.
Synonyms: Energetic (जीवंत), Vibrant (उत्साही), Animated (सक्रिय).
Antonyms: Dismal (उदास), Dull (नीरस), Somber (विषादपूर्ण).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Chided
questionsEn.s:
Chided - फटकारा / डांटा (Scolded or rebuked someone)
Reproved - निन्दा करना (To express disapproval)
Scolded - डांटा (To speak angrily to someone)
Applauded - सराहा (To show approval or praise)
Rebuked - फटकारा (To express sharp disapproval)
oa:
This verb means to express disapproval or to criticize someone, usually gently. It serves as a synonym for chided and therefore is not the required antonym.
Synonyms: Admonished (फटकारा), Rebuked (निंदा की), Scolded (डांटा).
Antonyms: Praised (प्रशंसा की), Complimented (तारीफ की), Applauded (सराहा).

This term refers to the act of speaking angrily to someone because they have done something wrong. It is a direct synonym for chided and does not satisfy the requirement.
Synonyms: Berated (डांटा), Chided (फटकारा), Reprimanded (धिक्कारा).
Antonyms: Applauded (सराहा), Lauded (प्रशंसा की), Commended (सराहना).

This word means to show approval or praise by clapping or positive acknowledgment. It is the direct behavioral opposite of chiding or scolding someone.
Synonyms: Praised (सराहा), Commended (सराहना), Extolled (बखान किया).
Antonyms: Chided (फटकारा), Criticized (आलोचना), Rebuked (डांटा).

This verb means to express sharp disapproval or criticism of someone because of their behavior. Like scolding, it is synonymous with chiding and not an opposite.
Synonyms: Reprimanded (फटकारा), Censure (निंदा की), Admonished (डांटा).
Antonyms: Praised (प्रशंसा की), Commended (सराहना), Extolled (बखान किया).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Disenfranchise
questionsEn.s:
Disenfranchise - नागरिकता से वंचित करना (To deprive someone of power or rights)
Authorised - अधिकृत / सक्षम किया (To give official approval or rights)
Powers - शक्तियाँ (Capacity or authority to influence)
Disabled - विकलांग (Having a physical or mental limitation)
Reins - लगाम (The means of control or guidance)
oa:
This word means to give legal or official approval to someone or to grant them rights. It stands as the direct opposite of disenfranchise, which involves depriving power.
Synonyms: Empowered (अधिकृत), Licensed (लाइसेंस प्राप्त), Sanctioned (स्वीकृत).
Antonyms: Disenfranchised (वंचित), Forbidden (वर्जित), Denied (नकारा).

This plural noun refers to the capacity or ability to direct or influence behavior. While related to the context, it is a noun identifying an asset rather than a verb of granting.
Synonyms: Authority (शक्तियाँ), Control (नियंत्रण), Influence (प्रभाव).
Antonyms: Weakness (कमज़ोरी), Inability (अक्षमता), Impotence (अशक्ति).

This adjective describes someone who has a physical or mental condition that limits their movements. It focuses on physical incapacity rather than the removal of rights.
Synonyms: Incapacitated (विकलांग), Crippled (अपंग), Impaired (क्षतिग्रस्त).
Antonyms: Able (सक्षम), Capable (योग्य), Healthy (स्वस्थ).

This noun refers to the leather straps used to control a horse, or metaphorically, the means of control. It describes the instrument of authority rather than the act of giving it.
Synonyms: Controls (लगाम), Guidance (मार्गदर्शन), Command (नियंत्रण).
Antonyms: Freedom (स्वतंत्रता), Liberty (आज़ादी), Anarchy (अराजकता).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Praised
questionsEn.s:
Praised - प्रशंसा / सराहना (Expressed approval or admiration)
Acclaimed - प्रशंसित (Enthusiastically praised)
Rebuked - झिड़की / फटकार (Expressed sharp disapproval)
Defended - बचाव किया (To protect from harm or danger)
Assaulted - हमला किया (To make a physical attack)
oa:
This adjective means praised enthusiastically and publicly. It functions as a direct synonym for the given word and therefore does not provide the required opposite.
Synonyms: Applauded (प्रशंसित), Lauded (सराहा), Honored (सम्मानित).
Antonyms: Rebuked (फटकारा), Criticized (आलोचना), Mocked (मज़ाक उड़ाया).

This verb means to express sharp disapproval or criticism of someone because of their actions. It is the direct behavioral opposite of being praised or admired.
Synonyms: Scolded (झिड़की), Reprimanded (फटकारा), Chided (डांटा).
Antonyms: Praised (प्रशंसा की), Commended (सराहना), Extolled (बखान किया).

This term refers to the act of protecting someone from harm or speaking in their favor. While it characterizes support, it is not a direct thematic opposite of praise.
Synonyms: Protected (बचाव किया), Guarded (सुरक्षित), Upheld (बनाए रखा).
Antonyms: Attacked (हमला किया), Assailed (आक्रमण), Criticized (आलोचना).

This verb means to make a physical attack on someone. It focuses on physical violence rather than the verbal judgment of approval or disapproval.
Synonyms: Attacked (हमला किया), Assailed (आक्रमण), Struck (मारा).
Antonyms: Defended (बचाव किया), Protected (रक्षा की), Guarded (सुरक्षित).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Intentional
questionsEn.s:
Intentional - जान-बूझकर (Done on purpose or with intent)
Cordial - सौहार्दपूर्ण (Warm and friendly)
Unplanned - अनायोजित (Not done with forethought or intent)
Amiable - सौम्य / मिलनसार (Friendly and pleasant in manner)
Inanimate - निर्जीव (Not alive or lifeless)
oa:
This adjective describes someone who is warm, friendly, and polite. it focuses on the quality of a social interaction rather than whether an act was planned or not.
Synonyms: Friendly (सौहार्दपूर्ण), Amicable (मैत्रीपूर्ण), Genial (मिलनसार).
Antonyms: Hostile (शत्रुतापूर्ण), Cold (रूखा), Unfriendly (अमित्र).

This word directly states that something was not done with intention or forethought. It serves as the perfect antonym for intentional, which implies being done on purpose.
Synonyms: Spontaneous (अनायोजित), Accidental (आकस्मिक), Haphazard (बेतरतीब).
Antonyms: Intentional (जानबूझकर), Planned (योजनाबद्ध), Purposely (सप्रयोजन).

This term refers to having or displaying a friendly and pleasant manner. Like "cordial," it describes a positive personality trait rather than the intent behind an action.
Synonyms: Pleasant (सौम्य), Sociable (मिलनसार), Gracious (विनीत).
Antonyms: Unpleasant (अप्रिय), Grouchy (चिड़चिड़ा), Mean (नीच).

This adjective describes something that is not alive or shows no sign of life. It categorizes the biological nature of an object and bears no relation to human intent.
Synonyms: Lifeless (निर्जीव), Dead (मृत), Insentient (जड़).
Antonyms: Living (जीवित), Animated (सजीव), Active (सक्रिय).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Abandon
questionsEn.s:
Abandon - त्यागना (To give up completely a course of action)
Quit - छोड़ देना (To leave or stop doing something)
Surrender - आत्मसमर्पण करना (To yield to the power of another)
Shorten - छोटा करना (To make something shorter)
Continue - जारी रखें (To persist in an activity without stopping)
oa:
This verb means to leave or stop doing something, often permanently. It serves as a direct synonym for abandon and therefore cannot be the required opposite.
Synonyms: Desert (छोड़ देना), Forsake (त्यागना), Resign (इस्तीफा देना).
Antonyms: Persist (डटे रहना), Continue (जारी रखना), Stay (रुकना).

This term means to give up or yield to the power of another, often after a struggle. it is a synonym for the idea of giving up implied by abandon.
Synonyms: Cede (आत्मसमर्पण करना), Yield (झुकना), Relinquish (छोड़ना).
Antonyms: Resist (विरोध करना), Defy (अवहेलना), Conquer (जीतना).

This verb means to make or become shorter in length or duration. It focuses on the dimension of time or space rather than the cessation or continuation of an action.
Synonyms: Curtail (छोटा किया), Abbreviate (संक्षिप्त), Abridge (घटाना).
Antonyms: Lengthen (लंबा करना), Extend (बढ़ाना), Expand (फैलाना).

This word means to persist in an activity or process without stopping. It stands as the direct opposite of abandon, which involves giving up a course of action completely.
Synonyms: Persist (जारी रखें), Sustain (कायम रखना), Endure (बने रहना).
Antonyms: Abandon (त्यागना), Stop (रुकना), Quit (छोड़ना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Confronted
questionsEn.s:
Confronted - सामना करना (To face directly with opposing views)
Resisted - विरोध करना (To withstand or fight against)
Avoided - टालना / बचना (To keep away from someone or something)
Challenged - चुनौती (To question or call someone out)
Encountered - सामना करना (To meet someone unexpectedly)
oa:
This verb means to withstand the action of something or to fight against it. Since resisting involves a form of engagement or opposition, it is similar to confrontation.
Synonyms: Withstood (विरोध किया), Opposed (सामना किया), Defied (अवहेलना की).
Antonyms: Yielded (झुक गया), Complied (पालन किया), Submitted (समर्पण किया).

This word means to keep away from something or to prevent it from happening. it is the direct opposite of confronted, which involves facing something directly.
Synonyms: Shunned (टालना), Evaded (बच निकला), Dodged (चकमा दिया).
Antonyms: Confronted (सामना किया), Faced (सामना किया), Encountered (मिला).

This term refers to calling someone out or questioning the validity of something. it is a synonym for the act of confronting someone with evidence or doubt.
Synonyms: Questioned (चुनौती), Disputed (विवाद), Impugned (खंडन किया).
Antonyms: Accepted (स्वीकार), Approved (मंजूर), Endorsed (समर्थन किया).

This verb means to come upon or meet something, especially unexpectedly. While it involves interaction, it lacks the deliberate nature of confrontation or its avoidance.
Synonyms: Met (सामना करना), Found (पाया), Faced (सामना किया).
Antonyms: Missed (चूक गया), Avoided (बचा), Lost (खो दिया).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Prohibition
questionsEn.s:
Prohibition - निषेध (The action of forbidding something by law)
Restriction - प्रतिबंध (A limiting condition or measure)
Inhibition - नियंत्रण (A feeling that restricts natural action)
Direction - दिशा (A course taken or instructions given)
Permission - अनुमति (The action of allowing or authorizing)


Hence, 'Permission ' is the most suitable antonym for 'Prohibition'.
oa:
This noun refers to a limiting condition or a measure that restricts someone's freedom. It is a synonym for the idea of prohibition rather than an opposite.
Synonyms: Limitation (प्रतिबंध), Constraint (बाधा), Curb (रोक).
Antonyms: Freedom (स्वतंत्रता), Liberty (आज़ादी), Allowance (छूट).

This term refers to a feeling that makes one unable to act in a relaxed or natural way. While it involves a type of internal "prohibition," it is not the conceptual opposite.
Synonyms: Restraint (नियंत्रण), Reserve (संकोच), Shyness (लज्जा).
Antonyms: Spontaneity (सहजता), Confidence (विश्वास), Freedom (मुक्ति).

This word refers to a course or route taken or a set of instructions. It deals with guidance and instruction rather than the act of forbidding or allowing.
Synonyms: Guidance (दिशा), Instruction (निर्देश), Route (मार्ग).
Antonyms: Deviation (विचलन), Aimlessness (निरुद्देश्यता), Confusion (भ्रम).

This term refers to the action of allowing or authorizing something to occur. it is the direct and most accurate antonym for prohibition, which involves forbidding something.
Synonyms: Consent (अनुमति), Authorization (मंजूरी), Approval (स्वीकृति).
Antonyms: Prohibition (निषेध), Ban (प्रतिबंध), Refusal (इनकार).

test.instructions: Standard CBT Pattern Exam. Positive Marks: +1, Negative Marks: -0.25. Total Questions: 50.

test.title: Set - 16

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Selective
questionsEn.s:
Selective - चयनात्मक (Carefully choosing the best or most suitable)
Stimulating - प्रेरक (Arousing interest or energy)
Careless - लापरवाह (Not giving sufficient attention or thought)
Doubtful - संदिग्ध (Feeling uncertain or lacking conviction)
Planned - योजनाबद्ध (Prepared for in advance)
oa:
This word refers to something that arouses interest, enthusiasm, or energy. While a choice can be stimulating, the word does not address the process of careful picking or choosing and thus fails to serve as an opposite.
Synonyms: Inspiring (प्रेरक), Invigorating (स्फूर्तिदायक), Provocative (उत्तेजक).
Antonyms: Boring (उबाऊ), Dull (नीरस), Uninspiring (अनुत्साहित करने वाला).

This word describes a lack of attention, thought, or precision. It is the direct opposite of being selective, which involves making very careful and deliberate choices.
Synonyms: Heedless (असावधान), Negligent (लापरवाह), Remiss (बेपरवाह).
Antonyms: Selective (चयनात्मक), Meticulous (अति सावधान), Prudent (विवेकपूर्ण).

This word reflects a lack of conviction, certainty, or trust in something. It describes a state of mind regarding belief rather than the method of choosing items or people.
Synonyms: Dubious (संदिग्ध), Uncertain (अनिश्चित), Skeptical (संदेहपूर्ण).
Antonyms: Certain (निश्चित), Confident (आत्मविश्वासी), Sure (पक्का).

This word describes something that is prepared for or organized in advance. While being selective often requires a plan, the word itself does not denote the opposite of careful picking.
Synonyms: Arranged (व्यवस्थित), Organized (योजनाबद्ध), Premeditated (पूर्वनियोजित).
Antonyms: Random (बेतरतीब), Spontaneous (स्वैच्छिक), Arbitrary (मनमाना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Exultant
questionsEn.s:
Exultant - उल्लसित (Triumphantly happy or joyful)
Rejoicing - आनंदित (Feeling or showing great joy)
Disconsolate - शोकाकुल (Very unhappy and unable to be comforted)
Jubilant - प्रफुल्लित (Extremely joyful because of success)
Elated - गर्वित/खुश (Ecstatically happy or proud)
oa:
This word describes feeling or showing great joy or delight. It is a synonym for the given word and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an antonym.
Synonyms: Jubilant (प्रफुल्लित), Elated (उल्लसित), Triumphant (विजयी).
Antonyms: Mourning (शोक मनाना), Sorrowful (उदासीन), Miserable (दुखी).

This word describes a state of being very unhappy and unable to be comforted. It serves as the perfect opposite to exultant, which signifies triumphant joy.
Synonyms: Dejected (हताश), Forlorn (लाचार), Woebegone (शोकग्रस्त).
Antonyms: Exultant (उल्लसित), Joyful (हर्षित), Cheerful (प्रसन्न).

This word refers to a person who is extremely joyful, especially because of a great success. It conveys the same positive emotion as exultant and is not an opposite.
Synonyms: Joyous (आनंदमय), Thrilled (रोमांचित), Ecstatic (अति प्रसन्न).
Antonyms: Depressed (उदास), Melancholy (विषादपूर्ण), Sad (दुखी).

This word means ecstatically happy or proud. Like the other positive options, it shares a similar meaning with exultant and cannot be its antonym.
Synonyms: Overjoyed (गदगद), Delighted (प्रसन्न), Radiant (चमकीला/प्रसन्न).
Antonyms: Miserable (दयनीय), Crestfallen (निराश), Gloomy (उदास).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Incessant
questionsEn.s:
Incessant - निरंतर (Never stopping, usually annoying)
Insistent - हठी (Demanding something forcefully)
Daily - दैनिक (Happening every day)
Sporadic - छिटपुट (Happening at irregular intervals)
Continual - लगातार (Happening again and again)
oa:
This word describes someone who demands something forcefully or something that continues in a way that cannot be ignored. It relates to persistence rather than a break in frequency.
Synonyms: Persistent (हठी), Firm (दृढ़), Importunate (ज़िद्दी).
Antonyms: Relenting (कोमल), Hesitant (दुविधापूर्ण), Indifferent (उदासीन).

This word refers to something that happens every day. While it indicates a regular frequency, it does not imply the "never-stopping" nature of the given word, nor is it a direct antonym.
Synonyms: Everyday (दैनिक), Diurnal (दिन का), Quotidian (रोज़ का).
Antonyms: Unusual (असामान्य), Occasional (कभी-कभार), Rare (दुर्लभ).

This word describes something that happens only at irregular intervals or in scattered instances. It is the direct opposite of incessant, which means continuing without pause.
Synonyms: Intermittent (रुक-रुक कर), Fitful (अनियमित), Occasional (यदा-कदा).
Antonyms: Incessant (निरंतर), Constant (सतत), Continuous (लगातार).

This word refers to something that happens repeatedly or frequently. It is often used as a synonym for incessant and therefore does not fit the requirement for an opposite.
Synonyms: Recurrent (बार-बार होने वाला), Constant (नियमित), Perpetual (अविराम).
Antonyms: Ceasing (समाप्त होने वाला), Sporadic (अनियमित), Rare (दुर्लभ).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Trivial
questionsEn.s:
Trivial - तुच्छ (Of little importance or value)
Significant - महत्वपूर्ण (Important or large enough to be noticed)
Huge - विशाल (Extremely large in size)
Heavy - भारी (Weighing a lot or difficult to lift)
Light - हल्का (Not of great weight)
oa:
This word refers to something that is important, meaningful, or large enough to be noticed. it expresses the direct opposite of trivial, which refers to things of little importance.
Synonyms: Important (महत्वपूर्ण), Momentous (प्रभावशाली), Vital (अत्यावश्यक).
Antonyms: Trivial (तुच्छ), Negligible (नगण्य), Minor (मामूली).

This word describes something that is extremely large in size or scale. While a huge thing might be important, the word itself is a physical descriptor and not a direct antonym for "unimportant."
Synonyms: Enormous (विशाल), Gigantic (विशालकाय), Vast (विस्तृत).
Antonyms: Tiny (बहुत छोटा), Small (छोटा), Minuscule (अति सूक्ष्म).

This word refers to something that has great weight or is difficult to lift. It describes physical mass rather than the importance or value of a situation or object.
Synonyms: Weighty (भारी), Hefty (तगड़ा), Burdensome (भारी/कष्टदायक).
Antonyms: Light (हल्का), Airy (हवादार), Weightless (वजनरहित).

This word can mean not heavy or easy to bear. In some contexts, it can mean unimportant, but it is less precise as an antonym for trivial than the word significant.
Synonyms: Weightless (हल्का), Easy (आसान), Slight (मामूली).
Antonyms: Heavy (भारी), Severe (गंभीर), Intense (तीव्र).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Object
questionsEn.s:
Object - विरोध करना (To not like or be against something)
Assent - सहमति (Express approval or agreement)
Ease - राहत (To make something less painful or serious)
Restore - बहाल करना (To put something back into its former condition)
Ascertain - पता लगाना (To find out with certainty)
oa:
This word means to express official approval or agreement to a proposal or idea. It is the direct opposite of objecting, which involves being against or disagreeing with something.
Synonyms: Agree (सहमत होना), Concede (स्वीकार करना), Acquiesce (सहमति देना).
Antonyms: Object (विरोध करना), Dissent (असहमत होना), Refuse (अस्वीकार करना).

This word refers to a state of being free from pain, trouble, or difficulty. It describes a condition of comfort rather than the act of agreeing or disagreeing.
Synonyms: Alleviate (राहत देना), Comfort (आराम), Simplicity (सरलता).
Antonyms: Difficulty (कठिनाई), Distress (कष्ट), Agitation (उत्तेजना).

This word means to return something to its former condition, place, or position. It describes an act of repair or reinstatement rather than an opinion or stance.
Synonyms: Reinstate (पुनः स्थापित करना), Renovate (नवीनीकरण), Revive (पुनर्जीवित करना).
Antonyms: Damage (क्षति पहुँचाना), Destroy (नष्ट करना), Ruin (बर्बाद करना).

This word means to find out or learn something with certainty through investigation. It is a cognitive process of discovery rather than a response of disapproval.
Synonyms: Determine (निर्धारित करना), Discover (पता लगाना), Confirm (पुष्टि करना).
Antonyms: Obscure (धुंधला करना), Misunderstand (गलत समझना), Ignore (अनदेखा करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Conceal
questionsEn.s:
Conceal - छिपाना (To prevent something from being seen)
Watch - ध्यान से देखना (To look at something for a time)
See - देखना (To become conscious of something using eyes)
Reveal - प्रकट करना (To make something known that was secret)
Hide - छिपाना (To put something where it cannot be seen)
oa:
This word means to look at someone or something attentively for a period of time. It describes an action of observation rather than the act of making something visible.
Synonyms: Observe (देखना), Monitor (निगरानी करना), View (निरीक्षण करना).
Antonyms: Ignore (अनदेखा करना), Neglect (उपेक्षा करना), Overlook (नज़रअंदाज़ करना).

This word means to become conscious of something through the eyes. While seeing involves perceiving, it is a sensory capability rather than the deliberate act of revealing what was hidden.
Synonyms: Perceive (प्रत्यक्ष करना), Behold (निहारना), Witness (देखना).
Antonyms: Miss (चूक जाना), Overlook (अनदेखा करना), Ignore (नज़रअंदाज़ करना).

This word means to make something known that was previously secret or hidden. It is the direct antonym of conceal, which involves keeping things out of sight.
Synonyms: Disclose (प्रकट करना), Unveil (रहस्य खोलना), Divulge (बताना).
Antonyms: Conceal (छिपाना), Hide (गुप्तरखना), Mask (ढकना).

This word refers to putting or keeping someone or something in a place where they cannot be seen. It is a synonym for conceal and does not provide the required opposite.
Synonyms: Cover (ढकना), Obscure (धुंधला करना), Camouflage (छलावरण करना).
Antonyms: Reveal (प्रकट करना), Expose (उजागर करना), Show (दिखाना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Memory
questionsEn.s:
Memory - स्मरण शक्ति (A person’s ability to remember things)
Suppress - दबाना (To prevent something from being seen)
Oblivion - विस्मृति (A state of being completely forgotten)
Retrospection - सिंहावलोकन (Looking back on past events)
Impart - प्रदान करना (To pass information or knowledge)
oa:
This word means to prevent something from being seen, expressed, or operating. While one might suppress a memory, the word itself is an action of control rather than the opposite of the faculty of remembering.
Synonyms: Subdue (दबाना), Quell (शांत करना), Restrain (रोकना).
Antonyms: Release (मुक्त करना), Encourage (प्रोत्साहित करना), Incite (उकसाना).

This word refers to a state of being completely forgotten or a state where one is unaware of what is happening. It serves as the conceptual opposite of memory and preservation of thought.
Synonyms: Forgetfulness (विस्मृति), Unawareness (अज्ञानता), Insensibility (चेतना-शून्यता).
Antonyms: Memory (स्मरण शक्ति), Remembrance (याद), Consciousness (चेतना).

This word refers to the action of looking back on or reviewing past events. It is a function of memory rather than its opposite.
Synonyms: Recollection (स्मरण), Review (समीक्षा), Reminiscence (यादें).
Antonyms: Foresight (दूरदर्शिता), Anticipation (पूर्वानुमान), Future (भविष्य).

This word means to pass on information or a quality to others. It describes the communication of knowledge rather than the state of having or losing a memory.
Synonyms: Convey (पहुँचाना), Communicate (संप्रेषित करना), Disclose (बता देना).
Antonyms: Withhold (रोक लेना), Conceal (छिपाना), Keep (रखना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Flexible
questionsEn.s:
Flexible - लचीला (Capable of bending easily without breaking)
Capable - सक्षम (Having the ability to achieve something)
Malleable - नम्य (Able to be pressed into shape)
Open-ended - अप्रतिबंधित (Having no predetermined limit)
Rigid - कठोर (Unable to bend or be forced out of shape)
oa:
This word refers to having the ability, fitness, or quality necessary to achieve a specific task. It describes competence rather than the physical or metaphorical ability to bend.
Synonyms: Competent (सक्षम), Able (योग्य), Efficient (कुशल).
Antonyms: Incompetent (अक्षम), Inept (अयोग्य), Feeble (कमज़ोर).

This word describes a material that can be hammered or pressed into shape without breaking. It is a synonym for flexible and therefore does not fit the requirement for an opposite.
Synonyms: Pliable (लचीला), Plastic (सुघट्य), Supple (नम्य).
Antonyms: Rigid (कठोर), Stiff (सख्त), Brittle (भंगुर).

This word describes something that has no predetermined limit or boundary. While it implies a lack of rigidity, it refers to scope or time rather than the quality of being flexible.
Synonyms: Unrestricted (अप्रतिबंधित), Infinite (असीमित), Variable (परिवर्तनीय).
Antonyms: Finite (सीमित), Closed (बंद), Restricted (प्रतिबंधित).

This word describes something that is unable to bend or be forced out of shape. It is the direct physical and metaphorical opposite of being flexible.
Synonyms: Stiff (सख्त), Unyielding (अटल), Firm (दृढ़).
Antonyms: Flexible (लचीला), Pliable (नम्य), Supple (कोमल).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Amateur
questionsEn.s:
Amateur - शौकिया (Taking part in an activity for pleasure, not as a job)
Boring - उबाऊ (Not at all interesting)
Freelancing - स्वतंत्र कार्य (Working on individual projects)
Expert - विशेषज्ञ (A person with a lot of special knowledge or skill)
Decent - शालीन/उचित (Being of an acceptable standard)
oa:
This word describes something that is not at all interesting or dull. While an amateur performance might be boring, the word describes interest levels rather than level of professional skill.
Synonyms: Dull (नीरस), Tedious (उबाऊ), Monotonous (एकरस).
Antonyms: Exciting (रोमांचक), Interesting (रोचक), Engaging (मोहक).

This word refers to working for different companies at different times rather than being permanently employed. It is a mode of professional work rather than an opposite of amateurism.
Synonyms: Independent (स्वतंत्र), Self-employed (स्व-नियोजित), Contractual (अनुबंधित).
Antonyms: Employed (नियोजित), Salaried (वेतनभोगी), Permanent (स्थायी).

This word refers to a person who has extensive knowledge or high skill in a particular field. It serves as the direct opposite of an amateur, who lacks professional experience.
Synonyms: Professional (पेशेवर), Specialist (विशेषज्ञ), Master (निपुण).
Antonyms: Amateur (शौकिया), Novice (नौसिखिया), Tyro (अनाड़ी).

This word describes something that is of an acceptable standard or satisfactory. It refers to the quality of behavior or performance rather than the professional status of a person.
Synonyms: Proper (उचित), Respectable (माननीय), Adequate (पर्याप्त).
Antonyms: Indecent (अशिष्ट), Poor (घटिया), Improper (अनुचित).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Naïve
questionsEn.s:
Naive - भोला-भाला (Lacking experience and too ready to trust)
Jaded - थका और ऊबा हुआ (Tired after doing something for too long)
Corrupt - भ्रष्ट (Involved in illegal or dishonest things)
Cynical - स्वार्थी समझने वाला (Believing people are purely motivated by self-interest)
Convinced - आश्वस्त (Completely sure about something)
oa:
This word describes someone who is tired and bored after doing the same thing for a long time. While a jaded person has lost their innocence, it refers to exhaustion rather than the cynical worldview.
Synonyms: Fatigued (थका हुआ), Sated (संतुष्ट/ऊबा हुआ), Weary (पस्त).
Antonyms: Fresh (ताज़ा), Enthusiastic (उत्साही), Energetic (ऊर्जावान).

This word refers to someone who is dishonest or involved in illegal activities for personal gain. It describes moral decay rather than the intellectual skepticism that is the opposite of naivety.
Synonyms: Dishonest (बेईमान), Depraved (भ्रष्ट), Crooked (कुटिल).
Antonyms: Honest (ईमानदार), Ethical (नैतिक), Pure (शुद्ध).

This word describes someone who believes that people are motivated purely by self-interest and is generally distrustful of human sincerity. It is the direct opposite of being naïve.
Synonyms: Skeptical (संदेहवादी), Distrustful (अविश्वासी), Sardonic (तिरस्कारपूर्ण).
Antonyms: Naive (भोला-भाला), Trusting (विश्रंभी), Optimistic (आशावादी).

This word describes being completely sure about something. It refers to the strength of a belief rather than the lack of experience or the presence of worldly wisdom.
Synonyms: Certain (निश्चित), Persuaded (आश्वस्त), Assured (भरोसेमंद).
Antonyms: Doubtful (संदेहपूर्ण), Uncertain (अनिश्चित), Skeptical (शंकित).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Wicked
questionsEn.s:
Wicked - दुष्ट (Morally bad or evil)
Virtuous - सदाचारी (Having high moral standards)
Savage - बर्बर (Fierce, violent, or uncontrolled)
Fierce - उग्र (Showing intense aggression or force)
Vile - घृणित (Extremely unpleasant or morally bad)
oa:
This word refers to someone who has high moral standards and behaves in a righteous manner. It is the direct opposite of wicked, which denotes being evil or morally bad.
Synonyms: Righteous (धर्मी), Ethical (नैतिक), Honorable (माननीय).
Antonyms: Wicked (दुष्ट), Evil (बुरा), Immoral (अनैतिक).

This word describes something fierce, violent, or uncontrolled. It shares a negative connotation with wicked and is more of a near-synonym in some contexts rather than an opposite.
Synonyms: Brutal (क्रूर), Ferocious (भयंकर), Barbaric (असभ्य).
Antonyms: Civilized (सभ्य), Gentle (सौम्य), Tame (पालतू).

This word means showing aggression, intensity, or strong force. While it describes a powerful or scary state, it does not address the moral dimension required to oppose "wicked."
Synonyms: Intense (तीव्र), Aggressive (आक्रामक), Vehement (प्रबल).
Antonyms: Mild (हल्का), Calm (शांत), Gentle (कोमल).

This word refers to something extremely unpleasant, disgusting, or morally reprehensible. It is a synonym for wicked and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an opposite.
Synonyms: Wretched (नीच), Despicable (घृणित), Foul (गंदा).
Antonyms: Noble (महान), Pleasant (सुखद), Worthy (योग्य).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Derision
questionsEn.s:
Derision - उपहास (Contemptuous ridicule or mockery)
Disintegration - टूटना (Process of losing cohesion or strength)
Termination - समाप्ति (The action of bringing something to an end)
Admiration - प्रशंसा (A feeling of respect and warm approval)
Estimation - अनुमान (A rough calculation of value or quantity)
oa:
This word refers to the process of losing cohesion or strength, such as a physical object breaking apart. It has no connection to the act of mocking or respecting someone.
Synonyms: Breakdown (विखंडन), Fragmentation (विघटन), Decay (क्षय).
Antonyms: Integration (एकीकरण), Construction (निर्माण), Unity (एकता).

This word means the action of bringing something to an end, such as a contract or a task. It describes the cessation of an activity rather than a social attitude.
Synonyms: Conclusion (समाप्ति), Expiration (अंत), Finish (पूर्णता).
Antonyms: Beginning (शुरुआत), Commencement (आरंभ), Inception (उत्पत्ति).

This word represents a feeling of great respect and warm approval for someone's qualities or achievements. It is the direct opposite of derision, which is contemptuous mockery.
Synonyms: Respect (सम्मान), Esteem (आदर), Appreciation (प्रशंसा).
Antonyms: Derision (उपहास), Contempt (तिरस्कार), Disdain (घृणा).

This word refers to a rough calculation of the value or quantity of something, or an opinion about someone's worth. While it involves judgment, it is neutral compared to derision.
Synonyms: Assessment (अनुमान), Evaluation (मूल्यांकन), Appraisal (आकलन).
Antonyms: Fact (सत्य), Calculation (सटीक गणना), Reality (वास्तविकता).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Gullible
questionsEn.s:
Gullible - भोला (Easily fooled or deceived)
Credulous - विश्वासी (Too willing to believe others)
Pliant - कोमल (Flexible or easily influenced)
Cynical - निंदक (Distrustful or skeptical about motives)
Simple - सरल (Uncomplicated or easy to understand)
oa:
This word describes someone who is too willing to believe or trust others without evidence. It is a synonym for the given word and cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Trusting (विश्रंभी), Naive (भोला), Unsuspecting (संदेह न करने वाला).
Antonyms: Cynical (निंदक), Skeptical (संदेहवादी), Suspicious (शंकित).

This word describes something flexible or easily influenced. While it relates to ease of handling, it does not specifically address the mental tendency of being easily deceived.
Synonyms: Flexible (लचीला), Adaptable (अनुकूलनीय), Supple (कोमल).
Antonyms: Rigid (कठोर), Obstinate (हठी), Firm (दृढ़).

This word describes someone who is distrustful or skeptical about human motives and sincerity. It is the direct antonym for gullible, as a cynical person is very hard to deceive.
Synonyms: Skeptical (संदेहवादी), Sardonic (व्यंग्यात्मक), Pessimistic (निराशावादी).
Antonyms: Gullible (भोला), Credulous (विश्वासी), Naive (अनुभवहीन).

This word means uncomplicated or easy to understand. While a simple person might be gullible, the word itself is too general to serve as a precise antonym.
Synonyms: Uncomplicated (सरल), Modest (विनीत), Plain (सादा).
Antonyms: Complex (जटिल), Sophisticated (दुनियादार), Intricate (पेचीदा).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: To redeem
questionsEn.s:
To redeem - भुनाना (To exchange something for a reward or benefit)
To forsake - त्यागना (To abandon or give up on someone)
To deplore - विलाप करना (To strongly disapprove of something)
To forfeit - दंड भरना (To lose something as a penalty)
To embezzle - ग़बन करना (To steal funds placed in one's trust)
oa:
This word means to abandon or give up on someone or something. It relates to desertion rather than losing a privilege or reward through a penalty.
Synonyms: Abandon (त्यागना), Desert (छोड़ देना), Relinquish (छोड़ना).
Antonyms: Keep (रखना), Maintain (बनाए रखना), Claim (दावा करना).

This word means to feel or express strong disapproval of something. It is an emotional or verbal response of condemnation rather than a loss of value.
Synonyms: Condemn (निंदा करना), Lament (विलाप करना), Regret (पछताना).
Antonyms: Approve (मंजूरी देना), Applaud (प्रशंसा करना), Celebrate (जश्न मनाना).

This word means to lose or give up something as a penalty for a mistake or fault. It is the direct opposite of redeeming, which involves regaining or reclaiming something of value.
Synonyms: Lose (खोना), Surrender (सौंप देना), Sacrifice (त्याग करना).
Antonyms: Redeem (भुनाना), Win (जीतना), Gain (प्राप्त करना).

This word means to steal or misappropriate funds placed in one's trust. It describes a specific criminal act of theft rather than the act of losing a coupon or right.
Synonyms: Pilfer (चुराना), Misappropriate (ग़बन करना), Defalcate (धोखाधड़ी करना).
Antonyms: Return (लौटाना), Compensate (मुआवजा देना), Protect (रक्षा करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Indolent
questionsEn.s:
Indolent - आलसी (Lazy or inactive)
Lazy - सुस्त (Unwilling to work or use energy)
Unskilled - अकुशल (Lacking special training or skill)
Active - सक्रिय (Energetic or engaged in action)
Sluggish - मंद (Moving slower than normal)
oa:
This word describes a person who is unwilling to work or use energy. It is a direct synonym of indolent and therefore cannot be the antonym required for this question.
Synonyms: Idle (कामचोर), Slothful (सुस्त), Inactive (निष्क्रिय).
Antonyms: Active (सक्रिय), Industrious (मेहनती), Busy (व्यस्त).

This word refers to a person who has not been trained or lacks the specific expertise needed for a task. It describes ability rather than the willingness to work.
Synonyms: Inexpert (अदक्ष), Amateur (शौकिया), Raw (अनुभवहीन).
Antonyms: Skilled (कुशल), Expert (विशेषज्ञ), Proficient (निपुण).

This word describes someone who is energetic, engaged in action, or constantly moving. It is the direct opposite of being indolent, which is a state of laziness or inactivity.
Synonyms: Energetic (ऊर्जावान), Lively (जीवंत), Dynamic (गतिशील).
Antonyms: Indolent (आलसी), Lazy (सुस्त), Passive (निष्क्रिय).

This word describes moving or working more slowly than normal, often in a way that suggests a lack of energy. It is similar in meaning to indolent and is not an opposite.
Synonyms: Lethargic (सुस्त), Listless (बेजान), Torpid (निष्क्रिय).
Antonyms: Brisk (तेज़), Rapid (द्रुत), Alert (चौकस).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Patriot
questionsEn.s:
Patriot - देशभक्त (Someone who loves and supports their country)
Nationalist - राष्ट्रवादी (Person strongly identified with their nation)
Dutiful - कर्तव्यनिष्ठ (Conscientious in fulfilling responsibilities)
Traitor - देशद्रोही (Someone who is disloyal to their country)
Loyal - वफादार (Faithful and committed to a cause)
oa:
This word refers to a person who strongly identifies with their own nation and supports its interests. It is a synonym for the given word and not an opposite.
Synonyms: Loyalist (निष्ठावान), Jingoist (अतिराष्ट्रभक्त), Chauvinist (अंधभक्त).
Antonyms: Traitor (देशद्रोही), Rebel (विद्रोही), Alien (विदेशी).

This word describes someone who is conscientious in fulfilling their responsibilities or duties. It describes a personality trait rather than a political or national allegiance.
Synonyms: Obedient (आज्ञाकारी), Compliant (अनुपालन करने वाला), Devoted (समर्पित).
Antonyms: Irresponsible (गैर-जिम्मेदार), Rebellious (विद्रोही), Defiant (अवज्ञाकारी).

This word refers to a person who betrays their country, a cause, or a trust. It is the direct opposite of a patriot, who loves and supports their country.
Synonyms: Betrayer (विश्वासघाती), Renegade (धर्मत्यागी), Turncoat (ग़द्दार).
Antonyms: Patriot (देशभक्त), Loyalist (निष्ठावान), Faithful (वफादार).

This word describes someone who gives firm and constant support or allegiance. It is an attribute often associated with a patriot rather than being its antonym.
Synonyms: Faithful (वफादार), Staunch (कट्टर), Committed (प्रतिबद्ध).
Antonyms: Treacherous (विश्वासघाती), Fickle (अस्थिर), Disloyal (बेवफ़ा).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Lucid
questionsEn.s:
Lucid - स्पष्ट (Clear and easily understood)
Orderly - व्यवस्थित (Neat and well-organized)
Ambiguous - अस्पष्ट (Unclear or open to more than one meaning)
Intelligible - बोधगम्य (Capable of being understood)
Transparent - पारदर्शी (Easy to see through or perceive)
oa:
This word means neat, well-organized, and arranged in a systematic way. While a lucid explanation is often orderly, the word does not address the clarity of the meaning itself.
Synonyms: Systematic (व्यवस्थित), Methodical (क्रमबद्ध), Disciplined (अनुशासित).
Antonyms: Chaotic (अराजक), Messy (गंदा), Disorganized (अव्यवस्थित).

This word refers to something that is unclear or open to more than one interpretation. It is the direct opposite of lucid, which means clear and easy to understand.
Synonyms: Vague (अस्पष्ट), Equivocal (संदिग्ध), Obscure (धुंधला).
Antonyms: Lucid (स्पष्ट), Explicit (सुस्पष्ट), Precise (सटीक).

This word describes something that is capable of being understood or comprehended. It is a synonym for lucid and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an opposite.
Synonyms: Comprehensible (समझने योग्य), Clear (साफ), Logical (तार्किक).
Antonyms: Incomprehensible (असमझनीय), Obscure (दुर्बोध), Confusing (भ्रमित).

This word means allowing light to pass through so objects behind can be seen, or being very easy to detect. It describes physical clarity rather than conceptual clarity.
Synonyms: Clear (पारदर्शी), Pellucid (निर्मल), Obvious (प्रत्यक्ष).
Antonyms: Opaque (अपारदर्शी), Cloudy (धुंधला), Hidden (छिपा हुआ).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Traitor
questionsEn.s:
Traitor - देशद्रोही (A person who is not loyal to their country)
Honest - ईमानदार (Truthful and able to be trusted)
Defender - रक्षक (Person who defends someone from attack)
Betrayer - विश्वासघाती (A person who is not loyal)
Loyal - वफादार (Firm resistance to temptation to betray)
oa:
This word refers to someone who tells the truth and is not likely to steal or cheat. While a traitor is often dishonest, the direct opposite of a traitor is someone who remains faithful to a cause.
Synonyms: Truthful (सत्यवादी), Sincere (ईमानदार), Trustworthy (भरोसेमंद).
Antonyms: Corrupt (भ्रष्ट), Deceitful (धोखेबाज), Dishonest (बेईमान).

This word refers to a person who protects someone or something from attack or injury. While a defender may be loyal, the word describes an action of protection rather than the status of allegiance.
Synonyms: Guardian (संरक्षक), Protector (रक्षक), Champion (समर्थक).
Antonyms: Attacker (आक्रमणकारी), Aggressor (हमलावर), Assailant (आक्रामक).

This word refers to a person who is not loyal to their country or friends. It is a direct synonym for traitor and therefore cannot be the antonym required.
Synonyms: Renegade (धर्मत्यागी), Backstabber (धोखेबाज), Double-crosser (छली).
Antonyms: Loyalist (निष्ठावान), Devotee (भक्त), Patriot (देशभक्त).

This word describes a firm resistance to any temptation to desert or betray. It is the perfect opposite of being a traitor, as it implies unwavering faithfulness.
Synonyms: Faithful (वफादार), Staunch (दृढ़), Constant (अटल).
Antonyms: Treacherous (विश्वासघाती), Traitorous (ग़द्दार), Disloyal (बेवफ़ा).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Disadvantage
questionsEn.s:
Disadvantage - प्रतिकूलता (A condition that causes problems)
Powered - शक्तिशाली (Supplied with energy or force)
Privileged - सौभाग्यशाली (Having special rights or advantages)
Useless - बेकार (That does not achieve anything)
Unhappy - असंतुष्ट (Not satisfied or pleased)
oa:
This word refers to something supplied with mechanical or electrical energy. It describes the state of being functional or forceful rather than a position of superiority or lack of problems.
Synonyms: Energized (ऊर्जावान), Driven (प्रेरित), Operative (क्रियाशील).
Antonyms: Weak (कमज़ोर), Manual (हाथ से किया हुआ), Inert (निष्क्रिय).

This word means having special rights, advantages, or immunities. It is the most appropriate opposite in a context where one group lacks access while the other has a superior position.
Synonyms: Advantaged (लाभान्वित), Favored (अनुग्रहित), Wealthy (संपन्न).
Antonyms: Disadvantaged (वंचित), Deprived (हीन), Poor (गरीब).

This word describes something that does not work well or achieves nothing. It is a negative attribute, much like disadvantage, and therefore cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Futile (व्यर्थ), Ineffective (बेकार), Pointless (निरर्थक).
Antonyms: Beneficial (लाभकारी), Helpful (सहायक), Productive (उत्पादक).

This word describes a state of not being satisfied or pleased. It relates to emotional distress rather than the presence of scientific or technological advantages.
Synonyms: Sad (दुखी), Miserable (दयनीय), Worried (परेशान).
Antonyms: Joyful (आनंदित), Content (संतुष्ट), Cheerful (प्रसन्न).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Triumph
questionsEn.s:
Triumph - विजय (A great victory or achievement)
Defeat - पराजय (To lose or be beaten in a battle)
Capture - पकड़ना (To take someone by force or skill)
Attainment - उपलब्धि (The action of achieving a goal)
Succeed - सफल होना (To achieve a desired aim or result)
oa:
This word means to be beaten in a competition or battle. It is the direct antonym for triumph, which represents a great victory or success.
Synonyms: Failure (असफलता), Loss (हार), Beating (पराजय).
Antonyms: Triumph (विजय), Success (सफलता), Victory (जीत).

This word means to take someone or something by force or skill. It describes a specific action of seizing rather than the overall outcome of winning or losing.
Synonyms: Seize (ज़ब्त करना), Apprehend (पकड़ना), Secure (हासिल करना).
Antonyms: Release (मुक्त करना), Free (आज़ाद करना), Lose (खोना).

This word refers to the action or fact of achieving a goal or objective. It is a synonym for triumph and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an opposite.
Synonyms: Achievement (उपलब्धि), Accomplishment (पूर्णता), Realization (सिद्धि).
Antonyms: Failure (विफलता), Forfeiture (दंड), Neglect (उपेक्षा).

This word means to achieve a desired aim or result. While it is the verbal form related to success, it is a synonym for triumph and not its opposite.
Synonyms: Flourish (फलना-फूलना), Prosper (समृद्ध होना), Prevail (जीतना).
Antonyms: Fail (असफल होना), Lose (हारना), Flounder (डगमगाना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Notion
questionsEn.s:
Notion - धारणा (An individual's conception or impression)
Quotient - भागफल (Result of dividing one number by another)
Law - कानून (Official rule of a country or state)
Reality - वास्तविकता (A thing that is actually experienced)
Portion - हिस्सा (A part or share of something larger)
oa:
This word refers to a result obtained by dividing one quantity by another. It is a mathematical term that has no conceptual relation to the idea of a mental belief or impression.
Synonyms: Result (परिणाम), Ratio (अनुपात), Portion (हिस्सा).
Antonyms: Dividend (लाभांश), Product (गुणनफल), Factor (कारक).

This word refers to an official rule of a country or state. While laws are formal, they do not directly contrast with the fluid, conceptual nature of an imagined idea.
Synonyms: Rule (नियम), Regulation (विनियम), Statute (विधान).
Antonyms: Chaos (अराजकता), Lawlessness (अधर्म), Anarchy (अव्यवस्था).

This word refers to things as they actually exist, rather than as they are imagined or believed to be. It serves as the direct opposite to a notion, which is just an individual's conception.
Synonyms: Fact (सत्य), Truth (असलियत), Actuality (वास्तविकता).
Antonyms: Notion (धारणा), Fantasy (कल्पना), Delusion (भ्रम).

This word refers to a part or share of something larger. It describes quantity or division and does not address the difference between belief and fact.
Synonyms: Section (भाग), Fragment (टुकड़ा), Allocation (हिस्सा).
Antonyms: Whole (संपूर्ण), Total (कुल), Entirety (पूर्णता).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Wax
questionsEn.s:
Wax - बढ़ना (To increase or grow)
Polish - चमकाना (To make something shine by rubbing)
Cane - बेंत (A stick used to help someone walk)
Wall - दीवार (A solid vertical structure for protection)
Wane - घटना (To gradually decrease in size)
oa:
This word means to make something shine by rubbing it. While "waxing" is a method used to polish items, the word does not address the concept of growth or increase.
Synonyms: Burnish (चमकाना), Shine (चमकाना), Glaze (रोग़न करना).
Antonyms: Dull (नीरस करना), Tarnish (धुंधला करना), Roughen (खुरदरा करना).
