This word refers to a stick used to help someone walk or a type of plant stem. It describes a physical object and has no relation to the cycle of increasing or decreasing.
Synonyms: Staff (छड़ी), Walking-stick (बेंत), Rod (डंडा).
Antonyms: Supportless (बिना सहारा), Falling (गिरना), Unstable (अस्थिर).

This word refers to a solid vertical structure built for protection or division. It describes a physical barrier and does not function as an opposite for a word denoting growth.
Synonyms: Barrier (अवरोध), Partition (विभाजन), Rampart (किले की दीवार).
Antonyms: Opening (खुला रास्ता), Gap (खाली जगह), Passage (गलियारा).

This word means to gradually decrease in size, strength, or power. It is the perfect antonym for wax, which means to increase or grow (especially of the moon).
Synonyms: Decrease (घटाना), Diminish (कम होना), Decline (क्षीण होना).
Antonyms: Wax (बढ़ना), Increase (वृद्धि), Grow (विकास).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Scattered
questionsEn.s:
Scattered - बिखरा हुआ (Spread out or dispersed)
Perished - नष्ट हो गया (To die or come to an end)
Dissipated - गँवाया हुआ (To disappear or disperse)
Sprinkled - छिड़का हुआ (Scatter in small amounts)
Gathered - एकत्रित (To bring together or collect)
oa:
This word means to die or come to an end, often in a violent or sudden way. It refers to the end of existence rather than the physical arrangement of objects.
Synonyms: Expired (समाप्त), Deceased (मृत), Vanished (गायब).
Antonyms: Survived (जीवित), Endured (सहन किया), Lived (जिया).

This word means to disappear or disperse, often describing feelings or wealth being wasted. It acts more like a synonym for scattered and cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Wasted (बर्बाद), Squandered (गँवाया), Evaporated (गायब).
Antonyms: Accumulated (संचित), Gathered (इकट्ठा), Conserved (संरक्षित).

This word refers to scattering small amounts of something over a surface. It describes a specific type of scattering and is not the opposite of the general term.
Synonyms: Strewn (बिखरा हुआ), Dotted (बिंदीदार), Spread (फैलाया हुआ).
Antonyms: Collected (संग्रहित), Concentrated (केंद्रित), Cleaned (साफ).

This word means to bring things together or collect them in one place. it is the direct physical opposite of being scattered, which implies being spread out in different directions.
Synonyms: Collected (इकट्ठा), Assembled (एकत्रित), Amassed (संग्रहित).
Antonyms: Scattered (बिखरा हुआ), Dispersed (छितराया हुआ), Strewn (फैला हुआ).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Obtuse
questionsEn.s:
Obtuse - मंदबुद्धि (Stupid and slow to understand)
Astute - चतुर (Very clever or good at judging situations)
Obese - बहुत मोटा (Very fat or overweight)
Banal - घिसा-पिटा (Lacking in originality or boring)
Obsolete - अप्रचलित (No longer in use or out of date)
oa:
This word means very clever and good at judging people or situations. It is the direct intellectual opposite of obtuse, which refers to being slow or stupid in understanding.
Synonyms: Shrewd (चतुर), Sharp (तीक्ष्ण), Intelligent (बुद्धिमान).
Antonyms: Obtuse (मूर्ख), Simple (साधारण), Gullible (भोला).

This word describes a person who is very fat or overweight in an unhealthy way. It describes physical condition and has no relevance to mental capability or understanding.
Synonyms: Portly (स्थूल), Stout (मोटा), Corpulent (चर्बीदार).
Antonyms: Slim (दुबला), Thin (पतला), Scrawny (हड्डीवाला).

This word describes something that is so lacking in originality that it is boring or uninteresting. It describes the quality of an idea rather than the slowness of a mind.
Synonyms: Trite (घिसा-पिटा), Humdrum (नीरस), Commonplace (साधारण).
Antonyms: Original (मौलिक), Unique (अद्वितीय), Creative (रचनात्मक).

This word refers to something that is no longer in use or has become out of date. It describes the relevance of a technology or idea rather than a person's intelligence.
Synonyms: Ancient (प्राचीन), Antiquated (पुराना), Archaic (आद्य).
Antonyms: Modern (आधुनिक), Contemporary (समकालीन), New (नया).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Filthy
questionsEn.s:
Filthy - गंदा (Extremely dirty or unpleasant)
Dignified - गरिमामय (Having a composed or serious manner)
Integral - मौलिक (Necessary to make a whole complete)
Barren - बंजर (Unable to bear fruit or produce crops)
Clean - साफ (Free from dirt, marks, or stains)
oa:
This word describes having or showing a composed or serious manner that is worthy of respect. It describes character and behavior rather than physical cleanliness.
Synonyms: Noble (महान), Stately (शानदार), Solemn (गंभीर).
Antonyms: Undignified (अशिष्ट), Lowly (नीच), Common (साधारण).

This word means necessary to make a whole complete or being essential. It describes importance and structure rather than the condition of being clean or dirty.
Synonyms: Essential (आवश्यक), Fundamental (मौलिक), Vital (अनिवार्य).
Antonyms: Peripheral (सतही), Optional (वैकल्पिक), Inessential (अनावश्यक).

This word describes land that is too poor to produce crops or a situation that is unproductive. While it implies a lack of life, it does not mean "clean."
Synonyms: Infertile (बांझ), Desolate (बंजर), Unproductive (निष्फल).
Antonyms: Fertile (उपजाऊ), Fecund (उर्वर), Productive (उत्पादक).

This word means free from dirt, marks, or stains. It is the direct and most appropriate antonym for filthy, which describes extreme dirtiness or unpleasantness.
Synonyms: Spotless (बेदाग), Pure (शुद्ध), Pristine (निर्मल).
Antonyms: Filthy (गंदा), Dirty (मैला), Soiled (दूषित).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Uncomfortable
questionsEn.s:
Uncomfortable - असुविधाजनक (Not comfortable or feeling uneasy)
Easeful - आरामदायक (Feeling at ease or providing comfort)
Difficult - कठिन (Not easy or needing much effort)
Awkward - अजीब (Lacking grace or causing embarrassment)
Troublesome - कष्टप्रद (Causing trouble or difficulty)
oa:
This word means feeling at ease or providing physical and mental comfort. It is the direct antonym for uncomfortable, which implies a state of unease or physical pain.
Synonyms: Comfortable (आरामदायक), Relaxed (निश्चिंत), Soothing (सुखद).
Antonyms: Uncomfortable (असुविधाजनक), Strenuous (श्रमसाध्य), Painful (दर्दनाक).

This word means needing much effort or skill to accomplish or deal with. While difficulty can cause discomfort, it is not the exact lexical opposite of the word "uncomfortable."
Synonyms: Arduous (कठिन), Hard (मुश्किल), Challenging (चुनौतीपूर्ण).
Antonyms: Easy (आसान), Simple (सरल), Effortless (सहज).

This word means lacking grace or causing embarrassment. It is actually a synonym for uncomfortable in social contexts and therefore cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Clumsy (अनाड़ी), Inept (अकुशल), Gauche (भद्दा).
Antonyms: Graceful (सुरुचिपूर्ण), Adroit (निपुण), Skillful (कुशल).

This word means causing difficulty or annoyance. It describes something that is a source of problems rather than the feeling of physical or mental discomfort itself.
Synonyms: Bothersome (परेशान करने वाला), Vexing (कष्टप्रद), Annoying (चिड़चिड़ा).
Antonyms: Pleasant (सुखद), Helpful (सहायक), Advantageous (फायदेमंद).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Sophisticated
questionsEn.s:
Sophisticated - जटिल/सभ्य (Refined, cultured, or advanced)
Technology - तकनीक (Application of scientific knowledge)
Primitive - आदिम (Basic, simple, or lacking development)
Modern - आधुनिक (Relating to recent times)
Techniques - तकनीकें (Specific methods or procedures)
oa:
This word refers to the application of scientific knowledge for practical purposes. It is a field of study and industry, not a characteristic that can oppose "sophisticated."
Synonyms: Engineering (अभियांत्रिकी), Mechanics (यांत्रिकी), Science (विज्ञान).
Antonyms: Nature (प्रकृति), Tradition (परंपरा), Simplicity (सरलता).

This word refers to something basic, simple, and lacking advanced development or complexity. It is the direct opposite of being sophisticated or refined.
Synonyms: Simple (सरल), Ancient (प्राचीन), Archaic (आदिम).
Antonyms: Sophisticated (जटिल/सभ्य), Modern (आधुनिक), Advanced (उन्नत).

This word refers to something relating to the present or recent times. It is often a synonym for sophisticated rather than its antonym.
Synonyms: Contemporary (समकालीन), Current (वर्तमान), Latest (नवीनतम).
Antonyms: Ancient (प्राचीन), Old-fashioned (पुराना), Obsolete (अप्रचलित).

This word refers to specific methods or procedures used to accomplish a task. It is a noun describing a process and does not serve as an antonym for an adjective.
Synonyms: Methods (विधियाँ), Systems (प्रणाली), Procedures (कार्यवाही).
Antonyms: Chaos (अराजकता), Randomness (बेतरतीब), Failure (विफलता).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Effervescent
questionsEn.s:
Effervescent - जीवंत (Lively, bubbly, and full of energy)
Bubbly - चुलबुली (Full of energy or containing bubbles)
Comparison - तुलना (Act of looking at similarities or differences)
Carefree - बेफिक्र (Feeling relaxed and without worries)
Subdued - शांत (Quiet, restrained, or lacking intensity)
oa:
This word means full of energy and excitement, or containing bubbles of gas. It is a direct synonym for effervescent and therefore cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Sparkling (चमकीला), Lively (जीवंत), Vivacious (उत्साही).
Antonyms: Flat (फीका), Dull (नीरस), Subdued (शांत).

This word refers to the act of looking at two or more things to see how they are similar or different. It is a conceptual action and not an antonym for an emotional state.
Synonyms: Contrast (तुलना), Correlation (सहसंबंध), Analogy (सादृश्य).
Antonyms: Distinction (भेद), Disparity (असमानता), Independence (स्वतंत्रता).

This word means feeling relaxed and without worries. While it describes a positive state, it aligns more with being effervescent rather than opposing it.
Synonyms: Blithe (निश्चिंत), Untroubled (बेफिक्र), Happy (प्रसन्न).
Antonyms: Anxious (चिंतित), Stressed (तनावग्रस्त), Gloomy (उदास).

This word means quiet, restrained, or lacking in its usual force and intensity. It is the perfect antonym for effervescent, which implies high energy and excitement.
Synonyms: Muted (धीमा), Restrained (संयमित), Solemn (गंभीर).
Antonyms: Effervescent (जीवंत), Exuberant (ऊर्जावान), Lively (चंचल).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Eloquent
questionsEn.s:
Eloquent - प्रभावशाली (Fluent or persuasive in speaking)
Modest - विनम्र (Unassuming or moderate in opinion)
Crucial - महत्वपूर्ण (Decisive or critical for success)
Impotent - शक्तिहीन (Powerless or ineffective)
Humble - नम्र (Having a low view of one's importance)
oa:
This word refers to being unassuming or moderate in the estimation of one's abilities. While an eloquent speaker could be modest, the word describes humility rather than speech quality.
Synonyms: Humble (विनम्र), Lowly (विनीत), Meek (नम्र).
Antonyms: Proud (गर्वित), Boastful (शेखीबाज़), Arrogant (अभिमानी).

This word means of great importance or decisive. It describes the weight of a situation rather than the persuasiveness or fluency of communication.
Synonyms: Vital (अत्यावश्यक), Essential (अनिवार्य), Critical (महत्वपूर्ण).
Antonyms: Trivial (तुच्छ), Minor (मामूली), Unimportant (महत्वहीन).

This word means powerless or ineffective. In the context of speech, an impotent speaker lacks the persuasive power or effect that an eloquent speaker possesses.
Synonyms: Powerless (शक्तिहीन), Weak (कमज़ोर), Ineffective (बेकार).
Antonyms: Powerful (शक्तिशाली), Eloquent (प्रभावशाली), Potent (प्रभावी).

This word refers to having a low view of one's importance. Like "modest," it describes a personality trait regarding ego rather than the ability to speak fluently and persuasively.
Synonyms: Unpretentious (साधारण), Respectful (आदरपूर्ण), Docile (विनम्र).
Antonyms: Haughty (घमंडी), Vain (अभिमानी), Superior (श्रेष्ठ).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Vouch
questionsEn.s:
Vouch - गवाही देना (To confirm something is true)
Maintain - बनाए रखना (To keep in an existing state)
Certify - प्रमाणित करना (To confirm or attest in writing)
Invalidate - अमान्य करना (To make an argument unsound or false)
Witness - गवाह (Someone who sees an event)
oa:
This word means to keep something in its existing state or to preserve it. It describes an act of continuing a condition rather than declaring something as true or false.
Synonyms: Sustain (बनाए रखना), Preserve (संरक्षित करना), Retain (रखना).
Antonyms: Abandon (त्यागना), Neglect (उपेक्षा करना), Change (बदलना).

This word means to confirm or attest to something as true, usually in writing. It is a synonym for vouch and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an opposite.
Synonyms: Verify (प्रमाणित करना), Endorse (समर्थन करना), Validate (पुष्टि करना).
Antonyms: Deny (नकारना), Invalidate (अमान्य करना), Reject (अस्वीकार करना).

This word means to make something (like an argument or claim) unsound or to prove it false. It is the direct antonym for vouching for something's validity or truth.
Synonyms: Disprove (खंडन करना), Nullify (रद्द करना), Annul (निरस्त करना).
Antonyms: Vouch (गवाही देना), Validate (मान्य करना), Confirm (पुष्टि करना).

This word refers to someone who sees an event and can report it. While a witness might vouch for someone, the word is a noun or verb of perception, not a direct opposite.
Synonyms: Observer (गवाह), Spectator (दर्शक), Testifier (प्रमाण देने वाला).
Antonyms: Participant (भागीदार), Ignoring (अनदेखा करना), Blind (अंधा).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Secure
questionsEn.s:
Secure - सुरक्षित करना (To make safe or protect from harm)
Succeed - सफल होना (To achieve a desired aim or result)
Save - बचाना (To keep safe from harm)
Attack - हमला करना (An aggressive action to cause harm)
Trundle - धीरे-धीरे चलना (To move or roll slowly and heavily)
oa:
This word means to achieve a desired aim or result. While success often brings security, the word describes an outcome rather than the state of being protected or safe.
Synonyms: Flourish (सफल होना), Prosper (समृद्ध होना), Prevail (जीतना).
Antonyms: Fail (असफल होना), Lose (हारना), Flounder (डगमगाना).

This word means to keep someone or something safe from harm or danger. It is similar in meaning to secure and cannot be used as its antonym.
Synonyms: Rescue (बचाना), Protect (रक्षित करना), Conserve (संरक्षित करना).
Antonyms: Endanger (खतरे में डालना), Harm (नुकसान पहुँचाना), Waste (गँवाना).

This word refers to an aggressive action intended to cause harm or damage. It is the direct opposite of secure, which involves protecting and making something safe.
Synonyms: Assault (हमला करना), Strike (आक्रमण करना), Charge (धावा बोलना).
Antonyms: Secure (सुरक्षित करना), Defend (रक्षा करना), Protect (बचाना).

This word means to move or roll something slowly and heavily on wheels. It describes a specific type of physical movement and has no relation to safety or protection.
Synonyms: Roll (लुढ़काना), Wheel (पहियों पर ले जाना), Lug (खींचना).
Antonyms: Fly (उड़ना), Speed (तेज़ी से चलना), Halt (रुकना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Receive
questionsEn.s:
Receive - प्राप्त करना (To accept or take what is given)
Admit - स्वीकार करना (To acknowledge or allow entry)
Exile - निर्वासन (To send someone away or banish)
Reward - इनाम (Something given for achievement)
Fund - निधि (A sum of money for a purpose)
oa:
This word means to acknowledge something as true or to allow someone to enter. While it involves accepting something, it is not a direct opposite for the act of receiving.
Synonyms: Confess (स्वीकार करना), Acknowledge (मानना), Accept (स्वीकार करना).
Antonyms: Deny (नकारना), Exclude (निकालना), Refuse (अस्वीकार करना).

This word means to send someone away or banish them from their native land. In this context, it represents the act of casting out, which is the opposite of receiving or accepting.
Synonyms: Banish (निर्वासित करना), Expel (निकाल देना), Oust (बेदखल करना).
Antonyms: Receive (प्राप्त करना), Welcome (स्वागत करना), Admit (प्रवेश देना).

This word refers to something given in recognition of effort or achievement. It is a positive gift given to someone, not an opposite of the act of taking or receiving.
Synonyms: Prize (इनाम), Award (पुरस्कार), Bounty (उपहार).
Antonyms: Punishment (दंड), Penalty (जुर्माना), Fine (जुर्माना).

This word refers to a sum of money provided for a particular purpose. It describes the resource itself rather than the action of accepting or rejecting it.
Synonyms: Finance (वित्तपोषित करना), Endow (दान देना), Sponsor (प्रायोजित करना).
Antonyms: Drain (खर्च करना), Withdraw (निकालना), Deplete (खाली करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Witty
questionsEn.s:
Witty - मज़ाकिया (Showing quick and inventive verbal humor)
Sorry - माफ़ करना (Feeling distress or sympathy)
Whimsical - सनकी (Playfully quaint or fanciful)
Unamusing - मज़ेदार नहीं (Not entertaining or humorous)
Woeful - खस्ताहाल (Characterized by sorrow or misery)
oa:
This word means feeling distress or sympathy for someone else's misfortune. It describes an emotional response and has no relation to the quality of being humorous or clever.
Synonyms: Regretful (पछतावा), Apologetic (क्षमाप्रार्थी), Sad (दुखी).
Antonyms: Glad (खुश), Unapologetic (निर्लज्ज), Defiant (अवज्ञाकारी).

This word describes something playfully quaint or fanciful. It is often a characteristic of being witty and thus acts more like a synonym than an antonym.
Synonyms: Fanciful (कल्पनाशील), Playful (चंचल), Eccentric (सनकी).
Antonyms: Serious (गंभीर), Practical (व्यावहारिक), Realistic (यथार्थवादी).

This word describes something that is not entertaining, funny, or humorous. It is the direct opposite of witty, which involves quick and inventive verbal humor.
Synonyms: Dull (नीरस), Boring (उबाऊ), Tedious (थकाऊ).
Antonyms: Witty (मज़ाकिया), Amusing (मनोरंजक), Humorous (हास्यपूर्ण).

This word describes something characterized by great sorrow or misery. It refers to deep sadness and tragedy rather than a lack of humor or cleverness.
Synonyms: Tragic (दुखद), Miserable (दयनीय), Sad (उदास).
Antonyms: Joyful (हर्षित), Cheerful (प्रसन्न), Happy (खुश).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Paralysed
questionsEn.s:
Paralysed - असहाय (Unable to move or act)
Demure - संकोची (Reserved, modest, and shy)
Stifled - दमित (To prevent or constrain an action)
Sultry - उमस भरा (Hot and humid weather)
Healthy - स्वस्थ (Being in good health, free from injury)
oa:
This word describes someone who is reserved, modest, and shy. it refers to a personality trait rather than the physical or functional ability to move or act.
Synonyms: Bashful (संकोची), Modest (विनीत), Shy (शर्मीला).
Antonyms: Brazen (बेशर्म), Outgoing (मिलनसार), Bold (निडर).

This word means to prevent or constrain an action or emotion. It is a near-synonym for the restrictive state of being paralysed and therefore not an opposite.
Synonyms: Suppressed (दमित), Restrained (नियंत्रित), Muzzled (दबाया हुआ).
Antonyms: Encouraged (प्रोत्साहित), Released (मुक्त), Expressed (व्यक्त).

This word describes weather that is hot and humid. It is an environmental descriptor and has no connection with the state of paralysis or health.
Synonyms: Muggy (उमस भरा), Steamy (गर्मी से भरा), Oppressive (दमनकारी).
Antonyms: Frigid (ठंडा), Cold (सर्द), Bracing (स्फूर्तिदायक).

This word describes a state of being in good health and free from injury or illness. It represents the functional opposite of being physically incapacitated or paralysed.
Synonyms: Robust (मजबूत), Fit (तंदुरुस्त), Vigorous (ऊर्जावान).
Antonyms: Paralysed (अशक्त), Sick (बीमार), Frail (कमज़ोर).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Catastrophe
questionsEn.s:
Catastrophe - महाविपत्ति (A sudden and widespread disaster)
Success - सफलता (Accomplishment of an aim or purpose)
Nurture - पालन-पोषण (To look after and protect someone)
Immaculate - निर्मल (Perfectly clean, neat, or tidy)
Disaster - आपदा (A sudden event causing great damage)
oa:
This word refers to the accomplishment of an aim or the attainment of wealth or status. It serves as an opposite to catastrophe, which implies a momentous tragic failure or disaster.
Synonyms: Achievement (सफलता), Triumph (विजय), Prosperity (समृद्धि).
Antonyms: Catastrophe (विपत्ति), Failure (असफलता), Disaster (आपदा).

This word means to look after and protect someone while they are growing. It describes an act of care rather than the positive outcome of an event that opposes a disaster.
Synonyms: Foster (पालन-पोषण करना), Tend (देखभाल करना), Support (समर्थन देना).
Antonyms: Neglect (उपेक्षा करना), Abandon (त्यागना), Harm (नुकसान पहुँचाना).

This word describes something that is perfectly clean, neat, or tidy. It is a physical descriptor of appearance rather than a measure of success or disaster.
Synonyms: Spotless (निर्मल), Pristine (स्वच्छ), Perfect (दोषरहित).
Antonyms: Dirty (गंदा), Filthy (मैला), Flawed (दोषपूर्ण).

This word refers to a sudden event that causes great damage or loss of life. It is a direct synonym for catastrophe and cannot be its antonym.
Synonyms: Calamity (विपत्ति), Tragedy (त्रासदी), Misfortune (दुर्भाग्य).
Antonyms: Success (सफलता), Boon (वरदान), Benefit (लाभ).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Strong
questionsEn.s:
Strong - मजबूत (Having power to perform physical tasks)
Mighty - शक्तिशाली (Possessing great and impressive power)
Weak - कमज़ोर (Lacking physical strength and energy)
Complicated - जटिल (Involving many confusing elements)
Rugged - कठोर (Having a rough, uneven surface)
oa:
This word means possessing great power or strength. It is a synonym for strong and does not satisfy the requirement for an antonym.
Synonyms: Powerful (शक्तिशाली), Potent (प्रभावी), Robust (मजबूत).
Antonyms: Weak (कमज़ोर), Fragile (नाज़ुक), Puny (नन्हा).

This word describes a lack of physical strength or energy. It is the direct and most appropriate antonym for the word strong.
Synonyms: Frail (दुर्बल), Feeble (अशक्त), Infirm (कमज़ोर).
Antonyms: Strong (मजबूत), Mighty (शक्तिशाली), Vigorous (ऊर्जावान).

This word refers to something involving many different and confusing elements. It describes the complexity of a task rather than the physical strength of a person.
Synonyms: Complex (जटिल), Intricate (पेचीदा), Knotty (पेचीदा).
Antonyms: Simple (सरल), Straightforward (सीधा), Plain (सादा).

This word describes having a rough, uneven surface or being strong and determined. While it implies durability, it does not function as an opposite for "strong."
Synonyms: Rough (कठोर), Tough (मजबूत), Hardy (सहनशील).
Antonyms: Smooth (चिकना), Delicate (नाजुक), Soft (कोमल).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Monotonous
questionsEn.s:
Monotonous - नीरस (Dull, tedious, and repetitious)
Tiresome - थकाऊ (Causing one to feel bored or annoyed)
Tedious - उबाऊ (Too long, slow, or dull)
Engrossing - रोमांचक (Absorbing all the attention)
Rational - तार्किक (Based on or in accordance with reason)
oa:
This word means causing someone to feel bored or annoyed. It is a consequence of something being monotonous and thus acts more like a synonym than an antonym.
Synonyms: Wearisome (थकाऊ), Boring (उबाऊ), Dull (नीरस).
Antonyms: Exciting (रोमांचक), Refreshing (ताज़गी भरा), Engaging (मोहक).

This word describes something that is too long, slow, or dull. It is a direct synonym for monotonous and therefore cannot be the correct answer.
Synonyms: Humdrum (घिसा-पिटा), Prosaic (नीरस), Mind-numbing (उबाऊ).
Antonyms: Interesting (दिलचस्प), Captivating (मोहक), Lively (जीवंत).

This word describes something so interesting that it absorbs all of one's attention. It is the perfect antonym for monotonous, which implies a lack of variety and interest.
Synonyms: Captivating (रोमांचक), Fascinating (मनमोहक), Gripping (दिलचस्प).
Antonyms: Monotonous (नीरस), Boring (उबाऊ), Dull (फीका).

This word means based on or in accordance with reason or logic. It describes the nature of a thought or explanation rather than the interest level of a routine.
Synonyms: Logical (तार्किक), Sensible (समझदार), Reasonable (उचित).
Antonyms: Irrational (अतार्किक), Illogical (बेतुका), Absurd (निरर्थक).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Epitome
questionsEn.s:
Epitome - सर्वोत्कृष्ट उदाहरण (A perfect example of a quality or type)
Exhort - प्रोत्साहित करना (Strongly encourage or urge someone)
Expansion - विस्तार (The action of becoming larger)
Lucid - स्पष्ट (Expressed clearly; easy to understand)
Precise - सटीक (Marked by exactness and accuracy)
oa:
This word means to strongly encourage or urge someone to do something. It is a verb describing an action of persuasion rather than the status of being a perfect example.
Synonyms: Urge (प्रोत्साहित करना), Advise (सलाह देना), Press (ज़ोर देना).
Antonyms: Discourage (निरुत्साहित करना), Deter (रोकना), Dissuade (मना करना).

This word refers to the action of becoming larger or more extensive. In many standardized tests, it is treated as an opposite to epitome, which represents the briefest or most condensed summary/example.
Synonyms: Enlargement (विस्तार), Growth (वृद्धि), Extension (फैलाव).
Antonyms: Epitome (संक्षिप्तीकरण), Contraction (संकुचन), Compression (कमी).

This word means expressed clearly or easy to understand. It describes the clarity of communication rather than the quality of being a representative model.
Synonyms: Clear (स्पष्ट), Intelligible (सुबोध), Transparent (पारदर्शी).
Antonyms: Vague (अस्पष्ट), Ambiguous (संदिग्ध), Confusing (भ्रमित).

This word means marked by exactness and accuracy of detail. While an epitome is often precise, the word does not function as a direct opposite.
Synonyms: Exact (सटीक), Accurate (शुद्ध), Specific (विशिष्ट).
Antonyms: Inexact (अशुद्ध), Vague (अस्पष्ट), Careless (लापरवाह).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Large
questionsEn.s:
Large - बड़ा (Big in size, extent, or amount)
Bumper - विशाल (Exceptionally large or abundant)
Gigantic - विशालकाय (Extremely large in size)
Tiny - छोटा (Very small in size)
Heroic - वीरता (Exhibiting courage and daring)
oa:
This word means exceptionally large or abundant, often used for crops. It is a synonym for large in certain contexts and cannot be used as its antonym.
Synonyms: Abundant (प्रचुर), Massive (विशाल), Plentiful (भरपूर).
Antonyms: Scanty (अल्प), Meager (थोड़ा), Small (छोटा).

This word describes something that is extremely large in size. It is an intensifier for the word large rather than an opposite.
Synonyms: Colossal (विशालकाय), Immense (अत्यधिक), Huge (विशाल).
Antonyms: Tiny (बहुत छोटा), Minuscule (अति सूक्ष्म), Small (छोटा).

This word refers to something that is very small in size. It is the direct and most accurate antonym for the word large.
Synonyms: Small (छोटा), Petite (नन्हा), Minuscule (सूक्ष्म).
Antonyms: Large (बड़ा), Huge (विशाल), Enormous (विशालकाय).

This word means exhibiting or marked by courage and daring. It describes the character of an action or person rather than the physical size of an object or mammal.
Synonyms: Brave (वीरता), Valiant (साहसी), Gallant (शौर्यपूर्ण).
Antonyms: Cowardly (कायर), Timid (डरपोक), Fearful (भयभीत).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Ambiguous
questionsEn.s:
Ambiguous - अस्पष्ट (Unclear or open to more than one meaning)
Puzzling - परेशान करने वाला (Confusing or difficult to understand)
Certain - निश्चित (Definite, clear, and not open to doubt)
Dubious - संदेहजनक (Doubtful or not to be relied upon)
Vague - अनिश्चित (Not clear or specific)
oa:
This word describes something that is confusing or difficult to understand. It is a synonym for the given word and therefore does not serve as an opposite.
Synonyms: Baffling (परेशान करने वाला), Perplexing (हैरान करने वाला), Mystifying (रहस्यमय).
Antonyms: Clear (स्पष्ट), Simple (सरल), Obvious (प्रत्यक्ष).

This word refers to something that is definite, clear, and not open to doubt. It is the direct antonym for ambiguous, which implies multiple interpretations or uncertainty.
Synonyms: Definite (निश्चित), Sure (पक्का), Unambiguous (सुस्पष्ट).
Antonyms: Ambiguous (अस्पष्ट), Uncertain (अनिश्चित), Vague (धुंधला).

This word means something that is doubtful or not to be relied upon. Like ambiguous, it conveys a lack of certainty and acts as a synonym.
Synonyms: Suspicious (संदेहजनक), Questionable (संदिग्ध), Fishy (संदेहास्पद).
Antonyms: Trustworthy (विश्वसनीय), Reliable (भरोसेमंद), Certain (निश्चित).

This word means not clearly expressed or specific. It is a direct synonym for ambiguous and cannot be used as its opposite.
Synonyms: Indistinct (अनिश्चित), Hazy (धुंधला), Nebulous (अस्पष्ट).
Antonyms: Explicit (स्पष्ट), Clear (साफ), Precise (सटीक).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Barbarity
questionsEn.s:
Barbarity - क्रूरता (Extreme cruelty or brutality)
Callous - निर्दयी (Showing insensitive disregard for others)
Compromise - समझौता (Agreement reached by making concessions)
Compassion - दया (Sympathetic pity and concern)
Rivalry - प्रतिद्वंद्विता (Competition for the same objective)
oa:
This word describes an insensitive and cruel disregard for others. It represents the behavior that leads to barbarity rather than its opposite.
Synonyms: Heartless (निर्दयी), Unfeeling (निष्ठुर), Ruthless (क्रूर).
Antonyms: Kind (दयालु), Compassionate (सहानुभूतिपूर्ण), Humane (मानवीय).

This word refers to an agreement reached by each side making concessions. It describes a method of conflict resolution rather than the moral quality that opposes cruelty.
Synonyms: Agreement (समझौता), Settlement (निबटारा), Accommodation (अनुकूलन).
Antonyms: Conflict (विवाद), Dispute (झगड़ा), Intransigence (जिद).

This word refers to sympathetic pity and concern for the sufferings of others. It is the direct moral opposite of barbarity, which involves extreme cruelty.
Synonyms: Kindness (दया), Empathy (सहानुभूति), Benevolence (भलाई).
Antonyms: Barbarity (क्रूरता), Cruelty (निर्दयता), Harshness (कठोरता).

This word refers to competition for the same objective or superiority. It describes a social dynamic of competing rather than the moral state of being civilized or kind.
Synonyms: Competition (प्रतिद्वंद्विता), Contention (होड़), Conflict (संघर्ष).
Antonyms: Cooperation (सहयोग), Alliance (गठबंधन), Harmony (सद्भाव).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Grudge
questionsEn.s:
Grudge - द्वेष (A persistent feeling of ill will)
Rancour - कड़वाहट (Bitterness or long-standing resentment)
Benevolence - भलाई (Quality of being well-meaning and kindly)
Revulsion - घृणा (A sense of disgust and loathing)
Malevolence - दुर्भावना (Having or showing a wish to do evil)
oa:
This word means bitterness or resentfulness, especially when long-standing. it is a direct synonym for grudge and cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Resentment (कड़वाहट), Bitterness (द्वेष), Enmity (शत्रुता).
Antonyms: Goodwill (सद्भावना), Amity (मित्रता), Benevolence (भलाई).

This word refers to the quality of being well-meaning and kindly. It is the direct opposite of holding a grudge, which involves persistent ill will.
Synonyms: Kindness (भलाई), Generosity (उदारता), Altruism (परोपकार).
Antonyms: Grudge (द्वेष), Malevolence (दुर्भावना), Malice (ईर्ष्या).

This word refers to a sense of disgust and loathing. While it is a negative emotion, it describes a reaction to something repulsive rather than a long-standing resentment.
Synonyms: Disgust (घृणा), Loathing (नफरत), Abhorrence (अरुचि).
Antonyms: Attraction (आकर्षण), Liking (पसंद), Admiration (प्रशंसा).

This word refers to the wish to do evil to others. It is similar in nature to a grudge and represents the same negative spectrum of emotion.
Synonyms: Spite (दुर्भावना), Malice (दुष्टता), Hostility (शत्रुता).
Antonyms: Benevolence (भलाई), Kindness (दया), Love (प्रेम).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Failed
questionsEn.s:
Failed - असफल होना (To be unsuccessful in achieving a goal)
Passed - उत्तीर्ण होना (To be successful in an examination)
Flunked - असफल होना (To fail in a course or exam)
Resized - पुनः आकार देना (To change the size of something)
Flopped - विफल होना (To fail completely in a performance)
oa:
This word means to be successful in an examination or to achieve a required standard. It is the direct and most accurate antonym for the word failed.
Synonyms: Succeeded (उत्तीर्ण होना), Achieved (प्राप्त करना), Won (जीता).
Antonyms: Failed (असफल होना), Flunked (अनुत्तीर्ण होना), Lost (हारा).

This word means to fail in a course or examination. it is a direct synonym for the given word and cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Failed (असफल होना), Dropped out (छोड़ देना), Lost (हार जाना).
Antonyms: Passed (उत्तीर्ण), Succeeded (सफल), Graduated (स्नातक).

This word refers to changing the size of an image or object. It describes a physical adjustment and has no conceptual relation to success or failure.
Synonyms: Adjusted (पुनः आकार देना), Scaled (मापा हुआ), Modified (संशोधित).
Antonyms: Fixed (नियत), Constant (स्थिर), Original (मूल).

This word means to fail completely, especially in a performance or commercial venture. It is a synonym for failed and not an antonym.
Synonyms: Failed (विफल होना), Tanked (बर्बाद होना), Collapsed (ढह जाना).
Antonyms: Triumphed (विजय प्राप्त करना), Succeeded (सफल होना), Prospered (समृद्ध होना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Hit
questionsEn.s:
Hit - लक्ष्य पर पहुंचना (To reach or achieve a target)
Touched - छुआ (To come into contact with something)
Bashed - पीटा (To strike something with force)
Missed - चूकना (Failing to reach or achieve a target)
Cleaned - साफ किया (To remove dirt or unwanted substances)
oa:
This word means to come into contact with something. While hitting involves touching, it is a milder form of the same action and not a direct opposite.
Synonyms: Felt (छुआ), Handled (हाथ लगाया), Brushed (स्पर्श किया).
Antonyms: Avoided (बचा), Evaded (टाल दिया), Missed (चूका).

This word means to strike something with great force. It is an intense synonym for hit and therefore cannot be the antonym required.
Synonyms: Smashed (पीटा), Battered (मारा), Pounded (धमाका).
Antonyms: Petted (दुलारा), Stroked (सहलाया), Missed (चूका).

This word means failing to reach, catch, or achieve a target. It is the perfect antonym for hit, which involves successfully striking or reaching the goal.
Synonyms: Failed (चूकना), Omitted (छोड़ दिया), Avoided (बचना).
Antonyms: Hit (लक्ष्य पर पहुंचना), Struck (मारा), Caught (पकड़ा).

This word means to remove dirt or unwanted substances. It describes a task of maintenance and has no relation to the act of striking or missing a target.
Synonyms: Scrubbed (साफ किया), Washed (धोया), Purified (शुद्ध किया).
Antonyms: Dirtied (गंदा किया), Soiled (मैला किया), Polluted (प्रदूषित किया).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Happy
questionsEn.s:
Happy - खुश (Feeling or showing pleasure)
Sad - दुखी (Feeling or showing sorrow)
Joyful - आनंदित (Feeling great pleasure and happiness)
Upbeat - उत्साही (Cheerful and optimistic)
Excited - उत्साहित (Very enthusiastic and eager)
oa:
This word describes a state of feeling sorrow or unhappiness. It is the direct and most universal antonym for the word happy.
Synonyms: Sorrowful (दुखी), Unhappy (उदास), Gloomy (विषादपूर्ण).
Antonyms: Happy (खुश), Joyful (प्रसन्न), Cheerful (हर्षित).

This word means feeling, expressing, or causing great pleasure. It is a strong synonym for happy and cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Elated (आनंदित), Ecstatic (अति प्रसन्न), Radiant (प्रफुल्लित).
Antonyms: Miserable (दयनीय), Sad (दुखी), Depressed (उदास).

This word describes being cheerful and optimistic. It describes a positive mindset similar to happiness and is not an antonym.
Synonyms: Optimistic (उत्साही), Positive (सकारात्मक), Hopeful (आशावान).
Antonyms: Pessimistic (निराशावादी), Gloomy (उदास), Negative (नकारात्मक).

This word means being very enthusiastic and eager. While excitement is a positive emotion, it describes high energy rather than the general state of contentment.
Synonyms: Thrilled (उत्साहित), Eager (उत्सुक), Animated (जोशीला).
Antonyms: Bored (ऊबा हुआ), Calm (शांत), Indifferent (उदासीन).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Prosperity
questionsEn.s:
Prosperity - समृद्धि (A state of being successful, usually with money)
Security - सुरक्षा (The state of being free from danger)
Secure - सुरक्षित (Fixed or fastened so as not to give way)
Affluence - धनाढ्यता (The state of having a great deal of money)
Failure - असफलता (Lack of success or inability to meet expectation)
oa:
This word refers to the state of being free from danger or threat. While a prosperous nation is often secure, the word describes safety rather than wealth or success.
Synonyms: Protection (सुरक्षा), Safety (बचाव), Certainty (निश्चितता).
Antonyms: Insecurity (असुरक्षा), Danger (खतरा), Peril (जोखिम).

This word means fixed or fastened so as not to give way, or feeling safe. It is an adjective describing a state of safety and not the opposite of financial success.
Synonyms: Safe (सुरक्षित), Stable (स्थिर), Firm (दृढ़).
Antonyms: Vulnerable (असुरक्षित), Risky (जोखिम भरा), Loose (ढीला).

This word refers to the state of having a great deal of money or wealth. it is a direct synonym for prosperity and therefore not an antonym.
Synonyms: Wealth (धनाढ्यता), Riches (अमीर), Opulence (वैभव).
Antonyms: Poverty (गरीबी), Penury (दरिद्रता), Scarcity (अभाव).

This word refers to the lack of success or the inability to meet an expectation. It serves as an opposite to prosperity, which implies a state of being successful.
Synonyms: Collapse (असफलता), Breakdown (विफलता), Ruin (बर्बादी).
Antonyms: Prosperity (समृद्धि), Success (सफलता), Triumph (विजय).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Babble
questionsEn.s:
Babble - बड़बड़ाना (To talk in a confused or excited way)
Gossips - गपशप (Talking casually about others)
Quiet - शांत (Making very little or no noise)
Talkative - बातूनी (Fond of or given to talking a lot)
Rants - प्रलाप (Speaking at length in an angry way)
oa:
This word means talking casually about others, often involving unconfirmed details. it is a form of talking much like babbling and is not its opposite.
Synonyms: Chatter (गपशप), Tattle (इधर-उधर की बातें), Prattle (बकवास).
Antonyms: Silence (चुप्पी), Secret (गुप्त), Quiet (मौन).

This word refers to making very little or no noise. It is the direct antonym for babble, which involves continuous and often confused talking.
Synonyms: Silent (शांत), Mute (मौन), Still (निश्चल).
Antonyms: Babble (बड़बड़ाना), Loud (जोरदार), Noisy (शोरगुल).

This word describes a person who is fond of or given to talking a lot. It is a trait that leads to babbling rather than an opposite of the action.
Synonyms: Garrulous (बातूनी), Loquacious (वाचाल), Chatty (गप्पी).
Antonyms: Taciturn (अल्पभाषी), Reserved (संकोची), Silent (चुप).

This word means speaking or shouting at length in an angry, impassioned way. It describes a specific style of loud talking and is not the opposite of babble.
Synonyms: Rave (प्रलाप), Tirade (कड़ी आलोचना), Harangue (भाषण).
Antonyms: Whisper (फुसफुसाना), Murmur (बुदबुदाना), Quiet (शांत).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Sell
questionsEn.s:
Sell - बेचना (To give something in exchange for money)
Loan - ऋण (A thing that is borrowed)
Rent - किराया (Payment for the use of property)
Buy - खरीदना (Acquiring something in exchange for money)
Make - बनाना (Create or form something)
oa:
This word refers to a thing that is borrowed, usually money, to be paid back. It describes a credit transaction rather than the transfer of ownership that opposes selling.
Synonyms: Lend (ऋण देना), Advance (अग्रिम), Credit (उधार).
Antonyms: Repay (चुकाना), Borrow (उधार लेना), Spend (खर्च करना).

This word refers to a tenant's payment to a landlord for the use of property. It describes a temporary use of an item rather than the permanent acquisition that opposes a sale.
Synonyms: Lease (किराया), Hire (किराए पर लेना), Charter (अनुबंध).
Antonyms: Own (अपना होना), Buy (खरीदना), Sell (बेचना).

This word refers to acquiring something in exchange for money. It is the direct and logical opposite of selling, which involves giving something away for money.
Synonyms: Purchase (खरीदना), Acquire (प्राप्त करना), Procure (हासिल करना).
Antonyms: Sell (बेचना), Vend (बेचना), Discard (त्यागना).

This word means to form or create something by putting parts together. It describes the production process rather than the commercial exchange of goods.
Synonyms: Create (बनाना), Construct (निर्माण करना), Manufacture (उत्पादन करना).
Antonyms: Destroy (नष्ट करना), Dismantle (विघटित करना), Break (तोड़ना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Affirmative
questionsEn.s:
Affirmative - सकारात्मक (Expressing agreement or consent)
Sanction - अनुमोदन (Official permission or approval)
Negative - नकारात्मक (Expressing refusal or denial)
Acquiescence - समर्पण (Agreement by silence)
Accession - अधिकार ग्रहण (Coming into a position of power)
oa:
This word refers to official permission or approval for an action. It describes an authoritative support rather than the simple quality of being positive or negative.
Synonyms: Approval (अनुमोदन), Authorization (प्राधिकरण), Consent (सहमति).
Antonyms: Prohibition (निषेध), Ban (प्रतिबंध), Veto (अस्वीकार).

This word refers to expressing refusal, disagreement, or denial. It is the direct grammatical and logical antonym for affirmative, which signifies agreement.
Synonyms: Denial (नकारात्मक), Refusal (अस्वीकृति), Contradictory (विरोधाभासी).
Antonyms: Affirmative (सकारात्मक), Positive (निश्चित), Agreeing (सहमत).

This word means agreement or consent by silence or without objection. It is a type of affirmative response and therefore cannot be its antonym.
Synonyms: Compliance (समर्पण), Agreement (सहमति), Acceptance (स्वीकृति).
Antonyms: Resistance (प्रतिरोध), Rebellion (विद्रोह), Objection (आपत्ति).

This word refers to the act of coming into a position of power or an increase in amount. It describes a formal rise in status rather than a response type.
Synonyms: Succession (अधिकार ग्रहण), Rise (उत्थान), Attainment (प्राप्ति).
Antonyms: Abdication (त्याग), Resignation (इस्तीफा), Decline (पतन).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Entire
questionsEn.s:
Entire - पूरा (Whole, complete, or having all parts)
Ingress - प्रवेश (The action of entering)
Thorough - पूरी तरह (Complete with regard to every detail)
Incomplete - अधूरा (Not whole or finished)
Undivided - अविभाजित (Not separated into parts or shares)
oa:
This word refers to the action or fact of going in or entering. It describes movement into a space and has no conceptual link to the completeness of an object.
Synonyms: Entry (प्रवेश), Access (पहुँच), Admission (दाखिला).
Antonyms: Egress (निकास), Exit (बाहर जाना), Departure (प्रस्थान).

This word means complete with regard to every detail. It is a synonym for the given word in many contexts and does not provide an opposite meaning.
Synonyms: Complete (पूरी तरह), Comprehensive (विस्तृत), Exhaustive (संपूर्ण).
Antonyms: Superficial (सतही), Cursory (लापरवाह), Incomplete (अधूरा).

This word refers to something that is not whole or finished, lacking some required parts. It is the direct and most accurate antonym for entire.
Synonyms: Partial (अधूरा), Fragmented (खंडित), Unfinished (अपूर्ण).
Antonyms: Entire (पूरा), Complete (संपूर्ण), Whole (सब).

This word means not separated into parts or shares. It describes the state of being whole and is a synonym for entire rather than an antonym.
Synonyms: Unified (अविभाजित), Continuous (निरंतर), Joint (संयुक्त).
Antonyms: Divided (विभाजित), Split (अलग), Separated (पृथक).

test.instructions: Standard CBT Pattern Exam. Positive Marks: +1, Negative Marks: -0.25. Total Questions: 50.

test.title: Set - 17

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Discouraged
questionsEn.s:
Discouraged - हतोत्साहित (Having lost confidence or enthusiasm)
Inspired - प्रेरित (Filled with the urge to do something)
Energetic - ऊर्जावान (Showing great activity or vitality)
Admired - प्रशंसित (Regarded with respect or warm approval)
Disappointed - निराश (Sad because hopes were not fulfilled)
oa:
This word means being filled with the urge to do or feel something, often providing motivation. It serves as the direct opposite of being discouraged or disheartened.
Synonyms: Motivated (प्रेरित), Animated (उत्साहित), Enlivened (जीवंत).
Antonyms: Discouraged (हतोत्साहित), Depressed (उदास), Disheartened (निराश).

This word refers to showing or involving great activity or vitality. While an inspired person is energetic, the word itself refers to energy levels rather than the mental state of hope.
Synonyms: Vigorous (ऊर्जावान), Active (सक्रिय), Dynamic (गतिशील).
Antonyms: Lethargic (सुस्त), Lazy (आलसी), Idle (बेकार).

This word describes being regarded with respect or warm approval by others. It describes how society views a person rather than the person's internal level of discouragement.
Synonyms: Respected (प्रशंसित), Honored (सम्मानित), Esteemed (आदरणीय).
Antonyms: Despised (घृणित), Criticized (आलोचित), Disdained (तिरस्कृत).

This word means being sad because someone or something has failed to fulfill one's hopes. It shares a negative sentiment with discouraged and is not its antonym.
Synonyms: Saddened (निराश), Crestfallen (दुखी), Let down (हताश).
Antonyms: Satisfied (संतुष्ट), Pleased (प्रसन्न), Content (खुश).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Attack
questionsEn.s:
Attack - आक्रमण (To take aggressive action against a target)
Ambush - घात (A surprise attack from a hidden position)
Defence - रक्षा (Action of protecting from attack)
Production - उत्पादन (The process of manufacturing goods)
Engagement - सगाई/मुठभेड़ (An agreement or a battle)
oa:
This word refers to a surprise attack by people lying in wait in a concealed position. It is a specific type of attack and therefore cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Trap (घात), Onslaught (धावा), Assail (आक्रमण).
Antonyms: Defense (रक्षा), Warning (चेतावनी), Alert (सतर्कता).

This word refers to the action of protecting from or resisting an onslaught. It is the direct and most logical antonym for attack.
Synonyms: Protection (रक्षा), Guard (बचाव), Shield (ढाल).
Antonyms: Attack (आक्रमण), Assault (हमला), Offence (अपराध/आक्रमण).

This word refers to the process of making or manufacturing goods. It is a term related to industry and creation and has no conceptual link to physical aggression.
Synonyms: Manufacture (उत्पादन), Creation (सृजन), Generation (निर्माण).
Antonyms: Destruction (विनाश), Consumption (उपभोग), Depletion (कमी).

This word can mean an agreement to marry or a battle. While it can involve fighting, it is not a direct opposite of the concept of attacking.
Synonyms: Appointment (सगाई), Battle (मुठभेड़), Conflict (संघर्ष).
Antonyms: Dismissal (बरखास्तगी), Withdrawal (वापसी), Separation (अलगाव).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Judiciously
questionsEn.s:
Judiciously - विवेकपूर्ण तरीके से (Using or showing good judgment)
Irreverent - असम्मानजनक (Showing a lack of respect)
Irrational - अतार्किक (Not based on reason or clear thinking)
Irrelevant - अप्रासंगिक (Not connected with or relevant)
Irritatingly - चिड़चिड़ेपन से (In a manner that causes annoyance)
oa:
This word describes showing a lack of respect for people or things that are generally taken seriously. It refers to attitude rather than the logical quality of judgment.
Synonyms: Disrespectful (असम्मानजनक), Insolent (धृष्ट), Impudent (बेशर्म).
Antonyms: Respectful (आदरपूर्ण), Devout (धार्मिक), Reverent (श्रद्धामय).

This word refers to a lack of reason or logic; it means not based on clear thinking. It is the direct opposite of being judicious, which implies wise and sensible judgment.
Synonyms: Illogical (अतार्किक), Unreasonable (बेतुका), Absurd (निरर्थक).
Antonyms: Judicious (विवेकपूर्ण), Rational (तार्किक), Logical (संगत).

This word means not connected with or relevant to something. It describes the applicability of information rather than the quality of the person's judgment.
Synonyms: Immaterial (अप्रासंगिक), Unrelated (असंगत), Inapplicable (अनुपयुक्त).
Antonyms: Relevant (प्रासंगिक), Germane (सार्थक), Pertinent (उचित).

This word describes acting in a manner that causes irritation or annoyance. it refers to the effect of an action on others rather than the soundness of the decision.
Synonyms: Annoyingly (चिड़चिड़ेपन से), Vexingly (कष्टप्रद रूप से), Pestiferously (परेशान करते हुए).
Antonyms: Pleasantly (सुखद रूप से), Soothingly (शांतिपूर्वक), Comfortably (आराम से).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Stale
questionsEn.s:
Stale - बासी (Something no longer fresh)
Green - हरा (Color like grass or being inexperienced)
Fresh - ताजा (Newly made or obtained, not old)
Cut - कटा हुआ (Divided into pieces with a tool)
Leafy - पत्तेदार (Having many leaves or much foliage)
oa:
This word refers to a color or being youthful and inexperienced. While fresh vegetables are often green, the word is not the direct lexical antonym for stale.
Synonyms: Verdant (हरा), Raw (कच्चा), Immature (अनुभवहीन).
Antonyms: Ripe (पका हुआ), Withered (मुरझाया), Experienced (अनुभवी).

This word refers to something newly made, obtained, or harvested and not old. It is the direct and most accurate antonym for the word stale.
Synonyms: New (ताजा), Recent (नवीन), Untainted (शुद्ध).
Antonyms: Stale (बासी), Old (पुराना), Rotten (सड़ा हुआ).

This word refers to something that has been divided with a sharp tool. It describes the physical state of an object rather than its freshness or age.
Synonyms: Chopped (कटा हुआ), Sliced (कटा हुआ), Severed (अलग किया हुआ).
Antonyms: Whole (पूरा), Intact (अखंड), Uncut (बिना कटा).

This word describes having many leaves or much foliage. It is a botanical descriptor and does not address whether a vegetable is old or new.
Synonyms: Verdant (पत्तेदार), Green (हरा-भरा), Lush (घना).
Antonyms: Leafless (बिना पत्तों का), Bare (नग्न), Withered (मुरझाया).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Refuse
questionsEn.s:
Refuse - इनकार करना (To show unwillingness to do something)
Repress - दबाना (To subdue someone or something by force)
Balk - रोकना (To hesitate or be unwilling to accept)
Accord - सहमति (To give or grant status or recognition)
Permit - अनुमति देना (To allow something to happen)
oa:
This word means to subdue or suppress something by force. It describes the containment of an action or emotion rather than the response to a request.
Synonyms: Subdue (दबाना), Restrain (रोकना), Stifle (दमित करना).
Antonyms: Express (व्यक्त करना), Release (मुक्त करना), Encourage (प्रोत्साहित करना).

This word means to hesitate or be unwilling to accept an idea. It is similar in meaning to refuse (to stop or resist) and therefore cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Hesitate (रोकना), Resist (विरोध करना), Shy away (कतराना).
Antonyms: Accept (स्वीकार करना), Face (सामना करना), Advance (आगे बढ़ना).

This word means to give or grant someone power, status, or recognition. While it implies giving, it is a formal act of granting rather than the simple act of permitting or accepting.
Synonyms: Grant (सहमति), Bestow (प्रदान करना), Concede (स्वीकार करना).
Antonyms: Withhold (रोक लेना), Refuse (इनकार करना), Deny (नकारना).

This word means to allow something to happen or to give permission for it. it is the direct and logical antonym for refusing to let something happen.
Synonyms: Allow (अनुमति देना), Authorize (अधिकृत करना), Let (होने देना).
Antonyms: Refuse (इनकार करना), Forbid (मना करना), Prohibit (प्रतिबंधित करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Synthetic
questionsEn.s:
Synthetic - कृत्रिम (Made by chemical synthesis to imitate nature)
Artificial - कृत्रिम (Made by human beings)
Imitation - नकली (Produced as a copy of something else)
Processed - प्रसंस्कृत (Subjected to a special treatment)
Natural - प्राकृतिक (Exists in nature; not made by humans)
oa:
This word refers to something made by human beings rather than occurring naturally. It is a direct synonym for synthetic and cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Man-made (कृत्रिम), Fake (नकली), Spurious (बनावटी).
Antonyms: Natural (प्राकृतिक), Genuine (असली), Real (वास्तविक).

This word refers to something produced as a copy of something else. Like artificial, it shares the same meaning as synthetic and is not an antonym.
Synonyms: Copy (नकली), Replica (प्रतिलिपि), Mock (बनावटी).
Antonyms: Original (मूल), Authentic (प्रामाणिक), Natural (प्राकृतिक).

This word describes something that has been treated or modified. While many synthetic items are processed, the word does not denote the opposite of human-made.
Synonyms: Refined (प्रसंस्कृत), Treated (उपचारित), Modified (संशोधित).
Antonyms: Raw (कच्चा), Unrefined (अपरिष्कृत), Natural (प्राकृतिक).

This word refers to something that exists in or is derived from nature; not made by humans. It is the direct and perfect antonym for synthetic.
Synonyms: Organic (प्राकृतिक), Native (स्वदेशी), Real (वास्तविक).
Antonyms: Synthetic (कृत्रिम), Artificial (बनावटी), Man-made (मानव-निर्मित).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Candid
questionsEn.s:
Candid - स्पष्टवादी (Being straightforward, honest, and open)
Tender - कोमल (Showing gentleness and concern)
Guileless - निर्दोष (Innocent and without deception)
Dishonest - बेईमान (Someone who lies or cheats)
Irrelevant - अप्रासंगिक (Not connected with or relevant)
oa:
This word means showing gentleness and concern or sympathy. While a candid person can be tender, the word describes kindness rather than the quality of being open and honest.
Synonyms: Gentle (कोमल), Kind (दयालु), Compassionate (सहानुभूतिपूर्ण).
Antonyms: Harsh (कठोर), Rough (खुरदरा), Cruel (निर्दयी).

This word means innocent and without deception. It is a synonym for the given word and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an antonym.
Synonyms: Honest (निर्दोष), Frank (स्पष्ट), Sincere (ईमानदार).
Antonyms: Deceitful (धोखेबाज), Artful (चालाक), Cunning (कुटिल).

This word refers to someone who lies, cheats, or is not truthful. It is the direct opposite of being candid, which involve being straightforward and sincere.
Synonyms: Deceitful (बेईमान), Untruthful (झूठा), Insincere (कपटी).
Antonyms: Candid (स्पष्टवादी), Honest (ईमानदार), Trustworthy (विश्वसनीय).

This word means not connected with or relevant to the subject. It describes the applicability of speech rather than the honesty or openness of the speaker.
Synonyms: Immaterial (अप्रासंगिक), Unrelated (असंगत), Inapplicable (अनुपयुक्त).
Antonyms: Relevant (प्रासंगिक), Pertinent (उचित), Germane (सार्थक).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Reluctant
questionsEn.s:
Reluctant - अनिच्छुक (Unwilling and hesitant)
Desperate - बेकरार (Feeling extreme urgency or hopelessness)
Obedient - आज्ञाकारी (Following orders or commands)
Enthusiastic - उत्साही (Showing intense and eager enjoyment)
Beautiful - सुंदर (Pleasing the senses or mind aesthetically)
oa:
This word means feeling a strong need or urgency, often because of hopelessness. While it implies a drive to act, it refers to extreme distress rather than willing enthusiasm.
Synonyms: Frantic (बेकरार), Reckless (लापरवाह), Hopeless (निराश).
Antonyms: Calm (शांत), Composed (स्थिर), Content (संतुष्ट).

This word means following orders or commands. A person can be obedient while still being reluctant, so it does not serve as a direct antonym for willingness.
Synonyms: Submissive (आज्ञाकारी), Compliant (अनुपालन करने वाला), Dutiful (कर्तव्यनिष्ठ).
Antonyms: Rebellious (विद्रोही), Defiant (अवज्ञाकारी), Mutinous (बागी).

This word refers to showing intense and eager enjoyment or approval. It is the direct antonym for reluctant, which implies being hesitant and unwilling.
Synonyms: Eager (उत्साही), Zealous (जोशीला), Keen (उत्सुक).
Antonyms: Reluctant (अनिच्छुक), Apathetic (उदासीन), Indifferent (बेपरवाह).

This word means pleasing the senses or mind aesthetically. It is an aesthetic descriptor and has no connection to the willingness or hesitation of a person.
Synonyms: Lovely (सुंदर), Gorgeous (भव्य), Stunning (मनमोहक).
Antonyms: Ugly (कुरूप), Repulsive (घृणित), Hideous (भयानक).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Predictable
questionsEn.s:
Predictable - पूर्वानुमान योग्य (Something that can be anticipated)
Undeviating - अविचलित (Not changing from a predetermined course)
Evident - स्पष्ट (Clearly seen or understood)
Unexpected - अप्रत्याशित (Not anticipated or foreseen)
Infelicitous - अप्रसन्न (Not suitable or appropriate)
oa:
This word means not changing or swerving from a predetermined course. It describes something that stays the same, which is a characteristic of being predictable rather than its opposite.
Synonyms: Constant (अविचलित), Steady (नियमित), Consistent (संगत).
Antonyms: Erratic (अनियमित), Varying (बदलता हुआ), Deviating (विचलित).

This word means clearly seen or understood. While predictable things are often evident, the word describes clarity rather than the lack of anticipation.
Synonyms: Clear (स्पष्ट), Obvious (प्रत्यक्ष), Manifest (प्रकट).
Antonyms: Hidden (छिपा हुआ), Obscure (धुंधला), Ambiguous (अस्पष्ट).

This word refers to something that is not anticipated or foreseen. It is the direct and perfect antonym for predictable, which describes things that are expected.
Synonyms: Unforeseen (अप्रत्याशित), Sudden (अचानक), Surprising (चौंकाने वाला).
Antonyms: Predictable (पूर्वानुमेय), Expected (अपेक्षित), Anticipated (अनुमानित).

This word means not suitable or appropriate for the occasion. It describes a lack of grace or luck in an action rather than the inability to foresee it.
Synonyms: Unfortunate (अप्रसन्न), Inappropriate (अनुचित), Awkward (भद्दा).
Antonyms: Felicitous (सुखद), Appropriate (उचित), Apt (सटीक).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Chronic
questionsEn.s:
Chronic - दीर्घकालीन (Persisting for a long time or recurring)
Common - सामान्य (Occurring or found often)
Universal - सार्वभौमिक (Applicable to all cases)
Usual - सामान्य (Habitually occurring or done)
Mild - हल्का (Not severe, serious, or harsh)
oa:
This word refers to something occurring or found often. Chronic diseases are common, so this is more of a characteristic than an antonym.
Synonyms: Usual (सामान्य), Frequent (अक्सर होने वाला), Regular (नियमित).
Antonyms: Rare (दुर्लभ), Unusual (असामान्य), Unique (अद्वितीय).

This word means applicable to all cases or existing everywhere. It describes the scope of a condition rather than its duration or severity.
Synonyms: General (सार्वभौमिक), Widespread (व्यापक), All-inclusive (सर्व-समावेशी).
Antonyms: Particular (विशिष्ट), Local (स्थानीय), Limited (सीमित).

This word means habitually or typically occurring. Like "common," it describes the frequency of occurrence rather than providing an opposite for a long-lasting condition.
Synonyms: Customary (सामान्य), Habitual (आदतन), Routine (नियमित).
Antonyms: Abnormal (असामान्य), Exceptional (असाधारण), Rare (विरल).

This word refers to something not severe, serious, or harsh. It is gentle in effect. in the context of disease duration vs severity, mild acts as the most appropriate opposite for a heavy/long-lasting condition.
Synonyms: Gentle (हल्का), Soft (कोमल), Light (मामूली).
Antonyms: Chronic (गंभीर/दीर्घकालीन), Severe (तीव्र), Intense (प्रबल).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Abolish
questionsEn.s:
Abolish - समाप्त करना (To formally put an end to a system)
Kill - मार डालना (To cause the death of a living being)
Terminate - समाप्त करना (To bring something to an end)
Establish - स्थापित करना (To set up or create something)
Damage - क्षति (Physical harm that impairs value)
oa:
This word means to cause the death of a living being. While both imply ending something, kill is literal for biological life, whereas abolish refers to systems or laws.
Synonyms: Murder (मार डालना), Slay (वध करना), Eliminate (खत्म करना).
Antonyms: Save (बचाना), Protect (रक्षा करना), Create (बनाना).

This word means to bring something to an end. It is a synonym for abolish and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an antonym.
Synonyms: Stop (समाप्त करना), End (अंत करना), Cease (रोकना).
Antonyms: Begin (शुरू करना), Start (आरंभ करना), Continue (जारी रखना).

This word means to set up or create something, especially a system or institution. it is the direct and most accurate antonym for abolish.
Synonyms: Create (स्थापित करना), Institute (संस्थापित करना), Found (नींव डालना).
Antonyms: Abolish (समाप्त करना), Destroy (नष्ट करना), Annul (रद्द करना).

This word refers to physical harm that impairs the value or normal function of something. It describes hurting an object rather than creating its existence.
Synonyms: Harm (क्षति), Impair (बिगाड़ना), Mar (खराब करना).
Antonyms: Repair (ठीक करना), Fix (सुधारना), Restore (बहाल करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Deceptive
questionsEn.s:
Deceptive - भ्रामक (Tending to deceive or give a false impression)
Honest - ईमानदार (Free from deceit; truthful and sincere)
Illusive - भ्रामक (Deceptive or misleading)
Ugly - कुरूप (Unpleasant or repulsive in appearance)
Beautiful - सुंदर (Pleasing the senses or mind aesthetically)
oa:
This word refers to someone or something that is free from deceit, truthful, and sincere. It is the direct opposite of deceptive, which implies giving a false impression.
Synonyms: Truthful (ईमानदार), Genuine (असली), Frank (स्पष्ट).
Antonyms: Deceptive (भ्रामक), Dishonest (बेईमान), Deceitful (धोखेबाज).

This word refers to something that is deceptive or misleading. it is a direct synonym for the given word and cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Illusory (भ्रामक), Imaginary (काल्पनिक), Unreal (अवास्तविक).
Antonyms: Real (वास्तविक), Tangible (ठोस), Genuine (प्रामाणिक).

This word describes something that is unpleasant or repulsive in appearance. It describes an aesthetic quality and has no relation to the honesty or deceit of a situation.
Synonyms: Hideous (कुरूप), Grotesque (भद्दा), Unattractive (अनाकर्षक).
Antonyms: Beautiful (सुंदर), Attractive (आकर्षक), Lovely (प्यारा).

This word means pleasing the senses or mind aesthetically. While a beautiful thing can be deceptive, the word itself is an aesthetic descriptor, not a moral or functional opposite.
Synonyms: Stunning (सुंदर), Gorgeous (भव्य), Alluring (मोहक).
Antonyms: Ugly (भद्दा), Repulsive (घृणित), Hideous (भयानक).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Feud
questionsEn.s:
Feud - झगड़ा/विवाद (A prolonged and bitter quarrel)
Humility - विनम्रता (A modest view of one's importance)
Harmony - सद्भाव (A state of agreement or concord)
Humble - विनम्र (Showing a modest estimate of importance)
Honesty - ईमानदारी (The quality of being truthful and sincere)
oa:
This word refers to a modest or low view of one's own importance. It describes a personality trait regarding ego and does not address the state of a conflict between groups.
Synonyms: Modesty (विनम्रता), Meekness (नम्रता), Lowliness (विनीत भाव).
Antonyms: Pride (गर्व), Arrogance (अहंकार), Haughtiness (घमंड).

This word refers to a state of being in agreement or concord, free from disputes. It is the direct antonym for a feud, which is a long-standing and bitter quarrel.
Synonyms: Accord (सद्भाव), Unity (एकता), Peace (शांति).
Antonyms: Feud (झगड़ा), Conflict (विवाद), Strife (कलह).

This word is an adjective describing someone who shows a modest estimate of their own importance. It does not function as an opposite to the concept of a long-standing fight.
Synonyms: Modest (विनम्र), Simple (साधारण), Unpretentious (विनीत).
Antonyms: Haughty (घमंडी), Proud (गर्वित), Arrogant (अभिमानी).

This word refers to the quality of being truthful and sincere. While honesty might help end a feud, it describes truthfulness rather than the state of peaceful coexistence.
Synonyms: Integrity (ईमानदारी), Probity (सत्यनिष्ठा), Truthfulness (सच्चाई).
Antonyms: Dishonesty (बेईमानी), Deceit (छल), Fraud (धोखा).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Autonomy
questionsEn.s:
Autonomy - स्वायत्तता (The right or condition of self-government)
Dependence - निर्भरता (State of relying on or being controlled by others)
Permanence - स्थायित्व (State of lasting or remaining unchanged)
Independence - स्वतंत्रता (The fact or state of being independent)
Economical - किफायती (Giving good value in relation to cost)
oa:
This word refers to the state of relying on or being controlled by someone else. It is the direct antonym of autonomy, which involves independence and self-government.
Synonyms: Reliance (निर्भरता), Subordination (आधीनता), Helplessness (मजबूरी).
Antonyms: Autonomy (स्वायत्तता), Independence (स्वतंत्रता), Self-sufficiency (आत्मनिर्भरता).

This word means the state or quality of lasting indefinitely. It describes the duration of a condition rather than the degree of freedom or control over it.
Synonyms: Stability (स्थायित्व), Durability (दृढ़ता), Continuity (निरंतरता).
Antonyms: Transience (क्षणिकता), Impermanence (अस्थिरता), Ephemerality (अल्पकालिकता).

This word refers to the fact of being independent or self-sufficient. It is a synonym for autonomy and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an opposite.
Synonyms: Freedom (स्वतंत्रता), Liberty (आज़ादी), Sovereignty (प्रभुसत्ता).
Antonyms: Dependence (निर्भरता), Slavery (दासता), Bondage (बंधन).

This word refers to giving good value for money or being efficient with resources. It describes financial prudence rather than political or personal independence.
Synonyms: Frugal (किफायती), Thrifty (मितव्ययी), Efficient (कुशल).
Antonyms: Extravagant (फिजूलखर्च), Wasteful (अपव्ययी), Expensive (महंगा).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Inquisitive
questionsEn.s:
Inquisitive - जिज्ञासु (Showing an interest in learning things)
Comprehensive - व्यापक (Dealing with all or nearly all elements)
Itemised - सूचीबद्ध (Presenting as a list of individual items)
Intrusive - आक्रामक (Causing disruption through being unwelcome)
Disinterested - निष्पक्ष (Having no personal interest or involvement)
oa:
This word means including or dealing with all or nearly all elements. It describes the scope of a study or report rather than the curiosity of a person's nature.
Synonyms: Extensive (व्यापक), Thorough (विस्तृत), Inclusive (व्यापक).
Antonyms: Selective (चयनात्मक), Limited (सीमित), Narrow (संकीर्ण).

This word refers to presenting information as a list of individual items. It describes a method of formatting data rather than an attitude toward learning.
Synonyms: Detailed (सूचीबद्ध), Catalogued (सूचीबद्ध), Listed (क्रमबद्ध).
Antonyms: General (सामान्य), Summarized (संक्षिप्त), Brief (छोटा).

This word means causing disruption or annoyance by being unwelcome. While an inquisitive person might be intrusive, the word describes an aggressive lack of privacy rather than its opposite.
Synonyms: Invasive (आक्रामक), Meddlesome (हस्तक्षेप करने वाला), Nosy (दखल देने वाला).
Antonyms: Reserved (संकोची), Polite (विनम्र), Respectful (सम्मानजनक).

This word refers to having no personal interest or involvement, making one impartial or neutral. It is the best antonym for being inquisitive (curious and interested).
Synonyms: Impartial (निष्पक्ष), Unbiased (तटस्थ), Indifferent (उदासीन).
Antonyms: Inquisitive (जिज्ञासु), Biased (पक्षपाती), Interested (रुचि रखने वाला).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Allay
questionsEn.s:
Allay - कम करना (To diminish or put at rest fear/suspicion)
Mitigate - कम करना (To make less severe or painful)
Simplify - सरल बनाना (To make something easier to understand)
Mollify - शांत करना (To appease the anger or anxiety of someone)
Aggravate - बढ़ाना (To make a problem or offense worse)
oa:
This word means to make something less severe, serious, or painful. It is a synonym for allay and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an antonym.
Synonyms: Relieve (कम करना), Soothe (शांत करना), Assuage (शांत करना).
Antonyms: Aggravate (बढ़ाना), Worsen (बिगाड़ना), Intensify (तीव्र करना).

This word means to make something simpler or easier to do. While simplifying a problem might allay fears, the word itself refers to the complexity of a task.
Synonyms: Streamline (सरल बनाना), Clarify (स्पष्ट करना), Ease (आसान करना).
Antonyms: Complicate (जटिल बनाना), Obscure (धुंधला करना), Confuse (उलझाना).

This word means to appease the anger or anxiety of someone. It is a direct synonym for allay and cannot be used as its opposite.
Synonyms: Pacify (शांत करना), Calm (शांत करना), Conciliate (मनाना).
Antonyms: Enrage (क्रोधित करना), Provoke (उकसाना), Agitate (उत्तेजित करना).

This word means to make a problem, injury, or offense worse or more serious. it is the direct and most accurate antonym for allay (which means to diminish).
Synonyms: Worsen (बिगाड़ना), Exacerbate (बदतर करना), Inflame (भड़काना).
Antonyms: Allay (कम करना), Mitigate (शांत करना), Alleviate (हल्का करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Scary
questionsEn.s:
Scary - डरावना (Something that causes fear)
Bright - उज्ज्वल (Emitting or reflecting a lot of light)
Pristine - अप्रदूषित (In its original and perfect condition)
Awful - भयानक (Very bad or unpleasant)
Comforting - सांत्वना देने वाला (Providing relief or reassurance)
oa:
This word means emitting or reflecting a lot of light. While a bright room is less scary than a dark one, the word describes illumination rather than the emotional sense of safety.
Synonyms: Shining (उज्ज्वल), Radiant (दीप्तिमान), Luminous (प्रकाशमान).
Antonyms: Dark (अंधेरा), Gloomy (उदास), Dim (धुंधला).

This word means in its original condition or unspoiled. it describes the purity or cleanliness of a place and has no relation to the feeling of fear.
Synonyms: Pure (अप्रदूषित), Unspoiled (निर्मल), Untouched (अछूता).
Antonyms: Dirty (गंदा), Polluted (प्रदूषित), Damaged (क्षतिग्रस्त).

This word refers to something that is very bad or unpleasant. It shares a negative tone with scary and often describes things that cause fear, so it is not an antonym.
Synonyms: Terrible (भयानक), Horrific (डरावना), Dreadful (भीषण).
Antonyms: Wonderful (अद्भुत), Excellent (शानदार), Pleasant (सुखद).

This word describes something that provides a sense of relief, reassurance, or safety. It is the direct emotional opposite of something that is scary.
Synonyms: Reassuring (सांत्वना देने वाला), Soothing (सुखद), Consoling (ढांढस बंधाने वाला).
Antonyms: Scary (डरावना), Frightening (भयानक), Terrifying (भयंकर).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Annoyance
questionsEn.s:
Annoyance - चिड़चिड़ापन (A feeling of irritation or displeasure)
Susceptibility - संवेदनशीलता (State of being likely to be harmed)
Absurdity - मूर्खता (Quality of being wildly unreasonable)
Gnawer - कुतरने वाला (An animal that gnaws)
Serenity - शांति (State of being calm and peaceful)
oa:
This word refers to the state of being likely to be influenced or harmed by something. It describes vulnerability rather than an emotional state of irritation.
Synonyms: Vulnerability (संवेदनशीलता), Sensitivity (सुग्राह्यता), Liability (संभावना).
Antonyms: Immunity (प्रतिरक्षा), Resistance (प्रतिरोध), Strength (शक्ति).

This word refers to the quality of being ridiculous or wildly unreasonable. It describes the nature of a logical or situational error rather than an emotion.
Synonyms: Folly (मूर्खता), Ridiculousness (हास्यास्पदता), Silliness (बेवकूफी).
Antonyms: Reasonableness (तार्किकता), Sense (बुद्धि), Logic (संगति).

This word refers to an animal that gnaws, typically a rodent like a mouse. It is a physical noun describing a creature and has no conceptual relation to human annoyance.
Synonyms: Rodent (कुतरने वाला), Nibbler (चबाने वाला), Vermin (कीट).
Antonyms: Protector (रक्षक), Builder (निर्माता), Giver (दाता).

This word refers to a state of being calm, peaceful, and untroubled. It is the perfect emotional antonym for annoyance, which involves irritation and disturbance.
Synonyms: Peace (शांति), Tranquility (निश्चिंतता), Calmness (स्थिरता).
Antonyms: Annoyance (चिड़चिड़ापन), Agitation (उत्तेजना), Turmoil (अशांति).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Dogmatic
questionsEn.s:
Dogmatic - कट्टरपंथी (Asserting opinions in an arrogant manner)
Concerned - चिंतित (Worried, troubled, or anxious)
Liberal - उदार (Open to new behavior or opinions)
Conservative - रूढ़िवादी (Holding to traditional values)
Diplomatic - कूटनीतिक (Dealing with people in a sensitive way)
oa:
This word means worried, troubled, or anxious about something. It describes an emotional state of care rather than the flexibility or arrogance of one's opinions.
Synonyms: Worried (चिंतित), Anxious (चिंतित), Solicitous (उत्सुक).
Antonyms: Indifferent (उदासीन), Unconcerned (बेपरवाह), Apathetic (उदासीन).

This word refers to being open to new behavior or opinions and willing to discard traditional values. It is the best antonym for dogmatic, which implies rigid and arrogant opinions.
Synonyms: Open-minded (उदार), Tolerant (सहनशील), Progressive (प्रगतिशील).
Antonyms: Dogmatic (कट्टरपंथी), Conservative (रूढ़िवादी), Narrow-minded (संकीर्ण).

This word refers to holding to traditional attitudes and values. it is similar in some ways to dogmatic (often used in the same context) and is not its opposite.
Synonyms: Traditional (रूढ़िवादी), Conventional (परंपरागत), Orthodox (मानक).
Antonyms: Liberal (उदार), Radical (मौलिक), Modern (आधुनिक).

This word means having an ability to deal with people in a sensitive and effective way. While a diplomat is not dogmatic, the word focuses on skill in handling people rather than the openness of beliefs.
Synonyms: Tactful (कूटनीतिक), Polished (शिष्ट), Urbane (सभ्य).
Antonyms: Rude (अशिष्ट), Blunt (मुँहफट), Undiplomatic (अकुशल).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Envious
questionsEn.s:
Envious - ईर्ष्यालु (Feeling jealousy towards others' possessions)
Generous - उदार (Ready to give more than strictly necessary)
Suspicious - संदेहास्पद (Having a cautious distrust of someone)
Malicious - दुर्भावनापूर्ण (Intending or intended to do harm)
Untrustworthy - अविश्वसनीय (Not able to be relied on as honest)
oa:
This word describes a readiness to give and help others freely. It acts as a moral opposite to being envious, which involves desiring others' possessions for oneself.
Synonyms: Benevolent (उदार), Magnanimous (महान हृदय), Charitable (दानशील).
Antonyms: Envious (ईर्ष्यालु), Greedy (लालची), Selfish (स्वार्थी).

This word means having a cautious distrust of someone. While one might be suspicious of a rival, the word describes distrust rather than the feeling of jealousy.
Synonyms: Distrustful (संदेहास्पद), Skeptical (शंकित), Wary (सावधान).
Antonyms: Trusting (विश्वासी), Confident (निश्चित), Gullible (भोला).

This word means intending or intended to do harm. It shares the same negative spectrum with envious (both are based on ill will) and is not its antonym.
Synonyms: Spiteful (दुर्भावनापूर्ण), Vengeful (प्रतिशोधी), Malevolent (दुष्ट).
Antonyms: Benevolent (भलाई करने वाला), Kind (दयालु), Friendly (मित्रवत).

This word describes someone who cannot be relied on to be honest or truthful. It refers to a lack of reliability rather than the presence of envy.
Synonyms: Deceitful (अविश्वसनीय), Shifty (छली), Dishonest (बेईमान).
Antonyms: Reliable (भरोसेमंद), Honest (ईमानदार), Trustworthy (विश्वासपात्र).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Lost
questionsEn.s:
Lost - खो गया (Unable to find one's way)
Paved - बनाया हुआ (Covered with a firm surface like concrete)
Slept - सोया हुआ (Past tense of sleep; resting)
Found - मिल गया (Discovering something that was missing)
Helped - मदद की (To assist or aid someone)
oa:
This word describes a path that has been covered with a firm surface. It refers to the physical construction of a road and has no relation to knowing or losing one's location.
Synonyms: Surfaced (बनाया हुआ), Floored (पक्का), Tiled (टाइल लगा हुआ).
Antonyms: Unpaved (कच्चा), Rough (खुरदरा), Natural (प्राकृतिक).

This word is the past tense of sleep, meaning to rest. It describes a biological state and is not conceptually related to the finding or losing of a destination.
Synonyms: Slumbered (सोया हुआ), Dozed (झपकी ली), Snoozed (सो गया).
Antonyms: Awakened (जागा हुआ), Worked (काम किया), Strayed (भटका हुआ).

This word means discovering something or someone that was missing or unknown. It is the direct and most accurate antonym for the word lost.
Synonyms: Discovered (मिल गया), Located (पता लगाया), Recovered (प्राप्त किया).
Antonyms: Lost (खो गया), Misplaced (भटक गया), Missing (गायब).

This word means to assist or aid someone. while someone might be helped because they are lost, the word describes an act of assistance rather than the state of being located.
Synonyms: Assisted (मदद की), Supported (सहारा दिया), Aided (सहायता की).
Antonyms: Hindered (बाधा डाली), Opposed (विरोध किया), Ignored (उपेक्षा की).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Hot
questionsEn.s:
Hot - गर्म (Having a high temperature)
Scorching - झुलसा देने वाला (Extremely hot)
Frigid - ठंडा (Extremely cold)
Balmy - सुहावना (Pleasantly warm)
Subtle - सूक्ष्म (Not obvious; delicate or precise)
oa:
This word means extremely hot, often to the point of burning. It is an intensifier for the given word and therefore cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Blistering (झुलसा देने वाला), Sweltering (तपती हुई), Searing (ज्वलनशील).
Antonyms: Freezing (ठंडा), Cold (सर्द), Frigid (जमाने वाला).

This word refers to something that is extremely cold or freezing. It is the direct and most appropriate physical antonym for the word hot.
Synonyms: Freezing (ठंडा), Chilly (सर्द), Icy (बर्फ जैसा).
Antonyms: Hot (गर्म), Warm (गुनगुना), Torrid (तपा हुआ).

This word describes weather that is pleasantly warm. it aligns with the warm spectrum and is not an opposite for something that is hot enough to burn.
Synonyms: Mild (सुहावना), Mellow (मधुर), Temperate (नरम).
Antonyms: Harsh (कठोर), Stormy (तूफानी), Frigid (ठंडा).

This word means something that is not obvious, or is delicate and precise. it refers to clarity and nuance rather than temperature and heat.
Synonyms: Elusive (सूक्ष्म), Nuanced (बारीक), Faint (हल्का).
Antonyms: Obvious (प्रत्यक्ष), Blatant (साफ), Harsh (कठोर).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Triumphant
questionsEn.s:
Triumphant - विजयी (Having achieved victory or success)
Flourishing - फूलता-फूलता (Developing rapidly and successfully)
Unsuccessful - असफल (Not achieving the desired aim or result)
Jubilant - प्रसन्न (Feeling or expressing great happiness)
Tender - कोमल (Showing gentleness and concern)
oa:
This word means developing rapidly and successfully; thriving. it describes success and prosperity, making it a synonym for the positive state of being triumphant.
Synonyms: Prospering (फूलता-फूलता), Thriving (सफल), Booming (उन्नत).
Antonyms: Failing (विफल), Declining (पतन), Languishing (क्षीण).

This word refers to a failure to achieve a desired aim or result. It is the direct antonym for triumphant, which means having achieved victory.
Synonyms: Failing (असफल), Fruitless (निष्फल), Abortive (विफल).
Antonyms: Triumphant (विजयी), Successful (सफल), Victorious (विजेता).

This word means feeling or expressing great happiness and triumph. It is a synonym for triumphant and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an opposite.
Synonyms: Exultant (प्रसन्न), Overjoyed (आनंदित), Elated (उल्लसित).
Antonyms: Depressed (उदास), Sorrowful (दुखी), Dejected (निराश).

This word means showing gentleness, concern, or sympathy. It describes a personality trait or physical softness and has no relation to winning or losing.
Synonyms: Gentle (कोमल), Kind (दयालु), Soft (मुलायम).
Antonyms: Hard (सख्त), Harsh (कठोर), Cruel (निर्दयी).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Dark
questionsEn.s:
Dark - अंधेरा (Having very little or no light)
Shadowy - छायादार (Full of shadows or difficult to see)
Dim - मंद (Not bright or clear)
Bright - उज्ज्वल (Emitting or reflecting much light)
Gloomy - उदास (Dark and depressing)
oa:
