This word means full of shadows or being dark and difficult to see. it is a synonym for the given word and cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Murky (छायादार), Dim (धुंधला), Obscure (अस्पष्ट).
Antonyms: Bright (उज्ज्वल), Clear (साफ), Radiant (दीप्तिमान).

This word refers to something that is not bright or clear. It describes a state of low light and is another synonym for dark rather than an antonym.
Synonyms: Faint (मंद), Dull (फीका), Darkened (धुंधला).
Antonyms: Bright (चमकीला), Intense (तीव्र), Luminous (प्रकाशमान).

This word refers to something that emits or reflects a lot of light, making it easy to see. It is the direct and most accurate antonym for the word dark.
Synonyms: Shining (उज्ज्वल), Radiant (दीप्तिमान), Luminous (प्रकाशमान).
Antonyms: Dark (अंधेरा), Gloomy (उदास), Dim (धुंधला).

This word describes being dark or poorly lit in a way that is depressing. It is a synonym for the environmental quality of being dark and not an opposite.
Synonyms: Dismal (उदास), Somber (विषादपूर्ण), Bleak (नीरस).
Antonyms: Cheerful (हर्षित), Bright (उज्ज्वल), Sunny (धूपदार).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Desolate
questionsEn.s:
Desolate - उजाड़ (A place empty of people and feeling sad)
Festive - उत्सव (Related to a celebration, bringing joy)
Allusive - संकेतपूर्ण (Making indirect references)
Frugal - मितव्ययी (Being economical with resources)
Melancholic - उदास (Feeling or expressing deep sadness)
oa:
This word refers to a state of celebration, joy, and the presence of people and decoration. It is the perfect opposite of a place that is sad, empty, and lonely (desolate).
Synonyms: Joyous (उत्सव), Cheerful (हर्षित), Merry (प्रसन्न).
Antonyms: Desolate (उजाड़), Gloomy (उदास), Solemn (गंभीर).

This word means making indirect references to something. it describes a style of communication or literature and has no relation to the emptiness or population of a place.
Synonyms: Suggestive (संकेतपूर्ण), Figurative (आलंकारिक), Symbolic (प्रतीकात्मक).
Antonyms: Direct (सीधा), Explicit (स्पष्ट), Literal (शब्दशः).

This word describes being economical or sparing with resources. It refers to a lifestyle of saving money and has no conceptual link to the physical state of a place being abandoned.
Synonyms: Thrifty (मितव्ययी), Economical (किफायती), Sparing (अल्पव्ययी).
Antonyms: Extravagant (फिजूलखर्च), Wasteful (अपव्ययी), Prodigal (खर्चीला).

This word refers to feeling or expressing deep sadness. it is a synonym for the atmosphere implied by the word desolate and therefore cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Somber (उदास), Depressed (विषादपूर्ण), Sorrowful (दुखी).
Antonyms: Happy (खुश), Jubilant (प्रफुल्लित), Cheerful (प्रसन्न).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Capricious
questionsEn.s:
Capricious - मनमौजी (Given to sudden and unaccountable changes)
Fickle - चंचल (Changing frequently in loyalties/affections)
Stable - स्थिर (Not likely to change or fail)
Mischievous - शरारती (Fond of causing trouble in a playful way)
Volatile - अस्थिर (Liable to change rapidly and unpredictably)
oa:
This word means changing frequently, especially regarding one's loyalties or interests. It is a direct synonym for capricious and therefore cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Volatile (चंचल), Unsteady (अस्थिर), Inconstant (अस्थिर).
Antonyms: Stable (स्थिर), Firm (दृढ़), Consistent (संगत).

This word refers to something that is not likely to change, fail, or move; it is firmly established and consistent. it is the direct antonym for capricious (unpredictable).
Synonyms: Steady (स्थिर), Constant (नियत), Reliable (विश्वसनीय).
Antonyms: Capricious (मनमौजी), Volatile (परिवर्तनशील), Fickle (चंचल).

This word describes causing or showing a fondness for causing trouble in a playful way. it refers to behavior rather than the frequency or predictability of a change in mood.
Synonyms: Naughty (शरारती), Playful (चंचल), Puckish (नटखट).
Antonyms: Well-behaved (सज्जन), Serious (गंभीर), Solemn (शान्त).

This word describes something liable to change rapidly and unpredictably. It is a synonym for capricious and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an antonym.
Synonyms: Unstable (अस्थिर), Explosive (विस्फोटक), Erratic (अनियमित).
Antonyms: Stable (स्थिर), Calm (शांत), Predictable (पूर्वानुमेय).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Stunning
questionsEn.s:
Stunning - मनमोहक (Extremely impressive or attractive)
Toxic - विषैला (Containing poisonous material)
Superfluous - अतिरिक्त (Unnecessary or excessive)
Smashing - शानदार (Excellent or wonderful)
Mundane - निरस (Lacking interest or excitement; ordinary)
oa:
This word refers to something containing poisonous material capable of causing death. It describes the harmful nature of a substance rather than its visual appeal.
Synonyms: Poisonous (विषैला), Lethal (घातक), Venonous (ज़हरीला).
Antonyms: Harmless (हानिरहित), Healthy (स्वस्थ), Benign (सौम्य).

This word means unnecessary, especially through being more than enough. it refers to the excessive quantity of something rather than its impressive quality.
Synonyms: Redundant (अतिरिक्त), Surplus (अतिरिक्त), Extra (फालतू).
Antonyms: Essential (आवश्यक), Vital (अनिवार्य), Necessary (ज़रूरी).

This word is a slang term for excellent, wonderful, or very attractive. it is a synonym for stunning and therefore does not serve as an antonym.
Synonyms: Magnificent (शानदार), Brilliant (शानदार), Superb (उत्कृष्ट).
Antonyms: Terrible (भयानक), Awful (बहुत बुरा), Bad (खराब).

This word refers to something that is lacking interest or excitement; dull or ordinary. it is the perfect antonym for stunning, which implies being breathtakingly impressive.
Synonyms: Dull (निरस), Ordinary (साधारण), Prosaic (सामान्य).
Antonyms: Stunning (मनमोहक), Extraordinary (असाधारण), Exciting (रोमांचक).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Inevitable
questionsEn.s:
Inevitable - अनिवार्य (Certain to happen and cannot be prevented)
Inexorable - अटल (Impossible to stop or prevent)
Clear - स्पष्ट (Easy to perceive or understand)
Avoidable - परिहार्य (Something that can be prevented or avoided)
Confident - आत्मविश्वासी (Feeling or showing certainty)
oa:
This word means impossible to stop or prevent. it is a direct synonym for the given word and therefore cannot be used as its opposite.
Synonyms: Relentless (अटल), Unavoidable (अपरिहार्य), Unstoppable (अजेय).
Antonyms: Avoidable (परिहार्य), Flexible (लचीला), Remiss (लापरवाह).

This word means easy to perceive, understand, or interpret. While an inevitable event might be clear, the word refers to clarity rather than the possibility of prevention.
Synonyms: Obvious (स्पष्ट), Manifest (प्रकट), Explicit (सुस्पष्ट).
Antonyms: Vague (अस्पष्ट), Obscure (धुंधला), Ambiguous (संदिग्ध).

This word refers to something that can be prevented from happening or kept away. It is the direct and most accurate antonym for inevitable (unavoidable).
Synonyms: Preventable (परिहार्य), Evadable (बचने योग्य), Escapable (त्यागने योग्य).
Antonyms: Inevitable (अनिवार्य), Certain (निश्चित), Inescapable (अटल).

This word describes feeling or showing certainty about something or one's own abilities. it refers to a mental attitude of trust rather than the fixed nature of an event.
Synonyms: Sure (आत्मविश्वासी), Positive (निश्चित), Self-assured (भरोसेमंद).
Antonyms: Doubtful (संदिग्ध), Uncertain (अनिश्चित), Diffident (संकोची).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Absolve
questionsEn.s:
Absolve - दोषमुक्त करना (To free from guilt, blame, or responsibility)
Commend - प्रशंसा करना (To praise formally or officially)
Accuse - आरोप लगाना (To charge someone with an offense)
Excuse - माफ़ करना (To forgive someone for an action)
Appeal - अपील करना (To make a serious or urgent request)
oa:
This word means to praise someone formally or officially. while it is a positive action, it describes giving approval rather than the legal or moral act of removing or assigning blame.
Synonyms: Praise (प्रशंसा करना), Applaud (सराहना), Extol (तारीफ़ करना).
Antonyms: Criticize (आलोचना करना), Condemn (निंदा करना), Blame (दोष देना).

This word means to charge someone with an offense or crime. It is the direct opposite of absolving, which involves freeing someone from guilt or blame.
Synonyms: Blame (आरोप लगाना), Indict (अभियुक्त करना), Charge (दोषारोपण).
Antonyms: Absolve (दोषमुक्त करना), Exonerate (बरी करना), Acquit (निर्दोष ठहराना).

This word means to forgive someone for a minor fault or to provide a reason for an action. It is a near-synonym to absolve and cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Forgive (माफ़ करना), Pardon (क्षमा करना), Condone (अनदेखा करना).
Antonyms: Punish (दंड देना), Condemn (निंदा करना), Accuse (दोष देना).

This word means to make a serious or urgent request, often for a legal decision to be reviewed. It describes a procedural request rather than the act of assigning guilt or freedom.
Synonyms: Petition (अपील करना), Entreat (विनती करना), Request (प्रार्थना).
Antonyms: Deny (नकारना), Refuse (अस्वीकार करना), Ignore (अनदेखा करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Appreciate
questionsEn.s:
Appreciate - सराहना करना (To recognize worth or be grateful)
Depict - चित्रण करना (To represent by drawing or painting)
Acknowledge - स्वीकार करना (To admit the existence or truth)
Esteem - सम्मान (Respect and admiration)
Depreciate - मूल्यह्रास करना (Reduction in value or to belittle)
oa:
This word means to represent something by a drawing, painting, or other art form. it describes the act of illustration rather than the valuation of an object's worth.
Synonyms: Portray (चित्रण करना), Represent (प्रस्तुत करना), Illustrate (दिखाना).
Antonyms: Hide (छिपाना), Obscure (धुंधला करना), Distort (बिगाड़ना).

This word means to accept or admit the existence or truth of something. It is often a step in appreciating something, making it a near-synonym rather than an opposite.
Synonyms: Admit (स्वीकार करना), Recognize (मानना), Accept (स्वीकृत करना).
Antonyms: Deny (नकारना), Reject (अस्वीकार करना), Disclaim (त्यागना).

This word refers to respect and admiration, typically for a person. It is a direct synonym for the act of appreciating someone and cannot be its antonym.
Synonyms: Respect (सम्मान), Honor (आदर), Revere (श्रद्धा).
Antonyms: Contempt (तिरस्कार), Disdain (घृणा), Scorn (अपमान).

This word refers to the reduction in the value of an asset over time or the act of belittling someone. it is the direct financial and metaphorical opposite of appreciate.
Synonyms: Devalue (मूल्यह्रास करना), Belittle (कम आंकना), Undervalue (कम समझना).
Antonyms: Appreciate (सराहना करना/मूल्य बढ़ना), Enhance (बढ़ाना), Value (सम्मान देना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Material
questionsEn.s:
Material - भौतिक (Physical, tangible, or perceivable)
Cheap - सस्ता (Low in price)
Abstract - सैद्धांतिक (Existing as an idea, not physical)
Concrete - ठोस (Existing in a physical or material form)
Temporary - अस्थायी (Lasting for only a limited period)
oa:
This word means low in price, especially in relation to similar items. it describes the cost of an object rather than its physical or conceptual nature.
Synonyms: Inexpensive (सस्ता), Low-cost (किफायती), Affordable (सस्ता).
Antonyms: Expensive (महंगा), Costly (कीमती), Precious (बहुमूल्य).

This word refers to something that exists as an idea or thought but does not have a physical or concrete existence. it is the direct opposite of being material (tangible).
Synonyms: Theoretical (सैद्धांतिक), Conceptual (वैचारिक), Intangible (अमूर्त).
Antonyms: Material (भौतिक), Concrete (ठोस), Physical (शारीरिक).

This word refers to something existing in a physical or material form; real or solid. it is a synonym for the given word and therefore cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Tangible (ठोस), Solid (मजबूत), Real (वास्तविक).
Antonyms: Abstract (अमूर्त), Vague (अस्पष्ट), Theoretical (सैद्धांतिक).

This word describes something lasting for only a limited period. It describes the duration of a condition rather than the physical substance of an object.
Synonyms: Transient (अस्थायी), Fleeting (क्षणिक), Impermanent (अस्थिर).
Antonyms: Permanent (स्थायी), Lasting (टिकाऊ), Eternal (शाश्वत).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Insatiable
questionsEn.s:
Insatiable - अतृप्त (Appetite or desire that cannot be satisfied)
Satisfiable - संतोषजनक (Desire or appetite that can be satisfied)
Urgent - तत्काल (Requiring immediate action or attention)
Curbed - नियंत्रित (Restrained or kept in check)
Pressing - महत्वपूर्ण (Requiring immediate attention; urgent)
oa:
This word describes a desire or appetite that can be fulfilled or satisfied. It is the direct and logical antonym for the word insatiable (cannot be satisfied).
Synonyms: Fulfillable (संतोषजनक), Appeasable (शांत करने योग्य), Quenchable (बुझाने योग्य).
Antonyms: Insatiable (अतृप्त), Unappeasable (अशांत), Greedy (लालची).

This word means requiring immediate action or attention. It describes the importance of a situation rather than the degree to which a desire can be fulfilled.
Synonyms: Pressing (तत्काल), Critical (महत्वपूर्ण), Immediate (तुरंत).
Antonyms: Trivial (तुच्छ), Unimportant (महत्वहीन), Minor (मामूली).

This word means restrained or kept in check. While it refers to controlling an appetite, it is an action of restriction rather than a descriptor of the nature of the desire.
Synonyms: Restrained (नियंत्रित), Controlled (संयमित), Checked (रोका हुआ).
Antonyms: Unrestrained (अनियंत्रित), Wild (जंगली), Indulged (लाड़ला).

This word is a synonym for urgent, meaning something that requires immediate attention. It does not address the ability to satisfy an appetite or desire.
Synonyms: Crucial (महत्वपूर्ण), Imperative (अनिवार्य), Urgent (तत्काल).
Antonyms: Negligible (नगण्य), Slight (मामूली), Minor (तुच्छ).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Brilliantly
questionsEn.s:
Brilliantly - प्रज्वलित (Very bright or exceptionally clever)
Brightly - चमकीले (In a way that produces a lot of light)
Dimly - मंद (Not bright or clear; giving little light)
Cunningly - चतुराई से (Skillful at achieving aims by deceit)
Strangely - अजीब तरह से (In a way that is unusual or surprising)
oa:
This word means in a way that produces or reflects a lot of light. It is a direct synonym for brilliantly and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an opposite.
Synonyms: Radiantly (चमकीले), Sharply (तीव्रता से), Vividly (जीवंत रूप से).
Antonyms: Dimly (मंद), Darkly (अंधेरे से), Obscurely (अस्पष्टता से).

This word refers to something that is not bright or clear, providing little light. It is the direct and most accurate antonym for acting or shining brilliantly.
Synonyms: Faintly (मंद), Obscurely (धुंधला), Shadowy (छायादार).
Antonyms: Brilliantly (प्रज्वलित), Brightly (चमकीले), Radiantly (प्रकाशमान).

This word means in a way that is skillful at achieving aims through deceit. it refers to behavioral trickery rather than the quality of light or talent.
Synonyms: Slyly (चतुराई से), Craftily (चालाकी से), Deceitfully (धोखे से).
Antonyms: Honestly (ईमानदारी से), Frankly (स्पष्ट रूप से), Openly (खुले तौर पर).

This word means in a way that is unusual or surprising. While someone might act strangely, the word does not address the brightness or cleverness implied by "brilliantly."
Synonyms: Oddly (अजीब तरह से), Peculiarly (विचित्रता से), Weirdly (अनोखे ढंग से).
Antonyms: Normally (सामान्य रूप से), Typically (आम तौर पर), Usually (अमूमन).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Purify
questionsEn.s:
Purify - शुद्ध करना (To remove contaminants from something)
Chant - जप (To say or shout repeatedly in a tone)
Invite - आमंत्रित करना (To ask someone to come somewhere)
Pollute - प्रदूषित करना (To make something dirty or contaminated)
Wash - धोना (To clean something with water)
oa:
This word means to say or shout repeatedly in a sing-song tone. It describes a vocal religious or rhythmic practice and has no connection to cleanliness or pollution.
Synonyms: Recite (जप), Intone (अलापना), Sing (गाना).
Antonyms: Silence (चुप्पी), Mute (मौन), Pause (रुकना).

This word means to ask someone to come to an event or do something. It describes a social interaction and does not address the purity of a substance or spirit.
Synonyms: Summon (आमंत्रित करना), Bid (बुलाना), Welcome (स्वागत करना).
Antonyms: Exclude (निकालना), Reject (अस्वीकार करना), Repel (दूर भगाना).

This word refers to making something dirty, impure, or contaminated. it is the direct and perfect antonym for the word purify.
Synonyms: Contaminate (प्रदूषित करना), Defile (अपवित्र करना), Soil (मैला करना).
Antonyms: Purify (शुद्ध करना), Cleanse (साफ करना), Sanitize (स्वच्छ करना).

This word means to clean something with water and soap. it is a synonym for the act of purifying or cleaning and therefore not an antonym.
Synonyms: Clean (धोना), Scrub (रगड़ना), Rinse (खंगालना).
Antonyms: Dirty (गंदा करना), Stain (दाग लगाना), Soil (दूषित करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Jibes
questionsEn.s:
Jibes - मज़ाक उड़ाना (Mocking or taunting remarks)
Consolation - सांत्वना (Comfort received after a loss)
Mockery - मज़ाक (Teasing and contemptuous language)
Inspiration - प्रेरणा (Mentally stimulated to do something)
Contradict - विरोधाभास (Deny the truth by asserting the opposite)
oa:
This word refers to comfort received by a person after a loss or disappointment. It acts as the emotional opposite to jibes, which are mocking or taunting remarks.
Synonyms: Comfort (सांत्वना), Solace (तसल्ली), Relief (राहत).
Antonyms: Mockery (मज़ाक), Jibes (ताना), Insult (अपमान).

This word means teasing or contemptuous language directed at someone. it is a direct synonym for jibes and therefore cannot be its antonym.
Synonyms: Ridicule (मज़ाक), Derision (उपहास), Taunt (व्यंग्य).
Antonyms: Respect (सम्मान), Praise (प्रशंसा), Tribute (श्रद्धांजलि).

This word refers to being mentally stimulated to do or feel something creative or positive. While positive, it does not directly address the act of taunting or comforting.
Synonyms: Motivation (प्रेरणा), Encouragement (उत्साह), Stimulus (प्रोत्साहन).
Antonyms: Discouragement (निराशा), Deterrent (बाधा), Depressant (अवसादक).

This word means to deny the truth of a statement by asserting the opposite. It describes a logical disagreement rather than the use of insults or comfort.
Synonyms: Deny (विरोधाभास), Oppose (विरोध करना), Refute (खंडन करना).
Antonyms: Confirm (पुष्टि करना), Agree (सहमत होना), Verify (सत्यापित करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Ostentatious
questionsEn.s:
Ostentatious - आडंबरपूर्ण (Characterized by vulgar or pretentious display)
Attractive - आकर्षक (Pleasing or appealing to the senses)
Restrained - संयमित (Characterized by reserve or moderation)
Gentle - सौम्य (Having a mild, kind, or tender temperament)
Repulsive - घृणित (Arousing intense distaste or disgust)
oa:
This word means pleasing or appealing to the senses. While an ostentatious display might be attractive to some, the word describes beauty rather than the lack of showing off.
Synonyms: Charming (आकर्षक), Appealing (मोहक), Beautiful (सुंदर).
Antonyms: Repulsive (घृणित), Ugly (कुरूप), Hideous (भयानक).

This word refers to being characterized by reserve, moderation, or a lack of showy display. it is the direct and most accurate antonym for being ostentatious.
Synonyms: Modest (संयमित), Humble (विनम्र), Unpretentious (विनीत).
Antonyms: Ostentatious (आडंबरपूर्ण), Showy (दिखावटी), Pretentious (दंभी).

This word describes having a mild, kind, or tender temperament. it refers to kindness and behavioral softness rather than the presence or absence of a flashy display.
Synonyms: Mild (सौम्य), Kind (दयालु), Tender (कोमल).
Antonyms: Harsh (कठोर), Brutal (क्रूर), Violent (हिंसक).

This word means arousing intense distaste or disgust. it describes an extreme negative reaction rather than the humble or modest nature required to oppose ostentation.
Synonyms: Disgusting (घृणित), Offensive (अपमानजनक), Loathsome (घृणास्पद).
Antonyms: Attractive (आकर्षक), Alluring (मोहक), Pleasant (सुखद).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Relevant
questionsEn.s:
Relevant - प्रासंगिक (Closely connected or appropriate)
Inappropriate - अनुचित (Not suitable or proper in circumstances)
Suitable - उपयुक्त (Right or appropriate for a situation)
Introductory - परिचयात्मक (Serving as an introduction)
Conclusive - निष्कर्षात्मक (Serving to prove a case; decisive)
oa:
This word refers to something that is not suitable or proper in the circumstances. It serves as an opposite to relevant (closely connected) by denoting a lack of suitability.
Synonyms: Unsuitable (अनुचित), Immaterial (अप्रासंगिक), Unfit (अनुपयुक्त).
Antonyms: Relevant (प्रासंगिक), Suitable (उपयुक्त), Appropriate (उचित).

This word means right or appropriate for a particular person or situation. It is a synonym for relevant in many contexts and therefore not an antonym.
Synonyms: Appropriate (उपयुक्त), Fitting (सटीक), Apt (योग्य).
Antonyms: Unsuitable (अनुचित), Improper (गलत), Irrelevant (अप्रासंगिक).

This word means serving as an introduction to a subject. It describes the timing or placement of information rather than its logical connection or applicability.
Synonyms: Preliminary (परिचयात्मक), Basic (बुनियादी), Initial (प्रारंभिक).
Antonyms: Conclusive (निष्कर्ष), Final (अंतिम), Closing (समापन).

This word means serving to prove a case or settling an issue. it describes the strength of evidence rather than its topical relevance to a discussion.
Synonyms: Decisive (निष्कर्षात्मक), Final (अंतिम), Definitive (निश्चित).
Antonyms: Ambiguous (संदिग्ध), Uncertain (अनिश्चित), Indecisive (अनिर्णीत).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Lethargic
questionsEn.s:
Lethargic - सुस्त (Sluggish, lacking energy or enthusiasm)
Active - सक्रिय (Energetic, lively, and ready to engage)
Languid - मंद (Slow and relaxed, lacking effort)
Moderate - मध्यम (Average in amount or intensity)
Angry - क्रोधित (Feeling or showing strong annoyance)
oa:
This word describes someone who is lively, energetic, and constantly engaged in activities. It is the direct and perfect antonym for being lethargic or sluggish.
Synonyms: Energetic (सक्रिय), Vigorous (ऊर्जावान), Dynamic (गतिशील).
Antonyms: Lethargic (सुस्त), Lazy (आलसी), Passive (निष्क्रिय).

This word means slow and relaxed, often showing a lack of energy or effort. it is a direct synonym for lethargic and therefore cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Sluggish (मंद), Listless (बेजान), Torpid (सुस्त).
Antonyms: Brisk (तेज़), Animated (जोशीला), Active (सक्रिय).

This word means average in amount, intensity, or quality. While a moderate person is not extreme, the word does not address the energy or laziness of a state.
Synonyms: Average (मध्यम), Temperate (संतुलित), Reasonable (उचित).
Antonyms: Extreme (चरम), Excessive (अत्यधिक), Intense (तीव्र).

This word describes feeling or showing strong annoyance or hostility. It refers to an emotional temper rather than the level of physical or mental energy.
Synonyms: Irritated (क्रोधित), Furious (आगबबूला), Enraged (रुष्ट).
Antonyms: Calm (शांत), Pleased (प्रसन्न), Happy (खुश).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Cynical
questionsEn.s:
Cynical - संदेहवादी (Believing people are motivated by self-interest)
Credulous - अतिसंवेदनशील (Too ready to believe things)
Distrustful - अविश्वासी (Feeling a lack of trust)
Persuasive - प्रभावशाली (Good at persuading someone)
Credible - विश्वसनीय (Able to be believed; convincing)
oa:
This word describes someone who is too ready to believe things without evidence. it is the perfect antonym for cynical, which involves distrust and skepticism.
Synonyms: Trusting (अतिसंवेदनशील), Gullible (भोला), Unsuspecting (सीधा-सादा).
Antonyms: Cynical (संदेहवादी), Skeptical (शंकालु), Wary (सावधान).

This word describes feeling or showing a lack of trust in someone. it is a synonym for the core attribute of being cynical and cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Suspicious (अविश्वासी), Skeptical (शंकित), Wary (सतर्क).
Antonyms: Trusting (विश्रंभी), Believing (विश्वासी), Credulous (भोला).

This word describes being good at convincing someone to do or believe something. it refers to communication skills rather than a person's underlying belief system.
Synonyms: Convincing (प्रभावशाली), Compelling (सम्मोहक), Influential (असरदार).
Antonyms: Weak (कमज़ोर), Ineffective (बेकार), Unconvincing (अप्रभावी).

This word means able to be believed or convincing. it describes the quality of a statement or evidence rather than the skeptical personality of an investor.
Synonyms: Believable (विश्वसनीय), Reliable (भरोसेमंद), Trustworthy (प्रामाणिक).
Antonyms: Incredible (अविश्वसनीय), Implausible (अकल्पनीय), Dubious (संदिग्ध).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Avariciousness
questionsEn.s:
Avariciousness - लोभ (Extreme greed for wealth or gain)
Generosity - उदारता (The quality of being kind and giving freely)
Criticism - आलोचना (The expression of disapproval based on faults)
Hatred - घृणा (Intense dislike or ill will)
Envy - ईर्ष्या (Resentful longing for others' possessions)
oa:
This word refers to the quality of being kind, giving freely, and not being greedy. it is the direct and most accurate antonym for avariciousness (extreme greed).
Synonyms: Magnanimity (उदारता), Altruism (परोपकार), Benevolence (भलाई).
Antonyms: Avariciousness (लोभ), Greed (लालच), Stinginess (कंजूसी).

This word means the expression of disapproval based on perceived faults. It is a verbal or written reaction and has no connection with the desire for wealth.
Synonyms: Censure (आलोचना), Condemnation (निंदा), Disapproval (अस्वीकृति).
Antonyms: Praise (प्रशंसा), Compliment (तारीफ़), Approval (मंजूरी).

This word refers to intense dislike or ill will. While a greedy person might be hated, the word describes an emotion of animosity rather than a lack of greed.
Synonyms: Loathing (घृणा), Animosity (शत्रुता), Detestation (नफरत).
Antonyms: Love (प्रेम), Affection (स्नेह), Liking (पसंद).

This word refers to a feeling of resentful longing for someone else's possessions. it is a sister emotion to greed (avariciousness) and therefore not an opposite.
Synonyms: Jealousy (ईर्ष्या), Grudge (द्वेष), Covetousness (लोभ).
Antonyms: Contentment (संतोष), Satisfaction (तृप्ति), Generosity (उदारता).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Barren
questionsEn.s:
Barren - बंजर (Lacking vegetation, life, or activity)
Believe - विश्वास करना (To accept something as true)
Grumbled - बड़बड़ाना (To complain in a bad-tempered way)
Glancing - झांकना (Taking a brief or hurried look)
Congested - भीड़-भाड़ वाला (Overcrowded or filled to excess)
oa:
This word means to accept something as true or to have faith. it is a mental action and has no relation to the productivity or physical state of land or traffic.
Synonyms: Accept (विश्वास करना), Trust (भरोसा करना), Admit (मानना).
Antonyms: Deny (अस्वीकार करना), Doubt (संदेह करना), Disbelieve (नकारना).

This word means to complain or protest in a bad-tempered way. it describes a verbal reaction and does not provide an opposite for being barren.
Synonyms: Complained (बड़बड़ाना), Muttered (बुदबुदाना), Moaned (कराहना).
Antonyms: Praised (प्रशंसा की), Commended (सराहना की), Rejoiced (प्रसन्न हुए).

This word refers to taking a brief or hurried look. it describes a physical movement of the eyes and has no conceptual link to emptiness or congestion.
Synonyms: Glimpsing (झांकना), Peeking (झलक देखना), Scanning (देखना).
Antonyms: Staring (घूरना), Gazing (टकटकी लगाना), Ignoring (अनदेखा करना).

This word refers to an area that is overcrowded or filled to excess. While "fertile" is the physical opposite of "barren," in the specific context of this sentence, "congested" (filled with traffic) is presented as a contrast to a "barren" (empty) state.
Synonyms: Crowded (भीड़-भाड़ वाला), Jammed (भरा हुआ), Blocked (अवरुद्ध).
Antonyms: Barren (बंजर/खाली), Clear (साफ), Empty (खाली).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Foment
questionsEn.s:
Foment - उकसाना (To instigate or stir up undesirable action)
Proximity - निकटता (Nearness in space, time, or relationship)
Remoteness - दूरस्थता (The state of being distant)
Separation - विच्छेद (The action of moving or being moved apart)
Regulate - नियंत्रित करना (To control or maintain properly)
oa:
This word means nearness in space, time, or relationship. it is a spatial descriptor and has no relation to the act of instigating or stirring up action.
Synonyms: Nearness (निकटता), Closeness (सामीप्य), Adjacency (समीपता).
Antonyms: Distance (दूरी), Remoteness (पृथकता), Separation (अलगाव).

This word refers to the state of being distant or far away. Like proximity, it describes physical or situational distance and does not oppose "foment."
Synonyms: Distance (दूरस्थता), Isolation (अलगाव), Farawayness (दूरी).
Antonyms: Nearness (निकटता), Proximity (सामीप्य), Presence (उपस्थिति).

This word means the action or state of moving or being moved apart. It describes the division of entities and is not a direct opposite for starting a conflict.
Synonyms: Division (विच्छेद), Disconnection (अलगाव), Detachment (पृथकता).
Antonyms: Union (एकता), Connection (जुड़ाव), Integration (एकीकरण).

This word means to control or maintain something so that it operates properly. it involves order and management, which is the opposite of fomenting (stirring up undesirable action/chaos).
Synonyms: Control (नियंत्रित करना), Manage (प्रबंधित करना), Govern (नियमित करना).
Antonyms: Foment (उकसाना), Provoke (भड़काना), Disrupt (बाधित करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Miserable
questionsEn.s:
Miserable - दुखी (Extremely unhappy or uncomfortable)
Melodious - सुरीला (Having a pleasant tune or melody)
Settled - स्थिर (Comfortable and established in a situation)
Restrained - संयमित (Characterized by reserve or moderation)
Cheerful - प्रसन्न (Noticeably happy and optimistic)
oa:
This word means having a pleasant tune or sound. it describes an auditory quality and has no relation to the state of emotional happiness or misery.
Synonyms: Tuneful (सुरीला), Dulcet (मधुर), Euphonious (मधुर ध्वनि).
Antonyms: Cacophonous (कर्कश), Jarring (बेसुरा), Harsh (कठोर).

This word means comfortable and established in a situation. While a settled person might be happy, the word refers to stability rather than the emotion of joy.
Synonyms: Established (स्थिर), Fixed (नियत), Regular (नियमित).
Antonyms: Unsettled (अस्थिर), Moving (बदलता हुआ), Disturbed (परेशान).

This word describes someone characterized by reserve or moderation. it refers to self-control and discipline rather than the feeling of intense happiness.
Synonyms: Controlled (संयमित), Moderate (संतुलित), Reserved (संकोची).
Antonyms: Unrestrained (अनियंत्रित), Wild (जंगली), Emotional (भावुक).

This word describes being noticeably happy and optimistic. it is the direct and most accurate antonym for being miserable or extremely unhappy.
Synonyms: Happy (प्रसन्न), Joyful (हर्षित), Buoyant (उत्साही).
Antonyms: Miserable (दुखी), Gloomy (उदास), Dejected (निराश).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Intelligible
questionsEn.s:
Intelligible - सुबोध (Something that is clear and easy to understand)
Sociable - मिलनसार (Willing to talk and engage with others)
Embezzle - गबन करना (To steal or misappropriate money)
Incoherent - असंबद्ध (Unclear, confusing, or not logically connected)
Deliberate - सोच समझकर किया हुआ (Done consciously and intentionally)
oa:
This word refers to being willing to talk and engage in activities with others. It describes a person's friendliness rather than the clarity of an explanation or idea.
Synonyms: Friendly (मिलनसार), Amicable (मित्रवत), Affable (सुशील).
Antonyms: Unsociable (असामाजिक), Aloof (अलग), Hostile (शत्रुतापूर्ण).

This word means to steal or misappropriate money placed in one's trust. it is a specific criminal act and has no linguistic connection with the concept of clarity.
Synonyms: Pilfer (गबन करना), Steal (चुराना), Misappropriate (दुरुपयोग करना).
Antonyms: Return (लौटाना), Compensate (मुआवजा देना), Protect (रक्षा करना).

This word describes something that is unclear, confusing, or not logically connected. It is the perfect antonym for intelligible, which means easy to understand.
Synonyms: Confused (असंबद्ध), Disjointed (असंगत), Muddled (उलझा हुआ).
Antonyms: Intelligible (सुबोध), Clear (स्पष्ट), Lucid (साफ).

This word means done consciously and intentionally. it describes the intent behind an action rather than whether the result is easy to comprehend.
Synonyms: Intentional (सोच समझकर किया हुआ), Calculated (नियोजित), Planned (योजनाबद्ध).
Antonyms: Accidental (आकस्मिक), Spontaneous (स्वैच्छिक), Unintentional (अनजाने में).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Failed
questionsEn.s:
Failed - असफल होना (To be unsuccessful in achieving a goal)
Elevated - उन्नत (Raised to a higher level or position)
Succeeded - सफल होना (Achieving the desired aim or result)
Enjoyed - आनंद लिया (To take delight or pleasure in something)
Reserved - आरक्षित (To keep something for a particular purpose)
oa:
This word means raised to a higher level or position. While success can lead to being elevated, the word describes physical or status height rather than the achievement itself.
Synonyms: Raised (उन्नत), Promoted (पदोन्नत), Lifted (ऊंचा किया हुआ).
Antonyms: Lowered (नीचा किया हुआ), Demoted (पदावनत), Dropped (गिरा हुआ).

This word refers to achieving a desired aim or result; accomplishing a purpose. It is the direct and most accurate antonym for the word failed.
Synonyms: Triumphed (सफल होना), Won (जीतना), Prevailed (विजयी होना).
Antonyms: Failed (असफल होना), Flunked (विफल होना), Lost (हारना).

This word means to take delight or pleasure in something. it describes an emotional response to an experience rather than the actual outcome of success or failure.
Synonyms: Relished (आनंद लिया), Liked (पसंद किया), Appreciated (सराहना की).
Antonyms: Hated (नफरत की), Disliked (नापसंद किया), Suffered (सहन किया).

This word means to keep something for a particular purpose or time. it describes the act of saving or setting aside rather than achieving a goal.
Synonyms: Booked (आरक्षित), Saved (बचाया हुआ), Kept (रखा हुआ).
Antonyms: Free (मुक्त), Available (उपलब्ध), Used (इस्तेमाल किया).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Laudable
questionsEn.s:
Laudable - प्रशंसनीय (Deserving praise and commendation)
Commendable - प्रशंसनीय (Deserving praise)
Severe - कठोर (Very great or intense)
Deplorable - निंदनीय (Deserving strong condemnation)
Humorous - हास्यपूर्ण (Causing laughter and amusement)
oa:
This word means deserving praise. It is a direct synonym for laudable and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an antonym.
Synonyms: Praiseworthy (प्रशंसनीय), Exemplary (अनुकरणीय), Worthy (योग्य).
Antonyms: Deplorable (निंदनीय), Blameworthy (दोषी), Poor (घटिया).

This word means very great or intense, often used for weather or punishment. it describes the intensity of a condition rather than its worthiness of praise or blame.
Synonyms: Harsh (कठोर), Intense (तीव्र), Strict (सख्त).
Antonyms: Mild (हल्का), Gentle (कोमल), Light (मामूली).

This word describes something deserving strong condemnation; it is completely unacceptable and shocking. It is the perfect antonym for laudable.
Synonyms: Disgraceful (निंदनीय), Shateful (घृणित), Wretched (दयनीय).
Antonyms: Laudable (प्रशंसनीय), Commendable (सराहनीय), Excellent (उत्कृष्ट).

This word means causing laughter and amusement. it describes the comic nature of something and has no relation to the act of praising or condemning behavior.
Synonyms: Funny (हास्यपूर्ण), Comic (मनोरंजक), Witty (मज़ाकिया).
Antonyms: Serious (गंभीर), Solemn (शान्त), Tragic (दुखद).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Dissolve
questionsEn.s:
Dissolve - घुलना/समाप्त होना (To become incorporated into liquid or disappear)
Vanish - गायब हो जाना (To disappear suddenly and completely)
Fade - मिट जाना (Gradually grow faint and disappear)
Solve - हल करना (Find an answer to a mystery or problem)
Appear - प्रकट होना (To come into sight or become visible)
oa:
This word means to disappear suddenly and completely. it describes the end result of a physical dissolution and thus acts as a synonym rather than an antonym.
Synonyms: Disappear (गायब हो जाना), Evaporate (मिट जाना), Faded (धुंधला होना).
Antonyms: Appear (प्रकट होना), Emerge (उभरना), Arrive (पहुंचना).

This word means to gradually grow faint and disappear. it describes a slow process of vanishing and is not the opposite of dissolving into a liquid or state.
Synonyms: Pale (मिट जाना), Wane (कम होना), Dim (धुंधला होना).
Antonyms: Brighten (चमकाना), Grow (बढ़ना), Strengthen (मजबूत होना).

This word means to find an answer to or effectively deal with a mystery or problem. while it sounds similar to dissolve, its meaning is entirely different.
Synonyms: Resolve (हल करना), Answer (उत्तर देना), Decipher (सुलझाना).
Antonyms: Confuse (उलझाना), Complicate (जटिल बनाना), Obscure (धुंधला करना).

This word means to come into sight or become visible. it is the direct functional opposite of dissolving or vanishing, where something ceases to be seen.
Synonyms: Emerge (प्रकट होना), Arrive (पहुंचना), Materialize (साकार होना).
Antonyms: Dissolve (घुलना/समाप्त होना), Vanish (गायब होना), Fade (मिटना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Concede
questionsEn.s:
Concede - स्वीकार करना (To admit that something is true)
Surrender - आत्मसमर्पण करना (To give up or hand over something)
Battle - लड़ाई (A sustained fight between armed forces)
Avow - स्वीकार करना (To assert or confess openly)
Deny - अस्वीकार करना (To state that something is not true)
oa:
This word means to give up or hand over something, often on demand. it is a near-synonym for concede in the context of yielding and is not an opposite.
Synonyms: Capitulate (आत्मसमर्पण करना), Yield (झुकना), Relinquish (त्यागना).
Antonyms: Resist (प्रतिरोध करना), Fight (लड़ना), Conquer (जीतना).

This word refers to a sustained fight between organized forces. it describes a physical conflict rather than the act of admitting truth or refusing a claim.
Synonyms: Fight (लड़ाई), Conflict (संघर्ष), Combat (मुकाबला).
Antonyms: Peace (शांति), Agreement (समझौता), Truce (युद्धविराम).

This word means to assert or confess openly. It is a synonym for the act of admitting something (conceding) and therefore not an antonym.
Synonyms: Assert (स्वीकार करना), Declare (घोषित करना), Profess (दावा करना).
Antonyms: Deny (अस्वीकार करना), Repudiate (त्यागना), Disavow (नकारना).

This word means to state that something is not true or to refuse to accept something. It is the direct and perfect antonym for concede (to admit).
Synonyms: Refuse (अस्वीकार करना), Reject (नकारना), Refute (खंडन करना).
Antonyms: Concede (स्वीकार करना), Admit (मानना), Agree (सहमत होना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Bombastic
questionsEn.s:
Bombastic - आडंबरपूर्ण (High-sounding but with little meaning)
Simple - सरल (Easily understood or done; plain)
Wicked - दुष्ट (Morally wrong and bad)
Elevated - उन्नत (Situated higher than the surrounding area)
Pastoral - ग्रामीण (Related to the countryside or rural life)
oa:
This word refers to something that is easily understood, plain, and presenting no difficulty. it is the direct stylistic opposite of bombastic, which involves inflated language.
Synonyms: Plain (सरल), Unadorned (सादा), Basic (मामूली).
Antonyms: Bombastic (आडंबरपूर्ण), Complex (जटिल), Elaborate (विस्तृत).

This word means morally wrong and bad. it describes the moral character of a person or act rather than the inflated or simple style of their communication.
Synonyms: Evil (दुष्ट), Sinful (पापी), Nefarious (नृशंस).
Antonyms: Virtuous (सदाचारी), Good (अच्छा), Pious (धार्मिक).

This word means situated or placed higher or can refer to a higher level of thought. while elevated thought is high, it is not necessarily "inflated" in the negative sense of bombastic.
Synonyms: Raised (उन्नत), High (ऊंचा), Loftly (बुलंद).
Antonyms: Lowered (नीचा), Depressed (गिरा हुआ), Base (नीच).

This word refers to the countryside or rural life. it describes a setting or a theme in literature rather than the use of inflated and meaningless words.
Synonyms: Rural (ग्रामीण), Rustic (देहाती), Bucolic (ग्राम्य).
Antonyms: Urban (शहरी), Industrial (औद्योगिक), Metropolitan (महानगरीय).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Forgive
questionsEn.s:
Forgive - क्षमा करना (To stop feeling angry for an offense)
Unburden - भारमुक्त करना (To relieve someone of a burden or worry)
Requite - बदला चुकाना (To make appropriate return for something)
Clear - स्पष्ट करना (To make free from confusion or ambiguity)
Loathe - घृणा करना (To feel intense dislike or disgust)


Hence, 'Loathe' is the most suitable antonym for 'Forgive'.
oa:
This word means to relieve someone of a worry or a load. While forgiving someone can unburden their mind, the word describes relief rather than assigning blame.
Synonyms: Relieve (भारमुक्त करना), Ease (आराम देना), Free (मुक्त करना).
Antonyms: Burden (बोझ डालना), Weigh down (दबाना), Oppress (उत्पीड़ित करना).

This word means to make an appropriate return for a favor or a wrongdoing. While it can imply taking revenge, it is less common as a direct antonym for "forgiveness" in general usage.
Synonyms: Recompense (बदला चुकाना), Retaliate (प्रतिशोध लेना), Reward (इनाम देना).
Antonyms: Forgive (क्षमा करना), Pardon (क्षमा करना), Ignore (अनदेखा करना).

This word means to make free from confusion or to remove doubts. It describes the state of clarity rather than the emotional or legal act of pardoning someone.
Synonyms: Clarify (स्पष्ट करना), Cleanse (साफ करना), Exonerate (बरी करना).
Antonyms: Obscure (धुंधला करना), Blame (दोष देना), Condemn (निंदा करना).

This word refers to feeling intense dislike or disgust for someone or something. it represents a strong negative emotion that is the spiritual opposite of the mercy and peace found in forgiveness.
Synonyms: Hate (घृणा करना), Detest (नफरत करना), Abhor (नापसंद करना).
Antonyms: Forgive (क्षमा करना), Love (प्रेम करना), Admire (प्रशंसा करना).

test.instructions: Standard CBT Pattern Exam. Positive Marks: +1, Negative Marks: -0.25. Total Questions: 50.

test.title: Set - 18

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Shallow
questionsEn.s:
Shallow - उथला (Having little depth)
Green - हरा (A color or being inexperienced)
Blue - नीला (A specific color)
Deep - गहरा (Extending far down from the top)
Cold - ठंडा (Having a low temperature)


Hence, 'Deep ' is the most suitable antonym for 'Shallow'.
oa:
This word refers to a color or signifies being youthful and inexperienced. It describes a physical appearance or a level of maturity and has no relation to the depth of a physical space.
Synonyms: Verdant (हरा-भरा), Immature (अनुभवहीन), Raw (कच्चा).
Antonyms: Ripe (पका हुआ), Experienced (अनुभवी), Sophisticated (दुनियादार).

This word refers to a specific color of the spectrum. While it may describe the color of a pool, it does not address the distance from the top to the bottom and therefore is not an opposite.
Synonyms: Azure (आसमानी), Cobalt (गहरा नीला), Sapphire (नीलम जैसा).
Antonyms: Red (लाल), Yellow (पीला), Orange (नारंगी).

This word refers to something that has a large distance from the top or surface to the bottom. it is the direct and most accurate antonym for shallow, which means having little depth.
Synonyms: Profound (गहरा), Bottomless (अगाध), Fathomless (अथाह).
Antonyms: Shallow (उथला), Superficial (सतही), Cursory (सरसरी).

This word describes a low temperature. While a pool can be cold, this descriptor relates to thermal conditions rather than the physical dimension of depth.
Synonyms: Chilly (ठंडा), Frigid (जमाने वाला), Icy (बर्फ जैसा).
Antonyms: Hot (गर्म), Warm (गुनगुना), Sultry (उमस भरा).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Late
questionsEn.s:
Late - देर से (After the expected or usual time)
Exit - निकास (A way out or leaving)
Early - जल्दी (Before the expected time)
Small - छोटा (Less than normal size)
Suffer - सहन करना (To experience pain or hardship)


Hence, 'Early ' is the most suitable antonym for 'Late'.
oa:
This word refers to a way out or the act of leaving a place. It is a noun or verb of movement and does not function as a temporal opposite to being behind schedule.
Synonyms: Departure (निकास), Egress (बाहर जाना), Withdrawal (वापसी).
Antonyms: Entrance (प्रवेश), Ingress (आगमन), Arrival (पहुंच).

This word refers to something happening before the expected or usual time. It serves as the direct temporal antonym for late, which means after the expected time.
Synonyms: Premature (जल्द), Advance (अग्रिम), Timely (सामयिक).
Antonyms: Late (देर), Delayed (विलंबित), Tardy (सुस्त).

This word describes something that is less than normal or usual in size. It is a descriptor of magnitude or scale and has no relation to time or punctuality.
Synonyms: Tiny (छोटा), Petite (नन्हा), Diminutive (अल्प).
Antonyms: Large (बड़ा), Big (विशाल), Enormous (विशालकाय).

This word means to experience pain, distress, or hardship. It describes a state of endurance or suffering rather than the timing of an arrival or event.
Synonyms: Endure (सहन करना), Tolerate (झेलना), Undergo (भुगतना).
Antonyms: Enjoy (आनंद लेना), Flourish (फलना-फूलना), Relish (मज़ा लेना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Unsure
questionsEn.s:
Unsure - अनिश्चित (Not feeling confidence or certainty)
Thoughtful - विचारशील (Showing consideration or deep thought)
Interested - दिलचस्पी (Showing curiosity or concern)
Certain - निश्चित (Completely confident or having no doubt)
Doubtful - संदेहास्पद (Feeling uncertain or lacking conviction)


Hence, 'Certain ' is the most suitable antonym for 'Unsure'.
oa:
This word describes someone who shows consideration for others or is absorbed in deep thought. While a thoughtful person might be sure, the word does not mean "certain."
Synonyms: Considerate (विचारशील), Reflective (चिंतनशील), Attentive (सजग).
Antonyms: Thoughtless (विचारहीन), Heedless (असावधान), Selfish (स्वार्थी).

This word describes showing curiosity or concern about something. It refers to the level of engagement or attraction rather than the level of certainty or doubt.
Synonyms: Curious (जिज्ञासु), Attracted (आकर्षित), Eager (उत्सुक).
Antonyms: Indifferent (उदासीन), Bored (ऊबा हुआ), Apathetic (बेपरवाह).

This word refers to being completely confident or having no doubt about something. it is the direct and perfect antonym for being unsure or doubtful.
Synonyms: Sure (निश्चित), Confident (विश्वासपूर्ण), Positive (पक्का).
Antonyms: Unsure (अनिश्चित), Doubtful (संदेहपूर्ण), Hesitant (दुविधापूर्ण).

This word means feeling uncertain or lacking conviction. It is a synonym for unsure and therefore cannot provide the required opposite relationship.
Synonyms: Dubious (संदेहास्पद), Skeptical (शंकित), Hesitant (अनिश्चित).
Antonyms: Certain (निश्चित), Sure (पक्का), Convinced (आश्वस्त).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Enthralled
questionsEn.s:
Enthralled - मंत्रमुग्ध (To capture fascinated attention)
Interested - रुचि (Showing curiosity or concern)
Agreement - समझौता (Harmony or accordance in opinion)
Bored - उबाऊ (Feeling weary because of lack of interest)
Intrigued - जिज्ञासु (Arouse the curiosity or interest)


Hence, 'Bored ' is the most suitable antonym for 'Enthralled'.
oa:
This word describes showing curiosity or concern. It is a milder version of being enthralled (fascinated) and therefore acts as a near-synonym rather than an antonym.
Synonyms: Eager (उत्सुक), Curious (जिज्ञासु), Keen (लालायित).
Antonyms: Uninterested (अरुचिकर), Indifferent (उदासीन), Bored (ऊबा हुआ).

This word refers to harmony or accordance in opinion. It is a noun describing a state of consensus and has no relation to the fascinated attention of a reader.
Synonyms: Consensus (समझौता), Concord (सहमति), Unity (एकता).
Antonyms: Discord (विवाद), Dissent (असमर्थन), Conflict (संघर्ष).

This word describes feeling weary and impatient due to a lack of interest. it is the direct emotional opposite of being enthralled, which involves being held spellbound.
Synonyms: Uninterested (ऊबा हुआ), Weary (थका हुआ), Tired (पस्त).
Antonyms: Enthralled (मंत्रमुग्ध), Fascinated (आकर्षित), Excited (उत्साहित).

This word means to have one's curiosity or interest aroused. It is a synonym for being enthralled in many contexts and does not provide an opposite meaning.
Synonyms: Fascinated (जिज्ञासु), Captivated (मोहक), Engaged (लीन).
Antonyms: Bored (ऊबा हुआ), Indifferent (उदासीन), Apathetic (बेपरवाह).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: High
questionsEn.s:
High - ऊँचा (Of great vertical extent or elevated)
Low - निचा (Situated not far above the ground)
Sturdy - मजबूत (Strongly and solidly built)
Hale - स्वस्थ (In good health, especially an old person)
Elevated - उन्नत (Situated higher than the surrounding area)


Hence, 'Low ' is the most suitable antonym for 'High'.
oa:
This word refers to something situated not far above the ground or something that is not tall. it is the direct and most universal antonym for high.
Synonyms: Short (निचा), Deep (नीचा), Shallow (उथला).
Antonyms: High (ऊँचा), Tall (लंबा), Lofty (बुलंद).

This word describes something that is strongly and solidly built. It refers to the durability and strength of a structure rather than its vertical extent or height.
Synonyms: Robust (मजबूत), Durable (टिकाऊ), Solid (दृढ़).
Antonyms: Weak (कमज़ोर), Fragile (नाज़ुक), Flimsy (कमज़ोर).

This word describes someone who is in good health, especially an elderly person. It refers to physical well-being and has no connection with the height of a building.
Synonyms: Healthy (स्वस्थ), Robust (तंदुरुस्त), Sound (निरोग).
Antonyms: Sick (बीमार), Ill (अस्वस्थ), Frail (दुर्बल).

This word means situated or placed higher than the surrounding area. It is a synonym for high and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an opposite.
Synonyms: Raised (उन्नत), Lofty (ऊँचा), High (बुलंद).
Antonyms: Lowered (नीचा), Below (नीचे), Sunken (धंसा हुआ).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Access
questionsEn.s:
Access - पहुँच (The ability to approach or enter)
Doubt - संदेह (A feeling of uncertainty)
Reach - पहुंच (The extent or range of application)
Clue - संकेत (A piece of evidence to solve a mystery)
Denial - इन्कार (The refusal to grant something)


Hence, 'Denial ' is the most suitable antonym for 'Access'.
oa:
This word refers to a feeling of uncertainty or a lack of conviction. It describes a state of mind rather than the ability to reach or use information or a place.
Synonyms: Uncertainty (संदेह), Hesitation (हिचकिचाहट), Skepticism (शंका).
Antonyms: Certainty (निश्चितता), Trust (विश्वास), Confidence (आत्मविश्वास).

This word refers to the extent or range of something's influence or the act of arriving at a destination. it is similar in meaning to access and cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Range (पहुंच), Scope (दायरा), Extension (विस्तार).
Antonyms: Distance (दूरी), Remoteness (दूरत्व), Inaccessibility (पहुंच से बाहर).

This word refers to a piece of evidence or information used to solve a mystery. It is a noun describing an indicator rather than the act of entering or using something.
Synonyms: Hint (संकेत), Lead (सुराग), Pointer (इशारा).
Antonyms: Mystery (रहस्य), Enigma (पहेली), Riddle (पहेली).

This word refers to the action of refusing to grant something or declaring something to be untrue. it serves as the logical opposite of access (granting the ability to use).
Synonyms: Refusal (इन्कार), Rejection (अस्वीकृति), Prohibition (निषेध).
Antonyms: Access (पहुँच), Acceptance (स्वीकृति), Grant (अनुदान).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Profuse
questionsEn.s:
Profuse - प्रचुर मात्रा में (Abundant or in great amount)
Scarce - दुर्लभ (In short supply or not easily available)
Humble - विनम्र (Showing a modest estimate of importance)
Prompt - तत्काल (Done without delay; immediate)
Just - न्यायसंगत (Based on what is morally right)


Hence, 'Scarce ' is the most suitable antonym for 'Profuse'.
oa:
This word refers to something that is in short supply or not easily available. it is the direct and most accurate antonym for profuse, which means abundant or in great amount.
Synonyms: Meager (दुर्लभ), Scanty (अल्प), Deficient (न्यून).
Antonyms: Profuse (प्रचुर), Abundant (भरपूर), Plentiful (प्रचुर).

This word describes having or showing a modest estimate of one's importance. It refers to a person's character and ego rather than the quantity or amount of a substance.
Synonyms: Modest (विनम्र), Meek (नम्र), Lowly (विनीत).
Antonyms: Proud (गर्वित), Arrogant (अभिमानी), Haughty (घमंडी).

This word means done without delay or being immediate. it refers to the speed of an action rather than the quantity or abundance of an item or emotion.
Synonyms: Immediate (तत्काल), Quick (जल्दी), Swift (तेज़).
Antonyms: Slow (धीरे), Late (देर), Sluggish (सुस्त).

This word describes being based on what is morally right and fair. It refers to justice and morality rather than the physical or metaphorical abundance of something.
Synonyms: Fair (न्यायसंगत), Equitable (पक्षपातरहित), Proper (उचित).
Antonyms: Unjust (अन्यायपूर्ण), Biased (पक्षपाती), Unfair (अनुचित).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Insert
questionsEn.s:
Insert - डालना (To put something into something else)
Remove - हटाना (Taking something away from a place)
Inform - सूचित करना (To give someone facts or information)
Select - चुनना (To carefully choose as best or suitable)
Inject - इंजेक्ट करना (To introduce a substance using a needle)


Hence, 'Remove ' is the most suitable antonym for 'Insert'.
oa:
This word means to take something away from a place or position. It is the direct functional and logical antonym for the word insert, which involves putting something in.
Synonyms: Delete (हटाना), Withdraw (निकालना), Extract (बाहर निकालना).
Antonyms: Insert (डालना), Add (जोड़ना), Attach (संलग्न करना).

This word means to give someone facts or information. It describes a communicative action and has no relation to the physical act of putting an object into something.
Synonyms: Notify (सूचित करना), Apprise (बताना), Update (अवगत कराना).
Antonyms: Conceal (छिपाना), Hide (गुप्तरखना), Suppress (दबाना).

This word means to carefully choose something as being the best. while it involves an action of choice, it does not describe the opposite of placing one thing inside another.
Synonyms: Pick (चुनना), Choose (पसंद करना), Opt (चुनाव करना).
Antonyms: Reject (अस्वीकार करना), Discard (त्यागना), Ignore (अनदेखा करना).

This word refers to introducing a substance into a body or system using a needle. it is a specific type of insertion and therefore acts as a synonym rather than an antonym.
Synonyms: Infuse (इंजेक्ट करना), Insert (डालना), Vaccinate (टीका लगाना).
Antonyms: Extract (निकालना), Withdraw (बाहर करना), Drain (खाली करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Active
questionsEn.s:
Active - सक्रिय (Engaging or ready to engage in pursuits)
Inert - निष्क्रिय (Lacking the ability or strength to move)
Careless - लापरवाह (Not giving sufficient attention or thought)
Angry - क्रोधित (Feeling or showing strong annoyance)
Naughty - शरारती (Badly behaved or disobedient)
oa:
This word refers to lacking the ability or strength to move or act. It is the direct scientific and general antonym for active, which describes being busy and energetic.
Synonyms: Inactive (निष्क्रिय), Idle (कामचोर), Passive (निष्क्रिय).
Antonyms: Active (सक्रिय), Energetic (ऊर्जावान), Lively (जोशीला).

This word describes someone who does not give sufficient attention to avoid harm. While a careless person might be inactive, the word describes lack of focus rather than lack of movement.
Synonyms: Negligent (लापरवाह), Heedless (असावधान), Remiss (बेपरवाह).
Antonyms: Careful (सावधान), Meticulous (अति सावधान), Attentive (सजग).

This word describes feeling or showing strong annoyance or hostility. it refers to an emotional state of temper rather than the level of activity or movement.
Synonyms: Furious (क्रोधित), Irritated (चिड़चिड़ा), Enraged (गुस्से में).
Antonyms: Calm (शांत), Peaceful (शांत), Serene (स्थिर).

This word describes a person (usually a child) who is badly behaved or disobedient. It refers to behavior and morality rather than physical or mental energy levels.
Synonyms: Mischievous (शरारती), Wayward (ज़िद्दी), Disobedient (अवज्ञाकारी).
Antonyms: Obedient (आज्ञाकारी), Good (सज्जन), Well-behaved (शिष्टाचारी).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Taboo
questionsEn.s:
Taboo - वर्जित (Socially or culturally prohibited)
Obedience - आज्ञाकारिता (Compliance with an order or law)
Acceptable - स्वीकार्य (Suitable, permissible, or satisfactory)
Promotion - प्रचार (The action of supporting a cause)
Prescription - पर्चा (An authoritative instruction or order)
oa:
This word refers to compliance with an order or request. It describes the following of rules rather than the quality of an act being socially permitted or restricted.
Synonyms: Compliance (आज्ञाकारिता), Submission (समर्पण), Duty (कर्तव्य).
Antonyms: Disobedience (अवज्ञा), Rebellion (विद्रोह), Defiance (उल्लंघन).

This word refers to something that is deemed suitable, permissible, or satisfactory by society. It is the direct opposite of a taboo, which is socially prohibited.
Synonyms: Permissible (स्वीकार्य), Suitable (उचित), Proper (मान्य).
Antonyms: Taboo (वर्जित), Forbidden (निषिद्ध), Unacceptable (अस्वीकार्य).

This word refers to the action of supporting a cause or raising someone to a higher position. It describes growth and advocacy rather than social permission.
Synonyms: Advancement (प्रचार), Elevation (उन्नति), Support (समर्थन).
Antonyms: Demotion (पदावनति), Hindrance (बाधा), Deterioration (गिरावट).

This word refers to a written instruction by a doctor or an authoritative recommendation. it describes an order or rule rather than the social acceptability of a behavior.
Synonyms: Instruction (पर्चा), Direction (निर्देश), Order (आदेश).
Antonyms: Prohibition (निषेध), Ban (रोक), Violation (उल्लंघन).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Astute
questionsEn.s:
Astute - चतुर (Accurately assessing situations for advantage)
Stupid - मूर्ख (Lacking intelligence or common sense)
Temporary - अस्थायी (Lasting for only a limited period)
Illegal - अवैध (Contrary to or forbidden by law)
Dispute - विवाद (A disagreement or argument)
oa:
This word refers to lacking intelligence, common sense, or judgment. it serves as the direct intellectual antonym for astute, which means very clever and sharp.
Synonyms: Foolish (मूर्ख), Ignorant (अज्ञानी), Dull (मंदबुद्धि).
Antonyms: Astute (चतुर), Clever (होशियार), Wise (बुद्धिमान).

This word describes something that lasts for only a limited period. It refers to the duration of a condition rather than the level of intelligence or judgment of a person.
Synonyms: Transient (अस्थायी), Brief (क्षणिक), Impermanent (अल्पकालिक).
Antonyms: Permanent (स्थायी), Lasting (टिकाऊ), Eternal (शाश्वत).

This word means contrary to or forbidden by law. It describes the legal status of an action rather than the mental capability or sharpness of a person.
Synonyms: Unlawful (अवैध), Prohibited (निषिद्ध), Illicit (गैरकानूनी).
Antonyms: Legal (कानूनी), Lawful (वैध), Authorized (मान्य).

This word refers to a disagreement or argument. It is a noun or verb of conflict and has no relation to the quality of being shrewd or clever.
Synonyms: Conflict (विवाद), Quarrel (झगड़ा), Contention (होड़).
Antonyms: Agreement (सहमति), Harmony (सद्भाव), Accord (समझौता).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Coy
questionsEn.s:
Coy - लजीला (Being shy or modest, often provocatively)
Shy - शर्मीला (Being reserved or timid)
Upright - ईमानदार (Being honest or morally correct)
Recent - हाल का (Happened a short time ago)
Extroverted - बहिर्मुखी (Outgoing, sociable, and expressive)
oa:
This word describes being nervous or uncomfortable in social situations. It is a synonym for coy and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an opposite.
Synonyms: Bashful (शर्मीला), Timid (संकोची), Reserved (कम बोलने वाला).
Antonyms: Extroverted (बहिर्मुखी), Bold (निडर), Confident (आत्मविश्वासी).

This word describes being honest or morally correct. While being upright is positive, it refers to ethical integrity rather than a person's level of social openness.
Synonyms: Honest (ईमानदार), Ethical (नैतिक), Honorable (माननीय).
Antonyms: Corrupt (भ्रष्ट), Dishonest (बेईमान), Wicked (दुष्ट).

This word refers to something that happened or was made only a short time ago. it describes the timing of an event rather than a person's social behavior or modesty.
Synonyms: Modern (हाल का), Latest (नवीनतम), New (नया).
Antonyms: Old (पुराना), Ancient (प्राचीन), Past (अतीत).

This word describes being outgoing, sociable, and openly expressive. it is the direct social antonym for coy, which implies being shy or artificially modest.
Synonyms: Outgoing (बहिर्मुखी), Sociable (मिलनसार), Gregarious (सामाजिक).
Antonyms: Coy (लजीला), Shy (शर्मीला), Introverted (अंतर्मुखी).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Grisly
questionsEn.s:
Grisly - भयानक (Causing horror or disgust)
rudely, attractive - असभ्यतापूर्वक, आकर्षक
disgusting, atrocious - घिनौना, क्रूर
ghastly, shameless - भयानक, बेशर्म
pleasantly, comforting - सुखद, सांत्वना देने वाला
oa:
These adverbs describe being offensive and appealing. While "attractive" is an opposite, the paired word "rudely" does not function as an antonym for "grisly" in this context.
Synonyms: Impolitely (असभ्यतापूर्वक), Appealingly (आकर्षक रूप से).
Antonyms: Politely (विनम्रतापूर्वक), Repulsively (घृणित रूप से).

These words describe things that are extremely unpleasant or horrifyingly wicked. They are synonyms for grisly and cannot provide the required opposite meaning.
Synonyms: Revolting (घिनौना), Cruel (क्रूर), Horrible (भयानक).
Antonyms: Pleasant (सुखद), Delightful (रमणीय), Kind (दयालु).

These words refer to being horrifying and lacking in shame. "Ghastly" is a synonym for grisly, making this pair unsuitable as an antonym set.
Synonyms: Frightful (भयानक), Brazen (बेशर्म), Audacious (निर्लज्ज).
Antonyms: Lovely (प्यारा), Modest (विनम्र), Respectful (सम्मानजनक).

These words describe being enjoyable and providing relief. They serve as the perfect antonyms for grisly, which involves horror, disgust, and discomfort.
Synonyms: Agreeably (सुखद), Soothingly (सांत्वना देने वाला), Comfortably (आराम से).
Antonyms: Grisly (भयानक), Horribly (भयंकर), Disturingly (परेशान करने वाला).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Customary
questionsEn.s:
Customary - रिवाज के अनुसार (According to usual practices)
Fashion - फैशन (A popular trend or style)
Protection - सुरक्षा (The action of protecting someone)
Habitual - आदतन (Done or doing constantly as a habit)
Unusual - असामान्य (Not common or typical; out of the ordinary)
oa:
This word refers to a popular trend or style of dress. While customs often relate to fashion, the word itself is a noun of style and not an antonym for "usual practice."
Synonyms: Trend (फैशन), Style (शैली), Mode (प्रचलन).
Antonyms: Archaism (पुरातनता), Disuse (अप्रचलन), Obsoleteness (पुरानापन).

This word refers to the action of keeping someone safe from harm. It is a functional noun related to security and has no connection with the frequency or typicality of an event.
Synonyms: Security (सुरक्षा), Defense (बचाव), Safeguard (रक्षा).
Antonyms: Danger (खतरा), Vulnerability (असुरक्षा), Exposure (जोखिम).

This word describes something done or doing constantly as a habit. It is a direct synonym for customary and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an opposite.
Synonyms: Usual (आदतन), Regular (नियमित), Routine (नित्य).
Antonyms: Unusual (असामान्य), Occasional (कभी-कभार), Irregular (अनियमित).

This word refers to something that is not common, typical, or expected; it is out of the ordinary. it is the perfect antonym for customary (which means typical).
Synonyms: Abnormal (असामान्य), Rare (दुर्लभ), Exceptional (असाधारण).
Antonyms: Customary (रिवाज के अनुसार), Usual (सामान्य), Typical (विशिष्ट).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Timid
questionsEn.s:
Timid - डरपोक (Showing a lack of courage or confidence)
Meek - नम्र (Quiet, gentle, and easily imposed on)
Anxious - चिंतित (Experiencing worry or unease)
Daring - साहसी (Adventurous or bold; showing courage)
Spooky - डरावना (Sinister or ghostly causing fear)
oa:
This word describes being quiet, gentle, and easily imposed upon. It is a synonym for timid and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an antonym.
Synonyms: Submissive (नम्र), Docile (विनम्र), Passive (दब्बू).
Antonyms: Assertive (मुखर), Bold (निडर), Aggressive (आक्रामक).

This word describes experiencing worry, unease, or nervousness. While a timid person might feel anxious, the word refers to an emotional state rather than a lack of courage.
Synonyms: Worried (चिंतित), Nervous (बेचैन), Apprehensive (शंकित).
Antonyms: Calm (शांत), Confident (आत्मविश्वासी), Serene (स्थिर).

This word refers to being adventurous or bold; showing a willingness to take risks. It is the direct and perfect antonym for being timid or shy.
Synonyms: Brave (साहसी), Bold (निडर), Courageous (हिम्मती).
Antonyms: Timid (डरपोक), Cowardly (कायर), Shy (शर्मीला).

This word describes something that is sinister or ghostly and causes fear. It is an environmental descriptor rather than a personality trait used to oppose timidity.
Synonyms: Eerie (डरावना), Creepy (भयावह), Ghostly (भूतिया).
Antonyms: Comforting (सुखद), Cheerful (प्रसन्न), Bright (उज्ज्वल).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Elated
questionsEn.s:
Elated - उत्साहित (Very happy and excited)
Cheerful - प्रसन्न (Noticeably happy and optimistic)
Proud - गर्वित (Feeling pleasure in achievements)
Discouraged - हतोत्साहित (Having lost determination or confidence)
Delighted - प्रसन्न (Feeling or showing great pleasure)
oa:
This word describes being noticeably happy and optimistic. it is a near-synonym for elated and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an opposite.
Synonyms: Joyful (प्रसन्न), Happy (खुश), Content (संतुष्ट).
Antonyms: Sad (दुखी), Gloomy (उदास), Depressed (विषादपूर्ण).

This word describes feeling deep pleasure as a result of one's achievements. While an elated person is often proud, the word refers to self-esteem rather than extreme joy.
Synonyms: Arrogant (गर्वित), Haughty (घमंडी), Satisfied (संतुष्ट).
Antonyms: Humble (विनम्र), Modest (विनीत), Ashamed (लज्जित).

This word refers to losing determination, confidence, or hope. It serves as the direct mental and emotional opposite of being elated (happy and excited).
Synonyms: Disheartened (हतोत्साहित), Depressed (निराश), Dejected (उदास).
Antonyms: Elated (उत्साहित), Inspired (प्रेरित), Encouraged (प्रोत्साहित).

This word means feeling or showing great pleasure. It is a synonym for the given word elated and cannot provide the required antonym.
Synonyms: Elated (प्रसन्न), Overjoyed (आनंदित), Ecstatic (अति प्रसन्न).
Antonyms: Miserable (दयनीय), Sad (दुखी), Sorrowful (उदासीन).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Utterly
questionsEn.s:
Utterly - पूरी तरह से (Completely and without qualification)
Extremely - अत्यंत (To a very great degree)
Correctly - सही ढंग से (In a way free from errors)
Minimally - न्यूनतम (To the smallest degree or amount)
Totally - पूरी तरह से (Completely; absolutely)
oa:
This word means to a very great degree. It is a direct synonym for utterly and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an antonym.
Synonyms: Totally (अत्यंत), Entirely (पूरी तरह), Very (बहुत).
Antonyms: Moderately (मध्यम रूप से), Slightly (थोड़ा), Minimally (न्यूनतम).

This word means in a way that is free from errors or mistakes. It refers to the accuracy of an action rather than the degree or extent of it.
Synonyms: Accurately (सही ढंग से), Properly (उचित तरीके से), Rightly (ठीक से).
Antonyms: Incorrectly (गलत ढंग से), Wrongly (गलत), Erroneously (त्रुटिपूर्ण).

This word refers to doing something to the smallest degree or amount possible. it is the direct logical opposite of utterly, which means completely or to the highest degree.
Synonyms: Slightly (न्यूनतम), Barely (थोड़ा सा), Scantily (अल्प रूप से).
Antonyms: Utterly (पूरी तरह से), Totally (संपूर्ण रूप से), Fully (पूर्ण रूप से).

This word means completely or absolutely. It is another direct synonym for the given word and cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Entirely (पूरी तरह से), Fully (पूर्ण रूप से), Wholly (संपूर्ण रूप से).
Antonyms: Partially (आंशिक रूप से), Slightly (थोड़ा), Minimally (न्यूनतम).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Bloom
questionsEn.s:
Bloom - खिलना (The state or period of flowering)
Flush - लालिमा आना (To become red and hot)
Wither - मुरझाना (To become dry and shriveled; decay)
Flourish - फलना-फूलना (To grow or develop in a healthy way)
Blossom - फूलना (To produce flowers or develop)
oa:
This word means to become red and hot, typically due to illness or emotion. it describes a biological or physical reaction that is unrelated to the flowering of a plant.
Synonyms: Blushes (लालिमा आना), Glow (चमकना), Redden (लाल होना).
Antonyms: Pale (फीका पड़ना), Fade (मिटना), Wane (कम होना).

This word refers to becoming dry and shriveled, or to fade away and decay. It is the direct and perfect antonym for bloom (to flower or grow).
Synonyms: Fade (मुरझाना), Shrivel (सिकुड़ना), Decay (सड़ना).
Antonyms: Bloom (खिलना), Flourish (फलना-फूलना), Grow (बढ़ना).

This word means to grow or develop in a healthy or vigorous way. it is a synonym for bloom in many contexts and therefore not an antonym.
Synonyms: Thrive (फलना-फूलना), Prosper (समृद्ध होना), Bloom (खिलना).
Antonyms: Wither (मुरझाना), Fail (विफल होना), Decline (पतन होना).

This word refers to the state of producing flowers or developing in a healthy way. it is a direct synonym for bloom and cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Flower (फूलना), Bud (खिलना), Mature (विकसित होना).
Antonyms: Wither (मुरझाना), Wilt (कुम्हलाना), Die (मरना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Risible
questionsEn.s:
Risible - हास्यास्पद (Provoking laughter or laughable)
Serious - गंभीर (Solemn or not intended to be funny)
Curious - जिज्ञासु (Eager to know or learn something)
Droll - रंजक (Amusing in an odd or whimsical way)
Giddy - चक्कर (Having a sensation of whirling)
oa:
This word refers to something solemn, grave, or not intended to be funny. it is the direct and logical antonym for risible, which means laughable.
Synonyms: Solemn (गंभीर), Grave (भारी), Earnest (संजीदा).
Antonyms: Risible (हास्यास्पद), Funny (मजाकिया), Ridiculous (मूर्खतापूर्ण).

This word describes being eager to know or learn something. It refers to inquisitiveness rather than the quality of being funny or serious.
Synonyms: Inquisitive (जिज्ञासु), Interested (उत्सुक), Prying (खोजी).
Antonyms: Indifferent (उदासीन), Apathetic (बेपरवाह), Uninterested (अरुचिकर).

This word describes being amusing in an odd or whimsical way. It is a synonym for risible and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an opposite.
Synonyms: Humorous (रंजक), Funny (मजाकिया), Witty (चतुर).
Antonyms: Serious (गंभीर), Somber (उदास), Dull (नीरस).

This word describes having a sensation of spinning or feeling lightheaded. It refers to a physical state of dizziness or flightiness and is not an antonym for "laughable."
Synonyms: Dizzy (चक्कर), Lightheaded (बेचैन), Frivolous (चंचल).
Antonyms: Steady (स्थिर), Calm (शांत), Level-headed (संतुलित).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Barren
questionsEn.s:
Barren - बंजर (Too poor to produce vegetation; unproductive)
Sterile - निष्क्रिय (Incapable of producing offspring)
Infertile - बांझ (Unable to reproduce or produce crops)
Fertile - उपजाऊ (Capable of producing abundant crops)
Unfruitful - अनुत्पादक (Not producing good results)
oa:
This word describes land or a person incapable of producing offspring or crops. it is a direct synonym for barren and therefore cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Infertile (निष्क्रिय), Unproductive (अनुत्पादक), Childless (बांझ).
Antonyms: Fertile (उपजाऊ), Productive (उत्पादक), Fecund (उर्वर).

This word means unable to reproduce or produce crops. It is a direct synonym for the given word and does not satisfy the requirement for an antonym.
Synonyms: Barren (बांझ), Sterile (बांझ), Unfruitful (अफल).
Antonyms: Fertile (उपजाऊ), Prolific (प्रचुर), Fecund (उर्वर).

This word refers to land or soil that is rich in nutrients and capable of producing abundant vegetation. It is the direct and perfect antonym for barren.
Synonyms: Productive (उपजाऊ), Fecund (उर्वर), Rich (समृद्ध).
Antonyms: Barren (बंजर), Sterile (बांझ), Desert (रेगिस्तानी).

This word describes not producing good results or being unproductive. It shares the same negative meaning as barren and cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Futile (अनुत्पादक), Unproductive (निष्फल), Vain (व्यर्थ).
Antonyms: Fruitful (फलदायक), Productive (उपजाऊ), Successful (सफल).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Exit
questionsEn.s:
Exit - निर्गम (A way out of a place; departure)
House - घर (A building for human habitation)
Road - सड़क (A wide way leading from one place to another)
Entry - प्रवेश (An act of going or coming in; a way in)
Ceremony - समारोह (A formal event held on special occasions)
oa:
This word refers to a building for human habitation. it is a noun describing a physical structure and has no functional relation to the act of leaving or entering.
Synonyms: Home (घर), Residence (निवास), Dwelling (डेरा).
Antonyms: Office (कार्यालय), Workplace (कार्यस्थल), Street (सड़क).

This word refers to a wide way leading from one place to another. It describes a path for travel and does not provide an opposite for the concept of departure or exit.
Synonyms: Path (सड़क), Street (मार्ग), Highway (राजमार्ग).
Antonyms: Obstruction (बाधा), Barrier (अवरोध), End (समाप्ति).

This word refers to the act of going or coming in, or a way in. It is the direct functional and situational antonym for the word exit.
Synonyms: Entrance (प्रवेश), Ingress (दाखिला), Access (पहुँच).
Antonyms: Exit (निर्गम), Egress (निकास), Departure (प्रस्थान).

This word refers to a formal religious or public occasion. It describes a social event and has no linguistic connection to the act of exiting or entering a space.
Synonyms: Ritual (समारोह), Rite (संस्कार), Celebration (उत्सव).
Antonyms: Informality (अनौपचारिकता), Routine (सामान्य कार्य), Neglect (उपेक्षा).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Mechanical
questionsEn.s:
Mechanical - यांत्रिक (Operated by machinery or done without thought)
Surrogate - प्रतिनिधि (A substitute deputizing for another)
Automatised - स्वचालित (Made to operate without human intervention)
Yielding - झुकने वाला (Giving way under pressure; not stiff)
Manual - हाथ से किया हुआ (Done with the hands or by a person)
oa:
This word refers to a substitute, especially a person deputizing for another. It describes a role of substitution and has no relation to the automatic or manual nature of a task.
Synonyms: Substitute (प्रतिनिधि), Proxy (प्रतिनिधि), Replacement (विकल्प).
Antonyms: Original (मूल), Principal (मुख्य), Primary (प्रधान).

This word refers to something made to operate without human intervention. it is a synonym for the "machinery" aspect of being mechanical and cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Automatic (स्वचालित), Programmed (मशीनी), Robotic (यांत्रिक).
Antonyms: Manual (हाथ से किया हुआ), Human (मानवीय), Natural (प्राकृतिक).

This word means giving way under pressure or not being stiff. while it describes physical flexibility, it does not address the machine-like or thoughtless nature of the word "mechanical."
Synonyms: Soft (झुकने वाला), Pliant (लचीला), Compliant (कोमल).
Antonyms: Rigid (कठोर), Firm (दृढ़), Resilient (मजबूत).

This word refers to something done with the hands or by a human rather than a machine. it is the direct functional antonym for mechanical.
Synonyms: Hand-operated (हाथ से किया हुआ), Human (मानवीय), Non-automatic (गैर-स्वचालित).
Antonyms: Mechanical (यांत्रिक), Automatic (स्वचालित), Robotic (मशीनी).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Forbid
questionsEn.s:
Forbid - मना करना (To refuse to allow something)
Prohibit - प्रतिबंधित करना (To formally forbid by law)
Allow - अनुमति देना (To let someone do something; permit)
Call - बुलाना (To cry out in a loud voice; summon)
Forsake - त्यागना (To abandon or leave someone)
oa:
This word means to formally forbid something by law or authority. It is a direct synonym for the given word and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an opposite.
Synonyms: Ban (प्रतिबंधित करना), Disallow (मना करना), Bar (रोकना).
Antonyms: Allow (अनुमति देना), Permit (मंजूरी देना), Authorize (अधिकृत करना).

This word means to give permission for something to happen or to let someone do something. it is the direct and logical antonym for the word forbid.
Synonyms: Permit (अनुमति देना), Authorize (मंजूरी देना), Let (होने देना).
Antonyms: Forbid (मना करना), Prohibit (प्रतिबंधित करना), Ban (रोकना).

This word means to cry out in a loud voice or to summon someone. It describes a vocal action of summoning rather than the granting or denying of permission.
Synonyms: Summon (बुलाना), Shout (चिल्लाना), Invite (आमंत्रित करना).
Antonyms: Dismiss (निकाल देना), Silence (शांत करना), Ignore (अनदेखा करना).

This word means to abandon or leave someone or something. it describes desertion rather than the prohibition or permission of an action.
Synonyms: Abandon (त्यागना), Desert (छोड़ना), Renounce (त्याग करना).
Antonyms: Keep (रखना), Support (सहारा देना), Adopt (अपनाना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Cruel
questionsEn.s:
Cruel - क्रूर (Showing a willingness to cause pain)
Skittish - चंचल (Nervous or easily frightened)
Kind - दयालु (Being friendly, generous, and considerate)
Malevolent - दुर्भावनापूर्ण (Having or showing a wish to do evil)
Kingly - राजसी (Befitting a king; regal)
oa:
This word describes someone who is nervous or easily frightened. while a skittish person is not aggressive, the word describes fear rather than the compassion required to oppose "cruel."
Synonyms: Nervous (चंचल), Fidgety (बेचैन), Timid (डरपोक).
Antonyms: Calm (शांत), Bold (निडर), Confident (आत्मविश्वासी).

This word refers to being friendly, generous, and considerate toward others. it is the direct moral and behavioral antonym for the word cruel.
Synonyms: Compassionate (दयालु), Benevolent (परोपकारी), Gentle (सौम्य).
Antonyms: Cruel (क्रूर), Mean (मतलबी), Harsh (कठोर).

This word describes having or showing a wish to do evil to others. it is a direct synonym for being cruel and therefore cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Spiteful (दुर्भावनापूर्ण), Malicious (दुष्ट), Hostile (शत्रुतापूर्ण).
Antonyms: Benevolent (भलाई करने वाला), Kind (दयालु), Friendly (मित्रवत).

This word means befitting a king or being regal and grand. It describes status and appearance rather than the moral quality of kindness or cruelty.
Synonyms: Royal (राजसी), Regal (भव्य), Majestic (आलीशान).
Antonyms: Lowly (नीच), Common (साधारण), Plebeian (मामूली).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Deficient
questionsEn.s:
Deficient - अपर्याप्त (Lacking in some necessary quality)
Skimpy - अल्प (Lacking in size or quantity)
Broken - टूटा हुआ (Separated into parts due to damage)
Ample - प्रचुर (More than enough in quantity or size)
Terrible - भयानक (Extremely or distressingly bad)
oa:
This word means lacking in size, fullness, or quantity. it describes something that is meager and thus acts as a synonym for deficient rather than an antonym.
Synonyms: Meager (अल्प), Scanty (कम), Insufficient (अपर्याप्त).
Antonyms: Ample (प्रचुर), Plentiful (भरपूर), Abundant (अधिक).
