This word refers to something separated into pieces due to damage. it describes the physical integrity of an object and has no relation to the sufficiency of an amount.
Synonyms: Fractured (टूटा हुआ), Smashed (चकनाचूर), Damaged (क्षतिग्रस्त).
Antonyms: Intact (अखंड), Whole (संपूर्ण), Fixed (नियत).

This word refers to being more than enough in quantity or size; fully sufficient. it is the direct and most accurate antonym for being deficient (insufficient).
Synonyms: Plentiful (प्रचुर), Abundant (भरपूर), Copious (अत्यधिक).
Antonyms: Deficient (अपर्याप्त), Scanty (अल्प), Meager (थोड़ा).

This word means extremely or distressingly bad. It describes the poor quality of something in a general negative sense but does not specifically address quantity or deficiency.
Synonyms: Awful (भयानक), Dreadful (भीषण), Horrible (भयंकर).
Antonyms: Wonderful (अद्भुत), Excellent (शानदार), Great (महान).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Meander
questionsEn.s:
Meander - भटकना (To follow a winding course or wander aimlessly)
Ramble - भटकना (To talk or write at length in a confused way)
Depute - प्रतिनिधि नियुक्त करना (To appoint or delegate someone)
Confirm - पुष्टि करना (To establish the truth or correctness)
Direct - सीधा (A straight path or route without detours)
oa:
This word means to talk or write at length in a confused or inconsequential way. it is a direct synonym for the aimless wandering implied by meander.
Synonyms: Wander (भटकना), Drift (विचलन), Stray (राह भटकना).
Antonyms: Focus (केंद्रित होना), Direct (सीधा चलना), Stay (रुकना).

This word means to appoint or delegate someone to a task or position. It describes an administrative action of assignment and has no connection with physical or verbal movement.
Synonyms: Delegate (प्रतिनिधि नियुक्त करना), Appoint (नियुक्त करना), Assign (सौंपना).
Antonyms: Revoke (वापस लेना), Cancel (रद्द करना), Withdraw (निकालना).

This word means to establish the truth or correctness of something. It refers to validation rather than providing a direct or non-winding path of movement.
Synonyms: Verify (पुष्टि करना), Substantiate (साबित करना), Validate (प्रमाणित करना).
Antonyms: Deny (नकारना), Refute (खंडन करना), Disprove (गलत साबित करना).

This word refers to a straight path or route without deviations; clear and straightforward. It serves as the perfect antonym for meander, which involves winding or aimless movement.
Synonyms: Straight (सीधा), Linear (नियत), Honest (स्पष्टवादी).
Antonyms: Meander (भटकना), Deviate (विचलित होना), Swerve (मुड़ना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Jeopardise
questionsEn.s:
Jeopardise - खतरे में डालना (To put in danger of loss or failure)
Safeguard - सुरक्षा करना (To protect something from harm)
Risk - जोखिम (Possibility of something bad happening)
Peril - खतरा (Serious and immediate danger)
Jape - मज़ाक (A practical joke or playful trick)
oa:
This word refers to protecting something from harm or damage. It is the direct and most accurate antonym for jeopardise, which involves putting something at risk.
Synonyms: Protect (सुरक्षा करना), Defend (बचाना), Shield (ढाल बनना).
Antonyms: Jeopardise (खतरे में डालना), Endanger (जोखिम में डालना), Risk (खतरा उठाना).

This word refers to the possibility of something bad happening or putting something in danger. it is a direct synonym for jeopardise and cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Endanger (जोखिम), Threaten (धमकी), Imperil (खतरे में डालना).
Antonyms: Save (बचाना), Secure (सुरक्षित करना), Protect (रक्षा करना).

This word refers to serious and immediate danger. it is a noun describing the state of being in jeopardy and therefore acts as a synonym rather than an antonym.
Synonyms: Danger (खतरा), Hazard (जोखिम), Jeopardy (जोखिम).
Antonyms: Safety (सुरक्षा), Security (बचाव), Ease (आराम).

This word refers to a practical joke or a playful trick. It describes a humorous prank and has no linguistic or situational connection with the concept of danger or safety.
Synonyms: Prank (मज़ाक), Joke (मज़ाक), Trick (खेल).
Antonyms: Seriousness (गंभीरता), Solemnity (गंभीरता), Grave (गंभीर).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Success
questionsEn.s:
Success - सफलता (The accomplishment of an aim or purpose)
Sensation - संवेदना (A physical feeling or perception)
Opulence - धनाढ्यता (Great wealth or luxuriousness)
Victory - विजय (The act of defeating an enemy or winning)
Failure - असफलता (The lack of success)
oa:
This word refers to a physical feeling or perception resulting from contact with the body. It describes a sensory experience rather than the outcome of an achievement.
Synonyms: Feeling (संवेदना), Perception (अनुभव), Impression (छाप).
Antonyms: Insensibility (शून्यता), Numbness (जड़ता), Apathy (उदासीनता).

This word refers to great wealth or luxuriousness. While success often leads to opulence, the word describes a state of richness rather than the act of achieving a goal.
Synonyms: Wealth (धनाढ्यता), Affluence (समृद्धि), Riches (अमीरी).
Antonyms: Poverty (गरीबी), Penury (दरिद्रता), Scarcity (अभाव).

This word refers to the act of defeating an enemy or winning a competition. It is a direct synonym for success and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an antonym.
Synonyms: Triumph (विजय), Success (सफलता), Win (जीत).
Antonyms: Defeat (हार), Failure (असफलता), Loss (पराजय).

This word refers to the lack of success or the inability to meet an expectation or goal. it is the direct and perfect antonym for the word success.
Synonyms: Collapse (असफलता), Loss (हार), Defeat (पराजय).
Antonyms: Success (सफलता), Achievement (उपलब्धि), Victory (जीत).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Mendacious
questionsEn.s:
Mendacious - झूठा (Dishonest or lying)
Dishonest - बेईमान (Untrustworthy or deceitful)
Fraudulent - धोखेबाज (Involving criminal deception)
Truthful - सत्यवादी (Honest and free of deceit)
Deceitful - धोखेबाज़ (Guilty of misleading others)
oa:
This word refers to behaving in an untrustworthy or deceitful way. it is a direct synonym for mendacious and therefore does not provide the required opposite relationship.
Synonyms: Deceitful (बेईमान), Untruthful (झूठा), Lying (मिथ्या).
Antonyms: Honest (ईमानदार), Truthful (सत्यवादी), Frank (स्पष्ट).

This word describes being obtained by or involving deception, especially criminal deception. it is a synonym for mendacious and cannot be its antonym.
Synonyms: Deceptive (धोखेबाज), Crooked (कुटिल), Shifty (छली).
Antonyms: Genuine (असली), Authentic (प्रामाणिक), Honest (ईमानदार).

This word refers to being honest, accurate, and free of deceit. It is the direct and perfect antonym for mendacious, which involves lying or being dishonest.
Synonyms: Honest (सत्यवादी), Sincere (ईमानदार), Candid (स्पष्ट).
Antonyms: Mendacious (झूठा), Deceitful (धोखेबाज), Lying (असत्य).

This word describes being guilty of or involving deceit; misleading others. It is another synonym for mendacious and does not satisfy the requirement for an opposite.
Synonyms: False (धोखेबाज़), Insincere (कपटी), Shifty (चालबाज़).
Antonyms: Candid (स्पष्टवादी), Open (खुला), Honest (ईमानदार).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Quixotic
questionsEn.s:
Quixotic - अव्यावहारिक/आदर्शवादी (Exceedingly idealistic or unrealistic)
Romantic - रोमांटिक (Characterized by idealized views)
Visionary - दूरदर्शी (Having original and imaginative ideas)
Pragmatic - व्यावहारिक (Dealing with things realistically)
Idealistic - आदर्शवादी (Guided by ideals, often unrealistic)
oa:
This word describes having an idealized or emotional view of life. it is often a characteristic of being quixotic and therefore acts more like a synonym than an antonym.
Synonyms: Idealistic (रोमांटिक), Fanciful (भावुक), Sentimental (भावपूर्ण).
Antonyms: Practical (व्यावहारिक), Realistic (यथार्थवादी), Hard-headed (सख्त).

This word refers to having original and imaginative ideas about the future. While positive, it implies a level of idealism similar to quixotic and is not its opposite.
Synonyms: Inspired (दूरदर्शी), Creative (रचनात्मक), Forward-looking (अग्रगामी).
Antonyms: Practical (व्यावहारिक), Ordinary (साधारण), Conventional (पारंपरिक).

This word refers to dealing with things sensibly and realistically based on practical considerations. It is the direct antonym for quixotic, which implies impractical idealism.
Synonyms: Practical (व्यावहारिक), Realistic (यथार्थवादी), Sensible (समझदार).
Antonyms: Quixotic (अव्यावहारिक), Idealistic (आदर्शवादी), Visionary (काल्पनिक).

This word means being guided by high principles or ideals, often in an unrealistic way. it is a synonym for the given word quixotic and cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Utopian (आदर्शवादी), Visionary (कल्पनाशील), Romantic (रोमांटिक).
Antonyms: Pragmatic (व्यावहारिक), Cynical (संदेहवादी), Realistic (यथार्थवादी).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Obsequious
questionsEn.s:
Obsequious - चापलूस (Excessively obedient or attentive)
Assertive - आत्मविश्वासी (Confident and forceful personality)
Submissive - आज्ञाकारी (Willing to obey without arguing)
Flattering - चापलूसी (Complimenting excessively to gain favor)
Senile - वृद्ध या बूढ़ा (Mental decline due to old age)
oa:
This word refers to having a confident and forceful personality, expressing desires in a firm way. it is the best antonym for being obsequious, which involves excessive obedience.
Synonyms: Confident (आत्मविश्वासी), Forceful (मुखर), Decisive (दृढ़).
Antonyms: Submissive (दब्बू), Obsequious (चापलूस), Hesitant (झिझकने वाला).

This word describes being willing to obey someone without arguing. it is a direct synonym for the core behavior of being obsequious and therefore cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Compliant (आज्ञाकारी), Passive (निष्क्रिय), Yielding (झुकने वाला).
Antonyms: Rebellious (विद्रोही), Defiant (अवज्ञाकारी), Assertive (मुखर).

This word means complimenting someone excessively to gain favor. it is a key characteristic of an obsequious person and therefore acts as a synonym rather than an antonym.
Synonyms: Sycophantic (चापलूसी), Adulatory (प्रशंसात्मक), Fawning (खुशामदी).
Antonyms: Critical (आलोचनात्मक), Honest (ईमानदार), Blunt (मुँहफट).

This word describes a decline in mental or physical faculties due to old age. it refers to an age-related condition and has no linguistic connection to the concept of obedience or flattery.
Synonyms: Doting (वृद्ध या बूढ़ा), Doddering (जर्जर), Decrepit (कमज़ोर).
Antonyms: Youthful (युवा), Alert (सजग), Vigorous (ऊर्जावान).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Soporific
questionsEn.s:
Soporific - नींद लाने वाला (Tending to induce drowsiness or sleep)
Stimulating - उत्तेजक (Arousing excitement or interest)
Drowsy - नींद से भरा हुआ (Feeling sleepy or lethargic)
Sleep-inducing - नींद लाने वाला (Promoting sleep; synonym for soporific)
Sedative - शामक (Substance that calms and induces sleep)
oa:
This word refers to something that arouses excitement, interest, or activity. it is the direct and most accurate antonym for soporific, which means sleep-inducing.
Synonyms: Invigorating (उत्तेजक), Inspiring (प्रेरक), Energizing (ऊर्जावान).
Antonyms: Soporific (नींद लाने वाला), Sedative (शामक), Boring (उबाऊ).

This word describes feeling sleepy or lethargic. it is a state caused by something soporific and acts as a near-synonym rather than an opposite relationship.
Synonyms: Sleepy (नींद से भरा हुआ), Somnolent (ऊंघता हुआ), Sluggish (सुस्त).
Antonyms: Alert (सजग), Wakeful (जागा हुआ), Energetic (ऊर्जावान).

This word refers to something that causes or promotes sleep. it is a literal definition of the word soporific and therefore cannot satisfy the requirement for an opposite.
Synonyms: Soporific (नींद लाने वाला), Somniferous (निद्राजनक), Hypnotic (नींद लाने वाला).
Antonyms: Stimulating (उत्तेजक), Bracing (स्फूर्तिदायक), Exciting (रोमांचक).

This word refers to a substance that calms someone or induces sleep. like soporific, it describes a calming or sleep-causing effect and acts as a synonym.
Synonyms: Calming (शांत करने वाली दवा), Tranquilizing (शामक), Soothing (सुखद).
Antonyms: Agitating (उत्तेजित करने वाला), Stimulant (उत्तेजक), Provocative (भड़काने वाला).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Oppugn
questionsEn.s:
Oppugn - विरोध करना (To oppose, contradict, or challenge)
Question - प्रश्न करना (To ask about or doubt the truth)
Defend - रक्षा करना (To support or protect from attack)
Dispute - विवाद करना (To argue or disagree over something)
Challenge - चुनौती देना (To call into question or demand proof)
oa:
This word means to ask or inquire about something, or to doubt its truth. it is a near-synonym for the act of oppugning and therefore cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Query (प्रश्न करना), Doubt (संदेह करना), Challenge (चुनौती देना).
Antonyms: Accept (मानना), Answer (उत्तर देना), Believe (विश्वास करना).

This word means to support or protect someone or something from attack or criticism. It is the direct antonym for oppugn, which means to contradict or challenge.
Synonyms: Protect (रक्षा करना), Support (समर्थन करना), Uphold (संरक्षित करना).
Antonyms: Oppugn (विरोध करना), Attack (हमला करना), Criticize (आलोचना करना).

This word means to argue or disagree over something. it is a synonym for the given word oppugn and does not satisfy the requirement for an opposite.
Synonyms: Contradict (विवाद करना), Argue (बहस करना), Conflict (संघर्ष करना).
Antonyms: Agree (सहमत होना), Concede (स्वीकार करना), Accord (समझौता).

This word means to call into question or demand proof. it is a direct synonym for the act of oppugning and cannot be used as its antonym.
Synonyms: Oppose (चुनौती देना), Question (प्रश्न करना), Defy (अवहेलना करना).
Antonyms: Submit (झुकना), Yield (समर्पण करना), Follow (अनुसरण करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Demur
questionsEn.s:
Demur - आपत्ति करना (To raise objections or show reluctance)
Agree - सहमत होना (To have the same opinion or accept)
Oppose - विरोध करना (To disagree or attempt to prevent)
Object - आपत्ति (To express disapproval or disagreement)
Resist - प्रतिरोध (To fight against or withstand something)
oa:
This word means to have the same opinion as someone else or to accept a proposal. It serves as the direct antonym for demur, which involves raising objections.
Synonyms: Consent (सहमत होना), Accept (स्वीकार करना), Concur (सहमति देना).
Antonyms: Demur (आपत्ति करना), Dissent (असहमत होना), Object (विरोध करना).

This word means to disagree with or attempt to prevent something. it is a synonym for the action implied by demur and therefore cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Resist (विरोध करना), Contradict (खंडन करना), Combat (मुकाबला करना).
Antonyms: Support (समर्थन करना), Agree (सहमत होना), Follow (अनुसरण करना).

This word refers to expressing disapproval or disagreement. it is a direct synonym for demur and does not provide the required antonym relationship.
Synonyms: Demur (आपत्ति करना), Protest (विरोध करना), Complain (शिकायत करना).
Antonyms: Approve (मंजूरी देना), Consent (सहमति देना), Accept (मानना).

This word means to fight against or withstand something. it is another synonym for the refusal to comply found in demur rather than being its antonym.
Synonyms: Withstand (प्रतिरोध करना), Defy (अवहेलना करना), Counter (मुकाबला करना).
Antonyms: Yield (झुकना), Submit (समर्पण करना), Comply (अनुपालन करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Zany
questionsEn.s:
Zany - सनकी/अजीब (Amusingly unconventional or peculiar)
Sensible - समझदार (Practical, reasonable, or showing judgment)
Bizarre - विचित्र (Very strange or unusual)
Clownish - जोकर जैसा (Characteristic of a clown; funny)
Eccentric - अजीब (Unconventional and slightly strange)
oa:
This word describes being practical, reasonable, or showing good judgment. it is the direct behavioral antonym for zany, which involves unconventional or peculiar humor.
Synonyms: Practical (समझदार), Reasonable (तार्किक), Prudent (विवेकपूर्ण).
Antonyms: Zany (सनकी), Foolish (मूर्ख), Ridiculous (हास्यास्पद).

This word refers to something very strange or unusual. it is a synonym for the peculiar nature of being zany and therefore cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Eccentric (विचित्र), Weird (अजीब), Peculiar (विचित्र).
Antonyms: Normal (सामान्य), Usual (साधारण), Ordinary (मामूली).

This word describes behavior that is characteristic of a clown; foolish and funny. it is a direct synonym for the given word and cannot provide the antonym.
Synonyms: Silly (जोकर जैसा), Buffoonish (मूर्खतापूर्ण), Playful (चंचल).
Antonyms: Solemn (गंभीर), Dignified (गरिमामय), Grave (संजीदा).

This word refers to a person or behavior that is unconventional and slightly strange. it is a synonym for zany and does not satisfy the requirement for an opposite.
Synonyms: Quirky (अजीब), Odd (विचित्र), Outlandish (अनोखा).
Antonyms: Conventional (पारंपरिक), Ordinary (साधारण), Typical (विशिष्ट).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Incessant
questionsEn.s:
Incessant - निरंतर (Continuing without interruption)
Constant - सतत (Continuous or staying the same)
Ceaseless - अविराम (Without any pause or stop)
Intermittent - रुक-रुक कर (Occurring at irregular intervals)
Perpetual - निरंतर (Lasting forever or never-ending)
oa:
This word refers to something that continues without pause or is faithful. it is a direct synonym for incessant and therefore does not provide the required opposite.
Synonyms: Persistent (सतत), Continuous (लगातार), Steady (नियमित).
Antonyms: Intermittent (रुक-रुक कर), Fitful (अनियमित), Occasional (कभी-कभार).

This word means without any pause or stop. it is a literal definition of incessant and therefore cannot satisfy the requirement for an antonym.
Synonyms: Unending (अविराम), Perpetual (अविराम), Eternal (अनंत).
Antonyms: Ending (समाप्त), Temporary (अस्थायी), Ceasing (रुकने वाला).

This word refers to something occurring at irregular intervals; not continuous. it is the direct and most accurate antonym for incessant (never-stopping).
Synonyms: Sporadic (रुक-रुक कर), Fitful (अनियमित), Scattered (छिटपुट).
Antonyms: Incessant (निरंतर), Continuous (सतत), Regular (नियमित).

This word refers to something that lasts forever or is never-ending. like ceaseless, it is a synonym for the continuous nature of incessant and not its opposite.
Synonyms: Everlasting (निरंतर), Infinite (अनंत), Unceasing (अविराम).
Antonyms: Temporary (क्षणिक), Finite (सीमित), Ending (समाप्त).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Piquant
questionsEn.s:
Piquant - मसालेदार (Pleasantly sharp, tangy, or spicy)
Bland - फीका (Lacking strong features or tasteless)
Spicy - मसालेदार (Flavorful or containing strong spices)
Zesty - तीखा (Full of flavor or excitement)
Tart - खट्टा (A sharp, acidic, or sour taste)
oa:
This word refers to something that lacks strong features or characteristics; it is tasteless or dull. it is the direct and perfect antonym for piquant (sharp or spicy).
Synonyms: Tasteless (फीका), Flavorless (बेस्वाद), Dull (नीरस).
Antonyms: Piquant (मसालेदार), Spicy (चटपटा), Zesty (तीखा).

This word describes something flavored with or containing strong spices. it is a direct synonym for piquant and therefore cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Peppery (मसालेदार), Hot (तीखा), Pungent (तिक्त).
Antonyms: Bland (फीका), Mild (नरम), Insipid (बेस्वाद).

This word describes something that is full of flavor, energy, or excitement. like spicy, it is a synonym for the pleasant sharpness of piquant and not its opposite.
Synonyms: Tangy (तीखा), Savory (स्वादिष्ट), Sharp (तीक्ष्ण).
Antonyms: Dull (नीरस), Tasteless (बेस्वाद), Insipid (फीका).

This word refers to a sharp, acidic, or sour taste. While tartness is a specific kind of sharp flavor, it aligns with the "piquant" spectrum rather than being its opposite.
Synonyms: Sour (खट्टा), Acidic (अम्लीय), Sharp (तीखा).
Antonyms: Sweet (मीठा), Bland (फीका), Mellow (मधुर).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Pulchritude
questionsEn.s:
Pulchritude - सौंदर्य (Physical beauty, especially of a woman)
Grace - अनुग्रह (Elegance or beauty of movement)
Ugliness - कुरूपता (Quality of being unpleasant in appearance)
Charm - आकर्षण (Power of delighting or attracting others)
Beauty - सुंदरता (Qualities that please the aesthetic senses)
oa:
This word refers to elegance or beauty of movement and expression. while it is a type of beauty, it is a synonym for the positive attributes of pulchritude rather than an opposite.
Synonyms: Elegance (अनुग्रह), Finesse (कौशल), Charm (आकर्षण).
Antonyms: Awkwardness (भद्दापन), Clumsiness (अनाड़ीपन), Ineptitude (अकुशलता).

This word refers to the quality of being unpleasant or unattractive in appearance. it is the direct and most accurate antonym for pulchritude (physical beauty).
Synonyms: Hideousness (कुरूपता), Deformity (विकृति), Repulsiveness (घृणा).
Antonyms: Pulchritude (सौंदर्य), Beauty (सुंदरता), Loveliness (मनोहरता).

This word refers to the power or quality of delighting or attracting others. it is a quality often associated with beauty and acts as a synonym in this context.
Synonyms: Allure (आकर्षण), Magnetism (मोहकता), Fascination (मनमोहक).
Antonyms: Repulsion (विकर्षण), Dislike (नापसंदगी), Boredom (नीरसता).

This word refers to the combination of qualities that pleases the aesthetic senses. it is the most common synonym for pulchritude and therefore cannot be its antonym.
Synonyms: Pulchritude (सुंदरता), Loveliness (मनोहरता), Prettiness (खूबसूरती).
Antonyms: Ugliness (बदसूरती), Repulsiveness (घृणा), Hideousness (भयानक).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Incorrigible
questionsEn.s:
Incorrigible - असुधारनीय (Incapable of being corrected or reformed)
Chronic - दीर्घकालिक (Persisting for a long time or recurring)
Deep-rooted - गहराई से जुड़ा हुआ (Firmly established over time)
Habitual - आदतन (Done regularly or as a habit)
Reclaimable - पुनः प्राप्त करने योग्य (Can be recovered or restored)
oa:
This word refers to something that persists for a long time or is constantly recurring. while it describes the duration of a habit, it does not mean it can or cannot be changed.
Synonyms: Constant (दीर्घकालिक), Habitual (आदतन), Persistent (सतत).
Antonyms: Acute (तीव्र), Occasional (कभी-कभार), Temporary (अस्थायी).

This word refers to something firmly established or ingrained. it is a characteristic of being incorrigible and acts more like a synonym than an opposite.
Synonyms: Ingrained (गहराई से जुड़ा हुआ), Entrenched (स्थापित), Fixed (नियत).
Antonyms: Superficial (सतही), Casual (अस्थायी), Changeable (परिवर्तनशील).

This word describes something done regularly as a habit. it is another descriptor for the fixed behavior of an incorrigible person rather than providing an opposite meaning.
Synonyms: Customary (आदतन), Routine (नियमित), Chronic (दीर्घकालिक).
Antonyms: Occasional (यदा-कदा), Random (बेतरतीब), Unusual (असामान्य).

This word refers to something that can be recovered, restored, or reformed. it is the direct logical opposite of incorrigible, which means incapable of being reformed.
Synonyms: Reformable (पुनः प्राप्त करने योग्य), Salvageable (बचाने योग्य), Restorable (सुधारने योग्य).
Antonyms: Incorrigible (असुधारनीय), Hopeless (निराश), Irredeemable (अप्रतिदेय).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Abrogate
questionsEn.s:
Abrogate - रद्द करना (To repeal or do away with a law)
Abolish - समाप्त करना (Formally put an end to a system)
Revoke - रद्द करना (To officially cancel or withdraw)
Uphold - संरक्षित करना (To maintain or support a law/decision)
Annul - निरस्त करना (To declare something invalid)
oa:
This word means to formally put an end to a system or practice. it is a direct synonym for abrogate and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an antonym.
Synonyms: Annul (समाप्त करना), Repeal (रद्द करना), Nullify (अमान्य करना).
Antonyms: Establish (स्थापित करना), Enact (लागू करना), Uphold (बनाए रखना).

This word means to officially cancel or withdraw a law or privilege. it is another synonym for abrogate and cannot provide the required opposite relationship.
Synonyms: Rescind (रद्द करना), Cancel (निरस्त करना), Countermand (वापस लेना).
Antonyms: Authorize (अधिकृत करना), Validate (पुष्टि करना), Confirm (पुख्ता करना).

This word refers to maintaining, supporting, or confirming a law or decision. It is the direct opposite of abrogate, which involves repealing or canceling a law.
Synonyms: Maintain (संरक्षित करना), Support (समर्थन करना), Sustain (जारी रखना).
Antonyms: Abrogate (रद्द करना), Repeal (खंडन करना), Overturn (उलट देना).

This word means to declare something invalid, especially a law or marriage. like the first two options, it is a synonym for abrogate and not its antonym.
Synonyms: Nullify (निरस्त करना), Void (अमान्य करना), Quash (खत्म करना).
Antonyms: Validate (मान्य करना), Legitimate (वैध करना), Establish (स्थापित करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Reverence
questionsEn.s:
Reverence - गहरा सम्मान (Deep respect or admiration)
Respect - सम्मान (Admiring someone's abilities)
Devotion - भक्ति (Love, loyalty, or enthusiasm)
Contempt - अवमानना (Feeling of disdain or lack of respect)
Worship - पूजा (Feeling of reverence for a deity)
oa:
This word refers to a feeling of deep admiration for someone's abilities or achievements. It is a direct synonym for reverence and cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Admiration (सम्मान), Esteem (आदर), Regard (सम्मान).
Antonyms: Contempt (तिरस्कार), Disdain (घृणा), Scorn (अपमान).

This word refers to love, loyalty, or enthusiasm for a person or cause. it is another synonym for the deep positive feeling of reverence and is not an antonym.
Synonyms: Loyalty (भक्ति), Dedication (समर्पण), Allegiance (निष्ठा).
Antonyms: Disloyalty (बेवफाई), Apathy (उदासीनता), Betrayal (विश्वासघात).

This word refers to a feeling of disdain or lack of respect for someone considered worthless. it is the direct and perfect antonym for reverence (deep respect).
Synonyms: Disdain (अवमानना), Scorn (तिरस्कार), Mockery (उपहास).
Antonyms: Reverence (गहरा सम्मान), Respect (आदर), Admiration (प्रशंसा).

This word refers to the feeling of reverence and adoration for a deity. it is a strong synonym for reverence and therefore does not satisfy the required relationship.
Synonyms: Adoration (पूजा), Revere (श्रद्धा), Venerate (आदर करना).
Antonyms: Desecration (अपवित्रीकरण), Blasphemy (ईश्वर निंदा), Scorn (तिरस्कार).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Incandescent
questionsEn.s:
Incandescent - प्रज्वलित (Emitting light as a result of being heated)
Dusky - अंधकारमय (Being dim, shadowy, or lacking brightness)
Resplendent - दीप्तिमान (Shining brilliantly; characterized by splendor)
Glistening - चमकता हुआ (Reflecting a sparkling or shimmering light)
Fulgent - चमकदार (Dazzlingly bright or radiant)
oa:
This word refers to being dim, shadowy, or lacking brightness. It serves as a perfect opposite to incandescent, which describes something glowing and extremely bright.
Synonyms: Dim (अंधकारमय), Shadowy (धुंधला), Murky (अंधेरा).
Antonyms: Bright (चमकीला), Incandescent (प्रज्वलित), Luminous (प्रकाशमान).

This word means shining brilliantly or being characterized by glowing splendor. it is a synonym for the brightness of incandescent and therefore not an antonym.
Synonyms: Radiant (दीप्तिमान), Splendid (शानदार), Brilliant (शानदार).
Antonyms: Dull (नीरस), Drab (फीका), Dark (अंधेरा).

This word means reflecting a sparkling or shimmering light. while it refers to light, it is a synonym for the radiance associated with the given word.
Synonyms: Shining (चमकता हुआ), Sparkling (चमकीला), Twinkling (टिमटिमाता).
Antonyms: Dull (बेचमक), Matte (फीका), Dim (धुंधला).

This word refers to being dazzlingly bright or radiant. It is another direct synonym for incandescent and does not satisfy the requirement for an opposite.
Synonyms: Luminous (चमकदार), Radiant (चमकदार), Beaming (प्रज्वलित).
Antonyms: Obscure (धुंधला), Dark (अंधेरा), Somber (उदास).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Turpitude
questionsEn.s:
Turpitude - दुष्टता/नीचता (Wickedness, depravity, or immoral behavior)
Depravity - दुष्टता (Moral corruption or wickedness)
Vice - दोष (Immoral or wicked behavior)
Morality - नैतिकता (Principles between right and wrong)
Sin - पाप (Act considered morally wrong)
oa:
This word refers to moral corruption or wickedness. It is a direct synonym for turpitude and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an antonym.
Synonyms: Wickedness (दुष्टता), Vice (दोष), Immorality (अनैतिकता).
Antonyms: Virtue (सद्गुण), Morality (नैतिकता), Integrity (सत्यनिष्ठा).

This word refers to immoral or wicked behavior or a bad habit. It is another synonym for turpitude and cannot provide the required opposite relationship.
Synonyms: Fault (दोष), Sin (पाप), Imperfection (कमजोरी).
Antonyms: Virtue (सदाचारी), Goodness (भलाई), Excellence (श्रेष्ठता).

This word refers to principles concerning the distinction between right and wrong conduct. It is the direct ethical opposite of turpitude (wickedness).
Synonyms: Ethics (नैतिकता), Virtue (सद्गुण), Integrity (सत्यनिष्ठा).
Antonyms: Turpitude (नीचता), Immorality (अनैतिकता), Depravity (दुष्टता).

This word refers to an act considered morally wrong or a transgression against divine law. it is a synonym for the behavior categorized under turpitude and is not its opposite.
Synonyms: Wrongdoing (पाप), Offense (अपराध), Transgression (उल्लंघन).
Antonyms: Good deed (पुण्य), Virtue (सदाचारी), Piety (धार्मिकता).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Lassitude
questionsEn.s:
Lassitude - थकान (A state of physical or mental weariness)
Exhaustion - अत्यधिक थकान (Extreme tiredness or fatigue)
Apathy - उदासीनता (Lack of interest, enthusiasm, or concern)
Vigor - ऊर्जा/जोश (Physical strength, energy, and enthusiasm)
Lethargy - सुस्ती (A state of sluggishness and lack of energy)
oa:
This word means extreme tiredness or fatigue. it is a direct synonym for lassitude and therefore cannot satisfy the requirement for an opposite.
Synonyms: Fatigue (अत्यधिक थकान), Weariness (थकान), Tiredness (पस्त).
Antonyms: Energy (ऊर्जा), Vigor (जोश), Vitality (स्फूर्ति).

This word refers to a lack of interest, enthusiasm, or concern. While related to a lack of energy, it describes emotional indifference rather than being the physical opposite of tiredness.
Synonyms: Indifference (उदासीनता), Detachment (विरक्ति), Passivity (निष्क्रियता).
Antonyms: Interest (रुचि), Enthusiasm (उत्साह), Passion (जुनून).

This word refers to physical strength, energy, and enthusiasm. It is the direct and perfect antonym for lassitude, which involves weariness and lack of energy.
Synonyms: Vitality (ऊर्जा), Energy (जोश), Stamina (सहनशक्ति).
Antonyms: Lassitude (थकान), Lethargy (सुस्ती), Weakness (कमज़ोरी).

This word describes a state of sluggishness and lack of energy. it is a direct synonym for lassitude and does not provide the required antonym relationship.
Synonyms: Sluggishness (सुस्ती), Inactivity (निष्क्रियता), Torpor (जड़ता).
Antonyms: Activity (सक्रियता), Alacrity (फुर्ती), Animation (जोश).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Sagacious
questionsEn.s:
Sagacious - बुद्धिमान (Having keen mental discernment and judgment)
Insightful - सूझबूझ वाला (Showing deep understanding)
Wise - बुद्धिमान (Having experience and good judgment)
Foolish - मूर्ख (Lacking good sense or judgment)
Prudent - विवेकपूर्ण (Acting with thought for the future)
oa:
This word describes showing a deep understanding or perception of a situation. it is a synonym for sagacious and therefore cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Perceptive (सूझबूझ वाला), Discerning (विवेकशील), Wise (बुद्धिमान).
Antonyms: Superficial (सतही), Ignorant (अज्ञानी), Foolish (मूर्ख).

This word refers to having experience, knowledge, and good judgment. it is the primary synonym for the given word sagacious and does not provide an antonym.
Synonyms: Sage (बुद्धिमान), Learned (विद्वान), Shrewd (चतुर).
Antonyms: Stupid (बेवकूफ), Foolish (मूर्ख), Unwise (नासमझ).

This word refers to lacking good sense or judgment; being unwise. it is the direct mental and behavioral antonym for sagacious (wise).
Synonyms: Silly (मूर्ख), Asinine (बेवकूफी भरा), Unwise (नासमझ).
Antonyms: Sagacious (बुद्धिमान), Prudent (विवेकपूर्ण), Wise (ज्ञानी).

This word means acting with or showing care and thought for the future. While it is a positive trait, it is a synonym for the judgment implied by sagacious.
Synonyms: Cautious (विवेकपूर्ण), Careful (सावधान), Judicious (समझदार).
Antonyms: Rash (लापरवाह), Reckless (अविवेकपूर्ण), Indiscreet (अविवेकी).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Opprobrium
questionsEn.s:
Opprobrium - निंदा/अपमान (Harsh criticism or public disgrace)
Disgrace - अपमान (Loss of respect or reputation)
Contempt - तिरस्कार (The feeling that someone is worthless)
Honor - सम्मान (High respect, esteem, or recognition)
Censure - निंदा (Formal expression of strong disapproval)
oa:
This word refers to the loss of respect or reputation as a result of a dishonorable action. It is a direct synonym for opprobrium and cannot be its antonym.
Synonyms: Shame (अपमान), Infamy (बदनामी), Ignominy (अकीर्ति).
Antonyms: Honor (सम्मान), Respect (आदर), Pride (गर्व).

This word means the feeling that someone or something is worthless or beneath consideration. it refers to the attitude that leads to opprobrium rather than its opposite.
Synonyms: Disdain (तिरस्कार), Scorn (अवमानना), Derision (उपहास).
Antonyms: Admiration (प्रशंसा), Reverence (श्रद्धा), Respect (आदर).

This word refers to high respect, esteem, or public recognition of achievement. It is the direct and most accurate antonym for opprobrium (public disgrace).
Synonyms: Prestige (सम्मान), Respect (आदर), Glory (महिमा).
Antonyms: Opprobrium (अपमान), Shame (शर्म), Disgrace (कलंक).

This word refers to a formal expression of strong disapproval. Like opprobrium, it describes a negative public judgment and acts as a synonym.
Synonyms: Criticism (निंदा), Condemnation (भर्त्सना), Rebuke (फटकार).
Antonyms: Approval (मंजूरी), Praise (प्रशंसा), Commendation (सराहना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Refulgent
questionsEn.s:
Refulgent - चमकदार (Shining brightly or radiant)
Dull - नीरस (Lacking brightness or vitality)
Radiant - दीप्तिमान (Sending out light; shining)
Gleaming - चमकता हुआ (Reflecting a soft or bright light)
Luminous - प्रकाशमान (Emitting or reflecting light)
oa:
This word refers to something that is not bright, shiny, or interesting. it is the direct visual antonym for refulgent, which means shining brightly.
Synonyms: Drab (नीरस), Dim (मंद), Lackluster (फीका).
Antonyms: Refulgent (चमकदार), Radiant (दीप्तिमान), Luminous (प्रकाशमान).

This word means sending out light or shining brightly. it is a direct synonym for the given word and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an antonym.
Synonyms: Refulgent (दीप्तिमान), Beaming (प्रज्वलित), Glowing (चमकदार).
Antonyms: Dull (नीरस), Dark (अंधेरा), Somber (उदास).

This word refers to reflecting a soft or bright light. It describes a state of brightness similar to refulgent and acts as its synonym.
Synonyms: Shimmering (चमकता हुआ), Glistening (चमकीला), Twinkling (जगमगाता).
Antonyms: Matte (फीका), Dull (बेचमक), Obscure (धुंधला).

This word means emitting or reflecting light, especially in the dark. It is another direct synonym for the brightness described by refulgent.
Synonyms: Bright (प्रकाशमान), Shining (चमकदार), Phosphorescent (प्रदीप्त).
Antonyms: Opaque (अपारदर्शी), Dark (अंधेरा), Dim (धुंधला).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Pusillanimous
questionsEn.s:
Pusillanimous - कायर (Showing a lack of courage or determination)
Timid - डरपोक (Showing a lack of courage or confidence)
Brave - साहसी (Showing courage without fear)
Cowardly - कायर (Lacking courage or overly afraid)
Faint-hearted - कमज़ोर दिल वाला (Easily scared or lacking bravery)
oa:
This word describes someone who shows a lack of courage or confidence. it is a direct synonym for the given word and therefore cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Cowardly (डरपोक), Fearful (भयभीत), Nervous (शंकित).
Antonyms: Brave (साहसी), Bold (निडर), Confident (आत्मविश्वासी).

This word refers to someone who shows courage and readiness to face danger without fear. it is the direct and perfect antonym for being pusillanimous (timid).
Synonyms: Courageous (साहसी), Valiant (वीर), Intrepid (निडर).
Antonyms: Pusillanimous (कायर), Timid (डरपोक), Gutless (कमज़ोर).

This word means lacking courage or being overly afraid of challenges. it is another direct synonym for pusillanimous and does not provide an antonym.
Synonyms: Craven (कायर), Gutless (डरपोक), Spineless (कमज़ोर दिल).
Antonyms: Heroic (वीर), Daring (साहसी), Gallant (शौर्यपूर्ण).

This word describes someone who is easily scared or lacks bravery. it is a synonym for the timid nature expressed by pusillanimous and not its opposite.
Synonyms: Meek (कमज़ोर दिल वाला), Shy (संकोची), Diffident (शर्मीला).
Antonyms: Stout-hearted (बहादुर), Bold (निडर), Audacious (साहसी).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Vociferous
questionsEn.s:
Vociferous - प्रबल और जोरदार (Expressing opinions loudly and forcefully)
Noisy - शोरगुल (Full of loud sounds or activity)
Loud - जोर से (Producing a lot of sound)
Silent - मौन (Quiet or free from loud sounds)
Boisterous - उल्लासपूर्ण (Rough, noisy, and full of energy)
oa:
This word refers to being full of loud sounds or activity. it is a synonym for the "loud" aspect of being vociferous and therefore cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Clamorous (शोरगुल), Raucous (कर्कश), Rowdy (उधमी).
Antonyms: Quiet (शांत), Silent (मौन), Peaceful (शांतिपूर्ण).

This word means producing a lot of sound. it is the primary descriptor and synonym for vociferous communication and not an antonym.
Synonyms: Blatant (जोर से), Thunderous (ज़ोरदार), Boisterous (उत्तेजित).
Antonyms: Soft (हल्का), Whispering (फुसफुसाता), Muted (धीमा).

This word refers to being quiet or free from loud sounds. It is the direct and most accurate antonym for vociferous, which involves loud and forceful expression.
Synonyms: Mute (मौन), Quiet (शांत), Taciturn (अल्पभाषी).
Antonyms: Vociferous (प्रबल), Loud (शोरगुल वाला), Noisy (ज़ोरदार).

This word describes someone or something that is rough, noisy, and full of energy. like noisy, it is a synonym for the loud energy of being vociferous.
Synonyms: Lively (उत्साही), Rowdy (शोरगुल), Animated (जोशीला).
Antonyms: Calm (शांत), Subdued (धीमा), Placid (स्थिर).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Exiguous
questionsEn.s:
Exiguous - अत्यल्प (Very small in size or amount)
Meager - अल्प (Lacking in quantity or quality)
Plentiful - प्रचुर मात्रा में (Existing in great quantity; abundant)
Sparse - विरल (Thinly scattered or distributed)
Skimpy - अपर्याप्त (Inadequate in size or amount)
oa:
This word refers to something that is lacking in quantity or quality; it is a direct synonym for exiguous and therefore not an antonym.
Synonyms: Scanty (अल्प), Insufficient (अपर्याप्त), Skimpy (मामूली).
Antonyms: Plentiful (प्रचुर), Abundant (भरपूर), Large (विशाल).

This word refers to something that exists in great quantity or is abundant. it is the direct and perfect antonym for exiguous, which means very small or scanty.
Synonyms: Abundant (प्रचुर मात्रा में), Ample (भरपूर), Copious (अत्यधिक).
Antonyms: Exiguous (अत्यल्प), Scarce (दुर्लभ), Meager (थोड़ा).

This word describes something that is thinly scattered or distributed. it is a synonym for the scanty or thin nature of exiguous and cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Scattered (विरल), Thin (पतला), Scanty (अल्प).
Antonyms: Dense (घना), Thick (मजबूत), Numerous (अनेक).

This word describes being inadequate in size or amount. like meager, it acts as a synonym for exiguous and does not provide the required opposite relationship.
Synonyms: Slight (अपर्याप्त), Meager (अल्प), Small (छोटा).
Antonyms: Profuse (प्रचुर), Extensive (व्यापक), Large (बड़ा).

test.instructions: Standard CBT Pattern Exam. Positive Marks: +1, Negative Marks: -0.25. Total Questions: 50.

test.title: Set - 19

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Transitory
questionsEn.s:
Transitory - क्षणिक (Something that lasts for a short duration)
Fleeting - क्षणिक (Lasting for a very short time)
Eternal - शाश्वत (Lasting forever or permanent)
Momentary - क्षणिक (Lasting for only a moment)
Temporary - अस्थायी (Not permanent; short-lived)
oa:
This word describes something that lasts for a very short time. it is a direct synonym for transitory and therefore does not provide the required opposite.
Synonyms: Ephemeral (क्षणिक), Brief (लघु), Momentary (क्षणिक).
Antonyms: Permanent (स्थायी), Eternal (अनंत), Long-lasting (टिकाऊ).

This word refers to something that lasts forever or is permanent. it is the direct and perfect antonym for transitory, which refers to short-lived states.
Synonyms: Everlasting (शाश्वत), Permanent (स्थायी), Perpetual (अविराम).
Antonyms: Transitory (क्षणिक), Temporary (अस्थायी), Fleeting (क्षणभंगुर).

This word refers to something that lasts for only a moment. it is a synonym for the temporary nature of transitory and cannot be its antonym.
Synonyms: Passing (क्षणिक), Transience (अस्थायी), Short-lived (अल्पकालिक).
Antonyms: Constant (निरंतर), Persistent (सतत), Enduring (स्थिर).

This word describes something that is not permanent. It is the primary synonym for transitory and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an opposite.
Synonyms: Provisional (अस्थायी), Short-term (अल्पकालिक), Transitory (क्षणिक).
Antonyms: Fixed (नियत), Permanent (स्थायी), Eternal (शाश्वत).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Nugatory
questionsEn.s:
Nugatory - नगण्य (Of no value or importance)
Worthless - बेकार (Having no real value or use)
Futile - व्यर्थ (Incapable of producing any result)
Significant - महत्वपूर्ण (Of great value or importance)
Trivial - तुच्छ (Of little importance or value)
oa:
This word means having no real value or use. it is a direct synonym for nugatory and therefore cannot be used as its opposite.
Synonyms: Useless (बेकार), Valueless (वर्थलेस), Hollow (सारहीन).
Antonyms: Valuable (मूल्यवान), Useful (उपयोगी), Worthy (योग्य).

This word describes something that is incapable of producing a result; it is a synonym for the ineffective nature of being nugatory.
Synonyms: Vain (व्यर्थ), Pointless (निरर्थक), Ineffective (बेकार).
Antonyms: Effective (प्रभावी), Fruitful (फलदायक), Productive (उत्पादक).

This word refers to something that is important, meaningful, or has value. it is the direct antonym for nugatory, which implies being of no importance.
Synonyms: Important (महत्वपूर्ण), Weighty (प्रभावशाली), Substantial (सार्थक).
Antonyms: Nugatory (नगण्य), Trivial (तुच्छ), Insignificant (महत्वहीन).

This word describes something that is of little importance or value. it is a direct synonym for nugatory and does not satisfy the requirement for an antonym.
Synonyms: Petty (तुच्छ), Minor (मामूली), Negligible (नगण्य).
Antonyms: Major (प्रमुख), Significant (महत्वपूर्ण), Essential (आवश्यक).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Vindicate
questionsEn.s:
Vindicate - निर्दोष ठहराना (To clear someone of blame or justify)
Justify - उचित ठहराना (To prove something to be right)
Carefree - निश्चिंत (Free from anxiety or stress)
Forgive - माफ़ करना (To stop feeling angry for an offense)
Accuse - आरोप लगाना (To charge someone with wrongdoing)
oa:
This word means to show or prove something to be right or reasonable. It is a direct synonym for vindicate and therefore cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Defend (उचित ठहराना), Warrant (प्रमाणित करना), Support (समर्थन करना).
Antonyms: Condemn (निंदा करना), Accuse (दोष देना), Refute (खंडन करना).

This word describes someone who is free from anxiety or stress. it refers to a personality trait or emotional state that is unrelated to the legal or moral act of vindicating someone.
Synonyms: Easy-going (निश्चिंत), Lighthearted (खुशमिजाज), Blithe (बेफिक्र).
Antonyms: Anxious (चिंतित), Stressed (तनावपूर्ण), Worried (परेशान).

This word means to stop feeling angry or resentful toward someone for an offense. While related to mercy, it is not a direct lexical antonym for the act of justifying or clearing a name.
Synonyms: Pardon (माफ़ करना), Absolve (क्षमा करना), Excuse (छोड़ना).
Antonyms: Resent (द्वेष करना), Punish (दंड देना), Condemn (निंदा करना).

This word means to charge someone with an offense or wrongdoing. it is the direct and perfect antonym for vindicating (clearing someone of blame).
Synonyms: Blame (आरोप लगाना), Indict (अभियुक्त करना), Charge (दोषारोपण).
Antonyms: Vindicate (निर्दोष ठहराना), Exonerate (बरी करना), Absolve (दोषमुक्त करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Dissemble
questionsEn.s:
Dissemble - छिपाना (To conceal one's true motives or beliefs)
Disguise - छिपाना (To conceal the appearance of something)
Reveal - प्रकट करना (To make something known that was hidden)
Obscure - धुंधला करना (To make something unclear or difficult to see)
Pretend - दिखावा करना (To behave as if something is true when it is not)
oa:
This word means to conceal the nature or appearance of something. it is a direct synonym for dissemble and therefore cannot be used as its opposite.
Synonyms: Mask (छिपाना), Conceal (ढकना), Camouflage (छलावरण करना).
Antonyms: Reveal (प्रकट करना), Expose (उजागर करना), Show (दिखाना).

This word means to make something known that was previously hidden or secret. it is the direct and perfect antonym for dissembling (hiding motives).
Synonyms: Disclose (प्रकट करना), Unveil (उजागर करना), Divulge (बताना).
Antonyms: Dissemble (छिपाना), Hide (गुप्तरखना), Mask (ढकना).

This word means to make something unclear or difficult to see. Like dissemble, it involve hiding the truth and thus acts as a synonym.
Synonyms: Blur (धुंधला करना), Hide (छिपाना), Cloud (अस्पष्ट करना).
Antonyms: Clarify (स्पष्ट करना), Illuminate (प्रकाश डालना), Explain (समझाना).

This word means to behave so as to make it appear that something is the case when it is not. it is a direct synonym for the act of dissembling.
Synonyms: Feign (दिखावा करना), Sham (ढोंग करना), Fake (नकली बनना).
Antonyms: Be real (वास्तविक होना), Authenticate (सच्चा होना), Assert (दावा करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Ostentatious
questionsEn.s:
Ostentatious - आडंबरपूर्ण (Characterized by pretentious display)
Modest - विनम्र (Humble, unassuming, or not showing off)
Showy - दिखावटी (Designed to attract notice; flashy)
Flashy - भड़कीला (Ostentatiously stylish or expensive)
Pretentious - दंभी (Affecting greater importance than is possessed)
oa:
This word describes being humble, unassuming, or moderate in behavior. it is the direct and most accurate antonym for being ostentatious (showing off).
Synonyms: Humble (विनम्र), Simple (साधारण), Unpretentious (विनीत).
Antonyms: Ostentatious (आडंबरपूर्ण), Showy (दिखावटी), Pretentious (दंभी).

This word describes having a striking or flashy appearance designed to attract notice. it is a direct synonym for ostentatious and therefore cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Flashy (दिखावटी), Gaudily (भड़कीला), Flamboyant (शानदार).
Antonyms: Plain (सादा), Modest (विनम्र), Subtle (सूक्ष्म).

This word refers to something that is ostentatiously stylish or expensive. Like "showy," it is a synonym for the given word and does not provide an antonym.
Synonyms: Garish (भड़कीला), Fancy (शानदार), Gaudy (आडंबरपूर्ण).
Antonyms: Dull (नीरस), Simple (सरल), Unadorned (बिना सजावट के).

This word describes attempting to impress by affecting greater importance than is possessed. it is a synonym for the negative aspect of being ostentatious.
Synonyms: Pompous (दंभी), Grandiose (भव्य), Affected (बनावटी).
Antonyms: Sincere (ईमानदार), Genuine (असली), Humble (विनम्र).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Impecunious
questionsEn.s:
Impecunious - निर्धन (Having little or no money; poor)
Insolvent - दिवालिया (Unable to pay debts owed)
Wealthy - धनी (Rich, affluent, and having abundance)
Indigent - निर्धन (Extremely poor and lacking necessities)
Penniless - कंगाल (Having no money at all)
oa:
This word describes someone who is unable to pay their debts. it is a synonym for the financial hardship implied by impecunious and cannot be its antonym.
Synonyms: Bankrupt (दिवालिया), Broke (कंगाल), Indigent (निर्धन).
Antonyms: Solvent (सक्षम), Wealthy (धनी), Rich (अमीर).

This word refers to someone who is rich, affluent, and has an abundance of money. it is the direct and perfect antonym for being impecunious (having little money).
Synonyms: Affluent (धनी), Rich (संपन्न), Prosperous (समृद्ध).
Antonyms: Impecunious (निर्धन), Poor (गरीब), Destitute (अभावग्रस्त).

This word describes being extremely poor and lacking basic necessities. it is a strong synonym for impecunious and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an opposite.
Synonyms: Penniless (निर्धन), Needy (ज़रूरतमंद), Destitute (कंगाल).
Antonyms: Wealthy (धनी), Rich (अमीर), Well-off (संपन्न).

This word means having no money at all. Like indigent, it is a synonym for impecunious and cannot provide the required antonym relationship.
Synonyms: Broke (कंगाल), Destitute (निर्धन), Impoverished (गरीब).
Antonyms: Opulent (वैभवशाली), Affluent (धनी), Moneyed (धनवान).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Pernicious
questionsEn.s:
Pernicious - हानिकारक (Highly harmful, destructive, or detrimental)
Harmful - हानिकारक (Something that causes damage or injury)
Innocuous - हानिरहित (Something not harmful or offensive)
Virulent - अत्यधिक विषैला (Extremely severe or harmful)
Noxious - हानिकारक (Harmful, poisonous, or very unpleasant)
oa:
This word means causing damage or injury. It is a primary definition and synonym for pernicious and therefore cannot be used as its antonym.
Synonyms: Damaging (हानिकारक), Detrimental (हानिकारक), Bad (बुरा).
Antonyms: Beneficial (लाभकारी), Helpful (सहायक), Advantageous (फायदेमंद).

This word refers to something that is not harmful or offensive. it is the direct and most accurate antonym for pernicious (highly harmful).
Synonyms: Harmless (हानिरहित), Safe (सुरक्षित), Benign (सौम्य).
Antonyms: Pernicious (हानिकारक), Dangerous (खतरनाक), Toxic (विषैला).

This word refers to something extremely severe or harmful in its effects. it is an intense synonym for pernicious and therefore not an antonym.
Synonyms: Poisonous (अत्यधिक विषैला), Lethal (घातक), Toxic (ज़हरीला).
Antonyms: Mild (हल्का), Harmless (अहानिकर), Weak (कमज़ोर).

This word describes something harmful, poisonous, or very unpleasant. It is a synonym for pernicious and does not satisfy the requirement for an opposite.
Synonyms: Toxic (हानिकारक), Foul (गंदा), Dangerous (खतरनाक).
Antonyms: Wholesome (पौष्टिक), Pure (शुद्ध), Healthy (स्वस्थ).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Lugubrious
questionsEn.s:
Lugubrious - उदास (Looking or sounding sad and dismal)
Joyous - हर्षित (Feeling, showing, or causing great happiness)
Mournful - शोकपूर्ण (Feeling or expressing sorrow or grief)
Gloomy - अंधकारमय (Dark, poorly lit, or causing sadness)
Sorrowful - दुखपूर्ण (Feeling or showing grief)
oa:
This word refers to feeling, showing, or causing great happiness. It serves as the direct emotional antonym for lugubrious (sounding sad and dismal).
Synonyms: Happy (हर्षित), Cheerful (आनंदमय), Merry (प्रसन्न).
Antonyms: Lugubrious (उदास), Gloomy (निराशाजनक), Sad (दुखी).

This word describes feeling or expressing sorrow or grief. it is a direct synonym for the dismal quality of being lugubrious and cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Sorrowful (शोकपूर्ण), Sad (दुखी), Doleful (शोकग्रस्त).
Antonyms: Joyful (हर्षित), Cheerful (खुश), Jubilant (प्रफुल्लित).

This word describes being dark, poorly lit, or causing a feeling of sadness. it is a synonym for the given word and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an antonym.
Synonyms: Somber (अंधकारमय), Dismal (निराशाजनक), Bleak (नीरस).
Antonyms: Bright (चमकीला), Sunny (धूपदार), Cheerful (प्रसन्न).

This word describes feeling or showing deep grief. it is a synonym for the sad nature of lugubrious rather than providing an opposite meaning.
Synonyms: Sad (दुखपूर्ण), Dejected (हताश), Miserable (दयनीय).
Antonyms: Joyous (हर्षित), Happy (खुश), Elated (उत्साहित).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Redolent
questionsEn.s:
Redolent - सुगंधित (Having a strong, pleasant smell)
Fragrant - सुगंधित (Having a pleasant or sweet smell)
Evocative - स्मरणीय (Bringing strong images or memories to mind)
Odorous - गंधयुक्त (Having or giving off a smell)
Unscented - गंधहीन (Having no smell or fragrance)
oa:
This word means having a pleasant or sweet smell. it is a direct synonym for the aromatic aspect of being redolent and therefore cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Aromatic (सुगंधित), Sweet-scented (खुशबूदार), Perfumed (इत्रदार).
Antonyms: Stinking (दुर्गंधयुक्त), Malodorous (बदबूदार), Unscented (गंधहीन).

This word means bringing strong images or memories to mind. while redolent can mean "suggestive of," evocative is a synonym for that specific sense rather than an antonym.
Synonyms: Suggestive (स्मरणीय), Reminiscent (याद दिलाने वाला), Vivid (जीवंत).
Antonyms: Forgettable (भूलने योग्य), Vague (अस्पष्ट), Dull (नीरस).

This word means having or giving off a smell, often a strong or unpleasant one. it refers to the presence of scent, making it a general synonym for the core nature of redolent.
Synonyms: Scented (गंधयुक्त), Smelly (बदबूदार), Pungent (तीखा).
Antonyms: Odorless (गंधहीन), Unscented (गंधरहित), Inodorous (गंधहीन).

This word refers to something that has no smell or fragrance. it is the direct physical antonym for redolent, which implies having a strong scent.
Synonyms: Odorless (गंधहीन), Fragrance-free (सुगंध रहित), Inodorous (गंधहीन).
Antonyms: Redolent (सुगंधित), Fragrant (खुशबूदार), Scented (गंधयुक्त).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Incipient
questionsEn.s:
Incipient - आरंभिक (In its initial stage; beginning to emerge)
Nascent - जन्म लेते हुए (Just beginning or emerging)
Developing - विकासशील (Growing or advancing but not yet mature)
Advanced - विकसित (Far along in development or progress)
Budding - पल्लवित (Beginning to show promise or potential)
oa:
This word refers to something that is just beginning or emerging. It is a direct synonym for incipient and therefore does not provide the required opposite relationship.
Synonyms: Beginning (जन्म लेते हुए), Initial (आरंभिक), Fledgling (नया).
Antonyms: Dying (समाप्त), Mature (परिपक्व), Old (पुराना).

This word describes something that is growing or advancing. While it implies progress, it refers to the early stages of a process, making it a near-synonym for incipient.
Synonyms: Growing (विकासशील), Progressing (अग्रसर), Evolving (विकसित हो रहा).
Antonyms: Receding (पीछे हटना), Stagnating (स्थिर), Waning (कम होना).

This word refers to something that is far along in development, progress, or maturity. It is the direct antonym for incipient, which means being in the initial stage.
Synonyms: Mature (विकसित), Developed (उन्नत), Sophisticated (जटिल).
Antonyms: Incipient (आरंभिक), Basic (बुनियादी), Elementary (प्राथमिक).

This word refers to something beginning to show promise or potential. it is a metaphorical synonym for incipient (like a flower bud) and cannot be its antonym.
Synonyms: Emerging (पल्लवित), Potential (संभावित), Promising (आशाजनक).
Antonyms: Fading (मुरझाना), Withered (सूखा हुआ), Dying (मरना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Pulverize
questionsEn.s:
Pulverize - चूर्ण करना (To crush or grind into fine particles)
Crumble - टुकड़े-टुकड़े करना (To break into small pieces)
Shatter - चकनाचूर करना (To break suddenly into many pieces)
Restore - बहाल करना (To bring back to original state)
Crush - कुचलना (To deform or pulverize by pressure)
oa:
This word means to break or cause to break into small pieces. It describes a similar action of destruction and therefore acts as a synonym rather than an antonym.
Synonyms: Fragment (टुकड़े-टुकड़े करना), Disintegrate (विघटित होना), Decay (सड़ना).
Antonyms: Build (बनाना), Construct (निर्माण करना), Unite (जोड़ना).

This word means to break suddenly into many small pieces. it is a direct synonym for the crushing action of pulverize and cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Smash (चकनाचूर करना), Break (तोड़ना), Crack (चटकाना).
Antonyms: Mend (मरम्मत करना), Repair (ठीक करना), Fix (जोड़ना).

This word means to bring something back to its original state or condition. It is the perfect antonym for pulverize, which involves breaking something into fine particles.
Synonyms: Repair (ठीक करना), Reinstate (बहाल करना), Renovate (नवीनीकरण करना).
Antonyms: Pulverize (चूर्ण करना), Destroy (नष्ट करना), Demolish (ध्वस्त करना).

This word means to deform, pulverize, or force out of shape by pressure. it is the primary synonym for pulverize and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an antonym.
Synonyms: Grind (पीसना), Mash (कुचलना), Squash (दबाना).
Antonyms: Expand (फैलाना), Restore (बहाल करना), Shape (आकार देना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Recalcitrance
questionsEn.s:
Recalcitrance - अड़ियलपन (Defiance or rebellious attitude to authority)
Defiance - उल्लंघन (Open resistance or bold disobedience)
Compliance - अनुपालन (Agreeing or conforming to rules)
Resistance - विरोध (The refusal to accept or comply)
Rebellion - विद्रोह (Violent or open resistance to order)
oa:
This word refers to open resistance or bold disobedience. It is a direct synonym for recalcitrance and therefore cannot satisfy the requirement for an opposite.
Synonyms: Rebellion (उल्लंघन), Resistance (विरोध), Obstinacy (हठ).
Antonyms: Compliance (अनुपालन), Submission (समर्पण), Obedience (आज्ञाकारिता).

This word refers to the act of conforming to a rule or agreeing to a request. It is the direct and logical antonym for recalcitrance, which implies defiance.
Synonyms: Obedience (अनुपालन), Agreement (सहमति), Submission (समर्पण).
Antonyms: Recalcitrance (अड़ियलपन), Defiance (उल्लंघन), Rebellion (विद्रोह).

This word means the refusal to accept or comply with something. it is a direct synonym for recalcitrance and does not provide the required antonym relationship.
Synonyms: Opposition (विरोध), Obstruction (बाधा), Defiance (चुनौती).
Antonyms: Acceptance (स्वीकृति), Compliance (अनुपालन), Cooperation (सहयोग).

This word refers to an act of violent or open resistance to an established ruler or order. It is a strong synonym for recalcitrance and not its opposite.
Synonyms: Revolt (विद्रोह), Insurgence (बगावत), Uprising (विद्रोह).
Antonyms: Loyalty (निष्ठा), Allegiance (वफादारी), Obedience (आज्ञाकारिता).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Torpor
questionsEn.s:
Torpor - जड़ता (A state of physical or mental inactivity)
Stupor - जड़ता (A state of near-unconsciousness)
Liveliness - जीवंतता (The quality of being energetic and full of life)
Sluggishness - सुस्ती (Moving or working slower than normal)
Inertia - जड़ता (Tendency to remain unchanged or do nothing)
oa:
This word refers to a state of near-unconsciousness or insensibility. It is a synonym for the lethargic or inactive nature of torpor and cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Daze (जड़ता), Trance (समाधि), Oblivion (बेहोशी).
Antonyms: Alertness (सजगता), Consciousness (चेतना), Vitality (स्फूर्ति).

This word refers to the quality of being outgoing, energetic, and full of life. It is the direct and perfect antonym for torpor, which implies physical or mental inactivity.
Synonyms: Energy (ऊर्जा), Vigor (जोश), Vitality (जीवंतता).
Antonyms: Torpor (जड़ता), Lethargy (सुस्ती), Apathy (उदासीनता).

This word describes moving or working more slowly than normal. it is a direct synonym for torpor and therefore does not provide the required antonym relationship.
Synonyms: Inactivity (सुस्ती), Dullness (मंदता), Indolence (आलस्य).
Antonyms: Alacrity (फुर्ती), Quickness (तेज़ी), Speed (गति).

This word refers to a tendency to do nothing or to remain unchanged. it is a synonym for the resistance to motion found in torpor rather than being its antonym.
Synonyms: Passivity (जड़ता), Stagnation (स्थिरता), Quiescence (शांति).
Antonyms: Momentum (गति), Action (कार्य), Change (परिवर्तन).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Prosaic
questionsEn.s:
Prosaic - सामान्य (Dull, ordinary, or lacking imagination)
Imaginative - कल्पनाशील (Creative, original, or full of ideas)
Banal - घिसा-पिटा (Lacking in originality; boring)
Ordinary - साधारण (With no special or distinctive features)
Dull - नीरस (Not interesting or exciting)
oa:
This word refers to being creative, original, or full of new ideas. it is the direct intellectual opposite of prosaic, which means dull, ordinary, or lacking imagination.
Synonyms: Creative (कल्पनाशील), Inventive (अविष्कारशील), Original (मौलिक).
Antonyms: Prosaic (सामान्य), Dull (नीरस), Mundane (साधारण).

This word refers to something so lacking in originality as to be obvious and boring. it is a direct synonym for the humdrum nature of being prosaic.
Synonyms: Trite (घिसा-पिटा), Ordinary (साधारण), Commonplace (मामूली).
Antonyms: Unique (अद्वितीय), Rare (दुर्लभ), Exceptional (असाधारण).

This word describes something with no special or distinctive features. It is the primary synonym for prosaic and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an antonym.
Synonyms: Normal (साधारण), Usual (सामान्य), Typical (विशिष्ट).
Antonyms: Extraordinary (असाधारण), Unusual (असामान्य), Remarkable (उल्लेखनीय).

This word describes something that is not interesting or exciting. It is a synonym for the uninspiring quality of being prosaic and cannot provide the required opposite.
Synonyms: Boring (नीरस), Monotonous (एकरस), Dreary (सुस्त).
Antonyms: Exciting (रोमांचक), Vivid (जीवंत), Sparkling (चमकीला).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Palliate
questionsEn.s:
Palliate - शांत करना (To reduce the severity of something)
Worsen - बिगाड़ना (To make something worse or more severe)
Alleviate - हल्का करना (To make suffering less severe)
Mitigate - कम करना (To make something less serious or painful)
Ease - आराम (To make something less difficult or painful)
oa:
This word means to make something (like a problem or condition) worse or more severe. It is the direct antonym for palliate, which involves reducing severity.
Synonyms: Aggravate (बिगाड़ना), Exacerbate (बदतर करना), Inflame (भड़काना).
Antonyms: Palliate (शांत करना), Alleviate (हल्का करना), Mitigate (कम करना).

This word means to make suffering or a problem less severe. it is a direct synonym for palliate and therefore cannot be used as its opposite.
Synonyms: Relieve (हल्का करना), Ease (आराम देना), Soothe (शांत करना).
Antonyms: Worsen (बिगाड़ना), Intensify (तीव्र करना), Aggravate (बढ़ाना).

This word means to make something less severe, serious, or painful. like alleviate, it is a synonym for palliate and does not provide an antonym relationship.
Synonyms: Soften (कम करना), Allay (शांत करना), Abate (घटाना).
Antonyms: Increase (बढ़ाना), Heighten (तीव्र करना), Exasperate (ख़राब करना).

This word means to make something less difficult or painful. it describes the act of relief, which is the same meaning as palliate, making it a synonym.
Synonyms: Assuage (आराम देना), Facilitate (सुगम बनाना), Lighten (हल्का करना).
Antonyms: Complicate (जटिल बनाना), Burden (बोझ डालना), Obstruct (बाधा डालना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Harbinger
questionsEn.s:
Harbinger - अग्रदूत (Person or thing that signals an approach)
Catalyst - उत्प्रेरक (Person or thing that precipitates change)
Precursor - पूर्वगामी (Something that comes before another)
Follower - अनुयायी (Someone who comes after or adheres to a leader)
Trailblazer - पथप्रदर्शक (Person who is the first to do something)
oa:
This word refers to a person or thing that precipitates an event or change. While it relates to the start of something, it is more of a functional synonym or related term than an opposite.
Synonyms: Trigger (उत्प्रेरक), Incentive (प्रोत्साहन), Stimulus (प्रोत्साहन).
Antonyms: Inhibitor (बाधक), Preventer (रोकने वाला), Blocker (अवरोधक).

This word refers to a person or thing that comes before another of the same kind. It is a direct synonym for harbinger and therefore cannot be its antonym.
Synonyms: Forerunner (पूर्वगामी), Herald (संदेशवाहक), Ancestor (पूर्वज).
Antonyms: Successor (उत्तराधिकारी), Follower (अनुयायी), Result (परिणाम).

This word refers to someone or something that comes after or adheres to a leader. it serves as the conceptual opposite of a harbinger, who signals the start or leads.
Synonyms: Disciple (अनुयायी), Supporter (समर्थक), Adherent (अनुगामी).
Antonyms: Harbinger (अग्रदूत), Leader (नेता), Pioneer (मार्गदर्शक).

This word refers to a person who is the first to do something; an innovator. it is a synonym for the "leading" or "forerunner" aspect of being a harbinger.
Synonyms: Pioneer (पथप्रदर्शक), Innovator (नवाचारक), Pathbreaker (मार्गदर्शक).
Antonyms: Follower (अनुयायी), Imitator (नकल करने वाला), Latecomer (देर से आने वाला).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Munificent
questionsEn.s:
Munificent - उदार (Extremely generous or liberal in giving)
Lavish - शानदार (Rich, elaborate, or luxurious)
Generous - उदार (Willing to give more than expected)
Stingy - कंजूस (Unwilling to spend or give; miserly)
Benevolent - परोपकारी (Well-meaning and kindly)
oa:
This word refers to something that is sumptuously rich, elaborate, or luxurious. it describes a high level of giving or spending and is a synonym for munificent.
Synonyms: Generous (शानदार), Extravagant (खर्चीला), Bountiful (प्रचुर).
Antonyms: Frugal (मितव्ययी), Scanty (अल्प), Meager (थोड़ा).

This word describes a readiness to give more than is necessary or expected. it is the most common synonym for munificent and cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Magnanimous (उदार), Charitable (दानशील), Openhanded (खुले दिल का).
Antonyms: Mean (मतलबी), Stingy (कंजूस), Selfish (स्वार्थी).

This word refers to someone who is unwilling to spend or give; they are miserly. It is the direct and perfect antonym for being munificent (extremely generous).
Synonyms: Miserly (कंजूस), Parsimonious (मितव्ययी), Mingy (तुच्छ).
Antonyms: Munificent (उदार), Generous (दानी), Bountiful (प्रचुर).

This word refers to being well-meaning and kindly. while it is a positive moral quality, it is a synonym for the goodwill found in a munificent person.
Synonyms: Kind (परोपकारी), Compassionate (दयालु), Altruistic (निःस्वार्थ).
Antonyms: Malevolent (दुर्भावनापूर्ण), Malicious (दुष्ट), Spiteful (द्वेषी).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Quell
questionsEn.s:
Quell - शांत करना (To suppress or put an end to by force)
Suppress - दबाना (To put an end to something by force)
Provoke - उकसाना (To stimulate or incite a strong reaction)
Subdue - वश में करना (To bring under control using force)
Restrain - नियंत्रित करना (To hold back or keep under control)
oa:
This word means to put an end to something, often by force. It is a direct synonym for quell and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an opposite.
Synonyms: Quash (दबाना), Subdue (वश में करना), Quell (शांत करना).
Antonyms: Incite (उकसाना), Provoke (भड़काना), Encourage (प्रोत्साहित करना).

This word means to stimulate, incite, or arouse anger and strong reactions. It is the direct antonym for quell, which involves calming or putting an end to a situation.
Synonyms: Instigate (उकसाना), Stimulate (उत्तेजित करना), Inflame (भड़काना).
Antonyms: Quell (शांत करना), Appease (संतुष्ट करना), Pacify (शांत करना).

This word means to bring a person or area under control, usually by force. It is a synonym for the action described by quell and cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Conquer (वश में करना), Overpower (हराना), Restrain (नियंत्रित करना).
Antonyms: Liberate (मुक्त करना), Release (आजाद करना), Incite (भड़काना).

This word means to hold back or keep someone or something under control. while it describes the act of limiting, it is a synonym for the intent of quelling rather than an antonym.
Synonyms: Check (नियंत्रित करना), Curb (रोकना), Inhibit (बाधित करना).
Antonyms: Release (मुक्त करना), Permit (अनुमति देना), Encourage (प्रोत्साहित करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Esoteric
questionsEn.s:
Esoteric - गूढ़ (Understood by only a small number of people)
Obscure - अस्पष्ट (Something unclear, uncertain, or not well known)
Straight Forward - सीधा-सादा (Simple, easy to understand, and direct)
Cryptic - गूढ़ (Having a meaning that is mysterious)
Abstract - सार (Existing in thought, not physical)
oa:
This word refers to something that is unclear, uncertain, or not well known. it is a direct synonym for the difficult or hidden nature of esoteric knowledge.
Synonyms: Abstruse (अस्पष्ट), Mysterious (रहस्यमय), Cryptic (गूढ़).
Antonyms: Clear (स्पष्ट), Obvious (प्रत्यक्ष), Manifest (प्रकट).

This word refers to something that is simple, easy to understand, and direct. it is the direct antonym for esoteric, which implies specialized and difficult concepts.
Synonyms: Simple (सीधा-सादा), Clear (स्पष्ट), Direct (प्रत्यक्ष).
Antonyms: Esoteric (गूढ़), Complex (जटिल), Convoluted (पेचीदा).

This word means having a meaning that is mysterious or obscure. like esoteric, it describes things that are intentionally or naturally hard to decode, making it a synonym.
Synonyms: Enigmatic (गूढ़), Arcane (रहस्यमय), Hidden (गुप्त).
Antonyms: Plain (सादा), Explicit (स्पष्ट), Obvious (प्रत्यक्ष).

This word refers to something that exists as an idea but does not have a physical existence. While related to intellectual depth, it does not provide an opposite for the "specialized" nature of esoteric.
Synonyms: Theoretical (सार), Conceptual (वैचारिक), Intangible (अमूर्त).
Antonyms: Concrete (ठोस), Physical (शारीरिक), Tangible (स्पृश्य).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Perfidious
questionsEn.s:
Perfidious - धोखेबाज (Deceitful and untrustworthy)
Betraying - धोखा देना (Act of being disloyal)
Faithless - अविश्वासी (Lacking loyalty or trustworthiness)
Loyal - वफादार (Faithful, devoted, and trustworthy)
Treacherous - धोखेबाज (Guilty of betrayal or deception)
oa:
This word refers to the act of being disloyal or breaking trust. it is a primary definition and synonym for being perfidious and therefore not an antonym.
Synonyms: Treacherous (धोखा देना), False (बेवफा), Faithless (अविश्वासी).
Antonyms: Loyal (वफादार), Faithful (नियत), Devoted (समर्पित).

This word describes lacking loyalty or being untrustworthy. it is a direct synonym for perfidious and cannot satisfy the requirement for an opposite.
Synonyms: Untrustworthy (अविश्वासी), Shifty (चंचल), Unreliable (अविश्वसनीय).
Antonyms: Faithful (विश्वासी), True (सच्चा), Reliable (भरोसेमंद).

This word refers to someone who is faithful, devoted, and trustworthy. It is the direct and perfect antonym for perfidious, which means deceitful and untrustworthy.
Synonyms: Faithful (वफादार), Constant (अटल), Devoted (समर्पित).
Antonyms: Perfidious (धोखेबाज), Treacherous (विश्वासघाती), Disloyal (बेवफ़ा).

This word describes being guilty of or involving betrayal or deception. It is another direct synonym for perfidious rather than an antonym.
Synonyms: Perfidious (धोखेबाज), Deceitful (छली), Double-crossing (कपटी).
Antonyms: Trustworthy (विश्वासपात्र), Honest (ईमानदार), Loyal (निष्ठावान).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Puissant
questionsEn.s:
Puissant - शक्तिशाली (Powerful, strong, or mighty)
Feeble - अशक्त (Weak or lacking strength)
Robust - मजबूत (Strong and healthy; vigorous)
Powerful - शक्तिशाली (Having great power or strength)
Strong - मजबूत (Possessing physical or mental power)
oa:
This word refers to being weak or lacking strength. It is the direct antonym for puissant, which means powerful, strong, or mighty.
Synonyms: Weak (कमज़ोर), Frail (दुर्बल), Powerless (अशक्त).
Antonyms: Puissant (शक्तिशाली), Mighty (मजबूत), Robust (तगड़ा).

This word refers to being strong and healthy or vigorous. it is a direct synonym for the power and strength implied by puissant and cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Strong (मजबूत), Sturdy (तगड़ा), Vigorous (ऊर्जावान).
Antonyms: Weak (कमज़ोर), Frail (दुर्बल), Feeble (अशक्त).

This word means having great power or strength. It is a literal definition and synonym for puissant and therefore does not provide the required opposite.
Synonyms: Mighty (शक्तिशाली), Puissant (बलवान), Potent (प्रभावी).
Antonyms: Impotent (अशक्त), Ineffective (बेकार), Weak (निर्बल).

This word describes possessing physical or mental power. Like the previous two options, it is a synonym for puissant rather than an antonym.
Synonyms: Robust (मजबूत), Tough (कठोर), Hardy (सहनशील).
Antonyms: Feeble (अशक्त), Fragile (नाजुक), Weak (कमज़ोर).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Erudite
questionsEn.s:
Erudite - विद्वान (Having or showing great knowledge)
Scholarly - विद्वत्तापूर्ण (Pertaining to serious academic study)
Uninformed - अज्ञानी (Lacking knowledge or awareness)
Learned - पंडित (Having profound knowledge acquired by study)
Intellectual - बौद्धिक (Relating to mental capacity and understanding)
oa:
This word pertains to serious academic study or learning. it is a direct synonym for the educated nature of an erudite person and cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Learned (विद्वत्तापूर्ण), Academic (अकादमिक), Intellectual (बौद्धिक).
Antonyms: Ignorant (अज्ञानी), Illiterate (निरक्षर), Uneducated (अशिक्षित).

This word refers to someone lacking knowledge, education, or awareness. It is the direct and most accurate antonym for erudite (having great learning).
Synonyms: Ignorant (अज्ञानी), Unaware (अनजान), Illiterate (अनपढ़).
Antonyms: Erudite (विद्वान), Learned (ज्ञानी), Informed (सूचित).

This word describes having profound knowledge acquired by study. it is a primary synonym for erudite and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an antonym.
Synonyms: Erudite (पंडित), Educated (शिक्षित), Scholarly (विद्वान).
Antonyms: Ignorant (अज्ञानी), Untrained (अप्रशिक्षित), Simple (साधारण).

This word relates to the intellect or mental capacity to understand complex ideas. while it is a positive trait, it acts as a synonym for erudite rather than an opposite.
Synonyms: Brainy (बौद्धिक), Wise (बुद्धिमान), Cerebral (दिमागी).
Antonyms: Foolish (मूर्ख), Shallow (सतही), Unintelligent (निर्बुद्धि).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Encomium
questionsEn.s:
Encomium - प्रशंसा (A speech or piece of writing that warmly praises)
Panegyric - प्रशंसा स्तुति (Public speech in praise of something)
Praise - प्रशंसा (Expression of approval or admiration)
Castigation - फटकार (Severe criticism or punishment)
Tribute - श्रद्धांजलि (Statement intended to show respect)
oa:
This word refers to a public speech or published text in praise of someone. it is a direct synonym for encomium and therefore cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Tribute (प्रशंसा स्तुति), Eulogy (प्रशंसा), Accolade (सम्मान).
Antonyms: Censure (निंदा), Vituperation (गाली-गलौज), Criticism (आलोचना).

This word refers to an expression of approval or admiration. it is the general definition of encomium and acts as its synonym rather than an antonym.
Synonyms: Commendation (प्रशंसा), Applause (सराहना), Honor (आदर).
Antonyms: Blame (दोष), Disapproval (अस्वीकृति), Scorn (तिरस्कार).

This word means severe criticism or punishment, often as a corrective measure. it is the direct and perfect antonym for encomium (warm praise).
Synonyms: Reprimand (फटकार), Censure (निंदा), Scolding (डांट).
Antonyms: Encomium (प्रशंसा), Praise (तारीफ़), Approval (मंजूरी).

This word refers to an act or statement intended to show gratitude or respect. it is another synonym for encomium and does not satisfy the required opposite relationship.
Synonyms: Homage (श्रद्धांजलि), Recognition (मान्यता), Testimonial (प्रशंसापत्र).
Antonyms: Insult (अपमान), Neglect (उपेक्षा), Disdain (तिरस्कार).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Evanescent
questionsEn.s:
Evanescent - क्षणिक/अस्थायी (Quickly fading or disappearing)
Ephemeral - क्षणभंगुर (Something that lasts for a very short time)
Transient - क्षणिक (Something temporary or short-lived)
Enduring - स्थायी (Lasting, permanent, or continuing over time)
Fleeting - क्षणिक (Something that passes quickly)
oa:
This word refers to something that lasts for a very short period of time. it is a direct synonym for evanescent and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an opposite.
Synonyms: Short-lived (क्षणभंगुर), Fleeting (अस्थायी), Passing (क्षणिक).
Antonyms: Permanent (स्थायी), Lasting (टिकाऊ), Constant (नियत).

This word describes something that is temporary or short-lived. like ephemeral, it is a synonym for the fleeting nature of evanescent rather than its opposite.
Synonyms: Fugacious (क्षणिक), Momentary (क्षणिक), Impermanent (अस्थायी).
Antonyms: Enduring (स्थायी), Persistent (सतत), Eternal (अनंत).

This word refers to something that is lasting, permanent, or continuing over time. It is the direct and perfect antonym for evanescent (vanishing quickly).
Synonyms: Permanent (स्थायी), Lasting (टिकाऊ), Perpetual (अनंत).
Antonyms: Evanescent (क्षणिक), Fleeting (क्षणभंगुर), Transient (अस्थायी).

This word describes something that passes quickly or is momentary. it is a direct synonym for the given word and cannot provide the antonym required.
Synonyms: Brief (क्षणिक), Fugitive (अस्थायी), Vanishing (गायब होने वाला).
Antonyms: Continuous (लगातार), Stable (स्थिर), Enduring (स्थायी).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Lachrymose
questionsEn.s:
Lachrymose - उदास/रोने वाला (Tearful or mournful)
Tearful - आँसू भरा (Prone to weeping or causing tears)
Mournful - शोकपूर्ण (Feeling or expressing sorrow or grief)
Weepy - रोने वाला (Tearful or inclined to cry easily)
Jovial - प्रसन्न (Cheerful, happy, and friendly)
oa:
This word means prone to weeping or causing tears. It is the primary definition and synonym for lachrymose and therefore cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Weeping (आँसू भरा), Sad (दुखी), Mournful (शोकपूर्ण).
Antonyms: Cheerful (हर्षित), Happy (खुश), Jubilant (प्रफुल्लित).

This word describes feeling or expressing sorrow or grief. It is a synonym for the sad and tearful quality of being lachrymose.
Synonyms: Sorrowful (शोकपूर्ण), Doleful (शोकग्रस्त), Lugubrious (उदास).
Antonyms: Joyful (हर्षित), Merry (प्रसन्न), Radiant (प्रफुल्लित).

This word describes being tearful or inclined to cry easily. it is an informal synonym for lachrymose and does not provide an antonym.
Synonyms: Crying (रोने वाला), Emotional (भावुक), Teary (सजल).
Antonyms: Stoic (शांत), Unmoved (अविचलित), Joyous (आनंदित).

This word refers to being cheerful, friendly, and full of happiness. it is the direct emotional and behavioral antonym for lachrymose (tearful/sad).
Synonyms: Cheerful (हर्षित), Happy (खुश), Merry (प्रसन्न).
Antonyms: Lachrymose (उदास), Gloomy (निराशाजनक), Morose (चिड़चिड़ा).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Subterfuge
questionsEn.s:
Subterfuge - छल-कपट (Deceit used to achieve one's goal)
Chicanery - धोखा (Use of trickery for a purpose)
Candor - स्पष्टता (The quality of being open and honest)
Trickery - छल (Practice of using deceptive methods)
Deception - धोखा (The action of deceiving someone)
oa:
This word refers to the use of trickery to achieve a legal or political purpose. it is a direct synonym for subterfuge and therefore cannot be used as its opposite.
Synonyms: Deception (धोखा), Trickery (छल-कपट), Artifice (चालाकी).
Antonyms: Honesty (ईमानदारी), Candor (निष्पक्षता), Frankness (स्पष्टता).

This word refers to the quality of being open, honest, and sincere in expression. It is the direct antonym for subterfuge, which involves deceit and trickery.
Synonyms: Honesty (ईमानदारी), Frankness (स्पष्टता), Sincerity (निष्कपटता).
Antonyms: Subterfuge (छल-कपट), Deception (धोखा), Trickery (चालबाजी).

This word means the practice of using deceptive methods to achieve something. it is a primary definition and synonym for the word subterfuge.
Synonyms: Deceit (छल), Guile (धोखा), Cunning (चालाकी).
