Antonyms: Integrity (सत्यनिष्ठा), Truthfulness (सच्चाई), Openness (खुलापन).

This word means the action of deceiving someone. it is another direct synonym for subterfuge and does not satisfy the requirement for an opposite.
Synonyms: Fraud (धोखा), Sham (बनावटी), Falsehood (असत्य).
Antonyms: Reality (वास्तविकता), Fact (सत्य), Candor (स्पष्टता).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Extirpate
questionsEn.s:
Extirpate - जड़ से उखाड़ना (To completely destroy or eradicate)
Exterminate - समाप्त करना (To destroy completely; kill)
Establish - स्थापित करना (To set up or create permanently)
Uproot - जड़ से उखाड़ना (To pull out by the roots)
Eradicate - समूल नष्ट करना (To destroy or eliminate completely)
oa:
This word means to destroy completely, often used for pests or enemies. it is a direct synonym for extirpate and cannot provide the required opposite relationship.
Synonyms: Eradicate (समाप्त करना), Annihilate (नष्ट करना), Eliminate (खत्म करना).
Antonyms: Save (बचाना), Protect (रक्षा करना), Build (बनाना).

This word means to set up or create something on a firm and permanent basis. it is the direct antonym for extirpating (rooting out and destroying).
Synonyms: Create (स्थापित करना), Found (नींव डालना), Institute (आरंभ करना).
Antonyms: Extirpate (उखाड़ना), Destroy (नष्ट करना), Demolish (ध्वस्त करना).

This word means to pull something out by the roots or completely remove it. it is a literal synonym for extirpate and therefore not an antonym.
Synonyms: Extirpate (जड़ से उखाड़ना), Extract (निकालना), Displace (हटाना).
Antonyms: Plant (लगाना), Settle (स्थिर करना), Establish (स्थापित करना).

This word means to destroy or eliminate something completely. it is the primary synonym for extirpate and does not satisfy the requirement for an opposite.
Synonyms: Exterminate (समूल नष्ट करना), Remove (मिटाना), Quash (कुचलना).
Antonyms: Foster (बढ़ावा देना), Nurture (पोषित करना), Construct (बनाना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Placatory
questionsEn.s:
Placatory - शांत कराने वाला (Intended to calm or pacify)
Provocative - उकसाने वाला (Causing anger or strong reaction)
Conciliatory - समझौता कराने वाला (Intended to pacify or make peace)
Soothing - शांतिदायक (Having a calming or comforting effect)
Appeasing - मनाने वाला (Trying to calm by giving in to demands)
oa:
This word means causing anger, irritation, or a strong reaction. it serves as the direct antonym for placatory, which involves trying to calm or pacify someone.
Synonyms: Inflammatory (भड़काने वाला), Agitating (उत्तेजक), Offensive (आक्रामक).
Antonyms: Placatory (शांत करने वाला), Soothing (सुखद), Pacifying (शांत).

This word describes being intended to pacify or make peace. it is a direct synonym for placatory and therefore cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Appeasing (समझौता कराने वाला), Peaceable (शांतिपूर्ण), Placatory (शांतिदायक).
Antonyms: Hostile (शत्रुतापूर्ण), Antagonistic (विरोधी), Aggressive (आक्रामक).

This word describes having a calming or comforting effect. it is another synonym for the calming nature of being placatory rather than an opposite.
Synonyms: Reassuring (शांतिदायक), Calming (आराम देने वाला), Mild (नरम).
Antonyms: Irritating (चिड़चिड़ा), Harsh (कठोर), Agitating (परेशान करने वाला).

This word means trying to calm someone by giving in to their demands. it is a synonym for the intent of a placatory action and is not an antonym.
Synonyms: Mollifying (मनाने वाला), Pacifying (शांत कराने वाला), Yielding (झुकने वाला).
Antonyms: Defiant (अवज्ञाकारी), Provocative (उकसाने वाला), Challenging (चुनौतीपूर्ण).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Fulsome
questionsEn.s:
Fulsome - अत्यधिक (Excessive or insincere in praise)
Restrained - संयमित (Characterized by reserve or moderation)
Sincere - ईमानदार (Being genuine, honest, and free from pretense)
Subtle - सूक्ष्म (Delicate or precise, not obvious)
Moderate - मध्यम (Avoiding extremes; average or balanced)
oa:
This word means characterized by reserve or moderation. while it describes a lack of excess, it is less common as a direct lexical antonym for the insincere nature of fulsome praise than "sincere."
Synonyms: Moderate (संयमित), Controlled (नियंत्रित), Muted (धीमा).
Antonyms: Excessive (अत्यधिक), Extreme (चरम), Fulsome (अतिशयोक्तिपूर्ण).

This word refers to being genuine, honest, and free from pretense. it is the direct antonym for fulsome, which implies excessive and insincere flattery.
Synonyms: Honest (ईमानदार), Genuine (सच्चा), Candid (स्पष्ट).
Antonyms: Fulsome (चापलूसी पूर्ण), Hypocritical (पाखंडी), Deceitful (धोखेबाज).

This word describes something delicate or precise and not obvious. While it is the opposite of "excessive" in style, it refers to nuance rather than the moral honesty of a statement.
Synonyms: Nuanced (सूक्ष्म), Faint (हल्का), Elusive (बारीक).
Antonyms: Blatant (साफ), Obvious (स्पष्ट), Crude (अशिष्ट).

This word means avoiding extremes and being average or balanced. like restrained, it addresses the lack of excess but is not the perfect thematic opposite for insincerity.
Synonyms: Temperate (मध्यम), Average (सामान्य), Balanced (संतुलित).
Antonyms: Excessive (अत्यधिक), Extreme (चरम), Immoderate (अतिशयोक्तिपूर्ण).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Virtual
questionsEn.s:
Virtual - वास्तविकता में नहीं (Almost or nearly as described, not actual)
Fundamental - मूलभूत (Serving as an essential component)
Implied - निहित (Suggested without being expressed)
Indirect - अप्रत्यक्ष (Not directly resulting from something)
Authentic - प्रामाणिक (Genuine and real, not false or copied)
oa:
This word refers to serving as an essential component or a basic principle. it describes importance rather than the distinction between simulated and real existence.
Synonyms: Basic (मूलभूत), Essential (अनिवार्य), Key (मुख्य).
Antonyms: Secondary (गौण), Peripheral (सतही), Minor (तुच्छ).

This word refers to something suggested without being directly expressed. while virtual things are "nearly" real, "implied" is a synonym for that which is not explicit, not an opposite.
Synonyms: Suggested (निहित), Tacit (अप्रत्यक्ष), Inferred (अनुमानित).
Antonyms: Explicit (स्पष्ट), Stated (व्यक्त), Direct (सीधा).

This word describes something not directly caused by or resulting from something. It refers to the manner of a result rather than the authenticity of existence.
Synonyms: Roundabout (अप्रत्यक्ष), Circuitous (घुमावदार), Oblique (तिरछा).
Antonyms: Direct (सीधा), Immediate (तत्काल), Straight (स्पष्ट).

This word refers to something that is genuine, real, and not a copy. It serves as the perfect antonym for virtual, which implies being "almost" but not truly as described.
Synonyms: Genuine (प्रामाणिक), Real (वास्तविक), True (सत्य).
Antonyms: Virtual (कल्पनाशील), Fake (नकली), Spurious (जाली).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Rustic
questionsEn.s:
Rustic - ग्राम्य (Pertaining to the countryside; rural or simple)
Homely - घरेलू (Associated with domestic life or simple)
Simple - सादगी (Not complicated or easy to understand)
Urban - शहरी (Relating to or characteristic of a city)
Plain - साधारण (Not decorated or elaborate; simple)
oa:
This word refers to something characteristic of domestic life or simple and plain. it is a synonym for the simple and rural aspect of being rustic.
Synonyms: Domestic (घरेलू), Simple (सादा), Cozy (आरामदायक).
Antonyms: Sophisticated (दुनियादार), Urban (शहरी), Fancy (शानदार).

This word means not complicated or easy to understand. it is a primary characteristic of a rustic lifestyle and therefore acts as its synonym rather than its antonym.
Synonyms: Plain (सादगी), Basic (मामूली), Uncomplicated (सरल).
Antonyms: Complex (जटिल), Intricate (पेचीदा), Grandiose (भव्य).

This word refers to something relating to or characteristic of a city or town. it is the direct situational and geographic antonym for rustic (rural).
Synonyms: Metropolitan (शहरी), Civic (नागरिक), Municipal (नगरपालिका).
Antonyms: Rustic (ग्राम्य), Rural (देहाती), Country (ग्रामीण).

This word describes something not decorated or elaborate. like "homely," it is a synonym for the unadorned quality of being rustic rather than its opposite.
Synonyms: Unadorned (साधारण), Simple (सादा), Basic (मामूली).
Antonyms: Ornate (सजावटी), Fancy (शानदार), Elaborate (विस्तृत).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Barren
questionsEn.s:
Barren - बंजर (Too poor to produce vegetation; unproductive)
Fertile - उपजाऊ (Capable of producing abundant vegetation)
Depleted - कम (Diminished or weakened)
Empty - खाली (Containing nothing)
Waste - बेकार (Unproductive land or unusable material)
oa:
This word refers to land or soil that is capable of producing abundant vegetation. it is the direct and most accurate antonym for the word barren (unproductive).
Synonyms: Productive (उपजाऊ), Fecund (उर्वर), Fruitful (फलदायक).
Antonyms: Barren (बंजर), Sterile (बांझ), Arid (शुष्क).

This word means diminished in number or quantity; exhausted. it is a synonym for the state of lacking resources often found in barren conditions.
Synonyms: Exhausted (कम), Drained (खाली), Reduced (घटा हुआ).
Antonyms: Full (पूरा), Abundant (प्रचुर), Replenished (भरा हुआ).

This word describes containing nothing or being vacant. While a barren land is often empty of life, the word describes physical presence rather than the ability to produce.
Synonyms: Vacant (खाली), Void (शून्य), Hollow (पोला).
Antonyms: Full (भरा हुआ), Occupied (व्यस्त), Packed (ठसाठस).

This word refers to an area that is unusable or an act of expending something carelessly. it is a synonym for the unproductive nature of barren land.
Synonyms: Desert (बेकार), Wild (जंगली), Barren (बंजर).
Antonyms: Resource (संसाधन), Use (उपयोग), Asset (संपत्ति).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Committed
questionsEn.s:
Committed - प्रतिबद्ध (Pledged or bound to a certain cause)
Dedicated - समर्पित (Devoted to a task or purpose)
Devoted - निष्ठावान (Very loving or loyal)
Faithful - वफादार (Remaining loyal and steadfast)
Uncertain - अनिश्चित (Not able to be relied on; not known)
oa:
This word describes being devoted to a task or purpose. it is a primary synonym for committed and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an antonym.
Synonyms: Devoted (समर्पित), Constant (नियत), Loyal (निष्ठावान).
Antonyms: Indifferent (उदासीन), Lazy (सुस्त), Uncommitted (अप्रतिबद्ध).

This word means being very loving or loyal toward someone or something. it is another direct synonym for committed and cannot provide the required opposite relationship.
Synonyms: Faithful (वफादार), Ardent (उत्साही), Dedicated (निष्ठावान).
Antonyms: Disloyal (बेवफ़ा), Unfaithful (अविश्वासी), Detached (अलग).

This word describes remaining loyal and steadfast. It is a synonym for the "loyal" aspect of being committed and cannot be its antonym.
Synonyms: True (सच्चा), Reliable (भरोसेमंद), Constant (अटल).
Antonyms: Treacherous (विश्वासघाती), Fickle (अस्थिर), False (गलत).

This word refers to not being able to be relied on or not having a fixed determination. it serves as the psychological antonym for someone who is committed and fixed.
Synonyms: Doubtful (अनिश्चित), Wavering (अस्थिर), Unsure (संदिग्ध).
Antonyms: Committed (प्रतिबद्ध), Sure (निश्चित), Decided (तय).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Erode
questionsEn.s:
Erode - क्षरण करना (Gradually destroy or wear away)
Eat - खाना (Put into mouth and swallow)
Destroy - नष्ट करना (End existence by damaging)
Spoil - बिगाड़ना (Diminish or destroy value or quality)
Fix - सुधारना (Measure taken to resolve a problem)
oa:
This word refers to putting food into the mouth and swallowing. While acids can "eat away" at a surface (erode), the word is too literal to serve as a general antonym.
Synonyms: Consume (खाना), Devour (निगलना), Swallow (निकलना).
Antonyms: Provide (प्रदान करना), Produce (निर्माण करना), Regurgitate (उगलना).

This word means to end the existence of something by damaging it. it is a near-synonym for the long-term destructive process of erosion rather than an opposite.
Synonyms: Demolish (नष्ट करना), Ruin (बर्बाद करना), Shatter (चकनाचूर करना).
Antonyms: Create (बनाना), Build (निर्माण करना), Restore (बहाल करना).

This word means to diminish or destroy the value or quality of something. Like destroy, it is a negative process and cannot provide the required opposite relationship.
Synonyms: Mar (खराब करना), Damage (क्षति), Ruin (बिगाड़ना).
Antonyms: Improve (सुधारना), Enhance (बढ़ाना), Better (बेहतर बनाना).

This word means to take a measure to resolve a problem or correct a mistake. In this context, it represents the act of stabilization or repair, which opposes the wearing away of erosion.
Synonyms: Repair (सुधारना), Restore (बहाल करना), Stabilize (स्थिर करना).
Antonyms: Erode (क्षरण करना), Break (तोड़ना), Damage (नुकसान पहुँचाना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Curb
questionsEn.s:
Curb - रोक (A check or restraint on something)
Chain - बांधना (Fasten or secure with a chain)
Freedom - आज़ादी (Power to act or speak as one wants)
Control - नियंत्रण (Power to influence behavior or events)
Brake - रोकना (A device for slowing or stopping)
oa:
This word means to fasten or secure something with a chain. it describes an act of restriction, which is a synonym for the given word curb and not its antonym.
Synonyms: Restrain (सीमित करना), Bind (बांधना), Confinement (कैद).
Antonyms: Release (मुक्त करना), Free (आज़ाद करना), Loosen (ढीला करना).

This word refers to the power or right to act, speak, or think as one wants. it is the direct conceptual antonym for curb, which involves checking or restraining something.
Synonyms: Liberty (आज़ादी), Independence (स्वतंत्रता), Autonomy (स्वायत्तता).
Antonyms: Curb (रोक), Bondage (बंधन), Constraint (बाध्यता).

This word refers to the power to influence or direct behavior or events. it is the primary synonym for the act of curbing and therefore cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Command (नियंत्रण), Regulation (विनियमन), Mastery (अधिकार).
Antonyms: Chaos (अराजकता), Freedom (स्वतंत्रता), Neglect (उपेक्षा).

This word refers to a device used for slowing or stopping a moving vehicle. it is a mechanical synonym for the slowing or stopping action of a curb.
Synonyms: Check (रोकना), Restraint (नियंत्रण), Stop (विराम).
Antonyms: Accelerate (गति बढ़ाना), Speed up (तेजी लाना), Catalyst (प्रेरक).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Estimate
questionsEn.s:
Estimate - अनुमान (Roughly calculate or judge value)
Assessment - आकलन (The act of assessing something)
Conclude - समाप्त (Bring or come to an end)
Opinion - विचार (A view or judgment formed)
Actual - वास्तविक (Existing in fact; real)
oa:
This word refers to the act of assessing someone or something to judge its value. it is a direct synonym for the process of estimating and not an opposite.
Synonyms: Appraisal (अनुमान), Evaluation (मूल्यांकन), Calculation (गणना).
Antonyms: Certainty (निश्चितता), Fact (सत्य), Reality (वास्तविकता).

This word means to bring something to an end or to form an opinion. while it is an outcome, it is not a direct antonym for the act of rough calculation.
Synonyms: Finish (समाप्त करना), Terminate (अंत करना), Deduce (निष्कर्ष निकालना).
Antonyms: Start (शुरू करना), Begin (आरंभ करना), Commenc (प्रारंभ करना).

This word refers to a view or judgment formed about something. Opinions are often based on estimates, making it a related term rather than an antonym.
Synonyms: Belief (विचार), View (दृष्टिकोण), Notion (धारणा).
Antonyms: Fact (सत्य), Certainty (निश्चितता), Knowledge (ज्ञान).

This word refers to something that is existing in fact or is real. It is the direct logical opposite of an estimate, which is a rough calculation or judgment.
Synonyms: Real (वास्तविक), True (सत्य), Tangible (ठोस).
Antonyms: Estimate (अनुमानित), Theoretical (सैद्धांतिक), Imaginary (काल्पनिक).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: To conceive
questionsEn.s:
To conceive - समझना/कल्पना करना (Form an idea in the mind)
To misunderstand - गलत समझना (Fail to interpret correctly)
To accept - स्वीकार करना (Consent to receive or undertake)
To expect - उम्मीद करना (Regard as likely to happen)
To assume - मान लेना (Suppose without proof)
oa:
This word means to fail to understand or interpret something correctly. it serves as the direct antonym for conceive, which involves forming or understanding an idea in the mind.
Synonyms: Misinterpret (गलत समझना), Confuse (भ्रमित होना), Misapprehend (गलत अर्थ निकालना).
Antonyms: Conceive (समझना), Understand (समझना), Comprehend (बोध करना).

This word means to consent to receive or undertake something offered. while it is a positive action, it describes receiving rather than the internal act of forming an idea.
Synonyms: Admit (स्वीकार करना), Agree (सहमत होना), Approve (मंजूरी देना).
Antonyms: Reject (अस्वीकार करना), Deny (नकारना), Refuse (इंकार करना).

This word means to regard something as likely to happen. it refers to anticipation of future events rather than the creation or understanding of a concept in the present.
Synonyms: Anticipate (आशा करना), Await (प्रतीक्षा करना), Foresee (अनुमान लगाना).
Antonyms: Surprise (चौंकना), Ignore (अनदेखा करना), Disregard (उपेक्षा करना).

This word means to suppose something to be the case without proof. it is a near-synonym for the mental formation implied by conceive rather than an opposite.
Synonyms: Presume (मानना), Suppose (कल्पना करना), Guess (अनुमान लगाना).
Antonyms: Prove (साबित करना), Know (जानना), Verify (पुष्टि करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Suspend
questionsEn.s:
Suspend - स्थगित करना (Temporarily prevent from continuing)
Cease - समाप्त (To stop)
Discontinue - रोक देना (Stop from doing or providing)
Eliminate - हटाना (Completely remove or get rid of)
Persist - डटे रहना (Continue in an action despite difficulty)
oa:
This word means to bring something to a final stop. While suspend involves stopping, it is temporary, whereas cease often implies a permanent end.
Synonyms: Stop (समाप्त करना), Terminate (अंत करना), Halt (रोकना).
Antonyms: Start (आरंभ करना), Continue (जारी रखना), Resume (फिर शुरू करना).

This word means to stop doing or providing something. it is similar in nature to suspend and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an opposite.
Synonyms: Abandon (रोक देना), Cease (बंद करना), Halt (ठहराना).
Antonyms: Continue (जारी रखना), Prolong (लंबा करना), Persist (डटे रहना).

This word means to completely remove or get rid of something. it describes total removal rather than the temporary pause or the continuation of an activity.
Synonyms: Remove (निकालना), Expel (बाहर करना), Delete (हटाना).
Antonyms: Add (जोड़ना), Include (शामिल करना), Create (बनाना).

This word means to continue in an opinion or course of action despite difficulty. it is the perfect antonym for suspend, as it implies moving forward without stopping.
Synonyms: Continue (जारी रखना), Endure (बने रहना), Persevere (डटे रहना).
Antonyms: Suspend (स्थगित करना), Quit (छोड़ना), Stop (रुकना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Swift
questionsEn.s:
Swift - तेज़ (Rapid or quick)
Rapid - तेज़ (Happening quickly or with great speed)
Slow - धीरे (Moving or acting at a low speed)
Fast - तेज़ (Moving at high speed; synonym for swift)
Lonely - अकेला (Sad because one is alone)
oa:
This word describes something happening very quickly or moving with great speed. it is a direct synonym for swift and therefore cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Fast (तेज़), Quick (शीघ्र), Speedy (तीव्र).
Antonyms: Slow (धीरे), Sluggish (सुस्त), Tardy (विलंबित).

This word describes moving or acting at a low speed; not quick. it is the direct and perfect antonym for the word swift.
Synonyms: Sluggish (धीरे), Tardy (सुस्त), Gradual (धीमा).
Antonyms: Swift (तेज़), Fast (तीव्र), Rapid (द्रुत).

This word means moving or capable of moving at high speed. It is the most common synonym for swift and does not satisfy the requirement for an antonym.
Synonyms: Speedy (तेज़), Quick (जल्दी), Rapid (द्रुत).
Antonyms: Slow (धीरे), Leisurely (आराम से), Heavy (धीमी).

This word refers to a state of being alone or sad because one has no friends. It describes a social or emotional condition and has no relation to physical speed.
Synonyms: Solitary (अकेला), Isolated (अलग-थलग), Desolate (वीरान).
Antonyms: Accompanied (साथी के साथ), Sociable (सामाजिक), Gregarious (मिलनसार).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Fragrance
questionsEn.s:
Fragrance - खुशबू (A pleasant smell)
Strength - शक्ति (The quality of being strong)
Stench - बदबू (A strong and very unpleasant odor)
Steal - चुराना (To take without permission)
Dirt - गंदगी (Unclean substance like soil or dust)
oa:
This word refers to the quality of being physically strong or the degree of intensity. While it can describe a strong scent, it is not an opposite to a pleasant smell.
Synonyms: Power (शक्ति), Force (बल), Potency (तीव्रता).
Antonyms: Weakness (कमज़ोरी), Frailty (दुर्बलता), Softness (कोमलता).

This word refers to a strong and very unpleasant odor. it is the direct and perfect antonym for fragrance, which describes a pleasant smell.
Synonyms: Odor (बदबू), Reek (दुर्गंध), Fetidness (सड़ांध).
Antonyms: Fragrance (सुगंध), Aroma (खुशबू), Perfume (इत्र).

This word means to take something without permission. It is a verb describing a criminal action and has no linguistic connection to the sensory concept of smell.
Synonyms: Pilfer (चुराना), Filch (हथियाना), Rob (लूटना).
Antonyms: Give (देना), Return (लौटाना), Compensate (मुआवजा देना).

This word refers to soil, dust, or an unclean substance. While dirt can have a bad smell, the word refers to the physical matter rather than being the lexical opposite of "fragrance."
Synonyms: Filth (गंदगी), Dust (धूल), Grime (मैल).
Antonyms: Cleanliness (सफाई), Purity (शुद्धता), Spotlessness (स्वच्छता).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Agony
questionsEn.s:
Agony - पीड़ा (Extreme physical or mental pain)
Suffering - कष्ट (Physical or mental pain)
Pain - दर्द (Highly unpleasant physical sensation)
Grief - शोक (Deep sorrow; synonym for emotional agony)
Delight - आनंद (A high degree of pleasure or enjoyment)
oa:
This word refers to physical or mental pain that a person or animal is feeling. It is a direct synonym for agony and therefore cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Distress (कष्ट), Pain (दर्द), Anguish (पीड़ा).
Antonyms: Joy (आनंद), Pleasure (सुख), Relief (राहत).

This word refers to the highly unpleasant physical sensation caused by illness or injury. it is a primary synonym for agony and not an antonym.
Synonyms: Ache (दर्द), Hurt (चोट), Soreness (पीड़ा).
Antonyms: Comfort (आराम), Ease (राहत), Well-being (स्वस्थता).

This word refers to deep sorrow, especially caused by someone's death. it describes an emotional form of agony and acts as its synonym rather than its opposite.
Synonyms: Sorrow (शोक), Sadness (दुख), Heartache (व्यथा).
Antonyms: Happiness (खुशी), Delight (आनंद), Cheerfulness (हर्ष).

This word refers to a high degree of pleasure or enjoyment. It is the direct and most accurate antonym for the state of intense pain or suffering known as agony.
Synonyms: Pleasure (आनंद), Joy (खुशी), Bliss (परमानंद).
Antonyms: Agony (पीड़ा), Suffering (कष्ट), Misery (दयनीयता).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Duplicate
questionsEn.s:
Duplicate - नकल (An exact copy of something)
Copy - प्रतिलिपि (A thing made to be similar to another)
Original - असली (The first or earliest version)
Alternative - विकल्प (One of two or more possibilities)
Replicate - दोहराना (To make an exact copy of something)
oa:
This word refers to a thing made to be similar or identical to another. It is a direct synonym for duplicate and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an antonym.
Synonyms: Replicate (नकल), Reproduction (प्रतिलिपि), Mock (नकली).
Antonyms: Original (असली), Archetype (मूल), Master (प्रमुख).

This word refers to the first or earliest version of something, from which copies are made. it is the direct and logical antonym for the word duplicate.
Synonyms: Authentic (असली), Master (मूल), Primary (प्राथमिक).
Antonyms: Duplicate (नकल), Fake (नकली), Imitation (अनुकरण).

This word refers to one of two or more available possibilities. While it describes a different choice, it does not mean "original" or oppose the concept of being a copy.
Synonyms: Substitute (विकल्प), Replacement (बदलाव), Choice (विकल्प).
Antonyms: Fixed (नियत), Compulsory (अनिवार्य), Only (एकमात्र).

This word means to make an exact copy of something. it is a synonym for the given word duplicate rather than being its antonym.
Synonyms: Clone (नकल करना), Duplicate (दोहराना), Reproduce (प्रजनन/नकल करना).
Antonyms: Create (बनाना), Invent (आविष्कार करना), Originate (आरंभ करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Prior
questionsEn.s:
Prior - पूर्व (Previous or coming before)
Sufficient - पर्याप्त (Enough for a purpose)
Subsequent - आगामी (Coming after something else)
Satire - व्यंग्य (Humor used to criticize stupidity)
Seductive - मोहक (Tempting and attractive)
oa:
This word means enough or adequate for a purpose. It describes quantity and adequacy rather than the timing or sequential order of an event.
Synonyms: Adequate (पर्याप्त), Ample (भरपूर), Enough (काफी).
Antonyms: Insufficient (अपर्याप्त), Meager (थोड़ा), Scanty (अल्प).

This word refers to something coming after something else in time or order. It serves as the direct temporal antonym for prior, which means before or previous.
Synonyms: Following (आगामी), Succeeding (बाद वाला), Next (अगला).
Antonyms: Prior (पूर्व), Previous (पिछला), Antecedent (पूर्वगामी).

This word refers to the use of humor or irony to criticize people's stupidity or vices. it describes a literary genre and has no relation to temporal sequence.
Synonyms: Mockery (व्यंग्य), Irony (विडंबना), Ridicule (उपहास).
Antonyms: Praise (प्रशंसा), Compliment (तारीफ़), Eulogy (स्तुति).

This word describes something tempting and attractive, often in a sexual way. it refers to the appeal of an object or person rather than their placement in time.
Synonyms: Tempting (मोहक), Alluring (आकर्षक), Enticing (लुभावना).
Antonyms: Repulsive (घृणित), Off-putting (अरुचिकर), Unattractive (अनाकर्षक).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Amiable
questionsEn.s:
Amiable - सुशील (Friendly and pleasant in manner)
Crabby - चिड़चिड़ा (Irritable and easily annoyed)
Affable - मिलनसार (Friendly and easy to talk to)
Amicable - मैत्रीपूर्ण (Characterized by friendliness)
Cheerful - हर्षित (Noticeably happy and optimistic)
oa:
This word describes someone who is irritable, ill-tempered, and easily annoyed. It is the direct personality antonym for amiable, which means friendly and pleasant.
Synonyms: Irritable (चिड़चिड़ा), Grumpy (बदमिज़ाज), Sour (तुनुकमिज़ाज).
Antonyms: Amiable (सुशील), Friendly (मिलनसार), Cheerful (हर्षित).

This word describes being friendly, good-natured, or easy to talk to. it is a direct synonym for amiable and therefore cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Genial (मिलनसार), Friendly (मित्रवत), Sociable (सामाजिक).
Antonyms: Hostile (शत्रुतापूर्ण), Unfriendly (अमित्र), Rude (अशिष्ट).

This word refers to relationships or agreements that are characterized by friendliness and absence of discord. it is a synonym for the given word.
Synonyms: Friendly (शांतिपूर्ण), Harmonious (सद्भावपूर्ण), Cordial (सौहार्दपूर्ण).
Antonyms: Hostile (शत्रुतापूर्ण), Quarrelsome (झगड़ालू), Bitter (कटु).

This word means being noticeably happy and optimistic. while an amiable person is often cheerful, the word refers to happiness rather than the friendliness itself.
Synonyms: Joyful (हर्षित), Happy (खुश), Bright (उज्ज्वल).
Antonyms: Gloomy (उदास), Sad (दुखी), Morose (चिड़चिड़ा).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Movement
questionsEn.s:
Movement - गति (The act or process of moving)
Static - स्थिर (Lacking in movement or still)
Rolling - लुढ़कता हुआ (Moving by turning over and over)
Loading - लदान (Putting a load on something)
Moving - चलायमान (Being in motion; synonym for movement)
oa:
This word refers to something that is still, lacking in movement, or unchanging. it is the direct and perfect antonym for movement.
Synonyms: Stationary (स्थिर), Motionless (निश्चल), Inert (निष्क्रिय).
Antonyms: Dynamic (गतिशील), Moving (चलायमान), Active (सक्रिय).

This word describes moving by turning over and over on an axis. it is a specific type of movement and therefore cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Rotating (घूमता हुआ), Revolving (लुढ़कता हुआ), Turning (मुड़ना).
Antonyms: Still (स्थिर), Fixed (नियत), Stopped (रुका हुआ).

This word refers to the act of putting a load on something or filling a container. it describes a task of preparation or filling rather than the lack of motion.
Synonyms: Filling (भरना), Packing (लदान), Burdening (बोझ डालना).
Antonyms: Unloading (उतारना), Emptying (खाली करना), Removing (हटाना).

This word means in motion or changing position. it is a direct synonym for the given word movement and cannot provide the required antonym.
Synonyms: Active (चलायमान), Mobile (गतिमान), Dynamic (गतिशील).
Antonyms: Still (स्थिर), Static (अचल), Stationary (गतिहीन).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Kindness
questionsEn.s:
Kindness - दया (The quality of being friendly and generous)
Meanness - क्रूरता (The quality of being unkind or spiteful)
Service - सेवा (The action of helping someone)
Shameful - शर्मनाक (Worthy of or causing shame)
Fatal - घातक (Causing death or leading to failure)
oa:
This word refers to the quality of being unkind, spiteful, or ungenerous. It is the direct behavioral and moral antonym for kindness.
Synonyms: Cruelty (क्रूरता), Malice (दुष्टता), Spite (द्वेष).
Antonyms: Kindness (दया), Generosity (उदारता), Benevolence (भलाई).

This word refers to the action of helping or doing work for someone. while kind people often provide service, the word describes an action of assistance rather than the moral opposite of kindness.
Synonyms: Help (सेवा), Assistance (सहायता), Aid (मदद).
Antonyms: Obstruction (बाधा), Disruption (विघ्न), Injury (क्षति).

This word describes something worthy of or causing shame or disgrace. it refers to a lack of honor or dignity rather than a direct lack of kindness.
Synonyms: Disgraceful (शर्मनाक), Dishonorable (अपमानजनक), Scant (अशोभनीय).
Antonyms: Honorable (माननीय), Noble (महान), Admirable (प्रशंसनीय).

This word means causing death or leading to failure. it describes the deadliness of a situation rather than the absence of a friendly or generous nature.
Synonyms: Deadly (घातक), Lethal (जानलेवा), Mortal (प्राणघातक).
Antonyms: Harmless (अहानिकर), Safe (सुरक्षित), Beneficial (लाभकारी).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Recondite
questionsEn.s:
Recondite - दुर्भेद्य (Little-known, obscure, or difficult to understand)
Difficult - कठिन (Not easy to understand or do)
Straight forward - सीधा-सादा (Direct and easy to understand)
Hard - कठिन (Solid or requiring great effort; synonym for difficult)
Occult - रहस्यमय (Mystical or supernatural powers)
oa:
This word means something that is not easy to understand or do. It is a direct synonym for recondite and therefore cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Hard (कठिन), Complex (जटिल), Abstruse (गहन).
Antonyms: Easy (सरल), Simple (आसान), Effortless (सहज).

This word refers to something that is direct, easy to understand, and not complicated. it serves as the perfect antonym for recondite (obscure and little-known).
Synonyms: Simple (सीधा-सादा), Clear (स्पष्ट), Direct (प्रत्यक्ष).
Antonyms: Recondite (दुर्भेद्य), Ambiguous (संदिग्ध), Complex (पेचीदा).

This word describes something solid or requiring great effort. It is a synonym for the "difficult" nature of recondite and does not provide an antonym relationship.
Synonyms: Tough (कठिन), Arduous (कष्टसाध्य), Rigorous (सख्त).
Antonyms: Soft (कोमल), Easy (आसान), Pliant (लचीला).

This word refers to mystical or supernatural powers and knowledge. It is a synonym for the obscure and hidden nature of being recondite.
Synonyms: Mystical (रहस्यमय), Esoteric (गूढ़), Arcane (गुप्त).
Antonyms: Common (साधारण), Public (सार्वजनिक), Known (ज्ञात).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Flourish
questionsEn.s:
Flourish - फलना-फूलना (To grow or develop well)
Garnish - सजाना (To decorate or embellish, usually food)
Hinder - बाधा डालना (To stop or block from progressing)
Amplify - बढ़ाना (To make something larger or more intense)
Develop - विकसित होना (To grow slowly or change into something advanced)
oa:
This word means to decorate or embellish something, usually food. it describes the act of adding decoration rather than the growth or development of a plant or person.
Synonyms: Decorate (सजाना), Embellish (सुशोभित करना), Adorn (अलंकृत करना).
Antonyms: Strip (हटाना), Bare (नग्न करना), Simplify (सरल बनाना).

This word means to create difficulties for someone or something, resulting in delay or obstruction. It is the direct functional antonym for flourish (to grow and develop well).
Synonyms: Obstruct (बाधा डालना), Impede (रोकना), Block (अवरोध पैदा करना).
Antonyms: Flourish (फलना-फूलना), Support (सहारा देना), Promote (बढ़ावा देना).

This word means to make something larger or more intense. While it involves an increase, it refers to volume or intensity rather than the healthy growth of an organism.
Synonyms: Magnify (बढ़ाना), Enhance (तीव्र करना), Boost (बढ़ावा देना).
Antonyms: Reduce (कम करना), Quiet (शांत करना), Diminish (घटाना).

This word means to grow slowly, increase, or change into something more advanced. it is a primary synonym for flourish and therefore not an antonym.
Synonyms: Grow (विकसित होना), Evolve (विकास करना), Advance (अग्रसर होना).
Antonyms: Stagnate (स्थिर होना), Regress (पीछे जाना), Decline (पतन होना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Triumph
questionsEn.s:
Triumph - विजय (A great success or victory)
Joy - आनंद (A feeling of great pleasure)
Jubilee - उत्सव (A special anniversary of an event)
Pride - गर्व (A feeling of pleasure in achievements)
Sorrow - शोक (Sadness after loss or failure)
oa:
This word refers to a feeling of great pleasure and happiness. While triumph brings joy, the word describes an emotion rather than the outcome of an event.
Synonyms: Delight (आनंद), Happiness (खुशी), Bliss (परमानंद).
Antonyms: Sorrow (शोक), Sadness (दुख), Misery (दयनीयता).

This word refers to a special anniversary of an event, especially a 25th or 50th one. it describes a celebration of an achievement rather than an opposite of success.
Synonyms: Celebration (उत्सव), Anniversary (वर्षगांठ), Festivity (समारोह).
Antonyms: Funeral (शोक सभा), Tragedy (त्रासदी), Mourning (शोक).

This word refers to a feeling of deep pleasure in one's own achievements. Like joy, it is a characteristic of triumph rather than its opposite.
Synonyms: Satisfaction (गर्व), Haughtiness (घमंड), Dignity (गरिमा).
Antonyms: Humility (विनम्रता), Modest (विनीत), Shame (शर्म).

This word refers to a feeling of deep distress caused by loss, disappointment, or misfortune. It serves as the direct emotional antonym for triumph (victory).
Synonyms: Sadness (शोक), Grief (दुख), Dejection (निराशा).
Antonyms: Triumph (विजय), Joy (खुशी), Elation (उल्लास).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Elementary
questionsEn.s:
Elementary - बुनियादी (Basic, simple, or uncomplicated)
Easy - आसान (Achieved without great effort; simple)
Fundamental - बुनियादी (Serving as an essential basis)
Primary - प्रथम (Earliest in time or chief importance)
Complex - जटिल (Difficult to understand or made of many parts)


Hence, 'Complex ' is the most suitable antonym for 'Elementary'.
oa:
This word means something that is achieved without great effort. it is a synonym for the simple and uncomplicated nature of elementary tasks.
Synonyms: Simple (आसान), Effortless (सहज), Straightforward (सीधा).
Antonyms: Hard (कठिन), Difficult (मुश्किल), Arduous (श्रमसाध्य).

This word refers to serving as an essential component or basis. it is a direct synonym for the primary and basic nature of being elementary.
Synonyms: Basic (बुनियादी), Essential (अनिवार्य), Primary (मुख्य).
Antonyms: Secondary (गौण), Advanced (उन्नत), Peripheral (सतही).

This word means being of chief importance or earliest in time. It describes the initial stage of something, much like elementary, and is its synonym.
Synonyms: Initial (प्रथम), Basic (मुख्य), Elementary (बुनियादी).
Antonyms: Final (अंतिम), Advanced (उन्नत), Superior (उच्च).

This word refers to something made up of many different and connected parts; it is difficult to understand. it is the direct and perfect antonym for elementary.
Synonyms: Complicated (जटिल), Intricate (पेचीदा), Sophisticated (दुनियादार).
Antonyms: Elementary (बुनियादी), Simple (सरल), Basic (मामूली).

test.instructions: Standard CBT Pattern Exam. Positive Marks: +1, Negative Marks: -0.25. Total Questions: 50.

test.title: Set - 20

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: LUSTER
questionsEn.s:
Luster - चमक / आभा (The quality of shining by reflecting light)
Gloss - रेशमी चमक (A smooth, shiny surface)
Shine - चमक (Brightness from reflected light)
Matte - फीका / चमकहीन (Having a dull or lusterless surface)
Dazzle - चकाचौंध (Brightness that blinds temporarily)
oa:
This word refers to a surface that is shiny or smooth, reflecting light clearly. It is a direct synonym for luster and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an opposite.
Synonyms: Sheen (चमक), Polish (चमक), Radiance (दीप्ति).
Antonyms: Dullness (धुंधलापन), Matte (फीका), Dimness (मंदता).

This word describes the quality of being bright or reflecting light. It conveys a very similar idea to luster and is unsuitable as an antonym.
Synonyms: Glow (दमक), Glint (चमक), Sparkle (झिलमिलाहट).
Antonyms: Darkness (अंधेरा), Obscurity (अस्पष्टता), Shadow (छाया).

This word describes a surface that is dull and flat, without any shine or luster. It represents the direct physical opposite of a lustrous or shiny appearance.
Synonyms: Dull (फीका), Flat (सपाट), Drab (नीरस).
Antonyms: Shiny (चमकदार), Glossy (चमकदार), Lustrous (तेजस्वी).

This word refers to an extremely bright light that briefly blinds someone or a magnificent display. It acts as an intensifier for luster rather than an opposite.
Synonyms: Brilliance (भव्यता), Flare (ज्वाला), Glare (चमक).
Antonyms: Faintness (धुंधलापन), Dullness (उदासी), Darkness (अंधकार).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: VICTOR
questionsEn.s:
Victor - विजेता (A person who has defeated an opponent)
Champ - विजेता (Short for champion)
Hero - नायक (A person admired for bravery)
King - राजा (A male monarch or ruler)
Loser - हारने वाला (A person who is defeated)
oa:
This word is a shortened form of "champion," referring to someone who has won a contest or competition. It is a synonym for victor and cannot be used as its antonym.
Synonyms: Winner (विजेता), Conqueror (विजेता), Hero (नायक).
Antonyms: Loser (हारने वाला), Underdog (कमजोर पक्ष), Failure (असफल).

This word refers to a person admired for courage or outstanding achievements, often a winner in a conflict. It shares the positive connotation of victor and is not an opposite.
Synonyms: Idol (आदर्श), Legend (दिग्गज), Protagonist (नायक).
Antonyms: Villain (खलनायक), Coward (कायर), Scoundrel (बदमाश).

This word refers to a male ruler of an independent state. While kings are often victors, the word describes a title or position rather than the result of a competition or battle.
Synonyms: Ruler (शासक), Monarch (महाराजा), Sovereign (प्रभु).
Antonyms: Subject (प्रजा), Servant (सेवक), Commoner (आम आदमी).

This word refers to a person, team, or side that is defeated in a game, competition, or struggle. It is the direct and most accurate antonym for victor.
Synonyms: Underdog (पराजित), Failure (असफल व्यक्ति), Victim (पीड़ित).
Antonyms: Victor (विजेता), Winner (जीतने वाला), Champion (विजेता).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: DARKEN
questionsEn.s:
Darken - अंधेरा करना (To make something dark or darker)
Deepen - गहरा करना (To make more intense or darker)
Dim - मंद करना (To make less bright)
Eclipse - ग्रहण (To obscure or overshadow)
Illuminated - प्रकाशित (To supply with light)
oa:
This word means to make something more intense or to make a color darker. It aligns with the meaning of darken and therefore cannot serve as its opposite.
Synonyms: Intensify (तीव्र करना), Darken (गहरा करना), Enhance (बढ़ाना).
Antonyms: Lighten (हल्का करना), Fade (फीका पड़ना), Soften (नरम करना).

This word refers to making something less bright or clear. It is a near-synonym for darken and does not satisfy the requirement for an antonym.
Synonyms: Obscure (धुंधला करना), Fade (मंद करना), Shadow (धुंधला करना).
Antonyms: Brighten (चमकना), Illuminate (प्रकाशित करना), Light (जलाना).

This word refers to the obscuring of light from one celestial body by another or a loss of importance. It implies making things dark and is not an opposite.
Synonyms: Obscure (धुंधला करना), Veil (ढकना), Overshadow (परछाई डालना).
Antonyms: Reveal (प्रकट करना), Unveil (उजागर करना), Highlight (प्रमुखता देना).

This word means to supply or brighten something with light. It is the direct functional opposite of darkening, as it involves removing darkness.
Synonyms: Brighten (प्रकाशित करना), Lighten (उजागर करना), Radiate (चमकना).
Antonyms: Darken (अंधेरा करना), Dim (धुंधला करना), Cloud (ढकना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: SOLACE
questionsEn.s:
Solace - सांत्वना / शांति (Comfort or consolation in a time of distress)
Pity - दया (Compassion for the suffering of others)
Disharmony - सामंजस्य का अभाव (Lack of agreement or harmony)
Relief - राहत (Reassurance following pain or anxiety)
Cheer - खुशी / प्रोत्साहन (Shout for joy or high spirits)
oa:
This word refers to the feeling of sorrow and compassion caused by the sufferings of others. While related to sympathy, it does not describe the opposite of providing comfort.
Synonyms: Compassion (दया), Sympathy (सहानुभूति), Empathy (सहानुभूति).
Antonyms: Cruelty (क्रूरता), Indifference (उदासीनता), Harshness (कठोरता).

This word refers to a lack of agreement or peaceful coexistence. Since solace implies a state of mental peace and comfort, disharmony acts as its conceptual opposite.
Synonyms: Discord (कलह), Conflict (विवाद), Strife (कलह).
Antonyms: Solace (शांति), Harmony (सामंजस्य), Peace (शांति).

This word describes a feeling of reassurance and relaxation following release from anxiety or pain. it is a synonym for solace and not an antonym.
Synonyms: Comfort (राहत), Ease (आराम), Mitigation (कमी).
Antonyms: Agony (पीड़ा), Distress (कष्ट), Pain (दर्द).

This word refers to shout for joy or to provide encouragement. While positive, it describes high-energy happiness rather than the opposite of peaceful comfort.
Synonyms: Joy (प्रसन्नता), Happiness (खुशी), Mirth (आमोद).
Antonyms: Gloom (उदास), Sadness (दुख), Despair (निराशा).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: GATHER
questionsEn.s:
Gather - इकट्ठा करना (To bring together or accumulate)
Choose - चुनना (To select from alternatives)
Unite - एकजुट करना (To bring together as one)
Crowd - भीड़ (A large group gathered together)
Divide - विभाजित करना (To separate into parts)
oa:
This word means to pick out or select the best from a number of alternatives. It describes a selection process rather than the physical act of spreading things out.
Synonyms: Select (चुनना), Opt (चुनना), Pick (छाँटना).
Antonyms: Reject (अस्वीकार करना), Discard (त्यागना), Dismiss (खारिज करना).

This word means to come or bring together for a common purpose or to form a single unit. It is a synonym for gather and cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Combine (जोड़ना), Join (मिलाना), Merge (एकीकृत करना).
Antonyms: Divide (बाँटना), Separate (अलग करना), Split (विभाजित करना).

This word refers to a large number of people gathered together in a disorganized way. It describes a collective group, which aligns with the meaning of gather.
Synonyms: Throng (भीड़), Multitude (जनसमूह), Swarm (झुंड).
Antonyms: Individual (व्यक्तिगत), Vacuum (शून्यता), Void (खालीपन).

This word means to separate something into parts or to cause things to be apart. It is the direct physical and conceptual opposite of gathering or bringing things together.
Synonyms: Split (विभाजित करना), Separate (अलग करना), Detach (हटाना).
Antonyms: Gather (इकट्ठा करना), Unite (जोड़ना), Assemble (एकत्र करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: INDUCE
questionsEn.s:
Induce - प्रेरित करना (To succeed in leading someone to do something)
Convince - विश्वास दिलाना (To make someone believe firmly)
Activate - सक्रिय करना (To make something operative)
Impel - मजबूर करना (To drive or force someone to act)
Prevent - रोकना (To keep something from happening)
oa:
This word means to cause someone to believe firmly in the truth of something. It is a way to induce belief and therefore serves as a synonym.
Synonyms: Persuade (राजी करना), Satisfy (आश्वस्त करना), Assure (विश्वास दिलाना).
Antonyms: Dissuade (रोकना), Discourage (निरुत्साहित करना), Deter (मना करना).

This word means to make something active or operative. It is a functional synonym for inducing a process and does not provide an opposite.
Synonyms: Trigger (सक्रिय करना), Stimulate (उत्तेजित करना), Start (शुरू करना).
Antonyms: Deactivate (निष्क्रिय करना), Stop (रोकना), Halt (विराम).

This word means to drive, force, or urge someone to do something. It is a strong synonym for induce and therefore cannot be its antonym.
Synonyms: Force (मजबूर करना), Drive (प्रेरित करना), Prompt (उकसाना).
Antonyms: Restrain (रोकना), Curb (नियंत्रित करना), Check (दबाना).

This word means to keep something from happening or to stop someone from doing something. It is the direct functional opposite of inducing or causing an action.
Synonyms: Hinder (बाधा डालना), Block (रोकना), Thwart (विफल करना).
Antonyms: Induce (प्रेरित करना), Allow (अनुमति देना), Permit (होने देना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: BRIEF
questionsEn.s:
Brief - संक्षिप्त (Short in duration or length)
Efficient - कुशल (Achieving productivity without waste)
Evident - प्रत्यक्ष (Clearly seen or understood)
Elaborate - विस्तृत (Involving many details; lengthy)
Educate - शिक्षित करना (To give instruction or training)
oa:
This word describes a person or system that achieves maximum productivity with minimum wasted effort. While brief communication can be efficient, the word describes ability rather than length.
Synonyms: Competent (कुशल), Effective (प्रभावी), Productive (उत्पादक).
Antonyms: Inefficient (अक्षम), Incompetent (अयोग्य), Feeble (कमज़ोर).

This word describes something that is clearly seen or understood; obvious. It refers to clarity rather than the duration or length of an object or speech.
Synonyms: Clear (स्पष्ट), Obvious (प्रत्यक्ष), Plain (साफ).
Antonyms: Obscure (धुंधला), Hidden (छिपा हुआ), Ambiguous (संदिग्ध).

This word means involving many carefully arranged parts or details; lengthy and detailed. It is the direct opposite of brief, which implies being short or concise.
Synonyms: Detailed (विस्तृत), Complex (जटिल), Intricate (पेचीदा).
Antonyms: Brief (संक्षिप्त), Simple (सरल), Concise (छोटा).

This word means to give intellectual, moral, and social instruction to someone. It is a verb describing a process of teaching and has no relation to the size or length of a thing.
Synonyms: Teach (शिक्षा देना), Instruct (सिखाना), Train (प्रशिक्षित करना).
Antonyms: Mislead (गुमराह करना), Ignore (अनदेखा करना), Neglect (उपेक्षा करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: CAPABLE
questionsEn.s:
Capable - सक्षम (Able to achieve efficiently; competent)
Deserving - योग्य (Worthy of a reward or treatment)
Palpable - प्रत्यक्ष (Able to be touched or felt; obvious)
Inept - अयोग्य (Having or showing no skill; clumsy)
Incognito - गुप्त रूप से (Having true identity hidden)
oa:
This word describes someone who is worthy of being treated in a particular way or receiving a reward. It refers to worthiness rather than the physical or mental ability to perform.
Synonyms: Worthy (योग्य), Meritorious (प्रशंसनीय), Entitled (हकदार).
Antonyms: Unworthy (अयोग्य), Undeserving (अपात्र), Base (नीच).

This word describes something so intense as to seem almost tangible or plain to see. It refers to sensory perception rather than an individual's skill or competence.
Synonyms: Tangible (स्पष्ट), Perceptible (प्रत्यक्ष), Concrete (ठोस).
Antonyms: Intangible (अमूर्त), Imperceptible (अप्रत्यक्ष), Vague (अस्पष्ट).

This word describes someone who has or shows no skill; clumsy or incompetent. it is the direct antonym for capable, which implies being able to achieve tasks efficiently.
Synonyms: Incompetent (अयोग्य), Clumsy (अनाड़ी), Unskilled (अकुशल).
Antonyms: Capable (सक्षम), Skillful (कुशल), Adept (निपुण).

This word describes a person who has their true identity hidden, often using a false name. It refers to anonymity rather than the level of competence or power.
Synonyms: Anonymous (गुमनाम), Disguised (वेश बदला हुआ), Hidden (गुप्त).
Antonyms: Known (प्रसिद्ध), Identified (पहचाना हुआ), Overt (खुला).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: EVOKE
questionsEn.s:
Evoke - आह्वान करना (To bring a feeling or memory to mind)
Forget - भूल जाना (To fail to remember or recall)
Call - बुलाना (To cry out or summon)
Extract - निकालना (To remove or take out by force)
Raise - उठाना (To lift or bring up a subject)
oa:
This word means to fail to remember or to fail to recall a memory. It acts as the direct functional opposite of evoking, which means to bring a memory or feeling to the conscious mind.
Synonyms: Overlook (भूल जाना), Ignore (अनदेखा करना), Neglect (उपेक्षा करना).
Antonyms: Remember (याद रखना), Recall (स्मरण करना), Evoke (आह्वान करना).

This word means to cry out to someone or to summon them. While evoking is a form of "calling up" an idea, the word call is a synonym or a generic verb, not an antonym.
Synonyms: Summon (बुलाना), Shout (चिल्लाना), Invite (आमंत्रित करना).
Antonyms: Dismiss (खारिज करना), Avoid (बचना), Ignore (उपेक्षा करना).

This word means to remove or take out something, especially by effort or force. It refers to the physical removal of an object rather than the failure to bring up an idea.
Synonyms: Remove (निकालना), Withdraw (वापस लेना), Elicit (प्राप्त करना).
Antonyms: Insert (डालना), Embed (स्थापित करना), Add (जोड़ना).

This word means to lift or move to a higher position or to bring up a subject. Since evoking also involves bringing something "up" to the mind, it is a synonym rather than an antonym.
Synonyms: Elevate (ऊपर उठाना), Boost (बढ़ाना), Lift (उठाना).
Antonyms: Lower (नीचे करना), Drop (गिराना), Suppress (दबाना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: OFFSET
questionsEn.s:
Offset - बराबर करना (To counteract by having an equal force)
Charge - शुल्क / आरोप (Demand a price or accuse)
Balance - संतुलन (A situation in which elements are equal)
Disproportion - असंतुलन (Being out of proportion)
Equal - बराबर (Being the same in quantity or value)
oa:
This word refers to a price asked for goods or services or an accusation. It describes a financial demand rather than the act of balancing two opposing forces.
Synonyms: Cost (कीमत), Fee (शुल्क), Indictment (आरोप).
Antonyms: Refund (वापसी), Exoneration (दोषमुक्ति), Credit (जमा).

This word means an even distribution of weight or a situation in which elements are equal. it is a direct synonym for the act of offsetting and therefore cannot be its antonym.
Synonyms: Counteract (संतुलित करना), Equalize (बराबर करना), Level (समान).
Antonyms: Upset (बिगाड़ना), Tilt (झुकाना), Disproportion (असंतुलन).

This word refers to an instance of being out of proportion or having an unequal distribution. It is the direct logical opposite of an offset, which aims for equality and balance.
Synonyms: Imbalance (असंतुलन), Inequality (असमानता), Disparity (अंतर).
Antonyms: Symmetry (समानता), Balance (संतुलन), Offset (बराबर करना).

This word means being the same in quantity, size, or value. it is a synonym for the state achieved by an offset and does not provide the required opposite relationship.
Synonyms: Identical (समान), Equivalent (समतुल्य), Uniform (एकरूप).
Antonyms: Different (अलग), Unequal (असमान), Disparate (भिन्न).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: DEPLETE
questionsEn.s:
Deplete - खाली करना (To use up or exhaust a resource)
Empty - खाली (Containing nothing)
Lessen - कम करना (To make or become less)
Expand - विस्तार करना (To become larger in size or quantity)
Waste - गँवाना (To expend carelessly or to no purpose)
oa:
This word means containing nothing or being completely used up. It is a synonym for the state of being depleted and therefore cannot serve as an opposite.
Synonyms: Vacant (खाली), Clear (साफ), Drain (खाली करना).
Antonyms: Full (भरा हुआ), Occupied (व्यस्त), Fill (भरना).

This word means to make or become less in amount or degree. it describes a reduction process similar to depletion and acts as a synonym rather than an antonym.
Synonyms: Reduce (कम करना), Diminish (घटाना), Decrease (कम करना).
Antonyms: Increase (बढ़ाना), Augment (वृद्धि करना), Grow (बढ़ना).

This word means to become larger in size, quantity, or scope. it is the direct logical opposite of depleting, which involves reduction and exhaustion of resources.
Synonyms: Enlarge (बढ़ाना), Grow (विकसित करना), Amplify (विस्तारित करना).
Antonyms: Deplete (खाली करना), Contract (सिकुड़ना), Shrink (कम करना).

This word means to use or expend resources carelessly or to no purpose. It describes the misuse of resources, which leads to depletion, making it a related concept rather than an opposite.
Synonyms: Squander (गँवाना), Dissipate (बर्बाद करना), Lavish (खर्च करना).
Antonyms: Save (बचाना), Conserve (संरक्षित करना), Hoard (जमा करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: NEGOTIATE
questionsEn.s:
Negotiate - समझौता करना (To discuss to reach an agreement)
Adjust - अनुकूल बनाना (To alter slightly to fit)
Consult - परामर्श करना (To seek advice or information)
Debate - बहस करना (To argue in a formal manner)
Remain - बने रहना (To continue to exist without change)
oa:
This word means to alter or move something slightly to achieve a desired result. While negotiations often require adjustments, the word itself is a part of the process, not an opposite.
Synonyms: Adapt (अनुकूल बनाना), Modify (बदलना), Alter (परिवर्तित करना).
Antonyms: Stagnate (स्थिर होना), Remain (बने रहना), Fix (नियत करना).

This word means to seek information or advice from an expert. It is an action taken during or before a negotiation and therefore acts more like a synonym or related term.
Synonyms: Advise (परामर्श करना), Confer (चर्चा करना), Ask (पूछना).
Antonyms: Dictate (निर्देश देना), Ignore (अनदेखा करना), Command (आदेश देना).

This word means to argue about a subject in a formal manner. it is a synonymous activity to negotiating, involving discussion and disagreement, and is not its opposite.
Synonyms: Argue (तर्क करना), Dispute (विवाद करना), Contend (होड़ करना).
Antonyms: Agree (सहमत होना), Concur (सहमत होना), Consent (मंजूरी देना).

This word means to continue to exist in the same state without change. It serves as an antonym to negotiate in contexts where negotiation implies movement or change toward a new agreement.
Synonyms: Stay (बने रहना), Persist (जारी रहना), Endure (बने रहना).
Antonyms: Change (बदलना), Depart (चले जाना), Negotiate (समझौता करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: DISTRESS
questionsEn.s:
Distress - संकट / पीड़ा (Extreme anxiety, sorrow, or pain)
Concern - चिंता (A feeling of worry or interest)
Pleasure - आनंद (A feeling of happy satisfaction)
Anxiety - घबराहट (The feeling of fear or unease)
Discomfort - असुविधा (Absence of comfort or ease)
oa:
This word refers to a feeling of worry or nervousness. It is a milder form of distress and therefore acts as a near-synonym rather than a direct opposite.
Synonyms: Worry (चिंता), Anxiety (घबराहट), Care (चिंता).
Antonyms: Indifference (उदासीनता), Unconcern (बेपरवाही), Calm (शांति).

This word refers to a feeling of happy satisfaction and enjoyment. It is the direct emotional opposite of distress, which involves extreme suffering or sorrow.
Synonyms: Joy (आनंद), Happiness (खुशी), Delight (प्रसन्नता).
Antonyms: Distress (संकट), Sorrow (दुख), Agony (पीड़ा).

This word refers to a state of being uneasy or worried. Like distress, it describes a negative mental state and therefore cannot be used as its antonym.
Synonyms: Unease (चिंता), Apprehension (डर), Tension (तनाव).
Antonyms: Confidence (आत्मविश्वास), Composure (धैर्य), Serenity (शांति).

This word refers to a lack of physical or mental ease. It is a lower-intensity synonym of distress and does not provide the required opposite relationship.
Synonyms: Uneasiness (असुविधा), Malaise (बेचैनी), Irritation (झुंझलाहट).
Antonyms: Comfort (आराम), Relief (राहत), Solace (सांत्वना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: TOLERATE
questionsEn.s:
Tolerate - सहन करना (To endure or resist something unpleasant)
Accept - स्वीकार करना (To consent to receive or undertake)
Bear - बर्दाश्त करना (To endure a difficult situation)
Permit - अनुमति देना (To give authorization to someone)
Disapprove - अस्वीकार करना (To express an unfavorable opinion)
oa:
This word means to consent to receive something or to agree that something is true. It is a synonym for the positive aspect of tolerating and is not an opposite.
Synonyms: Endure (स्वीकार करना), Admit (मानना), Approve (मंजूरी देना).
Antonyms: Reject (अस्वीकार करना), Deny (नकारना), Refuse (मना करना).

This word means to endure an unpleasant situation or to support a weight. It is a direct synonym for the act of tolerating and cannot be its antonym.
Synonyms: Suffer (सहन करना), Stand (बर्दाश्त करना), Withstand (सहना).
Antonyms: Surrender (आत्मसमर्पण करना), Avoid (बचना), Yield (झुकना).

This word means to give official authorization or consent. While tolerating involves allowing something, permit is more formal, yet it remains a synonym rather than an opposite.
Synonyms: Allow (अनुमति देना), Authorize (अधिकृत करना), Sanction (मंजूरी देना).
Antonyms: Forbid (मना करना), Ban (प्रतिबंध लगाना), Prohibit (रोकना).

This word means to have or express an unfavorable opinion of something. It is the direct psychological and verbal opposite of tolerating or accepting something.
Synonyms: Condemn (निंदा करना), Object (विरोध करना), Reject (अस्वीकार करना).
Antonyms: Approve (प्रशंसा करना), Tolerate (सहन करना), Commend (सराहना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: UNITARY
questionsEn.s:
Unitary - एककी (Lone, separate, or single)
Whole - पूरा (All of something; entire)
Couple - जोड़ा (Two things connected together)
Integral - अनिवार्य (Essential to the whole)
Entire - संपूर्ण (With no part left out)
oa:
This word means all of something or entire. It describes a single complete entity, which is a synonym for the core idea of being unitary.
Synonyms: Entire (पूरा), Total (कुल), Integrated (एककीकृत).
Antonyms: Fractional (आंशिक), Broken (खंडित), Divided (विभाजित).

This word refers to two things of the same kind connected together. Since unitary means single or lone, a couple represents a combination of two, making it a logical antonym.
Synonyms: Pair (जोड़ा), Duo (दो), Twosome (युगल).
Antonyms: Single (एकल), Solitary (अकेला), Unitary (एककी).

This word means necessary to make a whole complete or essential. It describes the importance of a part within a single unit and does not provide an opposite.
Synonyms: Essential (अनिवार्य), Fundamental (मौलिक), Inherent (अंतर्निहित).
Antonyms: Superficial (सतही), Optional (वैकल्पिक), Inessential (अनावश्यक).

This word means with no part left out; whole. It is a direct synonym for the "all-in-one" concept of unitary and therefore cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Complete (संपूर्ण), Absolute (पूर्ण), Total (समग्र).
Antonyms: Partial (अधूरा), Incomplete (अपूर्ण), Scattered (बिखरा हुआ).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: FORMER
questionsEn.s:
Former - भूतपूर्व (Previous or the first of two mentioned)
Ancient - प्राचीन (Belonging to the distant past)
Above - ऊपर (At a higher level or position)
Departed - दिवंगत (Deceased or someone who has left)
After - के पश्चात (Following in time or order)
oa:
This word refers to something belonging to the very distant past. While the former relates to the past, ancient is an extreme degree of it and does not serve as a functional opposite.
Synonyms: Primitive (प्राचीन), Antediluvian (अति प्राचीन), Archaic (पुराना).
Antonyms: Modern (आधुनिक), Contemporary (समकालीन), New (नया).

This word means at a higher level or layer than something else. it refers to physical position or status rather than the chronological sequence required to oppose "former."
Synonyms: Overhead (ऊपर), Atop (शिखर पर), Superior (बेहतर).
Antonyms: Below (नीचे), Beneath (तले), Inferior (घटिया).

This word refers to someone who has died or something that has left. While it implies being "past," it is a specific state of being and not the antonym for the first of two items.
Synonyms: Deceased (स्वर्गवासी), Gone (गया हुआ), Dead (मृत).
Antonyms: Present (उपस्थित), Living (जीवित), Arriving (पहुँचने वाला).

This word means following in time, place, or order. It serves as the direct chronological opposite for former (which means preceding or earlier).
Synonyms: Subsequent (आगामी), Later (बाद में), Next (अगला).
Antonyms: Before (पहले), Prior (पूर्व), Former (भूतपूर्व).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: DILATE
questionsEn.s:
Dilate - फैलाना (To expand or make wider)
Stretch - खींचना (To make longer or wider)
Develop - विकसित करना (To grow or become advanced)
Compress - दबाना (To flatten or squeeze into a smaller space)
Enlarge - बड़ा करना (To make larger in size)
oa:
This word means to cause something to become longer or wider without breaking. it is a direct synonym for dilating (expanding) and therefore not an antonym.
Synonyms: Expand (फैलाना), Elongate (लंबा करना), Extend (विस्तार करना).
Antonyms: Contract (सिकुड़ना), Shrink (छोटा करना), Shorten (घटाना).

This word means to grow or become more mature and advanced. While it implies a form of expansion in capability, it does not describe the specific physical narrowing required.
Synonyms: Evolve (विकसित होना), Progress (उन्नति करना), Grow (बढ़ना).
Antonyms: Decline (पतन होना), Regress (पीछे हटना), Deteriorate (बिगड़ना).

This word means to flatten by pressure or to squeeze into a smaller space. it is the direct physical and conceptual opposite of dilating (widening or expanding).
Synonyms: Squeeze (निचोड़ना), Condense (संक्षिप्त करना), Contract (सिकुड़ना).
Antonyms: Dilate (फैलाना), Expand (विस्तार करना), Inflate (फुलाना).

This word means to make something larger in size or scale. it is a synonym for dilate and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an opposite.
Synonyms: Magnify (बड़ा करना), Boost (बढ़ाना), Amplify (विस्तार करना).
Antonyms: Reduce (कम करना), Diminish (घटाना), Decrease (घटाना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: LEARNED
questionsEn.s:
Learned - विद्वान (Having acquired much knowledge through study)
Brainy - बुद्धिमान (Very intelligent or smart)
Cultured - सभ्य (Refined and well-educated)
Instinctive - स्वाभाविक (Promoted by instinct, not study)
Well informed - जानकार (Having knowledge about many subjects)
oa:
This word is an informal term for being very intelligent. it describes a high natural capacity for thought, which is a synonym or characteristic of being learned.
Synonyms: Intelligent (बुद्धिमान), Smart (चतुर), Clever (होशियार).
Antonyms: Stupid (मूर्ख), Dull (मंद), Inept (अयोग्य).

This word describes someone who is refined, well-educated, and has good taste. it is a synonym for the result of being learned and therefore not an antonym.
Synonyms: Sophisticated (सभ्य), Refined (शिष्ट), Polished (परिमार्जित).
Antonyms: Crude (अशिष्ट), Unrefined (अपरिष्कृत), Barbaric (असभ्य).

This word refers to behavior or knowledge that is natural or promoted by instinct rather than being acquired through study or experience. It is the direct opposite of being learned.
Synonyms: Innate (जन्मजात), Natural (स्वभाविक), Intuitive (सहज).
Antonyms: Learned (सीखा हुआ), Acquired (अर्जित), Studied (अध्ययन किया हुआ).

This word describes having or showing much knowledge about many subjects. it is a direct synonym for the given word and cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Knowledgeable (ज्ञानी), Educated (शिक्षित), Erudite (विद्वान).
Antonyms: Ignorant (अज्ञानी), Unaware (अनजान), Clueless (अनभिज्ञ).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: EXCITABLE
questionsEn.s:
Excitable - उत्तेजनशील (Responding too readily to stimulus)
Placid - शांत (Not easily upset or excited)
Edgy - घबराया हुआ (Tense, nervous, or irritable)
Fierce - उग्र (Having an intense aggressiveness)
Moody - उदास / सनकी (Prone to unpredictable mood changes)
oa:
This word describes someone who is calm, peaceful, and not easily upset. It is the direct emotional antonym for being excitable, which implies reacting readily to stimulus.
Synonyms: Calm (शांत), Serene (निर्मल), Tranquil (स्थिर).
Antonyms: Excitable (उत्तेजनशील), Agitated (उत्तेजित), Turbulent (अशांत).

This word describes someone who is tense, nervous, or irritable. it conveys a similar negative energy to being excitable and therefore acts more like a synonym.
Synonyms: Nervous (घबराया हुआ), Anxious (चिंतित), Irritable (चिड़चिड़ा).
Antonyms: Relaxed (निश्चिंत), Calm (शांत), Composed (धैर्यवान).

This word means having an intense aggressiveness or being powerful and scary. While distinct, it describes high-intensity behavior rather than the calmness needed for an antonym.
Synonyms: Ferocious (भयंकर), Violent (उग्र), Intense (प्रबल).
Antonyms: Gentle (कोमल), Mild (हल्का), Tame (पालतू).

This word describes someone whose moods change suddenly or who is prone to sadness. Like excitable, it implies emotional instability and is not an opposite.
Synonyms: Temperamental (सनकी), Sulky (उदास), Capricious (मनमौजी).
Antonyms: Stable (स्थिर), Consistent (संगत), Even-tempered (संतुलित).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: LAID-BACK
questionsEn.s:
Laid-back - आरामदेह (Relaxed and easygoing)
Ambitious - महत्वाकांक्षी (Showing strong desire to succeed)
Relaxed - निश्चिंत (Free from tension or anxiety)
Remote - दूर (Situated far away or distant in manner)
Casual - अनौपचारिक (Relaxed and unconcerned)
oa:
This word describes someone with a strong desire and determination to succeed. it implies intense drive and activity, making it the perfect antonym for being laid-back (relaxed and easygoing).
Synonyms: Driven (प्रेरित), Aspiring (महत्वाकांक्षी), Determined (कृतसंकल्प).
Antonyms: Laid-back (आरामदेह), Lazy (आलसी), Lethargic (सुस्त).

This word means free from tension or anxiety. It is a direct synonym for laid-back and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an opposite.
Synonyms: Easygoing (निश्चिंत), Calm (शांत), Unwinded (तनावमुक्त).
Antonyms: Tense (तनावपूर्ण), Stressed (तनावग्रस्त), Anxious (चिंतित).

This word refers to a place that is far from population centers or a person who is distant in manner. It does not address the energy or relaxation level of a personality.
Synonyms: Distant (दूर), Faraway (दूरवर्ती), Isolated (अलग-थलग).
Antonyms: Close (निकट), Nearby (पास), Accessible (सुलभ).

This word means relaxed and unconcerned or informal. Like relaxed, it is a synonym for the given word and cannot be used as its antonym.
Synonyms: Informal (अनौपचारिक), Offhand (लापरवाह), Nonchalant (बेपरवाह).
Antonyms: Formal (औपचारिक), Serious (गंभीर), Strict (सख्त).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: SERVANT
questionsEn.s:
Servant - सेवक (A person employed by another to perform duties)
Mister - श्रीमान (A title of respect for a man)
Master - मालिक (An employer or person in control)
Minister - मंत्री (A person appointed by government or church)
Matter - पदार्थ / मुद्दा (Physical substance or subject)
oa:
This word is a title of respect used for a man. while a servant might address a man as "Mister," the word is a social title and not the functional opposite of an employee.
Synonyms: Gentleman (श्रीमान), Sir (श्रीमान), Master (महाराज).
Antonyms: Madam (श्रीमती), Miss (सुश्री), Boy (लड़का).

This word refers to an employer of workers or a person who has control over others. it is the direct and logical antonym for a servant, who is employed to serve.
Synonyms: Employer (नियोक्ता), Owner (स्वामी), Boss (मालिक).
Antonyms: Servant (सेवक), Slave (दास), Subordinate (अधीनस्थ).

This word refers to a high government official or a religious leader. while it denotes a position of power, it is a specific professional title rather than the direct antonym for servant.
Synonyms: Official (अधिकारी), Priest (पादरी), Diplomat (राजनयिक).
Antonyms: Citizen (नागरिक), Layman (साधारण व्यक्ति), Follower (अनुयायी).

This word refers to physical substances or a subject under consideration. It is a noun with an entirely unrelated meaning and cannot function as an antonym for a person's role.
Synonyms: Substance (पदार्थ), Subject (विषय), Issue (मुद्दा).
Antonyms: Spirit (आत्मा), Vacuum (शून्यता), Nothingness (नगण्यता).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: TRAGEDY
questionsEn.s:
Tragedy - त्रासदी (A very sad event involving death or suffering)
Pathos - करुणा (A quality that evokes pity or sadness)
Fortune - सौभाग्य / भाग्य (Wealth or good luck)
Unfortunate - अभागा (Unlucky or having bad effects)
Damage - क्षति (Physical harm or injury)
oa:
This word refers to a quality in art or life that evokes feelings of pity or sadness. it is a characteristic element of a tragedy and thus acts as a synonym or related term.
Synonyms: Sadness (करुणा), Pity (दया), Poignancy (मार्मिकता).
Antonyms: Happiness (खुशी), Joy (आनंद), Mirth (आमोद).

This word refers to a large amount of wealth or good luck. It represents the positive outcome of life, which is the direct conceptual opposite of the extreme sorrow of a tragedy.
Synonyms: Wealth (भाग्य), Luck (सौभाग्य), Prosperity (समृद्धि).
Antonyms: Tragedy (त्रासदी), Misfortune (दुर्भाग्य), Calamity (विपत्ति).

This word describes something unlucky or having bad effects. Since a tragedy is the ultimate unfortunate event, this word is a synonym and not an opposite.
Synonyms: Unlucky (अभागा), Regrettable (अफसोसजनक), Hapless (बदनसीब).
Antonyms: Fortunate (भाग्यशाली), Lucky (भाग्यवान), Favored (भाग्यशाली).

This word refers to physical harm or injury caused to something. It is a common result of a tragic event and therefore acts as a related noun rather than an antonym.
Synonyms: Harm (क्षति), Injury (चोट), Ruin (बर्बाद करना).
Antonyms: Repair (मरम्मत), Restoration (बहाली), Fix (सुधार).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: FUGITIVE
questionsEn.s:
Fugitive - भगोड़ा (A person running away to avoid capture)
Evanescent - क्षणभंगुर (Vanishing or fading quickly)
Captive - कैदी (A person who is confined or imprisoned)
Unkempt - मैला-कुचैला (Untidy or messy in appearance)
Smart - चतुर / आकर्षक (Intelligent or neat and well-dressed)
oa:
This word describes something that is quickly fading or disappearing. While fugitives are "fleeting," this word refers to physical or visual disappearance rather than legal status.
Synonyms: Fleeting (क्षणिक), Transient (अस्थायी), Vanishing (मिटने वाला).
Antonyms: Permanent (स्थायी), Lasting (टिकाऊ), Enduring (अविनाशी).

This word refers to a person who is imprisoned or confined. It is the direct logical antonym for a fugitive, who is actively running away to avoid confinement.
Synonyms: Prisoner (कैदी), Convict (अपराधी), Hostage (बंधक).
Antonyms: Fugitive (भगोड़ा), Free (मुक्त), Liberated (आज़ाद).

This word describes a person or their appearance as untidy or messy. It refers to grooming and cleanliness and has no connection with the act of running or being caught.
Synonyms: Messy (बिखरा हुआ), Untidy (अव्यवस्थित), Slovenly (लापरवाह).
Antonyms: Tidy (साफ-सुथरा), Neat (व्यवस्थित), Groomed (सजा हुआ).

This word means clean, neat, and well-dressed, or intelligent. it refers to physical appearance or mental capability and does not provide an opposite for a criminal status.
Synonyms: Intelligent (बुद्धिमान), Elegant (शानदार), Clever (चतुर).
Antonyms: Stupid (मूर्ख), Shabby (फटा-पुराना), Dull (नीरस).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Menacing
questionsEn.s:
Menacing - खतरनाक / धमकाने वाला (Suggesting the presence of danger)
Helping - सहायक (Assisting someone or making things easier)
Alarming - चिंताजनक (Worrying or disturbing)
Frightening - डरावना (Making someone afraid or anxious)
Approaching - समीप आने वाला (Coming nearer in distance or time)
oa:
This word means to assist someone or make things easier. It is a positive action that provides safety or support, making it the best opposite for menacing (threatening).
Synonyms: Assisting (सहायक), Supportive (सहयोगी), Aiding (मददगार).
Antonyms: Hindering (बाधा डालने वाला), Opposing (विरोध करने वाला), Menacing (खतरनाक).

This word means worrying or disturbing. It is a direct synonym for menacing as both imply that something bad is likely to happen, so it is not an antonym.
Synonyms: Frightening (चिंताजनक), Scary (डरावना), Daunting (हतोत्साहित करने वाला).
Antonyms: Soothing (शांतिदायक), Reassuring (आश्वस्त करने वाला), Calming (शांत).

This word means making someone afraid or anxious. It describes the effect of a menacing person or situation and therefore acts as a synonym.
Synonyms: Terrifying (भयानक), Intimidating (डराने वाला), Spooky (डरावना).
Antonyms: Comforting (सुखद), Encouraging (प्रोत्साहित करने वाला), Inviting (आकर्षक).

This word means coming nearer in distance or time. While a threat can be approaching, the word itself is a neutral descriptor of movement and not an opposite.
Synonyms: Coming (आने वाला), Advancing (अग्रसर), Nearing (पास आने वाला).
Antonyms: Receding (पीछे हटने वाला), Leaving (जाने वाला), Retreating (पीछे हटना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Obliging
questionsEn.s:
Obliging - मददगार (Willing to do a service or kindness)
Unfriendly - अमित्र (Not friendly or hostile)
Helpful - सहायक (Ready to give help)
Civil - शिष्ट (Courteous and polite)
Amiable - मिलनसार (Friendly and pleasant in manner)
oa:
This word describes someone who is not kind or helpful. It is the direct social antonym for being obliging, which means being willing to help and do favors.
Synonyms: Hostile (अमित्र), Cold (रूखा), Aloof (अलग-थलग).
Antonyms: Friendly (मित्रवत), Obliging (मददगार), Amiable (सुशील).

This word describes someone who is ready to give help. It is a direct synonym for obliging and therefore cannot be the required antonym.
Synonyms: Supportive (सहायक), Accommodating (मिलनसार), Useful (उपयोगी).
Antonyms: Useless (बेकार), Hindering (बाधक), Unobliging (मदद न करने वाला).

This word means courteous and polite. While it describes good behavior, it is a characteristic often found in an obliging person and acts as a synonym.
Synonyms: Polite (शिष्ट), Respectful (सम्मानजनक), Gracious (विनीत).
Antonyms: Rude (अशिष्ट), Impolite (अभद्र), Boorish (गंवार).

This word describes having or displaying a friendly and pleasant manner. it is another synonym for obliging and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an opposite.
Synonyms: Genial (मिलनसार), Affable (सुशील), Friendly (मित्रवत).
Antonyms: Grumpy (चिड़चिड़ा), Hostile (शत्रुतापूर्ण), Surly (बदमिजाज).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Insatiable
questionsEn.s:
Insatiable - अतृप्त (Impossible to satisfy an appetite or desire)
Crying - रोना (Shedding tears due to pain or sorrow)
Wanting - अभावपूर्ण (Lacking a required quality)
Content - संतुष्ट (Satisfied or in a state of happiness)
Desiring - इच्छुक (Strongly wishing for something)
oa:
This word means shedding tears as an expression of distress or pain. It describes a physical emotional reaction and has no connection to the level of satisfaction.
Synonyms: Weeping (रोना), Sobbing (सिसकना), Wailing (विलाप करना).
Antonyms: Laughing (हँसना), Rejoicing (प्रसन्न होना), Smiling (मुस्कुराना).

This word refers to lacking a required quality or strongly wishing for something. It is similar to the "unfilled" state of being insatiable and is not an opposite.
Synonyms: Desiring (इच्छुक), Lacking (अपूर्ण), Deficient (कमी).
Antonyms: Sufficient (पर्याप्त), Abundant (प्रचुर), Satisfactory (संतोषजनक).

This word means being satisfied or in a state of peaceful happiness. it is the direct opposite of insatiable, which describes a state where satisfaction is impossible.
Synonyms: Satisfied (संतुष्ट), Fulfilled (तृप्त), Pleased (प्रसन्न).
Antonyms: Greedy (लालची), Restless (बेचैन), Insatiable (अतृप्त).

This word means to strongly wish for or want something. It is a core component of being insatiable and therefore acts as a synonym rather than an antonym.
Synonyms: Coveting (लालसा), Yearning (तड़पना), Wishing (चाहना).
Antonyms: Abhorring (घृणा करना), Rejecting (अस्वीकार करना), Satisfied (संतुष्ट).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: ANARCHIC
questionsEn.s:
Anarchic - अराजक (Not regulated by law or disordered)
Lawless - कानूनहीन (Having no laws or enforcement)
Disordered - अव्यवस्थित (Lacking order or confused)
Turbid - धुंधला (Cloudy, opaque, or confused in meaning)
Normal - सामान्य (Regular, natural, or free from disorder)
oa:
This word describes a situation where there are no laws or enforcement. It is a direct synonym for anarchic and therefore cannot be used as its opposite.
Synonyms: Chaotic (अराजक), Disordered (अव्यवस्थित), Unregulated (अनियंत्रित).
Antonyms: Orderly (व्यवस्थित), Lawful (कानूनी), Regulated (नियमित).

This word means lacking order or being messy and confused. It is another synonym for anarchic and does not provide the required opposite relationship.
Synonyms: Messy (गंदा), Jumbled (उलझा हुआ), Chaotic (अराजक).
Antonyms: Organized (संगठित), Neat (साफ-सुथरा), Systematic (व्यवस्थित).

This word refers to a liquid that is cloudy or opaque with suspended matter, or confused in meaning. it describes a state of "muddiness" rather than a lack of legal order.
Synonyms: Murky (धुंधला), Muddy (मैला), Opaque (अपारदर्शी).
Antonyms: Clear (साफ), Lucid (स्पष्ट), Pellucid (निर्मल).

This word means regular, natural, or free from disorder and deviation. it serves as the best antonym for anarchic by denoting a state of expected order and stability.
Synonyms: Regular (सामान्य), Standard (मानक), Typical (विशिष्ट).
Antonyms: Abnormal (असामान्य), Anarchic (अराजक), Eccentric (अनोखा).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: PROBITY
questionsEn.s:
Probity - सत्यनिष्ठा (Absolute honesty and integrity)
Fidelity - वफादारी (Faithfulness and loyalty)
Deceit - छल (The act of hiding the truth to mislead)
Equity - निष्पक्षता (The quality of being fair)
Justice - न्याय (The quality of being fair and reasonable)
oa:
This word means faithfulness to a person, cause, or belief, demonstrated by continuing loyalty. It is a positive moral quality similar to probity and not an opposite.
Synonyms: Loyalty (निष्ठा), Allegiance (वफादारी), Constancy (दृढ़ता).
Antonyms: Treachery (विश्वासघात), Infidelity (बेवफाई), Betrayal (धोखा).

This word refers to the act of hiding the truth or using fraud to mislead others. it is the direct moral opposite of probity, which represents absolute honesty.
Synonyms: Fraud (धोखाधड़ी), Deception (छल), Duplicity (कपट).
Antonyms: Probity (सत्यनिष्ठा), Honesty (ईमानदारी), Integrity (अखंडता).

This word refers to the quality of being fair and impartial. it is a synonym for a core part of probity and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an antonym.
Synonyms: Fairness (निष्पक्षता), Justice (न्याय), Impartiality (तटस्थता).
Antonyms: Bias (पक्षपात), Injustice (अन्याय), Partiality (तरफदारी).

This word means the quality of being fair and reasonable or the administration of law. It is another positive virtue aligned with probity rather than its opposite.
