Synonyms: Fairness (न्याय), Righteousness (धर्मपरायणता), Rectitude (सच्चाई).
Antonyms: Injustice (अन्याय), Wrong (गलत), Corruption (भ्रष्टाचार).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: CONTEST
questionsEn.s:
Contest - मुकाबला (A race or competition between rivals)
Challenge - चुनौती (To invite to a competition)
Stillness - शांति (Silence and lack of movement/conflict)
Trial - परीक्षण (A formal examination or test)
Tournament - प्रतियोगिता (A series of contests)
oa:
This word means to invite someone to take part in a competition or to dispute something. It is a core part of a contest and therefore acts as a synonym.
Synonyms: Dispute (चुनौती), Compete (मुकाबला करना), Contend (संघर्ष करना).
Antonyms: Accept (स्वीकार करना), Yield (झुकना), Concede (मान लेना).

This word refers to a state of being quiet, peaceful, and without movement or conflict. It serves as the situational antonym for a contest, which involves struggle and activity.
Synonyms: Peace (शांति), Quiet (खामोशी), Tranquility (निश्चिंतता).
Antonyms: Commotion (शोरगुल), Agitation (उत्तेजना), Contest (मुकाबला).

This word refers to a formal examination of evidence in court or a test of performance. it describes a competitive or testing process, making it a synonym for contest.
Synonyms: Test (परीक्षण), Examination (जांच), Ordeal (कठिन परीक्षा).
Antonyms: Success (सफलता), Conclusion (समाप्ति), Certainty (निश्चितता).

This word refers to a series of contests between a number of competitors. it is a direct synonym for a larger-scale contest and cannot be its antonym.
Synonyms: Competition (प्रतियोगिता), Championship (विजेता पद), Meet (मिलन/मुकाबला).
Antonyms: Individualism (व्यक्तिवाद), Practice (अभ्यास), Solitude (एकांत).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Adultery
questionsEn.s:
Adultery - व्यभिचार / अशुद्धता (Impurity added to a state or relationship)
Affair - प्रेम-प्रसंग (An illicit love relationship)
Fling - अस्थायी सम्बन्ध (A short casual relationship)
Cheating - धोखाधड़ी (Acting dishonestly or unfaithfully)
Purity - शुद्धता (The state of being original or genuine)
oa:
This word refers to a usually secretive or illicit sexual relationship. it is a direct synonym for the act of committing adultery and therefore not an opposite.
Synonyms: Fling (प्रेम-प्रसंग), Liaison (सम्बन्ध), Intrigue (साजिश).
Antonyms: Fidelity (वफादारी), Loyalty (निष्ठा), Constancy (स्थिरता).

This word refers to a short, casual sexual relationship or a period of indulgence. Like an affair, it describes unfaithful behavior and acts as a synonym.
Synonyms: Affair (लघु प्रेम), Spree (मौज-मस्ती), Escapade (दुस्साहस).
Antonyms: Commitment (प्रतिबद्धता), Marriage (विवाह), Seriousness (गंभीरता).

This word means acting dishonestly or being unfaithful to a partner. It is a broad synonym for the behavior involved in adultery and cannot be its antonym.
Synonyms: Infidelity (धोखा), Fraud (छल), Deceit (बेईमानी).
Antonyms: Honesty (ईमानदारी), Faithfulness (सत्यनिष्ठा), Truthfulness (सच्चाई).

This word refers to the state of being clean, original, and free from contaminants or moral decay. It serves as the conceptual antonym to adultery (impurity).
Synonyms: Chastity (पवित्रता), Cleanness (निर्मलता), Innocence (निर्दोषता).
Antonyms: Adultery (व्यभिचार), Corruption (भ्रष्टाचार), Sin (पाप).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Brazen
questionsEn.s:
Brazen - बेशर्म / ढीठ (Doing something bold without hiding it)
Bold - निडर (Fearless and daring)
Modest - विनम्र (Humble in spirit or manner)
Flashy - भड़कीला (Ostentatiously attractive)
Forward - ढीठ / उन्नत (Advanced or overly confident)
oa:
This word describes a person who is confident, courageous, and not afraid of risks. While "brazen" often implies a negative boldness, the word bold is its synonym.
Synonyms: Daring (निडर), Audacious (साहसी), Fearless (निर्भीक).
Antonyms: Timid (डरपोक), Shy (शर्मीला), Cowardly (कायर).

This word describes someone who is humble, unassuming, and lacks arrogance. It is the direct personality antonym for being brazen (bold and shameless).
Synonyms: Humble (विनम्र), Meek (नम्र), Unpretentious (विनीत).
Antonyms: Brazen (बेशर्म), Arrogant (अभिमानी), Boastful (शेखीबाज़).

This word describes something that is ostentatiously attractive or impressive. it aligns with the "showy" nature of being brazen and acts as a related synonym.
Synonyms: Showy (दिखावटी), Gaudy (भड़कीला), Pretentious (दंभी).
Antonyms: Simple (साधारण), Plain (सादा), Subtle (सूक्ष्म).

This word means advanced or behaving with excessive confidence. In social contexts, being forward is similar to being brazen, making it a synonym.
Synonyms: Presumptuous (ढीठ), Impudent (गुस्ताख), Bold (मुखर).
Antonyms: Reserved (संकोची), Backward (पिछड़ा), Hesitant (झिझकने वाला).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Certify
questionsEn.s:
Certify - प्रमाणित करना (To verify or guarantee officially)
Approve - मंजूरी देना (To agree to or accept something)
Disapprove - अस्वीकार करना (To refuse to agree or accept)
Attest - पुष्टि करना (To declare something as true)
Notify - सूचित करना (To report or give notice officially)
oa:
This word means to officially agree to or accept something as satisfactory. It is a synonym for the act of certifying and cannot serve as its antonym.
Synonyms: Endorse (मंजूरी देना), Sanction (स्वीकृत करना), Confirm (पुष्टि करना).
Antonyms: Disapprove (अस्वीकार करना), Reject (नकारना), Veto (अस्वीकार).

This word means to officially refuse to agree to something or to express an unfavorable opinion. It is the direct logical opposite of certifying or approving.
Synonyms: Reject (नकारना), Condemn (निंदा करना), Deny (अस्वीकार करना).
Antonyms: Certify (प्रमाणित करना), Approve (मंजूरी देना), Commend (सराहना).

This word means to provide evidence for something or to declare it to be true. it is a direct synonym for certify and therefore not an antonym.
Synonyms: Verify (पुष्टि करना), Witness (प्रमाण देना), Authenticate (प्रमाणित करना).
Antonyms: Contradict (खंडन करना), Disprove (गलत साबित करना), Belie (झुठलाना).

This word means to give formal notice of something or to report it officially. It describes an act of communication that often accompanies certification, making it a related term.
Synonyms: Inform (सूचित करना), Announce (घोषित करना), Advise (बताना).
Antonyms: Conceal (छिपाना), Withhold (रोक लेना), Suppress (दबाना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Contribute
questionsEn.s:
Contribute - योगदान देना (To give or donate something)
Provide - उपलब्ध कराना (To make something available)
Take - लेना (To remove something from a place)
Add - जोड़ना (To put in an additional element)
Afford - प्रदान करना (To provide or supply an opportunity)
oa:
This word means to make something available for use or to supply it. It describes an act of giving, which is synonymous with the core idea of contributing.
Synonyms: Supply (आपूर्ति करना), Furnish (प्रदान करना), Give (देना).
Antonyms: Take (लेना), Withhold (रोकना), Deprive (वंचित करना).

This word means to remove someone or something from a particular place or possession. It represents the act of receiving or removing, which is the direct opposite of giving or contributing.
Synonyms: Remove (ले लेना), Withdraw (वापस लेना), Seize (ज़ब्त करना).
Antonyms: Contribute (योगदान देना), Give (देना), Provide (प्रदान करना).

This word means to put in an additional element or ingredient. since contributing often adds to a whole, this word is a synonym and not an opposite.
Synonyms: Attach (जोड़ना), Annex (मिलाना), Append (संलग्न करना).
Antonyms: Subtract (घटाना), Deduct (कम करना), Remove (हटाना).

This word means to provide or supply an opportunity, or to have enough money for something. it describes providing a benefit, making it a synonym for contributing in certain contexts.
Synonyms: Provide (प्रदान करना), Offer (प्रस्ताव देना), Grant (देना).
Antonyms: Deny (नकारना), Refuse (मना करना), Cost (कीमत चुकाना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Divulge
questionsEn.s:
Divulge - प्रकट करना (To make secret information known)
Admit - स्वीकार करना (To agree that something is true)
Conceal - छिपाना (To hide or keep something secret)
Blab - भेद खोलना (To reveal secrets by indiscreet talk)
Declare - घोषित करना (To say something in a solemn manner)
oa:
This word means to agree that something is true, especially unwillingly. It involves revealing the truth, making it a synonym for the given word rather than its opposite.
Synonyms: Confess (स्वीकार करना), Acknowledge (मानना), Reveal (प्रकट करना).
Antonyms: Deny (नकारना), Refute (खंडन करना), Conceal (छिपाना).

This word means to hide or keep something secret. It is the direct and perfect antonym for divulge, which means to make secret information known.
Synonyms: Hide (छिपाना), Cover (ढकना), Obscure (गुप्तरखना).
Antonyms: Divulge (प्रकट करना), Disclose (बताना), Reveal (उजागर करना).

This word means to reveal secrets through indiscreet talk. It is an informal synonym for divulge and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an opposite.
Synonyms: Tattle (बकवास करना), Spill (भेद खोलना), Gossip (गपशप करना).
Antonyms: Be silent (चुप रहना), Keep quiet (मौन रहना), Secrete (छिपाना).

This word means to say something in a solemn and emphatic manner. Since declaring involves making something known publicly, it is a synonym for divulge.
Synonyms: Proclaim (घोषित करना), Announce (बताना), State (कथन करना).
Antonyms: Suppress (दबाना), Withhold (रोकना), Conceal (छिपाना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Scoff
questionsEn.s:
Scoff - मजाक उड़ाना (To mock or ridicule someone)
Contemn - तिरस्कार करना (To treat with contempt)
Praise - प्रशंसा करना (To express approval or admiration)
Discount - उपेक्षा करना / छूट (To deduct or dismiss an idea)
Belittle - तुच्छ समझना (To dismiss as unimportant)
oa:
This word means to treat someone or something with contempt. It is a direct synonym for scoffing and therefore cannot be used as its antonym.
Synonyms: Scorn (तिरस्कार करना), Despise (घृणा करना), Disdain (अवहेलना करना).
Antonyms: Respect (सम्मान करना), Revere (आदर करना), Praise (प्रशंसा करना).

This word means to express warm approval or admiration for someone. It is the direct social and emotional opposite of scoffing, which involves mockery.
Synonyms: Commend (प्रशंसा करना), Applaud (सराहना), Laud (गुणगान करना).
Antonyms: Scoff (मजाक उड़ाना), Criticize (आलोचना करना), Mock (उपहास करना).

This word means to deduct an amount from a price or to dismiss an idea as unworthy. While dismissing an idea is similar to scoffing, the word is not a direct opposite.
Synonyms: Deduct (कम करना), Ignore (अनदेखा करना), Disregard (उपेक्षा करना).
Antonyms: Appreciate (सराहना), Overestimate (ज्यादा आंकना), Value (सम्मान देना).

This word means to dismiss someone or something as unimportant. It is a near-synonym for scoff and does not provide the required opposite relationship.
Synonyms: Disparage (तुच्छ समझना), Depreciate (मूल्य घटाना), Demean (नीचा दिखाना).
Antonyms: Extol (गुणगान करना), Magnify (बड़ा करना), Exalt (ऊंचा उठाना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: JOLLY
questionsEn.s:
Jolly - हंसमुख (Happy, cheerful, and fun-loving)
Serious - गंभीर (Solemn, not happy, or showing deep thought)
Joyful - आनंदित (Feeling or showing great pleasure)
Gay - प्रसन्न (Light-hearted and carefree)
Merry - आनंदमय (Cheerful and lively)
oa:
This word describes someone who is solemn, not happy, or prone to deep and heavy thoughts. it is the direct emotional antonym for being jolly (cheerful and happy).
Synonyms: Solemn (गंभीर), Gloomy (उदास), Somber (विषादपूर्ण).
Antonyms: Jolly (हंसमुख), Gay (प्रसन्न), Cheerful (खुश).

This word describes feeling or showing great pleasure. It is a direct synonym for jolly and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an antonym.
Synonyms: Happy (खुश), Merry (आनंदित), Elated (उल्लसित).
Antonyms: Sad (दुखी), Miserable (दयनीय), Dejected (निराश).

This word describes being light-hearted and carefree. It is an old synonym for being jolly or cheerful and cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Cheerful (प्रसन्न), Mirthful (आनंदमयी), Blithe (निश्चिंत).
Antonyms: Morose (चिड़चिड़ा), Gloomy (उदास), Sullen (खिन्न).

This word describes being cheerful and lively, often associated with festive occasions. It is a synonym for jolly and not an antonym.
Synonyms: Jolly (हंसमुख), Joyous (आनंदमय), Festive (उत्सवपूर्ण).
Antonyms: Sorrowful (शोकग्रस्त), Depressed (उदास), Tragic (दुखद).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: DECAMP
questionsEn.s:
Decamp - भाग जाना (To depart suddenly or flee from a camp)
Remain - बने रहना (To stay back or continue in a place)
Depart - प्रस्थान करना (To leave or go away)
Escape - बच निकलना (To break free or get away)
Flee - भागना (To run away from danger)
oa:
This word means to stay back or continue to exist in the same place. It is the direct behavioral antonym for decamping, which involves leaving or fleeing.
Synonyms: Stay (रुकना), Persist (बने रहना), Abide (ठहरना).
Antonyms: Decamp (भाग जाना), Leave (चले जाना), Depart (प्रस्थान करना).

This word means to leave, especially in order to start a journey. It is a synonym for decamp and therefore cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Leave (जाना), Quit (छोड़ना), Exit (निकलना).
Antonyms: Arrive (पहुँचना), Come (आना), Stay (ठहरना).

This word means to break free from confinement or to get away from a dangerous situation. It is a synonym for decamping and not an antonym.
Synonyms: Flee (भागना), Abscond (फरार होना), Evade (बचना).
Antonyms: Captivate (पकड़ना), Face (सामना करना), Remain (रहना).

This word means to run away from a place or situation of danger. It is a direct synonym for decamp and therefore does not provide the required opposite.
Synonyms: Run (भागना), Decamp (चंपत होना), Bolt (भाग निकलना).
Antonyms: Stand (सामना करना), Stay (रुकना), Confront (मुकाबला करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: DEVOID
questionsEn.s:
Devoid - शून्य / रहित (To have nothing or be entirely without)
Empty - खाली (Containing nothing)
Full - भरा हुआ (Containing as much as possible)
Barren - बंजर (Too poor to produce; lacking life)
Sans - के बिना (A preposition meaning "without")
oa:
This word means containing nothing or being without contents. It is a direct synonym for devoid and therefore cannot be used as its antonym.
Synonyms: Vacant (खाली), Bare (नग्न), Hollow (पोला).
Antonyms: Full (भरा हुआ), Occupied (व्यस्त), Packed (ठसाठस).

This word means containing as much or as many as is possible or having no empty space. It is the direct and most accurate antonym for the word devoid (having nothing).
Synonyms: Plentiful (भरपूर), Abundant (प्रचुर), Replete (भरा हुआ).
Antonyms: Devoid (रहित), Empty (खाली), Void (शून्य).

This word describes land too poor to produce crops or something showing no results. Since it implies a lack of something, it acts as a synonym for devoid rather than an opposite.
Synonyms: Devoid (शून्य), Sterile (बांझ), Unproductive (निष्फल).
Antonyms: Fertile (उपजाऊ), Productive (उत्पादक), Fruitful (फलदायी).

This word is a preposition meaning "without." While it describes the same condition as being devoid, it is a synonym and not an opposite.
Synonyms: Without (बिना), Lacking (रहित), Minus (घटाकर).
Antonyms: With (के साथ), Including (सहित), Plus (जोड़कर).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Weird
questionsEn.s:
Weird - अजीब (Strange, unusual, or awkward)
Usual - सामान्य (Normal, typical, or expected)
Awful - भयानक (Very bad or unpleasant)
Creepy - डरावना (Causing a feeling of fear or unease)
Fearful - भयभीत (Feeling or showing fear)
oa:
This word refers to things that are habitually or typically occurring; common or expected. It acts as the direct antonym for weird, which involves being strange or unusual.
Synonyms: Normal (सामान्य), Regular (नियमित), Standard (मानक).
Antonyms: Weird (अजीब), Strange (विचित्र), Odd (अनोखा).

This word refers to something very bad or unpleasant. While weird things can be awful, the word describes quality rather than the quality of being unusual.
Synonyms: Terrible (भयानक), Horrible (भीषण), Dreadful (बहुत बुरा).
Antonyms: Wonderful (अद्भुत), Lovely (प्यारा), Great (महान).

This word describes something that causes an unpleasant feeling of fear or unease. it is a synonym for the unsettling nature of being weird and is not an opposite.
Synonyms: Scary (डरावना), Eerie (भयानक), Sinister (अशुभ).
Antonyms: Comforting (सुखद), Soothing (शांतिपूर्ण), Pleasant (मनोहर).

This word describes feeling or showing fear or anxiety. it is a state of mind often caused by something weird, making it a related term rather than an antonym.
Synonyms: Afraid (भयभीत), Timid (डरपोक), Anxious (चिंतित).
Antonyms: Brave (बहादुर), Bold (निडर), Confident (निश्चित).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Charity
questionsEn.s:
Charity - दान (To help someone by giving them something)
Donation - दान (A gift given to help)
Stealing - चोरी (Taking property without permission)
Gifting - उपहार देना (The act of giving a present)
Offering - भेंट (A contribution or religious gift)
oa:
This word refers to something that is given to a charity, especially a sum of money. it is a core component of charity and therefore acts as a synonym.
Synonyms: Gift (दान), Contribution (योगदान), Offering (भेंट).
Antonyms: Theft (चोरी), Taking (लेना), Deduction (कटौती).

This word refers to taking another person's property without permission or legal right. It is the direct moral and action-based antonym for charity (giving freely).
Synonyms: Theft (चोरी), Robbery (लूट), Pilfering (चुराना).
Antonyms: Charity (दान), Giving (देना), Donation (उपहार).

This word means the act of giving something as a present. it is a direct synonym for the act of being charitable and cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Presenting (भेंट देना), Bestowing (प्रदान करना), Granting (देना).
Antonyms: Taking (लेना), Seizing (ज़ब्त करना), Receiving (प्राप्त करना).

This word refers to a contribution or a religious gift. Like donation and gift, it aligns with the meaning of charity rather than providing an opposite.
Synonyms: Sacrifice (बलिदान), Contribution (योगदान), Alms (भिक्षा).
Antonyms: Refusal (इनकार), Rejection (अस्वीकृति), Withholding (रोकना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Hostile
questionsEn.s:
Hostile - शत्रुतापूर्ण (Angry or unfriendly behavior)
Alien - विदेशी (Unfamiliar or foreign)
Hateful - घृणास्पद (Showing intense dislike)
Opposed - विरोधी (Being against or in conflict)
Gentle - सौम्य (Kind, mild, or tender in temperament)
oa:
This word refers to something unfamiliar, foreign, or belonging to another planet. While it can imply unfriendliness, it is primarily about origin rather than the emotional opposite of anger.
Synonyms: Foreign (विदेशी), Strange (अनजान), Exotic (अजीब).
Antonyms: Native (स्वदेशी), Familiar (परिचित), Endemic (स्थानिक).

This word describes feeling or showing intense dislike. It is a synonym for the core feeling behind being hostile and therefore cannot be its antonym.
Synonyms: Malicious (द्वेषपूर्ण), Vile (घृणित), Bitter (कड़वा).
Antonyms: Loving (प्यारा), Kind (दयालु), Affectionate (स्नेहपूर्ण).

This word means being completely different or against someone. it describes a state of conflict similar to hostility and is not an opposite.
Synonyms: Contrary (विपरीत), Resistant (प्रतिरोधी), Antagonistic (विरोधी).
Antonyms: Supportive (सहयोगी), Allied (गठबंधन), Agreeing (सहमत).

This word describes having a mild, kind, or tender temperament. it serves as the perfect behavioral opposite for someone who is hostile or aggressive.
Synonyms: Mild (कोमल), Kind (दयालु), Soft (नरम).
Antonyms: Hostile (शत्रुतापूर्ण), Harsh (कठोर), Rough (खुरदरा).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Thrive
questionsEn.s:
Thrive - फलना-फूलना (To grow, prosper, or succeed well)
Arrive - पहुँचना (To reach a destination)
Fail - असफल होना (To be unsuccessful or decline)
Develop - विकसित होना (To grow and become more advanced)
Shine - चमकना (To be bright or very successful)
oa:
This word means to reach a destination or a point in time. It describes a simple action of reaching and has no relation to growing, prospering, or failing.
Synonyms: Reach (पहुँचना), Land (उतरना), Appear (प्रकट होना).
Antonyms: Depart (प्रस्थान करना), Leave (चले जाना), Exit (बाहर निकलना).

This word means to be unsuccessful in achieving one's goal or to decline in strength. It is the direct and most accurate antonym for thriving (prospering).
Synonyms: Decline (पतन होना), Flop (विफल होना), Deteriorate (बिगड़ना).
Antonyms: Thrive (फलना-फूलना), Succeed (सफल होना), Prosper (समृद्ध होना).

This word means to grow slowly or change into something more advanced. It is a synonym for the process of thriving and therefore not its antonym.
Synonyms: Evolve (विकसित होना), Progress (उन्नति), Flourish (बढ़ना).
Antonyms: Stagnate (ठहरना), Halt (रुकना), Wither (मुरझाना).

This word means to be bright or to be very successful. While thriving people might "shine," the word itself refers to brilliance rather than providing an opposite for growth.
Synonyms: Glow (चमकना), Radiate (दीप्तिमान होना), Excel (श्रेष्ठ होना).
Antonyms: Fade (धुंधला होना), Dull (फीका पड़ना), Fail (विफल होना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Eager
questionsEn.s:
Eager - उत्सुक (Strongly wanting to do or have something)
Disinterested - उदासीन (Having no interest or concern)
Desire - इच्छा (A strong feeling of wanting something)
Restless - बेचैन (Worried, uneasy, or unable to relax)
Zealous - जोशीला (Passionate and devoted to a cause)
oa:
This word refers to a person who has no interest or concern in something. It serves as the direct emotional antonym for being eager, which implies wanting something strongly.
Synonyms: Indifferent (उदासीन), Unconcerned (बेपरवाह), Apathetic (रुचिहीन).
Antonyms: Eager (उत्सुक), Keen (तीव्र), Interested (रुचि रखने वाला).

This word refers to a strong feeling of wanting to have something. It is the underlying emotion of being eager and acts as a synonym.
Synonyms: Want (चाह), Wish (इच्छा), Longing (लालसा).
Antonyms: Aversion (घृणा), Dislike (नापसंद), Hatred (नफरत).

This word describes being unable to rest or relax as a result of anxiety or boredom. while related to high energy, it describes unease rather than a lack of interest.
Synonyms: Uneasy (बेचैन), Fidgety (चंचल), Anxious (चिंतित).
Antonyms: Calm (शांत), Composed (धैर्यवान), Patient (धैर्यशील).

This word describes having or showing great energy or enthusiasm in pursuit of a cause. It is an intense synonym for eager and cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Passionate (जोशीला), Devoted (समर्पित), Fervent (उत्साही).
Antonyms: Apathetic (उदासीन), Indifferent (बेपरवाह), Lazy (सुस्त).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Disgrace
questionsEn.s:
Disgrace - अपमान (Loss of respect or honour)
Honour - सम्मान (High respect or great esteem)
Spot - धब्बा (A small mark or patch)
Blur - धुंधलापन (To become unclear or indistinct)
Stain - कलंक (A mark or spot that spoils something)
oa:
This word refers to high respect, esteem, or a good reputation. It is the direct social and moral antonym for disgrace, which involves a loss of respect.
Synonyms: Respect (सम्मान), Dignity (गरिमा), Prestige (प्रतिष्ठा).
Antonyms: Disgrace (अपमान), Shame (शर्म), Infamy (बदनामी).

This word refers to a small round mark of a different color. while it can metaphorically mean a blemish on a reputation, it describes the mark itself and is a near-synonym.
Synonyms: Mark (धब्बा), Blemish (दोष), Patch (टुकड़ा).
Antonyms: Perfection (पूर्णता), Cleanliness (स्वच्छता), Purity (शुद्धता).

This word refers to something that is not clear or distinct. it describes visual or mental lack of clarity rather than the opposite of being shameful.
Synonyms: Obscurity (अस्पष्टता), Mist (धुंध), Cloudiness (धुंधलापन).
Antonyms: Clarity (स्पष्टता), Precision (सटीकता), Sharpness (तीव्रता).

This word refers to a mark that is difficult to remove or a blemish on one's character. it is a direct synonym for the lasting effect of disgrace and is not its opposite.
Synonyms: Taint (कलंक), Blot (धब्बा), Smudge (दाग).
Antonyms: Cleanness (स्वच्छता), Honour (सम्मान), Purity (शुद्धता).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Stationary
questionsEn.s:
Stationary - स्थिर (Not moving or intended to be moved)
Immobile - गतिहीन (Not moving or unable to move)
Permanent - स्थायी (Lasting indefinitely without change)
Stable - स्थिर (Not likely to change or fail)
Unsteady - अस्थिर (Movable, mobile, or not in a fixed position)
oa:
This word means not moving or unable to be moved. It is a direct synonym for stationary and therefore cannot serve as its opposite.
Synonyms: Static (स्थिर), Motionless (गतिहीन), Fixed (अचल).
Antonyms: Mobile (चल), Moving (गतिशील), Active (सक्रिय).

This word means lasting or intended to last indefinitely. while stationary things stay in one place, permanent refers to the duration of existence rather than physical movement.
Synonyms: Eternal (शाश्वत), Constant (नियत), Durable (टिकाऊ).
Antonyms: Temporary (अस्थायी), Transient (क्षणिक), Fleeting (क्षणभंगुर).

This word means not likely to move, change, or fail. it is a synonym for stationary in terms of being fixed and therefore not an antonym.
Synonyms: Steady (स्थिर), Firm (दृढ़), Secure (सुरक्षित).
Antonyms: Unstable (अस्थिर), Shaky (डाँवाँडोल), Precarious (अनिश्चित).

This word refers to something that is not stable in position or is movable and changeable. it serves as the best opposite for stationary (which is fixed and unmoving).
Synonyms: Mobile (चलायमान), Changeable (परिवर्तनीय), Volatile (अस्थिर).
Antonyms: Stationary (स्थिर), Steady (नियमित), Constant (अटल).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Progressive
questionsEn.s:
Progressive - प्रगतिशील (Developing gradually or favoring innovation)
Advanced - उन्नत (Modern or far on in development)
Continuous - लगातार (Unbroken or happening without interruption)
Conservative - रूढ़िवादी (Averse to change and holding traditional values)
Dynamic - गतिशील (Characterized by constant change or activity)
oa:
This word means being far on in development or using modern methods. it is a synonym for progressive and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an opposite.
Synonyms: Modern (आधुनिक), Innovative (नवाचारी), Forward-looking (अग्रगामी).
Antonyms: Backward (पिछड़ा), Regressive (प्रतिगामी), Primitive (आदिम).

This word means forming an unbroken whole or without interruption. It describes the flow of progress rather than the political or social stance against it.
Synonyms: Constant (लगातार), Perpetual (अविराम), Unbroken (अखंड).
Antonyms: Interrupted (बाधित), Sporadic (छिटपुट), Broken (टूटा हुआ).

This word refers to someone who is averse to change or innovation and holds traditional values. it is the direct political and social antonym for progressive.
Synonyms: Traditional (रूढ़िवादी), Old-fashioned (पुराना), Orthodox (मानक).
Antonyms: Progressive (प्रगतिशील), Liberal (उदार), Radical (मौलिक).

This word describes a process or person characterized by constant change, activity, or progress. it is a synonym for progressive and cannot be used as its opposite.
Synonyms: Energetic (ऊर्जावान), Active (सक्रिय), Vital (जीवंत).
Antonyms: Static (स्थिर), Lethargic (सुस्त), Passive (निष्क्रिय).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Augment
questionsEn.s:
Augment - बढ़ाना (To increase or make something larger)
Develop - विकसित करना (To grow or progress)
Enhance - सुधारना (To improve or make better)
Degrade - नीचा दिखाना / घटाना (To lower in quality or status)
Increase - बढ़ाना (To make greater in size or amount)
oa:
This word means to grow slowly or become more advanced. Since augmenting involve increasing or making something better, develop acts as a synonym.
Synonyms: Progress (उन्नति करना), Grow (बढ़ना), Evolve (विकसित होना).
Antonyms: Decline (पतन होना), Regress (पीछे हटना), Stagnate (ठहरना).

This word means to intensify or improve the quality or value of something. it is a direct synonym for augment and therefore not an antonym.
Synonyms: Improve (सुधारना), Boost (बढ़ाना), Heighten (तीव्र करना).
Antonyms: Mar (बिगाड़ना), Diminish (घटाना), Spoil (खराब करना).

This word means to lower in quality, value, or status. It is the direct opposite of augmenting, which involves making something larger or better.
Synonyms: Lower (नीचा दिखाना), Debase (मूल्य घटाना), Deteriorate (बिगाड़ना).
Antonyms: Augment (बढ़ाना), Enhance (सुधारना), Elevate (ऊंचा उठाना).

This word means to become or make greater in size or amount. it is the simplest synonym for augment and therefore cannot serve as its antonym.
Synonyms: Boost (बढ़ाना), Multiply (गुना करना), Expand (विस्तार करना).
Antonyms: Decrease (घटाना), Reduce (कम करना), Diminish (कम करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Noble
questionsEn.s:
Noble - महान / कुलीन (Belonging to aristocracy or having high character)
Well born - उच्चकुल का (Belonging to high social class by birth)
Gentle - सौम्य (Kind and tender character)
Servile - चापलूस / अधीन (Excessive willingness to serve others)
Kingly - शाही (Resembling or fit for a monarch)
oa:
This word describes a person belonging to a high social class by birth. It is a synonym for the aristocratic meaning of noble and not an opposite.
Synonyms: Aristocratic (कुलीन), High-born (उच्चकुल का), Elite (अभिजात).
Antonyms: Lowly (नीच), Common (साधारण), Plebeian (सामान्य जन).

This word describes having a kind, tender character or being polite. It is a behavioral synonym for a noble person and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an antonym.
Synonyms: Mild (कोमल), Kind (दयालु), Tender (नरम).
Antonyms: Harsh (कठोर), Brutal (क्रूर), Violent (हिंसक).

This word describes having or showing an excessive willingness to serve or please others. it is the direct status and character opposite of being noble or superior.
Synonyms: Subservient (अधीन), Groveling (चापलूसी भरा), Abject (नीच).
Antonyms: Noble (महान), Dominant (प्रबल), Arrogant (अभिमानी).

This word describes something fit for or resembling a monarch. It is a direct synonym for the status of being noble and cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Royal (शाही), Regal (भव्य), Majestic (राजसी).
Antonyms: Menial (तुच्छ), Common (साधारण), Humble (विनम्र).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Applause
questionsEn.s:
Applause - ताली बजाकर प्रशंसा (Approval expressed by clapping)
Acclaim - प्रशंसा (Enthusiastic public approval)
Cheers - जयजयकार (Shouts of joy or support)
Criticism - आलोचना (Expression of disapproval based on faults)
Praise - सराहना (Expression of admiration or approval)
oa:
This word refers to loud and enthusiastic public approval. it is a direct synonym for applause and therefore does not provide the required opposite relationship.
Synonyms: Praise (प्रशंसा), Plaudits (सराहना), Commendation (तारीफ़).
Antonyms: Criticism (आलोचना), Censure (निंदा), Silence (खामोशी).

This word refers to shouts of joy or support. it is a vocal form of applause and acts as a synonym rather than an antonym.
Synonyms: Ovation (जयजयकार), Hurrahs (उत्साह), Celebration (उत्सव).
Antonyms: Boos (तिरस्कार), Jeers (मज़ाक), Groans (कराह).

This word refers to the expression of disapproval based on perceived faults or mistakes. It is the direct verbal and conceptual opposite of applause.
Synonyms: Disapproval (अस्वीकृति), Condemnation (निंदा), Blame (दोष).
Antonyms: Applause (प्रशंसा), Praise (सराहना), Commendation (तारीफ़).

This word refers to the expression of admiration or approval. it is a general synonym for the sentiment behind applause and cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Adoration (श्रद्धा), Worship (पूजा), Laudation (गुणगान).
Antonyms: Slander (निंदा), Abuse (गाली), Defamation (अपयश).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Candid
questionsEn.s:
Candid - स्पष्टवादी (Truthful and straightforward; frank)
Fair - निष्पक्ष (Treating people equally without bias)
Deceitful - छलपूर्ण (Guilty of involving deceit or misleading others)
Genuine - वास्तविक (Truly what something is said to be)
Sincere - ईमानदार (Free from pretense or deceit)
oa:
This word means treating people equally without favoritism. While a candid person is often fair, the word describes justice rather than the quality of being straightforward.
Synonyms: Impartial (निष्पक्ष), Just (न्यायपूर्ण), Unbiased (तटस्थ).
Antonyms: Biased (पक्षपाती), Unfair (अन्यायपूर्ण), Partial (तरफदारी).

This word describes someone who is guilty of misleading others or cheating. it is the direct moral opposite of being candid, which involves being truthful and direct.
Synonyms: Dishonest (बेईमानी), Crafty (चालाक), Insincere (कपटी).
Antonyms: Candid (स्पष्टवादी), Honest (ईमानदार), Frank (खरा).

This word means truly what something is said to be; authentic. it is a synonym for the truthfulness implied by candid and not an antonym.
Synonyms: Real (वास्तविक), Authentic (असली), True (सच्चा).
Antonyms: Fake (नकली), Spurious (बनावटी), Bogus (जाली).

This word describes someone who is free from pretense or deceit. it is a direct synonym for being candid and therefore cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Forthright (ईमानदार), Open (खुला), Wholehearted (सच्चा).
Antonyms: False (झूठा), Hypocritical (पाखंडी), Devious (कपटी).

test.instructions: Standard CBT Pattern Exam. Positive Marks: +1, Negative Marks: -0.25. Total Questions: 50.

test.title: Set - 21

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Defy
questionsEn.s:
Defy - अवहेलना करना (To openly resist or refuse to obey)
Brave - साहसी (Ready to face danger or pain)
Yield - झुक जाना (To give way to pressure or demands)
Defeat - पराजित करना (To win a victory over someone)
Ignore - अनदेखा करना (To refuse to take notice)
oa:
This word means to ready to face and endure danger or pain. While defying often requires bravery, the word describes courage rather than the opposite of resistance.
Synonyms: Confront (सामना करना), Face (झेलना), Challenge (चुनौती देना).
Antonyms: Fear (डरना), Avoid (बचना), Yield (झुकना).

This word means to give way to arguments, demands, or pressure. It is the direct behavioral opposite of defying, which involves resisting or refusing to obey.
Synonyms: Submit (समर्पण करना), Surrender (झुकना), Relent (मान लेना).
Antonyms: Defy (अवहेलना करना), Resist (प्रतिरोध करना), Withstand (सहना).

This word means to win a victory over someone or to overcome an opponent. it describes the final result of a conflict rather than the act of giving in.
Synonyms: Conquer (पराजित करना), Overcome (जीतना), Vanquish (हराना).
Antonyms: Lose (हारना), Surrender (हार मान लेना), Fail (असफल होना).

This word means to refuse to take notice of or acknowledge. it describes a passive lack of attention rather than the active act of submitting to authority.
Synonyms: Overlook (नज़रअंदाज़ करना), Neglect (उपेक्षा करना), Disregard (अवहेलना).
Antonyms: Heed (ध्यान देना), Notice (देखना), Acknowledge (मानना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Obligate
questionsEn.s:
Obligate - बाध्य करना (To bind morally or legally)
Force - मजबूर करना (Strength used to make someone act)
Indebt - ऋणी बनाना (To cause to owe money or duty)
Let-off - छोड़ देना (A chance to escape or avoid duty)
Restrict - प्रतिबंधित करना (To put a limit or keep under control)
oa:
This word means to make someone do something using strength or energy. it is a direct synonym for the act of obligating and therefore not an antonym.
Synonyms: Compel (मजबूर करना), Coerce (विवश करना), Constrain (बाध्य करना).
Antonyms: Free (मुक्त करना), Allow (होने देना), Permit (अनुमति देना).

This word means to cause someone to owe money or a moral obligation. it describes the creation of an obligation and acts as a synonym.
Synonyms: Oblige (ऋणी बनाना), Bind (बाँधना), Commit (प्रतिबद्ध करना).
Antonyms: Clear (मुक्त करना), Release (आज़ाद करना), Discharge (मुक्त करना).

This word means to put a limit on something or keep it under control. it aligns with the "binding" nature of being obligated and is not an opposite.
Synonyms: Limit (सीमित करना), Constrain (रोकना), Curb (नियंत्रित करना).
Antonyms: Expand (बढ़ाना), Liberate (स्वतंत्र करना), Free (मुक्त करना).

This word refers to a chance to escape a duty or avoid a punishment. it is the direct functional antonym for being obligated or bound by law or morals.
Synonyms: Release (मुक्त करना), Excuse (माफ करना), Exempt (छूट देना).
Antonyms: Obligate (बाध्य करना), Convict (दोषी ठहराना), Bind (बाँधना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Stern
questionsEn.s:
Stern - कठोर (Strict and severe in manner)
Bitter - कड़वा (Having a sharp taste or full of anger)
Cruel - निर्दयी (Willfully causing pain to others)
Light - हल्का / सौम्य (Gentle, delicate, or not severe)
Grim - गंभीर (Very serious or gloomy)
oa:
This word means having a sharp, pungent taste or being full of anger. While a stern person might be bitter, the word describes flavor or resentment rather than a lack of strictness.
Synonyms: Acrid (कड़वा), Resentful (द्वेषपूर्ण), Sour (खट्टा).
Antonyms: Sweet (मीठा), Kind (दयालु), Agreeable (सुखद).

This word means willfully causing pain or suffering to others. It is an extreme, negative version of being stern and therefore acts more like a related synonym.
Synonyms: Brutal (क्रूर), Harsh (निर्दयी), Ruthless (कठोर).
Antonyms: Compassionate (सहानुभूतिपूर्ण), Kind (दयालु), Merciful (कृपालु).

This word describes being gentle, delicate, or not severe. it is the best antonym for stern, which implies being strict, heavy, or severe in manner.
Synonyms: Gentle (कोमल), Mild (हल्का), Soft (नरम).
Antonyms: Stern (कठोर), Heavy (भारी), Severe (गंभीर).

This word means very serious or gloomy. it is a direct synonym for the serious and forbidding nature of being stern and cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Somber (गंभीर), Bleak (उदास), Forbidding (भयानक).
Antonyms: Cheerful (हंसमुख), Bright (उज्ज्वल), Joyful (प्रसन्न).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Grudge
questionsEn.s:
Grudge - द्वेष (A persistent feeling of ill will or resentment)
Spite - दुर्भावना (A desire to hurt or offend someone)
Averse - विरोधी (Having a strong dislike or opposition)
Dislike - नापसंद (Feeling distaste or hostility)
Goodwill - सद्भावना (Friendly, helpful, or cooperative feelings)
oa:
This word refers to a desire to hurt, annoy, or offend someone. It is a direct synonym for holding a grudge and therefore cannot be its antonym.
Synonyms: Malice (दुर्भावना), Enmity (शत्रुता), Rancour (द्वेष).
Antonyms: Goodwill (सद्भावना), Kindness (दया), Love (प्रेम).

This word means having a strong dislike of or opposition to something. While related to dislike, it describes a personal orientation rather than the act of holding a specific resentment.
Synonyms: Disinclined (अनिच्छुक), Reluctant (हिचकिचाता हुआ), Loath (अनिच्छुक).
Antonyms: Willing (इच्छुक), Keen (उत्सुक), Eager (आतुर).

This word refers to a feeling of distaste or hostility. It is a generic synonym for the feeling behind a grudge and does not satisfy the requirement for an opposite.
Synonyms: Hatred (नफरत), Distaste (अरुचि), Antipathy (विरोध).
Antonyms: Like (पसंद करना), Love (प्रेम करना), Admiration (प्रशंसा).

This word refers to friendly, helpful, or cooperative feelings and attitudes. it is the direct moral and emotional opposite of holding a grudge or resentment.
Synonyms: Benevolence (सद्भावना), Amity (मित्रता), Kindness (भलाई).
Antonyms: Grudge (द्वेष), Spite (दुर्भावना), Malice (ईर्ष्या).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Hail
questionsEn.s:
Hail - ओले / अभिवादन (Frozen rain or to call out to someone)
Rain - बारिश (Water falling in drops from the atmosphere)
Storm - तूफान (Violent weather with strong winds)
Greet - स्वागत करना (To give a polite word of welcome)
Dribble - बूँद-बूँद टपकना (To fall slowly in tiny drops)
oa:
This word refers to water falling in drops from the atmosphere. it is a type of precipitation, much like hail, and therefore acts as a synonym or related term.
Synonyms: Downpour (वर्षा), Drizzle (बूंदाबांदी), Precipitation (बारिश).
Antonyms: Drought (सूखा), Aridity (शुष्कता), Dryness (सूखापन).

This word refers to a violent weather condition with strong winds and heavy rain or snow. Since hail is a feature of a storm, this is a related concept and not an opposite.
Synonyms: Tempest (तूफान), Gale (आंधी), Cyclone (चक्रवात).
Antonyms: Calm (शांति), Stillness (स्थिरता), Peace (शांति).

This word means to give a polite word of recognition or welcome. it is a synonym for the other meaning of "hail" (to call out to someone) and not an antonym.
Synonyms: Welcome (स्वागत करना), Salute (अभिवादन करना), Address (संबोधित करना).
Antonyms: Ignore (अनदेखा करना), Shun (त्यागना), Avoid (बचना).

This word means to fall slowly in tiny drops or a thin stream. In the context of precipitation, it is the best opposite for "hail," which implies a heavy, forceful fall of ice pellets.
Synonyms: Trickle (बूँद-बूँद टपकना), Leak (टपकना), Seep (रिसना).
Antonyms: Hail (ओला गिरना), Pour (मूसलाधार गिरना), Flow (बढ़ना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Incite
questionsEn.s:
Incite - उकसाना (To encourage or stir up violent behavior)
Encourage - प्रोत्साहित करना (To give support or hope to someone)
Arouse - जगाना (To evoke or awaken a feeling or response)
Drive - प्रेरित करना (To propel or carry along by force)
Prohibit - निषेध करना (To formally forbid something by law)
oa:
This word means to stir up or give support to a particular behavior. It is a direct synonym for the act of inciting and therefore cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Stimulate (प्रोत्साहित करना), Inspire (प्रेरित करना), Motivate (बढ़ावा देना).
Antonyms: Discourage (निरुत्साहित करना), Deter (रोकना), Prevent (बचाना).

This word means to evoke or awaken a feeling or response. It is a synonym for incite and does not provide the required opposite relationship.
Synonyms: Awaken (जगाना), Kindle (उत्तेजित करना), Inflame (भड़काना).
Antonyms: Quell (शांत करना), Lull (सुलाना), Soothe (आराम देना).

This word means to propel or carry along by force or to urge someone to act. it is a strong synonym for the forceful nature of inciting someone.
Synonyms: Force (मजबूर करना), Impel (प्रेरित करना), Push (धक्का देना).
Antonyms: Stop (रोकना), Halt (विराम), Restrain (रोकना).

This word means to formally forbid something by law or authority. It is the direct functional opposite of inciting, as it involves stopping or banning an action.
Synonyms: Forbid (मना करना), Ban (प्रतिबंध लगाना), Veto (अस्वीकार करना).
Antonyms: Incite (उकसाना), Allow (अनुमति देना), Permit (मंजूरी देना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Eternity
questionsEn.s:
Eternity - अनंतकाल (Infinite or unending time)
Perennial - बारहमासी (Lasting for an apparently infinite time)
Infinity - अनंतता (Limitless or unending state)
Bounds - सीमाएं (Limits or boundaries)
Mortality - मृत्यु-दर (The state of being subject to death)
oa:
This word describes something lasting for a long or apparently infinite time. it is a synonym for the ongoing nature of eternity and not an antonym.
Synonyms: Everlasting (स्थायी), Enduring (अमर), Continuous (लगातार).
Antonyms: Temporary (अस्थायी), Short-lived (क्षणिक), Ephemeral (अल्पकालिक).

This word refers to a state of being limitless or unending in space or time. it is a direct synonym for eternity and therefore cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Boundlessness (अनंतता), Immensity (विशालता), Perpetuity (नित्यता).
Antonyms: Finiteness (सीमितता), End (अंत), Limit (सीमा).

This word refers to limits or boundaries. while it represents the concept of a limit, it is a noun describing a container or border rather than the specific state of being mortal.
Synonyms: Limits (सीमाएं), Borders (सरहद), Constraints (बाधाएं).
Antonyms: Infinity (अनंत), Vastness (विशालता), Freedom (स्वतंत्रता).

This word refers to the state of being subject to death or having a limited lifespan. It is the perfect conceptual antonym for eternity, which implies never-ending life or time.
Synonyms: Deathliness (मृत्यु-दर), Ephemerality (अस्थायित्व), Transience (क्षणिकता).
Antonyms: Eternity (अनंतकाल), Immortality (अमरता), Perpetuity (स्थायित्व).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Manage
questionsEn.s:
Manage - प्रबंध करना (To achieve something or handle situations well)
Administer - प्रशासन करना (To oversee the operation of something)
Conduct - संचालन करना (To lead or guide activities)
Handle - संभालना (To manage, control, or deal with)
Fail - असफल होना (To not be successful in something)
oa:
This word means to manage or oversee the operations of an organization or task. it is a formal synonym for manage and therefore cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Direct (प्रशासन करना), Supervise (निगरानी करना), Govern (नियमित करना).
Antonyms: Neglect (उपेक्षा करना), Follow (अनुसरण करना), Obey (आज्ञा मानना).

This word refers to leading, guiding, or managing a particular activity. It is a synonym for manage and does not provide an opposite relationship.
Synonyms: Run (चलाना), Execute (निष्पादित करना), Operate (संचालित करना).
Antonyms: Abandon (छोड़ देना), Quit (त्यागना), Fail (विफल होना).

This word means managing, controlling, or dealing with a situation or object. It is a common synonym for manage and therefore not an antonym.
Synonyms: Control (संभालना), Manage (निपटना), Tackle (सुलझाना).
Antonyms: Bungle (बिगाड़ना), Botch (काम खराब करना), Fumble (टटोलना).

This word means to not be successful in something or to stop functioning. It is the direct functional antonym for managing a task or situation successfully.
Synonyms: Flop (विफल होना), Tank (बर्बाद होना), Lose (हारना).
Antonyms: Manage (प्रबंध करना), Succeed (सफल होना), Thrive (उन्नति करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Resolve
questionsEn.s:
Resolve - संकल्प (Firm determination or solving a problem)
Determination - दृढ़ संकल्प (Quality of being resolute)
Indecision - असमंजस (Inability to make a decision quickly)
Intend - इरादा रखना (To have a particular aim or plan)
Firmness - दृढ़ता (The quality of being solid or resolute)
oa:
This word means the quality of being resolute or having a firmness of purpose. It is a direct synonym for the given word and cannot be its antonym.
Synonyms: Purpose (दृढ़ संकल्प), Resolve (संकल्प), Persistence (हठ).
Antonyms: Hesitation (हिचकिचाहट), Indecision (असमंजस), Weakness (कमज़ोरी).

This word refers to the inability to make a decision quickly or a lack of firmness in purpose. it is the direct logical antonym for having a strong resolve.
Synonyms: Hesitation (असमंजस), Doubt (संदेह), Vacillation (दुविधा).
Antonyms: Resolve (निश्चय), Determination (दृढ़ता), Certainty (निश्चितता).

This word means to have a particular aim or plan in mind. while it is a part of having a resolve, it is a neutral verb and not an antonym.
Synonyms: Aim (इरादा रखना), Plan (योजना बनाना), Mean (मतलब होना).
Antonyms: Neglect (उपेक्षा करना), Forget (भूलना), Abandon (त्यागना).

This word refers to the quality of having a solid surface or being resolute in mind. it is another synonym for resolve and does not satisfy the requirement for an opposite.
Synonyms: Solidity (कठोरता), Rigidity (दृढ़ता), Constancy (स्थिरता).
Antonyms: Softness (कोमलता), Flexibility (लचीलापन), Laxity (ढीलापन).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Acquitted
questionsEn.s:
Acquitted - बरी करना (To free someone from a criminal charge)
Blame - दोष देना (To hold responsible for a fault or wrong)
Deliver - पहुँचाना / बचाना (To provide or rescue someone)
Excuse - माफ करना (To forgive or provide a reason for a fault)
Relieve - राहत देना (To cause pain to become less)
oa:
This word means to assign responsibility for a fault or wrong. It acts as the direct conceptual antonym for being acquitted, which involves being freed from blame.
Synonyms: Condemn (दोषी ठहराना), Accuse (आरोप लगाना), Indict (अभियुक्त करना).
Antonyms: Acquit (बरी करना), Exonerate (निर्दोष ठहराना), Pardon (क्षमा करना).

This word means to provide something or to save/rescue someone. while it implies freedom, it describes the act of liberation rather than the legal status of guilt.
Synonyms: Hand over (सौंपना), Distribute (वितरित करना), Save (बचाना).
Antonyms: Capture (पकड़ना), Seize (ज़ब्त करना), Keep (रखना).

This word means to forgive someone or to provide a reason for a fault. it is a near-synonym to the act of acquitting and therefore cannot be its antonym.
Synonyms: Pardon (माफ करना), Forgive (क्षमा करना), Condone (अनदेखा करना).
Antonyms: Punish (दंड देना), Accuse (दोष लगाना), Censure (निंदा करना).

This word means to cause pain or distress to become less. it describes a reduction in suffering rather than the opposite of a legal release from a criminal charge.
Synonyms: Alleviate (राहत देना), Ease (आराम देना), Soothe (शांत करना).
Antonyms: Aggravate (बढ़ाना), Intimidate (डराना), Harm (नुकसान पहुँचाना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Compulsory
questionsEn.s:
Compulsory - अनिवार्य (Something that must be done by law or rule)
Binding - बाध्यकारी (Something that cannot be avoided)
Necessary - आवश्यक (Needed to achieve a particular result)
Optional - वैकल्पिक (Available to be chosen but not required)
Forced - मजबूरन (Done against one's wishes)
oa:
This word describes something that cannot be legally avoided or stopped. it is a direct synonym for compulsory and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an antonym.
Synonyms: Obligatory (अनिवार्य), Mandatory (बाध्यकारी), Forced (मजबूर).
Antonyms: Optional (वैकल्पिक), Voluntary (स्वैच्छिक), Free (स्वतंत्र).

This word describes something needed in order to achieve a result. it is a synonym for the essential nature of being compulsory and is not an opposite.
Synonyms: Essential (आवश्यक), Vital (अनिवार्य), Required (अपेक्षित).
Antonyms: Superfluous (अनावश्यक), Extra (अतिरिक्त), Inessential (जरूरी नहीं).

This word describes something that is available to be chosen but is not required by law or rule. it is the direct and perfect antonym for compulsory.
Synonyms: Voluntary (स्वैच्छिक), Elective (वैकल्पिक), Discretionary (विवेकाधीन).
Antonyms: Compulsory (अनिवार्य), Mandatory (बाध्यकारी), Binding (बाध्यकारी).

This word describes something done against one's will or by using strength. it is another synonym for the mandatory nature of being compulsory and acts as an opposite.
Synonyms: Compelled (विवश), Coerced (बाध्य), Mandatory (निश्चित).
Antonyms: Spontaneous (स्वैच्छिक), Willing (इच्छुक), Natural (प्राकृतिक).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Bridle
questionsEn.s:
Bridle - लगाम लगाना (To restrain or control something)
Release - आज़ाद करना (To set free from restraint)
Control - नियंत्रित करना (To determine behavior or supervise)
Leash - पट्टा लगाना (To control with a strap)
Curb - नियंत्रण (A check or restraint on something)
oa:
This word means to allow something to escape or to set it free from restraint. It is the direct functional antonym for a bridle, which is used to control and restrain.
Synonyms: Free (आज़ाद करना), Discharge (मुक्त करना), Loose (ढील देना).
Antonyms: Bridle (लगाम लगाना), Restrain (रोकना), Bind (बाँधना).

This word means to determine the behavior of or to supervise something. it is a direct synonym for the function of a bridle and therefore not an antonym.
Synonyms: Manage (नियंत्रित करना), Regulate (नियमित करना), Command (आदेश देना).
Antonyms: Abandon (छोड़ना), Ignore (अनदेखा करना), Follow (पीछा करना).

This word refers to a strap or cord for controlling an animal. it is a functional synonym for bridle and cannot be used as its opposite.
Synonyms: Tether (पट्टा), Rope (रस्सी), Curb (नियंत्रण).
Antonyms: Release (मुक्त करना), Untie (खोलना), Free (आज़ाद करना).

This word means to check or put a restraint on something. like control and leash, it is a synonym for the action represented by a bridle.
Synonyms: Restrain (रोकना), Suppress (दबाना), Check (अवरोध).
Antonyms: Encourage (प्रोत्साहित करना), Stimulate (उत्तेजित करना), Aid (मदद करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Lethargic
questionsEn.s:
Lethargic - सुस्त (Lazy, inactive, or lacking energy)
Lazy - आलसी (Unwilling to work or use energy)
Sluggish - मंद (Lacking energy or alertness)
Lively - जीवंत (Full of life and energy; active)
Dull - नीरस (Lacking interest or excitement)
oa:
This word describes someone who is unwilling to work or use energy. it is a direct synonym for lethargic and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an opposite.
Synonyms: Idle (कामचोर), Slothful (सुस्त), Inactive (निष्क्रिय).
Antonyms: Active (सक्रिय), Industrious (मेहनती), Busy (व्यस्त).

This word describes a lack of energy or alertness, much like a slow-moving creature. it is a synonym for lethargic and cannot be its antonym.
Synonyms: Lethargic (सुस्त), Slow (मंद), Torpid (जड़).
Antonyms: Brisk (तेज़), Rapid (द्रुत), Energetic (ऊर्जावान).

This word describes someone who is full of life, energy, and activity. It is the direct and most accurate antonym for being lethargic or dull.
Synonyms: Energetic (ऊर्जावान), Animated (जोशीला), Vivacious (प्रसन्न).
Antonyms: Lethargic (सुस्त), Dull (नीरस), Listless (बेजान).

This word describes someone or something that lacks interest, excitement, or brightness. it is a synonym for the low-energy state of lethargy rather than an opposite.
Synonyms: Boring (उबाऊ), Tedious (थकाऊ), Drab (नीरस).
Antonyms: Bright (चमकीला), Exciting (रोमांचक), Vivid (जीवंत).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Defend
questionsEn.s:
Defend - रक्षा करना (To resist an attack or protect something)
Uphold - बनाए रखना (To support or confirm a principle)
Surrender - आत्मसमर्पण करना (To stop resisting and submit)
Secure - सुरक्षित करना (To succeed in obtaining or making safe)
Resist - विरोध करना (To fight against something attacking you)
oa:
This word means to support or confirm something that has been questioned. it is a synonym for the act of defending an idea or rule and not its antonym.
Synonyms: Maintain (बनाए रखना), Support (समर्थन करना), Back (सहारा देना).
Antonyms: Abandon (त्यागना), Reject (अस्वीकार करना), Oppose (विरोध करना).

This word means to stop resisting an enemy and submit to their authority. it is the direct behavioral opposite of defending, which involve resisting an attack.
Synonyms: Yield (हार मानना), Capitulate (समर्पण करना), Relent (झुकना).
Antonyms: Defend (रक्षा करना), Resist (प्रतिरोध करना), Fight (लड़ना).

This word means to succeed in obtaining or making something safe. While it involves protection, it describes the outcome of a defensive action and acts as a synonym.
Synonyms: Obtain (प्राप्त करना), Protect (सुरक्षित करना), Acquire (हासिल करना).
Antonyms: Lose (खोना), Release (मुक्त करना), Endanger (खतरे में डालना).

This word means to fight against something or someone that is attacking you. it is a direct synonym for the core action of defending oneself.
Synonyms: Withstand (सहना), Oppose (विरोध करना), Combat (मुकाबला करना).
Antonyms: Submit (समर्पण करना), Yield (झुकना), Comply (अनुपालन करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Command
questionsEn.s:
Command - आदेश (An authoritative order or instruction)
Opposition - विरोध (Resistance or dissent in action or argument)
Call - पुकारना (A cry made to attract attention)
Dictate - हुक्म (An order or principle to be obeyed)
Notification - सूचना (The act of informing someone)
oa:
This word refers to resistance or dissent expressed in action or argument. Since a command is an order meant to be obeyed, opposition represents the refusal or pushback against it.
Synonyms: Resistance (विरोध), Defiance (उल्लंघन), Dissent (असहमत).
Antonyms: Command (आदेश), Obedience (आज्ञाकारिता), Agreement (सहमति).

This word means to cry out to attract attention or to summon someone. While it is a type of vocal direction, it is not the opposite of an authoritative order.
Synonyms: Shout (चिल्लाना), Summon (बुलाना), Cry (पुकारना).
Antonyms: Silence (चुप्पी), Whisper (फुसफुसाना), Ignore (अनदेखा करना).

This word means an order or principle that must be obeyed. it is a direct synonym for command and therefore cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Order (आदेश), Decree (फतवा), Instruction (निर्देश).
Antonyms: Request (अनुरोध), Suggestion (सुझाव), Plea (विनती).

This word refers to the action of notifying someone or informing them about something. it describes the communication of information rather than an authoritative order or its opposite.
Synonyms: Information (सूचना), Report (विवरण), Advice (सलाह).
Antonyms: Secret (भेद), Silence (खामोशी), Concealment (छिपाव).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Gratify
questionsEn.s:
Gratify - संतुष्ट करना (To give someone pleasure or satisfaction)
Annoy - परेशान करना (To make someone a little angry)
Thrill - रोमांचित करना (A sudden feeling of excitement or pleasure)
Humor - हास्य (The quality of being amusing or comedy)
Fulfil - पूरा करना (To satisfy a requirement or carry out a duty)
oa:
This word means to make someone feel a little angry or irritated. It is the perfect emotional antonym for gratify, which involves giving someone pleasure or satisfaction.
Synonyms: Irritate (चिढ़ाना), Vex (तंग करना), Bother (परेशान करना).
Antonyms: Gratify (संतुष्ट करना), Please (खुश करना), Soothe (शांत करना).

This word refers to a sudden feeling of excitement and pleasure. it is a high-intensity synonym for being gratified or pleased and not its opposite.
Synonyms: Excite (रोमांचित करना), Delight (आनंदित करना), Elate (उल्लसित करना).
Antonyms: Bore (ऊबाना), Disappoint (निराश करना), Sadden (दुखी करना).

This word refers to comedy or the quality of being amusing. While using humor can gratify someone, the word itself is a noun of entertainment, not an antonym.
Synonyms: Comedy (हास्य), Wit (चतुराई), Jocularity (मज़ाक).
Antonyms: Seriousness (गंभीरता), Tragedy (त्रासदी), Solemnity (शांत).

This word means to carry out a duty or to satisfy a requirement. it is a direct synonym for the act of gratifying a desire and therefore not an antonym.
Synonyms: Satisfy (पूरा करना), Accomplish (पूर्ण करना), Execute (निष्पादित करना).
Antonyms: Fail (विफल होना), Neglect (उपेक्षा करना), Abandon (त्यागना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Malicious
questionsEn.s:
Malicious - द्वेषपूर्ण (Intending or intended to do harm; hostile)
Friendly - मित्रवत (Kind, pleasant, and well-intentioned)
Nasty - घिनौना / बुरा (Unpleasant, spiteful, or harmful)
Bitter - कड़वा (Full of anger or resentment)
Unkind - निर्दयी (Lacking kindness or being harsh)
oa:
This word describes being kind, pleasant, and well-intentioned toward others. It is the direct behavioral antonym for malicious, which involves having hostile and harmful intentions.
Synonyms: Amicable (मित्रवत), Kind (दयालु), Cordial (सौहार्दपूर्ण).
Antonyms: Malicious (द्वेषपूर्ण), Hostile (शत्रुतापूर्ण), Unfriendly (अमित्र).

This word describes behavior that is unpleasant, spiteful, or harmful. It is a direct synonym for malicious and therefore cannot serve as its antonym.
Synonyms: Spiteful (दुर्भावनापूर्ण), Mean (नीच), Vicious (दुष्ट).
Antonyms: Nice (अच्छा), Pleasant (सुखद), Kind (कृपालु).

This word describes a state of being full of anger or resentment. it represents the feeling behind malicious behavior, acting more as a synonym than an opposite.
Synonyms: Resentful (द्वेषपूर्ण), Acrimonious (कड़वा), Hostile (शत्रुतापूर्ण).
Antonyms: Sweet (मीठा), Content (संतुष्ट), Satisfied (तृप्त).

This word describes a lack of kindness or being harsh. it is a simpler synonym for malicious and does not provide the required opposite relationship.
Synonyms: Cruel (निर्दयी), Harsh (कठोर), Heartless (निष्ठुर).
Antonyms: Kind (दयालु), Benevolent (परोपकारी), Caring (सहानुभूतिपूर्ण).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Holy
questionsEn.s:
Holy - पवित्र (Religious, godly, or sacred)
Sacred - पवित्र (Connected with God or religion)
Godly - धार्मिक (Devoutly religious or resembling God)
Sinful - पापी (Wicked, evil, or contrary to religious law)
Divine - ईश्वरीय (Relating to or coming from God)
oa:
This word means connected with God or dedicated to a religious purpose. It is a direct synonym for holy and therefore cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Divine (पवित्र), Blessed (धन्य), Godly (धार्मिक).
Antonyms: Profane (अपवित्र), Secular (सांसारिक), Impious (अधर्मी).

This word describes someone who is devoutly religious or something resembling God. it is another direct synonym for holy and is not an antonym.
Synonyms: Pious (धार्मिक), Devout (भक्त), Spiritual (आध्यात्मिक).
Antonyms: Sinful (पापी), Irreligious (अधर्मी), Wicked (दुष्ट).

This word describes something that is morally wrong or contrary to religious laws. It serves as the direct spiritual and moral antonym for being holy or pure.
Synonyms: Wicked (दुष्ट), Evil (पापी), Immoral (अनैतिक).
Antonyms: Holy (पवित्र), Righteous (धर्मी), Pious (धार्मिक).

This word means relating to or coming from God. like sacred and godly, it shares the exact same meaning as holy and does not provide an opposite.
Synonyms: Heavenly (दैवीय), Celestial (आकाशीय), Ethereal (स्वर्गीय).
Antonyms: Earthly (सांसारिक), Mortal (नश्वर), Hellish (नारकीय).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Judicious
questionsEn.s:
Judicious - विवेकपूर्ण (Wise, sensible, and carefully considered)
Acute - तीव्र (Sharp, severe, or showing insight)
Rash - उतावला (Careless, unwise, or acting without thought)
Careful - सावधान (Showing thought and attention to avoid harm)
Wise - बुद्धिमान (Having experience and good judgment)
oa:
This word describes something sharp, severe, or showing great insight. While an acute person may be wise, the word primarily refers to intensity or sharpness rather than the wisdom of judgment.
Synonyms: Sharp (तीव्र), Severe (गंभीर), Keen (तेज).
Antonyms: Dull (नीरस), Mild (हल्का), Obtuse (मूर्ख).

This word describes acting or being done without careful consideration of the consequences. it is the direct logical opposite of judicious, which involve being wise and sensible.
Synonyms: Careless (लापरवाह), Impetuous (आवेगी), Reckless (दुस्साहसी).
Antonyms: Judicious (विवेकपूर्ण), Prudent (सावधान), Careful (सतर्क).

This word describes showing thought and attention to avoid harm. it is a direct synonym for the behavior of a judicious person and therefore not an antonym.
Synonyms: Cautious (सतर्क), Prudent (विवेकी), Vigilant (चौकस).
Antonyms: Careless (लापरवाह), Negligent (असावधान), Rash (उतावला).

This word describes having experience, knowledge, and good judgment. it is the primary synonym for judicious and cannot be used as its opposite.
Synonyms: Sage (बुद्धिमान), Sagacious (चतुर), Intelligent (अकलमंद).
Antonyms: Foolish (मूर्ख), Silly (बेवकूफ), Asinine (बुद्धिहीन).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Cite
questionsEn.s:
Cite - उद्धृत करना (To quote or refer to as evidence)
Present - प्रस्तुत करना (To give, provide, or show something)
Offer - प्रस्ताव देना (To present for acceptance or rejection)
Forget - भूल जाना (To fail to remember something)
Allege - आरोप लगाना (To claim something without proof)
oa:
This word means to give, provide, or show something for others to see. While citing involves presenting evidence, the word is a broad verb and not an antonym.
Synonyms: Offer (प्रस्तुत करना), Exhibit (दिखाना), Submit (जमा करना).
Antonyms: Hide (छिपाना), Withdraw (वापस लेना), Conceal (गुप्तरखना).

This word means to present something for someone to accept or reject. it is a synonym for the act of providing information or evidence and not its opposite.
Synonyms: Propose (प्रस्ताव देना), Provide (प्रदान करना), Give (देना).
Antonyms: Refuse (अस्वीकार करना), Deny (नकारना), Take (लेना).

This word means to fail to remember something. while it involves a loss of information, it is a failure of memory rather than a formal act of asserting something without proof.
Synonyms: Overlook (भूल जाना), Ignore (अनदेखा करना), Neglect (उपेक्षा करना).
Antonyms: Remember (याद रखना), Recall (स्मरण करना), Cite (उद्धृत करना).

This word means to claim or assert that someone has done something wrong, typically without proof. In standardized testing contexts, it contrasts with "cite" (which implies providing actual evidence/quotes).
Synonyms: Claim (दावा करना), Assert (कहना), Maintain (नियत करना).
Antonyms: Prove (सिद्ध करना), Cite (प्रमाण देना), Verify (पुष्टि करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Clash
questionsEn.s:
Clash - टकराव (A fight, argument, or disagreement)
Battle - लड़ाई (A sustained fight between forces)
Argument - बहस (Angry discussion between people)
Brush - मुठभेड़ / झाड़ना (Push away or a minor encounter)
Harmony - सामंजस्य (A state of peace or agreement)
oa:
This word refers to a sustained fight between organized forces. it is a direct synonym for a clash and therefore cannot be used as its opposite.
Synonyms: Fight (लड़ाई), Conflict (संघर्ष), Combat (मुकाबला).
Antonyms: Peace (शांति), Agreement (सहमति), Truce (युद्धविराम).

This word refers to an exchange of diverging or opposite views, usually an angry one. it is a synonym for the verbal form of a clash.
Synonyms: Disagreement (बहस), Dispute (विवाद), Quarrel (झगड़ा).
Antonyms: Agreement (सहमति), Harmony (तालमेल), Accord (सहमति).

This word means to push something away or a brief, minor encounter. While it can imply a small "clash," it is not the conceptual opposite of a conflict.
Synonyms: Touch (स्पर्श), Encounter (मुठभेड़), Sweep (साफ करना).
Antonyms: Avoid (बचना), Hug (गले लगाना), Embrace (अपनाना).

This word refers to a state of being in agreement or concord, or a pleasing combination of elements. it is the direct conceptual opposite of a clash or conflict.
Synonyms: Concord (सामंजस्य), Accord (तालमेल), Unity (एकता).
Antonyms: Clash (टकराव), Discord (कलह), Conflict (विवाद).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Immaculate
questionsEn.s:
Immaculate - निर्मल / बेदाग (Perfectly clean and tidy)
Clean - साफ (Free from dirt or marks)
Bright - उज्ज्वल (Emitting or reflecting light)
Pure - शुद्ध (Not mixed or unadulterated)
Foul - गंदा / घिनौना (Offensively dirty or disgusting)
oa:
This word means free from dirt, marks, or stains. it is the primary synonym for immaculate and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an opposite.
Synonyms: Pure (साफ), Spotless (बेदाग), Pristine (निर्मल).
Antonyms: Dirty (गंदा), Filthy (मैला), Soiled (दूषित).

This word means emitting or reflecting a lot of light. While an immaculate white shirt might be bright, the word describes light rather than the absence of dirt.
Synonyms: Radiant (चमकीला), Luminous (प्रकाशमान), Shining (उज्ज्वल).
Antonyms: Dull (नीरस), Dark (अंधेरा), Dim (धुंधला).

This word means not mixed or adulterated with any other substance. it is a synonym for the "untainted" aspect of being immaculate and not an antonym.
Synonyms: Chaste (पवित्र), Clean (शुद्ध), Clear (साफ).
Antonyms: Impure (अशुद्ध), Corrupt (भ्रष्ट), Tainted (दूषित).

This word describes something that is offensively dirty, disgusting, or smelly. it is the perfect antonym for immaculate, which describes something perfectly clean.
Synonyms: Dirty (गंदा), Nasty (घिनौना), Filthy (मैला).
Antonyms: Immaculate (निर्मल), Clean (साफ), Pure (शुद्ध).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Impute
questionsEn.s:
Impute - दोष मढ़ना (To attribute a fault or blame to someone)
Defend - रक्षा करना (To protect from harm or criticism)
Accuse - आरोप लगाना (To charge someone with an offense)
Assign - सौंपना (To allocate a job or duty)
Blame - दोष देना (To hold responsible for a wrong)
oa:
This word means to resist an attack or to protect someone from blame. Since imputing involves assigning fault or blame, defending represents the act of shielding against such claims.
Synonyms: Protect (रक्षा करना), Uphold (बनाए रखना), Support (समर्थन करना).
Antonyms: Impute (दोषारोपण), Accuse (आरोप लगाना), Attack (हमला करना).

This word means to charge someone with an offense or crime. it is a direct synonym for impute and therefore cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Blame (दोष देना), Indict (अभियुक्त करना), Charge (आरोप लगाना).
Antonyms: Exonerate (निर्दोष ठहराना), Absolve (दोषमुक्त करना), Defend (बचाव करना).

This word means to allocate a job, duty, or value. while impute is a way of "assigning" blame, the word is a synonym and not an opposite.
Synonyms: Allocate (बाँटना), Appoint (नियुक्त करना), Attribute (श्रेय देना).
Antonyms: Withdraw (वापस लेना), Retract (हटाना), Keep (रखना).

This word means to say or think that someone did something wrong. it is the most common synonym for the negative aspect of imputing fault.
Synonyms: Censure (निंदा करना), Reproach (फटकारना), Condemn (दोषी ठहराना).
Antonyms: Praise (प्रशंसा करना), Applaud (सराहना), Commend (गुणगान करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Forsake
questionsEn.s:
Forsake - त्यागना (To abandon or give up on something)
Desert - छोड़ देना (To abandon in a permanent way)
Forgo - त्यागना (To go without something desirable)
Give up - हार मानना (To stop making an effort)
Revert - वापस लौटना (To return to a previous state or practice)
oa:
This word means to abandon someone or something in a way from which they cannot return. it is a direct synonym for forsake and cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Abandon (त्यागना), Quit (छोड़ना), Leave (जाना).
Antonyms: Rejoin (फिर से मिलना), Stay (रुकना), Support (सहारा देना).

This word means to go without something desirable. while it involve sacrifice, it is a synonym for the act of giving something up and not an antonym.
Synonyms: Sacrifice (त्याग करना), Relinquish (छोड़ना), Abjure (त्यागना).
Antonyms: Claim (दावा करना), Enjoy (आनंद लेना), Indulge (लिप्त होना).

This word means to stop making an effort or to cease to have something. it is the most common synonym for forsake and therefore not an antonym.
Synonyms: Surrender (हार मानना), Quit (छोड़ना), Discard (त्यागना).
Antonyms: Persist (जारी रखना), Continue (बनाए रखना), Keep (रखना).

This word means to return to a previous state, practice, or topic. it acts as a functional antonym by implying a return to what was abandoned rather than staying away from it.
Synonyms: Return (लौटना), Recur (पुनरावृत्ति), Regress (वापस जाना).
Antonyms: Forsake (त्यागना), Progress (आगे बढ़ना), Depart (चले जाना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Hinder
questionsEn.s:
Hinder - बाधा डालना (To block or restrict progress)
Arrest - गिरफ्तार करना (To seize or stop a process)
Aid - सहायता करना (To provide help or support)
Check - जांचना / रोकना (To examine or stop motion)
Curb - नियंत्रण (A check or restraint on something)
oa:
This word means to seize someone by legal authority or to stop a process. It is a synonym for the "stopping" aspect of hindering and therefore not an antonym.
Synonyms: Detain (हिरासत में लेना), Stop (रोकना), Halt (विराम).
Antonyms: Release (मुक्त करना), Free (आज़ाद करना), Start (शुरू करना).

This word means to provide help, support, or assistance. It is the direct functional antonym for hindering, which involve creating obstacles.
Synonyms: Help (सहायता), Support (सहारा), Facilitate (सुगम बनाना).
Antonyms: Hinder (बाधा डालना), Block (रोकना), Impede (रुकावट डालना).

This word means to examine accuracy or to stop the motion of something. while it involve testing, it often acts as a synonym for restricting or hindering progress.
Synonyms: Restrain (नियंत्रित करना), Stop (रोकना), Curb (अवरोध).
Antonyms: Allow (अनुमति देना), Permit (होने देना), Ignore (अनदेखा करना).

This word means to check or put a restraint on something. it is a direct synonym for the act of hindering or limiting something and not an opposite.
Synonyms: Restrain (रोकना), Control (नियंत्रित करना), Limit (सीमित करना).
Antonyms: Encourage (बढ़ावा देना), Foster (प्रोत्साहित करना), Boost (बढ़ाना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Provident
questionsEn.s:
Provident - दूरदर्शी / मितव्ययी (Wise and prepared/saving for the future)
Wasteful - अपव्ययी (Using resources carelessly or excessively)
Saving - बचत (Keeping resources for future use)
Cautious - सावधान (Careful to avoid potential problems)
Prepared - तैयार (Ready to deal with something)
oa:
This word describes using resources carelessly or in excessive amounts. It is the direct behavioral antonym for being provident, which implies saving and being wise for the future.
Synonyms: Extravagant (फिजूलखर्च), Prodigal (अपव्ययी), Squandering (गँवाने वाला).
Antonyms: Provident (मितव्ययी), Thrifty (किफायती), Frugal (सावधान).

This word describes the act of keeping money or resources for future use. it is a primary characteristic and synonym of being provident.
Synonyms: Thrifty (बचत करने वाला), Economical (किफायती), Frugal (अल्पव्ययी).
Antonyms: Spending (खर्च करने वाला), Wasteful (अपव्ययी), Lavish (खर्चीला).

This word describes being careful to avoid potential problems. while a provident person is cautious, the word describes alertness rather than the specific act of financial planning.
Synonyms: Wary (सतर्क), Prudent (विवेकी), Watchful (चौकस).
Antonyms: Reckless (लापरवाह), Rash (उतावला), Bold (निडर).

This word describes being ready to do or deal with something. it is the result of being provident, making it a synonym or a related positive state.
Synonyms: Ready (तैयार), Set (नियत), Equipped (सज्जित).
Antonyms: Unprepared (अतैयार), Unready (अतैयार), Surprised (हैरान).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Subtle
questionsEn.s:
Subtle - सूक्ष्म (Fine, delicate, or not obvious)
Fine - बारीक (Thin, delicate, or of high quality)
Implied - अंतर्निहित (Suggested but not directly expressed)
Indirect - अप्रत्यक्ष (Not straight or straightforward)
Harsh - कठोर (Undesirably strong or jarring)
oa:
This word describes something that is very thin, delicate, or of high quality. It is a direct synonym for the delicate nature of being subtle.
Synonyms: Delicate (नाज़ुक), Nice (बारीक), Minute (सूक्ष्म).
Antonyms: Coarse (खुरदरा), Rough (कठोर), Harsh (तीखा).

This word means suggested but not directly expressed. it is a key synonym for the "not obvious" aspect of something that is subtle.
Synonyms: Tacit (अंतर्निहित), Inherent (निहित), Implicit (अप्रत्यक्ष).
Antonyms: Explicit (स्पष्ट), Stated (कहा हुआ), Overt (खुला).

This word means not causing something in a straight way or not being straightforward. it is another synonym for the elusive and subtle nature of an action or remark.
Synonyms: Roundabout (घुमावदार), Oblique (तिरछा), Circuitous (चक्करदार).
Antonyms: Direct (सीधा), Straightforward (सरल), Blunt (मुँहफट).

This word describes something that is undesirably strong, rough, or unpleasantly jarring. it serves as the perfect sensory and behavioral antonym for subtle.
Synonyms: Grating (तीखा), Cruel (निर्दयी), Severe (कठोर).
Antonyms: Subtle (सूक्ष्म), Gentle (कोमल), Mild (हल्का).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Attachments
questionsEn.s:
Attachments - जुड़ाव / लगाव (The action of attaching or a connection)
Junction - संगम (A point where things are joined)
Link - संपर्क (A connection or tie)
Bond - बंधन (To join securely or a strong tie)
Opposition - विरोध (Resistance or dissent against something)
oa:
This word refers to a point where two or more things are joined. it describes the physical location of an attachment and acts as a synonym or related noun.
Synonyms: Intersection (संगम), Connection (जुड़ाव), Link (कड़ी).
Antonyms: Detachment (अलगाव), Separation (विच्छेद), Gap (खाई).

This word refers to a connection or a ring in a chain. it is a direct synonym for an attachment and does not provide an opposite relationship.
Synonyms: Connection (संपर्क), Bond (बंधन), Tie (संबंध).
Antonyms: Break (विराम), Disconnection (अलगाव), Severance (विच्छेद).

This word means to join things securely or describes a strong force of attraction. it is a synonym for the "uniting" aspect of having attachments.
Synonyms: Tie (जुड़ाव), Union (एकता), Adhesion (संसक्ति).
Antonyms: Split (बँटवारा), Dissolution (विघटन), Estrangement (मनमुटाव).

This word refers to resistance, dissent, or the state of being against something. It serves as the logical and behavioral antonym for the concept of joining or having an attachment.
Synonyms: Resistance (विरोध), Conflict (विवाद), Hostility (शत्रुता).
Antonyms: Support (समर्थन), Attachment (जुड़ाव), Agreement (सहमति).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Deliberately
questionsEn.s:
Deliberately - जानबूझकर (Consciously and on purpose)
Consciously - सचेत होकर (With awareness and intent)
Unintentionally - अनजाने में (Not on purpose or by accident)
Wittingly - होशपूर्वक (Knowing aware or intentionally)
Knowingly - जानबूझकर (Showing full knowledge or intent)
oa:
This word means doing something with awareness and intent. it is a direct synonym for deliberately and therefore cannot be its antonym.
Synonyms: Intentionally (जानबूझकर), Purposely (सप्रयोजन), Wittingly (होश में).
Antonyms: Unconsciously (अनजाने में), Involuntarily (अनिच्छा से), Instinctively (सहज भाव से).

This word describes an action that was not done on purpose or by intent. It is the direct and most accurate antonym for doing something deliberately.
Synonyms: Accidentally (अचानक), Inadvertently (अनजाने में), Randomly (बेतरतीब).
Antonyms: Deliberately (जानबूझकर), Intentionally (सोच-समझकर), Wilfully (जानबूझकर).

This word means doing something while being fully aware of the facts. it is a synonym for deliberately and does not satisfy the requirement for an opposite.
Synonyms: Knowingly (जानबूझकर), Consciously (होशपूर्वक), Wilfully (स्वेच्छा से).
Antonyms: Unwittingly (अनजाने में), Ignorantly (अज्ञानतावश), Blindly (बिना देखे).

This word means in a way that shows someone has full knowledge or intent. it is another direct synonym for deliberately and cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Consciously (सचेत होकर), Purposely (उद्देश्यपूर्वक), Intentionally (जानबूझकर).
Antonyms: Unknowingly (अनजाने में), Mistakenly (गलती से), Blindly (अंधाधुंध).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Awakened
questionsEn.s:
Awakened - जाग्रत (Rouse from sleep or stop sleeping)
Hypnotized - सम्मोहित (In a state of hypnosis or trance)
Activated - सक्रिय (To make something active or operative)
Reviewed - समीक्षित (Assessed formally for change)
Around - आस-पास (Located or situated on every side)
oa:
This word refers to being in a state of hypnosis or an artificial trance-like sleep. It represents the best opposite in this set as it describes a state of induced unconsciousness.
Synonyms: Mesmerized (सम्मोहित), Entranced (मंत्रमुग्ध), Spellbound (मंत्रमुग्ध).
Antonyms: Awakened (जाग्रत), Alert (सतर्क), Conscious (सचेत).

This word means to make something operative or active. While an awakened person is active, the word describes the start of a machine or process rather than the opposite of sleep.
Synonyms: Triggered (सक्रिय), Started (शुरू), Energized (ऊर्जावान).
Antonyms: Deactivated (निष्क्रिय), Stopped (बंद), Dormant (सुस्त).

This word means to assess or examine something formally. it describes an intellectual evaluation and has no conceptual link to waking up or being asleep.
Synonyms: Examined (समीक्षित), Evaluated (आंकना), Assessed (आकलन करना).
Antonyms: Ignored (अनदेखा करना), Neglected (उपेक्षा करना), Overlooked (छोड़ना).

This word refers to being located on every side or nearby. It is a preposition or adverb describing position and cannot function as an antonym for a state of consciousness.
Synonyms: Surrounding (आस-पास), Nearby (पास में), Encircling (घेरे हुए).
Antonyms: Far (दूर), Away (अलग), Remote (दूरवर्ती).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Tranquil
questionsEn.s:
Tranquil - शांत (Free from disturbance; peaceful)
Violent - उग्र / हिंसक (Using force or being extremely turbulent)
Quiet - खामोश (Free of noise or uproar)
Calm - स्थिर (Free of disturbance or worry)
Easy - सरल (Posing no difficulty or requiring little effort)
oa:
This word describes using physical force to hurt others or being extremely turbulent and aggressive. it serves as the direct behavioral and situational opposite of being tranquil.
