Synonyms: Aggressive (उग्र), Turbulent (अशांत), Fierce (भयंकर).
Antonyms: Tranquil (शांत), Peaceable (शांतिपूर्ण), Gentle (कोमल).

This word means being free of noise or uproar. It is a direct synonym for tranquil and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an opposite.
Synonyms: Silent (मौन), Still (निश्चल), Hushed (शांत).
Antonyms: Noisy (शोरगुल), Loud (जोरदार), Clamorous (कोलाहलपूर्ण).

This word describes being free of disturbance or high activity. it is the primary synonym for tranquil and cannot be used as its antonym.
Synonyms: Peaceful (शांतिपूर्ण), Serene (निर्मल), Placid (धैर्यवान).
Antonyms: Agitated (उत्तेजित), Worried (चिंतित), Stormy (तूफानी).

This word describes something that poses no difficulty or requires little effort. While a tranquil life might be easy, the word describes effort rather than the lack of disturbance.
Synonyms: Simple (सरल), Effortless (सहज), Manageable (सुगम).
Antonyms: Difficult (कठिन), Hard (मुश्किल), Arduous (श्रमसाध्य).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Shrewd
questionsEn.s:
Shrewd - चतुर (Having clear understanding and good judgment)
Naive - भोला-भाला (Inexpert, innocent, or inexperienced)
Clever - होशियार (Mentally quick and resourceful)
Brainy - बुद्धिमान (Having unusual intelligence)
Artful - चालाक (Skillful in achieving ends with cunning)
oa:
This word describes being mentally quick and resourceful. It is a direct synonym for shrewd and therefore cannot be used as its antonym.
Synonyms: Sharp (चतुर), Canny (चालाक), Astute (सयाना).
Antonyms: Stupid (मूर्ख), Dull (मंद), Inept (अयोग्य).

This word describes someone who is inexperienced, innocent, or too ready to believe others. it is the direct intellectual opposite of being shrewd or cunning.
Synonyms: Innocent (भोला), Credulous (विश्रंभी), Inexpert (अनुभवहीन).
Antonyms: Shrewd (चतुर), Sophisticated (सयाना), Worldly (दुनियादार).

This word is an informal term for having impressive intelligence. it describes a person's smartness, making it a synonym for the core quality of being shrewd.
Synonyms: Intelligent (बुद्धिमान), Smart (होशियार), Brilliant (प्रतिभाशाली).
Antonyms: Ignorant (अज्ञानी), Foolish (मूर्ख), Simple (साधारण).

This word describes having skill in achieving an end, especially through cunning. it is a direct synonym for the "crafty" aspect of being shrewd.
Synonyms: Cunning (चालाक), Sly (धूर्त), Wily (कपटपूर्ण).
Antonyms: Guileless (निष्कपट), Artless (सीधा-सादा), Sincere (ईमानदार).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Suspicious
questionsEn.s:
Suspicious - संदिग्ध (Doubtful, unsure, or distrustful)
Doubtful - अनिश्चित (Inclined to doubt or unsure)
Jealous - ईर्ष्यालु (Envious of someone else's advantage)
Wondering - जिज्ञासु (Thinking with curiosity or doubt)
Trustworthy - विश्वसनीय (Able to be relied on as honest)
oa:
This word describes someone who is unsure or inclined to doubt. It is a direct synonym for suspicious and therefore not an antonym.
Synonyms: Unsure (अनिश्चित), Skeptical (शंकालु), Questioning (संदिग्ध).
Antonyms: Certain (निश्चित), Confident (निश्चित), Sure (पक्का).

This word describes feeling resentment that someone else has an advantage or attraction. While it is a negative emotion, it refers to envy rather than a lack of trust.
Synonyms: Envious (ईर्ष्यालु), Resentful (द्वेषपूर्ण), Covetous (लोभी).
Antonyms: Generous (उदार), Satisfied (संतुष्ट), Content (तृप्त).

This word refers to thinking about something with curiosity or being unsure. It aligns with the "questioning" nature of suspicion rather than opposing it.
Synonyms: Curious (उत्सुक), Inquiring (जिज्ञासु), Pondering (विचारशील).
Antonyms: Knowing (जानकार), Certain (निश्चित), Indifferent (उदासीन).

This word describes someone who can be relied on as honest or truthful. it serves as the direct functional opposite of being suspicious or distrustful.
Synonyms: Reliable (भरोसेमंद), Honest (ईमानदार), Faithful (विश्वसनीय).
Antonyms: Suspicious (संदिग्ध), Deceitful (कपटी), Shifty (धूर्त).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Extreme
questionsEn.s:
Extreme - चरम / अत्‍यधिक (Reaching the highest degree)
Mild - हल्का (Not severe, serious, or harsh)
Highest - सर्वोच्च (The top position or greatest degree)
Maximum - अधिकतम (The greatest possible amount)
Supreme - सर्वोपरि (Highest in rank or authority)
oa:
This word describes something that is not severe, serious, or harsh. It is the direct logical opposite of an extreme degree of intensity or weather.
Synonyms: Gentle (हल्का), Moderate (मध्यम), Soft (नरम).
Antonyms: Extreme (चरम), Severe (गंभीर), Intense (तीव्र).

This word refers to the top position or the greatest degree. it is a synonym for the upper limit aspect of being extreme and not an antonym.
Synonyms: Supreme (सर्वोच्च), Maximum (अधिकतम), Topmost (शिखर).
Antonyms: Lowest (न्यूनतम), Base (आधार), Bottom (निचला).

This word refers to the greatest amount or quantity possible. it describes an extreme limit and therefore acts as a synonym.
Synonyms: Utmost (अधिकतम), Greatest (सबसे बड़ा), Peak (चरम).
Antonyms: Minimum (न्यूनतम), Least (सबसे कम), Nominal (नाममात्र).

This word describes something highest in rank or authority. it is a synonym for the "ultimate" or "highest" sense of being extreme.
Synonyms: Utmost (परम), Paramount (सर्वोपरि), Sovereign (प्रभु).
Antonyms: Lowly (तुच्छ), Inferior (अधीन), Subordinate (गौण).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Miserable
questionsEn.s:
Miserable - दुखी (Extremely unhappy or uncomfortable)
Joyful - आनंदित (Feeling or showing great happiness)
Agonized - पीड़ित (In a state of intense pain or suffering)
Inferior - निम्न (Lower in rank, status, or quality)
Penniless - कंगाल (Very poor; having no money)
oa:
This word describes feeling or showing great happiness and pleasure. It is the direct emotional antonym for being miserable (extremely unhappy).
Synonyms: Happy (प्रसन्न), Cheerful (हर्षित), Elated (उल्लसित).
Antonyms: Miserable (दुखी), Sad (उदासीन), Wretched (दयनीय).

This word describes being in a state of intense physical or mental pain. It is a high-intensity synonym for being miserable and cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Pained (पीड़ित), Tortured (व्यथित), Distressed (कष्टपूर्ण).
Antonyms: Ecstatic (अति प्रसन्न), Joyous (आनंदित), Comforted (आश्वस्त).

This word describes something lower in rank, status, or quality. It refers to a hierarchical position or value rather than a state of happiness or sadness.
Synonyms: Lower (निम्न), Substandard (घटिया), Secondary (गौण).
Antonyms: Superior (श्रेष्ठ), Better (बेहतर), Excellent (उत्कृष्ट).

This word describes someone who is very poor and has no money. while extreme poverty can make one miserable, the word is a financial status, not an emotional antonym.
Synonyms: Poor (दरिद्र), Destitute (निर्धन), Impecunious (कंगाल).
Antonyms: Wealthy (धनी), Affluent (संपन्न), Rich (अमीर).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Lucid
questionsEn.s:
Lucid - स्पष्ट (Clearly expressed and easy to understand)
Explicit - सुस्पष्ट (Stated clearly and in detail)
Crystal-clear - अत्यंत स्पष्ट (Exceptionally easy to understand)
Vague - अस्पष्ट (Uncertain, indefinite, or unclear)
Understandable - समझने योग्य (Able to be understood)
oa:
This word means stated clearly and in detail, leaving no room for doubt. it is a direct synonym for the clarity implied by lucid.
Synonyms: Clear (स्पष्ट), Precise (सटीक), Definite (निश्चित).
Antonyms: Ambiguous (संदिग्ध), Vague (अस्पष्ट), Obscure (धुंधला).

This word describes something that is exceptionally transparent or easy to understand. it is a strong synonym for lucid and not its opposite.
Synonyms: Transparent (पारदर्शी), Obvious (प्रत्यक्ष), Evident (साफ).
Antonyms: Opaque (अपारदर्शी), Cloudy (धुंधला), Muddy (मैला).

This word describes something that is unclear, indefinite, or not clearly expressed. It serves as the direct intellectual opposite of being lucid.
Synonyms: Unclear (अस्पष्ट), Ambiguous (संदिग्ध), Fuzzy (धुंधला).
Antonyms: Lucid (स्पष्ट), Explicit (सुस्पष्ट), Precise (सटीक).

This word means able to be understood or comprehended. it is a synonym for the primary quality of a lucid explanation and not an antonym.
Synonyms: Comprehensible (समझने योग्य), Logical (तार्किक), Clear (साफ).
Antonyms: Incomprehensible (असमझनीय), Obscure (दुर्बोध), Baffling (हैरान करने वाला).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Lucid
questionsEn.s:
Lucid - स्पष्ट (Expressed clearly; easy to understand)
Clear - साफ (Easy to perceive or interpret)
Distinct - विशिष्ट (Recognizably different in nature)
Vague - अस्पष्ट (Uncertain, indefinite, or unclear)
Bright - उज्ज्वल (Giving or reflecting much light)
oa:
This word means easy to perceive or understand. it is the primary synonym for lucid and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an opposite.
Synonyms: Obvious (साफ), Lucid (स्पष्ट), Evident (प्रत्यक्ष).
Antonyms: Vague (अस्पष्ट), Obscure (धुंधला), Hidden (छिपा हुआ).

This word means recognizably different in nature from something else. While clarity often makes things distinct, the word refers to difference rather than the opposite of being easy to understand.
Synonyms: Different (अलग), Clear-cut (सुस्पष्ट), Individual (विशिष्ट).
Antonyms: Indistinct (अस्पष्ट), Similar (समान), Vague (अनिश्चित).

This word refers to things that are uncertain, indefinite, or not clearly expressed. It is the direct and perfect antonym for being lucid or clear.
Synonyms: Unclear (अस्पष्ट), Ambiguous (संदिग्ध), Hazy (धुंधला).
Antonyms: Lucid (स्पष्ट), Explicit (सुस्पष्ट), Certain (निश्चित).

This word means giving or reflecting much light. While physical clarity can involve brightness, the word refers to illumination rather than the ease of understanding an idea.
Synonyms: Shining (चमकीला), Luminous (प्रकाशमान), Radiant (दीप्तिमान).
Antonyms: Dark (अंधेरा), Dull (नीरस), Dim (धुंधला).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Jovial
questionsEn.s:
Jovial - हंसमुख (Cheerful and friendly in manner)
Happy - खुश (Feeling pleasure or contentment)
Gay - प्रसन्न (Light-hearted and carefree)
Merry - आनंदमय (Cheerfully and lovely in mood)
Sorrowful - दुखी (Feeling or showing deep grief)
oa:
This word means feeling or showing pleasure or contentment. it is a direct synonym for the core emotion of being jovial and not an opposite.
Synonyms: Cheerful (प्रसन्न), Glad (खुश), Joyful (आनंदित).
Antonyms: Sad (दुखी), Miserable (दयनीय), Depressed (उदास).

This word describes being light-hearted and carefree. It is an old synonym for being cheerful or jovial and cannot serve as its antonym.
Synonyms: Mirthful (आनंदमयी), Blithe (निश्चिंत), Cheerful (हर्षित).
Antonyms: Morose (चिड़चिड़ा), Gloomy (उदास), Sullen (खिन्न).

This word means cheerfully and lovely, often associated with a lively mood. it is a direct synonym for jovial and therefore not an antonym.
Synonyms: Jolly (हंसमुख), Joyous (आनंदमय), Festive (उत्सवपूर्ण).
Antonyms: Sorrowful (शोकग्रस्त), Depressed (उदास), Gloomy (उदास).

This word describes feeling or showing deep grief or sadness. It is the direct and most accurate emotional antonym for being jovial.
Synonyms: Sad (दुखी), Mournful (शोकाकुल), Melancholy (विषादपूर्ण).
Antonyms: Jovial (हंसमुख), Happy (खुश), Cheerful (प्रसन्न).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Terrible
questionsEn.s:
Terrible - भयानक (Extremely bad or serious)
Bad - बुरा (Of poor quality or unpleasant)
Dire - गंभीर (Extremely serious or urgent)
Nice - सुखद / अच्छा (Giving pleasure or satisfaction)
Poor - गरीब / घटिया (Lacking money or low standard)
oa:
This word describes something of poor quality or something that causes trouble. it is a general synonym for the negative quality of being terrible and is not an opposite.
Synonyms: Poor (बुरा), Nasty (घिनौना), Awful (भयानक).
Antonyms: Good (अच्छा), Excellent (श्रेष्ठ), Great (महान).

This word describes something extremely serious, urgent, or ominous. it is a synonym for the extreme negative intensity of being terrible.
Synonyms: Critical (गंभीर), Alarming (चिंताजनक), Desperate (भयानक).
Antonyms: Trivial (तुच्छ), Unimportant (महत्वहीन), Bright (उज्ज्वल).

This word describes something giving pleasure or satisfaction; pleasant or attractive. It serves as a simple and effective antonym for being terrible.
Synonyms: Pleasant (सुखद), Agreeable (अनुकूल), Fine (अच्छा).
Antonyms: Terrible (भयानक), Awful (बहुत बुरा), Horrible (भीषण).

This word describes a lack of money or being of a low standard. While it shares a negative tone with terrible, it is not a direct opposite for something that causes horror or extreme distress.
Synonyms: Meager (अल्प), Needy (दरिद्र), Inferior (घटिया).
Antonyms: Rich (अमीर), Wealthy (संपन्न), Excellent (उत्कृष्ट).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: BARE
questionsEn.s:
BARE - नग्न / खुला (Without covering or clothing)
Bald - गंजा (Having no hair or natural covering)
Covered - ढका हुआ (Protected or concealed by something)
Naked - नंगा (Without clothing or covering)
Shorn - कटा हुआ (Stripped of hair or wool)
oa:
This word means having little or no hair on the scalp or a surface without its natural covering. It is a synonym for the "uncovered" aspect of being bare.
Synonyms: Hairless (गंजा), Exposed (नग्न), Stark (खुला).
Antonyms: Hairy (बालों वाला), Covered (ढका हुआ), Furry (रुआँदार).

This word means protected, concealed, or having something placed over it. it is the direct physical and conceptual opposite of being bare or exposed.
Synonyms: Hidden (छिपा हुआ), Protected (सुरक्षित), Cloaked (ढका हुआ).
Antonyms: Bare (नग्न), Exposed (खुला), Naked (नंगा).

This word means without clothing or covering. it is the most direct synonym for bare and therefore cannot satisfy the requirement for an opposite.
Synonyms: Nude (नंगा), Stripped (उघड़ा), Uncovered (अनावृत).
Antonyms: Dressed (पहना हुआ), Clothed (सज्जित), Covered (ढका).

This word is the past participle of "shear," meaning to strip or cut hair or wool. since it involves making something bare, it is a synonym for the action that creates a bare state.
Synonyms: Cut (कटा हुआ), Stripped (छीना हुआ), Trimmed (तराशा हुआ).
Antonyms: Long (लंबा), Shaggy (बालों वाला), Full (भरपूर).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: CAPTURE
questionsEn.s:
CAPTURE - पकड़ना (To take by force or gain control of)
Arrest - गिरफ्तार करना (To seize by legal authority)
Catching - पकड़ना (Capturing something that is moving)
Grab - झपटना (To take hold of something suddenly)
Release - छोड़ना / मुक्त करना (To free from captivity or bondage)
oa:
This word means to seize someone by legal authority. it is a direct synonym for the act of capturing a person and not its antonym.
Synonyms: Apprehend (पकड़ना), Detain (हिरासत में लेना), Seize (ज़ब्त करना).
Antonyms: Free (आज़ाद करना), Release (छोड़ना), Liberate (मुक्त करना).

This word is the present participle of "catch," meaning to capture something that is moving. it is a synonym for the core action of capturing.
Synonyms: Seizing (पकड़ना), Grabbing (झपटना), Snaring (जाल में फाँसना).
Antonyms: Missing (चूक जाना), Dropping (गिराना), Releasing (मुक्त करना).

This word means to take hold of something suddenly or roughly. it describes a forceful way to capture something and acts as a synonym.
Synonyms: Snatch (झपटना), Clutch (पकड़ना), Seize (पकड़ना).
Antonyms: Loose (छोड़ना), Release (मुक्त करना), Relinquish (त्यागना).

This word means to free from captivity, confinement, or restraint. It is the perfect functional antonym for the act of capturing or seizing something.
Synonyms: Free (आज़ाद करना), Liberate (मुक्त करना), Discharge (छोड़ना).
Antonyms: Capture (पकड़ना), Confine (कैद करना), Seize (ज़ब्त करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: COMMAND
questionsEn.s:
COMMAND - आदेश (To direct with authority or an order)
Permission - अनुमति (A formal consent from authority)
Direction - निर्देश (Management or guidance of someone)
Law - कानून (A system of recognized rules)
Call - पुकारना / बुलाना (To cry out or summon someone)
oa:
This word refers to a formal consent given by an authority to perform a task. since a command is an authoritative order that must be obeyed, permission represents the act of allowing choice or grant.
Synonyms: Consent (अनुमति), Authorization (मंजूरी), Approval (स्वीकृति).
Antonyms: Command (आदेश), Prohibition (निषेध), Denial (अस्वीकार).

This word refers to the management or guidance of something or someone. it is a direct synonym for the function of a command and not its antonym.
Synonyms: Guidance (मार्गदर्शन), Instruction (निर्देश), Control (नियंत्रण).
Antonyms: Mismanagement (कुप्रबंधन), Chaos (अराजकता), Disarray (अव्यवस्था).

This word refers to a system of rules that a country recognizes and enforces. While distinct, laws function as standing commands to a society, making them related terms rather than opposites.
Synonyms: Statute (विधान), Regulation (विनियम), Rule (नियम).
Antonyms: Anarchy (अराजकता), Chaos (अव्यवस्था), Lawlessness (अधर्म).

This word can mean to summon someone or to cry out. it describes a generic vocal action that is often used to give a command, making it a near-synonym in some contexts.
Synonyms: Summon (बुलाना), Shout (चिल्लाना), Invoke (आह्वान करना).
Antonyms: Ignore (अनदेखा करना), Dismiss (खारिज करना), Silence (चुप्पी).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: KINDNESS
questionsEn.s:
KINDNESS - दया (Having friendly feelings or being helpful)
Meanness - नीचता (Selfishness, unkindness, or small-mindedness)
Service - सेवा (An act of helpful activity for others)
Shameful - शर्मनाक (Feeling ashamed or disgraceful)
Fatal - घातक (Leading to death or disaster)
oa:
This word refers to a lack of generosity, being unkind, or being selfish and small-minded. It is the direct emotional and behavioral antonym for kindness.
Synonyms: Cruelty (क्रूरता), Spite (दुर्भावना), Malice (द्वेष).
Antonyms: Kindness (दया), Generosity (उदारता), Benevolence (भलाई).

This word refers to an act of helpful activity or work done for others. it is a physical manifestation of kindness and therefore acts as a synonym or related term.
Synonyms: Assistance (सहायता), Aid (मदद), Help (सेवा).
Antonyms: Obstruction (बाधा), Harm (नुकसान), Neglect (उपेक्षा).

This word describes behavior that is disgraceful or causing embarrassment. While unkind acts can be shameful, the word describes the social disgrace of an action rather than the opposite of being kind.
Synonyms: Disgraceful (शर्मनाक), Scandulous (कलंकपूर्ण), Base (नीच).
Antonyms: Honorable (सम्माननीय), Worthy (योग्य), Noble (महान).

This word describes something that leads to death or disaster. it refers to a deadly outcome and has no linguistic relation to the act of being kind or helpful.
Synonyms: Deadly (घातक), Lethal (जानलेवा), Mortal (नश्वर).
Antonyms: Life-giving (जीवन देने वाला), Beneficial (लाभकारी), Harmless (अहानिकर).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: RECONDITE
questionsEn.s:
RECONDITE - दुर्भेद्य (Dealing with a difficult subject known by few)
Difficult - कठिन (Something that is not easily done or understood)
Straightforward - सीधा-सादा (Easy to understand or direct)
Hard - मुश्किल (Difficult or strong to deal with)
Occult - गुप्त (Beyond general knowledge; secret)
oa:
This word describes something that is not easily done, understood, or achieved. it is a direct synonym for the "hard to understand" nature of being recondite.
Synonyms: Hard (कठिन), Challenging (चुनौतीपूर्ण), Arduous (मुश्किल).
Antonyms: Easy (सरल), Simple (आसान), Effortless (सहज).

This word describes something that is simple to understand, direct, and lacks complexity. It is the direct intellectual opposite of being recondite.
Synonyms: Simple (सरल), Direct (सीधा), Lucid (स्पष्ट).
Antonyms: Recondite (दुर्भेद्य), Complex (जटिल), Ambiguous (संदिग्ध).

This word describes something that requires much effort to deal with or is difficult to comprehend. it is another synonym for the obscure nature of being recondite.
Synonyms: Tough (मुश्किल), Strenuous (श्रमसाध्य), Complex (जटिल).
Antonyms: Soft (कोमल), Light (हल्का), Simple (सरल).

This word refers to something that is beyond the range of general knowledge or involves the supernatural. It is a synonym for the "secret/hidden" meaning of recondite.
Synonyms: Mysterious (रहस्यमय), Esoteric (गूढ़), Arcane (गुप्त).
Antonyms: Natural (प्राकृतिक), Public (सार्वजनिक), Common (सामान्य).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: APPLAUD
questionsEn.s:
APPLAUD - सराहना (Show approval or praise by clapping)
Praise - प्रशंसा (Express warm approval or admiration)
Clap - ताली बजाना (To strike palms together to applaud)
Criticize - आलोचना करना (To indicate faults in a disapproving way)
Cheer - जयजयकार (Shout for joy or in encouragement)
oa:
This word means to express warm approval or admiration. it is the most common synonym for applaud and therefore cannot serve as its antonym.
Synonyms: Laud (गुणगान करना), Commend (सराहना), Extol (तारीफ़ करना).
Antonyms: Criticize (आलोचना करना), Condemn (निंदा करना), Slander (निंदा).

This word refers to the physical action of striking palms together to show approval. It is the primary way to applaud, making it a synonym for the gesture.
Synonyms: Slap (ताली बजाना), Bang (धमाका), Beat (ठोकना).
Antonyms: Silence (चुप्पी), Hiss (सिसकारी), Boo (तिरस्कार).

This word means to indicate the faults of someone or something in a disapproving way. It is the direct verbal and emotional antonym for applauding or approving.
Synonyms: Censure (निंदा करना), Disapprove (अस्वीकार करना), Reprimand (फटकारना).
Antonyms: Applaud (सराहना करना), Praise (प्रशंसा करना), Appreciate (सराहना).

This word means to shout for joy or in encouragement. Like praise and clap, it is a form of applause and acts as a synonym rather than an opposite.
Synonyms: Celebrate (खुशी मनाना), Root for (समर्थन करना), Exult (हर्षित होना).
Antonyms: Groan (कराहना), Boo (तिरस्कार करना), Jeer (मजाक उड़ाना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Congested
questionsEn.s:
Congested - भीड़-भाड़ वाला (Crowded so as to prevent movement)
Cleared - साफ किया हुआ (Removing objects or obstructions)
Choked - अवरुद्ध (Blocked up or difficulty in breathing)
Crammed - ठसाठस भरा (Completely filled to overflowing)
Crowded - भीड़ वाला (Full of people with little room)
oa:
This word means getting rid of objects or obstructions from an area. It serves as the direct and most accurate antonym for being congested (crowded or blocked).
Synonyms: Empty (साफ), Free (मुक्त), Unblocked (खुला).
Antonyms: Congested (भीड़-भाड़ वाला), Blocked (अवरुद्ध), Clogged (भरा हुआ).

This word describes being blocked up or having breathing obstructed. it is a synonym for the "blocked" sense of being congested and cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Blocked (रुका हुआ), Obstructed (बाधित), Stuffed (भरा हुआ).
Antonyms: Clear (साफ), Open (खुला), Breathing (साँस लेता हुआ).

This word means completely filled to the point of overflowing. it is a strong synonym for the "overcrowded" nature of congestion and not an antonym.
Synonyms: Packed (ठसाठस), Stuffed (भरा हुआ), Crowded (भीड़ वाला).
Antonyms: Empty (खाली), Vacant (शून्य), Hollow (पोला).

This word describes a place full of people with little room for movement. it is a direct synonym for the given word and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an opposite.
Synonyms: Thronged (भीड़-भाड़), Jammed (भरा हुआ), Bustling (हलचल वाला).
Antonyms: Deserted (निर्जन), Isolated (सुनसान), Empty (खाली).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: GRADUAL
questionsEn.s:
GRADUAL - क्रमिक (Taking place slowly or by degrees)
Moderate - मध्यम (Average in amount or intensity)
Rapid - तेज़ (Happening in a short time or at a great rate)
Measured - नियमित (Having a slow, regular rhythm)
Slow - धीमा (Moving or happening without much speed)
oa:
This word means average in amount, intensity, or degree. it describes a middle ground that is similar to the "slow/steady" nature of being gradual and acts as a synonym.
Synonyms: Temperate (मध्यम), Reasonable (उचित), Balanced (संतुलित).
Antonyms: Extreme (चरम), Drastic (भीषण), Rapid (तेज़).

This word refers to something happening in a very short time or at a great rate. It is the direct chronological and intensity-based antonym for being gradual.
Synonyms: Quick (तेज़), Fast (द्रुत), Sudden (आकस्मिक).
Antonyms: Gradual (क्रमिक), Slow (धीमा), Steady (नियमित).

This word means having a slow, regular rhythm or being carefully considered. like gradual, it implies a lack of speed and therefore acts as a synonym.
Synonyms: Calculated (नियत), Methodical (नियमित), Rhythmic (लयबद्ध).
Antonyms: Haphazard (बेतरतीब), Rapid (तेज़), Sudden (अचानक).

This word means moving or happening without much speed. it is the most common synonym for the "degree-by-degree" nature of being gradual and not its antonym.
Synonyms: Sluggish (धीमा), Leisurly (आरामदेह), Dilatory (विलंबकारी).
Antonyms: Fast (तेज़), Quick (जल्दी), Rapid (द्रुत).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: CONSENSUS
questionsEn.s:
CONSENSUS - आम सहमति (A general agreement among a group)
Disagreement - असहमति (Not in harmony or accordance in opinion)
Agreement - समझौता (A binding arrangement or harmony)
Consent - सहमति (Permission or agreement to a proposal)
Harmony - सामंजस्य (A state of peaceful agreement or concord)
oa:
This word refers to a lack of harmony or accord in opinion or feeling. It is the perfect and most accurate antonym for consensus, which means a general agreement.
Synonyms: Discord (असहमत), Conflict (विवाद), Dissent (विरोध).
Antonyms: Consensus (सहमति), Agreement (समझौता), Accord (तालमेल).

This word refers to a negotiated and typically legally binding arrangement. it is the primary synonym for consensus and therefore cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Consent (सहमति), Accord (समझौता), Concurrence (एकरूपता).
Antonyms: Disagreement (असहमत), Conflict (संघर्ष), Deny (नकारना).

This word means permission for something to happen or agreement to a proposal. it is a direct synonym for the act of agreeing and not an antonym.
Synonyms: Approval (मंजूरी), Permission (अनुमति), Sanction (स्वीकृति).
Antonyms: Refusal (इनकार), Objection (आपत्ति), Dissent (असहमत).

This word refers to a state of being in agreement or concord. while it describes a peaceful state, it is a synonym for the unity found in a consensus.
Synonyms: Unity (एकता), Accord (तालमेल), Peace (शांति).
Antonyms: Discord (कलह), Strife (संघर्ष), Chaos (अव्यवस्था).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: AFFLUENCE
questionsEn.s:
AFFLUENCE - संपन्नता (The state of having a great deal of money; wealth)
Luxury - विलासिता (Great comfort or elegance at high expense)
Poverty - गरीबी (The state of being extremely poor)
Prosperity - समृद्धि (The state of being successful and flourishing)
Richness - प्रचुरता (Plentiful quantities of something desirable)
oa:
This word refers to a state of great comfort or elegance involving great expense. it is a direct result and synonym for the state of affluence.
Synonyms: Opulence (शानदार), Richness (वैभव), Wealth (विलासिता).
Antonyms: Austerity (कठोरता), Simplicity (सादगी), Poverty (गरीबी).

This word refers to the state of being extremely poor or lacking the means to provide for basic needs. it is the direct socioeconomic antonym for affluence.
Synonyms: Penury (दरिद्रता), Destitution (निर्धनता), Indigence (कमी).
Antonyms: Affluence (संपन्नता), Wealth (धन), Richness (अमीरी).

This word refers to the state of being successful, especially in financial terms. it is a synonym for affluence and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an opposite.
Synonyms: Success (सफलता), Fortune (भाग्य), Wealth (समृद्धि).
Antonyms: Adversity (विपत्ति), Failure (विफलता), Penury (गरीबी).

This word refers to the state of containing plentiful quantities of something desirable. like affluence, it describes abundance and acts as its synonym.
Synonyms: Abundance (प्रचुरता), Plentitude (भरमार), Plenty (अधिकता).
Antonyms: Scarcity (अभाव), Dearth (कमी), Lack (कमी).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: ILLICIT
questionsEn.s:
ILLICIT - अवैध (Forbidden by law, rules, or custom)
Prohibited - वर्जित (Something that has been forbidden or banned)
Illegal - गैरकानूनी (Contrary to or forbidden by law)
Lawful - वैध (Conforming to or permitted by law)
Illegible - अस्पष्ट (Handwriting not clear enough to be read)


Hence, 'Lawful ' is the most suitable antonym for 'ILLICIT'.
oa:
This word means something that has been forbidden by authority or law. it is a direct synonym for illicit and therefore cannot be used as its antonym.
Synonyms: Banned (वर्जित), Forbidden (मना किया हुआ), Barred (प्रतिबंधित).
Antonyms: Allowed (अनुमत), Permitted (मंजूर), Legal (कानूनी).

This word describes something that is contrary to or forbidden by law. it is the most common synonym for illicit and does not provide an opposite.
Synonyms: Unlawful (गैरकानूनी), Illegitimate (अवैध), Felonious (अपराधी).
Antonyms: Legal (कानूनी), Lawful (वैध), Valid (मान्य).

This word means conforming to, permitted by, or recognized by law or rules. it is the perfect antonym for illicit, which involve being forbidden.
Synonyms: Legal (वैध), Legitimate (कानूनी), Valid (मान्य).
Antonyms: Illicit (अवैध), Illegal (गैरकानूनी), Unlawful (अवैध).

This word describes handwriting or print that is not clear enough to be read. while it sounds similar to illicit, its meaning is entirely unrelated to legal permission.
Synonyms: Unreadable (अस्पष्ट), Indecipherable (दुर्बोध), Scrawled (बदशक्ल).
Antonyms: Legible (सुपाठ्य), Clear (साफ), Readable (पढ़ने योग्य).

test.instructions: Standard CBT Pattern Exam. Positive Marks: +1, Negative Marks: -0.25. Total Questions: 50.

test.title: Set - 22

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Relaxed
questionsEn.s:
Relaxed - तनावमुक्त (Free from tension and anxiety)
Calm - शांत (Tranquil and quiet)
Tense - तनावग्रस्त (Feeling nervous or unable to relax)
Arrogant - अभिमानी (Having an exaggerated sense of importance)
Peaceful - शांतिपूर्ण (Free from disturbance or conflict)
oa:
This word describes a state of being peaceful and quiet, free from strong emotions. It is a synonym for relaxed rather than an opposite, making it unsuitable for the requirement.
Synonyms: Tranquil (शांत), Serene (निर्मल), Placid (सौम्य).
Antonyms: Agitated (उत्तेजित), Nervous (घबराया हुआ), Turbulent (अशांत).

This word refers to a person who is unable to relax due to nervousness, anxiety, or stress. It is the direct emotional and physical antonym of being relaxed.
Synonyms: Strained (तनावपूर्ण), Anxious (चिंतित), Rigid (सख्त).
Antonyms: Relaxed (निश्चिंत), Calm (शांत), Loose (ढीला).

This word refers to having or revealing an exaggerated sense of one's own importance or abilities. It describes a personality flaw regarding ego rather than a state of tension or relaxation.
Synonyms: Haughty (अहंकारी), Conceited (अभिमानी), Proud (घमंडी).
Antonyms: Humble (विनम्र), Modest (विनीत), Meek (नम्र).

This word describes a situation or state that is free from disturbance or conflict. It carries a similar meaning to relaxed and therefore does not function as its opposite.
Synonyms: Amicable (शांतिपूर्ण), Quiet (शांत), Untroubled (निश्चिंत).
Antonyms: Violent (हिंसक), Chaotic (अराजक), Noisy (शोरगुल).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Steep
questionsEn.s:
Steep - तीव्र ढाल (Almost perpendicular incline or slope)
Narrow - तंग (Limited in width)
Shallow - छिछला (Of little depth)
Rough - खुरदरा (Having an uneven surface)
Flat - समतल (Horizontal without any slope)
oa:
This word refers to something that is small in width or limited in extent. It describes the horizontal distance across an object rather than the vertical angle or slope.
Synonyms: Slender (तंग), Thin (संकीर्ण), Constricted (संकुचित).
Antonyms: Broad (चौड़ा), Wide (विस्तृत), Spacious (विशाल).

This word describes something that is of little depth or only concerned with surface matters. It refers to depth rather than the sharpness of an incline or slope.
Synonyms: Superficial (सतही), Cursory (छिछला), Empty (खाली).
Antonyms: Deep (गहरा), Profound (गहन), Intensive (गहन).

This word refers to an uneven or irregular surface that is not smooth. While it describes terrain, it does not specifically address the angle of a climb or descent.
Synonyms: Coarse (खुरदरा), Rugged (कठोर), Uneven (असमतल).
Antonyms: Smooth (चिकना), Level (समतल), Polished (चमकीला).

This word describes a horizontal surface without any slope, tilt, or elevation. It is the perfect antonym for steep, which implies a sharp or vertical incline.
Synonyms: Level (समतल), Horizontal (क्षैतिज), Plane (मैदान).
Antonyms: Steep (ढालू), Inclined (झुका हुआ), Sloping (तिरछा).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Startle
questionsEn.s:
Startle - चौंका देना (To cause a sudden shock or alarm)
Agitate - उत्तेजित करना (To make someone feel troubled or nervous)
Shock - सदमा पहुँचाना (A sudden upsetting event or experience)
Amaze - चकित करना (To surprise someone greatly)
Soothe - शांत करना (To gently calm a person or their feelings)
oa:
This word means to make someone feel troubled, nervous, or upset. It is a synonym for the emotional distress caused by being startled rather than an opposite.
Synonyms: Disturb (परेशान करना), Fluster (घबराहट पैदा करना), Perturb (व्याकुल करना).
Antonyms: Soothe (शांत करना), Calm (स्थिर करना), Comfort (दिलासा देना).

This word refers to causing a sudden upsetting or surprising event that is hard to process. Like startle, it implies a sudden reaction to something unexpected.
Synonyms: Stun (भौंचक्का करना), Appal (डराना), Astound (चकित करना).
Antonyms: Expect (अपेक्षा करना), Assure (आश्वस्त करना), Predict (पूर्वानुमान करना).

This word means to surprise someone greatly or fill them with astonishment. It shares the same element of surprise as the given word and is not an antonym.
Synonyms: Astonish (चकित करना), Surprise (हैरान करना), Bewilder (भ्रमित करना).
Antonyms: Bore (उबाना), Tire (थकाना), Unimpress (प्रभावित न करना).

This word means to gently calm someone or alleviate their feelings of fear or distress. It is the direct functional opposite of startling someone.
Synonyms: Pacify (शांत करना), Comfort (राहत देना), Assuage (कम करना).
Antonyms: Startle (चौंकाना), Irritate (चिढ़ाना), Agitate (उत्तेजित करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Vanity
questionsEn.s:
Vanity - घमंड (Excessive pride in one's appearance or achievements)
Nobility - श्रेष्ठता (The quality of being noble in character)
Honour - सम्मान (High respect or great esteem)
Conceit - अहंकार (Excessive pride in oneself)
Modesty - नम्रता (The quality of being unassuming)
oa:
This word refers to the quality of being noble in character, birth, or rank. It describes high moral or social status rather than a person's attitude toward their own achievements.
Synonyms: Virtue (श्रेष्ठता), Dignity (मर्यादा), Honor (सम्मान).
Antonyms: Meanness (नीचता), Corruption (भ्रष्टता), Ignobility (अधमता).

This word refers to high respect and great esteem shown by others. While it is a positive trait, it describes social recognition rather than the humble attitude that opposes vanity.
Synonyms: Prestige (प्रतिष्ठा), Glory (महिमा), Reputation (यश).
Antonyms: Shame (शर्म), Disgrace (कलंक), Dishonour (अपमान).

This word refers to excessive pride in oneself. It is a direct synonym for vanity and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an antonym.
Synonyms: Egotism (अहंकार), Narcissism (आत्ममुग्धता), Arrogance (घमंड).
Antonyms: Modesty (नम्रता), Humility (विनम्रता), Diffidence (संकोच).

This word refers to the quality of being unassuming or moderate in the estimation of one's own abilities. it is the direct and perfect antonym for vanity.
Synonyms: Humility (विनम्रता), Meekness (नम्रता), Simplicity (सादगी).
Antonyms: Vanity (घमंड), Conceit (अहंकार), Pride (गर्व).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Infallible
questionsEn.s:
Infallible - अचूक (Incapable of making mistakes or being wrong)
Imperfect - अपूर्ण (Not perfect; having faults or flaws)
Notorious - कुख्यात (Famous for some bad quality or deed)
Dependable - विश्वसनीय (Trustworthy and reliable)
Flawless - दोषरहित (Without any imperfections or defects)
oa:
This word describes something that has faults, flaws, or is capable of making mistakes. It is the direct and logical antonym for infallible, which means incapable of error.
Synonyms: Flawed (त्रुटिपूर्ण), Faulty (दोषयुक्त), Defective (अपूर्ण).
Antonyms: Infallible (अचूक), Perfect (पूर्ण), Flawless (दोषरहित).

This word describes being famous or well-known for a bad quality or deed. It refers to reputation and social standing rather than the ability to perform without mistakes.
Synonyms: Infamous (कुख्यात), Disreputable (बदनाम), Scandulous (कलंकित).
Antonyms: Reputable (प्रतिष्ठित), Famous (प्रसिद्ध), Esteemed (आदरणीय).

This word refers to someone or something that is trustworthy and reliable. it is often a characteristic of being infallible rather than an opposite.
Synonyms: Reliable (विश्वसनीय), Trustworthy (भरोसेमंद), Constant (अटल).
Antonyms: Fickle (अस्थिर), Unreliable (अविश्वसनीय), Capricious (मनमौजी).

This word describes something without any imperfections or defects. It is a synonym for the given word and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an antonym.
Synonyms: Impeccable (निर्दोष), Perfect (पूर्ण), Absolute (शुद्ध).
Antonyms: Flawed (दोषपूर्ण), Imperfect (अपूर्ण), Defective (खराब).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Reward
questionsEn.s:
Reward - इनाम (A thing given in recognition of service)
Praise - प्रशंसा (Expression of warm approval)
Produce - उत्पादन करना (To make from components or raw materials)
Present - वर्तमान/उपहार (Existing now or given as a gift)
Punish - दंड देना (To inflict a penalty for an offense)
oa:
This word means to express warm approval or admiration. It is a verbal form of a reward and therefore acts as a synonym rather than an opposite.
Synonyms: Commend (प्रशंसा करना), Applaud (सराहना), Extol (तारीफ़ करना).
Antonyms: Criticize (आलोचना करना), Censure (निंदा करना), Blame (दोष देना).

This word means to make or manufacture something from raw materials. It describes an industrial or creative action and has no relation to giving recognition for a service.
Synonyms: Manufacture (उत्पादन करना), Create (बनाना), Yield (पैदा करना).
Antonyms: Destroy (नष्ट करना), Consume (उपभोग करना), Ruin (बर्बाद करना).

This word refers to something given as a gift or to the state of existing at the moment. While a present can be a reward, the word does not function as an opposite.
Synonyms: Gift (उपहार), Current (वर्तमान), Exhibit (प्रस्तुत करना).
Antonyms: Past (अतीत), Absent (अनुपस्थित), Future (भविष्य).

This word means to inflict a penalty on someone as retribution for an offense. It is the direct logical and behavioral antonym of giving a reward.
Synonyms: Penalize (दंड देना), Discipline (अनुशासित करना), Castigate (फटकारना).
Antonyms: Reward (इनाम देना), Forgive (क्षमा करना), Pardon (माफ़ करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Fragile
questionsEn.s:
Fragile - नाजुक (Easily broken or damaged)
Gross - कुल/भद्दा (Total amount or obvious/unacceptable)
Novel - नया (New and original)
Tiny - बहुत छोटा (Very small in size)
Tough - मजबूत (Not easily broken or very strong)
oa:
This word refers to the total amount before deductions or something very obvious and unacceptable. It describes quantity or quality and does not oppose the physical property of being easily broken.
Synonyms: Total (कुल), Coarse (भद्दा), Flagrant (घोर).
Antonyms: Net (निवल), Fine (महीन), Subtle (सूक्ष्म).

This word means something that is new, original, or unusual. It describes the age or uniqueness of an idea or object rather than its physical strength or delicacy.
Synonyms: Innovative (नया), Original (मौलिक), Unique (अनोखा).
Antonyms: Old (पुराना), Traditional (पारंपरिक), Ordinary (साधारण).

This word describes something that is very small. Small objects can be fragile, so the word acts as a potential characteristic rather than providing an opposite for durability.
Synonyms: Small (छोटा), Minuscule (अति सूक्ष्म), Petite (नन्हा).
Antonyms: Huge (विशाल), Enormous (विशालकाय), Massive (बड़ा).

This word refers to something that is strong, durable, and not easily broken, torn, or cut. It is the direct physical antonym of being fragile.
Synonyms: Robust (मजबूत), Durable (टिकाऊ), Strong (शक्तिशाली).
Antonyms: Fragile (नाजुक), Weak (कमजोर), Flimsy (कमज़ोर).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Persuade
questionsEn.s:
Persuade - राजी करना (To make someone do something by reasoning)
Endorse - समर्थन करना (To give official support or agreement)
Dissuade - मना करना (To persuade someone NOT to do something)
Convince - आश्वस्त करना (To succeed in making someone believe)
Fume - क्रोधित होना (To be very angry about something)
oa:
This word means to say publicly that you give official support or agreement to a plan or statement. It is an act of following or supporting an idea, not an opposite of convincing.
Synonyms: Support (समर्थन करना), Sanction (मंजूरी देना), Approve (अनुमोदन करना).
Antonyms: Oppose (विरोध करना), Reject (अस्वीकार करना), Denounce (निंदा करना).

This word means to convince someone not to take a particular course of action. It is the direct and perfect antonym for persuade (convince to do).
Synonyms: Deter (रोकना), Discourage (निरुत्साहित करना), Divert (ध्यान हटाना).
Antonyms: Persuade (मनाना), Convince (राजी करना), Induce (प्रेरित करना).

This word means to cause someone to believe firmly in the truth of something. It is a direct synonym for persuade and therefore cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Persuade (मनाना), Assure (आश्वस्त करना), Satisfy (संतुष्ट करना).
Antonyms: Dissuade (मना करना), Confuse (भ्रमित करना), Doubt (संदेह करना).

This word means to be very angry or to emit smoke. It describes an emotional outburst of anger and has no conceptual link to the act of reasoning or persuasion.
Synonyms: Rage (क्रोधित होना), Seethe (उबलना), Smoke (धुआँ छोड़ना).
Antonyms: Calm down (शांत होना), Delight (खुश होना), Please (प्रसन्न करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Quell
questionsEn.s:
Quell - दमन करना (To end something, typically by force)
Deny - इनकार करना (To state that something is not true)
Agitate - उत्तेजित करना (To make people feel strongly or stir up)
Entire - पूरा (Whole or complete)
Reduce - घटाना (To make something less or smaller)
oa:
This word means to state that something is not true or to refuse to accept a request. While it involves rejection, it does not describe the act of stirring up trouble that opposes quelling.
Synonyms: Refuse (नकारना), Reject (अस्वीकार करना), Disavow (त्यागना).
Antonyms: Admit (स्वीकार करना), Accept (मानना), Confirm (पुष्टि करना).

This word means to make people feel very strongly about something or to stir up a situation to cause trouble. it is the direct opposite of quelling, which means to end a disturbance.
Synonyms: Provoke (उत्तेजित करना), Inflame (भड़काना), Instigate (उकसाना).
Antonyms: Quell (शांत करना), Pacify (दबाना), Calm (स्थिर करना).

This word means whole or complete, having all its parts. it is a descriptor of quantity and completeness and has no relation to the act of ending or starting a riot.
Synonyms: Whole (पूरा), Total (संपूर्ण), Complete (समूचा).
Antonyms: Partial (अधूरा), Incomplete (अपूर्ण), Fragmented (खंडित).

This word means to make something less or smaller in quantity or price. While quelling reduces a disturbance, the word "reduce" is too broad to serve as a precise antonym.
Synonyms: Decrease (घटाना), Lessen (कम करना), Diminish (छोटा करना).
Antonyms: Increase (बढ़ाना), Expand (फैलाना), Augment (वृद्धि करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Confront
questionsEn.s:
Confront - सामना करना (To come face to face with hostile intent)
Oppose - विरोध करना (To disagree with and attempt to prevent)
Avoid - बचना (To keep away from or stop doing something)
Encounter - मुठभेड़ (Unexpectedly be faced with something)
Meet - मिलना (To come into the presence of someone)
oa:
This word means to disagree with and attempt to prevent something. it is a near-synonym for the hostile intent found in confronting and therefore is not an opposite.
Synonyms: Resist (विरोध करना), Counter (मुक़ाबला करना), Withstand (सहना).
Antonyms: Support (समर्थन करना), Agree (सहमत होना), Aid (सहायता करना).

This word means to keep away from or stop oneself from doing something. it is the direct antonym for confront, which means to face someone directly with hostile intent.
Synonyms: Evade (बचना), Shun (त्यागना), Dodge (टालना).
Antonyms: Confront (सामना करना), Face (सामने आना), Meet (मिलना).

This word means to unexpectedly be faced with or experience something hostile. It is a synonym for confront and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an opposite.
Synonyms: Face (सामना करना), Meet (मिलना), Undergo (अनुभव करना).
Antonyms: Avoid (बचना), Evade (टालना), Escape (बच निकलना).

This word means to arrange or happen to come into the presence of someone. It is a general term for coming face-to-face and does not denote the opposite of a confrontation.
Synonyms: Greet (मिलना), Encounter (सामना होना), Contact (संपर्क करना).
Antonyms: Miss (चूकना), Avoid (बचना), Part (अलग होना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Distant
questionsEn.s:
Distant - दूर (Far away in space or time)
Close - निकट (Only a short distance away)
Beyond - के परे (At or to the further side)
Faraway - दूर (Distant in space or time)
Remote - दूरवर्ती (Situated far from main centers)
oa:
This word refers to something that is only a short distance away in space or time. It is the direct and most accurate antonym for distant, which implies being far away.
Synonyms: Near (निकट), Adjacent (सटा हुआ), Proximate (पास).
Antonyms: Distant (दूर), Far (दूर), Remote (दूरवर्ती).

This word refers to the further side of something or being outside the range of. While it relates to distance, it is a preposition or adverb of location rather than an opposite for "distant."
Synonyms: Past (परे), Further (आगे), Outside (बाहर).
Antonyms: Inside (अंदर), Near (पास), Within (भीतर).

This word means situated at a great distance. It is a direct synonym for the given word and therefore cannot be its antonym.
Synonyms: Distant (दूर), Remote (दूरवर्ती), Isolated (अलग-थलग).
Antonyms: Close (निकट), Nearby (पास), Local (स्थानीय).

This word refers to a place situated far from the main centers of population. Like faraway, it shares the same meaning as distant and does not provide the required opposite.
Synonyms: Isolated (दूर), Secluded (एकांत), Distant (दूरवर्ती).
Antonyms: Central (केंद्रीय), Accessible (सुगम), Close (निकट).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Better
questionsEn.s:
Better - बेहतर (More desirable, satisfactory, or effective)
Good - अच्छा (Desired or approved of)
Worst - सबसे खराब (Of the poorest quality or lowest standard)
Bad - बुरा (Of poor quality or low standard)
Worse - बदतर (Of poorer quality or lower standard)
oa:
This word refers to something that is desired, approved of, or of high quality. While related, it is the positive base form and does not function as an opposite for the comparative "better."
Synonyms: Fine (अच्छा), Quality (बढ़िया), Choice (श्रेष्ठ).
Antonyms: Bad (बुरा), Poor (घटिया), Awful (भयानक).

This word means of the poorest quality or the lowest standard. It is the superlative opposite of "best," but "better" requires its direct comparative counterpart.
Synonyms: Lowest (सबसे खराब), Poorest (सबसे घटिया), Dreadful (भीषण).
Antonyms: Best (सबसे अच्छा), Finest (श्रेष्ठतम), Top (शीर्ष).

This word describes something of poor quality or a low standard. It is the base opposite, whereas "better" is a comparative term and needs a comparative antonym.
Synonyms: Poor (बुरा), Evil (दुष्ट), Nasty (खराब).
Antonyms: Good (अच्छा), Excellent (उत्कृष्ट), Beneficial (लाभकारी).

This word refers to something of poorer quality or lower standard. It is the direct comparative antonym for better, used when comparing two negative states or levels.
Synonyms: Inferior (खराब), Poorer (घटिया), Declining (बदतर).
Antonyms: Better (बेहतर), Improved (सुधरा हुआ), Superior (बेहतर).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Deficit
questionsEn.s:
Deficit - कमी (Shortfall or shortage of a sum of money or quantity)
Shortage - अभाव (A situation where something needed is obtaining in insufficient amounts)
Abundance - प्रचुरता (A very large quantity of something)
Scarcity - कमी (The state of being scarce or in short supply)
Manifold - अनेक (Many and various)
oa:
This word means a state or situation in which something needed cannot be obtained in sufficient amounts. It is a direct synonym for deficit and cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Lack (कमी), Scarcity (अभाव), Deficiency (न्यूनता).
Antonyms: Surplus (अधिशेष), Abundance (प्रचुरता), Excess (अधिकता).

This word refers to a very large quantity or more than enough of something. It is the direct antonym for a deficit, which implies a shortfall or shortage.
Synonyms: Surplus (प्रचुरता), Plenty (भरपूर), Profusion (बाहुल्य).
Antonyms: Deficit (कमी), Scarcity (अभाव), Dearth (अकाल).

This word means the state of being in short supply or difficult to find. it is a synonym for the given word and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an opposite.
Synonyms: Dearth (अभाव), Paucity (अल्पता), Insufficiency (कमी).
Antonyms: Plenitude (भरपूर), Abundance (प्रचुरता), Wealth (संपन्नता).

This word means many and various. While it describes a large number, it refers to variety and diversity rather than the economic or quantitative balance implied by deficit.
Synonyms: Diverse (विविध), Multiple (अनेक), Various (तरह-तरह के).
Antonyms: Single (एकल), Uniform (समान), Simple (साधारण).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Fertile
questionsEn.s:
Fertile - उपजाऊ (Capable of producing abundant crops or offspring)
Barren - बंजर (Too poor to produce much or any vegetation)
Civilized - सभ्य (At an advanced stage of social development)
Sane - समझदार (Of sound mind; not mad)
Tough - कठोर (Strong and not easily broken or durable)
oa:
This word describes land that is too poor to produce crops or any vegetation. It is the direct physical and biological opposite of being fertile.
Synonyms: Infertile (अनुर्वर), Sterile (बांझ), Unproductive (बंजर).
Antonyms: Fertile (उपजाऊ), Fecund (उर्वर), Productive (उत्पादक).

This word describes a society that has reached an advanced stage of social and cultural development. It refers to human behavior and history rather than soil productivity.
Synonyms: Cultured (सभ्य), Refined (शिष्ट), Polite (भद्र).
Antonyms: Barbaric (असभ्य), Savage (बर्बर), Wild (जंगली).

This word refers to a person of sound mind who is not mad or mentally ill. It describes mental health and has no relation to the ability of land to produce crops.
Synonyms: Rational (समझदार), Lucid (चेतन), Sensible (विवेकपूर्ण).
Antonyms: Insane (पागल), Mad (विक्षिप्त), Crazy (सनकी).

This word refers to something that is strong, durable, or difficult to deal with. While it describes a physical quality, it is not the conceptual opposite of productivity in land.
Synonyms: Durable (मजबूत), Hardy (सहनशील), Rugged (कठोर).
Antonyms: Weak (कमज़ोर), Fragile (नाजुक), Soft (मुलायम).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Acute
questionsEn.s:
Acute - तीव्र/नुकीला (Sharp, severe, or intense)
Dark - अंधेरा (Devoid of light)
Clever - चतुर (Mentally quick and resourceful)
Grave - गंभीर (Meriting serious consideration)
Blunt - कुंठित/मुँहफट (Not sharp or speaking without being polite)
oa:
This word refers to the absence of light or being deep in color. It describes a physical environment or shade rather than the severity or sharpness of a condition.
Synonyms: Gloomy (अंधेरा), Obscure (धुंधला), Dim (धुंधला).
Antonyms: Bright (उज्ज्वल), Light (प्रकाशित), Radiant (चमकीला).

This word describes someone who is quick to understand or learn. while "acute" can sometimes mean mentally sharp, "clever" is its synonym, not its opposite.
Synonyms: Sharp (चतुर), Intelligent (बुद्धिमान), Astute (सयाना).
Antonyms: Stupid (मूर्ख), Inept (अयोग्य), Dull (मंदबुद्धि).

This word describes a situation that is serious, solemn, or giving cause for alarm. it is a synonym for the "severe" meaning of acute and cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Serious (गंभीर), Critical (महत्वपूर्ण), Solemn (शान्त).
Antonyms: Trivial (तुच्छ), Frivolous (हल्का), Minor (मामूली).

This word refers to an object that is not sharp or a person who speaks without trying to be polite. it is the direct physical and metaphorical antonym for acute (sharp).
Synonyms: Dull (कुंठित), Unsharpened (बिना धार का), Direct (मुँहफट).
Antonyms: Acute (तीव्र/नुकीला), Sharp (तेज़), Keen (तीक्ष्ण).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Gloomy
questionsEn.s:
Gloomy - उदास/अंधेरा (Dark, poorly lit, or depressing)
Cloudy - बादलों से घिरा (Dull, dense, or covered with clouds)
Bright - उज्ज्वल (Shining, glittering, or cheerful)
Dull - नीरस (Lacking interest or excitement)
Greedy - लालची (Having an intense desire for more)
oa:
This word describes a sky covered with clouds or a liquid that is not clear. it is often a cause of a gloomy atmosphere and thus acts as a synonym or related term.
Synonyms: Overcast (मेघाच्छादित), Hazy (धुंधला), Murky (मैला).
Antonyms: Sunny (धूपदार), Clear (साफ), Bright (उज्ज्वल).

This word refers to something that is full of light, vivid in color, or cheerful in mood. It is the direct and perfect antonym for gloomy (dark/depressing).
Synonyms: Radiant (चमकीला), Luminous (प्रकाशमान), Cheerful (प्रसन्न).
Antonyms: Gloomy (उदास), Dark (अंधेरा), Dim (धुंधला).

This word describes something that is lacking interest, excitement, or brightness. It is a synonym for gloomy and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an opposite.
Synonyms: Boring (नीरस), Drab (फीका), Humdrum (नीरस).
Antonyms: Exciting (रोमांचक), Vivid (जीवंत), Sharp (तेज़).

This word describes having or showing an intense and selfish desire for wealth or food. It refers to a moral character trait and has no relation to the light level or mood of a place.
Synonyms: Avaricious (लालची), Covetous (लोभी), Insatiable (अतृप्त).
Antonyms: Generous (उदार), Selfless (निःस्वार्थ), Content (संतुष्ट).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Impartial
questionsEn.s:
Impartial - निष्पक्ष (Fair, unprejudiced, and unbiased)
Biased - पक्षपाती (Favoring one side over the other)
Judicious - विवेकपूर्ण (Wise, sensible, and prudent)
Involved - शामिल/जटिल (Difficult to understand or participating)
Impractical - अव्यावहारिक (Unrealistic or impossible to succeed)
oa:
This word refers to someone who unfairly favors one person or side over another. It is the direct and most accurate antonym for being impartial (fair and neutral).
Synonyms: Prejudiced (पक्षपाती), Partisan (तरफ़दार), Partial (अधूरा/पक्षपाती).
Antonyms: Impartial (निष्पक्ष), Neutral (तटस्थ), Unbiased (पक्षपातहीन).

This word describes having or showing good judgment or sense. While a judicious person might be impartial, the word refers to wisdom rather than the lack of bias.
Synonyms: Wise (विवेकपूर्ण), Prudent (सावधान), Sensible (समझदार).
Antonyms: Unwise (मूर्खतापूर्ण), Rash (जल्दबाज़), Impudent (बेशर्म).

This word describes being difficult to understand or being part of a particular situation. it refers to participation or complexity rather than the presence of fairness or bias.
Synonyms: Complicated (जटिल), Engaged (शामिल), Intricate (पेचीदा).
Antonyms: Simple (सरल), Detached (अलग), Uninvolved (असंबद्ध).

This word describes an idea or plan that is not sensible or likely to be successful in real situations. it refers to feasibility rather than the fairness of a judgment.
Synonyms: Unrealistic (अव्यावहारिक), Idealistic (आदर्शवादी), Infeasible (असंभव).
Antonyms: Practical (व्यावहारिक), Realistic (यथार्थवादी), Workable (संभव).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Jovial
questionsEn.s:
Jovial - हँसमुख (Cheerful, friendly, and jolly)
Hesitant - दुविधापूर्ण (Unsure or slow in acting)
Cheerful - प्रसन्न (Happy and optimistic)
Gloomy - उदास (Sad, poorly lit, or pessimistic)
Tired - थका हुआ (Weary or in need of rest)
oa:
This word describes being unsure or slow in speaking or doing actions. it refers to a lack of confidence or certainty rather than the opposite of a cheerful personality.
Synonyms: Tentative (दुविधापूर्ण), Wavering (अस्थिर), Reluctant (अनिच्छुक).
Antonyms: Confident (निश्चित), Decisive (निर्णायक), Eager (उत्सुक).

This word means feeling happy and showing it through behavior. It is a direct synonym for jovial and therefore does not function as its opposite.
Synonyms: Jolly (हँसमुख), Merry (प्रसन्न), Radiant (आनंदित).
Antonyms: Sad (उदास), Gloomy (विषादपूर्ण), Miserable (दुखी).

This word describes being dark, depressing, or having a mood of persistent sadness. it is the perfect emotional antonym for being jovial (cheerful and friendly).
Synonyms: Somber (विषादपूर्ण), Dismal (उदास), Sullen (चिड़चिड़ा).
Antonyms: Jovial (प्रसन्नचित्त), Happy (खुश), Cheerful (हर्षित).

This word refers to a feeling of being in need of rest or sleep. it describes a physical state of exhaustion rather than a long-standing personality trait or mood.
Synonyms: Weary (थका हुआ), Exhausted (पस्त), Fatigued (चूर).
Antonyms: Refreshed (ताज़ा), Energetic (ऊर्जावान), Lively (जीवंत).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Adept
questionsEn.s:
Adept - निपुण (Very good or skillful at something)
Efficient - कार्यकुशल (Able to work well without mistakes)
Competent - सक्षम (Having the necessary ability or skill)
Inept - अयोग्य (Not able to do something well; clumsy)
Skilled - कुशल (Having special training or ability)
oa:
This word means able to work well without making mistakes or wasting time. While an adept person is efficient, the word is a near-synonym and not an opposite.
Synonyms: Competent (कार्यकुशल), Productive (उत्पादक), Capable (सक्षम).
Antonyms: Inefficient (अकुशल), Sluggish (सुस्त), Wasteful (अपव्ययी).

This word refers to having the necessary ability or skill for a task. Like "efficient," it is a synonym for being adept and therefore cannot be its antonym.
Synonyms: Skilled (सक्षम), Proficient (निपुण), Able (योग्य).
Antonyms: Incompetent (अक्षम), Inept (अयोग्य), Unskilled (अकुशल).

This word describes a person who is not able to do something well; they lack skill or effectiveness. it is the direct and perfect antonym for being adept.
Synonyms: Clumsy (अनाड़ी), Unskilled (अकुशल), Inexpert (अदक्ष).
Antonyms: Adept (निपुण), Skilled (कुशल), Expert (विशेषज्ञ).

This word describes someone who has the training or natural ability to do a job well. it is a direct synonym for the given word and cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Deft (दक्ष), Gifted (प्रतिभाशाली), Talented (गुणी).
Antonyms: Amateur (शौकिया), Inept (अनाड़ी), Clumsy (फूहड़).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Delicious
questionsEn.s:
Delicious - स्वादिष्ट (Having a very pleasant taste or smell)
Tepid - गुनगुना (Only slightly warm/lukewarm)
Gross - भद्दा/कुल (Very obvious and unacceptable or total)
Insipid - बेस्वाद (Having too little taste or flavor)
Salty - नमकीन (Having the taste of salt)
oa:
This word refers to liquids that are only slightly warm or lukewarm. While it can describe unappealing food, its primary meaning relates to temperature rather than taste quality.
Synonyms: Lukewarm (गुनगुना), Mild (नरम), Half-hearted (उत्साहहीन).
Antonyms: Boiling (खौलता हुआ), Frigid (बर्फीला), Enthusiastic (उत्साही).

This word refers to the total amount before anything is taken away, or something extremely unpleasant. it is too broad and intense to be the precise antonym for a word describing taste.
Synonyms: Vulgar (भद्दा), Massive (विशाल), Flagrant (घोर).
Antonyms: Net (निवल), Fine (महीन), Delicate (नाजुक).

This word refers to something that has too little taste, flavor, or character; it is bland or flavorless. it is the direct culinary antonym for delicious.
Synonyms: Bland (बेस्वाद), Tasteless (फीका), Vapid (नीरस).
Antonyms: Delicious (स्वादिष्ट), Savory (चटपटा), Tasty (ज़ायके़दार).

This word describes something that has the taste of or contains a lot of salt. it is a specific flavor profile and not a general opposite for "tasting good."
Synonyms: Briny (नमकीन), Saline (खारा), Piquant (तीखा).
Antonyms: Sweet (मीठा), Fresh (ताजा), Bland (फीका).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Attract
questionsEn.s:
Attract - आकर्षित करना (To cause to come closer or give attention)
Lure - प्रलोभन देना (To trick someone by offering a reward)
Repel - दूर भगाना (To push something back or away)
Allure - आकर्षण (The quality of being attractive and exciting)
Invite - निमंत्रित करना (To ask someone to come somewhere)
oa:
This word means to persuade or trick someone into going somewhere by offering a reward. It is a specific way of attracting and therefore acts as a synonym.
Synonyms: Entice (प्रलोभन देना), Allure (लुभाना), Tempt (ललचाना).
Antonyms: Repel (दूर भगाना), Warn (चेतावनी देना), Deter (रोकना).

This word means to drive or push something or someone back or away. It is the direct physical and social antonym for the word attract.
Synonyms: Reject (दूर धकेलना), Disgust (घृणा पैदा करना), Resist (विरोध करना).
Antonyms: Attract (आकर्षित करना), Lure (लुभाना), Draw (खींचना).

This word refers to the quality of being powerfully attractive and exciting. it is a synonym for the given word and cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Charm (आकर्षण), Magnetism (सम्मोहन), Fascination (मोह).
Antonyms: Repulsion (विकर्षण), Dullness (नीरसता), Ugliness (कुरूपता).

This word means to ask someone to come somewhere or do something. it is an action used to attract social presence and is not an antonym.
Synonyms: Summon (निमंत्रित करना), Welcome (स्वागत करना), Request (अनुरोध करना).
Antonyms: Exclude (निकालना), Banish (निर्वासित करना), Reject (अस्वीकार करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Hopeful
questionsEn.s:
Hopeful - आशावान (Believing that something you want will happen)
Optimistic - आशावादी (Expecting good things to happen)
Cheerful - प्रसन्न (Feeling happy and showing it)
Healthy - स्वस्थ (Strong, well, and not often ill)
Pessimistic - निराशावादी (Thinking that bad things are more likely)
oa:
This word refers to expecting good things to happen or being successful. It is a direct synonym for hopeful and therefore does not function as an opposite.
Synonyms: Sanguine (आशावादी), Confident (निश्चित), Positive (सकारात्मक).
Antonyms: Pessimistic (निराशावादी), Gloomy (उदास), Cynical (संदेहवादी).

This word means feeling happy and showing it. While hopeful people are often cheerful, the word describes a current emotional state rather than a future outlook.
Synonyms: Joyful (प्रसन्न), Radiant (हर्षित), Merry (हँसमुख).
Antonyms: Sad (दुखी), Miserable (दयनीय), Somber (विषादपूर्ण).

This word describes being strong, well, and not often ill. it refers to physical or mental well-being rather than the expectation of a positive outcome.
Synonyms: Robust (निरोग), Fit (तंदुरुस्त), Sound (स्वस्थ).
Antonyms: Sick (बीमार), Infirm (अशक्त), Frail (दुर्बल).

This word describes thinking that bad things are more likely to happen or focusing on the worst part of a situation. it is the direct antonym for being hopeful.
Synonyms: Gloomy (निराशावादी), Cynical (शंकालु), Negative (नकारात्मक).
Antonyms: Hopeful (आशावान), Optimistic (आशावादी), Sanguine (उत्साही).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Attract
questionsEn.s:
Attract - आकर्षित करना (To cause to come closer by offering interest)
Lure - ललचाना (To tempt someone to do something)
Praise - प्रशंसा करना (To express warm approval)
Charm - मोहित करना (Power or quality of pleasing others)
Repel - दूर भगाना (To drive or force an attacker back or away)
oa:
This word means to tempt someone by offering an advantage. It describes the act of drawing someone in, making it a synonym for the given word.
Synonyms: Entice (ललचाना), Allure (लुभाना), Tempt (फुसलाना).
Antonyms: Repel (दूर भगाना), Warn (चेतावनी देना), Deter (रोकना).

This word means to express approval or admiration for someone. While positive, it relates to evaluation rather than the force of drawing objects or people together.
Synonyms: Commend (प्रशंसा करना), Extol (तारीफ़ करना), Laud (सराहना).
Antonyms: Criticize (आलोचना करना), Censure (निंदा करना), Scold (डांटना).

This word refers to the power of pleasing or attracting others. it is a noun or verb that acts as a synonym for attract and cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Ensnare (मोहित करना), Captivate (वशीभूत करना), Fascinate (लुभाना).
Antonyms: Repulse (घृणा पैदा करना), Offend (अपमानित करना), Disgust (खीझ दिलाना).

This word refers to the force that pushes someone or something away. it is the direct and most accurate antonym for the concept of attraction.
Synonyms: Drive back (पीछे धकेलना), Reject (अस्वीकार करना), Distaste (अरुचि).
Antonyms: Attract (आकर्षित करना), Draw (खींचना), Invite (आमंत्रित करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Glee
questionsEn.s:
Glee - आनंद (Great delight, especially from good fortune)
Joy - खुशी (A feeling of great pleasure)
Woe - संताप (Great sorrow or distress; trouble)
Mirth - उल्लास (Amusement, especially expressed in laughter)
Fun - मज़ा (Enjoyment or light-hearted pleasure)
oa:
This word refers to a feeling of great pleasure and happiness. It is a synonym for glee and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an opposite.
Synonyms: Delight (हर्ष), Bliss (परमानंद), Happiness (प्रसन्नता).
Antonyms: Sorrow (दुख), Misery (कष्ट), Sadness (उदासी).

This word refers to great sorrow, distress, or things that cause trouble. It is the perfect emotional and situational antonym for glee.
Synonyms: Misery (संताप), Distress (कष्ट), Anguish (पीड़ा).
Antonyms: Glee (आनंद), Joy (खुशी), Mirth (प्रसन्नता).

This word refers to amusement, especially as expressed in laughter. It describes the same positive energy as glee and cannot be used as its antonym.
Synonyms: Laughter (हँसी), Merriment (खुशी), Gaiety (उल्लास).
Antonyms: Melancholy (विषाद), Gloom (उदासी), Gravity (गंभीरता).

This word refers to enjoyment, amusement, or light-hearted pleasure. it is a less formal synonym for glee and does not provide an opposite meaning.
Synonyms: Entertainment (मज़ा), Play (खेल), Diversion (मनोरंजन).
Antonyms: Boredom (ऊब), Drudgery (कठिन श्रम), Misery (कष्ट).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Boisterous
questionsEn.s:
Boisterous - उद्धत (Noisy, energetic, and cheerful)
Peaceful - शांतिपूर्ण (Free from disturbance; tranquil)
Noisy - शोर मचाने वाला (Making a lot of noise)
Stormy - तूफानी (Characterized by strong winds or violence)
Loud - जोरदार (Producing much noise)
oa:
This word describes a state that is free from disturbance, noise, or conflict. It is the direct behavioral opposite of being boisterous (noisy and energetic).
Synonyms: Tranquil (शांत), Quiet (स्थिर), Serene (निर्मल).
Antonyms: Boisterous (उद्धत), Noisy (शोरगुल), Stormy (तूफानी).

This word describes making or given to making a lot of noise. It is a direct synonym for the given word and therefore cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Clamorous (शोर मचाने वाला), Rowdy (उपद्रवी), Loud (जोरदार).
Antonyms: Silent (मौन), Quiet (शांत), Hushed (शांत).

This word describes character or weather that is characterized by strong winds or violent disturbance. it is similar in intensity to being boisterous and is not an antonym.
Synonyms: Turbulent (तूफानी), Violent (उग्र), Blustery (तेज़ हवा वाला).
Antonyms: Calm (शांत), Placid (सौम्य), Mild (हल्का).

This word describes producing or capable of producing much noise. it is a primary characteristic of being boisterous and therefore acts as a synonym.
Synonyms: Resonant (तेज़), Blaring (जोरदार), Piercing (तीखा).
Antonyms: Soft (मृदु), Faint (मंद), Inaudible (न सुनाई देने वाला).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Feasible
questionsEn.s:
Feasible - संभव (Possible to do easily or conveniently)
Implausible - असंभव (Not seeming reasonable or probable)
Profitable - लाभप्रद (Yielding profit or financial gain)
Attainable - प्राप्य (Able to be attained or reached)
Achievable - साध्य (Able to be reached successfully)
oa:
This word describes something that does not seem reasonable or probable; it fails to convince. It is the direct antonym for feasible, which means easily possible.
Synonyms: Unlikely (असंभव), Impossible (असाध्य), Doubtful (संदिग्ध).
Antonyms: Feasible (संभव), Plausible (प्रशंसनीय), Credible (विश्वसनीय).

This word means yielding profit or financial gain. while a feasible project might be profitable, the word describes money-making potential rather than possibility.
Synonyms: Lucrative (लाभप्रद), Beneficial (फायदेमंद), Gainful (उपयोगी).
Antonyms: Unprofitable (अलाभकारी), Loss-making (घाटे का), Useless (बेकार).

This word refers to something that is able to be reached or achieved. it is a direct synonym for feasible and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an antonym.
Synonyms: Achievable (प्राप्य), Reachable (पहुँच योग्य), Possible (संभव).
Antonyms: Unattainable (अप्राप्य), Beyond reach (पहुँच से बाहर), Impossible (असंभव).

This word means able to be brought about or reached successfully. Like "attainable," it is a synonym for the given word and cannot be used as its opposite.
Synonyms: Feasible (संभव), Viable (व्यावहारिक), Doable (करने योग्य).
Antonyms: Hopeless (निराशाजनक), Futile (व्यर्थ), Unachievable (अप्राप्य).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Shrink
questionsEn.s:
Shrink - सिकुड़ना (To become or make smaller in size)
Reduce - घटाना (To make smaller in amount or degree)
Decrease - कम करना (To become smaller or fewer)
Enlarge - बड़ा करना (To make larger or more extensive)
Lessen - कम करना (To become less or diminish)
oa:
This word means to make something smaller in amount, degree, or size. It is a direct synonym for shrink and therefore cannot be used as its opposite.
Synonyms: Decrease (घटाना), Lessen (कम करना), Diminish (छोटा करना).
Antonyms: Increase (बढ़ाना), Expand (फैलाना), Augment (वृद्धि करना).

This word refers to becoming smaller or fewer in size or number. Like "reduce," it shares the same meaning as shrink and does not provide an opposite.
Synonyms: Wane (घटना), Drop (गिरना), Decline (कम होना).
Antonyms: Rise (उठना), Grow (बढ़ना), Increase (बढ़ाना).

This word means to make something larger or more extensive. It is the direct physical and conceptual antonym for the word shrink.
Synonyms: Expand (विस्तार करना), Magnify (बड़ा करना), Increase (बढ़ाना).
Antonyms: Shrink (सिकुड़ना), Contract (संकुचित करना), Compress (छोटा करना).

This word means to make something less or to diminish it. it is another synonym for the reduction implied by shrink and is not its antonym.
Synonyms: Abate (कम करना), Subside (धीमा करना), Moderate (नरम करना).
Antonyms: Intensify (तीव्र करना), Increase (बढ़ाना), Heighten (ऊँचा करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Ambiguous
questionsEn.s:
Ambiguous - अस्पष्ट (Not clear or decided; multiple meanings)
Strange - अजीब (Unusual or surprising)
Uncertain - अनिश्चित (Not known or definite)
Clear - स्पष्ट (Easy to perceive or understand)
Indefinite - अनिश्चित (Lasting for an unknown time or not defined)
oa:
This word describes something unusual or surprising that is difficult to understand. while an ambiguous statement can be strange, the word describes uniqueness rather than lack of clarity.
Synonyms: Weird (अजीब), Peculiar (विचित्र), Odd (अनोखा).
Antonyms: Normal (सामान्य), Usual (अमूमन), Ordinary (साधारण).

This word refers to something that is not able to be relied on or not known for sure. It is a direct synonym for ambiguous and cannot be used as its antonym.
Synonyms: Doubtful (अनिश्चित), Vague (अस्पष्ट), Hesitant (दुविधापूर्ण).
Antonyms: Certain (निश्चित), Sure (पक्का), Definite (स्पष्ट).

This word describes something that is easy to perceive, understand, or interpret. It is the direct and perfect antonym for ambiguous, which implies a lack of clarity.
Synonyms: Obvious (स्पष्ट), Explicit (सुस्पष्ट), Lucid (साफ).
Antonyms: Ambiguous (अस्पष्ट), Obscure (धुंधला), Vague (अनिश्चित).

This word means lasting for an unknown length of time or not clearly defined. Like ambiguous, it conveys a sense of lack of limits or clarity and acts as a synonym.
Synonyms: Unspecified (अनिश्चित), Vague (अस्पष्ट), Infinite (असीमित).
Antonyms: Definite (निश्चित), Specific (विशिष्ट), Fixed (नियत).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Fluctuate
questionsEn.s:
Fluctuate - उतार-चढ़ाव होना (To shift back and forth uncertainly)
Stumble - लड़खड़ाना (To trip while walking or running)
Waver - डगमगाना (To vacillate between choices)
Mobilize - संगठित करना (To put into movement or circulation)
Stabilize - स्थिर करना (To make stable, steadfast, or firm)
oa:
This word means to trip in walking or running. While it implies an unsteady movement, it refers to a physical accident rather than the periodic variation found in fluctuation.
Synonyms: Trip (लड़खड़ाना), Totter (डगमगाना), Falter (हिचकिचाना).
Antonyms: Glide (सहज चलना), Steady (स्थिर रहना), Succeed (सफल होना).

This word means to vacillate irresolutely between choices or to flicker. It is a direct synonym for the unstable movement of fluctuation and is not an opposite.
Synonyms: Vacillate (डगमगाना), Oscillate (हिलना), Falter (हिचकना).
Antonyms: Persist (दृढ़ रहना), Decide (निर्णय लेना), Continue (जारी रखना).

This word means to put into movement or circulation, often for military or political purposes. It refers to organizing action rather than the steadying of a varying rate.
Synonyms: Assemble (एकत्र करना), Rally (इकट्ठा करना), Deploy (तैनात करना).
Antonyms: Disperse (बिखेरना), Halt (रोकना), Demobilize (विघटित करना).

This word means to make something stable, steadfast, or firm. It is the direct functional antonym for fluctuate, which involves constant change.
Synonyms: Steady (स्थिर करना), Settle (नियत करना), Anchor (जमाना).
Antonyms: Fluctuate (उतार-चढ़ाव होना), Vary (बदलना), Shake (हिलाना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Disperse
questionsEn.s:
Disperse - छितराना (To cause to become spread widely)
Send - भेजना (To cause to go to a place)
Hold - थामना (To have possession or control of)
Gather - एकत्रित करना (To bring together in one place)
Neglect - उपेक्षा करना (To give little attention or respect)
oa:
This word means to cause someone or something to go to a destination. While you might send people away to disperse them, the word describes an act of dispatching, not an opposite of scattering.
Synonyms: Dispatch (भेजना), Transmit (भेजना), Forward (अग्रसारित करना).
Antonyms: Receive (प्राप्त करना), Keep (रखना), Collect (इकट्ठा करना).

This word means to have possession of or to have at one's disposal. It describes containment or ownership rather than the act of bringing together that opposes dispersing.
Synonyms: Retain (पकड़ना), Keep (रखना), Clasp (थामना).
Antonyms: Release (छोड़ना), Drop (गिराना), Disperse (बिखेरना).

This word means to bring people or things together from different places into one group. It is the direct physical and conceptual antonym for disperse.
Synonyms: Collect (इकट्ठा करना), Assemble (एकत्र करना), Accumulate (जमा करना).
Antonyms: Disperse (बिखेरना), Scatter (छितराना), Dissipate (नष्ट करना).

This word means to give little attention or respect to something. it refers to a lack of care rather than the physical arrangement of objects or groups.
Synonyms: Disregard (उपेक्षा करना), Overlook (नज़रअंदाज़ करना), Ignore (अनदेखा करना).
Antonyms: Care (देखभाल करना), Attend (ध्यान देना), Heed (मानना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Approve
questionsEn.s:
Approve - मंजूरी देना (To officially accept as satisfactory)
Reject - अस्वीकार करना (To dismiss as inadequate or faulty)
Appeal - अपील (A serious or heartfelt request)
Confirm - पुष्टि करना (To verify or establish truth)
Agree - सहमत होना (To have the same opinion)
oa:
This word means to dismiss something as inadequate, unacceptable, or faulty. It is the direct logical and official antonym for the word approve.
Synonyms: Decline (अस्वीकार करना), Dismiss (ख़ारिज करना), Spurn (तिरस्कार करना).
Antonyms: Approve (मंजूरी देना), Accept (स्वीकार करना), Ratify (पुष्टि करना).

This word refers to a serious, urgent, or heartfelt request for help or information. it describes a plea for consideration rather than the act of granting approval.
Synonyms: Entreat (विनती करना), Petition (अपील करना), Request (अनुरोध करना).
Antonyms: Answer (उत्तर देना), Refuse (मना करना), Deny (नकारना).

This word means to establish the truth or correctness of an arrangement or fact. It is a synonym for the act of approval and therefore not an antonym.
Synonyms: Corroborate (पुष्टि करना), Verify (सत्यापित करना), Substantiate (साबित करना).
Antonyms: Contradict (विरोधाभास), Refute (खंडन करना), Disprove (गलत साबित करना).

This word means to have the same opinion as another person or to say one will do something suggested. It is a synonym for approve and cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Concur (सहमत होना), Assent (स्वीकृति देना), Comply (अनुपालन करना).
Antonyms: Disagree (असहमत होना), Dissent (विरोध करना), Differ (अलग होना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Captivity
questionsEn.s:
Captivity - कैद (The condition of being imprisoned or confined)
Liberty - स्वतंत्रता (The power or scope to act as one pleases)
Imprisonment - कारावास (The state of being kept in jail)
Cheer - उल्लास (A shout of joy or expression of approval)
Offence - अपराध (A punishable act or breach of law)
oa:
This word refers to the power or scope to act as one pleases or the state of being free. it is the direct and perfect antonym for captivity.
Synonyms: Freedom (स्वतंत्रता), Autonomy (स्वायत्तता), Independence (आज़ादी).
Antonyms: Captivity (कैद), Bondage (गुलामी), Slavery (दासता).

This word refers to the state of being kept in a prison or jail. it is a direct synonym for captivity and therefore cannot be used as its antonym.
Synonyms: Confinement (क़ैद), Detention (हिरासत), Incarceration (कारावास).
Antonyms: Release (रिहाई), Liberation (मुक्ति), Freedom (आज़ादी).

This word refers to an expression of approval or a shout of joy. it describes a positive emotional response and has no relation to the physical state of confinement.
Synonyms: Joy (प्रसन्नता), Delight (हर्ष), Applause (सराहना).
Antonyms: Sorrow (दुख), Gloom (उदास), Boos (धिक्कार).

This word refers to a punishable act or a breach of a law or rule. While an offence can lead to captivity, the word itself is not an antonym for being confined.
Synonyms: Crime (अपराध), Sin (पाप), Violation (उल्लंघन).
Antonyms: Innocence (निर्दोषता), Compliance (अनुपालन), Obedience (आज्ञाकारिता).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Loiter
questionsEn.s:
Loiter - मटरगश्ती करना (To walk slowly with no apparent purpose)
Repel - दूर भगाना (To be repulsive or distasteful)
Dawdle - समय गँवाना (To move slowly and idly)
Loaf - आलस्य में समय बिताना (To spend time aimlessly or lazily)
Hasten - शीघ्र करना (To move or travel hurriedly)
oa:
This word means to be repulsive or to drive away someone with distaste. it describes a force of pushing away rather than the speed of movement through an area.
Synonyms: Disgust (घृणा पैदा करना), Reject (अस्वीकार करना), Repulse (दूर भगाना).
Antonyms: Attract (आकर्षित करना), Charm (मोहित करना), Draw (खींचना).

This word means to move slowly and idly in a particular direction. it is a direct synonym for loiter and therefore cannot be used as its opposite.
Synonyms: Idle (समय गँवाना), Dally (देर करना), Procrastinate (टालमटोल करना).
Antonyms: Hasten (शीघ्र करना), Hurry (जल्दी करना), Rush (दौड़ना).

This word means to spend one's time in an aimless or lazy way. Like "dawdle," it is a synonym for loitering and does not provide an opposite meaning.
Synonyms: Lounge (आलस्य करना), Idle (बेकार बैठना), Saunter (मटरगश्ती करना).
