Antonyms: Work (काम करना), Labor (परिश्रम करना), Hustle (तेज़ी करना).

This word means to move or travel hurriedly or to cause something to happen sooner. It is the direct functional antonym for loitering or moving slowly.
Synonyms: Hurry (जल्दी करना), Speed (तेज़ चलना), Quickened (त्वरित).
Antonyms: Loiter (मटरगश्ती करना), Delay (विलंब करना), Dawdle (देर करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Morose
questionsEn.s:
Morose - बदमिजाज (Sullen and ill-tempered)
Cranky - चिड़चिड़ा (Bad-tempered or irritable)
Cheerful - प्रसन्न (Noticeably happy and optimistic)
Solemn - गंभीर (Formal, dignified, and serious)
Prudent - विवेकपूर्ण (Sensible and careful in judgment)
oa:
This word describes someone who is bad-tempered or easily irritable. It is a synonym for the negative temperament of morose and cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Irritable (चिड़चिड़ा), Grumpy (बदमिजाज), Peevish (चिड़चिड़ा).
Antonyms: Amiable (सुशील), Patient (धैर्यवान), Good-natured (नेक).

This word describes being noticeably happy and optimistic. It is the direct and most accurate antonym for morose (sullen/gloomy).
Synonyms: Joyful (हर्षित), Buoyant (प्रसन्न), Sunny (खुशनुमा).
Antonyms: Morose (उदास), Sullen (चिड़चिड़ा), Gloomy (विषादपूर्ण).

This word describes being formal, dignified, and serious. while not necessarily ill-tempered, it is closer to the serious nature of morose than it is to an opposite.
Synonyms: Grave (गंभीर), Stately (शानदार), Somber (विषादपूर्ण).
Antonyms: Frivolous (हल्का), Jocular (हास्यपूर्ण), Cheerful (प्रसन्न).

This word describes being sensible and careful when making judgments. it refers to wisdom and caution rather than a person's underlying emotional mood or temper.
Synonyms: Sagacious (विवेकपूर्ण), Discreet (सावधान), Wise (बुद्धिमान).
Antonyms: Rash (जल्दबाज़), Imprudent (अविवेकी), Reckless (लापरवाह).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Adamant
questionsEn.s:
Adamant - अटल (Refusing to be persuaded or to change one's mind)
Stubborn - ज़िद्दी (Showing determination not to change)
Coherent - सुसंगत (Logical, consistent, and easy to understand)
Flexible - लचीला (Capable of bending or changing easily)
Stupid - बेवकूफ (Lacking intelligence or common sense)
oa:
This word describes someone who shows dogged determination not to change their attitude. It is a direct synonym for adamant and cannot be its antonym.
Synonyms: Obstinate (ज़िद्दी), Unyielding (अटल), Tenacious (दृढ़).
Antonyms: Flexible (लचीला), Compliant (मानने वाला), Docile (विनम्र).

This word describes something that is logical, consistent, and easy to understand. It refers to the quality of communication or thought rather than the firmness of a decision.
Synonyms: Logical (सुसंगत), Rational (तार्किक), Consistent (संगत).
Antonyms: Incoherent (असंगत), Illogical (बेतुका), Confusing (भ्रमित).

This word describes being capable of bending easily without breaking or being willing to change one's mind. It is the perfect antonym for being adamant (rigid).
Synonyms: Adaptable (लचीला), Pliable (नम्य), Yielding (झुकने वाला).
Antonyms: Adamant (अटल), Rigid (कठोर), Inflexible (दृढ़).

This word describes having or showing a great lack of intelligence. While an adamant person might be called stupid by critics, the word is not a direct opposite for firmness.
Synonyms: Foolish (बेवकूफ), Asinine (मूर्खतापूर्ण), Inane (बुद्धिहीन).
Antonyms: Intelligent (बुद्धिमान), Clever (चतुर), Wise (विवेकपूर्ण).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Delicate
questionsEn.s:
Delicate - नाजुक (Very fine in texture or easily broken)
Flimsy - कमज़ोर (Insubstantial and vulnerable to damage)
Firm - मज़बूत (Having a solid, unyielding structure)
Feeble - अशक्त (Lacking physical strength or energy)
Fragile - भंगुर (Easily broken or damaged)
oa:
This word refers to something that is weak, insubstantial, and easily damaged. It is a synonym for delicate and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an opposite.
Synonyms: Fragile (कमज़ोर), Weak (दुर्बल), Brittle (भंगुर).
Antonyms: Sturdy (मजबूत), Strong (शक्तिशाली), Durable (टिकाऊ).

This word describes having a solid, stable, and unyielding surface or structure. It is the direct physical antonym for something that is delicate and easily broken.
Synonyms: Solid (मज़बूत), Stable (स्थिर), Strong (शक्तिशाली).
Antonyms: Delicate (नाजुक), Weak (कमजोर), Flimsy (पतला).

This word describes a lack of physical strength or energy, especially due to age or illness. It is a synonym for the "weak" aspect of being delicate and is not an opposite.
Synonyms: Weak (दुर्बल), Frail (अशक्त), Infirm (कमज़ोर).
Antonyms: Strong (बलवान), Robust (स्वस्थ), Vigorous (ऊर्जावान).

This word describes something that is easily broken or damaged. it is a direct synonym for the given word and cannot be used as its antonym.
Synonyms: Delicate (नाजुक), Breakable (टूने वाला), Flimsy (कमज़ोर).
Antonyms: Tough (मजबूत), Robust (सशक्त), Unbreakable (अखंड).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Hidden
questionsEn.s:
Hidden - छुपा हुआ (Kept out of sight or not visible)
Apparent - प्रत्यक्ष (Clearly visible or obvious)
Covered - ढका हुआ (Protected or hidden by something over it)
Veiled - गुप्त (Having a concealing cover or being indirect)
Concealed - गुप्त (Kept out of sight or hidden from view)
oa:
This word describes something that is clearly visible, understood, or obvious. It is the direct and perfect antonym for being hidden or out of sight.
Synonyms: Obvious (प्रत्यक्ष), Manifest (प्रकट), Evident (स्पष्ट).
Antonyms: Hidden (छुपा हुआ), Concealed (गुप्तरखना), Obscure (धुंधला).

This word means to put something over another thing to protect or hide it. It is a state that causes something to be hidden and therefore is not an opposite.
Synonyms: Concealed (ढका हुआ), Shrouded (लपेटा हुआ), Veiled (ढका हुआ).
Antonyms: Exposed (उजागर), Uncovered (नंगा), Revealed (प्रकट).

This word describes having a concealing cover or being expressed indirectly. Like "covered," it describes a state of being hidden rather than an opposite.
Synonyms: Disguised (अस्पष्ट), Masked (ढका हुआ), Obscure (गुप्त).
Antonyms: Open (खुला), Clear (साफ), Blatant (प्रकट).

This word refers to keeping something out of sight or hidden from view. it is a direct synonym for the given word and cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Hidden (गुप्त), Secret (छिपा हुआ), Latent (अव्यक्त).
Antonyms: Revealed (प्रकट), Exposed (उजागर), Displayed (दिखाया हुआ).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Goodwill
questionsEn.s:
Goodwill - सद्भावना (Benevolent interest, approval, or concern)
Facility - सुविधा (Quality of being easily performed or a resource)
Insanity - पागलपन (A severely disordered state of mind)
Felicity - प्रसन्नता (Intense happiness or intense joy)
Hostility - शत्रुता (Hostile behavior or active opposition)
oa:
This word refers to the quality of being easily performed or a place provided for a particular purpose. It describes infrastructure or ease rather than an emotional or moral attitude.
Synonyms: Amenity (सुविधा), Ease (आसानी), Resource (साधन).
Antonyms: Difficulty (कठिनाई), Obstacle (बाधा), Hindrance (अवरोध).

This word refers to a severely disordered state of mind or madness. it describes mental illness rather than the social or emotional feeling of kindness or approval.
Synonyms: Madness (पागलपन), Lunacy (विक्षिप्तता), Folly (मूर्खता).
Antonyms: Sanity (समझदारी), Wisdom (बुद्धिमत्ता), Reason (तर्क).

This word refers to intense happiness or the ability to find appropriate expression for one's thoughts. While positive, it relates to joy rather than the kindness intended by "goodwill."
Synonyms: Bliss (प्रसन्नता), Joy (सौभाग्य), Aptness (उपयुक्तता).
Antonyms: Misery (कष्ट), Sorrow (दुख), Inappropriateness (अनुपयुक्तता).

This word refers to unfriendly behavior, unfriendliness, or active opposition. It is the direct and perfect antonym for goodwill, which involves benevolent interest.
Synonyms: Enmity (शत्रुता), Animosity (वैर), Antagonism (विरोध).
Antonyms: Goodwill (सद्भावना), Amity (मित्रता), Friendship (दोस्ती).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Pompous
questionsEn.s:
Pompous - आडंबरपूर्ण (Affectedly grand, solemn, or self-important)
Arrogant - अभिमानी (Having an exaggerated sense of importance)
Calm - शांत (Not showing nervousness or anger)
Impatient - बेचैन (Having a tendency to be quickly irritated)
Humble - विनम्र (Having a modest view of one's importance)
oa:
This word means having or revealing an exaggerated sense of one's own importance. It is a direct synonym for pompous and therefore cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Haughty (अहंकारी), Conceited (अभिमानी), Overweening (उद्धत).
Antonyms: Humble (विनम्र), Modest (विनीत), Meek (नम्र).

This word describes a state of not showing nervousness or anger. While a humble person might be calm, the word does not address the self-importance implied by "pompous."
Synonyms: Serene (शांत), Tranquil (स्थिर), Placid (सौम्य).
Antonyms: Agitated (उत्तेजित), Nervous (व्याकुल), Hysterical (उन्मादी).

This word describes a tendency to be quickly irritated or provoked. it refers to a lack of patience rather than the presence or absence of affected grandiosity.
Synonyms: Restless (बेचैन), Hasty (जल्दबाज़), Eager (उत्सुक).
Antonyms: Patient (धैर्यवान), Calm (शांत), Enduring (सहनशील).

This word describes someone who has a modest or low estimate of their own importance. It is the direct and most accurate antonym for being pompous.
Synonyms: Modest (विनम्र), Unpretentious (साधारण), Meek (नम्र).
Antonyms: Pompous (आडंबरपूर्ण), Arrogant (अभिमानी), Proud (गर्वित).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Refined
questionsEn.s:
Refined - परिष्कृत (With impurities removed or elegant in manners)
Cruel - क्रूर (Willfully causing pain or suffering)
Crude - अपरिष्कृत (In a natural/raw state; lacking sophistication)
Fierce - उग्र (Displaying intense or ferocious aggression)
Smooth - चिकना (Having an even and regular surface)
oa:
This word refers to willfully causing pain or suffering to others. while unrefined people might act crudely, "cruel" describes a moral lack of pity rather than a lack of sophistication.
Synonyms: Brutal (क्रूर), Ruthless (निर्मम), Heartless (निर्दयी).
Antonyms: Kind (दयालु), Compassionate (सहानुभूतिपूर्ण), Humane (मानवीय).

This word describes something in its natural or raw state, not yet processed or refined. it is the direct physical and social antonym for the word refined.
Synonyms: Raw (अपरिष्कृत), Unrefined (अशोधित), Vulgar (अशिष्ट).
Antonyms: Refined (परिष्कृत), Polished (शिष्ट), Pure (शुद्ध).

This word describes having or displaying an intense or ferocious aggressiveness. it refers to intensity and aggression rather than a lack of processing or elegance.
Synonyms: Ferocious (भयंकर), Intense (उग्र), Aggressive (आक्रामक).
Antonyms: Gentle (कोमल), Mild (हल्का), Tame (पालतू).

This word describes having an even and regular surface without projections. it is a characteristic of being refined rather than providing an opposite for it.
Synonyms: Level (चिकना), Flat (समतल), Polished (चमकीला).
Antonyms: Rough (खुरदरा), Coarse (मोटा), Uneven (असमतल).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Yell
questionsEn.s:
Yell - चिल्लाना (A loud, sharp cry of pain or delight)
Whisper - फुसफुसाना (A soft or confidential tone of voice)
Scream - चीखना (A long, loud, piercing cry)
Shout - शोर मचाना (A loud cry expressing strong emotion)
Shriek - चीख (A high-pitched piercing cry)
oa:
This word refers to speaking in a very soft, low, or confidential tone. It is the direct and perfect antonym for yelling, which involves loud shouting.
Synonyms: Murmur (फुसफुसाना), Mumble (बुदबुदाना), Mutters (अस्पष्ट कहना).
Antonyms: Yell (चिल्लाना), Shout (शोर मचाना), Scream (चीखना).

This word means to give a long, loud, piercing cry expressing pain or excitement. It is a synonym for yell and therefore cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Shriek (चीख), Howl (चिल्लाहट), Bellow (गरजना).
Antonyms: Whisper (फुसफुसाना), Silence (चुप्पी), Mute (मौन).

This word means to utter a loud cry to express emotion or call attention. it is a direct synonym for the given word and does not satisfy the requirement for an antonym.
Synonyms: Yell (चिल्लाना), Cry (चिल्लाहट), Call (पुकारना).
Antonyms: Whisper (फुसफुसाना), Hushed (शांत), Quiet (स्थिर).

This word refers to a high-pitched piercing cry or sound. Like "scream," it is a synonym for yelling and does not provide the required opposite.
Synonyms: Screech (चीख), Squawk (कर्कश ध्वनि), Caterwaul (चीखना-चिल्लाना).
Antonyms: Murmur (बुदबुदाहट), Whisper (मन्द स्वर), Soften (धीमा करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Reluctant
questionsEn.s:
Reluctant - अनिच्छुक (Unwilling and hesitant)
Hesitant - संकोची (Tentative or slow in acting)
Uncertain - अनिश्चित (Not known for sure or definite)
Eager - उत्सुक (Strongly willing to do or have something)
Consent - सहमति (Permission or agreement for something to happen)
oa:
This word describes someone who is tentative or slow in acting because of doubt. It is a synonym for reluctant and therefore cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Unsure (अनिश्चित), Wavering (डगमगाता हुआ), Indecisive (अनिर्णीत).
Antonyms: Resolute (दृढ़), Decisive (निर्णायक), Eager (उत्सुक).

This word refers to not being able to be relied on or not knowing for sure. Like "hesitant," it describes a lack of certainty and acts as a synonym for reluctance.
Synonyms: Doubtful (संदिग्ध), Questionable (अनिश्चित), Vague (अस्पष्ट).
Antonyms: Certain (निश्चित), Sure (पक्का), Clear (स्पष्ट).

This word describes someone who is strongly willing or enthusiastic about doing something. It is the direct behavioral antonym for being reluctant or hesitant.
Synonyms: Keen (उत्सुक), Enthusiastic (उत्साही), Zealous (जोशीला).
Antonyms: Reluctant (अनिच्छुक), Apathetic (उदासीन), Indifferent (बेपरवाह).

This word refers to permission for something to happen or agreement to do something. It is a noun describing an act of approval, not a characteristic opposite to reluctance.
Synonyms: Agreement (सहमति), Permission (अनुमति), Assent (स्वीकृति).
Antonyms: Dissent (असहमति), Denial (अस्वीकार), Refusal (इनकार).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Current
questionsEn.s:
Current - वर्तमान (Belonging to the present time)
Present - वर्तमान (Existing or occurring now)
Modern - आधुनिक (Relating to the present or recent times)
General - सामान्य (Involving or relating to most people)
Past - अतीत (Something that has already happened)
oa:
This word refers to things existing or occurring now. It is a direct synonym for the given word "current" and therefore cannot be used as its opposite.
Synonyms: Contemporary (वर्तमान), Modern (हाल का), Existing (मौजूदा).
Antonyms: Past (अतीत), Future (भविष्य), Former (भूतपूर्व).

This word refers to something relating to the present or recent times as opposed to the past. it is a synonym for the given word and is not an antonym.
Synonyms: Novel (नवीन), New (नया), Contemporary (समकालीन).
Antonyms: Ancient (प्राचीन), Archaic (आदिम), Old (पुराना).

This word means involving or relating to most or all people, places, or things. It describes the scope of something rather than its position in time.
Synonyms: Common (सामान्य), Universal (सर्वव्यापी), Broad (विस्तृत).
Antonyms: Specific (विशिष्ट), Particular (खास), Limited (सीमित).

This word refers to things that have already happened or a time before the present. It is the direct and logical antonym for the word current.
Synonyms: Former (अतीत), Previous (पिछला), Ancient (पुराना).
Antonyms: Current (वर्तमान), Present (मौजूदा), Future (भविष्य).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Familiar
questionsEn.s:
Familiar - परिचित (Well-known or easily recognized)
Usual - सामान्य (Habitually or typically occurring)
Common - आम (Found often or in many places)
Known - ज्ञात (Recognized or familiar to people)
Strange - अजीब (Difficult to understand or explain)
oa:
This word describes something that is habitually or typically occurring. It is a synonym for familiar in many contexts and therefore not an antonym.
Synonyms: Customary (सामान्य), Habitual (आदतन), Routine (नियमित).
Antonyms: Unusual (असामान्य), Rare (दुर्लभ), Strange (विचित्र).

This word refers to something occurring, found, or done often. it describes something well-known, acting as a synonym rather than an opposite.
Synonyms: Frequent (आम), Universal (सर्वव्यापी), Ordinary (साधारण).
Antonyms: Exclusive (विशिष्ट), Uncommon (असामान्य), Unique (अद्वितीय).

This word means recognized or familiar to people. it is a direct synonym for the given word and therefore does not provide the required opposite.
Synonyms: Familiar (परिचित), Famous (प्रसिद्ध), Established (ज्ञात).
Antonyms: Unknown (अज्ञात), Secret (गुप्त), Mysterious (रहस्यमय).

This word refers to something that is difficult to understand, explain, or identify because it is new or unusual. It is the direct antonym for familiar.
Synonyms: Weird (अजीब), Peculiar (विचित्र), Unknown (अनजान).
Antonyms: Familiar (परिचित), Common (आम), Normal (सामान्य).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: To create
questionsEn.s:
To create - बनाना (To bring something into existence)
To develop - विकसित करना (To grow and become more mature)
To deploy - तैनात करना (To move into position for action)
To derive - प्राप्त करना (To obtain from a specified source)
To destroy - नष्ट करना (To end the existence of something)
oa:
This word means to grow or cause to grow and become more advanced. It is a process of enhancement and creation, making it a near-synonym rather than an antonym.
Synonyms: Evolve (विकसित होना), Advance (प्रगति करना), Grow (बढ़ना).
Antonyms: Decline (पतन होना), Regress (पीछे हटना), Halt (रुकना).

This word means to move troops or equipment into position for action. It describes the tactical arrangement of resources and is not an opposite of making them.
Synonyms: Position (तैनात करना), Arrange (व्यवस्थित करना), Utilize (उपयोग करना).
Antonyms: Withdraw (वापस लेना), Retract (वापस बुलाना), Recall (वापस बुलाना).

This word means to obtain something from a specified source. While it involves getting something, it is an act of acquisition rather than the destruction of something.
Synonyms: Obtain (प्राप्त करना), Deduce (निष्कर्ष निकालना), Get (पाना).
Antonyms: Give (देना), Offer (प्रदान करना), Create (बनाना).

This word means to end the existence of something by damaging or attacking it. it is the direct and perfect antonym for creating or bringing something into existence.
Synonyms: Demolish (नष्ट करना), Ruin (बर्बाद करना), Shatter (टुकड़े-टुकड़े करना).
Antonyms: Create (बनाना), Build (निर्माण करना), Construct (बनाना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Modest
questionsEn.s:
Modest - विनम्र (Unassuming in the estimation of one's abilities)
Vain - अभिमानी (Having an excessively high opinion of oneself)
Furious - क्रोधित (Extremely angry)
Dishonest - बेईमान (Untrustworthy or deceitful)
Simple - सरल (Easily understood or done)
oa:
This word describes having or showing an excessively high opinion of one's own appearance, abilities, or worth. it is the direct character antonym for being modest.
Synonyms: Conceited (अभिमानी), Arrogant (घमंडी), Egotistical (अहंकारी).
Antonyms: Modest (विनम्र), Humble (विनीत), Meek (नम्र).

This word means extremely angry. it describes a temporary emotional state of rage rather than a stable personality trait regarding one's ego or importance.
Synonyms: Enraged (क्रोधित), Wrathful (अतिक्रुद्ध), Livid (नाराज़).
Antonyms: Calm (शांत), Placid (सौम्य), Pleased (प्रसन्न).

This word refers to someone who is untrustworthy, deceitful, or insincere. While it is a negative trait, it is not the conceptual opposite of humility or modesty.
Synonyms: Deceitful (कपटी), Shifty (बेईमान), Corrupt (भ्रष्ट).
Antonyms: Honest (ईमानदार), Truthful (सत्यवादी), Ethical (नैतिक).

This word means easily understood or done; presenting no difficulty. While modest people are often simple, the word is not an antonym for modesty.
Synonyms: Plain (साधारण), Basic (सरल), Uncomplicated (सरल).
Antonyms: Complex (जटिल), Elaborate (विस्तृत), Sophisticated (दुनियादार).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Illusion
questionsEn.s:
Illusion - भ्रम (An idea or belief that is not true)
Reality - वास्तविकता (The state of things as they actually are)
Fantasy - कल्पना (A pleasant situation that you enjoy imagining)
Hallucination - मतिभ्रम (Experience of seeing things that don't exist)
Mirage - मृगतृष्णा (Optical illusion caused by heat)
oa:
This word refers to the state of things as they actually exist, rather than how they are imagined. It is the direct and perfect antonym for an illusion (false belief).
Synonyms: Fact (वास्तविकता), Truth (सत्य), Actuality (यथार्थ).
Antonyms: Illusion (भ्रम), Fantasy (कल्पना), Delusion (माया).

This word describes a pleasant situation that is imagined but is unlikely to happen. it is a direct synonym for the imaginative nature of an illusion and not its opposite.
Synonyms: Dream (कल्पना), Daydream (दिवास्वप्न), Figment (मनगढ़ंत).
Antonyms: Reality (वास्तविकता), Fact (सत्य), Substance (ठोस वस्तु).

This word refers to an experience where one sees or feels things that do not exist, usually due to illness. it is a specific type of illusion and therefore not an antonym.
Synonyms: Delusion (मतिभ्रम), Mirages (मृगतृष्णा), Phantom (छाया).
Antonyms: Perception (प्रत्यक्ष ज्ञान), Clarity (स्पष्टता), Evidence (प्रमाण).

This word refers to an optical illusion caused by atmospheric conditions. Like "hallucination," it is a synonym for the given word and cannot be its antonym.
Synonyms: Illusion (भ्रम), Apparition (भूत/दिखावा), Specter (छाया).
Antonyms: Reality (यथार्थ), Ground (जमीन), Certitude (निश्चितता).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Diminish
questionsEn.s:
Diminish - कम होना (To become or make something less or smaller)
Decrease - घटाना (To become less or make something smaller)
Decline - क्षीण होना (To gradually become less or worse)
Shrink - सिकुड़ना (To become smaller in size or amount)
Increase - बढ़ाना (To become or make larger in amount or size)
oa:
This word means to become or to make something smaller in amount or intensity. It is a direct synonym for diminish and therefore cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Lessen (घटाना), Reduce (कम करना), Lower (नीचा करना).
Antonyms: Increase (बढ़ाना), Grow (बढ़ना), Rise (उठना).

This word means to gradually become less, worse, or lower. Like "decrease," it shares the same reductive meaning as the given word and acts as a synonym.
Synonyms: Deteriorate (बिगड़ना), Ebb (कम होना), Wane (क्षीण होना).
Antonyms: Improve (सुधारना), Progress (उन्नति करना), Advance (आगे बढ़ना).

This word means to become smaller or make something smaller in size. It is a direct physical synonym for diminish and therefore not an antonym.
Synonyms: Contract (सिकुड़ना), Constrict (संकुचित करना), Narrow (संकीर्ण होना).
Antonyms: Expand (फैलाना), Enlarge (बड़ा करना), Stretch (तानना).

This word means to make something larger or to become larger in amount or size. It is the direct and most accurate antonym for the word diminish.
Synonyms: Augment (बढ़ाना), Grow (बढ़ना), Expand (विस्तार करना).
Antonyms: Diminish (कम होना), Lessen (घटाना), Decrease (घटाना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Harsh
questionsEn.s:
Harsh - कठोर (Unpleasantly rough, cruel, or severe)
Honest - ईमानदार (Free of deceit, truthful, and sincere)
Rough - खुरदरा (Having an uneven surface or violent)
Dirty - गंदा (Covered with an unclean substance)
Gentle - सौम्य (Having a mild, kind, or tender temperament)
oa:
This word refers to being truthful, sincere, and free of deceit. While an honest person might speak harshly, the word itself describes moral integrity rather than behavioral roughness.
Synonyms: Upright (ईमानदार), Candid (स्पष्ट), Sincere (सत्यनिष्ठ).
Antonyms: Dishonest (बेईमान), Deceitful (धोखेबाज), Corrupt (भ्रष्ट).

This word refers to having an uneven surface or being violent and lacking gentleness. it is a direct synonym for harsh and therefore cannot be used as its opposite.
Synonyms: Rugged (खुरदरा), Coarse (मोटा), Turbulent (उग्र).
Antonyms: Smooth (चिकना), Gentle (नरम), Level (समतल).

This word refers to being covered with an unclean substance or being dishonest. it describes cleanliness rather than the severe or rough quality implied by the word "harsh."
Synonyms: Filthy (गंदा), Soiled (मैला), Grimy (धूल भरा).
Antonyms: Clean (साफ), Pure (शुद्ध), Spotless (बेदाग).

This word describes having or showing a mild, kind, or tender temperament. it is the direct and perfect behavioral antonym for being harsh or rough.
Synonyms: Mild (कोमल), Kind (दयालु), Soft (नरम).
Antonyms: Harsh (कठोर), Brutal (क्रूर), Rough (उग्र).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Obstinate
questionsEn.s:
Obstinate - हठी (Stubbornly refusing to change one's opinion)
Stern - कठोर (Serious and unrelenting; strict)
Flexible - लचीला (Capable of bending or being easily modified)
Stubborn - ज़िद्दी (Dogged determination not to change attitude)
Adamant - अटल (Refusing to be persuaded or change mind)
oa:
This word describes someone who is serious and unrelenting, or strict and severe. it shares a sense of rigidity with "obstinate" and therefore cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Rigid (कठोर), Strict (सख्त), Grim (निष्ठुर).
Antonyms: Lenient (कोमल), Mild (नरम), Gentle (सौम्य).

This word describes someone or something capable of bending easily or being modified to respond to changing circumstances. it is the direct antonym for being obstinate.
Synonyms: Pliable (लचीला), Adaptable (अनुकूलनीय), Compliant (मानने वाला).
Antonyms: Obstinate (ज़िद्दी), Rigid (कठोर), Adamant (अटल).

This word refers to having dogged determination not to change one's attitude. It is a direct synonym for obstinate and does not provide an opposite meaning.
Synonyms: Tenacious (हठी), Headstrong (ज़िद्दी), Mulish (अड़ियल).
Antonyms: Yielding (झुकने वाला), Docile (विनम्र), Obedient (आज्ञाकारी).

This word means refusing to be persuaded or to change one's mind. it is another strong synonym for the rigid persistence of being obstinate and is not an antonym.
Synonyms: Inflexible (अटल), Unyielding (दृढ़), Firm (मजबूत).
Antonyms: Pliant (लचीला), Submissive (दब्बू), Uncertain (अनिश्चित).

test.instructions: Standard CBT Pattern Exam. Positive Marks: +1, Negative Marks: -0.25. Total Questions: 50.

test.title: Set - 23

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Inexpensive
questionsEn.s:
Inexpensive - सस्ता (Something that is cheap and readily available)
Popular - लोकप्रिय (Liked or admired by many people)
Dear - कीमती/महंगा (Highly valued or expensive)
Reasonable - उचित (Sensible or fair in accordance with reason)
Liberal - उदार (Willing to respect others' ideas or broad-based)
oa:
This word refers to something that is liked or admired by many people. while inexpensive things can be popular, the word describes popularity rather than the high cost that opposes "inexpensive."
Synonyms: Famous (प्रसिद्ध), Acclaimed (लोकप्रिय), Common (आम).
Antonyms: Unpopular (अलोकप्रिय), Obscure (गुमनाम), Hated (घृणास्पद).

This word refers to something that is highly valued, precious, or in British English, it specifically means expensive. it serves as the most accurate antonym for inexpensive.
Synonyms: Expensive (महंगा), Costly (कीमती), Priceless (बहुमूल्य).
Antonyms: Inexpensive (सस्ता), Cheap (मामूली), Worthless (बेकार).

This word describes a price that is fair and sensible. It is a near-synonym for inexpensive (as it implies a good price) and therefore cannot be its antonym.
Synonyms: Fair (उचित), Sensible (तार्किक), Modest (मामूली).
Antonyms: Exorbitant (अत्यधिक), Irrational (अतार्किक), Excessive (बहुत ज्यादा).

This word refers to being willing to respect others' ideas or being generous with giving. it describes an open attitude rather than the cost or value of a commercial item.
Synonyms: Broad-minded (उदार), Generous (दानी), Tolerant (सहनशील).
Antonyms: Narrow-minded (संकीर्ण), Stingy (कंजूस), Intolerant (असहिष्णु).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Comic
questionsEn.s:
Comic - हास्यपूर्ण (Humorous, funny; meant to cause laughter)
Tragic - दुखद (Catastrophic; characterized by extreme distress)
Jubilant - उल्लासित (Feeling or expressing great happiness)
Tickle - गुदगुदाना (To touch lightly to excite nerves/laughter)
Happy - खुश (Feeling or expressing great joy)
oa:
This word refers to something that is catastrophic or characterized by extreme distress and sorrow. It is the direct and perfect antonym for being comic or funny.
Synonyms: Sad (दुखद), Dreadful (भीषण), Catastrophic (विनाशकारी).
Antonyms: Comic (हास्यपूर्ण), Joyful (आनंदित), Happy (प्रसन्न).

This word refers to feeling or expressing great happiness and triumph. while it is a positive emotion, it describes victory rather than the opposite of being funny.
Synonyms: Overjoyed (उल्लासित), Elated (प्रफुल्लित), Triumphant (विजयी).
Antonyms: Dejected (हताश), Depressed (निराश), Sorrowful (उदास).

This word refers to the physical act of touching someone lightly to cause laughter. while related to laughter, it is a physical action rather than a descriptor that opposes "comic."
Synonyms: Amuse (गुदगुदाना), Stimulate (उत्तेजित करना), Chuckle (हँसाना).
Antonyms: Hurt (चोट पहुँचाना), Pain (पीड़ा देना), Irritate (चिढ़ाना).

This word refers to feeling or expressing great joy or contentment. while positive, it aligns with the comic spectrum and therefore cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Glad (खुश), Cheerful (हर्षित), Content (संतुष्ट).
Antonyms: Unhappy (उदास), Miserable (दुखी), Sad (बुरा).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Crooked
questionsEn.s:
Crooked - टेढ़ा-मेढ़ा (Bent or twisted out of shape or place)
Curved - घुमावदार (Having the form of a curve)
Straight - सीधा (Positioned in a level or symmetrical line)
Spiral - पेचदार (Winding in a continuous curve)
Bent - मुड़ा हुआ (Sharply curved or having an angle)
oa:
This word describes something having the form of a curve or bend. It is a synonym for the "bent" aspect of being crooked and therefore cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Bent (घुमावदार), Arched (मेहराबदार), Bowed (मुड़ा हुआ).
Antonyms: Straight (सीधा), Linear (रैखिक), Direct (सटीक).

This word refers to something positioned in a level, upright, or symmetrical line without bends. It is the direct and perfect antonym for being crooked.
Synonyms: Direct (सीधा), Linear (रैखिक), Level (समतल).
Antonyms: Crooked (टेढ़ा-मेढ़ा), Bent (मुड़ा हुआ), Zigzag (टेढ़ा).

This word describes something winding in a continuous and gradually widening or tightening curve. It is a specific type of bent shape and not an antonym for "crooked."
Synonyms: Coiled (कुंडलित), Winding (पेचदार), Twisting (घुमावदार).
Antonyms: Straight (सीधा), Vertical (लंबवत), Level (समतल).

This word describes something sharply curved or having an angle. it is a direct synonym for crooked and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an antonym.
Synonyms: Twisted (मुड़ा हुआ), Crooked (टेढ़ा), Curved (घुमावदार).
Antonyms: Straight (सीधा), Firm (दृढ़), Unbent (न मुड़ा हुआ).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Progress
questionsEn.s:
Progress - प्रगति (Movement forwards or towards achievement)
Betterment - सुधार (Improvement or enhancement)
Decline - पतन (Becoming weaker, smaller, or inferior)
Advancement - उन्नति (The process of helping something succeed)
Growth - विकास (The process of growing and developing)
oa:
This word means the improvement or enhancement of something. it is a synonym for the positive movement implied by "progress" and cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Improvement (सुधार), Enhancement (सुधार), Refinement (परिष्कार).
Antonyms: Worsening (बिगाड़), Decline (पतन), Degradation (अवनति).

This word refers to a process or period of becoming weaker, smaller, or inferior. It is the direct antonym for progress, which implies moving forward or achieving success.
Synonyms: Regress (पतन), Worsening (ह्रास), Deterioration (गिरावट).
Antonyms: Progress (प्रगति), Growth (विकास), Advance (उन्नति).

This word means the process of helping something make progress and succeed. It is a direct synonym for progress and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an opposite.
Synonyms: Advance (उन्नति), Development (विकास), Promotion (पदोन्नति).
Antonyms: Decline (पतन), Retreat (पीछे हटना), Stagnation (स्थिरता).

This word refers to the process of increasing in size, quantity, or importance. it is a primary synonym for progress and therefore acts as its counterpart rather than its antonym.
Synonyms: Development (विकास), Increase (वृद्धि), Expansion (विस्तार).
Antonyms: Shrinkage (संकुचन), Decay (क्षय), Decline (गिरावट).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Coarse
questionsEn.s:
Coarse - खुरदरा (Of ordinary or inferior quality or rough texture)
Attractive - आकर्षक (Arousing interest or pleasure)
Smooth - चिकना (Having a continuous even surface)
Ragged - फटा-पुराना (Having an irregular edge or roughly unkempt)
Shiny - चमकदार (Reflecting light; polished)
oa:
This word describes something that arouses interest or pleasure. While a fine fabric can be attractive, the word refers to beauty rather than the texture or quality of a substance.
Synonyms: Appealing (आकर्षक), Charming (मोहक), Stunning (सुंदर).
Antonyms: Repulsive (घृणित), Ugly (बदसूरत), Hideous (भयानक).

This word describes having a continuous, even, or level surface. It is the direct physical and sensory antonym for being coarse or rough in texture.
Synonyms: Silky (चिकना), Even (समतल), Polished (चमकीला).
Antonyms: Coarse (खुरदरा), Rough (कठोर), Uneven (असमतल).

This word describes having an irregular edge or outline or being roughly unkempt. it is a synonym for the rough quality of coarse and cannot be its antonym.
Synonyms: Shaggy (फटा-पुराना), Rough (असमतल), Frayed (घिसा हुआ).
Antonyms: Neat (साफ), Smooth (चिकना), Trimmed (तराशा हुआ).

This word describes reflecting light, usually because something is clean or polished. While polished things are smooth, the word specifically refers to light reflection rather than texture.
Synonyms: Lustrous (चमकदार), Radiant (दीप्तिमान), Bright (उज्ज्वल).
Antonyms: Dull (नीरस), Matte (फीका), Dark (अंधेरा).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Notorious
questionsEn.s:
Notorious - कुख्यात (Famous or well known for some bad quality)
Efficient - कुशल (Achieving productivity with minimum waste)
Infamous - बदनाम (Well known for some bad quality or deed)
Optimistic - आशावादी (Hopeful and confident about the future)
Popular - लोकप्रिय (Liked or admired by many people)
oa:
This word means achieving maximum productivity with minimum wasted effort. it describes a person's working ability and has no connection to their social reputation.
Synonyms: Competent (कुशल), Effective (प्रभावी), Skilled (दक्ष).
Antonyms: Inefficient (अकुशल), Inept (अयोग्य), Lazy (कामचोर).

This word means well known for some bad quality or deed. It is a direct synonym for notorious and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an antonym.
Synonyms: Notorious (कुख्यात), Scandalous (कलंकित), Ill-famed (बदनाम).
Antonyms: Reputable (प्रतिष्ठित), Famous (प्रसिद्ध), Popular (लोकप्रिय).

This word describes being hopeful and confident about the future. It refers to a person's mental outlook rather than the quality of their public fame or reputation.
Synonyms: Sanguine (आशावादी), Positive (सकारात्मक), Hopeful (उत्साही).
Antonyms: Pessimistic (निराशावादी), Gloomy (उदास), Negative (नकारात्मक).

This word refers to being liked or admired by many people, usually for a good quality. it is the perfect antonym for notorious (famous for bad reasons).
Synonyms: Famous (लोकप्रिय), Respected (प्रसिद्ध), Acclaimed (सराहनीय).
Antonyms: Notorious (कुख्यात), Unpopular (अलोकप्रिय), Hated (घृणास्पद).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Treacherous
questionsEn.s:
Treacherous - विश्वासघाती (Guilty of or involving betrayal or deception)
Deceitful - कपटी (Guilty of or involving deceit)
Faithful - वफादार (Remaining loyal and steadfast)
Disloyal - बेवफ़ा (Failing to be loyal to a person or cause)
Dangerous - ख़तरनाक (Able or likely to cause harm or injury)
oa:
This word describes being guilty of or involving deceit; misleading others. It is a direct synonym for the betrayal aspect of treacherous and cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Fraudulent (धोखेबाज), Dishonest (कपटी), Shifty (छली).
Antonyms: Honest (ईमानदार), Truthful (सत्यवादी), Open (खुला).

This word refers to someone who remains loyal, steadfast, and trustworthy. it is the direct behavioral and moral antonym for being treacherous.
Synonyms: Loyal (वफादार), Devoted (समर्पित), Constant (अटल).
Antonyms: Treacherous (विश्वासघाती), Perfidious (ग़द्दार), Unreliable (अविश्वसनीय).

This word means failing to be loyal to a person or country. it is a direct synonym for the given word and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an opposite.
Synonyms: Treacherous (बेवफ़ा), Unfaithful (विश्वासघाती), Traitorous (ग़द्दार).
Antonyms: Loyal (वफादार), Faithful (सच्चा), Devoted (समर्पित).

This word means able or likely to cause harm or injury. while treacherous paths are dangerous, the word describes potential harm rather than the act of betrayal.
Synonyms: Perilous (ख़तरनाक), Risky (जोखिम भरा), Hazardous (हानिकारक).
Antonyms: Safe (सुरक्षित), Secure (निश्चित), Harmless (हानिरहित).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Abundant
questionsEn.s:
Abundant - प्रचुर (Existing or available in large quantities)
Scarce - दुर्लभ (Insufficient for the demand)
Plentiful - भरपूर (Existing in or yielding great quantities)
Ample - प्रचुर (Enough or more than enough)
Copious - अत्यधिक (Abundant in supply or quantity)
oa:
This word refers to something that is in short supply or insufficient for the demand. It is the direct quantitative antonym for being abundant.
Synonyms: Meager (दुर्लभ), Scanty (अल्प), Sparse (विरल).
Antonyms: Abundant (प्रचुर), Plentiful (भरपूर), Copious (अत्यधिक).

This word means existing in or yielding great quantities. It is a direct synonym for abundant and therefore does not function as its opposite.
Synonyms: Bountiful (भरपूर), Ample (प्रचुर), Profuse (बाहुल्य).
Antonyms: Scarce (दुर्लभ), Inadequate (अपर्याप्त), Lacking (अभाव).

This word refers to having enough or more than enough of something. Like "plentiful," it acts as a synonym for abundant rather than an antonym.
Synonyms: Sufficient (प्रचुर), Adequate (पर्याप्त), Substantial (काफी).
Antonyms: Scant (कम), Meager (थोड़ा), Insufficient (अपर्याप्त).

This word means abundant in supply or quantity. It is another strong synonym for the given word and does not provide an opposite meaning.
Synonyms: Profuse (बाहुल्य), Lavish (अत्यधिक), Numerous (अनेक).
Antonyms: Sparse (विरल), Scarce (दुर्लभ), Few (कम).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Cautious
questionsEn.s:
Cautious - सावधान (Careful to avoid potential problems or dangers)
Prudent - विवेकपूर्ण (Sensible and careful when making judgments)
Alert - सतर्क (Watchful for possible danger)
Negligent - असावधान (Failing to take proper care of something)
Discreet - सावधान (Careful not to cause embarrassment)
oa:
This word describes being sensible and careful when making judgments to avoid unnecessary risks. It is a direct synonym for cautious and cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Sagacious (विवेकपूर्ण), Careful (सावधान), Wise (बुद्धिमान).
Antonyms: Rash (जल्दबाज़), Imprudent (अविवेकी), Reckless (लापरवाह).

This word means watchful for possible danger or paying attention with one's senses. While it is a positive trait, it describes watchfulness which is a synonym of being cautious.
Synonyms: Watchful (सतर्क), Vigilant (चौकस), Observant (ध्यान देने वाला).
Antonyms: Careless (असावधान), Asleep (सोया हुआ), Oblivious (बेखबर).

This word refers to failing to take proper care of something or someone. it is the direct and most accurate behavioral antonym for being cautious.
Synonyms: Careless (असावधान), Remiss (उपेक्षाशील), Heedless (बेपरवाह).
Antonyms: Cautious (सावधान), Meticulous (अति सावधान), Careful (सतर्क).

This word describes being careful not to cause embarrassment or attract too much attention. it is a specific type of being cautious and acts as a synonym.
Synonyms: Circumspect (सावधान), Tactful (विनम्र), Guarded (संयमित).
Antonyms: Blatant (प्रकट), Indiscreet (अविवेकी), Obvious (साफ).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Tranquil
questionsEn.s:
Tranquil - शांत (Free from disturbance; peaceful and calm)
Calm - स्थिर (Peaceful, quiet, and without worry)
Stormy - तूफानी (Strong wind, rain, or full of conflict)
Peaceful - शांतिपूर्ण (Free from disturbance or violence)
Cool - ठंडा (At a fairly low temperature)
oa:
This word describes a state of being peaceful, quiet, and without worry. It is a direct synonym for tranquil and therefore cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Serene (शांत), Placid (सौम्य), Still (स्थिर).
Antonyms: Agitated (उत्तेजित), Violent (उग्र), Stormy (तूफानी).

This word refers to weather with strong winds and lightning or a situation full of angry conflict. It is the direct metaphorical antonym for being tranquil.
Synonyms: Turbulent (तूफानी), Violent (उग्र), Blustery (प्रचंड).
Antonyms: Tranquil (शांत), Calm (स्थिर), Serene (निर्मल).

This word describes being free from disturbance or conflict. Like "calm," it is a direct synonym for the given word and does not provide an antonym.
Synonyms: Amicable (शांतिपूर्ण), Harmonious (सद्भावपूर्ण), Untroubled (निश्चिंत).
Antonyms: Hostile (शत्रुतापूर्ण), Chaotic (अराजक), Noisy (शोरगुल).

This word refers to a fairly low temperature or being fashionably attractive. it describes a sensory state and is not a direct opposite for the quality of tranquility.
Synonyms: Chilly (ठंडा), Composed (शांत), Stylish (शानदार).
Antonyms: Hot (गर्म), Warm (गुनगुना), Excited (उत्तेजित).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: To destroy
questionsEn.s:
To destroy - नष्ट करना (To end existence by damaging or attacking)
To obliterate - मिटा देना (To destroy utterly or wipe out)
To abolish - समाप्त करना (To formally put an end to a system)
To shine - चमकना (To give out or reflect bright light)
To preserve - सुरक्षित रखना (To keep safe from harm or injury)
oa:
This word means to destroy something utterly or wipe it out completely. it is an intense synonym for destroy and therefore cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Eradicate (मिटा देना), Annihilate (नष्ट करना), Demolish (ध्वस्त करना).
Antonyms: Create (बनाना), Build (निर्माण करना), Restore (बहाल करना).

This word means to formally put an end to a system, practice, or institution. While specific, it describes ending something, acting as a synonym for destroy.
Synonyms: Annul (समाप्त करना), Cancel (रद्द करना), Terminate (अंत करना).
Antonyms: Establish (स्थापित करना), Found (नींव डालना), Institute (शुरू करना).

This word means to give out a bright light or to excel. it describes a visual quality or a level of performance and has no conceptual relation to destruction.
Synonyms: Glow (चमकना), Radiate (प्रकाशित होना), Glisten (टिमटिमाना).
Antonyms: Dull (फीका करना), Darken (अंधेरा करना), Fade (मिटना).

This word means to keep something safe from harm or to maintain it in its original state. it is the direct functional antonym for the word destroy.
Synonyms: Conserve (सुरक्षित रखना), Maintain (बनाए रखना), Protect (रक्षा करना).
Antonyms: Destroy (नष्ट करना), Ruin (बर्बाद करना), Waste (गँवाना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Quarrel
questionsEn.s:
Quarrel - झगड़ा (A heated argument or disagreement)
Strife - संघर्ष (Angry or bitter disagreement over issues)
Feud - विवाद (A prolonged and bitter quarrel or dispute)
Bias - पक्षपात (Inclination or prejudice for or against)
Harmony - सद्भाव (Combination of parts to produce a pleasing effect)
oa:
This word refers to angry or bitter disagreement over fundamental issues. It is a synonym for the conflict found in a quarrel and cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Conflict (संघर्ष), Friction (अनबन), Discord (विवाद).
Antonyms: Peace (शांति), Harmony (सद्भाव), Agreement (सहमति).

This word refers to a prolonged and bitter quarrel or dispute between families or groups. It is a direct synonym for a long-standing quarrel and is not an antonym.
Synonyms: Vendetta (पुश्तैनी रंजिश), Conflict (विवाद), Rivalry (प्रतिद्वंद्विता).
Antonyms: Friendship (मित्रता), Amity (मेल-जोल), Reconciliation (सुलह).

This word refers to an inclination or prejudice for or against one person or group. it describes a mental state of unfairness rather than the act of arguing.
Synonyms: Prejudice (पक्षपात), Partiality (तरफ़दारी), Predilection (झुकाव).
Antonyms: Impartiality (निष्पक्षता), Fairness (उचित व्यवहार), Neutrality (तटस्थता).

This word refers to the combination of parts or people in a pleasing or peaceful way. It is the direct social and musical antonym for a quarrel.
Synonyms: Peace (शांति), Concord (सामंजस्य), Tranquility (सद्भाव).
Antonyms: Quarrel (झगड़ा), Strife (कलह), Conflict (संघर्ष).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Slander
questionsEn.s:
Slander - निंदा (A false spoken statement to spoil a reputation)
Appeal - अपील (A serious, urgent, or heartfelt request)
Malign - बदनाम करना (Evil in nature or speaking critical manners)
Admire - प्रशंसा करना (Regarding something with respect and approval)
Defame - बदनाम करना (The act of damaging someone's reputation)
oa:
This word refers to a serious, urgent, or heartfelt request. it describes a plea for help or consideration rather than the act of evaluating or damaging a reputation.
Synonyms: Petition (अपील करना), Entreaty (विनती), Request (अनुरोध).
Antonyms: Denial (इनकार), Refusal (मनाही), Command (आदेश).

This word means to speak about someone in a spitefully critical manner. It is a direct synonym for slander and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an opposite.
Synonyms: Defame (बदनाम करना), Libel (अपमान करना), Vilify (नीचा दिखाना).
Antonyms: Praise (प्रशंसा करना), Applaud (सराहना), Commend (प्रशंसा करना).

This word refers to regarding someone with respect and approval. It is the direct emotional and social antonym for slander (damaging a reputation).
Synonyms: Respect (सम्मान करना), Appreciate (सराहना), Esteem (आदर करना).
Antonyms: Slander (निंदा करना), Despise (घृणा करना), Scorn (तिरस्कार करना).

This word means to damage the good reputation of someone. Like "malign," it is a direct synonym for slander and cannot be used as its antonym.
Synonyms: Libel (कलंकित करना), Besmirch (मैला करना), Denigrate (नीचा दिखाना).
Antonyms: Honor (सम्मान देना), Exalt (ऊँचा उठाना), Glorify (महिमा करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Entrance
questionsEn.s:
Entrance - प्रवेश (An opening like a door or a way in)
End - अंत (The final part of something or conclusion)
Closing - समापन (Bringing something to an end or shutting)
Exit - निकास (A way out of someplace)
Opening - द्वार (A gap that allows something to pass through)
oa:
This word refers to the final part of something or the conclusion. while an exit is at the end of a building, the word "end" is a temporal or structural term that is not a direct opposite for entrance.
Synonyms: Conclusion (समाप्ति), Finish (अंत), Termination (खत्म).
Antonyms: Beginning (शुरुआत), Start (आरंभ), Inception (उत्पत्ति).

This word refers to the act of bringing something to an end or shutting it. it describes a process rather than the physical location that serves as the opposite of an entrance.
Synonyms: Shutting (बंद करना), Sealing (मोहर लगाना), Finalizing (समापन).
Antonyms: Opening (खोलना), Launching (शुरू करना), Beginning (आरंभ).

This word refers to a way out of a place or the act of leaving. It is the direct and most accurate architectural and functional antonym for an entrance.
Synonyms: Way out (निकास), Departure (प्रस्थान), Egress (बाहर जाना).
Antonyms: Entrance (प्रवेश), Entry (दाखिला), Ingress (अंदर आना).

This word refers to a gap or hole that allows something to pass through. it is a synonym for the function of an entrance and therefore cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Entry (द्वार), Aperture (छेद), Gap (दरार).
Antonyms: Obstruction (बाधा), Blockage (अवरोध), Closing (बंद).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Deter
questionsEn.s:
Deter - रोकना (To discourage someone from doing something)
Generalise - सामान्यीकरण (To make something widely applicable)
Dissuade - मना करना (To persuade someone NOT to take an action)
Occupy - घेरना (To reside in or take up space/time)
Incite - उकसाना (To urge or persuade someone to act)
oa:
This word means to make something more widespread or to form a general opinion from specific facts. it refers to logic and scope rather than the discouragement of an action.
Synonyms: Universalize (सामान्यीकरण करना), Simplify (सरल बनाना), Broaden (विस्तृत करना).
Antonyms: Specialize (विशिष्ट बनाना), Specify (निर्दिष्ट करना), Differentiate (भेद करना).

This word means to persuade someone not to take a particular course of action. It is a direct synonym for deter and therefore cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Discourage (निरुत्साहित करना), Prevent (रोकना), Halt (थमाना).
Antonyms: Persuade (मनाना), Convince (राजी करना), Induce (प्रेरित करना).

This word means to reside in a building or to take up time and space. it describes a state of habitation or use and has no relation to the act of stopping an action.
Synonyms: Inhabit (निवास करना), Fill (भरना), Seize (कब्जा करना).
Antonyms: Vacate (खाली करना), Leave (छोड़ना), Abandon (त्यागना).

This word means to encourage or stir up someone to act in a certain way, usually a violent or undesirable one. it is the direct functional antonym for deter (stopping action).
Synonyms: Instigate (उकसाना), Provoke (भड़काना), Stimulate (प्रेरित करना).
Antonyms: Deter (रोकना), Discourage (निरुत्साहित करना), Quell (दबाना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Sympathy
questionsEn.s:
Sympathy - सहानुभूति (Pity and sorrow for someone else's misfortune)
Tragedy - त्रासदी (An event causing great suffering or destruction)
Warmth - स्नेह (The quality of being warm or friendly)
Cruelty - क्रूरता (Behavior that causes harm to another)
Enthusiasm - उत्साह (Intense and eager enjoyment or interest)
oa:
This word refers to an event causing great suffering and distress. while a tragedy elicits sympathy, the word itself describes a disastrous event rather than the emotion of care.
Synonyms: Calamity (आपदा), Disaster (विपत्ति), Misfortune (दुर्भाग्य).
Antonyms: Comedy (प्रहसन), Triumph (विजय), Joy (खुशी).

This word refers to the quality of being warm or a friendly, enthusiastic disposition. it is a positive trait often associated with sympathy and therefore not an antonym.
Synonyms: Affection (स्नेह), Cordiality (सौहार्द), Kindness (दया).
Antonyms: Coldness (ठंडक/रुखापन), Hostility (शत्रुता), Apathy (उदासीनता).

This word refers to behavior that willfully causes physical or mental harm to others. it is the direct moral and emotional antonym for sympathy (pity and sorrow for others).
Synonyms: Brutality (क्रूरता), Harshness (निष्ठुरता), Malice (दुष्टता).
Antonyms: Sympathy (सहानुभूति), Kindness (दया), Compassion (करुणा).

This word refers to intense and eager enjoyment or approval. it describes high energy and interest rather than the specific feeling of pity or lack thereof for others.
Synonyms: Zeal (जोश), Fervor (उत्साह), Eagerness (उत्सुकता).
Antonyms: Apathy (उदासीनता), Indifference (बेपरवाही), Boredom (ऊब).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Fickle
questionsEn.s:
Fickle - चंचल (Changing frequently in opinions or loyalties)
Mild - कोमल (Not severe, lenient, or gentle)
Hasty - जल्दबाज़ (Done with excessive speed or urgency)
Constant - स्थिर (Occurring continuously or unchanging)
Feeble - कमजोर (Lacking physical strength or weak)
oa:
This word describes something not severe, serious, or harsh. It refers to the intensity or temperament of a situation rather than the consistency or changing nature of loyalty.
Synonyms: Gentle (सौम्य), Lenient (नरम), Temperate (मध्यम).
Antonyms: Severe (कठोर), Harsh (सख्त), Extreme (अत्यधिक).

This word describes acting with excessive speed or urgency. it refers to the speed of an action rather than the frequency with which a person changes their mind.
Synonyms: Hurried (जल्दबाज़), Rash (अविवेकपूर्ण), Impetuous (आवेगपूर्ण).
Antonyms: Slow (धीमा), Deliberate (सोचा-समझा), Cautious (सावधान).

This word describes occurring continuously over time or remaining unchanging in attitude and loyalty. It is the direct and perfect antonym for being fickle.
Synonyms: Steady (स्थिर), Persistent (सतत), Unchanging (नियत).
Antonyms: Fickle (अस्थिर), Variable (परिवर्तनशील), Capricious (मनमौजी).

This word describes being weak or lacking physical strength. it refers to physical energy or power rather than the mental stability required to be consistent.
Synonyms: Weak (कमजोर), Frail (दुर्बल), Infirm (अशक्त).
Antonyms: Strong (मजबूत), Robust (सशक्त), Vigorous (ऊर्जावान).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Vile
questionsEn.s:
Vile - नीच (Extremely unpleasant, evil, or immoral)
Decent - शालीन (Considered to be of an acceptable standard)
Crafty - चालाक (Achieving goals in a clever/deceptive way)
Horrid - भयानक (Very unpleasant indeed)
Evil - बुरा (Wicked and bad force)
oa:
This word refers to something of an acceptable standard or a person who is honest and respectable. It is the perfect moral antonym for being vile (unpleasant/evil).
Synonyms: Respectable (शालीन), Proper (उचित), Honorable (माननीय).
Antonyms: Vile (नीच), Indecent (अशिष्ट), Improper (अनुचित).

This word describes achieving what one wants in a clever and often deceptive way. it refers to being shifty or wily, which is closer to being vile than it is to an opposite.
Synonyms: Wily (चालाक), Deceptive (धूर्त), Cunning (कुटिल).
Antonyms: Naive (भोला), Honest (ईमानदार), Guileless (निष्कपट).

This word describes something that is very unpleasant or unkind. It is a direct synonym for vile and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an antonym.
Synonyms: Hideous (भयानक), Awful (बहुत बुरा), Dreadful (भीषण).
Antonyms: Pleasant (सुखद), Lovely (प्यारा), Delightful (मनोहर).

This word refers to a powerful force that causes wicked and bad things to happen. it is a direct synonym for the moral sense of being vile and is not its opposite.
Synonyms: Wicked (दुष्ट), Sinful (पापी), Malicious (दुर्भावनापूर्ण).
Antonyms: Good (अच्छा), Virtuous (सदाचारी), Holy (पवित्र).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Harmony
questionsEn.s:
Harmony - सद्भाव (State of being in agreement or concord)
Accord - तालमेल (To be harmonious or consistent)
Strife - संघर्ष (Angry or bitter disagreement over issues)
Agreement - सहमति (Harmony or accordance in opinion)
Consensus - आम सहमति (A general agreement among a group)
oa:
This word refers to being harmonious or consistent with something. It is a direct synonym for harmony and therefore cannot be used as its antonym.
Synonyms: Agreement (सहमति), Concurrence (तालमेल), Unity (एकता).
Antonyms: Discord (कलह), Conflict (विवाद), Dissent (असहमति).

This word refers to angry or bitter disagreement over fundamental issues. It is the direct social and interpersonal antonym for being in harmony.
Synonyms: Conflict (संघर्ष), Discord (विवाद), Friction (अनबन).
Antonyms: Harmony (सद्भाव), Peace (शांति), Accord (सहमति).

This word refers to a state of harmony or accordance in opinion. Like "accord," it is a direct synonym for harmony and does not provide an opposite meaning.
Synonyms: Assent (स्वीकृति), Consent (अनुमति), Concord (मेल).
Antonyms: Disagreement (असहमत होना), Objection (आपत्ति), Refusal (इनकार).

This word refers to a general agreement among a group of people. it is a synonym for the state of collective harmony and therefore acts as its counterpart rather than an opposite.
Synonyms: Unity (एकमतता), Concurrence (सहमति), Accord (मेल-मिलाप).
Antonyms: Disagreement (मतभेद), Conflict (विवाद), Division (विभाजन).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Facilitate
questionsEn.s:
Facilitate - सुगम बनाना (To make an action or process easy)
Ease - आराम (The absence of difficulty or effort)
Hinder - बाधा डालना (To make it difficult for something to happen)
Encourage - प्रोत्साहित करना (To give support, confidence, or hope)
Aid - सहायता (Help, typically of a practical nature)
oa:
This word means the absence of difficulty or effort. It is a synonym for the effect of facilitating something and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an antonym.
Synonyms: Alleviate (राहत देना), Simplify (सरल बनाना), Smooth (सुगम करना).
Antonyms: Complicate (जटिल बनाना), Hinder (बाधा डालना), Block (रोकना).

This word means to make it difficult for someone to do something or for something to happen. It is the direct functional antonym for facilitate (make easy).
Synonyms: Obstruct (बाधा डालना), Impede (रोकना), Thwart (बाधित करना).
Antonyms: Facilitate (सुविधाजनक बनाना), Assist (सहायता करना), Help (मदद करना).

This word means to give support, confidence, or hope to someone. while it is a positive action, it describes motivational support rather than the easing of a process.
Synonyms: Motivate (प्रोत्साहित करना), Stimulate (प्रेरित करना), Inspire (प्रेरणा देना).
Antonyms: Discourage (निरुत्साहित करना), Deter (रोकना), Dissuade (मना करना).

This word refers to help, typically of a practical nature. it is a direct synonym for facilitate (helping a process move forward) and cannot be its antonym.
Synonyms: Help (मदद), Assist (सहायता), Support (सहयोग).
Antonyms: Obstacle (बाधा), Hinder (रोकना), Oppose (विरोध करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Admire
questionsEn.s:
Admire - प्रशंसा करना (To respect or like very much)
Respect - आदर (Feeling of deep admiration or high opinion)
Dislike - नापसंद (A feeling of not liking or approving)
Disagree - असहमत होना (To have a different opinion)
Approve - स्वीकार करना (To believe something is good or acceptable)
oa:
This word refers to a feeling of deep admiration for someone elicited by their abilities. It is a direct synonym for admire and therefore not an antonym.
Synonyms: Revere (आदर करना), Honor (सम्मान देना), Esteem (मानना).
Antonyms: Despise (घृणा करना), Scorn (तिरस्कार करना), Disdain (उपेक्षा करना).

This word refers to a strong feeling of not liking or approving of someone. It is the direct emotional and behavioral antonym for being an admirer.
Synonyms: Hate (नापसंद करना), Distaste (अरुचि), Aversion (घृणा).
Antonyms: Admire (प्रशंसा करना), Like (पसंद करना), Love (प्रेम करना).

This word means to have a different opinion from someone. while you might disagree with someone you admire, the word describes opinion rather than personal regard.
Synonyms: Dissent (असहमत होना), Differ (अलग होना), Object (विरोध करना).
Antonyms: Agree (सहमत होना), Concur (एकमत होना), Assent (स्वीकृति देना).

This word means to believe that something is good or acceptable. it is a synonym for the supportive nature of admiration and therefore not its opposite.
Synonyms: Commend (स्वीकार्य समझना), Sanction (मंजूरी देना), Ratify (पुष्टि करना).
Antonyms: Disapprove (अस्वीकार करना), Reject (नकारना), Condemn (निंदा करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Absolute
questionsEn.s:
Absolute - पूर्ण (Complete, total, and unconditional)
Total - कुल (Complete or absolute)
Limited - सीमित (Small or controlled in number or amount)
Complete - संपूर्ण (Having all parts; with nothing missing)
Adequate - पर्याप्त (Enough for what is needed)
oa:
This word means complete or absolute. it is a direct synonym for the given word and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an antonym.
Synonyms: Complete (कुल), Entire (पूरा), Sheer (बिल्कुल).
Antonyms: Partial (आंशिक), Limited (सीमित), Fragmented (अधूरा).

This word refers to being small or controlled in number, scope, or power. It is the perfect antonym for absolute, which implies being total and unconditional.
Synonyms: Restricted (सीमित), Constrained (नियंत्रित), Finite (नियत).
Antonyms: Absolute (पूर्ण), Total (कुल), Infinite (असीमित).

This word means having all the necessary or appropriate parts; with nothing missing. It is a synonym for absolute and cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Finished (संपूर्ण), Whole (पूरा), Thorough (पुख्ता).
Antonyms: Incomplete (अधूरा), Partial (आंशिक), Lacking (अभावपूर्ण).

This word means enough for what you need or requirement. While it describes sufficiency, it is a neutral descriptor that does not oppose the concept of being absolute.
Synonyms: Sufficient (पर्याप्त), Enough (काफी), Satisfactory (संतोषजनक).
Antonyms: Inadequate (अपर्याप्त), Scant (कम), Deficient (न्यून).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Bright
questionsEn.s:
Bright - उज्ज्वल (Full of light or sunny)
Colourful - रंगीन (Having much or varied colour)
Bleak - नीरस (Cold and miserable weather or outlook)
Charming - मनोहर (Very pleasant or attractive)
Active - सक्रिय (Engaging in physically energetic pursuits)
oa:
This word describes having many or varied colors. while colorful things are often bright, the word is a synonym/attribute and not an opposite.
Synonyms: Vibrant (रंगीन), Vivid (चमकीला), Variegated (विविध).
Antonyms: Colorless (रंगहीन), Monochrome (एकवर्णी), Pale (फीका).

This word describes weather or a situation that is cold, miserable, and lacking in hope or light. It is the direct environmental and emotional antonym for bright.
Synonyms: Dismal (उदास), Gloomy (निराशाजनक), Somber (विषादपूर्ण).
Antonyms: Bright (उज्ज्वल), Cheerful (प्रसन्न), Radiant (चमकीला).

This word describes something that is very pleasant or attractive. while a bright person can be charming, the word describes appeal rather than the level of light or cheer.
Synonyms: Delightful (मनमोहक), Appealing (आकर्षक), Winsome (मनोहर).
Antonyms: Repulsive (घृणित), Ugly (बदसूरत), Hideous (भयानक).

This word refers to engaging or ready to engage in physically energetic pursuits. It describes movement and energy rather than the quality of being full of light.
Synonyms: Energetic (सक्रिय), Lively (चुस्त), Dynamic (गतिशील).
Antonyms: Passive (निष्क्रिय), Lazy (आलसी), Sluggish (सुस्त).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Shallow
questionsEn.s:
Shallow - छिछला (Of little depth or superficial)
Wide - चौड़ा (Of great distance from side to side)
Deep - गहरा (Extending far down from the surface)
Near - पास (At or to a short distance away)
Long - लंबा (Measuring a great distance end to end)
oa:
This word refers to the distance from one side to the other. It describes horizontal breadth rather than the vertical distance that opposes "shallow."
Synonyms: Broad (चौड़ा), Vast (विस्तृत), Spacious (विशाल).
Antonyms: Narrow (तंग), Thin (संकीर्ण), Constricted (संकुचित).

This word refers to something extending far down from the top or surface. It is the direct and perfect physical and metaphorical antonym for shallow.
Synonyms: Profound (गहरा), Intensive (गहन), Bottomless (अथाह).
Antonyms: Shallow (छिछला), Superficial (सतही), Cursory (ऊपरी).

This word refers to something situated at or to a short distance away. it describes proximity in distance rather than the vertical measure of a hole or water.
Synonyms: Close (पास), Adjacent (निकट), Proximate (समीप).
Antonyms: Far (दूर), Distant (दूरवर्ती), Remote (दूर का).

This word refers to measuring a great distance from end to end. it describes length rather than the depth required to provide an opposite for "shallow."
Synonyms: Extended (लंबा), Lengthy (विस्तृत), Protracted (दीर्घ).
Antonyms: Short (छोटा), Brief (संक्षिप्त), Concise (लघु).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Prominent
questionsEn.s:
Prominent - प्रसिद्ध/स्पष्ट (Important, famous, or easily seen)
Inconspicuous - अस्पष्ट (Not clearly visible or attracting attention)
Dangerous - ख़तरनाक (Able or likely to cause harm)
Crazy - पागल (Mad or acting in a wild behavior)
Evident - स्पष्ट (Clearly seen or understood; obvious)
oa:
This word describes something that is not clearly visible or does not attract attention. it is the direct antonym for prominent, which means famous or noticeable.
Synonyms: Hidden (अस्पष्ट), Unnoticeable (अप्रत्यक्ष), Subtle (सूक्ष्म).
Antonyms: Prominent (प्रसिद्ध), Noticeable (स्पष्ट), Conspicuous (विशिष्ट).

This word describes being able or likely to cause harm or injury. It refers to safety and risk rather than how much attention something or someone attracts.
Synonyms: Perilous (ख़तरनाक), Risky (जोखिम भरा), Hazardous (हानिकारक).
Antonyms: Safe (सुरक्षित), Secure (निश्चित), Harmless (हानिरहित).

This word describes someone who is mad or acting in a wild or aggressive behavior. It refers to mental state rather than being well-known or easily seen.
Synonyms: Insane (पागल), Mad (विक्षिप्त), Eccentric (सनकी).
Antonyms: Sane (समझदार), Rational (तार्किक), Sensible (विवेकपूर्ण).

This word describes something that is clearly seen or understood. it is a synonym for the "noticeable" aspect of being prominent and therefore not an antonym.
Synonyms: Obvious (स्पष्ट), Obvious (प्रत्यक्ष), Manifest (सुस्पष्ट).
Antonyms: Hidden (छिपा हुआ), Obscure (धुंधला), Doubtful (संदिग्ध).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: To acquire
questionsEn.s:
To acquire - प्राप्त करना (To obtain or buy something)
To collect - एकत्रित करना (To bring a number of things together)
To gain - पाना (To obtain or win something)
To disperse - बिखेरना (To separate and go in different directions)
To earn - कमाना (To get money or status by working)
oa:
This word means to bring a number of things together. While acquiring often involves collecting, the word is a near-synonym and does not function as an opposite.
Synonyms: Gather (एकत्र करना), Accumulate (संग्रह करना), Assemble (इकट्ठा करना).
Antonyms: Disperse (बिखेरना), Scatter (छितराना), Distribute (बाँटना).

This word means to obtain or win something, especially something needed. It is a direct synonym for acquire and therefore cannot be its antonym.
Synonyms: Obtain (पाना), Get (प्राप्त करना), Achieve (हासिल करना).
Antonyms: Lose (खोना), Forfeit (दंड भरना), Give up (त्यागना).

This word means to separate and go in different directions or to distribute. In this context, it represents the act of spreading out what was obtained, acting as a functional antonym.
Synonyms: Scatter (बिखेरना), Distribute (बाँटना), Dissipate (नष्ट करना).
Antonyms: Acquire (अर्जित करना), Collect (एकत्र करना), Gather (इकट्ठा करना).

This word refers to getting money or a reputation by working. it is a specific way of acquiring something and therefore acts as a synonym.
Synonyms: Deserve (कमाना), Merit (पाना), Gain (प्राप्त करना).
Antonyms: Lose (गँवाना), Waste (बर्बाद करना), Spend (खर्च करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Excited
questionsEn.s:
Excited - उत्साहित (Feeling happiness and enthusiasm)
Bored - ऊबा हुआ (Feeling tired because of lack of interest)
Active - सक्रिय (Involved in activity; lively)
Busy - व्यस्त (Having a lot of work or tasks to do)
Thrilled - रोमांचित (Sudden feeling of excitement and pleasure)
oa:
This word describes a state of feeling tired or annoyed because something is not interesting. it is the direct emotional opposite of being excited or enthusiastic.
Synonyms: Weary (ऊबा हुआ), Disinterested (उदासीन), Tired (उकताया हुआ).
Antonyms: Excited (उत्तेजित), Interested (रुचि रखने वाला), Thrilled (पुलकित).

This word describes being involved in activity or being lively. It is often a characteristic of being excited rather than providing an opposite for it.
Synonyms: Energetic (सक्रिय), Vigorous (गतिशील), Busy (चुस्त).
Antonyms: Passive (निष्क्रिय), Lazy (आलसी), Inactive (सुस्त).

This word describes having a lot of work or tasks to do. While an excited person might be busy, the word refers to the volume of work rather than the state of enthusiasm.
Synonyms: Occupied (व्यस्त), Engaged (कार्यरत), Employed (लगा हुआ).
Antonyms: Idle (खाली), Free (मुक्त), Unemployed (बेकार).

This word describes a sudden feeling of great excitement and pleasure. it is a strong synonym for being excited and therefore cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Elated (रोमांचित), Delighted (पुलकित), Overjoyed (गदगद).
Antonyms: Depressed (उदास), Bored (ऊबा हुआ), Miserable (दुखी).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Sufficient
questionsEn.s:
Sufficient - पर्याप्त (As much as is necessary; enough)
Precise - सटीक (Clear and accurate in detail)
Intense - तीव्र (Very great, strong, or serious)
Inadequate - अपर्याप्त (Not enough or not good enough)
Enough - काफी (As much as is necessary)
oa:
This word describes being clear, accurate, and marked by exactness. It refers to the quality of detail rather than the quantity of a resource being enough.
Synonyms: Exact (सटीक), Accurate (शुद्ध), Specific (विशिष्ट).
Antonyms: Vague (अस्पष्ट), Inexact (अशुद्ध), Careless (लापरवाह).

This word describes something that is very great, strong, or serious. it refers to the magnitude or strength of a condition rather than the sufficiency of an amount.
Synonyms: Acute (तीव्र), Extreme (प्रबल), Powerful (शक्तिशाली).
Antonyms: Mild (हल्का), Weak (कमजोर), Moderate (मध्यम).

This word refers to something that is not enough or not good enough for a purpose. It is the direct and perfect antonym for sufficient (enough).
Synonyms: Insufficient (अपर्याप्त), Scant (नाकाफ़ी), Deficient (न्यून).
Antonyms: Sufficient (पर्याप्त), Abundant (प्रचुर), Enough (काफी).

This word refers to as much or as many as is necessary. It is a direct synonym for the given word and therefore does not function as its opposite.
Synonyms: Sufficient (पर्याप्त), Adequate (संतोषजनक), Ample (प्रचुर).
Antonyms: Lacking (अभाव), Short (कम), Inadequate (नाकाफ़ी).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Eager
questionsEn.s:
Eager - उत्सुक (Keenly expectant or interested)
Easier - आसान (Not difficult; simpler)
Indifferent - उदासीन (Not interested or caring about something)
Different - भिन्न (Not the same as another)
Loveable - प्यारा (Having a personality easy to love)
oa:
This word describes something that is not difficult or requires little effort. It is the comparative form of "easy" and has no conceptual relation to a person's desire.
Synonyms: Simpler (आसान), Smoother (सुगम), More manageable (अधिक सुलभ).
Antonyms: Harder (कठिन), More difficult (जटिल), Strenuous (श्रमसाध्य).

This word describes having no particular interest, concern, or sympathy. It is the direct behavioral antonym for being eager or keenly interested.
Synonyms: Apathetic (उदासीन), Unconcerned (बेपरवाह), Detached (अलग).
Antonyms: Eager (उत्सुक), Keen (व्यग्र), Interested (रुचि रखने वाला).

This word describes something that is not the same as another. it refers to variety or distinctness rather than the intensity of interest or enthusiasm.
Synonyms: Dissimilar (भिन्न), Distinct (अलग), Diverse (विविध).
Antonyms: Similar (समान), Same (वही), Alike (सदृश).

This word describes having a personality or appearance that is easy to love. It is a positive attribute of character rather than a description of a person's eagerness.
Synonyms: Adorable (प्यारा), Amiable (प्रिय), Charming (आकर्षक).
Antonyms: Hateful (घृणास्पद), Repulsive (अरुचिकर), Obnoxious (अप्रिय).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Agree
questionsEn.s:
Agree - सहमत होना (To have the same opinion as another)
Oppose - विरोध करना (To disagree and try to stop something)
Distance - दूरी (Amount of space between two places)
Question - प्रश्न (A sentence that asks for an answer or doubt)
Support - समर्थन (To help by agreeing or providing aid)
oa:
This word means to disagree with a belief or plan and try to change or stop it. It is the direct functional and verbal antonym for the word agree.
Synonyms: Object (विरोध करना), Dissent (असहमत होना), Resist (प्रतिरोध करना).
Antonyms: Agree (सहमत होना), Support (समर्थन करना), Assent (स्वीकृति देना).

This word refers to the amount of space between two places or people. It is a spatial or temporal term and has no logical relation to the act of shared opinion.
Synonyms: Span (दूरी), Interval (अंतराल), Gap (फासला).
Antonyms: Nearness (निकटता), Proximity (सामीप्य), Closeness (निकटता).

This word refers to a sentence that asks for an answer or the act of expressing doubt. While questioning can imply disagreement, it is not a direct antonym for "agree."
Synonyms: Query (प्रशन), Interrogate (पूछताछ करना), Dispute (संदेह करना).
Antonyms: Answer (उत्तर देना), Accept (मानना), Confirm (पुष्टि करना).

This word means to help someone by agreeing with them or providing assistance. it is a synonym for the supportive outcome of agreeing and is not its opposite.
Synonyms: Back (समर्थन देना), Aid (सहायता करना), Endorse (पुष्टि करना).
Antonyms: Oppose (विरोध करना), Hinder (बाधा डालना), Undermine (कमज़ोर करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Thrive
questionsEn.s:
Thrive - फलना-फूलना (To grow or develop well)
Prosper - समृद्ध होना (To develop in a successful way)
Shrink - सिकुड़ना (To become or make something smaller)
Develop - विकसित होना (To grow slowly or change into something better)
Shine - चमकना (To reflect light or be bright)
oa:
This word means to develop in a successful way, especially with money. it is a direct synonym for thrive and therefore cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Flourish (फलना-फूलना), Bloom (खिलना), Succeed (सफल होना).
Antonyms: Fail (असफल होना), Decline (पतन होना), Struggle (संघर्ष करना).

This word refers to becoming smaller in size, amount, or prosperity. it serves as the functional antonym for thrive, which implies growth and success.
Synonyms: Decrease (सिकुड़ना), Diminish (घटाना), Wane (क्षीण होना).
Antonyms: Thrive (उन्नति करना), Grow (बढ़ना), Expand (फैलाना).

This word means to grow slowly, increase, or change into something more advanced. It is a synonym for the progress found in thriving and not an antonym.
Synonyms: Advance (विकसित होना), Mature (परिपक्व होना), Evolve (बदलना).
Antonyms: Deteriorate (बिगड़ना), Stop (रुकना), Regress (पीछे हटना).

This word refers to emitting light or being exceptionally bright and successful. it describes brilliance rather than the successful growth implied by "thrive."
Synonyms: Radiate (चमकना), Gleam (टिमटिमाना), Excel (श्रेष्ठ होना).
Antonyms: Dull (फीका), Darken (अंधेरा होना), Fail (विफल होना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Succeed
questionsEn.s:
Succeed - सफल होना (To achieve what you want or do well)
Win - जीतना (To be the best in a race or competition)
Achieve - पूरा करना (To complete something by skill)
Gain - पाना (To obtain or win something needed)
Lose - हारना (To fail to win or no longer have something)
oa:
This word refers to being the best or strongest in a race or competition. it is a direct synonym for the act of succeeding and therefore not an antonym.
Synonyms: Triumph (जीतना), Prevail (विजयी होना), Conquer (जीतना).
Antonyms: Lose (हारना), Fail (विफल होना), Surrender (समर्पण करना).

This word means to complete something by hard work and skill. Like "succeed," it describes the accomplishment of a goal and is not its opposite.
Synonyms: Accomplish (पूरा करना), Fulfill (सिद्ध करना), Realize (प्राप्त करना).
Antonyms: Neglect (उपेक्षा करना), Fail (चूकना), Abandon (त्यागना).

This word means to obtain something that you need or want. While gaining is a positive outcome of succeeding, it is a synonym rather than providing an opposite.
Synonyms: Obtain (पाना), Acquire (प्राप्त करना), Procure (हासिल करना).
Antonyms: Lose (गँवाना), Spend (खर्च करना), Forfeit (दंड भरना).

This word means to fail to win a game or contest, or to no longer have something. It is the direct and perfect antonym for succeeding.
Synonyms: Fail (हारना), Misplace (खोना), Drop (गिराना).
Antonyms: Succeed (सफल होना), Win (जीतना), Gain (पाना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Distant
questionsEn.s:
Distant - दूर (A long way away in space or time)
Isolated - अलग-थलग (Alone or apart from other people)
Remote - दूरवर्ती (Far away from where others live)
Near - पास (Not far away in time or distance)
Removed - अलग किया (Taken away or in a separate position)
oa:
This word describes being alone or apart from other people. It is a synonym for the "remote" aspect of being distant and therefore cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Secluded (अलग-थलग), Lonely (अकेला), Detached (पृथक).
Antonyms: Social (सामाजिक), Integrated (एकीकृत), Central (मध्य).

This word describes being situated far away from main centers. It is a direct synonym for distant and does not satisfy the requirement for an antonym.
Synonyms: Far (दूरवर्ती), Isolated (दूर), Outlying (बाहरी).
Antonyms: Close (निकट), Nearby (समीप), Accessible (सुगम).

This word describes being situated at a short distance away in space or time. It is the direct and most accurate antonym for distant.
Synonyms: Close (पास), Adjacent (निकट), Proximate (समीप).
Antonyms: Distant (दूर), Far (दूर), Remote (दूरवर्ती).

This word refers to having been taken away or being separate from something. While it implies separation, it is a result of an action rather than a direct spatial opposite like "near."
Synonyms: Detached (निकाला गया), Displaced (हटाया हुआ), Separated (अलग).
Antonyms: Attached (जुड़ा हुआ), Present (उपस्थित), Connected (संबद्ध).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Alike
questionsEn.s:
Alike - समान (Very similar in appearance or nature)
Ordinary - साधारण (Normal or not unusual/different)
Similar - सदृश (Like someone but not exactly same)
Same - वही (Exactly the one mentioned before; identical)
Different - भिन्न (Not the same; unlike another)
oa:
This word describes something normal or not unusual. It describes a level of quality or commonality rather than the relationship of similarity between two things.
Synonyms: Normal (साधारण), Common (आम), Average (औसत).
Antonyms: Unusual (असामान्य), Unique (अद्वितीय), Special (विशिष्ट).

This word describes being like somebody or something but not exactly the same. it is a direct synonym for alike and therefore cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Alike (समान), Comparable (सदृश), Related (संबद्ध).
Antonyms: Different (भिन्न), Dissimilar (अलग), Opposite (विपरीत).

This word describes exactly the one or one mentioned before; identical. Like "similar," it conveys the idea of being alike and acts as a synonym.
Synonyms: Identical (वही), Equal (समान), Uniform (एक जैसा).
Antonyms: Different (अलग), Various (विविध), Other (अन्य).

This word describes things that are not the same or unlike each other. It is the direct and perfect antonym for being alike.
Synonyms: Dissimilar (भिन्न), Diverse (विविध), Varying (अलग).
Antonyms: Alike (समान), Same (एक जैसा), Identical (वही).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Abolish
questionsEn.s:
Abolish - समाप्त करना (To end a law or system officially)
Disprove - असत्य सिद्ध करना (To show that something is not true)
Contest - मुक़ाबला (A competition or a challenge)
Continue - जारी रखना (To keep happening without stopping)
Disclose - प्रकट करना (To tell something secret or make it known)
oa:
This word means to show that something is not true or to refute a claim. it refers to the validity of information rather than the ending of a law or practice.
Synonyms: Refute (असत्य सिद्ध करना), Deny (नकारना), Debunk (झूठा साबित करना).
Antonyms: Prove (सिद्ध करना), Confirm (पुष्टि करना), Substantiate (साबित करना).

This word refers to a competition or the act of challenging something. While one might contest an abolition, the word itself is an act of dispute, not an opposite of ending.
Synonyms: Dispute (प्रतियोगिता), Challenge (चुनौती देना), Struggle (मुकाबला).
Antonyms: Accept (स्वीकार करना), Yield (झुकना), Agree (सहमत होना).

This word means to keep something happening or existing without stopping. It is the perfect functional antonym for abolish (which means to end).
Synonyms: Persist (जारी रखना), Endure (बनाए रखना), Resume (फिर शुरू करना).
