Antonyms: Abolish (समाप्त करना), Stop (रोकना), Cease (खत्म करना).

This word means to tell something secret or to make it known publicly. it refers to revelation rather than the creation or termination of a system.
Synonyms: Reveal (प्रकट करना), Divulge (बताना), Unveil (उजागर करना).
Antonyms: Conceal (छिपाना), Hide (गुप्त रखना), Withhold (रोकना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Prompt
questionsEn.s:
Prompt - शीघ्र (Immediate or done without delay)
Sluggish - सुस्त (Moving or working more slowly than normal)
Alert - सतर्क (Watchful for danger or paying attention)
Immediate - तत्काल (Happening without any delay)
Speedy - तेज़ (Fast or quick in movement)
oa:
This word describes someone or something moving or working more slowly than normal, often in a lazy way. it is the perfect antonym for being prompt (immediate).
Synonyms: Slow (सुस्त), Lethargic (मंद), Laggard (ढीला-ढाला).
Antonyms: Prompt (शीघ्र), Brisk (तेज़), Quick (त्वरित).

This word describes being watchful and paying attention to possible danger. while a prompt person is often alert, the word is a synonym for vigilance rather than an opposite.
Synonyms: Vigilant (सतर्क), Watchful (चौकस), Observant (चौकन्ना).
Antonyms: Careless (असावधान), Inattentive (लापरवाह), Oblivious (बेखबर).

This word describes something happening or done without any delay. It is a direct synonym for prompt and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an antonym.
Synonyms: Instant (तत्काल), Direct (सीधा), Sudden (अचानक).
Antonyms: Delayed (विलंबित), Slow (धीमा), Gradual (क्रमशः).

This word describes someone or something that is fast or quick. Like "immediate," it is a synonym for the rapid response implied by "prompt."
Synonyms: Rapid (तेज़), Fast (द्रुत), Swift (शीघ्र).
Antonyms: Slow (मन्द), Tardy (विलंबित), Leisurely (आराम से).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Slacken
questionsEn.s:
Slacken - धीमा करना (To become or make something slower or less active)
Relax - विश्राम करना (To rest or make less tight)
Intensify - तीव्र करना (To become or make something stronger)
Retard - धीमा करना (To delay or make progress slower)
Weaken - कमज़ोर करना (To become less strong or powerful)
oa:
This word means to rest or to make something less hard or tight. It is a synonym for the reduction in tension found in slackening and cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Ease (आराम फ़रमाना), Unwind (शिथिल होना), Loosen (ढीला करना).
Antonyms: Tighten (कसना), Work (काम करना), Intensify (तीव्र करना).

This word means to become or make something greater, stronger, or more active. It is the direct functional antonym for slackening (becoming slower or less active).
Synonyms: Strengthen (तीव्र करना), Escalates (बढ़ाना), Heighten (प्रबल करना).
Antonyms: Slacken (धीमा करना), Weaken (कमज़ोर करना), Abate (कम करना).

This word means to delay something or make its progress slower. it is a synonym for the "slowing down" aspect of slackening and is not an antonym.
Synonyms: Hinder (धीमा करना), Slow (विलंब करना), Impede (बाधा डालना).
Antonyms: Advance (आगे बढ़ाना), Accelerate (त्वरित करना), Expedite (तेज़ करना).

This word means to become or make someone less strong or powerful. It is another synonym for the loss of force implied by slacken rather than providing an opposite.
Synonyms: Enfeeble (कमज़ोर करना), Debilitate (अशक्त करना), Sap (क्षीण करना).
Antonyms: Strengthen (मजबूत करना), Fortify (सशक्त करना), Reinforce (सुदृढ़ करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Unfeeling
questionsEn.s:
Unfeeling - कठोर (Unsympathetic, harsh, or callous)
Modest - विनम्र (Not talking too much about own abilities)
Affectionate - स्नेहशील (Readily showing fondness or tenderness)
Cruel - क्रूर (Causing physical or mental pain to others)
Aloof - भावशून्य (Not friendly to others; distant)
oa:
This word refers to someone who does not talk too much about their own abilities or achievements. It describes humility rather than the capacity for sympathy or emotion.
Synonyms: Humble (विनम्र), Unpretentious (विनीत), Meek (नम्र).
Antonyms: Proud (गर्वित), Boastful (शेखीबाज़), Arrogant (अभिमानी).

This word refers to someone who readily feels or shows fondness and tenderness. it is the direct emotional antonym for being unfeeling or callous.
Synonyms: Loving (स्नेही), Tender (स्नेहशील), Caring (सहानुभूतिपूर्ण).
Antonyms: Unfeeling (कठोर), Cold (उदासीन), Cruel (निर्मम).

This word refers to causing physical or mental pain to others. it is a synonym for the harsh or callous nature of being unfeeling and cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Harsh (निर्मम), Brutal (क्रूर), Pitiless (बेदर्द).
Antonyms: Kind (दयालु), Compassionate (सहानुभूतिपूर्ण), Merciful (कृपालु).

This word describes someone who is not friendly or is distant toward others. Like "unfeeling," it implies a lack of emotional connection and acts as a near-synonym.
Synonyms: Detached (अलग), Distant (दूर), Indifferent (भावशून्य).
Antonyms: Friendly (मित्रवत), Sociable (मिलनसार), Involved (शामिल).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Initiate
questionsEn.s:
Initiate - आरंभ करना (To start something)
Launch - प्रारंभ करना (To send a ship out or start an enterprise)
Conclude - समाप्त करना (To bring to an end or form a result)
Begin - शुरू करना (To start doing the first part of something)
Inspire - प्रेरित करना (To make someone want to do something)
oa:
This word means to start a ship into water or to start an enterprise. it is a direct synonym for initiate and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an antonym.
Synonyms: Start (शुरू करना), Begin (आरंभ करना), Found (संस्थापित करना).
Antonyms: Close (बंद करना), Terminate (समाप्त करना), Finish (खत्म करना).

This word means to bring something to an end or to form an opinion after a study. it is the direct and perfect functional antonym for initiating something.
Synonyms: Finish (समाप्त करना), Terminate (खत्म करना), End (अंत करना).
Antonyms: Initiate (आरंभ करना), Start (शुरू करना), Launch (प्रारंभ करना).

This word means to start doing something or to do the first part of a task. it is a common synonym for initiate and cannot be used as its opposite.
Synonyms: Commence (आरंभ करना), Open (खोलना), Institute (स्थापित करना).
Antonyms: End (अंत करना), Cease (रोकना), Conclude (समाप्त करना).

This word means to make someone want to do or create something. While it can be a cause of initiation, the word describes motivation rather than the starting of a process.
Synonyms: Motivate (प्रेरित करना), Encourage (उत्साहित करना), Stimulate (उत्तेजित करना).
Antonyms: Discourage (निरुत्साहित करना), Depress (हतोत्साहित करना), Deter (रोकना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Cherish
questionsEn.s:
Cherish - संजोकर रखना (To love and look after something carefully)
Distribute - बाँटना (To give things to a number of people)
Disperse - छितराना (To separate and go in different directions)
Disturb - परेशान करना (To interrupt someone or spoil a situation)
Disregard - उपेक्षा करना (To treat something as unimportant)
oa:
This word means to give things out to a number of people or spread them over an area. it describes allocation rather than the emotional valuing of an object or person.
Synonyms: Spread (बाँटना), Allocate (वितरित करना), Apportion (विभाजित करना).
Antonyms: Collect (इकट्ठा करना), Hoard (जमा करना), Gather (एकत्र करना).

This word means to separate and go in different directions. While it involves moving away from a center, it does not address the emotional neglect required to oppose "cherish."
Synonyms: Scatter (बिखरना), Dissipate (विसर्जित करना), Diffuse (फैलाना).
Antonyms: Assemble (एकत्र करना), Gather (इकट्ठा करना), Concentrate (केंद्रित करना).

This word means to interrupt someone while they are busy or to spoil a peaceful situation. it refers to interference rather than a lack of affection or care.
Synonyms: Interrupt (बाधा पहुँचाना), Annoy (परेशान करना), Disrupt (अव्यवस्थित करना).
Antonyms: Calm (शांत करना), Soothe (सहलाना), Settle (स्थिर करना).

This word refers to taking no notice of something or treating it as unimportant. It is the direct behavioral antonym for cherishing (loving and caring for) something.
Synonyms: Ignore (उपेक्षा करना), Neglect (अनदेखा करना), Overlook (नज़रअंदाज़ करना).
Antonyms: Cherish (सँभाल कर रखना), Value (सम्मान देना), Respect (आदर करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Nab
questionsEn.s:
Nab - पकड़ना (To catch or arrest someone doing wrong)
Catch - थामना (To capture someone you have been following)
Grab - झपटना (To take hold of something suddenly)
Free - आज़ाद करना (To let someone leave from confinement)
Arrest - गिरफ्तार करना (To seize someone by legal authority)
oa:
This word means to capture or seize someone who has been moving. it is a direct synonym for nab and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an antonym.
Synonyms: Capture (पकड़ना), Seize (पकड़ना), Apprehend (पकड़ लेना).
Antonyms: Release (छोड़ना), Free (आज़ाद करना), Lose (गँवाना).

This word means to take hold of something or someone suddenly and roughly. It is another synonym for the quick seizure implied by "nab" and is not its opposite.
Synonyms: Snatch (झपटना), Clutch (पकड़ना), Seize (जब्त करना).
Antonyms: Let go (छोड़ना), Release (मुक्त करना), Drop (गिराना).

This word means to let someone leave or escape from confinement. It is the direct functional antonym for nabbing or arresting a person.
Synonyms: Release (आज़ाद करना), Liberate (मुक्त करना), Discharge (छोड़ना).
Antonyms: Nab (पकड़ना), Arrest (गिरफ्तार करना), Confine (कैद करना).

This word refers to using legal authority to take someone into custody. it is a formal synonym for nab and cannot be used as its antonym.
Synonyms: Detain (बंदी बनाना), Incarcerate (जेल भेजना), Apprehend (हिरासत में लेना).
Antonyms: Liberate (मुक्त करना), Pardon (क्षमा करना), Release (रिहा करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Barrier
questionsEn.s:
Barrier - अवरोध (An object that keeps things separate or stops movement)
Advocate - समर्थक (To recommend or support a plan or action)
Obstacle - बाधा (Something that makes it difficult to do something)
Hindrance - रुकावट (A person or thing that makes things difficult)
Opening - द्वार (A space or hole that something can go through)
oa:
This word refers to a person who publicly supports a particular plan or action. it describes a legal or vocal supporter rather than a physical or functional passage.
Synonyms: Supporter (समर्थक), Proponent (पक्षधर), Champion (हिमायती).
Antonyms: Opponent (विरोधी), Critic (आलोचक), Adversary (दुश्मन).

This word refers to something that makes it difficult to do something or go somewhere. It is a direct synonym for barrier and cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Hurdle (बाधा), Impediment (अड़चन), Block (अवरोध).
Antonyms: Path (रास्ता), Aid (सहायता), Opening (द्वार).

This word means a person or thing that makes it difficult for someone to do something. Like "obstacle," it is a synonym for the restrictive nature of a barrier.
Synonyms: Obstruction (विघ्न), Hitch (रुकावट), Drag (बाधा).
Antonyms: Help (मदद), Assistance (सहयोग), Advantage (लाभ).

This word refers to a space or hole that someone or something can go through. It is the direct physical and functional antonym for a barrier.
Synonyms: Gap (द्वार), Passage (रास्ता), Aperture (सुराख़).
Antonyms: Barrier (अवरोध), Blockage (रुकावट), Closure (समाप्ति).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Clear
questionsEn.s:
Clear - स्पष्ट (Easy to understand, bright, or transparent)
Doubt - संदेह (A feeling of uncertainty or lack of confidence)
Open - खुला (Not closed or allowing access)
Dim - धुंधला (Not bright or clear; lacking sharpness)
Known - ज्ञात (Recognized or familiar to people)
oa:
This word refers to a feeling of uncertainty or a lack of confidence. while being unclear causes doubt, the word itself is an emotion rather than a physical or visual quality.
Synonyms: Uncertainty (संदेह), Suspicion (शंका), Hesitation (दुविधा).
Antonyms: Certainty (निश्चितता), Trust (विश्वास), Confidence (भरोसा).

This word means not closed or allowing access to everyone. while clear objects are often open to view, the word describes accessibility rather than the quality of light or transparency.
Synonyms: Accessible (खुला), Uncovered (अनावृत), Frank (स्पष्टवादी).
Antonyms: Closed (बंद), Restricted (सीमित), Secret (गुप्त).

This word describes something that is not bright, sharp, or clear to the eyes. it is the direct visual and conceptual antonym for being clear.
Synonyms: Faint (धुंधला), Obscure (अस्पष्ट), Dull (फीका).
Antonyms: Clear (साफ), Bright (उज्ज्वल), Sharp (तेज़).

This word means recognized or familiar. while a clear thing is often known, the word refers to the status of knowledge rather than the clarity of the object itself.
Synonyms: Familiar (ज्ञात), Established (प्रसिद्ध), Recognized (मान्य).
Antonyms: Unknown (अज्ञात), Secret (गुप्त), Mysterious (रहस्यमय).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: To highlight
questionsEn.s:
To highlight - मुख्य आकर्षण (An outstanding part of an event)
To recognise - पहचानना (To identify from previous encounters)
To describe - वर्णन करना (To give a detailed account in words)
To downplay - महत्व घटाना (To make something appear less important)
To consider - विचार करना (To think carefully before a decision)
oa:
This word means to identify someone from previous encounters or to acknowledge their importance. While identifying someone highlights them, it is not an opposite.
Synonyms: Identify (पहचानना), Acknowledge (मानना), Know (जानना).
Antonyms: Ignore (अनदेखा करना), Forget (भूलना), Overlook (नज़रअंदाज़ करना).

This word means to give a detailed account in words. while highlighting points out a specific part, describing explains it, which is not an opposing action.
Synonyms: Explain (विवरण देना), Narrate (वर्णन करना), Relate (बताना).
Antonyms: Confuse (भ्रमित करना), Obscure (धुंधला करना), Distort (बिगाड़ना).

This word means to make something appear less important or significant than it actually is. It is the direct conceptual antonym for highlighting.
Synonyms: Understate (कम करके बताना), Minimize (महत्व घटाना), Soft-pedal (धीमा करना).
Antonyms: Highlight (मुख्य आकर्षण बनाना), Emphasize (ज़ोर देना), Accentuate (उजागर करना).

This word means to think carefully about something, usually before making a decision. it describes a process of thought rather than the act of making something stand out.
Synonyms: Ponder (विचार करना), Contemplate (मनन करना), Weigh (तोलना).
Antonyms: Disregard (उपेक्षा करना), Ignore (नज़रअंदाज़ करना), Reject (अस्वीकार करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Disaster
questionsEn.s:
Disaster - आपदा (An event with unfortunate consequences)
Safety - सुरक्षा (The condition of being protected from danger)
Downfall - पतन (A loss of power, prosperity, or status)
Success - सफलता (The accomplishment of an aim or purpose)
Collapse - गिरावट (To fall down or give way suddenly)
oa:
This word refers to the condition of being protected from or unlikely to cause danger or risk. it is a state of prevention rather than the outcome of an event that opposes a disaster.
Synonyms: Protection (सुरक्षा), Security (बचाव), Refuge (आश्रय).
Antonyms: Danger (खतरा), Peril (जोखिम), Threat (धमकी).

This word refers to a sudden loss of power, status, or prosperity. it is a synonym for the consequences of a disaster rather than its antonym.
Synonyms: Ruin (पतन), Collapse (गिरावट), Failure (विफलता).
Antonyms: Rise (उत्थान), Success (सफलता), Triumph (विजय).

This word refers to the accomplishment of an aim or purpose and a positive outcome. It is the direct conceptual antonym for a disaster (which implies total failure).
Synonyms: Achievement (सफलता), Triumph (विजय), Victory (जीत).
Antonyms: Disaster (आपदा), Failure (विफलता), Defeat (हार).

This word means to fall down or give way suddenly. it is a physical or metaphorical event that constitutes a disaster, not its opposite.
Synonyms: Breakdown (गिरावट), Crash (दुर्घटना), Ruin (बर्बादी).
Antonyms: Construction (निर्माण), Rise (उत्थान), Stability (स्थिरता).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: To add
questionsEn.s:
To add - जोड़ना (To join to increase size or number)
To remove - हटाना (To take something off)
To continue - जारी रखना (To persist in an activity or process)
To multiply - गुणा करना (To increase greatly in number)
To increase - बढ़ाना (To become or make greater in size)
oa:
This word means to take something away or off from its position. it is the direct functional and logical antonym for adding or joining something.
Synonyms: Delete (हटाना), Withdraw (निकालना), Eliminate (मिटाना).
Antonyms: Add (जोड़ना), Insert (डालना), Include (शामिल करना).

This word means to persist in an activity or process without stopping. It describes the maintenance of a state rather than the addition of new components.
Synonyms: Persist (जारी रखना), Endure (सहन करना), Sustain (बनाए रखना).
Antonyms: Stop (रोकना), Halt (थमाना), Cease (खत्म करना).

This word means to increase or cause to increase greatly in number. it is a mathematical synonym for adding repeatedly and therefore not an antonym.
Synonyms: Proliferate (बढ़ना), Increase (गुणा करना), Expand (फैलाना).
Antonyms: Divide (भाग देना), Decrease (कम करना), Reduce (घटाना).

This word means to become or make greater in size or amount. it is a general synonym for the result of adding something and cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Augment (बढ़ाना), Grow (बढ़ना), Heighten (ऊँचा करना).
Antonyms: Decrease (घटाना), Diminish (छोटा करना), Lessen (कम करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: To absorb
questionsEn.s:
To absorb - सोख लेना (To take in and understand or soak up)
To eject - छोड़ना (To force or throw something out)
To oppose - विरोध करना (To disagree and attempt to prevent)
To solve - हल करना (To find an answer to a problem)
To drink - पीना (To take liquid into the mouth and swallow)
oa:
This word means to force or throw something out in a violent or sudden way. it is the direct physical antonym for absorbing or soaking something in.
Synonyms: Expel (बाहर निकालना), Emit (छोड़ना), Discharge (निकालना).
Antonyms: Absorb (सोखना), Inhale (अंदर खींचना), Admit (प्रवेश देना).

This word means to disagree with and attempt to prevent something by argument. it refers to logic and conflict rather than the physical act of taking in or releasing.
Synonyms: Resist (विरोध करना), Counter (मुक़ाबला करना), Confront (सामना करना).
Antonyms: Support (समर्थन करना), Agree (सहमत होना), Aid (सहायता करना).

This word means to find an answer to or means of dealing with a problem. it refers to an intellectual resolution and has no connection with physical absorption.
Synonyms: Resolve (हल करना), Decipher (सुलझाना), Answer (उत्तर देना).
Antonyms: Perplex (उलझाना), Complicate (जटिल बनाना), Confuse (भ्रमित करना).

This word means to take a liquid into the mouth and swallow. it is a specific biological way of absorbing liquid and therefore acts as a synonym.
Synonyms: Gulp (पीना), Imbibe (अन्तर्ग्रहण करना), Quaff (गटकना).
Antonyms: Vomit (उल्टी करना), Eject (उगलना), Expel (बाहर निकालना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Classic
questionsEn.s:
Classic - उत्कृष्ट/मानक (Highest quality and outstanding of its kind)
Usual - सामान्य (Habitually or typically occurring)
Atypical - असामान्य (Not representative of a type or group)
Expensive - महंगा (Costing a lot of money)
Traditional - पारंपरिक (Existing as part of a tradition)
oa:
This word describes something habitually or typically occurring. While classics are often well-known, the word describes commonality rather than the exceptional standard of a classic.
Synonyms: Common (सामान्य), Habitual (आदतन), Typical (प्रतिनिधिक).
Antonyms: Unusual (असामान्य), Unique (अद्वितीय), Rare (दुर्लभ).

This word describes something that is not representative of a type, group, or expected standard. It is the direct antonym for something that is a "classic" example of its kind.
Synonyms: Unusual (असामान्य), Abnormal (असामान्य), Irregular (अनियमित).
Antonyms: Typical (विशिष्ट), Classic (मानक), Standard (सामान्य).

This word describes something costing a lot of money. While some classic cars or books are expensive, the word describes price rather than the quality or status of being a classic.
Synonyms: Costly (महंगा), Dear (कीमती), Priceless (बहुमूल्य).
Antonyms: Cheap (सस्ता), Inexpensive (सस्ता), Worthless (बेकार).

This word describes something existing as part of a long-established tradition. it is a synonym for the enduring and historical nature of being classic and is not an antonym.
Synonyms: Conventional (पारंपरिक), Old-fashioned (पुराना), Established (स्थापित).
Antonyms: Modern (आधुनिक), Innovative (नया), Contemporary (समकालीन).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Hope
questionsEn.s:
Hope - आशा (To want something to happen or be true)
Promise - वचन (To say definitely that something will happen)
Faith - आस्था (Strong belief in someone or something)
Trust - विश्वास (Belief that someone is good and honest)
Despair - निराशा (To lose all hope that something will happen)
oa:
This word refers to a statement that one will definitely do or not do something. While hope and promises are positive, a promise is a social commitment, not an opposite of hope.
Synonyms: Vow (वचन), Guarantee (गारंटी), Pledge (प्रतिज्ञा).
Antonyms: Breach (उल्लंघन), Denial (इनकार), Betrayal (विश्वासघात).

This word refers to a strong belief in someone or something without proof. it is a direct synonym for the confidence found in hope and therefore cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Trust (विश्वास), Belief (आस्था), Conviction (दृढ़ विश्वास).
Antonyms: Doubt (संदेह), Skepticism (शंका), Disbelief (अविश्वास).

This word refers to the belief that someone is good, honest, or sincere. Like "faith," it is a positive sentiment of reliance and acts as a synonym for hope.
Synonyms: Reliance (भरोसा), Confidence (विश्वास), Credence (प्रमाण).
Antonyms: Distrust (अविश्वास), Suspicion (संदेह), Wariness (सावधानी).

This word refers to the state of having lost all hope or having no expectation of improvement. it is the direct and perfect emotional antonym for hope.
Synonyms: Hopelessness (निराशा), Misery (कष्ट), Desperation (निराशा).
Antonyms: Hope (आशा), Optimism (आशावाद), Joy (खुशी).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: Barren
questionsEn.s:
Barren - बंजर (Too poor to produce much or any vegetation)
Fertile - उपजाऊ (Capable of producing abundant vegetation)
Empty - खाली (Containing nothing; not filled)
Vacant - रिक्त (Not occupied; empty)
Clear - स्पष्ट (Easy to perceive, understand, or interpret)


Hence, 'Fertile ' is the most suitable antonym for 'Barren'.
oa:
This word describes land or soil that is producing or capable of producing abundant vegetation or crops. It is the direct and perfect antonym for barren.
Synonyms: Productive (उपजाऊ), Fecund (उर्वर), Lush (हरा-भरा).
Antonyms: Barren (बंजर), Sterile (बांझ), Infertile (अनुर्वर).

This word describes a container or place containing nothing. While barren land is often empty, the word describes a lack of content rather than a lack of productive capability.
Synonyms: Vacant (खाली), Void (रिक्त), Hollow (खोखला).
Antonyms: Full (भरा हुआ), Occupied (व्यस्त), Packed (ठसाठस).

This word describes a house, room, or seat that is not being used. It refers to availability or occupation rather than the biological fertility of the soil.
Synonyms: Empty (खाली), Unfilled (अकब्जित), Available (उपलब्ध).
Antonyms: Occupied (भरा हुआ), Filled (पूर्ण), Used (इस्तेमाल किया).

This word describes being easy to perceive or understand. it refers to clarity and transparency rather than the ability of land to sustain life.
Synonyms: Obvious (साफ), Transparent (पारदर्शी), Lucid (स्पष्ट).
Antonyms: Opaque (अस्पष्ट), Obscure (धुंधला), Vague (अनिश्चित).

test.instructions: Standard CBT Pattern Exam. Positive Marks: +1, Negative Marks: -0.25. Total Questions: 50.

test.title: Set - 24

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: DIFFERENCE
questionsEn.s:
DIFFERENCE - अंतर (State of being unlike)
Similarity - समानता (State of being alike)
Contrast - विषमता (Striking difference)
Distinction - विभेद (Difference between similar things)
Acceptance - स्वीकृति (Action of consenting to receive)
Hence, 'Similarity' is the most suitable antonym for 'DIFFERENCE'.
oa:
This word refers to the state or fact of being alike or having a resemblance. It is the direct opposite of difference, which implies a state of being unlike or having a distinct variation.
Synonyms: Likeness (समानता), Resemblance (सादृश्य), Affinity (समानता).
Antonyms: Difference (अंतर), Disparity (असमानता), Contrast (विषमता).

This word refers to the state of being strikingly different from something else in juxtaposition or association. It acts as a synonym for difference rather than an antonym.
Synonyms: Dissimilarity (असमानता), Distinction (विभेद), Divergence (विचलन).
Antonyms: Harmony (सामंजस्य), Uniformity (एकरूपता), Similarity (समानता).

This word refers to a difference or contrast between similar things or people. It emphasizes the specific detail that makes things different and therefore is not the required opposite.
Synonyms: Differentiation (भेदभाव), Discrimination (अंतर), Particularity (विशिष्टता).
Antonyms: Identicalness (समानता), Equivalence (तुल्यता), Analogy (सादृश्य).

This word means the action of consenting to receive or undertake something offered. Its meaning is related to approval or agreement rather than the quality of being alike or different.
Synonyms: Consent (सहमति), Approval (मंजूरी), Admission (स्वीकृति).
Antonyms: Rejection (अस्वीकृति), Refusal (इनकार), Denial (अस्वीकार).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: IGNORANT
questionsEn.s:
IGNORANT - अज्ञानी (Lacking knowledge or awareness)
Learned - ज्ञानी (Having acquired much knowledge)
Simple - सरल (Easy to understand or do)
Crude - अपरिष्कृत (In a raw or unrefined state)
Innocent - निर्दोष (Not guilty of a crime or wrong)
Hence, 'Learned' is the most suitable antonym for 'IGNORANT'.
oa:
This word describes a person who has acquired much knowledge through study and experience. It is the direct opposite of ignorant, which refers to lacking knowledge or awareness.
Synonyms: Educated (शिक्षित), Erudite (विद्वान), Knowledgeable (ज्ञानी).
Antonyms: Ignorant (अज्ञानी), Illiterate (अनपढ़), Uneducated (अशिक्षित).

This word means easy to understand, do, or use. While an ignorant person might be described as simple, the word refers to complexity or lack of decoration rather than knowledge levels.
Synonyms: Uncomplicated (सरल), Straightforward (सीधा), Plain (सादा).
Antonyms: Complex (जटिल), Intricate (पेचीदा), Sophisticated (दुनियादार).

This word refers to being in a natural or raw state, or lacking refinement. It describes a lack of processing or manners rather than a lack of academic or factual knowledge.
Synonyms: Raw (अपरिष्कृत), Unrefined (अशुद्ध), Coarse (खुरदरा).
Antonyms: Refined (परिष्कृत), Polished (चमकदार/शिष्ट), Processed (संसाधित).

This word means not guilty of a crime or being free from moral wrong. It relates to guilt and moral purity rather than the possession of extensive knowledge or information.
Synonyms: Guileless (निर्दोष), Blameless (बेगुनाह), Pure (पवित्र).
Antonyms: Guilty (दोषी), Wicked (दुष्ट), Sinful (पापी).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: PARTNER
questionsEn.s:
PARTNER - साथी (A person who takes part in an activity with others)
Associate - सहयोगी (A person united in business or project)
Opponent - प्रतिद्वंद्वी (Someone who is against another in a contest)
Participant - सहभागी (A person who takes part in an event)
Friend - मित्र (A person known and liked)
Hence, 'Opponent' is the most suitable antonym for 'PARTNER'.
oa:
This word refers to a person with whom one is united in a business, project, or common interest. It is a synonym for partner and does not provide an opposite meaning.
Synonyms: Colleague (सहकर्मी), Companion (साथी), Ally (सहयोगी).
Antonyms: Opponent (प्रतिद्वंद्वी), Enemy (दुश्मन), Rival (प्रतिस्पर्धी).

This word refers to someone who competes against or fights another in a contest, game, or argument. It is the direct opposite of a partner who works with you.
Synonyms: Adversary (विरोधी), Rival (प्रतिद्वंद्वी), Competitor (प्रतिस्पर्धी).
Antonyms: Partner (साथी), Ally (सहयोगी), Supporter (समर्थक).

This word refers to a person who takes part in an event or activity. While a partner is a participant, this word is neutral and describes involvement rather than competition.
Synonyms: Contributor (सहभागी), Member (सदस्य), Player (खिलाड़ी).
Antonyms: Observer (दर्शक), Spectator (दर्शक), Non-participant (गैर-सहभागी).

This word refers to a person with whom one has a bond of mutual affection. While partners are often friends, the word describes a personal bond rather than the structural opposite of a rival.
Synonyms: Companion (मित्र), Buddy (दोस्त), Comrade (साथी).
Antonyms: Enemy (शत्रु), Foe (दुश्मन), Stranger (अजनबी).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: FARSIGHTED
questionsEn.s:
FARSIGHTED - दूरदर्शी (Having foresight or good judgment)
Cautious - सतर्क (Careful to avoid potential problems)
Proactive - सक्रिय (Controlling a situation before it happens)
Unwise - अविवेकपूर्ण (Lacking good judgment or sense)
Careful - सावधान (Showing thought and attention)
Hence, 'Unwise' is the most suitable antonym for 'FARSIGHTED'.
oa:
This word describes someone who is careful to avoid potential problems or dangers. This is a characteristic often found in farsighted people and therefore is not an opposite.
Synonyms: Careful (सावधान), Wary (सतर्क), Prudent (विवेकपूर्ण).
Antonyms: Rash (अविवेकपूर्ण), Reckless (लापरवाह), Heedless (असावधान).

This word refers to creating or controlling a situation rather than just responding to it. This is a positive trait aligned with foresight rather than being its antonym.
Synonyms: Preemptive (अग्रगामी), Driven (प्रेरित), Enterprising (उद्यमी).
Antonyms: Reactive (प्रतिक्रियाशील), Passive (निष्क्रिय), Idle (बेकार).

This word describes a lack of good judgment or sense. It serves as an appropriate antonym for farsighted, which implies having excellent judgment and foresight.
Synonyms: Foolish (मूर्ख), Injudicious (अविवेकपूर्ण), Silly (नासमझ).
Antonyms: Wise (बुद्धिमान), Farsighted (दूरदर्शी), Sagacious (चतुर).

This word means showing thought and attention to avoid mistakes or harm. Like cautious, it is a quality that supports foresight rather than contradicting it.
Synonyms: Attentive (सजग), Meticulous (सूक्ष्म), Vigilant (चौकस).
Antonyms: Careless (लापरवाह), Negligent (असावधान), Inattentive (बेपरवाह).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: JUICY
questionsEn.s:
JUICY - रसीला (Containing a lot of juice)
Oily - तेलयुक्त (Covered in or containing oil)
Dewy - ओसयुक्त (Wet with dew)
Watery - पनीला (Containing mostly water)
Dry - सूखा (Free from moisture or liquid)
Hence, 'Dry ' is the most suitable antonym for 'JUICY'.
oa:
This word refers to something covered in or containing a lot of oil. It describes a different type of moisture and texture rather than the absence of juice or succulence.
Synonyms: Greasy (चिकना), Fatty (वसायुक्त), Slick (फिसलन भरा).
Antonyms: Dry (सूखा), Non-greasy (बिना तेल का), Matte (फीका).

This word means wet with dew or appearing soft and lustrous. It implies a certain type of moisture, making it more of a near-synonym to juicy rather than an opposite.
Synonyms: Moist (नम), Damp (गीला), Humid (आर्द्र).
Antonyms: Parched (झुलसा हुआ), Arid (शुष्क), Dry (सूखा).

This word means containing mostly water or being too thin in consistency. It describes a dilute state of liquid and does not represent the absence of moisture required for an antonym.
Synonyms: Dilute (पतला), Liquid (जलीय), Thin (हल्का).
Antonyms: Thick (गाढ़ा), Solid (ठोस), Concentrated (सांद्रित).

This word refers to being free from moisture or liquid. It is the direct physical antonym for juicy, which implies being full of liquid and succulence.
Synonyms: Parched (सूखा), Arid (शुष्क), Dehydrated (निर्जलित).
Antonyms: Juicy (रसीला), Moist (नम), Succulent (रसदार).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: STIFF
questionsEn.s:
STIFF - सख्त (Rigid, firm, or difficult to bend)
Strong - मजबूत (Physically powerful)
Tender - कोमल (Weak, delicate, or easy to chew)
Rigid - कठोर (Unable to bend or be forced out of shape)
Tight - कसकर (Fixed firmly in position)
Hence, 'Tender' is the most suitable antonym for 'STIFF'.
oa:
This word means physically powerful or able to lift heavy things. While a stiff object might be strong, the word refers to power rather than the inability to bend or flex.
Synonyms: Powerful (शक्तिशाली), Robust (मजबूत), Mighty (बलवान).
Antonyms: Weak (कमज़ोर), Feeble (अशक्त), Frail (दुर्बल).

This word means easy to cut or chew, or showing gentleness and kindness. In physical and emotional contexts, it serves as the best opposite to the rigidity implied by stiff.
Synonyms: Soft (कोमल), Delicate (नाज़ुक), Gentle (नरम).
Antonyms: Stiff (सख्त), Hard (कठोर), Tough (मजबूत).

This word means unable to bend or be forced out of shape. It is a direct synonym for stiff and therefore cannot be used as its antonym in this context.
Synonyms: Stiff (सख्त), Inflexible (अटल), Firm (दृढ़).
Antonyms: Flexible (लचीला), Pliable (नम्य), Supple (कोमल).

This word means fixed firmly in position or difficult to move. While related to physical tension, it does not specifically address the flexibility or softness required to oppose stiff.
Synonyms: Firm (कसकर), Secure (सुरक्षित), Taut (तना हुआ).
Antonyms: Loose (ढीला), Slack (ढीला-ढाला), Free (मुक्त).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: PERMANENT
questionsEn.s:
PERMANENT - स्थायी (Lasting for a long time or forever)
Temporary - अस्थायी (Lasting for a very short time)
Stable - स्थिर (Steady, firm, unlikely to change)
Lasting - टिकाऊ (Continuing for a long time)
Constant - निरंतर (Happening all the time)
Hence, 'Temporary ' is the most suitable antonym for 'PERMANENT'.
oa:
This word refers to something lasting for only a limited period of time. It is the direct and logical antonym for permanent, which means lasting forever or indefinitely.
Synonyms: Transient (क्षणिक), Evanescent (अस्थायी), Fleeting (क्षणभंगुर).
Antonyms: Permanent (स्थायी), Lasting (टिकाऊ), Eternal (शाश्वत).

This word means not likely to change or fail; firmly established. This is a characteristic of being permanent and therefore acts as a synonym rather than an opposite.
Synonyms: Steady (स्थिर), Firm (दृढ़), Fixed (नियत).
Antonyms: Unstable (अस्थिर), Shaky (डाँवाँडोल), Variable (परिवर्तनीय).

This word means continuing for a long time. it describes durability and endurance, making it a synonym for permanent rather than its antonym.
Synonyms: Enduring (चिरस्थायी), Perpetual (निरंतर), Abiding (अविनाशी).
Antonyms: Short-lived (अल्पकालिक), Ephemeral (क्षणिक), Temporary (अस्थायी).

This word means occurring continuously over a period of time. Like stable and lasting, it implies a lack of change, which aligns with the meaning of permanent.
Synonyms: Continuous (सतत), Consistent (संगत), Unchanging (अपरिवर्तनीय).
Antonyms: Inconstant (परिवर्तनशील), Fickle (अस्थिर), Irregular (अनियमित).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: DELIBERATE
questionsEn.s:
DELIBERATE - जानबूझकर (Done slowly without hurry or on purpose)
Thoughtful - विचारशील (Thinking deeply or showing consideration)
Illiterate - निरक्षर (Not able to read and write)
Spontaneous - अनायास (Done or happening suddenly)
Careful - सावधान (Giving a lot of attention to details)
Hence, 'Spontaneous ' is the most suitable antonym for 'DELIBERATE'.
oa:
This word describes someone showing consideration for others or being absorbed in thought. This involves the same mental intent as being deliberate and is not an opposite.
Synonyms: Pensive (विचारमग्न), Considerate (विचारशील), Reflective (चिंतनशील).
Antonyms: Thoughtless (विचारहीन), Heedless (असावधान), Cruel (निर्दयी).

This word refers to a person who is unable to read or write. It describes educational status and has no relation to whether an action was performed intentionally or suddenly.
Synonyms: Uneducated (अशिक्षित), Untaught (बेपढ़ा), Ignorant (अज्ञानी).
Antonyms: Literate (साक्षर), Educated (शिक्षित), Erudite (विद्वान).

This word refers to something done or happening suddenly and without premeditation. It is the direct opposite of deliberate, which involves careful thought and slow action.
Synonyms: Impulsive (अनायास), Unplanned (अनायोजित), Instinctive (स्वाभाविक).
Antonyms: Deliberate (जानबूझकर), Planned (योजनाबद्ध), Intentional (सविचार).

This word means giving a lot of attention to what you are doing to avoid mistakes. it is a synonym for the manner in which deliberate actions are performed and not an opposite.
Synonyms: Cautious (सावधान), Meticulous (सूक्ष्म), Vigilant (चौकस).
Antonyms: Careless (लापरवाह), Reckless (असावधान), Negligent (बेपरवाह).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: SLY
questionsEn.s:
SLY - धूर्त (Acting in a secret or dishonest way to trick people)
Stiff - सख्त (Firm and difficult to bend)
Thick - मोटा (Having a large distance between sides)
Slow - धीमा (Moving without much speed)
Honest - ईमानदार (Telling the truth and not lying)
Hence, 'Honest ' is the most suitable antonym for 'SLY'.
oa:
This word refers to being firm and difficult to bend or move. It describes a physical property or a formal manner rather than the deceptive or honest nature of a person.
Synonyms: Rigid (सख्त), Firm (दृढ़), Inflexible (अटल).
Antonyms: Flexible (लचीला), Pliable (नम्य), Supple (कोमल).

This word describes something solid having a large distance between opposite sides. It refers to physical dimensions and does not provide an opposite for being cunning or deceptive.
Synonyms: Dense (घना), Solid (ठोस), Hefty (भारी).
Antonyms: Thin (पतला), Slender (बारीक), Slim (दुबला).

This word means moving or doing something without much speed. While a sly person might be fast, "slow" describes pace rather than the moral quality of honesty.
Synonyms: Sluggish (मंद), Leisurely (धीमा), Plodding (सुस्त).
Antonyms: Fast (तेज़), Rapid (द्रुत), Quick (शीघ्र).

This word describes a person who tells the truth and does not lie, steal, or cheat. It is the direct moral opposite of being sly, which involves being sneaky and deceptive.
Synonyms: Truthful (ईमानदार), Sincere (निष्कपट), Upright (सच्चा).
Antonyms: Sly (धूर्त), Deceitful (कपटी), Dishonest (बेईमान).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: NARROW
questionsEn.s:
NARROW - संकीर्ण (Having only a short distance from side to side)
Tight - कसकर (Fixed firmly or having little space)
Wide - चौड़ा (Measuring a lot from one side to the other)
Firm - दृढ़ (Able to stay the same shape or determined)
Solid - ठोस (Hard, firm, or not liquid)
Hence, 'wide ' is the most suitable antonym for 'NARROW'.
oa:
This word means fixed firmly in position or having very little space. it is a synonym for narrow in many contexts and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an antonym.
Synonyms: Constricted (तंग), Firm (कसकर), Taut (तना हुआ).
Antonyms: Loose (ढीला), Slack (ढीला-ढाला), Wide (चौड़ा).

This word refers to measuring a large distance from one side to the other. It is the direct physical antonym for narrow, which implies a short distance between sides.
Synonyms: Broad (चौड़ा), Expansive (विस्तृत), Vast (विशाल).
Antonyms: Narrow (संकीर्ण), Constricted (तंग), Slender (बारीक).

This word means able to stay the same shape when pressed or being determined. It describes stability and strength rather than the width of an opening or path.
Synonyms: Solid (सुदृढ़), Fixed (नियत), Resolute (दृढ़).
Antonyms: Weak (कमज़ोर), Shaky (डाँवाँडोल), Soft (कोमल).

This word describes something hard and firm or not in the form of liquid. it refers to the state of matter or structural integrity rather than spatial width.
Synonyms: Hard (ठोस), Substantial (मजबूत), Concrete (वास्तविक).
Antonyms: Liquid (द्रव), Hollow (खोखला), Fragile (नाजुक).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: ZEALOUS
questionsEn.s:
ZEALOUS - जोशीला (Showing strong desire to get something done)
Eager - उत्सुक (Strongly wanting to have something)
Indifferent - उदासीन (Not interested in or caring about someone)
Anxious - चिंतित (Worried and afraid)
Annoyed - नाराज़ (Feeling slightly angry or irritated)
Hence, 'Indifferent ' is the most suitable antonym for 'ZEALOUS'.
oa:
This word means strongly wanting to do or have something. It is a synonym for zealous as both involve a high level of interest and enthusiasm.
Synonyms: Keen (उत्सुक), Enthusiastic (उत्साही), Avid (लालसापूर्ण).
Antonyms: Apathetic (उदासीन), Indifferent (बेपरवाह), Uninterested (रुचिहीन).

This word describes having no particular interest or sympathy; being unconcerned. It is the perfect antonym for zealous, which implies being highly passionate and interested.
Synonyms: Apathetic (उदासीन), Unconcerned (बेपरवाह), Detached (तटस्थ).
Antonyms: Zealous (जोशीला), Passionate (भावुक), Eager (उत्सुक).

This word means feeling worried, nervous, or afraid about something. It describes a state of unease rather than the absence of passion or enthusiasm.
Synonyms: Worried (चिंतित), Uneasy (बेचैन), Apprehensive (शंकित).
Antonyms: Calm (शांत), Confident (आत्मविश्वासी), Secure (निश्चिंत).

This word describes feeling slightly angry or irritated. It is a specific negative emotional reaction and does not represent the general lack of interest required to oppose "zealous."
Synonyms: Irritated (नाराज़), Vexed (परेशान), Peeved (क्रुद्ध).
Antonyms: Pleased (प्रसन्न), Content (संतुष्ट), Gratified (कृतज्ञ).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: SLEEK
questionsEn.s:
SLEEK - चिकना/चमकदार (Smooth and shiny in appearance)
Dull - मंद/धुंधला (Lacking brightness or shine)
Easy - आसान (Posing no difficulty or effort)
Smooth - समतल (Having an even and regular surface)
Flat - सपाट (Having a level surface with no raised areas)
Hence, 'Dull ' is the most suitable antonym for 'SLEEK'.
oa:
This word refers to something that lacks brightness, shine, or liveliness. It is the direct opposite of sleek, which describes surfaces or appearances that are smooth and shiny.
Synonyms: Drab (फीका), Lackluster (बेचमक), Dim (धुंधला).
Antonyms: Sleek (चमकदार), Bright (उज्ज्वल), Radiant (देदीप्यमान).

This word means posing no difficulty or requiring little effort. it describes the simplicity of a task rather than the visual quality of a texture or surface.
Synonyms: Simple (सरल), Effortless (सहज), Manageable (सुगम).
Antonyms: Difficult (कठिन), Arduous (श्रमसाध्य), Hard (मुश्किल).

This word refers to an even and regular surface without lumps. it is a synonym for sleek and therefore cannot be used as its antonym in this context.
Synonyms: Level (समतल), Flat (चिकना), Polished (सँवारा हुआ).
Antonyms: Rough (खुरदरा), Coarse (रूखा), Rugged (कठोर).

This word describes a horizontal position or a surface with no raised areas. While a sleek surface is often flat, the word does not address the "shiny" aspect that "dull" opposes.
Synonyms: Level (समतल), Plain (सादा), Horizontal (क्षैतिज).
Antonyms: Vertical (लंबवत), Steep (खड़ी ढलान), Uneven (असमतल).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: COMPLEX
questionsEn.s:
COMPLEX - जटिल (Made up of several connected parts; difficult)
Knotty - पेचीदा (Full of knots or extremely difficult)
Motley - पंचमेल (Consisting of disconnected parts or colors)
Simple - सरल (Easy to understand; not complicated)
Mixed - मिश्रित (Consisting of different qualities or elements)
Hence, 'simple ' is the most suitable antonym for 'COMPLEX'.
oa:
This word means full of knots or extremely difficult and intricate. It is a synonym for complex and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an opposite.
Synonyms: Intricate (पेचीदा), Tangled (उलझा हुआ), Involved (जटिल).
Antonyms: Simple (सरल), Straightforward (सीधा), Easy (आसान).

This word refers to something consisting of many different and disconnected parts or colors. While it implies variety, it does not directly oppose the idea of being complex or difficult.
Synonyms: Varied (विविध), Diverse (विभिन्न), Assorted (मिश्रित).
Antonyms: Uniform (समान), Homogeneous (सजातीय), Identical (एक जैसा).

This word refers to something that is easy to understand, do, or use, and is not complicated. It is the direct and perfect antonym for the word complex.
Synonyms: Easy (सरल), Uncomplicated (सुबोध), Straightforward (सीधा).
Antonyms: Complex (जटिल), Intricate (पेचीदा), Elaborate (विस्तृत).

This word describes being both good and bad or consisting of different elements. It refers to a combination rather than the level of difficulty or structural intricacy.
Synonyms: Blended (मिश्रित), Hybrid (मिश्रण), Composite (संयुक्त).
Antonyms: Pure (शुद्ध), Separate (अलग), Unmixed (अमिश्रित).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: VALIANT
questionsEn.s:
VALIANT - साहसी (Full of courage and not afraid)
Worthy - योग्य (Good enough or deserving respect)
Cowardly - कायर (Lacking courage or being afraid)
Gallant - वीर (Brave, heroic, or chivalrous)
Barren - बंजर (Not good enough for plants to grow)
Hence, 'Cowardly ' is the most suitable antonym for 'VALIANT'.
oa:
This word means good enough for something or deserving respect. While a valiant person is worthy, the word itself does not denote courage and therefore cannot be a direct opposite.
Synonyms: Deserving (योग्य), Laudable (प्रशंसनीय), Meritorious (गुणी).
Antonyms: Unworthy (अयोग्य), Base (नीच), Despicable (घृणित).

This word describes a total lack of courage or being easily frightened. It is the direct and most accurate antonym for valiant, which means brave and bold.
Synonyms: Timid (डरपोक), Craven (कायर), Gutless (भीरु).
Antonyms: Valiant (साहसी), Brave (बहादुर), Gallant (वीर).

This word refers to a person being brave and heroic, especially in behavior toward others. It is a synonym for valiant and cannot be used as its opposite.
Synonyms: Brave (वीर), Chivalrous (शिष्ट), Courageous (साहसी).
Antonyms: Cowardly (कायर), Rude (अशिष्ट), Timid (डरपोक).

This word describes land that is too poor to produce crops or being unproductive. It has no conceptual connection to the moral or physical courage of a person.
Synonyms: Infertile (बांझ), Desolate (बंजर), Unproductive (निष्फल).
Antonyms: Fertile (उपजाऊ), Productive (उत्पादक), Fecund (उर्वर).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: EFFICIENT
questionsEn.s:
EFFICIENT - कुशल (Achieving maximum productivity with minimum waste)
Expert - विशेषज्ञ (Very knowledgeable or skillful person)
Common - सामान्य (Occurring often or ordinary)
Idle - बेकार/आलसी (Avoiding work or being lazy)
Clever - चतुर (Quick to understand or apply ideas)
Hence, 'idle ' is the most suitable antonym for 'EFFICIENT'.
oa:
This word refers to a person who is very knowledgeable or skillful in a particular area. An expert is usually efficient, so this word acts as a synonym rather than an antonym.
Synonyms: Professional (पेशेवर), Master (निपुण), Specialist (विशेषज्ञ).
Antonyms: Amateur (शौकिया), Novice (नौसिखिया), Inexpert (अदक्ष).

This word means occurring or found often or being ordinary. It describes frequency or status rather than the effectiveness or productivity of a system or person.
Synonyms: Ordinary (सामान्य), Usual (अमूमन), Commonplace (साधारण).
Antonyms: Rare (दुर्लभ), Unusual (असाधारण), Unique (अद्वितीय).

This word refers to a person avoiding work or being lazy, or a machine not in use. It represents the lack of activity and productivity, serving as the best opposite to being efficient.
Synonyms: Lazy (कामचोर), Inactive (निष्क्रिय), Slothful (सुस्त).
Antonyms: Efficient (कुशल), Active (सक्रिय), Industrious (परिश्रमी).

This word means being quick to understand or apply ideas. While a clever person might be efficient, the word describes intelligence rather than organized productivity.
Synonyms: Smart (चतुर), Intelligent (बुद्धिमान), Sharp (तेज़).
Antonyms: Stupid (मूर्ख), Dull (मंद), Inept (अयोग्य).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: STABLE
questionsEn.s:
STABLE - स्थिर (Sane, sensible, or firmly fixed)
Steady - नियमित (Firmly fixed or not shaking)
Shaky - अस्थिर (Not safe or liable to fail)
Stout - मोटा (Rather fat or of heavy build)
Safe - सुरक्षित (Protected from danger or risk)
Hence, 'shaky ' is the most suitable antonym for 'STABLE'.
oa:
This word means firmly fixed, supported, or balanced. It is a direct synonym for stable and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an antonym.
Synonyms: Constant (नियमित), Fixed (नियत), Firm (दृढ़).
Antonyms: Shaky (अस्थिर), Fickle (चंचल), Unsteady (डाँवाँडोल).

This word refers to something that is not safe, reliable, or likely to fail; it implies a lack of stability. It is the perfect antonym for being stable or firmly fixed.
Synonyms: Unsteady (अस्थिर), Precarious (डाँवाँडोल), Tottering (लड़खड़ाता हुआ).
Antonyms: Stable (स्थिर), Firm (मजबूत), Secure (सुरक्षित).

This word describes a person who is rather fat or heavily built. While it implies a certain physical sturdiness, it refers to body type rather than the state of balance or constancy.
Synonyms: Plump (मोटा), Hefty (तगड़ा), Robust (हृष्ट-पुष्ट).
Antonyms: Thin (पतला), Slender (दुबला), Frail (दुर्बल).

This word means protected from danger or risk. While a stable structure is often safe, the word describes security rather than the lack of movement or change.
Synonyms: Secure (सुरक्षित), Guarded (रक्षित), Protected (बचा हुआ).
Antonyms: Dangerous (खतरनाक), Risky (जोखिम भरा), Unsafe (असुरक्षित).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: BLAME
questionsEn.s:
BLAME - आरोप (Declaring someone responsible for a fault)
Rebuke - फटकार (Sharp disapproval of behavior)
Criticise - आलोचना (Indicating faults in a disapproving way)
Shout - चिल्लाहट (Uttering a loud cry)
Praise - प्रशंसा (Expressing warm approval or admiration)
Hence, 'Praise ' is the most suitable antonym for 'BLAME'.
oa:
This word means to express sharp disapproval or criticism of someone. It is a synonym for the action of blaming and therefore cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Scold (फटकारना), Reprimand (झिड़कना), Admonish (चेतावनी देना).
Antonyms: Praise (प्रशंसा करना), Compliment (तारीफ़ करना), Applaud (सराहना).

This word means to indicate the faults of someone or something in a disapproving way. it is similar in meaning to blame and does not serve as an antonym.
Synonyms: Censure (आलोचना), Condemn (निंदा), Denounce (दोषारोपण).
Antonyms: Appreciate (सराहना), Commend (प्रशंसा), Approve (मंजूरी).

This word refers to uttering a loud cry, typically to express strong emotion. While one might shout while blaming, the word refers to volume rather than the act of assigning responsibility.
Synonyms: Yell (चिल्लाहट), Scream (चीखना), Bellow (गरजना).
Antonyms: Whisper (फुसफुसाना), Murmur (बुदबुदाना), Mumble (मुंह में बोलना).

This word means to express warm approval or admiration of someone. it is the direct behavioral and verbal opposite of assigning blame.
Synonyms: Commend (प्रशंसा), Extol (सराहना), Laud (गुणगान).
Antonyms: Blame (दोष देना), Criticise (आलोचना), Condemn (निंदा).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: RIDICULOUS
questionsEn.s:
RIDICULOUS - मूर्खतापूर्ण (Stupid or unreasonable; laughable)
Incredible - अविश्वसनीय (Impossible or difficult to believe)
Unbelievable - अविश्वसनीय (Extremely surprising)
Noteworthy - उल्लेखनीय (Deserving attention because of importance)
Reasonable - समझदार (Based on good judgment; practical)
Hence, 'Reasonable ' is the most suitable antonym for 'RIDICULOUS'.
oa:
This word means impossible or very difficult to believe. While something ridiculous is often hard to believe, this word refers to the level of belief rather than the lack of common sense.
Synonyms: Unbelievable (अविश्वसनीय), Amazing (अद्भुत), Extraordinary (असाधारण).
Antonyms: Believable (विश्वसनीय), Plausible (संभव), Credible (प्रामाणिक).

This word is a synonym for incredible, meaning extremely surprising or hard to accept as true. It does not function as an opposite for something that is stupid or laughable.
Synonyms: Astonishing (अविश्वसनीय), Miraculous (चमत्कारी), Stunning (चौंकाने वाला).
Antonyms: Common (सामान्य), Expected (अपेक्षित), Likely (संभावित).

This word describes something deserving attention because of being important or interesting. While positive, it does not directly address the foolishness implied by "ridiculous."
Synonyms: Remarkable (गौरतलब), Significant (महत्वपूर्ण), Prominent (प्रमुख).
Antonyms: Unremarkable (साधारण), Trivial (तुच्छ), Minor (मामूली).

This word means based on or using good judgment and being fair or practical. It is the direct logical opposite of something that is ridiculous (stupid or unreasonable).
Synonyms: Sensible (समझदार), Logical (तार्किक), Rational (उचित).
Antonyms: Ridiculous (मूर्ख), Absurd (बेतुका), Irrational (अतार्किक).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: PROTECT
questionsEn.s:
PROTECT - रक्षा करना (To keep safe from injury or damage)
Harm - नुकसान पहुँचाना (Physical or other injury or damage)
Cover - ढकना (To put something over something else)
Keep - रखना (To have in your possession)
Secure - सुरक्षित (Fixed firmly and not likely to fall)
Hence, 'Harm' is the most suitable antonym for 'PROTECT'.
oa:
This word refers to causing physical or other injury or damage. It is the direct functional opposite of protecting, which involves keeping someone or something safe from harm.
Synonyms: Injure (नुकसान पहुँचाना), Damage (क्षति पहुँचाना), Hurt (चोट पहुँचाना).
Antonyms: Protect (रक्षा करना), Heal (स्वस्थ करना), Preserve (संरक्षित करना).

This word means to put or spread something over something else. while covering can be a way to protect, the word itself describes the physical act rather than the conceptual opposite.
Synonyms: Cloak (ढकना), Envelop (लपेटना), Overlay (परत चढ़ाना).
Antonyms: Uncover (उजागर), Reveal (प्रकट), Expose (खोलना).

This word means to have or continue to have in your possession. it refers to ownership or continuation and does not address the protection or endangerment of an object.
Synonyms: Retain (रखना), Maintain (बनाए रखना), Hold (थामना).
Antonyms: Lose (खोना), Discard (त्यागना), Release (छोड़ना).

This word means positioned or fixed firmly so as not to fall or move. it is a synonym for the result of protection and therefore cannot be its antonym.
Synonyms: Stable (सुरक्षित), Fasten (कसना), Guard (बचाना).
Antonyms: Vulnerable (असुरक्षित), Loose (ढीला), Risky (जोखिम भरा).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: CONTENTED
questionsEn.s:
CONTENTED - संतुष्ट (Happy and satisfied)
Thankful - आभारी (Feeling or showing gratitude)
Pleased - प्रसन्न (Happy or satisfied with something)
Comfortable - आरामदायक (Providing physical ease)
Dissatisfied - असंतुष्ट (Not pleased with something)
Hence, 'Dissatisfied ' is the most suitable antonym for 'CONTENTED'.
oa:
This word means feeling or showing gratitude for something. While a contented person is often thankful, the word describes gratitude rather than the general state of satisfaction.
Synonyms: Grateful (आभारी), Appreciative (कृतज्ञ), Obliged (ऋणी).
Antonyms: Ungrateful (अकृतज्ञ), Thankless (अहसान फरामोश), Heedless (असावधान).

This word describes feeling happy or satisfied with a specific event or situation. it is a synonym for contented and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an opposite.
Synonyms: Satisfied (प्रसन्न), Glad (खुश), Gratified (संतुष्ट).
Antonyms: Unhappy (नाखुश), Sad (उदास), Dissatisfied (असंतुष्ट).

This word describes providing physical ease and relaxation. While being comfortable can lead to contentment, the word refers to physical sensation rather than an emotional state.
Synonyms: Snug (आरामदायक), Cozy (सुखद), Pleasant (सुहाना).
Antonyms: Uncomfortable (असुविधाजनक), Harsh (कठोर), Stiff (सख्त).

This word refers to not being pleased with something or feeling that something is not good enough. it is the direct and perfect antonym for being contented.
Synonyms: Displeased (असंतुष्ट), Malcontent (नाराज़), Unhappy (नाखुश).
Antonyms: Contented (संतुष्ट), Satisfied (प्रसन्न), Pleased (खुश).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: FRIEND
questionsEn.s:
FRIEND - मित्र (A person liked and trusted)
Helper - सहायक (A person who assists with work)
Foe - शत्रु (An enemy or adversary)
Companion - साथी (Person with whom one spends time)
Partner - संगी (Person one is married to or works with)
Hence, 'Foe ' is the most suitable antonym for 'FRIEND'.
oa:
This word refers to a person who assists someone, especially with work. While a friend may be a helper, the word describes a role of assistance rather than the fundamental opposite of a friend.
Synonyms: Assistant (सहायक), Supporter (सहयोगी), Aide (मददगार).
Antonyms: Obstructor (बाधक), Hinderer (बाधा डालने वाला), Opponent (विरोधी).

This word refers to an enemy or an adversary. It is the direct and most accurate lexical opposite for the word friend.
Synonyms: Enemy (शत्रु), Adversary (विरोधी), Opponent (दुश्मन).
Antonyms: Friend (मित्र), Ally (सहयोगी), Companion (साथी).

This word refers to a person or animal with whom one spends a lot of time. It is a synonym for friend and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an opposite.
Synonyms: Partner (साथी), Associate (सखा), Comrade (सहचर).
Antonyms: Stranger (अजनबी), Foe (शत्रु), Enemy (दुश्मन).

This word refers to a person one is married to or works with in a business. while it implies a close association like a friend, it refers to a specific formal bond and is not an antonym.
Synonyms: Associate (संगी), Spouse (साथी), Teammate (जोड़ीदार).
Antonyms: Opponent (प्रतिद्वंद्वी), Rival (प्रतिस्पर्धी), Adversary (विरोधी).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: FAKE
questionsEn.s:
FAKE - नकली (Not genuine; imitation or counterfeit)
Bogus - बनावटी (Pretending to be real or genuine)
Artificial - कृत्रिम (Not natural; made by people)
False - असत्य (Not true or not correct)
Genuine - वास्तविक (Real and exactly what it appears to be)
Hence, 'Genuine ' is the most suitable antonym for 'FAKE'.
oa:
This word means pretending to be real or genuine. It is a direct synonym for fake and therefore cannot be used as its antonym in this context.
Synonyms: Counterfeit (जाली), Spurious (बनावटी), False (खोटा).
Antonyms: Genuine (असली), Authentic (वास्तविक), Real (सच्चा).

This word means not genuine or natural but made by people. Like bogus, it describes things that are not the original versions, acting as a synonym for fake.
Synonyms: Synthetic (कृत्रिम), Man-made (मानव-निर्मित), Mock (बनावटी).
Antonyms: Natural (प्राकृतिक), Real (वास्तविक), Genuine (असली).

This word means not true or not correct. It is a primary characteristic of being fake and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an opposite.
Synonyms: Untrue (असत्य), Incorrect (गलत), Inaccurate (अशुद्ध).
Antonyms: True (सत्य), Correct (सही), Right (सच्चा).

This word refers to something that is real and true; it is exactly what it appears to be. it is the direct and most accurate antonym for the word fake.
Synonyms: Authentic (वास्तविक), Real (असली), Original (मौलिक).
Antonyms: Fake (नकली), Bogus (जाली), Counterfeit (बनावटी).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: REMOTE
questionsEn.s:
REMOTE - दूरवर्ती (Far away from where others live)
Unlikely - असंभावित (Not expected to happen)
Secret - गोपनीय (Not to be known by others)
Unknown - अज्ञात (Something that is not known)
Close - समीप (Only a short distance away)
Hence, 'close ' is the most suitable antonym for 'REMOTE'.
oa:
This word means not expected to happen or not probable. While "remote" can sometimes mean a small chance, this word refers to probability rather than physical or situational distance.
Synonyms: Improbable (असंभावित), Doubtful (संदिग्ध), Uncertain (अनिश्चित).
Antonyms: Likely (संभावित), Probable (होने योग्य), Certain (निश्चित).

This word refers to something that is not or must not be known by others. It describes confidentiality rather than the distance of a location or relationship.
Synonyms: Hidden (गोपनीय), Confidential (गुप्त), Private (निजी).
Antonyms: Public (सार्वजनिक), Known (ज्ञात), Open (खुला).

This word means that someone does not know something or it is not familiar. it describes a lack of knowledge rather than a lack of distance.
Synonyms: Unidentified (अज्ञात), Strange (अपरिचित), Mysterious (रहस्यमय).
Antonyms: Known (मालूम), Famous (प्रसिद्ध), Familiar (जाना-पहचाना).

This word refers to being near in space, time, or relationship. It is the direct physical and situational antonym for remote, which implies being far away.
Synonyms: Near (समीप), Adjacent (निकट), Nearby (पास).
Antonyms: Remote (दूरवर्ती), Distant (दूर), Far (दूर).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: NEGLECT
questionsEn.s:
NEGLECT - उपेक्षा (To give too little or no attention)
Taste - स्वाद (Quality of flavors in food)
Care - देखभाल (Looking after someone's needs)
Wish - इच्छा (Wanting something that probably won't happen)
Mock - उपहास (To laugh at someone in an unkind way)
Hence, 'care ' is the most suitable antonym for 'NEGLECT'.
oa:
This word refers to the quality of flavors in food or a person's preference. It is a sensory capability and has no relation to the act of giving or withholding attention.
Synonyms: Flavor (ज़ायक़ा), Savor (स्वाद), Palate (रुचि).
Antonyms: Tastelessness (बेस्वाद), Blandness (नीरसता), Dislike (नापसंद).

This word refers to looking after someone or something to ensure their health and protection. It is the direct behavioral antonym for neglect, which means failing to provide attention.
Synonyms: Attention (देखभाल), Vigilance (सतर्कता), Protection (रक्षा).
Antonyms: Neglect (उपेक्षा), Disregard (अवहेलना), Abandonment (त्याग).

This word means to want something that is unlikely to happen. it describes a desire or hope rather than the actual provision of care or maintenance.
Synonyms: Desire (इच्छा), Hope (आशा), Aspiration (चाह).
Antonyms: Reality (वास्तविकता), Fact (सत्य), Dislike (अरुचि).

This word means to laugh at someone in an unkind way or make them look foolish. it is a specific negative social interaction and not the opposite of withholding attention or maintenance.
Synonyms: Ridicule (उपहास), Deride (हँसी उड़ाना), Taunt (व्यंग्य).
Antonyms: Respect (सम्मान), Praise (प्रशंसा), Commend (सराहना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: APPROACH
questionsEn.s:
APPROACH - निकट आना (To deal with or move towards something)
Meet - मिलना (To come into the presence of someone)
Reach - पहुँचना (To arrive at a place)
Near - पास (Not far away in distance)
Avoid - टालना/बचना (To stay away from someone or something)
Hence, 'avoid ' is the most suitable antonym for 'APPROACH'.
oa:
This word means to arrange or happen to come into the presence of someone. Meeting is the result of an approach and therefore cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Encounter (मिलना), Confront (सामना करना), Greet (अभिवादन).
Antonyms: Avoid (बचना), Miss (चूक जाना), Part (अलग होना).

This word means to arrive at a destination or to stretch out for something. it describes the completion of an approach rather than the act of moving away.
Synonyms: Arrive (पहुँचना), Attain (प्राप्त करना), Achieve (हासिल करना).
Antonyms: Depart (प्रस्थान), Leave (छोड़ना), Fail (विफल).

This word means not far away in distance or time. it is an adjective or adverb describing proximity, which is a synonym for the state of an approach rather than an antonym.
Synonyms: Close (पास), Adjacent (निकट), Nearby (समीप).
Antonyms: Far (दूर), Distant (दूरवर्ती), Remote (पृथक).

This word means to stay away from someone or something or to try not to do something. It is the direct behavioral antonym for approach, which involves moving towards.
Synonyms: Evade (बचना), Shunt (टालना), Shun (परहेज करना).
Antonyms: Approach (निकट आना), Seek (खोजना), Face (सामना करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: TARDY
questionsEn.s:
TARDY - देर/सुस्त (Delaying beyond the expected time)
Late - देर (After the expected or usual time)
Slow - धीमा (Not quick or taking a long time)
Lazy - आलसी (Not wanting to work or use energy)
Early - जल्दी (Happening before the expected time)
Hence, 'early ' is the most suitable antonym for 'TARDY'.
oa:
This word means doing something after the expected or proper time. It is a direct synonym for tardy and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an antonym.
Synonyms: Delayed (विलंबित), Overdue (देर), Behindhand (पिछड़ा).
Antonyms: Early (जल्दी), Punctual (समय पर), Prompt (शीघ्र).

This word means not quick or taking a long time to perform a task. While a slow person is often tardy, the word describes pace rather than the failure to meet a specific time deadline.
Synonyms: Sluggish (सुस्त), Plodding (धीमा), Gradual (क्रमशः).
Antonyms: Fast (तेज़), Rapid (द्रुत), Quick (शीघ्र).

This word describes a person not wanting to work or use energy. While laziness causes tardiness, it is a personality trait and not the exact lexical opposite of being late.
Synonyms: Idle (कामचोर), Indolent (आलसी), Slothful (सुस्त).
Antonyms: Industrious (परिश्रमी), Diligent (मेहनती), Busy (व्यस्त).

This word refers to something happening or done before the usual or expected time. it is the direct and perfect antonym for tardy, which involves being late.
Synonyms: Timely (शीघ्र), Premature (असामयिक), Forward (अग्रिम).
Antonyms: Tardy (देर से), Late (विलंब), Delayed (पिछड़ा).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: RADIANCE
questionsEn.s:
RADIANCE - चमक/प्रकाश (Happiness or beauty visible in the face)
Brilliance - प्रतिभा/दीप्ति (Great skill or bright light)
Glow - दमक (Steady light or heat)
Dullness - मंदता (Lacking brightness or interest)
Glitter - झिलमिलाहट (Flashing reflected light)
Hence, 'Dullness ' is the most suitable antonym for 'RADIANCE'.
oa:
This word means great skill or intelligence, or very bright light. It is a synonym for radiance and therefore does not provide the required opposite meaning.
Synonyms: Splendor (वैभव), Radiance (दीप्ति), Luster (चमक).
Antonyms: Dullness (नीरसता), Obscurity (अस्पष्टता), Darkness (अंधेरा).

This word means to produce a steady light and sometimes heat. it is a physical descriptor of radiance and cannot be used as its antonym.
Synonyms: Beam (चमकना), Radiate (निकलना), Shine (दमकना).
Antonyms: Fade (मिटना), Extinguish (बुझना), Darken (अंधेरा होना).

This word refers to the lack of brightness, interest, or excitement. It is the perfect antonym for radiance, which implies glowing brightness and happiness.
Synonyms: Drabness (उदासी), Lackluster (मंदता), Gloom (अंधेरा).
Antonyms: Radiance (चमक), Brightness (उज्ज्वलता), Brilliance (प्रतिभा).

This word means to produce many small, bright flashes of reflected light. it is a synonym for the sparkling quality of radiance rather than its opposite.
Synonyms: Sparkle (झिलमिलाहट), Shimmer (झिलमिलाना), Gleam (चमक).
Antonyms: Matteness (बेचमक), Darkness (अंधेरा), Dullness (धुंधलापन).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: PRECISE
questionsEn.s:
PRECISE - सटीक (Exact and accurate)
Actual - वास्तविक (Existing in fact)
Definite - निश्चित (Fixed, certain, or clear)
Vague - अस्पष्ट (Not clearly expressed or known)
Hence, 'Vague ' is the most suitable antonym for 'PRECISE'.
oa:
This word means existing in fact or being real. While precise measurements relate to facts, "actual" refers to existence rather than the exactness and accuracy of detail.
Synonyms: Real (वास्तविक), Authentic (असली), Genuine (प्रामाणिक).
Antonyms: Imaginary (काल्पनिक), False (झूठा), Potential (संभावित).

This word means in agreement with true facts or generally accepted standards. It is a synonym for precise and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an antonym.
Synonyms: Accurate (सटीक), Right (सही), True (सत्य).
Antonyms: Incorrect (गलत), Wrong (अशुद्ध), False (असत्य).

This word means fixed, certain, or clear. it describes something that is well-defined, making it a synonym for precise rather than its opposite.
Synonyms: Clear (स्पष्ट), Specific (निश्चित), Explicit (सुस्पष्ट).
Antonyms: Indefinite (अनिश्चित), Vague (अस्पष्ट), Ambiguous (संदिग्ध).

This word describes something that is not clearly expressed, known, or decided. It is the direct and perfect antonym for precise, which implies exactness.
Synonyms: Unclear (अस्पष्ट), Indefinite (अनिश्चित), Obscure (धुंधला).
Antonyms: Precise (सटीक), Clear (साफ), Exact (निश्चित).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: SUBTLE
questionsEn.s:
SUBTLE - सूक्ष्म (Not very noticeable, slight, or delicate)
Crafty - चालाक (Clever at being deceptive)
Harsh - कठोर (Having a strong, unpleasant effect)
Faint - हल्का (Not strong or clear)
Slight - मामूली (Very small or not important)
Hence, 'harsh ' is the most suitable antonym for 'SUBTLE'.
oa:
This word means clever at getting what you want through unfair or dishonest methods. it refers to cunning and trickery rather than the slightness of a quality or tone.
Synonyms: Sly (धूर्त), Cunning (चालाक), Deceptive (कपटी).
Antonyms: Honest (ईमानदार), Frank (स्पष्ट), Naive (भोला).

This word refers to having an undesirably strong or unpleasant effect. It serves as an opposite to subtle, which implies being delicate, faint, or not very strong.
Synonyms: Severe (कठोर), Rough (रूखा), Jarring (तीखा).
Antonyms: Subtle (सूक्ष्म), Mild (हल्का), Gentle (कोमल).

This word means not strong or clear, or losing consciousness. It is a synonym for the "not very noticeable" aspect of subtle and cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Slight (हल्का), Weak (कमज़ोर), Dim (धुंधला).
Antonyms: Strong (मजबूत), Vivid (जीवंत), Loud (ज़ोरदार).

This word means very small or not important. Like faint, it describes something that is not strong or intense, making it a synonym for subtle rather than an antonym.
Synonyms: Minor (मामूली), Petty (तुच्छ), Slender (नन्हा).
Antonyms: Great (महान), Significant (महत्वपूर्ण), Massive (विशाल).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: CEASE
questionsEn.s:
CEASE - समाप्त होना (To stop or end)
Stop - विराम (To come to an end)
Catch - पकड़ना (To take hold of something moving)
Halt - रुकाव (A short stop in an activity)
Start - शुरू करना (To begin doing something)
Hence, 'start ' is the most suitable antonym for 'CEASE'.
oa:
This word means to come to an end or to no longer happen. It is a direct synonym for cease and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an antonym.
Synonyms: Halt (विराम), Quit (छोड़ना), End (अंत).
Antonyms: Start (शुरू करना), Begin (आरंभ करना), Continue (जारी रखना).

This word means to take hold of something that is moving. It describes an act of physical capture and has no connection to the beginning or ending of an event.
Synonyms: Seize (पकड़ना), Grasp (थामना), Snatch (झपटना).
Antonyms: Release (छोड़ना), Drop (गिराना), Miss (चूकना).

This word refers to a short stop in an activity or growth. it is a synonym for cease and cannot be used as its logical opposite.
Synonyms: Pause (रुकाव), Stop (रोकना), Check (अवरोध).
Antonyms: Proceed (आगे बढ़ना), Resume (फिर से शुरू), Start (आरंभ).

This word means to begin doing something or to set it in motion. It is the direct and most universal antonym for cease, which means to stop.
Synonyms: Begin (शुरू करना), Initiate (आरंभ करना), Launch (शुरुआत).
Antonyms: Cease (समाप्त करना), Stop (रोकना), Finish (खत्म करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: END
questionsEn.s:
END - अंत (The final part of something)
Show - दिखाना (To make something seen)
Start - शुरू करना (To begin doing something)
Hide - छिपाना (To put something where it cannot be seen)
Close - बंद करना (To conclude or shut)
Hence, 'Start ' is the most suitable antonym for 'END'.
oa:
This word means to make it possible for something to be seen. It refers to visual display and does not address the starting or finishing of a timeline or activity.
Synonyms: Display (दिखाना), Exhibit (प्रदर्शित), Reveal (प्रकट).
Antonyms: Hide (छिपाना), Conceal (गुप्त रखना), Mask (ढकना).

This word means to begin doing something or to come into existence. It is the direct and most accurate antonym for the word end.
Synonyms: Begin (शुरू करना), Commence (आरंभ), Initiate (प्रारंभ).
Antonyms: End (अंत), Finish (खत्म), Stop (रुकना).

This word means to put something where it cannot be seen. It describes concealment and is not conceptually related to the final part of a period or story.
Synonyms: Conceal (छिपाना), Cover (ढकना), Obscure (धुंधला).
Antonyms: Reveal (प्रकट), Show (दिखाना), Expose (उजागर).

This word means to change something from being open or to conclude. While it can mean "to end," it is often a synonym rather than a direct opposite.
Synonyms: Conclude (समाप्त), Shut (बंद), Finish (खत्म).
Antonyms: Open (खोलना), Unlock (खोलना), Start (शुरू).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: CONFIRM
questionsEn.s:
CONFIRM - पुष्टि करना (To make an arrangement or meeting certain)
Open - खुला (Not closed or fastened)
Agree - सहमत होना (To have the same opinion)
Reject - अस्वीकार करना (To refuse to accept or believe)
Accept - स्वीकार करना (To agree to take something)
Hence, 'Reject ' is the most suitable antonym for 'CONFIRM'.
oa:
This word means not closed or fastened, or being honest. it describes physical access or character rather than the validation of an agreement or meeting.
Synonyms: Unlock (खोलना), Accessible (खुला), Frank (स्पष्टवादी).
Antonyms: Closed (बंद), Fastened (जकड़ा हुआ), Reserved (संकोची).

This word means to have the same opinion or to consent. While confirming involves agreement, the word is a synonym in that context rather than an opposite.
Synonyms: Concur (सहमत होना), Consent (सहमति), Accede (मानना).
Antonyms: Disagree (असहमत), Object (विरोध), Differ (अलग होना).

This word means to refuse to accept, use, or believe something. It is the direct antonym for confirm, which involves validating or accepting an arrangement.
Synonyms: Dismiss (अस्वीकार), Refuse (नकारना), Deny (अस्वीकार).
Antonyms: Confirm (पुष्टि करना), Accept (स्वीकार), Approve (मंजूरी).

This word means to agree to take something or to receive it. It is a synonym for the "confirm" process and therefore cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Receive (ग्रहण), Admit (स्वीकार), Adopt (अपनाना).
Antonyms: Reject (अस्वीकार), Refuse (नकारना), Decline (अस्वीकार).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: FLIMSY
questionsEn.s:
FLIMSY - कमज़ोर (Very thin or easily broken)
Clumsy - अनाड़ी (Behaving in a careless or awkward way)
Strong - शक्तिशाली (Powerful or having great force)
Weak - अशक्त (Not physically strong)
Tiny - अत्यंत छोटा (Extremely small in size)
Hence, 'strong ' is the most suitable antonym for 'FLIMSY'.
oa:
This word describes a person who has accidents because they do not behave in a careful, controlled way. It refers to coordination rather than the physical strength of a material.
Synonyms: Inept (अनाड़ी), Awkward (भद्दा), Gauche (फूहड़).
Antonyms: Graceful (सुरुचिपूर्ण), Adroit (निपुण), Skillful (कुशल).

This word means powerful, having great force, or not easily broken. It is the perfect and most accurate antonym for flimsy, which means thin and weak.
Synonyms: Robust (मजबूत), Sturdy (दृढ़), Durable (टिकाऊ).
Antonyms: Flimsy (कमज़ोर), Weak (अशक्त), Fragile (नाज़ुक).

This word means not physically strong or having little power. It is a direct synonym for flimsy and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an antonym.
Synonyms: Frail (दुर्बल), Feeble (अशक्त), Puny (नन्हा).
Antonyms: Strong (शक्तिशाली), Mighty (बलवान), Tough (मजबूत).

This word means extremely small. While a flimsy object might be small, "tiny" refers to physical size rather than the lack of structural strength or durability.
Synonyms: Small (छोटा), Minute (सूक्ष्म), Minuscule (नन्हा).
Antonyms: Huge (विशाल), Enormous (अत्यधिक), Giant (विशालकाय).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: DEFENCE
questionsEn.s:
DEFENCE - रक्षा (Act of protecting someone or something)
Guard - पहरेदार (Person whose job is to protect)
Protection - बचाव (Act of protecting or being protected)
Security - सुरक्षा (Protection against threats or crime)
Offence - अपराध/हमला (An illegal act or an attack)
Hence, 'offence ' is the most suitable antonym for 'DEFENCE'.
oa:
This word refers to a person or group that protects others or the state of being watchful. It is a synonym for the function of defense and not its opposite.
Synonyms: Protection (बचाव), Sentry (पहरेदार), Shield (ढाल).
Antonyms: Attacker (आक्रमणकारी), Target (लक्ष्य), Offence (हमला).

This word means the act of protecting or the state of being protected. It is a direct synonym for defense and therefore cannot be used as its antonym.
Synonyms: Safety (सुरक्षा), Security (बचाव), Shelter (शरण).
Antonyms: Exposure (अनावृत्ति), Vulnerability (संवेदनशीलता), Threat (खतरा).

This word means protection against threats such as crime or foreign attacks. Like protection, it is a synonym for defense and does not provide an opposite meaning.
Synonyms: Safeguard (बचाव), Assurance (आश्वासन), Stability (स्थिरता).
Antonyms: Risk (जोखिम), Danger (खतरा), Insecurity (असुरक्षा).

This word refers to an illegal act, crime, or the act of attacking. It is the direct and logical antonym for defense in both legal and physical contexts.
Synonyms: Attack (आक्रमण), Assault (हमला), Crime (अपराध).
Antonyms: Defence (रक्षा), Protection (बचाव), Resistance (प्रतिरोध).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: UNUSUAL
questionsEn.s:
UNUSUAL - असामान्य (Different from others; surprising)
Commonplace - सामान्य (Happening often; not special)
Questionable - संदिग्ध (Not certain or wrong in some way)
Fantastic - अद्भुत (Extremely good or attractive)
Rare - दुर्लभ (Not common or frequent)
Hence, 'Commonplace ' is the most suitable antonym for 'UNUSUAL'.
oa:
This word describes something that happens often or is seen frequently and is not considered special. It is the direct opposite of unusual, which means surprising or rare.
Synonyms: Ordinary (सामान्य), Frequent (प्रचलित), Routine (नियमित).
Antonyms: Unusual (असामान्य), Unique (अद्वितीय), Exceptional (असाधारण).

This word refers to something that is not certain or is wrong in some way. It describes doubt or lack of reliability rather than the frequency or normalcy of an event.
Synonyms: Doubtful (संदिग्ध), Dubious (संदेहास्पद), Fishy (शंकास्पद).
Antonyms: Certain (निश्चित), Reliable (विश्वसनीय), Sure (पक्का).

This word means extraordinarily good or attractive. While unusual things can be fantastic, the word describes high quality rather than the normalcy required for an antonym.
Synonyms: Wonderful (अद्भुत), Great (उत्कृष्ट), Excellent (शानदार).
Antonyms: Terrible (भयानक), Awful (बहुत बुरा), Ordinary (साधारण).

This word means not common or frequent; very unusual. it is a direct synonym for the given word and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an opposite.
Synonyms: Uncommon (दुर्लभ), Scarce (अल्प), Infrequent (विरल).
Antonyms: Common (सामान्य), Frequent (अक्सर), Usual (हमेशा).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: GLITTERING
questionsEn.s:
GLITTERING - चमकदार (Exciting, admired, or shining brightly)
Shingly - पथरीला (Covered in small, round stones)
Attractive - आकर्षक (Pleasing in appearance or sound)
Dull - मंद/नीरस (Not interesting or bright in any way)
Shiny - चमकीला (Bright because it reflects light)
Hence, 'Dull ' is the most suitable antonym for 'GLITTERING'.
oa:
This word describes being covered in small, round stones or pebbles. It refers to a physical terrain or texture and has no connection to the brightness or fame implied by "glittering."
Synonyms: Stony (पथरीला), Pebbly (कंकड़दार), Gravelly (बजरी वाला).
Antonyms: Sandy (रेतीला), Smooth (चिकना), Grassy (घास वाला).

This word means pleasing in appearance or sound. This is a common quality of things that are glittering, making it a near-synonym rather than an antonym.
Synonyms: Appealing (मोहक), Beautiful (सुंदर), Charming (मनोहर).
