Antonyms: Repulsive (घृणित), Ugly (बदसूरत), Unattractive (अनाकर्षक).

This word refers to something that is not interesting, exciting, or bright in any way. It is the direct and perfect antonym for glittering, which involves being bright and shining.
Synonyms: Drab (नीरस), Lackluster (फीका), Boring (उबाऊ).
Antonyms: Glittering (चमकदार), Shining (उज्ज्वल), Radiant (देदीप्यमान).

This word means being bright because it reflects light. It is a direct synonym for the physical aspect of glittering and therefore cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Lustrous (चमकीला), Glossy (चिकना), Bright (दमकता हुआ).
Antonyms: Dull (धुंधला), Matte (फीका), Dark (अंधेरा).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: OBESE
questionsEn.s:
OBESE - बहुत मोटा (Very fat in an unhealthy way)
Skinny - दुबला-पतला (Too thin)
Rude - अशिष्ट (Not polite)
Paunchy - तोंद वाला (Having a large belly)
Cute - आकर्षक (Attractive or pretty)
Hence, 'Skinny ' is the most suitable antonym for 'OBESE'.
oa:
This word describes a person who is too thin or lacking in flesh. It is the direct and most accurate physical antonym for obese, which means being very fat in an unhealthy way.
Synonyms: Thin (दुबला-पतला), Lean (पतला), Scrawny (सींकिया).
Antonyms: Obese (मोटा), Fat (स्थूल), Corpulent (भारी-भरकम).

This word means not polite or lacking manners. It describes a personality trait or social behavior and has no relevance to the physical weight or build of a person.
Synonyms: Impolite (अशिष्ट), Insolent (धृष्ट), Boorish (गंवार).
Antonyms: Polite (विनम्र), Courteous (शिष्ट), Respectful (आदरपूर्ण).

This word means having a large or protruding belly. It is a specific type of being overweight and acts as a near-synonym for obese rather than an antonym.
Synonyms: Potbellied (तोंद वाला), Fat (मोटा), Portly (भारी).
Antonyms: Flat-stomached (सपाट पेट), Thin (दुबला), Fit (तंदुरुस्त).

This word means attractive or pretty, often in a delicate way. while some people might find certain traits cute, it describes attractiveness rather than the physical state of being thin.
Synonyms: Adorable (मनमोहक), Pretty (सुंदर), Charming (प्यारा).
Antonyms: Ugly (भद्दा), Repulsive (घृणित), Hideous (भयानक).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: STUNNING
questionsEn.s:
STUNNING - मनमोहक (Very attractive, impressive, or surprising)
Impulsive - आवेगशील (Acting suddenly without thinking)
Obedient - आज्ञाकारी (Doing what you are told to do)
Unattractive - अनाकर्षक (Not pretty or pleasant to look at)
Gorgeous - भव्य (Extremely pleasant or attractive)
Hence, 'Unattractive ' is the most suitable antonym for 'STUNNING'.
oa:
This word means acting suddenly without thinking carefully. It refers to a psychological behavior or decision-making style and has no connection to visual beauty or surprise.
Synonyms: Rash (आवेगपूर्ण), Reckless (लापरवाह), Spontaneous (अनायास).
Antonyms: Cautious (सावधान), Prudent (विवेकपूर्ण), Deliberate (सोच-समझकर).

This word means doing what you are told to do by someone in authority. It describes a state of submission and compliance rather than the quality of being impressive or attractive.
Synonyms: Compliant (आज्ञाकारी), Submissive (विनम्र), Dutiful (कर्तव्यनिष्ठ).
Antonyms: Rebellious (विद्रोही), Defiant (अवज्ञाकारी), Mutinous (बागी).

This word means not pretty, pleasant, or appealing to look at. It is the direct and logical antonym for stunning, which implies being exceptionally beautiful or impressive.
Synonyms: Ugly (अनाकर्षक), Plain (साधारण), Hideous (भयानक).
Antonyms: Stunning (मनमोहक), Gorgeous (भव्य), Beautiful (सुंदर).

This word means extremely pleasant or attractive. it is a direct synonym for stunning and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an antonym.
Synonyms: Splendid (शानदार), Magnificent (भव्य), Ravishing (अत्यंत सुंदर).
Antonyms: Plain (सादा), Ugly (कुरूप), Repulsive (घृणित).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: HEFTY
questionsEn.s:
HEFTY - भारी/तगड़ा (Large and heavy)
Handsome - सुंदर (Good-looking)
Generous - उदार (Ready to give more than necessary)
Slight - मामूली/पतला (Not sturdy; thin or slender)
Liberal - उदार (Willing to respect different opinions)
Hence, 'slight ' is the most suitable antonym for 'HEFTY'.
oa:
This word describes a man who is good-looking or something large and impressive in value. It refers to beauty or quantity rather than the physical weight or bulk of a person.
Synonyms: Good-looking (सुंदर), Striking (आकर्षक), Comely (सजीला).
Antonyms: Ugly (भद्दा), Unattractive (अनाकर्षक), Plain (साधारण).

This word describes a person willing to give money or help freely. It refers to a moral or financial trait and does not address the physical size or heaviness of an object or person.
Synonyms: Benevolent (उदार), Charitable (दानशील), Bountiful (प्रचुर).
Antonyms: Stingy (कंजूस), Selfish (स्वार्थी), Miserly (कृपण).

This word means not sturdy, thin, or very small in amount. It is the direct physical antonym for hefty, which implies being large, heavy, and powerful.
Synonyms: Slender (पतला), Thin (दुबला), Meager (अल्प).
Antonyms: Hefty (तगड़ा), Large (बड़ा), Massive (विशाल).

This word means willing to respect opinions different from one's own or being generous. it describes an open-minded attitude and is not a direct opposite for physical bulk.
Synonyms: Open-minded (उदार), Tolerant (सहिष्णु), Broad-based (व्यापक).
Antonyms: Conservative (रूढ़िवादी), Narrow-minded (संकीर्ण), Strict (सख्त).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: FATIGUE
questionsEn.s:
FATIGUE - थकान (Extreme tiredness resulting from exertion)
Strength - ताकत (The quality of being physically strong)
Control - नियंत्रण (Power to influence or direct behavior)
Weakness - दुर्बलता (The state or condition of being weak)
Threat - धमकी (Statement of intention to inflict harm)
Hence, 'strength ' is the most suitable antonym for 'FATIGUE'.
oa:
This word refers to the quality of being physically or mentally strong. it is the direct functional opposite of fatigue, which involves being extremely tired or weak.
Synonyms: Energy (ताकत), Vigour (ऊर्जा), Potency (शक्ति).
Antonyms: Fatigue (थकान), Weakness (दुर्बलता), Frailty (कमज़ोरी).

This word means the power to influence or direct behavior or events. it refers to management and authority rather than the level of physical energy or tiredness.
Synonyms: Command (नियंत्रण), Authority (अधिकार), Regulation (नियमन).
Antonyms: Chaos (अव्यवस्था), Powerlessness (अशक्तता), Submission (समर्पण).

This word refers to the state or condition of being weak. It is a symptom or synonym for the result of fatigue and therefore cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Frailty (दुर्बलता), Feeble (अशक्तता), Debility (कमज़ोरी).
Antonyms: Strength (बल), Robustness (मजबूती), Might (शक्ति).

This word refers to a statement of intention to inflict harm or the possibility of danger. it describes a potential risk and has no relation to the feeling of exhaustion.
Synonyms: Menace (धमकी), Danger (खतरा), Peril (जोखिम).
Antonyms: Safety (सुरक्षा), Assurance (आश्वासन), Protection (बचाव).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: RENOWNED
questionsEn.s:
RENOWNED - प्रसिद्ध (Famous or well known)
Obscure - अज्ञात (Not discovered or known about)
Vain - अभिमानी (Showing an excessively high opinion of oneself)
Noted - विख्यात (Notice or pay attention to; important)
Glorious - शानदार (Having or bringing fame or admiration)
Hence, 'Obscure ' is the most suitable antonym for 'RENOWNED'.
oa:
This word refers to something that is not discovered or known about; it is the direct opposite of renowned, which means being famous and respected by many.
Synonyms: Unknown (अज्ञात), Unfamiliar (अनजाना), Unheard-of (अनाम).
Antonyms: Renowned (प्रसिद्ध), Famous (प्रख्यात), Noted (विख्यात).

This word means having an excessively high opinion of one's appearance or being pointless. It refers to ego or futility rather than how well-known a person is.
Synonyms: Conceited (अभिमानी), Futile (व्यर्थ), Proud (गर्वित).
Antonyms: Humble (विनम्र), Modest (विनीत), Useful (उपयोगी).

This word means being noticed or being a person of importance. it is a direct synonym for renowned and therefore cannot be used as its antonym.
Synonyms: Famous (विख्यात), Distinguished (प्रतिष्ठित), Prominent (प्रमुख).
Antonyms: Obscure (अस्पष्ट), Unknown (अनाम), Common (साधारण).

This word means having or bringing fame and admiration. it is a strong synonym for renowned and describes the same positive status.
Synonyms: Magnificent (शानदार), Illustrious (तेजस्वी), Splendid (भव्य).
Antonyms: Disgraceful (अपमानजनक), Inglorious (अधम), Bad (बुरा).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: IRRITATE
questionsEn.s:
IRRITATE - चिढ़ाना (To annoy someone or make them angry)
Shock - चौंकाना (To surprise someone greatly)
Delight - प्रसन्न करना (To please someone greatly)
Frighten - डराना (To make someone afraid)
Annoy - परेशान करना (To make someone slightly angry)
Hence, 'Delight ' is the most suitable antonym for 'IRRITATE'.
oa:
This word means to surprise someone very much, often unpleasantly. while irritation is a continuous nuisance, a shock is a sudden event, and it does not represent the relief required for an antonym.
Synonyms: Startle (चौंका देना), Appal (स्तब्ध करना), Astound (चकित करना).
Antonyms: Expect (अपेक्षा करना), Reassure (आश्वस्त करना), Comfort (दिलासा देना).

This word means to please someone greatly or to give intense pleasure. It is the perfect emotional antonym for irritate, which involves causing anger or annoyance.
Synonyms: Please (प्रसन्न करना), Charm (मोहित करना), Gratify (संतुष्ट करना).
Antonyms: Irritate (चिढ़ाना), Annoy (परेशान करना), Displease (नाखुश करना).

This word means to make someone afraid. It describes an act of scaring someone rather than providing the pleasant feeling that opposes irritation.
Synonyms: Scare (डराना), Terrify (आतंकित करना), Daunt (धमकाना).
Antonyms: Reassure (आश्वासन देना), Comfort (आराम देना), Bolden (उत्साहित करना).

This word means to make someone slightly angry or to bother them. It is a direct synonym for irritate and therefore cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Vex (परेशान करना), Irk (झुंझलाना), Pester (तंग करना).
Antonyms: Soothe (शांत करना), Calm (शांत करना), Please (खुश करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: FORMER
questionsEn.s:
FORMER - भूतपूर्व (Previous or the first of two)
Latter - बाद वाला (Happened last or the second of two)
Further - और आगे (Extra or at a greater distance)
Earlier - पहले (Former or previous in time)
Anterior - सामने का (Frontward or occurring before)
Hence, 'latter ' is the most suitable antonym for 'FORMER'.
oa:
This word refers to the second of two things mentioned, or something happening towards the end. it is the direct logical antonym for former, which refers to the first of two or previous times.
Synonyms: Final (अंतिम), Subsequent (बाद का), Recent (हाल का).
Antonyms: Former (भूतपूर्व), Initial (प्रारंभिक), Prior (पूर्व).

This word means additional or at a greater distance. It describes an increase in extent or space rather than the sequence of time or position relative to "former."
Synonyms: Additional (अतिरिक्त), Extra (ज्यादा), More (और).
Antonyms: Nearer (पास), Less (कम), Close (नजदीक).

This word means happening before the present or before the time mentioned. it is a direct synonym for former and therefore cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Previous (पहले का), Prior (पूर्व), Erstwhile (भूतपूर्व).
Antonyms: Later (बाद में), Subsequent (आगामी), Future (भविष्य).

This word means situated at the front or occurring before. it is a technical synonym for former and does not provide an opposite meaning.
Synonyms: Fore (अग्र), Front (सामने का), Preceding (पूर्ववर्ती).
Antonyms: Posterior (पिछला), Latter (बाद का), Back (पीछे का).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: DEMOTE
questionsEn.s:
DEMOTE - पद घटाना (To move to a lower rank)
Break - तोड़ना (To separate into pieces)
Elevate - उन्नति करना (To move to a higher rank or position)
Disregard - उपेक्षा (To pay no attention to)
Sack - बर्खास्त करना (To dismiss from a job)
Hence, 'Elevate' is the most suitable antonym for 'DEMOTE'.
oa:
This word means to separate into pieces or to interrupt a continuity. It describes damage or pause and has no relation to the ranking or status of a person in an organization.
Synonyms: Fracture (तोड़ना), Smash (बर्बाद करना), Interruption (विराम).
Antonyms: Mend (मरम्मत करना), Repair (ठीक करना), Join (जोड़ना).

This word means to move someone or something to a higher place or position. It is the direct antonym for demote, which involves lowering someone's rank.
Synonyms: Promote (पदोन्नत करना), Upgrade (उन्नति करना), Raise (ऊपर उठाना).
Antonyms: Demote (पदावनति करना), Lower (नीचा करना), Degrade (अपमानित करना).

This word means to pay no attention to something or to treat it as unimportant. it describes an act of ignoring rather than changing someone's formal rank.
Synonyms: Ignore (उपेक्षा), Neglect (अनदेखा), Overlook (नज़रअंदाज़).
Antonyms: Regard (सम्मान), Note (ध्यान), Notice (देखना).

This word is an informal term meaning to dismiss someone from their job. while it is a negative action like demoting, it is a synonym for firing rather than an opposite of lowering rank.
Synonyms: Dismiss (बर्खास्त करना), Fire (निकालना), Oust (बेदखल करना).
Antonyms: Hire (नियुक्त करना), Employ (काम देना), Appoint (चुनना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: FORTHRIGHT
questionsEn.s:
FORTHRIGHT - स्पष्टवादी (Direct, honest, and straightforward)
Motivated - प्रेरित (Driven to achieve something)
Upfront - ईमानदार (Honest and transparent)
Devious - धूर्त (Dishonest, cunning, or using underhanded methods)
Outspoken - मुखर (Expressing opinions freely and openly)
Hence, 'Devious ' is the most suitable antonym for 'FORTHRIGHT'.
oa:
This word describes someone having a strong desire to achieve a goal. It refers to inner drive and enthusiasm rather than the honesty or directness of one's speech.
Synonyms: Driven (प्रेरित), Ambitious (महत्वाकांक्षी), Enthusiastic (उत्साही).
Antonyms: Apathetic (उदासीन), Idle (बेकार), Reluctant (अनिच्छुक).

This word means to be honest, candid, and transparent about something. it is a direct synonym for forthright and therefore cannot be its antonym.
Synonyms: Frank (स्पष्ट), Open (खुला), Candid (निष्कपट).
Antonyms: Evasive (टालमटोल), Devious (धूर्त), Secretive (गुप्त).

This word describes someone who is dishonest, cunning, or uses underhanded methods to achieve a goal. It is the perfect antonym for forthright (honest and direct).
Synonyms: Cunning (धूर्त), Shifty (कुटिल), Indirect (घुमावदार).
Antonyms: Forthright (स्पष्टवादी), Honest (ईमानदार), Straightforward (सीधा).

This word refers to a person who speaks their mind freely and openly. it is a synonym for forthright and describes the same quality of directness.
Synonyms: Vocal (मुखर), Blunt (मुँहफट), Candid (साफ-साफ).
Antonyms: Reserved (संकोची), Silent (मौन), Reticent (अल्पभाषी).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: REJUVENATE
questionsEn.s:
REJUVENATE - ताजगी लाना (To restore or refresh to a healthy state)
Update - अद्यतन (To make something more modern)
Replenish - पूरा करना (To refill something used up)
Suppress - दबाना (To prevent or restrain something)
Revive - पुनर्जीवित करना (To bring back to life or energy)
Hence, 'suppress' is the most suitable antonym for 'REJUVENATE'.
oa:
This word means to make something more modern or up-to-date. while it involve making changes, it refers to current information rather than the restoration of youth and energy.
Synonyms: Modernize (अद्यतन), Refresh (ताज़ा करना), Renew (नवीनीकरण).
Antonyms: Outdate (पुराना करना), Preserve (सुरक्षित रखना), Neglect (उपेक्षा).

This word means to refill or restore something that has been used up. it is a near-synonym for the "restoration" aspect of rejuvenate and not its opposite.
Synonyms: Refill (फिर से भरना), Restock (भंडार भरना), Renew (नया करना).
Antonyms: Deplete (खाली करना), Drain (खत्म करना), Exhaust (थका देना).

This word means to prevent or restrain something from being expressed or developing. It represents inhibition and limitation, which is the functional opposite of revitalizing or rejuvenating.
Synonyms: Subdue (दबाना), Restrain (रोकना), Quell (शांत करना).
Antonyms: Rejuvenate (ताजगी लाना), Stimulate (उत्तेजित करना), Release (मुक्त करना).

This word means to bring back to life or consciousness. it is a direct synonym for rejuvenate and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an opposite.
Synonyms: Resuscitate (पुनर्जीवित), Restore (बहाल), Reanimate (जीवित करना).
Antonyms: Kill (मारना), Wither (मुरझाना), Destroy (नष्ट करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: LUMINOUS
questionsEn.s:
LUMINOUS - प्रकाशमान (Shining in the dark)
Hunched - झुका हुआ (Bending back and shoulders forward)
Homespun - सादा (Simple and unsophisticated)
Simple - सरल (Easy to understand or basic)
Dim - मंद (Not bright or easy to see)
Hence, 'Dim ' is the most suitable antonym for 'LUMINOUS'.
oa:
This word describes bending one's back and shoulders forward. It refers to a physical posture and has no relation to light, brightness, or the absence of it.
Synonyms: Bent (झुका हुआ), Stooped (झुका), Curved (टेढ़ा).
Antonyms: Upright (सीधा), Straight (समतल), Erect (खड़ा).

This word describes something simple, unsophisticated, or made at home. it refers to style and quality rather than the visual property of emitting light.
Synonyms: Simple (सरल), Rustic (ग्राम्य), Plain (सादा).
Antonyms: Sophisticated (जटिल), Elegant (सुरुचिपूर्ण), Fancy (विशिष्ट).

This word means easy to understand, do, or use. While simple things are not complex, the word does not address the brightness or darkness required to oppose luminous.
Synonyms: Easy (सुगम), Uncomplicated (सरल), Basic (मामूली).
Antonyms: Complex (जटिल), Intricate (पेचीदा), Hard (मुश्किल).

This word means not bright, clear, or easy to see. It is the direct visual antonym for luminous, which refers to something that shines brightly in the dark.
Synonyms: Faint (मंद), Dull (धुंधला), Obscure (अस्पष्ट).
Antonyms: Luminous (प्रकाशमान), Bright (चमकीला), Radiant (देदीप्यमान).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: WICKED
questionsEn.s:
WICKED - दुष्ट (Morally very bad or evil)
Evil - बुरा (Morally bad or causing harm)
Sinful - पापपूर्ण (Breaking religious law or immoral)
Errant - अनुचित (Behaving badly or disobeying)
Moral - नैतिक (Relating to beliefs about right and wrong)
Hence, 'Moral ' is the most suitable antonym for 'WICKED'.
oa:
This word refers to being profoundly immoral and malevolent. It is a direct synonym for wicked and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an antonym.
Synonyms: Sinful (पापी), Corrupt (भ्रष्ट), Nefarious (दुष्ट).
Antonyms: Good (अच्छा), Virtuous (सदाचारी), Moral (नैतिक).

This word means breaking a religious law or being immoral. Like evil, it is a synonym for wicked and acts as a description of the same negative behavior.
Synonyms: Wicked (दुष्ट), Wrong (ग़लत), Depraved (चरित्रहीन).
Antonyms: Pious (धार्मिक), Righteous (धर्मी), Pure (पवित्र).

This word describes someone behaving badly or disobeying parents. While it refers to wrongdoing, it is a milder term and not a direct conceptual opposite of the word wicked.
Synonyms: Wayward (अनुचित), Offending (अपराधी), Deviant (विचलित).
Antonyms: Obedient (आज्ञाकारी), Compliant (विनम्र), Correct (सही).

This word refers to beliefs and behaviors concerning what is right and wrong. It represents virtuous conduct and is the most appropriate antonym for being wicked.
Synonyms: Ethical (नैतिक), Virtuous (सदाचारी), Upright (ईमानदार).
Antonyms: Wicked (दुष्ट), Immoral (अनैतिक), Evil (बुरा).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: ABATE
questionsEn.s:
ABATE - कम होना (To become less strong or intense)
Moderate - मध्यम (To become less extreme)
Observe - निरीक्षण (To watch carefully or follow rules)
Aggravate - बिगाड़ना (To make something worse or more serious)
Decrease - घटाना (To become or make smaller)
Hence, 'Aggravate ' is the most suitable antonym for 'ABATE'.
oa:
This word means to make or become less extreme or intense. It is a synonym for abate and therefore does not provide the required opposite meaning.
Synonyms: Ease (नरम करना), Lessen (कम करना), Temper (संतुलित).
Antonyms: Intensify (तीव्र करना), Aggravate (बिगाड़ना), Increase (बढ़ाना).

This word means to watch carefully or to follow a law. it describes an act of perception or compliance and has no relation to the intensity or decrease of a condition.
Synonyms: Watch (देखना), Monitor (निगरानी), Follow (पालन करना).
Antonyms: Ignore (अनदेखा), Neglect (उपेक्षा), Break (उल्लंघन).

This word means to make a problem, injury, or situation worse or more serious. it is the direct and most accurate antonym for abate (to make less strong).
Synonyms: Worsen (बिगाड़ना), Exacerbate (बदतर करना), Inflame (उत्तेजित).
Antonyms: Abate (कम करना), Alleviate (हल्का करना), Soothe (शांत करना).

This word means to become or make something smaller or less. It is a direct synonym for abate and therefore cannot be used as its antonym.
Synonyms: Reduce (घटाना), Diminish (कम होना), Decline (क्षीण).
Antonyms: Increase (बढ़ाना), Grow (विकसित), Augment (विस्तार).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: OBVIOUS
questionsEn.s:
OBVIOUS - स्पष्ट (Easily seen or understood)
Hidden - छिपा हुआ (Out of sight or not apparent)
Plain - सादा/साफ (Clear or not decorated)
Vapid - नीरस (Dull or lacking interest)
Active - सक्रिय (Engaged in action or movement)
Hence, 'Hidden ' is the most suitable antonym for 'OBVIOUS'.
oa:
This word means kept out of sight or not readily apparent. It is the direct and most accurate antonym for obvious, which means easily seen or understood.
Synonyms: Concealed (छिपा हुआ), Obscure (धुंधला), Secret (गुप्त).
Antonyms: Obvious (स्पष्ट), Apparent (प्रत्यक्ष), Manifest (प्रकट).

This word means clear, easy to understand, or not decorated. it is a synonym for obvious and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an opposite.
Synonyms: Simple (सादा), Evident (स्पष्ट), Explicit (सुस्पष्ट).
Antonyms: Ornate (सजावटी), Complex (जटिल), Vague (अस्पष्ट).

This word describes something that is dull or lacking in interest and energy. while uninteresting, it refers to quality and zest rather than how clearly something can be seen.
Synonyms: Insipid (नीरस), Boring (उबाऊ), Flat (फीका).
Antonyms: Lively (जीवंत), Interesting (रोचक), Vivid (सजीव).

This word refers to being engaged in action or movement. It describes a state of functioning or energy rather than the visibility or clarity of a situation or object.
Synonyms: Energetic (सक्रिय), Operative (क्रियाशील), Busy (व्यस्त).
Antonyms: Passive (निष्क्रिय), Idle (बेकार), Latent (अव्यक्त).

test.instructions: Standard CBT Pattern Exam. Positive Marks: +1, Negative Marks: -0.25. Total Questions: 50.

test.title: Set - 25

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: BRUTALITY
questionsEn.s:
BRUTALITY - बर्बरता (Very cruel and violent behavior)
Ferocity - उग्रता (State of being violent and frightening)
Cruelty - निर्दयता (Causing pain or suffering to others)
Sensuality - कामुकता (Enjoyment of physical pleasure)
Gentleness - सौम्यता (Quality of being calm, kind, or soft)
Hence, 'gentleness ' is the most suitable antonym for 'BRUTALITY'.
oa:
This word refers to the state of being violent, frightening, and aggressive. it is a synonym for brutality and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an opposite.
Synonyms: Savagery (क्रूरता), Violence (हिंसा), Barbarity (बर्बरता).
Antonyms: Gentleness (कोमलता), Mildness (सौम्यता), Kindness (दया).

This word means the quality of causing pain or suffering to others intentionally. It is a direct synonym for brutality and cannot be used as its antonym.
Synonyms: Brutality (निर्दयता), Malice (दुर्भावना), Heartlessness (निष्ठुरता).
Antonyms: Compassion (सहानुभूति), Mercy (दया), Humanity (मानवता).

This word refers to the enjoyment or pursuit of physical, especially sexual, pleasure. It describes a specific type of sensory focus and has no conceptual relation to cruelty or violence.
Synonyms: Carnality (कामुकता), Hedonism (सुखवाद), Lust (भोग).
Antonyms: Asceticism (तपस्या), Purity (पवित्रता), Chastity (शुद्धता).

This word refers to the quality of being calm, kind, and soft in behavior. It is the direct moral and behavioral antonym for brutality, which involves violence.
Synonyms: Mildness (सौम्यता), Kindness (दयालुता), Softness (कोमलता).
Antonyms: Brutality (क्रूरता), Harshness (कठोरता), Severity (गंभीरता).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: COWARDLY
questionsEn.s:
COWARDLY - कायर (Lacking courage or easily frightened)
Integral - मौलिक (Necessary to make something complete)
Fleeting - क्षणिक (Lasting for a very short time)
Spineless - भीरु (Weak and easily frightened)
Valiant - साहसी (Full of courage and not afraid)
Hence, 'Valiant ' is the most suitable antonym for 'COWARDLY'.
oa:
This word means necessary to make something complete or being essential. it describes structural importance rather than the presence or absence of bravery.
Synonyms: Essential (आवश्यक), Fundamental (मौलिक), Vital (अनिवार्य).
Antonyms: Peripheral (सतही), Optional (वैकल्पिक), Inessential (अनावश्यक).

This word refers to something lasting for a very short time. It describes the duration of an event rather than the courageous or fearful character of a person.
Synonyms: Transient (क्षणिक), Evanescent (अस्थायी), Brief (संक्षिप्त).
Antonyms: Permanent (स्थायी), Lasting (टिकाऊ), Eternal (शाश्वत).

This word describes a person who is weak and easily frightened. it is a direct synonym for cowardly and therefore cannot be the required antonym.
Synonyms: Timid (डरपोक), Weak (कमज़ोर), Irresolute (अस्थिर).
Antonyms: Brave (बहादुर), Gutsy (हिम्मती), Bold (निडर).

This word refers to being full of courage and not being afraid to face danger. it is the direct and most accurate antonym for being cowardly.
Synonyms: Brave (साहसी), Heroic (वीर), Gallant (शौर्यपूर्ण).
Antonyms: Cowardly (कायर), Timid (भीरु), Fearful (भयभीत).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: LUCID
questionsEn.s:
LUCID - स्पष्ट (Clear and easy to understand)
Ambiguous - अस्पष्ट (Having more than one meaning)
Tangible - वास्तविक (Clearly seen to exist or touched)
Coherent - सुसंगत (Logical and easy to understand)
Blazing - प्रज्वलित (Burning with strong flames or intensity)
Hence, 'Ambiguous ' is the most suitable antonym for 'LUCID'.
oa:
This word refers to something that has more than one possible meaning or is unclear. It serves as the direct antonym for lucid, which means clear and easy to understand.
Synonyms: Vague (अस्पष्ट), Equivocal (संदिग्ध), Obscure (धुंधला).
Antonyms: Lucid (स्पष्ट), Clear (साफ), Explicit (सुस्पष्ट).

This word describes something that can be clearly seen to exist or be touched. while a lucid idea is clear, "tangible" refers to physical reality rather than the clarity of communication.
Synonyms: Real (वास्तविक), Concrete (ठोस), Physical (शारीरिक).
Antonyms: Abstract (अमूर्त), Intangible (अस्पृश्य), Ethereal (हल्का).

This word describes ideas or speech that are clear, logical, and easy to understand. It is a synonym for lucid and therefore cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Logical (तार्किक), Consistent (संगत), Rational (उचित).
Antonyms: Incoherent (असंबद्ध), Muddled (उलझा हुआ), Confused (भ्रमित).

This word means to burn with bright strong flames or to shine intensely. while it implies brightness, it refers to light and heat rather than the conceptual clarity of a conversation.
Synonyms: Burning (प्रज्वलित), Fiery (उग्र), Glowing (दमकता हुआ).
Antonyms: Extinguished (बुझा हुआ), Cold (ठंडा), Dim (मंद).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: ERADICATE
questionsEn.s:
ERADICATE - जड़ से मिटाना (To completely destroy or get rid of)
Emancipate - मुक्त करना (To set free from restrictions)
Annihilate - मिटा देना (To completely wipe out)
Conserve - संरक्षित करना (To protect or preserve from harm)
Devastate - तबाह करना (To cause severe damage)
Hence, 'conserve ' is the most suitable antonym for 'ERADICATE'.
oa:
This word means to set someone free from legal or social restrictions. It relates to liberation rather than the preservation or destruction of a physical or biological entity.
Synonyms: Liberate (मुक्त करना), Free (आज़ाद करना), Release (छोड़ना).
Antonyms: Enslave (गुलाम बनाना), Bind (बाँधना), Imprison (कैद करना).

This word means to completely destroy or wipe out something. It is a strong synonym for eradicate and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an antonym.
Synonyms: Obliterate (मिटाना), Destroy (नष्ट करना), Decimate (तहस-नहस).
Antonyms: Create (बनाना), Build (निर्माण), Save (बचाना).

This word means to protect and preserve something from harm, loss, or destruction. it is the direct and most appropriate antonym for eradicate.
Synonyms: Preserve (संरक्षित करना), Maintain (बनाए रखना), Safeguard (सुरक्षित रखना).
Antonyms: Eradicate (उन्मूलन करना), Destroy (नष्ट करना), Waste (गँवाना).

This word means to cause severe damage or destruction to something. Like annihilate, it describes the act of ruining rather than preserving, making it a synonym for the given word.
Synonyms: Ruin (बर्बाद करना), Wreck (तबाह करना), Desolate (उजाड़ना).
Antonyms: Restore (बहाल करना), Improve (सुधारना), Fix (ठीक करना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: CREDIBILITY
questionsEn.s:
CREDIBILITY - विश्वसनीयता (The quality that makes people believe you)
Serenity - शांति (Quality of being peaceful and calm)
Improbability - असंभावना (The quality of not being likely)
Integrity - सत्यनिष्ठा (Quality of being honest and moral)
Accuracy - शुद्धता (Ability to do something without mistakes)
Hence, 'improbability ' is the most suitable antonym for 'CREDIBILITY'.
oa:
This word refers to the quality of being peaceful and calm. It describes an emotional or environmental state and has no relation to the trustworthiness or probability of information.
Synonyms: Tranquility (शांति), Calmness (स्थिरता), Peace (सुकून).
Antonyms: Agitation (उत्तेजना), Turmoil (अशांति), Chaos (अराजकता).

This word refers to the quality of not being likely to happen or be true. it is the direct conceptual antonym for credibility, which implies being believable and likely.
Synonyms: Unlikelihood (असंभावना), Doubt (संदेह), Uncertainty (अनिश्चितता).
Antonyms: Probability (संभावना), Credibility (विश्वसनीयता), Likelihood (आसार).

This word refers to the quality of being honest and having strong moral principles. While it supports credibility, it is a synonym in that context rather than an opposite.
Synonyms: Honesty (ईमानदारी), Probity (सत्यनिष्ठा), Rectitude (शुचिता).
Antonyms: Corruption (भ्रष्टाचार), Dishonesty (बेईमानी), Deceit (छल).

This word refers to the ability to do something without making mistakes or the quality of being precise. It is a positive attribute aligned with credibility rather than being its antonym.
Synonyms: Precision (सटीकता), Correctness (शुद्धता), Exactness (निश्चितता).
Antonyms: Error (त्रुटि), Inaccuracy (अशुद्धता), Flaw (दोष).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: FRAIL
questionsEn.s:
FRAIL - दुर्बल (Physically weak or easily damaged)
Unreliable - अविश्वसनीय (That cannot be trusted or depended on)
Fresh - ताजा (Newly made or original state)
Robust - मजबूत (Strong and healthy; vigorous)
Fragile - नाज़ुक (Easily damaged or broken)
Hence, 'Robust ' is the most suitable antonym for 'FRAIL'.
oa:
This word describes something that cannot be trusted or depended on. it refers to a lack of reliability in performance or character rather than physical weakness or health.
Synonyms: Untrustworthy (अविश्वसनीय), Fickle (अस्थिर), Shifty (छली).
Antonyms: Reliable (भरोसेमंद), Dependable (विश्वसनीय), Constant (नियत).

This word describes something that is newly made or in its original vigorous state. While energy can be fresh, the word does not denote the physical strength required to oppose frail.
Synonyms: New (ताजा), Recent (नवीन), Untainted (शुद्ध).
Antonyms: Stale (बासी), Old (पुराना), Withered (मुरझाया).

This word means strong and healthy in a vigorous way. It is the direct and perfect antonym for frail, which implies being weak, delicate, and easily damaged.
Synonyms: Strong (मजबूत), Sturdy (तगड़ा), Vigorous (ऊर्जावान).
Antonyms: Frail (दुर्बल), Feeble (अशक्त), Weak (कमज़ोर).

This word means easily damaged or broken. It is a direct synonym for frail and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an antonym.
Synonyms: Delicate (नाज़ुक), Brittle (भंगुर), Flimsy (कमज़ोर).
Antonyms: Strong (मजबूत), Tough (कठोर), Robust (स्वस्थ).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: STORMY
questionsEn.s:
STORMY - अशांत/तूफानी (Involving angry argument or strong feeling)
Ferocious - उग्र (Very aggressive and violent)
Sporadic - अनियमित (Not done or happening regularly)
Serene - शांत (Calm, peaceful, and untroubled)
Rough - खुरदरा (Violent or not calm)
Hence, 'Serene ' is the most suitable antonym for 'STORMY'.
oa:
This word describes something very aggressive, violent, or frightening. it is a synonym for the "violent" aspect of being stormy and therefore cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Savage (क्रूर), Fierce (उग्र), Brutal (निष्ठुर).
Antonyms: Gentle (कोमल), Mild (नरम), Tame (पालतू).

This word means not done or happening regularly; occurring at scattered intervals. it describes frequency rather than the lack of turbulence or the presence of calm.
Synonyms: Intermittent (छिटपुट), Occasional (यदा-कदा), Infrequent (अनियमित).
Antonyms: Constant (नियमित), Regular (सामान्य), Continuous (निरंतर).

This word refers to being calm, peaceful, and untroubled. It is the direct environmental and emotional antonym for stormy, which involves conflict and strong feelings.
Synonyms: Calm (शांत), Tranquil (स्थिर), Placid (शांत).
Antonyms: Stormy (अशांत), Turbulent (विप्लवकारी), Agitated (उत्तेजित).

This word describes something violent, not calm, or having an uneven surface. It is a direct synonym for the conditions implied by "stormy" and not an opposite.
Synonyms: Rugged (खुरदरा), Harsh (कठोर), Coarse (रूखा).
Antonyms: Smooth (चिकना), Gentle (कोमल), Calm (शांत).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: MOIL
questionsEn.s:
MOIL - कठिन परिश्रम (To work hard; drudge)
Cultivate - विकसित करना (Try to develop a skill or prepare land)
Grow - बढ़ना (Become larger or greater over time)
Discourage - निरुत्साहित करना (Cause someone to lose confidence)
Work - कार्य (Activity involving effort for a purpose)
Hence, 'Discourage ' is the most suitable antonym for 'MOIL'.
oa:
This word means to try to acquire or develop a quality or to prepare land for crops. While it involves effort, it is an action of growth rather than the direct opposite of hard labor.
Synonyms: Foster (विकसित करना), Nurture (पोषित करना), Prepare (तैयार करना).
Antonyms: Neglect (उपेक्षा), Destroy (नष्ट), Abandon (त्याग).

This word means to become larger or greater over time. It describes a biological or numerical increase rather than the cessation or opposite of working hard.
Synonyms: Expand (बढ़ना), Increase (वृद्धि), Flourish (पनपना).
Antonyms: Shrink (सिकुड़ना), Decrease (घटना), Decline (कम होना).

This word means to cause someone to lose confidence or enthusiasm. in standard vocabulary testing, it acts as an opposite to moil (which can mean to move or work with enthusiasm/effort) by representing a dampening of spirit.
Synonyms: Dishearten (निरुत्साहित), Deter (रोकना), Dissuade (मना करना).
Antonyms: Encourage (प्रोत्साहित), Motivate (प्रेरित), Inspire (प्रेरणा देना).

This word refers to activity involving mental or physical effort. it is a direct synonym for moil (to work hard or drudge) and therefore cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Labor (परिश्रम), Toil (मेहनत), Drudgery (कठिन काम).
Antonyms: Rest (आराम), Play (खेल), Idle (बेकार बैठना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: OBEDIENT
questionsEn.s:
OBEDIENT - आज्ञाकारी (Willing to do what you are told)
Compliant - विनीत (Willing to do what is asked)
Submissive - दब्बू (Ready to conform to authority)
Cheery - प्रसन्न (Feeling or showing happiness)
Resistant - प्रतिरोधी (Not accepting or difficult to change)
Hence, 'Resistant ' is the most suitable antonym for 'OBEDIENT'.
oa:
This word describes someone who is willing to do what they are asked. It is a direct synonym for obedient and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an antonym.
Synonyms: Submissive (आज्ञाकारी), Cooperative (सहयोगी), Docile (विनम्र).
Antonyms: Defiant (अवज्ञाकारी), Resistant (प्रतिरोधी), Obstinate (हठी).

This word means being ready to conform to the authority of others. It is another synonym for obedient and represents the same quality of yielding to control.
Synonyms: Passive (विनम्र), Meek (नम्र), Yielding (झुकने वाला).
Antonyms: Assertive (मुखर), Dominant (प्रभावी), Rebellious (विद्रोही).

This word means feeling or showing happiness. It describes a bright emotional state and has no relation to the willingness to follow rules or authority.
Synonyms: Happy (प्रसन्न), Bright (खुशमिजाज), Joyful (आनंदित).
Antonyms: Gloomy (उदास), Sad (दुखी), Morose (बदमिज़ाज).

This word refers to not accepting something or being difficult to change. It is the direct functional opposite of being obedient, which involve yielding and following.
Synonyms: Defiant (विद्रोही), Opposing (विरोधी), Unyielding (अटल).
Antonyms: Obedient (आज्ञाकारी), Compliant (सहमत), Docile (विनम्र).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: EVIDENT
questionsEn.s:
EVIDENT - स्पष्ट (Clearly seen or understood)
Obvious - प्रत्यक्ष (Easily seen or recognized)
Indistinct - अस्पष्ट (Not clear or sharply defined)
Stubborn - हठी (Refusing to do anything else)
Irritable - चिड़चिड़ा (Easily annoyed)
Hence, 'Indistinct ' is the most suitable antonym for 'EVIDENT'.
oa:
This word means easily seen, recognized, or understood. It is a direct synonym for evident and therefore does not provide an opposite meaning.
Synonyms: Clear (स्पष्ट), Manifest (प्रकट), Explicit (सुस्पष्ट).
Antonyms: Hidden (छिपा हुआ), Vague (अस्पष्ट), Obscure (धुंधला).

This word refers to something that is not clear or not sharply defined. It is the direct and most accurate antonym for evident (which means clearly seen).
Synonyms: Blurry (धुंधला), Vague (अस्पष्ट), Obscure (दुर्बोध).
Antonyms: Evident (स्पष्ट), Clear (साफ), Distinct (निश्चित).

This word describes someone determined to do what they want and refusing to change. it refers to a personality trait regarding will rather than the clarity of an observation.
Synonyms: Obstinate (हठी), Adamant (अडिग), Headstrong (जिद्दी).
Antonyms: Flexible (लचीला), Compliant (विनम्र), Yielding (झुकने वाला).

This word means having a tendency to be easily annoyed. It describes a temperamental state and has no relation to how clearly a fact or object is perceived.
Synonyms: Grumpy (चिड़चिड़ा), Peevish (चिड़चिड़ा), Testy (बदमिज़ाज).
Antonyms: Amiable (सुशील), Patient (धैर्यवान), Calm (शांत).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: MUNDANE
questionsEn.s:
MUNDANE - साधारण (Lacking interest or excitement; dull)
Standard - मानक (A level of quality or attainment)
Temporal - सांसारिक (Relating to worldly affairs)
Customary - व्यावहारिक (According to custom or usual)
Exceptional - असाधारण (Unusual, rare, or outstanding)
Hence, 'exceptional ' is the most suitable antonym for 'MUNDANE'.
oa:
This word refers to a level of quality or attainment or being normal. it is a near-synonym for the "ordinary" aspect of mundane and not its antonym.
Synonyms: Conventional (सामान्य), Routine (मानक), Usual (अमूमन).
Antonyms: Irregular (अनियमित), Unusual (असामान्य), Unique (अद्वितीय).

This word means relating to worldly as opposed to spiritual affairs. Since mundane also means worldly, this is a synonym and not an opposite.
Synonyms: Secular (लौकिक), Terrestrial (सांसारिक), Earthly (पार्थिव).
Antonyms: Spiritual (आध्यात्मिक), Eternal (शाश्वत), Heavenly (दिव्य).

This word means according to custom or being usual. it acts as a synonym for the "routine" nature of mundane things rather than providing an opposite.
Synonyms: Traditional (व्यावहारिक), Usual (प्रचलित), Habitual (आदतन).
Antonyms: Exceptional (असाधारण), Rare (दुर्लभ), Novel (नवीन).

This word refers to something unusual, outstanding, or impressive. It is the direct and perfect antonym for mundane, which implies something dull and ordinary.
Synonyms: Extraordinary (असाधारण), Remarkable (उल्लेखनीय), Outstanding (बेमिसाल).
Antonyms: Mundane (साधारण), Common (सामान्य), Normal (औसत).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: AGITATE
questionsEn.s:
AGITATE - उत्तेजित करना (To make someone feel anxious or troubled)
Blame - दोष देना (To hold responsible for a fault)
Strike - प्रहार/हड़ताल (To hit or refuse to work)
Distress - कष्ट (To cause worry or upset)
Soothe - शांत करना (To calm or relieve anxiety)
Hence, 'Soothe ' is the most suitable antonym for 'AGITATE'.
oa:
This word means to hold someone responsible for a fault or wrong. It describes a moral or legal assignment of responsibility rather than a mental or physical state of disturbance.
Synonyms: Accuse (दोष देना), Censure (निंदा), Condemn (तिरस्कार).
Antonyms: Praise (प्रशंसा), Exonerate (बरी करना), Forgive (क्षमा).

This word means to hit with force or to refuse to work as a protest. While a strike involves agitation, the word itself is a specific action rather than an opposite of disturbance.
Synonyms: Hit (प्रहार), Attack (हमला), Protest (हड़ताल).
Antonyms: Tap (थपथपाना), Surrender (समर्पण), Support (सहयोग).

This word means to cause someone to feel worried or upset. it is a synonym for the result of being agitated and therefore cannot be its antonym.
Synonyms: Upset (कष्ट), Agonize (पीड़ा), Trouble (परेशान).
Antonyms: Comfort (आराम), Soothe (शांत), Please (खुश).

This word means to gently calm someone or their feelings or to relieve pain. it is the direct functional and emotional antonym for agitate (to disturb).
Synonyms: Calm (शांत करना), Relieve (राहत देना), Pacify (दिलासा देना).
Antonyms: Agitate (उत्तेजित करना), Irritate (चिढ़ाना), Provoke (उकसाना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: INSATIABLE
questionsEn.s:
INSATIABLE - अतृप्त (That cannot be satisfied)
Urgent - अत्यावश्यक (Needing immediate attention)
Fulfilled - संतुष्ट (Feeling happy and satisfied)
Greedy - लालची (Wanting more than needed)
Insistent - हठी (Continuing in a way that cannot be ignored)
Hence, 'fulfilled ' is the most suitable antonym for 'INSATIABLE'.
oa:
This word means needing immediate attention or action. It describes the timing and importance of a situation rather than the nature of a desire or whether it can be satisfied.
Synonyms: Pressing (अत्यावश्यक), Crucial (महत्वपूर्ण), Immediate (तुरंत).
Antonyms: Trivial (तुच्छ), Unimportant (महत्वहीन), Deferred (स्थगित).

This word refers to feeling happy and satisfied because one's needs or desires have been met. It is the direct emotional and logical opposite of being insatiable.
Synonyms: Satisfied (संतुष्ट), Content (प्रसन्न), Gratified (कृतज्ञ).
Antonyms: Insatiable (अतृप्त), Greedy (लालची), Discontent (असंतुष्ट).

This word means wanting more of something than you really need. it is a characteristic associated with having an insatiable appetite and acts as a synonym.
Synonyms: Covetous (लोभी), Avaricious (लालची), Rapacious (भक्षक).
Antonyms: Generous (उदार), Selfless (निःस्वार्थ), Content (संतुष्ट).

This word means continuing for a long time in a way that cannot be ignored. While a desire can be insistent, the word describes persistence rather than the capacity for satisfaction.
Synonyms: Persistent (हठी), Firm (दृढ़), Tenacious (ज़िद्दी).
Antonyms: Relenting (कोमल), Hesitant (दुविधापूर्ण), Indifferent (उदासीन).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: ALLEVIATE
questionsEn.s:
ALLEVIATE - कम करना (To make something less strong or bad)
Soothe - शांत करना (To make calmer or comfort someone)
Ameliorate - सुधारना (To make something better)
Aggravate - बिगाड़ना (To make something worse or more serious)
Destroy - नष्ट करना (To damage so badly it ceases to exist)
Hence, 'Aggravate ' is the most suitable antonym for 'ALLEVIATE'.
oa:
This word means to make someone calmer or to relieve pain. it is a direct synonym for alleviate and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an antonym.
Synonyms: Relieve (राहत देना), Ease (आराम देना), Pacify (शांत करना).
Antonyms: Aggravate (बिगाड़ना), Irritate (चिढ़ाना), Provoke (उत्तेजित).

This word means to make something bad or unsatisfactory better. it is another synonym for the positive improvement implied by alleviate.
Synonyms: Improve (सुधारना), Enhance (बढ़ाना), Better (बेहतर करना).
Antonyms: Worsen (बिगाड़ना), Deteriorate (खराब होना), Harm (नुकसान).

This word means to make a problem, injury, or situation worse or more serious. it is the direct and perfect antonym for alleviate, which involves lessening severity.
Synonyms: Worsen (बिगाड़ना), Exacerbate (बदतर करना), Inflame (उत्तेजित करना).
Antonyms: Alleviate (कम करना), Soothe (शांत करना), Mitigate (हल्का करना).

This word means to damage something so badly that it can no longer be used or exists. While extreme, it refers to total annihilation rather than the simple worsening of a condition.
Synonyms: Ruin (नष्ट करना), Demolish (ध्वस्त करना), Wipe out (मिटाना).
Antonyms: Create (बनाना), Build (निर्माण), Restore (बहाल).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: IMPROVIDENT
questionsEn.s:
IMPROVIDENT - बेपरवाह/अविवेकी (Lacking foresight; wasteful)
Tardy - विलंब (Habitually late or delayed)
Thrifty - मितव्ययी (Showing care in managing resources)
Cautious - सतर्क (Exercising care to avoid risk)
Hungry - भूखा (Experiencing a desire for food)
Hence, 'Thrifty' is the most suitable antonym for 'IMPROVIDENT'.
oa:
This word means habitually late or delayed. While it describes a negative habit, it refers to punctuality rather than the lack of financial or situational foresight.
Synonyms: Late (विलंब), Overdue (देर), Behindhand (पिछड़ा).
Antonyms: Punctual (समय पर), Early (जल्दी), Prompt (शीघ्र).

This word refers to showing care and wisdom in managing resources, especially money. It is the direct and logical antonym for improvident (wasteful).
Synonyms: Frugal (मितव्ययी), Economical (किफायती), Sparing (अल्पव्ययी).
Antonyms: Improvident (बेपरवाह), Extravagant (फिजूलखर्च), Wasteful (अपव्ययी).

This word means exercising care to avoid potential risks. While thrifty people are cautious, this word is more general and refers to safety rather than specifically to resource management.
Synonyms: Careful (सतर्क), Wary (सावधान), Vigilant (चौकस).
Antonyms: Rash (अविवेकपूर्ण), Reckless (लापरवाह), Daring (साहसी).

This word refers to experiencing a desire for food. it describes a biological need and has no conceptual relation to the wisdom or lack of it in managing affairs.
Synonyms: Famished (भूखा), Ravenous (अत्यधिक भूखा), Starving (भूखमरी).
Antonyms: Satiated (तृप्त), Full (भरा हुआ), Fed (खिलाया हुआ).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: PERILOUS
questionsEn.s:
PERILOUS - खतरनाक (Full of danger or risk)
Verbose - वाचाल (Utilizing more words than required)
Unstable - अस्थिर (Likely to give way; not constant)
Cruel - निर्दयी (Wilfully causing pain or suffering)
Safe - सुरक्षित (Not exposed to danger or risk)
Hence, 'Safe ' is the most suitable antonym for 'PERILOUS'.
oa:
This word refers to using or expressing more words than are required. it describes a style of communication and has no connection to safety or danger.
Synonyms: Wordy (वाचाल), Talkative (बातूनी), Garrulous (बड़बड़िया).
Antonyms: Laconic (संक्षिप्त), Succinct (सारगर्भित), Concise (छोटा).

This word describes something that is likely to give way or not be constant. It is a near-synonym for a perilous situation and therefore not an antonym.
Synonyms: Shaky (अस्थिर), Precarious (डाँवाँडोल), Variable (परिवर्तनशील).
Antonyms: Stable (स्थिर), Steady (नियमित), Secure (सुरक्षित).

This word means willfully causing pain or suffering to others. it describes a moral or behavioral wickedness rather than the environmental or situational risk of danger.
Synonyms: Brutal (निर्दयी), Heartless (निष्ठुर), Ruthless (क्रूर).
Antonyms: Kind (दयालु), Compassionate (सहानुभूतिपूर्ण), Humane (मानवीय).

This word refers to being protected from or not exposed to danger or risk. It is the direct and perfect antonym for perilous, which means full of danger.
Synonyms: Secure (सुरक्षित), Protected (बचा हुआ), Harmless (हानिरहित).
Antonyms: Perilous (खतरनाक), Dangerous (भयानक), Risky (जोखिम भरा).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: ENLIGHTENED
questionsEn.s:
ENLIGHTENED - प्रबुद्ध (Having a well-informed outlook)
Civilised - सभ्य (Polite and well-mannered)
Educated - शिक्षित (Having acquired knowledge)
Confounded - भ्रमित (Confused, bewildered, or perplexed)
Reasonable - उचित (Fair, sensible, and logical)
Hence, 'Confounded ' is the most suitable antonym for 'ENLIGHTENED'.
oa:
This word refers to people who are polite and have an advanced culture. It is often a synonym for enlightened and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an opposite.
Synonyms: Cultured (सभ्य), Refined (शिष्ट), Advanced (उन्नत).
Antonyms: Barbaric (असभ्य), Primitive (आदिम), Ignorant (अज्ञानी).

This word means having acquired knowledge through formal schooling. Since education is a path to becoming enlightened, the word is a synonym and not an antonym.
Synonyms: Learned (शिक्षित), Schooled (पढ़ा-लिखा), Literate (साक्षर).
Antonyms: Illiterate (अनपढ़), Ignorant (अज्ञानी), Uneducated (अशिक्षित).

This word refers to being confused, bewildered, or perplexed. It represents a lack of understanding or clarity, making it the best antonym for being enlightened (well-informed/aware).
Synonyms: Baffled (भ्रमित), Puzzled (चकित), Bewildered (हैरान).
Antonyms: Enlightened (प्रबुद्ध), Informed (सूचित), Aware (सचेत).

This word means being fair, sensible, and logical. this is a characteristic of an enlightened mind and acts as a synonym rather than an opposite.
Synonyms: Logical (उचित), Rational (तार्किक), Sensible (समझदार).
Antonyms: Unreasonable (अनुचित), Irrational (अतार्किक), Ridiculous (बेतुका).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: OVERRUN
questionsEn.s:
OVERRUN - हावी होना (To spread all over or occupy by force)
Surrender - हार मान लेना (To stop fighting and admit defeat)
Inundate - सराबोर करना (To overwhelm with things or people)
Storm - आक्रमण (To attack violently or bad weather)
Invade - आक्रमण करना (To enter a country to attack)
Hence, 'Surrender ' is the most suitable antonym for 'OVERRUN'.
oa:
This word means to stop fighting and admit defeat. In the context of being "overrun" (conquered or occupied by force), surrendering represents the act of giving up control, serving as a functional antonym.
Synonyms: Yield (हार मान लेना), Capitulate (समर्पण करना), Relinquish (त्यागना).
Antonyms: Overrun (हावी होना), Resist (विरोध करना), Conquer (जीतना).

This word means to overwhelm or flood something with too many things. It is a direct synonym for overrun and therefore cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Overwhelm (अभिभूत), Flood (बाढ़ आना), Swamp (सराबोर).
Antonyms: Drain (खाली करना), Deplete (कम करना), Clear (साफ).

This word refers to a violent attack or bad weather. as a verb of aggression, it is similar in meaning to overrun (to attack and take control) and not an antonym.
Synonyms: Assault (आक्रमण), Attack (हमला), Charge (धावा).
Antonyms: Defend (रक्षा), Retreat (वापसी), Protect (बचाना).

This word means to enter a country with an army to attack it. it is a direct synonym for the process of overrunning a place and cannot be used as an antonym.
Synonyms: Occupy (आक्रमण करना), Encroach (अतिक्रमण), Raid (छापा मारना).
Antonyms: Evacuate (खाली करना), Leave (छोड़ना), Exit (निकलना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: IMPURE
questionsEn.s:
IMPURE - अशुद्ध (Not pure or clean; mixed substances)
Contaminated - प्रदूषित (Made dirty or harmful)
Segregated - अलग (Set apart from the rest)
Sterile - स्वच्छ/बाँझ (Completely clean or free from bacteria)
Concentrated - सांद्रित (Stronger due to removal of liquid)
Hence, 'Sterile ' is the most suitable antonym for 'IMPURE'.
oa:
This word means made dirty or harmful by exposure to a substance. It is a direct synonym for impure and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an antonym.
Synonyms: Polluted (प्रदूषित), Tainted (दूषित), Soiled (मैला).
Antonyms: Pure (शुद्ध), Clean (साफ), Purified (निर्मल).

This word refers to being set apart from the rest of a group. while it involves separation, it does not describe the quality of cleanliness or purity required to oppose impure.
Synonyms: Separated (अलग), Isolated (पृथक), Detached (जुदा).
Antonyms: Integrated (एकीकृत), Combined (संयुक्त), United (एकत्र).

This word means completely clean and free from bacteria, or unable to produce offspring. it represents the ultimate state of purity and cleanliness, making it a suitable antonym.
Synonyms: Antiseptic (जीवाणुरहित), Clean (साफ), Pure (शुद्ध).
Antonyms: Impure (अशुद्ध), Contaminated (दूषित), Dirty (गंदा).

This word refers to a substance made stronger by removing water or being determined. It describes density and focus rather than the level of contamination or purity.
Synonyms: Condensed (सांद्रित), Intense (प्रबल), Focused (केंद्रित).
Antonyms: Diluted (पतला), Weak (कमज़ोर), Diffuse (बिखरा हुआ).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: STURDY
questionsEn.s:
STURDY - मजबूत (Strong and healthy; not easily broken)
Delicate - नाज़ुक (Easy to damage or break)
Dragging - थका हुआ (Extremely tired or slow)
Tiny - छोटा (Very small in size)
Drab - नीरस (Not interesting or attractive)
Hence, 'Delicate ' is the most suitable antonym for 'STURDY'.
oa:
This word describes something that is easy to damage or break. It is the direct and most accurate antonym for sturdy, which implies strength and durability.
Synonyms: Fragile (नाज़ुक), Frail (दुर्बल), Flimsy (कमज़ोर).
Antonyms: Sturdy (मजबूत), Robust (दृढ़), Strong (शक्तिशाली).

This word describes being extremely tired or moving slowly. it refers to physical exhaustion or pace rather than the structural strength or health of an object or person.
Synonyms: Exhausting (थका देने वाला), Slow (धीमा), Weary (पस्त).
Antonyms: Energetic (ऊर्जावान), Quick (तेज़), Brisk (फुरतीला).

This word means very small in size. while a tiny thing might be weak, the word describes physical dimensions rather than the lack of strength or robustness.
Synonyms: Small (छोटा), Minute (सूक्ष्म), Petite (नन्हा).
Antonyms: Huge (विशाल), Massive (विराट), Big (बड़ा).

This word describes something that is not interesting, attractive, or lacks brightness. It refers to visual appeal or excitement rather than physical strength.
Synonyms: Dull (फीका), Boring (नीरस), Unattractive (अनाकर्षक).
Antonyms: Bright (चमकीला), Vivid (सजीव), Interesting (रोचक).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: MINIATURE
questionsEn.s:
MINIATURE - बहुत छोटा (Much smaller than the usual size)
Teeny - छोटा (Small or little; tiny)
Mammoth - विशाल (Very big or gigantic)
Average - सामान्य (Normal or typical in size)
Minuscule - अति सूक्ष्म (Extremely small)
Hence, 'Mammoth ' is the most suitable antonym for 'MINIATURE'.
oa:
This word means very small or little. it is a direct synonym for miniature and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an antonym.
Synonyms: Tiny (छोटा), Small (नन्हा), Minute (सूक्ष्म).
Antonyms: Huge (विशाल), Large (बड़ा), Big (बड़ा).

This word means extremely large or huge. It serves as a perfect antonym for miniature, which describes something much smaller than the usual size.
Synonyms: Gigantic (विशाल), Enormous (अत्यधिक), Colossal (विशालकाय).
Antonyms: Miniature (छोटा), Tiny (सूक्ष्म), Small (छोटा).

This word refers to being normal or typical in size or quantity. it describes a middle point rather than the extreme large size required to oppose miniature.
Synonyms: Standard (सामान्य), Normal (साधारण), Moderate (मध्यम).
Antonyms: Exceptional (असाधारण), Tiny (छोटा), Huge (विशाल).

This word means extremely small. Like teeny, it is a synonym for miniature and describes things that are very tiny.
Synonyms: Tiny (अति सूक्ष्म), Little (छोटा), Infinitesimal (नन्हा).
Antonyms: Immense (विशाल), Large (बड़ा), Vast (विस्तृत).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: VICIOUS
questionsEn.s:
VICIOUS - क्रूर (Cruel; done in order to hurt someone)
Influential - प्रभावशाली (Having power or influence)
Gentle - सज्जन (Kind and calm; treating with care)
Privileged - सौभाग्यशाली (Having special advantages)
Poor - गरीब (Not having enough money)
Hence, 'Gentle ' is the most suitable antonym for 'VICIOUS'.
oa:
This word describes someone who has the power to change or affect things. it refers to social or political power rather than the moral quality of kindness or cruelty.
Synonyms: Powerful (प्रभावशाली), Important (महत्वपूर्ण), Authoritative (अधिकारिक).
Antonyms: Weak (कमज़ोर), Powerless (अशक्त), Ineffective (बेकार).

This word refers to people who are kind, calm, and treat others with care. It is the direct behavioral antonym for vicious, which involves being cruel or violent.
Synonyms: Kind (सज्जन), Tender (कोमल), Mild (सौम्य).
Antonyms: Vicious (क्रूर), Harsh (कठोर), Brutal (निष्ठुर).

This word describes having an advantage or opportunity that most people do not have. it refers to social status or wealth rather than the act of being kind or cruel.
Synonyms: Advantaged (सौभाग्यशाली), Elite (विशिष्ट), Wealthy (संपन्न).
Antonyms: Deprived (वंचित), Poor (गरीब), Underprivileged (पिछड़ा).

This word means not having enough money or being of low quality. it refers to financial status and does not address the violent or cruel nature of an action or person.
Synonyms: Destitute (गरीब), Needy (ज़रूरतमंद), Penniless (कंगाल).
Antonyms: Rich (अमीर), Wealthy (धनी), Affluent (संपन्न).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: UNFEIGNED
questionsEn.s:
UNFEIGNED - वास्तविक (Devoid of hypocrisy; genuine)
Sincere - ईमानदार (Not pretending or lying)
Genuine - सच्चा (Authentic and honest)
Pretended - ढोंग (Behaving in a way to make others believe a lie)
Expressive - भावभरा (Showing feelings or thoughts clearly)
Hence, 'Pretended ' is the most suitable antonym for 'UNFEIGNED'.
oa:
This word means not pretending or lying; it involves being honest and genuine. It is a direct synonym for unfeigned and therefore not an antonym.
Synonyms: Honest (ईमानदार), Genuine (सच्चा), Frank (निष्कपट).
Antonyms: Deceitful (धोखेबाज), Fake (नकली), Feigned (बनावटी).

This word refers to being real, true, and worthy of trust. Like sincere, it shares the same meaning as unfeigned and does not provide an opposite.
Synonyms: Authentic (वास्तविक), True (असली), Original (मौलिक).
Antonyms: Counterfeit (जाली), False (झूठा), Pretended (दिखावटी).

This word refers to behaving in a way to make others believe something that is not true. It is the perfect antonym for unfeigned (real/not faked).
Synonyms: Fake (दिखावटी), Insincere (बनावटी), Mock (ढोंग करना).
Antonyms: Unfeigned (वास्तविक), Sincere (ईमानदार), Genuine (सच्चा).

This word describes something or someone that effectively shows feelings or thoughts. it refers to the clarity of expression rather than the truthfulness of the emotion.
Synonyms: Eloquent (भावपूर्ण), Vivid (सजीव), Graphic (स्पष्ट).
Antonyms: Dull (नीरस), Expressionless (भावहीन), Mute (मूक).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: INSECURE
questionsEn.s:
INSECURE - असुरक्षित (Uncertain or anxious about oneself)
Suspicious - संदिग्ध (Feeling doubt or mistrust)
Anxious - चिंतित (Feeling worried or nervous)
Massive - विशाल (Large and heavy or solid)
Confident - आत्मविश्वासी (Feeling or showing certainty in oneself)
Hence, 'Confident ' is the most suitable antonym for 'INSECURE'.
oa:
This word refers to having a feeling of doubt or mistrust toward someone. it describes a state of questioning others rather than a lack of confidence in oneself.
Synonyms: Doubtful (संदिग्ध), Sceptical (शंकालु), Wary (सतर्क).
Antonyms: Trusting (विश्वासी), Confident (निश्चित), Gullible (भोला).

This word describes feeling worried, nervous, or uneasy. It is a direct symptom or synonym for being insecure and therefore cannot be its antonym.
Synonyms: Worried (चिंतित), Uneasy (बेचैन), Apprehensive (शंकित).
Antonyms: Calm (शांत), Composed (स्थिर), Relaxed (निश्चिंत).

This word describes something that is extremely large and heavy. it refers to physical size or scale and has no linguistic connection to the feeling of insecurity.
Synonyms: Enormous (विशाल), Huge (विराट), Colossal (विशालकाय).
Antonyms: Tiny (छोटा), Small (नन्हा), Minuscule (अति सूक्ष्म).

This word refers to feeling or showing certainty in oneself and one's abilities. it is the direct and perfect antonym for being insecure.
Synonyms: Sure (आत्मविश्वासी), Positive (निश्चित), Self-assured (भरोसेमंद).
Antonyms: Insecure (असुरक्षित), Doubtful (शंकित), Diffident (संकोची).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: RESOLUTE
questionsEn.s:
RESOLUTE - दृढ़ (Admirably purposeful and determined)
Inflexible - अटल (Unwilling to change or compromise)
Sluggish - सुस्त (Lacking energy or alertness)
Barbaric - बर्बर (Savagely cruel or primitive)
Wavering - अस्थिर (Becoming weaker or faltering)
Hence, 'wavering ' is the most suitable antonym for 'RESOLUTE'.
oa:
This word means unwilling to change or compromise one's views. It is a synonym for the determined nature of being resolute and is not an opposite.
Synonyms: Adamant (अडिग), Rigid (कठोर), Unyielding (अटल).
Antonyms: Flexible (लचीला), Pliable (नम्य), Yielding (झुकने वाला).

This word describes lacking energy, alertness, or moving slowly. it refers to pace and vitality rather than the firmness of a person's purpose or belief.
Synonyms: Lethargic (सुस्त), Slow (धीमा), Inactive (निष्क्रिय).
Antonyms: Energetic (ऊर्जावान), Active (सक्रिय), Brisk (तेज़).

This word refers to being savagely cruel, primitive, or unsophisticated. it describes moral or social standards rather than the determination of a person's will.
Synonyms: Brutal (क्रूर), Savage (बर्बर), Vicious (निष्ठुर).
Antonyms: Civilized (सभ्य), Humane (मानवीय), Kind (दयालु).

This word means becoming weaker, faltering, or being unable to make a decision. It is the perfect antonym for being resolute (purposeful and unwavering).
Synonyms: Faltering (अस्थिर), Indecisive (दुविधापूर्ण), Vacillating (डगमगाता हुआ).
Antonyms: Resolute (दृढ़), Determined (कृतसंकल्प), Steadfast (अडिग).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: BRASHNESS
questionsEn.s:
BRASHNESS - धृष्टता (Confident actions that are disrespectful)
Intelligence - बुद्धिमत्ता (Ability to understand and think)
Nerve - घबराहट/साहस (Nervous feelings or boldness)
Timidity - भीरुता (State of being shy and uneasy)
Boldness - साहस (Fearless display of bravery)
Hence, 'Timidity ' is the most suitable antonym for 'BRASHNESS'.
oa:
This word refers to the ability to understand, learn, and think. While intelligence helps in making better social choices, it is not a direct opposite of acting boldly or rudely.
Synonyms: Cleverness (बुद्धिमत्ता), Wisdom (बुद्धि), Intellect (मेधा).
Antonyms: Stupidity (मूर्खता), Ignorance (अज्ञानता), Folly (बेवकूफी).

This word refers to worried, nervous feelings or can mean boldness. in the context of feeling, it is a negative state but not the humble opposite required for brashness.
Synonyms: Anxiety (घबराहट), Courage (साहस), Audacity (धृष्टता).
Antonyms: Calmness (स्थिरता), Peace (शांति), Confidence (विश्वास).

This word refers to a state of being shy, easily frightened, or lacking confidence. It is the direct behavioral opposite of brashness (bold and disrespectful confidence).
Synonyms: Shyness (संकोच), Meekness (नम्रता), Diffidence (भीरुता).
Antonyms: Brashness (धृष्टता), Boldness (साहस), Audacity (बेशर्मी).

This word refers to a fearless display of bravery or self-assurance. it is a near-synonym for the "bold" aspect of brashness and therefore cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Bravery (बहादुरी), Courage (साहस), Audacity (निर्भीकता).
Antonyms: Timidity (कायरता), Fear (डर), Cowardice (भीरुता).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: HIDEOUS
questionsEn.s:
HIDEOUS - भयानक (Offensive, extremely ugly, or shocking)
Disgusting - घृणित (Extremely unpleasant or unacceptable)
Shocking - चौंकाने वाला (Causing indignation or disgust)
Attractive - आकर्षक (Arousing interest or pleasure; charming)
Ghastly - भयंकर (Horrifying and repellent in appearance)
Hence, 'Attractive ' is the most suitable antonym for 'HIDEOUS'.
oa:
This word refers to something extremely unpleasant or unacceptable to the senses. It is a synonym for hideous and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an antonym.
Synonyms: Revolting (घृणित), Repulsive (अरुचिकर), Vile (नीच).
Antonyms: Pleasant (सुखद), Delightful (सुहावना), Attractive (आकर्षक).

This word refers to causing indignation, disgust, or surprise. like hideous, it describes something that is very offensive or disturbing, acting as a synonym.
Synonyms: Appalling (चौंकाने वाला), Horrific (भयानक), Stunning (स्तब्धकारी).
Antonyms: Expected (अपेक्षित), Normal (सामान्य), Calming (शांतिदायक).

This word means pleasing or appealing to the senses; charming. It is the direct visual and sensory antonym for hideous, which means repulsively ugly.
Synonyms: Beautiful (आकर्षक), Charming (मनोहर), Pretty (सुंदर).
Antonyms: Hideous (भयानक), Ugly (कुरूप), Repulsive (घृणित).

This word describes something horrifying and repellent in appearance. it is a synonym for the extreme ugliness and shock associated with being hideous.
Synonyms: Gruesome (भयंकर), Horrible (भीषण), Grim (विकट).
Antonyms: Pleasant (सुखद), Wonderful (अद्भुत), Beautiful (सुंदर).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: LAUDABLE
questionsEn.s:
LAUDABLE - प्रशंसनीय (Deserving of praise and commendation)
Noticeable - ध्यान देने योग्य (Easily seen or noticed)
Precious - कीमती (Something of great value)
Commendable - सराहनीय (Worthy of high praise)
Disrespected - अपमानित (Shown a lack of respect; insulted)
Hence, 'Disrespected ' is the most suitable antonym for 'LAUDABLE'.
oa:
This word describes something easily seen or noticed. while a laudable act can be noticeable, the word refers to visibility rather than the quality of deserving praise.
Synonyms: Clear (ध्यान देने योग्य), Apparent (स्पष्ट), Obvious (प्रत्यक्ष).
Antonyms: Hidden (छिपा हुआ), Obscure (अस्पष्ट), Inconspicuous (अगोचर).

This word refers to something of great value or importance. While laudable things are valuable, "precious" refers to worth and rarity rather than the moral opposite of praise.
Synonyms: Valuable (कीमती), Prized (बहुमूल्य), Cherished (प्यारा).
Antonyms: Worthless (बेकार), Cheap (सस्ता), Common (साधारण).

This word means worthy of high praise. it is a direct synonym for laudable and therefore cannot be used as its antonym.
Synonyms: Praiseworthy (सराहनीय), Admirable (प्रशंसनीय), Meritorious (गुणी).
Antonyms: Despicable (निंदनीय), Blameworthy (दोषी), Poor (घटिया).

This word means being shown a lack of respect or being insulted. It serves as an appropriate functional antonym for laudable (which implies gaining praise/respect).
Synonyms: Insulted (अपमानित), Scorned (तिरस्कृत), Slighted (उपेक्षित).
Antonyms: Respected (सम्मानित), Praised (प्रशंसनीय), Honored (माननीय).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: IRRELEVANT
questionsEn.s:
IRRELEVANT - अप्रासंगिक (Not related or significant to something)
Reluctant - अनिच्छुक (Hesitating or unwilling to do something)
Meaningful - अर्थपूर्ण (Useful, significant, or fascinating)
Meagre - अल्प (Too little of a quantity)
Incidental - प्रासंगिक (Occurring as a minor component)
Hence, 'Meaningful ' is the most suitable antonym for 'IRRELEVANT'.
oa:
This word describes someone who is hesitant or unwilling to do something. It refers to a person's willingness rather than the logical connection of an idea to a topic.
Synonyms: Unwilling (अनिच्छुक), Hesitant (झिझकने वाला), Disinclined (विमुख).
Antonyms: Eager (उत्सुक), Willing (तैयार), Ready (तत्पर).

This word refers to something that is useful, significant, or has a serious purpose. it is the direct logical opposite of irrelevant, which means not related or insignificant.
Synonyms: Significant (अर्थपूर्ण), Relevant (प्रासंगिक), Vital (महत्वपूर्ण).
Antonyms: Irrelevant (अप्रासंगिक), Trivial (तुच्छ), Minor (मामूली).

This word refers to an amount that is too small or insufficient. it describes quantity or quality rather than the topical relation of an argument or rule.
Synonyms: Scanty (अल्प), Paltry (तुच्छ), Sparse (थोड़ा).
Antonyms: Abundant (प्रचुर), Plentiful (भरपूर), Copious (अत्यधिक).

This word means occurring as a minor accompaniment to something more important. it is a near-synonym for irrelevant in certain contexts and not its opposite.
Synonyms: Secondary (प्रासंगिक), Minor (मामूली), Occasional (यदा-कदा).
Antonyms: Primary (मुख्य), Essential (आवश्यक), Fundamental (मौलिक).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: IMPRESSIVE
questionsEn.s:
IMPRESSIVE - प्रभावशाली (Arousing admiration and respect)
Dramatic - नाटकीय (Conspicuous, abrupt, and surprising)
Significant - महत्वपूर्ण (Huge or important enough to be noticed)
Ordinary - साधारण (Typical; not unique or special)
Industrious - परिश्रमी (Always working hard; diligent)
Hence, 'Ordinary ' is the most suitable antonym for 'IMPRESSIVE'.
oa:
This word means conspicuous, sudden, or surprising. While an impressive event can be dramatic, the word is a synonym for the intensity of the effect and not an opposite.
Synonyms: Conspicuous (नाटकीय), Striking (प्रभावशाली), Vivid (सजीव).
Antonyms: Ordinary (साधारण), Dull (नीरस), Unexciting (फीका).

This word refers to something large or important enough to be noticed. it is a synonym for impressive and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an antonym.
Synonyms: Momentous (महत्वपूर्ण), Vital (अनिवार्य), Substantial (मजबूत).
Antonyms: Trivial (तुच्छ), Insignificant (नगण्य), Minor (मामूली).

This word refers to being normal, typical, and having no special or distinctive features. It is the direct opposite of impressive, which implies being exceptional.
Synonyms: Typical (साधारण), Common (सामान्य), Average (औसत).
Antonyms: Impressive (प्रभावशाली), Remarkable (असाधारण), Unique (अद्वितीय).

This word describes a person who is always working hard and exerting effort. it refers to a person's work ethic rather than the quality of an object or achievement being impressive.
Synonyms: Hardworking (परिश्रमी), Diligent (मेहनती), Assiduous (तत्पर).
Antonyms: Lazy (आलसी), Idle (बेकार), Indolent (सुस्त).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: FLARED
questionsEn.s:
FLARED - चमकना (A sudden burst of light)
Darkened - अंधेरा (Having no light or being made dark)
Radiated - निकलना (Energy being emitted in rays)
Flamed - प्रज्वलित (To burn and give off flames)
Glared - चमक (To shine with a strong or dazzling light)
Hence, 'Darkened ' is the most suitable antonym for 'FLARED'.
oa:
This word means having no light or being made dark. It is the direct logical opposite of flared, which involves a sudden and bright burst of light.
Synonyms: Obscured (अंधेरा), Dimmed (धुंधला), Shadowed (छायादार).
Antonyms: Flared (चमकना), Illuminated (प्रकाशित), Brightened (चमकीला).

This word means energy being emitted in the form of waves or rays. it is a synonym for the process of light or heat spreading out, much like a flare.
Synonyms: Emitted (निकलना), Shed (चमकना), Diffused (फैलना).
Antonyms: Absorbed (सोखना), Contained (भीतर रखना), Collected (एकत्रित).

This word means to burn and give off flames. it is a direct synonym for the act of flaring up and therefore cannot be used as its antonym.
Synonyms: Burned (जला), Blazed (प्रज्वलित), Ignited (सुलगा).
Antonyms: Extinguished (बुझा), Quenched (शांत), Put out (बुझाया).

This word means to shine with a strong or dazzling light. it describes intense light, acting as a synonym for flared rather than an opposite.
Synonyms: Shone (चमकना), Beamed (दमकना), Radiated (प्रकाशमान).
Antonyms: Faded (मिटना), Dimmed (मंद), Darkened (अंधेरा).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: IMPOLITE
questionsEn.s:
IMPOLITE - अशिष्ट (Not having or showing good manners)
Courteous - शिष्ट (Polite, respectful, and considerate)
Superior - श्रेष्ठ (Higher in rank, status, or quality)
Uncivil - असभ्य (Discourteous or impolite)
Blunt - मुँहफट (To be straightforward or direct)
Hence, 'Courteous ' is the most suitable antonym for 'IMPOLITE'.
oa:
This word refers to being polite, respectful, and considerate in manner. It is the direct and most accurate antonym for impolite, which involves a lack of manners.
Synonyms: Polite (शिष्ट), Respectful (नम्र), Civil (सभ्य).
Antonyms: Impolite (अशिष्ट), Rude (असभ्य), Boorish (गंवार).

This word means higher in rank, status, or quality. It describes a position in a hierarchy rather than the quality of social manners or respect shown to others.
Synonyms: Higher (श्रेष्ठ), Better (बेहतर), Senior (वरिष्ठ).
Antonyms: Inferior (निम्न), Lower (नीचा), Subordinate (अधीन).

This word means discourteous or impolite. it is a direct synonym for the given word and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an opposite.
Synonyms: Rude (असभ्य), Boorish (गंवार), Churlish (अशिष्ट).
Antonyms: Civil (सभ्य), Polite (शिष्ट), Courteous (विनम्र).

This word refers to being straightforward or outspoken, sometimes to the point of being rude. It is often a characteristic of being impolite and not its opposite.
Synonyms: Direct (साफ-साफ), Candid (स्पष्टवादी), Forthright (खरा).
Antonyms: Subtle (सूक्ष्म), Tactful (कुशल), Evasive (टालमटोल).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: VANISH
questionsEn.s:
VANISH - गायब होना (To cease to be visible; disappear)
Disappear - ओझल होना (To cease to be visible)
Depart - प्रस्थान करना (To leave or go away from a place)
Conquer - जीतना (To overcome or defeat)
Emerge - प्रकट होना (To come out into view or appear)
Hence, 'Emerge ' is the most suitable antonym for 'VANISH'.
oa:
This word means to cease to be visible or to go out of sight. It is a direct synonym for vanish and therefore cannot be its antonym.
Synonyms: Evaporate (लुप्त होना), Fade (मिटना), Dissolve (विलीन).
Antonyms: Appear (प्रकट होना), Emerge (उभरना), Materialize (साकार होना).

This word means to leave or to go away from a place. while it involves moving out of sight, it refers to a planned exit rather than the opposite of being invisible.
Synonyms: Leave (प्रस्थान), Exit (निकलना), Quit (छोड़ना).
Antonyms: Arrive (पहुँचना), Stay (रुकना), Remain (बने रहना).

This word means to overcome or defeat an enemy or a difficulty. It describes a victory in a struggle and has no relation to the visibility or presence of an object.
Synonyms: Defeat (जीतना), Overcome (परास्त करना), Vanquish (पराजित करना).
Antonyms: Surrender (आत्मसमर्पण), Yield (झुकना), Lose (हारना).

This word means to come out into view, as from concealment or a state of being unknown. It is the direct functional opposite of vanishing (becoming invisible).
Synonyms: Appear (प्रकट होना), Arise (उभरना), Materialize (साकार होना).
Antonyms: Vanish (गायब होना), Disappear (ओझल होना), Fade (मिटना).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: OUTSTANDING
questionsEn.s:
OUTSTANDING - बेमिसाल (Exceptional, excellent, or remarkable)
Astounding - आश्चर्यजनक (Surprising or shocking)
Ordinary - साधारण (Plain, average, or usual)
Remarkable - उल्लेखनीय (Surprising or deserving attention)
Honest - ईमानदार (Truthful or sincere)
Hence, 'Ordinary ' is the most suitable antonym for 'OUTSTANDING'.
oa:
This word means surprisingly impressive or shocking. It is a synonym for outstanding and therefore does not satisfy the requirement for an opposite.
Synonyms: Amazing (आश्चर्यजनक), Stunning (चौंकाने वाला), Incredible (अविश्वसनीय).
Antonyms: Unimpressive (अप्रभावी), Dull (नीरस), Mundane (साधारण).

This word refers to being plain, average, or usual, with no special features. It is the direct and most accurate antonym for outstanding, which implies excellence.
Synonyms: Typical (साधारण), Average (औसत), Common (सामान्य).
Antonyms: Outstanding (बेमिसाल), Exceptional (असाधारण), Unique (अद्वितीय).

This word means unusual and surprising in a way that deserves attention. it is a synonym for the "exceptional" nature of being outstanding.
Synonyms: Noteworthy (उल्लेखनीय), Striking (प्रभावशाली), Signal (विशिष्ट).
Antonyms: Commonplace (मामूली), Unexceptional (साधारण), Routine (नियमित).

This word describes a person who is truthful and sincere. While an outstanding person might be honest, the word refers to moral integrity rather than the high quality of a performance.
Synonyms: Truthful (ईमानदार), Upright (सच्चा), Sincere (निष्कपट).
Antonyms: Deceitful (धोखेबाज), Dishonest (बेईमान), Corrupt (भ्रष्ट).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: SALIENT
questionsEn.s:
SALIENT - मुख्य (Most important or noticeable)
Chief - प्रधान (The most important person or feature)
Remarkable - उल्लेखनीय (Surprising or noticeable)
Insignificant - महत्वहीन (Of little value or importance)
Eminent - प्रतिष्ठित (Famous and important person)
Hence, 'Insignificant ' is the most suitable antonym for 'SALIENT'.
oa:
This word refers to the most important person in an organization or the main feature of something. it is a synonym for salient and cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Primary (प्रधान), Main (मुख्य), Principal (प्रमुख).
Antonyms: Minor (मामूली), Subordinate (अधीन), Secondary (गौण).

This word means unusual or surprising in a way that people notice. it is a synonym for the "noticeable" aspect of salient and does not serve as an antonym.
Synonyms: Notable (उल्लेखनीय), Prominent (स्पष्ट), Extraordinary (असाधारण).
Antonyms: Unremarkable (साधारण), Average (औसत), Common (सामान्य).

This word refers to something of little value or importance. It is the direct conceptual antonym for salient, which means the most important or noticeable part.
Synonyms: Minor (महत्वहीन), Trivial (तुच्छ), Negligible (नगण्य).
Antonyms: Salient (महत्वपूर्ण), Significant (सार्थक), Vital (अनिवार्य).

This word describes a person who is famous and respected within a particular profession. it is a synonym for salient when used for people and not its opposite.
Synonyms: Famous (प्रतिष्ठित), Noted (विख्यात), Illustrious (तेजस्वी).
Antonyms: Obscure (अज्ञात), Unknown (अनाम), Ordinary (साधारण).

questionsEn.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to: AMBITIOUS
questionsEn.s:
AMBITIOUS - महत्वाकांक्षी (Having a strong desire for success)
Vigorous - ऊर्जावान (Highly energetic or strong)
Lazy - आलसी (Unwilling to work or use effort)
Dynamic - गतिशील (Full of energy and ideas)
Lively - जीवंत (Energetic and enthusiastic)
Hence, 'Lazy ' is the most suitable antonym for 'AMBITIOUS'.
oa:
This word describes being full of physical strength or energy. While an ambitious person is often vigorous, the word refers to energy levels rather than the desire for success.
Synonyms: Energetic (ऊर्जावान), Dynamic (शक्तिशाली), Spirited (उत्साही).
Antonyms: Weak (कमज़ोर), Feeble (अशक्त), Lethargic (सुस्त).

This word refers to a person who is unwilling to put in any effort or work. It is the direct behavioral antonym for being ambitious, which involves a drive for success.
Synonyms: Idle (आलसी), Slothful (कामचोर), Indolent (सुस्त).
Antonyms: Ambitious (महत्वाकांक्षी), Industrious (परिश्रमी), Active (सक्रिय).

This word describes being full of energy and new ideas. it is a synonym for the spirited nature of an ambitious person and therefore cannot be its opposite.
Synonyms: Active (गतिशील), Enterprising (उद्यमी), Forceful (प्रभावी).
Antonyms: Static (स्थिर), Passive (निष्क्रिय), Stagnant (अवरुद्ध).

This word means being energetic, enthusiastic, and full of life. it aligns with the positive energy of an ambitious individual and does not represent the required opposite.
